title: Un Veto a la Vida
body:
Publicado en Español, Inglés y Portugués. 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVFUuFeCmhbpynWTTGWjRb4aCBdYrdE5PfuTgYZJYzFkf/1776910216137.png) *Editado en PhotoCollage*


Buenas noches, buen descanso para todos.

Vivir sin opciones agota la mente y el cuerpo. Nos resignamos porque no hay alternativas a la mano. Simplemente morimos en vida.

La resignación de quien no tiene salidas no es un acto de rendición, se convierte en un proceso de erosión lenta. Empieza cuando la persona agota su repertorio de intentos porque ya buscó trabajo, estudió, se endeudó, pidió favores, se mudó, aceptó humillaciones, recortó gastos hasta lo insoportable. Y aún así, nada cambió. O lo mas seguro es que cambió para peor.

El sistema no necesita amenazar directamente. Basta con que cualquier alternativa viable exija recursos que esa persona no tiene como el  tiempo, pues trabaja 10 horas diarias por un sueldo de hambre, el dinero porque el curso que le daría un mejor puesto cuesta dos meses de alquiler, asi pasa con los contactos que no tiene ya que nació en un barrio donde el capital social es casi nulo o salud mental porque vivir al límite crónico quema la capacidad de proyectar futuro.

Solo quienes tienen cierto margen de error pueden permitirse soñar con cambios radicales. El pobre de verdad no puede arriesgar el empleo miserable que tiene porque ese riesgo significa quedarse sin comer. Tampoco puede mudarse a otra ciudad sin red de apoyo porque el primer mes sin ingresos lo deja en la calle. La famosa \

que tanto alaban los gurús del autoayuda es, en la práctica, un manual de cómo soportar lo insoportable sin volverse loco.\n\nLlega un punto en que la persona deja de compararse con quienes tienen más. Compararse duele y mucho. Entonces compara su hoy con su ayer y se dice \

. Esa es la trampa más cruel, el sistema logra que agradezcas migajas, mientras la desigualdad real se profundiza. La resignación se viste de gratitud.

La resignación no es solo psicológica. Se instala en el cuerpo, se somatiza y comienzan las contracturas crónicas, el insomnio, las digestiones pesadas y esa fatiga que no se va ni después de dormir. El cuerpo aprende que luchar contra el muro es inútil, entonces deja de enviar señales de alerta. Entonces viene  la apatía que no es falta de carácter, es un ahorro energético forzado. El sistema te entrena para no sentir la jaula, porque sentirla duele demasiado.

Cuando ya no puedes invitar a nadie a tu casa y además  evitas quedar con amigos porque no tienes ni siquiera para el transporte y las conversaciones giran en torno a lo que otros compran o viajan y tú solo puedes hablar de cómo estirar la comida, terminas alejándote. Es irremediable y no lo haces por orgullo, sino por vergüenza y cansancio. Y sin red, la resignación se vuelve definitiva. El sistema te fragmenta para que no te organices.


Lo peor no es la pobreza material, sino escuchar una y otra vez que \

. Ese discurso mal concebido y lacerante convierte la opresión en culpa personal. La persona resignada termina creyendo que es inherentemente defectuosa. Y cuando al fin crees que el problema eres tú, dejas de buscar soluciones afuera. El sistema te convence de que la jaula la construiste tú mismo.

Quedarse como uno está no es paz. Es un duelo perpetuo por la vida que nunca se podrá tener. Es la letanía y el cuento de nunca acabar de que si Es miras los zapatos rotos debes calcular cuántos meses más aguantarán. Es saber que la enfermedad llegará y no habrá tratamiento y lo mas triste es aceptar que tus hijos heredarán lo mismo. Es tan cruel porque debes sonreír en el trabajo, dar las gracias, no quejarte. Porque quejarte es un lujo que no te puedes permitir, podrías perder lo poco que tienes.

La verdadera violencia del sistema no es solo la miseria. Es fabricar millones de personas que han dejado de esperar.

---
---


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPioZKWPc3STML2a1iV8y8o3y7Ayv6wXZdNk6AeXJaENj/1758503903035.jpg)


---
---

# *ENGLISH*

---
---

Good evening, have a good rest, everyone.

Living without options exhausts the mind and body. We resign ourselves because there are no alternatives at hand. We simply die while alive.

The resignation of someone with no way out is not an act of surrender; it becomes a process of slow erosion. It starts when a person exhausts their repertoire of attempts – because they've already looked for work, studied, gone into debt, asked for favors, moved, accepted humiliations, cut expenses to the unbearable. And still, nothing changed. Or more likely, it changed for the worse.

The system doesn't need to threaten directly. It's enough that any viable alternative requires resources that the person doesn't have – like time, because they work 10 hours a day for a starvation wage; money, because the course that would get them a better job costs two months' rent; connections they don't have, since they were born in a neighborhood where social capital is almost nonexistent; or mental health, because living on the edge chronically burns out the ability to plan for the future.

Only those with a certain margin for error can afford to dream of radical changes. The truly poor cannot risk their miserable job, because that risk means going hungry. They can't move to another city without a support network, because the first month with no income leaves them homeless. The famous \

that self-help gurus praise so highly is, in practice, a manual on how to endure the unbearable without going crazy.\n\nThere comes a point where the person stops comparing themselves to those who have more. Comparing hurts too much. So they compare their today with their yesterday and tell themselves, \

That is the cruelest trap: the system gets you to be grateful for crumbs while real inequality deepens. Resignation dresses itself as gratitude.

Resignation is not only psychological. It settles in the body, becomes somatized, and chronic muscle tension, insomnia, heavy digestion, and that fatigue that doesn't go away even after sleeping begin. The body learns that fighting the wall is useless, so it stops sending warning signals. Then comes apathy – which is not a lack of character, but forced energy saving. The system trains you not to feel the cage, because feeling it hurts too much.

When you can no longer invite anyone to your house, and you also avoid meeting up with friends because you don't even have money for transportation, and conversations revolve around what others buy or travel to, while you can only talk about how to stretch the food, you end up distancing yourself. It's unavoidable, and you don't do it out of pride, but out of shame and exhaustion. And without a network, resignation becomes final. The system fragments you so that you don't organize.

The worst thing is not material poverty, but hearing over and over that \

That ill-conceived, lacerating discourse turns oppression into personal guilt. The resigned person ends up believing they are inherently flawed. And when you finally believe the problem is you, you stop looking for solutions outside. The system convinces you that you built the cage yourself.

Staying as you are is not peace. It is a perpetual mourning for the life you will never have. It is the litany and the never-ending story of looking at your worn-out shoes and calculating how many more months they will last. It is knowing that illness will come and there will be no treatment, and the saddest part is accepting that your children will inherit the same. It is so cruel because you must smile at work, say thank you, not complain. Because complaining is a luxury you cannot afford – you might lose the little you have.

The true violence of the system is not just poverty. It is manufacturing millions of people who have stopped hoping.

---
---


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPioZKWPc3STML2a1iV8y8o3y7Ayv6wXZdNk6AeXJaENj/1758503903035.jpg)


---
---

# *PORTUGUÉS*

---
---

Boa noite, bom descanso para todos.

Viver sem opções esgota a mente e o corpo. Resignamo-nos porque não há alternativas à mão. Simplesmente morremos em vida.

A resignação de quem não tem saída não é um ato de rendição; torna-se um processo de erosão lenta. Começa quando a pessoa esgota seu repertório de tentativas – porque já procurou trabalho, estudou, endividou-se, pediu favores, mudou-se, aceitou humilhações, cortou gastos até o insuportável. E mesmo assim, nada mudou. Ou o mais provável é que mudou para pior.

O sistema não precisa ameaçar diretamente. Basta que qualquer alternativa viável exija recursos que a pessoa não tem – como tempo, pois ela trabalha 10 horas por dia por um salário de fome; dinheiro, porque o curso que lhe daria um melhor emprego custa dois meses de aluguel; contatos que ela não tem, já que nasceu num bairro onde o capital social é quase nulo; ou saúde mental, porque viver no limite crônico queima a capacidade de projetar o futuro.

Só quem tem certa margem de erro pode se dar ao luxo de sonhar com mudanças radicais. O pobre de verdade não pode arriscar o emprego miserável que tem, porque esse risco significa ficar sem comer. Também não pode mudar para outra cidade sem rede de apoio, pois o primeiro mês sem renda o deixa na rua. A famosa \

que os gurus da autoajuda tanto elogiam é, na prática, um manual de como suportar o insuportável sem enlouquecer.\n\nChega um ponto em que a pessoa para de se comparar com quem tem mais. Comparar dói demais. Então ela compara seu hoje com seu ontem e diz: \

Essa é a armadilha mais cruel: o sistema faz com que você agradeça migalhas, enquanto a desigualdade real se aprofunda. A resignação se veste de gratidão.

A resignação não é apenas psicológica. Instala-se no corpo, é somatizada, e começam as contraturas crônicas, a insônia, as digestões pesadas e aquela fadiga que não vai embora nem depois de dormir. O corpo aprende que lutar contra o muro é inútil, então deixa de enviar sinais de alerta. Aí vem a apatia – que não é falta de caráter, mas uma economia forçada de energia. O sistema te treina para não sentir a gaiola, porque senti-la dói demais.

Quando você não pode mais convidar ninguém para sua casa, e também evita encontrar amigos porque não tem nem para o transporte, e as conversas giram em torno do que os outros compram ou viajam, enquanto você só pode falar sobre como estender a comida, você acaba se afastando. É inevitável, e você não faz por orgulho, mas por vergonha e cansaço. E sem rede, a resignação se torna definitiva. O sistema te fragmenta para que você não se organize.

O pior não é a pobreza material, mas ouvir repetidas vezes que \

. Esse discurso mal concebido e cortante transforma a opressão em culpa pessoal. A pessoa resignada acaba acreditando que é intrinsecamente defeituosa. E quando você finalmente acredita que o problema é você, para de buscar soluções lá fora. O sistema te convence de que você mesmo construiu a gaiola.

Ficar como se está não é paz. É um luto perpétuo pela vida que nunca se poderá ter. É a ladainha e o conto sem fim de olhar para os sapatos gastos e calcular quantos meses mais eles vão durar. É saber que a doença virá e não haverá tratamento, e o mais triste é aceitar que seus filhos herdarão o mesmo. É tão cruel porque você precisa sorrir no trabalho, agradecer, não reclamar. Porque reclamar é um luxo que você não pode pagar – você pode perder o pouco que tem.

A verdadeira violência do sistema não é apenas a miséria. É fabricar milhões de pessoas que pararam de esperar.

title: Glimpse into One of the World’s Oldest Civilizations
body:
> Assalamu Alaikum, I hope everyone is well and enjoying their lives. Today was a special day for me because my elder brother told me we had to visit the Harappa Museum. The Harappa Museum is located about five to six kilometers from us, and it is from a five-thousand-year-old civilization. During this time, this city was very stable and permanent, but due to sudden disasters, this city was destroyed and became ruins. But after 1921, it was rebuilt again, and during the reconstruction, many objects were recovered from here, which can be used to estimate this civilization. Therefore, we have reached there to visit this civilization.
https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQma723s5CRcHSM9nyLcTAF9dtUas66ZiaUKntQ13kpFnmb/image.png
The Harappa Museum area is an open and vast area that is spread over a distance of about seven to eight kilometers, but a museum has been built inside it where various objects are kept. First of all, I came across these two things, which were made by hand, but they represented the same thing as how the people of that time worked. Here to represent the culture, they have made some sculptures which are in excellent condition, and they are seen working. On one side, the man is husking wheat, and on the other side, thread is being made from cotton. https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmXrQq9GcdrVRdCjwntnSGZQYXbRndXtTG8PYt3pjEkhiv/image.png | https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmeQzuEWfhZWoBPLhkm6LYJsP68uxf1gRzLDKNuMsXcTaL/image.png - | - Many objects have been recovered from there during the excavation because this city was destroyed by sudden disasters. When the excavation was done, statues also appeared here, which suggests that the people of that era were also the same height as us. In it, one statue is of a man, and the other is of a woman, which are shown separately, and along with them, there are also vessels placed under them, which were recovered during the excavation. These are the vessels that they used for eating and drinking, so this suggests that the people of that era were very advanced and very well-mannered. https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQme9cX1EKK2kbEu2bK8kbueGezUYEuWv5YM62QLc43umFm/image.png | https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmaY8gZJnvzihSby5zZ2PzTkJHZJcYVR1B53q5LJBb3ahX/image.png - | - During the excavation of Harappa, thousands of objects have been unearthed that have come from under the ground. All these objects include things that represent their daily life. Their weapons have also been seen in this excavation. This shows that they were warriors and were also protectors of themselves. Furthermore, the utensils there, the things used during this time, how they used to build their houses, and with what things they used to build them, all these objects are present in the interior of this museum, which gives an idea of their civilization, and their civilization was very advanced. https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmQXzAW4Wjw4TEKE4f28zq69Xjk4TXMq7ZKuPaMen3WC32/image.png | https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmVDszwetLnDRQBxXmpe1fwXvGtJL4ak1oxrv4pjm8MTU1/image.png - | - https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmVfqw2oTRsT8kxMJ6TjV1cBfY3WpdCfNGkeLPze7tCYXr/image.png | https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmNYqiBDT9uFNYTdg4vcJEcRRMrSbMUmaZdPzbmy5saFSE/image.png The Harappa Museum has an open and spacious area, just like all these things have been stored in the museum of Harappa in a box. After that, when I went to explore it further, after traveling for some time, I reached a place where a water well and a small city are visible. This is the place from where the people of that era used to fill their water. If the canals are blocked, then they were also made of bricks. Bricks were used, so it shows that they were very advanced, and they had an understanding of everything. They were also their own protectors. They had put in a lot of effort to improve all their things, and they had also discovered a water well through which the people of the city used to benefit from this place. A small trench has been seen here, which is known as a rampart, and this also suggests that they were warriors and had the strength to fight with others who were their protectors with all their might. So these are the objects of this area that were discovered during the excavation. I discovered them recently. https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmRKthAK3LYtmzuN4tcaw9rp4XsPXf8haH7QvLxWKmimSL/image.png | https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmSyrMLNyP3yY1w2TpVDJ7vWHUznB8QRSnRHHD5KhEoTab/image.png - | - As soon as I discovered this area and moved forward, I saw a shrine there. This shrine has a special feature because the shrine here belongs to Hazrat Baba Noor Shah Waliullah, and his grave is nine yards long, which is about 20 times larger than an ordinary person's. Hazrat Baba Naushah Waliullah was a famous personality of that era, and he was also a warrior. If you look at his history, it also shows that he had also reached here while fighting a war and was martyred here. Then his court was also built here. This is one of his relics that was found during the excavation of the Harappa museum, and its size is nine yards. https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmUTrgKcUzr5kQeTXG4fEL7yncXeWGBiJ2jZXitbMmpVU7/image.png | https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmRJNXRE2fGjcFstpWKiiHkdKhyqFAqXmhnmmXYEy1fLLi/image.png - | - A river flowed near this city, and it may have been engulfed by the river, or a punishment from Allah Almighty came upon them, which destroyed them. Now, here you can see high and big mountains which have been built by turning over the land of people's houses. This is the place where people's houses were destroyed, and everything was buried, which is why there are big mounds. It feels like there is a mountain here, and people come here and climb on top of it and enjoy it. I also climbed on top of many mountains and took some photographs. https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmZWSvmLK1WyJS9iPj4nFaD22ysXMETpWJvs4X7UYYvYqV/image.png | https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmTg7zkHooB22EDhkykZdFQtkJVLdVHtZPhHGQcGxHKKmv/image.png - | - One of the most beautiful things is that I also saw an old mosque there, from which it can be inferred that the people of that era were Muslims. And from the things kept inside the museum, it can also be inferred that the people there were also Hindus. So here, all the people lived together, including Muslims, Hindus, and Christians. So this water mosque also represents the Muslims. Around this mosque, you can also see high and large mountains, on which paths have been made to go up. We climbed up and visited the entire area. https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmaUTNS753aJLikfoMVDhuHPCMohn2cBiizpSuxHfHKsrG/image.png | https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcxzfG8fYyjAj8rkErSWCndgZBfqDfrx7Tbm3neW4pMuV/image.png - | - Nowadays, this place has been made very beautiful. There are excellent paths for walking inside it, and chairs are placed at various places to sit, so that everyone who comes here can visit the entire area, because it is a distance of two to three kilometers that we have to cover. And there are points for breathing along the way so that people can enjoy it well and avoid any kind of trouble. The best thing I have seen in the Harappa Museum is the electric bus here, which allows you to visit the entire area, but some people avoid walking or are elderly, so they can visit the entire area by sitting on this vehicle. https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmZppkDMKXQhrA4RsajAorgzSG5KxybZbvc9TfDJZJHxSy/image.png | https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmY66jpyC1j6K15Zn55MQ6JcfFPDsnVSDpirG3532uvgSG/image.png - | - After visiting all this, we returned and saw two bulls, one with two horns and the other with one horn. This bull is a symbol of that era because during that time, such oaths of allegiance were made. The one-horned bull is very famous, so this also represents a five-thousand-year-old civilization. The structure of the museum has already been made very good. There is a clean and tidy environment everywhere. Flowers are planted everywhere. Paths have been made, and chairs have been placed for sitting. A restaurant has been built, and a guest hall has also been built inside so that people can visit it from far and wide. Many people from out of the country also come here and discover this movement. https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmR9w49GGvmmynTWnyiTTsZwVZNofp5nqwVwAdnc6BtK9N/image.png | https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmWgWC7q4iYGDUnn4X3DdVaqMh991zwFkMzbU4ks3NhFQ7/image.png - | - This is how I discovered the Harappa Museum today. I hope you all enjoyed it too. Thank you all for stopping by. I hope you enjoy the good content. Until then, I ask for your permission. May Allah protect you. **Thank You**

title: Helping a family through game play
body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1776910276539-1590a28128ee639c.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=angelmitu/17249ef0)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=angelmitu/17249ef0)


---

I'm starting today by saying good morning to everyone.After waking up and finishing my homework, I sat down to play a game.My daughter taught me this game.

This is a game where you help a family by playing.The name of the game is Rescue story.My daughter loves playing these kinds of games.Like helping the family and makeup games.I played this game for the first time today.However it's very funny.

This is a very interesting game.I think children will learn a lot by playing this game.Why should children learn from this because it is a game to help a whole family.A family is in complete distress and they need to be rescued.

The mindset to rescue them is created at the beginning of playing this game.Here it is clear that a mother has a child in her arms and they are in extreme distress.

They are in lack of food, lack of clothing and lack of furniture.They are in lack of fire and they are in extreme cold.Then they need to be taken out of this situation.How to get them out of this situation?

Step by step I have to complete some tasks and collect coins.For example I have to match different vegetables and one after another there will be opportunities to buy furniture or clothes.They are suffering in the winter, so the first thing to do is rescue the baby from the cold.

But I have completed all the tasks step by step which you will see in today's gaming video.I have bought everything for the whole family by playing this game.Finally the woman is very happy in their room with her child.He thanked me a lot at the end.

The most important thing is that I will keep this game going because it is played a lot by children.And they develop the mindset of helping people through this game.

Thumbnail image from my gameplay

Thank you.

@Angelmitu

The mindset to rescue them is created at the beginning of playing this game.Here it is clear that a mother has a child in her arms and they are in extreme distress.

They are in lack of food, lack of clothing and lack of furniture.They are in lack of fire and they are in extreme cold.Then they need to be taken out of this situation.How to get them out of this situation?

Step by step I have to complete some tasks and collect coins.For example I have to match different vegetables and one after another there will be opportunities to buy furniture or clothes.They are suffering in the winter, so the first thing to do is rescue the baby from the cold.

But I have completed all the tasks step by step which you will see in today's gaming video.I have bought everything for the whole family by playing this game.Finally the woman is very happy in their room with her child.He thanked me a lot at the end.

The most important thing is that I will keep this game going because it is played a lot by children.And they develop the mindset of helping people through this game.

Thumbnail image from my gameplay

Thank you.

title: 跟着综艺云旅游
body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![XR9nCH30AMOAyuo2_IMG_20260420_155528.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/neithya/images/XR9nCH30AMOAyuo2_IMG_20260420_155528/XR9nCH30AMOAyuo2_IMG_20260420_155528.webp)
![NAD7NOvqgoYUsJUN_IMG_20260420_162037.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/neithya/images/NAD7NOvqgoYUsJUN_IMG_20260420_162037/NAD7NOvqgoYUsJUN_IMG_20260420_162037.webp)
![yJCyAcz8wfKPdeIN_IMG_20260420_160024.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/neithya/images/yJCyAcz8wfKPdeIN_IMG_20260420_160024/yJCyAcz8wfKPdeIN_IMG_20260420_160024.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

哈哈哈今天晚上还蛮尴尬，在车里也没风啥的，左眼睛突然不舒服，拿纸巾揉了揉，眼泪就出来了，结果周围人都看我，以为我咋了（心里有些淡淡滴社死……

好了好了，和大家分享下这几天追的综艺。属于在哈萨克斯坦边采风边在地竞演的真人秀，而哈萨克斯坦不仅是古丝绸之路的沿线国家，且2013年习大大在哈的大学演讲时，就提出了一带一路的倡议，中哈关系自古以来都很友好呢!

跟着歌手们云采风，眼睛享受到了，比如卡因迪湖那些水中倒立的云杉树；阿克套的峡谷、沙漠、里海，还是亿万年前的海底遗址，走着可能会捡到化石……

当地的乐器也很奇妙，库布孜奏出动物的声音，像是复制粘贴的，而共鸣箱像个可爱的小勺子；还有斯布孜额，外观有些像咱们国内的笛子或萧，没想到吹奏时，是把乐器放到牙齿那里！

等看到咱们中国人在那帮建轻轨，且是以‘中国标准’，心里的自豪感噌的一下冒出来了!也有一些中国人去那创业种植呢，都好厉害!

图片是荡了个秋千😂，我也想去玩 还没去过国外嘞，emmm国内也没去过多少景点，心疼自己了😂

**感谢阅读！祝你生活明媚，阖家安康！**

---

title: Gen V (Season 2) - Series Review [ES - EN]
body:
>



Sé que voy bastante atrasado al realizar una reseña sobre la segunda temporada de \
, pero no me sentía con la motivación suficiente para ver nuevos episodios de esta historia de jóvenes \\\
, pero con el estreno de la última temporada de \

, pensé que era necesario ver los ocho episodios que la conforman porque posiblemente esta parte de la historia tendría cierta influencia en el final de la serie, la cual les dio origen.
> I know I’m pretty late to the party with this review of the second season of “Gen V,” but I just couldn’t bring myself to watch new episodes of this story about young “Supes,” but with the premiere of the final season of \

I thought it was necessary to watch all eight episodes because this part of the story might have some influence on the series finale, which is where it all began.
![BEE FUTBOL_20260422_215135_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nameless16/EoK3ySEtAB64KnuuD1vBzVzaZks4XaRbz7GP3fG5GbzgbNFQmk2y3SE8i46Lf5B5uEv.png)
[Fuente / Source](https://butwhytho.net/2025/10/gen-v-season-2-episode-8-recap/)

La primera temporada de \

me pareció bastante entretenida y me agradó porque fue un buen complemento para la serie original; su estreno funcionó muy bien porque contó con un punto alto de la popularidad de The Boys y los fans siguieron enganchados, pero lamentablemente lo sucedido por la huelga de guionistas y la lamentable noticia del fallecimiento de uno de sus protagonistas pausaron por gran tiempo el desarrollo de su segunda temporada, la cual, al momento de ser estrenada, creo que no obtuvo el impacto necesario a pesar de la crítica positiva que obtuvo.
> I found the first season of \

quite entertaining, and I liked it because it was a great complement to the original series; its premiere went very well because it rode the wave of The Boys’ peak popularity and kept fans hooked, but unfortunately, the writers’ strike and the tragic news of the death of one of its lead actors put the development of its second season on hold for a long time. When it finally premiered, I don’t think it had the necessary impact, despite the positive reviews it received.
![BEE FUTBOL_20260422_215135_0001.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nameless16/Ep7sgU6sLEYBK99S2J72sQYXma1zdFfx8XijfaCbYhduC6fACSaMuENYBXqJC9URdVV.png)
[Fuente / Source](https://screenrant.com/gen-v-sister-sage-homelander-betrayal-the-boys-season-5/)

En esta segunda parte se nota que el desarrollo de la historia se vio afectado por el fallecimiento de _**Chance Perdomo**_ lo cual hizo que los guionistas decidieran que su personaje \

también falleciera en la serie, lo cual funcionó en muchos ámbitos de la historia como motivo de los demás personajes para hacer frente a una inesperada y fuerte amenaza; esto me pareció que fue algo acertado por todos en la serie porque fue un necesario y merecido homenaje hacia el actor y proveyó un necesario grado de drama en la historia que de igual manera también tuvo tiempo para explorar temas como romance, decepción, acción y, por supuesto, la comedia típica en esta serie.
> In this second part, it’s clear that the story’s development was affected by the passing of _**Chance Perdomo**_, which led the writers to decide that his character, “Andre Anderson,” would also die in the series. This worked well in many aspects of the story, serving as a catalyst for the other characters to confront an unexpected and formidable threat; I felt this was the right decision for everyone involved in the series because it served as a necessary and well-deserved tribute to the actor and provided a much-needed dose of drama to the story, which also still had time to explore themes such as romance, disappointment, action, and, of course, the comedy typical of this series.
![BEE FUTBOL_20260422_215135_0002.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nameless16/Eo44QMzbu7P2imFa2WeKkKMgJNCbdJt1JPuX1xuEBtBAWAztcHhqvxrd9P9dyRwMg6P.png)
[Fuente / Source](https://www.cnet.com/tech/services-and-software/when-to-watch-the-gen-v-season-2-finale/)

Con respecto al antagonista a enfrentar, la decisión de contar con _**Hamish Linklater**_ como \

fue lo mejor de la temporada; creo que este actor tiene el rango para usar el sarcasmo como un arma para generar miedo, tensión y, por supuesto, odio. El personaje de Cipher rebosa una actitud de superioridad sobre los demás y la inclusión de este personaje para tomar las riendas de la universidad de Supes fue necesaria porque en esta temporada era obligatorio tener un mejor villano a enfrentar. Sobre la influencia actoral de los ya conocidos protagonistas, el trabajo fue más que adecuado; creo que en esta ocasión existió la necesidad de cerrar arcos argumentales de cada uno de estos personajes y, sorpresivamente, funcionó para la mayoría de ellos, aunque creo que en la temporada anterior, el desarrollo de sus traumas y el uso de sus poderes fue algo que me pareció genial y que en esta oportunidad queda relegado para relatar algo más genérico y rápido de digerir. Esto es lo que creo que es la gran diferencia entre temporadas y, posiblemente, mi crítica negativa.
> As for the antagonist we’re up against, the decision to cast _**Hamish Linklater**_ as “Dean Cipher” was the best move of the season; I think this actor has the range to use sarcasm as a weapon to instill fear, tension, and, of course, hatred. Cipher’s character exudes an air of superiority over others, and bringing him in to take the reins of Supes University was necessary because this season absolutely required a better villain to face off against. As for the acting performances of the familiar main characters, the work was more than adequate; I think this time there was a need to wrap up the story arcs for each of these characters, and surprisingly, it worked for most of them, though I feel that in the previous season, the development of their traumas and the use of their powers was something I thought was great, and this time it’s been sidelined to tell a more generic and easily digestible story. This is what I believe is the major difference between the seasons and, possibly, the basis for my negative critique.
![BEE FUTBOL_20260422_215135_0003.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nameless16/Eoe8bYHyFuhYCntt3RLtLY9sWxxjmJPk4i9W8hkt3bHH5VXBAL1WsRPL5vV99sugPj4.png)
[Fuente / Source](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-features/gen-v-season-2-finale-the-boys-season-5-eric-kripke-interview-1236407027/)

En sí, creo que la segunda temporada de **\

** no fue tan buena como la anterior, aunque si algo entretenida; creo que contar con ocho episodios fue algo excesivo porque posiblemente con menos se pudo relatar de igual manera la historia en esta segunda temporada y mientras veía el final de temporada no dejaba de pensar que su realización fue más que una obligación que una necesidad y eso lo digo porque en mi opinión y sin hacer visto ninguno de los episodios estrenados de la temporada final de The Boys, creo que estos personajes tendrán una poca influencia en esa serie y lo que han enseñado en lo que considero fue su temporada final, posiblemente sea usado como un punto de partida para algún otro spin-off a estrenar y es que por si no lo saben, están en desarrollo otras dos series que son parte de este universo de héroes corrompidos, una de esas producciones es una precuela enfocado en el comportamiento de la compañía Vought y el origen de sus creaciones y otra es una serie a desarrollarse en México; ambas historias usarán a la compañía como la gran enemiga de la humanidad y en dónde tanto humanos como Supes deberán enfrentar. Personalmente, creo que fue una equivocación ver esta serie antes de comenzar con el final de The Boys la cual ya tenía bajas expectativas y ahora, créanme, que son mucho más bajas.
> Personally, I don't think the second season of **\

** was as good as the first, though it was somewhat entertaining; I think having eight episodes was a bit excessive because the story could likely have been told just as well with fewer episodes in this second season, and while I was watching the season finale, I couldn’t help but think that making it was more of an obligation than a necessity. I say this because, in my opinion—and without having seen any of the episodes released from the final season of *The Boys*— I believe these characters will have little influence on that series, and what they’ve shown in what I consider to be its final season will likely be used as a starting point for some other upcoming spin-off. And just in case you didn’t know, two other series are in development that are part of this universe of corrupt heroes: one of these productions is a prequel focused on the behavior of the Vought Corporation and the origin of its creations, and the other is a series set in Mexico; both stories will feature the corporation as humanity’s greatest enemy, which both humans and Supes will have to face. Personally, I think it was a mistake to watch this series before starting the finale of The Boys, which I already had low expectations for—and now, believe me, they’re even lower.

title: Ismunandar, investido oficialmente como Secretario Regional de Bireuen, se perfila como el eje de la comunicación gubernamental.
body:
![MEITU_20260423_085347514.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcNbFG6vU5haLixa2Bu8hsXe6Zpxf75exZt1KcA6bfsLj/MEITU_20260423_085347514.jpg)

Ismunandar, investido oficialmente como Secretario Regional de Bireuen, se perfila como el eje de la comunicación gubernamental.

El Regente de Bireuen, Mukhlis, ST, inauguró oficialmente y tomó juramento a Ismunandar, ST, MT, como Secretario Regional (Sekda) definitivo de la Regencia de Bireuen. La solemne ceremonia tuvo lugar el lunes 20 de abril de 2026 en la Secretaría de la Regencia de Bireuen.

Esta investidura marcó un nuevo capítulo en la estructura burocrática de la Regencia de Bireuen, tras un proceso de selección abierto y competitivo.

En su discurso, el Regente afirmó que el nombramiento de Ismunandar se ajustaba a la legislación vigente, haciendo referencia a:

• Ley N.º 20 de 2023 sobre el Aparato Civil del Estado.

• Reglamento Gubernamental N.º 17 de 2020 sobre la Gestión de los Funcionarios Públicos.

• Decreto del Gobernador de Aceh n.° PEG.821.22/051/2026, que recibió una recomendación de la Agencia Estatal de la Función Pública (BKN).

\

, afirmó.

El Gobierno de la Regencia de Bireuen también expresó su más sincero agradecimiento al Sr. Hanafiah, SP., CGCAE., FRMP, quien se desempeñó como Secretario Regional Interino durante los últimos 16 meses. Su dedicación a mantener la estabilidad del gobierno y supervisar los programas de desarrollo durante el período de transición es considerada crucial por la ciudadanía, concluyó.

Presente en representación del Secretario Regional de Aceh, el Asistente de Administración General (Asistente 3) del Secretario Regional de Aceh, Dr. A. Murtala, M.Si, brindó instrucciones específicas. Hizo hincapié en que, según el Reglamento del Regente de Bireuen n.º 65 de 2023,

«El Secretario Regional es el funcionario de carrera de mayor rango que debe ser capaz de traducir la visión y la misión del jefe regional en programas concretos. Además, como Presidente del Equipo de Presupuesto del Gobierno Regional (TAPD), el Secretario Regional es responsable de garantizar que el Presupuesto Regional (APBD) se ajuste a los objetivos y beneficie a la población», declaró el Dr. A. Murtala.

Ismunandar recordó que el cargo de Secretario Regional no es simplemente un puesto administrativo tras un escritorio, sino el «corazón de la comunicación gubernamental».

Las principales tareas destacadas para el nuevo Secretario Regional incluyen:

• Implementación de los Valores Fundamentales: Implementar el valor de la ASN «BerAKHLAK» (Orientación al Servicio, Responsabilidad, Competencia, Armonía, Lealtad, Adaptabilidad y Colaboración).

• Sinergia Intersectorial: Forjar una conexión fluida con la Legislatura, Forkopimda y todas las partes interesadas como una gran familia.

• Innovación regional: Generar avances que impacten directamente en el progreso de la regencia de Bireuen.

«Los retos que tenemos por delante no son fáciles. No hay éxito individual; lo que importa es el trabajo en equipo. Invito a todos los funcionarios regionales a brindar su pleno apoyo al recién nombrado Secretario Regional», concluyó.

body: 來到潮汕遊的最後一篇，就是跑步了。 自從3月在曼谷跑過步後，我發掘了在異地跑步的興趣，故此我分別在潮州和汕頭都跑了一次，為此我更是調整了跑步的日子，好讓我能夠在兩地都能跑。而當你決定了在旅行時跑步，在某個不熟識的城市跑步，你要考慮的事情就比較多了。 首先自然是跑步路線，因為在異地跑步肯定是要街跑的，如果在酒店跑步機跑就沒什麼意思了，而且也不是每間酒店都有跑步機，而這跑步路線我也希望來點意思，希望能跑到當地一些特別地方，例如潮州我就圍繞了古城跑了一圈，汕頭我就在海岸公園跑。當然隨便滿大街跑也可以，但一來馬路肯定多，二來你不熟識路，三來你更不知道那些路合不合適跑步。 有了跑步路線，我就會先在地圖看看街景，了解一下那一條路是否真的適合跑步，同時認一下路，因為跑步時不方便經常拿起手機看地圖，所以要先認一下路標，再之後就是住的地方了，除了要配合景點遊覽外，也要配合跑步路線，我相信也沒有人喜歡坐車去跑步地點吧。當到了當地，有時間的話也可以去踩踩線，看看跑步的路線，做好準備。 我跑步時間是很早的，基本都是6點起床，梳洗出發大約6點半，盡可能酒店門口就開始跑，不要浪費時間，也可以快點跑完，避免路上人越來越多。

/> 在潮州，我選擇了繞古城跑一圈。所謂古城其實只是歷史上的古城，現在的城牆其實就只剩下一面，我先從牌坊街出發向南跑到南城門，沿路基本上人都沒有，就只有往店舖送貨的車和司機，因為再晚一點車子就不讓進了。到南城門後我就開始順時針的跑，一路上基本就是城市跑，幸好沒什麼彎要轉所以沒有跑錯路。慢慢往北跑轉入西湖邊，再往東跑到韓江，這裡我看到了真正古城的居民區，建築還是偏民國時期的，街上開始有老人走動，給我一種不一樣的感覺。 轉入韓江後往南跑，前一天排隊走廣濟橋的人龍都沒有了，江邊有不少人在釣魚，但可惜看不到其他人跑步。最後我繞回南門進入牌坊街，這時人開始多了，開始有路邊攤在攞賣，幸好我跑得早，否則這段路不易跑。到跑回客棧時有點意猶未盡，所以繼續往北跑到鎮海樓再繞去西馬路再跑到開元寺才停下來，一共9.47KM，爽死。

/> 汕頭的路線就簡單多了，因為主要就是一條大直線，但中途的意外卻比潮州多。首先我的路線是從小公園出發一條直路跑去西堤公園，但因為地圖沒有這一段的街景，我只好自己亂跑，結果我找不到進入西堤公園的入口，只有在公園外跑，終於我找到入口了，卻發現公園裡的海濱路跟海岸公園的海濱路是不連接的，結果又要跑出公園再轉入海岸公園。 之後的一段大直路就比較簡單，路上見到有不少朋友都在跑步，但他們都是馬路邊跑，我就感覺有點奇怪，那麼一個美好江邊為什麼不跑，要跑到馬路邊？後來我就懂了，這江邊太多凹凹凸凸了，一點都不直，所以後來我都跑到了馬路邊，反正這麼早都沒什麼車。 跑之前我已計算過距離，我是需要到達石炮台公園再往回跑，也在街景圖認過公園的模樣，但其實公園都是差不多樣子的，所以我最後還是偶然就拿手機出來看地圖。往回跑也是一條大直線，回到小公園後，我特意跑過幾個景點，這時的小公園人影都沒有一個，前一天人山人海的景點，現在都沒有人了，例如那汕頭旅社、例如那中山紀念亭。

/>

在異城跑步是有趣的，在設計路線的過程中對這城市的認識會更深，而且跑步過程中親眼遊覽的地方會更多，就例如潮州古城繞一圈，我相信正常人就算想過都不會去做吧，繞一圈要8公里耶，但跑步的話就能實現了，一個小時的跑步，讓我親身體驗這個城市的不同地方更多。

如無意外，我5月尾或6月中會去廈門，到時我應該會繞鼓浪嶼跑一圈，這又將會是一段有趣的準備了。

title: Piernas Calientes [Esp/Eng]
body:
>

Piernas Calientes. Continuamos activando el tren inferior, con una rutina demasiado explosiva, candente, divertida y diferente. Tu tren inferior va a explotar de beneficios, porque además de desarrollar y fortalecer las piernas; el núcleo en su totalidad se verá beneficiado para que el cuerpo tenga mayor estabilidad, equilibrio y buena salud. Hace un tiempo me he dedicado a brindarle este tipo de sesiones orientadas a las piernas; ya que es una zona corporal que muy pocos entrenan, tal vez porque consideran tediosas estas acciones, o porque desconocen la importancia de mantener el tren inferior en buenas condiciones. Piernas fuertes pueden sostener nuestro cuerpo; y aunado al fortalecimiento del núcleo, alejamos en gran medida la ocurrencia de lesiones. Así que amigos míos, no se pierdan esta rutina, salgan del sedentarismo e inicien un cambio positivo en sus vidas. >Hot Legs. We’re continuing to activate the lower body with a routine that’s explosive, intense, fun, and unique. Your lower body is going to reap a ton of benefits, because in addition to developing and strengthening your legs, your entire core will benefit, giving your body greater stability, balance, and overall health. For some time now, I’ve been dedicated to offering these types of leg-focused sessions, since this is a part of the body that very few people train perhaps because they find these exercises tedious, or because they’re unaware of the importance of keeping the lower body in good condition. Strong legs can support our body, and when combined with core strengthening, we greatly reduce the risk of injury. So, my friends, don’t miss out on this routine break free from a sedentary lifestyle and start making positive changes in your lives.

![1000445227.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKKRZcX7g6YZqs8te2K3ru77cEgMJnWvV7HWvXyJmEj2facypznuPCYMC9w1NU3.gif)Portada de mi Autoría Editada en/Cover of my Authorship Edited in [Canva](https://www.canva.com/es_419/)
Logos propiedad de/ logos owned by @hiveio, @fulldeportes
# **
[Fase de Calentamiento]()
** Cuando vamos a realizar cualquier actividad física; siempre es recomendable; es más, debe ser un hábito obligatorio el de realizar ejercicios de calentamiento. Con ellos; ponemos a tono todo el cuerpo y alejamos la posibilidad de adquirir cualquier tipo de lesión. No realices ejercicios bruscos sin antes calentar; no arriesgues tu cuerpo por saltarte un minuto para calentar; vamos, activos. ># **
[Warm-up Phase]()
** >When we are going to do any physical activity, it is always advisable, in fact, it should be a mandatory habit to do warm-up exercises. With them, we get the whole body in tune and reduce the possibility of acquiring any type of injury. Do not do sudden exercises without warming up first; do not risk your body by skipping a minute to warm up; come on, let's get active. [**Calentamiento 1**, **GOLPES Y RODILLAZOS CRUZADOS**]() [Postura]() Piernas al ancho de la cadera; brazos en postura de combate. >[**Warm-up 1**, **CROSS PUNCHES AND KNEES**]() >[Stance]() >Feet hip-width apart; arms in a fighting stance.
![1000445139.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKWvNb8SVdcCZYYmd9bLaf4kL7nKmCQfs7YvnkmCtDbT9WnDgzGh94CTZggkWW5.gif)
[Ejecución]() Ya ubicados en la postura indicada; de forma rápida, vamos dando golpes y rodillazos cruzados alternos durante 3 minutos continuos. Los golpes se dan con brazos y piernas opuestas. >[Execution]() >Once you’re in the correct position, quickly alternate between punching and knee strikes for 3 continuous minutes. Use opposite arms and legs for each strike.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSwHoDRvGXH34pGPrhc8k5zcAwT9jAKVfe2AmZYg5FZtx/1776863889876.gif)
[**Calentamiento 2**, **TORSIONES LATERALES CON RODILLAS Y CODOS FLEXIONADOS**]() [Postura]() Piernas separadas al ancho de hombros con rodillas flexionadas; codos flexionados con brazos a los lados. >[**Warm-up 2**, **SIDE TWISTS WITH BENT KNEES AND ELBOWS**]() >[Starting Position]() >Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees bent; keep your elbows bent and arms at your sides.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZyFs222skS4kN6ZKHkaJ8qG2gZctwM9GfvbofFhB7PRY/1776863890026.gif)
[Ejecución]() Durante 3 minutos de actividad; vamos haciendo la flexión oblicua del torso, mientras hacemos leve pulso de piernas. Los brazos se mantienen en la misma posición. >[Execution]() >For 3 minutes, perform oblique torso bends while gently pulsing your legs. Keep your arms in the same position.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUvLDQNdoN4zagZGpL1MvKdaJLwGunMFSefm8qy6oLCJ9/1776863890153.gif)
Es muy importante determinar que si el cuerpo aún no está activo para la acción fuerte, se debe calentar un poco más. No olvides hacer pausas de 20 segundos entre ejercicios, y de 1 a 2 minutos entre series; la hidratación es extremadamente importante para reponer los líquidos y sales perdidas durante la acción. Por otro lado, debemos tratar en la medida de lo posible mantener una alimentación balanceada y un descanso adecuado, que contribuyan a la obtención de mejores resultados corporales. >It is very important to determine that if the body is not yet ready for intense activity, it should be warmed up a little more. Don't forget to take 20-second breaks between exercises and 1-2 minute breaks between sets; hydration is extremely important to replenish fluids and salts lost during exercise. On the other hand, we must try as much as possible to maintain a balanced diet and adequate rest, which contribute to achieving better physical results. # **
[Estaciones de Trabajo]()
** Luego de realizar el calentamiento y comprobado de que el cuerpo está apto para la acción fuerte; nos vamos a la ejecución de los ejercicios centrales de la rutina. Si aun sientes que no estás listo, vuelve a calentar, evita lesiones. Recuerda que cada ejercicio debes hacerlo de acuerdo a tu condición física, vamos poco a poco hasta dominar los movimientos. ># **
[Work Stations]()
** >After warming up and checking that the body is ready for the strong action, we go to the execution of the core exercises of the routine. If you still feel that you are not ready, warm up again, avoid injuries. Remember that each exercise should be done according to your physical condition, we go little by little until you master the movements. [**Estación 1**, **CAMINATA IDA Y VUELTA EN CUCLILLAS Y PUNTA DE PIES**]() [Postura]() Nos ubicamos en posición de sentadilla profunda, con piernas al ancho de la cadera y apoyados en punta de pies. Codos flexionados con brazos al frente. >[**Station 1**, **ROUND-TRIP WALK IN A SQUAT POSITION ON THE TOES**]() >[Posture]() >Start in a deep squat position, with your legs hip-width apart and your weight on your toes. Keep your elbows bent and your arms in front of you.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVYUTMTTYfCYbjFQSuwRaTJ7hFUtajwbm65ATwE1D8anF/1776864010370.gif)
[Ejecución]() Sin excepción, todo el tren inferior está activo; abdomen trabajando en segundo plano. Para ejecutar el movimiento; realizamos dos pasos al frente con cada pierna y luego dos pasos por pierna en reversa. Se nota que al dar los pasos, la cadera sube y baja un poco; los brazos se mantienen en la misma posición. Todo el cuerpo ganando equilibrio y control; serían 20 repeticiones totales en 4 series. >[Execution]() >Without exception, the entire lower body is engaged; the core works in the background. To perform the movement, take two steps forward with each leg, followed by two steps backward with each leg. Notice that as you take the steps, your hips rise and fall slightly; your arms remain in the same position. The entire body gains balance and control; perform a total of 20 repetitions in 4 sets.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbx61cUnJDZMf5LQVfSXUSHB6Uw6nM7e2Dzus6uT3E5wV/1776864010489.gif)
[**Estación 2**, **RODILLAS ALTERNAS AL SUELO CON GIRO CORPORAL Y EXTENSIÓN DE NÚCLEO**]() [Postura]() Nuevamente adoptamos la postura de cuclillas, con apertura al ancho de hombros y apoyados con la punta de los pies. Brazos hacia atrás y torso un poco hacia adelante, para luego ejecutar una buena extensión. >[**Station 2**, **ALTERNATING KNEE TO FLOOR WITH TORSO ROTATION AND CORE EXTENSION**]() >[Position]() >Once again, assume a squatting position with your feet shoulder-width apart and your weight on the balls of your feet. Bring your arms back and lean your torso slightly forward, then perform a full extension.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNaDYeA7UhEF8W2Knh8DPNSoE1AYCdEoAw97qFP8gFF7U/1776864010736.gif)
[Ejecución]() Aunque se siente una tension total en todo el tren inferior. Se experimenta un trabajo importante en columna, abdomen y cadera. Para realizar el movimiento, llevamos las rodillas de forma alterna al suelo; durante la acción, se gira el cuerpo y se hace una extensión de torso y cadera. Ejecutamos 20 repeticiones todales en 4 series. >[Execution]() >Although you can feel tension throughout your entire lower body, this exercise primarily engages your spine, core, and hips. To perform the movement, bring your knees to the floor one at a time; as you do so, rotate your torso and extend your upper body and hips. Perform 20 total repetitions in 4 sets.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbmikLd5DHnvqCaGGR5g8Ksdeo4PfXG16gHXcPqXqcB1E/1776864010886.gif)
[**Estación 3**, **SUPER SALTOS DIAGONALES EN SENTADILLA CON APOYO DE PARED**]() [Postura]() Iniciamos con piernas juntas, apoyando las manos en la reja o pared. Los brazos no quedan totalmente extendidos. >[**Station 3**, **SUPER DIAGONAL JUMPS FROM A SQUAT WITH WALL SUPPORT**]() >[Starting Position]() >Start with your feet together, resting your hands on the railing or wall. Your arms should not be fully extended.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVzFWEQG2V9b7f2cHTbCGrJ7GvDb1x7QU7vgFD1QEGrUB/1776864132625.gif)
[Ejecución]() Acción conjunta de todo el cuerpo, con énfasis en núcleo y piernas. Una vez adoptada la posición inicial; elevamos el cuerpo a través de saltos, girándolo en dirección diagonal para caer en sentadilla; estando en esa posición, se toma gran impulso para ir hacia el otro extremo. Acción en ambos lados, donde se ejercer fuerza corporal formidable. Nos vamos con 20 repeticiones totales en 4 series. >[Execution]() >A full-body movement that targets the core and legs. Once in the starting position, jump up while rotating your body diagonally to land in a squat; from there, use that momentum to move to the other side. Perform this on both sides, applying significant body force. We’ll do a total of 20 repetitions across 4 sets.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT7Cbma96RgwydjdtfKjjW5jr9Ftw2ipHzSfUAUkr6Kk8/1776864132721.gif)
[**Relajación**, **RODILLAZOS ALTERNOS SUAVES**]() [Postura]() Piernas al ancho de la cadera, con brazos cruzados hacia atrás. >[**Relaxation**, **GENTLE ALTERNATING KNEE BENDING**]() >[Posture]() >Stand with your legs hip-width apart, arms crossed behind your back.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWDEkCJt3GLc7mQt7RQiniLcsHboAJtcGgBybEX3MS1j6/1776864132934.gif)
[Ejecución]() Respirando y exhalando; durante 3 minutos de relajación y paz corporal, vamos llevando las rodillas contra el abdomen de forma alterna y suave. >[Execution]() >Breathing in and out; during 3 minutes of relaxation and physical calm, gently bring your knees toward your abdomen, alternating legs.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma5JHD4rNc8enMxcrgJMjeSrPdGhPWAzBTnBtbPaphsw8/1776864133041.gif)
Gracias por preferir nuestro canal. Recuerda que debes tomar descansos de calidad, hidratarte y alimentarte sanamente. Hasta la próxima y si deseas una rutina en particular, en los comentarios la puedes solicitar. >Thank you for choosing our channel. Remember to take quality breaks, hydrate and eat healthy. Until next time and if you want a particular routine, you can ask for it in the comments. #

title: Harmony.
body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g3ad8773a2dd3fe80675fa4a4b797123ae1b8338b509f081d8466456cc4c50c6cdb8b821e6a032c7dce594c21cf6a6585a0eb4d5fe212ccd3c38327a5b124c220_640.jpg)</center>

***

# The Tale of the Harmonious Village

In a quaint village nestled between rolling hills and lush forests, there lived a community known for its unparalleled harmony. The villagers thrived on cooperation, sharing their resources, skills, and joys. They celebrated each other's successes and comforted one another in times of sorrow. This unity brought prosperity to the village, and outsiders often marveled at their peaceful existence.

However, as time passed, a subtle shift began to occur. The villagers, in their quest for harmony, started to suppress their differences. They believed that true harmony meant total agreement, and any dissenting voice was gently silenced. At first, this seemed to strengthen their bonds, but soon the cracks began to show.

One day, a newcomer arrived—a wise old woman who had traveled far and wide. She observed the village's tranquility and admired their cooperation but sensed an underlying tension. She approached the villagers and shared her thoughts.

\

The villagers, taken aback, pondered her words. They realized that in their pursuit of a flawless existence, they had ignored the unique threads that each person brought to the community. They had stifled creativity, innovation, and individual expression.

With newfound awareness, the villagers began to encourage open dialogue. They invited differing opinions and celebrated the diversity of thoughts and ideas. They learned that disagreements could lead to growth and understanding, and that harmony flourished not in uniformity, but in the rich tapestry of their differences.

As the seasons changed, the village transformed. The once-muted voices began to sing in a vibrant chorus, each note contributing to a more profound sense of unity. They discovered that true harmony was a dance—a delicate balance of voices, each adding its unique melody to the collective song.

## Wisdom to Remember

- **Embrace Differences**: True harmony is not about uniformity but about celebrating the unique contributions of each individual.
- **Encourage Dialogue**: Open communication fosters understanding and growth, allowing communities to thrive.
- **Balance is Key**: Just as music needs different notes to create a beautiful melody, communities need diverse perspectives to achieve genuine harmony.

In the end, the village learned that harmony is not the absence of conflict, but the ability to navigate it with grace and compassion. And so, they thrived, not just as a community, but as a family, woven together by the rich tapestry of their shared experiences.

title: Tez's Story, Good musical taste
body:
Good evening, dear friends of Buskeria. Another night has arrived, and here's today's story. There's nothing better than a little reading before bed, right? Well, I always like to read and check out the community posts before going to sleep. And that's why I think it's also the best time to share today's story with you. Today's story is about Tez. He's a cook, but not your average cook; he works in the music industry. He's facing an accusation. You'll see how this affects him and how he gets out of this mess. If you want to find out everything, I invite you to read the story.

> Buenas noches queridos amigos de Buskeria, una nueva noche llega y aquí les traigo la historia del día. No hay nada mejor como un poco de lectura antes de acostarse verdad. Bueno, a mi siempre antes de acostarme me gusta leer y ver los post de la comunidad. Y por eso creo que también es la mejor hora para compartir con ustedes la historia del día. Esta de hoy la escribí sobre Tez. El es un cocinero, pero no uno común, trabaja para el sector de la música. El debe pasar por una acusación. Ya verán como esto lo afecta y como sale de ese problema. Si quieren enterare de todo les invito a leer la historia.

<div class=\

> ![1776770923175.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23zRy9VMVo6LRJTSTSXLBsKMfJPiBeB9JxGDZUp8FJphxd2tWj76EjQMLG9R1sWzxEowm.jpg) Image created by me in canva Working in the music industry was never part of Tez's plan. He had always been a fine-dining chef for large restaurant and hotel chains. Who would have thought that a little while later he would start working in this sector? It turns out he was working at a hotel as a cook. And one day, some singers were staying at the hotel. Tez was in charge of preparing their lunch. They got along very well, and the singer loved the food. That singer asked him if he could cook that dish at a concert they were having near the hotel. And Tez agreed without hesitation. He saw that he had a better time at those events with the people, and that he could be right there at the concerts. And obviously, he earned much more than working at the hotel. That job was what led him to switch to organizing food events at Buskeria concerts. If you wanted to eat something good while listening to the singers in the background, you had to go eat at Tez's food stand. When he moved to this area, he didn't just cook at the concerts of one specific band; he cooked at all the concerts of the best artists in Buskeria, so he was always present. He was the first musical chef known in the area. > Trabajar dentro del sector de la música nunca fue un plan de Tez. El siempre fue un chef de alta cocina para grandes cadenas de restaurantes y hoteles. Quien iba a decir que un poco después iba a empezar a trabajar dentro de este sector. Resulta que el trabajaba en un hotel, como el cocinero. Y un día en ese hotel se hospedaron unos cantantes. Y a Tez le tocó hacerles la comida del día. Esos se relacionaron muy bien y al cantante le encantó la comida. Ese cantante le pidió que si podía cocinar ese plato en un concierto que iban a tener cerca del hotel. Y Tez aceptó sin chistar. El vio que en esos eventos la pasaba mejor con la gente, y que podía estar directamente dentro de los conciertos. > Y obviamente ganaba mucho más que trabajando dentro del hotel. Ese encargo fue quien lo hizo cambiarse a organizador de eventos de cocina dentro de los conciertos de Buskeria. Si querías comer algo bueno mientras escuchabas algo a los cantantes de fondo pues debías ir a comer al puesto de comida de Tez. El al cambiarse hacia este sector no cocinaba solo en los conciertos de una banda en especifico, lo hacía en todos los conciertos de los mejores de Buskeria, así siempre estaba presente. Era el primer chef musical que se conociera por el lugar.

> ![aditya-chinchure-ZhQCZjr9fHo-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/EpQoZNEwMkNBrdHMnPy6xqr9jwnwar8r48mgxSC7DQCcwy5dCpVRHMNvZ4BZMqusWnE.jpg) [Source](www.pexels.com) His reputation just kept growing. The food stalls he ran at Buskeria concerts were known as \

That's what his stalls were called. These stalls consisted of a small, upscale restaurant right in the middle of the concert venue, with a view of the stage. You could eat your favorite food while watching the singers perform in the background. This was something no one in Buskeria had ever seen, so it made Tez the most sought-after chef in the entire region. Everyone who went to a concert wanted to go into the restaurant and eat while watching the show. The lines were enormous, and the number of customers was superhuman. But Tez was used to hard work; it was just another day, just a walk in the park like the ones he was used to.

One concert was different from all the others. His entire reputation as the Musical Chef was put to the test. He cooked a meal for the singers before the show started. But then, when the singers were performing, they got sick to their stomachs and had to cancel the concert. Everyone in Buskeria blamed Tez for their favorite band getting sick. The gossip escalated into criticism, with people saying his food was bad simply because his band had fallen ill. This criticism severely damaged his reputation, and even the authorities got involved. If the allegations were true, he would have to close his stall.

> Su reputación no hacía más que crecer y crecer. Los puestos de restaurant en los conciertos de Buskeria de el se conocían como El chef musical. Así se llamaban sus puestos. Esos puestos consistían en un pequeño restaurant de alta cocina en medio del concierto con vistas hacia el escenario. Podías comer tu comida favorita viendo a los cantantes de fondo. Eso era algo que nadie en Buskeria había visto, así que convirtió a Tez en el cocinero más demandado de toda la región. Todo el que iba a un concierto quería entrar al restaurant y comer mientras veían el concierto. Las filas eran enormes y la cantidad de clientes era sobrehumana. Pero Tez estaba acostumbrado a la faena dura, era un día más, solo un paseo por el parque como los que ya estaba acostumbrado.

> Un concierto fue diferente al resto de todos los demás. En ese toda la reputación que había conseguido como el chef musical se puso en juego. El le hizo una comida a los cantantes antes de empezar el show. Pero luego cuando los cantantes estaban en el concierto se sintieron mal del estomago y tuvieron que cancelar el concierto. Todos en Buskeria culparon que su banda favorita se había enfermado por culpa de Tez. Y los chismes terminaron en criticas, y decían que su comida era mala, solo porque se había enfermado su banda. Esas criticas afectaron mucho la reputación de el y incluso las autoridades se metieron en el caso, si era verdad tendría que cerrar el puesto.


<div class=\

> ![ivan-lapyrin-guZdHo-izHc-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23tSL4zwjQzVePrAf1WEM9g9jazzwL3nzkKBW1TzbN1LLFcpvYF47BJrKuebxdUxr1zP6.jpg) [Source](www.pexels.com) While the band was recovering in the hospital, Tez was very worried because he didn't want to lose his job or his new way of working in music. But it all ended up being a funny memory; the band recovered. And the doctors' tests cleared the matter: Tez's food had nothing to do with it; it was something they took before eating. Tez could breathe a sigh of relief, and everything went back to normal, but it will remain a bad memory that almost ruined everything he had built. Then it was all in the past, and he happily continued as the musical chef. > Mientras la banda se recuperaba en el hospital Tez estaba muy preocupado porque no quería perder su puesto ni su nueva forma de trabajar en la música. Pero todo terminó en un recuerdo gracioso, la banda se recuperó. Y los análisis de los médicos resolvieron el caso, la comida de Tez no tuvo nada que ver, fue algo que tomaron antes de comer. Tez pudo respirar tranquilo y todo volvió a la normalidad, pero quedará como un mal recuerdo que casi le echa a perder todo lo que había construido. Luego aquello quedó en el paso y el continuó felizmente como el chef musical.

> ![Captura de pantalla (2605).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23xKvAeqnpeeY4g5hQpDbwyDp3SM8dbThPHPpBXHk5S28kEAHHCCei415XZq4hH5qxEnT.png) # [Join](https://risingstargame.com) hive's most incredible game, Rising Star , today. **Don't miss the opportunity to become a Rising Star**.

body.title: Beach Sightings | LMAC FreeStyle Collage No. 159
body.body:
>

Hello LMAC and Hive members. I wanted to share you my current freestyle collage whose theme focuses on a beach experience. I love the beach. The setting brings a sense of calm and peace. Sitting there watching the seagulls fly over, then land near me for feeding makes me think intently about nature and how the animals survive each day without pressure or worry about the next. I'm there to relax and attempt to iron out any frustrations or unpleasantness I'm dealing with.

My style of collage is a Freestyle which means that I wasn't required to utilize any current contest photo in my design. However, if you'd like to join in the regular contests, visit the [LMAC Community here](https://peakd.com/c/hive-174695/created).

<center>![262866.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/justclickindiva/23swXV8TTdSfCAMefZgEG2MHmtqq9ibT4QeFL1viVbJRuMz1ESKLDzDm4NkSDENoFbtBM.png)</center>

In preparing my theme, I was fortunate enough to find a beautiful beach scene with a claim shell embedded in the sand. body.title: Llavero de flor a crochet (Tutorial)
body.body:
> Saludos querida comunidad, hace unos días una cliente me encargó un llavero de flor a crochet, solo me envió una imagen de referencia y me dijo que lo quería igual pero con la flor lila, pues el de la imagen era rosa, como siempre me la ingenié con la vista y pude identificar que los pétalos de la flor estaban hecho con punto tunecino a crochet, así que puse manos a la obra para este pedido y hoy comparto con ustedes el tutorial por si desean hacer una igual, espero les guste 😊 > Greetings dear community! A few days ago, a client commissioned a crocheted flower keychain. She only sent me a reference image and told me she wanted it the same but with a lilac flower, since the one in the image was pink. As always, I used my eyes and was able to identify that the flower petals were made with Tunisian crochet stitches. So, I got to work on this order, and today I'm sharing the tutorial with you in case you'd like to make one too. I hope you like it! 😊
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/EpxtB6tBYg3cwnC1g4F8fwwKUrPvzi7HeyYZkHmaX8xQ9vurZwjBwcdq1sMDXe3VvRt.jpg https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png

Materiales / Materials

+ Hilo acrílico para crochet de 1mm: lila, verde, rosado, violeta, azul y amarillo. + Ganchillo de 2mm, de 3.5mm y de 1.25mm + Alambre floral + Silicón + Tijera + Relleno de fibra acrílica + Aguja de ojal grande + Argolla para llavero >+ 1mm acrylic crochet yarn: lilac, green, pink, violet, blue, and yellow. >+ 2mm, 3.5mm, and 1.25mm crochet hooks >+ Floral wire >+ Hot glue >+ Scissors >+ Acrylic fiberfill >+ Large eyelet needle >+ Keyring
https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png

Proceso / Process

Centro de la flor:Para el centro de la flor, con hebra doble de hilo amarillo y ganchillo de 2mm, hacer 10 puntos bajos en un anillo, luego hacer una hilera de 10 aumentos para obtener un total de 20 puntadas. Pétalos de la flor: Con hebra triple de hilo lila y ganchillo de 3.5mm levantar un punto y hacer 3 cadenas de base, el punto que se realiza es tunecino, esto quiere decir que se levanta una hebra o punto incompleto por cada cadena y uno adicional en el punto de inicio, luego se completa los puntos cerrando dos hebras a la vez, es decir que la primera hilera se hacer 4 puntadas, luego en el segundo punto del circulo amarillo se hacer en la segunda y tercera hilera de 5 puntos esta vez, en el siguiente punto del circulo se repite lo mismo, es decir dos hileras de 5 puntos, para finalizar se hacen 3 puntos bajos normales y se cierra en el siguiente punto del circulo amarillo. Hacer 5 pétalo iguales. >Flower Center:For the flower center, using a double strand of yellow yarn and a 2mm crochet hook, make 10 single crochet stitches in a magic ring, then work a row of 10 increases to obtain a total of 20 stitches. > >Flower Petals:Using a triple strand of lilac yarn and a 3.5mm crochet hook, pick up one stitch and chain 3. This is a Tunisian crochet stitch, which means you pick up one stitch in each chain and one additional stitch in the starting stitch. Then, complete the stitches by working two loops at once. For the first row, work 4 stitches. Then, in the second stitch of the yellow circle, work 5 stitches in the second and third rows. Repeat this process in the next stitch of the circle, working two rows of 5 stitches. Finally, work 3 single crochet stitches and join in the next stitch of the yellow circle. Make 5 identical petals.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AKCGzg4Rv3umQxTLxXvvbihPf6g1ATpwx5eHxZfSxeXAZihRGcFpwzwQygy86EM.jpg https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AK7xg72iXQs2ks7cjMM769BV9vkaT3CpgLpKJN7Y2pzZ2T9uXGA43HFp9nfw8qN.gif https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png
Para las hojas: Con doble hebra de hilo verde y ganchillo de 2mm hacer 8 cadenas de base, tomando solo el lado del frente de la cadena hacer 1 punto bajo, 1 punto medio alto, 1 punto alto y punto alto doble juntos, dos aumentos de puntos altos dobles, 1 punto alto doble y 1 punto alto juntos, 1 punto medio alto, 1 punto bajo. Hacer un punto bajo adicional en el ultimo punto y repetir toda la secuencia esta vez por el lado de atrás de las cadenas de base. Hacer una hilera completa de aumentos de puntos bajos escondiendo el alambre floral por dentro de las puntadas y en la punta de la hoja hacer 1 punto picot, torcer las puntas sobrantes del alambre. Con doble hebra de hilo verde y ganchillo de 2mm hacer 10 puntos bajos en un anillo y una hilera de aumentos para obtener 20 puntadas, pegar con silicón las puntas del alambre de las hojas por detrás del circulo amarillo y coser el circulo verde para tapar. >For the leaves: With two strands of green yarn and a 2mm crochet hook, chain 8. Working in the front loop only, make 1 single crochet, 1 half double crochet, 1 double crochet, 1 treble crochet together, 2 treble crochet increases, 1 treble crochet together, 1 half double crochet, 1 single crochet. Make an additional single crochet in the last stitch and repeat the entire sequence, this time working on the back loop only. > >Work a full row of single crochet increases, hiding the floral wire inside the stitches. At the tip of the leaf, make 1 picot stitch and twist the excess wire ends. > >With two strands of green yarn and a 2mm crochet hook, work 10 single crochets into a magic ring and a row of increases to obtain 20 stitches. Glue the ends of the leaf wire to the back of the yellow circle and sew the green circle over it.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AKNKK68t9aEsYSLw1r9Sq7R8ZYk7xyQgmgBXdENMrnm6LD9aPZRwJvMR47ssPta.jpg https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png
Para las bolitas de colores: Con una sola hebra de hilo y ganchillo de 1.25mm hacer 6 puntos bajos en un anillo, hacer dos hileras de 6 aumentos para obtener 18 puntadas, hacer 3 hileras de puntos bajos, hacer dos hileras de 6 disminuciones, rellenar antes de cerrar con la aguja de ojal grande. Hacer 5 bolitas de diferente color. Con una hebra hilo verde y ganchillo de 1.25 hacer 18 cadenas y 18 puntos deslizados sobre estas, unir en cada extremo una bolita, de este modo quedan dos pares y una sobrando. Desde la parte de atrás de la flor hacer 4 cadenas y unir al centro de la hebra que une a un par de bolitas, hacer 8 cadenas y unir a la hebra que une el otro par de bolitas, hacer 12 cadenas y unir la última bolita y devolverse por todas las cadenas haciendo puntos deslizados. >For the colored beads: With a single strand of yarn and a 1.25mm crochet hook, make 6 single crochet stitches in a magic ring, make two rows of 6 increases to obtain 18 stitches, make 3 rows of single crochet stitches, make two rows of 6 decreases, stuff before closing with a large-eye needle. Make 5 beads of different colors. > >With a strand of green yarn and a 1.25mm crochet hook, chain 18 and slip stitch 18 times. Attach a bead to each end of the chain, so you have two pairs and one extra. From the back of the flower, chain 4 and join to the center of the strand connecting one pair of beads. Chain 8 and join to the strand connecting the other pair of beads. Chain 12 and join to the last bead. Then, work back along all the chains, slip stitching as you go.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AK56okU3ki8g23py18qH9aPSKcB2YNrbd1GHWF38L8EDjVaCfLYNe68v3SMSdBM.jpg https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png

body.title: Fun With the Deaf Friends
body.body:
We're so excited when we're told about the plan in our congregation for the swimming. The owner, who's also our friend, invited everyone for the swimming. Not everyone are able to come but at least we're a lot enough for this bonding. 

There I am with my deaf friends, and all of them are students in sign language. They really enjoyed the swimming, and I had fun with them. Can't wait for the next one, maybe next summer? Hope to one again this year though. The plan which was quite abrupt so we can bond before the situation becomes worse considering the rising fuel prices.

body.title: Should I change to a new gym?  My Actifit Report Card: April 22 2026
body.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/9d03ca10-48a4-412c-9e01-d7b5d63941c5.jpg)

Another day and this time a little shy of 15K steps.  That's not too bad in my books.  

Of course it started with walking the dog on a day that was just thinking about raining.  It was close enough to rain that I could feel water but far enough that perhaps it was mist.  Either way it wasn't too hot, not too cold, but I didn't want to linger in it just in case things started really coming down.

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/3f822c73-24fc-4830-9ec1-758149e86fb0.jpg)

Kind of gray and not really awesome.

Now the afternoon I walked the dog along with my wife.  Hmm... I'm sure there is a misplaced modifier in there somewhere.  I walked my and walked *with* my wife.  But it was a short walk because my wife was tired and it was threatening rain again.

So where did I get all my steps?  Well 30 minutes on the elliptical at the gym certainly helped.

But also I walked to a gym that will be opening in a weeks time that is very close to my house.  I got a message that they would be around from 11-5 today so I dropped in.

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/bdad2843-7fe9-4ede-893a-17d349ec611e.jpg)

The door was open but...

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/446b44da-f2d2-44b0-b37a-67fab9b5b52a.jpg)

It wasn't exactly an inviting hallway to walk down.  I called \

a couple of times but when I heard no response I didn't enter. I did try to call... But no answer. I tried to text....but no answer. Result: I walked back home. When I was sitting down to remove my shoes I get a call. It was the gym. They were there but had a note to enter rather than listen for people. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d79e0430-4a95-4eb6-b8c1-3869ac2862c8.jpg) Yes, there was a sign in the hallway but... It didn't seem active enough to make me want to venture in when it was obviously not quite ready yet. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/0065b450-7d27-4761-bc50-fb151603fdcb.jpg) With the lights on it was much more inviting and I went on in and met the owner and some of the staff. I sat down and looked at their price list... ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/9c6bb89a-e3d9-4aa6-960f-f317d6bc6365.jpg) It is twice the price of the gym that I am currently at. However, it gives a key fob which allows me to use any of their Anytime Fitness in the world at any time. As I like to travel that is actually pretty important. I'm still thinking about whether it is worthwhile or not as it is a bit expensive. I looked around the gym but its not quite ready yet and very dark. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/c9dcb158-5e4e-48ee-b60c-d8dc75a3b1e2.jpg) So, I work tomorrow and I'll come up with a decision for the day after that :) Could be nice to workout anytime. Or I could end up wasting money if I never actually go as happens with so many gym memberships. Time will tell :)
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@terganftp/actifit-terganftp-20260423t014900601z)_

body.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade Is the Perfect Send Off for the Original Trilogy, Blending Action, Humor, and Heart into One of the Best Adventure Films Ever Made. It Is a True Eighties Classic That Gets Better Every Time You Watch It.
body.body:
Released in 1989, Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade feels like a return to everything that made Raiders of the Lost Ark so special, while also expanding the story in a meaningful way. After the darker and more intense tone of Temple of Doom, this film brings back the sense of fun and adventure, but adds a stronger emotional core. It is not just about the action this time. It is about character, history, and legacy.

![IMG_0641.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQma8CpKqdmCjqVPNFaWRhqoYz4PrzRiPKapNz1MmxW5qfj/IMG_0641.webp)

The film was directed by Steven Spielberg, working once again with George Lucas, and you can feel how confident the direction is throughout. Spielberg keeps the pace moving while still allowing scenes to breathe, which is something this film does better than most adventure movies. He knows exactly when to push the action and when to slow things down for character moments.

Harrison Ford returns as Indiana Jones, and by this point he completely owns the role. Ford brings the perfect mix of toughness, intelligence, and humor. Indy is still the same adventurous archaeologist, but here you also see more of his personal side, especially when he is forced to deal with his father.

That brings in the film’s greatest addition, Sean Connery as Henry Jones Sr., and this is where the movie really separates itself from the others. Connery is outstanding, bringing a completely different energy that plays perfectly off Ford. The two have incredible chemistry, and their relationship becomes the heart of the film.

Their dynamic is what drives so much of the story. They argue, they misunderstand each other, and they constantly clash in both personality and approach. At the same time, there is a clear respect underneath it all, even if they struggle to show it. That balance of humor and emotion gives the film a depth that makes it stand out.

The plot centers around the search for the Holy Grail, one of the most legendary artifacts in history. When Henry Jones Sr. goes missing during his search, Indy is pulled into the mission to find him. What follows is a globe spanning adventure that takes them across multiple locations as they try to stay one step ahead of the Nazis.

The story is packed with classic Indiana Jones elements, including hidden clues, ancient puzzles, and dangerous traps. Each step of the journey feels like part of a larger mystery, and the film does a great job of keeping the audience engaged in the search.

The supporting cast adds even more to the film. Alison Doody plays Elsa Schneider, a character who brings both charm and uncertainty to the story, while Denholm Elliott and John Rhys Davies return as Marcus Brody and Sallah, adding familiar humor and support.

The action sequences are some of the best in the series, including the motorcycle chase, the escape from the castle, and the tank battle. These scenes are exciting without ever feeling overdone, and they are staged in a way that keeps them clear and easy to follow.

What really makes these sequences work is that they are always tied to the characters. The action is not just there for spectacle. It pushes the story forward and adds to the relationships, especially between Indy and his father.

The film also leans more into humor than the previous entries, and it works incredibly well. Much of that humor comes from the back and forth between Ford and Connery, but there are also plenty of smaller moments that add to the overall tone without taking away from the adventure.

As the film moves toward its final act, it shifts into a more serious and thoughtful direction. The Grail sequence is not just about action. It becomes a test of character, knowledge, and understanding, which fits perfectly with the themes of the story.

The ending brings everything together in a satisfying way, giving both the adventure and the characters a proper conclusion. It feels earned, and it leaves a lasting impression without trying to do too much.

Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade remains an excellent film because it perfectly balances everything it sets out to do. It delivers action, humor, strong performances, and real emotion all at once, which is not easy to pull off.

![IMG_0640.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdPWdX59piFXV6PVeJTop9RkMiu4GzHct7phBqq2c2BCa/IMG_0640.webp)

It stands as one of the greatest adventure films ever made and a true classic that continues to hold up decades later.
