body.title: THE LOVE RECESSION
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVBeVGpVQQvSU4M2idvdb2X72yWTb34TzYMDktEmKGYcR/Gemini_Generated_Image_73e6pb73e6pb73e6.png 
image generated using Gemini AI

A lot of us grew up in families where we learned how to love from our parents; while some had bad examples, others had good ones. While some individuals grew up where love was toxic between parents, others grew up in an environment where love speaks loudly. It is still possible that our parents hide the rotten part of love from their kids, only to show them the good parts. Such children grow up to believe that love is perfect, and when they don’t seem to find the perfect love that they so much longed for, they run as fast as they can.

We watch movies and see what they say about love, setting high expectations for what our partners should be like when they say they love us. When we watch movies, we see the result of love, the grand gestures, but rarely do we see the process of it all, the silence, the boredom, the compromise, the shared bills. Movies only show us the sweet part of it, leaving the bitter part untouched, and when we meet this bitterness in relationships, we feel the love is not there or not true. Because we have different ideologies and understandings of love, we sometimes feel as though we are not loved enough by our partners or loved rightly.

I believe that love is a give-and-take thing and should never be one-sided or have one partner care more about the other. When you teach the other person how to love you, then there is a problem to begin with.

Love has become expensive these days because individuals keep demanding from their partners where the provision is not stable, men feel overwhelmed with everything, and sometimes find better comfort in being alone, having their sexual needs satisfied on calls.

The problem of having fewer people getting married or craving to be married is a result of the above, as well as having rampant infidelity happening in our society at large, people raising and taking care of children that are not theirs, men going outside marriage to commit atrocities while their wives are at home and unaware of what is happening.

A lot of individuals who are due and ready to get married have the excuse of the deteriorating economic condition of the country. They set goals and targets they want to meet, only to set another goal every time a goal is achieved, to prevent themselves from being committed for life. Marriage to a lot of individuals is an idea they love, but they are really scared to go into or are not ready for a commitment.

There used to be low rates of divorce, and it was a dream of every man and woman to get married someday. Back in those days, individuals were matched and would get married even before knowing each other. It was during their stay together that they learned about each other. Marriages before now had a higher success rate, with them live long in the process. A good marriage is a blessing to both parties, and when we do find the spark, we should give marriage, love and a resting place.

My name is @rishagamo, and above is my submission for the Sci-Fi Multiverse prompt Week 64 Edition 2 “THE FUTURE OF FAMILY (DECLINING MARRIAGE)”.

body.title: 小学生养蚕记
body.body:

<center>
![yRCImTtjNhp0ne59_IMG_20260414_180116.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/trina77/images/yRCImTtjNhp0ne59_IMG_20260414_180116/yRCImTtjNhp0ne59_IMG_20260414_180116.webp)
![IwFVKqAuqjqpfzEg_1776160821136_0dcf6184.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/trina77/images/IwFVKqAuqjqpfzEg_1776160821136_0dcf6184/IwFVKqAuqjqpfzEg_1776160821136_0dcf6184.webp)
![tRuzgSRQSHUR97BU_IMG_20260414_180113.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/trina77/images/tRuzgSRQSHUR97BU_IMG_20260414_180113/tRuzgSRQSHUR97BU_IMG_20260414_180113.webp)
![9QjZ3uNqktFJr6GS_IMG_20260422_193023.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/trina77/images/9QjZ3uNqktFJr6GS_IMG_20260422_193023/9QjZ3uNqktFJr6GS_IMG_20260422_193023.webp)
![Ac2fpZTrwJsoZycL_IMG_20260422_193029.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/trina77/images/Ac2fpZTrwJsoZycL_IMG_20260422_193029/Ac2fpZTrwJsoZycL_IMG_20260422_193029.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

伙伴们，你们小时候都养过蚕吗？没想到时隔这么多年，养蚕又成了现在小学生里的流行风潮，这份小小的童趣，竟就这样流传了几十年。
 
下午去接孩子放学，她一蹦一跳地跑到我身边，神神秘秘地说：“妈妈，我给你看样东西，你可别犯密集恐惧症哦！”我满心好奇，猜了半天也没想出是什么，结果她掏出来的，竟是一盒还没孵化的蚕卵。原来是同学特意送给她，让她带回家慢慢孵化的。
 
记忆里，养蚕的时光格外清晰：蚕卵慢慢变黑，就预示着黑蚕宝宝快要破壳而出，等它们一天天啃食桑叶，身子会渐渐褪去黑色，变得白白胖胖。最后再吐出细细的蚕丝，有白色还有黄色。把自己紧紧裹进蚕茧里，破茧而出时，就变成了小小的飞蛾。
 
看着孩子的蚕卵一点点接近黑色，我们便盘算着回老家采摘桑叶。印象中，老家门口枇杷树下，曾长着一棵枝繁叶茂的桑树，只是早前听妈妈说砍掉了，此番回去也只是抱着碰碰运气的心思。没想到桑树的生命力如此顽强，被砍掉的树根旁，竟冒出了不少新枝叶，虽说长得东倒西歪，却格外茂密，桑叶嫩生生的，翠绿翠绿正是小蚕最爱吃的口感。我们摘了满满一把，又在老家宅基地上，发现了一棵刚冒出来的小桑树苗，索性连根挖起，打算带回家栽种，以后喂蚕就方便多了。
 
回家后，孩子拿着我的手机，兴致勃勃地问豆包该怎么孵化蚕卵。看到说要保持75%的湿度，她立马找来纸巾打湿，垫在了蚕卵下面。我连忙提醒她，不用特意打湿，干纸巾铺垫就好，太潮湿反而会影响蚕卵孵化。可小家伙偏偏认准了“无所不能”的豆包，压根不听我的劝说，执着地按着方法操作。
 
就这样耐心等了好几天，垫着的桑叶都慢慢蔫了，也没等到蚕宝宝破壳的身影。昨天再去接孩子放学，她手里又捧着一堆东西，不仅有已经孵化好的小蚕宝宝，还有新鲜的桑叶。兴奋地告诉我，她在学校旁边排了二十分钟的队，这些都是别人免费送的，既送蚕宝宝又送桑叶，实在太贴心了！
 
我们赶紧回家，找了个干净的盒子，小心翼翼地把小蚕宝宝安置进去。担心领到的桑叶偏老，不适合娇嫩的蚕宝宝吃，我又带着孩子折返老家，摘了一兜鲜嫩桑叶。回来后仔细用棉签清理蚕宝宝，给它们换了干净的小窝，我数了数竟整整有二十只。

我家孩子眼睛直勾勾地盯着电视，把这些小生灵抛在了脑后，到头来，照顾蚕宝宝的活儿，又变成了我的任务。
 
看着盒子里这些蠕动的小身影，童年里养蚕的回忆涌上心头，满是儿时的美好。

---

body.title: No estés triste (o sí) [Esp/Eng]
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVJQXyS6ieoLrD7FGff4HMzZgxG2mSfCXNPndnb7QA59o/1776908116255.jpg)


***
***
Todas las tardes, al salir de mi sala en el hospital pediátrico, paso frente al mural. Una niña de trazos coloridos me sonríe desde la pared, bajo un sol amarillo, y dice: \

. Es un mensaje pensado para aliviar, para dar fuerzas y, sin embargo, cada vez que lo leo, algo dentro de mí se tensa.

No porque la intención sea mala, pues alguien quiso regalar un poco de luz en un lugar donde a menudo sobra oscuridad. Lo entiendo y lo valoro, pero después de años trabajando aquí, después de ver tantas madres apretando los dientes frente a una quimioterapia, tantos padres llorando a escondidas en el pasillo de oncología, tantos niños de cuatro años preguntando con una serenidad devastadora, me pregunto: ¿de verdad queremos que no estén tristes? ¿Estar triste no es acaso válido?
***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP6yiuSpoLKBaTgfbANvDeqMqhGdfKyDDLjX1hG9wmxdz/1776908397527.jpg)


***
Hemos construido una cultura que huye del dolor como si fuera un enemigo y pone canciones alegres cuando alguien llora. También decimos \

como si fuera un hechizo, y etiquetamos la tristeza como algo que hay que superar rápido, como una gripe menor. Pero en un hospital pediátrico, la tristeza no es un síntoma que curar. Es una respuesta lógica, humana, inevitable ante lo incomprensible.
***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVWqNPJ8PkBGsdcTNswm2hKcrpo7sGMbbfETDXiHu8xBJ/1776908397980.jpg)


***
Recuerdo a Lucía, una madre que pasó tres semanas junto a la cama de su hija recién diagnosticada, y una tarde, al fin sola en la sala de espera, rompió a llorar. Yo sentí deseos de sentarme a su lado y, por inercia, casi le digo \
. Menos mal que me callé. La tristeza no es un pozo sin fondo; es una marea que viene y va. Pero para que se vaya, primero hay que dejarla llegar. Decir \

es cerrar la puerta antes de que entre la visita, y la visita, aunque duela, tiene algo que enseñarnos.
***



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQCGbwUmJW1fghLfgHGBVwaUMkdTWAmBZgK4MGCN8mTRR/1776908398465.jpg)

***
No propongo que instalemos la tristeza como un modo de vida. En su lugar, propongo que la honremos, que dejemos de tratarla como una vergüenza y que aprendamos a decir \

. Porque cuando alguien sufre, lo que más necesita no es que le quiten el dolor, sino que no lo dejen solo con él.
***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYMqRp4EwXu7K7r7rYbkgcHPGyoiJA3JBvHTmnfn6sBBR/1776908398224.jpg)


***
Así que cada tarde, al salir, miro a la niña del mural y le agradezco su cartel, pero en mi cabeza corrijo su frase. \

. Sigo caminando hacia la salida, sabiendo que mañana habrá más llanto, más abrazos, más madres que se desmoronan, y estaré ahí, sin apagar nada, porque la tristeza compartida pesa menos y porque, al final, lo más humano que podemos hacer es permitirnos sentir.

<center>🌼</center>

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRSmczRZ7mh457ozsGyfJF93vxnsidtnD9LmCYpF1XK9K/1776476176416.jpg)

![cinti 800x20 - copia.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWKGeMBmj14VqKn8xBrmpFM3RYVcgmAXX6bGnGwuNWEnc/cinti%20800x20%20-%20copia.jpg) 
### <center>ENGLISH VERSION</center>

![cinti 800x20 - copia.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWKGeMBmj14VqKn8xBrmpFM3RYVcgmAXX6bGnGwuNWEnc/cinti%20800x20%20-%20copia.jpg) 

## <center>Don't be sad (or yes) </center>




![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRjtVNqBHP8TT27f14EpFT33phSHtoqss3Qw7QE3Dispq/1776908116804.jpg)



***
***

Every afternoon, when I leave my ward in the children's hospital, I walk past the mural. A girl with colorful strokes smiles at me from the wall, beneath a yellow sun, and says, \

It is a message meant to comfort, to give strength, and yet every time I read it, something inside me tightens.

Not because the intention is bad; someone wanted to offer a little light in a place where darkness often abounds. I understand and appreciate that, but after years of working here, after seeing so many mothers clenching their jaws through chemotherapy, so many fathers crying in secret in the oncology hallway, so many four-year-olds asking with devastating calmness, I wonder: do we really want them not to be sad? Isn't being sad valid?
***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP6yiuSpoLKBaTgfbANvDeqMqhGdfKyDDLjX1hG9wmxdz/1776908397527.jpg)


***
We have built a culture that flees from pain as if it were an enemy, and puts on cheerful songs when someone cries. We also say \

as if it were a spell, and we label sadness as something to overcome quickly, like a minor cold. But in a children's hospital, sadness is not a symptom to cure. It is a logical, human, inevitable response to the incomprehensible.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVWqNPJ8PkBGsdcTNswm2hKcrpo7sGMbbfETDXiHu8xBJ/1776908397980.jpg)

***
I remember Lucía, a mother who spent three weeks by her daughter's bedside after a new diagnosis, and one afternoon, finally alone in the waiting room, she burst into tears. I felt like sitting next to her and, out of habit, almost said \
Good thing I kept quiet. Sadness is not a bottomless pit; it is a tide that comes and goes. But for it to go away, you first have to let it arrive. Saying \

is closing the door before the visitor comes in, and the visitor, painful as it may be, has something to teach us.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQCGbwUmJW1fghLfgHGBVwaUMkdTWAmBZgK4MGCN8mTRR/1776908398465.jpg)


***
I am not proposing that we embrace sadness as a way of life. Instead, I propose that we honor it, that we stop treating it like a shame, and that we learn to say \

Because when someone is suffering, what they need most is not to have their pain taken away, but not to be left alone with it.
***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYMqRp4EwXu7K7r7rYbkgcHPGyoiJA3JBvHTmnfn6sBBR/1776908398224.jpg)


***
So every afternoon, as I leave, I look at the girl on the mural and thank her for her sign, but in my head I correct her phrase. \

I keep walking toward the exit, knowing that tomorrow there will be more tears, more hugs, more mothers falling apart, and I will be there, without putting out any of the fire, because shared sadness weighs less, and because, in the end, the most human thing we can do is allow ourselves to feel.

body.body: > Presentamos la trayectoria de **Cebollas Ardientes**, la agrupación que desde 1994 se convirtió en un pilar fundamental del ska y el reggae underground en Caracas, marcando una época con su sonido auténtico.

>\n\nLa agrupación **Cebollas Ardientes** se fundó en Caracas en 1994, emergiendo como una propuesta fresca y enérgica dentro de la escena musical alternativa de Venezuela. Su debut formal ocurrió en un escenario emblemático para el género: el \

, evento que sirvió de vitrina para las bandas que buscaban rescatar y reinterpretar los ritmos jamaiquinos desde una perspectiva local. Desde sus primeras presentaciones, el grupo destacó por su capacidad para amalgamar la potencia del ska con una presencia escénica que rápidamente les ganó un lugar en el circuito subterráneo de la capital.\n\nEn el año 1997, tras consolidar su alineación y madurar su propuesta sonora, **Cebollas Ardientes** grabó su primera producción discográfica. Este álbum se caracterizó por una cuidada combinación de estilos, paseándose con naturalidad por el rock steady, el ska, el reggae y el ragamuffin. La receptividad de este material fue notable, logrando que tres de sus temas se posicionaran con fuerza en las principales emisoras de radio de Caracas y en diversas estaciones del interior de Venezuela. Hits como \

se convirtieron en himnos de la movida, lo que permitió a la banda realizar innumerables presentaciones en vivo durante dos años consecutivos.\n\nTras este periodo de intensa actividad, la agrupación entró en un receso de dos años en los que su presencia en los medios y escenarios disminuyó considerablemente. Durante este tiempo, la incertidumbre sobre el futuro de la banda llevó a muchos a pensar que el proyecto había desaparecido definitivamente. Sin embargo, en un movimiento que sorprendió a sus seguidores, **Cebollas Ardientes** anunció su regreso con una segunda producción discográfica. Este renacimiento musical trajo consigo temas como \

, canciones que demostraron una evolución en su composición y una reafirmación de sus raíces musicales. A lo largo de su trayectoria, la banda ha sido un pilar para el desarrollo del ska en el país, demostrando que los ritmos caribeños pueden coexistir con la actitud del rock. Su legado se mantiene vigente entre los entusiastas de la música nacional, siendo recordados como una de las agrupaciones que mejor supo capturar el espíritu de una época marcada por la experimentación y la autogestión. Con una propuesta que siempre priorizó el mensaje y la calidad interpretativa, **Cebollas Ardientes** continúa siendo un referente necesario para comprender la historia de la música urbana y alternativa en Venezuela. -----

>

### Cebollas Ardientes: The Sound of Ska and Underground Resistance

The group **Cebollas Ardientes** was founded in Caracas in 1994, emerging as a fresh and energetic proposal within Venezuela's alternative music scene. Their formal debut took place on an emblematic stage for the genre: the \

an event that served as a showcase for bands seeking to rescue and reinterpret Jamaican rhythms from a local perspective. From their earliest performances, the group stood out for their ability to blend the power of ska with a stage presence that quickly earned them a place in the capital's underground circuit.\n\nIn 1997, after consolidating their lineup and maturing their sonic proposal, **Cebollas Ardientes** recorded their first album. This record was characterized by a careful combination of styles, naturally moving through rock steady, ska, reggae, and ragamuffin. The receptivity of this material was remarkable, with three of their tracks gaining strong airplay on major radio stations in Caracas and various stations in the Venezuelan interior. Hits like \

became anthems of the scene, allowing the band to perform countless live shows for two consecutive years.\n\nAfter this period of intense activity, the group entered a two-year hiatus during which their presence in the media and on stage significantly decreased. During this time, uncertainty about the band's future led many to believe that the project had disappeared for good. However, in a move that surprised their followers, **Cebollas Ardientes** announced their return with a second studio production. This musical rebirth brought tracks like \

songs that demonstrated an evolution in their songwriting and a reaffirmation of their musical roots. Throughout their career, the band has been a pillar for the development of ska in the country, proving that Caribbean rhythms can coexist with rock attitude. Their legacy remains relevant among national music enthusiasts, remembered as one of the groups that best captured the spirit of an era marked by experimentation and self-management. With a proposal that always prioritized the message and interpretive quality, **Cebollas Ardientes** continues to be a necessary reference for understanding the history of urban and alternative music in Venezuela. #

body.title: How to get started in Mining Sim
body.body:
![mining sim.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jef-001/23u63EiHLvKRxbdtUPxLDcHATgstNTabqJB1T2EywM6LrptGNfp7q8kBAFnKSxnAjoUvv.jpg) # How to get started in Mining Sim After my last post explaining what **Mining Sim** actually is, I thought it would be better to also show how to get started in the current demo. The UI you see now is still a testing/demo shell and not what the final game UI is supposed to look like. The core loop shown here is the one being tested now. I use dark mode, so it may look a bit different for you in light mode. Also just to be clear, this test is free to try. There are no real tokens or NFTs in it yet, and there is nothing to earn from testing right now. This stage is just about testing the game loop and seeing what works and what doesn't. The basic idea is simple: - buy miners - keep them powered - mine for rewards - reinvest those rewards to keep growing ![image.png](11) Game link: https://mining-sim-player.netlify.app/ Discord: https://discord.gg/kfvFamvNQe
The **Start Here** card should guide you through the first steps and take you to where you need to be for each one. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jef-001/23t72sqosdyo5nTATrpHLmqqpHsBCFB2KUDsaLpyFN6CBCpjiHdBoqsxszmcA83JodLG1.png) ## 1. Log in with Keychain The first thing to do is log in with your Hive account through Keychain. The page uses that to know which account is playing and to sign the actions you make. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jef-001/23t72QyVRAhV2vkptPiEoEX4bHs4AZqPS7ojS6Ec2y3rQ8xGkb7Bnr2HiQ62Awx9ZnE86.png) ## 2. Set inviter if you have one This part is optional. If u only have 1 account, I would just skip this. If you have more and want to see how it works, then leave it blank for the first account, but fill it in on the others and use the first account as inviter. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jef-001/23tv1vSgTv7qNzzjwNNc64hibYAM9WGDjrP9iy6S7DrpD1C4HUTkt5rfVJzLhdsosPdRJ.png) ## 3. Get starter balance Before buying your first miner, grab the one-time demo starter balance. That gives you the test balance used for your first purchase. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jef-001/EoCZRwbw95WUMDUVjm2Y3Kx3N98U6sxHDQnHLDtybuAk2H4X8ZFp8xfLe5Gm9jxpw8p.png) ## 4. Buy your first miners After that you can buy your first Gen1 miners. With the starter balance, you can get 5. Starter miners come with prepaid energy, so you do not need to worry about buying energy right away. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jef-001/EoGpDEFrKrs8kWQzPGgMXs46wWSAgZFusiFao2CbideSsW93K7aMAkdZH61b2ukgqqB.png) ## 5. Start mining Once you own miners, you can stake them from the miner table and start mining. That is when the actual loop begins. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jef-001/23t6zyScN33faqDA5M1daerrruYzNWaRtKH6e4sAsHJ7ZUyvjHEJjwqLv1wnMhqQu8zeU.png) ## 6. Watch your state Once your miners are running, you can see the important things on the player page: - your **CREDIT** - your active **TH** - your energy runtime - your **MINE** That gives you a quick view of how your farm is doing. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jef-001/23sweCxkyK4tfvYmupNEEoZdMSJtadCFK3SPAMUmbFPz78EYHkhSwYS2imdbpTcDngfHK.png) ## 7. Reinvest your rewards When you have **MINE**, you can convert it into **CREDIT**. That is how you keep growing without adding new outside value all the time. You use **CREDIT** for things like: - energy - more miners - research - repairs ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jef-001/23uQC892qVVZQ5CGHRyakkWcKo3uekj1GC1cNRTibZztq4sCWqvmUhgHTVvH2vAMV5bWx.png) ## 8. Keep your miners powered When the starter energy runs out, you need to buy more energy using **CREDIT**. That is one of the main ongoing costs in the game. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jef-001/Eo1vSr4j3KDrG81qtB1gpJvtg7zL9DiAVSymcKJL2TDoRUEjYQuFDvxtmfqmDp4CZR2.png) ## 9. Repairs are now part of the loop too Miners now wear down over time from being used. That means they are not just something you buy once and forget forever. Once a miner drops low enough in condition, repairs become available. So over time the loop is not just buying energy and miners, but also deciding when it is still worth repairing older hardware and when newer hardware starts making more sense. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jef-001/23swcKD8oxv47mQH4rBHzg2goDdnt1urC3W6r1gp2UrjRLQWRtV71WerY2U9WzkYquke5.png) ## What the current loop is So in simple words, the current loop is: - get your first miners - start mining - use **MINE** to get **CREDIT** - spend **CREDIT** on energy, more miners, research, and repairs - keep growing and decide how long older miners are still worth keeping around
There are also things like anomalies and hash races, but the steps above are the main way to get started. If you do try it, what helps me most is honest feedback from fresh eyes. If something is unclear, if you don't know what to click next, if wording is confusing, or if the loop just doesn't feel good yet, that is exactly the kind of feedback I need right now.

body.title: Day 43: How I would create a tokenized stock on Hive
body.body:
#
TTSLA is already on Hive

If you look on HIVE there is already a tokenized stock. It is issued by the LEO people and goes by the ticker TTSLA on the hive-engine. Now I do *not* own any of this coin and I did look at the information released by the LeoStrategy team which I found..

>here I tried reading it but it was a bit beyond me so I will admit that I asked AI to give me the toddler version of it. What I got was this: TTSLA does not have any true exposure to the TESLA stock. Instead if offers a coin which is designed to simulate 1/100th of the stock. If you hold the coin and it is less than the TSLA value it pays a high dividend. Incentive for people to buy and bring the value up to where the stock price should be. If the price is too high? dividend drops to make buying less desirable. However, the thing I heard was this: * There is no stock actually underpinning the offering.

#
I would do things a little differently

TTSLA is a great synthetic system that uses backing, incentives and algorithms to make an awesome coin. For me? I would lean towards a different model. One that is not a trustless system but rather a custodial model backed by real-world assets and HBD reserves. # The Dream ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23tbMYLLxqSmGgh6ak2USdnozBNGtGSkdR6hkpUZsknfhGWR9Ged27v9DSBfHHbAfuY6P.png) Image Source: Dall-e
Before you read further a few caveats: 1) This is designed as a sandbox using accounts at arms length at least for now. Regulatory issues make this a nightmare legally. 2) I use words like \

for liquidity and distributions.  In reality things can always break down and everything is pinned on the asset holder being trustworthy.  If the assets I hold pinned to NFT's get sold?  Everything crumbles.

However..

I'll continue with how I see my dream below :)

If you have read my previous posts you will know that two different accounts @cinderclaw.gld and @gldloan.test have been sending GLD tokens to @tergan in order to facilitate the purchase of different FIAT assets.  These assets are :


![Screenshot_20260422-074131.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23uEzR6uDvNP46swHUffdTJZCkJeDJaKr2xiZHWhbXtQqd9TGoNmjwWx2E4LYWysmbeAk.png)

* 1 x BTCI for @gldloan.test 
* 1 x ZWQT for @gldloan.test
* 1 x HDIF for @gldloan.test and @cinderclaw.gld 

Right now those assets exist in the real world and their dividends will be converted into HIVE and distributed to their respective owners but right now it is a very manual system.  

Which leads to the question:  How would I do a virtual stock offering on HIVE?

And here is my thoughts:

# ONE:  Own the actual asset in real life.

To me this is important.  As cool as the TTSLA stock is there is a problem I see.  What happens if the actual TESLA stock were to skyrocket to $500,000/share?  Would the LEO funding cover that kind of boost?  My first thought is that it would break the system but I could also be wrong.  

However, if the offering is backed by the actual share?  No matter how high it goes there is always backing for it.  $5 or $5 million there is cash to make sure virtual holders get the full value.

# TWO: NFT's as claim tokens.


![Screenshot_20260422-074426.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23sxpXQpjBiM2QExkPVTEWMZwCotXD2pnDDt4ic7HrSYsvewP5oLNDh47s5SfctKTpvZ8.png)

If you look you will see that I actually hold

* 2 x BTCI shares
* 11 x HDIF shares
* 35 x ZWQT shares.

The GLD community can mint up to 10,000 NFT's for a trivial sum of 0.1 BEE per NFT.  Right now there are 10 NFT's that are not linked to anything.  Each NFT could easily be linked to a physical stock.

In effect I could make each NFT a \

for the value of the actual real life share. # THIRD: A buy and sell website. Let's say that I mint 48 NFTs and each NFT links exactly to one of those stocks. On a website I could track the price of each stock daily and offer to sell it to someone as the current value. On the same website I could offer to BUY the exact same stock to anyone holding it. If the website holds enough cash to cover every buy and enough NFTs to cover every sell then there is a direct correlation between what is owned and what can be bought. # FOURTH: A stablecoin is needed to bridge the FIAT to VIRTUAL In this case the GLD token has two sources. * It can be purchased or sold to the GLD Merchant at a fixed 100 GLD : 1 HBD * It can be exchanged for LTC and moved to or from external exchanges using the TribalDex liquidity pool. In short if you want to buy? Get GLD by bringing in LTC from an exchange or use on chain HIVE/HBD to purchase GLD directly. Having GLD pegged to $0.01 USD by pegging to HBD it makes calculations simple: $36.29 for BTCI would be 3629 GLD tokens :) # Fifth: Enable fractional buying Now lets assume I have 2 BTCI stock, 2 BTCI NFT, and offer 200 BTCI coin. If I offer the BTCI coin at 1/100th of the BTCI price then everyone is able to buy it on the HIVE engine at whatever the going price is on the engine. But here is the fun part. Assume I only make 100 BTCI available for sale and guarantee 1 BTCI NFT in return for 100 BTCI coins. That means if you accumulate enough BTCI coin you are guaranteed 1/100th of the price of the stock. The bot guarantees purchase as the end of day rate. If all 100 BTCI coins sell out? Take the other NFT off the market and offer another 100 coins. The coins as locked in value to the NFT because there is a bot that trades it 100:1. The NFT is locked in value because a bot guarantees stablecoin price based on the end of day rate. The value is guaranteed liquid (although possibly with delay) because the virtual stock has a real world counterpart that can be sold for full value. **Nothing Synthetic** Other key points. # Maintaining the PEG Making sure that the GLD token keeps its value is crucial. Nothing worst than a bot that say you are selling for $30 if after exchange you only get $20! In that regard every GLD token is backed 100:1 to HBD # Maintaining an offramp / liquidity If you sold the stock for $30 and have $30 in coin but can't move your profit back to the real world then things aren't great. In that regard the liquidity pool has more than enough value ($500) to cover most every withdrawl. In addition the $750 in HBD (staked) allow every GLD to be redeemed at par... with 3 days notice. # Dividends As each of those etfs were chosen because they pay out regular monthly distributions making sure that every holder gets their correct dividend is really important. Again, having a bot that looks for distributions daily and making sure that NFT holders get a full dividend and coin holders get 1/100th dividend is important. Luckily I have a bot that already distributes weekly distributions to GLD holders so I think that shouldn't take too long to code :) Side benefit: It is always good when off chain money comes onto HIVE and I love the idea of dividends coming from FIAT investments to HIVE wallets :)

#
I want to get the bots up and running and try it

I still have work to do on the bots. Right now I have a bot that tracks the different NFT's and allows for their movement back and forth. I'll have to figure out a bot that allows transfer with payment, then price inquiry via API, and repurchase of sold NFT's. ***that is a lot of work*** If I can get that all running I'll do a sandbox with a fractional token to mimic the value of the NFT at a value of 1/100th the NFT. That will take time also.
# Those are my thoughts. I am grateful that LEO has made the TTSLA virtual token. I love the idea of a HIVE stock market. I am not large enough to do it on my own but I'm looking forward to making a sandbox version in the GLD community so others can see how it can be done. Not as an investment offering, but as a working model to show how it could function. How it looks when using real accounts, real stocks, real liquidity pools, and real bots. The real side benefit? It is a way to get off chain money back onto HIVE and I believe that is so important moving forward. Show people what HIVE can do AND how it can make HIVE stronger financially :) I like that dream. I would really love to get feedback though on whether it is a good idea, bad idea, terrible idea, or just something that another party has already done. Thanks for reading.

body.title: [ENG-ESP] 📚💖 Book Review: Play Along (Windy City Series Book 4) ⚾⚕️
body.body:
ENGLISH

- - -

“I promised you I’d make sure the other blokes don’t give you a hard time, but I never said anything about myself. —⁠His lips part slightly and he gives her another wink⁠—. See you around, Doctor.”

- - -
Hi dear Hive users ✨💕!
- - -

> Hello Hello Community! ✨, Although romance has always been my comfort zone, I must admit that sports romance wasn’t a genre I’d explored much… until now. Surprisingly, this series managed to completely hook me, but to be honest, it shouldn’t come as such a surprise that baseball stories have become my favourites – after all, this sport has always held a special place in my heart ⚾💖. But if there’s one thing that really won me over, it was the Rhodes brothers. After getting to know Kai, it was simply impossible not to want to know more about Isaiah… so yes, it was only a matter of time before I ended up falling for his story 🤭✨. That’s why today we’re talking about ***Play Along (Windy City Series Book 4) ⚾⚕️***.

![Image of my property created in Canva](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kiutvariedades/23wMcxSvFzjDNkcwfhK7ACa27zwkRqefUrcLja4iAaCVpXRP686dpZXEYkGPm1PKBd4DG.png)
[Image Source Used](https://www.amazon.de/Play-Along-Windy-City-English-ebook/dp/B0CKH896T8)
---

⚾ SYNOPSIS ⚕️

> **Isaiah Rhodes** has always been the life and soul of the party. Charismatic, funny and with that energy that makes everyone want to be around him, he’s the sort of person who seems to take life in his stride… even though deep down he’s carrying more of a burden than he lets on. But when a night out in Las Vegas ends in an unexpected marriage, his life takes a turn he didn’t see coming. **Kennedy Kay** is the complete opposite: organised, focused and with a clear plan for her life. She’s known Isaiah for years, but it’s not until now—in the midst of a sham marriage that’s starting to feel all too real—that she really begins to see him. What seemed like a convenient arrangement soon turns into something deeper, forcing them to question not only what they feel, but also what they’re willing to risk. ***He had always seen her as someone almost out of reach; she had never stopped to really get to know him… 💖***

![81N8uTGkmwL._UF1000,1000_QL80_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kiutvariedades/23vsQK2kbrJYwcuxmnnJZpmbJyyVjRv6dNDVAAvKYT5bCt8Jumm1mGwFMzA4ffc1SwLHk.jpg)
[Source](https://www.amazon.de/Play-Along-Windy-City-English-ebook/dp/B0CKH896T8)
- - -

⚾ FROM THE WORST DAY OF THE YEAR… TO THE BEST DAY OF HIS LIFE ⚕️

> I’ll start by being completely honest: **I really liked this book, but it didn’t quite match the impact Kai and Miller’s story had on me**. And I think it’s important to say that right from the start, because inevitably, as they’re siblings and part of the same series, the comparison is there… and it weighs heavily. I gave it 3.5 stars, and I think that’s a pretty fair rating. It’s a book I thoroughly enjoyed, which I read really quickly because both Isaiah and Kennedy had already left me intrigued from the previous book, but emotionally it didn’t quite move me in the same way as its predecessor. However, something I do value immensely is the consistency of the story. **There are no strange ups and downs, no characters who feel out of place… everything flows quite naturally**. And that, in this sort of book, is a major plus. Furthermore, one of the aspects I liked most was the development of the romance. It isn’t immediate, it isn’t forced, and Kennedy doesn’t fall into the cliché of having the protagonist rejected for no apparent reason. In fact, something as simple as the detail that she didn’t know Isaiah was colour-blind says a great deal. Because beyond being a curious fact, it perfectly reflects what their relationship had been like up to that point: **superficial, distant, based on preconceived ideas that fuelled prejudices.**

![17768943618485847999776741815815.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kiutvariedades/AKYNxusSQ1P3VxfFiMCtRLJigA3fZYpFrEpn7LipKDcpXw6eGkzc7N93z5pQQp7.jpg)
[Source](https://booktankbd.com/products/windy-city-series?srsltid=AfmBOopuT25KZ87si_En3c0_JfljSUvAjSVza0UPLPWeJKHwg0PTnXKv)

> But that changes, and little by little, they both start to see each other for who they really are. On the one hand, Isaiah, who had always idealised Kennedy in some way, begins to get to know her as she really is. **And far from shattering that image, it only makes him love her more**. Because she is no longer a fantasy, no longer someone out of reach… *she is a real woman, with nuances, with complexities*, with everything that loving someone truly entails. And on the other hand, Kennedy also begins her own journey. **She starts to discover the Isaiah who was always there, but whom she had never stopped to observe. **And that shift in perception is what really gives the story its weight. Now, if there’s one thing I found particularly interesting, it was the way the character of Isaiah is approached from a more emotional perspective. Unlike Kai, who is more reserved, Isaiah reveals much more of the consequences of his past. Especially everything related to the loss of his mum. Not only because of the trauma caused by the way it happened, but also because of the role he took on as a result: **being the one who makes people laugh, the one who lightens the mood, the one who supports others… even when he himself isn’t well.** And that gives his character a beautiful depth, because we understand that his cheerfulness isn’t superficial; *it’s a form of survival.*

![scribbubbles_bbd3be4d779547469fbfa9e2b89d3bab.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kiutvariedades/Eoptt3igfJHRtRxWVFrMwmLzpF2PkMwN3A9mLBLwMw3oB66zJuDtMxmHtboo7WkCM7q.jpg)
[Source](https://www.instagram.com/p/DLptEB7SieG/?img_index=2&igsh=c2Zva296NnR1cWk3)

> That said, not everything was perfect. The dynamics of the physical intimacy between the main characters… didn’t quite convince me. I understand its role within the story, and I know it’s quite common in tropes like a fake marriage, but at times it felt more like a **ploy to justify the sexual element than a completely organic development of their bond**. I didn’t dislike it, but it wasn’t my favourite part either. Another aspect I feel could have been explored much further was Kennedy’s family dynamic. There was so much potential there. That more materialistic, colder, more superficial environment… contrasted perfectly with what Isaiah represents. And besides, the whole situation with his ex-partner—the affair with his stepsister—had significant emotional weight that could have been developed in greater depth. **I feel there was a story within that story that fell a bit short.**

![sanktadu1_096fda129712435f90bb6bbb5040e215.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kiutvariedades/23ynhM4xTYARNhcUVzX1LyucxXBiioEBCs82pvCnGXGZHKkuG6tNuWThNNxMhBYP7qH82.jpg)
[Source](https://www.instagram.com/p/DLTlBWFNvep/?igsh=MXF0Y2hib2F2aG9waA==)

> But if there’s one thing I definitely have to give Isaiah credit for… it’s this: **He did make a choice.** Unlike Kai (and yes, I’m going to say it 🤦🏼‍♀️), Isaiah didn’t give up on Kennedy for the sake of his career. He didn’t put her in a position where she had to choose between her career and the relationship. Quite the opposite: **he looked for ways to adapt, to come up with a plan, to move if necessary…** even if that meant moving away from his brother and his nephew, who were basically his whole world. And that… that says a great deal. ***Because it’s a love that doesn’t restrict, that doesn’t impose conditions, that doesn’t demand one-sided sacrifices.*** And I think that’s the best way to describe the love Isaiah feels for Kennedy: *his red-haired girl.*

![anianiemczak_0677f5d44d5e4bfab43cab4caa207a08.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kiutvariedades/Ep1cfVLadV4gVH2ZrTExB2Y4XKYM1g1kHaHHLmFzUKS9i6Pyc7Jk8BUara768sESeN7.jpg)
[Source](https://www.instagram.com/p/DKw1bHsK1Kl/?igsh=enhnd2VhbnB3M3c5)
- - -

“I have never looked at him or touched him for any reason other than science. But now I’m looking at him, and this certainly has nothing to do with science.”

- - -
In short, *Play Along* is a lovely, well-crafted story with characters who develop in a very realistic way. It didn’t make me feel the same way as *Caught Up*, but that doesn’t detract from its merits. It simply connects with you in a different way. Because not all stories have to break your heart to be special… some simply keep you company, entertain you and leave you with something lovely at the end. 💖
![separador nuevo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kiutvariedades/EoibzJBuKooMnVdgJahuM46NCrLqCQuNqYyj1hFhu6eT7e3G3jft7A7Tu33wLKDwTCF.png)

ESPAÑOL

- - -

“Te he prometido que me aseguraré de que los otros tíos no te hagan pasar un mal rato, pero en ningún momento he dicho nada de mí. —⁠Sus labios se separan ligeramente y le lanzo otro guiño⁠—. Te veré por ahí, doctora.”

- - -
¡Hola queridos usuarios de Hive ✨💕!
- - -

> ¡Hola Hola Comunidad! ✨ Aunque el romance siempre ha sido mi zona de confort, debo admitir que el sport romance no era un territorio que hubiese explorado demasiado… hasta ahora. Sorprendentemente, esta serie logró engancharme por completo, pero siendo honesta, no debería extrañarme tanto, que justamente las historias de béisbol se hayan convertido en mis favoritas, y es que este deporte siempre ha tenido un lugar especial para mí ⚾💖. Pero si hay algo que realmente terminó de conquistarme, fueron los hermanos Rhodes. Después de conocer a Kai, era simplemente imposible no querer saber más de Isaiah… así que sí, era cuestión de tiempo para que terminara cayendo en su historia 🤭✨. Es por ésta razón, que hoy hablaremos de ***Siguiendo el Juego (La Ciudad de los Vientos 4) ⚾⚕️***.

![Image of my property created in Canva](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kiutvariedades/23wMcxSvFzjDNkcwfhK7ACa27zwkRqefUrcLja4iAaCVpXRP686dpZXEYkGPm1PKBd4DG.png)
[Image Source Used](https://www.amazon.de/Play-Along-Windy-City-English-ebook/dp/B0CKH896T8)
- - -

⚾ SINOPSIS ⚕️

> **Isaiah Rhodes** siempre ha sido el alma de la fiesta. Carismático, divertido y con esa energía que hace que todos quieran estar cerca de él, es el tipo de persona que parece tomarse la vida a la ligera… aunque en el fondo cargue con más de lo que deja ver. Pero cuando una noche en Las Vegas termina en un matrimonio inesperado, su vida da un giro que ni él mismo vio venir. **Kennedy Kay** es todo lo contrario: estructurada, enfocada y con un plan claro para su vida. Lleva años conociendo a Isaiah, pero no es hasta ahora —en medio de un matrimonio falso que empieza a sentirse demasiado real— que realmente comienza a verlo. Lo que parecía una relación conveniente pronto se transforma en algo más profundo, obligándolos a cuestionarse no solo lo que sienten, sino también lo que están dispuestos a arriesgar. ***Él siempre la había visto como alguien casi inalcanzable, ella nunca se había detenido a conocerlo de verdad… 💖***

![17768961397334070566684507273530.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kiutvariedades/23wgMyAww3pxRaCmxJAMKX774YSiJzU8gU6B8fEBxs4kn6Z7sxbf68didvw4EtFLYrW4g.jpg)
[Source](https://www.goodreads.com/book/show/227800108)
- - -

⚾ DEL PEOR DÍA DEL AÑO… AL MEJOR DÍA DE SU VIDA ⚕️

> Voy a empezar por lo más honesto: **este libro me gustó mucho, pero no logró superar lo que sentí con la historia de Kai y Miller**. Y creo que eso es importante decirlo desde el inicio, porque inevitablemente, al ser hermanos y formar parte de la misma serie, la comparación existe… y pesa. Le di 3.5 estrellas, y creo que es una puntuación bastante justa. Es una lectura que disfruté muchísimo, que leí súper rápido porque tanto Isaiah como Kennedy ya me habían dejado intrigada desde el libro anterior, pero que emocionalmente no me terminó de tocar de la misma forma que su predecesora. Sin embargo, algo que sí valoro muchísimo es la consistencia de la historia. **No hay altibajos extraños, no hay personajes que se sientan fuera de lugar… todo fluye de manera bastante natural**. Y eso, en este tipo de libros, es un punto muy a favor. Además, uno de los aspectos que más me gustó fue la construcción del romance. No es inmediato, no es forzado, y Kennedy no cae en ese cliché de rechazar al protagonista sin razón aparente. De hecho, algo tan simple como el detalle de que no supiera que Isaiah es daltónico dice muchísimo. Porque más allá de ser un dato curioso, refleja perfectamente cómo había sido su relación hasta ese momento: **superficial, distante, basada en ideas preconcebidas que alimentaban prejuicios.**

![17768943618485847999776741815815.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kiutvariedades/AKYNxusSQ1P3VxfFiMCtRLJigA3fZYpFrEpn7LipKDcpXw6eGkzc7N93z5pQQp7.jpg)
[Source](https://booktankbd.com/products/windy-city-series?srsltid=AfmBOopuT25KZ87si_En3c0_JfljSUvAjSVza0UPLPWeJKHwg0PTnXKv)

> Pero eso cambia y poco a poco, ambos empiezan a verse de verdad. Por un lado, Isaiah, que siempre había tenido una especie de idealización hacia Kennedy, comienza a conocerla como realmente es. **Y lejos de romper esa imagen, eso solo hace que la quiera más**. Porque ya no es una fantasía, ya no es alguien inalcanzable… *es una mujer real, con matices, con complejidades*, con todo lo que implica amar a alguien de verdad. Y por otro lado, Kennedy también inicia su propio proceso. **Empieza a descubrir a ese Isaiah que siempre estuvo ahí, pero que nunca se había detenido a observar.** Y ese cambio en la percepción es lo que realmente le da peso a la historia. Ahora, si hay algo que me pareció especialmente interesante, fue la forma en la que se aborda el personaje de Isaiah desde un lugar más emocional. A diferencia de Kai, que es más contenido, Isaiah muestra mucho más las consecuencias de su pasado. Especialmente todo lo relacionado con la pérdida de su mamá. No solo por el trauma que le generó la forma en la que ocurrió, sino también por el rol que asumió a partir de eso: **ser el que hace reír, el que aligera el ambiente, el que sostiene a los demás… incluso cuando él mismo no está bien.** Y eso le da una profundidad muy bonita a su personaje, porque entendemos que su alegría no es superficial, *es una forma de supervivencia.*

![scribbubbles_bbd3be4d779547469fbfa9e2b89d3bab.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kiutvariedades/Eoptt3igfJHRtRxWVFrMwmLzpF2PkMwN3A9mLBLwMw3oB66zJuDtMxmHtboo7WkCM7q.jpg)
[Source](https://www.instagram.com/p/DLptEB7SieG/?img_index=2&igsh=c2Zva296NnR1cWk3)

> Ahora bien, no todo fue perfecto. La dinámica de acercamiento físico entre los protagonistas… no terminó de convencerme del todo. Entiendo su función dentro de la historia, y sé que es algo bastante común en este tipo de tropos como el matrimonio falso, pero en ciertos momentos se sentía más como un **recurso para justificar el componente sexual que como una evolución completamente orgánica del vínculo**. No me disgustó, pero tampoco fue lo que más disfruté. Otro punto que siento que se pudo haber explorado mucho más fue la dinámica familiar de Kennedy. Había muchísimo potencial ahí. Ese entorno más materialista, más frío, más enfocado en lo superficial… contrastaba perfectamente con lo que Isaiah representa. Y además, toda la situación con su ex pareja —la infidelidad con su hermanastra— tenía una carga emocional importante que pudo haberse desarrollado con más profundidad. **Siento que había una historia dentro de esa historia que se quedó un poco corta.**

![sanktadu1_096fda129712435f90bb6bbb5040e215.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kiutvariedades/23ynhM4xTYARNhcUVzX1LyucxXBiioEBCs82pvCnGXGZHKkuG6tNuWThNNxMhBYP7qH82.jpg)
[Source](https://www.instagram.com/p/DLTlBWFNvep/?igsh=MXF0Y2hib2F2aG9waA==)

> Pero si hay algo que definitivamente tengo que aplaudirle a Isaiah… es esto: **Él sí eligió.** A diferencia de Kai (y sí, lo voy a decir 🤦🏼‍♀️), Isaiah no renunció a Kennedy por sus oportunidades laborales. No la puso en una posición donde tuviera que elegir entre su carrera y la relación. Todo lo contrario: **él buscó la forma de adaptarse, de construir un plan, de moverse si era necesario…** incluso si eso implicaba alejarse de su hermano y de su sobrino, que eran básicamente su mundo. Y eso… eso dice muchísimo. ***Porque es un amor que no limita, que no condiciona, que no exige sacrificios unilaterales.*** Y me parece que esa es la mejor forma de describir, el amor que Isaiah siente por Kenney: *su chica de cabello rojo.*

![anianiemczak_0677f5d44d5e4bfab43cab4caa207a08.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kiutvariedades/Ep1cfVLadV4gVH2ZrTExB2Y4XKYM1g1kHaHHLmFzUKS9i6Pyc7Jk8BUara768sESeN7.jpg)
[Source](https://www.instagram.com/p/DKw1bHsK1Kl/?igsh=enhnd2VhbnB3M3c5)
- - -

“Nunca le he mirado ni tocado por otra razón que no sea la ciencia. Pero ahora le estoy mirando y, decididamente, esto no guarda ninguna relación con la ciencia.”

- - -
En resumen, *Siguiendo el Juego* es una historia bonita, consistente y con personajes que evolucionan de una manera muy real. No me hizo sentir lo mismo que Caught Up, pero eso no le quita mérito. Simplemente conecta desde otro lugar. Porque no todas las historias tienen que romperte el corazón para ser especiales… algunas simplemente te acompañan, te entretienen y te dejan algo bonito al final. 💖

我又和帅哥去吃了麻辣烫，上次吃麻辣烫花了60+，我不服气，又带帅哥去了另外一家，这家没有前一家的汤浓郁，但是味道也不错。

单价是20.80一斤，之前那家是26.8一斤，这次两个人点了43+吃得撑撑的，米饭和酸梅汁自助无限续，我感觉还是这里性价比高一点，以前上学的时候就爱吃这家，只是我可能口味变重了，感觉没有以前浓郁了，所以感觉味道差一点点。

吃完麻辣烫出来，发现隔壁还有一家石锅鱼的店铺，还有团购80-90双人餐，帅哥说下次可以来看看。

吃饱了又热，我和帅哥就去了楼下的超市，琳琅满目的零食和商品，最后我俩选了一个甘美西瓜，严格来说是我坚持要买的。因为我一直觉得买甘美西瓜很奢侈，一般都不便宜。

这次超市特价2块钱一斤，我肯定不能错过，买了我就说要验瓜，打开一看，比我之前买的宏好多，籽也比较少，看着要好吃很多，很诱人。天热帅哥又买了两斤绿豆，说煮绿豆粥喝。这个绿豆还蛮贵的，6-7块钱一斤，买了两斤多15+。

其他也不懂买啥了，我俩就打算走了。帅哥想买火龙果，我们又去了其他超市，结果也是不太新鲜，但是为了吃到火龙果，不新鲜也买了两个。看到那个芹菜很新鲜也买了一把，还买了油果。

去到菜市，又看到了卖鸭子的有鸭血卖，一问，0.5元一碗，老板说买鸭子送鸭血。我一问15元一斤鸭肉，刚好还剩半边，我就直接买了，花了36块钱，老板要收摊了，送了八碗鸭血给我们。老板也是真豪气，她问我要几碗，我说拿多几碗呗，帅哥可能不好意思，说要两碗就得了喂🤣后面老板说要四五碗、五六碗也可以啊，结果最后给我们装了八碗。

带着一堆吃的和菜满载而归了。最后帅哥的外卖箱都装满了。回到楼下只好把车骑到门口上楼放好东西再下来挪车放到放车的地方🙈

今天运气不错，没想到朋友从香港过来那么快，一个小时多点儿到广州新塘南站啦！真是好快，比我想象中的都要快啊哈哈！而且九点半到了，太好啦！我带他周围走走，喝一杯瑞幸咖啡后再去吃古田居日本料理！

我换好美美的裙子就出发，他说我穿的太漂亮了，他好像麦当劳叔叔！我买的新衣服不穿出去臭美就对不起自己啦！还好大家没迷路，很快见到面啦。他说买了回程票再出去瑞幸咖啡，那也没事！他急着今晚去上班，买了下午一点五十分的票票！

我带他去看了美食街，再去瑞幸咖啡！他说真的太多吃的，又带了他逛大润发！朋友中意逛商场，觉得很大很漂亮！

我美团了两个小黄油咖啡，都要冰的和小小甜！十点半就在店里扫码确认，我们坐门外的位置喝咖啡聊天！觉得还是生椰拿铁好喝，虽然这个热量低！

我们聊了运动的话题，他新家和工作的话题！感觉好开心，他说我比以前健康很多，手也没抖！叫我不要太心急上班，等身体再好点儿！我比较中意倾听他说话，我适当的回应他的话！感觉喝的挺饱饱的，就慢慢的步行去古田居！

Aquí está la letra: No pierdo el tiempo invocando al Señor No pierdo el tiempo invocando al Señor Ayea aaa, ayeaa aaa Letra escrita a mano por mí Esta canción me inspira mucho cuando siento que no solo pierdo el tiempo, sino que también siento que estoy desperdiciando. La presencia de Dios es la cura para el desperdicio, porque nada se puede desperdiciar ante su Creador; Él hará algo hermoso de ello. https://youtu.be/PBqOWbH-ay4?si=qeQqK1ZBcskDiYwj

@merit.ahama proposal seems simple, but since its presentation I have read and reread it; How many times have I sought refuge and strength among those places she names. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWFVFxNgvdo9Us4ShJnBrmhnKSnC8AvcM9fLb4Tfzw8Tn/img_20260422_202320.jpg)

I am a person who prefers the warmth and silence of home. My most faithful companions have been cinema and literature, and I adore it; I always preferred watching a movie rather than going out, or getting lost in the pages of a book rather than seeking adventure in the streets. I don't know how to answer; There have been so many letters that have helped me understand life, so many lives lived between images. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYfPSPDsykQYupVArN1HT2hG7RoBoWYZSZjfazLBeSYTK/img_20260422_210810.jpg)

​One of the strongest images that still lingers in my head was that of that first Dracula made into a movie (now I don't remember by whom). It was one of my first films; I saw her very young. My grandfather loved cinema and I was always very attached to it. And well, what did Dracula teach me? Well, although it may seem like a joke, it showed me that it is always good to watch your back. To stay in tune, now the images that Stephen King's The Shining left me come to mind; I think he showed me that truth so often repeated in a popular saying because, as it says: \

brought me the truth about love, capable of turning pain into a smile and bitterness into hope. Alice in Wonderland was one of my first books; I loved it and made it my way of life. I have always felt identified with her. Momo, another of those magical books that have accompanied me, gave me the strength to know that no time is wasted time. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbFKAibrpELg5df4PJQiynU4AAgCyxgtwy2pRPdXUXXZh/img_20260422_210519.jpg)

​I think I'm jumping because, as I write, ideas enter and escape my head. I've never been into podcasts or watching much YouTube; I am from the \

, the one that loved movie theaters and the smell of the pages. 

Perhaps I have already commented too much, but my favorite place has always been poetry. While some verses by Jaime Sabines hover in my head, I confess that in them is that look that I hope will embrace me one day. 

​Thank you for reading me. I hug you and leave you these verses from Walt Whitman, which I hope will also serve you as much as they do me:

​\

***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmakXP7KpSYiFhT8kE4nTDarAozzoLhC8BwuMrJR1Dekzd/azul_20y_20rosa_20moderno_20tecnolog_c3_ada_20electr_c3_b3nica_20y_20tecnolog_c3_ada_20retractable_20exhibic_20251026_022842_0000.png)

***

​Parece simple la propuesta de @merit.ahama, pero desde su presentación la leo y releo; cuántas veces he buscado refugio y fuerza entre esos sitios que ella nombra.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmekfLqfoCsh2ZeLSSMtbi2sN8WfCVau6FifiW3MDT1s4V/img_20260422_211357.jpg)

​Soy una persona que prefiere el calor y el silencio del hogar. Mis compañeros más fieles han sido el cine y la literatura, y lo adoro; siempre preferí ver una película a una salida, o perderme entre las páginas de un libro antes que buscar la aventura en las calles. No sé cómo responder; han sido tantas las letras que me han ayudado a entender la vida, tantas las vidas vividas entre imágenes.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYfPSPDsykQYupVArN1HT2hG7RoBoWYZSZjfazLBeSYTK/img_20260422_210810.jpg)

​Una de las imágenes más fuertes que aún perdura en mi cabeza fue la de aquel primer Drácula llevado al cine (ahora no recuerdo por quién). Fue una de mis primeras películas; la vi muy niña. Mi abuelo adoraba el cine y siempre fui muy pegada a él. Y bueno, ¿qué me enseñó Drácula? Pues, aunque parezca broma, me mostró que siempre es bueno cuidarse las espaldas. Para seguir a tono, ahora llegan a mi mente las imágenes que me dejó El resplandor de Stephen King; creo que me mostró esa verdad tan repetida en un refrán popular porque, como dice: \

me trajo la verdad sobre el amor, capaz de convertir el dolor en sonrisa y lo amargo en esperanza. Alicia en el país de las maravillas fue de mis primeros libros; lo amé y lo convertí en mi modo de vivir. Siempre me he sentido identificada con ella. Momo, otro de esos libros mágicos que me han acompañado, me dio la fuerza de saber que ningún tiempo es tiempo perdido.\n​Creo que voy dando saltos porque, mientras escribo, las ideas entran y escapan de mi cabeza. Nunca he sido de podcasts o de ver mucho YouTube; soy de la \

, esa que adoraba las salas de cine y el olor de las páginas.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdNFn8z3XZffsQ7Ud9t9xuzqGNwCiGiAD1jaYLc1fVMsL/img_20260422_211425.jpg)

​Quizás ya he comentado de más, pero mi lugar preferido siempre ha sido la poesía. Mientras en mi cabeza rondan algunos versos de Jaime Sabines, les confieso que en ellos está esa mirada que espero me abrace algún día.

​Gracias por leerme. Les abrazo y les dejo estos versos de Walt Whitman, que espero también les sirvan a ustedes tanto como a mí:

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPbMyZJxCMJZaPthHEc4sGZjzg3U1kKXwQKPzaVqds1nd/1776907249588.jpg)


EPL Round 34 ပွဲစဉ် အချို့ ထပ်မံ ကစားခဲ့၏။ Bournemouth vs Leeds ပွဲစဉ်မှာတော့ တဖက် ၂ ဂိုးစီ သရေကျသွားခဲ့လေ၏။ ၁၄ ပွဲဆက် ရှုံးပွဲ မရှိ စံချိန်ကို Bournemouth တို့ ရရှိသွားခဲ့လေ၏။ ယခုပွဲစဉ်မှာ Bournemouth တို့ ၂-၁ ဖြင့် အနိုင်ရမှာ ဖြစ်ပေမဲ့။ ကံကြမ္မာက Leeds ကိုလည်း မျက်နှာသာ ပေးခဲ့လေ၏။ ၂ သင်းလုံး အတွက် ရှဉ့်လည်း လျှောက်သာ၊ ပျားလည်း စွဲသာ အခြေအနေမျိုး ဖြစ်၏။ 

Bournemouth အနေဖြင့် အနိုင်ရခဲ့ရင် အဆင့် ၆ နေရာထိ တက်လှမ်းနိုင်မှာ ဖြစ်ပေမဲ့ သရေ ရလဒ်ကြောင့် အဆင့် ၇ နေရာဖြင့်သာ ကျေနပ်ခဲ့ရ၏။ Chelsea ကတော့ အဆင့် ၈ နေရာထိ ဆင်းပေးခဲ့ရလေ၏။ Bournemouth တို့ အကြိမ်ကြိမ် ဦးဆောင်ဂိုးတွေ သွင်းယူခဲ့ပေမဲ့ Leeds ကလည်း ချေပနိုင်ခဲ့၏။ ၆၀ မိနစ်မှာ Bournemouth တို့ ဦးဆောင်ဂိုး သွင်း၏။ ၆၈ မိနစ်မှာ Leeds တို့ ချေပဂိုး ရ၏။ ၈၅ မိနစ်မှာ Bournemouth တို့ ဦးဆောင်ဂိုး သွင်း၏။ ဒီရလဒ်ဖြင့် ပွဲပြီးပြီ ထင်မှတ်ထားချိန် ၉၀+၇ မိနစ် အရောက်မှာ Leeds က ချေပဂိုး ပြန်လည်လို့ သွင်းယူသွားခဲ့၏။


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNu4n9Laa3VZCDtVWRwZRCxjQbk2B5aK6uaGLHprzvgtN/1776907249607.jpg)


သရေ ရလဒ်ကြောင့် Bournemouth အနေဖြင့် အဆင့် ၆ နေရာထိ မတက်လှမ်း နိုင်ခဲ့ပေမဲ့ Leeds အနေနဲ့ကတော့ တန်းဆင်းဇုန်နဲ့ ဝေးရာ နေရာမှာ ရပ်တည်နိုင်ဖို့ အခြေအနေ ကောင်းမွန် သွားခဲ့ပြီ ဖြစ်၏။ နောက်ထပ် တပွဲကတော့ Burnley vs Man City တို့၏ ပွဲစဉ် ဖြစ်၏။

ဒီလထဲမှာ အသင်းကြီးတွေကို ၂ ဂိုး အနည်းဆုံးသွင်းပြီး အနိုင်ယူပြခဲ့သည့် City ဒီတခေါက် Burnley နဲ့ အတွေ့မှာတော့ ၀-၁ ဖြင့်သာ အနိုင်ရသွားခဲ့လေ၏။ မသိရင် Arsenal ကို တမင်ကလိနေသလိုပင်။ အမှတ်တူ ဂိုးရလဒ်တူ နေပေမဲ့ head to head အရ City က အဆင့် ၁ နေရာကို ရယူသွားခဲ့လေ၏။ ၁ ဂိုးလောက် ထပ်သွင်းပြီး ၁ ဂိုးအသာဖြင့် အဆင့် ၁ နေရာကို ယူလိုက်ရင် ဘာဖြစ်သွားမှာ စိုးလို့လဲပေါ့။ 

ပွဲအစ ၅ မိနစ်မှာ သွင်းယူခဲ့သည့် တလုံးထဲသော ဂိုးဖြင့် ပွဲပြီးသွားခဲ့၏။ City လည်း ဂိုးတွေ သွင်းရတာ ပင်ပန်းသွားလို့ ထင်ပါရဲ့။ ဒါပေမဲ့ တန်းဆင်းထားရပြီး အသင်းမို့ အားနာလို့ ဂိုးအများကြီး မသွင်းလေသလားပေါ့။ ဒါမှ မဟုတ် အထက်မှာ ပြောခဲ့သည့်အတိုင်း ၁ ဂိုးထဲနဲ့ နိုင်လည်း ငါတို့က အဆင့် ၁ နေရာ ရတယ်ဆိုပြီး ပြချင်လို့ပဲလားပေါ့။ မည်သို့ပင် ဆိုစေ Arsenal ကာလအတော်ကြာ ရယူခဲ့သည့် အဆင့် ၁ နေရာကို City တို့ လက်လွှဲ ယူသွားခဲ့လေပြီ။ လက်ကျန် ၄ ပွဲထိပါ သိမ်းယူထားပြီး ချန်ပီယံဘွဲ့ကို အရယူသွားမလား၊ ဒါမှ မဟုတ် Arsenal ကပဲ ဒုတိယလူ ကျိန်စာဆိုးကို ချေဖျက် ပြသွားနိုင်မလားကတော့ စိတ်ဝင်စားဖွယ် စောင့်ကြည့်ရပေလိမ့်မည်။

body.title: My Actifit Report Card: April 23 2026
body.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g63fd74ab518845a4f0dceb829889cb8a3d04361c090c901040ca8e6d7aff31be239952d86465c32baf2b0c28669b643df77f777c503c38a87c7244e7c1d7b40f_640.jpg)
Hoy fue una caminata bastante interesante. Comencé mi recorrido por un parque local donde el aire fresco me llenó de energía. Mientras paseaba, conocí a una madre y su pequeño hijo que estaban alimentando a las palomas. El niño, con una sonrisa brillante, me contó que quería ser un astronauta cuando sea grande, lo que me recordó la importancia de nunca dejar de soñar. Más adelante, me topé con un grupo de artistas callejeros que estaban pintando un mural vibrante en una de las paredes de un edificio. Me detuve un momento para admirar su trabajo. Ellos estaban retratando escenas de la vida urbana y el ambiente era contagiosamente creativo. Me sentí inspirado por su pasión y dedicación. Finalmente, al llegar a una pequeña cafetería, decidí detenerme a disfrutar de un café. El lugar estaba lleno de gente, y escuché a dos amigos hablando sobre sus planes de viaje. Todo en mi caminata de hoy me recordó la riqueza de la vida cotidiana y las pequeñas conexiones que podemos hacer con los demás. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@titusfrost/actifit-titusfrost-20231229t015511428z)_

|     Genus Eurema      |      Apr 22, 2026      |       Vodrochol, Ullapara, Bangladesh      | 

Yesterday afternoon, I caught sight of this beautiful yellow butterfly. It was sitting on a small tree branch, as if it was resting quietly on its own. Its wings showed light stains and some signs of decay. Even then, its beauty had not diminished, it looked wonderfully beautiful.

Butterflies always bring a kind of soft beauty. Their color, posture and presence make the environment different. This butterfly is just like that, its yellow color stands out beautifully among the surrounding greenery.

Butterflies are truly wonderful creatures. They come in many different shapes. Some butterflies are more fickle.

body.title: Pizza A Slice of Madness Brawl Report
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQXxxnCtPvmQQ4Q8Kfq6gXmBbDvSFcdttfV4fCuSg2FUZ/image.png)

Greetings to all Splinterlands players and hive gaming community! This is my report for Pizza A Slice of Madness brawl. We are a guild that plays for fun, competitions and rewards. We play in the weekly guild brawls where we fight with other guilds for the fun challenge and rewards. This is our battle report for the week.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf2x6Ui9aG1QMGHoD3weawfV1T5BYM5zeZsQXcA7rXqTb/image.png)

***Overall Guild Rank: Fifth Place***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdAZ3Y56B2Xyy3ytNZavGZv1Sjbf5hZs4tCRkAmeN5gyA/image.png)

We were ranked fifth in this week's brawl and lost our consistent third place. We were grouped with strong guilds this time with Goat Gang and Lux Aeterna taking huge leads over us in third and fourth rank respectively. We had a healthy ten win lead against six placer Earn guild.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf2x6Ui9aG1QMGHoD3weawfV1T5BYM5zeZsQXcA7rXqTb/image.png)

***Top Brawl Participants and my Rank*** 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfDRF9X8PHN8GDu4rAPeeqQ7bwT9KPFuQrc8CzLBHwAyT/image.png)

I shared rank eighth to ninth in our guild's top contributors with a 7-2 win loss record. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf2x6Ui9aG1QMGHoD3weawfV1T5BYM5zeZsQXcA7rXqTb/image.png)

***Selected Games***

Here I present three of the games that I won.

**Game 1**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfJf22LZDbYiC7PXH8X6Z1w256ivvd91FvSirpVKPrqzV/image.png)

Maneuvers modifier means that I can play Quora behind Dread Tafarian and still use her dual attack. There followed my three archers with high attacks including legendary A'lan Musketeer with double strike skill. In last place was New Beluroc Aegis to attract attacks from the opponent. My opponent had a legendary gladiator to reinforce his team but my combination was a better mix of offensive and defensive cards. 

Game link: https://splinterlands.com/battle/sm_Qbj79tUHj5zKBhmIUE0L?ref=iamchessguy

**Game 2**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaim3p4F3qxkUzCGUZEpaepnnis9euYPNUVzgLM9HyFfU/image.png)

Game two had Back to Basics modifier. Quora's skills is no use in this game so I had Korthipus Bayne for my gladiator card. He has twelve life to stay long in the game. My dps units were an archer and two magic units. My opponent's cards were a good team if not for Back to Basics modifier. The thing is their skills don't work which means no healing, no reach skill so his second card cannot attack. My cards were not impeded and were able to attack from their positions. They were also not dependent on their skills so this was my win.

Game link: https://splinterlands.com/battle/sm_sshfhmeWApTpjGXCJkvh?ref=iamchessguy

**Game 3**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZxaxXdtZAU6AECZVsPc7rEkuVBJCYX7mHVXruWjiHCDe/image.png)

Game three had Super Sneak modifier which means I can place Quora in any position and still can use her dual attacks. I also had the Dire Bear in the team with its three melee attack and is very strong. Because of the modifier, I had New Beluroc Aegis guard the rear. My opponent opted for Katrelba Gobson as a gladiator card. He didn't use much melee and his last card, Great Bear Druid was soft on defense. It got killed by Quora and started her bloodlust early. This paved the way for my winning the game. 

Game link: https://splinterlands.com/battle/sm_ocQ4nLZqMckKurjEGBW4?ref=iamchessguy

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf2x6Ui9aG1QMGHoD3weawfV1T5BYM5zeZsQXcA7rXqTb/image.png)

***Spending the Rewards***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTmxpvUPfkTG2Cf1HagiFk2SGj5qqzxbRuEPNCniJc9jF/image.png)

I had another Quora and more rare cards in the mix. While there are no legendary cards, it's not a bad pull either. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfUu5affYm36tb7M3tL8pUNehBZfD1ngX93wzahk2Lg8P/image.png)


There were cards that were upgraded after opening the chests. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf2x6Ui9aG1QMGHoD3weawfV1T5BYM5zeZsQXcA7rXqTb/image.png)


***Conclusion***

We earned 3,500 merits and 24 SPS from the brawl. The reward is generous that we get just from joining and playing brawls. With regular brawls, it adds to my weekly SPS stake. I'm grateful to the Pizza guild for accepting me as a member and gave me a regular spot to join the brawls and earn rewards.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf2x6Ui9aG1QMGHoD3weawfV1T5BYM5zeZsQXcA7rXqTb/image.png)

***My Referrals***

If this post interests you and you are not playing Splinterlands yet, please consider joining this wonderful game using my referral.

https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=iamchessguy

Be active. Walk or run and earn afit tokens! Join me at actifit.io

https://actifit.io/signup?referrer=chessguy-actifit

body.title: Tour of Las Flores Street and San Francisco Convent (Eng - Esp)
body.body:
>

**<center>INGLÉS</center>**



Cumaná, known as the firstborn city of the Americas, has an interesting history, an excellent location, beautiful beaches, and colonial streets and buildings with much to tell. Last year, I had the opportunity to explore several streets in the city that I was completely unfamiliar with. One of them was Calle Las Flores, located in the historic center of the San Francisco sector. This street is notable for its spacious houses, or \
as they are also known, which occupy a large portion of the corners on long, narrow streets. One of the houses that impressed and pleased me is called \

According to information provided by a gentleman I had the opportunity to speak with, this house belongs to a well-established family in the city, and a commercial establishment will operate there. What's interesting about this house is that it's very old. It was restored, but the original design was maintained. In the first photograph, you can see the extent of the house, which covers almost a whole block, from the corner to the other end, approximately three-quarters of the street. It has several doors, windows, and a cement floor with tiles. In the next photo, we see a corner window, followed by a door, and then several more windows and doors. It gives the impression that it's several houses in one, but at that time, houses had numerous doors and windows because family members, servants, and others were located in different areas.

>

**<center>ESPAÑOL</center>**




Cumaná conocida como la primogénita del continente americano tiene una intresante historia, excelente ubicación, lindas playas,  calles y vasas coloniales  con mucho por decir,  el año pasado tuve la oportunidad de recorrer varias calles de la ciudad que desconocía por completo,  una de ellas fue la calle las Flores ubicada en el casco histórico del sector San Francisco,  esta calle destaca por sus amplias casas o casonas, como también se les conoce, las cuales abarcan gran parte de las esquinas en calles largas y angostas, una de las casas que me impresionó y me gustó es la que  se llama \

Lo interesante de esta casa es que tiene muchos años de construida, fue restaurada pero manteniendo, el diseño original, en la primera fotografía se observa la extensión de la casa, que abarca casi una cuadra, desde la esquina hasta el otro extremo cubra aproximadamente tres cuartas partes de la calle, tiene varias puertas, ventanas y el piso de cemento con caico, en la siguiente foto vemos la body.title: Freewrite || Between Boats and Hope
body.body:
![PSX_20260423_080410.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWWbY8hqRZ4HtY6U6NDpWyLrddm8FuxVRe7UxKUxMqLPe/PSX_20260423_080410.jpg)
![hive dividers-04.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvc788wxsBSQHY3z21o3wSTU7hqRnyYc2JFEn2pEYSev/hive%20dividers-04.png)
The afternoon felt so bright, as if the sun was eager to demonstrate its power without hesitation. At the edge of the pier, rows of colorful boats rested after a long journey at sea. The air seemed calm, but beneath that serenity hid a story that was never simple.

I stood for a moment, observing each of the neatly tied boats. There were hanging nets, stacked buoys, and tangled yet functional ropes. All of these were not mere objects, but part of the life that continues to revolve in this place.

Each boat had its own story. Some had just returned with a substantial catch, while others might have returned empty-handed. But one thing was in common: they all set out with hope and returned with lessons.

The sea breeze occasionally greeted us, bringing a distinctive salty aroma. The stops, the sound of the boats' engines, and the fishermen's conversations blended into a familiar rhythm. I realized that this place was more than just a harbor, but also a space where hard work and patience intersect every day.

Beneath the heat of the sun and the sometimes unfriendly air, there's a steadfastness that persists. The fishermen never truly stop. They simply pause for a moment, before returning to the sea and braving a new day.

Seeing all this, I'm reminded that life is like these boats. Sometimes calm, sometimes adrift. But as long as we persevere and keep moving forward, there's always a chance to return with something valuable.
![hive dividers-04.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvc788wxsBSQHY3z21o3wSTU7hqRnyYc2JFEn2pEYSev/hive%20dividers-04.png)

#



LA SUPREMACÍA MUNDIAL

Se fueron callados
por la tortura del silencio
que domina el mundo
que domina el suprematismo
y su poder es destructor.

Cualquiera que se crea 
que el mundo nos pertenece
es una bofetada 
para las oligarquías
del planeta
que hoy te vigilan
para que te vuelvas esclavo
de las nuevas tecnologías.

Tenemos que despertar
antes que llegue lo imaginable
eso que cres ver y no es
es el sucio engaño
de los supremáticos del mundo.

Despertemos la conciencia
es tiempo de abrir nuestra mente
y nuestra voluntad
para luchar contra los asesinos
de los que pensamos con cordura.

#

![photo_2026-02-22_13-59-34.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZBhWsqMhysu7huZNUjASro1DLogADUxRZyAYCMdW4hX3/photo_2026-02-22_13-59-34.jpg)


#

WORLD SUPREMACY

They left in silence
from the torture of silence
that dominates the world
that dominates supremacism
and its power is destructive.

Anyone who believes
that the world belongs to us
is a slap in the face
to the oligarchies
of the planet
that today watch you
so that you become a slave
to new technologies.

We must awaken
before the unimaginable arrives
that which you think you see but isn't
is the dirty deception
of the world's supremacists.

Let us awaken our consciousness
it is time to open our minds
and our will
to fight against the murderers
of those of us who think rationally.


#

body.title: Unreal / Thursday / Peaceful
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdejTEudrm2ogKn7WYaWRkjBjyDTEjoih4wwA1G53KXiP/img_20260422_214827.jpg)

### Unreal
My friend recently talked about her experience when she lost her mom. I can feel her pain because those who also lost a parent can relate. It even feels so unreal, and your emotions can swing in ways you haven't felt before. 
I remember even seeing any of my parents in my sleep. It felt real that they're alive, but at the back of my head, I know they're already gone. There's a bit of happiness seeing them alive, but loneliness kicks in because the reality is they're not here anymore. You end up opening your eyes from sleep with tears. 
No matter what your age already is, there will always be a missing piece in you with your parents' absence.

### Thursday 
Days has already passed. Seriously, time is moving fast-paced. It's becoming hotter due to the summer season. There are thunderstorms in other places but I hope not in our place. Just a rain will do. 

### Peaceful
Loving this peaceful place we visited in Buguias, where we also had our accommodation. They're gifted with such beauty and peace. Of course, there are downsides. Still, being in this place feels like being in paradise.

body.title: Calling All Zinesters with Integrity!
body.body:
3 years ago, I published a paperback, all-ages anthology arts and literature zine featuring original and clean handmade comics, drawings, and stories from many different creators around the world.
*This summer I'm doing it again.*
Let me know if you'd like to get involved.

I have been making zines and artist's books since the mid 1980s. It has been a lifelong passion that never gets old. Here's the trailer from the zine I released 3 years ago.
https://youtu.be/zZsUvi7LlxQ?si=JTthjY056NPX7Rpv

The new zine I plan to release in summer 2026 will have a different title, but the same joyful, fun, and friendly spirit. Also some of the same great creators from last time have already committed to contributing new creations for the upcoming zine.

If making zine content that is light-hearted yet sophisticated, while also being all-ages friendly, but with no AI, please reach out and perhaps you can join the project too.

body.title: Bandana para el cabello [Esp/Eng]
body.body:
>  ![336768.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23xevVBer3GuRnvCTV7BziZb7Px4u7rLNAiqeFDDiCo867Q8hDGQmSa9Gz5EApkKdTzod.jpg) Hola, ¿qué tal, amiguis, cómo están? Por aquí todo muy pero muy bien, gracias a Dios, en este preciso momento descansando luego de un día bastante largo y agotador de trabajo; ustedes cuenten cómo les va, espero que muy bien y que, de no ser así, de todo corazón que mejore.
Hi there, how are you all doing, mates? Everything’s going really, really well here, thank goodness. Right now, I’m taking a break after a rather long and tiring day at work. Let me know how things are going for you; I hope you’re doing well, and if not, I sincerely hope things improve.
![20260422_185431.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23tmWXkLc4Yzq6f6YY2rxfTzCrjr37Rkz2vo3icNuNfWTGZb54u4jVFaCApEuDznD86Uk.jpg) Hoy estaba revisando mi lugar feliz; así le digo yo a mi lugar de coser porque es donde se me olvida todo y fluyen las ideas, encontré un pedacito de tela de microdurazno que es como tipo peluche; yo, la verdad es que no me acuerdo para que fue que la use o que hice con ella porque en serio que no recuerdo pero los que conocen el microdurazno saben que es una tela bastante flexible que se adapta muy facil a todo el problema de ella no es su comodida, mayormente es lo incomodo que resulta coserla. Después de darme mil vueltas en mi cabeza sobre que podía hacer, pensé en unas bandanas para el cabello, saben esas que usan las chicas bien cool para ir al gym, pero yo la quería realmente para estar en la casa y maquillarme correctamente sin que los cabellos se me vengan a la cara, así que es muy fácil, vamos por ella.
Today I was having a look around my happy place – that’s what I call my sewing corner because it’s where I forget everything and ideas just flow – and I found a little piece of micro-plush fabric, which is kind of like a soft toy; To be honest, I can’t remember what I used it for or what I did with it because I really can’t recall, but those who know micro-plush know it’s a fairly flexible fabric that adapts very easily to everything. The problem with it isn’t its comfort; it’s mainly how awkward it is to sew. After mulling it over in my head a thousand times, I thought of some hair bandanas – you know, the ones those really cool girls wear to the gym. But I actually wanted one for wearing at home so I could apply my make-up properly without my hair getting in my face. So it’s very simple – let’s get on with it.
![20260422_190327.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23t7v2HU2jHTQG7NVDu6P4sHbSzQPyUB66VEHQ85SV24rPKnarWGzgZr149JQTgrji5eB.jpg) Así que saqué un rectángulo grande de 46 cm de largo y 23 cm de ancho. Este ancho lo vamos a dividir entre dos, que más o menos son 11 cm, ya que yo tampoco quería que fuera algo muy grueso.
So I cut out a large rectangle measuring 46 cm long and 23 cm wide. We’re going to halve that width, which comes to about 11 cm, as I didn’t want it to be too thick either.
![20260422_190813.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23tSgr8TeK519s4Hd3vd6ewSoZ5reU295BzjVyMHGXUkW59epmhFiy7Npz5C1KeYtU1vp.jpg) ![20260422_190632.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23ywcVK5uALX4cxBXdFZJmGG3hbVhN36J1Zishd7QYqGiHnTJTcFcCuzPydfytUNmpARB.jpg) ![20260422_190858.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23tSer31VwcaYDQndU7HLywuppkJa9Rr4tfKouuSkAbkQTnNHmt5yGL4vawinG9mqXQVY.jpg) Una vez que ya tenemos vamos a unirlo por ambas puntas y luego hacemos que nuestra costura quede en el centro para hacer la famosa tecnica samdwich, cabe destacar que la costura debe quedar por dentro y la parte derecha por fuera.
,Once we have that, we’ll join the two ends together and then position the seam in the centre to create the famous sandwich technique. It’s worth noting that the seam should be on the inside and the right side facing outwards.
![20260422_190946.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23w2sW1QzhohvsoFj6DVvPbPQQLtj1eiBD7XBDrZ8daPid9sM9xh9pK2MRCbQKbu1eFZy.jpg) ![20260422_191150.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23xov5wzm5k9W8bodmNj8ZgLNawVDgkgSmJ5EjWvyTXrCs9hzn5aHSS9fwJXG63i1NVnp.jpg) ![20260422_191015.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23vsUYr2Ta88mSPFQt9RAsDkkDwdt9XJwFWP615NLKS2nRRwuk6gvfcyuDN16EHjA4Mex.jpg) ![20260422_191345.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23xeBek3XQ9pKce99HF9UbZ6f3xWxYqwFytAi75t2DYGsJKh9UQxoSo56Js16o7SUZRcT.jpg) Para hacer esta tecnica vamos a doblar toda la parte de arriba para que quede en el centro y la parte de abajo la vamos a unir para ir cosiendo y a medida que vamos cosiendo vamos sacando el que esta adentro y acomodando para coser.
To do this, we’re going to fold the top section over so that it sits in the centre, and we’ll join the bottom section as we sew; as we sew, we’ll pull out the inner layer and adjust it to make sure it’s positioned correctly.
![20260422_191810.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23xowwtN1NiQLyihyyqae7kvwAqFCWzLLUG72Ahy5C9GLe9QPceVcZZhAabgXqXMZe1GB.jpg) ![20260422_192826.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23wWrwVCrwxsfd7oMg3hCwYkhAkLLeJgiT8oKYMwP9mHQD21P9CHWbKDW8hnddHBEHEgk.jpg) ![20260422_191728.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23ywenpqoN9vq2RjkHfBzdm27Zwx14ABScBAGHGwCHDrGh5wAVh98fobeHiMWSpa5EDFu.jpg) ![20260422_192907.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23tvo2ynksej7gYerbzsNBwwgbgkrYsbHu9gChsBwWut4f5ete8qemyiwnNbj67PZAHDK.jpg) Una vez que vamos cerrando van a ver el final porque se van a conseguir con la otra costura, aqui es importante que dejen un huequito muy pequeño por donde vamos a darle la vuelta y luego coceremos esa pequeña avertura a mano para que no se note, disculpen que elegi el hilo negro jajajaja esta tecnica se puede usar tambien para las colitas para el cabello.
As we’re finishing off, you’ll see the end because the two seams will meet; here it’s important to leave a tiny opening through which we’ll turn it inside out, and then we’ll sew that little opening up by hand so it’s not noticeable. Sorry I chose black thread, ha ha ha! This technique can also be used for hair ties.
![20260422_193605.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23ynats5d4mE93wpmRoxBFNdaePbMp7KF1AXimHLJ8jHWnvXiexuXe5xo6MSDDrFpbnjX.jpg) ![20260422_193610.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23z7NDdJHY6nFfjty6P72sD9KGK9ukKVVjyQV1ALCmfjNMbRAQzunNN2k3c42JJWzr4b1.jpg) ![20260422_193431.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23w2iyavM98xxQt242cYdypKrGNH5qLvcoT4P2aPH3BEyAGpM9uDvfVFwNN16RahnxeLG.jpg) Y asi de facil tenemos una bandana para el cabello que se puede usar para sostener nuestro cabello mientras nos maquillamos o para hacer ejercicios y pueden observar mi bella sobrina como modelo como le recoge todo su cabellito ¡Saludos!
And just like that, we’ve got a hair bandana that can be used to keep our hair out of the way whilst we’re putting on make-up or working out. Take a look at my lovely niece modelling it, with all her little hair tied back. Best wishes!

https://images.hive.blog/DQmPp3w4d7XKqyHe7ehy2vRmWfJDa3A7FvafWG3WpoLJcc5/11.png
 
📷*Photography by|Fotografía por:@emilypino,🔅 Cover created in/Portada creada en [Canva](https://www.canva.com), [Separator and banner/separador y banner](https://hive.blog/hive-148441/@ikasumanera/eng-es-i-made-hive-free-use-art-of-for-all-of-you-part-1-dividers-and-banners-or-hice-arte-de-libre-uso-para-todos-parte-1), 🇺🇸Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)*
