body.title: Freewrite - “I’m just drifting”
body.body:
​The sky was gray. It seemed like the sky was always gray ever since the ship wreck. Lars was lucky to have made it out alive, but at the same time, you could say he was unlucky for that very same reason. He sat alone in that liferaft with nothing but the clothes on his back and a gnawing sense of despair.. 

This was not the vacation he had planned, not by a long shot. It looked like he might have to stay at sea for the rest of his life, however many hours that would be. As that depressing thought crossed his mind he noticed the sharks were circling. It was almost calming, the way they went round and round in the water. His phone was probably in pieces somewhere several thousand leagues beneath the sea (how much is a league anyway?) so this would have to do for entertainment. He’d almost come to think of them as friends. There certainly weren’t any dolphins, which was a shame. Dolphins seemed like they might have been good company. 

​As he drifted, he began to think about how he could have been at work. He had decided, just this once, to do something for himself, to take a day off that no one else expected. Yes, he had left the school in a bit of a lurch, but couldn’t he do this one thing for himself without inviting some massively disproportionate punishment? It pained him to think that instead of dying of thirst and starvation, he could have been safe and fed, 'imparting knowledge' to the uninterested. 

And so he was stuck. With no hope for rescue. Until a cruise ship appeared in the distance. 

It got closer and closer and closer…and passed through him and the raft like they were nothing more than mist. As he rematerialized, it occurred to him that he wasn’t even there anymore. All that was left to drift was his ghost.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZkHUXwLEEVEewYmBUMfEhiKeAcXqC6f6wtFREBWQiBtY/1776903530528.jpg)



[*Image*](https://pixabay.com/photos/boat-shark-dorsal-fin-shark-fin-7355328/)

******

I'm back, sort of. I can't make any promises, but I can make an effort. Stay tuned, and we'll see how that goes.

Head on over [here](https://ecency.com/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/22-april-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3081-im-just-drifting) for the details and prompt to write your own freewrite today.

body.body:
# Warm and happy mid-week hivers and creative community 🥰❤️.

![30B8A96E-D350-44FF-8D03-0A62919DA5E2.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AK2FfTA342RCet3WsAMmLX2wSHW8Qm2SLAq1P9ajF7DG7wS3ETowByiXKRetKkg.jpeg)

![67010541-34C7-4855-9A3F-AAFB440F325A.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23uFgorMyMLQVxm3UKLGrvNgKDddhLRXLKN2y8M91wys8ZREoF5xfiVo4C11juMLMDKjk.jpeg)

![CB83BF92-4AC0-4C72-B759-860522F21DDB.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23uR4yCtMUXQS5Y88n8f6QYSWWCHXu6hRZoVray5SMYavdCCvyJSRtnhNCZEQqaCNKVEM.jpeg)

Hope we are enjoying wellness while thriving to achieve all we set out for this week, and also enjoying some great cuisine to keep the energy. 

French fries 🍟 is one snacks meal I love to prepare for lunch from my kitchen rooster, and at least once in a week,  mostly served hot, paired with some sides. It could be paired with fried egg, fried plantains or seasoned vegetable sauce. It’s always such a delightful lunch for family.

So today I made French fries 🍟 to serve for lunch, but this time I decided to serve it with a seasoned dip made from onions 🧅 and garlic 🧄 I had in the refrigerator. Then pair the hot fries with also a hot seasoned porridge beans I made as side. 

![FB9032CA-4732-450D-BE19-DF5A14AE93DA.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23w2yoV5nzpKJ9LokQhLQ4ReBA4zFfdP3vTMwMVo9WV8ZyvDiYV22SGsp8w6NJc9g71oj.jpeg)

Lunch meals 🥘 like this does not come to the table easily because its time consuming especially with the porridge beans being made fresh from the scratch. But it’s one meal you will love because its healthy for everyone, especially growing up children 👧 with beans as a side. 

Below, I will show you step by step process how to bring this lunch to the table.

# INGREDIENTS:

![1E688353-D4ED-4842-A459-D70F6C69CCFA.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/242rwKT46BrmkKTSAwi8VjbYBGhqicvdB7FR3BMMa2uwAJCArLHFkn6SjyQ1EN7wJey9V.jpeg)

![DF6E0E14-64AF-4EF0-8B3B-1D88AF43CF7B.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23vhyN2PeFXsMeEU3jRRmJ7QVTU3gmTMFuRMm6oUUu2WHasQPNk8E72mFF1VMtfwUm9u1.jpeg)

2 cups of brown beans 
1 large sweet potatoes 
1/2 packet of tomatoes paste 
1/2 teaspoon of spicity  seasoning 
1/2 medium red onions 
1 teaspoon of chili pepper 🌶 
1/2 teaspoon of salt
3 fresh red hot peppers
10 ml cap of red palm oil🌴
Enough vegetable oil for fries 🍟 

# STEPS FOR PREPARATION:

Step 1.

![2EA0FB20-1FAC-4FF8-8558-808439214AC7.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/245nC7nxsn9DKMPet8Bi6NDJT5g6SJVRLUtxoktbUt1Z1QN8GQw64xPcoSvuv4oiSVG7r.jpeg)
- 
![09423E0E-E8A5-4E44-BA27-123997633690.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/ALAGmtpW1hPm94tTA5obqKJmSVH7tuPwYWGn9278JkPBUhn8RtdmSpbprz1eo8k.jpeg)

First , we will cook our beans freshly. So we start by taking the beans into the pot to wash it though.

![748BBC7C-9E04-404B-84CF-E896CB57E1BA.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/ALQc8FHgWekycXyqUgoosF7AErFWGSdMAdq3w2qw9XxHwzqbh4dkL12UJQuohzU.jpeg)

And we set it on the cooker, cover  to per boil it for the first water.

Step 2.

![60CC0CF3-12CE-4029-8EA5-B151A55CF749.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23vrtNnZ96D52F5oqGPUCuXofUjw7WG58Qf6MWjRwFZdvhKw2steNkrdhJBFnUj5C92jW.jpeg)

![088EC395-69C3-4FDD-97B6-CEC881F282D1.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wzzisukzs33gJPrqXxK5S3xS56mNTuk76wGnc6sgNoPZhJf8MWJqNTczotAZ9Dxx5AJ.jpeg)

Once the beans per boils, we sieve off the first water that contains more gas that can cause constipation 

![71DA4DC6-5999-4A04-8654-9F14CE8AD603.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23tS2g9hignfiV3jGCzFhTN2zk8FDiargqswuaYdihqsLbS5fAiHhgwV9HsrH54MePtAq.jpeg)

![64C0B03A-088C-4C04-82EF-3260CF94427F.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/ALJsDszQQmDpd7QYQFgyXv1tBssAy4YPjjDKKQZDb4MKXxWXA4RP9Ga612HkFZc.jpeg)

Then we add fresh water to the beans for proper cooking .

Step 3.

![BBD8FD64-3836-4124-9BC3-0146D595CB7C.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/24244NCEnq6BrFzyeWWCjie54b1HVs4K2aXeJSZNJE9aPfCtiT7TAKqPxvWSNkKYi7x82.jpeg)

![B3D062FB-00B8-43E6-BDD3-51CC3A999627.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23rBNAvpmAMP6sTETy5xFnzPvxCQpZtRAm6viUtx87cmAfUWw5HPKAZ3GhFEELjCu3YGp.jpeg)

We wash and chop the onions and pepper readily here above 

Step 4.

![ED8C77B2-8470-4FB4-AA36-5AA383887AEB.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/244yEoVCdZZ1puvd9yscWZxJrbvfJzqTg7jeaBdKxEBcxVqJoePhmq1wVTd5g38p6qGs4.jpeg)

![00F3FF47-674F-4B18-AB90-9EC4009B1C7A.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AKCJL6HRiECc6DjStFpk5Ry1THnXzSjsDNM4vUxYGM5xnup3QqEuRFu7QBKCnER.jpeg)

Peel and slice the potatoes readily for French fries , adding salt .

![0E5A53B8-F3CF-46C8-BFBF-6E9A3C6CB8C4.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wgKUUTXnQdWxhoyuc5dm7THwyeiLH3irTBY1YwFVXLVa1G3idEJH6mYmjyuibuTuZLb.jpeg)

As here above.

Step 5.

![80235208-21C0-443A-A043-290325FB4A41.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23vhnpwgZ44n8hYvHj58Ax8rzshk1YiZp9Wf5oxNdrwdnrj9JyaUTZUoqmGbnQZ5NqEW4.jpeg)

![11D44833-CBBF-4D7D-80CE-422BB5372BE8.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23u5bFL1gRJMn96LsWdK1PsqVknynU7PShZ7N2FNLssJFr1Gfi7iCdia7oKBwTsAZEAcB.jpeg)

We allow the beans to cook and tender, drying 

![B66F0624-388E-43F6-A138-C455CCCFA5ED.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AKCFiwnJY9pJejjxRfhLYjitveWTDqaUVykKyjmGctwnCi9A879uJVLRFF1XMsW.jpeg)

Then we add the chopped 🧅 , fresh pepper, tomatoes paste, seasoning, salt and chilies 🌶  and stir to incorporate.

Step 6.

![6BF4F83D-ED1D-4E0E-93AD-2BB5804D556D.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AJpir74ohnHLqjAfvyVsamQY5RXmn2gfRmYTPRGMcYjUnJgggeEuMjZ89oPSj8r.jpeg)

We add the red palm oil, stir to incorporate 

![DB290AC0-773A-40B6-A917-85680B95FA27.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/ALAFYHPbE8nYa4xLAf347iQrWa2sbymo9KUJh3NcYoHmHigKEAmc5H8HstEUFJm.jpeg)

Allow just few more minutes to dry up and we lower heat 

Step 7.

![0D380957-7E23-47EE-9212-B21A8FC82684.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AK6WPBpaNS5ccFfmXk3WoR3YJznBEXNTvyGfzXWNzaPtVTdUXmsCBqUo5cvXJ1Y.jpeg)

We quickly heat up our vegetable oil and fry our French fries 🍟 

![7CD55F9E-7818-42E2-A206-D9D683CD34F0.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23uFGqdzwwtcZLs9PLhomk8ioFdscoge2vZ3QGEJ5GZXQaS1dAooTEGScjYAPMyiZK2bV.jpeg)

![04CB4C94-AAA4-4BAB-98B8-CF4E130357DC.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23u5tD4d7avfmQraAcAygK4YSSfzCF5gX1b8BpfrCr6kkXVeeK3qkEqueorpXaHJkJ9jU.jpeg)

![523DCF28-2DD6-452B-8CA4-766AB71AA81F.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wCJExbwrE1kCdpyZHRv2xFqZNNDKnEe1K5FT7V6rJV11JLZfw9vXyDY1TESxvW1RNtQ.jpeg)

As here above 

![215A5078-ECF8-40A6-8749-82C893377E5F.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23uR4yCtMUXQS5Y88n8f6QYSWWCHXu6hRZoVray5SMYavdCCvyJSRtnhNCZEQqaCNKVEM.jpeg)

This lunch needs to be served immediately, as French fries are enjoyed better once they are out from the frying pan. And porridge beans also more delicious 🤤 when served hot. This is truly one lunch I don’t miss out from during the week.

![CCB98757-EDCA-42FF-9622-41E4D0F1D5AA.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23w2yoV5nzpKJ9LokQhLQ4ReBA4zFfdP3vTMwMVo9WV8ZyvDiYV22SGsp8w6NJc9g71oj.jpeg)

Use any beans of your choice and make this recipe in your own version , making sure to serve it hot to enjoy with family for lunch. Taste so delicious that you will want to make it again. Inexpensive and healthy for everyone.

body.body: I remember 14 year old me being addicted to this movie ,I had seen it more than eight times.one of best I had ever seen.\nThe movie \

,a classic by writer and producer Tina fey, taught me a lot of self realization and how people can smile at your face and be a different person at your back.Everybody just wants to fit in.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaiGsZHKsp5fHT7eshDxUKQSPmoPf2pRSF5QrV5i8eMWW/1776787267269.jpg)



While growing up,i've learnt that  most friendships especially female friendships are  never genuine,people will likely turn against you when you stop having what it is  you had that attracted them to you in the first place be it,status,wealth,brains,power,it is usually intangible these days.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbsxuVvxcJJ4s1F1KSBa1zjLK3QxGYEcSgZaL7FEahT2c/1776787309474.jpg)


      This generation of genz s don't care about personality in a human what so ever, it's about what you have and what they can gain from being in that friendship or relationship with you.Most times people will try to get close to you just so that they can be you and bring you down in the process.
Watching this film initially,i saw Regina George as the bad guy,while Cady heron was seen as sweet and innocent,but over the course of the years combined with my real life experiences,I then saw Regina as the good guy,not the good guy but better than Cady,who had snake-ishly drifted close to Regina not to bring her down but to bring her down and have her life,status,power . 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPVdBuASA4gEtCcBCiKeLUDWtLX5SehG4khLbXpkkkUUT/1776787349551.jpg)


A lesson I learned is \

many people, mostly teenagers are desperate to belong somewhere,most have tried , given up and now are loners.\nFrom this movie,I learnt that mean girls don't always look fake,most of them sit ,laugh and don't genuinely support you.

body.title: My Tactile Journey to Celia and the Grimms.
body.body:
> *There are memories that do not enter through the eyes, but remain etched on the fingertips. For many, childhood is a colourful photo album; for me, my first ten years were a choreography of textures, sounds and the rhythmic relief of dots on paper.* *I was born into a world of shadows before four operations and fate allowed me, at the age of eight, to discover the world through my left eye, my reality was built on touch. At the age of six, I enrolled in a school for the visually impaired, and it was there that the first miracle of my life occurred... Braille.*
# ***
My Tactile Journey to Celia and the Grimms
*** It was the late 1950s and early 1960s, decades of a prosperous Venezuela, but Braille books were scarce, expensive and, above all, monumental treasures. A story that any child could fit in their pocket was, for us, a massive volume that took up half a desk. That is why, today, I wish to pay a deeply heartfelt tribute to the National Organisation of the Blind of Spain (ONCE). Thanks to their pioneering work in that decade, we children who lived in visual silence were able to access the gems of the Brothers Grimm, Perrault and the unforgettable Elena Fortún.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTjoAcpp62ATxGD8H3pSTDgNG3VxeW1AgKMFvj9axwNFy/image.png) [Kobo Ebook](https://www.kobo.com/es/es/ebook/the-original-folk-and-fairy-tales-of-the-brothers-grimm?srsltid=AfmBOopqnW5p0zi0NPeadCZkGB9knWdXbLmNYM7vlH5YPcoBc5WYitmT)
I remember with particular fondness a edition of the Brothers Grimm’s fairy tales. It wasn’t just raised lettering; that book came with three-dimensional figures, little figurines that brought the story to life. My fingers would trace the wolf’s ears, Little Red Riding Hood’s cloak or the hardness of a little chocolate house before reading the description in the text. It was an immersive experience long before technology was invented; it was cinema for the senses.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZisW6YSdxGrBbVevzKYM7JYbnUJ27MbzWzWGWaHNhTBV/image.png) [Renaissance Publishing House.](https://www.editorialrenacimiento.com/biblioteca-elena-fortun/1837-el-cuaderno-de-celia.html)
But if there was one character who stole my heart and taught me what freedom of spirit meant, it was Celia. Elena Fortún’s series was a window into a world of mischief, childish questions and boundless tenderness. Celia was more than just a girl who ‘said things’; to me, she was the friend who told me what the outside world was like whilst I learnt to decipher it with my fingertips.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTJxngyfXWF9ox2Tva53sWoa5Vt8acudvsKrwkMMMUrk8/image.png) [Filmoffice Madrid](https://madridfilmoffice.com/produccion/celia/)
Life takes wonderful turns. Two decades ago, now with the sight that medicine had given me in my left eye, I had the chance to bring an emotional circle full circle. The TV series based on Celia was released, and I was able to sit on the sofa with my daughter Sofía, who was seven at the time (the same age as the protagonist). Watching the series with her was like reclaiming a piece of my own childhood. I told her how I imagined Celia when I could only touch her words, and she looked at me in amazement, discovering that her father, before seeing with his eyes, had already seen with his soul.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaoQEjzAW9LQE69o8NdeqUg5zS7NYFQ963pFLkP2ZDzgv/image.png) [RTVE Play.](https://www.rtve.es/play/videos/celia/)
This piece is a tribute to those thick books that filled my darkness with light. To ONCE, for investing in our education when the world seemed to ignore us. And, above all, to literature, which showed me that you don’t need sight to travel to enchanted forests or to laugh at the witty remarks of a girl from Madrid.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdhgQmN9QNn6g6XbwGwng2J36cJpAv9bauqB31Vkpqiz7/escr.png)

*Today, as a [‘Silver Blogger’](https://peakd.com/c/hive-106316/created) who treasures the past, I realise that [my favourite story](https://peakd.com/hive-106316/@hive-106316/the-silverbloggers-chronicles-prompt-43-favourite-childhood-story) was not just one story, but the tale of how I learnt that true vision is that which is born of curiosity and nurtured by the love of a book in one’s hands… whether you read it with your eyes or with your heart in your fingertips.* *** ***

body.title: Phillies are slowly approaching rock bottom after seventh straight loss... | Kyle Backhus starts today followed by Taijuan Walker apparently...
body.body:
![mlb-Philadelphia-Phillies-Logo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/adhammer/AJhXiRGysGbqrUVr31VqR8j9iJthXQeNsJRnjA5UgF2TrkK4JXLPjHUG9MUr24D.png)
[Src](https://loodibee.com/mlb/philadelphia-phillies/)

Another day another Phillies loss. I'm not having a great time... 

Again, as I said before, the two biggest stars on the team are actually producing for the most part. Kyle Schwarber hit his eighth homer yesterday, Bryce Harper hit his fifth. Schwarber's batting average is pretty lousy but he doesn't often hit for a great average. He is playing his role fairly well though as the team's biggest power threat.

Alec Bohm is hitting .128 with an OPS of .384. Bryson Stott and Adolis García are both hitting .210. Stott has an OPS of .511 and García's is .634. I don't want to pick on these guys for any particular reason other than to simply point out a sample of how these Phillies batters have been doing. Bohm, Stott, and García are three everyday players and well, they ain't really doing much of anything at the plate. 

Only four Phillies have a league average or better OPS. From what I understand the league average bare minimum OPS is about .700. Well, Felix Reyes is a fifth player but he's only played two games. The other four with a respectable-good OPS are Kyle Schwarber, Bryce Harper, Justin Crawford, and Brandon Marsh. So I guess props to them.

But that means everyone else needs to step it up.

Taijuan Walker is not starting today but will apparently pitch after the first inning or two. Kyle Backhus will start. Walker has been bad in general with an absurd 9.16 ERA but he's been ***extra*** bad in the first inning. So I guess the Phillies are trying anything to get a win at this point.

Yes a win feels impossible for the Phillies right now. It's like the team is melting.

But as a fan I am admittedly intrigued to see how they handle this strong adversity. I am a sucker for a good underdog/comeback story so maybe the Phillies will turn this thing around.

Hopefully SOON. LOL. 

At the end of the day as always...

body.title: LOH285 || I love period movies ...
body.body:
>

There is a movie by Yasujiro Ozu, from the Japanese cinema with a very significant film called Late Spring (1949). This jewel of the Ozu period explodes with a unique delicacy, the relationship between a father and a daughter, and the inevitable passage of time that transforms the affections and family dynamics. >I love the message it leaves about filial love, social duties and the melancholy beauty of *letting go, of letting go*. It is a work of universal cinema, it manages to turn the everyday into a deep reflection of our human bonds, emotional maturity and the cycles of life, from a sensitive perspective, of contemporary cinema. This work also illuminates, with subtlety, the silences and emotions that inhabit every family. Because it marks the relationship of a father with his daughter without melodrama in the framework of a vital conflict of detachment, the daughter's marriage, and her resistance to marry in order not to leave her father alone and the wisdom of the.father who urges her to marry, as a law of life, aware that it is the best for the daughter, although he knows that the cost will be his own loneliness. In the end, the dialogue between father and daughter is full of tenderness, love and hope, where each one assumes the destiny that life indicates, in a dynamic of humanization, between detachment, kindness and the need for affection. There is a lot of humanism without sentimentality, in this film, it is about understanding the inner storm of every passion and emotion with the sad smile and the look, in the distance, of human beings, that we are real. Big hug for everyone. Nice day. Janitze.🐝

body.title: 22 April 2026, Freewriters Community Daily Writing Prompt Day 3081: I’m just drifting
body.body:
/>

“So, I'm reaching out because I'm just drifting, Uncle, and there's a lot of temptation out here in the wake of the hurricanes, and I need to be delivered from temptation and taken in.”

“Nephew, I need you to know that Jesus is still on the mainline, and He told you not to call here but call His Father for any deliverance of temptation you do not have strength enough to do for yourelf.”

Mrs. Melissa Trent wrapped herself around her husband, Sgt. Vincent Trent, knowing he was talking to one of the “lost boys” … one of the sons of his lost brothers who were following in their dead fathers' criminal footsteps, though less successfully.

“I need you to give up on crime, because the family talent for it missed you,” he had once said to one of them before hanging up on one of the most youthfully exuberant cuss-outs Mrs. Trent had ever heard.

“But see, he should be in music – the boy's rhyming skills are unmatched,” Sgt. Trent said … and, quietly, Cousin Van had figured it out, and was a heavy user of his cousin Melvin's beats in teaching the younger man how to find a better way to succeed than crime. Van Trent was now a successful music producer, helping to divert young people from the pathway to criminality into positive activity.

“One down, so many to go,” his uncle had said.

The next one had called, realizing his uncle was going to give him tough love and shove him in the right direction.

“Wait – you're not going to take me in?” this particular nephew said.

“Of course not, nephew. You're one of those who has shed blood to get what you want, and so I can't have you around my wife and children because you are not safe for them and they definitely are not safe for you. You're a puppy dog in violence, asking to move in with a 20-year hardened veteran so you can get jealous of the life your cousins have lived because they have their father, do something dumb, and have their father shed every drop of your blood down to the ground like you are not even my nephew. That's why you need to call somebody else, or just stop drifting and come to port in one of those re-entry programs for young offenders my father-in-law funds.”

“Man, you know I hate to be tied down!”

“Man, you better understand how to make a good choice of commitment before you get a real felony as an adult and don't have a choice for a decade about being tied down. Worse things can happen. Did I mention your grandma is over here?”

Mrs. Trent almost started laughing because she could hear the flinch of the young man through the phone about his grandmother, Gladys Jubilee Trent.

“Look, if she asks, tell her I said hello and that I'm getting into re-entry, like, now!” he said, and Sgt. Trent chuckled darkly.

“Now, see, I'm going back to what I said at first. Grandma is who y'all all fear, but you need to fear God like that and get your lives in order with Him – Jesus is on the mainline that you need to be calling.”

“Uncle, here's the thing: Jesus is not giving us the options we want out here!”

“Nephew, every man wants a path to being respected and admired, but the Lord's path is humility first. Reject that path, and you may get what you want for a time – but you are going to lose so much more in the end. Glendon Trent your father should be 44 this year. _Where is he, Glendon Jr.?”_

Silence, and then Glendon Jr. tried it.

“Jesus could have given him another chance, though – just one more! I hate God for taking my father – I hate Him!”

Sgt. Trent waited on the phone with Glendon Trent Jr. as the heart of the matter at last came out between the rage-filled tears.

“I'm drifting because what else am I supposed to do? I was nine, man – just nine when it happened! How am I supposed to trust a God that would take a nine-year-old's dad from him, man? That don't even make sense!”

“It doesn't make sense because it isn't true, Glendon,” Sgt. Trent said gently, but firmly. “I am your father's elder brother. You don't think your grandfather and I didn't have conversations like this with him, warning him that if he kept going as he was, he was going to face deadly consequences? You don't think we didn't step in where we could, and then listen to him talking about he was going to do better and walk right back into the mess just as soon as he thought he had beaten the rap? God didn't take your father. Your father chose the life, and the life took him like it takes everybody in it – because crime does pay. The wages of sin always is death.”

There was long silence, and then deep, painful, awful sobbing.

Sgt. Trent put the phone on mute, called up an app, worked it, and then said, “He's not coming here, but I am going to him – don't wait up. Tell the kids I'm checking on a cousin.”

Glendon Trent Jr. was at a bus stop on a bus route that wasn't even running during the pandemic, so, completely alone in the middle of nowhere, having a complete breakdown – however, the instant he heard a footstep, he was up and ready – and had the gun knocked clean out of his hands.

“Like I said, nephew, you're a puppy dog compared to me.”

“Uncle Vincent!”

The sergeant opened his arms, and the nephew ran into them, sobbing. They drove around Lofton County for the next six hours, just working everything out … and Glendon Trent Jr. came to Christ as Savior, and entered re-entry that night, beginning his new life as a redeemed man. He and his uncle would talk every day, and Glendon Jr. would successfully complete the program and join his Cousins Van and Melvin in business.

Sgt. Trent came home at midnight to see his wife and his mother, Glendon's grandmother, waiting up on the porch.

“Glendon was lost, but now is found,” he said, and they came and embraced him.

body.title: Our Recent Guild Brawl and Featured Battles
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfUbS897pcCc582But3UTtcnGnLAcF9P8s9mNd4YTmWKh/image.png)

Hello Splinterlands summoners and welcome back to my blog!

Our guild has just finished another brawl. We had a luckluster brawl this time. We only finished in seventh place compared to last week's fifth. In today’s post, I’ll share a breakdown of our overall brawl results, share my personal contribution and feature a few of my favorite battles.

***

# Guild Rank and Personal Performance

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPTSEbvY4Qgh7RckevMUHeT7QfL8ME9t25SmH5VutmXa8/image.png)

We were not able to keep our spot from last week's brawl. We only placed seventh this week. Our guild earned fifty nine crowns which we can use to upgrade our buildings. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRvLvZc9qDs2cxpRbGoTJYVJ2Cp7aCrtV8PfotZNNDphq/image.png)

Personally, my performance was great. I won seven battles out of eight and contributed twenty one points. The rewards for this brawl was low though with only 3k merits and 39 SPS.

***

# Featured Battle

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYSxQBiJTdgjsftZgjYxHEV3ezLnZeJBBn2hsSvZv2BWb/image.png)

The battle had the Little League and Equalizer rulesets. There were few choices of splinters so I chose Earth with Kaylia Silverleaf archon. The rest of my team were as follows.

## Halfling Refugee

Halfling Refugee is a great tank in low mana battles. He's only one mana but deals three melee damage and has three speed. He also has six health to tank.

## Ironwing Juggernaut

Ironwing Juggernaut is also a decent tank for low mana battles. He's three mana and deals a bit lower damage of two. On the other hand, he has more defense as he has three armor. I put him as a second tank since he has a Charge ability, enabling him to attack from any position.

## Halaran Huntress

Halaran Huntress is a four mana card that I usually use for Earthquake rulesets. She's a dependable damage dealer and her flying ability increases her chance to evade physical attacks.

## Mad Kaboomist

The Mad Kaboomist is a four mana, magic damage dealer. His setback is his low health but that's not a problem because of the Equalizer ruleset.

## Jini Guise

Although a legendary card, I don't usually use Jini Guise as my gladiator card in brawls. The Earth splinter is packed with a lot of good gladiator cards like Quora and Katrelba that even legendary card takes a back seat. However, the Little League ruleset gave her a chance to be played. She is a support card that grants two armor stats to the team.

## Blackmoor Jinx

A one mana card to complete the team. I usually use this card to guard the rear against sneak attackers since he doesn't contribute much on offense.

***

# Enemy Team and Battle 

The enemy chose Water and had a good mix of melee, magic and range units. His units include the legendary Sten Slatehelm whom I wrote about in a previous post. His gladiator card was the two mana epic card Alfredo. The enemy team had a lower damage output since he had units that only deal one damage. He also had the Shock Trooper in his team that deals one damage to allies. This works if his team also has high damage and can kill his enemy fast before the Shock Trooper reduces his own team. These put him at a disadvantage and lost the battle. 

[Replay the Battle](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sm_hTX9ltVYcAWzHJdepXbH?ref=logen9f)

body.title: Evolving Marlai Singariel in Splinterlands
body.body:
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmatPJ3kjJABLT1yffZAR2UuCsFeUnifiPxpKdfycC79s6/marlai.png</center>

One of the formats I'm playing in Splinterlands is Frontier, which only allows Foundation Cards and reminds me of how Splinterlands used to be.

An advantage and also a disadvantage of playing in the Frontier format is that Foundation Cards are cheap, so you won't spend much to evolve your cards and become a strong player in this battle format. The disadvantage is that in this format you earn Foundation Cards, which means you won't have great profits, but it's still a great battle format to play.

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTNJek4xYRXm8AdZaDCjyZu8AcaRgLnFY8HDLcGMvMbtX/m.png</center>

Today my goal is to evolve the Marlai Singariel card to level 2. It's one of the summoners I use most in my battles, and evolving the summoner is essential to use higher-level cards in battles.

The summoner Marlai Singariel belongs to the Water deck and has only one function in battle.

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmaic5oGXqm4Pv2LVxY5p9S1f9HBm4NFsuR2BqeixewWFt/mm.png</center>

**Marlai Singariel increases the spell attack of all allied cards in battle by +1.**

I hate facing cards with magic attacks, but I love using them in my battles because they can attack from any position and ignore enemy card armor.

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcR1APoZnaawrM4FwQh4JvCJVXa2fpp8nYNzCAMaaqCfm/mmm.png</center>

To evolve Marlai Singariel to level 2, you need 5 cards, and each Marlai Singariel card costs $0.07. I already had 1 card, so I bought 4 more to reach level 2.

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRgBkhPihi61u6f93tyvsqaVpAsa39syKSWie8JEZ1jqH/mmmm.png</center>

This is a small investment, and unfortunately, I'm unlucky enough not to get Marlai Singariel as a reward in the Frontier format, so I decided to buy the cards on the market. However, my goal is still to evolve Foundation Cards using only my Frontier format rewards.

Foundation Cards aren't very powerful, but I like them, and they're cheap, so they're great to add to my card collection and use in battles.

My goal is to evolve all my Foundation Cards to the maximum level this year.

## Arcade Colony

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmeVhSb4SzdyDLvV8kzgZHxx6k28Qf7zRFm1ENJnTfcxxR/mmmmm.png</center>

Now I'll talk about the **[Arcade Colony](https://arcadecolony.com/)** platform. On it, you'll find the games: **[Splinterlands](https://splinterlands.com/?ref=moonblast)**, **[Moon Karts](https://moonkarts.arcadecolony.com/)**, **[StakeHouse Den](https://stakehouseden.arcadecolony.com/)**, and **[Genesis League Goals](https://goals.genesisleaguesports.com/)**.

*For those unfamiliar with Arcade Colony, it's owned by Invennium Corp. Arcade Colony is a platform for arcades and video games with a functional economy based on a governance token, \

.*

**Invennium Corp. is a 100% subsidiary of Splinterlands.**

Find more information about Arcade Colony in my post: **[Discover the Arcade Colony Platform](https://peakd.com/hive-13323/@moonblast/discover-the-arcade-colony-platform-lne)**.

## Acess The Game: [Splinterlands](https://splinterlands.com/?ref=moonblast)

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNMwhG6zdf6tcSMJBMuDya6e1Wy9xEHLoNjiZrcoqHEnK/mmmmmm.png</center>

body.title: Un deseo prohibido. A forbidden wish. (ESP-ENG)
body.body:
Te busco con ansias que no entiende de leyes,
un pulso que me golpea como martillo,
porque tenerte cerca es caminar sobre brasas
y saber que no eres mío 
Mis manos son náufragos buscando la orilla,
se cierran en el aire, fingiendo que te alcanzan,
imaginando la textura de tu espalda, el mapa de las venas,
ese calor que guardas y  a otra pertenece.
Te poseo en la sombra, en ese reino clandestino
donde no hay nombres, ni anillos, ni promesas.
Allí te obligo a amarme, deshago tu ropa con el pensamiento
y te bebo como si fueras el último sorbo de un desierto.
Es intenso este fuego porque se alimenta de lo imposible, 
Donde cada suspiro es un grito ahogado
que rebota contra la  armadura de hombre ajeno.
Me quema el pecho la verdad  que pronuncio,
eco de voz que resuena en mis noches vacías,
mientras me hundo en el delirio de inventarte
Aún sabiendo que tus manos nunca serán mías.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSCNXTnv4B5wmVb9sGdsb4LNyugoTcx3mD23JdRczbuTM/1776902227702.png)

Poema de mi autoría.
Texto traducido por Traductor en linea de Google.
imagen tomada de Géminis IA.

✨✨✨✨✨✨✨✨✨✨✨✨✨✨

English.
I look for you with eagerness that does not understand laws,
a pulse that hits me like a hammer,
because having you close is walking on hot coals
and know that you are not mine 
My hands are castaways searching for the shore,
They close in the air, pretending to reach you,
imagining the texture of your back, the map of the veins,
that heat that you keep and belongs to another.
I possess you in the shadows, in that clandestine kingdom
where there are no names, no rings, no promises.
There I force you to love me, I undo your clothes with the thought
and I drink you as if you were the last sip of a desert.
This fire is intense because it feeds on the impossible, 
Where every sigh is a gasp
that bounces against the armor of another man.
The truth that I speak burns in my chest,
echo of voice that resonates in my empty nights,
while I sink into the delirium of inventing you
Even knowing that your hands will never be mine.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSCNXTnv4B5wmVb9sGdsb4LNyugoTcx3mD23JdRczbuTM/1776902227702.png)

Poem of my authorship.
Text translated by Google Online Translator.
image taken from Gemini IA.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWjaDiHryaXCMXiynQePrbXbTxnvUMriFx2zgQtV9dNiD/1776901627275.jpg)


I joined Hive not to flip coins. I came with the investment mindset - to build for the long term. I was glad I finally found a place where I could save for my future — maybe even retirement. 

> But then investors can also cash out, right? 

I understood that if I wanted this goal achieved, then I would have to treat Hive as a business - be consistent, create, earn and stake and stake!

That's why from day one, I set my rewards to 100% HP. It was like that till after a year or so, by then, my HP had grown considerably, so I reverted to 50%/50% payout. I began to participate in the monthly power up and have been consistent with it till this month. 

And you know what, just a few days ago I hit *Dolphin status.*  I plan to grow more. What’s wrong with hitting 50K HP? You know what that means — more weight, more voting power, more rewards, and more earnings to sort out the bills. 

Yes, I spend some of my earnings, just like others do. I'm human. But powering down everything and cashing out? Now? With Hive this low? That’s not business. That’s wasting resources - trading long-term stake for short-term dust. Seriously, I can't imagine my three years plus of consistent grinding wasted like that. Just for dust! No way. 

***
Hive price is at its dip, no doubt. Lowest I've seen in the three years plus I've been here. People are getting anxious and confused about what's happening. Some have left the platform, discouraged. 

In fact, a few weeks ago, a fellow Hivian came in DM, expressing her worries over the low price of Hive, asking the way forward and if it's okay to power down or not? She also asked if I had powered down. 

**First, I asked her, \
I don't intend to power down. I’m letting it be.\

body.title: I Am #AliveAndThriving Today! || #IAmAliveChallenge || Daily Off-Grid Jungle Journal Entry: Day #1363 - My Education in  FOSS AI-Agents and How to Build Them Continues  - GaiaYoga Gardens, Lower Puna, Far East Big Island, Hawai'i - Tuesday, April 21, 2026
body.body: ![Hive-Banner-Green-Rounded.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tGM7REKBsvoBhPiEV5Fvb8tb333qQ8N9x2YfxaF9vWohE9Qf39RUEAn3LfysdgfbYpZ.png) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260419_162409641.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23vhyvpxnpwXUjHp2HHAru36HsQH5VvS4wUTk63UinyKmKkj2NfiCyLt1GvahhiL3yvk7.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) >I live naked and barefooted, very close to Earth and Nature, in an 18-acre, off-grid, clothing-optional, food-forest intentional community ([GaiaYoga Gardens](https://gaiayoga.org)), way out in the jungles of Lower Puna, far East Big Island, Hawai'i, and I have for more than 7 years now. Although there are many challenges, I love my life, and I'm immensely grateful to live where and how I do, on my own terms! I would not want to live any other way! 😁🙏💚⚡💥🔥✴️✳️❇️👣🌱✨🤙 ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) ``` Hive Debt: 23.00% HIVE Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.062 USD HBD/HIVE-Backed Dollar Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.991 USD ALIVE SWAP.HIVE Price: 0.04639009 SWAP.HIVE HEARTBEAT ALIVE Price: 0.07142992 ALIVE BLURT Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.00119195 USD QORT Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.153000 USD VOI Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.0001633 USD BTC/Bitcoin Fiat-Dollar Price: 78,610.15 USD BCH/Bitcoin Cash Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.0001633 USD LTC/Litecoin Fiat-Dollar Price: 55.9 USD Gold Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.0001633 USD Silver Fiat-Dollar Price: 77.64 USD Ranking for Our @aliveandmmb Witness Node: #130 (among all witnesses, including inactive)/#103 (among active witnesses only)/461.7k HP in votes/48 votes in total ``` ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) Warm greetings all! 😁🙏💚✨🤙 My growing fascination with locally-run FOSS (*Free and Open-Source Software*) AI models and agents, and learning and figuring out how to craft a multi-purpose and multi-capable AI agent of my own, to act as an onboard assistant on my Arch/Artix Linux laptop, is indeed taking up quite a bit of my focus as of late, with both a few setbacks and notable progress. What I'm learning is there there are not only assorted FOSS AI models and agents, that people can use/and or modify as they see fit, but there are also several different AI-agent development frameworks, that make it quite simple and easy to build custom AI agents, to meet particular needs and purposes. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260419_162526894.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23xKr35uNRq7oeL3RKi4P1pGTtfbL1eTiLQbmipA239SN18uBsb3YaCeUaDmVFTVUgRmP.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260419_162708395.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tvijmeBeo6m9fdyrDvcmXKoLyEY6iaaFwCZYtnrvdKkVrDw4xWi9W3N8BCuK8p8TeaP.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) So while I'm still exploring podman's container-pod way of doing it, which I like a lot, I'm also now expanding my search a bit to other frameworks that would facilitate creating my own ideal custom AI agent. I'm just going to say that Linux and FOSS frameworks are truly incredible, and for so many reasons, and the fact that there exist several quite easy paths within those community-driven frameworks to install, configure, run, and customize locally-installed AI models and agents, that are open to anyone, exemplifies that point exceedingly well indeed. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260419_165700839_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wMUMxrFrX5eTjYQgLtHmofGLwi5EPPbxntk8MvLnkseGVjdWhVu4zsVN3TDkCigrcZF.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260419_165836071.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/2458G4e9DQZeGKAkLxMYLC6kbcTLiuHcWRLH7rb2YtmN3oMCWMPt3KjYscEdzFenSLDWG.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) While there are all sorts of tools that could be incorporated into my custom AI agent, to expand its capabilities in assorted ways, the two main purposes that I want to it to fulfill are to do autonomous and/or directed synthesized and summarized web searches, and to be able to perform partially-autonomous and partially-constrained operations in my Arch/Artix Linux installations, such as searching for and editing files, troubleshooting, testing, automating, maintaining, and even developing helpful and useful custom systems. Once I'm able to get those two areas of functionality working as I'd like, then I'll likely explore implementing other domains of capability. I'm sure that I could come up with all sorts of other useful tasks for it to do, both locally on my laptop, and online, perhaps even on Hive at some point. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260419_170304469.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tmBQauQSifvM4yT46kEvTTFfdrWg66nvUpiQQgbLATc26dVKbcAu2Ed1cGW6XwrBzNB.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260419_170901033_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23vhwer6aCeeCyg1YFmSAugsDfd1nSLc8a38kuYkPhVE3jLAXj9Ewh7mVq5zFKZKM2C5V.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) I'm still very new in this AI-agent domain of learning and exploration, and although I am certainly making excellent progress, there's still so much to learn, so the process of becoming proficient in it will of course take me some time. The potential benefits to being able to implement this on my Arch/Artix systems make it well worth the time and effort I think, especially if I'm able to replicate it easily to my other two Arch installations. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260420_132104619.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23uQtNCTGcMkpvWj4CSDsxHfksQNem41RAhBBS3gKjTRDw1hbRG4AEvEjj8pMNc7tgcPv.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260420_132224371.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tveWQfA5fNyRXeNdH2Sa81wVNayeCcvdjjsrXQTDTfcuGs2kTpn9aTP4qPUnK9CzPfR.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) The best thing about building my own personal and locally-run onboard AI agent, is that my data does not leave my computer, as it would if I were to make use of cloud-based AI infrastructure, so I'll have the benefits of a quite-capable custom AI agent, while at the same time keeping my sensitive information private. That sounds pretty great to me. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260420_153036851.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23xAP6StqrrsqPE6KHa9yWCMVF8iUQFUrMaRQsxXbU1qmJAbrbnppRpkiHz6PQ1n7aaxb.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260420_153224484_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23uQiChy1UTYBZRMeLa3Nqehgpiq7gsqsfnJzfdxY7GBRmNPX8iR5XWvVA3udsoGW4SRT.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Yesterday, Tuesday, after finishing up my Hive-Blurt-'We Are Alive Tribe' tasks by around 1PM, I prepared for a session that was scheduled for 1:30PM. The session started slightly late, it went very well, and we wrapped it up by just after 5:15PM, after which I headed to turn on the generator, then to Wabisabi to make myself some food, and with that and my jar of leftover superfood fire coffee in hands, I returned to the Flow House to begin my evening Hive tasks. While I didn't get through all my notifications last night, I did got close, finally stopping by just before 10PM, to do some asset management, do a little more AI-agent research, then to go to bed by just before 12:30AM. I woke up just after 8AM, having slept fairly well, going to prepare my superfood fire coffee in Wabisabi, then heading back to the Flow House to write this post. ---

Every Tuesday and Wednesday, the ALIVE community comes together to celebrate something I genuinely look forward to every single week — **ALIVE and HEARTBEAT Power Up Day**.

**@alive.chat** runs this activity where you stake your tokens, share proof, and earn rewards for showing up consistently. Simple, but it adds up more than you think.

Want to know more? Check out the original post right here:

🔹 [Alive Chat Tuesday Challenge – 21st April 2026](https://ecency.com/hive-155221/@alive.chat/alive-chat-tuesday-challenge-21st-of-april-2026-lets-stake-and-be-alive?referral=rajpootg)

Today is **Wednesday, 15 April 2026** and I am back again for what has become one of my favourite weekly rituals 💪🔥

But I don't just power up one token anymore. A while back, I decided to combine three things into one routine, and honestly, it just made everything feel more intentional and more fun.

I call it:

---

## 🎯 H.A.T. Power Up Day
### **HEARTBEAT ❤️ | ALIVE 💚 | TOOFUCKEH 🔥**

Three tokens. One mission. Stack a little every week and watch it grow.

I stake **ALIVE** — the token of the [WE ARE ALIVE TRIBE](https://peakd.com/c/hive-155221/created)

I stake **HEARTBEAT** — the reward and income token of the same tribe

I stake **TOOFUCKEH** — the problem-solving token of [THE #PEPT GAME PROJECT](https://ecency.com/created/hive-102963)

Together they make H.A.T., and together they keep me building week after week.

Last year, I staked small amounts every single week and just kept going. This year, I am doing the same thing — except now I have three tokens to grow instead of one, and that makes it feel even more worthwhile.

Small steps. Every week. That is the whole plan.

If you are staking too, keep going. It adds up faster than it looks from the outside. And if you haven't started yet, there is no better time than right now 💪

body.title: Chicken Churrasco with Seafood: A Must-Try at Porks Grill, Maracay [En-Es]
body.body:
![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/EoeEsdpkmQFDdPyWQYcbFcjw7861r4fgYWs5A5oVx7mqLb2FfBLLe2tUnzHNadqenHv.jpg)
Taking the time to write is not always easy. Today, I’m bringing you a review of my visit to Porks Grill, a restaurant located in the city of Maracay, Aragua State, Venezuela. How did I end up at this restaurant? My brother had been watching videos about this place on TikTok for several months, and since we were returning from the city of Valencia, Carabobo State, we decided to stop by and eat at this exclusive spot. #
| | | | |---|---|---| |https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/242NjKJ3Q1jVSuWbFfdWiUD9VVTk3YdnXP22nWhf8yxnQTpazPpFwuzjxGMw1XLHggaRB.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/23wC7iAggUt2QjM9aqX2RrDry868wbEhggheu3SA7P82uVQ84AHSAYnCcTWsJrRR7rkf6.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/242NjKJ3Q1jVSuWbFfdWiUD9VVTk3YdnXP22nWhf8yxnQTpazPpFwuzjxGMw1XLHggaRB.jpg|

> # I really liked the restaurant’s entrance. It was eye-catching, and the overall design was very elegant. Everything was clean and well organized. From the moment we walked in, the service felt wonderful; the staff were smiling and very attentive. The atmosphere was completely different from that of Barquisimeto, the city where I live (and where I’m considering moving away from). #
![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/23xKxJwhao5CkWAe69Z2B8J3uVV8atE2xP8rsie3ZvyGUwUBKRFKg4HkEY1UURauQ4gdS.jpg)

> # We chose a table for four. As we sat down, a young waiter—articulate and charismatic—approached us. He handed each of us a menu, and we began deciding what to order. My brother ordered a dish called “Picadito,” which was a mix of grilled cuts: chicken churrasco, beef tenderloin, chorizo, and grilled blood sausage, served with yuca sticks and chimichurri. My mom ordered a veal sirloin, a premium tender cut of beef braised in spices and red wine, then grilled. She chose to have it with sautéed vegetables and baked potatoes. #
![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/Eoc7yb5qn1MBiheDg89zLxq4Yk23gp4f1VU2WEHajGpx8thGR4FZZx1WATrw1DsjftW.jpg)

> # My uncle ordered pork ribs—oven-baked and braised, coated in barbecue sauce and sesame seeds, served with French fries and coleslaw. As for me, I ordered a grilled chicken churrasco topped with seafood and chorizo, along with a Caesar salad and sautéed vegetables. To drink, we ordered juices, beer, and an Orange Tres (a house specialty). #
![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/23wCDgNhq46YfRjd7qTj27J9fGpYq1zEY1jDZugnGisq2shXxwVpf7yzVup3Gbo5DD17u.jpg)

> # After spending a good amount of time choosing our dishes, we started talking. Lately, my stress levels have been quite high, and I’ve been experiencing sudden mood swings. We talked about that, as well as how beautiful the restaurant was and the excellent service. Real estate in Aragua is not as expensive as in Barquisimeto; however, power outages are a serious issue. We discussed that as well as the possibility of moving to another city given the current situation in Venezuela. # | | | | |---|---|---| |https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/23xejoodJSf9w7MUzzJRR4ScsBWwCc4R6WPQB7csQ94cXZH48fhbJvFPSTuCGPUX2BUi1.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/23w2sRBpzHJTGjCJp4efBepesKNFsAHPDMYYxGoNJwDH5sTtGGBqenUT3WQBEftidpsKb.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/23xejoodJSf9w7MUzzJRR4ScsBWwCc4R6WPQB7csQ94cXZH48fhbJvFPSTuCGPUX2BUi1.jpg|

> # The conversation flowed quickly—so quickly that before we knew it, 15 minutes had passed, and the waiter returned with a large tray carrying all of our dishes. We were surprised by how much food there was—honestly, it was a lot. #
![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/EoCj1w6Z2SJSFvy3Q3MXxKdTZbM8YC6ACvCKoH1ebyh1uMUsUfVvFTLcYsTman16ErY.jpg)

> # Each dish had more than enough food to satisfy us comfortably. I really liked how everything was presented. I didn’t take many photos because it felt a bit uncomfortable. We were seated in a more private area, so I only took the necessary ones to document the experience. #
![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/EoeEsdpkmQFDdPyWQYcbFcjw7861r4fgYWs5A5oVx7mqLb2FfBLLe2tUnzHNadqenHv.jpg)

> # The grilled chicken churrasco topped with seafood and chorizo was outstanding. The presentation was delicate and inviting—it looked absolutely delicious. I hadn’t planned on eating chicken; I actually wanted seafood for lunch. This dish turned out to be a pleasant surprise and a great combination. # | | | | |---|---|---| |https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/23tbsBFBGUNbC6Yb65EcHqWFPEsPknBYPNKewKqRE7A2ndx2wngJN8HohM8e9my9QkS3R.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/23uQrM6VG1dCAG2sKFpRVkrgWZokYTwjemgVskxVDCgLmho3xPryK65UiMi5NRP2asNUa.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/23tbsBFBGUNbC6Yb65EcHqWFPEsPknBYPNKewKqRE7A2ndx2wngJN8HohM8e9my9QkS3R.jpg|

> # I was especially impressed by the Caesar salad. It was prepared with Greek yogurt and had a hint of orange, which gave it a bold and refreshing flavor. Usually, it’s made with mayonnaise and doesn’t include these ingredients. As for the sautéed vegetables, they were prepared with care—their flavor was intense, with a rich blend of vegetables and a subtle Venezuelan sweetness. #
![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/23vsQcMTn8E8fsT6MAXrY758Sm3YFvFdi9Wb96fMbcj4DYH6FsAEgtZn9F1tRPU4qcWgt.jpg)

> # The bill was one of the most affordable we’ve paid in recent months considering everything we ordered: about 79 USDT or HBD. That covered four people, alcohol, drinks, four main dishes with sides, and two desserts we ordered to go. It was a very reasonable price. I’ve paid the same in Barquisimeto for food that doesn’t come close to this. This place was a delight in both food and experience. If you ever visit Venezuela, I highly recommend stopping by. With love, Neruel. # Original content by @neruel. All rights reserved ©, 2026. Images: Samsung Galaxy A54. English translation and grammar correction: ChatGPT – DeepL – LanguageTool.
SPANISH VERSION (click here!)

> Churrasco de Pollo con Mariscos: lo que vale la pena en Porks Grill, Maracay > > # > > Tomar algo de tiempo para escribir es algo complejo. Hoy les traigo una reseña sobre mi visita a Porks Grill, un restaurante ubicado en la ciudad de Maracay, Estado Aragua, Venezuela. ¿Cómo llegué a este restaurante? Mi hermano vio durante varios meses videos sobre este lugar en TikTok y, como estábamos retornando de la ciudad de Valencia, Estado Carabobo, decidimos pasar a comer en este exclusivo lugar. > > # > > La entrada del restaurante me gustó. Era llamativa y el diseño del restaurante era muy elegante. Todo estaba limpio y ordenado. La atención desde que entramos me pareció maravillosa; los trabajadores tenían una sonrisa y eran muy serviciales. La dinámica era totalmente distinta a la de la ciudad de Barquisimeto donde vivo (pensando en mudarme). > > # > > Escogimos una mesa para cuatro personas. Nos sentamos mientras que un joven mesero, elocuente y carismático, llegó. Entregó a cada uno de nosotros un menú y empezamos a escoger qué comer. Mi hermano ordenó un plato llamado Picadito, que era un mix de cortes de churrasco de pollo, lomito de res, chorizo, morcilla al grill, acompañado de sticks de yuca y chimichurri. Mi mamá ordenó un solomillo de novillo, que era un corte premium de res tierno braseado en especias y vino tinto al grill. Este solomillo lo pidió acompañado de vegetales salteados y papas al horno. > > # > > Mi tío pidió de comer un Pork Ribs, que era un costillar de cerdo horneado y braseado, bañado en barbecue y ajonjolí, acompañado de papas fritas y ensalada coleslaw. En mi caso, ordené un churrasco de pollo gratinado con mariscos y chorizo junto a una ensalada César y vegetales salteados. De tomar, pedimos jugos, cerveza y un Orange Tres (esto es una bebida de la casa). > > # > > Luego de haber escogido todos los platos por un buen rato. Nos pusimos a conversar; últimamente, mis niveles de estrés han sido muy altos. He tenido cambios de humor repentinos. Conversamos sobre ese tema, también de lo lindo del restaurante y la buena atención. Los inmuebles en Aragua no son tan costosos como en Barquisimeto; sin embargo, el tema de los apagones o cortes de luz es complejo. Hablamos sobre ese detalle y una eventual posibilidad de cambio de ciudad ante los acontecimientos que suceden en la actualidad en Venezuela. > > # > > La conversación fluyó rápido, tan rápido que, al darnos cuenta, pasaron 15 minutos y el mesero trajo consigo una inmensa bandeja con cada uno de los platos que ordenamos. Estábamos sorprendidos porque era mucha comida. Demasiada, diría yo. > > # > > Cada uno de los platos tenía suficiente comida para saciar a cada uno tranquilamente. Me gustó la manera en que cada plato fue presentado. No tomé fotografías de cada comida porque era incómodo Estábamos en una mesa retirada y tomé solo las necesarias para escribir sobre la experiencia. > > # > > El churrasco de pollo gratinado con marisco y chorizo estaba espectacular. La presentación del plato era delicada y provocaba. Era muy apetitoso. No quería comer pollo, quería almorzar mariscos. Este plato fue una sorpresa y una combinación adecuada. > > # > > Me impresionó el sabor y la preparación de la ensalada césar La prepararon con yogurt griego y le agregaron naranja. El sabor era impactante; usualmente la preparan con mayonesa y no agregan estos ingredientes. En el caso de los vegetales salteados, los prepararon con cariño; su sabor era intenso y se sentía esa mezcla intensa de los sabores y vegetales con dulzura venezolana. > > # > > La cuenta fue una de las más económicas y que hemos pagado en estos últimos meses, con relación a todo lo que consumimos. Unos 79, USDT O HBD. Para cuatro personas, alcohol, bebidas, cuatro platos con acompañamientos y dos postres que pedimos para llevar. Es un monto adecuado. He pagado esto en Barquisimeto y la comida no está cerca de lo que comimos; una delicia de lugar y experiencia. Espero que, si vienes a Venezuela, puedas ir a este lugar. body.title: La salud siempre es primero en la vida.
body.body:
>Espero que se encuentren muy bien, y que estén pasando un día muy hermoso. Hoy estoy aquí, para compartir una pequeña reflexión. Espero que les guste mucho. #
![La salud Siempre es primero En la vida._20260422_193612_0000.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZSMFzWeqapPwyH6qo5RMC2m3s64ZYqnCKNENVG57ESkz/La%20salud%20Siempre%20es%20primero%20En%20la%20vida._20260422_193612_0000.png)
Imagen diseñada en CANVA
#

>La salud es lo más valioso e importante que hay en la vida. Debemos cuidarlo, pues con mal uso y maltratos nos puede llevar a la muerte. Y si no es eso, nos lleva a sufrir, pero de una manera horrible, y poco a poco va acabando con nuestra vida. Muchas veces pensamos que la salud se recupera nada más que tomando agua, comiendo y durmiendo, pero qué feo se ve o qué feo se siente cuando te das cuenta de que toda la vida estuviste equivocado, que la salud no solo se recuperaba con eso, sino que también le debes dar mucho amor, cariño y un cuidado. Otra cosa, por hacer solo ejercicio no significa que ya estamos bien, pues podemos entrenar y no tener una rutina adecuada o no comer lo suficiente; la verdad es que son cosas que uno se pone a ver, y siempre debemos tener en cuenta; puede parecer un fastidio, pero una persona con una salud sana tiene una vida hermosa, se ve más bonita; con esto no quiero decir que son feos, jaja, pero mejoran bastante. Las personas mayores, al cuidar su salud, se ven más elegantes, lindas y jóvenes, y, para ser sincero, me encanta verlas así, verlas que trabajan por algo bueno, bonito, una vida llena de fuerzas. # Además, muchas veces decimos que los medicamentos o las medicinas son muy caras, y si no te duele algo, no lo compras. Es entendible que las medicinas son caras, pero la salud siempre va primero; pero lo peor es que, si nos quejamos por el precio de los medicamentos, va a ser horrible ver los precios de ir a un hospital. Por eso es mejor siempre tener, por lo menos, una medicina y también una pastilla; en momentos fuertes, ahí está. Siempre nos tiene que importar la salud, amigos, no comer mucha grasa, pero tampoco no comer; son muchas cosas de las que debemos estar pendientes, pero, como ya lo dije, vas a tener una vida bonita, no tienes dolores muy rápido, te sientes más joven y más bonito. Si no puedes ir a un gimnasio, puedes trotar en tu barrio, jaja, pero es superefectivo. No se detenga por lo que dicen las demás personas; es su vida y su salud. Más bien, les puedes recomendar que ellos deben hacer lo mismo, porque hoy se ríen, pero mañana te agradecen porque se sienten más fuertes, seguros y más saludables. El tema está en querer y confiar. Ver que nos tenemos mucho por cumplir, pero que con un mal cuidado no podemos llegar a nada. #
![La salud Siempre es primero En la vida._20260422_193716_0000.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWgbwtbcLK1U4ND42B3Gv5agPMWvQCCGdyePrw5tSRYXp/La%20salud%20Siempre%20es%20primero%20En%20la%20vida._20260422_193716_0000.png)
Imagen diseñada en CANVA
#

>Así que ya saben, amigos, cuiden mucho su salud; las medicinas son caras, pero es un gran favor que nos hacemos a nosotros mismos, además de que la fuerza y el aprendizaje son más grandes. La verdad es que yo confío en ustedes, y que cuidan mucho su salud. Un fuerte abrazo. # Y bueno amigos. Hasta aquí dejo mi publicación, espero que les haya gustado mucho y les sirva de reflexión. Un fuerte abrazo. # #
Greetings, writers!
# I hope you're all doing well and having a wonderful day. Today I'm here to share a short reflection. I hope you enjoy it. #
![La salud Siempre es primero En la vida._20260422_193612_0000.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZSMFzWeqapPwyH6qo5RMC2m3s64ZYqnCKNENVG57ESkz/La%20salud%20Siempre%20es%20primero%20En%20la%20vida._20260422_193612_0000.png)
Imagen diseñada en CANVA
#

>Health is the most valuable and important thing in life. We must take care of it, because misuse and abuse can lead to death. And if it doesn't lead to death, it leads to suffering, but in a horrible way, slowly destroying our lives. We often think that health is recovered simply by drinking water, eating, and sleeping, but how awful it looks or feels when you realize you've been wrong your whole life, that health isn't only recovered with those things, but also requires a lot of love, affection, and care. Another thing: just exercising doesn't mean we're healthy, because we can train without a proper routine or without eating enough. The truth is, these are things we start to consider, and we should always keep them in mind. It might seem like a nuisance, but a healthy person has a beautiful life, they look more attractive; I don't mean to say they're ugly, haha, but they definitely look better. Older people, by taking care of their health, look more elegant, beautiful and young, and, to be honest, I love seeing them like that, seeing them working for something good, beautiful, a life full of strength. # Besides, we often say that medications are very expensive, and if you're not in pain, you don't buy them. It's understandable that medications are expensive, but health always comes first. But the worst part is that if we complain about the price of medications, it's going to be awful to see the cost of going to the hospital. That's why it's always best to have at least one medicine and a pill on hand; in tough times, they're there. We should always prioritize our health, friends. Don't eat too much fat, but don't starve yourself either; there are many things we should be mindful of, but, as I already said, you'll have a good life, you won't get pains so quickly, you'll feel younger and more attractive. If you can't go to a gym, you can jog in your neighborhood, haha, but it's super effective. Don't let what other people say stop you; it's your life and your health. Instead, you can recommend that they do the same, because today they might laugh, but tomorrow they'll thank you because they feel stronger, more confident, and healthier. The key is wanting it and having faith. Recognizing that we have a lot to accomplish, but that without proper care we can achieve nothing. #
![La salud Siempre es primero En la vida._20260422_193716_0000.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWgbwtbcLK1U4ND42B3Gv5agPMWvQCCGdyePrw5tSRYXp/La%20salud%20Siempre%20es%20primero%20En%20la%20vida._20260422_193716_0000.png)
Imagen diseñada en CANVA
#

>So, you know, friends, take good care of your health; medicines are expensive, but it's a huge favor we do ourselves, plus the strength and learning are greater. The truth is, I trust you all, and I know you take good care of your health. A big hug. # And well, friends. That's all for my post. I hope you enjoyed it and that it gave you food for thought. A big hug.

body.body: > Hello friends of the hive, it's a pleasure to greet you on this new occasion. I hope you are all well and have had a blessed day. Today I want to present this beautiful smoky eye makeup look, ideal for nights out. In the post, I show you how I created that brown shade, which was the tone I wanted. I hope you like it. \n

> The first step is to cleanse and moisturize my face. Then I begin my makeup, starting with my eyebrows. For this, I apply glycerin soap and shape my eyebrows. Now I work on my eyelids. I add concealer and blend it. Then I begin working on the eyelids. First, I use a soft brown eyeshadow as a base, then a medium brown, and finally a dark brown. This way, I build up the desired shade of brown. To finish, I apply black eyeliner. \n

> el primer paso es limpiar e hidratar el rostro, luego comienzo con mi maquillaje por las cejas para esto aplico jabon de glicerina y le doy la forma a mis cejes , ahora trabajo en el parpado , agrego corrector y difumino luego comienzo a trabajar en el parpado lo primero es un sombra café suave este me sirve como base, luego un café medio y finalemente el café oscuro de esta forma construyo el tono de café que deseo , para finalizar le realizo el delineado en color negro ![07587446-403F-43EB-94CB-823E5C89630C.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ariannysg/AJbpS97Zjw3MpUxDgJ4Ke49zVuhcihD8thgSYnx7nAuSzpaCeN8MPZq3ZioqWcv.jpeg)

body.title: Yu Gi Oh la película, la serie y el juego de Pc. Reseña y opinión. [Spanish-English]
body.body:
Hola amigos y amantes del anime hoy vengo a hablarles de un personaje del mundo anime casi tan famoso y especial como Naruto. Estamos hablando de Yu Gi Moto o el famoso Yu Gi Oh como también se lo conoce a nivel internacional 🌎🌏🌍.  Como mencionaba en el título existe la película, la serie y un juego de computadora que aún hoy a pesar de los avances y años sigue dejando a muchos pegados en el monitor 🖥️. Pero para comenzar, vamos a enfocar el contenido de hoy en la película 🍿🥤🎬 como un punto de partida para el inicio de nuestra historia y luego vamos con más. Listos para el duelo!.

___
___

<center>Yu-Gi-Oh! La película: Pirámide de la luz.</center>

<center>Breve resumen</center>
___
___

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbBjWoq1czjUNASgU8bZjcgHC4GcAAgnpRv1xyhuT4ura/1776899352337.jpg)

[www.imdb.com](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt0403703/)


La película de YuGi se resume en la lucha del bien y del mal. El dios de las muerte Anubis en el mundo egipcio reencarna en Seto Kaiba un joven ambicioso he inteligente de Japón. Yugi Moto por su parte es un adolescente simple sin ambiciones que irradia luz en cualquier parte y esto es lo que hace que la lucha entre ambos sea constante y sonante durante la entrega.  Siempre haciendo que venza el bien sobre el mal. 
___
___

Opinión personal y crítica 

Aunque la muestra cinematográfica de YuGi tuvo varias secuelas La pirámide de la luz fue una de las más exitosas. Mostraba en cada escena diversos efectos especiales representados por la lucha de los monstruos a través de un paquete de cartas mágicas. Dónde cada uno tenía un valor especial.

En mi época de adolescente este juego se hizo viral y cuando digo esto no fue por la cantidad de visualizaciones en plataformas como Youtube por ejemplo sino que hubieron muchos artistas digitales sobretodo que quisieron mostrar si arte sobre la base de las cartas y esto tuvo incluso consecuencias negativas sobretodo para los coleccionistas más antiguos. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaZQn3JXDvYMsZw7QTR3ExeQeuJrnv9C1K1vYpHFJq724/1776899553557.jpg)

[www.imdb.com](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt0403703/mediaviewer/rm1042612736/?ref_=tt_ph_1_2)

Más bien lo que hacía brillar a la película eran los varios efectos especiales y la combinación con la paleta de colores que mostraba desde colores oscuros hasta los más tenues. 
___
___

Reparto banda sonora 

Su reparto de actores originalmente estuvo representando por:

Dan Green - YuGi Moto
Eric Stuart - Seto Kaiba
Scott Rayow - Anubis
Wayne Grayson - Joey Wheeler
Greg Abbey - Tristan Taylor
Amy Birnbaum - Téa Gardner
Tara Sands/Tara Jayne - Mokuba Kaiba
Maddie Blaustein - Solomon Mutō
Darren Dunstan - Maximillion Pegasus

Su música fue otro de su fuerte donde estuvieron artistas y grupos de la talla The Black Eyed Peas, que contribuyó con la canción \

) en su versión inglesa. 
___
___

Conclusiones 

Ya para completar el viaje por la primera parte de YuGi esta entrega cinematográfica a pesar de que ya tiene algunos años en pantalla y no fue aceptada del todo por la crítica logró aun así demostrar que muchos necesitamos de un personaje como este que nos dé algo en qué creer y porque no soñar. En fi que le doy un 8/10 para ser un poco justos. Entonces si aún no la habéis visto todavía espero que les haya animado a ver la entrega junto a sus familiares y amigos más queridos. 

Entonces este fue mi contenido de hoy espero que les guste. Sin más nos vemos en la próxima vez. 

___
___

___
___

English version content 

Hello friends and anime lovers! Today I'm going to talk to you about a character from the anime world almost as famous and special as Naruto. We're talking about Yu-Gi-Oh!, or the famous Yu-Gi-Oh! as it's also known internationally 🌎🌏🌍. As I mentioned in the title, there's a movie, a series, and a computer game that, even today, despite advancements and years, still keeps many people glued to their monitors 🖥️. But to begin, we're going to focus today's content on the movie 🍿🥤🎬 as a starting point for our story, and then we'll delve deeper. Ready for the duel!

___
___

<center>Yu-Gi-Oh! The movie: Pyramid of Light.

Brief summary

___
___

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbBjWoq1czjUNASgU8bZjcgHC4GcAAgnpRv1xyhuT4ura/1776899352337.jpg)

[www.imdb.com](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt0403703/)

The Yu-Gi-Oh! movie can be summarized as the struggle between good and evil. Anubis, the Egyptian god of death, is reincarnated as Seto Kaiba, an ambitious and intelligent young man from Japan. Yugi Moto, on the other hand, is a simple, unambitious teenager who radiates light wherever he goes, and this is what makes the struggle between them constant and intense throughout the film. Good always triumphs over evil.

___
___

Personal Opinion and Critique

Although the Yu-Gi-Oh! movie had several sequels, *The Pyramid of Light* was one of the most successful. Each scene showcased various special effects represented by the battles of monsters using a set of magical cards, each with a special value.

During my teenage years, this game went viral, and I don't mean that because of the number of views on platforms like YouTube, for example. Rather, many digital artists, especially, wanted to showcase their art based on the cards, and this even had negative consequences, particularly for older collectors.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaZQn3JXDvYMsZw7QTR3ExeQeuJrnv9C1K1vYpHFJq724/1776899553557.jpg)

[www.imdb.com](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt0403703/mediaviewer/rm1042612736/?ref_=tt_ph_1_2)

Rather, what made the film shine were the various special effects and their combination with the color palette, which ranged from dark to the most subtle hues.

___
___

Soundtrack Cast

The original cast included:

Dan Green - YuGi Moto
Eric Stuart - Seto Kaiba
Scott Rayow - Anubis
Wayne Grayson - Joey Wheeler
Greg Abbey - Tristan Taylor
Amy Birnbaum - Téa Gardner
Tara Sands/Tara Jayne - Mokuba Kaiba
Maddie Blaustein - Solomon Mutō
Darren Dunstan - Maximillion Pegasus

The music was another of its strengths, featuring artists and groups such as The Black Eyed Peas, who contributed the song \

in its English version.

___
___

Conclusions

To complete the journey through the first part of YuGi, this film, despite being a few years old and not entirely well-received by critics, still managed to demonstrate that many of us need a character like this who gives us something to believe in and, why not, dream about. In short, I'd give it an 8/10 to be fair. So, if you haven't seen it yet, I hope this has encouraged you to watch it with your family and closest friends.

That's all for today's content. I hope you enjoyed it. See you next time!

body.title: “We Walk Past Art Without Seeing It / Caminamos sin ver el arte” [Eng/Spa]
body.body:
Sometimes we walk past art as if it were just part of the scenery… without stopping, without really seeing. We pass by sculptures, paintings, stories carved in stone or brushstrokes, and continue on as if nothing happened. I realized this during my visit to the Fine Arts Museum in Havana, Cuba.

I remember standing in front of a powerful sculpture, almost alive, where the figures seemed frozen in an eternal moment. While some visitors quickly took pictures and moved on, I chose to stay. To observe. To feel. And that’s when something shifted.

Art doesn’t demand attention… but it deserves it.

We’ve become used to fast consumption: images, videos, experiences. But art isn’t meant to be consumed, it’s meant to be contemplated. It’s a silent dialogue between the creator and the observer. And when you choose to listen, even for a moment, you discover emotions you didn’t know were there.

That day I understood it’s not about seeing art, but about allowing art to see you.

Maybe next time you walk past a piece of art, you’ll pause a little longer. Not out of obligation, but curiosity. Because in that small moment, there might be an unexpected connection.




A veces caminamos frente al arte como si fuera parte del paisaje… sin detenernos, sin mirar realmente. Pasamos al lado de esculturas, pinturas, historias talladas en piedra o pinceladas, y seguimos nuestro camino como si nada. Me di cuenta de eso durante mi visita al Museo de Bellas Artes en La Habana, Cuba.

Recuerdo estar frente a una escultura imponente, casi viva, donde las figuras parecían atrapadas en un instante eterno. Mientras algunos turistas tomaban fotos rápidas y seguían, yo decidí quedarme. Observar. Sentir. Y fue ahí cuando algo cambió.

El arte no exige atención… pero la merece.

Nos hemos acostumbrado a consumir rápido: imágenes, videos, experiencias. Pero el arte no es para consumir, es para contemplar. Es un diálogo silencioso entre quien crea y quien observa. Y cuando decides escuchar, aunque sea por un momento, descubres emociones que no sabías que estaban ahí.

Ese día entendí que no se trata de ver arte, sino de permitir que el arte te vea a ti.

Quizás la próxima vez que pases frente a una obra, te detengas un poco más. No por obligación, sino por curiosidad. Porque en ese pequeño gesto, puede haber una conexión inesperada.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR2VXz83eWNfSHoicSej3kjPvs9xzywsDrZwTDAFHgqob/1776901407301.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd4mRegxpKLZGtvcZ8kJMfGGFvhCnPVjGfhsk44LdKQAm/diy_4_.gif)

**Hello, Hive family, I hope you’re all doing well. As we start this new week, I’d like to show you this jumper design I made for my mum. It’s a simple jumper to make, very basic, yet at the same time it offers comfort, warmth and a smart look, depending on the occasion.**

Hola familia de Hive, espero que se encuentren muy bien. En esta nueva semana que inicia quiero mostrarles este diseño de suéter que le hice a mi mamá. Es un suéter sencillo de hacer, muy básico pero que al mismo tiempo brinda comodidad, seguridad y formalidad según el caso que requiera. 


# Materials - Materiales

- 1 metre of Ribb fabric
- Fuchsia-coloured thread

- 1 metro de tela Ribb 
- Hilo color Fucsia
 
# Step By Step - Paso a Paso 

**1**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcdod5P2YF2NGXzJHwn25u2vDuSgPVACsJy9WidvxrWHR/image.png)

Starting from the base of the front panels, the sleeves and the trims: the trim for the cuff, the trim sewn onto the neckline, and the bottom trim of the jumper. 

Desde la base de las piezas delanteras, las mangas y las cintas, cinta para hacer la pieza de la muñequera, la cinta que va cosida en el cuello y la cinta baja del sueter. 


**2**
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcQFpCUmgR6ryNvQAJY4nVEXfEqL4hjXSk1zBc1iYTrEp/image.png)

Next, we need to sew the sleeves in place at the underarm, using the basting stitches to ensure a neat finish! 


Luego debemos coser las mangas justo en la zona de la sisa y nos ayudamos con los afileres para tener un bonito acabado! 

**3**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWE6Eph2PAY5dKsiAoZiuqyaiCcqvoh9vi1mg4vLgmeRx/image.png)

We then proceed to sew the binding tape to the bottom of the jumper; this tape should be 3 centimetres shorter than the total diameter of the jumper. 


Luego procedemos a coser la cinta de costura en la parte baja del sueter, esta cinta debe ser 3 centímetros menores al diámetro total del sueter. 

**4**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZm5i1wQmuzGpL8rX8xGVM6EQSJ3x21iWj9nNUZe72Ras/image.png)
Next, we need to sew the neckline using a strip of the same fabric, and we also sew the sleeves to achieve a better finish.

Luego debemos coser la zona del cuello con una cinta de la misma tela y también cosemos la zona de las mangas para tener un mejor  resultado.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdbkoMcoSrseZ8sTaLLG6AvGNuA9jLgzXd1PNe6SAQ9g5/diy_5_.gif)

Here’s the final result of my project! I hope you like it. Thanks for stopping by; I look forward to your comments and suggestions. Have a lovely day, everyone! 

Este es el resultado final de mi proyecto! Espero que les guste. Gracias por pasar, espero sus comentarios y sugerencias. Feliz dia para todos! 


***Greetings, friends! May creativity always be with you!***
