body.title: Inspiration for students
body.body:
Greetings and parents and students. Today I want to talk to you about inspiration. Basically, we need inspiration at any point in our lives. If we do well in any work and if someone encourages us, then we become more interested in that work. That is, when we do something good and when people encourage us, our interest in that work increases more. Then we get more success in that work. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPLDyxwYGaEKLPmbP35fhMzS1b9Hd3wdH6VMCXVr8wrCr/photo-1660794486110-7fca371c86b0.jpeg [Source](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-man-speaking-into-a-microphone-irN49P-8yOU) Basically, how do you see inspiration in student life? A student needs a lot of inspiration in his life. Because if he gets inspiration, any person can do something good in life. Exactly the same activities are completed in a student's life. When a student studies in the classroom and is able to manage his activities, he should be encouraged. Suppose sir is taking a math class in your classroom. A math seemed very complicated to you. Then the teacher went to the blackboard and showed you the math well. After finishing the math well, you all said okay sir, we have understood the matter well and we have no problem understanding this whole math now. Now the question is? If sir again asks a student to solve the math, what will the student do here. The student will start doing the math on the blackboard directly. If the student can do the math, then he should be encouraged here. Although he has learned the math from sir and he has solved the math. But even then, the fact that he quickly grasped a difficult task in an easy way and was able to do the math with the proof of his brain deserves real praise. If that student is inspired and encouraged, that student can do even better. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPvwd5xxBwquG68Sixm91YTYLpQcHJgtLm4ZxtG1Z9AL6/photo-1758612898788-38a249839c1d.jpeg [Source](https://unsplash.com/photos/smiling-boy-wearing-glasses-studying-at-a-desk-_z2Ii760I38) We have different schools. Basically, students are discouraged there. When the teacher asks a student about a subject, sometimes a student gives a wrong answer. And the teacher and the students make fun and laugh a lot for giving that wrong answer. As a result, that student does not show interest in any other subject later. He has doubts in his mind and thinks that if he makes a mistake again, everyone will make fun of him. So later he tells the teacher about what he knows that he did not understand the matter. But here is a solution for the teacher and the students. Although a student said a mistake, the matter should have been explained to that student again. It is never right to make fun of him or make fun of the students. In this case, a lot of pressure is put on the motivation of the students and it disrupts the brain of the students. https://img.leopedia.io/DQma47ZrNbEQ6XkRV23kLdvfU91pyybzrGXxRn5fRKxTceq/pexels-ahmetkurt-35745591.jpg [Source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/teacher-and-student-giving-thumbs-up-at-school-35745591/) Basically, encouragement and motivation work very well for students. When a student learns one percent of his/her education, he/she needs 10% motivation. When a student is proficient in 10 percent of the subject, he/she needs to provide 50% motivation and celebration. And in this way, through gradual motivation, a student can make his/her life more beautiful and strong. Motivation and encouragement play a very important role in making his/her education life more rich and beautiful. So let us give motivation to students. We will never belittle them and make fun of them. Today, a student may have said a wrong thing, later the same student will correct his/her mistake and conduct his/her academic activities well. So every teacher and student should be by the side of every student. If we can provide celebration by being by each other, then every student will get good results and they will have a beautiful future. So let us provide motivation for students and encourage them. I think an encouragement will help children build and brighten their future.

body.title: Modern Gold II Unlocked”
body.body:
Splinterlands is not just a game for me now, it is like a special feeling in my daily life. Whenever I have some time at the beginning day in the middle a busy day, I enter this game. Because here there is not only the joy of winning battles, there is also planning, strategy, patience, experience and a different taste of self-improvement. Many people see games just entertainment, but for me Splinterlands is a place where I learn something new every day, test myself gain confidence to move forward step by step. The position I have reached today, unlocking Modern Gold II League, is not just a rank for me—it is a symbol my hard work, patience and consistency.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTcMJvqD832V3MJHy7SwedKMhLCr1q5oCk3CMqwb588rk/1776899797794.png)

When I first started playing Splinterlands, everything was not so easy. I could not win every match many times I chose  wrong cards used the wrong strategy, did not understand the opponent moves. But that is the real beauty this game. Even if you lose, there is an opportunity to learn. I learned  understand which team to use in which rules, which card is more effective in which mana cap, which Summoner Monster can turn the match around in which situations. Gradually, I realized that Splinterlands is not just a game  war—it is a game thinking, a game patience, a game making  right decisions.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcwrc7AakHouiXstLFgUmYd6p6C3QmVhbjBap5Qa6gKj8/1776899797987.jpg)

When the words “Modern Gold II Unlocked” appeared on my screen today, I honestly felt a strange joy in my chest. Because behind this achievement are countless matches, wins and losses, playing all night, changing strategies, upgrading cards, and constantly trying to improve myself. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYnGnaYFM7DzL3qhPB2PUfFRXNH6ZmUetMknPRLB2FNQN/1776899797923.jpg)

The gifts I have received for reaching  position are very valuable me. Because they are not just rewards, they are recognition of my hard work. The Merits that I received in the first place are very important. Merits in Splinterlands are a resource that can be used to purchase special Gladius Packs from the Guild Store. These Gladius cards are incredibly effective in Brawl battles.  As a result, the more Merits I can accumulate, the more powerful cards I can collect. This means that my contribution to future Guild Wars will increase. So these Merits seem like a future strength to me.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW9i1bNWMrbiPNoXLNbn8Xs9U9Qn1b2Q8Hrfy3a1PBZb8/1776899798286.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeVXRGC47j2L1tUGSC3psund3aCBgvSrEpWnQfU8Z2rfJ/1776899798126.jpg)

Then getting the Legendary Potion Charge is also a great joy. Because using Legendary Potion increases the chances getting a Legendary Card when opening a new Pack. Legendary cards in Splinterlands mean a different status, power, and often decisive role in the match. So this Potion Charge is a kind hope for me. Maybe when opening a Pack in future, luck will smile at me and I will get a card that will make my entire deck stronger.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeFMNJGKCc8wkkic9KPZh18A9WGDNgyQEypqP9Xmd7a3j/1776899926604.jpg)

The Alchemy Potion Charge is also very useful. It increases the chances of getting a Gold Foil Card. The Gold Foil card is not only beautiful to look at, but it also has a high financial value and often provides additional benefits in Battle or Reward. So this Potion Charge is like an investment in the future for me. Because getting a Gold Foil card is not only a matter of pride in collecting, but it can also provide good returns in the future.

I also got Scrolls, which are very valuable in the current system. Scrolls are usually used for various development purposes and bring new opportunities. If you save them you can use them for special upgrades crafting other purposes in future. So even though they look small they are very valuable.A regular player knows that even small rewards can eventually turn into big power.

Getting Energy is also a great thing for me. Because with Energy you can play more matches, earn more rewards, and maintain the continuity game. Sometimes, when Energy decreases, you have stop playing even if you want to. So getting Energy as a reward means an opportunity start fighting again with new enthusiasm.

Getting a card in Reward is one of the most enjoyable parts. Because every new card means new possibilities. Maybe a card wasn't in my deck before, now it will open up new strategies. If you get an extra copy an old card, you can Level Up and make it stronger. In Splinterlands, cards are not just collectibles, they are the foundation a player.

Seeing today's Reward Screen, I felt that hard work is never in vain. 

 Splinterlands sometimes feels like a reflection of real life to me. Just as planning is needed here, so is real life. Just as making mistakes here means losing, so does paying the price for mistakes in life. Just as trying repeatedly here means succeeding, so does life. So this game not only provides entertainment, it teaches a lot mentally.

I believe that those who give this game time and study hard will definitely understand its beauty. From the outside it may seem like it just a card battle. But when you go inside, you can understand that there is economy, community competition opportunities for self-improvement.

I have carefully looked at each reward I received today. Because these are not just numbers to me. 88 Merits, 163 Merits, 633 Merits—these are the calculations of my struggle. Potion Charges are my future potential. Scrolls are my future preparation. New cards are an increase in my power. And this entire Reward Package is a symbol of honor for me.

 

I don't want stop this journey mine. I will learn new things every day, play better build stronger decks climb higher leagues. Because Splinterlands is not just a game anymore, it is my addiction my joy my daily motivation. Today's reward and achievement have given me new strength. Even greater success awaits ahead—I am ready for it.

My i,d

body.title: Los Dos Caminos, Caracas, Venezuela
body.body:
> Even though it lies on the other side of the city, that day I looked out the window, saw the intense blue of the sky and the beauty of the fluffy clouds, and knew that it wouldn't be a day to stay at home. The best part is that my wife is always up for embarking on any new adventure right alongside me. I didn't know if we would just go for a walk, head out for some sweets, grab lunch, or catch a movie; but life led us to an area of ​​Caracas that we rarely visit these days—specifically, Los Dos Caminos. In fact, a large portion of our outing took place at the Millennium Shopping Center, the beautiful building you can see on the cover of this post.
***Miranda Square:*** ![IMG_20260315_124645.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/242Y7rJpS3PoBAPkpz1csi3QAKD3zZFykqDs86qNVu4vYFtekEnn7s562XPLpHJLZA4nG.jpg)

> ![IMG_20260315_124816.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/244KM7cKZCGxJnxGfjwo36xCQtiHzGvepVMkxYDYv9i444tLewyHf11zEs68HKrbL7Qdv.jpg) ![IMG_20260315_124752.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/245cWQMw8FnY5G7C7GcftgymZm8S1AJF1RNFLHh9M2DAbJDP3Paq31mtpeuhwLTfE45jQ.jpg)
There is a great deal of hustle and bustle in this popular and historic district of Caracas. Los Dos Caminos is home to a metro station, a Metrobús stop, major avenues, shopping centers, parks, and public squares; in fact, the photographs I have shared above were taken at Plaza Miranda—a spot I had always admired from a distance whenever I visited the nearby shopping mall. However, as I wanted to capture a good shot of the mall's façade, I ventured into the square itself, where an imposing statue of Francisco de Miranda stands alongside the fountains that bear his name. It wasn't a hot day, so stepping into the square on that particular occasion was absolutely perfect.
![IMG_20260315_124941.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/2423sVGnRAyZq7fpPEJEP6czxZy58wGC6m9qz6u7BRm4w6YhKqCG68JunkHS2xQ2KzE3w.jpg)

> ![IMG_20260315_125006.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/242DJAJ3XjJRUpQLZABmE4czcLGzPcgjvzXR8pFZnSSDfFzb2gqQBtC3aguAhcAfq7dMk.jpg) ![IMG_20260315_125018.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/243Be8SbnuabW9KBHRawDGo6NX4GsgBLYwPhmkahGiDdUvBzAsDw4ezR9kRi2ubGrfsFV.jpg)
I haven't visited this plaza at night, but I imagine that—since it lacks many trees and features only a few palm trees—many people avoid visiting it while the sun is shining intensely. In reality, however, one could sit there without suffering any ill effects; the clouds were doing their job. Since everything was close at hand, we ventured into the shopping mall, entering through its main façade—an iconic building with a peculiar architectural style that, when viewed from above, looks like a massive triangle lying across this part of Caracas. Inside the mall, we were able to do some shopping, had lunch, and even went to the movies. We spent many hours of that Sunday right there.
***The Millennium Shopping Center:*** ![IMG_20260315_125321.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/242hQ92Vp9Q2dmZxfJBoPZDn6eozrQPNk5aHTBwwpwHfuDiqxuGNzHjLfU2RMiKDPeR6F.jpg)

> ![IMG_20260315_125522.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23ywnspuXxGGshxF9iondBPtKBMe4MkiCYGiCR8NBLi6EV3NTKUMwhUftiy58dyL6DqQo.jpg) ![IMG_20260315_125426.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23wMcxvtQkjM7CKx86Qy3yEHSSJiGpGpNRHmx86wrMLuhXeazjtopdPdRiwHqNugtcAMG.jpg)
I mention this last point because, for those of us who don't own a car, the easiest way to enter is through the back of the shopping center; the rear entrances connect directly to all the bus routes and the metro. In fact—as I noted regarding the Plaza Miranda area I shared above—the main entrance isn't exactly accessible, though it *is* undoubtedly the best spot for taking photos! 😅 Upon entering through the main doors, you immediately take in the venue's five levels and its unusual architecture. It appears chaotic—and perhaps it is, to some extent—yet its entire structure proves quite logical if you analyze it closely. Visually, stepping inside feels like entering a space completely unlike any other shopping mall in the city.
![IMG_20260315_125948.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23u67Yrkcyt5TWueuRYu6s6JDgsdWb1u7ZA8xmLfyhc3nwLWpNYSFBKLa5SCEj4AXMBwp.jpg)

> ![IMG_20260315_130032.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23yTYxnNRfSBoaK4HRHAR1L9vLS29HeqE9hY1QusATvXGPGYUu9tVa8gNmjpc78o6VZ49.jpg) ![IMG_20260315_130046.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23xp47YN7qYaRdQww1eu8BdWBKKKtwV69PDSRUAX4fYVYiqzdHQ9PvcUCSYdCrLxMqSZK.jpg)
If you are an architecture enthusiast, then you are sure to enjoy the Millennium Shopping Center in Los Dos Caminos. It is a special—and almost mandatory—stop, and not merely within the city's eastern district; indeed, it ranks as one of the capital's most iconic, visited, and frequently mentioned landmarks. In fact, I believe that one of the best movie theaters in Caracas is located right here—at the Cines Unidos complex on the top floor. Modernity and beauty are the defining characteristics of this area, which happens to be situated just a stone's throw from Generalísimo Francisco de Miranda Park—better known as *Parque del Este*. Moreover, located right behind the shopping center is a transport hub that can take you to *Parque Los Chorros*; thus, if you set out from this spot, these two special, lush green spaces become—in a sense—interconnected.
***Rear Entrance (the most popular):*** ![IMG_20260315_130425.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/245mvzxYFqpcqRjgeX8oP9P4Fjnf3maYGNKL1F1PNYncYGHVQPpVY2BKMQQ5WX5aBhdxs.jpg) |![IMG_20260315_130329.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23xydo56XGnmXVqc63pfcdtvPAVqmo8VJcc6v1GFCSMv1ewEiEu29minuVxNPtwySJgfP.jpg)|![IMG_20260315_130254.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/246ajs58KbooQY5HgqkbwX5oUVceGEqtRgGc9YxwhJkhU5yg8chmsH8RCfSrYKV4uMVmH.jpg)|![IMG_20260315_130608.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23xyZHtnBPnV4Es93izHjWGMx13uU37fj2fpxGTm2Ng9WSVaxq22bCHxBQEyuDm3P1Wso.jpg)| |-|-|-| ![IMG_20260315_130631.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23wgHqcoMDti9SRGbcg71R19G936t6Cd9SJiXk1PPenYkaEAMbXVfNg72fjTdGxRvQvW5.jpg)
Thank you for visiting, reading, and supporting this post; it means a great deal to me—plus, I really enjoy marking new places on the Hive map. If you happen to be in Caracas, I invite you to take a stroll through Los Dos Caminos—specifically the Millennium Shopping Center—especially if you haven't visited it yet. You won't regret it; the entire area is beautiful. And if you're planning a trip to the city, it's definitely a spot you might want to consider. Personally, I usually make the trip out here for the cinema; while it isn't particularly large, the venue is visually appealing, and it’s well worth spending some time enjoying the facilities and sharing a delicious snack. A warm hug to everyone—until the next post! 🙏
![IMG_20260315_124900.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/EqNJW6uGPq9TMcjEMbQ1SVB81FeyPgngQcG96cxvynyvsU679eoskPWLCHiRZxgqNYQ.jpg) [//]:# (!worldmappin 10.49564 lat -66.83392 long Los Dos Caminos d3scr)

body.title: Exquisite vegan brownie (ENG - ESP)
body.body:
***Greetings, dear vegan community 😊💚***

* ***Saludos, querida comunidad vegana 😊💚***

---
---
![photo_5136610024087031099_x.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23xKvnFfxJznjDtHF1EtTEobesHGhcBjYuYxZCXfCSbLrmXT4Ry81yLw9vL5QRa3pqoNG.jpg)

---
---
Today our dessert will be brownies! Yes, more chocolate desserts, but who can resist that flavor? Chocolate is synonymous with energy, well-being, and joy 😊 I think it's because of all these qualities that chocolate becomes so addictive.

I hope you'll join me in preparing this recipe because I'm sure you'll fall in love with it. This brownie is perfect, not only for its delicious flavor and soft, moist texture, but also because it's super easy to make. When you see the ingredients I'm going to use, you'll have no doubt about how wonderful this recipe is.

This recipe won't take up much of your time. I think you'll only need 15 minutes to measure and weigh the ingredients and prepare the batter, plus approximately 20 minutes for baking. So in no time, you'll have a magnificent dessert to enjoy after lunch, as I did, but it's also ideal for breakfast or an afternoon snack 😉

+ Hoy nuestro postre será brownie, si, más postres con chocolate, ¿pero ¿quién se puede resistir a ese sabor? si el chocolate es sinónimo de energía, bienestar y alegría 😊 creo que, por todas esas cualidades, el chocolate se vuelve tan adictivo.

+ Deseo que me acompañen a preparar esta receta, porque estoy segura de que les va a enamorar, este brownie es perfecto, no solo por su sabor tan delicioso, su textura suave y húmeda, sino también porque es super fácil de hacer,  cuando veas los ingredientes que voy a usar no tendrás dudas de lo estupenda que es esta receta.

+ Esta receta no quitará mucho de tu tiempo, creo que solo necesitarás 15 minutos entre medir, pesar los ingredientes y en preparar la mezcla, mas 20 minutos aproximados para que se hornee, así que en poco tiempo tendrás un postre magnifico para disfrutar después del almuerzo como fue mi caso, pero también es ideal para desayunar o merendar 😉

***If you're interested in the recipe, I invite you to join me! 😉***

+ ***¡Si te interesa la receta, te invito a que me acompañes! 😉***

# Ingredients:
-150 grams of banana or one large banana.
-60 grams of ground oats or oat flour.
-2 tablespoons of unsweetened cocoa powder.
-5 tablespoons of plant-based milk (I used almond milk).
-3 tablespoons of sugar or your preferred sweetener (this step is optional).
-2 tablespoons of peanut butter (you can use almond butter or extra virgin coconut oil).
-1/2 teaspoon of vanilla extract.
For decoration: chocolate-covered peanuts (you can also use walnuts or chocolate chips).
-Mold: 500 ml capacity.

+ # Ingredientes:
+ -150 gramos de banana o una banana grande.
+ -60 gramos de avena molida o harina de avena.
+ -2 cucharadas de cacao en polvo sin azúcar.
+ -5 cucharadas de leche vegetal, yo he usado de almendras.
+ -3 cucharadas de azúcar o el endulzante de tu preferencia, este paso es opcional.
+ -2 cucharadas de mantequilla de maní, puedes usar mantequilla de almendras o aceite de coco extra virgen.
+ -1/2 cucharadita de esencia de vainilla.
+ -Para decorar: maní cubierto de chocolate, también puedes usar nueces o chispas de chocolate.
+ -Molde: 500 ml de capacidad.

![photo_5136610024087031078_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EpEGmACPrCMCLyDRGctftwMxtW9DF1sZnVRqM72t6DEajp72wRHDqFjqmT1SRdc3XGK.jpg)

---
---
# Let's get started:

Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius (350 degrees Fahrenheit).

+ # Vamos con la preparación:

+ Precalentamos el horno a 180 grados.

We start by mashing the banana until we get a puree.

+ Empezamos triturando la banana hasta que nos quede un puré.

![photo_5136610024087031079_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoAaJwXEgF1wFyjXjNbR7zdkgBipvgNPW4Q6VRSuLbkEj2WpsHEcab76K5rJn4CMPCn.jpg)

Then we put the banana puree in a bowl, add the peanut butter, vanilla essence and plant-based milk.

+ Luego echamos el puré de banana en un recipiente, le agregamos la mantequilla de maní, la esencia de vainilla y la leche vegetal.

![photo_5136610024087031080_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/Eokd6DJNZuVN7wiT3nfqcdHLwLtQE9vaABrJ2FHzp41pif6fj9QjuTsy3NjZZZjj4CV.jpg)

---
![photo_5136610024087031081_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EogNNc2h5qNT2jB8EZWvchib4iv538KYvfCYLXzzG1rxioUcJ3UFgf2HtmednkaomCk.jpg)

---
![photo_5136610024087031082_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoGxthRoxD3et6hmsPmM614WF5P8ZxMjSNTmthKqEjwedj2e2RRfUmDqYE6U1ejb42k.jpg)

We mix, thoroughly integrating the ingredients.

+ Mezclamos integrando bien los ingredientes.

![photo_5136610024087031083_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/Eokd7CmpbL1FP2q5Amwt2NVsY9YWypKr2G193fFHj81Hd2cevUcnVUYRYaEuwXge23d.jpg)

Now we add the dry ingredients: ground oats, cocoa powder, and baking powder.

+ Ahora incorporamos los ingredientes secos, la avena molida, el cacao en polvo y el polvo para hornear.

![photo_5136610024087031084_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23w2ieKvYBx2CVM2tJ2vR5VJrSooGujYbuboaLLja3WeBx1m9KH23Werbqm2KJ8h9nhbM.jpg)

---
![photo_5136610024087031085_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23u67LBsTh8bzxapHFTUjjgxN9fnV47R41K6yba9M3j5xXR5hSmTXJcNvqVjd3WRdKx1n.jpg)

---
![photo_5136610024087031086_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EogNp3v4c2jVW6kgAYgcv33DkSRDL9Vs7yeXn57XptbXU2ucm4ozwecPJi3dvXmNnY3.jpg)

We mix again until we obtain a homogeneous mixture.

+ Mezclamos nuevamente hasta obtener una mezcla homogénea.

![photo_5136610024087031087_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EpA3w7a9nvBV8BcYSg3qb9qDEs4s4br8G1dKAJXAtpXiMiq7bDx4b8pDDKKQCiKbZiP.jpg)

---
![photo_5136610024087031088_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoyQ4U88pYUnR5GmduJRcSxp363Yyw27UTTCaGAbT1mNr3Bousmi33FmrFABWNAm4vh.jpg)

We pour the mixture into the mold we have chosen.

+ Vertemos la mezcla en el molde que hayamos elegido.

![photo_5136610024087031089_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23vsNg1Zq6MNVUH2DfQX1T1VPN7caNkYqScqKiN2qPThrg6YEsCJq9GTaAmc3D7BY5vZn.jpg)

Now we decorate. This time I've used chocolate-covered peanuts, which gives it an extra touch of chocolate and a touch of crunch from the peanuts. You can also decorate with nuts or chocolate chips.

+ Ahora decoramos, en esta oportunidad he usado maní cubierto de chocolate, esto le da un toque extra de chocolate y un toque de crocancia por el maní, puedes decorar también con nueces o chispas de chocolate.

![photo_5136610024087031090_x.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23wCJN8URsLTLWj4CiXpTSiGCz4Fdopq3F4bYYXUbApFveDnvpUU7uMBZKvuRnKKMVLp8.jpg)

---
![photo_5136610024087031092_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EpA228uFLP5HUDoXJZBqsCHxDzNPiiDeKq8tgzxj8Lq8ixVmv5R9TZfYticRd9ZfVVo.jpg)

We put it in the oven for approximately 20 minutes, make sure to do the toothpick test, if you insert it in the center and it comes out dry, it means that our cake is ready, probably in this case the toothpick comes out slightly wet, it is normal, because the brownie has a moist texture.

+ Llevamos al horno por aproximadamente 20 minutos, asegúrate de hacer la prueba del palillo, si lo introduces en el centro y sale seco, significa que nuestra torta está lista, probablemente en este caso el palillo salga ligeramente húmedo, es normal, porque el brownie su textura es húmeda.

![photo_5136610024087031093_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23xVMX6dADHuhQqvqQ7bYT4GSSTGUMHueYkMd7f3bdcgd15L8wktzqR7Bzq6Xsi1pH327.jpg)

---
![photo_5136610024087031094_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23wC9VMjTy1TpzYRYFgJu7AJh9JCVBRG4vMXErwn2okKk8coJxkvnGavzxxgFbTPcaESW.jpg)

***Once it's ready, take it out of the oven, let it cool slightly before unmolding, and enjoy! 😍***

+ ***Al estar listo, sacamos del horno, dejamos enfriar un poco para desmoldar, ¡y disfrutar! 😍***

![photo_5136610024087031095_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EpJY8AejjatKvSWaecAgJE5xowhCPJ5kg5ZpNnjDoEdB59Lh9GG6TxHW4Vn5vfJtgtf.jpg)

---
![photo_5136610024087031096_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23xVMEECWjsaYvtik8mAQJKCSFeFhPSp6Cm1h3i43JinyJfaYqqB4jmMQTL756PPVrcAM.jpg)

---
![photo_5136610024087031097_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23yd5bqveK6uw43GYFyTTrkcpr4manMh9SwDx7gxLb5HKbQKQiXH2n6D8dCtMYpvSMb2f.jpg)

---
---
**Serves:** 6 small portions.

+ **Rinde:** 6 pequeñas porciones.

**I hope you'll try this recipe! If you're a chocolate lover, you're going to love this brownie! 👌 See you soon!**

+ **Espero y te animes a preparar esta receta, si eres apasionado del chocolate, ¡este brownie te va a encantar 👌 hasta pronto!** 

# <center>Thank you for your kind company and support, may the Creator bless you generously 🙏</center>

+ # <center>Gracias por tu amable compañía y apoyo,que el Creador te bendiga generosamente 🙏</center>

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23tRmZS3sdUh1CH46rTPA2XMrJ8Hi76bJUZaYx5JjmmyWRaRaPi1JjvFQcPwQhRrCG92r.png)






<center><sub>Photos are my own, taken and edited with my Tecno Spark 20C phone.
Separators and shapes from Microsoft Word.
Collage used: CollageMaker.</sub></center>

+ <center><sub>Fotos de mi propiedad tomadas y editadas con mi teléfono Tecno Spark 20C.
Separadores y Figuras de Microsoft Word.
Collage Usado: CollageMaker.</sub></center>

body.title: Escalation Death Units
body.body: > It's been a few seasons now since **Escalation**, a Conclave Arcana mini-set, was released, which introduced new cards and new abilities that once again shake the game's meta. The mini-set has consisted of 43 cards in total, with 12 commons, 12 rares, 8 epics, and 11 legendaries, not including the promo cards that can only be acquired by participating in the set presale and the additional Archons that will be airdropped through conflicts soon. In this post, I want to take a look at all the Death units from Escalation. ![CA.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23tvY7mZ5F1UqsiqG2X3RRGzAX3ozTT6Hq4tcztUxyzehmwovZ6ty8JR6rmEoqVCkYBQp.png)

>

The Escalation Death units consisted of cards under different bloodlines, so, depending on what their bloodlines were, it was possible for them to be used by Archons from other elements and benefit from their Bloodline Dominion abilities. But aside from that, they had these new abilities that could affect the result of the battles.

<div class=\

>


**Magnificent Mollusk** is a Tideborn range unit with a max damage of 7, Along with some decent speed, armor and health stats. The catch is that summoning this unit will require you to spend 13 mana, making it difficult to use on low and mid mana battles. It also doesn't have *Close Range*, making it quite useless when it goes to the first position, unless, you summon it with the Archon **Razi Clanktrap**. As far of its abilities goes, it only has 2 abilities, one of which was *Demoralize* that reduces the melee damage of all opponent units, and one of the new abilities called *Apex Strike* that targets the enemy unit with the highest attack.
In terms of other Archon use, this card can be used by the Life Archon **Captain Frankie**, and with that, it gains the *Inspire* ability to boost the attack of all your allied melee units, and through tactics, you can give this card the *Piercing* and *True Strike* ability that will make sure that you would not miss your target and able to inflict damage to it even if it has an armor. ___

>
https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/website/abilities/ability_apex-strike.png
Apex Strike - Targets the enemy unit with the most power.
___

>
On the other hand, **Shire Knacker** was another range unit with the Halfling Bloodline, with a maximum of 3 damage for 5 mana that can strike the closest non-melee unit with its *Snipe* ability, and as a support, it has the *Rust* ability that reduce the armor of all opponent units, as well as *Invigorate* that will keep any units from being *Exhausted*, making it a good match with cards that has the *Weary* debilitation and units with the *Soul Siphon* ability, such as **Heloise the Hollow** Being a range unit, Using it with **Razi Clanktrap** will give it the *Close Range* ability, so even if it gets into the first position, it will still have the means of attacking the enemy unit. ___

> Moving on with the rare units, we had **Ignited Alchemist**, which is a 5-mana non-damage unit, so the only way that it can attack was if it was placed next to a card with *Weapon's Training* ability, and make use of its *Affliction* ability to prevent the opponent unit from being healed, which it can also further spread out through the opponent units due to its *Scattershot* ability. Aside from that, this card also has *Flying*, which will enable it have better chance to evade both melee and range attack. But it has some downside to use since it has the *Incendiary* debilitation that will inflict burn damage to this card. It has the *Flamefed* ability that will allow it to increase in health instead, but the problem was that the Burning has 33% chance to spread among allied units. Since it was a Dwarf unit, using it along with the Fire Archon **Fithe Bladestone** will gain this card the *Void* ability, reducing the damage it receives from magic units, and it is also posible that this card has some good use with **Razi Clanktrap** if you use a lot of Gnome units since they will gain *Painforge* and increase their damage each time they get the Burning damage. ___

>
https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/website/abilities/ability_flame-fed.png
Flame Fed - When Burning, instead of losing health, gains +1 health and max health at the beginning of each round.
___

>
**Grimshield Hexpriest**, on the other hand, was a *Leonine* magic unit, that can inflict a maximum of 8 damage on its target, and with *Apex Strike*, the initial target of this card will be the enemy unit with the most attack. Aside from that, it also has *Void* that reduces magic attacks to half and *Magic Reflect* that will return magic damage towards the attacker. This was certainly a good anti-magic, magic unit. Among the modern Archons, using it with the Archon **Lorkus** will allow it to gain an additional magic attack, and if you want to, you can also give it the *Life Leech* and *Affliction* tactics, so that this card can gain more health as it damage your opponent units. ___

>
For the only Epic Life unit, we have the range unit **Vextali**, which has the *Goblin* bloodline, so it gains the *Deflect* ability when used with the Fire Archon **Hanv**. Its *Kindred Spirit* ability will give the unit next to it that has the *Kindred Will* the *Stregthen* ability and got all your team a health boost, but its *Final Rest* ability makes it kind of underwhelming amongst the epic cards in the mini-set, given how the ability was recently nerfed. Aside from that, it has the *Return Fire* ability that returns range damage to the attacker. By the way, for an epic card, this unit only costs 3 mana to use, so it can be used on low mana and little league battles. ___

>

Moving to the legendary units, we have **Kyraseth Nythlarian**, which is a melee unit with the *Elf* Bloodline, so it gains the *Execute* ability from the bloodline skill when used with the Earth Archon **Kaylia Silverleaf**. It does not have much health and damage, but it still deserves to be a legendary unit, since it does not cost any mana to use, and can attack the opponent with the least health using its *Opportunity* ability. Aside from that, it has the *Bloodline Pact* ability, which is kind of similar to *Bloodlust*, but will trigger if any of the cards that share bloodline with this card defeat an opponent, which will increase the damage of all the cards with the same bloodline.

___

<div align=\

>
https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/website/abilities/ability_bloodline-pact.png
Bloodline Pact -Allied units that share this unit's bloodline gain +1 power when any of them defeats an enemy and take 1 true damage when any of them is defeated. If this unit is defeated, allied units that share its bloodline take 2 damage and lose all power gained from this ability.
___

> And finally, we have the Rodentian unit **Skrika**, with both melee and range attack, for 7 mana. It has the *Charge* ability that allows it to use melee attack in any position, and when it got yo the first position, its *Bulwark* ability will now be triggered and will now gain an additional 8 health and armor though it will also lose -2 attack in the process. Aside from that its *Kindred Will* will give the unit with *Kindred Spirit* the *Life Leech* ability and be able to gain health for every time that they inflict damage to their opponent. Being a Rodentian unit, it can be summoned by the Life Archon **Captain Frankie** and gains the *Inpire* ability. And given that it has melee attack, the more Rodentian and Tideborn units in your team, the stronger the melee damage of this card would be. Now you just need to give it the *True Strike* and *Piercing* ability to make sure that it can effectively inflict those damage.

>
https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/website/abilities/ability_bulwark.png
Bulwark -When in the first position, -2 power, +8 health, and +8 armor.

> And that was it for my early assessment of the Escalation Death units. So far, I find them not as strong as the units from other elements. Can't be really certain right now as I neither do own or rent any of the cards. But the recent nerf to the *Final Rest* may have heavily affected my assesment. Thank you, and see you on the next post!

body.title: I Live for People Like You | L.O.H #285 (EN-ES)
body.body:
I couldn't post yesterday due to lack of time, but every week I'm very mindful of contributing my bit to the #LadiesofHive initiative. Better late than never, and it's better to be here and now. We must remember why we live, because it's something very easy to forget when we feel lost in the darkness. Even if we sometimes take steps backward, we mustn't forget to take a step forward.
![candle-8661042_1280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neotopher/EoCgEwKSJgZpRWqHc5GhPRvHwgVy1gCd2rUxAXUJW8WGDaEqsMDW4A5NNQgScNmDSMf.jpg) [SOURCE](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/vela-fuego-luz-de-una-vela-incendio-8661042/)
#### **Right now in your life, what feels like your main reason for living? How would you describe your purpose at this moment, and what keeps you moving forward each day?** My main reason for doing what I do in life is for my loved ones; without them, I am nothing. My purpose at this stage of my life is to move forward and prosper without rushing into the future. Time is something that slips through my fingers; every minute counts, and I don't want to waste it on things like the unattainable ideal of success or the greatest amount of money imaginable, because in the end, those who truly matter are the people who remember your name.
![Separa.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neotopher/48PwZMRqLxxMKLKxytNfynhQzrWAcWzbcD2LYQfU59uX2C7kHETsVr5TPhHe5va3NY.png)
Original version in Spanish Ayer no pude publicar por falta de tiempo, pero cada semana tengo muy presente que debo aportar mi grano de arena en la iniciativa de #LadiesofHive. Es mejor tarde que nunca y es mejor aquí y ahora. Hay que recordar porqué vivimos, por que es algo muy fácil de olvidar cuando nos sentimos perdidos en la oscuridad. Aunque algunas veces se den pasos hacia atrás, no hay que olvidar dar un paso hacia el frente.
![candle-8661042_1280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neotopher/EoCgEwKSJgZpRWqHc5GhPRvHwgVy1gCd2rUxAXUJW8WGDaEqsMDW4A5NNQgScNmDSMf.jpg) [FUENTE](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/vela-fuego-luz-de-una-vela-incendio-8661042/)
#### **En este momento de tu vida, ¿cuál crees que es tu principal razón para vivir? ¿Cómo describirías tu propósito en este momento y qué te mantiene avanzando cada día?** Mi principar razón por la cual hago lo que hago en mi vida es por mis seres queridos, sin ellos, yo soy nada. Mi propósito en esta etapa de mi vida es avanzar y prosperar sin prisa por el futuro. El tiempo es algo que se me escapa de las manos, cada minuto cuenta y no quisiera gastarlo en cosas como el ideal de éxito inalcanzable o la mayor cantidad de dinero que se te ocurra, porque al final, quienes si importan son las personas que recuerdan tu nombre.

![Separa.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neotopher/48PwZMRqLxxMKLKxytNfynhQzrWAcWzbcD2LYQfU59uX2C7kHETsVr5TPhHe5va3NY.png)
Translation by [deepl.com](https://www.deepl.com/es/translator)
![Topher tenkiu.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neotopher/EpENgWgAqX2r8DoxTJwqkQiu4V36Xp1ZVNk2J9KZQ4M7eFsZjFXBNX6Szr6zm8i19Ru.jpeg)

body.title: [ES/EN] Leading the Elite Force
body.body:
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmT1WtjrPvzBp3nu4tTFtoiqmKr2GSyfahtbu2anZBYhup/Portada%20-%20Leading%20the%20Elite%20Force.png</center>

<center>Some time has passed since **Elite Force** arrived on **April 14, 2026**. After having tried to clarify some doubts about how it works in a previous publication, now I want to talk about how I face and direct my strategy when I find battles with this Ruleset. This being a card limiting Ruleset, it will be focused on players who use or have collections that are mostly cards from reward sets and the **Chaos Legion** set like mine.</center>

><center>Ya ha pasado un tiempo desde que llegó **Elite Force** el **14 de abril de 2026**. Después de haber intentado aclarar algunas dudas de cómo funciona en una publicación anterior, ahora quiero hablar de cómo yo enfrento y dirijo mi estrategia cuando encuentro batallas con esta Ruleset. Esta al ser una Ruleset limitador de tarjetas estará enfocado a los jugadores que usan o tiene colecciones que en su mayoría son tarjetas de conjuntos de recompensas y del conjunto **Chaos Legion** como la mía.</center>

### <center> Elite Force</center><center> https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQ9a7pxik6Wqjw2jb1PppkmNrXLgDiQndVqe8U2WJzvD2/img_combat-rule_elite-force_150.png </center>

- **Elite Force:** You can not summon common units.

>- **Elite Force:** No puedes invocar unidades comunes.

### <center>Disabled cards | Tarjetas deshabilitadas</center>

<center>Many may think that it is not very different from other limiting Rulesets but the lack of habit can make a huge difference and in my case, it can be seen a lot by affecting many cards such as:</center>

><center>Muchos pueden pensar que no es muy diferente a otras Rulesets limitantes pero la falta de costumbre puede hacer una enorme diferencia y en mi caso se puede ver mucha al afectar a muchas tarjetas como:</center>

- **Arkemis the Bear**: one of my main tanks having good statistics, having **Forcefield** and giving armor to the entire team.
>- **Arkemis the Bear**: uno de mis tanques principales al tener buenas estadísticas, tener **Forcefield** y dar armadura a todo el equipo.

- **Junker**: a card that combines very well with **Arkemis the Bear** being able to attack from the second position and repair armor but which on its own is very good with teams that have armor.
>- **Junker**: una tarjeta que combina muy bien con **Arkemis the Bear** al poder atacar desde la segunda posición y reparar armadura pero que por sí sola es muy buena con equipos que tiene armadura.

- **Goblin Psychic**: one of the best support cards for the **Earth** element.
>- **Goblin Psychic**: uno de las mejores tarjetas de apoyo del elemento **Tierra**.

- **Imperial Knight**: a very good anti-magic tank.
>- **Imperial Knight**: un muy buen tanque antimagia.

- **Vruz**: a booster due to its **Martyr** with high speed to ensure it attacks before being eliminated.
>- **Vruz**: un potenciador por su **Martyr** con mucha velocidad para asegurar que ataca antes de ser eliminado.

<center>Among other cards that I will not be able to use.</center>

><center>Entre otras tarjetas más que no podré usar.</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQ5HSJkwMMFk9FVJoa1gWPm62SSD6xPUz6U3Txg8ZJtAZ/Separador%20-%20Wild.png</center>

<center>I will concentrate on my strategies in the **Wild** format since they are the ones that can also be used in another format being **Survival** and it is where I have had the most battles with this new Ruleset in addition to another reason that I will say later.</center>

><center>Me concentraré en mis estrategias en el formato **Wild** ya que son las que se pueden usar también en otro formato siendo **Survival** y es donde más he tenido batallas con esta nueva Ruleset además de otra razón que diré más adelante.</center>

<center>[Epics and Legendaries | Épicas y Legendarias](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_ca2fb9a5be1e808166b6fd06fb451ad9?ref=durlan)</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPhRy3pwcoXdWuT86ZGAdjtMVCkvVBGjpy6CrJhoNmx1B/Epicas%20y%20Legendarias%20V2.png</center>

<center>The easiest way to win battles is to use strategies already proven in teams that do not use **Common** cards so you avoid the randomness of experimenting. Like this battle where I don't use **Rare** cards either.</center>

><center>La forma más fácil de ganar las batallas es usar estrategias ya probadas en equipos que no usan tarjetas **Comunes** así evitas el azar de estar experimentando. Como esta batalla donde tampoco uso tarjetas raras.</center>

<center>[Battles with limiters | Batallas con limitantes](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_85826be165e5d0a8e4bac9a3ff7d8833?ref=durlan)</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQme5zbJdQK7s6AEfAmbbx2RiwmP5FuMgq29jpoPY83eTUo/Batallas%20con%20limitantes%20V2.png</center>

<center>One of the things about limiting Rulesets is how restrictive battles are when joined with other limiting Rulesets, which complicates team building but also makes it easier to predict how enemy teams will be and facilitates being able to counteract them.</center>

><center>Una de las cosas de las Rulesets limitadoras es lo restrictivas que son las batallas cuando se une a otra Rulesets limitantes lo que complica hacer los equipos pero también que sea más fácil predecir cómo serán los equipos enemigos y facilita el poder contrarrestarlos.</center>

<center>[Battles with extra abilities | Batallas con habilidades extra](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_953b91ce4d9e70113a92c1c7a642d44d?ref=durlan)</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdjuGu6573vw7518cMZaUFGe4XtmV8Vmpy8Qp7QT28ZKD/Batallas%20con%20habilidades%20extra%20V2.png</center>

<center>Another frequent Ruleset are those that give an extra ability to all units that, by not being able to use **Common** cards, can be hindered by not having key units.</center>

><center>Otra de las Rulesets frecuentes son las que dan una habilidad extra a todas las unidades que al no poder usar tarjetas **Comunes** puede verse dificultado al no contar con unidades clave.</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbWHMXswDfxpKCjPrFL6BBUfc73AMPyBqJkrxdsszTvz5/Separador%20-%20Frontier.png</center>

<center>For now I have not had any battles in the **Frontier** format with the **Elite Force** Ruleset and searching the battle histories of my opponents they haven't had any battles with **Elite Force** either, which makes me think that this Ruleset is disabled for this format, which would be reasonable given the limited amount of cards and even more considering that **Common** rarity cards are a third of the total cards, which are **19** in the **Core** set and **1** in the **Extra** set.</center>

><center>Por ahora no he tenido ninguna batallas en el formato **Frontier** con la Ruleset de **Elite Force** y buscando en los historiales de batallas de mis oponente tampoco han tenido ninguna batallas con **Elite Force** lo que me hace pensar que esta Ruleset está deshabilitada para este formato lo cual sería algo razonable por la cantidad limitada de tarjetas y más teniendo en cuenta que las tarjetas de rareza **Común** son un tercio del total de tarjetas que son **19** en la conjunto básico (**Core**) y **1** en el conjunto jackpot (**Extra**).</center>

<center>Although it could be that the chances of this ruleset appearing in battle are very low or that I and the players I reviewed have not seen it appear, since although they would be very limiting battles, those battles where all the team positions are not reached and thinking of the best strategies to counteract battles without **Commons** would be very interesting.</center>

><center>Aunque puede ser que las posibilidades de que esta ruleset aparezca en batalla sea muy baja o que yo y los jugadores a los que revisé no nos haya aparecido ya que aunque serían batallas muy limitantes serían muy interesante esas batallas donde no se llegue a todas las posiciones del equipo y pensando las mejores estrategias para contrarrestar las batallas sin **Comunes**.</center>

<center>But taking into account as I had already said in my publication talking about the arrival of **Elite Force**, this Ruleset buffs or greatly improves **Water** element teams since their **Archons** boost the magic damage of the team where all the cards with magic damage are **Rare** and higher and there will be no tanks to resist their attacks.</center>

><center>Pero teniendo en cuenta como ya había dicho en mi publicación hablando de la llegada de **Elite Force** esta Ruleset buffea o mejora mucho los equipos del elemento **Agua** ya que su **Archons** potencia el daño mágico del equipo donde todas las tarjetas con daño mágico son raras y superiores y no habrá tanques que resistan sus ataques.</center>

# <center>[Join Splinterlands here. / Unete aqui a Splinterlands.](https://splinterlands.com/?ref=durlan)</center>

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@durlan/esen-leading-the-elite-force-qf)

你说生活平静却又不平静，欢仔昨天打电话我，说是在外面打球，不小心摔到手了，刚开始我还以为是他开玩笑，哪知过了一会儿，他又打电话我，说是今天摔到手还真的有点痛，问我第一节课可以接他，听到他说到这么严重。

我急冲冲敢到学校，没有想到手心既然留血了，我说你怎么总是打球把自己弄得伤痕累累，为妈看到你这样，心也是累？第一节后，急着带他去社区总医院，哪知医生说照片只能白天照，我只有开了个转诊单 ，又转到康华去看。

这结果一出来，把我们吓了一跳，医生说，手指骨折了，要么住院做手术，要不手上打石膏，欢欢一听到自己骨折，更是吃惊，这点伤既然骨折，而且我看他的表情，还挺开心的，我说你手指骨折，你还笑得出。

我看你这笑容，比任何时都开心，也许娃娃第一次骨折吧，费用都用了一千了，还不知能不能很快就好，医生说一般来说要30天，下周就是期中考试了，老师说下周能参加考试吗？我说估计拿不了笔，还要看看下周怎么样。

为了今天带他看医生，我五点多就起来了，然后跑到公司去把事情弄好，后来又急冲冲带他去看医生，晚上下班又去接他，真的够累的一天，还好的是孩子这次开窍，受伤了，还坚持去学校，这是值得表扬的,生活总有鸡毛又不蒜皮的事找你，但愿欢欢能汲取教训。

---

body.title: Multimedia En La Terminal
body.body: Si bien hoy día el uso de la terminal en Linux es algo opcional, el desarrollo de aplicaciones y herramientas de terminal continúan, por diversos motivos existen personas que prefieren seguir utilizando la terminal sobre aplicaciones con una GUI gráfica, bien sea porque consideran que es más eficiente el uso de terminales para moverse, porque su consumo de recursos es menor, se ve bien o simplemente por costumbre de usuarios de Linux que ya están acostumbrados. No piensen que solo personas con equipos de pocos recursos buscan aplicaciones de terminal, la reciente popularidad de compositores de pantalla, como Hyprland y Niri han dado un nuevo aire y popularidad a entornos donde la terminal es una pieza clave. Por eso me ha parecido interesante ver algunas herramientas que permiten el uso del multimedia en la terminal, empezando por la reproducción de sonido, para esto yo acostumbro a utilizar **mpg123**, una herramienta de uso sencillo, bata con ubicarse en la carpeta donde se guarda la música y colocar _mpg123 -Z \*.mp3_, con lo cual obtendremos una pantalla de uso sencilla. Con _S_ podemos pausar la reproducción, _f_ la siguiente canción, _h_ para la ayuda con los mandos básicos. No tiene alarde de grandes funciones, pero en sencillez está su encanto. La _\-Z_ usada en el comando es para que la lista pase de forma aleatoria, de forma contraria lo realizara por el orden alfabético de las canciones en la carpeta. Para instalarla en Arch y derivadas basta con \_ sudo pacman -S mpg123\_

/> – Imagen de mpg123 Siguiendo en el uso de música esta **termusic**, es una interfaz más completa, más pulida. Si bien barrera la música de la carpeta desde donde se abre, se podrá agregar carpetas con _a_. _TAB_ permite moverse entre los espacios de la interfaz. _control +h_ para la ayuda
/> – Imagen de Ayuda **termusic** Con _shift +C_ nos llevará a la configuración.

/> – Imagen de Configuración **termusic** **Termusic** cuenta con otras funciones que cualquiera puede encontrar revisando las funciones de la ayuda, lo que puede terminar siendo divertido. Podemos instalarla en Arch y derivadas con _sudo pacman -S termusic_ Las herramientas para escuchar la música de forma local quizás no es ya tan popular, posiblemente escuchar música en línea puede ser algo más del día de hoy. Las radio en línea se han vuelto la alternativa de las clásicas radios que envía señales en zonas limitadas. **pyradio** es mi favorita para dicha actividad, se instala en Arch y derivadas desde AUR con _paru -S pyradio_ en caso de usar **yay** en lugar de **paru**, _yay -S pyradio_.

/> – Imagen de Pyradio Al abrirla recién instalada no traerá una lista de radios predefinidas, con algunas radios por defecto, puedes modificar cualquiera de estas, colocando otra posicionándote sobre la emisora y presionando _e_.

/> – Imagen de edición de una emisora (Lofi Girl es mi favorita y siempre la agrego manualmente) Aquí una lista con algunas emisoras, algunas vienen actualmente por defecto en **pyradio** otras simplemente las podras agregar si te llama la atención. Emisoras Pyradio ---------------- Ambient Sleeping Pill,[http://radio.stereoscenic.com/asp-h](http://radio.stereoscenic.com/asp-h) Lofi: Lofi Girl,[https://play.streamafrica.net/lofiradio](https://play.streamafrica.net/lofiradio) Lofi: Chillhop,[http://stream.zeno.fm/fyn8eh3h5f8uv](http://stream.zeno.fm/fyn8eh3h5f8uv) Lofi: Box Lofi,[http://stream.zeno.fm/f3wvbbqmdg8uv](http://stream.zeno.fm/f3wvbbqmdg8uv) Lofi: The Bootleg Boy,[http://stream.zeno.fm/0r0xa792kwzuv](http://stream.zeno.fm/0r0xa792kwzuv) Lofi: Radio Spinner,[https://live.radiospinner.com/lofi-hip-hop-64](https://live.radiospinner.com/lofi-hip-hop-64) Lofi: SmoothChill,[https://media-ssl.musicradio.com/SmoothChill](https://media-ssl.musicradio.com/SmoothChill) Chillout (Groove Salad - SomaFM),[http://somafm.com/startstream=groovesalad.pls](http://somafm.com/startstream=groovesalad.pls) Alternative (BAGeL Radio - SomaFM),[http://somafm.com/bagel.pls](http://somafm.com/bagel.pls) American Roots (Boot Liquor - SomaFM),[http://somafm.com/bootliquor.pls](http://somafm.com/bootliquor.pls) Celtic (ThistleRadio - SomaFM),[http://somafm.com/thistle.pls](http://somafm.com/thistle.pls) Atmospheric (Drone Zone - SomaFM),[http://somafm.com/dronezone.pls](http://somafm.com/dronezone.pls) Ambient (Space Station - SomaFM),[http://somafm.com/spacestation.pls](http://somafm.com/spacestation.pls) Covers (SomaFM),[http://somafm.com/covers.pls](http://somafm.com/covers.pls) Downtempo (Secret Agent - SomaFM),[http://somafm.com/secretagent.pls](http://somafm.com/secretagent.pls) Dub Step (Dub Step Beyond - SomaFM),[http://somafm.com/dubstep.pls](http://somafm.com/dubstep.pls) Folk (Folk Forward - SomaFM),[http://somafm.com/folkfwd.pls](http://somafm.com/folkfwd.pls) House (Beat Blender - SomaFM),[http://somafm.com/startstream=beatblender.pls](http://somafm.com/startstream=beatblender.pls) Indie Pop (Indie Pop Rocks! - SomaFM),[http://somafm.com/indiepop130.pls](http://somafm.com/indiepop130.pls) Intelligent dance music (Cliq Hop - SomaFM),[http://somafm.com/startstream=cliqhop.pls](http://somafm.com/startstream=cliqhop.pls) Jazz (Sonic Universe - SomaFM),[http://somafm.com/startstream=sonicuniverse.pls](http://somafm.com/startstream=sonicuniverse.pls) Lounge (Illinois Street Lounge - SomaFM),[http://somafm.com/illstreet.pls](http://somafm.com/illstreet.pls) Pop (PopTron! - SomaFM),[http://somafm.com/poptron.pls](http://somafm.com/poptron.pls) Progressive (Tags Trance Trip - SomaFM),[http://somafm.com/tagstrance.pls](http://somafm.com/tagstrance.pls) Public Radio (WNYC - Public Radio from New York to the World),[http://wnyc-iheart.streamguys.com/wnycfm-iheart.aac](http://wnyc-iheart.streamguys.com/wnycfm-iheart.aac) Rock (Digitalis - SomaFM),[http://somafm.com/digitalis.pls](http://somafm.com/digitalis.pls) Noticias (Radio-FORMULA),[https://myradioenvivo.mx/radio-formula](https://myradioenvivo.mx/radio-formula) La Ke Buena ,[https://myradioenvivo.mx/la-ke-buena](https://myradioenvivo.mx/la-ke-buena) Aristegui noticias ,[https://myradioenvivo.mx/aristegui-noticias](https://myradioenvivo.mx/aristegui-noticias) Culiacán - Exa FM,[https://myradioenvivo.mx/exa-fm#server190](https://myradioenvivo.mx/exa-fm#server190) Culiacán - La Mejor 97.7,[https://myradioenvivo.mx/la-mejor#server237](https://myradioenvivo.mx/la-mejor#server237) Culiacán - La Comadre ,[https://myradioenvivo.mx/la-comadre#server333](https://myradioenvivo.mx/la-comadre#server333) Culiacán - Match FM ,[https://myradioenvivo.mx/match-fm#server387](https://myradioenvivo.mx/match-fm#server387) Con _?_ llamaras la ayuda en **Pyradio**.

/> – Imagen ayuda **Pyradio** Si lo que deseas es ver Youtube existe herramientas para la terminal, pero yo he encontrado que es más eficiente usar **mpv** para eso, generalmente el consumo de recursos en el navegador de un vídeo es alto, por eso personas que tienen recursos limitados en un equipo acostumbran a reproducir vídeos desde **mpv**, para lo cual basta con arrastrar el link del video a **mpv** y soltarlo. Si eres una persona que disfruta de ver las barras de audio de forma hipnótica esta **cava**, una aplicación que muestra un conjunto de barras al estilo de un ecualizador digital, para instalarlo en Arch y derivadas basta con _sudo pacman -S cava_, con _f_ se puede cambiar el color de las barras y con las flechas derecha izquierda se puede cambiar el ancho de las barras.
/> – Imagen de **Cava** Una muestra de como e vería trabajar con música en la terminal [

/>](https://play.3speak.tv/embed?v=ubaldonet/gg8nh4y4)

– Vídeo de herramientas

El uso de esta manera de trabajo tiene dos grandes justificaciones, la primera lo rápido que se vuelve trabajar en la termina cuando estas habituado a su uso, sobre todo si usas un Windows Manager o Compositor de Vídeo, más aun cuando son Tilling y se basan en combinaciones de teclas, asi que si es lo que buscas migrar a herramientas de terminal mejorara tu flujo de trabajo.

Lo segundo la terminal se brinca los adornos de la GUI que si bien agregan belleza al escritorio consumen recursos, así que si poseer pocos recursos o tienes muchos pero con procesos de trabajo pesado, el ahorro de recursos puede ser tu objetivo.

Si quieres seguir usando la GUI tambien es valido, pero ya sabes que hay otras formas de trabajo.

Gracias por su atención

Nota: Los vídeos colocados en este post pertenecen a mi canal de Youtube [https://www.youtube.com/@MaquinasLinux](https://www.youtube.com/@MaquinasLinux) y las imágenes del #ViernesDeEscritorio son capturas de pantalla de mis escritorios También se encuentra material en el Telegram [https://t.me/+RlAVNsKQbM5Z0hkt](https://t.me/+RlAVNsKQbM5Z0hkt)

body.title: The Mental Weight of Unfinished Things
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdmwY4yPrxhAojy4EY4xk2wi4G5zrjmF1zL6xsdDb1UJK/IMG_8345.jpeg 



I am behind I am behind , I am behind, I am behind I am behind, I am behind ! 
I want to move forward 
Okay… now move!  
You feel you are behind but the real question is behind who?!  

 https://media.tenor.com/irMwxciieRIAAAAC/yes-unfinished-business.gif 

Look it’s just something very simple and you are stuck for a very funny reason, in fact you are not stuck but you just feel so!
Do you know that unfinished things have a way of staying in your mind longer than completed ones? 




 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdmwY4yPrxhAojy4EY4xk2wi4G5zrjmF1zL6xsdDb1UJK/IMG_8345.jpeg 
[source](https://pin.it/44VstrJkJ)

I am sooo sorry to tell you all this but yes! It is true! I know your teachers wont even tell you, but I will for free just for the love of #hive and the community lovers.  
You always feel stuck or stagnant when you have too many things on an open loop, and its normal for every human to feel that way. 
That’s why I always tell my friends and acquaintances whenever we speak to do one thing at a time and that brings productivity and efficiency especially in this beautiful ramification that we take pride in which is #education. 


 https://media.tenor.com/y7Dn94p0s1cAAAAC/brain-brain-workout.gif 

You may still be wondering, what is Herod saying right now or what does he mean? 
But here… clearly, leaving tasks half way and doing something else weakens our mind and takes a away some reasonable percentage of our peace because at that moment or those moments we always tend to think about the unfinished course, assignment or project that we currently have open in hand meanwhile we forget that there are a whole lot of stuffs that we have finished that may even be greater than what is at hand now and the thought of unfinished tasks weigh us down a bit  and weakens our thoughts and productivity. 

 https://media.tenor.com/ubGTa3ZwHJoAAAAC/disappointed-disgusted.gif 

I don’t blame anyone because not all of us can handle that, not even me but we are getting there!Tasks you didn’t finish, decisions you delayed and even some of the conversations that you avoided all sit quietly in the background and what does that do to us? 
Like an android phone it eats up our ram or memory and doesnt allow us to think well, we could even gi hit in temperature like our phones. 

 https://media.tenor.com/3tuq2Zx53ccAAAAC/worried-pete-davidson.gif 

Even when you are doing something else, a part of your mind is still holding onto them and guess what? That’s exactly where the mental weight comes from.
It’s not always about how big the task is, sometimes even small unfinished things create stress because they remain open and not that they matter all the time but the presence and thought of it does something to us. 
What’s the simple solution ? Closing those loops! It’s not easy but when we do it gradually brings a sense of relief and it clears space in your mind and makes it easier to focus on what matters.

 https://media.tenor.com/tQX7-huxlREAAAAC/take-care-of-unfinished-business-dwayne-johnson.gif 
Sometimes peace does not come from doing more but simply from finishing what you already started and what happens when you do that? 
Youll be more effective and no more complain of I am behind I am behind , I am behind, I am behind I am behind, I am behind ! I want to move forward. 

Reduce your mental weight today !

Thanks for reading 

SAINT HEROD 🦸‍♂️

body.title: From Imagination to Reality: My Textile Design Journey Day 2
body.body:
Creating this textile design was an exciting and rewarding experience that began with a simple pencil sketch on paper. The concept was inspired purely by imagination, and once the idea came to mind, I immediately picked up my pencil and started drawing. As the sketch developed, it gradually transformed into a beautiful pattern that perfectly reflected the creative vision I had in mind. This initial stage was important because it allowed me to freely express my ideas and build the foundation of the final design.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYBTSf2Jcv9Vrcfv6sW3Hq8AezqdrxvMNbLGrT9kuwfaP/1776899466644.jpg)

After completing the hand-drawn sketch, I proceeded to Adobe Illustrator to refine and digitize the artwork. Using digital tools gave me the opportunity to enhance the lines, improve the symmetry, and add a more professional touch to the overall design. It also allowed me to experiment with different elements while maintaining the originality of the initial concept.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTnGt8WhQR2CdnjAVRnnJnEqX3PNoTzGBMzBHPqpMxUTW/1776899483567.jpg)

The colouring stage was one of the most enjoyable parts of the process. Although it required patience and attention to detail, it was satisfying to watch the design gradually come to life through the use of carefully selected colours. Each shade added depth, vibrancy, and personality to the final piece.

Overall, this project was both creative and educational. It combined traditional sketching techniques with modern digital design tools, resulting in a unique textile pattern that I am proud to have created. The entire process was truly worth the time and effort invested.

body.title: Mi experiencia con el médico internista | My experience with the internist
body.body: > \n \nSiguiendo mi plan de cuidar mi salud, hoy fui a una consulta médica con el internista que está a cargo del \

de la empresa en la que trabajo, que surge tras la necesidad de intentar controlar las enfermedades que se derivan del síndrome metabólico, para evitar, en lo posible, complicaciones que nos lleven a la emergencia de un hospital. El doctor que me atendió me informó que hay una tasa alta de trabajadores menores a 50 años con infartos, ACVs, diábetes... lo que al final, limita y reduce la vida del trabajador. También me comentó, que, aunque hay cosas que no podemos evitar, con un buen control de alimentación, ejercicio físico y supervisión médica, podemos disminuir el riesgo de padecer enfermedades metabólicas.
> \n \nAs part of my plan to take care of my health, today I went to a medical appointment with the internist who oversees the \

at the company where I work. This program was created in response to the need to manage conditions stemming from metabolic syndrome, in order to prevent, as much as possible, complications that could lead to a trip to the emergency room. The doctor who saw me informed me that there is a high rate of workers under 50 suffering from heart attacks, strokes, diabetes... which ultimately limits and shortens the worker’s life. He also told me that, although there are things we cannot avoid, with good dietary control, physical exercise, and medical supervision, we can reduce the risk of developing metabolic diseases. ***
https://images.ecency.com/DQmZAXygkBDm42PdJjNDevzDJAqcF2Uh4FoHM3TCMHSikgJ/20260422_182753.jpg
***

> A pesar de que yo creo que me cuido un poco, mis valores de química sanguínea no fueron buenos, por lo que me dio ingreso al plan de control que el departamento médico de la empresa está llevando. El internista, que por cierto, me atendió de forma excelente, me indicó ir al nutricionista y al laboratorio de la salud, que lógicamente, son especialidades que forman parte del plan. Aunque estoy comiendo casi sin carbohidratos y sin azúcar, no estoy ejercitándome y el doctor me dejó claro que el ejercicio y la alimentación van de la mano y más a mi edad. Es muy necesario disminuir la pérdida de masa muscular, para no quedarme sin defensa, entre otras cosas.

> Even though I think I take fairly good care of myself, my blood test results weren’t good, so I was enrolled in the health management program run by the company’s medical department. The internist—who, by the way, provided excellent care—told me to see a nutritionist and visit the health lab, which, of course, are services included in the program. Although I’m eating almost no carbohydrates or sugar, I’m not exercising, and the doctor made it clear to me that exercise and diet go hand in hand, especially at my age. It’s very important to slow down muscle loss so I don’t lose my strength, among other things. ***
https://images.ecency.com/DQmTK45fdYPKH4TVDRo7LEP4px5Vrd8JVDYkSu3C1jHDgsa/20260422_182944.jpg
***

> Por supuesto que se me hizo saber que no estaba de acuerdo con el plan de alimentación keto que comencé hace dos semanas, y le expliqué que lo comencé porque por mucho que me esfuerzo, mis análisis de sangre y mi peso, no mejoran. Me recordó la importancia de la actividad física en todo esto y me dijo que quien mejor podía orientarme era el nutricionista que había estudiado para eso. Sé que el nutricionista tampoco estará de acuerdo.

> Of course, he let me know that he didn’t agree with the keto diet I started two weeks ago, and I explained to him that I started it because, no matter how hard I try, my blood tests and my weight aren’t improving. He reminded me of the importance of physical activity in all of this and told me that the best person to guide me would be a nutritionist, who is trained for that. I know the nutritionist won’t agree either. ***
https://images.ecency.com/DQmPNCLUhvofYqhqXYk25kSiniypaTYnFZW36MraTqbRXcj/20260224_205221.jpg
***
> \n \nQuiero mantenerme firme en mi plan de 210 días que según el libro \

, me ayudará a sanar mi cuerpo. El internista me insistió que el problema es que será a costo de mi masa muscular y ya sabemos lo negativo que eso para la salud. Yo sabía que encontraría esa resistencia y en este punto, no estoy segura de qué haré luego de ver al nutricionista. Creo que estoy haciendo lo correcto, pero tengo por hábito, poner en duda lo que pienso, cuando es necesario, porque sé que siempre hay probabilidades de que esté equivocada. Un día a la vez, por lo pronto sigo con mi alimentación keto, hasta la consulta con el experto en nutrición. Ya luego veremos.

> I want to stick to my 210-day plan, which, according to the book *Eating for Healing*, will help me heal my body. The internist insisted that the problem is that it will come at the expense of my muscle mass, and we all know how bad that is for your health. I knew I would encounter that resistance, and at this point, I’m not sure what I’ll do after seeing the nutritionist. I think I’m doing the right thing, but I have a habit of questioning my own thoughts when necessary, because I know there’s always a chance I could be wrong. One day at a time—for now, I’m sticking with my keto diet until my appointment with the nutrition expert. We’ll see what happens after that. ***
https://images.ecency.com/DQmQWEVwuqK5miCnuge1FPEtTr2QVoEsivc6brP47HP8xh9/20260422_183010.jpg
https://images.ecency.com/DQmbCVkiZrRxXwagi66h8U8HT3PQgpx2dZx7ZTs8ZKtUYu1/mi_sep.png

> Y estas son las reflexiones que quería compartir con ustedes hoy amigos. Cada día nos ofrece un lienzo en blanco, listo para que construyamos nuestros sueños, trazo a trazo. A ustedes, gracias por haberme acompañado a través de estas letras.

> And these were my thoughts to share with you today, friends. Every day gives us a blank canvas, ready for us to build our dreams, line by line. To you, thank you for joining me in this reading. ***

body.title: Sporting grind their way into the Taça de Portugal final
body.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptosimplify/23sweN8cw9gPQBmpTkbMtggu84fvumyqMPEubpeJ8Vst365r6H3TjTLPKQTLLVfD2U98y.png)


I'm going to be honest. I watched this entire game and I still don't fully understand how FC Porto didn't score. Not once. Not in ninety minutes plus nine of stoppage time. Not with Diogo Costa coming up for corners. Not with everything they threw at it. Zero goals. Sporting through on a 1-0 aggregate built on a Luis Suárez penalty from seven weeks ago.
And somehow, weirdly, it felt right. Not because Porto didn't deserve more — they absolutely did — but because this is who this Sporting team is right now. They're not pretty. They're not playing the kind of football that makes you fall in love with the game. But they survive. They grind. They dig trenches and they hold them. And last night at the Dragão, with nearly 50,000 people screaming at them for ninety minutes straight, they did exactly that.

Let me set the scene. The Dragão was electric before kick-off. The Curva had two massive banners — one saying something about stones in the road being used to build their history, the other a mosaic of João Pinto lifting the Taça at the Jamor. The fans knew what was at stake. After the Nottingham Forest disaster knocked Porto out of the Europa League and with the league title almost mathematically guaranteed, this was supposed to be Porto's chance at a domestic double. Win the Taça, cap off Farioli's first season with two trophies, send the fans home happy.
Instead they got one of the most frustrating nights of the entire season.
Farioli changed four players from the Tondela game on Sunday. Thiago Silva came in, Pablo Rosario started, Gabri Veiga got the nod in midfield and William Gomes led the attack. No Zaidu (injured), no Alan Varela or Pepê from the start — both were on the bench. On the Sporting side, Rui Borges made a surprise call by starting Quenda on the left instead of Pedro Gonçalves. First start for Quenda in almost five months apparently. Luís Guilherme, back from a March injury, was among the subs.
And from the first minute you could see what each team's plan was. Porto wanted to press high, win the ball early, and bombard the Sporting box. Sporting wanted to sit deep, stay compact, frustrate, and hit on the counter when the chance came. It's not complicated, it's not revolutionary, but when you're protecting a one-goal lead away from home in a semi-final, you don't need to reinvent football. You just need to not concede.

The first half was tense but honestly kind of uneventful. Porto had the ball most of the time — I'd guess somewhere around 55-60% possession — but they couldn't find the gaps. William Gomes tried to create from the right, Gabri Veiga tried his usual through balls, but Sporting's defensive block was incredibly well-organized. Diomandé was a rock at the back. Eduardo Quaresma read everything. Gonçalo Inácio swept up what was left. It was like trying to break through a wall by throwing tennis balls at it.
Porto's best chance of the first half came when Froholdt let fly from distance and it wasn't far off. But \

doesn't count on the scoreboard and that's all that matters.
The problem for Porto was clear: they had no natural number nine who could hold the ball up, bring others into play, and attack crosses. Samu Aghehowa's been out all season with a cruciate injury. Luuk de Jong is done for the year too. Deniz Gül started but he's more of a mobile forward than a target man. When you're trying to break down a defence that's sitting with five players across the back line, you need someone in the box who can win headers and create chaos. Porto just didn't have that.
Farioli obviously knew this. At half-time and then in the second half, he threw everything at it. Pepê came on. Then Rodrigo Mora. Then Alan Varela. Then Borja Sainz. At one point in the last twenty minutes it felt like Porto were playing a 2-3-5 formation, just bodies everywhere going forward.

And they came close. God, they came close.
Diogo Costa — yes, the goalkeeper — made a stunning save at one point to deny Luís Guilherme, who'd come on for Sporting and had a huge chance on the break. The ball deflected off Kiwior and somehow Diogo Costa clawed it away. If that goes in, it's 0-1 on the night and the tie is effectively dead. That save kept Porto alive.
But then, at about the 87th minute, things went from bad to worse. Alan Varela got himself sent off. I didn't get the clearest view of what happened but it looked like a reckless challenge born out of pure frustration. Red card. Ten men. Nine minutes of added time still to play. And somehow the Dragão got LOUDER. The fans weren't going to let the team die quietly.
Those final nine minutes were chaos. Porto pumped long balls into the box. Bednarek went up for everything. Corners came in one after another. Sporting defended with their lives — every clearance, every block, every header. Ricardo Mangas got booked for a foul on Pepê and the resulting free kick was dangerous but came to nothing.
And then, in the very last play of the game. The absolute last second. Diogo Costa had come up for the corner. The ball bounced around the box and Rui Silva — who'd been decent all night but not spectacular — pulled off THE save. A reaction stop from close range that somehow kept the ball out. Froholdt tried to get on the rebound but a Sporting defender got in the way and the chance was gone.
Whistle.
0-0.
Sporting are in the final.

I sat there for a good minute afterwards just kind of processing it. Porto did everything they could. They pressed, they attacked, they brought on every attacking option they had, their goalkeeper went up for corners, they played with ten men and still pushed. But Sporting held on. With fingernails and teeth and sheer stubbornness, they held on.
For Rui Borges, this is redemption. Or at least the start of it. After the derby loss to Benfica on Sunday — that brutal, soul-crushing defeat with the disallowed goal and the Rafa winner in added time — there was a real concern that this Sporting team might mentally collapse. That the season was over. That the players wouldn't recover. Three days later, they go to the Dragão and put in one of the most disciplined defensive displays I've seen all year. No, it wasn't entertaining. No, it won't make any highlight reels unless you're into compilations of last-ditch blocks and desperate clearances. But it was effective. And after the week they'd had, I think most Sporting fans would take effective over pretty every single time.
The Taça de Portugal might genuinely be Sporting's last shot at a trophy this season. The league title is basically Porto's to lose. Champions League is done. The Taça da Liga is long gone. This is it. And on May 24th, at the Jamor, they'll face either Fafe or Torreense — both from the lower divisions — which, on paper at least, should give them a very real chance at silverware.
For Porto? They've still got the league. And they're almost certainly going to win it. But last night stings. Farioli will know that his team created enough chances across two legs to go through and just couldn't find the net when it mattered. The Taça de Portugal would have been the cherry on top of a great first season. Instead, it'll be a nagging \

— especially that last-second Rui Silva save that will probably show up in Sporting highlight videos for years to come.\nSometimes football isn't about who plays better. Sometimes it's about who can suffer more. And last night, nobody suffered quite like Sporting — and nobody benefited more from that suffering.\nThe Jamor awaits. And honestly? After a week like this, Sporting probably feel like they can survive anything.

body.title: What is truth? P-hacking in scientific papers
body.body:
**Not all data is good data, and not all statistically significant results are helpful**

A lot of people think that truth can be found by trusting the scientific literature as the source of truth. The hidden truth or open lie, is that statistics can be gamed. In a scientific paper there is a way to make the statistics say whatever the writer of the paper wants it to say, and one was of doing this is p-value hacking. By scientific convention, if a p-values are less than 0.05, they are labeled statistically significant by this arbitrary convention. Once labeled statistically significant, it becomes scientifically true and worthy of publication.

But with p-hacking, any paper could be produced by simply searching through the data to find patterns which produce the desired statistical significance. Cherry picking, collecting data until P<0.05, then stop. Now you can say you discovered a new \

, because something statistically significant was found, even if it's of low scientific value. \n\nThere are many mice studies, many bizarre studies, which produce some statistically significant result from the data. Nothing comes of it, but it satisfies the publish or perish condition that the writers of the papers are living under. Is any of this truth? It could be statistically significant, but is it truth?

body.body:
What a wonderful account of your experiences with cartoons. I absolutely loved the first drawing, not just because of how special the little girl is, but also because of your memories of sitting in that little chair and knowing exactly what time that cartoon was on!

I remember the Care Bears too; I used to watch them as well, and my mum would buy me some ‘letter sheets’, that’s what they were called in Argentina, which I could swap with my classmates at school. They were like collectable figures.

But of all the ones you chose, The Thundercats are my favourites; I was a fan of them for the same reasons as you, that Cheetah woman was fabulous, and my brother loved Mumm-Ra, and yes, I feel the same thrill when I hear the intro.

I’ve only heard of the last one by name, but it’s very entertaining and fun. I’ve loved your review and, as I always say, experiences are what matter most. Thank you so much for taking part in the Mees thread. Big hugs!💗

>Que maravillosa reseña de tus experiencias con las caricaturas o dibujos animados. Me ha encantado el primer dibujo pero no sólo por lo especial de la niña sino por tus recuerdos de estar sentada en esa silla pequeña y saber a que hora transmitían ese dibujo!

>Recuerdo a los ositos cariñosos, también los veía, y además mi madre me compraba unas hojas de carta, se llamaban así en Argentina, que podía intercambiar por otras en la escuela con mis compañeras. Eran como figuras coleccionables.

>Pero de todos los que elegiste Los Thundercats son mis favoritos, era fan de ellos y por las mismas razones que vos, esa mujer mirad cheetah era fabulosa y a mi hermano le encantaba Mumm-Ra y sí, siento la misma emoción al escuchar la intro.

>El último lo escuché sólo de nombre pero es muy entretenido y divertido. Me ha encantado tu reseña y como siempre digo las experiencias son lo más importante. Muchas gracias por participar en el tema del mees. Un gran abrazo!💗
