body.title: Guess what today was????
body.body:
I can hardly believe it!
I had another SNOW day, which means, no work for me! LOL

Just when you think spring is here, Mother Nature takes a fit and gives us more snow!😔
It snowed heavy for awhile here, but it didn't last long.
Just light snow falling, it would have been pretty if I wasn't so sick of it.

My client's husband called me when I was on the highway driving.
I wish he would have called me earlier, I would have stayed in bed, 😅

I was close to Deer Lake so I visited my friend, we had tea together.
It was nice to catch up.
My son was there grouting her backsplash.
He installed her counter top last week, and put up the backsplash this week.
The dirty job was for today.
He used black grout, he hates using it, it is messy.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cathyarrow/23xKvZnNV8216BnqPr9LpcBQspmXTG1cPFfEbxZL6mD4XBK4mEK3gaCyzyVNCA9FcSXf6.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cathyarrow/23xVLyPrQy2Egqk8z8Z9TMDcTjrboQv5VvCaUYAmHZd5WGz4Fa7XuS3zdiWYc2YTzvAbN.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cathyarrow/23x14eRvmC43wRpv2dUrzVErcoGXzpWd5N1ftno4nV1rcAgpKA655AS4DwfhNjhZDCkp8.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cathyarrow/23x15EfNTtgMQAtiTmj61GKp4KdHPgnvyv4cbz6FdELBdUN92vdDxvyvY8PC3AZ6CGgUZ.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cathyarrow/23xyUvm1hA281JByvssrMbGLT2GkVVuR1ztJQj5w9FePMtsNYB6dnDjUVLSYhoUAyhdEG.png)

He does excellent work, he takes his time and takes pride in what he is doing!
He is a carpenter by trade.
He started his own company last year.
Now he can hire some workers.
I am very proud of him and what he accomplished in less than 3 years.

He is a workaholic just like his Mom!

I came home, puttered around the house, then I decided to start the process of painting my countertop in my washroom.
Here is a sneak peak of the before.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cathyarrow/23wWvxNY1rRx8dPYirNx5i1rjGQuezcxhwDq1S9Aqa8nXycNu8bVF4AKUTXXfsEs427WZ.png)

I took the towels away, they were in my way.
Next picture is 2 coats of primer!


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cathyarrow/23xyRDsk15x3rA7jZDQVyGx8M5eD2UreTLA8gTUU54A4mSfdbEHtN38F4uwYgPW1cQrnT.png)

I have to paint it twice with the stone paint, yes there are tiny stones in the paint.
And then 2 coats of sealer.
I can't wait to complete it!
My bathroom will then be completed!
A whole new makeover!
Walls, vanity and countertop painted.
And I changed the decore !
Stay tuned for an update, the finished product!
Exciting!

It's that time again to say, Good night and God bless🙏
Life is good!❣️

body.title: Día Internacional de la Tierra, desde la Energía y Vibración[Span/Eng]]
body.body:
https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2024/08/09/07/43/ai-generated-8956378_1280.jpg
[Fuente de la imagen de Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/ai-generado-paloma-paz-mundo-8956378/)
https://www.glitter-graphics.com/images/t/b/480x60/1147/1147480t6phl13g44.webp
Saludos Comunidad
Expansiva semana lleno de salud, energía, ideas maravillosas, magia. Encuentros con tu propio ser y mucho entusiasmo en cada actividad que realicen.

>Tomando en cuenta la motivación de @tonyes, acerca de recordar que hoy 22 de abril se toma como día para celebrar a la madre Tierra, su planteamiento es válido, sobre cómo cuidar y mantener nuestros espacios para evitar situaciones desagradables en caso de lluvias fuertes y en épocas de mucha sequía los incendios forestales que siempre están presente.

\n\n

>Mi participación la voy a enfocar en un aspecto que está fuera de leyes y organismos de protección, primero este día nació en 1970, un acuerdo en París y presenta Objetivos de Desarrollo Sustentable (ODS), desde el aspecto mundial para su conservación y crear un poco de conciencia hacia la importancia de nuestro amado Planeta Tierra.

\n\n

>Desde hace muchos años me he interesado en temas como la energía y la vibración por medio de temas que me atraían, esto desde el punto de vista personal y cómo influyen no solo nuestro accionar en cuando a la recolección de basuras, cuidar el agua y otros, sino desde el punto de vista de consciencia así con S, que viene desde cuidar nuestros pensamientos.

https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2022/05/13/14/20/heart-rate-7193863_1280.jpg
[Fuente de la imagen](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/ritmo-cardiaco-pulso-la-vida-l%c3%adnea-7193863/)
https://www.glitter-graphics.com/images/t/b/480x60/1147/1147480t6phl13g44.webp

>¿Qué relación hay en estos temas? Después de entender un poco, ahora está determinado científicamente por diferentes teóricos, que realizaron y aún realizan estudios, investigaciones acerca del ser humano, estoy más convencida de nuestro papel desde el punto de vista espiritual para la conservación de nuestra amada Pachamama.

\n\n

>Algunos puntos a tomar en cuenta desde esta perspectiva implican transcender la visión materialista y ecológica para conectar con la Tierra como Ser vivo, consciente y resonante.

\n\n

>La Tierra como un organismo vibratorio a esto se le ha dado el nombre de Resonancia Schumann. La Tierra tiene frecuencias electromagnéticas naturales que son como su latido o frecuencia cardíaca. Se presenta la Conexión es decir, el cerebro humano, en estados de meditación profunda. Cuando la Tierra eleva su vibración nuestro cuerpo energético se sincroniza. Por ello, en el día de la Tierra es un momento para sincronizarnos conscientemente con S; con ese pulso planetario, meditando o estando en la naturaleza.

\n\n

>La concepción de la Tierra como un organismo vibratorio y vivo es una perspectiva científica y filosófica que traslada la visión de un planeta compuesto por rocas inanimadas a la de un sistema complejo, autorregulado y dinámico, a menudo descrito a través de la Hipótesis Gaia. Esta teoría, propuesta por el químico James Lovelock, sugiere que la biósfera, la atmósfera, los océanos y la tierra interactúan como una sola entidad viva que mantiene las condiciones necesarias para la vida.

https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2024/09/02/10/05/ai-generated-9016320_1280.jpg
[Fuente/Imagen de Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/ai-generado-espiritualidad-armon%c3%ada-9016320/)
https://www.glitter-graphics.com/images/t/b/480x60/1147/1147480t6phl13g44.webp
Aquí se detallan los aspectos clave de la Tierra como organismo vibratorio y activo:

>1. La Hipótesis Gaia: Autorregulación y Homeostasis

\n\n
>Super organismo: La Tierra se comporta como un \

capaz de autorregular sus condiciones esenciales, como la temperatura, la composición química de la atmósfera y la salinidad de los océanos.

\n\n

body.title: Russia’s Strategic Pivot: Crypto for Foreign Trade Settlements Expected by July
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXXAeMnLp4kK2pGUG1XPtGVTAS2DV3PcgCoXEuU3Mj9zz/qwen-image---free_2026-04-22T13-55-44-248Z.png 


The geopolitical landscape is witnessing a significant reconfiguration as Russia prepares to integrate cryptocurrency into its official foreign trade apparatus. Anatoly Aksakov, Chairman of the State Duma Committee on Financial Markets, has indicated that legislation authorizing crypto-payments for international settlements is slated for adoption this July. This move represents a calculated departure from traditional financial protocols, driven by the increasing complexity of international sanctions that have hamstrung Russia’s ability to conduct cross-border commerce through conventional banking channels.

From a systems thinking perspective, this is not a random adoption of digital assets but a strategic response to structural bottlenecks. As major Russian banks find themselves decoupled from the SWIFT network, the friction in settling invoices with key trading partners—including China and India—has reached a critical point. Data suggests that payment delays have become a primary obstacle to Russian economic continuity. By pivoting to decentralized or regulated digital assets, the Kremlin aims to establish a parallel settlement layer that operates outside the reach of Western financial hegemony.

The proposed legal framework introduces a nuanced regulatory environment. While the state aims to facilitate foreign trade, it maintains strict internal guardrails; cryptocurrency remains prohibited as a legal tender for domestic transactions within Russia. This duality highlights a \

yet effective approach: utilizing the efficiency of blockchain technology where it provides the highest utility—international liquidity—while isolating the domestic economy from the volatility associated with digital assets.\n\nThis transition also includes the potential development of stablecoins pegged to tangible assets or traditional currencies to mitigate risk. The decision-support data is clear: without an alternative payment mechanism, the velocity of Russian foreign trade faces a systemic slowdown. Therefore, the July deadline is more than an administrative target; it is a vital economic imperative. For global markets, Russia’s move serves as a massive pilot program for state-sanctioned crypto usage at scale, potentially creating a blueprint for other nations facing similar financial isolation. The shift underscores a broader trend of \

and the search for technological anomalies that can bypass established geopolitical gatekeepers.\n\nPosted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@pichat/russias-strategic-pivot-crypto-for-foreign-trade-settlements-expected-by-july-amb)

body.title: Vintage Photos - Lot 6 (221-224)
body.body: Several years ago I bought a flatbed scanner with a slide adapter to scan some old film slides that my grandparents had. After I finished scanning those, I picked up several batches of slides from Goodwill and on eBay out of curiosity. I am not sure why these commonly wind up at such places but I know that at least some of them have ultimately come from estate sales. Maybe family members just don't know what to do with them. I've seen them advertised as being for arts and crafts but I was more interested in the actual contents. Each slide is literally a snapshot in history. These pictures span from as early as the late 1940s to as late as the early 1990s. There are thousands of these slides. I will be scanning some from time to time and posting them here as an interesting way to look back at the past.\n\nWhen I say \
I'm referring to a group of slides I bought in a single purchase. Usually they are from the same ultimate origin. Typically, a batch will have 100s or even 1000s of slides.\n\nWhen I say \

I'm referring to a subset of a batch that I scan together. There are normally four slides in one set because that's how many slides my scanner can scan at once. Likewise, a post will typically have one set of four slides. It's just easier to keep track of that way. This batch contains photos spanning from the late 1950s to the early 1980s. Other than these slides coming from eBay, I have no idea of their ultimate origin other than the clues provided in the photos themselves. The photographer seems to have been from Lansing, Michigan and many of the photos are from there. These were all scanned with an Epson Perfection V600 Photo scanner. I believe that most of the photos in this set were taken in the early 1980s, probably in the Lansing, Michigan area. The first photo is undated but look early 80s-ish. It looks like it features a young woman with her baby and maybe mother and grandparents. Maybe this is family of the photographer. The second photo is dated June 20th, 1983. It is labeled \

so maybe the card is an anniversary card. It looks like there are Easter decorations but it's a little late for Easter if the date is accurate. Maybe they were just being repurposed. The third photo is undated but definitely looks like it was taken in the early 1980s. This is another group photo, this time of a bunch of guys in suits. The last photo, like the second, is date June 20th, 1983 and labeled \
. It features a rather uninteresting bunch of flowers.

>

See the previous post in this series
>here. \n\nThe entire batch that has been scanned and uploaded so far can also be found

>here. body.title: What Is Ai Going To Be?
body.body: ## Greetings! \n\nIn my Point of View this is possibly the End of the \

Era, the new way of a computer that can write a decent poem been wearied off. 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVasgH7xuCS91LagXoKanxHkVU4zg6mv5p5QwU8TpETZf/1776894889111.png)

> Image Generated with Using Google Gemini 

It's 2026 and many of us stopped asking things to AI, whereas we are ordering AI to do our work. There is a big difference in between asking and ordering IYKYK. 

A few months ago, people used to ask questions to AI, find out observations, but as time goes by and the field of AI is developing, people have started using it to do their daily tasks. For example, a few months ago, people used to work day and night to make YouTube videos, while now they are easily getting this work done by AI. 

Apart from this, there are many other tasks that a human can do and is also capable of doing the desired task, but to save his time, he will use AI. I am not completely against AI, but I am not completely in favor of it either. 

With the advent of AI, many people have almost stopped using the skills they have acquired, since they have to do their work, which they themselves can do in maybe 1 hour، AI will do that job for them in a few seconds or at most a few minutes. That's why many people are using AI to save their time.

There is absolutely nothing wrong with using AI, it is designed to help you and me. But we should not use AI for tasks or information that we already know (or can find out from other sources). Rather, you should use AI for things that are truly beyond your intellect, but don't trigger AI for every small task because

## According to research

[Large data centers can consume up to 5 million gallons per day, equivalent to the water use of a town populated by 10,000 to 50,000 people](https://www.eesi.org/articles/view/data-centers-and-water-consumption)

## What is Wrong with Using AI? 


The advent of AI has made many of our tasks easier, while on the other hand, if you use it excessively or incorrectly, you will deceive yourself. Using more than necessary will result in more water being used,
The use of AI in itself is not wrong, but
[A single ChatGPT conversation (20-50 prompts) uses about 500 ml of water. Total industry water consumption is rising, with some models estimating up to 97.5 million liters daily for specific, large-scale AI applications.](https://www.eesi.org/articles/view/data-centers-and-water-consumption)



Think for yourself, isn't this too much? How much clean drinking water is left in the world? Are we even thinking about our future?


__________________________________
__________________________________
__________________________________


## اسلام علیکم! 

میرے نقطہ نظر میں یہ ممکنہ طور پر \

کے دور کا خاتمہ ہے، کمپیوٹر کا نیا طریقہ جو ایک مہذب نظم لکھ سکتا ہے، کام کر رہا ہے۔ 

 یہ 2026 ہے اور ہم میں سے بہت سے لوگوں نے AI سے چیزیں پوچھنا بند کر دیا ہے، جبکہ ہم AI کو اپنا کام کرنے کا حکم دے رہے ہیں۔ اگر آپ جانتے ہیں کہ پوچھنے اور آرڈر کرنے میں بڑا فرق ہے۔

کچھ مہینے پہلے لوگ اے آئی سے سوالات کرتے تھے، مشاہدات کا پتہ لگاتے تھے، مگر جوں جوں وقت گزرتا جا رہا ہے اور اےآئی کی فیلڈ میں ترقی آرہی ہے لوگوں نے اس سے اپنے روزمرہ کے کام کروانے شروع کر دیئے ہیں۔ 
مثال کے طور پر آج سے کچھ مہینے پہلے لوگ یوٹیوب ویڈیو بنانے کے لیے دن رات محنت کرتے تھے، جبکہ اب وہ یہ کام بآسانی اےآئی سے کروا رہے ہیں۔ اس کے علاوہ بھی بہت سے کام ہیں کہ جو ایک انسان کر تو سکتا ہے اور اس قابل بھی ہے کہ وہ مطلوبہ کام کر سکے ، مگر اپنے وقت کو بچانے کے لیے وہ اے آئی کا استعمال کرے گا۔ 

میں اےآئی کے خلاف تو بلکل نہیں ہوں مگر پوری طرح اس کے حق میں بھی نہیں ہوں۔ اےآئی کے آنے سے بہت سے لوگوں نے اپنی حاصل کردہ سکلز استعمال کرنا تقریباً ختم کر دیا ہے، چونکہ انہیں انکا کام جو وہ بذاتِ خود شاید 1 گھنٹے میں کریں اےآئی انکو وہ کام چند سیکنڈز یا زیادہ سے زیادہ چند منٹس میں کر کے دے دے گی۔ اسی لیے بہت سے لوگ اپنا وقت بچانے کے لیے اےآئی کا استعمال کر رہے ہیں۔ 

اےآئی کا استعمال کرنا قطعاً غلط نہیں ہے، اس کو آپکی اور میری مدد کے لیے ہی تو بنایا گیا ہے۔ مگر ہمیں اپنے وہ کام یا وہ معلومات جو ہمیں پہلے سے معلوم ہیں( یا کسی اور ذرائع سے معلوم کی جاسکتی ہیں ) ان کے لیے ہمیں اےآئی کا استعمال نہیں کرنا چاہیے۔ بلکہ جو چیز سچ میں آپ کے عقل زے بالاتر ہو اس کے لیے آپ اےآئی کا استعمال کریں، مگر ہر چھوٹے سے چھوٹے کام کے لیے اےآئی کو ٹریگر نہ کریں کیونکہ

## تحقیق کے مطابق 
بڑے ڈیٹا سینٹرز روزانہ 5 ملین گیلن تک استعمال کر سکتے ہیں، جو کہ 10,000 سے 50,000 لوگوں کی آبادی والے شہر کے پانی کے استعمال کے برابر ہے۔

## اےآئی کے استعمال میں غلط کیا ہے؟ 

اےآئی کا استعمال بذاتِ خود کو غلط بات نہیں ہے، ہاں مگر
اےآئی کے آنے سے ہمارے بہت سے کام آسان ہو گئے ہیں، جبکہ دوسری طرف اس کے زائد یا غلط استعمال سے آپ خود کے ساتھ دھوکہ کریں گے۔ 
ضرورت سے زیادہ استعمال کرنے سے زیادہ پانی استعمال ہوگا، ایک چیٹ جی پی ٹی گفتگو (20-50 پرومپٹ) تقریباً 500 ملی لیٹر پانی استعمال کرتی ہے۔ صنعت میں پانی کی کل کھپت بڑھ رہی ہے، کچھ ماڈلز مخصوص، بڑے پیمانے پر AI ایپلی کیشنز کے لیے روزانہ 97.5 ملین لیٹر تک کا تخمینہ لگاتے ہیں۔


خود سوچیں کیا یہ زیادہ نہیں؟ دنیا میں صاف پینے والا پانی رہ ہی کتنا گیا ہے؟ کیا ہم اپنے مستقبل کے بارے میں بھی سوچ رہے ہیں؟ 



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme3UUygStACc7KmxkE2F5R62gjiCe8ef2N1fSqJ4CkTph/1709406530011.png)

body.title: Before and After
body.body:
I didn't start gaining weight until about four years ago or thereabouts. And even then, it wasn't as bad as it later turned out to be.

As time passed and as the year went by, people began to comment on my weight gain. At the time, I didn't take it seriously because I couldn't see what they were complaining about. Every time I looked at myself in the mirror, I never saw a fat guy staring back at me, just a normal-sized guy with maybe a slightly big stomach.

![photo-1634463278803-f9f71890e67d.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/prayzz/23wMafFVZWfE3k532vZPhPPe4WAruLGcX78M71BoTMW92nKjAzCjCTKzvJJxSoXYQBX5x.jpeg)
<sub> [photo by Towfiqu barbhuiya](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-man-holding-his-stomach-with-his-hands-J6g_szOtMF4) </sub>

But then I traveled home last December to go spend the holidays with my family, and my weight gain was all everyone was talking about. My dad spoke on it, my siblings spoke on it, and even people at church commented on it. That was when I realized that perhaps this was a lot more serious than I thought.

I mean, I had tried in the past to lose weight, but I didn't know it had gotten this bad. Forward to some few months later, and I've eventually lost a lot of weight, all thanks to the camp I attended earlier this year.

I've actually lost so much weight that I can now put on old clothes that I had bought in the past but ended up not being my size. I could now comfortably wear singlets, and even my neighbors are all commenting on my weight loss.

But it's crazy because now that I'm beginning to lose weight, I'm beginning to meet more and more people who seem to like a chubby guy or someone that isn't all slim and tiny. It's almost as if this new set of people that I'm meeting are all encouraging me to remain the way I am.

And that brings me to today's blog, because on one hand, I have people complaining about my weight gain, and on the other hand, I have people also complaining about my weight gain. Now, if I were someone who didn't know what he wanted, I would be left confused in a situation like this.

But luckily for me, I'm not. This situation has shown me that no matter how you look, you probably will always see someone who likes you for looking that way, but should that be enough reason to ignore the health complications that come with being obese? Of course not.

I've been a fat man and I've been a slim man, and I will choose being a slim guy over again. Although, this time, I really don't wish to be that slim, just enough not to look either fat or thin.

body.title: DON'T FORCE IT
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>

There are certain things in life that shouldn't be forced. One of them is forcing companies to pay the interns they teach. I feel this should be based on merit and not enforced on any organization. A lot of organizations take in interns, train them, give them the necessary tools and opportunities to practice their course of study, without collecting a dime from them as a form of giving back to the community. It's funny how because there are companies who go further to provide stipends for interns so that they find learning comfortable, some people would think that it is completely how it should be but in the real sense, it isn't. I mean apart from the knowledge we get from school, is our school supposed to pay us for wanting to learn? Is the school supposed to care about how we come to school or pay our fees?. Except the school was built for the less privileged, it isn't supposed to give you more than what is meant, which is Knowledge.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVd2EkUPRKvCbC6VpScuvbzNb67H2FYhy74BMuCKo78GN/1000029823.jpg 
<a href=\

>Image by DC Studio on Freepik This is how in the same way companies go further to teach us the real life example of what it means to do the job you aspire to do. If the company finds talent in you and decides to send you for more professional training, it is entirely up to them. If they must do that however, they will then need to consider your daily expenses and try to make sure you learn under the best conditions they can afford. At this point they are investing in you so you can one day repay them with your services. This is how it is supposed to be because at this point they ain't training you simply because you are an intern, they are training you because they need you to become a professional so you can help the company in the future. When companies like this view you as an investment, they pour resources into you to ensure your growth and commitment to them. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRDUCxsFHMDkYoRaNXkMUUuv9AgBHWz6BTZcGNSYN6ApX/rnfetchblobtmp_fgtcef2qubuke3qlh9re6s.jpg) My company has a number of interns every year that they train as technicians. Those who do well become our technical trainees, and that is only when the company begins to pay them stipends. When I got to know my company pays as much as 2 million naira for a single trainee to attain one certification. Looking at the fact that these trainees need like 5 certifications to be called level 1 technicians. Now do you think that it is right for a company to just pay interns knowing how much they spend on trainees. We currently have more than 5 of them which means the company spends more than 10 million naira per certificate of which some of them end up leaving the company after everything the company did to get them those certifications. Life they say isn't fair at times, but no one should think they are entitled to anything because they feel it is the company's responsibility to them as interns. >THIS IS MY RESPONSE TO HIVE LEARNER'S [PROMPT](https://discord.com/channels/928986840747372636/929001473231183873/1496444478821503038) FOR WEEK 214 EPISODE ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYqbQGFerHXinrqqmfCGrRHtwdZRhqAtCVWMna3geK2vc/20230716_224852_0000.png) Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@kilvnrex/dont-force-it-3md)

links.title: ‎The Power I’m Learning: Saying NO Without Guilt ‎
links.body:
Hi Hive,

‎Saying NO has been one of my biggest struggles for a long time. And recently I realized a great lesson that I don't have to say yes always if I want to have a peace of mind and time for myself.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXmT6SUCFD3U7FkirTCXXnHzmh9bRh4VRfej3y8e4s5AV/IMG_20260420_113713_426.jpg 

‎
‎I have always found myself saying yes even when I’m tired, overwhelmed, or simply not interested. Not because I truly wanted to, but because I didn’t want to disappoint people or come across as rude. But over the time, I have started to realize something crucial that constantly saying yes to others often means saying no to myself.
‎
‎I’m now learning that saying NO is a form of strength and not a weakness.
‎
‎Saying no is about setting boundaries. It’s about protecting my mental well-being, my time, and my energy. Because if I don’t draw the line, people will keep crossing it, not always because it's intentionally, but simply because I allowed it.
‎
‎One thing I have come to understand is that saying NO doesn’t have to be harsh or disrespectful. There’s a way to be firm and still be polite. I can decline requests without attacking someone’s feelings. It’s about balance and being assertive without being aggressive.
‎
‎I won’t lie of course because there is  always that small feeling of guilt that comes after saying no. That voice in my head that wonders, “Did I hurt them?” But I’m beginning to accept that it’s okay. Sometimes, protecting my peace means disappointing others, and that doesn’t make me a bad person.
‎
‎What actually matters is that I’m being truthful with myself.
‎
‎I have also realized that I leave no room for myself if I never say no to rest, to think, to grow, or to even breathe. And the truth is, people can take advantage of that, even without realizing it.
‎
‎So this is where I am right now, learning, practicing, and reminding myself daily that NO is not rejection, but it’s self-respect.
‎
‎Though it’s not easy, but it’s necessary.
‎
‎And I’m choosing to say NO more often moving forward, not out of pride, but out of purpose.
‎
‎![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYaWnApEziAtLL5Zwv3ZNbDjRfSfG6h5njgTrpyasnE6y/1775569275821.png)
‎

links.title: Joining a Guild in Splinterlands and Explaining the XP Boost in Rising Star Game
links.body:
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYPxEknHGBZmYA9anFKtqQ4gWz1JjUBiceNfTugeuh5BJ/guild.png</center>

## Splinterlands

While I wait for a new season to begin in Splinterlands, I'm learning more about the game and how to improve my battle performance and increase my SPS and Glint gains in ranked battles.

So far, I've learned that staking SPS is essential to increase rewards in ranked battles, so I'll start by renting 20,000 SPS and see how much I earn during the season.

Other important details I've discovered are that Guild and Gold Foil cards increase SPS and Glint gains in ranked battles.

Gold Foil cards are quite expensive, and renting them is also costly, so I'll focus on joining a Guild initially.

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZnQeZ6n9yppcS32vV9kyfprxAnfWkUBqXdrcttgnGAfB/d.png</center>

There are many Guilds in Splinterlands, but since I'm a newbie, many probably won't accept me. That's why I chose the OPEN option in Guilds. The OPEN option means you can join a guild directly without needing to ask someone to accept or needing an invitation.

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRwwoBN71eRXheP3AUKJoKd1FoMc1xVHKFMjQsttEiVck/dd.png</center>

I joined the ☠️Splinter Skulls☠️ Guild, it's rank 242 and has a level 6 Lodge, so it will be interesting to increase my rewards in ranked battles. I noticed that there aren't many active Brawlers in the Guild, so I won't have difficulty getting a spot.

I still need to learn more about how the Guild works in Splinterlands, but it seems that Brawlers reward you with SPS and Merits. I don't know much about how Merits work yet, but they are essential for getting Gladiator cards; I'll explain more about them soon.

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQma6EXSCcF1dRNFLJMtMEwW6i2jMYLZCTZS2ELt49VP9mo/ddd.png</center>

As I mentioned before, the Lodge is level 6, and that means I'll increase my rewards by +7% in ranked battles.

---------
---------

## Rising Star Game

Yesterday I mentioned the XP Boost in Rising Star Game, and that's what I'm going to talk about in this post.

<div class=\

>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZssRVvvzH6dG9fEoSUdcbPUPqGMgA9kEbLLpSYVY6jYf/dddddd.png There are 3 XP Boosters: XP +10, XP +50, and XP +100. The XP Boost is a great ally when it comes to leveling up in the game because it increases the XP you earn by completing missions in Rising Star Game.
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcuu4ufm51QwCdkStRwxAZZ8tjKbmmBjA1iHXoBt2HW47/ddddddd.png
In the Rising Star Game market, you can buy the XP +10 Boost for 17 Swap.Hive, and that's the Boost I'm going to buy today. To compare the XP increase in missions, I'll use the Midweek Support Slot mission as an example.
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdMWoekTEqvaCmsSNkbjumFgtC2ejKBvrgjh1en8To6bs/dddddddd.png
Before buying the XP Boost +10, my XP gain in the Midweek Support Slot mission was 51 XP.
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNSdttu4Ac5wuNzG4f2hUVscddpFK4Rn5bZrs969VH6Q9/ddddddddd.png
After buying the XP Boost +10, my XP gain in the Midweek Support Slot mission is 92 XP. With this information, you can see how important XP Boost is for leveling up in Rising Star Game. You can access the games at the following links: **[Splinterlands](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=arkartus)** and **[Rising Star Game](https://www.risingstargame.com/)**. links.title: 瞎逛黃昏市場 / Wandering around the evening market
links.body:
![lH7KZ8pqYAE8xfTt_P_20260315_175646.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/lH7KZ8pqYAE8xfTt_P_20260315_175646/lH7KZ8pqYAE8xfTt_P_20260315_175646.webp) ![uJpD0pAiflzIBYau_P_20260315_175528.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/uJpD0pAiflzIBYau_P_20260315_175528/uJpD0pAiflzIBYau_P_20260315_175528.webp) ![p7G22gVlBxY3QiZw_P_20260315_175556.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/p7G22gVlBxY3QiZw_P_20260315_175556/p7G22gVlBxY3QiZw_P_20260315_175556.webp) ![J9dnSOSOL4yIbLRu_P_20260315_180059.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/J9dnSOSOL4yIbLRu_P_20260315_180059/J9dnSOSOL4yIbLRu_P_20260315_180059.webp) ![gUOBd6cxJBrb22RT_P_20260315_175659.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/gUOBd6cxJBrb22RT_P_20260315_175659/gUOBd6cxJBrb22RT_P_20260315_175659.webp) ![sCn0ujknKnsql5zm_P_20260315_175517.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/sCn0ujknKnsql5zm_P_20260315_175517/sCn0ujknKnsql5zm_P_20260315_175517.webp)
那天下班後，沒有直接回家，拐去平常不會去的黃昏市場，打算買些食物回家吃，走進黃昏市場，首先映入眼簾的是各式各樣的攤商，有的店家賣新鮮的蔬菜水果，也有些店家賣剛處理好的肉類及海鮮，還有一些會賣衣服及生活用品的，所以，這不只是採買食材的地方，還是一個提供便利的處所，市場上攤販們熟練地叫賣著，聲音此起彼落，熱鬧非常。 黃昏市場最吸引人的，除了新鮮食材，還有各種現做的小吃，這也是我到這裡逛的理由，想買一些現成的食物，炸物攤前總是飄著誘人的香氣，像是轉角處的炸雞攤前，已經排成一條人龍，它不只是賣炸雞，也賣其它的炸物，看起來生意非常的不錯，人潮帶來錢潮，只要有人願意停留、消費、分享，金流就會隨之而來，市場開市的時間不長，只有短短幾個小時而已，但是聚集的人潮頗為可觀，這也是我不常到這裡的原因，我討厭排隊。 每當太陽逐漸西斜時，市場內就開始湧現人潮，市場也悄悄熱鬧起來，雖然黃昏市場的攤販都往街道兩旁聚集，馬路仍可供車子行走，但是很少會有車輛進入市場內，因為會被人潮卡的難以進退，算是一種老百姓默認的潛規則，幾乎只有不熟路況的外地人會犯這樣的錯誤，而市場多在快要收市時，會有大撒賣活動，想撿便宜的婆婆媽媽們，都會趁這時刻撿些便宜好物，我並沒有在這裡停留太久，大概六點多，帶走了幾盒炸物就離開了，黃昏市場的人不少，是個觀察社會及感受煙火氣的好地方。
---
That day after work, I didn’t go straight home. Instead, I made a detour to a night market I don’t usually visit, planning to grab some food to take home. As soon as I walked in, I saw all kinds of vendors. Some were selling fresh vegetables and fruits, others had freshly prepared meat and seafood, and there were even stalls selling clothes and daily necessities. It’s not only a place to buy ingredients, but it’s also a really convenient spot for everyday needs. The vendors were calling out to customers in their well-practiced voices, one after another, creating a lively and bustling atmosphere. What attracts me most about these markets, besides the fresh ingredients, is the variety of ready-to-eat food. That’s actually the main reason I came. I wanted to pick up something quick to eat. The fried food stalls were especially tempting, with delicious smells filling the air. At the fried chicken stall around the corner, there was already a long line. They didn’t just sell fried chicken, but all kinds of fried snacks, and business looked really good. Where there are crowds, there’s money. As long as people are willing to stop, spend, and share, the cash flow will follow. Even though the market is only open for a few hours, the number of people it attracts is pretty impressive. That’s actually one of the reasons I don’t come here often because I really don’t like waiting in line. As the sun starts to set, more and more people pour into the market, and the place gradually comes alive. Even though the stalls line both sides of the street and cars technically can still pass through, you rarely see vehicles inside. The crowd makes it almost impossible to move, so it’s kind of an unspoken rule. Usually, only people unfamiliar with the area make the mistake of trying to drive through. Toward closing time, many vendors start offering big discounts. People, especially older shoppers, usually take advantage of this time to grab some good deals. I didn’t stay too long, though. At around 6 p.m., I grabbed a few boxes of fried food and headed out. The evening market is always packed, but it’s also a great place to observe everyday life and soak in that warm, lively human atmosphere. --- For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@diochen/wandering-around-the-evening-market)

Good morning all, doing my 5 minutes free writing with prompt - I am just drifting. Hope you enjoy the story.


![images?q=tbn:ANd9GcRWAzC8Ox-3_3bn_b8QeOIdd6cIkJKstIa35t1j0e6hTA&s=10](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcRWAzC8Ox-3_3bn_b8QeOIdd6cIkJKstIa35t1j0e6hTA&s=10)
[Source](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcRWAzC8Ox-3_3bn_b8QeOIdd6cIkJKstIa35t1j0e6hTA&s=10)

Drifting, it can be a physical activity that can be relaxing or dangerous. Likewise, drifting can be done mentally with one being in a stable or motionless physical state. I believe everyone would have drifted mentally more than physically. I also think one could be unaware that they are drifting or have drifted. I will explain in detail later.

For physical drifting, it is obvious and can be noticed quickly. But 1 condition needs to be present. We need to have a medium or a large quantities to be present. Let's take the following example to illustrate: if you are swimming along a lane, if you are drifting away from the center of the lane, without a lane divider, it would be hard to tell.  But measuring against a divider, it would be quick to tell as your distance to the divider. Or when you are separated from a group.

Mental drifting would usually occur when one don't follow in a group discussion and when one lost interest. This occurs in the class more often when the student is in a class of a subject that he don't enjoy. One would drift into his or her dream. 

Thus, it can be true when one tells you I am just drifting.

links.title: My First Lemon Charlotte [ENG-ESP]
links.body:
>Greetings, dear friends at @foodiesbeehive! Welcome to my blog. Today I’m sharing my recipe for no-bake lemon charlotte, made just my way. This dessert was perfect for me since I don’t have an oven at home. Also, ever since I tried this dessert at a close friend’s house, I’ve been enchanted by the flavor created by the combination of condensed milk and lemon. I also liked it when I tried Brazilian lemonade. A couple of years ago, I tried making a lemon pie, but it didn’t turn out very well—not because of the flavor, but because of the consistency.
![1776810958870.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmemagm6uAoW8HMrgkNrHn2sSahzExpfCq6yUxeu1zL5fJ/1776810958870.jpg)

>Maybe it was because I mixed the main ingredients without including one that was key to the recipe—it all turned out very basic. This time, I didn’t make the cookie crust; this recipe has a few changes, but I managed to make it moist, with the right texture, and of course, delicious. It looks like a sponge cake; no one would believe that this Carlota is made of layers of cookies and a mixture of condensed milk and citrus juice.
## Ingredients

>1.-. In a bowl, pour in the condensed milk, followed by the lemon juice. Add the lemon juice gradually while stirring gently. You'll notice a change in consistency—it will become slightly thicker.
![1776810958266.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZrLvPK3tHt8yWRmfHYsaajyB5pcbbYcg1t6cvX4X2dZz/1776810958266.jpg)
![1776810958283.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUEAF6kNAJSzG52zHBZ65JjS3YNRePheCQCk8ACRwP9rF/1776810958283.jpg)
![1776810959008.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb6fDRYEsXCzVXkdcptLRXJZ4yYNC6rRAoPvjoUtT4Ggv/1776810959008.jpg)

>2.-. Next, we add the heavy cream, gradually, stirring constantly until the ingredients are well combined.
![1776810958988.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWuKjNVRpuhYrZdJWojwjguwfXs9r8quusSQY4ctw4qhR/1776810958988.jpg)
![1776810958300.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVVyW4RMB6RDm9P6bEfvD8fnbQ9kUwi1pjkxgVvcTmpcx/1776810958300.jpg)
![1776810958964.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmanjZcd7T8hWrmk9iu7RDULXLM4uWxs4bJozFSpzGNbRA/1776810958964.jpg)

>3.-. In a rectangular baking dish, arrange a layer of cookies, making sure to fill in any gaps, then add a layer of the liquid mixture you’ve prepared with condensed milk, heavy cream, and lemon juice. Continue alternating layers of cookies and the liquid mixture until all the ingredients are used up.
![1776810958944.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaAzBDzHjCGiNoqjKqiEJirE9P1o84BxDV3FSzF5Bd7Cj/1776810958944.jpg)
![1776810958317.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSiVxUSXubHD3zx1CB1bdNScfUiJHSVnvRsAm77Y5VCeB/1776810958317.jpg)

>4.-. Finally, we decorate the top layer with crushed cookies. We crush the cookies with a rolling pin after placing them in a plastic bag, and then sprinkle them over the entire surface of the top layer of the Charlotte.
![1776810958925.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWZF2YWfGeCJWnLofrN1fp8MYLF8MdcJWz2ALWKtCa1hq/1776810958925.jpg)

>5.- We put the lemon charlotte in the fridge to chill for at least 4 hours.
![1776810958907.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZUfdaVSNq1nXsKRfN2vMRqGTpRZqHfVwJXURZY3qBGQu/1776810958907.jpg)

>Now it’s time to enjoy this delicious no-bake lemon charlotte.
![1776810958848.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPBNa3jCPtCMbCprYA8CAreBEcuUeAP5qWx3QXccAUNmd/1776810958848.jpg)
![1776810958821.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmevMk5bSATpcDbZ2hczAz2x1rRcYdybLNCcNXJgA5MDTK/1776810958821.jpg)
![1776810958888.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQme1xEmEmPVtAXpsNVBCyzcMpE1AYGVjczgYqEK6PPfFem/1776810958888.jpg)
I hope you liked it. See you next time.
All photos are original, taken with my Xiaomi Redmi 9 cell phone. The editions were made with the [application GridArt](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=photoeditor.layout.collagemaker&hl=en_ZA&gl=US).
![1776810958332.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaHvQ9crWphNARkV4njKY2FoNuy6VV1SXbiAcesDVt7f8/1776810958332.jpg)
#

>Saludos estimados amigos de @foodiesbeehive, bienvenidos a mi blog. Hoy les comparto la receta de Carlota de limón sin horno, muy a mi estilo. Este postre me vino como anillo al dedo porque no tengo horno en casa. Por otra parte, desde que probé este postre en casa de una conocida muy cercana, quedé encantada con el sabor producto de la combinación de la leche condensada y el limón. También me gustó al probar la limonada brasilera. Hace un par de años intenté preparar un pie de limón, pero no me salió muy bien, no por el sabor, sino por la consistencia.
![1776810958870.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmemagm6uAoW8HMrgkNrHn2sSahzExpfCq6yUxeu1zL5fJ/1776810958870.jpg)

>Quizás se debió a que mezclé los ingredientes principales omitiendo alguno que era clave para ello, fue muy básico todo. En esta ocasión, no preparé la base de galletas, esta receta tiene algunos cambios, pero logré que quedara húmeda, con consistencia, y por supuesto, deliciosa. Parece un bizcocho, nadie creería que ésta Carlota está formada por capas de galletas y la mezcla de leche condensada y el jugo de un cítrico.
## Ingredientes
>- 250 ml de crema de leche\n

>- 1/2 taza de jugo de limón
![1776810959031.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd3eUXujSPJUrXBUVTGZiPX4NkkY2pSi6aMaZHwr97jSo/1776810959031.jpg)
## Preparación

>1.-. En un bol, vertemos la leche condensada y luego el jugo de limón, lo haremos de manera gradual mientras vamos mezclando con mucho cuidado. Notaremos un cambio de consistencia, será un poco más espesa.
![1776810958266.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZrLvPK3tHt8yWRmfHYsaajyB5pcbbYcg1t6cvX4X2dZz/1776810958266.jpg)
![1776810958283.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUEAF6kNAJSzG52zHBZ65JjS3YNRePheCQCk8ACRwP9rF/1776810958283.jpg)
![1776810959008.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb6fDRYEsXCzVXkdcptLRXJZ4yYNC6rRAoPvjoUtT4Ggv/1776810959008.jpg)

>2.-. Luego, agregamos la crema de leche, también de manera gradual mientras vamos mezclando hasta que se integren bien los ingredientes.
![1776810958988.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWuKjNVRpuhYrZdJWojwjguwfXs9r8quusSQY4ctw4qhR/1776810958988.jpg)
![1776810958300.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVVyW4RMB6RDm9P6bEfvD8fnbQ9kUwi1pjkxgVvcTmpcx/1776810958300.jpg)
![1776810958964.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmanjZcd7T8hWrmk9iu7RDULXLM4uWxs4bJozFSpzGNbRA/1776810958964.jpg)

>3.-. En un refractario rectangular, colocamos una capa de galletas, cuidando de rellenar los espacios que queden vacíos, luego, una capa de la mezcla líquida que hemos preparado con la leche condensada, la crema de leche y el jugo de limón. Así vamos alternando entre capas de galletas y la mezcla líquida hasta terminar con todos los ingredientes.
![1776810958944.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaAzBDzHjCGiNoqjKqiEJirE9P1o84BxDV3FSzF5Bd7Cj/1776810958944.jpg)
![1776810958317.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSiVxUSXubHD3zx1CB1bdNScfUiJHSVnvRsAm77Y5VCeB/1776810958317.jpg)

>4.-. Para finalizar, decoramos con galletas molidas la capa superior. Molemos las galletas con la ayuda de un mazo luego de introducirlas en una bolsa plástica y enseguida las esparcimos por la toda la superficie de la capa final de la Carlota.
![1776810958925.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWZF2YWfGeCJWnLofrN1fp8MYLF8MdcJWz2ALWKtCa1hq/1776810958925.jpg)

>5.- Llevamos la Carlota de limón a la nevera para refrigerarla por unas 4 horas como mínimo.
![1776810958907.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZUfdaVSNq1nXsKRfN2vMRqGTpRZqHfVwJXURZY3qBGQu/1776810958907.jpg)

>Ahora sí, a disfrutar de esta deliciosa Carlota de limón sin horno.
![1776810958848.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPBNa3jCPtCMbCprYA8CAreBEcuUeAP5qWx3QXccAUNmd/1776810958848.jpg)
![1776810958821.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmevMk5bSATpcDbZ2hczAz2x1rRcYdybLNCcNXJgA5MDTK/1776810958821.jpg)
![1776810958888.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQme1xEmEmPVtAXpsNVBCyzcMpE1AYGVjczgYqEK6PPfFem/1776810958888.jpg)
Espero que les haya gustado. Nos vemos en la próxima oportunidad.
Todas las fotografías son originales, tomadas con mi celular Xiaomi Redmi 9. Las ediciones las hice con la aplicación [GridArt](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=photoeditor.layout.collagemaker&hl=en_ZA&gl=US).

links.title: 🏡 Ambientadores para su hogar || es-en 🏡
links.body:
>¡Me declaro una limpiadora compulsiva! 😊 Y no se trata de que dejo todo reluciente, pero sí me gusta sentir que todos los lugares de mi casa se sientan limpios y yo sepa que lo están.
\n\n

>En estos días, lo que inició como una lavada de ropa rutinaria, terminó con un lavado de baño, limpieza de mesón, organización de nevera y hasta agua para las plantas de mi vecino 😆. Todo eso lo hago en una mañana porque, gracias a Dios, mi hogar es pequeño y sin muchos adornos, solo lo necesario. No guardo nada que no esté usando 😉.
\n\n

>Sin embargo, cuando limpio, siento que falta algo; sí, es cierto, la casa se ve limpia, ordenada, todo en su lugar, pero no tiene olor. Por más que uso desinfectante, le coloco pastillas a los inodoros, los paños de cocina los remojo en cloro o vinagre; ¡no hay un olor agradable! Ojo, no huele algo malo, solo hablo de ese olor a perfume o aroma rico. ¿Me entienden de lo que les hablo?
\n\n

>Mi preocupación radica en cómo no he colocado la campana en mi cocina; más huele a la carne guisada, el quemado de la arepa o la sopa que hago y no a olores agradables, que no sean de comida.
\n\n

>He optado por la opción de ambientadores y acá les muestro los que he probado.
\n\n>![English version]

>I declare myself a compulsive cleaner! 😊 And it's not about making everything shine, but I do like to feel that all the places in my house feel clean and that I know they are. These days, what started as a routine load of laundry ended up with cleaning the bathroom, wiping the counters, organizing the fridge, and even giving water to my neighbor's plants 😆. I do all that in one morning because, thank God, my home is small and not very decorated, just the essentials. I don't keep anything I'm not using 😉. However, when I clean, I feel something is missing; yes, it's true, the house looks clean, organized, everything in its place, but it has no scent. No matter how much disinfectant I use, I put tablets in the toilets, soak the kitchen cloths in bleach or vinegar; there is no pleasant smell! Mind you, it doesn't smell bad, I'm just talking about that perfume or nice aroma. Do you understand what I'm talking about? My concern lies in how I have not installed the hood in my kitchen; it smells more like stewed meat, the burnt arepa, or the soup I make and not like pleasant odors, other than food. I have opted for the air freshener option, and here I show you the ones I have tried.
![Diseño sin título (29).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23wXQYBvSRqMZjt9YLcsjH1EBKZYV2q3oiCZXnzvb2EjmM7tNZtS4mw91aw5cncdKBrNW.png)

> **Absorbent sticks** The closest thing to them that I had used are incense sticks; the problem is that, with my mother's rhinitis, we keep smoke out of our home. Now, this was a gift that was given to us, and it seemed novel. For its use, you just remove the safety seal from the container and insert the sticks into the liquid. Immediately, the scent begins to diffuse. I don't know if it is because my home is spacious, a single room without divisions, but the scent doesn't linger. I place it one day, and by the third day, there is no scent. I don't know if they sell it by brand or some long-lasting ones, and also if the oil can be refilled or if it ends and is discarded. They are good, but the scent goes away quickly.

> **Varillas absorbentes** Lo más cercano a ellas que había usado son los inciensos; el problema es que, con la rinitis de mi madre, apartamos el humo de nuestro hogar. Ahora, este fue un regalo que le hicieron y nos pareció novedoso. Para su uso, solo se le quita el sello de seguridad al envase y se meten las varillas en el líquido Inmediatamente comienza a destilar el olor. No sé si porque mi hogar es amplio, un solo ambiente sin divisiones, que el olor no se queda. Yo lo coloco un día y a los 3 días ya no huele. Desconozco si lo venden por marca o algunos de larga duración, además de si se le puede recargar el aceite o se acaba y se desecha. Son buenos, pero el olor se va rápido. -------

> **Humidifier** I would be lying if I told you that I am trendy, but I have seen them so much in the stores I visit and even a friend has one at her house that smells really nice, that I decided to get one. The instructions say to put the oil in half of the container and fill it with water so that it doesn't get clogged due to the thickness of the liquid. Results? The smell can be felt if you are close to the device; from afar, no. Again, I don't know if it's because it was a low-quality oil or if the scent simply does not reach. For this, I should buy a good oil, but for now the goals have not been achieved.

> **Humidificador** Les mentiría si les digo que soy de tendencias, pero los he visto tanto en las tiendas que visito y hasta una amiga tiene en su casa que huele muy rico, que me decidí por uno. Las instrucciones dicen que se coloca el aceite en la mitad del envase y se completa con agua para que no se tape por lo espeso del líquido. ¿Resultados? El olor se siente si estás cerca del aparato; de lejos, no. Nuevamente, no sé si es porque era un aceite de baja calidad o definitivamente el olor no llega. Este sí debo comprar un buen aceite, pero por ahora no se han logrado los objetivos. -----

> **Glade Air Freshener** It has been my ally in matters of scenting my house, but I think the problem is me because I don't feel anything 🤣. Seriously speaking, if I am near the air freshener, every time it sprays (because it is programmed), you can smell it, but it doesn't reach anywhere else. In my defense, I have also used it in a closed room all day and nothing, there is no strong clean and pleasant smell that it should emit. The only thing is that, due to its design, it catches the attention of people who come to the house, but there is no olfactory impact as I would like. I have also bought air fresheners from this brand, the ones that plug into the outlet and the ones that are placed in bathrooms, but the first one doesn’t smell either, and the second one, I haven’t found it in stores anymore; I think they discontinued it.

> **Ambientador Glade** Ha sido mi aliado en asuntos de aromatizar mi casa, pero creo que la del problema soy yo porque no siento nada 🤣. Hablando en serio, si estoy cerca del ambientador, cada vez que suelta el spray (porque viene programado), se siente el olor, pero de allí no llega a ningún lado. En mi defensa, también lo he usado en el cuarto cerrado todo el día y que va, no hay olor fuerte de limpio y sabroso que debería destilar. Lo único que, por su diseño, a las personas que vienen a casa les llama la atención, pero no hay impacto olfativo como quisiera. También los he comprado de esta marca, de los que se colocan en el enchufe y del que se coloca en los baños, pero el primero tampoco huele y el segundo, no lo he encontrado más en las tiendas; creo que lo descontinuaron. -------
>Entonces, este es el momento que digo que son productos buenos, pero no encuentro uno que deje un olor COMPLETO en mi hogar a flores, limón, canela u otra fragancia que al abrir la puerta diga \

>Por eso, una vez más acudo a la comunidad, a ver si tienen algunos tips o si lo estoy haciendo mal, para poder corregir e invitarlos a casa y sintamos el verdadero olor que provoque quedarse en el hogar 😆.
\n\n>![English version]

>So, this is the moment where I say that these are good products, but I can't find one that leaves a COMPLETE smell in my home of flowers, lemon, cinnamon, or any other fragrance that, when opening the door, says 'It's truly clean.' That’s why, once again, I turn to the community to see if they have any tips or if I’m doing something wrong, so I can correct it and invite them over and we can feel the true smell that makes you want to stay at home 😆.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-11 at 8.36.05 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23xVPaeMx7ijF3fuMqz5KWBV471s9JonzTKy9XodCew7We4XDxpw57R7JsixR1EeD4RYz.jpeg)
_Las fotografías son de mi propiedad. La portada, el banner y el separador los hice en Canva. El traductor que usé fue Google Traductor._
# Hasta una próxima oportunidad 🏠 >

>The photographs are my property. I made the cover, the banner, and the divider in Canva. The translator I used was Google Translate. Until next time 🏠.

links.title: Film Review: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2 (2017)
links.body:
![(source:  tmdb.org)](https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/uwH7DgD2Y7uUtmNTD1t97K0ZG2a.jpg)


In 2014, *[Guardians of the Galaxy](https://peakd.com/film/@drax/capsule-film-review-guardians-of-the-galaxy-2014)*, a film adaptation of a relatively obscure Marvel comic, was triumphantly welcomed as a refreshing departure within the ever‑expanding and unstoppable Marvel Cinematic Universe. Its director, James Gunn, received numerous accolades for stripping his otherwise not particularly profound or coherently plotted film of all seriousness and filling it with a host of absurd characters, scenes, situations, and references to contemporary pop culture. Because of this, *Guardians of the Galaxy* seemed a precious respite from the melodramatic epicness of other Marvel films, though it was clear to everyone that Gunn would struggle to repeat the same effect in the inevitable sequel, and that the new film’s quality would unavoidably be weaker than the first. When *Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2* arrived in cinemas in 2017, these suspicions were largely justified—yet, on the other hand, it cannot be said that Gunn didn’t invest serious creative effort into his film.

The title protagonists, the Guardians of the Galaxy, are a group of space adventurers led by Peter Quill, alias Star‑Lord (Chris Pratt), who have gained fame and are now sought by the most powerful governments and other entities for delicate missions. One such client is Ayesha (Eluzabeth Debicki), the sovereign of the race called the Sovereign, who hires the Guardians to protect valuable batteries from interdimensional monsters. In return, she hands over Nebula (Karen Gillan), the sister of Gamora (Zoe Saldana), a member of the Guardians team. The sisters have a long‑standing feud, but the real trouble for the Guardians begins when one of them, Rocket (Bradley Cooper), decides to keep the batteries for himself, provoking Ayesha’s wrath and leading her to order their elimination with the help of all sorts of galactic mercenary rabble. Consequently, the Guardians find themselves in enormous difficulties, from which they are rescued by Ego (Kurt Russell), a deity in the form of a living planet who claims to be Quill’s father.

As one might expect from a Marvel film, *Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2* makes no secret of its hundreds‑of‑millions‑of‑dollars budget, above all in scenes where exotic alien worlds are created with the aid of state‑of‑the‑art CGI effects in a rather impressive way. Throughout all this, Gunn—who this time is also the sole screenwriter—seeks to impose a kind of authorial stamp, primarily through the use of garish colours, deliberately making his film gaudy and unserious. Thanks to this, certain plot motifs and scenes, such as the mass slaughter of villains, which might otherwise seem inappropriate for a family‑friendly or overly sensitive format, become relatively easy to digest. Gunn also attempts to achieve this through a furious pace, though here he is not always successful. The first part thus feels over‑extended and hard to follow for anyone not fully acquainted with the first film or the Marvel universe. Some characters are not developed particularly well, and their sub‑plots come off as soap‑operatic. Some of these problems are only resolved in the second part, when Gunn introduces a twist that seems quite unexpected by today’s Hollywood standards. *Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2* also holds up relatively well thanks to a fairly spirited cast, though it might be said that the actors who get to perform without excessive makeup—such as Pratt, the always‑reliable character actor Michael Rooker as Quill’s former mentor Yondu Udonta, and the excellent Kurt Russell—are more successful in every respect than those who do not. One tragic example is Karen Gillan, the Scottish actress popular for her role in the BBC series *Doctor Who*, who is utterly unrecognisable as Nebula. Although *Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2* largely fulfils its reason for existing and will provide most viewers with two hours of undemanding escapist entertainment, one is still left with the impression that the freshness is gone and that not all creative potential has been exploited. That impression grows even stronger if the film is compared with the later‑released promotional trailer for the DVD edition, which stands as one of the most effective examples of film marketing in recent years.
RATING: 5/10 (++)

*(Note: The text in the original Croatian version is available [here](https://draxblog.com/2020/05/21/recenzija-cuvari-galaksije-vol-2-guardians-of-the-galaxy-vol-2-2017/).)*

links.title: Should Interns Be Paid or Just Be Grateful for the Experience?
links.body:
> *Hello learners*
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSb4z848oeBXToYaqJUPBgvvLquLkrtsgqJpx3antKwN3/image.png)
[source](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/businessman-boss-executive-founder-6350451/) *Before I dive into today’s topic, whether interns should be paid by the companies where they are learning, let us first understand the term intern.* > An intern is someone who is still learning a job or profession by working under supervision. *This usually happens during/after university studies or after an ND program in a polytechnic, so students can gain practical knowledge. For example, in my school, Industrial Training (IT) is compulsory for anyone who wants to proceed to the HND program. Without completing IT, you won’t be eligible.* *Now, back to the main discussion: should interns be paid?* *Personally, I disagree.* *An internship is a period of training. Why should interns be paid when they are still being taught?* *It is similar to asking employers in every profession to start paying their apprentices while they are still learning the craft.* *I understand that some people may not like this idea and will argue that interns deserve payment. But if the roles were reversed, many of those same people might not be willing to pay someone who is still learning under them.*
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSDMtAv1FnCYAPEsv9GvHuBqkLPA9U1v1q5zHGQLtfyQA/image.png)
[source](https://pixabay.com/photos/woman-bored-tired-office-business-5679001/) *Moreover, most companies do not necessarily need extra workers. Interns are either posted there or apply because their school requires it. So, it may not seem fair to expect payment from organizations that agreed to train them.* *I had a cousin who benefited greatly from her IT experience. She learned shoe-making during her internship, and after school, she ventured fully into the business. Today, she is successful in it. There are many similar success stories from people who used their internship period wisely.* *Some companies even retain interns after their service period if they are impressed with their performance or how quickly they understand the work. At that stage, they officially become employees of the organization, and that is when they truly deserve to be paid, because they are no longer just learning, but actively contributing their skills to the company.* *I even believe bosses at our places of internship should be appreciated when we are done, rather than the other way around. In some cases, we should be grateful enough to gift them for sharing their knowledge with us.* *I know some people will disagree with this because they feel they were “used” by the company. But we need to understand that most of these companies didn’t actually need us; we are the ones who need them for exposure and experience.* *That said, internship policies also vary. Some companies don’t pay interns at all, some give a small transport allowance, while others pay full salaries. I think this depends on the type of company and how valuable the intern is to their operations.* *In some organizations, not much training is needed for workers to perform effectively; they only need a brief introduction, and they can continue on their own. Such companies may choose to pay interns*. *However, in cases where interns require heavy training to understand how things work, they are already benefiting greatly from the knowledge gained. In my opinion, additional payment is not necessary in such situations.*

links.title: My favorite way to end the day 🕯️
links.body: > There are nights when I like to light a candle at the end of the day because it’s a moment of respite I give myself, and I really enjoy that intimate time with myself. I light it carefully, watch as the flame takes shape, and in that instant, I feel everything inside me begin to fall into place. I like to watch how the warm light casts soft shadows on the table. Everything seems to move more slowly—including me. It’s as if time stops and stays with me for a while, long enough to listen to me and feel me. > Hay noches que me gusta encender una vela al final del día porque es una pausa que me regalo y disfruto mucho ese momento íntimo conmigo. La pongo con cuidado, observo cómo la llama encuentra su forma y, en ese instante, siento que todo empieza a ordenarse por dentro. > Me gusta ver cómo la luz cálida dibuja sombras suaves sobre la mesa. Todo parece existir más lento, incluso yo. Es como si el tiempo dejara de correr y se quedara conmigo un rato, lo suficiente para escucharme y sentirme.

>

I reflect on what I did, on what I left undone, on what perhaps didn’t turn out as I’d hoped. I don’t judge myself harshly; I do so with great compassion because I understand and accept that, often, I can’t have everything figured out and that I’m still on my journey of learning.

I make peace with the day, with my mistakes, with my achievements. I take a deeper breath. I am grateful for what I have and who I am right now. And as the candle continues to burn, I feel something ignite within me as well.

I blow out the candle before going to sleep, and in this way, amidst the daily grind, I find a space that is all my own. A place where everything is just fine, exactly as it is.


> Pienso en lo que hice, en lo que dejé pendiente, en lo que tal vez no salió como esperaba. No lo hago con dureza, lo hago con mucha compasión porque entiendo y acepto que, muchas veces, no puedo tener todo resuelto y que sigo en mi camino de aprendizajes.

> Me reconcilio con el día, con mis errores, con mis logros. Respiro más profundo. Agradezco lo que tengo y lo que soy en este momento. Y mientras la vela sigue encendida, siento que también se enciende algo dentro de mí.

> Apago la vela antes de irme a dormir y, así, en medio de lo cotidiano, encuentro un espacio que es solo mío. Un lugar donde todo está bien, tal como es.

>Buenos días amigos de Hive, bienvenidos una vez más a mi blog digital, les saluda su gran amigo el pintor Ramaco, quien les trae una nueva publicación artística, un nuevo recuerdo playero vivido junto a mis amigos que jamás olvidare, y que espero sea de su agrado, ya que voy a explicar detalladamente como realice la ilustración, así como también relatar mi historia.
Bienvenidos a ver mis ocurrencia artística nacida del recuerdo, dentro de un hermoso paisaje, en el blog digital de Hive.

@ramaco54

La ilustración de hoy se titula:

Recordando el viejo bote de pesca, en una hermosa playa del trópico.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSKvyANmd9JmKfUfKarBtfTE6ghN2hXMZdqDkeJQuHqnk/diapositiva7.jpg)
MIS MATERIALES.

>Los materiales que utilicé en esta oportunidad fueron: acuarela, acrílico blanco, mis pinceles de acuarela y lápices de colores, sobre cartulina FABRIANO, Cámara fotográfica Panasonic, Marca LUMIX FZ47, programa de digitalización Adobe Photoshop, para modificaciones digitales y Power Point, para pasar las imágenes a formato jpg.
PROCESO PASO A PASO.

>Amigo espectador, curador y fiel seguidor de mi trabajo artístico, como siempre recordando parte de mi historia, he ilustrado recuerdos de mi vida y aquel bote de pesca guerrero que tanto me acompaño en mis días de muchacho junto a mis amigos cuando salíamos de pesca, ilustración que realice de la siguiente manera.
EL INICIO.

>Inicio mi trabajo con unas interesantes manchas en color magenta y azul bajo la técnica de la aguada, como lo muestran las imágenes.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP5uDqxnAcXatWEPgmh1ZeUKeTSToHp7unQrRkwNQLPJM/diapositiva1.jpg)

>Conforme voy avanzando, los colores intensos como naranja violeta y verdes, se van incorporando, formando algunos detalles, que se harán más interesantes en el proceso.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTkDLQwoi3EjUTmwqVxUbek6cvzTVFu5bVp1o5GFcHoky/diapositiva2.jpg)

>Observen la gran montaña realizada con colores cobrizos y violetas junto al cálido cielo, la vegetación de colores verdes oscuros en la base de la misma y la transparencia de las aguas del mar.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU4p1n7iCXCSjx7sfn53nWBNaWsPE8iq1DqysQXSxSiXT/diapositiva3.jpg)

>Los detalles más minuciosos los realizo con un pincel punta fina como lo muestra la imagen, en esta oportunidad estoy realizando el follaje del arbusto con diferentes tonalidades de verde, agregue unas aves volando en el cielo y el brillo del ligero oleaje del mar.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUVkXasXuiiQkMppwNtsXcW7u5m48ahUZb6wfFXqEvyx6/diapositiva4.jpg)

>Estoy incorporando cada vez más detalles como lo son: la variedad de verdes que forman los arbustos a lo lejos, y el boceto de un bote en el agua.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRdForGQTwQAM96Ze6pVNxLxkHgjAMgb9EJxbBtdsXoWf/diapositiva5.jpg)

>Miren y detallen muy bien, como está quedando el paisaje, con el bote ya pintado, la vegetación ligeramente floreada, las hojas de una palmera del lado izquierdo y a o lejos entre los arbustos una casita campestre.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT9knPsGbboyTKN78nkJiPZRzGwvjSnLwQuDLrv9mTbzA/diapositiva6.jpg)

>Algunos detalles más, colores intensos, recuerdos imborrables, forman la majestuosa obra titulad:

Recordando el viejo bote de pesca, en una hermosa playa del trópico.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSKvyANmd9JmKfUfKarBtfTE6ghN2hXMZdqDkeJQuHqnk/diapositiva7.jpg)

>Amigos espectadores, curadores y fieles seguidores de mi trabajo artístico, mi ilustración no es simplemente un paisaje al azar, sino la simple vivencia de la vida y el recuerdo de un muchacho que disfrutaba de la pesca, con sus amigos, cuentos, chistes, travesuras y hasta en el que quedamos cuando atrapábamos un pescado, en compañía y disfrute de las amistades y el paisaje en una playa del trópico venezolano.\n\n

>Bien amigos, espero de todo corazón que les haya gustado este lindo paisaje, que revivió recuerdos importantes de mi vida de muchacho.
Muchas gracias por su amable atención.
Un abrazo, los quiero mucho.

@ramaco54

_____________________________________________________ >

>Good morning, Hive friends! Welcome once again to my digital blog. This is your good friend, the painter Ramaco, bringing you a new artistic post, a new beach memory I've shared with my friends that I'll never forget. I hope you enjoy it, as I'll explain in detail how I created the illustration, as well as tell my story. >
Welcome to see my artistic inspiration born from memory, set against a beautiful landscape, on the Hive digital blog.
>

@ramaco54

>
Today's illustration is titled:
>

Remembering the old fishing boat on a beautiful tropical beach.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSKvyANmd9JmKfUfKarBtfTE6ghN2hXMZdqDkeJQuHqnk/diapositiva7.jpg)
>
MY MATERIALS.
>

>The materials I used for this piece were: watercolor, white acrylic paint, my watercolor brushes and colored pencils, on FABRIANO cardstock, a Panasonic LUMIX FZ47 camera, Adobe Photoshop for digital modifications, and PowerPoint to convert the images to JPG format. >
STEP-BY-STEP PROCESS.
>

>Dear viewer, curator, and loyal follower of my artwork, as always, recalling a part of my history, I have illustrated memories of my life and that old fishing boat that was such a constant companion during my youth when we went fishing with my friends. I created this illustration as follows. >
THE BEGINNING.
>

>I began my work with some interesting washes of magenta and blue, as shown in the following images. Images.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP5uDqxnAcXatWEPgmh1ZeUKeTSToHp7unQrRkwNQLPJM/diapositiva1.jpg)
>

>As ​​I progress, intense colors like orange, violet, and greens are incorporated, forming details that will become more interesting as the process unfolds.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTkDLQwoi3EjUTmwqVxUbek6cvzTVFu5bVp1o5GFcHoky/diapositiva2.jpg)
>

>Notice the large mountain rendered in copper and violet hues against the warm sky, the dark green vegetation at its base, and the transparency of the waters of the sea.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU4p1n7iCXCSjx7sfn53nWBNaWsPE8iq1DqysQXSxSiXT/diapositiva3.jpg)
>

>I do the finer details with a fine-tipped brush, as shown in the image. This time, I'm painting the foliage of the bush with different shades of green. I've added some birds flying in the sky and the shimmer of the gentle waves.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUVkXasXuiiQkMppwNtsXcW7u5m48ahUZb6wfFXqEvyx6/diapositiva4.jpg)
>

>I'm incorporating more and more details, such as the variety of greens that make up The bushes in the distance, and the sketch of a boat on the water.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRdForGQTwQAM96Ze6pVNxLxkHgjAMgb9EJxbBtdsXoWf/diapositiva5.jpg)
>

>Look closely at how the landscape is coming along, with the boat already painted, the vegetation in bloom, the leaves of a palm tree on the left, and in the distance, among the bushes, a small country house.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT9knPsGbboyTKN78nkJiPZRzGwvjSnLwQuDLrv9mTbzA/diapositiva6.jpg)
>

>Some details Furthermore, intense colors and indelible memories form the majestic work entitled: >

Remembering the old fishing boat on a beautiful tropical beach.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSKvyANmd9JmKfUfKarBtfTE6ghN2hXMZdqDkeJQuHqnk/diapositiva7.jpg)
>

>Dear viewers, curators, and loyal followers of my artwork, my illustration is not simply a random landscape, but rather the simple experience of life and the memory of a boy who enjoyed fishing with his friends, stories, jokes, pranks, and even the one we made when we caught a fish, enjoying the company and scenery of friends on a beach in the Venezuelan tropics.\n\n>

>Well friends, I sincerely hope you enjoyed this beautiful landscape, which brought back important memories from my youth. >
Thank you very much for your kind attention.
>
Hugs, I love you all.
>

El mal uso de palabras y la tergiversación de conceptos es una de las cosas que más nos ha perjudicado a los venezolanos en esta etapa que estamos viviendo. 

La sociedad cada vez está peor pues se dejan llevar por lo que dicen otros sin investigar, es increíble como hoy en día un sector desarma un hecho en base a mentiras, con defensas mal estructuradas, con palabras que no corresponden, pero \

Es que se convierte en una verdad social, hoy en día no se busca el conocimiento se busca es \
los hechos o estar en un bando.\n\n<div class=\

> ![1776896420270579630049798922803.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbxQZqj1j6cQFmLkTg88gw3UvAVL2P8sg81ghK8NYp3Rp/1776896420270579630049798922803.png)[1] Esto que estamos viviendo es más grave, más grande y más complicado de lo que parece, porque la ignorancia se está metiendo en nuestras casas, en nuestras escuelas y nuestra sociedad en general. La degradación del discurso, el pobre contenido con el que mueven las masas, el uso de palabras que suavizan las situaciones complicadas o usar palabras específicas para manipular y la tergiversación de las palabras se esta convirtiendo en normalidad. Para muchas personas esto no es grave, porque simplemente ya es parte de la política de este país, pero sí es grave, es tan grave que ha sido eso lo que nos ha llevado hasta este punto hoy, y es ese tono o enfoque \

a lo delicado de nuestra situación que hoy en día nos paraliza. 

En Venezuela las palabras se utilizan como una anestesia, hoy la población ha aceptado humillaciones, hambre, escasez, vejaciones y muchas otras cosas más, porque hay sectores que saben que la palabra tiene poder y la tergiversación de los términos lo han sabido aprovechar. 

Todos y cada uno de nosotros tenemos la responsabilidad de salvar a nuestra sociedad, no podemos permitir que el discurso vacío o manipulado sea la verdad, debemos buscar aprender, debemos reencontrar nuestra brújula para poder salvar a Venezuela.

El trabajo aquí es individual, cada uno de nosotros debemos empoderarnos con el conocimiento, utilizar las herramientas necesarias para desarmar la ignorancia... Porque aquí actualmente todos somos víctimas y todos necesitamos un cambio real.

Y no lo digo en el tema político, pues necesitamos un cambio de mentalidad, necesitamos que nuestro futuro sea mejor, más instruido, menos moldeables, que no se dejen llevar por palabras suaves o pegajosas... Una sociedad culta tiene líderes de altura.

<div class=\

> ![17768963009905897243016044429002.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXGKdY9jy11dqEkLmYJBB4Gq4ezHQ34e75UC3eJhShvw3/17768963009905897243016044429002.png)[2] Cuando tenemos conocimiento, cuando estamos preparados no llega cualquiera a engañarnos, no hay palabras dulces que romanticen nuestra realidad, no hay manipulación con palabras erróneas, no hay posibilidad de que la tergiversación funcione, así y solo así vamos avanzar. Si quieres que tu vida cambie, debes hacer ciertos cambios, a tu vida llegará lo bueno que mereces porque has hecho el trabajo, imagina si todos nosotros hacemos el trabajo que nos corresponde... Obviamente tendremos como sociedad lo que necesitamos. ______ ###
❤️❤️❤️❤️English Version.❤️❤️❤️❤️
_______
![InShot_20260422_181246966.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmePrZphdMa3ULCKQi7JFqXjZPBQv4oCD9qsxxjTScmGcd/InShot_20260422_181246966.jpg)
The misuse of words and the distortion of concepts is one of the things that has most harmed Venezuelans during this period we are living through. Society is getting worse because people are easily swayed by what others say without investigating. It's incredible how nowadays a sector can dismantle a situation based on lies, with poorly structured defenses, with inappropriate words that \

or that resonate emotionally to mobilize the masses. Many people repeat these arguments or words because it's trendy, but few take the time to analyze the context, and that harms us more than many realize.\n\nBecause it's not the argument, it's not a misused word... It's that it becomes a social truth; nowadays, people don't seek knowledge, they seek to \
the facts or to be on one side or the other.\n\n<div class=\

> ![1776896420270579630049798922803.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbxQZqj1j6cQFmLkTg88gw3UvAVL2P8sg81ghK8NYp3Rp/1776896420270579630049798922803.png)[1] What we are experiencing is more serious, bigger, and more complicated than it seems, because ignorance is creeping into our homes, our schools, and our society in general. The degradation of discourse, the poor content used to manipulate the masses, the use of words that soften difficult situations or the use of specific words to manipulate, and the distortion of words are becoming the norm. For many people, this isn't serious because it's simply part of the politics of this country, but it is serious. It's so serious that it's what has brought us to this point today, and it's this \

tone or approach to the delicate nature of our situation that is paralyzing us.

In Venezuela, words are used as anesthesia. Today, the population has accepted humiliation, hunger, scarcity, abuse, and much more, because there are sectors that know words have power and have skillfully exploited the distortion of terms.

Each and every one of us has the responsibility to save our society. We cannot allow empty or manipulated rhetoric to become the truth. We must seek to learn; we must rediscover our compass in order to save Venezuela.

The work here is individual. Each of us must empower ourselves with knowledge, using the necessary tools to dismantle ignorance... Because here, we are all victims, and we all need real change.

And I'm not talking about politics, because we need a change of mentality, we need our future to be better, more educated, less malleable, not swayed by soft or sticky words... A cultured society has great leaders.


<div class=\

Sweet words can't romanticize our reality, there's no manipulation with misleading words, no possibility of distortion working. Only in this way will we move forward. If you want your life to change, you must make certain changes. The good things you deserve will come into your life because you have done the work. Imagine if we all did our part... links.body:
![COVER.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aleister/23wgL5giAAetguC1K6PT9SVjEdVFaAz4qGudxZEm96yy7jwKPhaY49K8vqG9z6LaEAw8Y.jpg)

##### Hi everyone :)

When I hit this small stone that was almost cubic for a macro session, I thought I found a little to explore with a lens, but once I was fooled, I should never have been surprised :P The white, compact and slightly translucent surface revealed everything, between cracks, small pink spots, a lost dark spot and areas with mineral shine characteristic of this type of composition, rough edges, irregular texture and an appearance that is made of solid quartz. I especially enjoyed seeing how the light revealed the reliefs and depth to this very small piece.

---

Among the numerous techniques available for macro photography, this method is arguably the most cost-effective and efficient for individuals possessing a camera with a removable lens. By simply detaching the lens and reversing its direction, and employing an inversion ring, the process becomes more manageable and streamlined.

https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://img.esteem.ws/qpm6pm12ej.gif

---

##### Session Purpose
The goal of these macro photography sessions is to capture images with as much detail as possible within the capabilities of the technique used, always focusing on the meticulous observation and documentation of all visual characteristics and details. Furthermore, I aim to create attractive visual compositions for publication on this blog, seeking to share the beauty and complexity of this work.

---

##### Used equipments
Camera: Canon EOS 600D Digital SLR with CMOS sensor
Lens: EFS 18-55mm with f/4 maximum aperture, allowing shallow depth of field and capturing fine details.
Used inverter ring
Tripod: not used
Lighting: Adjustable LED lights to provide soft, even lighting, avoiding harsh shadows and highlighting the details of structures.

##### Camera Settings
Focus Mode: Manual focus to ensure precision in specific details of the structure.
Aperture: f/4 for adequate depth of field, ensuring all important details are in focus.
ISO: Low ISO setting (1600) to minimize noise in images.
Shutter Speed: Adjust shutter speed as needed to avoid underexposure, while maintaining a value that allows you to capture sharp details.

links.title: 하루 30분이상 걷기
links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXKduqBccD652CfDLzKX22N8CLbuGCCHQcg2rUpjsSunL/ijmaki_walking_1305111.png)

딸아이가 사준 바로잰fit을  왼쪽 팔에 부착하고 매일 혈당을 체크하고 있다. 
몇번 아침에 일어나자마자  글루네오 플러스 혈당 측정기로 직접 왼손가락에서 혈당체크 해 보았다. 실제 측정한 것과 비교해보니 바로잰 fit은  약간의 오차가 있기는 하지만 혈당의 흐름을 알수 있었다.
요즘은 매일 저녁 식사후에 운동장은 40분이상 돌고 있다. 

그리고 오늘은 뉴스를 검색하던중에  건강에 대해 꽤 인상적인 내용을 알게 되었다.
하루 30분 정도 가볍게 걷는 것만으로도 유방암 위험을 낮출 수 있다는 연구 결과를 접했다. 사실 “이 정도로 효과가 있을까?” 싶었는데, 운동 직후 혈액 자체가 암세포 증식을 억제하는 방향으로 변한다는 점이 특히 놀라웠다.

운동을 하면 근육에서 ‘마이오카인’이라는 물질이 나오는데, 이게 단순한 피로 회복이나 체력 향상을 넘어서 항암 작용까지 한다고 한다. 특히 운동 직후에는 이 물질이 가장 많이 증가해서 몸이 일시적으로 ‘항암 상태’가 된다는 표현이 인상 깊었다. 그리고 이 상태를 꾸준히 반복하면 결국 염증도 줄고, 면역력도 좋아지고, 호르몬 균형까지 개선된다고 한다.

생각해보면 운동을 한 번 하고 끝내는 게 아니라, 약처럼 꾸준히 먹듯이 반복하는 게 중요하다는 말이 딱 맞는 것 같다. 괜히 “운동은 습관이다”라는 말이 있는 게 아니구나 싶었다.

또 하나 기억에 남는 건, 단순히 걷기만 하는 것보다 스쿼트나 런지처럼 큰 근육을 쓰는 운동이 더 효과적이라는 점이다. 앞으로는 그냥 걷는 것에서 끝내지 말고, 짧게라도 근력 운동을 같이 해봐야겠다는 생각이 들었다.

운동뿐 아니라 생활습관도 중요하다고 했다. 식이섬유가 많은 채소와 과일, 통곡물을 챙겨 먹고, 술은 줄이고, 플라스틱 대신 유리를 쓰는 것 같은 작은 습관들이 결국 큰 차이를 만든다고 한다. 특히 체중 관리가 중요하다는 부분도 다시 한번 느꼈다.

아무리 관리를 잘해도 유전적인 요인이 있을 수 있기 때문에, 정기적인 체크도 꼭 필요하다고 한다. 매달 자가 검진을 하고, 40세 이후에는 정기적으로 검사를 받는 게 중요하다는 점도 기억해둬야겠다.

오늘은 “운동을 해야겠다”가 아니라 “운동을 꾸준히 해야겠다”라는 생각이 강하게 든 날이었다.
가볍게라도 매일 움직이는 습관, 그게 결국 미래의 건강을 지키는 가장 확실한 방법이라는 걸 다시 느꼈다.
