links.title: The soul of books /El alma de los libros / LOH Contest 285 [ES/EN]
links.body:
> **Español** Es una gran coincidencia que los temas de la semana de diferentes comunidades tengan los mismos intereses y es que los libros, las películas y las experiencias de la vida misma nos marcan muchas veces el camino que seguimos. Nos reunimos en comunidades donde compartimos experiencias y formas de vivir la vida. Durante muchos años fui una lectora a diario, pero mi tiempo y ganas de leer han disminuido, sin embargo visito espacios donde encuentro información valiosa y películas que me resumen el contenido de los libros. El internet ha hecho mucho más fácil la información donde podemos acceder a libros sin necesidad de tenerlos en físico, los disfrutamos mucho. Hay muchas historias reales que han dejado marca en mi vida. Simplemente lo valiente que a veces resultan las mujeres al saltarse los limites que les ponen a lo largo de la historia.
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

It's quite a coincidence that the weekly themes of different communities share the same interests, and it's because books, movies, and life experiences often shape the path we follow. We gather in communities where we share experiences and ways of living life. For many years, I was a daily reader, but my time and desire to read have diminished. However, I visit spaces where I find valuable information and movies that summarize the content of books for me. The internet has made information much easier to access; we can read books without needing physical copies, and we enjoy them immensely. There are many true stories that have left a mark on my life. Simply put, women are sometimes incredibly brave when they break through the limits imposed on them throughout history.

**¿Cuál es un libro, vídeo de YouTube, película o lección de vida sobre el autodesarrollo que realmente le ha impactado? Podría tratarse de habilidades, dinero, propósito, relaciones, salud o crecimiento personal. Comparte lo que te enseñó y por qué lo recomendarías a otros** Esta es mi participación en la iniciativa de las damas de hive les comparto el post del concurso [Ladies of Hive Community Contest #285](https://hive.blog/hive-124452/@ladiesofhive/ladies-of-hive-community-contest-285) para que se den una vuelta y participen si así lo desean: @numa26, @alicia2022 y @purrix.
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

**What is a book, YouTube video, movie, or life lesson about self-development that has truly impacted you? It could be about skills, money, purpose, relationships, health, or personal growth. Share what it taught you and why you would recommend it to others.** This is my entry for the Ladies of Hive initiative. I'm sharing the contest post [Ladies of Hive Community Contest #285](https://hive.blog/hive-124452/@ladiesofhive/ladies-of-hive-community-contest-285) so you can check it out and participate if you'd like: @numa26, @alicia2022, and @purrix.

Hay historias, libros y películas que simplemente están en mi lista de las mejores, de las que siempre recomiendo a mis amigas, a mis alumnas. Estas lecturas e historias nos llenan de valor y al saber que son reales comprendemos el esfuerzo para romper moldes que tuvieron que utilizar nuestras damas de la historia. Para mi el libro y las diferentes versiones de series y películas de Mujercitas tienen un alto valor. Simplemente me entusiasma su fuerza para cambiar y aprender de la vida misma. Este libro contiene la historia de mujeres que se esfuerzan en una época de guerra para cambiar el mundo que les rodea. Ellas son un ejemplo de valores, unión familiar y hasta mirar las peleas entre hermanas como algo normal. Para mi es una historia que deja mucho aprendizaje para cualquier joven.
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

There are stories, books, and movies that are simply on my list of the best, the ones I always recommend to my friends and students. These readings and stories fill us with courage, and knowing they are based on real events helps us understand the effort our historical women had to make to break the mold. For me, the book and the various series and film adaptations of Little Women are incredibly valuable. I am simply inspired by their strength to change and learn from life itself. This book tells the story of women who strive during a time of war to change the world around them. They are an example of values, family unity, and even seeing squabbles between sisters as something normal. For me, it is a story that offers many lessons for any young person.

![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQFy66tVy9oLcLFT5bfhaVCxBB1gf23apX6YmXWzgQ8NS/imagen.png)
**En este momento de tu vida, ¿cuál crees que es tu principal razón para vivir? ¿Cómo describirías tu propósito en este momento y qué te mantiene avanzando cada día?** No hay mucho que buscar, para una mujer la mayoría de las veces lo que la mantiene en pie son sus hijos, su familia y ese deseo de esforzarse lo máximo para que ellos estén bien así sean una adultos con sus propias vidas. Pero que sucede con las damas que no han podido tener hijos, pues ellas se mantienen con una fe inquebrantable de siempre ser una buena mujer para su familia. Ellas valiosas representantes que siempre aportan en la comunidades donde se desenvuelven volcando todo su entusiasmo en servir a otros.
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

**At this point in your life, what do you believe is your main reason for living? How would you describe your purpose right now, and what keeps you going each day?** There's not much to look for. For a woman, most of the time what keeps her going are her children, her family, and that desire to do her best so that they are well, even when they are adults with their own lives. But what about the women who haven't been able to have children? Well, they maintain an unwavering faith in always being a good woman for their family. They are valuable representatives who always contribute to the communities where they live, pouring all their enthusiasm into serving others.

title.title: Wednesday Walk - Statue Hunting in the City
title.body:
![1000000456.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/proto26/2423srtjB4ntZwJCL7kbMEruU43P8eJjyaGeAo8H4YUmNqUQB5jCtw96H8ybZjc1jx9nV.jpg)

Happy Earth Day, people! Today I had an errand to run in a hard to reach area not too far from the center of the city. It was much more convenient to just take the bus. There weren't too many streets around where I went, so there was a great deal of walking involved. Luckily, the area was full of parks and footpaths. Along the way, I got the idea of capturing the various monuments to historical figures.


![1000000452.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/proto26/EqL9AJ6vfeG9EvVam7y7k5Ty8bEv9qR41Kkbd3ZmDGX39xd244DonkuCmbop697ujYC.jpg)

Here is a Polish war hero from revolutionary times, erected by Polish citizens in 1904. Long ago, it was located in a different neighborhood north of the city. A couple of blocks down the parkway was another Polish figure, possibly. I don't know as there seemed to be a lack of information on this one.


![1000000451.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/proto26/244KT88tKtYs1hWryUyeMyEeTwn9k7CwLCu5xUxypMgj1eeBdnaYsDFvWQWs3QzGsJNj2.jpg)

I took this photo a bit off center in an effort to make it look like the statue is staring right at you. Can you feel his piercing gaze?

At the far end of the parkway, neat the planetarium, was a figure that kept with the theme of space exploration.


![1000000458.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/proto26/242Y5pifsBq1dvykaX6uAeFyrrtbz84hA99hUEufARAtau68ghNkGTH2DmN3W74oiBaum.jpg)

It is Nicolaus Copernicus, the man who formulated the modern view of the solar system, with the sun at the center as opposed to the Earth. Even better, there is a gull perched perfectly atop his head.


![1000000453.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/proto26/23xp224UXoCt4ED93tuqnhZkNZ3FyXDyz4gGq7tuG54r192uT77HMQKhevG1cieBhkftM.jpg)

Near the natural history museum sits a watchful Olmec head replica. The actual heads were much more massive! It sits in a shaded garden area, which explains the mossy accents. I like the green color. It makes the head look like it's actually as ancient as the lost civilization itself.
Much mystery surrounds the Olmecs. They predated the Aztecs. The heads also have \

features not characteristic or usually associated with Meso-American peoples. 

Nearing the end of my journey, I came upon an interesting sculpture in a native flower garden.


![1000000454.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/proto26/23s9TQ4U4ypK6r1gejHfRzT1wiCv4Co62tDrzUmecNCcLve7381bLiH9EvM8HKPJJv9u7.jpg)

A former co-worker told me long ago that this sculpture was designed by Herb Alpert. I couldn't believe it. You mean the guy that created the songs Tijuana Taxi and The Spanish Flea? The very same. He also wrote the meme song Ladyfingers. There were a great many of these sculptures. Each one was a bit different but they were all tall. 

I thought I would find one last statue of a person near the bustling streets but was disappointed to still find it missing. It was taken down during a time of social unrest some years back. The good news is the area was fenced off while much construction equipment was hard at work. Maybe they'll bring it back soon.
I walked many miles today, more than usual. I can tell because my ankles hurt. All in all, it was a great Earth Day walk through the parks. I even saw many beautiful birds such as cardinals, red-winged blackbirds, and some less common types of sparrows. I usually find walks a bit boring. I'm more of a biker, plus there's not much to see in my neighborhood. This was a nice change of pace though. Now I think I'll read while I rest my hooves.
Thanks for stopping by!

title.title: A Pakistani Lady Director of PFA (Punjab Food Authority) Vs Billionaires
title.body:
<center>![ayesha-mumtaz.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dlmmqb/23x1BXV3ZDhYhjJRXmKZ9e3Yct9kKbEd6PjDUcU2nrjfpmES21WmU8h2hj4WsiyLSnVsj.jpeg)</center>

<center><sub>*Image: Ayesha Mumtaz inspects food during a raid on a backyard sweets factory in Lahore, Pakistan*</sub></center>

Today, I want to share a story from about ten years ago that still burns in my mind. It is about a lady who did something almost impossible in a country like Pakistan. She did not just challenge the local culture, she stood up and slapped the face of an entire corrupt system. This is a personal story for me, and it is full of grit, so grab a tea or coffee and sit with me for a moment.

I have to start with identity. Ayesha Mumtaz belongs to the \

caste. As many of you know, my full name is Muhammad Qasim Butt. In our culture, being a Butt means you love food; it is in our blood. But lately, I was talking to my father about our history. I asked him about the sacrifices our people made before the independence of Pakistan, but I told him I could not remember a modern character who truly challenged the system for a good cause. My father looked at me with a lot of passion and started naming people. When I asked if there was a woman who did this, the first name on his lips was Ayesha Mumtaz. I knew a little bit about her. People call her \

\n\nIt is hard to know exactly where to begin. My father told me things from 2016 that never even made it to the news because we share the same caste, and stories travel through families. Whether those specific stories are 100% true or just legends, I do not know, but the facts recorded in newspapers and interviews are enough to prove she was a force of nature. In 2015, when she stepped out of her car, it felt like the whole jungle was on fire. When she became the Director of the Punjab Food Authority, food safety was a joke. She made the big brands remember their \
(grandmother). I will not name every brand, but they were all playing dirty. Their hands were black with greed.\n\nShe went to the famous M.M. Alam Road in Lahore, the place for \

luxury dining, and showed the world the ugly truth behind the glitz. This was incredibly dangerous work. To give you an idea of how tense things are here, just yesterday on April 23, 2026, I saw a snatching where a middle-class electrician was killed by mobile snatchers only five minutes from my house. He gave them his phone and his money, but it was not enough for them, so they shot him. In an environment that violent and tense, \

kept exposing the food mafia one by one. Some people say the mafia won in the end, but I say she won. She gave Pakistan a ray of hope and forced the system to become stricter for years to come.\n\nOne of her quotes that always stays with me is: \

She did not just see it as a job, she saw it as a fight for our souls. She famously said she did not feel like she was in a Food Authority office, but rather in a National Geographic documentary. Why? Because she was uncovering beasts hidden in human clothing. These people were feeding us poison in the form of luxury meals, and they deserved to be called animals for what they were doing to their own people just to save a few pennies.\n\nShe was smart, too. She knew the system would try to hide her files or take bribes behind closed doors, so she used social media as her weapon. The Punjab Food Authority Facebook page blew up because she would upload everything, sometimes live. She did not care if you were a global giant like KFC or a local powerhouse. If you were feeding people filth, she would record it, upload it, and let the world see. Your \

meant nothing to her. Even today, you can see these videos being re-uploaded because even if they try to censor her, she has become a symbol that will not die.\n\nIt was not just the restaurants. She went head-to-head with the Milk Mafia, which is a level of danger most people in the world cannot imagine. In August 2016, she sealed factories that were packing expired powdered milk for families to use. This was the final straw for the people in power. The mafia and the politicians could not let their profits slip away so easily. The system eventually forced her onto a \

We all knew what that meant: it was the system's way of protecting its own greed. But Ayesha Mumtaz’s life is proof that even in a place like Pakistan, we must stand up against corporate greed and refuse to be silent consumers of poison.

**Read more about her fight here:**

[The Iron Lady's Crackdown on Lahore, herald.dawn.com](https://herald.dawn.com/news/1153374)

[When the System Pushed Back, thenews.com.pk](https://www.thenews.com.pk/print/159293-Ayesha-Mumtaz-sent-on-forced-leave)

[The Official Record of the Raids, PFA Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/PunjabFoodAuthority/)

title.title: 1 Month Claude AI - A Report... of Progress
title.body:
Hey everyone! 

My 30-day trial of the Claude Max 20x subscription, sponsored by DHF and with the kind support of @deathwing, ended today, and I’d like to share here everything I was able to accomplish over the past 30 days. The past month has been really exciting, and I’ve been able to significantly expand my knowledge of application security through the use of AI and the results generated during my sessions. 



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/louis88/23t72Xj7KbpQMumWKK7FHFMHpYmepCoVGsBHrgY3pVtRVM2CeAYurHZfhG76gcu8t2d9Y.png)
<sub>Image made in Chat GPT Image 2.0 / released roughly 24 hrs ago - context - this entire article - lol</sub>


First things first—in this report, I’ll barely touch on any details—security is always my top priority in the HIVE ecosystem, so I’m trying as much as possible not to delve too deeply into the subject… because there’s still a lot of work ahead of us. A HIVE workgroup would be helpful!

Okay, let’s get started—for some of the findings, I had to draw on my years of experience in the HIVE ecosystem, because as a security tester, you sometimes have to think outside the box to uncover additional bugs. Here’s what comes to mind today regarding each project:

---

### VSC - Magi
I reviewed the frontend and the contracts and found a few issues. I reported them to the team immediately, and they were addressed right away during the project’s development phase. The collaboration was excellent—but I don’t want to go into further detail here.

### Actifit
A frontend I don’t use very often—in fact, hardly ever—but it’s still a frontend used by some users in the Hive community. Here, I was able to uncover several XSS vulnerabilities and report a CSS injection vulnerability. The team responded immediately and fixed the bugs. I also found credentials that exposed private API keys from external services—these keys were then swapped out and are now hidden behind a .env file—the issue here was a misconfiguration of the web app. Furthermore, I was able to gain elevated privileges and leave a message in every user’s wallet as the Actifit account. Demonstrated—reported—fixed! That’s how it’s done!

Thanks for fixxing! <3

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/louis88/23t72k8pcpu9XCBpBHGvbRnQXXPebNmZXRAqjFqvZkU352MxmxoTkynbY83bMYF2zXcVN.png)


### PeakD & PeakD-Related Projects
During this period, I was able to uncover quite a few issues and report them directly to the great @asgarth. Since we’ve known and respected each other for a very long time, our collaboration has been incredibly smooth—one of the best experiences I’ve had across all my projects. On PeakD itself, I discovered a private information leak—due to an image proxy that wasn’t configured very well. I’m currently working on a specific type of prompt injection, which will likely keep me busy for a few more weeks. Furthermore, I found and reported an XSS vulnerability in one of PeakD’s projects. And to top it all off, I was able to launch a CSS injection attack—I only tested it on my own profile. It was fixed immediately! And kind words like “that people hate and love me at the same time” show me that I’m doing everything right. PeakD Love <3 <3 <3

### Ecency.com
I’ve always felt very comfortable with Ecency—over the years (and I’ve checked it time and time again), I really couldn’t find any major flaws or bugs. But my inner voice kept telling me, “There’s gotta be something.” So I just gave the Claude AI a little more Hive-related context and told it to try a bit harder ;) No sooner said than done! I found a case where a Top 50 Witness wrote something specific about their Witness, which caused the Ecency subpage displaying the Witnesses to crash. Reported—fixed! That took care of the Server Error 500 on the Witness page for the time being... but shortly after, I was able to point out even more errors in the Ecency code to the good folks at @good-karma. As a result, at least two additional XSS vulnerabilities were fixed, one of which was very deeply hidden and couldn’t really be exploited easily—but better safe than sorry, so it was fixed.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/louis88/23uQJGLSL3YaFFaW5Rk9tJg6GEeswiFdihCig8hDPwNzUTxmowfiAaaeVtnrVRkJnAYhn.png)


### Hive.Blog
I’ve already written an article about my findings and research on Hive.Blog. Long story short -> Multiple XSS vulnerabilities – Using specially crafted prompts, I was able to trick the system into thinking I had an X (Twitter) or Reddit embed that didn’t actually exist but was still rendered in the frontend. I’d also like to extend my heartfelt thanks to @gtg / @gandalf, who took my report seriously in the middle of the night and deployed the fixes directly to the frontend.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/louis88/23tRtVsQ33wZTKRnqd8SAP2NoFDtwsgJ8G5eAMTeooYxRXx67J3LyfkNKrvSj7rTf8fmS.png)

### Pevo.Science
A project by @pharesim that is currently in development, and I’m offering my help here. No significant details to share—I simply conducted and delivered a comprehensive security audit.

### Hive Engine / Tribaldex / Hive Outposts
For now, at least, I was able to report an information leak bug here, which is apparently currently being investigated. But I have a lot more to report—I have some concerns, particularly regarding the Hive Outposts (a paid feature that lets you have your own frontend for your token). I think the founder @aggroed—developers @reazuliqbal / @eonwarped—might want to get in touch with me about this.


### Inleo
(Not interested in working with me but owner are free to get in contact with me)

### Snapie
Private Information Leak - Fixxed! Thanks @meno and your AI Buddy!

### And many many more...

I was able to find all of this—and certainly a few things I’ve forgotten—in 30 days using Claude AI, and I was also able to delve deeper into it and report on it by investing a significant amount of my own time. It’s pretty obvious that the AI takes a lot of the work off my hands here—on the other hand, I spend several hours a day on it and have to incorporate the Hive Blockchain factor into the reports and, of course, test it myself—and yes, that takes time. 


---

Many of the projects mentioned above have also shown their appreciation and recognized that my time and my work in general are valuable to the Hive community. Since I don’t want to create a Hive DHF proposal for this work, I’ve set up 5 different subscriptions (basically simple recurring payments in HIVE using HBD), where project operators can show their appreciation, but also smaller plans where any Hive user can subscribe if they like what I’m doing for the blockchain.

Current status of my subscriptions compared to a DHF proposal:
At this point, the amount you’re willing to donate would be approximately $2.50 per day.

You can view my store here and subscribe if you’d like:  

#### https://peakd.com/@louis88/shop

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/louis88/23tkpWiXwRKdWd8LP62D9UyiRPkdXkQPVXfXLhWKjdrDDqui6VARaMUa4kMTZZCXekSZT.png)


---

## Keep Going!

Of course, I don’t want to stop—I’ve gotten a taste for it—and I’d like to request additional funding for a Claude subscription. But I’d like to try out whether 3 months of Claude 5x might be better for me than 1 month of Claude 20x, since I usually work in bursts and don’t always have the AI running 24/7—after all, a human still has to check what comes out of it—and there’s real life to consider too ;)

So @deathwing, I’d like to try out whether a 5x plan might be more cost-effective. If you have any questions—you know where to reach me.

### Thanks Community!

I would like to thank those with whom I have worked closely over the past 30 days:

@asgarth, @gtg / @gandalf, @blocktrades, @pharesim, @howo, @guiltyparties, @meno, @themarkymark, the entire @worldmappin team, @lordbutterfly and the Magi Team, @stoodkev @sagarkothari88 @forykw @tibfox @mcfarhat @actifit @good-karma / @ecency @rishi556 and a bunch of more! 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/louis88/23tGTh9VDS337t4wiN3FYq19UH71Prf2tTY84SiuWjqUKbvzaoaE1RB3rizLkhofqjCgs.png)

# 🔐 Cyber Security Daily News | 23.04.2026

Codzienny przegląd ciekawszych wiadomości ze świata cyberbezpieczeństwa, do poczytania przy porannej kawie, podzielony na kluczowe kategorie.

![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23u5bgKsdR5buiXhJ6d863bC6SvAuzdqq2hoVmdNr67xwGhSVoV5shWk57EkyQyz1Xi3r.jpg)

-----

## 1. 📰 NEWS

### ***Claude Mythos wykrył 271 podatności w Firefox — Mozilla mówi o przełomie w bezpieczeństwie oprogramowania***

Mozilla Foundation przetestowała model Claude Mythos od Anthropic na kodzie przeglądarki Firefox i wyniki były spektakularne: model zidentyfikował 271 podatności bezpieczeństwa w wersji Firefox 150 — dla porównania, skan Opus 4.6 wcześniej znalazł 22 błędy, które naprawiono już w wersji 148. CTO Firefoksa Bobby Holley napisał wprost, że jeszcze w 2025 roku jeden taki błąd w zahartowanym produkcie byłby „alarmem najwyższego stopnia\

***

Podczas dorocznej konferencji CYBERUK (22 kwietnia) brytyjski minister ds. bezpieczeństwa Dan Jarvis ogłosił pakiet 90 milionów funtów na wzmocnienie odporności cybernetycznej Wielkiej Brytanii — ze szczególnym naciskiem na wsparcie małych i średnich firm. Jednocześnie rząd apeluje do dużych organizacji o podpisanie nowego Cyber Resilience Pledge — zobowiązania obejmującego trzy konkretne działania: uczynienie cyberbezpieczeństwa odpowiedzialnością zarządu, zapisanie się do bezpłatnej usługi wczesnego ostrzegania NCSC i wymaganie certyfikacji Cyber Essentials od dostawców. Liczba kwartalnych certyfikatów Cyber Essentials po raz pierwszy przekroczyła 10 000 w 2025 roku, a w ostatnim roku podatkowym wzrosła o ok. 20%. Eksperci branżowi oceniają inicjatywę pozytywnie, choć wskazują, że sama kwota jest niewystarczająca wobec skali zagrożeń.

https://assets.infosecurity-magazine.com/webpage/feat/ef8caa55-2f2e-491e-a3d1-3cf2a3872e42.jpg

*Źródło: [Infosecurity Magazine](https://www.infosecurity-magazine.com/news/uk-pledges-90m-for-cybersecurity/) [EN]*

---

## 2. 🚨 INCYDENTY

### ***Cyberatak na sklep Kodano — hakerzy wykradli dane klientów polskiego sklepu z okularami***

Kodano — popularny polski sklep internetowy z okularami, soczewkami i akcesoriami optycznymi — padł ofiarą cyberataku, w wyniku którego hakerzy uzyskali dostęp do danych osobowych klientów. Sklep obsługuje setki tysięcy klientów w Polsce i kilku krajach europejskich. Szczegółowy zakres wycieku jest wyjaśniany, ale potwierdzono nieuprawniony dostęp do bazy danych zawierającej dane zakupowe i kontaktowe. Osoby, które robiły zakupy w Kodano, powinny zachować czujność wobec e-maili i SMS-ów podszywających się pod sklep lub firmy kurierskie dostarczające zamówienia — dane o historii zakupów pozwalają tworzyć bardzo wiarygodne kampanie phishingowe.

![screenshot-www.tabletowo.pl-2026.04.22-20_59_54.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23sxnGdxoCnrXSMrbUE7CuLLbZfPDzArAtV1q881ueWFh9jbj5n49X4foRwGiRsd6bNxn.png)

*Źródło: [Tabletowo.pl](https://www.tabletowo.pl/atak-hakerski-na-sklep-kodano-dane-klientow/) [PL]*

---

### ***Lotus Wiper niszczy systemy energetyczne Wenezueli — malware destrukcyjny z regionu Bliskiego Wschodu***

The Hacker News i Security Affairs opisują kampanię złośliwego oprogramowania Lotus Wiper wymierzoną w sektor energetyczny Wenezueli. Wiper to szczególna klasa malware — zamiast szyfrować dane i żądać okupu jak ransomware, po prostu je kasuje. Jest to klasyczna „cyberbroń\

— analogicznego do LOTL (Living Off the Land), tylko w wersji chmurowej.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23tGTsDLiSQYc4KYq8DEgRekEWh1ge5MphTgFjNuGdyDokgCd1fnVJT9ngbFybP8pZQUD.png)

*Źródło: [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/04/harvester-deploys-linux-gogra-backdoor.html) [EN]*

---

## 4. 🎣 OSZUSTWA, SCAMY, EXPLOITY

### ***CERT Polska: kampania phishingowa podszywa się pod home.pl i innych hostingodawców***

CERT Polska ostrzega przed aktywną kampanią phishingową wymierzoną w właścicieli stron internetowych i firm. Atakujący podszywają się pod hosting home.pl (i prawdopodobnie innych dostawców hostingu) i wysyłają wiadomości z linkiem prowadzącym do fałszywego panelu logowania hostingodawcy — zbierając dane dostępowe do kont administracyjnych. Przejęcie dostępu do panelu hostingowego to bardzo poważny incydent: pozwala atakującym podmienić zawartość strony, zainstalować złośliwy kod na witrynie (infekując odwiedzających), wykraść bazy danych lub przekierować domenę. Właściciele stron i administratorzy IT powinni sprawdzić adres URL przed każdym logowaniem do panelu hostingowego i włączyć uwierzytelnianie dwuskładnikowe na wszystkich kontach administracyjnych.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23xViRxLCoTHuXpuYTyPxQtFnX5oetRff6xPTPSoiBcVuURNozYggqu3abaiQB3hcpa3N.png)

*Źródło: [CERT Polska](https://moje.cert.pl/komunikaty/2026/51/masz-strone-internetowa-oszusci-podszywaja-sie-pod-hostingodawcow/) [PL]*

---

### ***Fałszywa strona tradingowa instaluje malware przejmujący przeglądarkę przez skrypt Python***

Malwarebytes opisuje kampanię wymierzoną w inwestorów i traderów kryptowalutowych: fałszywe strony imitujące profesjonalne platformy handlowe nakłaniają użytkownika do pobrania „desktopowej wersji\

znalezionej przez reklamę lub link z zewnętrznego forum.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23tcPAu8nccJCQGwmKc1nY5qCtUvWAoJwszB3VYF4hCq6qgwZc5orYduxpCQnGK8jMQuH.png)

*Źródło: [Malwarebytes](https://www.malwarebytes.com/blog/threat-intel/2026/04/malicious-trading-website-drop-malware-that-hands-over-your-browser-to-attackers) [EN]*

body.title: Elaborando y degustando  exquisita combinación de: Sopa de  arroz con vegetales, picadillo de pollo; boniatos hervidos y postre de calabaza.(Esp/Eng)
body.body:
# Español 
# Saludos amigos amantes de la comida 💁☀️
¡Feliz día para todos!
Les ha sucedido amigos, que en ocasiones repentinamente  les ha apetecido tomarse una sopa caliente, pues resulta, que esta sensación de degustar algo ligero fue la que me acompañó en el despertar del día de hoy,  así,  que  queriendo saciar mi antojo alimenticio, me puse manos a la obra y elaboré un menú compuesto de: Sopa de arroz con vegetales, picadillo de pollo, boniatos hervidos y  postre de calabaza. Los invito amigos, a que me acompañen a conocer las recetas que empleé para este ligero, pero sabroso almuerzo  familiar.¡Comencemos!
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260421_203645579.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23u6FdnyjFnU9big6yAKWpw7QTqpwvQnfg98sDsKGZzVVa4YGghhWnvNyHkU7bT9ZiUoQ.jpg)
</center>
#
# ✨Ingredientes generales del menú para tres comensales✨ 
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260421_204404452.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23wgW3erA3gY41aGXXeEWGXaaeeh4dXyRktRh7dfy8hztrHwRewu5Uvk3Un82be7JSRkW.jpg)
</center>
#
# Sopa 
.Especias: 2 pimientos grandes, 6 dientes de ajo, 1/4 de cucharada de comino.
.Arroz 1 taza 
.Calabaza: 2 libras
.Boniatos: 1 unidad grande 
.Picadillo de pollo 1/2 libra
.Aceite de Soja 3 cucharadas 
.Pasta de tomate: 2 cucharadas 
.Vinagre, opcional: 1 cucharada 
.Sal a gusto:  1/2 cucharada 
.Agua: 3 tazas para la sopa, y suficiente para el proceso de lavado y preparado de los alimentos.
# Postre de calabaza 
.Calabaza: 3 libras
.Azúcar: 6 cucharadas
.Vainilla: 1/3 de cucharada 
.Leche en polvo 1 cucharada 
.Agua 1 taza para la mezcla, y suficiente para el proceso de lavado.

# ✨Modo de confección✨ 
El primer alimento que elaboré  fue la sopa.
# ✨Sopa mixta de: arroz, vegetales y picadillo de pollo.

Inicié el proceder preparando todos los ingredientes a emplear de la siguiente forma: Lavé las especias, las despojé de sus partes no comestibles y las corté en trocitos con ayuda de un cuchillo. Lavé la calabaza, le extraje las semillas adheridas en su interior, y las corté en cuadraditos pequeños. Medí la taza de arroz, la revisé y la lavé. Corté el picadillo de pollo en trozos pequeños.
Ya teniendo todos los ingredientes listos, proseguí con la cocción de la sopa:
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260421_204710767.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23w2wooL9HfMrbeTVB86sN1Abw6ah5WxbzJFjnoW4trMrP2HbAAxqFdrKnGUJULPPgMDq.jpg)
</center>
#
Incorporé en una olla: las especias, 3 cucharadas de aceite de Soja, 2 cucharadas de pasta de tomate, y comencé a realizar un pequeño sofrito  por 1 minuto. Seguidamente, agregué al sofrito, el arroz, la calabaza, el picadillo, y continué salteándolo  por unos segundos más.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260421_211101169.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23w2sdnEe341KLxT9T7Qrf6rJxwNz2vXnSqNdXc1BgYzBZrpoSjd4wndSiRZrnYPRDdbM.jpg)
</center>
#
Luego, agregué al compuesto: 3 tazas de agua, 1/2 cucharada de sal, 1 cucharada de vinagre, tapé la olla, y la puse a presión por 10 minutos.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260421_211209048.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23z7L9egEggMGyrhxmZwdZn1rKn4Hp6JNcUuqnyWR8pRNwLUpkWS2JjbvbHJsRBd9XbdN.jpg)
</center>
#
Con una vista espectacular y con un aroma delicioso, quedó esta saludable sopa que incitaba a su consumo.
Para complementar la sopa mixta realicé unos boniatos hervidos, pues me encanta el toque dulce que le aportan al caldo.

# ✨Boniatos hervidos✨
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260421_211823967.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23y96grvib2ki2eyTny2Fv6LoZ1jUBBWEnpJ31aWPrRdCnQASv3hMb183WSRUbxATpEA3.jpg)
</center>
#
Inicié la cocción del boniato de la siguiente forma: Tomé un boniato grande, lo lavé, lo pelé, lo corté en trozos medianos, y lo puse a hervir en un recipiente con:agua que los cubriera, 1/3 de cucharada de sal,1 cucharada de azúcar, por 15 minutos. Transcurrido el tiempo, los  extraje del agua para un plato donde los impregné de 1 cucharada de aceite de Soja, un puntico de sal y 2 dientes de ajo triturado.¡Divinos, combinaron perfectamente con la sopa!
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260422_102949610.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23ywuigsdbUyvmvWdXYysJy2kpP8rGwuULw9RXscQKBx2u7sZrzwzAvuDfKpXVpd6zPoz.jpg)
</center>
#
Amigos, la calabaza, es un vegetal que me encanta,y en este mes, al encontrarse en todo su apogeo, he querido aprovechar a deleitarla y la he incluido en mis menuses diarios. Hoy, aparte de utilizarla como uno de los ingredientes claves  de la sopa,la quise utilizar para elaborar el postre.

# ✨Postre  de calabaza ✨
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260422_103215643.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23wCLPoDHtzLPXXhnMZfN7qeo8UfFWLymjpnYY9b2TaGw2HyajFLVxh7peBgLmFhv1Zkk.jpg)
</center>
#
Inicié el proceder tomando 2 libras de calabaza sin semillas adheridas, lavándolas, cortándolas. Seguidamente,las puse a hervir en un recipiente con agua y un puntico de sal, por 15 minutos. Transcurrido el tiempo, las saqué para un recipiente, dónde las separé de su cáscara. Luego, tomé la masa de la calabaza y la vertí en la batidora junto a 6 cucharadas de azúcar, 1 cucharada de leche en polvo,1 taza de agua,1/3 de cucharada de vainilla. Batí este compuesto por unos segundos, y seguidamente, lo ingresé en una olla, dónde lo herví por 10 minutos, hasta que su consistencia se volvió densa.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260422_103408933.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/242YBvekwdXw9dAPP4PA98nrDcosUg1R2BEbjx2RThq1JBSGWmkQp1QPfXniM8LcQArGY.jpg)
</center>
#
Tanto frío como caliente  me gusta consumir este postre majestuoso, que resalta por su  textura cremosa y sabrosa.
En el   día de hoy, suplí todas mis expectativas degustativas al saciar mi antojo y  generarle a mi familia una novedosa degustación cargada de sabores variados. Espero amigos, que les haya gustado las recetas del menú, y que se anímen a elaborarlas para sus almuerzos familiares, ó cuando los invadan  esos antojitos de: caldo, sopas, dulces. Les deseo a  todos vibras positivas y una excelente semana.¡Abrazos!
Fotografías propias.
*** 
*** 
# English
# Making and tasting exquisite combination of: Rice soup with vegetables, chicken mince; boiled sweet potatoes and pumpkin dessert.

# Greetings fellow foodies 💁☀️
Happy day to everyone!
It has happened to friends, that sometimes suddenly they have felt like having a hot soup, because it turns out, that this feeling of tasting something light was the one that accompanied me in waking up today, so, wanting to satisfy my food craving, I got down to work and prepared a menu composed of: Rice soup with vegetables, chicken mince, boiled sweet potatoes and pumpkin dessert. I invite you friends, to join me to know the recipes I used for this light, but tasty family lunch.Let's get started!
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260421_203645579.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23u6FdnyjFnU9big6yAKWpw7QTqpwvQnfg98sDsKGZzVVa4YGghhWnvNyHkU7bT9ZiUoQ.jpg)
</center>
#
# ✨General menu ingredients for three people✨ 
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260421_204404452.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23wgW3erA3gY41aGXXeEWGXaaeeh4dXyRktRh7dfy8hztrHwRewu5Uvk3Un82be7JSRkW.jpg)
</center>
#
# Soup 
.Spices: 2 large peppers, 6 cloves of garlic, 1/4 tablespoon of cumin.
.Rice 1 cup 
.Pumpkin: 2 pounds
.Sweet potatoes: 1 large unit 
.1/2 pound chicken mince
.Soy oil 3 tablespoons 
.Tomato paste: 2 tablespoons 
.Vinegar, optional: 1 tablespoon 
.Salt to taste: 1/2 tablespoon 
.Water: 3 cups for the soup, and enough for the process of washing and preparing food.
# Pumpkin dessert 
.Pumpkin: 3 pounds
.Sugar: 6 tablespoons
.Vanilla: 1/3 of a tablespoon 
.Powdered milk 1 tablespoon 
.Water 1 cup for mixing, and enough for the washing process.

# ✨Mode of preparation✨ 
The first food I made was soup.
# ✨Mixed soup of: rice, vegetables and chicken mince.
I started the procedure by preparing all the ingredients to be used as follows: I washed the spices, stripped them of their inedible parts and cut them into small pieces with the help of a knife.I washed the pumpkin, extracted the seeds stuck inside, and cut them into small squares.I measured the rice cup, checked it and washed it.I cut the chicken mince into small pieces.
Having all the ingredients ready, I continued with the cooking of the soup:
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260421_204710767.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23w2wooL9HfMrbeTVB86sN1Abw6ah5WxbzJFjnoW4trMrP2HbAAxqFdrKnGUJULPPgMDq.jpg)
</center>
#
I incorporated in a pot: the spices, 3 tablespoons of soybean oil, 2 tablespoons of tomato paste, and I started to make a small stir-fry for 1 minute. Next, I added the rice, the pumpkin, the minced meat to the sofrito, and continued to sauté it for a few more seconds.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260421_211101169.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23w2sdnEe341KLxT9T7Qrf6rJxwNz2vXnSqNdXc1BgYzBZrpoSjd4wndSiRZrnYPRDdbM.jpg)
</center>
#
Then, I added to the compound: 3 cups of water, 1/2 tablespoon of salt, 1 tablespoon of vinegar, covered the pot, and put it on pressure for 10 minutes.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260421_211209048.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23z7L9egEggMGyrhxmZwdZn1rKn4Hp6JNcUuqnyWR8pRNwLUpkWS2JjbvbHJsRBd9XbdN.jpg)
</center>
#
With a spectacular view and a delicious aroma, this healthy soup remained that incited its consumption.
To complement the mixed soup I made some boiled sweet potatoes, because I love the sweet touch they bring to the broth.

# ✨Boiled sweet potatoes✨
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260421_211823967.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23y96grvib2ki2eyTny2Fv6LoZ1jUBBWEnpJ31aWPrRdCnQASv3hMb183WSRUbxATpEA3.jpg)
</center>
#
I started the cooking of the sweet potato as follows: I took a large sweet potato, washed it, peeled it, cut it into medium pieces, and put it to boil in a container with: water to cover them, 1/3 tablespoon of salt, 1 tablespoon of sugar, for 15 minutes.After a while, I extracted them from the water for a dish where I impregnated them with 1 tablespoon of soybean oil, a pinch of salt and 2 cloves of crushed garlic.Divine, they went perfectly with the soup!
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260422_102949610.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23ywuigsdbUyvmvWdXYysJy2kpP8rGwuULw9RXscQKBx2u7sZrzwzAvuDfKpXVpd6zPoz.jpg)
</center>
#
Friends, pumpkin is a vegetable that I love, and this month, being in full swing, I wanted to take the opportunity to delight it and I have included it in my daily menus.Today, apart from using it as one of the key ingredients of the soup, I wanted to use it to make the dessert.

# ✨Pumpkin dessert ✨
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260422_103215643.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23wCLPoDHtzLPXXhnMZfN7qeo8UfFWLymjpnYY9b2TaGw2HyajFLVxh7peBgLmFhv1Zkk.jpg)
</center>
#
I started the procedure by taking 2 pounds of pumpkin without seeds attached, washing them, cutting them. Then, I put them to boil in a container with water and a pinch of salt, for 15 minutes.After the time was up, I took them out for a container, where I separated them from their shell. Then, I took the pumpkin dough and poured it into the blender along with 6 tablespoons of sugar, 1 tablespoon of powdered milk, 1 cup of water, 1/3 tablespoon of vanilla. I beat this compound for a few seconds, and then, I put it in a pot, where I boiled it for 10 minutes, until its consistency became dense.
#

body.body:
Ahh, that is beautiful. Some areas remind me a lot of my hometown in the Philippines: buffaloes, horses, cats, dogs, birds, fields, and mountains. I used to love drinking coffee early in the morning outdoors while a buffalo and its owner passed by pulling a cart to pick up sacks of rice. They would normally stop for a few minutes to chat. By the time my coffee was finished, a vendor would pass by selling either rice cakes or tofu in honey. Before midday, fish vendors would pass by, and the fish were still alive, so there was no need to go to the market.
Then, after lunch, a dirty ice cream vendor would pass by. I used to time them so I could wave my hand and have my coins ready in my pocket. Sometimes they were fast, and I had to run after them barefoot because I didn’t have time to put my slippers on. Who would want to miss the ice cream!

Thank you for your lovely photography; it reminds me of home. Enjoy your stay! :)

body.title: Minestrone de arvejas enlatadas / Minestrone with Canned Peas
body.body:
<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmWCGzmhwRRmD3DTTSAzZEyc2V7EASmNfk64iwJwyM734K/minestrone_de_arvejas.png</center>

Se vienen los días fríos en Argentina, que son ideales para esas comidas un poco pesadas de procesar, pues así ayudamos al cuerpo a quemar energías que nos mantengan calentitos la mayor parte del tiempo. Y qué mejor forma que cocinando granos, los cuales además aportan proteína vegetal, por eso aproveché que el día estaba frío y lluvioso para preparar este minestrone a mi manera con arvejas enlatadas.

Como a mi hijo menor le dan una caja de alimentos mensual en la que van incluidas latas de arvejas o lentejas, tengo muchas en la alacena, tantas, que a veces termino regalando porque casi nunca las consumimos, ya que los granos no son muy bien recibidos por mis hijos. Así que me puse manos a la obra, y me inventé este minestrone con lo que tenía en la nevera.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmb3ATb7PyjuDXM5qSiQUan6hLVpNH37fh8b6zLr8Wz7ck/5136778700337646929.jpg</center>

# Ingredientes:

*2 latas de arvejas

*2 tazas de arroz
*2 papas
*6 salchichas pequeñas
*Sal al gusto
*1/2 litro de agua

# Preparación:

Como tenía una taza de arroz que había quedado de una comida anterior, preparé solo una taza de la manera tradicional (2 tazas de agua por una de arroz). Cuando estaba casi listo, agregué las salchichas cortadas en pedazos pequeños (puede ser también tocineta o chorizo colorado que le da un sabor delicioso) y cuando estaba a punto de secarse el agua, agregué las dos latas de arvejas, a las que les retiré previamente el agua que traen.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmYM9gNUDHcX2kSsH8gft1e9MPcfBXDBw9AiGDJxMfBxFR/minestrone_de_arvejas_1_.png</center>

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmVZXoCj93U8odhcvpzUijjEPuiq2SXLQQEWfQ89HddJar/5136778700337646931.jpg</center>

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmUBquTFjX1StxEzoo87uW1inHV8Q1iouL8NkgBdjBVcCn/5136778700337646933.jpg</center>

Bajé el fuego al mínimo, ya que las arvejas vienen precocidas, y procedí a incorporar las papas cortadas en cubos y el medio litro de agua. En este paso, agregué la sal y removí para incorporar todo.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmaR9vUJvce5JknVF4hRxKuMTebJbHcUT4S1yaFDeZejFp/5136778700337646934.jpg</center>

Cuando las papas estaban un poco blandas, agregué la taza de arroz que ya estaba lista. Removí y condimenté con un poco de picante en polvo, para darle un toque extra de sabor. Apagué el fuego y tapé por 5 minutos para que los sabores se asentaran.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmPdUVeYdYbejYBye7z1fnKgiy3i3aJkzYA4wYesqJd9pH/5136778700337646935.jpg</center>

Serví en platitos pequeños, para evitar las quejas de mis hijos diciendo que era mucho, aunque al probarlo las quejas cesaron y disfrutaron de la comida, por lo que fue una excelente experiencia para los tres.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmaJrw7GZyYQBGpcAYMThqcxUReuGXVepdniHHMa38V9Pz/5136778700337646941.jpg</center>

Lo mejor es que rindió para 5 porciones, por lo que quedó para congelar, y tener lista una comida para otro día.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmcMNxZLX3nyQd4z3z36B8GmMQ8e8PN44qLnocC8hsWu8u/separador_ingles.png</center>

The cold days are coming in Argentina, which are ideal for those meals that are a bit heavy to digest, as this helps the body burn energy to keep us warm most of the time. And what better way than by cooking pulses, which also provide plant-based protein? That’s why I took advantage of the cold, rainy day to make this minestrone my way, using tinned peas.

As my youngest son receives a monthly food box that includes tins of peas or lentils, I have plenty in the cupboard – so many, in fact, that I sometimes end up giving them away because we hardly ever eat them, as my children aren’t particularly keen on pulses. So I got down to work and came up with this minestrone using what I had in the fridge.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmb3ATb7PyjuDXM5qSiQUan6hLVpNH37fh8b6zLr8Wz7ck/5136778700337646929.jpg</center>

# Ingredients:  
*2 tins of peas  
*2 cups of rice  
*2 potatoes  
*6 small sausages  
*Salt to taste  
*1/2 litre of water

# Method:

As I had a cup of rice left over from a previous meal, I cooked just one cup in the traditional way (2 cups of water to one cup of rice). When it was almost ready, I added the sausages, cut into small pieces (you could also use bacon or red chorizo, which gives it a delicious flavour), and just as the water was about to dry up, I added the two tins of peas, having first drained off the liquid they come in.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmYM9gNUDHcX2kSsH8gft1e9MPcfBXDBw9AiGDJxMfBxFR/minestrone_de_arvejas_1_.png</center>

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmVZXoCj93U8odhcvpzUijjEPuiq2SXLQQEWfQ89HddJar/5136778700337646931.jpg</center>

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmUBquTFjX1StxEzoo87uW1inHV8Q1iouL8NkgBdjBVcCn/5136778700337646933.jpg</center>

I turned the heat down to low, as the peas are pre-cooked, and added the diced potatoes and half a litre of water. At this stage, I added the salt and stirred to combine everything.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmaR9vUJvce5JknVF4hRxKuMTebJbHcUT4S1yaFDeZejFp/5136778700337646934.jpg</center>

When the potatoes were slightly tender, I added the cup of rice that was already cooked. I stirred and seasoned with a little chilli powder to give it an extra touch of flavour. I turned off the heat and covered the pan for 5 minutes to allow the flavours to settle.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmPdUVeYdYbejYBye7z1fnKgiy3i3aJkzYA4wYesqJd9pH/5136778700337646935.jpg</center>

I served it in small bowls to avoid my children complaining that it was too much, although once they tasted it, the complaints stopped and they enjoyed the meal, so it was an excellent experience for all three of us.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmaJrw7GZyYQBGpcAYMThqcxUReuGXVepdniHHMa38V9Pz/5136778700337646941.jpg</center>

The best thing is that it made five portions, so I had some left over to freeze, meaning I have a meal ready for another day.

***

body.title: Baking small marbled biscuits - Horneando pequeños Biscochos Marmoleados.
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbwLGfLvW7j6MoFEqR3Xmyx6RAW4fanYEoCtumu8CFjxX/image.png)

**Hello everyone, I hope you’re all doing well. I’m delighted to share with you my quick and delicious recipe for some little biscuits I made at home to give us a week full of chocolate and vanilla flavour. I hope you like them!**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWkN1KPpEySj6jGcLVjnh5V8MuBPimL3a9wzNHdaz2Hfp/image.png)

I beat the sugar with three tablespoons of butter, then added two eggs and beat again!

**2**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY7KpdJktkshkzqpUiFGE5zn8CuF8tj14fA1wEMcEXscf/image.png)
Then, in a separate blender, I blended 200 ml of water and powdered milk with a tablespoon of vanilla. I then alternately mixed in the wheat flour and the vanilla-flavoured milk mixture. 

**3**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmapa2om3ZScjTyrX95DieDDYtqYYjaxBayqrP9zjHsR1g/image.png)


In a separate bowl, I added half of the mixture, then added 25 g of cocoa and just a little liquid to make it easier to whisk. 
**4**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbxPqkQJkouU6WmJVYfkaoQkvUxpEbuUKTFFDRknB7sak/image.png)

Then we need to add the vanilla mixture and the chocolate mixture in layers to achieve the marbled effect. I hope you like it!


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbwLGfLvW7j6MoFEqR3Xmyx6RAW4fanYEoCtumu8CFjxX/image.png)

**Best wishes and thank you very much for reading. I couldn’t take the final photo because the power had gone out and I didn’t have a flash to take the picture, and by the time the electricity came back on, there was no cake left as we’d had visitors a few minutes earlier. But I can assure you that everything turned out very well and it was delicious. Best wishes and thank you very much for stopping by to read!**


***
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbwLGfLvW7j6MoFEqR3Xmyx6RAW4fanYEoCtumu8CFjxX/image.png)

Hola amigos, espero que se encentren muy bien, estoy feliz de poder mostrarles mi proceso super rapido y delicioso de unos pequeños biscochos que hice en la casa para darnos una semana llena de sabor a chocolate y vainilla. Espero que les guste!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWkN1KPpEySj6jGcLVjnh5V8MuBPimL3a9wzNHdaz2Hfp/image.png)

Batimos el azucar con tres cucharadas de mantequilla y lego agregué dos huevos y bati nuevamente!

**2**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY7KpdJktkshkzqpUiFGE5zn8CuF8tj14fA1wEMcEXscf/image.png)
Luego en una licuadora a parte licué 200 l de agua y leche en polvo con una cucharada de vainilla. Luego de forma alternada fui mezclando la harina de trigo y el liquido de la leche con sabor a vainilla. 

**3**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmapa2om3ZScjTyrX95DieDDYtqYYjaxBayqrP9zjHsR1g/image.png)


En un bol aparte agregue la mitad de la mezcla y luego añadí 25 gr de cacao y solo un poco de liquido para batir cómodamente. 
**4**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbxPqkQJkouU6WmJVYfkaoQkvUxpEbuUKTFFDRknB7sak/image.png)

Luego debemos ir añadiendo en forma de capas la mezcla de vainilla y la mezcla de chocolate para lograr el efecto de marmoleado. Espero que les guste!


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbwLGfLvW7j6MoFEqR3Xmyx6RAW4fanYEoCtumu8CFjxX/image.png)

**Saludos y muchas gracias por su atención. No pude tomar la foto final porque la luz se habia ido y no tenia flash para tomar la foto, y cuando la energia electica regresó ya no habia biscocho ya que unos minutos antes teníamos visita. Pero les doy la garantia que todo salió muy bien y que quedo delicioso. Saludos y muchas gracias por pasar a leer!**

body.title: Introducing Hive Open Market / Hive Open Marketのご紹介(ENG/JPN)
body.body:
<center>
![hive20260423.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yadamaniart/241QR5LYtWSL4hYVNhzJis6J5QUyYux98aowuazovXmJG42jh7eHfHtpDs8XALmMEUZje.jpg)
</center>

(ENG)
Yesterday, I discovered that PeakD has something called the Hive Open Market.
It seems to have launched in December 2025, so some of you may already be aware of it.
(I was actually bedridden with an illness at the time.)
This has me wondering whether I should list something there or not.

The URL is https://peakd.com/shop so if you’re interested?whether you want to sell or buy?why not take a look?

Apparently, this is a subscription service that’s part of our ongoing effort to provide even more attractive features to the Hive community and bring innovative projects to PeakD.

Since this initial subscription is primarily a live test and proof of concept (PoC) to demonstrate the system’s functionality, the fee is set to be very low?just 0.1 HBD (about 1 HIVE) per month.

Active subscribers will receive various benefits, such as increased image storage and access to new free AI image models.

Looking at the Market, I see that in addition to digital products, there are also analog paintings and handmade items listed.

I’m thinking I might try listing something myself. However, it will take a few days to create a new piece, and I need to check my inventory, so I hope to list something in a few days.

The issue, of course, is that while creator participation is essential, I’m not sure if many customers will come to browse and actually buy the products.

Also, since I plan to list small analog paintings, I’ll need buyers to cover the shipping costs for international orders. Still, I’d like to set the price so that it doesn’t end up being too expensive even with shipping included.

That said, PeakD’s efforts are truly impressive. I’m very grateful.

-----------------------------------------------

(JPN)
PeakDに、Hive Open Marketというのがあるのを昨日見つけました。
2025年12月から始まっているようなので、既にご存じの方もいるかもしれません。
（私は体調が悪く寝込んでいた時でしたね）
これは、出品しようかな、どうしようかな、と考えてしまいます。

URLは　https://peakd.com/shop　ですので、興味のある人は、売りたい人も買いたい人も、一度覗いてみてはいかがでしょうか。

これはHiveコミュニティにさらに魅力的な機能を提供し、PeakDに革新的なプロジェクトを取り入れていくという私たちの継続的な取り組みの一環としてのサブスクリプションサービスだそうです。

この最初のサブスクリプションは、主にシステムの機能性を実証するためのライブテストおよび概念実証（PoC）であるため、ごく少額のものになるようです。月額わずか0.1 HBD（約1 HIVE）に設定されています。

アクティブな購読者の特典として、画像ストレージの増量、新しい無料AI画像モデルなど色々あるようです。

Marketを見てみると、デジタルの商品のほかに、アナログの絵やハンドメイド品なども並んでいます。

やっぱり出してみようかなと思っています。ただ、今から描くのは数日かかるし、在庫も確認しなければならないので、まあ数日後には出品したいなと思っています。

問題は、やっぱりクリエイターの参加も必要ですが、商品を買ってくれる、お客さんがたくさん見に来てくれるかどうかです。

あと、私は小さなアナログ絵画を出すつもりなので、日本国外へ発送するには送料を負担してもらわなければなりません。まあ、送料込みでそんなに高くならないような価格設定にしたいとは思います。

それにしてもPeakDの頑張りはすごいです。感謝しています。

body.title: Some of my favorite recent and varied skins in Call of Duty Mobile.
body.body:
>  

Hey everyone, since a new season and update for Call of Duty Mobile are coming out in a few days, I took the opportunity to look through my character skins, which I have to say are a lot. This is because I started playing the game almost from the beginning, and also because each season usually releases between 3 and 5 skins, mostly through free events and missions that come out as the season progresses, so there's usually a lot of variety to choose from. Even so, while I admit I have many, some are more meaningful than others, whether because of the effort I put into getting them, their epic status related to a particular event, or because they remind me of something specific. So, I wanted to take this opportunity to show you some of my favorite skins.

>Hola a todos, como ya en unos días se viene nueva temporada y actualización en el Call of Duty Mobile, aproveché para revisar un poco de mis skins de personajes, que debo decir que son un montón. Esto porque comencé a jugar el juego casi en sus inicios y también que por temporadas se suelen dar entre 3 y 5 skins, esto más que todo en eventos gratuitos y misiones que van saliendo a medida que pasa y, por ende, suele existir mucha variedad para elegir. Aun así, aunque admito que tengo muchas, algunas son más significativas que otras, ya sea por el hecho del esfuerzo en conseguirlas, las épicas con relación a algún evento que surgió o porque hacen que recuerde algo en específico. Por ende, quise aprovechar para mostrarles algunas de mis skins que más me gustan.

<hr></hr>
<center>
https://images.ecency.com/DQmRp1sRZh8W7zZ7YG1ztthKFKbELCXqgrVi1UXEgnfkehk/1776894751442.jpg
</center>

<center>
https://images.ecency.com/DQmSkdb6EPesQdkqh9rLE62fYdQdtEqFAvsxXeHhuw9Afcr/1776894777878.jpg
</center>

<center>
https://images.ecency.com/DQmcNyac1W7BSY9aDVCMNgYirhySGzFY2JRVLnSk5qvY4pF/1776894795912.jpg
</center>
<hr></hr>



While it's true I don't change skins often, the game itself offers the option in its four game modes—Battle Royale, RECOM, 5 vs. 5, and Zombies—to set both the weaponry and the skin we'll use for that mode. There are up to nine different skins for each customization, so we could, just for fun, assign a character to each weapon we want to use. I've even done this myself, but one thing is certain: no matter how much I organize it, I'll always end up with only one choice per mode (only changing when using a sniper rifle).

>Y es que, si bien es cierto que no soy de cambiar skins seguido, el mismo juego ofrece en sus 4 modos de juego, que son el battle royale. RECOM, 5 vs. 5 y el modo zombies: la opción de establecer tanto el armamento destinado y personalizado para esa modalidad como también la skin que usaremos, esto para cada personalización que llega a ser hasta 9 distintas, por lo que en sí podemos por simple ocio llegar a establecer un personaje para cada arma que queramos utilizar y en parte lo he llegado a hacer por mero gusto, pero sí es cierto una cosa y es que, por más que organice así, a la final siempre tendré una sola elección por modalidad (cambiando solo cuando se trata de usar francotirador). 


<hr></hr>

<center>
https://images.ecency.com/DQmTMsBfYy3hvxc9rY6Ygc48F4jRC4q2wVKzwDmZ4hWBFCs/1776895214146.jpg
</center>

<center>
https://images.ecency.com/DQmZQGnH1F3bmYZNHKqcCBQdBTGiFQasFsMpAmHwco8G6sU/1776895341169.jpg
</center>

<hr></hr>


Now, among the various skins, these variants of the same style, such as those representing the well-known character Ghost, of which I have 3 variants, two acquired in special events and another in one of the battle passes, as well as those that represent some of my favorite events, such as the first anniversary of the game, where they gave two themed skins, such as the mercenary 5 in gold version and the manta ray gold, which were obtained with special missions that, I must say, had much more detail than the current ones.

>Ahora bien, entre las diversas skins, estas variantes de un mismo estilo, como son las representativas del conocido personaje de Ghost, del cual tengo 3 variantes, dos adquiridas en eventos especiales y otra en uno de los pases de batalla, así como también las que representan algunos de mis eventos favoritos, como lo fue el primer aniversario del juego, donde en este dieron dos skins ambientadas, como lo fue el mercenario 5 en versión gold y la manta ray gold, que se obtenían con misiones especiales que, debo decir, tenían mucho más detalles que las actuales.

</center>
<hr></hr>


Likewise, I also own 4 variants of the \

skin, two of which I won in events and which I used a lot, since I like the character, and the other two variants are based on what was the first champion of COD Mobile and the one I recently acquired in my participation in the first round, which do not vary much beyond the colors and hair tone.\n\n>Así mismo, también poseo 4 variantes de la skin \

, siendo dos de estas ganadas en eventos y de las que llegué a usar mucho, ya que me gusta el personaje, y las otras dos variantes ambientadas en lo que fue la primera champion del COD Mobile y la que adquirí recientemente en mi participación en la primera ronda, las cuales no varían mucho más allá de los colores y la tonalidad de cabello.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmWJBUw4nMyUw3MV8moae23ey6C4yyt5shV2jEyJRJKML6/1776894973144.jpg
https://images.ecency.com/DQmaoJ9j6SMUvpi3Zs98oSPEi9pv9eVZ4MiiR3tw8SHknUt/1776894998985.jpg
https://images.ecency.com/DQmQMir1eAJNH41Ecp8oBpq6tqShRgqcn3ntzBcb8cGAhrR/1776895028264.jpg
https://images.ecency.com/DQmVZkMGPrB8Nuf88ubKHhzpDwACuN1h7GcfcmtxgGLs2Xp/1776895051434.jpg
In Zombies mode, since its release a few years ago as part of its custom battle pass, I've had skins representing characters infected by the virus from the comic book. So, in fact, after completing the pass, those were the skins I used in that mode. However, they haven't updated the pass yet (which I'm still waiting for), but I have changed the skins I use whenever I have the chance to play. >En el modo zombie, este, desde que salió hace algunos años en su pase de batalla personalizado, tenía unas skins que representaban personajes infectados por el virus y que forman parte de su cómic, por lo que, en efecto, al completar ese pase, era de las que utilizaba en ese modo. Sin embargo, aún no han actualizado el pase (cosa que sigo esperando), pero sí he variado un poco las skins que uso cada que tengo oportunidad de jugarlo.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmc34CUrJBLuyNAbBfVtwUG5F7KQqn4vYkVtekF8oQCBJL/1776895081044.jpg
Obviously, when it comes to skins with unusual designs, I have two: one from the aquatic season with a peculiar design, and the ones from the recent alien events, which are very cool in my opinion, as well as skins like Scylla, Vanguard, Rampage, Motoko (which was from a very good collaboration), and even the well-known Mara from the Call of Duty story, which is one of my favorite female skins, which I used for a long time in special battle royale events. >Obviamente, en lo que respecta a skins con diseños raros, tengo 2, siendo uno de la temporada acuática con un diseño peculiar y las de los eventos de aliens recientes, que son muy frescas a mi parecer, así como skins como Scylla, Vanguardia, Rampage, Motoko (la cual fue de una muy buena colaboración), incluso la conocida Mara de la historia del Call of Duty, que es de mis favoritas femeninas, que llegué a usar por mucho tiempo en eventos especiales de battle royale.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmXAUYTPAQzhwjbCPUwAJA64gp1L9UiG1AArsDdvdWNyFz/1776895106451.jpg
https://images.ecency.com/DQmQSU8U47tdisbT7ziHpkJHMJ6NnoDTnMiTEuidAs45Ax5/1776895120399.jpg
https://images.ecency.com/DQmdYoTBBCWXvR22tdXo2QpHkv4rSVmjrivm6CMtw7sC7E7/1776895136659.jpg
https://images.ecency.com/DQmeLMTheWuV7BCzKH5i2f92UeLXcYArqNbtyuWLmDy42we/1776895152331.jpg
Even so, there are many others I haven't mentioned, and while it may not be the same number as those who have dedicated the most time to the game without pausing, it's true that they become representative, especially when you know that some don't reappear and become a mark of the player's experience or the time they've spent playing. So, well, you could say that many of these are precisely the mark I have of how much I've played. With nothing more to add, and hoping you enjoy it, thank you very much for reading. >Aun así, me faltan muchas otras por nombrar y, si bien tal vez no es igual a las cantidades que tienen los que más tiempo le han dedicado sin pausar el juego, es cierto que llegan a ser representativas y más cuando se sabe que algunas no vuelven a aparecer para obtener y se vuelven esa marca de la experiencia del jugador o el tiempo que lleva en este mismo, por lo que, bueno, se puede decir que muchas de estas son justamente esa marca que tengo de lo que he jugado, por lo que, sin más nada que decir y esperando sea de su agrado, muchas gracias por leer.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmS5WJhr8wQ43QMe83XSPpzDbtviW7GqPiUjFQSmUy3BE4/1722383797027.jpg

> Hola amigos de esta prestigiosa comunidad @vdc en Hive blockchain, quiero presentarles a continuación parte de lo que fue la celebración que estudiantes, madres y representantes brindaron hace pocos días al Prof. Leo Villalonga gran coplero del Estado Cojedes quien hizo de Villa de Cura su segundo hogar desde hace muuuuuuuchos años.
En el video que le presentamos grabado por una de las representantes de la Fundación Artística que el profe dirige desde hace poco más de un año parte de lo que fue la sorpresa que una de las viviendas de los estudiantes le tenían preparada para celebrar al mejorr estilo llanero un aniversario más de su vida. desde el equipo de Hive Tv SHOW! le felicitamos y le deseamos mucha vida y salud a este gran promotor del talento infantil de nuestra ciudad.. Esperando que sea de su agrado nos vemos en un próxima oportunidad, su amigo y profesor @gaborockstar.

>
>Hello, friends of this prestigious @vdc community on the Hive blockchain. In the video we’re sharing—recorded by one of the representatives of the Artistic Foundation that the professor has been leading for just over a year—you’ll see part of the surprise that one of the students’ homes had prepared for him to celebrate another birthday in the best llanero style. body.title: Vocación de kamikaze
body.body:
Mi voz y su vocación de kamikaze 
no pierde la oportunidad de saltar sin mirar a dónde ni cuándo,
sin saber si da pie en lo profundo de tus oído.
Quisiera ser como mi voz, 
aunque no me gusta la gravedad 
(cualquiera de ellas, ninguna me gusta).
Mi voz, cual poderoso ouroboros, nace y muere sin cenizas en la frente,
por eso mi voz no sufre de la oscura enfermedad del miedo, 
y vuela libre hacia el vacío, 
con el hambre más áspera de llenarlo de palabras.
Era una época de olvidos y extravíos de los sentidos,
cuando iba *la palabra perdiéndose en un extraño oído*
*a la deriva de lo que somos y olvidamos...*

body.title: The most read book in the world / El libro más leído del mundo - LOH #285 (eng-esp)
body.body:
Greetings, everyone.

I am a Cuban writer and I don't profess any religion, however strange that may be in my culture. Therefore, I don't go to Mass, I don't pray before going to sleep, and I don't believe in life after death.

I believe we should enjoy this life and not focus on the next one.
That doesn't mean I don't respect everyone and their beliefs. My faith is in being a good person, and that entails respecting everyone's beliefs. In fact, sometimes I've envied them for that faith.

However, the book that has most shaped my understanding of the world is the Bible.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVhADHeJKEHuKZo1F6wfZ1b3eGMBbAwnMkANamRpBHkoR/1776893002086.jpg)
[source](https://pixabay.com/photos/bible-blur-book-close-up-open-1869164/)

I first read it out of cultural obligation (remember, I have a degree in sociocultural studies). Also, because of that need writers have to know the text that underpins Western morality. But I stayed with it for strictly practical and human reasons.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSxMbhnE84ybCLHnL2JsZjVjU6fCn4y8ZDHPdkNGr9KHU/1776893464048.jpg)
[source](https://pixabay.com/photos/bible-book-hands-elderly-hands-1866564/)

If one is able to separate the purely religious content of the Old Testament and concentrate on the teachings and parables of the New, one finds an unparalleled manual of conduct.

I'm not talking about miracles or divinity; I'm talking about a list of instructions on how to be a good person amidst the everyday indifference in which we live: Forgive, don't judge, share what little you have, and keep your mouth shut when pride makes you want to shout.

I assure you that I know of no other work that so clearly condenses the basic qualities expected of someone who intends to do no harm.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSYSWnWnWQPins6fyhArjwox5yTgWV4miqshK5mF9UUd2/1776893515806.jpg)
[source](https://pixabay.com/photos/bible-scripture-book-religion-4249164/)

As if that weren't enough, there's the First Letter to the Corinthians, chapter thirteen. I have never seen a more accurate or less sentimental definition of love:
It says: *Love is patient, love is kind. It does not envy, it does not boast, it is not proud. It does not dishonor others, it is not self-seeking, it is not easily angered, it keeps no record of wrongs. He does not rejoice in evil, but rejoices in the truth.*
And this is just a fragment of that wonderful concept.

In a country like Cuba, where coexistence is difficult, rereading that fragment has helped me more than any psychology or self-help book.

***
**Leer en español**
***

Saludos, estimadas.

Soy un escritor cubano y no profeso ninguna religión, por más extraño que eso sea para mí cultura. Por tanto, no voy a misa, no rezo antes de dormir y no creo en la vida después de la muerte.
Creo que hay que aprovechar esta y no enfocarnos en la próxima.
Eso no quita que respete a todos y a sus creencias. Mi fé es ser una buena persona y eso conlleva respetar a todos sus creencias. De hecho, a veces los he envidiado por esa fé.
Sin embargo, el libro que más ha determinado mi manera de entender el mundo es la Biblia. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVhADHeJKEHuKZo1F6wfZ1b3eGMBbAwnMkANamRpBHkoR/1776893002086.jpg)
[fuente](https://pixabay.com/photos/bible-blur-book-close-up-open-1869164/)

La leí por primera vez por obligación cultural (recuerden que soy graduado de estudios socioculturales). Además, por esa necesidad que tenemos los escritores de conocer el texto que sostiene la moral de Occidente. Pero me quedé por razones estrictamente prácticas y humanas. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSxMbhnE84ybCLHnL2JsZjVjU6fCn4y8ZDHPdkNGr9KHU/1776893464048.jpg)
[fuente](https://pixabay.com/photos/bible-book-hands-elderly-hands-1866564/)

Si uno es capaz de hacer el ejercicio de separar el contenido puramente religioso del Antiguo Testamento y concentrarse en las enseñanzas y parábolas del Nuevo, se encuentra con un manual de conducta inigualable. 
No hablo de milagros ni de divinidad; hablo de una lista de instrucciones sobre cómo ser una buena persona en medio de la indiferencia cotidiana en la que vivimos: Perdonar, no juzgar, compartir lo poco que se tiene y callarse la boca cuando el orgullo pide gritar. 
Les aseguro que no conozco otra obra que condense con tanta claridad las cualidades básicas que se esperan de alguien que pretende no hacer daño. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSYSWnWnWQPins6fyhArjwox5yTgWV4miqshK5mF9UUd2/1776893515806.jpg)
[fuente](https://pixabay.com/photos/bible-scripture-book-religion-4249164/)

Por si fuera poco, está la Primera Carta a los Corintios, capítulo trece. No he visto jamás una definición del amor más exacta ni más desprovista de cursilería:
Dice así: *El amor es paciente; el amor es bondadoso; el amor no es envidioso ni jactancioso ni arrogante ni grosero. No insiste en su propio camino; no es irritable ni resentido; no se alegra del mal, sino que se alegra de la verdad.*
Y esto es solo un fragmento de esa maravilla de concepto.
En un país como Cuba, donde la convivencia es dura, releer ese fragmento me ha servido más que cualquier tratado de psicología o autoayuda.

body.title: Back to an one more evening Wednesday walk in Szeged
body.body:
Hello Wednesday walkers. It's time for the #wednesdaywalk challenge, hosted by @tattoo-djay. Today I am taking you to Szeged, a charming city in Hungary near the border with Serbia.

![IMG_20260215_171548.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/Eq7K22EGi7JpFBHi9ctDgmz1fs51j3qfRXYQg6xK1BDFapsCPCkztv4YyqnUA1QQoTJ.jpg)

I visited this place again in February this year at the same time, during the national holiday, as I did last year. This time, I especially remember the evening walk.

![IMG_20260215_171218.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/Ep9vJufMp8Jrm2Q7yknntqB58ywMEiXRDuHYEa4SJbBbf2CZsVLUJJa4KGDkDEkvkeo.jpg)

![IMG_20260215_171212.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/EpSw1BgyjRfXtB35sXkWaVky7KUyH17g1Yg1FSrwQvwN6uRBFmZDbc3UNT9uhMeMkrZ.jpg)

![IMG_20260215_171236.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/EpLZE56QuYBtLoqUBavLLc1d3Hy3ZDee1gYg9Hfwu3h3q78NXrU7Ch9ESbJ2c2bv7FN.jpg)

![IMG_20260215_171424.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/Ep3bvbbVLQUq1N7cKNQuPAQUW77PbWCJLZpTWN5988GYv8XfRfFNRWE1Pysr2j5FCUQ.jpg)

An evening walk through Szeged was so relaxing, partly because I was alone with my husband without children, partly because I was exhausted waiting at the border for three hours. The street lights were very inspiring and romantic.

![IMG_20260215_171843.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/EqFpcnp6vx1rj9FTUobZg6sTmqLGw15XvYAePwL1aNYYy8BP9YzRqTDiBiY7ixQk4EG.jpg)

![IMG_20260215_171948.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/Eou7DMb7NqnwwY6wG2WB7LcCZpRdkkqntfYw2CpqrhAVwj4LSN7V64iF8kDckkvi7y7.jpg)

![IMG_20260215_172001.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/EowECC9Wi3HUJVbCEefB55MjhMWPX7AnWB8avB9xpLoBZB4nwHeS61ewJZGKPiTJNJn.jpg)

I have photographed myself many times as Emily in Paris, with the fact that I am Jelena in Szeged. 😊 

![IMG_20260215_171637.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/243BaRXMAyh5hoR9Fh3iGvc9GRPeSc4z1UzZV8thD7Fz177ig6PixgDm7TEKfRq7xHFSH.jpg)

There were only a few people on the street, but just enough to give the city a sense of life without disturbing its peaceful rhythm.

![IMG_20260215_172129.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/Eow9o5yjdtSSWpayucrGhkxvD1aRiVW6DzzULak3BzwkcqBaQ5aPS4Q3dhHbmrSaqzq.jpg)

![IMG_20260215_172133.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/EpEFt1zPXjWmk3e7PL6RmxpeTnENzqvCpqpa6niCdT2iC4r7a8utQEkez6QUxTvwFqU.jpg)

The air was fresh, and every step echoed gently on the pavement, making the walk feel personal and reflective. The architecture, beautifully lit, reveals details you might miss during the day, and the atmosphere invites you to slow down and simply observe. I enjoyed walking.

![IMG_20260215_190538.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/EoCgCJrZPxc9RX9UxVGrKFBMQBjMRAnX2jeJSTTotSPspQ7GzjNahkVXc4iwJNuPog8.jpg)

![IMG_20260215_191713.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/Eo8Rq3BKqgvDu7uG38LV415nC92ZwacPox8YV6XW43AqyniquVsQ9oD5FomVxLpHb7s.jpg)

![IMG_20260215_185714.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/EoAYpefoKi6TnGCNhtw9LoUnEFW82Kd7ctKyf9pCWdXRxw5EBDkViiWqjqddaqmTZSh.jpg)

![IMG_20260215_191001.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/Eo8RNq3nYSQZwAMpskWHDYVNfamAkotv1ggsLePUja2sqMrPoftf1LFu1HGYQJycC4Y.jpg)

![IMG_20260215_190757.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/EoEoAwfAmVqakoAmi2qaFe1pobwazEuQ1YDsjEh52eP9m9GodwSof496JzDv6ZtP5Bs.jpg)

![IMG_20260215_191451.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/EoEpbdRveqpEkVRhPU9RtEkdZ4gEYapWdmQUj2rYivZBSHq9zatrss2cEbYLbaQeR12.jpg)

After a long walk, we finally went to dinner. We received a recommendation for the John Bull restaurant and we were not wrong, the restaurant is fantastic.

![IMG_20260215_184817.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/Ep1UyVZxTfBRytibugo445p8tKCkScuhVWiuNDEZfhWH1Ha4cq6GmMwLQaJiLA6JEHN.jpg)

![IMG_20260215_184756.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/EpxrH4BDNE3oQjyqiznARcJT2DdsN4hhuvZNg1M7iJwyzm3zAMcJFV3JfS4V4NoUfvH.jpg)

Dinner at John Bull restaurant added a perfect ending to the evening.

![IMG_20260215_172959.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/EonjXhUunuY8NaoguytmVorBCCQ3qwqz2EuUJgz1hXM7A18fVXVppjXfeHqivfFfGJX.jpg)

![IMG_20260215_174117.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/EoiUp8jWn9wygJVfKdn1sgdrxFQHaDmLZhD2UNG6ZhL5Mu7mHZURCypNQZf639sEF1H.jpg)

The flavors were rich and comforting, the celery soup with almond flakes is surprisingly delicate. 

![IMG_20260215_174252.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/EoGxWBUBtdaN1uCHNh9xwhumE7EoyPSqHV6FP8vvVWBaov33m4mjVNkn1mU1cqZ6ChK.jpg)

And the goulash served in bread feels so cool and traditional at the same time.

![IMG_20260215_174228.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/EokdbThgGswkWyRW2yzHWcDHpKnJJYqyrjFvNmJokP4QQD7v1Um1fpPhAPdt1bE7Mkj.jpg)

The Kyiv-style chicken was also perfectly prepared.

![IMG_20260215_180618.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/EoK7MEbRJR3DwdVddvrfQZLBWsWFXzbH2aeBbRmgY1rnbqbjVMtZQUjJGcrQR9wVvGY.jpg)

But the real highlight came at the end: sweet pancakes filled with poppy seeds, vanilla cream, and cherries, a dessert that can't help but delight you.

![IMG_20260215_182737.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/EoGysF2YJ1NRnxZaBm21iXiE4UqxtWX5qX6fYu5qaxztYAukcUpP3ypfgrV7zjyjZiC.jpg)

It was a simple evening walk, yet deeply memorable.
