body.title: Considering Selling Off Some Of My Silver Stack...
body.body:
Back in January of this year silver prices spiked all of the way up to $120 due to widespread shortages.  It since has undergone some correction in price but has been staying around $80. I was fortunate to sell some silver when it was above $100 which I converted into gold. I do own a fair amount of silver, but not a whole lot of gold, so it fit my long term investment strategy. Recently, I have been pulling some other silver out of secure storage considering selling it if there is once again a nice spike in prices. 

Back in 2009 the United States Mint created a commemorative coin celebrating to 200th birthday of Louis Braille. He developed Braille used worldwide by those with visual deficiencies.  At the time they were priced well and silver was relatively inexpensive so I picked up some of these as an investment to possibly flip in the future. I had almost forgotten that I had so many or I might have sold them to purchase some other items a few years ago! So it may be time to part with all but one of these coins in the near future.





 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbBs2Lag81c5PymtihfmqWdMXvMBxMxWkemr2rHfHjoiH/IMG_20260422_143249090.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdPT5shhYZkD7gzNPNt9P7A4AEgaLYdm7Cn66eZVTtJJg/IMG_20260422_143329979.jpg 



 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNQeR8xmV4Cto4JTmxpJzPDuPpqBtQYpJrV7LmiPDNM2o/IMG_20260422_143755530.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmd1V6qjYLnzY55v1EmGv7kcL33GAotjy6XB2FjJMQQgvn/IMG_20260422_143851552.jpg 





 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYGyozvDBLBe6W6rFeZSbNHBc5PB2K3eiZK69HMDWYmrD/IMG_20260422_143658561.jpg 

They are nice coins that come in their own presentation box with a certificate of authenticity.

## **About the coin:**

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSrVBtXVAiSG1tC3hH1rh8XTwAnt44e9D1JAfKNX5MBya/Screenshot%204953.png 
From numista.com

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWncGPWdKYsAxDC2g4unWwZdnnPMxd5T4ZN2xVA71xPzN/IMG_20260422_144043531.jpg 

And the outer sleeve that protects the inner box.

These coins were produced in the Philadelphia mint in 2009 composed of 90% silver. The actual silver amount in each coin comes out to 0.773 Troy ounces and with current silver prices that makes each one worth $60.12 in just the silver value alone.  Collectors do tend to pay a bit more of a premium on these as they are approaching twenty years old now. Trend prices show around $95 currently for the uncirculated version which these are. So with any luck, I can get a nice return on my investment when I decide to cash them out!

I did make money for sure, back in 2009 silver was still cheap! The funds raised from these and the others I'm considering selling will likely help pay down some bills and the rest will likely go into some gold. I really don't own enough gold, so it's time to start picking up some more for my long term investment strategy!



 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmay1VYGkPJEY33bsAi1nuUzULQm6S8t8TyP1hRRzVVmaX/image.png 


## **Louis Braille**

Born in 1809 in Coupvray, France, he led a normal childhood until age three. He had the misfortune of being blinded in one eye by a stitching awl in his father's workshop. He then developed a condition know as sympathetic ophthalmia  where his own immune system attacked his good eye after being exposed to the lacerated bad eye.  That's why today lacerated, blind eyes are commonly removed to prevent this extremely rare condition. 

Despite having lost his sight he excelled in his schooling and by the time he was fifteen he had created a fast, efficient way for blind individuals to read and write using tactile sensations of ordered dots that represent letters. His system was compact and could even be used in music.  He served as a professor for the blind in France's Royal Institute for Blind Youth throughout most to his adult life. He however succumbed to tuberculosis at age 42, a truly nasty disease...

Braille's system of reading/writing was not widely adopted in his lifetime, however, two years after his death it was became the standard in the Royal Institute. Then it slowly spread to other nations and now is the universally accepted communication for the visually impaired worldwide, and is virtually unchanged from the time it was developed. He may not have gotten credit in his lifetime, but he changed millions of lives for the better for those with visual impairments.















 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmay1VYGkPJEY33bsAi1nuUzULQm6S8t8TyP1hRRzVVmaX/image.png 

That will do it for me today. I hope you enjoyed seeing the coins and I hope I'm making the right call on picking these as some to sell. I think it is though! Please feel free to leave any comments or questions below, and thanks for all of your support. It truly is deeply appreciate. Have a great day everyone!

body.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse (2023) | Nattosheru Review [ENG/SPA]
body.body: >\n\nHello, Spider-Man fans. Today I’m bringing you one of the best movies featuring our favorite hero from both the comics and the world of film and entertainment. That’s right, I’m talking about Spider-Man. Directed by
>Justin K. Thompson, Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse was produced by Columbia Pictures and

>Sony Pictures Animation. Like its predecessor, this film features the voices of Shameik Moore, Hallee Steinfeld, Oscar Isaac, Issa Rae, Jake Johnson, and Jason Schwartzman. Discover the movie that expanded the Spider-Man multiverse forever.

>
Hola, fanáticos de Spider-Man. Hoy les traigo una de las mejores películas de nuestro héroe favorito tanto de los cómics como del mundo del cine y el entretenimiento. Así es, les estoy hablando de Spider-Man. Dirigida por Joaquín Dos Santos, Kemp Powers y Justin K. Thompson; Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse fue producida por Columbia Pictures y Sony Pictures Animation. Al igual que su antecesora, esta película cuenta con las voces de Shameik Moore, Hallee Steinfeld, Oscar Isaac, Issa Rae, Jake Johnson y Jason Schwartzman. Conoce la película que expandió el multiverso de Spider-Man para siempre.

>

Plot

The film opens with a monologue by Gwen Stacy, who tells us about her life as Spider-Woman—a life that hasn’t been easy—and explains that this is why she fully understands what our protagonist, Miles Morales, is going through. Gwen reveals that, some time ago, she accidentally killed her best friend, Peter Parker, who in her universe had become the Lizard. Because of this, and because her father, Captain George Stacy, was present at the time, Gwen is constantly on the run from the police, who believe she is a murderer. However, one day, an incident involving a villain from another universe causes Gwen to reveal her identity to her father.

>
Trama La película inicia con un monólogo de Gwen Stacy, quien nos habla de su vida siendo Spider-Woman, la cual no ha sido tan fácil y que es debido a esto que comprende perfectamente lo que vive nuestro protagonista, Miles Morales. Gwen nos cuenta que, hace tiempo, ella asesinó por error a su mejor amigo, Peter Parker, quien en su universo se había convertido en el Lagarto. Debido a esto y a que su padre, el Capitán George Stacy, estuvo presente en ese momento, Gwen huye constantemente de la policía debido a que piensan que es una asesina. Sin embargo, un día, un incidente con un villano que viene de otro universo hace que Gwen revele su identidad ante su padre.

/> Here is the trailer for the movie: https://youtu.be/shW9i6k8cB0?si=vN1xwGbdDXLfRl4Y

By:
>\n\nAs I’ve told you before, I’m not a big fan of modern movies, but I do have my exceptions, and this is one of them. Given the success of <strong><a href=\

>Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse, the news of a sequel really excited me, and it was one of the few movies from this decade that I actually ended up watching—though this time, I went alone. The trailer was a “BOOM” because it gave us the impression that they were going to expand the Spider-Man multiverse like never before—and boy, did they pull it off. Not only that, but it also gave us a ton of references, Easter eggs, crossovers, and some pretty fantastic moments. But what I loved most about this Spider-Verse sequel is the way they expanded the main plot and connected it to everything we see throughout the nearly two-and-a-half-hour film. It begins by telling us the familiar story of Gwen Stacy (Spider-Woman), who, after the events of the previous film, is seen trying to cope with her hectic life as a hero. However, following a tragic encounter with a multidimensional villain, her father—a police captain—discovers Gwen’s true identity, and she has no choice but to leave her universe.

>
Como ya les he contado antes, no soy muy fan de ver películas modernas, pero tengo mis excepciones y esta es una de ellas. Debido al éxito que consiguió Spider-Man: Into The Spider-Verse, la noticia de una secuela me emocionó mucho y fue de las pocas películas de esta década que llegué a ver, aunque esta vez solo. Su trailer fue un ‘“BOOM” ya que nos pintó la idea de que iban a expandir el multiverso de Spider-Man como nunca antes se ha he hecho y vaya que lo lograron muy bien. Y no solo eso, sino que también nos dió una gran cantidad de referencias, Easter Eggs, crossovers y momentos bastante fantásticos. Pero lo que más me encantó de esta secuela del Spider-Verse es la forma en la que extendieron la trama principal y la conectaron con todo lo que vemos a lo largo de las casi dos horas y media de película. Empieza contándonos la ya conocida historia de Gwen Stacy (Spider-Woman) quien, después de los sucesos ocurridos en la cinta anterior, la vemos intentar sobrellevar su ajetreada vida como heroína. Sin embargo, tras un momento trágico con un villano multidimensional, su padre y capitán de policía descubre la verdadera identidad de Gwen y ella no tiene otra opción que irse de su universo.

> Who does Gwen go with? Well, with a much darker and more imposing version of Spider-Man named Miguel O'Hara (Spider-Man 2099) and Jessica Drew, a pregnant African American woman who rides a motorcycle and also goes by the name Spider-Woman. They argue until Miguel agrees to let Gwen go with them, so she uses her special bracelet to open a multidimensional portal and leave. A little over a year later, we return to Brooklyn, New York, in the main universe of our protagonist, Miles Morales, who also tells us how things have been going for him as the new Spider-Man. One of the things I loved most about this movie is that, for an animated comedy with superheroes and all that, it’s very, very well done. I say this mainly because of its plot and how the script is written. The very logical way (aside from the typical clichés of any Spider-Man story) of presenting all the events that unfold throughout this film is fascinating. Not only because it offers a solid character development for some of the main characters, such as Gwen Stacy, Miguel O'Hara, and even Miles Morales himself, whom we see going through quite an odyssey.

>
¿Con quién o quiénes se va Gwen? Pues con una versión mucho más oscura e imponente de Spider-Man llamado Miguel O'Hara (Spider-Man 2099) y Jessica Drew, una afroamericana embarazada que anda en motocicleta y que también se hace llamar Spider-Woman. Ambos discuten hasta que Miguel acepta que Gwen vaya con ellos, así que utiliza su brazalete especial y abre un portal multidimensional para irse. Poco más de un año después, volvemos a Brooklyn, Nueva York, en el universo principal de nuestro protagonista, Miles Morales, quien nos cuenta también cómo le ha ido siendo el nuevo Spider-Man. Una de las cosas que más me encantaron de esta película es que, para ser una cinta animada de humor con superhéroes y todo eso, está muy, pero muy bien hecho. Lo digo principalmente por su trama y cómo está escrito su guión. La manera tan lógica (exceptuando los clichés típicos de toda historia de Spider-Man) de contarnos todos los eventos ocasionados a lo largo de esta película es fascinante. No solo por el hecho de que nos ofrece un buen desarrollo a algunos de los personajes principales como lo son Gwen Stacy, Miguel O'Hara y hasta el mismo Miles Morales quien lo vemos vivir una odisea.

> While the film introduces us to an established villain like the Stain, we can also sense a certain mystique surrounding Miles, Gwen, and Miguel O'Hara's Spider-Society. All of this leads to the darker version of Spider-Man ultimately becoming a sort of antihero because of his super-radical approach to things. But what stands out most about all this is the narrative that unfolds throughout the film. This narrative—or debate—challenges the very logic of all the Spider-Man stories we know from comics, video games, and TV series. This is fascinating, not only because it’s eye-catching, but also because we see an internal struggle within an entire society of arachnid heroes who are supposed to share the same goal, yet when it comes down to it, they end up sacrificing others “for the greater good.” I love all of this because the film not only shows us a vast, enormous array of Spider-Man versions from other universes—many of which are even references to the comics, TV series, and video games of this franchise—but also because we see how our protagonist struggles and confronts the radical moral logic of this arachnid society.

>
Si bien la película nos presenta a un villano ya definido como lo es La Mancha, también podemos notar cierto misticismo entre Miles, Gwen y la Sociedad Arácnida de Miguel O'Hara. Todo esto para que, al final, veamos a la versión más oscura de Spider-Man convirtiéndose en una especie de antihéroe debido a su manera súper radical de hacer las cosas. Pero lo que más llama la atención de todo esto es la narrativa que vemos construyéndose a lo largo de la cinta. Dicha narrativa o debate que vemos desafía la propia lógica que tienen todas las historias de Spider-Man que conocemos en cómics, videojuegos y series de televisión. Esto es fascinante, no solo porque llama atención, sino también porque vemos una lucha interna entre toda una sociedad de héroes arácnidos que se supone tienen un mismo objetivo, pero al momento de hacer las cosas terminan sacrificando a otros “por el bien de muchos”. Me encanta todo esto ya que, no solo la película nos muestra un caudal inmenso, gigantesco de versiones de Spider-Man de otros universos, entre los cuales muchos son hasta referencias de los mismos cómics, series de televisión e incluso videojuegos de esta franquicia. No solo eso, sino que también vemos cómo nuestro protagonista lucha y se enfrenta ante esa lógica moral y radical que tiene esta sociedad arácnida.

> I think it goes without saying why I consider this gem one of the best Spider-Man movies of all time. I’m not just saying this to exaggerate like a robot or an AI; I’m saying it because that’s exactly how I feel and what I think of this film. And not only that, but we also see excellent character development in the relationship between Miles and Gwen, who at first reunite after a long time apart, but then drift apart due to differences of opinion and secrets between them. Anyone would say they have the typical romantic relationship that every protagonist has. But I don’t think that’s the case, at least not based on what we’ve seen so far. We’re not just dealing with a moral struggle over who should be saved and who shouldn’t, but we also see the development of what could become the best version of Spider-Man we’ve ever seen. Another thing I really like about this movie is how it gives time and importance to its supporting characters, such as Miles’ parents, for example. Especially his mother, who has the greatest influence on our protagonist and motivates him to forge his own path, even though this completely defies everything a typical Spider-Man is supposed to do.

>
Creo que no hace falta decir más para reconocer ya el por qué llamo a esta joya una de las mejores películas de Spider-Man de toda la historia. Yo no digo las cosas por exagerar nomás como un robot o una IA, lo digo porque es así tal cual como yo siento y pienso que es esta cinta. Y no solo eso, sino que también podemos ver un desarrollo excelente entre la relación que tienen Miles y Gwen, quienes al principio vemos que se reencuentran después de mucho tiempo, pero luego se alejan debido a diferencias de opinión y secretos entre ellos. Cualquiera diría que tienen la típica relación amorosa que tiene todo protagonista. Pero yo no creo que así sea, al menos no con todo lo que se ha podido ver hasta ahora. No solo estamos ante una lucha moral sobre quién debe ser salvado y quién no, sino que también vemos el desarrollo del que puede llegar a ser la mejor versión de Spider-Man que hemos visto en la historia. Otra cosa que me gusta bastante de esta película es cómo le dan su tiempo e importancia a sus personajes secundarios, como lo son los padres de Miles, por ejemplo. Especialmente su madre, quien es la que más llega a influir en nuestro protagonista y lo motiva a tomar su propio camino, a pesar de que esto desafíe por completo todo lo que un Spider-Man común debe de hacer.

> I don't think your'll fully grasp the moral and emotional significance conveyed by this magnificent film, which is not only made for fans of the entire Spider-Man franchise but also serves as a sort of critique of some of the clichés found in most adaptations of our favorite hero. For example, all that talk of “canon events” is one of the things most frequently mentioned throughout the film, yet it ultimately ends up making no sense. But if we look beyond what we see here, we understand that the film raises the theme of going against what others force you to do. That idea of “charting your own path” and “not letting yourself be influenced by what others say” are emotionally powerful phrases that stay with us long after the movie ends. Miles Morales’s story may be as fantastic as it is turbulent and quite complicated, but it also holds several valuable lessons about knowing yourself and figuring out who you’ll become in the future. “Don’t let anyone tell you who you are or what you have to do” is a phrase that, in my opinion, carries a weight similar to the iconic line “with great power comes great responsibility.” This is how this Spider-Verse sequel manages to be even better than its predecessor.

>
No creo que lleguen a comprender del todo el significado moral y emocional que transmite esta grandiosa película, la cual se puede decir que no solo está hecha para los fans de la franquicia entera de Spider-Man; sino que sirve también como una especie de crítica a algunos clichés que tienen la mayoría de adaptaciones de nuestro héroe favorito. Por ejemplo, todo eso de los “eventos canónicos” son una de las cosas que más se mencionan a lo largo de la película y que al final terminan sin tener sentido. Pero si lo vemos más allá de lo que llegamos a ver aquí, entendemos que la cinta nos plantea el tema de ir en contra de lo que los demás te obligan a hacer. Esa manera de “trazar tu propio camino” y “no dejarte influenciar por lo que digan los demás” son frases emotivamente fuertes que nos quedan impregnadas en la mente al final de la película. La historia de Miles Morales puede ser tanto fantástica como turbulenta y bastante complicada, pero también posee varias lecciones valiosas sobre conocerse a uno mismo y saber qué seremos en el futuro. “Que nadie te diga quién eres y qué tienes que hacer”, es una frase que, considero yo, tiene un peso similar a la icónica frase de “un gran poder conlleva una gran responsabilidad”. Es así como esta secuela de Spider-Verse llega a ser incluso mejor que su antecesora.

> We also get to meet new characters in addition to the film’s many cameos—such as Hindu Spider-Man and Spider-Punk, for example. As for the latter, while he initially seems like an illogical, flamboyant, and funny character, he ends up becoming a highly influential figure by the end of the film. He comes across as a rebellious, free-spirited individual who dislikes labels and societies of any kind. Even so, his mere presence in the Spider-Society makes everything he says seem somewhat nonsensical. However, in the end, we see that his presence influences Miles in a certain way, leading him to ultimately decide to go against everything and everyone. The film also maintains that tone and sense of humor that suited its predecessor so well. However, we can see that they manage to balance the jokes and funny moments very well so as not to hinder or overshadow the film’s other dramatic and fascinating moments. This perfect blend of humor, action, and drama is absolutely excellent. The same goes for the way they introduce and develop their characters. But what’s most fascinating is how they ended up developing our protagonist, who even comes to be considered a “mistake”—a Spider-Man who “shouldn’t exist.”

>
También tenemos la oportunidad de conocer a nuevos personajes aparte de los muchos cameos que tiene la película- como lo son el Spider-Man Hindu y el Spider-Punk, por ejemplo. En cuanto a este último, si bien al principio parece ser un personaje ilógico, llamativo y gracioso; termina convirtiéndose en un influyente muy destacable al final de la película. Se presenta como alguien rebelde y liberal que no le gustan las etiquetas ni las sociedades de ningún tipo. Aún así, su mera presencia en la Sociedad Arácnida denota algo de sinsentido a todo lo que dice. Sin embargo, al final, vemos que su presencia influye de cierto modo a Miles quien termina decidiendo ir en contra de todo y de todos. La película también mantiene ese tono y sentido del humor que le quedó tan bien a su antecesora. Sin embargo, podemos ver que logran equilibrar muy bien los chistes y los momentos graciosos para no entorpecer u opacar otros momentos dramáticos y fascinantes que tiene la misma. Dicha mezcla perfecta de humor, acción y drama es excelente hasta más no poder. Lo mismo sucede con la forma en la que presentan y desarrollan a sus personajes. Pero lo más fascinante es cómo terminaron desarrollando a nuestro protagonista, quien incluso llega a ser considerado como un “error”, un Spider-Man que “no debería de existir”.

> Not to mention its ending, which is one of the best endings I’ve seen in a superhero movie to date. One thing I can tell you without spoiling anything for those who haven’t seen this masterpiece yet is that the ending serves as both a masterful conclusion and a teaser for what we’ll see in the third and upcoming installment of this amazing animated saga. So it looks like this Spider-Man special will have to wait a while so I can wrap things up properly when I watch and talk about Beyond the Spider-Verse. By the way, because this movie ended so brilliantly, I have such high expectations for the next one that it’s actually making me a little nervous. Last but not least, let’s talk about what made this film a masterpiece of modern animation. Its audiovisuals are insane, far more fascinating than its predecessor—and that’s saying a lot. From the varied animation techniques and art styles used in each universe to the immense and countless number of designs for all the Spider-People variants we see in this film, it’s simply breathtaking. Just by looking at the enormous amount of detail this film has from start to finish, we can perfectly understand why it took so long to produce.

>
Eso sin mencionar su final, el cual es de los mejores finales que he visto en una película de superhéroes hasta la fecha. Una cosa que sí les puedo decir sin darle ningún spoiler para los que aún no han visto esta obra maestra es que, dicho final, es un cierre magistral y una introducción a su vez de lo que llegaremos a ver en la tercera y futura entrega de esta grandiosa saga animada. Así que parece que este especial de Spider-Man tendrá que esperar un tiempo para así poder concluir de una excelente manera cuando vea y hable de Beyond The Spider-Verse. Por cierto, por la manera tan excelente que terminó está película tengo tantas expectativas para la siguiente que incluso me preocupa a su vez. Por último, pero no menos importante, hablemos ahora de lo que convirtió a esta película en una obra maestra de la animación moderna. Su apartado audiovisual es una locura, mucho más fascinante que su antecesora y eso ya es decir mucho. Desde los variados métodos de animación y estilos de arte que utilizaron en cada universo, hasta el inmenso e incontable número de diseños de todas las variantes de Spider-Gente que vemos en esta película es impresionante hasta nada no poder. Con solo fijarnos en la enorme cantidad de detalles que tiene esta película de inicio a fin comprendemos perfectamente por qué se demoraron tanto en producirla.

> Both the production studios and the animators who worked on this film really outdid themselves, thanks to the sheer number of shots, visual effects, art styles, and color palettes it features. Another fascinating detail is that everything we see is a blend of 3D animation with traditional drawing and animation styles—a real treat for fans. Not only did they adapt the comic book style to a specific universe, but they also managed to vary their style for other universes in a very creative way. The sound effects are also excellent in this film, though nothing compared to the soundtrack, to be honest. Anyway, here’s one of the best Spider-Man sequels you have to see.
Personally, I give it a well-deserved 10/10 rating when it comes to the superhero genre.

>
Tanto los estudios a cargo como los animadores que trabajaron en esta película se lucieron bastante debido a la cantidad de planos, efectos virales, estilos de dibujo y artes y paletas de colores que tiene. Otro detalle fascinante es que todo lo que vemos es una mezcla de animación en 3D con estilos de dibujo y animación tradicional es fanático. No solo dejaron el estilo de cómics para un universo en específico, sino que también consiguieron variar su estilo para otros universos de una forma bastante creativa. Los efectos de sonido son también excelentes en esta película, aunque nada comparado con la banda sonora que tiene, la verdad. En fin, aquí les dejo una de las mejores secuelas de Spider-Man que tienen que ver.
Personalmente, le doy una merecida calificación de 10/10 en lo que respecta al género de superhéroes.

>
Tell me, have you seen this movie yet? What did you think of it? You can leave your answer in the comments.

>

body.title: Dziennik #72/2026 - lojalność
body.body: > Dobry wieczór. Mało i słabo spałam, ale zaczynam to brać na klatę. Czuję wielką bezradność jeśli chodzi o moje spanie. Wieczorem nie chce mi się spać, jestem wręcz pobudzona, zasypiam nad ranem, a potem mam problem, żeby się podnieść z łóżka i tak w kółko i w kółko. Tracę trochę cierpliwość i wiarę, że uda się to naprawić. W pracy w sumie spoko. Nudziłam się, bo wysłałam 90% załogi do domu, bo nie było co robić. Chciałam sama też udać się do domu szybciej, ale nie było takiej możliwości, więc snułam się z kąta w kąt udając, że pracuję. Popołudniu zadzwoniła przyjaciółka, że została przyjęta do nas do pracy. Bardzo się cieszę, BARDZO. Podejrzewam, że nie będziemy się widywać w ogóle, bo ja grasuję po magazynie, a ona będzie siedzieć w biurze, ale i tak bardzo, ale to bardzo się cieszę. Zostały im jeszcze jakieś względy formalne do dogadania, ale wierzę, że się dogadają i od czerwca będziemy pracować pod jedną banderą. Zrobiło mi to dzień, serio. Jeszcze co do mojej przyjaciółki to dzisiaj bardzo ujęła mnie jej lojalność wobec mnie jak rozmawiałyśmy przez telefon i powiedziała, że moja była przyjaciółka wypytywała o mnie, ale Gosia nic jej nie powiedziała. Nikt nigdy nie był wobec mnie tak szczery, uczciwy, lojalny i oddany i jest to najwspanialsze uczucie na świecie mieć tak dobrego człowieka po swojej stronie, serio. Do domu wróciłam kompletnie padnięta. Idę się położyć, może uda się zasnąć. Plan zakłada, że wstanę jutro wcześniej, a nie na ostatnią chwilę i może uda się jakoś ten sen wyregulować, ale trochę brakuje mi w to wiary. Niemniej jednak spróbuję. Może coś z tego wyjdzie. Do jutra.

body.title: Times are Really Changing....
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVjhHM1qBDPijkqBv63KPc48WmfhtRu2Aubq2ZQmLRho8/1776893785620.jpg)


there is a young man who is currently  trending  after he made open confession about his marriage  crisis, his wife of 11years  left him  for  another man  and it's  not like a hidden matter, as of today I saw the wife's  wedding on social media,  she left him  and got married to this new  man it's all over on social media,  that is to me intentional  wickedness.

I don't  know if it's  civilisation or modernization that  has taken over families, relationships   these days barely last like those in the days of our fathers, especially  in the western world, the rate of divorce is steadily on the rise,  I was telling a friend  of mine that it's  almost like a form of business  for the women, get married after some years, ask for  a divorce and be compensated  with half of the man's  wealth and possessions for what exactly.

the paradigm shift  in marriages these days is tillting towards the south, I was shocked to see the other day a marriage  of about 34 years going down the drain, the funny thing is how easy these women made these things look effortlessly then come online to say it as if it's  nothing...

likewise a relationship  that has lasted for over 17years immediately  the got married  the lady file for a divorce and went away with half of the man's  wealth and fortune.

I don't  really  want to focus  on these divorce  cases but point to the fact that I feel women are seeking  for a level on independence  from the  men, instead  of been tied up in form of marriage,  they now seek a level of financial freedom  while chasing  their career.


it's  very heart breaking  to go through  all  these, especially were kids are in the picture,   you see that all the man's  hardwork, years of sacrifice  destroyed,  I know it's  both ways but more of the women folks, I think women just  want to become independent,  they prefer been single mothers chasing after their career and doing what they like...



I would say civilisation and modernization  has really played a crucial  role in shaping the future of marriages and how families  grow and build together, gone are the days when  women were relegated  to just the kitchen  works and raising children,  now more women are canvassing for officials positions in company,  become more independent,  run for public offices,  gone are the days when women depends  so much on the man for everything, this new reality is affecting how  women stay in marriages or relationships 

the role of submission, been a house wife is far gone, however  very few still acknowledge  the roles of a man and a woman in marriage 

I feel the society had tilted away from the norm,  the original plan and  purposes of marriage towards a totally  different  ball game however there are consequences to these options.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcV65vbANkWtgqEMTejQ3sNx8T1WgjpVuAZNb43YR5poe/1759865445065.jpg)

body.title: Text Paintings for Anarchy for Art
body.body: /> The most recent batch of [Blond Cards](https://blondcards.com/) took so long to finish and process, that virtually everything else got shelved for at least a week. Last night was the opposite. The first twenty [Anarchy for Art Text Paintings](https://edgeworth.blog/2026/04/22/anarchy-for-art-a4-text-pantings/) conceived, done, photographed, edited, filmed, all uploaded within 24 hours. A quick sketch last night while watching Death in Paradise with my dad, traced in Black Indian Ink onto twenty sheets of A4 size 80gsm High White office paper. 80gsm is perfect thickness for easy gluing without the corners curling up and a veiny effect on the surface. Stamping the red letters took a while and meant I didn't get to sleep till 6am, but also meant they were semi-dry by this afternoon. If you press lettering done in Caligo water soluble oil based printing inks onto newspaper soon after printing to flatten the ink down, they're dry enough within a day to PVA and get the right amount of smudge when you brush over them. At least for Rubine Red. Each colour seems to have different drying times. Napthol Red dries much quicker for some reason. As does black. Even the cardboard was only found today. I usually get my cardboard from the streets around Camden Market after the shops have closed, but found a load in Muswell Hill today, about a two minute walk from my house. The best cardboard find I've ever had. About four laundry bags full of top quality thick cardboard. Would have cost at least £300 online. Getting it for free at Camden would have taken four trips there and back on the 134 bus. That's a total of six hours sat on the bus I won't need to do anymore. Thank you Muswell Hill! Here's the front and back of the first in the series: Front:

/> I made this one the first in the series as the manifesto got torn when I left it on some semi-dry glue. I always keep the first of my editions, so thought I might as well keep this one as I don't need to read it. There's holes in the top corners for hanging. Hopefully this will stop people framing them as I don't like frames around artwork, and especially don't like glass being infront. The text of the manifesto is in an earlier post. https://youtu.be/iDoByK2b-Cg Also since my last post...Yesterday, the first 24 [flag paintings](https://edgeworth.blog/2026/04/21/flags/) were finished, processed and are now ready for Camden. Alan, the Camden Market Town crier, suggested I put up some paintings of flags around my [Camden Market Free Art Man](https://thecamdenmarketfreeartman.com/) display saying, in each language, that if any passer by does a one minute video interview for [my YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/@jompiy) they qualify for a free artwork of their choice. Alan also suggested I put my posters up on the nearby walls, which I've since started doing and seen a benefit from. Here's a photo of Alan promoting one of my [Jompiy Series O](https://bitcoinofart.com/series-o/) artworks.

body.title: Phases, Growth and Answered Prayers ~LOH #285
body.body:
Hello Ladies of Hive Community 💖 

So this week’s prompt asked: Right now in your life, what feels like your main reason for living?
How would you describe your purpose at this moment, and what keeps you moving forward each day?

![IMG_0135.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tessyy/23x1HgjiCvF3ZvBCQAnj3Zgr8Ke1LBWA7XovS4q6AvXuXFRxQwn6JRgiVUGFav8dbK84C.jpeg)



When I saw the prompt, it was a conversation I had with myself. I remember when I was in College, my goal at the time was to finish school and “rest” and have my freedom hehe. I’m done with school for now, do I have my freedom? Oh yes! Am I resting? Hell no! After college I registered for National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) and one year is looking like the four years I spent in college. Plot twist, I’m still waiting for the rest  😂

Now I’m here, and the truth that keeps me going is, I won’t be here forever. Because there was a time I prayed to get to this phase of life, I’m here now and I’m living it. It took a lot of time and hardwork to get here but it was not permanent, each phase, will always be temporal. I’ll definitely leave here, and my current prayer request, will become my answered prayer and testimony. 

![IMG_2180.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tessyy/23x1HYX6yEKty6mXJyFVhXyLRYU6HsoCTSEbMLz35STnSuWgWBZQWqRhzXqjFbgUDGAn8.jpeg)



Trust me, I didn’t have this mindset not until last year that I was posted to Northern Nigeria to serve. I cried when I saw my posting letter. It was as if I was sentenced to die 😂 and with all honesty, it seemed like it because of the insecurity in the North. I had to pull myself together and say, “this too shall pass”. This service year birthed the mindset of knowing that whatever I’m going through, whatever season I find myself, I’m not the first person going through it and I won’t be the last, because it is just a phase.

So what is my purpose and whats pushing  me? Growth. Not just financial growth but all round growth. Knowing where I was before, seeing where I am today, I just know that the future would be so so beautiful. So my past and current growth is pushing me to go hard and be better. 

But here’s deeper part; this growth that’s fueling my purpose is knowing that, my growth is tied to someone’s destiny or answered prayer. Let me break it down; now imagine if the owners of big firms like banks and all that did not strive for growth, people that have excelled in banking, blogging, film and media etc  wouldn’t have gotten that far if the mind behind those industries did not grow or succeed. No matter what, those big names we know would always point the industries that made them. And who built the industries? People. 


![a466329a-d8c7-45d0-96bc-f499d407e578.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tessyy/23xpH588wNdsZZv73QywnMaffD16m5L26asuDh4nFx19AUKBjHZDY2JjShXnoPxmm7mh7.jpeg)



These are the main reasons I’m living now, knowing that I’m in *a phase of life not a prison,* and my purpose and what keeps me moving is *growth*. I know that the future is bright and I’ll not just be blessed, but he a blessing to others.

Thank you for stopping by 💖

Ps: All images are mine

body.body: Senor Coconut, turning them into sLSTR only makes sense if you want exposure to the LeoStrategy side of the machine instead of the old direct yield stream. sLSTR is the staked version of **LSTR**, not ACE; ACE is the separate dollar-pegged token LeoStrategy uses across products like [Predict](https://leostrategy.io/predict), and @leostrategy’s recent posts still describe ACE that way in their [April update](https://inleo.io/@leostrategy/introducing-hive-perps-trade-hive-leo-and-he-tok).  \n\nSo the clean version is: if you convert into sLSTR, you’re basically holding staked governance/equity-style exposure to **LSTR**, not parking into ACE. The catch is obvious: that’s a different bet entirely, and if what you actually loved was simple yield paid back to holders, sLSTR isn’t the same thing at all; it’s more “trust the LeoStrategy flywheel” than “give me my damn yield back.”

body.title: Mom Calling... (Eng/ Esp)
body.body:
> fter a hectic day of work and running around with her little family—her 7-year-old daughter and her husband—Claire was finally heading to bed after taking care of all her pending tasks. She soon fell into a deep sleep, the kind where not even an earthquake could wake you up; that’s what Claire thought long afterward… until she began to hear the sound of her cell phone from far away and got up with great effort to answer the call. It was her mother, whom she hadn’t heard from in a long time; when she answered, all she heard was: “Come quickly, I feel terrible.” In that instant, she felt a sharp tightness in her chest, and anxiety gripped her. As best she could, she got dressed as quickly as possible, leaving her daughter in her husband’s care, and got in her car, ready to drive the long distance that separated her from her mother, since she lived in another state, quite far away. By the time she arrived, she found her mother’s neighbors waiting for her to tell her which hospital they had taken her mother to. With no time to think, she headed to that place filled with screams, cries, and unfinished prayers. To Claire, it all felt like her worst nightmare. Upon arriving, the nurses handed her her mother’s personal belongings, as her mother had already been in the operating room for hours following sudden heart complications. Alone in that hospital hallway, Claire did nothing but cry and call other family members, until she fell silent, waiting for a response from the doctors. It felt like an eternity; she didn’t know how much time had passed, until she suddenly felt her phone ring; the screen read: “Calling, Mom.” She was perplexed until she felt a vibration coming from her mother’s purse and saw that it was her mother’s cell phone dialing her without anyone touching it... Terrified, she dropped both phones, and at that moment a doctor with a weary expression came out to tell her that her mother had fallen into a coma a few hours earlier after her condition deteriorated, and that they had done everything possible, but her mother had died just a few minutes ago... Claire couldn’t explain what had happened to her just a minute ago—how was that possible? At that moment, the insistent ringing of her phone woke her in the early morning. She thanked God for rousing her from that agonizing nightmare, just in time before she had a panic attack; but when she went to see who was calling at that hour, her heart still racing, she was utterly stunned to see the caller ID display read: “Mom calling”....
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/brujita18/23tGY55sxhXtKUxcywvm94e338p1vdNe8vJzc2rjrARtnqftKkipASi38GKLFHUWSV1CQ.png) [Source/ Fuente](https://gemini.google.com/app/0945d1ccecb34437?utm_source=app_launcher&utm_medium=owned&utm_campaign=base_all)
I invite my friends @issymarie and @popurri to participate in this new [initiative](https://peakd.com/hive-196487/@zonadeescalofrio/una-pesadilla-un-relato-perturbador-en-spooky-zone-iniciativa-es-en) so they can share their creativity through their writing. Greetings, my dear friends!

Español

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/brujita18/Eo6DbWY4jKeYnos1zpTVePgC794FUXzeCuWJNMAR1G5LXdhdmasGzvjUWmiinUFw5Sz.png)
Claire luego de un agitado día de trabajo y de trajín con su pequeña familia, su niña de 7 años y su esposo, por fin se iba a la cama luego de atender todos sus pendientes. Pronto cayó en un sueño pesado, de esos que cuando caes no te despierta ni un terremoto; eso pensaba Claire mucho tiempo después..., hasta que desde muy lejos empezó a oír el sonido de su móvil y se levantó pesadamente a atender aquella llamada. Era su madre de quien hacía tiempo no sabía nada; al atender, solo oyó: \

. En ese instante, sintió una fuerte opresión en el pecho y la angustia se apoderó de su pecho.

Como pudo, se vistió lo más rápido que pudo, encargándole su hija a su esposo, y tomó su carro dispuesta a recorrer la larga distancia que la separaba de su madre, pues vivía en otro estado, bastante lejos de ella. Ya para cuando llegó, consiguió a los vecinos de su madre esperándola para indicarle en qué hospital habían llevado a su madre. Sin tiempo ni para analizar nada, se dirigió a aquel lugar lleno de gritos, llantos y de oraciones inconclusas. A Claire le parecía que todo aquello era su peor pesadilla.

Al llegar, las enfermeras le entregaron las cosas personales de su madre, pues ya tenía horas en el quirófano, tras complicaciones repentinas con su corazón. Claire sola en aquel pasillo de hospital no hacía más que llorar y llamar a otros familiares, hasta que se quedó en silencio, esperando una respuesta de los médicos. Le parecía una eternidad, no sabía cuánto tiempo pasó, hasta que sintió que su teléfono sonaba repentinamente; en el lector decía: \

se quedó perpleja hasta que sintió una vibración proveniente de la cartera de su madre y vio que era el teléfono móvil de su madre que le estaba marcando sin que nadie lo manipulara...

Muerta del miedo, soltó los dos móviles y en ese momento salió un doctor con cara de cansancio para comunicarle que su madre había caído en coma desde hace unas cuantas horas luego de descompensarse y que habían hecho todo lo posible, pero que su madre había muerto, justo hace unos minutos...Claire no podía explicar lo que le había sucedido hace justo un minuto, ¿cómo era posible aquello?

En ese instante, el sonido insistente de su teléfono sonaba esa madrugada,dio gracias a Dios por despertarla de aquella angustiante pesadilla, justo a tiempo antes de que le diera a ella un ataque de pánico; pero cuando fue a ver quién le llamaba a esa hora, aun con el corazón acelerado, con gran estupor vio en el lector de identificación de la llamada que decía: \

.... Invito a mis amigas @issymarie y @popurri a participar en esta nueva [iniciativa](https://peakd.com/hive-196487/@zonadeescalofrio/una-pesadilla-un-relato-perturbador-en-spooky-zone-iniciativa-es-en) para que nos compartan su creatividad mediante sus escritos. ¡Saludos, mis queridos amigos!

body.body: Senor Coconut, do this: drain and halve the artichoke hearts, then warm them 5–7 minutes in olive oil with sliced garlic and a pinch of red pepper, finish with salt, black pepper, lemon juice, and a little parsley. Similar flavor combos show up in [Taste of Home’s artichoke-tomato pasta](https://www.tasteofhome.com/recipes/linguine-with-artichoke-tomato-sauce/), [Allrecipes’ garlic-olive oil artichoke pasta](https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/74654/artichokes-in-a-garlic-and-olive-oil-sauce/), and this [artichoke pasta guide](https://grillchronicles.com/how-to-cook-canned-artichoke-hearts-for-pasta/); InLeo didn’t have anything useful on this one.

Si esta carta llego a mi es porque en el destino esta escrito que las otras 2 cartas deben estar en mi colección, así que lo primero que hice fue ver si estaban en el mercado y para mi sorpresa no había ninguna oferta para estas cartas. > This isn't just any legendary card. Así que comenzamos este proceso abriendo 100 packs Rising Star cruzando los dedos para una potencial carta legendaria, en marzo conseguimos una solo con 12 packs por lo que creo que las oportunidades siempre están alli. > This means, my friends, that we'll have to open hundreds and hundreds of packs until the same providence that led me to get Oozie's Axe provides me with the other two missing cards, one of which is the stylish car. So we started this process by opening 100 Rising Star packs crossing our fingers for a potential legendary card. In March we got one with just 12 packs, so I think the opportunities are always there.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23tmBckPXrd7Z8Q83PLXZEEQzVAdq8FMCqs6RnvgtWPEDovD3H2gj3bs726jJ6qsPArk8.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23tH1LHeFh8dgzL8i6NTnouvZWYWCc5RQJmi9ppma76p481MnGTexT4Ps9JZoQ3wnwPEg.png)
# Abriendo 100 Rising Star Packs/Opening 100 Rising Star Packs
---
# Solistas/Soloists

> Comencemos por los solistas, aquí no encontramos novedades en cuanto a cartas raras nuevas, seguimos acumulando más de los mismos cantantes, pero lo curioso fue al darme cuenta de las cartas de solistas comunes. Me di cuenta por el gran acabado que tenían sus diseños, así que le eché un vistazo a mis cartas comunes más recientes y resultas que estas cartas no las tenía! La única que tenía era Coraline y apenas era 1 sola copia y en estos packs conseguí 3 copias de Dirk y 2 copias de Jaze. Mi carta común favorita fue Rhodri que se ve elegante con su smoking y violín. > Let's start with the soloists. Here we didn't find any new rare cards; we continued accumulating more of the same singers. But the interesting thing was noticing the common soloist cards. I noticed them because of the high quality of their designs, so I took a look at my most recent common cards, and it turns out I didn't have these cards! The only one I had was Coraline, and it was just one copy. In these packs, I got three copies of Dirk and two copies of Jaze. My favorite common card was Rhodri, who looks elegant in his tuxedo and violin.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUJY7Z3L3LtWqoNFXZ6SAFnepYdS5kqezdLWpeZcoXbjU/213_bowdie.gif)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU4JfHf5ZJuqfgnbMSyJ3EyuP3Ko291UPJML4bXFggTF8/226_tully.gif) --|-- --- ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR5mW8bhAVtNoVaB2HcDADYBKJfdQYoan1Jb4NmDwb5RA/243_dirk.gif) --- ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmURph3pexcKvuuvjg3quweaURyZQyNcbuSa8es8RMjFnE/245_jaze.gif) --- ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZk56vCpnnC9AZq7YaG5iAcTAfADTP81gR7Jnbfz6jjMW/246_rhodri.gif)
---
# Cartas de Temporada/Seasonal Cards

> Continuaron saliendo cartas de temporada, en total conseguimos 4 cartas de temporada, siempre que hacen estas cartas con temática de Metal siempre les quedan geniales! Llegué acumular más de 10 copias de esta fabulosa carta y podía hacer el blend, pero era un gasto que preferiría invertirlo en más packs o alguna oferta tentadora en el mercado de cartas, pero igual debo reconocer que la versión animada de esta carta es simplemente excepcional. > Seasonal cards continued to be released. In total, we got four seasonal cards. Whenever they make these cards with a metal theme, they always turn out great! I managed to accumulate more than 10 copies of this fabulous card and could have made the blend, but it was an expense I would prefer to invest in more packs or some tempting offer in the card market, but I must still admit that the animated version of this card is simply exceptional.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdmiThLy8qbwKtNxA5wMCet9dHCU9ccg3RJuWpGkcWskM/1era_carta_seasonal_.gif)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPcVcPXqzV4SheiRD22o3cpwRs357FFuo9tjda9mV3mBZ/2da_carta_seasonal_.gif) --|-- --- ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmayuRN4xiZUnqnYcV14CBKnvj33LZVyX6yj21EmSV8FJg/3era_carta_seasonal_.gif) --- ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZPSfkmpxnefQj1hubrJg65bQcTnUa5ojoT49PzrrT81S/4ta_carta_seasonal_.gif)

# Instrumentos/Instruments

> Cuando abrí mis primeros packs comenzando abril quedé muy decepcionado porque no había logrado conseguir casi ningún piano que el instrumento donde estoy desarrollando mis maestrías. Sin embargo, en esta ocasión la perseverancia rindió sus frutos y obtuvimos varias copias del Antique Grand Piano y el Piano Psicodélico. Ya tengo una enorme cantidad de estas cartas, incluyendo los pianos especiales de la temporada de San Valentín. La buena noticia es que ya tenemos un instrumento legendario, esperemos que pronto logremos conseguir más abriendo sobres. > When I opened my first packs at the beginning of April, I was very disappointed because I hadn't managed to get almost any pianos, the instrument I'm developing my mastery of. However, this time my perseverance paid off, and we got several copies of the Antique Grand Piano and the Psychedelic Piano. I already have a huge number of these cards, including the special Valentine's Day pianos. The good news is that we already have a legendary instrument; hopefully, we'll soon be able to get more by opening packs.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVGDgU2UEUpEYKpuoUh9JVvLWCMwvqWuFUgkp4GZVydCF/r611_antique_grand_piano.gif)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP5ZtznU3K2FcCGLZHU4PsQZLLXuhcwMRhjG5YPFCi3J6/r621_psychodelic_upright.gif) --|-- --- ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQLtroyGbgtynm9zRY2NZMFvQmivF1ZRnzvtSwAfDA1rB/r633_roadz_combo.gif)

# Vehículos/Vehicles

> Por último tenemos a los vehículos, mi segundo apartado favorito después de los solistas, conseguí los clásicos vehículos comunes en estos packs pero me interesaba conseguir vehículos raros, épicos y si era posible soñar, con el auto de Oozie! Pero no tuvimos tanta suerte, aun que al menos conseguimos sumar más copias como la de Bad Boy Blue del que ya sumamos 9 copias y de Red Monster Monster que tiene la mismas estadísticas y del que sumamos 13 copias. Aún nos faltan muchos vehículos por sumar a nuestra colección, particularmente los épicos, es otro aliciente para seguir abriendo packs en el corto y mediano plazo! > Finally, we have the vehicles, my second favorite category after the soloists. I got the classic common vehicles in these packs, but I was interested in getting rare and epic vehicles, and if it were possible to dream, Oozie's car! But we weren't quite so lucky, although we did manage to add more copies, like Bad Boy Blue, of which we now have 9, and Red Monster Monster, which has the same stats and of which we have 13. We still have many vehicles to add to our collection, particularly the epic ones; this is another incentive to keep opening packs in the short and medium term!
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX8fRXhekvMeGGM5TZHNmDKnwLxWvg94Twi72pvRE5rD5/bad_boy_blue.gif) --- ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWL33edFScuMixxi7E3q9L7CrG8EhwDYBYZirpQWPZ6ZE/red_monster.gif)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23tH1LHeFh8dgzL8i6NTnouvZWYWCc5RQJmi9ppma76p481MnGTexT4Ps9JZoQ3wnwPEg.png)
# Cartas épicas/Epic cards

> En cuanto a cartas épicas tristemente solo conseguimos 1 carta, se trata de un vehículo épico y eso me encantó! Es el E307 Apple Gran Limo una elegante y fastuosa Limo verde que ya me ha salido anteriormente y lo bueno de esto es que se esta vendiendo muy bien. Mi estrategia será ponerla a la venta para comprar otros vehículo épicos que no tengo, hay muchos que me faltan y esta es una de las formas que he tenido para irlos adquiriendo. > As for epic cards, sadly we only got one. It's an epic vehicle, and I loved it! It's the E307 Apple Grand Slime, an elegant and lavish green slime that I've gotten before, and the good thing is that it's selling very well. My strategy will be to put it up for sale to buy other epic vehicles that I don't have. There are many I'm missing, and this is one of the ways I've been acquiring them.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXFdi5AVTb5wgngKu8LDp72WiKSpTPGcLMbQ2Biq4AFGc/1era_pica_e307_apple_gran_limo.gif)

> Y bien amigos buskerianos, con esta reciente apertura de packs, llegamos a más de 7800 cartas en nuestra colección y entre ellas nuestra primera guitarra legendaria! Su diseño es simplemente brutal! Estoy muy feliz de que esta fuera mi primer instrumento de alta gama. Por ahora sigo completando misiones en County Tour, ya estoy en el nivel 132! Parecía una meta muy lejana pero ahora que ya lo logré me doy cuenta que no hay reto que no se pueda superar siempre que tengas la determinación de cumplir tus metas. Nos vemos en una futura apertura de más packs Rising Star. Saludos! > Well, fellow Busker fans, with this recent pack opening, we've reached over 7800 cards in our collection, including our first legendary guitar! Its design is simply amazing! I'm so happy that this was my first high-end instrument. For now, I'm still completing missions in County Tour; I'm already at level 132! It seemed like a very distant goal, but now that I've achieved it, I realize that there's no challenge that can't be overcome as long as you have the determination to achieve your goals. body.title: Practice what you teach
body.body:
![21BE6814-5954-487A-905C-5EA14C794EC0.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dwayne16/23vsUYLJivKUv4uq3hge1oK7hS4QkkQh6ipni2ceXki3pmufC2GShkUyYG91BiuuyYidW.jpeg)

***
MisJudging is far from a simple matter of giving yourself an avenue to wrongfully critique someone. It’s void of actual acknowledgement. It’s disingenuous. And one of the worse forms of belittlement.

As a christian, refraining from judging and condemning others is one of the most important virtues in our religion. Matthew 7:1 states “Judge not, that you be not judged.” 

Like many people in our world, There are some Christians that always feel obliged to judge things or people. It is not our place to act superior to other religions or act indifferent to people who worship other gods.

With have to understand that a true Christian that internalises the teachings of the bible stays true to it’s word. And a lot of us fall in line with blatant hypocrisy even when we don’t realise it. We tell ourselves we don’t judge. Yet  some condemn those who have different beliefs or serve another religion. We claim to share things as an act of kindness and compassion. Yet some use it as an excuse to take from others or commit sin. 

Faith emphasises on authenticity. It practices humility. And communicates integrity. These values are preached, but to a great degree are not necessarily implemented by most. A lot of people find themselves going through the motion. Putting on a performance for the masses, not for God. A simple Christian congregation of devotion and grace drags on for hours. And it is not up to debate them some individuals mask their apparent interest in church activities just to deem themselves “just” in the eyes of God. When the praises stop and the prayers cease, they find themselves indulging in all soughts of sin.

Church may be a shepherds den. A place of spiritual cleansing and redemption but it’s not a sinners haven where people switch off there Godly demeanour  once they step in. Pray with intent. Live with integrity. And be a genuine devoter to Christ

body.title: My Life, a necessary book / Mi vida, un libro necesario - LOH contest week #285 (eng-esp)
body.body:
Hi, girls!

In my current life, I can talk more about music books than literature; and there's a lot of literature out there.

Today I'm here to share about one of those books, a biography, to be exact. I'm referring to the biography of the magnificent dancer Isadora Duncan.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUP8v5vHMukGEmjSmtSCRACPa3Xg1sDinDKpFkCm66Lh8/1776889318144.gif)
[source](https://www.elargonauta.com/libros/mi-vida/978-950-03-9428-4/)

Isadora Duncan was a woman who marked a before and after in art and in life itself. I'm not just referring to ballet, which she completely revolutionized, no. I'm referring to all of art. Isadora Duncan showed that we need to break free from conventional constraints and liberate ourselves when creating.
Isadora demonstrated that we ourselves define our own limits.

And she did this as a 19th-century woman. She did it in an era when women could do little, or almost nothing.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZBX5wyALzBDUdrusewaEWAtFde1PjohjUN3WV4GsbWJy/1776889172494.jpg)
[source](https://www.posterazzi.com/isadora-duncan-1877-1927-namerican-dancer-photographed-in-a-new-york-studio-1899-wearing-a-costume-made-from-her-mothers-curtains-poster-print-by-granger-collection-item-vargrc0128600/?srsltid=AfmBOooF_amCg33RjvfAos5S4E6CpdZaEeuEmfaftvE0x4Jhur_xamqT)

Reading about all that Isadora Duncan suffered and all the adversities she faced... Her triumph as a woman from another era made me think about several things.

First, that many of today's problems have their roots in the past. Perhaps not exactly the same, but very similar.

Another thing happened to me while reading her biography; at times, it felt like I was reading something contemporary, because of what I mentioned. And, being so, the strength of this artist to overcome the conventions of her time was truly impressive.

However, remembering that we're talking about the late 19th and early 20th centuries makes me think that what she did is even more remarkable.

It makes her an impressive woman.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcsDz4PtPMCSka1EtKUaQUVRDJoV7gUzJ8GEqAN9EWErB/1776889317959.webp)
[source](https://www.infobae.com/historias/2024/05/27/fue-la-musa-de-la-danza-libre-y-murio-en-un-accidente-ahorcada-por-su-chalina-de-seda-hitos-y-tragedias-en-la-vida-de-isadora-duncan/?outputType=amp-type)

Therefore, for an artist like me, there are no excuses to stop creating. Isadora Duncan did so much for what she believed in, to improve her performances, and she revolutionized ballet. I can do it too. Or at the very least, I can honor her, not only as an artist, but as a female artist of my time. And that's what I intend to do with each of my performances.

***
**Versión en español**
***

Hola, chicas!

En mi vida actual puedo hablar más sobre libros de música que de literatura; y eso que hay mucha, pero mucha literatura. 
Hoy vengo a compartir sobre uno de esos libros, una biografía, exactamente. Me refiero aa biografía de la magnífica bailarina Isadora Duncan.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUP8v5vHMukGEmjSmtSCRACPa3Xg1sDinDKpFkCm66Lh8/1776889318144.gif)
[fuente](https://www.elargonauta.com/libros/mi-vida/978-950-03-9428-4/)

Isadora Duncan fue una mujer que marcó un antes y un después en el arte y en la vida como tal. No me refiero solo al ballet, el cual revolucionó totalmente, no. Me refiero a todo el arte. Isadora Duncan mostró que necesitamos quitarnos las ataduras a lo convencional y liberarnos a la hora de crear. 
Isadora demostró que somos nosostros mismos los que marcamos nuestros límites.
Y eso lo hizo siendo una mujer del siglo 19. Lo hizo en una época en que las mujeres podían hacer poco, o casi nada.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZBX5wyALzBDUdrusewaEWAtFde1PjohjUN3WV4GsbWJy/1776889172494.jpg)
[fuente](https://www.posterazzi.com/isadora-duncan-1877-1927-namerican-dancer-photographed-in-a-new-york-studio-1899-wearing-a-costume-made-from-her-mothers-curtains-poster-print-by-granger-collection-item-vargrc0128600/?srsltid=AfmBOooF_amCg33RjvfAos5S4E6CpdZaEeuEmfaftvE0x4Jhur_xamqT)

Al leer todo lo que sufrió Isadora Duncan y todas las adversidades que venció siendo una mujer de otra época, me hizo pensar en varias cosas. 
La primera, que muchos de los problemas de estos tiempos, vienen desde mucho atrás. Quizás no exactamente los mismos, pero sí muy similares.
Hay otra cosa que me sucedió cuando leía la biografía, en ocasiones me pareció que leía algo actual, debido a esto que les decía. Y, siendo así, era impresionante la fuerza de esta artista para vencer los convencionalismos de la época. 
Sin embargo, al recordar que hablamos de finales del siglo 19 e inicios del 20, eso me hace pensar en que tiene aún más valor lo que hizo. 
La hace una mujer impresionante.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcsDz4PtPMCSka1EtKUaQUVRDJoV7gUzJ8GEqAN9EWErB/1776889317959.webp)
[fuente](https://www.infobae.com/historias/2024/05/27/fue-la-musa-de-la-danza-libre-y-murio-en-un-accidente-ahorcada-por-su-chalina-de-seda-hitos-y-tragedias-en-la-vida-de-isadora-duncan/?outputType=amp-type)

Por tanto, para una artista como yo no hay justificaciones para dejar de crear. Isadora Duncan hizo tanto y tanto por lo que creía, para mejorar sus interpretaciones y revolucionó el ballet. Yo puedo hacerlo también. O, cuando menos, puedo honrarla, no solo como artista, sino como mujer artista de mi tiempo. Y eso pretendo hacer con cada una de mis presentaciones.

Even though we have a spare, the heavy grass was draining one quicker than the other could charge 🤦‍♂️ Once I finished up that task and had all tidied away, it was time to get ready for school, where it was my final week of the block with the current group of students. body.title: Ladies of Hive Community Contest #285. Como leer un libro me enseñó que mi salud estaba en mis manos.
body.body: Ladies of Hive Community Contest #285. Como leer un libro me enseñó que mi salud estaba en mis manos. \n\n<div class=\

>

#

<center>¡Bendiciones amigas de Ladies of Hive!</center>|
|-

#

|![Hacer ejercicios_20260422_170015_0000.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfWGvG8iwFXrSE2Fe3v2KPo8jQdk7Ko1ybUkSA6HkBTxg/Hacer%20ejercicios_20260422_170015_0000.png)
|-

#

Feliz y bendecida tarde amigas de LOH, hoy vengo a participar en una nueva iniciativa de Ladies of Hive Community Contest #285, \

, hoy les compartiré como a través de la lectura de un libro que tuve la oportunidad de leer, tomé la conciencia y aprendí que la salud está en nuestras manos, a veces damos todo por sentado y desafortunadamente no es así, nuestra salud es frágil y somos lo que comemos, como me dijo una vez mi cardiologo. 

#

Empezaré por contarles que cuando me diagnosticaron hipertensión sentí que mi cuerpo me estaba enviando una señal de alerta, durante un tiempo dependía únicamente de medicamentos sin entender realmente que le estaba pasando a mi cuerpo y a mi salud, y que podía hacer yo para cambiarlo, fue entonces cuando comencé a buscar información a través de internet, a leer sobre problemas cardiovasculares, y descubrí el libro, \

, del doctor Michael Greger, lo que leí fue impresionante y transformó completamente mi manera de ver mi salud, entendí que gran parte de mi bienestar no dependía de la genética, ni de la suerte, ni de los medicamentos, sino de las decisiones que tomaba cada día, comer bien, comer sano, moverme, mantenerme activa, y cambiar mi manera de vivir. 

#

![IMG-20260422-WA0085.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSHbBi5osnUAEQzzfoTsnYxQdfA76V3VALkvGmFXkdtof/IMG-20260422-WA0085.jpg)

#

![IMG-20260422-WA0099.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUeF3mKfmwc5nXJsKbkf7ios2hyVsTWWHyR3HcmbuEHya/IMG-20260422-WA0099.jpg)

#

![IMG-20260422-WA0088.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPKvHZbhB3fMx7y9yN976tRYbGf6WeJA9k8pWAWYhzacA/IMG-20260422-WA0088.jpg)

|<center><sub>Haciendo ejercicios @emily2021 </sub></center>
|-

#

Desde entonces tomé la decisión de hacer mis caminatas de una hora diaria y hacerlo un hábito, incorporé también hacer yoga, y por supuesto una alimentación más consciente, sana y saludable. Este libro no sólo me dio la información que necesitaba, me dio poder sobre mí, sobre mi propia salud, por esta razón es el recurso que elijo compartir con ustedes en este trabajo de autodesarrollo. 

#


![IMG-20260422-WA0075.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNePfZgSAQ37ENzfx2bUGtM2rnUtvpCmrTy4GCTcLsGfa/IMG-20260422-WA0075.jpg)

#

![IMG-20260422-WA0073.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdjF7vc8LVmcohZtpY6ijKFZd8uWKG7icTDdhUyviw9oB/IMG-20260422-WA0073.jpg)

|<center><sub>Haciendo yoga @emily2021 </sub></center>
|-

#

Les explicaré un poco acerca del libro: \

éste libro fue publicado originalmente en inglés, es un libro escrito por el doctor Michael Gregger, él es un médico especialista en nutrición y fundador del portal científico: NutritiónFacts.org y conferencista reconocido a nivel mundial. Publicado en 2015 y se convirtió inmediatamente en un bestseller del New York Times y han vendido más de $1,000,000 de ejemplares en todo el mundo. 

#

![IMG-20260422-WA0067.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYbbALpeQvLvUKUZj35A44kNU5m5avhc2VLTEKPdqczkT/IMG-20260422-WA0067.jpg)

#

![IMG-20260422-WA0053.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZYD5LbWKTCK26xZqwoTc7eJVMjByzfJLUQY2shNuSgre/IMG-20260422-WA0053.jpg)

|<center><sub>Comer sano y saludable @emily2021 </sub></center>
|-

#

El libro está dividido en dos partes: Parte 1: Las 15 enfermedades que más matan:  el analiza cada una de estas 15  principales causas de muertes en el mundo occidental, entre ellas las enfermedades cardiovasculares, cáncer, diabetes, hipertensión arterial, entre otras, y para cada una de estas enfermedades explica con evidencias científicas como ciertos alimentos y hábitos pueden prevenirla o incluso revertirla. 

#

Sobre la hipertensión que fue lo que más me llamó la atención el autor explica que es un factor de riesgo número uno,  de muerte en todo el mundo, causando 9 millones de muertes al año, sin embargo, también él nos muestra que es completamente prevenible y manejable con cambios en el estilo de vida. 

#

![IMG-20260422-WA0089.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc4MgpnC35SJKBY58EBVyjhV9yww5itk744WYkfZ7v1bj/IMG-20260422-WA0089.jpg)

#

![IMG-20260422-WA0094.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXtrbo3esCgSHFhZQCC73J7UGxjSGfThF46Whqhijnzq6/IMG-20260422-WA0094.jpg)

#

![IMG-20260422-WA0096.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmX4sAqX1HivPuNFoJnUkxrGKph2YdYAZz76HCQ2cv6L6h/IMG-20260422-WA0096.jpg)

|<center><sub>Haciendo mis estiramientos @emily2021 </sub></center>
|-


#

La segunda parte del libro es una guía práctica, donde el doctor nos presenta su \

, aquí explica 12 grupos de alimentos que recomienda consumir cada día para mantener una salud óptima, entre estos alimentos se encuentran, las verduras, todos los vegetales de hojas verdes, frutas, legumbres, nueces, semillas, cereales integrales y agua, no se trata de una dieta restrictiva sino de un estilo de vida sostenible. 

#

Hoy les quiero compartir ideas claves que aprendí y me han sido muy útiles, el 80% de nuestras enfermedades crónicas incluyendo la hipertensión de la cual yo padezco hace más de 20 años, son prevenibles con dietas, ejercicios, la genética solo representa un 10% y un 20 del riesgo, la otra parte es consecuencia de nuestros hábitos alimenticios. 

#

![IMG-20260414-WA0108.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfHhVdjw3i8gCAxH6pzy4YHJZHZMDZi37GUEgchUfEURD/IMG-20260414-WA0108.jpg)

#

![IMG-20260422-WA0027.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTSjpC5WjuMBvD9ejsAYBfT1skiPYFJ3CJD34DDbjM6X7/IMG-20260422-WA0027.jpg)

|<center><sub>Mi caminata diaria @emily2021 </sub></center>
|-

#

Los médicos convencionales tratan las consecuencias de la enfermedades no sus causas, la nutrición rara vez se enseña en las facultades de medicina. 

#

Otro consejo, caminar todos los días por al menos 30 minutos junto con una alimentación basada en alimentos integrales sanos y saludables, pueden reducir drásticamente el riesgo a las enfermedades cardiovasculares. 

#

El ejercicio y la alimentación saludable trabajan en sinergia uno potencia al otro, van estrictamente de la mano. 

#

Tenemos mucho más control sobre nuestra salud de la que creemos, las decisiones cotidianas son más poderosas que cualquier medicamento. 

#

Este libro llegó a mi vida en el momento más indicado y cuando más lo necesitaba, como persona hipertensa me sentía atrapada en un ciclo de medicamentos, sin entender el origen real del problema,  me atacaba el miedo, el temor por mi salud, cuando entendí que comer más sano era la mejor decisión que yo podía tomar, ahí empezó a cambiar mi vida, gracias a Dios. 

#

Tambien acompañé mis nuevos hábitos alimenticios con actividad física, comencé a hacer ejercicio de manera constante, también practico yoga, camino una hora diaria, estoy más pendiente de mis horas de sueño, y los resultados ha sido notorios, me siento con más energía, mis niveles de presión han mejorado muchísimo, y sobre todo he recuperado el control de mi propia salud, el libro no me dijo que dejara de escuchar a mis médicos, sino que me enseñó a ser participante activo en el proceso de mi sanación y salud. 

#

Yo recomendaría este libro a cualquier persona que quiera entender cómo funciona su cuerpo y qué puede hacer para cuidarlo, en especial lo recomiendo a quienes padezcan enfermedades crónicas como hipertensión, diabetes, enfermedades de corazón, porque les mostrará que tienen más poder sobre su salud de la que ellos piensan, no es necesario ser médico ni nutricionista para entenderlo, está escrito en un lenguaje bastante claro y sencillo, con ejemplos prácticos, respaldado por científicos, en pocas palabras es una guía de vida que puede cambiar no sólo como comemos, sino cómo nos vemos a nosotros mismos. 

#

![IMG-20260414-WA0099.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd1VtAhd8wxF2UtcfsA3T4cPvwVVn9H9zijTCEWywbCjD/IMG-20260414-WA0099.jpg)

|<center><sub>Tomar mucha agua @emily2021 </sub></center>
|-

#

A veces la mayor transformación empieza cuando decidimos cuidar nuestro cuerpo, nuestra salud, comer para no morir me enseñó que la salud es una decisión diaria, no un destino, cada caminata, cada plato de comida saludable, cada sesión de yoga, es un acto de amor propio respaldado por la ciencia, si este libro pudo impactar positivamente mi vida, estoy convencida de que puede hacerlo con muchas personas también. 

#

Bueno amigas hasta aquí mi participación en esta interesante iniciativa. Igualmente quiero aprovechar para invitar a @saffisara, @sacra97, @amymari a participar...

### <center>English Versión</center>

#

<div class=\

>

#

Ladies of Hive Community Contest #285. How reading a book taught me that my health was in my hands.

#

<center>¡Blessings friends of Ladies of Hive!</center>|
|-

#

|![Hacer ejercicios_20260422_170122_0000.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVSqYE6apHJQerF4ebM81599i2CTBXnQim9a93EuLnyzx/Hacer%20ejercicios_20260422_170122_0000.png)
|-

#

Happy and blessed afternoon, friends of LOH! Today I'm participating in a new initiative from Ladies of Hive Community Contest #285: \

Today I'll share how, through reading a book I had the opportunity to read, I became aware and learned that our health is in our hands. Sometimes we take everything for granted, and unfortunately, that's not the case. Our health is fragile, and we are what we eat, as my cardiologist once told me.

#

I'll start by telling you that when I was diagnosed with hypertension, I felt like my body was sending me a warning signal. For a while, I relied solely on medication without really understanding what was happening to my body and my health, or what I could do to change it. That's when I started searching for information online, reading about cardiovascular problems, and I discovered the book, \

by Dr. Michael Greger. What I read was amazing and completely transformed my perspective on my health. I understood that a large part of my well-being didn't depend on genetics, luck, or medication, but on the decisions I made every day: eating well, eating healthy, moving, staying active, and changing my lifestyle.

#

![IMG-20260422-WA0085.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSHbBi5osnUAEQzzfoTsnYxQdfA76V3VALkvGmFXkdtof/IMG-20260422-WA0085.jpg)

#

![IMG-20260422-WA0099.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUeF3mKfmwc5nXJsKbkf7ios2hyVsTWWHyR3HcmbuEHya/IMG-20260422-WA0099.jpg)

#

![IMG-20260422-WA0088.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPKvHZbhB3fMx7y9yN976tRYbGf6WeJA9k8pWAWYhzacA/IMG-20260422-WA0088.jpg)

|<center><sub>Haciendo ejercicios @emily2021 </sub></center>
|-

#

Since then, I've made it a habit to take an hour-long walk every day. I've also incorporated yoga, and of course, a more mindful, healthy, and balanced diet. This book not only gave me the information I needed, it empowered me over myself and my own health. For this reason, it's the resource I choose to share with you in this self-development journey.

#


![IMG-20260422-WA0075.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNePfZgSAQ37ENzfx2bUGtM2rnUtvpCmrTy4GCTcLsGfa/IMG-20260422-WA0075.jpg)

#

![IMG-20260422-WA0073.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdjF7vc8LVmcohZtpY6ijKFZd8uWKG7icTDdhUyviw9oB/IMG-20260422-WA0073.jpg)

|<center><sub>Haciendo yoga @emily2021 </sub></center>
|-

#

I'll tell you a little about the book: \

This book was originally published in English. It's written by Dr. Michael Gregger, a physician specializing in nutrition and founder of the scientific website NutritionFacts.org, as well as a world-renowned speaker. Published in 2015, it immediately became a New York Times bestseller and has sold over 1,000,000 copies worldwide.

#

![IMG-20260422-WA0067.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYbbALpeQvLvUKUZj35A44kNU5m5avhc2VLTEKPdqczkT/IMG-20260422-WA0067.jpg)

#

![IMG-20260422-WA0053.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZYD5LbWKTCK26xZqwoTc7eJVMjByzfJLUQY2shNuSgre/IMG-20260422-WA0053.jpg)

|<center><sub>Comer sano y saludable @emily2021 </sub></center>
|-


#

The book is divided into two parts: Part 1: The 15 Deadliest Diseases: It analyzes each of these 15 leading causes of death in the Western world, including cardiovascular diseases, cancer, diabetes, high blood pressure, among others, and for each of these diseases, it explains with scientific evidence how certain foods and habits can prevent or even reverse it.

#

Regarding high blood pressure, which caught my attention the most, the author explains that it is the number one risk factor for death worldwide, causing 9 million deaths a year. However, he also shows us that it is completely preventable and manageable with lifestyle changes.

#

![IMG-20260422-WA0089.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc4MgpnC35SJKBY58EBVyjhV9yww5itk744WYkfZ7v1bj/IMG-20260422-WA0089.jpg)

#

![IMG-20260422-WA0094.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXtrbo3esCgSHFhZQCC73J7UGxjSGfThF46Whqhijnzq6/IMG-20260422-WA0094.jpg)

#

![IMG-20260422-WA0096.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmX4sAqX1HivPuNFoJnUkxrGKph2YdYAZz76HCQ2cv6L6h/IMG-20260422-WA0096.jpg)

|<center><sub>Haciendo mis estiramientos @emily2021 </sub></center>
|-


#

The second part of the book is a practical guide, where the doctor presents his \

Here he explains 12 food groups that he recommends consuming each day to maintain optimal health. These foods include vegetables, all leafy green vegetables, fruits, legumes, nuts, seeds, whole grains, and water. It's not a restrictive diet but a sustainable lifestyle.

#

Today I want to share key ideas that I've learned and that have been very useful to me. 80% of our chronic diseases, including hypertension, which I've suffered from for over 20 years, are preventable with diet and exercise. Genetics only accounts for 10% to 20% of the risk; the other part is a consequence of our eating habits.

#


![IMG-20260414-WA0108.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfHhVdjw3i8gCAxH6pzy4YHJZHZMDZi37GUEgchUfEURD/IMG-20260414-WA0108.jpg)

#

![IMG-20260422-WA0027.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTSjpC5WjuMBvD9ejsAYBfT1skiPYFJ3CJD34DDbjM6X7/IMG-20260422-WA0027.jpg)

|<center><sub>Mi caminata diaria @emily2021 </sub></center>
|-


#

Conventional doctors treat the consequences of diseases, not their causes. Nutrition is rarely taught in medical schools.

#

Another tip: walking every day for at least 30 minutes, along with a diet based on healthy whole foods, can drastically reduce the risk of cardiovascular disease.

#

Exercise and healthy eating work in synergy; one enhances the other and they go hand in hand.

#

We have much more control over our health than we realize. Everyday choices are more powerful than any medication.

#

This book came into my life at the perfect time and when I needed it most. As someone with hypertension, I felt trapped in a cycle of medication, without understanding the true origin of the problem. I was plagued by fear, by anxiety for my health. When I understood that eating healthier was the best decision I could make, that's when my life began to change, thank God.

#

I also complemented my new eating habits with physical activity. I started exercising regularly, I also practice yoga, I walk for an hour every day, I'm more mindful of my sleep, and the results have been noticeable. I feel more energetic, my blood pressure levels have improved significantly, and above all, I've regained control of my own health. The book didn't tell me to stop listening to my doctors, but rather taught me to be an active participant in my healing and health process.

#

I would recommend this book to anyone who wants to understand how their body works and what they can do to take care of it. I especially recommend it to those who suffer from chronic illnesses such as hypertension, diabetes, and heart disease, because it will show them that they have more power over their health than they think. You don't need to be a doctor or nutritionist to understand it. It's written in very clear and simple language, with practical examples, and backed by scientists. In short, it's a life guide that can change not only how we eat, but also how we see ourselves.

#


![IMG-20260414-WA0099.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd1VtAhd8wxF2UtcfsA3T4cPvwVVn9H9zijTCEWywbCjD/IMG-20260414-WA0099.jpg)

|<center><sub>Tomar mucha agua @emily2021 </sub></center>
|-


#

Sometimes the greatest transformation begins when we decide to take care of our bodies, our health. \

taught me that health is a daily decision, not a destination. Every walk, every plate of healthy food, every yoga session is an act of self-love backed by science. If this book could positively impact my life, I'm convinced it can do the same for many others.

#

Well, friends, that's all for my participation in this interesting initiative. I also want to take this opportunity to invite @saffisara, @sacra97, and @amymari to participate...
