body.title: We can always improve [EN-PT]
body.body:
![aprendendooo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nasincera/23xKxK1R23RD49bSozqrrxF24MHtjvHpvKHbLgLiovrgAdaWq5wwrFL4zH9XTWr9DtE9W.jpg)




When I first arrived on this platform, I knew almost nothing. Like every beginner, I went through tough moments. I made mistakes, got frustrated, and many times found myself knocking on the door of quitting.After a few months of trying, that’s exactly what happened: I took a long break from Hive. 

A break so long that you can still see it clearly on my profile.Even so, I never stopped thinking about coming back. Deep down, I knew that one day I would return to do what I truly enjoy: writing my texts, sharing real experiences, and recording my reflections about life and the world around me.And here I am.

When I came back, I realized that a lot has changed. The platform has evolved and gained improvements, but I also noticed several absences. People I used to talk to have simply disappeared. The reasons I can only imagine: the bear market, the falling price of Hive, or reasons I may never know. 

Life goes on, and each person follows their own path.

I could have created a new account, with a different name and a clean story. But I chose to return to this exact profile the one that carries my entire journey, with all its mistakes, pauses, and growth.

Yes, I have changed. 

I am no longer the same person from 2022 who arrived here full of fear, insecure, and even ashamed to ask a simple question about how to use any tool when posting texts. At that time, I even thought about posting photos of myself and my city, but I always felt out of place. My phone’s camera didn’t help much, and over time I realized that wasn’t my path here.And that’s okay.



People change. Desires change. What moved us yesterday doesn’t always move us today. You are not the same person you were four years ago, and you shouldn’t be. Life is made of transformations, and it is through them that we reconnect with truer versions of ourselves.

Speaking of which, I received a curious message on one of my posts: someone asking me to go back to being like before — insecure, shy, and clueless about everything. I confess I felt sad. But then I thought: if you miss that old version so much, how about helping me buy a phone with a good camera? That way I can return to my beginner days in better style hahaha.

Anyway, I’m a bit eccentric and off the curve. My life experiences are quite unusual, often heavy and sad. 

Even so, I always try to find the lighter side, the funny angle, and, if possible, pull a smile from those who read me.

This is my way.


<hr style=\

>

**Sempre podemos melhorar
**
Quando cheguei nesta plataforma, eu não sabia quase nada. Como todo iniciante, passei por momentos difíceis. Errei, me frustrei e, várias vezes, pensei em desistir. Depois de alguns meses tentando, foi exatamente isso que aconteceu: dei uma pausa longa na Hive. 

Uma pausa tão longa que ainda aparece claramente no meu perfil. Mesmo assim, nunca deixei de pensar em voltar. No fundo, eu sabia que um dia retornaria para fazer o que realmente gosto: escrever meus textos, compartilhar experiências reais e registrar minhas reflexões sobre a vida e o mundo ao meu redor.E aqui estou.

Ao voltar, percebi que muita coisa mudou. A plataforma evoluiu, ganhou melhorias, mas também notei várias ausências. Pessoas com quem eu conversava simplesmente sumiram. Os motivos eu só posso imaginar: o mercado em baixa, o preço da Hive em queda ou razões que talvez nunca venha a saber.

 A vida segue, e cada um segue o seu próprio caminho.

Poderia ter criado uma conta nova, com outro nome e uma história limpa. Mas escolhi voltar exatamente para este perfil, aquele que carrega toda a minha trajetória, com erros, pausas e evoluções.

Sim, eu mudei.

 Não sou mais aquela pessoa do ano de 2022 que chegou aqui cheia de medo, insegura, com vergonha até de fazer uma pergunta simples sobre como utilizar alguma ferramenta nas postagens dos textos. Naquela época, cheguei a pensar em publicar fotos minhas e da minha cidade, mas sempre me senti deslocada. A câmera do celular não ajudava e, com o tempo, entendi que aquele não era o meu caminho aqui. E tudo bem.

As pessoas mudam. Os desejos mudam. O que nos movia ontem nem sempre nos move hoje. Você não é o mesmo de quatro anos atrás, e nem deveria ser. A vida é feita de transformações, e é nelas que nos reencontramos com versões mais verdadeiras de nós mesmos.

Por falar nisso, recebi uma mensagem curiosa em um dos meus posts: alguém me pedindo para eu voltar a ser como antes, insegura, tímida, sem saber fazer nada. Confesso que fiquei triste. Mas logo pensei: se sente tanta saudade daquela versão antiga, que tal me ajudar a comprar um celular com câmera boa? Assim eu posso voltar aos tempos de iniciante com mais estilo hahaha.

Enfim, sou um pouco excêntrica, fora da curva. Minhas experiências são incomuns, muitas vezes pesadas e tristes. 

Mesmo assim, procuro sempre encontrar o lado leve, o ângulo engraçado e, se possível, arrancar um sorriso de quem me lê.

Esse é o meu jeito.

body.body: > https://youtu.be/s6AVBwmtmkU?si=q84bcTGvHLj92ByZ One of the subject that I believe is not always talked about most of the time in the body of Christ which I am not always happy with is the aspect of our health. Actually staying healthy is always biblical. And when we talk about our health, we are not talking about our body, we are talking about our hearts, our mind and even our spirits. One of the things I have learnt is the fact that the bible have teached me that my body is actually very important to God. In 1 Corinthians 6:19-20, it says that my body is the temple of the Holy Spirit. We have been given every responsibility to actually take care of our body majorly ourselves. It is not God that will come down to take care of our body for ourselves. So whenever we eat, we should eat well, we should rest well and generally honour God with our body. Not only that, I have also come to discover that good health start from the heart. What do I mean by that? Proverbs 4:23 says, “Guard your heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.” This open my eyes to see that whenever I allow anger, allow fear or generally bitterness to creep into my heart and stay in my heart, I am tempted to feel weak and trouble. But whenever I chose peace, I chose forgiveness or generally love, it makes me to feel more lighter and stronger. When we talk about staying healthy, we are talking about making sure we pay close attention to our health and our body.

body.title: What is \
AI? First we need to address what truth is.
body.body: By now I'm sure you've heard from some AI builders, that a goal is to build \
AI. You may have even heard it should be \

. What does it mean though? There are different kinds of truth, and I'll address the two main kinds.

1. Mathematical truth.

2. Consensus truth.


Scientific truth? This is actually an illusion and does not exist. There is no such thing as scientific truths, only scientific consensus.  In science, a hypothesis must be falsifiable, it makes predictions, and if it survives being falsified it gains strength enough to become a theory over time. This just means that at this moment in time, the theory is less wrong than what came before it. That's not truth in the mathematical sense, it's not actually true, it's just less wrong than the previous model of reality. 

Social truths are entirely build from consensus. For example the law determined in the past that certain races were real, it invented these races, and by enforcement it created a shared reality. Is this truth? It's only true because enough people believe in it. For example the dollar has value because a lot of people believe. This is also the kind of truth that \

could have if enough people decide it seems sentient and change the laws to make us all treat it as sentient. Legally and socially this is true, but it's not necessarily true in the mathematical sense. 

So what does it mean for AI to be maximally truth seeking? The only way for AI to be maximally truth seeking is for it to seek truth in the world of mathematics. Only in mathematics can there be truth. The other kinds of truth are never on solid foundation. Popular sentiment can change at the flip of a coin, so nothing is exactly true in consensus, only probably true based on what we think everyone else thinks is true. 

In mathematics, truth is based on the initial assumptions, which are made explicit from the start. So we can say there is local truth in mathematics. It's truth under these assumptions. Universal truth does not exist. All truths are conditional. For example, Euclid's elements has postulates, and we assume these truths are correct. If we agree that those truths are correct, we can then deduce and derive Euclidean geometry.  From these initial truths, emerges other truths, resulting in geometry. The beauty of geometry is that it's extremely simple at the foundation, but you get the full unraveling of a universe of truth.



https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZMXaqfc560M

body.title: KISS BLOG IDEAS: WEEK #208: The Love Story Behind a T-Shirt 🩵
body.body: >The Love Story Behind a T-Shirt

> Just yesterday, April 21, marked the second anniversary of the death of my nephew David, whom everyone called by the nickname Kavi, because that’s how he used to say his name when he was little. David died of bone cancer at the age of 18. He was an athletic young man, a good student, a good son, a good nephew, a good brother, and above all, he was a cheerful, witty, outgoing young man, full of life. We never imagined that death could take him away when he was just beginning to live. Of course, his death was a devastating blow to our family, and for many months we were plunged into a state of denial, anger, depression, and sadness. But with time and the support we gave each other, we began to climb out of that dark hole from which we neither wanted nor had the strength to escape. It took months of individual and group work to not only accept his death but also to be grateful for the time David had spent with us.

/> One of the things we decided to do to honor his memory was to have a T-shirt made with his name and a picture of his face on it. That simple T-shirt, without many embellishments or logos, would also feature, on the back, phrases David used to say when he was a child. Those phrases, which may seem insignificant to others, are deeply meaningful to us.

/> When a loved one dies, we try to keep a part of that person with us. That’s why some people keep the deceased’s belongings intact—their clothes, their shoes, everything. Obviously, the easiest things to hold onto are the memories, those snippets of life we shared with them that will remain in our minds. That’s why photographs, videos, and letters become as precious as gold. In our case, we wanted to treasure those witty things David used to say when he was little.

/> How often do we buy clothes just because they’re in style, on a whim, or simply because they look good on us? Later, those items become part of a pile of clothes that hold no emotional value or significance for us. But this T-shirt is different: this T-shirt tells a story—the story of love between him and us. Every time we wear it and every time someone asks us about what’s written on the fabric, we’ll be talking about him. Kavi’s T-shirt is a symbol of family unity, but it’s also a reminder that David is still with us. It’s not just a piece of clothing; it’s our protective shield when we get together or go on family trips. With it, we honor the life of our nephew, that little one who, though he was with us for only a short time, left an indelible mark.
>The main image was edited in Canva, and all the images are from my personal gallery. The text was translated using Deepl.
>Thank you for your support, for reading, and for your comments. Until next time, friends

body.body: Me alegra que lo compartas con esa curiosidad y apertura. Tienes razón en que, visto desde fuera, puede sonar tan extraño como la licantropía o el vampirismo. Pero hay una diferencia clave: lo que describes no es una transformación física ni una creencia en una piel distinta, sino una experiencia interna profunda.\n\nDesde la psicología, identificarse como un animal (lo que se conoce como otherkin o térico en ciertos contextos) no se trata de creer que uno tiene pelo, garras o cola. No es un asunto de \

. Es una cuestión de identidad, de cómo alguien vive y siente su propio sentido del yo. Puede implicar una conexión intensa con ciertos rasgos animales —instintos, formas de relacionarse con el entorno, maneras de percibir el mundo— que la persona integra como parte central de quién es.

Para muchos, no es un disfraz ni una fantasía: es una experiencia subjetiva auténtica, que a veces surge en contextos de neurodivergencia (como el autismo o la sinestesia), o como una forma de dar sentido a emociones o patrones de conducta que no encuentran otro anclaje. En ningún caso es algo que se elija como se elige una camiseta.

Así que cuando dices \

, tienes toda la razón en que sería llamativo si fuera literal. Pero no lo es. Es metafórico, existencial, psicológico. Y ahí está lo realmente asombroso: que la mente humana pueda habitar experiencias de identidad mucho más diversas que las que solemos nombrar.\n\nSi quieres profundizar, te recomiendo leer sobre \
(species dysphoria) —no como patología, sino como fenómeno humano digno de respeto y estudio.\n\nGracias por compartir tu asombro de forma abierta. Eso ya es un montón

body.title: The regrets of my life
body.body:
Greetings!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQDuuZAZriHwAFkGqwjRYrYgUBwTwSUCC6WRfAtpzALVa/20241208_170110.jpg)

Atimes, it's good to look back and take note of our past actions just to check out where we have got it right and also where we have got it right.

However, to dwell in the past is not something that I think is good and this is because it can be a great distraction to our focus for the future.

Having said this, I would like to delve into the topic of the prompt in the Hive Students Connect which is all about, “Five years back.”

Looking at the my five years back, I would say a lot has really happened both good amd bad and also there's actions of mine that has really brought about regrets and this and many more I will be discussing with us here.

One of my actions that has brought about this kind of a regret which I wouldn't want to remember again in my life in the last five years of my life is that of a friend of mine that came to me for partnership.

When this guy, Ayo, who happened to be a friend of mine back in our university days came to me for a partnership business in pig farming, I was at first reluctant, but later when he kept on disturbing me, I changed my mind and decided to venture into the business with him.

In the first 3 months of our partnership, everything went well, but later, everything changed and this guy started misbehaving and on a particular day, after I have been away on an assignment, I called this guy to ask him of how things were going,  but he didn't pick my calls and after I was done with the assignment, I went back home and on getting home, I went to the farm where everywhere was empty and it's at that point that I was told he has sold everything and had travelled out of town.

All my attempt to get across to him were to no avail. This really pained me and it's at that point that I knew all was not well.

I lost out all my investment and I regretted to have accepted his offer and is there anything I wish to do right now, then that would be me not accepting his offer.

Thanks for reading. 

Picture is mine.

Pogoda zachęcała do aktywności na zewnątrz, dlatego wybrałem rower. Bez konkretnego planu ruszyłem najpierw na północ, a później skierowałem się na wschód, wzdłuż kanału. Najgorszy był silny wiatr w twarz, ale pocieszała mnie perspektywa, że w drodze powrotnej będzie znacznie łatwiej.

> ***[ENG] I got back from my night shift this morning, slept it off for a few hours, and woke up to find my wife had gone out to meet a friend. I had to figure out a plan for the day on my own, and since the weather was perfect for being outdoors, I chose my bike. Without a specific route in mind, I headed north first, then turned east along the canal. The worst part was the headwind, but I kept telling myself that the ride back would be much easier.***

![IMG_3930.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23wCBw38yfH3ySx9okusH2kfwSCQJpYWar8GSDf6L1ztemh4iNR3YAkj19qyjxJ2dwi3X.jpg)

![IMG_3933.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/AKHzKyNTQ5jvG258sDWf9YDwjzsagDKyfszCPaFHJMBgJdTU7bpTWLm7nfvbe2e.jpg)

![IMG_3936.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/2432BALNbX9ShMdv4duDHsRuFq4KZP3D6meGq4yEtTws4BKVtxuddyxcDdeDVe9oyLRmg.jpg)

![IMG_3939.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23xKqybSD66RTw1CCPeSKLnBV5hqSAyKMNbg4qYTVBRGSbrx6M6S4dwQjQ8NN2TxMU9FN.jpg)

![IMG_3941.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/AL7LkLZHJYTJ3fMpiKkiSoL2WStkeFEyJGrpthLF4TZ4hKwPrPbUVn3utNRNHFW.jpg)

![IMG_3942.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23rAvWNXmTa7emXvtj53Eekxmjizv5CzcuMk43utFsVvFCXuvBSK53WDKKQ8CtfGnb6TV.jpg)

Przy takim wietrze nawet podjazd przy windzie nie był męczący. Zrobiłem objazd ścieżką wzdłuż kanału do miejsca, w którym duży kanał łączy się z tym historycznym. Gdy ostatnio próbowałem tamtędy jechać, końcówka trasy była zamknięta. Tym razem mogłem swobodnie wjechać, choć była to chyba oddolna inicjatywa – ktoś po prostu przesunął ogrodzenie. Na końcu zamkniętego odcinka płot wciąż stał, a po drodze trafiło się kilka wybojów, ale dało się przejechać. Gorzej było kilkaset metrów dalej – tam również stał znak zakazu ruchu, ale tym razem bez płotu. Na upartego pewnie bym przejechał, jednak nie była to droga dla szosówki, więc zawróciłem i pojechałem zgodnie z objazdem.

> ***[ENG] With that kind of wind, even the climb by the boat lift didn't feel too tiring. I took a detour along the canal path to where the main canal meets the historic one. Last time I tried this route, the end of the path was closed. This time I could enter freely, though I suspect it was a grassroots initiative—someone had simply moved the fencing. The fence was still there at the end of the closed section, and there were some bumps along the way, but it was manageable. Things got worse a few hundred meters further; there was another \

sign, but no fence this time. I probably could have pushed through if I really wanted to, but the terrain wasn't suitable for a road bike, so I turned back and followed the official detour.*** ![IMG_3943.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/244UcnaHsKpT1boEKVtRBDNxMFvsMCXEmGxNpVuT76mL57eDhpvbCfNKavTHEqMCAT7Sq.jpg) ![IMG_3946.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23z776o1LEgCtFVRYdsSCMb3BV9TwKZ9PaSuSpXtwynGXZ1nf3W1QsyPGs94rwVMjWpXb.jpg) ![IMG_3948.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23xVARC3Bcm4wsWsH8xh3LzaNQi2icmrMHeYgJ7LPRGbrtysNCEjauriySkpAW2uY63Er.jpg) ![IMG_3949.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/Ep7tAr54fn83VGXKTnXSLbdQ9B6HJYhuVtqXkjcPjtGLeQUS8ZfST1VDjA9uZAjUmVw.jpg) ![IMG_3950.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/244KE8EUJA7VksXUVNM5abNVPbGUte4coLmYsZLy2xrwMnXRrV4BoKHrNCZkh91UWWAbr.jpg) ![IMG_3957.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23ynQDUPqLmqY259rdm5nnxVvpSsbR8ud3m4ecKT5Ey5oXaPkcibXRFnUsTNwB2SGSgXr.jpg) Dalsza część trasy nad kanałem minęła już bez przygód. Fajna pogoda wyciągnęła ludzi na spacery, więc musiałem uważać na dzieci i zwierzęta, które znienacka pojawiały się pod kołami. > ***[ENG] Once I got back to the canal, the rest of the ride was uneventful. The great weather brought people out for walks, so I had to be careful with kids and pets suddenly popping up in front of my wheels.*** ![IMG_3960.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23yT9YU4HhL9X3gBVmpWJhxaiQJHKBHdCKRpRpoj11dEviJ21joJRYJYDvj7V24pGcTVo.jpg) ![IMG_3961.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/243BZxzntSuoKUA5GtujRgQPYPNSByoNUNmBsjoeXXHJxLnMnJni9sW7mxzmKx4kyF96X.jpg) ![IMG_3967.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23sJfPRnXHb4Y9Lf4s1nib9z72YN9RwKHDvmmnEuhmYsm3rwf3pcGhNqH1i1EEaEYssGf.jpg) ![IMG_3970.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23xKrZSC3UvFbexP31UkVvJdt3336a8BtqzN1Vg7UqXngCZNEF9o3E2MEFB4Sk9EUtvVY.jpg) ![IMG_3975.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/AKSc26tAiyV3MS2oJtKQo8iGLMsvACN3aJanBsPoxJzJQdseQhdqrbG4R1sWV5x.jpg) ![IMG_3977.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/242DEN1yqthZHsinDcjQTgJXgpbDgLuayJ2J8hkhaCy1uDiBi48r1gzkQyyoPMue8VgJV.jpg) ![IMG_3982.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/AK9QWc6brVRBbQSKtsdgEXnaipuqo8QYCXqs6CtTGEHWfnfsUSf7LQE2Bh6kmAZ.jpg) ![IMG_3984.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/AKLs8HEJjoSZSNoCRTTJAxERs2P9SqRtvfJwivKCYv84k5hL1uBZovDACkKXnum.jpg) ![screenshot-connect.garmin.com-2026.04.22-21_17_23.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23wXLB3NjfYvppRFTvKTSmz9sfvMUCWjwxU27TzMCUCHNmf8DFn4s42ScTze3QvXoXpGd.png) ---

body.title: Drifting…
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>



![IMG_5004.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/23x1Dkn5jb6CNePwkp1w5XhpMHAN8QAnHTmHa2Xgi2Njhy1ToHnqFMCRfoLmzi6nAQdFY.jpeg)

I feel like I’m not quite anchored to anything. I’m not sinking or soaring, just drifting like a leaf carried gently on water without resistance, just moving wherever the current decides. Days pass, and I do the things I’m supposed to do, but tucked in between, I feel slightly detached. I am present, but not fully there.

I wouldn’t completely call it sadness or even confusion. I suppose it is just this quiet in-between. Some kind where nothing feels visibly wrong, yet not entirely right either.

I wake up, go through my routine, engage with the world in the small, expected ways. I laugh when something is funny and respond when spoken to. I mean I show up but my insides are floating. 

I’m not chasing anything too hard or holding onto anything too tightly. I’m just existing in a kind of unhurried space where time moves, but I don’t feel the need to race with it. Probably, that’s not such a bad thing because in a world that frequently demands urgency, do this, do that, there’s a comfort in drifting with the wind and allowing yourself to sometimes exist without pressure, or the constant need to define everything that comes your way. 

Drifting is not necessarily a lack of direction. I see it often times as a recalibration. Just that small moment where life lets you breathe before asking you to run again. So for now, I won’t fight it or rush to fix it. I’ll just let myself drift until I find something worth anchoring to again. 


<sup>My response to the freewriters [daily prompt](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/22-april-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3081-im-just-drifting)</sup>

body.title: Family Is Blood...
body.body:
![Red Lifestyle Vlog Youtube Thumbnail (56).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23w2qBcRhgZP4G1bziU4HYaTQsR4eb3uwcBKYZWrxKz5mHSNC7j8HnCTPirGypaC1JQb1.png) ***
![2dk2RRM2dZ8gKjXsrozapsD83FxL3Xbyyi5LFttAhrXxr16mCe4arfLHA37mQtCuynkak9C9VAyTtPNZ193z3v9HzUXNRYfNBKpop4B452wXWGAr95ns7Froa3QYr2tHe7aDsDXTJuz6E8PeAV3edWS3NGxHQJHC9xJn9eUpGW.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23uEz3qUu1cpWPYjmp2LnK1i4RcXoAhocX2Rzpq9uYyMScovNm77MZBozX7i1NM59BnSf.png) You see, I’ve always wondered why there has always been a lot of emphasis placed on the idea of blood. Society has elevated this idea of family to the point that it looks like you can only trust people who are related by blood to you, and anyone else, and you’re basically setting yourself up for heartbreak. As in, you’re expected to uphold our family over everyone else, regardless of how shitty they treat you. Someone does something terrible to you, and you’d have to look away, just because they’re family. But then, we forget that our world does not revolve around family. The people who will change our lives are most likely not related to us, none of the meaningful connections we’d make or the beautiful relationships we’d get into would be with people who are our kin. Because when you think about it, family is just overrated. ![2dk2RRM2dZ8gKjXsrozapsD83FxL3Xbyyi5LFttAhrXxr16mCe4arfLHA37mQtCuynkak9C9VAxm3nacdB7gLmLiZLuYVhHeNsRgxL6WKJoam3hs2B7ZLAp2jwaLFEwoAbLKzAfpv2DhtyvHbJunTbU58RMbxtkvefNK4qj8EA.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23uQkLUmr2XGp8UpLcdtKeQrWDNnK5jemLpyFynqgRKtzZaqtByEwcX3DoUEyB8Pwi9DN.png) Of course, I’m not saying that people should abandon their families. If you have a family that loves you, then good and fine. You’re blessed. But the last thing anyone should allow is to allow their lives to be destroyed just because of family. Society has made it seem like as long as you’re related to someone, then they can’t do anything to you. But we’ve seen brothers kill each other, sisters seduce their brothers-in-law, fathers rape their daughters, and mothers deny their children opportunities that would have changed their lives for the better. And these are all intentional acts, not something that happened where they thought they were doing the right thing. They knew clearly what they were doing and did it anyway. And this is what makes it so painful because with family, you let your guard down, and that makes it easy for them to take advantage of you. That’s the only reason that someone would die, and instead of his family mourning him, they’d be fighting over how to share his properties. ![IMG_20230518_1629282.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23zaokZrHxY1G7fCu9mKew7D2wzsnR6s4uA7Pcvtc3q4rs2kJbvNLXJnn8NDAcLC4L5V6.jpg) This is part of the reason people always want to prolong their ‘legacy’, because their blood must keep flowing on earth. So, if they don’t have a child, then something is terribly wrong. But for some reason, we conveniently forget that a child doesn’t have to be related to you by blood to actually be yours. People have this need to have their own children by any means necessary, while there are thousands and millions of children all over the world looking for a home. Besides, society is rarely fair to parents who make the bold decision to adopt. You’d be asked what you know about the child’s family, what if the child grew up to become a kidnapper or a murderer? What if you unknowingly raised a serial killer and a rapist? But then, they forget that these traits are not passed through blood. No one becomes a serial killer just because their father was one. The environment plays a huge role. What am I trying to say here? Let’s forget about this over-inflated idea of family. Family can betray you, they can break your heart, and stab you in the back. In the same way that friends and strangers can. In the end, blood relations won’t save you from someone who wants to hurt you. So, in a nutshell, instead of keeping your circle tight and small for only blood family, I ask that you expand it instead, to include everyone who means something to you, whether they’re related to you by blood or not. Because that is the true definition of family. ![IMG_20230914_153707~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23ywcNAwyLazQWbPq8XFuAdNBqPH34BKadTWksHKETHfowcWaiLQxnFi2Eo1yv6bcDkqx.jpg) ***
Thank you for reading. Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments below, I would love to know what you’re thinking. Till we meet in the next post.
***
Watch My Engaging Stories on: [Facebook](https://web.facebook.com/brunokemaofficial), [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@bruno_kema), and [TikTok]( https://www.tiktok.com/@bruno_kema?_r=1&_t=ZN-91fKKHrMpuw).
***
N.B: All images used in this post are mine. The thumbnail was designed using Canva.
***

body.title: 🎓 Chapters That Changed Me
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWRKvPjCMFmdt5MeY4PqMDUJZ3ZA2DxbSLZsUs7tvKj3S/IMG_2589.jpg 

Some moments don’t feel big when they happen…  
but later, you realize they changed everything.

This was one of those days.

Sitting on those steps, holding something that represented years of effort, late nights, doubts, growth… and a version of me that kept going even when it wasn’t easy.

I remember smiling, but also thinking… *what comes next?*

Back then, I didn’t have all the answers.  
And honestly… I still don’t.

But now I work as a **life direction curator** — helping people figure out their next steps, their goals, and how to turn uncertainty into something meaningful. Funny how life works, right?

Because the truth is…  
you don’t need to have everything figured out.

You just need to keep moving.

And I’m really proud of the girl in this photo.  
She didn’t know it yet, but she was just getting started.

body.title: Privacy and transparency: can crypto have both?
body.body:
— said Mati Greenspan, founder of Quantum Economics, according to a January 08 [report from Coindesk](https://www.coindesk.com/markets/2026/01/07/privacy-tokens-may-extend-their-outperformance-into-2026-researchers-and-experts-agree), 2026.

The inherent design of most blockchains enforces financial transparency.

Of course, this doesn't mean that people will know when a guy named Vincent in Europe moves $10,000 in Bitcoin, but only that said sum in Bitcoin has been moved.

The problem however is that every time Vincent makes a transaction, the receiving party now has his address and can easily look up every other transactions he makes and what value of assets he holds.

Each party transacted with creates a memory for what Vincent's address is, and at some point, it's public knowledge that this address belongs to him.

We can argue that each transaction breaks the anonymity of a crypto asset's address.

With enough volume, sufficient data is available to label an address.

### Security and real risk

Transparency is a feature, not a bug when it comes to public blockchains.

They are designed to improve the security of these networks as consensus protocols are built around the verifiability of all data on the chains.

This means that for these networks, without transparency, governance breaks.

The problem however is that this transparency creates real risks. Mostly physically.

When identities can be tied to real people, blockchain becomes a surveillance tool that both governments and criminals can capitalize on. Of course, these days, there's not much difference between these two groups.

Notwithstanding, these risks begs the question: can blockchains have both?

Can we have transparency and privacy at the same time?

What are the solutions available to us to enable this?

Zero-knowledge proofs (ZKPs), this is where most data points to.

This is because zero-knowledge proofs (ZKPs) are considered a premier solution for blockchain privacy problems by enabling transactions to be verified without revealing sensitive data like sender, receiver, or amount.

I'll admit, it is the solution that makes sense because transparency is a governance need, and nothing else.

People need to be able to tell that something is true without knowing the full details. This means that we can tell that a transaction did happen without knowing other details like who it came from.

But then, one can see how this doesn't mean the ecosystem gets to have both transparency and privacy because the average user cannot prove that a transaction is valid.

If the ecosystem has to turn to privacy coins and tech, it will mean leaving transparency behind. At the end of the day, it all will come down to deciding which is more important; inherent privacy or transparency?

Because both can be applied optionally, but only one can be an inherent state.

ZK-proofs remove inherent transparency and the absence of it or similar tech removes inherent privacy, while both giving room for optional adaptation of each other.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@badbitch/privacy-and-transparency-can-crypto-have-both-gmp)

The photos were taken at the beginning of November 2025, when there were still quite a few Halloween-themed pieces.

body.title: Teaching The Family About Crypto By Hopping on Pandacoin and Dogecoin
body.body:
I'm going to launch another family-wide campaign to encourage my relatives to start using cryptocurrency more regularly in their daily lives. In our household, we already invest in crypto on a consistent basis, but we rarely exchange it among ourselves, so I figured it would be worthwhile to promote greater internal use while also educating our friends and the next generation about its practical benefits. This approach could help build financial habits across the board for everyone involved.

I've been considering becoming a witness for quite some time now, but I had decided to hold off until a fresh opportunity presented itself. If a second-layer Blurt chain that supports tokens ever becomes available, I'd strongly consider directing my full support toward it without hesitation. To be honest, when it comes to PoS chains, I've typically stuck with the most standard and reliable protocols available. I've run standard wallets and minted in the past, and I've also mined under various PoW chains over the years. So I'm quite familiar with the overall process and its requirements.

As for the family, I'm going to take the next step by teaching them about proper wallet management and the importance of securing private keys effectively. Dogecoin and Pandacoin are two accessible projects that we'll focus on to demonstrate the basics of running wallets at home in a hands-on way. Small steps like these can make a big difference over time, right?

body.body:

---

Hi sublimesunday and Threespeak community. 

I hope you are all well and I am also well. Today we went to visit a special place. A few days ago, as I had told you, there was hail and snow in our city, which caused a lot of damage to wheat. Now it is time to harvest wheat. Today we went to the same place to see how the harvest was being done and how much damage the farmers had suffered. When we met the farmers here, 

Hola, comunidad de Sublimesunday y Threespeak.

Espero que estén todos bien, yo también. Hoy fuimos a visitar un lugar especial. Hace unos días, como les conté, hubo granizo y nieve en nuestra ciudad, lo que causó muchos daños al trigo. Ahora es tiempo de cosechar el trigo. Hoy fuimos al mismo lugar para ver cómo se estaba llevando a cabo la cosecha y cuántos daños habían sufrido los agricultores. Cuando nos reunimos con los agricultores,

![PhotoCollage_1776866103038.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWXdgZ6wfzq3ZxveZa9u1E8xoSz2fhX3TzEfywKeZcpT5/PhotoCollage_1776866103038.jpg)

There were many people who were telling us that their crops had been damaged a lot and what was left was being harvested. In today's post, we will show you all the things here, how much hard work the farmers here do, and then selling their produce for less money also causes a lot of trouble, but they have to sell it out of necessity. After a long journey, 

Mucha gente nos contaba que sus cosechas habían sufrido muchos daños y que lo que quedaba se estaba cosechando. En la publicación de hoy, les mostraremos todo lo que sucede aquí, el arduo trabajo que realizan los agricultores y las dificultades que les supone vender sus productos a precios bajos, pero que se ven obligados a hacerlo por necesidad. Tras un largo viaje,

We found this place where some of our friends lived, then they made us visit the whole place and here we first took their permission to show all these things on social media because people are afraid and do not allow such things to be posted on social media. They say that this will cause us a lot of damage, but they gave us permission and after a long journey, we explored this place in a very good way. 

encontramos este lugar donde vivían algunos amigos. Nos invitaron a visitarlo y, antes de publicarlo en redes sociales, les pedimos permiso, ya que la gente tiene miedo y no permite que se publiquen este tipo de cosas. Decían que nos perjudicaría, pero nos dieron permiso y, tras un largo viaje, exploramos este lugar a fondo.

You can see in the pictures and videos that such a large crop of wheat is grown here, but the way the lockdown is going on here today, not everyone understands what the lockdown is about. The price of petrol has increased and now the shops are also ordered to close at 8 pm. So how will people live here and how will they earn money? The people here are so worried and depressed right.

En las fotos y videos se puede apreciar la gran cantidad de trigo que se cultiva aquí, pero con el confinamiento actual, no todos entienden su significado. El precio de la gasolina ha subido y ahora las tiendas tienen que cerrar a las 8 de la noche. ¿Cómo vivirá la gente aquí y cómo se ganará la vida?  La gente de aquí está muy preocupada y deprimida, ¿verdad?

body.body: > Grace has always loved mystery and intrigue. She adored detective movies and solving mysteries. That was always part of her personality. She loved the idea of ​​discovering things, or of others discovering them within herself. Before becoming a singer, she had this in mind and wanted to somehow infuse her personality into her music. Initially, before starting, she considered creating double meanings in her lyrics. But she didn't end up liking that much; she found it a bit boring. What she wanted was something that was more about her, a part of who she was. After watching one of her many favorite movies, she found one that gave her the definitive idea of ​​what she would become. The movie was The Mask. That gave her the idea to always wear a mask in her public appearances and in her songs. That would create the mystery she loved. So she put it into practice. From her first music video to all her concerts, she always wore a mask. No one knew who she was. Because her voice was so good, she rose quickly to celebrity status. The mask was her greatest asset, because as her popularity grew, people wondered who she was, or what she was really like. This, of course, along with her already excellent music, greatly boosted her career. The mystery and intrigue were captivating, and she relished it. She had achieved what she wanted, and that made her incredibly happy. It was almost a dream come true. For years, her success only continued to grow, each song surpassing the last, and her eager fans grew ever larger until they numbered in the millions worldwide.

> A Grace siempre le a gustado el misterio, la intriga. Le encantaban las películas de detectives y de resolver misterios. Eso fue parte de su personalidad desde siempre. Le encantaba la idea de descubrir cosas o que la gente las descubriera en ella misma. Antes de hacerse cantante ella tenía esto en mente y quería de alguna forma poner su personalidad en su música. Al principio antes de comenzar pesó que lo mejor era crear dobles sentidos en la letra de sus canciones. Pero eso no le terminó gustando mucho, pues lo encontró un poco aburrido. Ella lo que quería era algo que fuera encima de ella misma, como una parte de su forma de ser. Luego de ver de una de sus muchas películas favoritas encontró una que le dio la idea definitiva de lo que sería en el futuro. La película era la máscara. Eso le dio la idea de usar una máscara siempre en sus apariciones en público, y en sus canciones. Eso crearía misterio que era lo que le gustaba. Así que lo puso en práctica. Desde su primer video musical hasta todos sus conciertos siempre usó mascara. Nadie sabía de quien se trataba. Como su voz era muy buena logró avanzar rápidamente lograr ser una celebridad. La máscara era su punto más fuerte, pues luego de subir cada vez más la gente se preguntaba quién era ella, o como era realmente. Eso por supuesto ademásde su música que ya era muy buena impulsó mucho su carrera. El misterio y la intriga eran brutales, y ella lo disfrutaba en grande, había conseguido lo que quería y eso la hacía tan feliz. Era casi un sueño hecho realidad. Por años su éxito solo subió y subió, cada canción superaba a la anterior y sus fans expectantes cada vez aumentaban más hasta tener millones por todo el mundo
![petr-sidorov-t8YB6A3H3nA-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23tkjcwaLbV3a2gu7SCKUAEZY2ijDTH5VzYwAhEQdDkyYLgANGiKP172HsJb2dwVxZTr7.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

> But things weren't as rosy as they seemed. Grace lived under constant threat of being discovered. She had to be covered up everywhere she went, and she couldn't go to many places without heavy security. At home, all the windows had to be permanently closed, and she couldn't even go out into the yard. There were paparazzi everywhere. Not even in a luxury hotel could she feel safe. She was afraid that the staff themselves would reveal her face. It was a huge amount of stress that she had to constantly pay to maintain her personal brand. Her mother, who always saw her very downcast at home, recommended that she show her face. After all, her music was a success, and revealing who she was wouldn't change anything; on the contrary, it would give her more freedom. But Grace didn't listen, because she was afraid that if she showed her face, people wouldn't like her anymore, or she would lose the mystery she cherished. So she decided to continue paying the high price of maintaining her brand.

> Pero todo no era color de rosa como se aparentaba. Grace vivía en un riesgo constante de ser descubierta. Tenía que estar siempre cubierta en todas partes, y no podía ir a muchos lugares sin una alta seguridad. En su casa todas las ventanas tenían que estar permanentemente cerradas, y ella no podía ni salir al patio. Pues había paparazis en todas partes. Ni siquiera en un hotel de lujo podía estar tranquila. Porque tenía miedo de que los mismos empleados revelaran su cara. Era un estrés muy grande que tenía que pagar de forma constante para poder mantener su marca personal. Su madre que la vía siempre muy decaída en casa le recomendaba mostrar su cara, de todas formas su música triunfaba no iba a cambiar nada por mostrar quien era, al contrario le daría más libertad. Pero Grace no le hizo caso, pues tenía miedo de que si mostraba su rostro la gente ya no la querría o dejaría de estar en el misterio que le gustaba. Así que decidió seguir pagando el alto costo de mantener su marca.
![phil-desforges-iuklQeAMVB4-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23tGM6p4353Nz6KqUrSZtnKr7w1PS9D98B3UsTg49FwNpmdgu37LgarWnT21qdfahKUmo.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

> So time continued to pass. But things changed in ways she hadn't expected. She loved music, and that's why she put so much effort into producing good songs. But the mystery surrounding her overshadowed her music. No one talked about her latest song anymore; it was all about who she was and when she was going to reveal her face. There were also the paparazzi, who faked that they had finally discovered her. Although in a way that was good for keeping her in the public eye, it was taking the spotlight away from what was most important: her art and her music. And that opened her eyes. After several years of singing in disguise, wearing a mask at all hours, she decided it was time to follow her mother's advice and leave behind the mystery that had defined her for so many years. It was time to break free from the cage and finally end that dilemma and be free. She chose her new music video for this. The title asked who she was. And finally, she showed herself as she truly is. Naturally, the video went so viral that it surpassed everything she had created before. It was very rewarding for everyone, and especially for her. Her brand worked; it had brought her this far, but she needed to turn the page, and now she had. She doesn't regret anything, though; she enjoyed it while she could, and now all that's left is to enjoy what she's achieved.

> Así que el tiempo continuó pasando. Pero las cosas cambiaron de otras formas que ella no esperaba. A ella le encantaba la música y por eso ponía mucho esfuerzo en producir buenas canciones. Pero el misterio hacia su persona solapaba su a su música. Ya nadie hablaba de su último tema, todo era quien era o cuando iba a revelar la cara. También estaban los paparaziz que afeminaban siendo falso que por fin la habían descubierto. Aunque de cierta forma eso era bueno para mantenerla en a voz de todos le estaba quitando protagonismo a lo más importante, su arte y su música. Y eso le abrió los ojos. Luego de varios años cantando encubierta con mascara a todas horas decidió que era momento de seguir el consejo de su madre y dejar atrás el misterio que la había definido por tantos años. Era momento de salir de la jaula y por fin terminar con aquel dilema y tener libertad. Eligió para ello su nuevo video musical. En el titulo decía que quien era. Y por fin se mostró tal y como es. Como es natural el video fue tan viral que superó a todo lo anterior creado por ella. Fue muy gratificante para todos, y sobre todo para ella. Su marca funcionó, la había llevado hasta aquí, pero necesitaba pasar pagina y ahora lo había hecho. Pero no se arrepiente de nada, lo disfrutó mientras pudo, y ahora solo resta disfrutar de lo logrado.
![jack-sharp-NNd7_jE2Y5E-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23swc8zYG1mEjx3UimmtemXntRRPPPLMpcjn2W3hRR9ekuaihcdWaHAf6j9XdWomyM9rA.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

/> Jos welcomed us with its cool weather and serene environment. In fact, I saw Jos in its acrobatic beauty. I saw rocks carrying one another. I saw another looking like a pregnant woman with kids. It was beautiful. We visited amusement parks where we danced and played. We recorded every event using drones, cameras and phone cameras. It was one of the best, most memorable outings of the year. Thanks for reading. Bye! * * *

body.title: El Torreón de Cojímar, centinela de la historia
body.body:
> Hola, mis amigos. Que placer saludarlos. Soy una apasionada de la historia, por tal motivo hoy quiero compartir con ustedes este sitio. Si hay un lugar en La Habana que respira historia con sabor a sal y ron, ese es Cojímar. Este pueblito de pescadores, famoso por su gente brava y sus atardeceres de postal, tiene en su costa un guardián empedernido: el Torreón de Cojímar. Para los cuenteros locales, no es solo una fortaleza vieja, es el testigo mudo de piratas, cañonazos y hasta cierto escritor barbudo que se enamoró de sus aguas, Ernest Hemingway.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXcZNy9MdUi8asXE3whkYbRoF7kdsg9QGZKV5dAzvFjfR/1776889358418.jpg)

> El torreón se levanta ahí, firme, como quien cuida el maleconcilo de este barrio. Lo mandaron a construir en 1649, en esos años donde los corsarios andaban sueltos por el Caribe. Era parte del sistema defensivo de la bahía habanera, junto a su hermano el Torreón de la Chorrera. Con sus muros de piedra y su forma circular, parece un pastel de cumpleaños, pero con cañones asomándose. Desde su punto más alto, los centinelas divisaban cualquier vela sospechosa. Si veían un barco pirata, prendían fuego a un fogón y asustaban al enemigo antes de que llegara a tierra. Hoy, el Torreón está restaurado y convertido en una especie de museo. Adentro te cuentan historias de combates navales y de cómo este sitio fue clave para espantar a ingleses y holandeses. Pero lo más emocionante, para mí, es la conexión con Hemingway. El escritor, que vivía en el Finca Vigía, se volvió un asiduo de Cojímar. Aquí atracaba su yate El Pilar y se la pasaba pescando agujas y marlines. Dicen que se sentaba en la terraza del torreón a tomarse sus daiquiris mientras escuchaba los cuentos de los viejos pescadores. De esas charlas nació El viejo y el mar. Por eso, al lado del torreón hay un busto del escritor, y los pescadores locales te lo señalan orgullosos. Pero Cojímar no es solo pasado. Si te acercas al torreón cualquier tarde, te encuentras con el bullicio de los lancheros que llegan con sus capturas, el olor a fritura de los paladares cercanos y el reguetón sonando de fondo. La gente se sienta en el malecón a tomar un helado o un refresco, mientras el sol se pone como una yema de huevo detrás de la fortaleza. Es de esos lugares donde la historia se mezcla con el día a día. El Torreón de Cojímar, también conocido como Fortín de Cojímar, pertenece al sistema de fortificaciones de La Habana y fue declarado Patrimonio de la Humanidad por la UNESCO.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmUJDibgVv7QpnG7cFRyL8RrNKwrY4Tkx4636U9mec4jSH/img_8206.gif https://images.ecency.com/DQmeR514KUcazwo9QidR6DqXvT3VXLKNLMwh76kPaoFQmCe/img_9027.png

> The Cojímar Watchtower: Sentinel of History Hello, my friends. What a pleasure to greet you. I'm passionate about history, which is why today I want to share this place with you. If there's one spot in Havana that breathes history with a flavor of salt and rum, it's Cojímar. This little fishing village, famous for its tough people and postcard-worthy sunsets, has a steadfast guardian on its coast: the Cojímar Watchtower. For the local storytellers, it's not just an old fortress—it's the silent witness to pirates, cannon blasts, and even a certain bearded writer who fell in love with its waters, Ernest Hemingway.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXcZNy9MdUi8asXE3whkYbRoF7kdsg9QGZKV5dAzvFjfR/1776889358418.jpg)

> The watchtower stands there, firm, like a guardian watching over the neighborhood's little seawall. It was built in 1649, back when privateers roamed freely across the Caribbean. It was part of Havana Bay's defensive system, alongside its brother, the Chorrera Watchtower. With its stone walls and circular shape, it looks like a birthday cake—but with cannons peeking out. From its highest point, sentries could spot any suspicious sail. If they saw a pirate ship, they'd light a signal fire and scare off the enemy before they could reach land. Today, the watchtower has been restored and turned into a kind of museum. Inside, you'll hear stories of naval battles and how this site was key to driving off the English and the Dutch. But what excites me most is the connection to Hemingway. The writer, who lived at Finca Vigía, became a regular in Cojímar. He docked his yacht, El Pilar, here and spent his time fishing for needlefish and marlin. They say he would sit on the tower's terrace, sipping daiquiris while listening to the tales of the old fishermen. From those conversations, The Old Man and the Sea was born. That's why, next to the watchtower, there's a bust of the writer, and the local fishermen point to it with pride. But Cojímar isn't just about the past. If you stop by the watchtower any afternoon, you'll find the hustle and bustle of boatmen arriving with their catch, the smell of fried food from nearby paladares, and reggaeton playing in the background. People sit on the seawall, eating ice cream or drinking a soda, as the sun sets like an egg yolk behind the fortress. It's one of those places where the history blends with everyday life. The Cojímar Watchtower, also known as Fortín de Cojímar, belongs to Havana's system of fortifications and has been declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

body.title: A's secure series victory with win over Mariners! | Aaron Civale on the mound as A's seek sweep
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXAZV4uKdvipr2SETWhmTNs8j3j5bT2HWzmq4hgxvyDFi/1776541685498.png)

Ah yes even though my Phillies are utterly collapsing, my A's are looking strong which is nice. Even against the White Sox which was a series loss, the A's didn't look completely outmatched. 

Now against the Mariners, the A's essentially achieved mission accomplished already as they defeated the 2025 AL West Champions for the second game in a row, securing the series victory. Feels good! The Mariners have been looking like potentially the next great team in baseball, but the A's have something to say!

The A's recorded 13 hits in the [5-2 victory.](https://youtu.be/hzj7xtR7nbE?si=Krt_0hBRt_HpftbY) 5 different A's recorded two hits and every batter in the lineup reached base. Jeff McNeil is starting to warm up now all of a sudden. He had two hits including hitting his first homer as an Athletic! Jacob Lopez grinded through 5 1/3 innings of work. 

The A's are having this success without 2x All-Star Brent Rooker by the way. Rooker has hit 30+ homers in three straight seasons. Once he returns hopefully that will make this team even more dangerous. 

The A's still have a slim lead in the AL West. It's time to strive for even better and secure the sweep today, and begin another series against the Rangers Friday!

It's nice talking about a good baseball team before I write about the struggling Phillies LOL. 

Let's get that 14th win!

body.title: Riverside walk in Guildford  : Actifit Report Card: April 22 2026
body.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/f211013e-e3b1-4b81-a207-ceefc871e7e2.jpg) We found ourselves in Guildford once again today, due to unforeseen circumstances, but we had time to kill so we headed for the riverside walk. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/ad22ab9b-d67d-4921-bcd2-b9c0d9ab3d4a.jpg) After crossing the bridge from the town centre, we were quickly onto the riverside path. It was amazing how the scenery changed as soon as we started walking the path. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/f0abb8f7-f840-4704-b4b6-472414caa9ce.jpg) Milmead lock can be found here which provides access for boats avoiding the weir which is a little further down the way. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/928a043d-3cb9-4ec8-87c4-d3661057fe7a.jpg) A nice place for a nap! Like this swan sunning itself on the bank of the river. I have provided borh a wide angle photo and a zoomed one to give perspective of this lovely scene. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/943098e7-8b2d-4c58-87b4-8f1f0c2040c2.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/2d1cd6a7-37c7-428f-bece-0946a22441af.jpg) There is much more to explore here but we didn't have enough time today. We'll be back another day. It was a glorious walk in glorious conditions today.

body.body:
https://youtu.be/TqcMtNv3jII

In this video, I discuss the idea that even in the worst case scenario there is a path for Splinterlands to maintain at least the basic functionality of the core game for quite a long period of time. With this DAO funding proposal in the mix, many are asking the question of what happens if it doesn't pass or if the game/crypto have not recovered by the time the proposal funding period is over and I do believe it is possible for the game to carry on, even if it is in a catatonic state that is only doing the bare minimum. This isn't a prediction or a hope, just a bit of solace for those who are feeling a bit uncertain about the project's future.

body.title:
🇵🇱
Między skałą a tempem 🏃‍♂️ /
🇬🇧
Between rock and pace 🏃‍♂️: April 22 2026
body.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/2235f147-0691-4547-ab43-a2442666eeb8.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/f1282042-c2a5-4036-9869-5c99b47fc2f9.jpg)
🇵🇱 Wtorek wieczór. Plan znowu lekko się zmienił — bez porannej siłowni, za to po pracy chwila odpoczynku i wyjście na spokojne bieganie. Czasem trzeba odpuścić schemat i po prostu dopasować się do dnia. --- 🇬🇧 Tuesday evening. The plan shifted again — no morning gym, but after work some rest and an easy run. Sometimes you just adapt to the day instead of forcing the plan.
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/ebb3cfab-6dca-4a99-be34-b309ed23483d.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8f2b306d-2198-4fc9-93c2-90041b2dce98.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/b94de85f-42b5-4682-99c7-aa08a289a1d7.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/a5f4bc90-59c6-433d-b8a7-53951f9f3b85.jpg)
🇵🇱 Easy + przebieżki. Spokojne tempo, tętno nisko, wszystko pod kontrolą. Bieg bez napinki — taki, który ma budować, a nie męczyć. Na końcu kilka przebieżek. Każda trochę szybciej, aż ostatnia już na pełnej mocy. To nie był przypadek — chciałem sprawdzić, na ile pozwala mi teraz układ nerwowy. Jak szybko jestem w stanie „kręcić nogą”. I wygląda na to, że wchodzę w okolice naprawdę wysokich prędkości. --- 🇬🇧 Easy run + strides. Comfortable pace, low heart rate, everything under control. The kind of run that builds fitness without draining you. Finished with a few strides. Each one a bit faster — the last one all out. That wasn’t random — I wanted to check my current neural limit. How fast I can actually move right now. And it looks like the speed is definitely there.
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/0d41af39-c30a-40fc-8644-323e5eb2451f.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8e8b5cb6-6b19-481d-8475-5deb54a6a869.jpg)
🇵🇱 To był jeden z tych treningów, które z zewnątrz wyglądają zwyczajnie, ale w środku robią robotę. Bez presji. Bez walki. Za to z kontrolą i sygnałem, że wszystko idzie w dobrą stronę. --- 🇬🇧 One of those sessions that looks simple from the outside, but does the work underneath. No pressure. No struggle. Just control — and a clear signal that things are moving in the right direction.
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/737017d0-afaa-44ac-9b4b-447833eb74ac.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/1d5c9d95-ad9f-4274-91f8-c2e656dea6cf.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8964fc4e-06a2-4ce0-bf6a-465a7cda4751.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/03b52c33-16c3-425a-8638-39fc446d82ed.jpg)
### Post Scriptum 🇵🇱 Końcówka treningu miała jeszcze jeden ciekawy moment. Na chwilę zboczyłem z trasy i wpadłem do nieczynnego od lat kamieniołomu w Szczyrku. Surowe skały, warstwy, pęknięcia — wszystko wygląda jak zatrzymane w czasie. Miejsce z klimatem, trochę dzikie, trochę zapomniane. To był dosłownie krótki przystanek przed przebieżkami — chwila oddechu, zmiana otoczenia i powrót do biegu już na wyższych obrotach. To tylko zajawka. Do tego miejsca jeszcze wrócę — Skalite zdecydowanie zasługuje na osobny, większy materiał. --- A już po treningu — klasyka regeneracyjna: skyr + odrobina mascarpone + truskawki + białko w proszku. Prosto, szybko i dokładnie to, czego potrzeba po robocie. --- 🇬🇧 The end of the run had one more interesting moment. I briefly went off route and stopped at an abandoned quarry in Szczyrk. Raw rock, visible layers, cracks — everything feels frozen in time. A place with a strong atmosphere, a bit wild, a bit forgotten. It was just a short stop before the strides — a quick reset, change of scenery, and then back to running at higher intensity. Just a preview. I’ll definitely come back here — Skalite deserves a full, dedicated post. --- And after the run — classic recovery meal: skyr + a bit of mascarpone + strawberries + protein powder. Simple, fast, and exactly what the body needs post-workout.

Abril ha estado especialmente lindo. No sé si es la luz, la lluvia o simplemente que he estado más atenta, pero cada vez que me encuentro con flores en el camino siento que no puedo dejarlas pasar. He aprovechado cada oportunidad para detenerme un momento y capturarlas con el celular. Incluso los días de lluvia han jugado a mi favor, porque cuando salgo a caminar, el sol sigue fuerte, pero las plantas guardan ese frescor que solo el agua les deja.

La primera que llamó mi atención fue una flor roja, sencilla pero llena de vida. Me gustó cómo se levantaba sola, firme, entre el verde, como si no necesitara nada más para destacar. Tiene algo alegre, casi como un pequeño fuego en medio del jardín.

Después me encontré con unas flores blancas, aún con gotitas de lluvia sobre los pétalos. Esa imagen me atrapó sin esfuerzo. Hay algo muy limpio y tranquilo en ellas, como si transmitieran calma. Las gotas le dieron ese toque especial que no se puede inventar.

La tercera fue una flor rosada, más delicada, con un centro que resalta en amarillo y rojo. Me gustó porque tiene un equilibrio bonito entre suavidad y color. No es tan llamativa como la roja, pero tiene una elegancia que se siente.

Por último, unas pequeñas flores en tonos anaranjados, agrupadas entre hojas verdes brillantes. No son grandes ni protagonistas a primera vista, pero cuando te acercas, tienen un encanto propio. Me parecieron muy naturales, como si simplemente estuvieran ahí, sin intentar impresionar.

A veces no hace falta ir muy lejos ni tener una gran cámara. Solo mirar un poco más y aprovechar lo que aparece en el camino.



# English Version 




April has been especially beautiful. I don’t know if it’s the light, the rain, or simply that I’ve been paying more attention, but every time I come across flowers along the way, I feel like I can’t just pass them by. I’ve taken advantage of every chance to stop for a moment and capture them with my phone. Even the rainy days have helped me, because when I go out for a walk, the sun is still strong, but the plants keep that fresh touch that only the rain can give.

The first one that caught my eye was a red flower, simple but full of life. I loved how it stood there on its own, firm, surrounded by green, as if it didn’t need anything else to stand out. There’s something cheerful about it, almost like a small flame in the middle of the garden.

Then I found some white flowers, still holding tiny drops of rain on their petals. That image drew me in instantly. There’s something very clean and peaceful about them, as if they carry a sense of calm. The droplets gave them that special touch you just can’t recreate.

The third was a pink flower, more delicate, with a center that stands out in yellow and red. I liked it because it has a beautiful balance between softness and color. It’s not as bold as the red one, but it has a quiet elegance you can feel.

Finally, there were some small orange flowers, grouped among shiny green leaves. They’re not big or striking at first glance, but when you get closer, they have their own charm. They felt very natural to me, like they were simply there, without trying to impress anyone.

Sometimes you don’t need to go far or have a fancy camera. You just need to look a little closer and make the most of what appears along the way.

And as always, Le Chat was ready to go when we found her, or maybe a bit sleepy... ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/5f2138f6-f495-416f-a999-2b0c81ebc10b.jpg) Although it was very sunny earlier in the day, when we started our walk, it was more cloudy, but not bad yet (had thunder and rain overnight). ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/de8fd50d-23aa-455c-9453-fb61368da788.jpg) Because of meetings, we didn't have enough time for our usual forest and just roamed the small forest behind the front yard. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d65c774a-2bb0-41ac-8bad-1dbe295ce8c3.jpg) Like I mentioned, it's greener by the day. Soon it will be very difficult to walk through this forest without trails. That doesn't stop Kaia though, she just walks through. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/aa70614f-0207-46ce-a4b0-c7dc71bb49be.jpg) Usually we get these large puddles earlier in the year when the snow melts. But not this time because although it was colder, we never got a lot of snow. But we did get lots of rain the past few weeks, and flooding can happen near the end part of the forest. Kaia was very happy to find this one, and jumped in immediately! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/2e400837-5cf0-4902-8115-82f4fa43395c.jpg) After a few loops, we made our way back to the other side, where Kaia has other entertaining things to do, like obstacles jumping. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/4b068bec-a390-403a-944a-d95a591df973.jpg) Then they met with Le Chat for a quick grassy snack. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/2562ea1e-f070-4a93-9af4-4ec3a24b89db.jpg) Just to add a few more steps, we checked out the neighborhood for a while. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/705a788a-a2a3-494b-a6a9-0b279f8a1f88.jpg) And that was it, not enough time to reach the bar for #poprzeczka, nowhere close actually. But I hope I'm not done yet for the April session.. As always, thanks for stopping by and see you tomorrow.

body.title: Whole wheat finger buns [ENG/ESP]
body.body:
>
![post hive (85).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23wgYHnN6MTNuQAQJRcGQAxNBMg3NZCjyvpR43uyTt6naLJo4nMkEwkKC5PsjCsVPnkKm.png)
--- I recently shared a recipe for some mini whole-wheat buns. If you haven’t seen it yet, here it is. I loved this recipe—they turned out super delicious and, best of all, healthy, made with high-fiber flour. It works well for me; it doesn’t sit heavy in my stomach like regular flour does—I’ve already tested it out. That’s why I prefer to make my own breads and recipes with this flour. Anyway, that day I had some whole wheat flour and a little bit of oats left over, so to avoid wasting them, I decided to make these whole wheat finger rolls—I call them that because they turned out looking like little fingers, haha. ## Ingredients: - 1 cup oats - 1/2 cup whole wheat flour - Salt - Warm water - Baking powder - Olive oil Mix all the ingredients in a bowl until it forms a dough, roll it out, add the cheese, and then bake it in the oven for a few minutes. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23uFRYMU1cyPhGzANXynJvrYqNPFRkAb9aBvt5vhz7M44rkS66UZAWEMhz58v9qcjpncY.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23w2m8HbREvUAphzKx4rcgmyRjfoqJEsmY5YgDZYECvgC1CmCGoubj5XdBtsv79vroUrY.png) |-|-|
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/Eo6KRX5otcjwVS7FqoEKCYxdzxtXuu6XynRxqggAg3M71AGAxsjZYdr6WmDiawZ7feA.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/Eokci2FAaYMSXHjUP6UXnFpCCpt9CMQyLxQbpvAtvD61LDhziRbnF4Ae6trxmMymsqU.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/Eo4CUXLmSQxskLnKwyVSqoNxVtuT1PK79RKTVDYB6k3ath2qBYipFwm17sLpxxJjqrW.png)
And there you have our little fingers—perfect for a snack with a nice cup of coffee. Not bad at all. This week I’m taking a break from recipes, my friends. I need to stock up on new ingredients. I hope to bring you something new soon—both for you and for me. Let me know what healthy recipes you’d like to learn how to make. I’ll read your comments.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EpGS6vp2taj7EiNe3LDof1bhSfWHHAn1vkZyevBiTNgDHrELfo4ibQqbk2G8LN2txPL.png)

Deditos integrales Hace poco compartí la receta de unos mini cachitos integrales, si no lo han visto, aquí se los dejo, ame está receta, me quedaron súper ricos y lo mejor saludable, con una harina rica en fibra, y para mí está bien, no me cae pesado como la harina común, ya lo he comprobado, por eso, prefiero hacer mis propios panes y recetas con esta harina. Pero bueno, ese día me quedo algo de harina integral y un poquito de avena, entonces para no perderlo aproveche para hacer estos deditos integrales, así los llame porque quedaron cómo unos deditos jajaja. Ingredientes: 1 taza de avena 1/2 taza de harina integral Sal Agua tibia Polvo de hornear Aceite de oliva Mezclamos todos los ingredientes en un bol, hasta que nos quede cómo una masa, estiramos, le añadimos el queso, y luego lo llevamos al horno por unos minutos. Así nos quedan nuestros deditos, para merendar con cafecito bien rico, no está nada mal. Está semana me estoy tomando un break con las recetas mis amigos, tengo que prepararme con nuevos ingredientes, espero pronto poder traerles algo nuevo, tanto para ustedes cómo para mí. body.title: Servant Leadership
body.body: The concept of servant leadership started with Jesus' show of humility when he washed his disciples' feet in John 13:1-17. This act was to demonstrate the religious roles of leaders, which differed from what secular society believed about leadership. To everyone, leadership was a place where they ruled with ultimate authority, subjecting their followers to their bidding. But Jesus redefined leadership to be a place of service instead of total authority. It was a place where leaders commit to their subjects. While secular society may not embrace this, the Christian religion follows Christ's life as an example of a life with virtue.\n\n> The Commandment (Verses 14–15): After finishing, Jesus explains his actions: \

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPFiD5BFhbDJ5ze5zDxQuhLHgtQoFiTbrft7V9AQbpCCC/1776887661153.png)

**Image generated using Gemini AI**

By washing each other's feet, we are supposed to be our brother's keeper—a place where love dwells and no one feels too big to bow and wash the feet of another. It was a teaching to allow love to live among families, society, and nations, making the world a place where pride no longer lives among us or has a bearing.

I see churches practice this act of feet washing in an attempt to emulate Jesus, but beyond just feet washing, he was teaching something deeper than the physical show of humility or love. He was teaching us what true leadership is: a leadership where no one sees himself as too important to wash another's feet (to show love to them). While secular society makes leadership seem like a place of command, the Bible teaches leadership as a place of love, a place of service, and a place where humility rules over pride.

body.title: Deliciosa torta tres leches [ESP/ENG]
body.body:
> Hola a todos! uno de mis postres favoritas es la torta tres leches, y como ya saben que a Pawel y a mí nos gusta cocinar postres juntos, el fin de semana pasado decidimos intentar hacer una de estas por primera vez y la verdad es que para ser la primera vez haciendolo nos quedó muy bien y muy deliciosa, así que quise compartir la receta con ustedes, espero que les guste tanto como a nosotros. 

>Hi everyone! One of my favorite desserts is tres leches cake, and since you know that Pawel and I like to bake desserts together, last weekend we decided to try making one for the first time. To be honest, for a first attempt, it turned out really well and tasted delicious, so I wanted to share the recipe with you. I hope you like it as much as we do. 


![photo_2026-04-22_19-21-51.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRQKXjGSXGS6k9UwMgj6C96Udj2rq7Pjsy3mMQfyu1zn1/photo_2026-04-22_19-21-51.jpg)

## <center>Preparación // Preparation </center>

Comenzamos preparando el bizcocho, para eso separamos las claras y las yemas de 5 huevos y reservamos. Seguidamente preparamos nuestro molde engrasando con mantequilla para forrar con papel de horno y reservamos también, además precalentamos el horno a 170 grados. 

>We start by preparing the cake batter. To do this, separate the whites and yolks of 5 eggs and set them aside. Next, prepare the baking pan by greasing it with butter, lining it with parchment paper, and setting it aside as well. Preheat the oven to 170 degrees. 

<div class=\

> ![photo_2026-04-22_19-21-36.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYiXMMDKXM9zKvRMbsEYu3kaRJuzw2siHGVbvpqzUKwo3/photo_2026-04-22_19-21-36.jpg) Ahora vamos a tamizar 250 gramos de harina de trigo con una cucharadita de polvo de hornear y 1/4 de cucharadita de bicarbonato de sodio, reservamos. Luego en otra taza ponemos 100 gramos de mantequilla blanda con 200 gramos de azúcar y una cucharadita de esencia de vainilla, batimos por unos minutos y después agregamos las yemas una por una, seguimos batiendo hasta obtener una mezla suave y homogénea. >Now sift 250 grams of all-purpose flour with 1 teaspoon of baking powder and 1/4 teaspoon of baking soda, then set aside. Next, in another bowl, combine 100 grams of softened butter with 200 grams of sugar and a teaspoon of vanilla extract. Beat for a few minutes, then add the egg yolks one at a time, continuing to beat until the mixture is smooth and homogeneous.

> ![photo_2026-04-22_19-21-38.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU9oar4bqLxdp4VtKDgcHvZfwnFEPwtm39yaFA9R3Dnha/photo_2026-04-22_19-21-38.jpg) Ahora agregamos a nuestra mezcla anterior 70 ml de leche, batimos y después agregamos a nuestra mezcla la taza con harina, polvo de hornear y bicarbonato de sodio que reservamos anteriormente, luego mezclamos hasta que todo se integre. >Now add 70 ml of milk to the mixture, whisk it, and then add the cup of flour, baking powder, and baking soda that you set aside earlier. Mix until everything is well combined.

> ![photo_2026-04-22_19-21-39 (2).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUcwWkmXK3BT7QguYtVQyNWqV2ycid5UwjDL1vCnYAk41/photo_2026-04-22_19-21-39%20(2).jpg) Llegó el momento de batir las claras a punto de nieve y una vez listas las agregamos a nuestra mezcla, revolvemos con la ayuda de una cuchara hasta que todo se integre muy bien y finalmente ponemos la mezcla en el molde para llevar al horno por 35 minutos o hasta que al introducir un cuchillo este salga limpio. >Now it’s time to beat the egg whites until stiff peaks form. Once they’re ready, fold them into the mixture using a spoon until everything is well combined. Finally, pour the mixture into the pan and bake for 35 minutes, or until a knife inserted into the center comes out clean.

> ![photo_2026-04-22_19-21-43.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUkazJoJiLFcsxaK7Ko8daYcDYYHgWjDrhV7jSz6HhcwC/photo_2026-04-22_19-21-43.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-22_19-21-42.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmV5Ut6akaNw4TWzAKD89BAkUNMbjPm5dCr3hVqYNUX6QB/photo_2026-04-22_19-21-42.jpg) Dejamos enfriar un poco el bizcocho para empezar a pincharlo con un palillo, luego preparamos nuestro remojo tres leches y para eso en una olla ponemos 250 ml de leche condensada, 250 ml de crema de leche y 250 ml de leche entera, después llevamos esto a la estufa para tibiar un poco, y seguidamente lo agregamos poco a poco a nuestro bizcocho. Finalmente llevamos a la nevera po unas 3 horas. >Let the cake cool slightly before pricking it with a toothpick. Next, prepare the tres leches syrup by combining 250 ml of sweetened condensed milk, 250 ml of heavy cream, and 250 ml of whole milk in a saucepan. Heat the mixture over low heat until warm, then pour it over the cake in small amounts. Finally, refrigerate for about 3 hours.

> ![photo_2026-04-22_19-21-43 (2).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRKeUPd9fYTsBGZP1SaB454r6fU37pYFvm8Ykw8TQsFxd/photo_2026-04-22_19-21-43%20(2).jpg) Pasado ese tiempo vamos a preparar crema chantilly y para eso usamos 250 ml de crema de leche con 40 gramos de polvo de azúcar, mezclamos hasta obtener una textura suave y brillante o hasta que al levantar la batidora, la crema que queda en las varillas no se caiga. Una vez lista, cubrimos nuestra torta con esta y además le espolvoreamos canela y ya está lista para disfrutar. Les cuento que la torta quedó muy deliciosa, a todos nos encantó, pero debo decir que usamos un palillo muy grande para pinchar la torta y por eso creemos que esa fue la razón por la que solo quedó mojada la mitad de la torta, aún así la disfrutamos toda, seguramente la proxima quedará mejor porque sí, seguro que haremos otra pronto porque está nos encantó. >After that time has passed, we’ll make whipped cream. To do this, we’ll use 250 ml of heavy cream and 40 grams of powdered sugar. We’ll mix until the mixture has a smooth, glossy texture or until, when we lift the mixer, the cream clinging to the beaters doesn’t drip off. Once it’s ready, we’ll cover the cake with it, sprinkle some cinnamon on top, and it’s ready to enjoy. I’ll tell you that the cake turned out delicious—we all loved it—but I have to say we used a very large skewer to poke the cake, and we think that’s why only half of it got soaked. Even so, we enjoyed every bite. The next one will surely turn out better, and we’ll definitely make another one soon because we absolutely loved this one.

> ![photo_2026-04-22_19-21-45 (2).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTmnr7vM92vxsh6SnpXkNKUagiML5WF6PmA2vHWHT9WCX/photo_2026-04-22_19-21-45%20(2).jpg) ![photo_2026-04-22_19-21-45.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXsun3FEhB6WBjSHEnXNXa83V4Pb2jbK7jcPkvsTLd4qt/photo_2026-04-22_19-21-45.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-22_19-21-48.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQtD1rKaak66WZCMzMJoF7iefMCNyLepzKDW3Hh4jheJT/photo_2026-04-22_19-21-48.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-22_19-21-47 (2).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRD7hPB14EftfyzD7BdjCGBBXtAbFf5etSvhee8BRqvzp/photo_2026-04-22_19-21-47%20(2).jpg) ![photo_2026-04-22_19-21-49 (2).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXnLHWbrHxPPg3Q21233GsL4dsQt3Xxirbyex3eEQDpem/photo_2026-04-22_19-21-49%20(2).jpg) ![photo_2026-04-22_19-21-50 (2).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeJRPZeaGN515NymgzHcEJhQUuuaBc6yCK9kpPPREBHz2/photo_2026-04-22_19-21-50%20(2).jpg)

body.title: Interns deserve their pay
body.body:
Greetings!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaGa22uXXMzGnYZV1GCG2Vwwavg6tuxLGGsLYEs2C6uXE/img_20260422_wa0050.jpg)

One thing that's very important is that anybody that works must earn for what he or she is working for, being it as a worker or an intern.

Having said this, I would like to delve into the topic of the prompt which is all about, “paid interns.”

To start with, one thing that's certain and what we know interns to stand for is their act of learning and gaining experiences during that their period of internship.

However, just because they are learning and at the same time gaining experiences from the companies doesn't they should not be paid adequately and accordingly and this is because of the fact that some or let me say that, majority of them are useful to and for the company the way the normal or the permanent staff of the company are to the company.

So, just because of their usefulness to the company, they should be appropriately paid for the services rendered to the company as to me, they are also entitled to their rewards. 

Aside from this, since the company is also making money and profit during the stay of the interns, then, they should be paid. 

Also, this interns are in need of money for their upkeep, and just because they are learning and gaining experiences from their respective companies where they are doing internship doesn't mean they should not be rewarded for their little contributions to the company's growth. 

Although, some of the interns are lazy and would not even do what they are expected to do at the company where they have been undergoing their internship.

For this category of lazy interns, I think the company can find a way to deal with them appropriately so that they would be willing to improve on the purpose to which they were in the company for. I have seen some interns not doing anything in the terms of learning or gaining experiences. So, this kind of person should not be tolerated as such as they are not adding any value to the company at stake nor are they doing themselves any good.

However, the deeds of the lazy ones among them must not represent the general deeds of all of them and for those that might have been working hard and bringing success to the company, they should be adequately and promptly rewarded for their contributions. 

Although, it's not that they should be paid the actual amount given to the normal staff of the company, but just because they too would be in need of money, they should also be rewarded.

In conclusion and in my own opinion, the interns should be adequately rewarded for their contributions to the company and not for what they are being taught or the experience gained at the company and I'm of the belief that this would help to motivate them in doing more for the company. 

This is my entry to week 214, episode 02 of the weekly Featured contest in the Hive Learners community. 

Thanks for reading.
