body.body:
![P1240318.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EoTcLCRjsosVmGiCfvTM26K2ZQCD28aVV1dkAstkn6nLpVAsFWUmfzYwSCr13MoQryn.JPG)

Lara is a surname that immediately connects us to a vanished world, but whose fragments, scattered like breadcrumbs across the most solitary corners of a legendary land, illuminate the imagination of the traveler. When they decide to stray from the beaten path, they know they are treading on land where the echoes of History and Legend meet them, challenging them to delve into those primeval pools where epic tales rivaled the great deeds of universal mythology.

![P1240331.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/23wgmYgHTPqKuSgAZ3BQnimvftG2KykswKa4sS1xpv1jHGLyosNscv62SMAJzs798CkpA.JPG)

Lara de los Infantes, the privileged territory of those seven brothers—a number considered magical—who crossed the threshold into legend when they lost their heads on the orders of their stepmother, the offended Doña Lambra, is an unmissable example of this and a real-life precursor to Gone with the Wind, like in Hollywood, also in an era of unleashed violence, of suicidal clashes between civilizations, of power struggles, of pacts and betrayals, which, after all, shared a single common denominator: this land is mine.

![P1240346.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/23tSmZwMA6K7rDX8w7GYdksZEZeAqyapbFTLWuZd5kTJB7Cc3bTMSeK9P6Hw58rNfEbcz.JPG)

It is difficult to know if that land, which today seems desolate, stretching out beside the stumps of what was once a proud stronghold, was fertile then, when the peasant watered it with his own blood, transformed into an impromptu but necessary warrior, and the warlike first Counts of Castile watched the wheat ripen from the heights of its battlements. It is equally difficult to know if the beautiful 12th-century Romanesque church, whose battered foundation is visible in the distance, was, judging by the terrible wounds it displays, torn apart in two different dimensions, becoming an atypical relic whose poles point in different directions: the past and the future.

![P1240353.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EouBZR8aSFNYqpRsfcDQ9jWi6VZhV2xomzaXfTSwzYiZWvKkdLpogkmdSdAiG3V5Bug.JPG)

Lara es un apellido que enseguida nos conecta con un mundo desaparecido, pero cuyos fragmentos, distribuidos como migajas de pan por los más solitarios rincones de una tierra legendaria, iluminan la imaginación del viajero, que, cuando decide salirse de los caminos convencionales, sabe que está pisando un territorio donde los ecos de la Historia y la Leyenda le salen al paso, retándole a inmiscuirse en aquellos primitivos charcos donde la épica no tenía nada que envidiar a las grandes gestas de la Mitología universal.

![P1240375.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/23yJSynnaiaeqBLbToRLDMPcvHqfqMerKxEvHKFdhr8xsnAN3UwqBphNgbRVyQky8DKvY.JPG)

Lara de los Infantes, alfoz privilegiado de aquellos siete hermanos -número mágico por antonomasia- que atravesaron el umbral de las leyendas cuando perdieron sus cabezas por orden de su madrastra, una ofendida Doña Lambra, es un ejemplo imperdible de ello y un antecedente real de lo que el viento se llevó, como en Hollywood, también en una época de violencia desatada, de enfrentamiento suicida entre civilizaciones, de tiras y aflojas, de pactos y traiciones, que, después de todo, tenían como denominador común un único sentimiento: esta tierra es mía.

![P1240348.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EoAe6tR6XBHoSY5w4xpt4sEVLLAkLhGkunEriRjCwKZBSh2sGfDgP6XwQMBW1aeAnvC.JPG)

Es difícil saber si esa tierra que hoy parece desolada extendiéndose a la vera de los muñones de lo que antaño fuera un orgulloso baluarte era fértil entonces, cuando el campesino la regaba con su propia sangre, convertido en improvisado pero necesario guerrero y los belicosos primeros condes de Castilla veían el trigo madurar desde las alturas de sus almenas, como es difícil saber, por añadidura, si la hermosa iglesia románica del siglo XII, cuya malherida planta se ve en la distancia, quedó, a juzgar por las terribles heridas que muestra, descoyuntada en dos dimensiones diferentes, para convertirse en una reliquia atípica cuyos polos apuntan a direcciones diferentes: el pasado y el futuro.

![P1240355.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EpELHG3spVomu9UrFBajVDmB7uSTRR31r3gvEbxipUmKMpfFr7MHbRgPYEHHM7f8q6W.JPG)

body.title: Should Interns Be Paid?
body.body: > Somehow, I find this topic interesting. Maybe because I've seen similar situations and felt that this needs to be talked about. The world of service internship is an important one. This is because it allows the interns; who could be students or graduates in professional fields or individuals with some skills, to learn and have experience of what there is in that field or industry. And for some courses or fields, this is necessary. Not just for the sake of the accolades but for gaining relevant industry practical knowledge and experience. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQCtb5xYJtQpn5G922Ewt3cQCqRsNriUkSLVzyY9PjjGU/photo_1690393637175_a75f13ff6798.jpeg) [Image Source.](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-man-standing-in-front-of-a-tortoise-FmtrLDnJdek) The purpose of an internship is to learn and have the needed knowledge and experience. But here comes the conversation: Should interns be paid or not? Well, it's a relevant question because we're looking at the fact that this is an internship, and the interns are gaining from the firm's or organisation's pool of knowledge and expertise. We can say it's a gain for the interns, to have access to such. But when I look at things critically, especially in relation to my own country, I consider that it won't be a bad idea to pay interns a stipend. While I speak on this, I do it from the perspective of things in my country and part of the world. We're a people living in a financially disadvantaged situation; for the most population at least. Virtually everything people do here are expected to bring some monetary reward. Well, I don't applaud the totality of that ideology because of cases like volunteerism, which we don't see much of. Yes, because we have to be making some money. You can't blame anyone here for thinking that way, not when more than half of the population struggles to live a basic life. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaPMmQBstFb11CTfLHH3f37Z4akCzHYLvDLpbiHpAMVQM/photo_1695891689981_0be360e84d3f.jpeg) [Image Source.](https://unsplash.com/photos/two-men-sitting-at-a-desk-looking-at-a-laptop-cIocF-SSZiM) Looking at all these, I consider that some stipend could help. Some firms and organisations are so demanding that interns do the work of staff even. They do work out of their scope and yet the workers take their salaries while the interns receive not even a little allowance. If the system is working well here, I might not be so on this. Consider how much it would cost for transportation and feeding. This is someone who's interning and doing it for their future, and who is basically not earning any income. Yet, they have to cover these expenses. Some stipend or allowance won't be bad. Even if not much, but for the time and energy interns expend in the course of delivering their duties, sometimes beyond their scope of work. If an organisation can't cover the basics to sustain interns for their feeding and transportation, it should think twice before requesting or taking them. In the case where interns don't mind, then it's fine. Looking at the national service program, we see why this is necessary for interns. If they are delivering their skills, time and energy, they should be appreciated. This will serve as a boost and encouragement as well. --- ###### Thank you for reading! ----- ##### 🔗 Apps which I recommend built by sagarkothari88 | | | | |---|---|---| | body.title: Incorporated Harmlessness
body.body: > > The UK has banned the sale of cigarettes *forever* to anyone born after 2008. Good. The UK isn't the only to do it, New Zealand did it a few years ago, but a year later it was repealed by the new government, after lobbying from tobacco companies. A lot of people don't believe government intervention is the way to go with these kinds of things and that tax systems are terrible (which they are) and all that, but the fact is and quite unfortunately, this is the system we currently have, so take the wins where they exist and work toward having more wins in the future. --- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tarazkp/23wgYqdCbUvFq39vuhSxvS2te2NVEfRpSmW82BjUXdFFnuU7yqSNBZEuZJMi8S2pvmXWP.png) --- Now there is irrefutable evidence that smoking is bad for health and there have been campaigns to stop smoking since I was a little kid, so at least four decades. In Australia it has significantly reduced the number of smokers, but it is more the price than the health, since a packet of cigarettes is now up to $50 USD. That is $18,250 USD a year. Still, almost 10% of the population over the age of 14 smoke. And then there is vaping. But since it is irrefutable that smoking is bad for health, why is it that the *addicted* user bears the cost? And of course, society pays for a lot of the treatment and other costs associated with cigarette usage. What should happen instead of the user pays the tax, is that in an industry like tobacco which is irrefutably bad for the health, the tobacco company should be taxed significantly more than the corporate rate. Some percentage that *can't be reduced* through reductive accounting practices. For example, let's say a pack of cigarettes is 10 dollars in Australia. Currently, $7.50 of that is tax collected by the government, with 10% of that being goods and services tax. And of course, the government isn't going to go without their tax. So what if the tobacco company had to cover the excise tax percentage of $6.75 through their corporate tax. For them to maintain the same profits as now, they would have to significantly raise the price of cigarettes, which would have the same effect as the user paying more anyway. But there is a key difference, because the user is addicted to the cigarettes and struggles to stop, but the corporation is addicted to profit. Essentially, it should be *impossible* for a clear health damaging industry like tobacco (medical implications aside) to be profitable. Or what about if that is too complicated, tobacco companies have to pay 50% of all medical costs for smoking related illnesses and treatments? The bill each year would be split by the amount of cigarettes sold by a company and they have to pay that money as a lumpsum to the government. When it comes to harmful industries, the cost should be paid by the industry itself, because quite often the user has little choice in the matter. For instance, the tobacco and oil industries have very strong lobbyists who influence policy globally, and that policy is inflicted upon the respective populations. The cost of any harm they do, should be paid directly by the companies. Air quality and respiratory problems, micro plastics and heavy metal poisoning, and whatever else can be proven. And once proven, each case doesn't need to go to court, because it becomes a blanket rule to say when this happens and is caused by that, the bill goes to the companies. > There has to be a cost to the companies that cause harm. Because leaving it up to the user leaves the companies at an unfair advantage, as they are able to manipulate policy, influence through advertising and use a whole range of sneaky behavioural economics tricks to push users to use. And unlike the tobacco *smoking* industry that has almost zero potential for good, other than some promise in using nicotine in certain medications, there are a host of other industries that might have a mix of good and bad in them. For instance media platforms like Facebook, TikTok and Instagram, which do offer some value to users, but also creates a lot of harm for users and creators also. So what if they too were to get the bill for therapists dealing with children who have behavioural issues likely caused by over usage of the platform. What if gaming companies had to cover the costs of therapy for people who are addicted to games? What if these companies have to cover rehabilitation costs for people and improvement of learning environments? This doesn't stop them from exploiting their benefits, but it should encourage them to reduce the harms. As I see it, the economy is harmful in its current form because profits can be made even when there is significant harm to users. In a perfect world, profits would be aligned to the benefits they bring to society, not the ability to convince society to pay the costs. The deck is stacked against the enduser by both the government systems in place, and the corporate ability to drive policy and influence to the user. The user themselves is made to feel like they have a choice, even though many do not, because to do differently means to know more than is possible to know for an individual, act on it, and do things that will take away all convenience. >Corporate goods and service convenience shouldn't come at the cost of our health and wellbeing, they should be designed to improve them. Especially now with the technological push for complete automation, we should be making an enormous shift in business practices, taxes, and the way we define corporate success, to align with maximising wellbeing for people. Profits can still be made, but the competition isn't in who can convince and extract the most, but which companies can help the most. Those that do harm, are unable to turn a profit under any condition. > Clean air. Clean water. Clean earth. Clean food. Clean living. *Clear conscience.* Do no harm - or pay the price of repair. body.body:
Johannes Kepler

Saludos a toda la comunidad de HIVE, con el fin de promocionar el contenido matemático dentro de nuestra querida red social, a continuación les presento la siguiente sección en la cual se estará publicando un problema matemático a ser resuelto, los problemas abordarán diversas áreas de la Matemática (Aritmética, Álgebra, Geometría, Análisis, entre otros).

Los invito a compartir sus soluciones, sin más preámbulo les presento el problema

En una piscina, un nadador recorre 25 metros en su primer largo. En cada largo siguiente aumenta su distancia en 5 metros más que en el anterior (porque mejora su impulso en cada vuelta). Si realiza 10 largos en total: ¿Cuántos metros recorre en el último largo? ¿Cuál es la distancia total recorrida?


La matemática es la ciencia de la abstracciones, que presenta cierta belleza austera para todo aquel que decide dedicarse a su estudio.

Me despido deseándoles feliz blogging.

@ydavgonzalez\n\nPosted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@ydavgonzalez/practicando-matemticas-todos-los-das-21042026-ax8)

links.title: The Fall of Santana: Strategic Breakthrough / Freeciv Gameplay #3 [ENG🇬🇧|ESP🇻🇪]
links.body:
>

In this new stage of my Freeciv session, I have finally achieved a decisive victory: the capture of the coastal city of Santana. This triumph marks a turning point in the war against the Dahomeans, especially after the setbacks and losses I suffered in previous attempts near this location. To guarantee success, I gathered a large number of tank units in my closest border city. From there, I launched a coordinated offensive that combined land power with naval support. Battleships and destroyers opened fire from the sea to soften the defenses, while mechanized infantry moved in to secure the urban center.

#

The cost of the operation was high, as I lost several units during the assault, but the strategic advantage of controlling a coastal city of this caliber justifies the investment. Santana not only serves as a vital port for my future operations in the north but also significantly weakens the enemy's logistical network. In a conflict where every square is disputed, establishing a solid foothold on the coast allows me to project my power more efficiently and gives my fleet a safe place to regroup and repair after naval skirmishes.

#

A fundamental aspect of this conquest was the technological breakthrough. As many Freeciv players know, capturing an enemy city provides the opportunity to seize their knowledge. Since the Dahomeans possess superior technology, I managed to steal a key advancement upon taking Santana. My civilization is heavily focused on industrial production and military power, which makes independent research slow, as most of my resources are diverted to the front lines. This \

acquisition of technology is the only way my empire can stay competitive against more advanced rivals. # Finally, to ensure that this victory is not ephemeral, I have ordered my fighter jets to carry out reconnaissance missions further north. It is vital to maintain constant surveillance over the unexplored areas to prevent the enemy from organizing a counter-offensive on a different front. In Freeciv, being surprised by a hidden force can mean the loss of several conquered cities in a few turns. Maintaining air superiority and updated intelligence is the only way to protect the integrity of my new borders while I prepare the next step of the campaign. # Without anything more to add, I bid farewell. Stay tuned for future posts! Until next time!

>

En esta nueva etapa de mi partida de Freeciv, finalmente he logrado una victoria decisiva: la captura de la ciudad costera de Santana. Este triunfo marca un punto de inflexión en la guerra contra los dahomeanos, especialmente tras los reveses y pérdidas que sufrí en intentos previos cerca de esta localidad. Para garantizar el éxito, reuní una gran cantidad de unidades de tanques en mi ciudad fronteriza más cercana. Desde allí, lancé una ofensiva coordinada que combinó el poder terrestre con el apoyo naval. Acorazados y destructores abrieron fuego desde el mar para ablandar las defensas, mientras la infantería mecanizada avanzaba para asegurar el casco urbano.

#

El costo de la operación fue elevado, ya que perdí varias unidades durante el asalto, pero la ventaja estratégica de controlar una ciudad costera de este calibre justifica la inversión. Santana no solo sirve como un puerto vital para mis futuras operaciones en el norte, sino que debilita significativamente la red logística del enemigo. En un conflicto donde cada casilla es disputada, establecer una base sólida en la costa me permite proyectar mi poder de forma más eficiente y le otorga a mi flota un lugar seguro para reagruparse y repararse tras las escaramuzas navales.

#

Un aspecto fundamental de esta conquista fue el avance tecnológico. Como muchos jugadores de Freeciv sabrán, capturar una ciudad enemiga brinda la oportunidad de apoderarse de sus conocimientos. Dado que los dahomeanos poseen una tecnología superior, logré robarles un avance clave al tomar Santana. Mi civilización está fuertemente enfocada en la producción industrial y el poderío militar, lo que hace que la investigación por cuenta propia sea lenta, ya que la mayoría de mis recursos se desvían a las líneas de frente. Esta adquisición \

de tecnología es la única vía para que mi imperio siga siendo competitivo frente a rivales más avanzados. # Finalmente, para asegurar que esta victoria no sea efímera, he ordenado a mis cazas de combate realizar misiones de reconocimiento más hacia el norte. Es vital mantener una vigilancia constante sobre las zonas inexploradas para evitar que el enemigo organice una contraofensiva por un frente distinto. En Freeciv, ser sorprendido por una fuerza oculta puede significar la pérdida de varias ciudades conquistadas en pocos turnos. Mantener la superioridad aérea y la inteligencia actualizada es la única forma de proteger la integridad de mis nuevas fronteras mientras preparo el siguiente paso de la campaña. # Sin más que agregar me despido, estén atentos a los próximos post. ¡Hasta la Próxima! ------ ---- |

links.title: Project Log 6: The Kovuk & The Utility Wardrobe
links.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dinglehopper/23x1YNSiDY84Me5XB84nKP2zHKRdZLtgP1Wa6WCekYGVSb4wUcYjei4RVFVQHddHfZ8yf.png)

*The Kovuk is the most feral part of Lohummti's kit. It looks harvested. It has a jagged, prehistoric quality that ties him directly to the petrified landscape.*


### The Kovuk / Windbreaker (The Paper-Skin Shell)
The **Kovuk** is a vital piece of gear for a scout operating in the tundra that is heavy with minerals.

**Material Composition:** Cured salt lichen membrane.
Derived from the massive lichens that colonize the petrified stumps. 

**Harvest & Processing:**
* **The Peel:** Harvested in whole sheets using an axe to pull the membrane away from the mineralized bark. The lichens are gigantic here compared to real world lichens.
* **The Weld:** Seams are created by overlapping wetted edges and applying heat from a hearth stone fusing the membrane with no need for thread or sewing
* **Pressing:** The raw plant matter is hammered with smooth stones to compress the fibers into a dense sheet.

**Functional Utility:**
* **Defense:** The hardened surface deflects sharp mineral grit carried by the winds.
* **Stealth:** The brittle Kovuk remains rigid. It vibrates at a high frequency masking the scout's movement.
* **The Hem:** The fractured edges are not decorative; they shred wind turbulence and break up the wearer's silhouette against the petrified forest.

### Other Utility Wardrobe
The Nivukti wardrobe is organized by a vowel-shift that dictates environmental utility. 

* **-U (Cold/Heavy):** Denotes high-density insulation and protection against frost
    Examples:
**Opsoku** (Heavy Jacket), 
**Kuvka** (Thermal Pants), 
**Mūm** (Heavy Winter Socks)

* **-I / -A (Warm/Light):** Denotes breathable materials for high activity or summer
    Examples:
* **Ipseka** (Light Jacket), 
**Kivka** (Thin Pants), 
**Mīm** (Summer Socks)

*Opsoku can also mean shadow and Ipseka, dust*

links.body:
> 


## Hello, everyone.
I welcome you to my blog. I think there are many of us out there for whom the main reason for joining Hive was to start making some money for ourselves. Almost everyone of us, after being told about Hive, our first question was, \

Some of us felt it was just another Ponzi scheme and would crash soon, and we stepped into the space with the strategy used for Ponzi schemes, which is to withdraw earnings before the platform crashes so that in case it does, you will have no regrets. Now it has been about 5 years since joining the Hive platform, and there is not a single sign of crashing. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSgsttMAYMpHyzuLttSEMcoaBV2E5CezUA9HKMDzvrLGB/1776887353129.jpg) [Source](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-person-stacking-coins-on-top-of-a-table-jpqyfK7GB4w) The hive platform is not one you can understand from outside the hive space but one that you need to be a part of before you can fully grasp what it is all about. When my onboarder was talking, I only understood a few things he was talking about; I came to understand the rest of the things years after I joined Hive. The hive space is a very big one, and understanding it takes time and dedication. Some people see it as a platform where they can get rich quick or make quick money, and for that reason, they go all out for their earnings and withdrawal or take everything. One thing with the Hive platform is that it is decentralized, and nobody tells you what to do with your earnings, but if you look around, you will see that it is only those who choose long-term growth that have influence on the Hive platform, while those who withdraw all their earnings are subjected to being at the mercy of those who don't withdraw their earnings for curation support and every other support that they actually need to grow on Hive as well as enjoy Hive. Those who don't withdraw their earnings have more influence on the platform than those who withdraw their every earning. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWugpmpCQkZbsME1cN5nPiRvrqW7ghTA89UH8gk1n4amu/1776887353180.jpg) [Source](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-glass-jar-filled-with-coins-and-a-plant-joqWSI9u_XM) You only get to learn that those who don't withdraw all their earnings are more influential on the platform after you have been on the platform for some time, and at that point you must have been withdrawing most or all of your earnings. The fact is that to be influential on Hive, you have to think long-term, power up earnings, and power up more of your earnings than you actually withdraw. I personally choose long-term because I aim to be influential someday too. This is my entry to the India United contest; you can also join [here.](https://peakd.com/hive-197685/@indiaunited/indiaunited-new-contest-and-last-7af84b1d12ba8)

links.title: El libro que me enseñó a habitar mi presente| LOH #285
links.body:
>En la calidez de un café o en el silencio de una mañana que despierta, solemos buscar el hilo invisible que une lo que somos. El crecimiento personal no es una meta lejana, sino un lenguaje del alma; una forma hermosa de decirnos cuánto nos queremos a través de nuestras decisiones. Hoy les comparto mi respuesta a las preguntas de esta comunidad donde todas florecemos.

\n\n>

>In the warmth of a cup of coffee or the silence of a morning just waking up, we often seek the invisible thread that binds us to who we are. Personal growth isn’t a distant goal, but a language of the soul; a beautiful way of telling ourselves how much we love ourselves through our decisions. Today, I’m sharing my answer to the questions from this community where we all flourish.

\n\n
>Imagen creada con inteligencia artificial Gemini/Credit:
>Una enseñanza que me transformó de un libro/A lesson from a book that changed my life
>Hay libros que no se buscan, sino que te encuentran como un susurro. Mi encuentro con <strong>\

de Eckhart Tolle fue pura magia cotidiana. Lo había visto antes en casa de una amiga, pero el destino esperó hasta una feria del libro universitaria para ponérmelo en las manos. Ella lo había donado y allí estaba él, aguardando entre muchos otros títulos. Lo tomé con la certeza de quien recupera algo que ya le pertenecía.

\n\n>

>There are books you don’t go looking for—they find you, like a whisper. My encounter with Eckhart Tolle’s The Power of Now was pure everyday magic. I had seen it before at a friend’s house, but fate waited until a college book fair to place it in my hands. She had donated it, and there it was, waiting among many other titles. I picked it up with the certainty of someone reclaiming something that already belonged to them.

\n\n

>Leerlo fue un proceso profundamente íntimo. Me enseñó que gran parte de mi sufrimiento no nacía de mis vivencias, sino de los laberintos de mi mente, atrapada en ecos del pasado o sombras del futuro. Aprendí que <span class=\

>el ahora es el único hogar real y a observar mis pensamientos con ternura, sin creerlos todos. Recomiendo este camino porque nos devuelve el derecho a respirar sin el peso de lo que ya fue o lo que será.

\n\n>

>Reading it was a deeply personal experience. It taught me that much of my suffering didn’t stem from my experiences, but from the labyrinths of my mind, trapped in echoes of the past or shadows of the future. I learned that <span class=\

>the present is the only real home and to observe my thoughts with kindness, without believing every single one of them. I recommend this path because it restores our right to breathe without the weight of what has already been or what will be.

\n\n
>Imagen creada con inteligencia artificial Gemini/Credit:
>Mi propósito: El arte de descubrirse/My Purpose: The Art of Self-Discovery

>Mi razón para vivir hoy no es algo grandioso o rígido; es algo suave y profundamente humano. Como profesional recién graduada, me motiva saber que hay un mundo infinito de oportunidades esperando en cada curso o maestría, pero mi motor real es aprender a escucharme y construir una vida que se sienta verdaderamente mía.

\n\n>

>My reason for living today isn’t something grand or rigid; it’s something gentle and deeply human. As a recent graduate, I’m motivated by the knowledge that there’s an endless world of opportunities waiting in every course or master’s program, but what truly drives me is learning to listen to myself and build a life that truly feels like my own.

Aunque tengo mis metas en la agenda y mi vision board en la repisa, lo que me mantiene en pie cada mañana es: >

>Even though I have my goals written down in my planner and my vision board on the shelf, what keeps me going every morning is:

\n\n*

>La mujer en la que me estoy convirtiendo./The woman I'm becoming.

\n*

>Las palabras que aún no he escrito./The words I haven't written yet.

\n*

>Las versiones de mí que todavía no conozco./The versions of myself that I haven't met yet.

\n\n

>Entendí que el propósito no se encuentra de golpe; se revela en lo cotidiano, en lo que eliges sostener y en lo que decides ya no cargar. Confío en que, en este proceso de búsqueda, la vida misma va cobrando sentido.

\n\n>

>I realized that purpose isn’t something you stumble upon all at once; it reveals itself in the everyday, in what you choose to hold onto and what you decide to let go of. I believe that, in this process of searching, life itself begins to make sense.

\n\n
>Imagen creada con inteligencia artificial Gemini/Credit:

>Cuéntame: ¿Quién estás siendo hoy y quién sientes que estás aprendiendo a ser?

\n\n>

>Tell me: Who are you today, and who do you feel you’re learning to become?

\n\n

links.title: My mind reason for living #285
links.body:
Good day, amazing people of the Hive blockchain. Welcome back to my blog. It is another beautiful week. #ladiesofhive topic Right now in your life, what feels like your main reason for living? How would you describe your purpose at this moment, and what keeps you moving forward each day?


![IMG_0770.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cindynancy/48ikMMQJr3E6anvhar9ji7bc4FupvHLZpfDqp6gbYDEV28qJtUoXwYyu2TpikFvYPQ.png)



Every one of us has a purpose for living. I don't think there is life without purpose; it is very important that we understand our purpose here on earth and why we are living. When you understand your purpose here on earth, you will walk in the right direction. There are times I will sit and ask myself, 'What is my purpose here on earth?' This topic puts me in deeper reflection. Currently now I have one main reason for living, and if I am able to fulfil it, I will be very happy.





Right now many main reasons for living are to make my parents proud. I want to build a career that will enable me to support myself and my family. I am not only after building myself; my family is my biggest priority because they matter to me. My focus is not only on my personal growth; building a career for myself is more than earning money. It will help me build an empire where I and my family will live happily without stress.



Every effort I put in is to make sure that I build a beautiful career for myself to be able to take responsibility and care for the people that matter the most in my life. At this point my purpose is to secure a beautiful future for myself and my family. A career doesn’t grow overnight; it takes time. Of course there will be challenges, a period of giving up and a period I will doubt myself. Like this, it motivates me never to give up because I am not only building for myself but also for people who matter the most to me.




![ChatGPT Image Apr 22, 2026 at 08_25_49 PM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cindynancy/242YLGXFj2dGbkaSzAW1Jmy5FSGxDnvpqhvP5baA5LiaTGE3WVNTdk7bsYeaCebeHEwwu.png)



When I look at my parent, I see every reason to keep moving forward because I want to make them proud. They are the main reason I will never give up and also the reason why I always push. Everyone has a purpose; we should try our best to discover our purpose on time.

***All images is generated with meta AI***

This is my entry on the ongoing weekly prompts #ladiesofhive topic. Right now in your life, what feels like your main reason for living? How would you describe your purpose at this moment, and what keeps you moving forward each day?



Thank you for stopping by my blog. I appreciate your comment, support and upvotes. Do have a lovely day.

links.title: My entry to the Feathered Friends - Show Me A Photo Contest Round 267 [En-Es] Pinky, a little creole hen
links.body:
![20260422_150758.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elentogether/23vsQTB6UULGiQv5k5tcUXMijpnfTFgyEse2sg3akdkHEaGHrcBsSwea27vDXTBWex3iY.jpg)

<center>

**How are you friends?, I hope you are very well.**

> **¿Qué tal amigos?, espero que estén muy bien.**
</center>
---

<center>
![20260330_090119.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elentogether/23t7mRRZBkzNQApkbgNwuDfXGiXDXdYmmy1mBw596Y2nUnVLLNQMBHCzWeEGVVWCnWiPk.jpg)
</center>

**Caring for this little hen has allowed me to touch a feathered friend again. I hadn't done it since Chico, our parakeet, died a few years ago.**

> **Cuidar a esta gallinita me ha permitido tocar de nuevo a un amigo con plumas. Yo no lo hacía desde que murió Chico, nuestro periquito, hace algunos años.**

---

<center>
![IMG-20260317-WA0063.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elentogether/23uFPqVwUb9wgGLTQJcpukLUxLMARnZgoiUv7juvQsN1y3PfFPbemGqFzmAd8AVG86kvD.jpeg)
</center>

**Pinky, as we call her, was brought by my veterinarian sister. She was near her house, saw some dogs chasing her and ran to rescue her without knowing what sex it was.**

> **A Pinky, que es como la llamamos, la trajo mi hermana veterinaria. Ella estaba cerca de su casa, vió a unos perros persiguiéndola y corrió a rescatarla sin conocer de qué sexo era.**

---


![20260404_182034.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elentogether/23xoyouApKubogGm4z58AHB6Ch6CBELTWDaqH716udLGui3xySjPcQPCodeRzJVwiY1SM.jpg)

**She had a head wound and couldn't open one of her eyes.**

> **Tenía una herida en la cabeza y no podía abrir uno de sus ojos.**

---

<center>
![20260327_155609.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elentogether/23wMWRz1r2h3rfpNcprpznU9vgpacqcSCBJNw96r5H6KP4sfjoX4GF1T7zEg5JGia2fgU.jpg)
</center>

**We thought she was kept in a house because one of her wings was clipped. Also, she is very tame, she lets herself be carried and eats from the hand.**

> **Creímos que la tenían en una casa porque una de sus alas estaba cortada. Además, es muy mansa, se deja cargar y come de la mano.**

---

<center>
![20260327_170353.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elentogether/23x14sQVWnifiA9HnYMdxa3BXUb4HDgCrmgcs2MC7tnyVQu61h98ZQKAmnyDhBQaXkv8p.jpg)
</center>

**Since we have dogs and cats, at first, she was in an improvised mini-corral most of the time.**

> **Como tenemos perros y gatas, al principio, casi todo el tiempo estaba en un minicorral que improvisamos.**

---

<center>
![20260419_140446.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elentogether/23xyXDKCaQRgFAyuN8XqEsyaUwxbD6DNNBmtMfKWoDZBFEpDtvQwhDyBiBKw3yN3Yyw2x.jpg)

![20260327_155452.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elentogether/23vsLK54EJ2vgmM1APcjrLKis1hgWiL8CWowPgajHzrBetVFhvLjsHgMmXER9BiDcM5W6.jpg)
</center>

**From time to time we let her walk but we would lock her up again for fear that they would hurt her.**

> **De vez en cuando la dejábamos caminar pero volvíamos a encerrarla por temor a que le hicieran daño.**

---

<center>
![20260330_171111.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elentogether/23tmFUmgw2sQ9ZxzoGbZiPRc7GYuU7tfAn6tF6kXg8LWBUTLp742gkn7252uWB7tMncMS.jpg)

![20260330_171127.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elentogether/23u652hwZpsWo4pQcwCGeAcbH9qDA38KDAUjHuYBy5EJpewBj2zPyBs22kXBv8Up8cBGC.jpg)

![IMG-20260317-WA0065.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elentogether/23xKtdLETEVq7PaDZx1bUBxnHSE7VLSZG78f1H1k4K9ewwf1zX95v8DVktozYNQeut9VZ.jpeg)

![20260327_170436.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elentogether/23uQpVWRHkFN1rjFZvH4UparBSf6QfrgbP2MDiEzKEgRLtsVZZXtNyNzzd3cyms6aM6yr.jpg)
</center>

**Later she grew up and the rest of the pets got used to her.**

> **Después creció y el resto de las mascotas se acostumbró a ella.**

---

<center>
![20260319_133427.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elentogether/23uFRNEZaBMX5WNmkCKZyfP93W9EGcYpvewW4jgkjuypWH5rXgo9RBYYZcNdfB6szcqme.jpg)

![20260319_133433.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elentogether/23tmFr36gbLn16x9qRYuBYzKRF5m9yXVh8fs1CDUpYVkZ4bxB4RLxDLwWuWjCn2KN7AMi.jpg)
</center>

**As she began to walk with difficulty, thinking that inactivity had affected her legs, we decided to let her free.**

> **Como comenzó a caminar con dificultad, pensando que la inactividad le había afectado las patas, decidimos dejarla libre.**

---

<center>
![20260330_090109.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elentogether/23tSYuNrCU2y3qnKNACDM2vCDggF3UU7SUq8XAbTRQSGd3UTSFVXS5Kantnda1g8cYStj.jpg)

![20260316_075357.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elentogether/23vhya4aiY5zykoczYihSLT8w9sSuCPmX612g8aXHfT6DGVthqF9Jwi6kXmRPrCCHKLRm.jpg)

![20260330_171509.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elentogether/23xAXkbgrgpRiB1DdFn2NF1Gwn1YiLxUugpB18TbYyiy7DF1GgSoDRT2F8mtEuXjYX9pG.jpg)

![20260330_090112.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elentogether/23tSYghZPETxpW8fPEQ9z1YNHgGxuAUHAvz5QtiVaJsMjZTNqULnMjXCJBjrTWY1v2HUX.jpg)

![20260330_171531.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elentogether/23wMaJfGfyTedbeFbPkxtvt3eSKF5xisL7DnQd9Uzoh4dWytiXQhHfpt85oz1sN9WGua5.jpg)

</center>

**But something prevents her from enjoying the patio. Sometimes she goes, walks a little, then comes into the house and rests here.**

> **Pero algo le impide disfrutar del patio. A veces va, camina un poco, luego entra a la casa y aquí descansa.**

---

<center>
![20260421_142313.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elentogether/23w2f46FL6qiWdCAxEKmeWp1aDqKjvvykojrYZGmv5uB8p1LqShYqmSkc3SVLNQxUFoKm.jpg)


**And at night he continues to sleep in her little pen.**

>**Y de noche sigue durmiendo en su corralito.**



![20260404_182037.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elentogether/23xoytCXGouqcDqQb3zKZHXqMWhYxaMTsJb8cGLzmfoLe3jmviQ2fCGTz4m8T1JJWASMF.jpg)


**All photos were taken with my Samsung Galaxy A15 smartphone.**

>**Todas las fotos fueron tomadas con mi teléfono inteligente Samsung Galaxy A15.** 

![20260330_090811(1).gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elentogether/23vi21QT4A7vu1YqNMDSKnaW8ArAw1fBnNP7KUfQSucE8ZAZtsd8a4LtWuFGwf9TTNgRV.gif)
</center>

**Thank you so much for stopping by and reading my post.**

>*Muchas gracias por detenerse y leer mi publicación.*

![Presentación Mi proyecto Final Femenino Delicado Rosa y Nude.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elentogether/23wXQcW8JRJd8imKFZA3Dy18RijyjDHUdiC5TgotdiqGY4T3Qgdfd52nijjcAxkWDLDQx.jpg)
*Imagen hecha con [Canva](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Canva).

links.title: My Aboki Friend And Suya.
links.body:
I stopped by this aboki shop on my street to buy suya as I was coming back from work.

Immediately he saw me, he shouted, “Customer! Customer! Shebi na ₦500 own you want?”

I said, “No o, not today. I want ₦1,000 own.”

He smiled immediately and said, “Ahh, today good o! This one you want ₦1,000 own. Before na ₦500 suya you dey buy. I don sabi you well well.”

I just laughed. “Na so nah. Today good. Abeg give me correct ₦1,000 own… and cut plenty onions put inside.”

He said, “No wahala. Today wey you buy plenty, I go package am well for you.”

As he was slicing the onions, I still reminded him again, “Please o, I love onions, you have to add more.”

He said, “Okay.”

After that, he wanted to sprinkle small pepper on the suya.

I said, “No o, this one no go reach, please add more pepper.”

He looked at me and said, “Haaa! You know say no be ordinary pepper. Na yaji.”

I said, “Yes na, I know. That’s why I’m telling you to add more.”

He started explaining how strong yaji spice is and how people even use it to cook food.

I said, “Exactly! Na wetin I dey talk. Add more for me.”

He added small again and wanted to close it.

I still stopped him.
“No, no… this one still no do. Abeg, add more.”

He now looked at me somehow and said,
“Customer, you want make I finish my yaji for this your ₦1,000 suya? Pepper don too much o.”

I said, “I’m not complaining. Just add am. I know wetin I dey do.”


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmde3NhtHo8v3UyyGpwvFXqYnfDqt86zFaq4GT6y72gxsD/screenshot_20260422_203431.jpg)

He shook his head but still added more.

I thanked him and told him to tie it for me.

As he was tying it, he was still talking. “I just dey wonder why you want too much pepper today. Before before, you no dey do like this.

I just kept quiet… because this man don dey talk too much already.
  

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcKqsxd1d1T7en8VcTUYy2mFpQYjdWsvXYJViuNnmduJ3/screenshot_20260422_202745.jpg)


Because how I wan take explain give am say…

Na this same pepper and onions I wan use cook jollof rice when I reach house.

This man no know say na complete ingredients and protein I come buy for him shop with my last 1k.

Abeg, put am for nylon make I dey go house. 
 
#HealthyLiving #wave #ecency #hive.blog,#kachi2024, #sarahbaby, #ekeke, #therichking, #preshy007#hivefoodology, #amara. 

#ekeke

links.title: Spirit Harvest.
links.body: > After reaching Shibuya station and defeating a student of misery, I followed a vision of Rinko to find a locker key. After being ambushed by Shine dancers near a Torii gate, I returned to defeat them and cleared a graveyard of demons using stealth and quick reflexes. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV3riDyk3VyLKKBW4deVNr9pc3dokxfTajFK4Zh9es6wH/screenshot_1_.png) I found a student of misery after reaching Shibuya station. I took her down really fast with my powers and absorbed some spirits that were floating nearby. It felt good to clear the entrance and gather more energy before heading deeper into the massive station complex. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSYig7nS5UDkR6dzWzzsE24zoMfjskiGoNmrcb3rKckQ9/screenshot_2_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme17CEwSRjburWCFgcT8K8fnzoyjDLVEKpVjpNc4SfpyQ/screenshot_3_.png) Then I found a vision of Rinko and it looked like she was using the spirit transmission lens to get around through the telephone booth to stay hidden from the visitors. I watched her ghostly form interact with the equipment, realizing she had been moving through the city in ways I had not yet mastered. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQEPFQbRhhfxCh3zRyWzcekPgzQ8u3jWUrHYuSmyNVypA/screenshot_4_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYpXHa8JTaG4g7egQw21RCNjfWzzSCziDgdzc2Ab86qjb/screenshot_5_.png) After absorbing some more stray spirits on my way, I reached the lockers of the station. I searched the area and found a key and a note left behind by Rinko. The message was meant for KK in case she could not find Erika, providing a vital clue for my next objective in this haunted city. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR9yNW4qcpxqCs4khJP7JgZHvXm4WwsRpLgCvNEErkmdj/screenshot_6_.png) Then I fast traveled to the Torii gate I had cleansed last to save some time. After climbing onto a nearby roof to get a better view, I noticed two demons standing below at a graveyard. They seemed to be guarding something important, and I stayed low to plan my approach without being spotted. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmehR8BJnVcj7UJX4yugjzGNWfh8SiBG7RBgdpFDBb18DK/screenshot_7_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbTw98UHtAfdZGzRCRVk9C6nPopa7itPvWYACZc3StUnA/screenshot_8_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP7k8pATPwH81jzY8TBwGr8QHiM5aQLjvVpGQnjCBcr7M/screenshot_9_.png) Before I could even approach the graveyard, I was suddenly ambushed by two Shine dancers. I didn't see them as a big problem at first, but they moved with incredible speed and took me down real fast with their rhythmic attacks. I hit the ground before I could even draw enough power to defend myself. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXvSShMANZVs7Ykczsakdmwu2tQt1WuUJpHBe31z5atRc/screenshot_10_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVip4o5FSBCtehUc4qrNfsnmxsjT2PHZKcD52aqSLUkwK/screenshot_11_.png) I was respawned right at that Torii gate where I had fast traveled last time. This time I stopped there for a moment to check around the area more carefully. I didn't want to get surprised again, so I looked for any shimmering air or sounds. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaUNE46mZqGQra7WNYBocae8xReuqqcjKv2uMeiL5ps18/screenshot_12_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTAmEKUw7iP6URRLgst8FKe9F9Fsvf5kRU4DZe9Je7Hr3/screenshot_13_.png) I climbed up on the rooftop again with the help of a Tengu that was hovering nearby. Those Shine dancers came to ambush me once more as soon as I reached the roof, but I didn't give them the chance to strike this time. Instead, I stayed aggressive and took them both down before they could start their dance properly. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVDkzHND9GLenw9eoRoACzXYBEjws4jEUHCUeHzWfVUUu/screenshot_14_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbbUSDAFCer2D7UDzF3XdPRbVacoV92cXewnmw1q6wWmj/screenshot_15_.png) Then I checked on the demons below in the graveyard once the rooftops were safe. I jumped down to get close to them. The air felt heavy with spirit energy, and I knew I had to move with absolute silence to win. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd2A5HLfZkWxHGJyciDQBPf7pvbD391ZwhGfAjimPn3QJ/screenshot_16_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXuFRbLV8toeJRqfU1wog8N1QEKJ1yFhzX6afeY87XjKi/screenshot_17_.png) I had been ensured the rain slasher on the other side would not see me fighting this one, so I went for this rugged walker and took him down in stealth with a quick strike. After he vanished, I absorbed the spirit he was guarding. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ7aJCEScEDooEmWbMXAuxiKszWiFspqYYrvVSzeGwqww/screenshot_18_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmadNJUyGYF1ZfGUFWGKzLNP2TCp9iVCMbeCHMuraJamyy/screenshot_19_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbQF6ecCzi8NRFdZVQDi89vTVQzJBuFQ1MSH61x7x4np1/screenshot_20_.png) Then I jumped over towards the rain slasher, hoping I could take her down in a stealth move as well. However, she somehow saw me at the last second and started attacking me with her blades. I took her down after a brief struggle, just before she almost took me down. We'll continue in another post. --- **Thanks for reading. If you like my post, please follow, comment and upvote me. All the in-game screenshots are taken by me, just the games logo is borrowed from deviantart.** --- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=hrichakar/4b6eca7d)

I didn't want to get surprised again, so I looked for any shimmering air or sounds. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaUNE46mZqGQra7WNYBocae8xReuqqcjKv2uMeiL5ps18/screenshot_12_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTAmEKUw7iP6URRLgst8FKe9F9Fsvf5kRU4DZe9Je7Hr3/screenshot_13_.png) I climbed up on the rooftop again with the help of a Tengu that was hovering nearby. Those Shine dancers came to ambush me once more as soon as I reached the roof, but I didn't give them the chance to strike this time. Instead, I stayed aggressive and took them both down before they could start their dance properly. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVDkzHND9GLenw9eoRoACzXYBEjws4jEUHCUeHzWfVUUu/screenshot_14_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbbUSDAFCer2D7UDzF3XdPRbVacoV92cXewnmw1q6wWmj/screenshot_15_.png) Then I checked on the demons below in the graveyard once the rooftops were safe. I jumped down to get close to them. The air felt heavy with spirit energy, and I knew I had to move with absolute silence to win. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd2A5HLfZkWxHGJyciDQBPf7pvbD391ZwhGfAjimPn3QJ/screenshot_16_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXuFRbLV8toeJRqfU1wog8N1QEKJ1yFhzX6afeY87XjKi/screenshot_17_.png) I had been ensured the rain slasher on the other side would not see me fighting this one, so I went for this rugged walker and took him down in stealth with a quick strike. After he vanished, I absorbed the spirit he was guarding. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ7aJCEScEDooEmWbMXAuxiKszWiFspqYYrvVSzeGwqww/screenshot_18_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmadNJUyGYF1ZfGUFWGKzLNP2TCp9iVCMbeCHMuraJamyy/screenshot_19_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbQF6ecCzi8NRFdZVQDi89vTVQzJBuFQ1MSH61x7x4np1/screenshot_20_.png) Then I jumped over towards the rain slasher, hoping I could take her down in a stealth move as well. However, she somehow saw me at the last second and started attacking me with her blades. I took her down after a brief struggle, just before she almost took me down. We'll continue in another post. --- **Thanks for reading. If you like my post, please follow, comment and upvote me. All the in-game screenshots are taken by me, just the games logo is borrowed from deviantart.**

links.title: GPT-5.4: OpenAI Merged Reasoning and Code into a Single Engine
links.body:
## What GPT-5.4 Is

GPT-5.4 is the fusion of advanced reasoning with the coding capabilities of GPT-5.3-codex — the specialized model OpenAI previously used separately for programming tasks. Instead of having two models that complement each other, there is now one that does both well.

Think of it as a Swiss Army knife that finally has a good blade. Swiss Army knives always had many tools, but the main knife was mediocre. GPT-5.4 is the version where the main blade actually got sharp.

## The Number That Changes the Conversation

GPT-5.4 is 33% less likely to make errors in individual factual claims than GPT-5.2, and full responses are 18% less likely to contain errors overall. That might sound like cold statistics, but in practice it means less hallucination, less invented information, less rework for those who use the model professionally.

For an analyst using AI to draft reports, or a developer asking for code explanations, that error reduction is not trivial. It's the difference between trusting the answer and always having to verify everything from scratch.

## 1 Million Token Context

The model supports context windows of up to 1 million tokens. To put that in perspective: a 300-page book contains around 100,000 words. With 1 million tokens, you can process something between 5 and 10 complete books in a single session.

In practice, this opens possibilities that were previously theoretical: analyzing entire codebases, processing extensive legal contracts, reviewing technical documentation for complex products without losing prior context.

## Native Computer Use

One of the most talked-about additions is native computer use capability — in Codex and the API, GPT-5.4 is the first general-purpose OpenAI model capable of interacting with graphical interfaces, clicking buttons, filling out forms, and navigating systems as if it were a human user.

This positions GPT-5.4 as a real automation agent, not just an assistant that generates text about what to do. It can execute.

## GPT-5.4 Thinking: The Version That Reasons Out Loud

There is a variant called GPT-5.4 Thinking that shows the reasoning plan before responding. It's not just the final result — it's the process. For complex tasks like deep web research, data analysis, or decision-making with multiple variables, seeing the model's reasoning helps identify flaws before they become problems.

This version is available for ChatGPT Plus, Team, and Pro plans.

## Tool Search for Agents

Another relevant advance for those building agent systems: GPT-5.4 includes a feature called **tool search**, which helps the model find and use the right tools within large ecosystems. When an agent has access to dozens or hundreds of tools, knowing which one to use and when is just as important as knowing how to use it.

## What to Expect

GPT-5.4 is not the end of the race — OpenAI is already on GPT-5.4 and continues iterating. But it represents the moment when reasoning and coding stopped being a choice and began to coexist natively. For those who use AI in daily work, that is worth paying attention to.

links.title: (ESP/ENG) ✨✍️ A veces es bueno detenerse / Sometimes it's good to stop ✨✍️
links.body:
#
CONTENIDO EN ESPAÑOL

¡Hola a todos los integrantes de esta comunidad y amantes de la escritura creativa! Mientras me encontraba observando la fotografía propuesta para el [concurso](https://peakd.com/hive-192096/@lanzjoseg/concurso-observa-piensa-escribe-8fe489d7947e8), no pude evitar pensar en esos eventos que inevitablemente, nos hacen detenernos, ya sea paulatina o abruptamente, no como una forma de \

, sino más bien como una oportunidad para reflexionar sobre lo que estamos haciendo o dónde nos encontramos.
![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23xedoKLUBnM6s2UWpV7sqSdxza5AUF2He6t4eRhn5MCG3kz7N3Rp1XbtAwLhB4kRs1eJ.png)

Parecer que estamos acostumbrados a ser eficientes y a dar todo de nosotros hasta el cansancio. Como comenté en mi post pasado, una rutina de sobre esfuerzo, no sólo nos lleva a la obsesión por el trabajo, sino también a ser incapaces de descansar. Porque, cuando estamos demasiado agotados, a veces se nos hace imposible poder recuperarnos en poco tiempo y es peor cuando sientes que tu cuerpo \

.
De hecho, cuando estoy muy cansada, siento que me cuesta dormir. Mi cerebro sigue activo y mi cuerpo, es incapaz de relajarse, lo cual se agudiza ante mi insomnio. Aunque no he podido aprender del todo a descansar, he buscado arduamente las formas de tener un equilibrio, ya sea teniendo un horario para realizar mis actividades o limitarme con la cantidad de tareas en las que puedo enfocarme en el día, sin mencionar nunca olvidar prestar atención a pequeños detalles, como los que muestra una mente cansada, así como darme un pequeño premio por mi arduo esfuerzo.
Y es que, hemos olvidado que aunque no somos una máquina, nuestro cuerpo es semejante a una. Es el \

de nuestro ser y como toda máquina, requiere de sus cuidados. Si nos sobre esforzamos, es natural que nuestra máquina falle y se detenga. Es en esos momentos en los que tenemos que reflexionar sobre lo que estamos haciendo.
Siempre nos quejamos si algo no sale como quisiéramos o nos enfermamos \

. Pero un pequeño bache en nuestro camino, puede significar el momento crucial para poner nuestra vida en orden. Quizás, en ese momento la vida y tu propio cuerpo te están tratando de dar un mensaje, quizás recordándote que no es necesario ir tan deprisa o esos planes que tenemos en mente, no son tan maravillosos como lo creemos. A veces, es bueno detenerse, porque en la calma, somos capaces de ver detalles que habíamos pasado por alto.
### ✨ Muchas gracias por haber visitado mi publicación. Espero que les haya parecido interesante ✨
![Sue taza.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/AK7w4GdH1MPQStuqcVxKZ7aLEz1CNG33KwxnKAnYGM9U9kSYaEBvhSvZfbHwHty.gif)

#
💚 ¡Hasta una próxima oportunidad! 💚

![Separador.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23ydCKUob6Veoru2WkSHzGEJYsVaCtXW1faq9AvNDGGoHQ7EK3BnMYaWz3Kvh37TGkuVa.jpg)
#
ENGLISH CONTENT

Hello to all members of this community and lovers of creative writing! While I was looking at the photograph submitted for the [contest](https://peakd.com/hive-192096/@lanzjoseg/concurso-observa-piensa-escribe-8fe489d7947e8), I couldn't help but think about those events that inevitably make us stop, whether gradually or abruptly, not as a form of \

but rather as an opportunity to reflect on what we are doing or where we are.
![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23xedoKLUBnM6s2UWpV7sqSdxza5AUF2He6t4eRhn5MCG3kz7N3Rp1XbtAwLhB4kRs1eJ.png)

It seems we're used to being efficient and giving our all until we're exhausted. As I mentioned in my last post, a routine of overexertion not only leads to workaholism but also to an inability to rest. Because when we're too exhausted, it's sometimes impossible to recover quickly, and it's even worse when you feel like your body \

In fact, when I'm very tired, I find it hard to sleep. My brain stays active, and my body is unable to relax, which is exacerbated by my insomnia. Although I haven't been able to fully learn how to rest, I've diligently sought ways to achieve balance, whether by setting a schedule for my activities or limiting the number of tasks I can focus on each day, not to mention never forgetting to pay attention to small details, like those that a tired mind reveals, as well as giving myself a small reward for my hard work.
And the thing is, we've forgotten that although we aren't machines, our bodies are similar to one. They are the \

of our being, and like any machine, they require care. If we overexert ourselves, it's natural for our machine to fail and stop. It's in those moments that we need to reflect on what we're doing.
We always complain if something doesn't go as planned or if we get sick \

But a small bump in the road can be the crucial moment to put our lives in order. Perhaps, at that moment, life and your own body are trying to give you a message, perhaps reminding you that it's not necessary to go so fast, or that those plans we have in mind aren't as wonderful as we think. Sometimes, it's good to stop, because in the calm, we are able to see details we had overlooked.
### ✨ Thank you so much for visiting my post. I hope you found it interesting ✨
![Sue taza.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/AK7w4GdH1MPQStuqcVxKZ7aLEz1CNG33KwxnKAnYGM9U9kSYaEBvhSvZfbHwHty.gif)

#
💚 Until next time! 💚

# <center> ✦ ***I'm Just Adrift (Monologue)*** ✦</center>

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdhZSs6aFtZcGbVqQKfnoTWhqF8Q8nhaZzt6KtDdM9hZz/image_4gswjkdxes_pfhu_dymib.webp)


#### 📸https://raphael.app/es

I'm floating in this pool and I think my life preserver is deflating. Am I depressed? Who? Me?...No...no, no, and no, I'm just adrift, and floating adrift isn't the same as being lost in a sea of ​​possibilities. Floating, floating takes technique.

What if I quit my job? What if I used a text message? And I used a laughing emoji at the end. So what? Is that unserious? I thought about using the explosion emoji. I have thousands of messages from my boss, but no desire to hear his voice, so I didn't even open them. I don't want them marked as read. Anyway, I've taken a vacation, and this float? I stole it from my neighbor. It's shaped like a unicorn and has rainbow decorations. Isn't it cute?!
What if I spent my savings at this five-star hotel and I'm unemployed? That's not being lost, that's floating. For the first time, I've spent three hours staring at the clouds. I only opened my eyes when the unicorn started making a rather obscene noise: pssssss, very obscene indeed, it's deflating, look at my life! How curious! The water's already up to my chin.

But how happy I am, floating, drifting aimlessly, everything's easier here, everything's simpler. Do I have a plan? Of course I do, to take the little money I have left and buy another life preserver. Aaaah, about my job? That's the one that's really adrift.

#### <center>─── ❖ ── ✦ ── ❖ ───</center>  
 ![](https://images.ecency.com/p/3ossSWoLBnTDQ1TvAjS9Kmow57ZbFshVns79LnDvVUgHmyB6wd16NRx56R33JmgTV6Lbh41zkpSVr5ou4TryEoAMMYQwT66EFbNybWKw9DcxBGgtP8cEYXGoFzvLxt9bJU1exVtC7Bo4ScXWZaPEkSciz4F4Mu44m83fqhLpP5iEpQdimxeKYvy96eb2M4gQrPoPtLNAEgH2vrBtxYJQNPyGJdcvvBib4LPmU8RHM4FAqezegCkeFq9DMqAXPXWchZ4s?format=match&mode=fit)
#### <center>─── ❖ ── ✦ ── ❖ ───</center>  

 
# <center> ✦ ***Solo estoy a la deriva (Monologo)*** ✦</center> 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdhZSs6aFtZcGbVqQKfnoTWhqF8Q8nhaZzt6KtDdM9hZz/image_4gswjkdxes_pfhu_dymib.webp)


#### 📸https://raphael.app/es


Estoy flotando en esta piscina y creo que mi salvavidas se desinfla. ¿Que si estoy deprimido? ¿Quién? ¿Yo?...No...no, no y no, solo estoy a la deriva, y no es lo mismo estar flotando a la deriva que perdido en el mar de posibilidades, flotar, flotar lleva su técnica.
Si renuncia a mi trabajo, si por un mensaje, y use un emoji de risa al final. ¿Y que? ¿Qué es poco serio? Había pensado poner el emoji de la explosión. Tengo miles de mensajes de mi jefe, pero ningún deseo de escuchar su voz, por eso ni los abrí, no quiero que se me marquen como leídos. Total, me he tomada vacaciones, y este flotador? Se lo robé a mi vecino, tiene forma de unicornio y adornos de arcoíris, ¡a que está lindo!
¿Que si me he gastado los ahorros en este hotel cinco estrellas y que estoy sin trabajo? Eso no es estar perdido, eso es estar flotando. Por primera vez llevo tres horas mirando a las nubes, solo abrí los ojos cuando el unicornio comenzó a hacer un ruido bastante obsceno: pssssss, muy obsceno, si se está desinflando, ¡mira como mi vida! ¡Qué curioso! El agua ya me llega a la barbilla.

Pero qué feliz soy, flotando, flotando a la deriva, aquí todo es más fácil aquí todo es más simple. ¿Que si tengo un plan? Claro que sí, coger el poco de dinero que me queda y comprarme otro salvavidas. Aaaaah sobre mi trabajo? Ese ese sí que está a la deriva.

#### <center>─── ❖ ── ✦ ── ❖ ───</center>

links.title: Shopping with some friends [Eng-Spn]
links.body:
Hey Hive guys, I'm going to tell you about my experience the day I went with my friend and her boyfriend to Los Guajiros. This place is like a big, popular market where they sell clothes and other accessories at more affordable prices. It was a fun adventure, although a bit tiring. It all started when we got in the truck in front of my friend's house. When we arrived at Los Guajiros, we waited a bit for her boyfriend to arrive, and once he did, we went to look for the clothes I wanted to buy. ![1000190348.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23vsN2Sj7vtX7y47ZfDKUxos11E3QNHYVjZyQrYx3dwMrkwiPiBqKbpFdGfqbUdR2Ly8t.jpg) ![1000190345.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23uQrp6CpvkQBP5aDBLhwvV4Lk1ueWJFGWqMgK7LbfiRBuG2vZ1YDMqtCSu1kNaZoS5rs.jpg) My goal was to find some gym shorts, while my friend wanted a dress and a jumpsuit set. ![1000189371.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23vhuW1UcYzPnQjZN41QYCxKHPyfopcWTEZQWq8eNiae1ZtNfAvU3pzATjJ3RTbPoZBHH.jpg) Upon arriving, we started walking, as the place where the van dropped us off was a bit far. We visited several stores, looking for the best prices and the best options. After a while, my friend finally found a brown dress that she loved. However, the search for a jumpsuit and a matching set wasn't as successful, as neither of us found anything we liked. ![1000189405.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23xyVLMy3AKZ4EELLt1shxZoD1oJLBjjLSmWPJic4QNTHbhynpBaASdtSoDrTZzNLpZpk.jpg) After so much walking, my friend's boyfriend decided to buy us a soda to replenish our energy. We were tired, to be honest, but thanks to having an umbrella, the sun didn't affect us too much. Although, to be honest, I felt a little uncomfortable because I had forgotten mine; I always go out with my umbrella because the sun has been very strong these days. ![1000190351.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23zGescxKY626owPneAKLPgeTiDbEhBDqrCzPW9GKrtvNtFhLy8UnL7m1CoQH3pAsWNQ5.jpg) After freshening up, we found a store that had some really cute and reasonably priced workout shorts. I couldn't resist and bought four: one navy blue, one light purple, one dark brown, and one light brown that I loved. However, I was a little disappointed not to find the pants I was looking for. Instead, I decided to get two dresses: a long white one, similar to my friend's, perfect for the beach, and a shorter brown one with a low back that made me feel fabulous. ![1000190336.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23wMaXA8F5sUpXJU9fCtJVUVkgTsKHayH4JeAtfwBaZ4SNSgAXBE5Xgrgabv4CwW2Cov2.jpg) It was a great day of laughter and shopping, despite a few minor disappointments and the incredibly strong sun. Going out with my friend and her boyfriend was a lot of fun. Thanks for reading, and see you in the next post. Bye guys! --- *Photos taken with my iPhone Used Google Translate*
Español #

> Hola chicos de Hive, les voy a contar mi experiencia de el día que fui con mi amiga y su novio a Los Guajiros, este sitio es como un mercado popular grande donde venden a precios más accesibles ropa y otros accesorios. Fue una aventura divertida, aunque algo agotadora. Todo comenzó cuando nos subimos a la camioneta frente a la casa de mi amiga. Cuando llegamos a Los Guajiros, esperamos un poco a que llegara su novio, y una vez que su novio llegó, nos dirigimos a buscar la ropa que quería comprar. ![1000190348.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23vsN2Sj7vtX7y47ZfDKUxos11E3QNHYVjZyQrYx3dwMrkwiPiBqKbpFdGfqbUdR2Ly8t.jpg) ![1000190345.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23uQrp6CpvkQBP5aDBLhwvV4Lk1ueWJFGWqMgK7LbfiRBuG2vZ1YDMqtCSu1kNaZoS5rs.jpg) Mi objetivo era encontrar unos shorts para el gym, mientras que mi amiga quería un vestido y un conjunto de monos. ![1000189371.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23vhuW1UcYzPnQjZN41QYCxKHPyfopcWTEZQWq8eNiae1ZtNfAvU3pzATjJ3RTbPoZBHH.jpg) Al llegar, comenzamos a caminar, ya que el lugar donde nos dejó la camioneta estaba un poco lejos. Recorrimos varias tiendas, buscando los mejores precios y las mejores opciones. Después de un rato, mi amiga finalmente encontró un vestido marrón que le encantó. Sin embargo, la búsqueda del mono y el conjunto no fue tan exitosa, ya que ninguno de los dos encontró algo que nos gustara. ![1000189405.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23xyVLMy3AKZ4EELLt1shxZoD1oJLBjjLSmWPJic4QNTHbhynpBaASdtSoDrTZzNLpZpk.jpg) Después de tanta caminata, el novio de mi amiga decidió comprar un refresco para reponernos un poco. La verdad es que estábamos cansados, pero gracias a que llevábamos una sombrilla, no nos afectó tanto el sol. Aunque, para ser honesta, me sentí un poco incómoda porque había olvidado la mía, yo siempre salgo con mi sombrilla porque el sol estos días ha estado muy fuerte. ![1000190351.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23zGescxKY626owPneAKLPgeTiDbEhBDqrCzPW9GKrtvNtFhLy8UnL7m1CoQH3pAsWNQ5.jpg) Luego de refrescarnos, encontramos una tienda que tenía unos shorts de entrenamiento muy bonitos y a buen precio. No pude resistirme y compré cuatro: uno azul marino, otro morado claro, un marrón oscuro y uno marrón claro que me encantaron. Sin embargo, me decepcioné un poco al no encontrar el pantalón que buscaba. A cambio, decidí llevarme dos vestidos: uno blanco largo, similar al de mi amiga, perfecto para la playa, y otro marrón más corto y con un escote en la espalda que me hizo sentir fabulosa. ![1000190336.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23wMaXA8F5sUpXJU9fCtJVUVkgTsKHayH4JeAtfwBaZ4SNSgAXBE5Xgrgabv4CwW2Cov2.jpg) Fue un día genial de risas y compras, a pesar de las pequeñas decepciones y de que hacía un sol increíblemente fuerte. La experiencia de salir con mi amiga y su novio fue muy divertida. Gracias por leerme y nos vemos en un próximo post, chao chicos. ---- Fotos tomadas con mi iPhone Utilice Google Traductor

links.title: Learning or Exploitation? The Truth About Internships
links.body:
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zoe01/EokiTz3MyG9P9kT99XWoaVqHbJucHWQJs9D3AKYskTmKPpe8f9Bnh978EoiTjWw9UFm.jpg)


Whether it's online or offline I've always seen that people always debate about this same topic again and again that \

To be honest I have only heard the negative response, every time someone would say that interns are gaining experience so that should be enough for them. I feel that people are not thinking with their brain that's why they say those stuff. It feels like they are disconnected from the reality. I agree that internships are there because it can help people to learn. And I'm absolutely not denying that. I think of it as a phase rookies can develope their skills and learn many new things, and it helps each one of them to build for their future career. But the fact is that interns do not only sit around in the corner and observe. Most of the time they work harder and give extra time which is more than the full-time employees. So the real question arrives here if someone is working hard giving away their energy, effort and time as like the real employees then why shouldn’t they get paid? I feel the biggest issue is that companies often ignore the financial reality of the students who just graduated. The companies should see from interns point of view that everyone does not have the privilege to work for free and give away their time. There's a cost for everything such as food, transportation. Well, some people even has to support their families because they are the only breadwinner in the family. If the internship does not pay it can automatically limit ones opportunities, there are only a few who can survive without income. In my opinion I feel this is completely unfair. I’ve personally seen my close one's struggle during their internships. It was one of my senior cousin he used to wake up early and had to travel to long distanced places each day, he could bearly breathe in peace because he had to work the whole day. After all that he came back home with exhaustion and in return he got “experience.” Even though the experience is valuable it won't put food on his plate in the moment also it's not gonna pay for the daily expenses. So, his stress didn't take the name of stopping. And yeah he went through hell for nothing but experience which didn't make life easier at the moment. This is where unpaid internships can start to feel like exploitation and it doesn’t feel like an opportunity at all. In argument companies has some valid points, like they invest time behind the intern also use their resources and effort into training those interns. But I believe training someone does not require that much of effort and time. I don't wanna sound neutral as it's not a one-sided investment. As the companies give their time the interns are also giving their time. So even if they are learning, they are also adding value. I don't think that interns should be paid full salaries like permanent employees. Because they are not employees yet. But they should receive the basic allowance and we should also think realistically that small new companies can't give that much of allowance for interns. But at least a reasonable allowance or stipend should exist. I think if the interns are paid a small amount this can change their mindset about the work. Also they will be motivated to work more hard with responsibility. It will truly make them feel better about the work. They will start to feel more valued and become more connected to the company. Surely they won't turn out like a temporary helper. So, if you ask for my opinion that the interns should be paid? Then again my answer would be, yes—absolutely. ____ The thumbnail is taken from canva and created with [canva](www.canva.com) ____

links.body:
​Hello to all my friends in the Hive community and the amazing Actifit family! ​I am writing today’s report with a heart full of gratitude and a body that feels energized after another productive day. If there is one thing I have learned since joining this platform, it’s that consistency is the bridge between goals and accomplishment. Today was a perfect example of that. Not only did I manage to hit my physical activity targets, but I also took some time to appreciate the world around me and the wonderful community that supports my journey here. ​The Beauty of Today's Walk ​The weather today was simply breathtaking. Looking at the sky, it was such a deep, clear blue that it felt almost like a painting. I decided to head out early to make the most of the sunshine. There is something incredibly peaceful about walking through a park when the trees are just starting to show their full spring green. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/24579b0a-9d45-4e86-8110-08765408dfdc.jpg) ​As I walked along the green fields, I found myself reflecting on how much my daily routine has changed. Before Actifit, I might have taken a short walk, but now, I am always looking for that extra mile. I reached a total of 12,462 steps today! You can see the steady progress in my activity chart. Those peaks in the graph represent the moments where I felt most focused breathing in the fresh air and just enjoying the movement. ​![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/bcd96a3d-7f96-4d9b-9bd0-c1722f07fd26.jpg) ​I took this photo of the tree lined path because it reminded me of my journey on Hive. Just like these trees, progress takes time, but if you keep moving forward, you eventually find yourself in a very beautiful place. The shade was perfect, and the contrast between the green grass and the blue sky was exactly what I needed to clear my mind. ​Reaching New Heights Rank 31.79 ​On the technical side of things, I am very proud of my current standing. My User Rank has reached 31.79. This might just seem like a number to some, but to me, it represents dedication. Passing the Rank 30 milestone recently opened up so many doors for me in the Actifit Market, and I am already seeing the benefits of the boosters I’ve been using. ​Seeing my AFIT balance grow to over 10,949 tokens is very motivating. It’s a reminder that every step literally counts. I am learning how to manage my resources better, how to delegate (like the 100 HP I sent to @helios.voter yesterday), and how to maximize the rewards from my activity. It’s not just about walking; it’s about being part of an economy that rewards a healthy lifestyle. ​A Sincere Thank You to @terganftp ​I cannot write this post without mentioning @terganftp. Your feedback on my previous posts has been a guiding light for me. You challenged me to put more life into my writing and to aim for higher quality and longer descriptions. I hope this post shows that I am taking your advice to heart! ​The community on Hive is built on this kind of peer to peer encouragement. It makes me want to work harder, not just for the rewards, but to be a better content creator for all of you. Also, thank you for the tip about the BBH tokens I am making sure to use that daily to spread some love to others too! !BBH ​Looking Forward ​Tomorrow is a new day with new opportunities. I plan to keep my momentum above 10k steps and continue exploring new paths in my area. Whether the sky is blue like today or grey with rain, I am committed to this journey. My next goal is to keep climbing that User Rank and eventually hit Rank 40! ​Thank you for being part of my day. Remember to stay active, stay positive, and keep supporting each other. See you in the next report!

links.title: Premier League Has Seen 13 Managerial Firings This Season Which Is Becoming The New Normal
links.body: /> [source](https://www.transfermarkt.co.za/premier-league/trainerwechselprosaison/wettbewerb/GB1) Today Chelsea Football Club unsurprisingly sacked their latest manager after being in charge for only 3 months and a few days. 106 days to be precise after he lead the team to 5 straight defeats in which the team were unable to score a goal equaling the teams worst record since 1912. Liam Rosenior must have seen it coming a mile off as we all know if you do not get the results you will be moved on very quickly. Rosenior is unlucky number 13 for this season and we still have games to go so that number could still rise. If you look at the list above 2022/23 was a particularly bad season with a record 26 managers being fired by 11 different clubs. If we go back to 1992/93 and take an average per season until present day we have a figure of 9.5 managers per season who are fired which is nearly half the teams being 20 teams. The problem is a few teams can have 3 different managers in one season so the performances will reflect the instability and desperation. Tottenham and Nottingham Forest have been a proper merry go round this season and look where they are in the points table being 18th and 16th respectively. As an outsider looking in as a sports fan this makes no sense in how the clubs employ their managers. A football club is a business involving professional high end athletes that are expected to perform to a certain level. The manager and the back room staff are employed to get the best out of their players by whatever means they deem necessary. Surely with that in mind how can a club fire 3 managers in one season because commonsense tells you whoever is hiring the managers has also failed and should be fired as well. At some point there has to be accountability by everyone involved in the hiring process because anyone would have told you Rosenior was not the right candidate for the job. He was the convenient option for Chelsea removing him from another club the owners own. Convenient as in cheap as they would not have to pay compensation to the other club for stealing their manager as they own that club. When we look at the managers on the move it tends to be the same faces each time and this you would think would be a red flag. When Graham Potter moved from Brighton who were doing very well under his guidance you just knew he made a huge mistake going to Chelsea. Thomas Frank left his managerial role at Brentford who were also ding well and then failed at Tottenham. Why leave a set up that you are having success in risking your career at another club that has underlying issues. I would call it the height of stupidity and these managers suddenly go from being successful to failures all because of ego and chasing the dollars. The problem many of the clubs have when they change the managers so often is that they buy players to suit a certain managers playing style and a new manager arrives with another game plan suiting different players. There are quite a few clubs in the English Premier League that we could call a mess and this starts at the top and filters down with crazy player purchases and idiotic managerial appointments.

/></center>

[source](https://www.google.com/search?q=how+many+football+clubs+in+europe+made+a+profit+last+season&oq=how+many+football+clubs+in+europe+made+a+profit+last+season&gs_lcrp=EgZjaHJvbWUyBggAEEUYOTIHCAEQIRigATIHCAIQIRiPAtIBCjI1MjI1ajBqMTWoAgiwAgHxBQERLU3aps3j&sourceid=chrome&ie=UTF-8)


Very few of the football clubs make any profit and it is very clear why they do not due to how they are being run. If these were normal businesses they would have gone broke long ago or whoever was running them would have been replaced. This does highlight how ignorant the club owners are in running a successful football team that makes a profit.
