body.body:
<center>
![IMG_6024.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcvU1vj7nuaLkcvXB1qTKhNgL7QNZMjncS47wKzqcE8S1/IMG_6024.jpeg)
___
___

It’s kind of funny that today I lost track of time just as I did yesterday. Funny thing is that I’d make the drawing very early in the morning and had planned to post it accordingly too. Interestingly, I came upon a video of one moderator in my country who was going through a rocky separation with his wife and was being interviewed about it.
___
Usually I don’t watch stuffs like that but yesterday I was speaking with a friend of mine from my Uni days and she updated me on some of my close colleagues relationship status. I must confess that I was very disappointed by what I heard my colleagues did and made some calls this morning to other people I knew were credible to confirm if it was a rumor or she was just hating. Sadly, she was right and what pained me most was that she even put it mildly that what actually happened.
___
I’m beginning to think that the algorithm picked up on that and recommended the interview i’d been watching for the past two hours. Anyways, I’m happy the young man didn’t lose his life in the process and realizes that he was just being played. I just pray he doesn’t switch up on everybody around him or transfer the hate on another woman in the future because things like these really mess up the mind.
___

body.title: Beyond Cursing Leaders: How Prayer and Civic Action Can Heal a Nation
body.body:
<center> https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdhtG1jQb7hC7BkuJCLYYs8j9mc6pdGRs2LzUJJzQuXLk/image.png 
[Source](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-person-holding-a-sign-that-says-justice-acconttability-leads-to-no-yWGKFKpbX2Y)</center>


There are so many things that I used to think at times, there are so many things that I used to think at times, and behind these thoughts there are real constant stuff like cursing, bitterness and hatred towards leaders of this country and the fact that they don't even improve the situation of the country. They sometimes leave the country more hopeless, divided and disengaged. Though,  prayer is one of the solutions, that is just half of the story. 

When public conversation is dominated by insult and a lot of mediocrity, people start to believe nothing can change and no leader is worth engaging with. There has been research that has been done over and over again that shows the high political mediocrity and the lower participation. So people stop voting, they stop organising, they stop holding leaders accountable, they turn to another way. 

That vacuum of engagement can lead to bad leaders, even more room for them to misbehave and do whatever they like with public funds, because fewer citizens are watching. 

There is no questioning of the authority anymore and there is no demanding a better life. In that sense, cursing the leaders can hurt us as a spiritual person, as a Christian but practically by feeding a culture of resignation instead of responsibility. 

So when we don't even curse them again, we just return back to our fate and just say, oh so far this and that is not working in this country now, then the next thing to do is just to resign to our fate. There is power in prayer, yes. Prayer for people of faith is not weakness. 

It is a powerful way to cope with hardship and find strength, then stay grounded when life under bad relationship feels overwhelming. Prayer and religious practice can reduce anxiety sometimes and it can strengthen mental resilience and help people maintain hope in difficult times. We've found out through history that whenever people pray, especially the one you can see in the Bible, that whenever people pray they can change the situation of things. 

So if I'm trying to tell you that prayer matters, yes it does. It shifts character, softens bitterness and can keep people from being consumed by hatred. But even in faith traditions, prayer was never meant to replace responsibilities. 

Healthy societies are built when citizens pray, think and speak wisely and act constructively. Paths include voting and staying informed, not withdrawing in frustration. Peaceful, demanding transparency and the likes and demanding accountability from our leaders will surely help us to bring a lasting solution to a better society. 

And when we join hands together to build strong communities that support one another through hardship, prayer can guide this action so they are rooted in love, justice and wisdom. Instead of cursing our leaders, there are stronger things that we can do. We can decide to pray for them, for God to give them wisdom and compassion. 

Then we can criticize every of their bad actions and talk about their policies among ourselves and point the leaders to the right directions too. But this comes without dehumanizing them. Then we can organize with each other to push for a better society. 

That is one thing that we can do that can help this country. If you continually do what you are supposed to do consistently for good sense, it is enough to completely reset your trajectory in almost every area of life, health, money, skills and business. The illusion of nothing is happening is not something that everyone should buy into. 


Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@timscreative/beyond-cursing-leaders-how-prayer-and-civic-action-can-heal-a-nation-hsb)

body.title: If I could choose Again.
body.body: > If I could go back five years, there is one decision I would clearly change. After my National Diploma, I had the chance to go for direct entry into a degree program, but I refused. It wasn’t because I didn’t know the importance of a degree, but because of the people around me. I didn’t want to leave my friends behind. We started our National Diploma together, and I wanted us to continue the journey side by side. So, I chose to stay back and go for Higher National Diploma with them. ![ioana_radu-woman-1890573_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/toluwanih/23wC7J7DEuQToW3XnXL1SMSPKRyE6kokFSxd2HaSriaEPAdVRnasWNyuaa8xPmPGtmRJ8.jpg)[source](https://pixabay.com/photos/woman-thinking-girl-female-person-1890573/) At that time, it felt like the right thing to do. I valued friendship and togetherness, and I believed we would all move forward at the same pace. I didn’t think too deeply about the long-term effect of that decision. I was more focused on the present moment and the comfort of not being alone. But now, looking back, I see things differently. If I had chosen direct entry, I would have saved time and placed myself in a better position for job opportunities. Instead, I followed a path that has made things a bit harder. In many organizations in Nigeria today, there is still a clear difference between those with a university degree and those with National Diploma or Higher National Diploma. This difference shows in salary, job roles, and even how people are treated at work. I have experienced this myself. I got a job where I noticed the gap, and it made me reflect on my decision. It is not just me, many people I did Higher National Diploma with are also facing the same challenge. We often do similar work as degree holders, yet there is still a difference in how we are paid and valued. It can be frustrating, especially when you know you are capable. If I could go back, I would choose direct entry without thinking twice. Not because Higher National Diploma is useless, but because I now understand how the system works better. Sometimes, it is not just about your skills or how hardworking you are. It is also about the qualification you hold and how it positions you in the job market. ![mohamed_hassan-mindset-3455748_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/toluwanih/Epxsnq1EmPqiJrPQLgWE89PXXeXFYg4UDdfofNYKvniX3XiorqxcmkXc16NpVrFL6xN.jpg)[source](https://pixabay.com/photos/mindset-brain-storming-tablet-woman-3455748/) One thing that makes me realize this even more is this: the same friends I didn’t want to leave behind, we have all gone our separate ways now. Life happened, and everyone moved in different directions. We are all trying to find our own balance, and things are not as easy as we thought they would be. This made me realize that holding myself back for the sake of staying together did not really change the outcome. This is not about regret. At that time, I made the best decision I could with the understanding I had. But now I know better. I have learned that some decisions should be based on your future, not just your present feelings. If I could go back five years, I would still value my friendships, but I would not let them stop me from growing. I would choose the path that helps me move forward, even if it means walking alone for a while. Even though I cannot change the past, I can use this lesson to make better choices now and in the future. I am inviting @remi-c, @busayoluwaseun and @andrew-charles to this prompt. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@toluwanih/if-i-could-choose-again-pl)

body.title: Вечір, парк і раптова зірка: як одна вивірка зробила мій день
body.body: >Знаєте, бувають такі вечори, коли йдеш у парк просто «провітрити голову». Без великих планів, без навушників, просто послухати шелест дерев, який ще тільки набирає сили навесні, і подивитися, як сонце повільно ховається за горизонт. Тиша, спокій і той самий стан, коли думки нарешті розкладаються по поличках.

>Але сьогодні мій спокій був перерваний зустріччю з абсолютно неймовірною істотою. Йду собі вздовж огорожі, аж раптом — завмирання серця. Прямо на поручнях, за кілька кроків від мене, сидить вона. Вивірка. Але не просто якась там перелякана тваринка, що одразу дряпається на дерево, а справжня артистка!

>Ви тільки подивіться на цю грацію! Вона не просто сиділа — вона позувала. Повернула голову, завмерла, ніби даючи мені можливість обрати найкращий ракурс. В її погляді було стільки цікавості й впевненості, що на мить здалося: це не я її зустрів, а вона вийшла проінспектувати, хто це тут гуляє її територією.

>До речі, ви помітили її «вбрання»? Зараз якраз той період, коли вивірки змінюють свій гардероб. Вона ще трохи сіренька на боках — відголоски зими, але руда спинка вже яскраво світиться на вечірньому сонці. Такий собі пухнастий «color block» у природному виконанні.

>Знаєте, такі моменти — це найкраще нагадування про те, що дива зовсім поруч. Нам часто здається, що для вражень треба їхати кудись далеко, шукати екзотику чи купувати квитки на шоу. А насправді достатньо просто вимкнути телефон (ну, або дістати його на хвилинку, щоб зробити такий кадр), підняти голову і роззирнутися довкола.

>А ви давно були в парку просто так, без мети? Кого зустрічали? Діліться своїми «пухнастими» історіями в коментарях! 🐿️✨

\n\n

body.title: Two frames from last Sunday night under pristine skies
body.body:
I spent last weekend doing astrophotography near the Tatra Mountains. I used well weather conditions to capture some night shots.

The first image captures the rich region around Sadr in the Cygnus constellation — a deep-sky tapestry filled with emission nebulae. Visible here are the delicate structures of the Butterfly Nebula (IC 1318) and the Crescent Nebula (NGC 6888), both shaped by powerful stellar winds and intense radiation from massive stars. This area is a true showcase of the dynamic processes sculpting our galaxy.


![Autosave kopia_1-2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lchphoto/23swiDQKhqibxX5s8DDdEN4234CHjdQ5KaikYaqxWK14drgEpJHYcPFYmEteAYLJ7a9J3.jpg)


The second image shows the Milky Way stretching above the Tatra Mountains, photographed from the Litwinka viewpoint in Czarna Góra (Podhale, Poland). A warm glow from nearby towns contrasts with the cool, star-filled sky, creating a layered landscape where Earth and cosmos meet.


![Litwinka DM 04.2026_1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lchphoto/23tvc91pQCqdcyX3tJH9WaXRczLn8Y9s7kPZd5vLW1NgrAvYVMndpkFTUWkKMzEjVQiEh.jpg)


Two perspectives — one looking deep into interstellar space, the other grounding the galaxy in a familiar horizon.

body.title: Hello, 3D Printer!
body.body:
>We have neeeeews, we got a 3D printer, wooohooo! It feels like just yesterday, 8 or 9 years ago, when my sister and I went to a tech fair to support our brother, who had built a 3D printer from scratch with his friends. I remember being amazed back then, how something could draw an entire figure with plastic and even make parts of it flexible. So interesting and really cool. My fiancé ordered a Creality printer a few weeks ago, mainly to print some parts he needs for his CNC machine that he's building from scratch. But that doesn't mean we can't play with it first and print all sorts of little figures like kids. I just sit there and watch it working, layer by layer.

\n\n

/>First, we printed a beer opener. It was suggested as the simplest G-code file, one hour of printing and boom, you get a super cool, solid bottle opener. The edge is at such a good angle that I'm pretty sure it could be used to scrape frost off a car windshield in winter. And we did not make just one, we made two. xD We did not quite get the slicing right at first, so the second object we wanted to print did not work out. It was late in the evening and we were like, whatever, let's just make another one, you can never have too many of those, ahahh. After that we actually argued over whose one was nicer, even though they were identical, lol. But I insisted mine was the better one and he eventually had to agree with me. 🥰

/>He asked me what filament color we should order, since the printer only came with a small amount of white just for testing. And I, logically and very normally, said I want YELLOW, a proper yellow, not greenish, not fluorescent, but that exact shade, like Beatrix Kiddo's suit. Yup! <span class=\

>Yellow is ne of the most beautiful colors! <3 Today the spool arrived, and it is not 100 percent that perfect shade of yellow, but it is pretty close, the closest one available from all the options they had. Next up was an octopus, to test how flexible figures will turn out and it came out really great. Of course it took longer than the bottle opener, but not as long as you would expect for something that looks so complex and solid. Most of the work is in the tentacles, and then the printer finishes the head in the last fifteen minutes of printing.
/>The most interesting part for me is removing it from the build plate and peeling off the support material that holds parts of the figure in place, in this case the octopus's \

. (: Didnt it turn out cool? I'm thinking about what else would be interesting to make, I'm already googling fictional characters from my favorite series and movies, objects from iconic scenes, video game characters, primers and paints for painting them afterwards, basically a whole little mini world is there.

/>Who would have thought this would become so easily accessible, when less than 10 years ago it was almost completely unknown to most people. Do you have a 3D printer at home, and what do you usually print the most? And what do you think, could we come up with some fun object that would actually sell well? I'm really thinking about that.

body.body: **Hello, I’m Lara! 😊** Today, I want to introduce you to a dish that is incredibly popular in Korea and one of my personal favorites: Beef Shabu-Shabu. The reason I love this place so much isn't just for the Shabu-Shabu itself—it's because of the amazing variety of food offered! It’s a full-course buffet where you can enjoy: Unlimited Beef: Fresh, thinly sliced beef to your heart's content. Fresh Vegetables & Various Sauces: Customize your pot with all kinds of veggies and dipping sauces. Global & Local Sides: A wide spread of pasta, pizza, tteokbokki (Korean spicy rice cakes), and fresh salads. Drinks & Dessert: Unlimited soft drinks and freshly brewed coffee to finish your meal. The best part is that you can pick and choose exactly what you want to eat as much as you like! It’s a true feast for both the eyes and the stomach. If you ever visit Korea, this is a must-try dining experience.

body.title: Organizador de escritorio al estilo k-pop/ K-pop-style desk organiser 📚🖇
body.body:
> Hello gente bella de Hive! Espero que todos estén muy bien, por mi parte ayer los abandoné porque no me sentía nada bien, pero ya estoy de vuelta con otro trabajito manual para la habitación de Miranda, y se trata de un organizador para colocar en la pared, pero no es un organizador cualquiera, sino uno especial para mi pequeña k-poper (fan del k-pop).
Hello, lovely Hive community! I hope you’re all doing well. As for me, I had to take a break yesterday because I wasn’t feeling well at all, but I’m back now with another little DIY project for Miranda’s room. It’s a wall-mounted organiser, but not just any organiser – it’s a special one for my little K-pop fan.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNdMzM86yt9fr8jBpbygu5bofKMxfMqSArnY5ajLXeHUW/1776878392901.png) *** Este organizador pasó por mil fases ya que aunque es una manualidad del tipo *\

*, yo quería que la cosa se viera como comprado 🤣🤣, y por supuesto eso es un problema, pero se hizo el intento muchas veces hasta que estuve satisfecha, aunque les cuento que después de las fotos finales he decido cambiar algo, pero eso será para cuando ya estemos armando el cuarto. De momento vamos con el paso a paso. >This organiser went through a thousand stages because, even though it’s a *“do-it-yourself”* project, I wanted it to look like something I’d bought 🤣🤣, and of course that’s a problem, but I kept trying until I was happy with it. I should mention, though, that after taking the final photos I’ve decided to change something, but that’ll be for when we’re actually setting up the room. For now, let’s get on with the step-by-step guide. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeQdmYkTT5AzFtQN73nojTSST2Zdy11zvYD1M5DCwD8mj/1776877780561.jpg) *** ## Materiales 2 cajitas de cartón vacías Base de plástico Foto cards Pintura acrílica lila Pintura acrílica blanca Esponja Pincel Silicón frío Pistola de silicón Adhesivo doble faz
## Materials 2 empty cardboard boxes Plastic base Photo cards Lilac acrylic paint White acrylic paint Sponge Paintbrush Cold-setting silicone Silicone gun Double-sided adhesive tape
## Paso a paso/ Step by step Lo primero que hice fue pintar por dentro las cajitas que utilicé, y para esto usé un pincel mediano y la pintura de color lila y di varias capas de pintura, dejando secar muy bien entre capa y capa. Les cuento que yo utilicé cajitas de celulares, ya que estas además de ser gruesas vienen muy bien recubiertas, por lo que su apariencia es muy prolija y esto es algo muy importante para mí a la hora de hacer cualquier trabajo manual, ya que un buen acabo es primordial.
The first thing I did was paint the inside of the boxes I was using; for this, I used a medium-sized brush and lilac paint, applying several coats and allowing each one to dry thoroughly before applying the next. I should mention that I used mobile phone boxes, as these are not only sturdy but also have a very smooth finish, giving them a neat appearance – and this is something very important to me when doing any craft work, as a good finish is essential.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmej3PWHxBjhUUTxjTihsu3eBPAuNG3hejjF11pRFi7hd5/1776877546724.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma5c49grHJKhjcuRZwSqSFJmSmNyR5yUk2GKSQddGqK5D/1776877878265.jpg) *** Una vez las cajitas estuvieron bien cubiertas y secas por dentro, me dediqué a trabajar en la parte de afuera, y les cuento que esto fue todo un tema porque yo quería darles un toque diferente y pensé que usando una malla me iría súper bien y lograría marcar los cuadritos de la malla, cosa que no fue así aunque lo intenté de diferentes maneras, pero después de varios intentos aunque no quedó como quería el resultado me gustó muchísimo. Lo que hice fue usar un trozo de una malla plástica y colocarlo sobre la cajita, para luego dar toques con la esponja cargada con pintura lila y listo.
Once the little boxes were properly coated and dry on the inside, I set about working on the outside, and I have to tell you, this was quite a challenge because I wanted to give them a unique touch and thought that using a mesh would work really well and allow me to highlight the mesh squares – which didn’t happen, even though I tried different methods, but after several attempts, even though it didn’t turn out exactly as I’d hoped, I really loved the result. What I did was use a piece of plastic mesh and place it over the box, then dab it with a sponge loaded with lilac paint, and that was it.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZgoBYBG6qYAinTKfW85awGME74q9kQhPM5z1LFQaND5V/1776877546894.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcnp4BRwS38NBsnjUEdcacfAq8dizKCqoka5H7juav67p/1776877547227.jpg) *** Cubrí con esta técnica los cuatro lados de las cajitas, y decidí hacer a la más grande un separador, para lo que recorté una pieza de cartón, la pinté de color lila con ayuda del pincel y finalmente la coloqué en la cajita para crear dos espacios.
I used this technique to cover all four sides of the boxes, and decided to turn the largest one into a divider, so I cut out a piece of card, painted it lilac using a brush, and finally placed it inside the box to create two compartments.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc4dkaQUtyngkD6bC1xJ3Zxk5cPfg2z4284bDB3ygufeZ/1776877546989.jpg) *** En este punto fue que comenzó el problema porque yo tenía en mente hacer un listón también de cartón blanco para pegar abajo la cajita grande y arriba la pequeña, pero cuando lo hice me pareció horrible, luego decidí que solo las pegaría una al lado de la otra y no me gustó, después decidí hacerles una base atrás tipo decorativa, pero adivinen qué pasó? Exacto!!! No me gustó! Finalmente me puse a dar vueltas por toda la casa y encontré una pieza de plástico firme que me pareció perfecta para este proyecto y con esto en mente decidí avanzar.
That’s when the trouble started, because I’d planned to make a strip of white cardboard to stick the large box at the bottom and the small one at the top, but when I did it, I thought it looked awful. Then I decided to just stick them side by side, but I didn’t like that either. After that, I decided to make a decorative base for the back, but guess what happened? Exactly!!! I didn’t like it! Finally, I started wandering around the house and found a sturdy piece of plastic that seemed perfect for this project, and with that in mind, I decided to press on.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc5ZFieCLszt6unQthbze2ZmKdfemCG3QiYfLMy9tqTcq/1776877591842.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmevbVvEmmgpSqqht3hfuQQZL48zZ2NifpHPJD9v9L7aFN/1776877591761.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf3oLYtHhLTmEK7hBLMnTQk2uUAWXwZkQb63r9wYi14bP/1776877591924.jpg) Lavé y dejé secar la pieza plástica para luego pintarla de blanco con ayuda de la esponja, y una vez logré cubrirla muy bien, pegué en uno de los extremos inferiores la cajita grande, y en el extremo superior opuesto la pequeña, y como la idea es incorporar en su habitación parte de la temática k-pop decidí pegar algunas foto cards de dos de sus grupos favoritos que son Twice y Enhypen, y por cierto no tuve que preguntar los nombres de los grupos para escribirlos, porque ya me los sé (toda una mamá de k-poper 🤣🤣). Les cuento que las foto cards las pegué con adhesivo doble faz porque *\

*, palabras de la jefa de la obra (la niña Miranda), y de esta forma bastante sencilla terminamos el organizador para mi flaca, que como pueden ver está precioso, muy a su estilo (sin muchos periquitos), y puede usarlo tanto en la pared como en el escritorio.
I washed the plastic piece and left it to dry, then painted it white using a sponge. Once I’d covered it thoroughly, I stuck the large box to one of the bottom corners, and the small one to the opposite top edge. As the idea is to incorporate some K-pop themes into her room, I decided to stick on some photo cards of two of her favourite groups, Twice and Enhypen. By the way, I didn’t have to ask her the names of the groups to write them down, because I already know them (a proper K-pop mum 🤣🤣). I’ll tell you that I stuck the photo cards on with double-sided tape because *“under no circumstances must they get damaged”*, in the words of the project manager (Miranda herself), and in this rather simple way we finished the organiser for my little girl, which, as you can see, looks lovely, very much in her style (without too many parakeets), and she can use it either on the wall or on her desk.

body.title: My Jaws Are Glued But My Heart Still Speaks.
body.body:
>



Just anyone and every dreams of a perfect home and some already has that perfect home that's perfect both inward and outward and not just by the decors of the house, but for a floating Island Hmmmmmmm! My jaws are glued together but I can still manage to talk out my heart desires.


![IMG_20260416_110230_682.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/graceze/244eK7EeGQCViitZ9zquSxLTUZKVPUA4ukKxy23a5SsfwS8dQ281FkmdYqQotRSYM9qFj.jpg)


I am confident, bold, courageous, fearless, smart, intelligent and what have you but we can't still lie that even the strongest kind of humans are also vulnerable and one among many ways that depict my own vulnerability is that fear also exist, not fear of fellow humans like me, not certainly fear of failure even though we should be but this kind of fear is of the little things that you may think don't matter.

My fear sometimes is that my loved ones shouldn't die and leave that vacuum in me or that my friends shouldn't turn strangers to me one day or that fear of being in a two or three storey building, bending to watch the remaining building and just imagining \

yess those are the kind of unreasonable fear I might be having at some point, do just imagining me reaching out or going to the floating island, hmmmm my dears I would imagine the unimaginable on my way there and even while am there. Only my shaking and fear would throw me down, I know there are adventures that we should sometimes take just to explore and maybe later in the future I might want to take but now if I ever engage in such my heart would pull out to my hands. I know there's fun in those very scary video games or movies or even adventures like this floating island and I hope that one day I would gather the balls to engage in it but as for now my heart is still fragile so let's not break it. It's my pleasure having to explore this contest topic with all these lovely souls out here but it's at this junction I would let you breathe, thank you all for staying through, see you all next time 😘.

body.title: A Peaceful Evening Walk
body.body:
There is something truly special about stepping outside for a quiet walk and finding peace in the simplest moments.

**Finding Joy in a Simple Evening Walk**

Yesterday evening, I went out for a short walk, and it turned out to be one of the most peaceful moments of my day. I usually enjoy morning walks more because the fresh morning air feels so calm and refreshing. But evening walks have their own special beauty too. The quiet paths, the cool air, and the soft lights in the park create a very relaxing atmosphere.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS75wSJr37not8XeDP7KHgNEKAadzHBcsyLMrZpjrc5Nn/img_1353.jpg)


I had stayed at home all day and had not moved much, so I really needed to get outside for some fresh air. Even though the weather was a little cold, I thought I was dressed warmly enough. When I started walking, everything felt wonderful. The park was not crowded, and the peaceful surroundings made the walk even more enjoyable.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQyNYqRNhrps84MyNactToWKELhCv4QTys76fe5qtsfsf/img_1339.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQZjvvFww9y3Zny1N6Hr4P93azLym6Ff3UTthr691zYcs/img_1340.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNN5TnvvRKCmvYESKoQ2qQeQSco8JGZVGDj5AQXLE3Lyp/img_1343.jpg)


One of my favorite parts of the walk was seeing so many cats around the park. As always, they felt like little walking companions along the way. Watching them made the experience warmer and happier. Small moments like this can make an ordinary walk feel very special.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRYXKAJioZ3GQcDez1dfoojbJq7dpi2r5efoq11N5adnv/img_1347.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeSDxiYdiSuNbVWzGv6ybDiJkephGiWm7eKMb1Ha7T9r7/img_1349.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYyFv9qztAdpqDjY7MCPzcmQDrvLv272f76ZgnyfTQJo2/img_1350.jpg)


I walked for about forty minutes. I wanted to continue a little longer, but by the end of the walk I felt colder than I expected. Even so, those forty minutes were enough to refresh my mind and make me feel better. Sometimes a short walk is all we need to relax and reset after spending too much time indoors.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeaoAQTWSGwo4rg3gmhjuA8vTXnubm1ZDVfrPJU5TMpky/img_1345.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSRNdSX4g2jBkVyGDGV5CvdactcAT1jAruTax56y6PR8e/img_1351.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaavbSqmbR1CFQoq69ePnAjtgiwSuwrthMQqx8EhLTKu5/img_1352.jpg)


After the walk, I felt tired and wanted to warm up a little. I sat outside for a while and drank a glass of orange juice. It was a simple moment, but it felt peaceful. Later, my sister came to pick me up, and that was the end of my lovely evening.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVkTPXPkJLt1QF2tysbfRX2vizBrbfh2Byqfn2kV8fiYT/img_1356.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNvksh8r5EPDGVsPcWdgmL31dvzyGNVdKVCjBtqgYpZ7T/img_1357.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPTFSzggesHmMcPFX3XJXVS6LFKSrGoUtSX2rRUvm9CMt/img_1342.jpg)


Moments like this remind me that happiness can be found in simple things—a quiet park, a few cats, fresh air, and a peaceful walk at the end of the day. Yesterday’s evening walk was simple, but it brought me a lot of peace.

body.title: Receta: Arepas de calabacín, zanahoria y avena. Recipe:  Zucchini, carrot, and oat Arepas (Esp/Eng).
body.body:
>Hola a todos los seguidores de la comida fácil, sabrosa y sana para incluir en nuestra dieta. Cuando nos hablan de dieta, pensamos que vamos a pasar por una experiencia aburrida y sin sabor, pero todo es según el punto de vista de cada quien. Considero que una de las comidas que debe ser liviana, es la cena, ya que el cuerpo se prepara para el descanso. Es costumbre preparar mi cena antes de las 6 de la tarde. Por lo general, las características son: menos cantidad, liviana y baja en grasa. Son ideales para pacientes diabéticos, pues no estarían comiendo harina y la glucosa no subiría. Por tal razón hoy les comparto la receta de unas sabrosas y sanas arepas de calabacín, zanahoria y avena, fácil de preparar incluso las puedes guardar en la nevera, las puedes acompañar con el relleno de tu preferencia, un dato importante es que no hay harina en la preparación de las arepitas. Decido dejar la receta porque siempre preguntan cómo se hacen las arepas de calabacín, zanahoria y avena.

>Hello to all fans of easy, tasty, and healthy meals to include in our diet. When people talk about dieting, we tend to think it’s going to be a boring, flavorless experience, but it all depends on your perspective. I believe that dinner should be a light meal, since the body is preparing to rest. I usually prepare my dinner before 6 p.m. Generally, the key features are: smaller portions, light, and low in fat. They’re ideal for people with diabetes, since they don’t contain flour and won’t cause blood sugar spikes. That’s why today I’m sharing a recipe for tasty and healthy zucchini, carrot, and oat arepas. They’re easy to make, and you can even store them in the fridge. You can serve them with your favorite filling. An important note is that there’s no flour in the recipe. I’m posting this recipe because people are always asking how to make zucchini, carrot, and oat arepas. #

***INGREDIENTES/ INGREDIENTS***
* 1 Calabacín. * 1 taza de avena en hojuelas. * 1 zanahoria. * 1 cucharada de chía. * 1 cucharada de ajonjolí. * Una pizca de sal. >* 1 zucchini. >* 1 cup rolled oats. >* 1 carrot. >* 1 tablespoon chia seeds. >* 1 tablespoon sesame seeds. >* A pinch of salt.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSxGyvu9i4Z6j6rFC5JjFBHybqW3xbtieZNwHzdr7W4uw/image.png)
#
***PREPARACIÓN/ PREPARATION***
* Lavar y pelar tanto la zanahoria como el calabacín. Luego rallar por el lado más fino. >* Wash and peel both the carrot and the zucchini. Then grate them using the finest side of the grater.

> https://images.hive.blog/DQmbNawhWRvmhcJUmLkngFzEpMoAwcYkpUjQ9VYtEzBst51/image.png * Viertes en un bowl el calabacín y la zanahoria rallada, una taza de avena en hojuela, 1 cucharada de chía, 1 cucharada de ajonjolí, una pizca de sal. >* Place the zucchini and grated carrot in a bowl, along with 1 cup of rolled oats, 1 tablespoon of chia seeds, 1 tablespoon of sesame seeds, and a pinch of salt.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPR1jqGXnq54AcMQc9WVBpHJCX7CPFB4u1BnFcnstyPU5/image.png)
* Mezclar todo, no hay necesidad de agregar agua, la humedad del calabacín hidrata la avena en hojuelas. Dejar unos minutos. Seguir amasando hasta conseguir una masa consistente. >* Mix everything together; there’s no need to add water—the moisture from the zucchini will hydrate the rolled oats. Let it sit for a few minutes. Keep kneading until you get a consistent dough.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZht1SW6S2Z3Y7QN1GgvAKeP7SZuda2fDf262A9t6PQ6V/image.png)
* Con las manos ligeramente húmedas hacer bolitas con la masa. >* With slightly damp hands, roll the dough into small balls.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmacH5HFLkP3x23xkjT6oKa43xiu1mSD5Yx5EUw9bUo5ZD/image.png)
* Darle forma de arepa. >* Shape it into an arepa.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfSzboPvMvqGzEMs9jvmimGLAi8sPDDqQAvNwi9HowgCX/image.png)
. * Mientras se calienta la plancha, pasar una servilleta con un poquito de aceite, luego colocar en la plancha las arepas, dar vuelta y vuelta hasta que estén doradas. Me gustan las arepas delgadas.😋 >* While the griddle is heating up, wipe it with a napkin dipped in a little oil, then place the arepas on the griddle and flip them over until they’re golden brown. I like my arepas thin.😋
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmemCxbNnkVowbrSQS7Tduv3rV2AcLN97waXJhgvoFuqHU/image.png)
* Listo!!! a disfrutar de estas saludales arepas. Son mis favoritas. Las rellené con queso blanco, a mí me encantan. Cuéntenme ustedes si han preparado las arepas de calabacín, zanahoria y avena. >* All done!!! Enjoy these healthy arepas. They're my favorites. I filled them with white cheese—I love them. Let me know if you've made the zucchini, carrot, and oat arepas.

body.title: The Blame Game: Who Was Really at Fault in the $290 Million Kelp DAO Exploit?
body.body:
On April 18, 2026, the DeFi world was shaken by one of the largest exploits of the year. Attackers drained approximately 116,500 rsETH — worth around $290-293 million — from Kelp DAO’s cross-chain bridge powered by LayerZero. The incident involved a forged message that tricked the bridge into releasing unbacked rsETH without a corresponding burn on the source chain (Unichain). Kelp DAO quickly paused contracts and froze the recipient address, preventing a second packet that could have cost another $100 million. However, the stolen funds were used to borrow against on platforms like Aave, creating significant bad debt and triggering liquidity issues across DeFi.

The exploit centered on LayerZero’s cross-chain messaging infrastructure, specifically its Decentralized Verifier Network (DVN). Attackers, likely linked to North Korea’s Lazarus Group (TraderTraitor subgroup), compromised or poisoned RPC nodes used by LayerZero’s verifier. They launched a DDoS attack on backups to force failover to tainted infrastructure, allowing a fake message to pass verification and execute on Ethereum. This highlights sophisticated state-actor tactics targeting infrastructure rather than smart contract bugs.

A fierce blame game quickly erupted. LayerZero’s post-mortem placed primary responsibility on Kelp DAO for using a **1-of-1 DVN configuration** — a single verifier setup that created a single point of failure. They argued Kelp ignored repeated warnings to upgrade to a multi-verifier (e.g., 2-of-3 or higher) setup for better security. Security firms like SlowMist described the 1/1 as the weakest possible level, essentially delegating all trust to one signing key.

Kelp DAO pushed back strongly. In statements and through sources, the protocol claimed the 1-of-1 setup was LayerZero’s own documented default for onboarding, especially during L2 expansions. They emphasized that the compromised verifier ran on LayerZero’s infrastructure, not Kelp’s custom code. The single verifier in question was operated by LayerZero Labs itself, and the attack exploited flaws in its RPC dependencies and failover mechanisms. Critics, including Chainlink’s Zach Rynes, accused LayerZero of “deflecting responsibility” by throwing Kelp under the bus for trusting the provider’s recommended defaults.

Ultimately, fault appears shared. Kelp DAO bears responsibility for not implementing stronger security despite the flexibility LayerZero offers — protocols can choose their own DVN thresholds, and a 1/1 is inherently risky for high-value bridges. However, LayerZero’s architecture allows such minimal configurations, and if defaults encouraged it, the infrastructure provider shares accountability for not enforcing minimum security standards or better protecting its own verifier nodes.

This incident exposes deeper issues in DeFi interoperability: reliance on trusted oracles and verifiers, the dangers of single points of failure, and how one bridge exploit can cascade into ecosystem-wide stress (with billions in withdrawals and potential losses on lending platforms). It serves as a stark reminder that “verified” cross-chain messages are only as strong as the weakest link in configuration and infrastructure.

As investigations continue and funds are traced (some frozen on Arbitrum), the community awaits clearer compensation plans. The Kelp DAO exploit is not just a hack story — it’s a cautionary tale about shared responsibility in decentralized systems. True security demands better defaults, enforced multi-verification, and less finger-pointing after disasters.

body.title: Mi vida con mi tres gatos | My life with my three cats
body.body:
> Hola de nuevo! Hoy les traigo un nuevo post bastante genial, esta vez de un nuevo set de fotos de mis tres hermosos gatos. Últimamente he estado muy full de cosas, sin embargo siempre quiero apartar un poco de tiempo para traer más publicaciones, ya que estoy dispuesta con mi meta de publicar más seguido por acá. He comenzado la universidad y en mi trabajo hay cambios de nuevo, hace unos 8 meses más o menos ocurrieron cambios que me mantuvieron con mucha intriga y algo de estrés, y algo que siempre me mantiene feliz es ver a mis hermosos gatos. Remy llegó en un momento de mi vida donde cargaba mucha incertidumbre y estrés, en ese momento ya tenía a un gatito que ya no está en este plano, y tener dos gatos de verdad que fue una de las mejores decisiones. Al año llegó Jade, poco después del fallecimiento de mi primer gato, y fue una luz muy bonita a nuestra casa a pesar de la profunda pérdida. Lia es una gatita especial, ella llegó hace casi 6 meses, muy chiquita pero feliz. Desde que llegó ha sido pura alegría para los otros dos gatos, los cuales la adoran mucho. Algo muy distintivo de mis gatos es que prácticamente no hizo falta introducción entre ellos, la verdad es que nunca hubo peleas fuertes ni cosas raras entre ellos, los únicos que se la pasan peleando son Remy y Jade, y es que a veces ellos dos no se llevan bien, pero en otras ocasiones los puedo ver a los dos juntos durmiendo o montados en la ventana. Jade últimamente tiene la costumbre de dormir en mi cuarto sobre mis cosas, así no esté, Lia ahora se la pasa en un mueble para gatos que hizo mi papá, y Remy ahora es el que se la pasa despierto casi todo el tiempo para hacer travesuras. Les tomé varias fotos a lo largo de estos días y espero que les guste!
Hi again! Today I’m come to you with another awesome post, this time featuring a new photo set of my three beautiful cats. Lately I’ve been really busy, but I always try to set aside a little time to post more, since I’m committed to my goal of posting here more often. I’ve started college, and there are changes at work again. About eight months ago, some changes happened that left me feeling pretty anxious and a bit stressed, but one thing that always makes me happy is seeing my beautiful cats. Remy came into my life at a time when I was dealing with a lot of uncertainty and stress. At that time, I already had a kitten who is no longer with us, and having two cats was truly one of the best decisions I ever made. A year later, Jade arrived, shortly after the passing of my first cat, and she brought such a beautiful light into our home despite the deep loss. Lia is a special little cat; she arrived almost six months ago, very tiny but happy. Ever since she arrived, she’s been nothing but joy for the other two cats, who absolutely adore her. Something very distinctive about my cats is that they practically didn’t need any introduction to each other; the truth is, there were never any serious fights or strange incidents between them. The only ones who are always fighting are Remy and Jade, sometimes they don’t get along, but other times I can see them both sleeping together or perched on the windowsill. Lately, Jade has gotten into the habit of sleeping in my room on my stuff, even when I’m not there. Lia now spends her time on a cat tree my dad built, and Remy is the one who stays awake almost all the time, getting into mischief. I’ve taken several photos of them over the past few days, and I hope you like them!

Digital ID isn't necessarily biometric ID.  Our accounts on Hive are digital, but not biometric.  Biometric ID uses some unique biological feature, like retina scans, DNA, or fingerprints, as a source of data to identify each individual.  The problem with biometric data used for ID is that the data is not secure, and no government or institution has demonstrated the ability to prevent that data from being hacked by criminals.  If our password is hacked, we can change our password and protect our identity.  If our biometric data is hacked, the hackers can exploit us for as long as we live, because we cannot change our biometric data.

India required biometric ID ~10 years ago, and today you can purchase the biometric data of >1B Indians on the darkweb for ~$80k, last I heard.  Every one of those people can never change their biometric data that is now for sale by criminals.

Regarding digital ID and jobs, I do not have a job, and do not need digital ID to get a job.  I strongly recommend people provide goods and services instead of seeking employment that requires digital ID.  I am confident that digital ID will be used to force us to comply with government tyranny using social credit scores managed by AI, likely by Palantir that is providing means to genocide Palestinians today.

Thanks!

body.title: Why You Compare Yourself Even When You Know You Shouldn’t
body.body:
In today’s world, comparison feels almost automatic. You scroll through social media, see someone achieving something big, and suddenly your own progress feels small. Deep down, you know comparing yourself to others isn’t helpful—but still, you do it. Why?

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX2j2fS5w8a8NnzNoGmfAugYQKWjMaP2am8groAQgAuNF/img_3655.png)

The truth is, comparison is a natural human behavior. Our brains are wired to evaluate where we stand in relation to others. It comes from a time when survival depended on understanding your position within a group. But in the modern world, this instinct often works against us.

One of the biggest reasons we compare ourselves is constant exposure. Social media shows us the highlights of other people’s lives—their success, happiness, and achievements. What we don’t see are their struggles, failures, and behind-the-scenes efforts. When you compare your full reality to someone else’s highlight reel, the result is always unfair.

Another reason is lack of clarity in your own path. When you’re unsure about your goals or progress, it’s easy to look at others for direction. You start measuring your worth based on someone else’s timeline. But life doesn’t follow a universal schedule. Everyone has a different starting point, different challenges, and different opportunities.

There’s also a deeper emotional layer—the need for validation. When you see someone doing better, it can make you question your own value. This isn’t because you’re weak; it’s because you’re human. We all want to feel like we’re doing enough and moving forward.

The problem with comparison is not that it exists, but that it becomes constant and negative. Instead of motivating you, it starts draining your confidence. You begin to focus more on what you lack rather than what you’ve achieved.

So how do you deal with it?

First, be aware of your triggers. Notice when and where you compare yourself the most. Is it while using social media? After talking to certain people? Awareness is the first step to control.

Second, shift your focus inward. Instead of asking “How am I doing compared to them?”, ask “Am I better than I was yesterday?” Growth is personal, not competitive.

Third, limit unnecessary exposure. You don’t have to quit social media completely, but you can control what you consume. Follow people who inspire you without making you feel inadequate.

Finally, accept your own journey. Life is not a race with one finish line. It’s a path with different directions for everyone. What works for someone else may not work for you—and that’s perfectly okay.

At the end of the day, comparison only steals your peace. The more you focus on your own progress, the more confident and fulfilled you become. You may not be where someone else is—but you are exactly where you need to be to grow.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPmVP53JytEx7m6DXBX2sp4p6zmaa8ajcdv3prHnrV9H5/0_wj9yq_ch2s3og5dg.gif)

We have all been doing a great job building the #hive community by making insightful posts and having our amazing students follow up and also leaving nice, heartfelt comments that keeps the teachers encouraged and that is called CONSISTENCY, that is a great habit that we should never stop inculcating. 

 https://media.tenor.com/6IWbsMnNr8MAAAAC/rainbow-spongebob.gif 

While waiting for the weekend so we can rest I want is to quickly enjoy mercredi to the fullest so I want you all to put into consideration a very important lesson in 5 minutes. 
That brings us to the topic of Today.
Today’s word is TOUJOURS and Toujours means always, now you see what I meant by relating the today’s lesson with consistency right?

 https://media.tenor.com/mTFl9_JXgkoAAAAC/monogatari-series-skedaddle.gif 

When we say toujours it’s not just for fun but it is used to talk about something that happens all the time or something that continues without stopping thats why I applauded us all and the #hive-engine ecosystem for  being continuous or running toujours with or without me. It’s very easy to read and put in sentences and the pronunciation is like too-zhoor. Too zhur! It’s pronounced sharply. 

 https://media.tenor.com/M_7u8OBRiPwAAAAC/i-love-you-love.gif 

Study these few examples below 👇 

Je suis toujours là — I am always here 

(là) means there 

Suis means am

Je means I

 https://media.tenor.com/MBqLC5Be_swAAAAC/you-and-me-you-and-i.gif 
 So read the ⬆️ together again

Elle parle toujours — She always talks

Elle means HER 

parle means TALK

Dieu est bon toujours — God is good always. 

It’s a simple word but very expressive. 

When you use toujours, it adds a sense of consistency to what you are saying like when we all know that God is good toujours or #hive  runs toujours. 
And when you think about it, “always” is a strong word even in life. 

I love God always and it keeps me going. Toujours  shows repetition, habit and sometimes even commitment.

 Thank you all for reading  and learning with me. 

I love you 🫶🏻 toujours. 

 https://media.tenor.com/Y4GZI_Qes3IAAAAC/beach-beautiful.gif 

SAINT HEROD 🦸‍♂️

body.title: Sedi, Pokhara, My Home in Nepal
body.body:
![ ](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/x-rain/Eoc6a1v7FDLrD6Q74A6UL6UEZZkrPgDMdWpEQT8hM8VFD9Zp3bJPv3wBcUBeeFWcmZ2.png)

Pokhara is a city that appeals to many.

Its touristy part called Lakeside resembles a Thai town from the point of infrastructure and cleanliness; there are many bars and cool cafes there (and twice as cheap as in Thailand). And Lakeside is quite concrete and unauthentic, though cozy, and European bakery is amazing there. Love Pokhara has this place, but it's not where I want to stay.

Pokhara also has a more authentic part - the economic center (Chipledhunga) and [historic area](https://peakd.com/hive-163772/@x-rain/old-pokhara) (Old Pokhara Bazaar's neighborhood).

And the third option is to stay at more rural locations. I chose Sedi Village.

![ ](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/x-rain/23tbijUHhFGRgZmurqsZqUsNoKKTDJCjaLmWrnJxzT4VD4zz6HseFYUgMEkh5fGgwVGAs.jpg)

*Sedi on [Google Maps](https://www.google.com/maps/@28.2259725,83.9529586,1883m/data=!3m1!1e3?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDQxOS4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D)*

It's actually a part of the city - it's only a 15-minute walk to the nightlife of Lakeside. There are frequent public buses from Sedi to Lakeside, Chipledhunga, and other districts. But it's greener, quieter, and cheaper.

I believe that's the best place to stay in Pokhara... Sharing views and info.

![DSC_6123-3.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/x-rain/23zkk7TPqXtZAhroFwXxcVfGh9nrKjWiN7zzYuG58RLnmXNcMAbLDij3SyFaALKMTcPSD.JPG)

Going down the hill slope, my everyday routine.


![DSC_6129-4.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/x-rain/23wMTzjHLR5Htz7iyMqpdGopaVPQwrCY9M2HybLzJkaPrg7u3g4mvvPFLDJqYyD7761de.JPG)


Passing by corn fields,

![DSC_6067.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/x-rain/242Nefj5QR2Q3DsBwzhakoHds8pitB6Pdaj3fBu13syJ9Qs7ctRD5FCbPXjeJpVy3287L.JPG)

Grass thickets,

![DSC_6125.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/x-rain/242ruFUPjr11qHska8CqWLvas1VAWwq8CACEdmDV1upQbUJAmULiRFMCWQfCXjVjphtor.JPG)

And bizarre houses -

![DSC_6132-2.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/x-rain/EoyQTvb2KjzYHAGp2k8saKGsbYemdd8JLdJtUqhWdeVN5pRzPJYeivSYxTSWwBuLTw8.JPG)

Houses with kitties. 

![DSC_6132.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/x-rain/EoEr1jzjxBatCXs2GTDpc6bBo6X8N2KE2iQ5vhFkoZGzuGwdWDGDD6CD47av1Az5rcH.JPG)

Many households have cats there - half of them perhaps. But you can't see cats so easily as in the more urban environment since they stay indoors or in the gardens or hide somewhere in thickets. Nevertheless, I regularly meet some of them.

The main street:

![DSC_5692.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/x-rain/23w2kq6WHERUUW7WFqxHYcA7pGmQJeDLoyWZQhoyir24Ad1JjE5NLSLbt2zJaDradFz1K.JPG)

Here, I go every day to buy food. Quite urban, with a series of shops, eateries, and even a decent cafe with cappuccino and wifi where foreigners come to hang out with their laptops.

Right behind the main street, there is a lowland on the shore of the lake.


![DSC_5699.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/x-rain/244e6HYbJcfHUquLgM5EgGeErwS7yK6ZGhYRKzPpTVbfCViefG2eXcZXdxGcuvp4amHq7.JPG)

The area is open to everyone. Nothing grows there except for grass in April 2026, and the field serves as a pasture for cattle.
 
![DSC_5959.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/x-rain/23tbuQvNVb4FbVXR7jVziMhWV8fc2aX7TTJyeW2MFLisAFmUtVzvVd2TaEfUxwpBxXkFA.JPG)

There are dogs as well but Nepalese mongrels are so sweet that they almost have made me a full-swing dog lover.

Apart from dogs, mongooses are regular there. Never seen so many mongooses in my life as in Sedi. 

![DSC_6029.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/x-rain/23tc5WWGpEU9zKTrxpfsRKmwpyy1nAqirbZx32BUQ8intCJWJ55FbHgqaJsWzzhMnG1FG.JPG)

Never ever encountered kites (Milvus migrans) so daring as in Pokhara. Once, one of them, playfully rushing away from an angry crow, flew a couple of meters over me, with his powerful wings wide open.

![DSC_6055.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/x-rain/23tSRuxpyX7vJckHMwC8q5UnngvKS1S13ayUFGHmhfrkf7wQndZyJ6GtMJ1h3NLAJmtvu.JPG)

Kingfishers are another type of feathered hunters here.

There are plenty of shrikes (charming birds!) in Sedi, and specifically on the lowland I am talking about.

Another living beings who immediately attract your attention:

![DSC_5711.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/x-rain/23ynQDW4KgwbqK5t9fJHHLYv79QSZdtYxVY5AHRwdk1MD8UyABiUf2LHG6j6temr7YgVB.JPG)

Horses are remarkably perfect from the aesthetic point of view.

![DSC_5712.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/x-rain/242rqFfrsGmnG2MBWsWfmpyFhQbr8L4UZNUmwgBnrKmXinXKbXeDtKwTWoEFjcCK3L8fs.JPG)

Beautiful, but not my favorite hoofed creatures.

![DSC_5728.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/x-rain/243zk6ZAwT3nEvY9kMJqKEtgU7Uh3xQKdChJNFAu7MNezPbHxNJW3sThJZQp4JAoyHcu6.JPG)

They feel too introverted for me (sorry, horse lovers!)

And these are my favorite hoofers:

![DSC_5783.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/x-rain/23wX5guNahN9NQsP9WWf6wbcexRshKD6Yj6cAw4rHp3ufSG7vjEmyEc76aqyhRn3j5doh.JPG)

I don't know their psychology well, so try to keep a safe distance, lol. But love reading their eyes - they talk with their faces... at least to me, lol.

![DSC_5786.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/x-rain/23xKtCkwuHtbG1Bp1d2xn4br1MjZhenFo11boW2Rh9dUL1uMEBPDEuAGSZydRSooC9ZJp.JPG)

Hope to make friends with a buffalo one day. 😀 And I have a good chance for that - you'll know why below!


![DSC_6073-3.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/x-rain/EprT5For5Jdbw2oMCXiDq2KC1rhgQ76EU4TN46Gsv4Jm8k9HBhh8o97FiU8VuuLXtfz.JPG)


Such is the idyll in the valley at the foot of the Himalayas... I'm actually writing this post from the Nepal-India border - getting a three-month visa and then returning to Sedi - I love the place.

![DSC_5804.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/x-rain/23vhuD32sdXp1HHWmgdvpWMeZjwmgG6HmufA1GbaeR3kqJ5JSx5yPcRdwgRbW2kzLPrHm.JPG)

My Beautiful Garden - a simple sign of a guesthouse in Sedi I stayed previously ($4 a day, with a shared bathroom). A good place but popular on booking.com - my room was booked by someone and I had to leave... And that's how I found even a better place - a guesthouse ($3.3 a day, with a shared bathroom) next door to its owner's place, where he keeps his own buffaloes... 😍 He also said they have a cat. Looking forward to meeting her! 😀

*The photos were taken with a Nikkor 50mm f/1.8G and a Nikkor 70-300mm on a full-frame DSLR Nikon D750 in April 2026 in Sedi, Pokhara, Nepal*

body.title: Tomorrow is the Polling day in our State
body.body:
Tomorrow is a very important day for our state. We have some interesting politics going on in our State for the last few months. The candidates who are in the election are very interesting. Polling happens tomorrow and the results are coming out on the 5 th of next month. That is when counting happens. We are very curious to know about this election because we have a new movie star who is one of the candidates. There is a huge hope on that candidate and people are also expecting a change. 

In my opinion polling is very important and it is the right of every citizen to vote in the elections. They should also participate on the elections if they can. I stopped following politics long back but I do keep myself up to date on a high level. Till 2017, I used to even talk some politics with friends and in social media. After a big realisation, I stopped doing that and I feel very good about it now. 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfT5LDqzsMG1U8ocTEpyqYAbBwztWcFPUYwYhYydWWKJg/1776877127234.png)


Source - ChatGPT

Tomorrow has been declared a holiday by the government to make it easier for people to Vote. People even travel to their home town just for the sake of voting. There are also many dedicated individuals coming from foreign countries to cast their votes. This time it is very hard to say who will become the chief minister here because there is a tough competition going on. People expect change but still not sure if they will vote for the right candidate or not. 

I usually take part in this and go and cast my vote to the candidates that I think is deserving. I also feel that this voting system should be improved by the government. They are still using manual methods to cast votes. There are so many technological advancements happening and even Blockchain can be used to make people cast their votes but we are still dependent on physical devices to capture the votes. There again I wouldn't say that it is a flawless system. But it just works. Hopefully in the near future when we have proper government and good adoption of the technology, we might have a better system someday.

Yeah, the whole blockchain thing would have never happened under Tim Crook. But is what it is. I see them focusing more on AI from here as the Apple Silicon is honestly the best thing for consumers to run local models on. 

And that's what I have been doing is building my own little AI data center at home with Mac Mini M4 Pro with 64Gb of unified memory as the brain of it all that connects to 2 ubuntu machines. One runs 4 UTXO nodes (BTC, LTC, DOGE, XMR) and mines XMR. The other machine is a dedicated Ethereum layer 1 RPC node that is about to be running some arbitrage and liquidation bots on it. I have given it all the tools I need to be completely local so I do not have to use corporate or public models anymore. It is currently building itself a massive library to get data from on my external drive. It's basically downloading and archiving all the important information on the internet I would need for basically any situation. Training it with RAG, web tools, giving it terminal and file access to the system, and even TradingView charting and pinescript skills and abilities, all without have to 'retrain' the actual model.

body.title: A Nice Harp Playing Music Video and Playing Activities in Rising Star Game...!
body.body:
Hello to all members on Hive Blockchain Platform.

I would like to share you about A Nice Harp Playing Music and Playing Activities in Rising Star Game.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfH6BZrynR4riLWQ1qwa8rk4K8YuLUVeo46ncc4mJKnx5/1776876191152.jpg)


I wanted to share a Harp Music today.
So I chose a NFT card from **Rising Star Game**.
The name of card is **225 Nala**.
She is a beautiful girl.She is a nice player of harp.She played very well.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWBWpTnSCBkUW4hdKjzok3cGfRHSjus48pnShXijc4a6D/1776876216828.jpg)



I created about **225 Nala** harp music video from **PixVerse** AI application.
I took a screenshot photo how to make a music video from there.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXBWBu6X2b8kTY4jeG4FsuCyp5U5oSg35UUdAqfWkPRXs/1776876244169.jpg)


I got a nice harp playing music of **225 Nala** from **PixVerse** AI.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVJCrfW4WLWuT9Lpbm5LdRZQQCgPG43yXxg15Ge22zCdY/1776876298214.jpg)



I wanted to edit to get more interesting for this music video.
So I used and edited **Capcut** application.
I used Text button and added Text as a title for starting video.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbAbNMVfNxGXzBew4pNNWMN1wnwDDTP6TJ37jFmGen9e2/1776876329129.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWoFWNAEfGZx41vwsKus9z8aVqfncZQvLs1FuqYQMXSQb/1776876329173.jpg)


I used the related sticker for music video.
And then I used **Thanks for watching** sticker for the end of video.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmStvyz3wYwVvBa9QuS5e3CWEu37zSRwqrj6xSWaGybgoT/1776876371957.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWaGYLKzvehg2n8ZbTiPbM6fppJycu7rtZGTFNz5VWmnj/1776876371999.jpg)


I did not adjust this music video today because it is not possible to use free users for better resolution as a 1080P and image quality of this video.
I did not upgrade yet for my **Capcut** account.
Anyway I exported this music video as a free user.
I got a nice harp playing music video of **225 Nala**.
Please be patient for the best quality of this music video.

https://youtube.com/shorts/W1mVypXeIAs?si=seMy2v54QvCpx6z0


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdzAZKTA8sJKVL5MfqQZpnJ2hBABPP8a26JVqscW4j7Ug/1776876557213.jpg)


I am playing in **Rising Star Game** today.

I played more and more missions day by day.
I finished some of my favorite missions in game today.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXNhQ6ESMFgVQAHz6UMkQsP1NjVxLgn1oc8BNLuCz2t3b/1776876607062.jpg)


I made a sell ordered of Special- Seasonal NFT card on the market.
The name of card is **S125 Eggos Kit** .
It has 10 Luck.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmem682Fzpqk8AETF7WLp2LWv1nDjserN3kbodyLZ5rksK/1776876649138.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYucqApUrHCG3J5vgDrh23t87wsDNSURJkqjLQVnaUdXJ/1776876674412.jpg)


I made the lowest price of this card on the market today.
I made it for 310000 STARBITS.
It is the lowest price of this card after making of my selling ordered on the market.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRDT2A1YkE8TH7Yg3F6bvUpacKUaxhPSdvE2mj41Q7azy/1776876696933.jpg)


I bought three NFT cards pack today.
I got one rare card and two common cards.
They are not so bad.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmePKQdrbR1wtkKv4XR9pikbaWRAEoY6K9LYetDqSBaYXV/1776876729133.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNMSGTFSF6f9wZ2Mt8Q9mKMkij1qHbuk9S3bk5DeXaJny/1776876729171.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeiqvc4SThe35f6SHSqEtWsVSg7ctGsNgQcTU8MC9MT6r/1776876729219.jpg)



I will try my best in future.

Thank you so much for reading my post.

Have a nice day.

Good luck.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd6rW76Jnc5YwLKZMQi2QKhy834b21T872AUnMQp287pE/1776876826751.jpg)

body.title: A Biblical Representation of the portrait.
body.body: > The room was silent except for the faint crackle of a dying candle. Its flame flickered low, casting a warm, trembling glow on the man’s face. Shadows danced across his features, deepening the lines of worry carved by years of struggle. His eyes steady yet heavy seemed to hold stories too weighty for words.

/> His name was Emmanuel. That night, Emmanuel sat alone, his back against the wall, his hands clasped tightly together. Not in strength but in surrender. Life had not turned out the way he had hoped. Dreams once bright had faded into disappointments. Opportunities slipped through his fingers like sand. And though he had tried to remain strong, something inside him was quietly breaking. He looked into the small flame before him, as if searching for answers hidden in its glow. “God… are You still there?” he whispered. The question hung in the air, fragile and honest. For a long time, there was no response at least not the kind he expected. No thunder. No voice. Just silence. But it was not an empty silence. It was the kind that invites you to listen deeper. Emmanuel’s mind drifted to a memory from years ago, when his mother would pray over him before sleep. “Even in darkness, God’s light never leaves you,” she used to say. At the time, he believed it easily. But now, surrounded by what felt like endless night, belief seemed harder to hold. The candle flickered again, almost going out. Emmanuel leaned forward instinctively, shielding it with his hand. And then it struck him. The flame was small weak, even. Yet it refused to die. Not because it was strong, but because it was protected. Because something stood between it and the darkness. He froze. “What if… that’s me?” he murmured. What if all this time, even in the moments he felt abandoned, God had been quietly shielding him? Not removing the darkness, but preserving the light within him? Tears gathered in his eyes—not from pain this time, but from realization. He thought of the times he should have fallen completely… but didn’t. The doors that closed, only for something better to open later. The strength he somehow found on days he was certain he had none left. Maybe God had never left. Maybe God had been there in the silence, in the waiting, in the unseen protection. Emmanuel exhaled slowly, his grip loosening. For the first time in a long while, peace settled over him not because his problems had disappeared, but because his perspective had changed. He bowed his head. “Lord… I don’t need all the answers tonight,” he said softly. “I just need to know You’re with me.” The candle steadied. Its light, though small, seemed brighter now—reflecting in Emmanuel’s eyes, no longer weighed down by despair but quietly renewed with hope. He stood up, not as a man who had everything figured out, but as one who had remembered something essential: that faith is not the absence of darkness, but the decision to trust God’s light within it. And as he stepped away from the wall, leaving the flickering flame behind, he realized something even deeper. The light he had been searching for… had been inside him all along.

body.title: Outfox Launches In SA Schools And Universities
body.body: that teaches players how to perform under pressure using a simulation. Those that watched the documentary series \

which was an inside view into the South African rugby team would have seen Outfox being used as preparation ahead of their next matches. Outfox has been in development for the last 13 years and has been over seen by Rassie Erasmus the Springbok rugby coach. Rassie has always been into analysis and finding new ways to unlock and break down his competition since his playing days. When he was playing he used to spend hours on research analyzing their next opponent and developing new moves that may or may not work. This video analysis was not available back then and this was done off his own back using video cassettes and a video machine. Once he showed his value to the team coaches allowed him to do his thing and introduce new moves.

/> [source](https://ssschoolsplus.co.za/outfox-by-rassie-erasmus-officially-launched-to-sas-leading-school-rugby-coaches/) Outfox is a next level game app for the players and teams along with coaches to experiment. The app will load the current data of the opposing team and then the team with the app simulates game play looking for weaknesses. If you can recall during the World Cup quarter final against France back in 2023 the players noticed a chink in the French armor and discussed tactics on how to take advantage of this. The tactics discussed were used in the match and they scored from these moves which caught the French off guard.

/></center>

[source](https://ssschoolsplus.co.za/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/WhatsApp-Image-2026-04-10-at-08.56.51-1-400x184.jpeg)


One of the schools in the Western Cape has been using Outfox since February this year as part of their rugby training program. This school was never seen as a rugby powerhouse and what they have achieved in the last two weeks beating the top 2 ranked schools in the country is quite remarkable. Yes they have an elite training program that has been on the go for a number of years, but these results were a shock to how things are quickly changing. 

As we know the schools are spending vast amounts of money on their elite rugby programs and this app will definitely help speed the process up of achieving higher standards. This is being offered to all schools and universities in South Africa before being rolled out in the UK for those who want to benefit from this app.

One can expect most of the professional rugby teams if not all will invest into the app and expect to see the likes of the England rugby team joining. Coaches along with players have to continually develop and the SA rugby team being part of this app for the last 4 or 5 years has definitely benefitted. Sharing this app with other teams is the right thing to do and the SA rugby team will still have the upper hand as they have been using it for so long and know how to use this to benefit the team. This has come over years of experience using this app where other teams will still be adjusting to learning what the app can offer.

links.title: MLB: El arte de batear  [ESP/ENG]  ||  OPINION
links.body: <div class= 'text-justify'>\n\n      Es bien difícil saber cuan peor estarían los Reales de Kansas City, sin la contribución desde el roster, del jugador MVP (Clásico Mundial de Béisbol) natural de \

Maikel García. Un cuerpo de pitcheo que se suponía más consistente de lo que ha sido, no ha ayudado en la crisis por la que atraviesan los nobles, en el último lugar de la división central de la liga Americana. Pero esto no ha detenido a Maikel, como propulsor de la parte ofensiva y se ve envuelto en la mayoría de los movimientos de carreras sobre el terreno. Ayer, fue un ejemplo palpable. Luego de un sencillo para impulsar la segunda rayita y acercar 3 a 2 a los Royals, abajo en el marcador contra los Orioles de Baltimore en el cierre del 5to., García logró avanzar a 3ra. con el siguiente hit y anotó la del empate con fly de sacrificio de Pasquantino. Más tarde, sería el resolutor del juego con sus piernas, al aprovechar un \

que no pudo retener el receptor oropéndola, para anotar la de dejar en el terreno al equipo contrario. Marcador final: 6 a 5, para capear el temporal encima de los nobles. Esperemos. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     It’s tough to imagine how much worse the KC Royals would be without World Baseball Classic MVP and 'La Sabana' native Maikel García carrying his weight on the roster. A pitching staff that was supposed to be more consistent has done no favors for the Blue Crew, who are currently bottom-feeders in the AL Central. But that hasn't slowed Maikel down; he’s been the spark plug for the offense, right in the middle of almost every rally. Yesterday was a perfect example. After a knock to drive in the second run and pull the Royals within one in the bottom of the 5th, García reached third on the next hit and scored the game-tying run on a Pasquantino sac fly. Later, he’d use his wheels to end it, taking advantage of a wild pitch the O's catcher couldn't handle to score the walk-off run. Final score: 6-5, a much-needed W to help the club weather the storm.

# ---

![García.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23yTjZPsde9jkB3hmuXA6JJqSpNDHWRSvUPTkENcaU6nFfrFW6uvfCwVHALRvqGXpp4Ac.jpg) Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/orioles-vs-royals/2026/04/21/824127/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
#
     Batear es un arte. Es una de esas frases clásicas que, quienes no han visto una recta a 95 MPH venir hacia ellos, no pueden colocar en su justa dimensión. Y tal dificultad, se magnifica cuando usted está metido en una racha, porque muy dentro de usted desea continuarla. Claro, no todos tienen los mismos reflejos cuando enfrentan un pitcheo a alta velocidad, pero pude corroborar lo difícil que es golpear una pelota a 65 MPH (unas 30 MPH menos que el promedio en las mayores), cuando nos metimos varias veces a jaulas de bateo, justamente para practicar. Es el caso de Shohei Ohtani metido en una de 52 partidos llegando a base (ésta un poco más \

dado que incluye base por bolas, golpeados, etc.) o un poco más difícil, la de batear de hit en partidos consecutivos. El infielder venezolano Ildemaro Vargas extendió ayer a 19 juegos (los tres últimos de la temporada pasada y los 16 que lleva en la presente), su cadena de partidos bateando de hit, la más larga activa en la actualidad dentro de MLB. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

      Hitting is an art. It’s one of those classic phrases that people who haven’t faced a 95 MPH heater can’t truly appreciate. That difficulty is magnified when you’re on a hitting streak, because deep down, you're desperate to keep it alive. Not everyone has the same fast-twitch reflexes, and I saw firsthand how tough it is to even square up a 65 MPH pitch—30 MPH slower than the Big League average—when we hit the cages for some BP. Take Shohei Ohtani, for example, with his 52-game on-base streak (a bit 'easier' since it includes walks and HBPs). But stringing together hits is another story. Venezuelan infielder Ildemaro Vargas just extended his hitting streak to 19 games yesterday (carrying over the last three from last season plus 16 this year), making it the longest active streak in the Bigs right now.

# ---

![Vargas.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23wqgD5eqBB5iokcCDy5gojAmnw3M2ZyBLewUu6geF8Q2W2KsWTLtWTz4SkXexhYMHi91.jpg) Screenshot from [Source](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/white-sox-vs-d-backs/2026/04/21/825099/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
     Ildemaro ya impuso un récord de franquicia en Arizona cuando llegó a 17, ahora con 19 está a 7 juegos de distancia de la cadena más larga para un venezolano en la historia de la MLB, en poder de Wilson Ramos impuesta en 2019. Ayer, estuvo a punto de ser detenida por el pitcheo de los Medias Blancas y aunque no pudo detener la caída de su equipo, Vergas pudo maquillar sus números y de los Backs al aprovechar su último turno al bate en el noveno. Hombres en las esquinas, conteo de 1-0 y a una sinker a 95 MPH le dió con el alma, aterrizando la pelota detrás de la cerca del jardín derecho. Con el estacazo, el hombre continuó con la racha viva, además de acercar a Arizona 11 a 5. Es verdad, no alcanzó, pero ese marcador se lee mejor así que haber obtenido 11 a 2. Por cierto, dentro del equipo de Chicago no alineó Luisangel Acuña, hasta hace poco titular del jardín central de la ciudad de los vientos. Quien sabe si los \

le perdieron la paciencia. Sigamos ligando a Ildemaro para que alargue su cadena de imparables. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     Ildemaro already set a franchise record in Arizona when he hit 17, and now at 19, he’s just 7 games shy of the all-time mark for a Venezuelan, held by Wilson Ramos since 2019. Yesterday, his streak was on the ropes against the White Sox pitching staff. Although he couldn't stop his team’s slide, Vargas managed to pad his stats and help the D-backs' box score by coming through in his last lick in the 9th. With runners on the corners and a 1-0 count, he got a 95 MPH sinker and absolutely crushed it, sending it deep over the right-field wall. With that no-doubter, he kept the streak alive and cut Arizona's deficit to 11-5. Sure, they fell short, but that score looks a lot better than a 11-2 blowout. By the way, Luisangel Acuña—who until recently was the everyday center fielder for the Windy City—was out of the ChiSox lineup. Who knows if the Sox are starting to lose patience with him. Let’s keep pulling for Ildemaro to keep that hit parade going.

---

![Contreras.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23vhwxaryvg1iLboWU4TuA6tmC4gyBYqXZ4cMUB95hfsCbzC9uCQySbtccHqhtSKew7MM.jpg) Screenshot from [Source](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/brewers-vs-tigers/2026/04/21/824290/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
     El receptor venezolano de los Cerveceros de Milwaukee, William Contreras, continúa siendo una pieza importante para la ofensiva lupulosa. Por estos días están de visita en Detroit y ayer estuvo metido entre los bates clave en el movimiento de carreras, de una victoria holgada de 12 carreras a 4. Y aunque el abridor venezolano Keider Montero por Detroit entregó una salida de calidad, fue otro venezolano relevista (Enmanuel De Jesus), quien cayó en el abismo al aceptar de la ofensiva de Milwaukee 5 carreras limpias entre los episodios 7 y 8. Contreras fue uno de los ejecutores de su compatriota, al batear par de hits impulsores de carrera y estacionar su AVE en .308, demostrando que es uno de los mejores receptores ofensivos de la pelota en la actualidad. Con el triunfo, los lupulosos se mantienen peleando desde el 4to. lugar en la cerrada división central de la liga Nacional a dos juegos del líder, mientra que -a pesar de la derrota- los Tigres se mantienen en el 3er. lugar de la división central de la liga Americana. Amanecerá y veremos. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     Milwaukee Brewers Venezuelan´s catcher William Contreras remains a cornerstone of the Brew Crew’s offense. During their current road trip to Detroit, he was a clutch factor in a 12-4 rout yesterday. Although Venezuelan starter Keider Montero turned in a quality start for the Tigers, it was another fellow countryman, reliever Enmanuel De Jesus, who got shelled—giving up 5 earned runs to Milwaukee between the 7th and 8th. Contreras helped do the damage against his compatriot, racking up a pair of RBI knocks to sit his average at a solid .308, proving he’s one of the elite offensive backstops in the Bigs today. With the W, the Brewers keep battling from 4th place in a tight NL Central, just two games back of the lead, while the Tigers—despite the L—hold onto 3rd in the AL Central. We’ll see how the rest of the season unfolds.

#

En serio que en este país parece imposible aburrirse; uno nunca sabe con qué sorpresa va a llegar el día.

El mundo en general suele ser un lugar de más incertidumbres que de certezas, pero la mente humana necesita algo de estabilidad para mantener su salud mental. Quizás es por eso que las estadísticas de afecciones mentales han ido incrementando a la par que la crisis económica, política y social se fue agravando.

Lamentablemente, tengo tiempo sin datos actualizados, pero recuerdo que ese gráfico de curva ascendente que relacionaba la cantidad de consultas a psiquiatras y psicólogos, las compras de medicamentos para tratamientos a condiciones mentales diversas y el aumento del nivel de riesgo y de estado de crisis fue algo bastante revelador hace unos años.

Lo que me queda es tratar de mantener el mejor ánimo que puedo, seguir a flote y esperar a ver qué nueva sorpresa me trae el día a día.
