links.title: Wednesday stroll, beautiful avenues, city and more./ Paseo de miércoles, hermosas avenidas, la ciudad y mucho más.
links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme9NTMVmeKCApf26GUAXB22F3n3bL2Df6vvicT6G7PWnF/1776869242681.jpg)

Good afternoon, blog friends, how are you? Here I am again with my Wednesday walk. Today I returned to Pistoia in the morning, luckily I went in the morning because this afternoon there was a big storm. I went to Pistoia to run some errands and I stopped in Pistoia Sud, where I sometimes go to buy some things for my husband and go to my doctor, who is in that area. Luckily, I always like Pistoia a lot, and it's always a pleasure to walk around the city. I should walk a lot more, I confess, but unfortunately, between depression and anxiety, sometimes I get really stuck and become too sedentary, which isn't good, especially because taking medication and eating a lot makes me tend to gain weight easily. Anyway, it was a pleasant walk. First I passed one of the city's tree-lined streets, which fortunately has many (if you follow my blog, you'll know I have a weakness for tree-lined streets), with its beautiful, small, well-kept terraced houses in soft colors. It's a charming and simple avenue, perfect for a walk.

> Buenas tardes, amigos del blog, ¿cómo están? Aquí estoy de nuevo con mi paseo del miércoles. Hoy regresé a Pistoia por la mañana, por suerte fui temprano porque esta tarde hubo una gran tormenta. Fui a Pistoia para hacer algunos recados y me detuve en Pistoia Sud, donde a veces voy a comprar algunas cosas para mi esposo y a mi médico, que está en esa zona. Por suerte, siempre me gusta mucho Pistoia, y siempre es un placer pasear por la ciudad. Debería caminar mucho más, lo confieso, pero desafortunadamente, entre la depresión y la ansiedad, a veces me quedo realmente estancada y me vuelvo demasiado sedentaria, lo cual no es bueno, especialmente porque tomar medicamentos y comer mucho me hace tender a subir de peso fácilmente. En fin, fue un paseo agradable. Primero pasé por una de las calles arboladas de la ciudad, que afortunadamente tiene muchas (si siguen mi blog, sabrán que tengo debilidad por las calles arboladas), con sus hermosas, pequeñas y bien cuidadas casas adosadas en colores suaves. Es una avenida encantadora y sencilla, perfecta para dar un paseo.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbNEcQMn54oXabqxVrSEaDaSQiVriJxxQAS6Kroe8GGdH/1776869292168.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd5L6MWiirnpY8AwKuR3Ler8mWcGUok9FXWw6CpFBfVKY/1776869292329.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPKYhxkdajKLwJUHAka9yMXy1PTEKYXJ6RFxZihDxwwSK/1776869292451.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbRZZzibvzbSawAnBSNSrdRMNgjqn6wKnfrU9xNaEAXas/1776869292576.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUs33kuvntJ8kCMPJzTgbWLp8QmFjnbzRHcc1q76myn8e/1776869292709.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWwufrUaaeh8238M1Ay4giffW2rxjTk84VpeyC5FsQivB/1776869349667.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPuxftkBZQ8U8DwzhWfDbiAmxVLDTDFsH5ZAVK7jUycRe/1776869349822.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbauhADMwByLydJjobeCAHxJBrTXED3K9ivo8ZoQS7avQ/1776869349936.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTH4KH6g1PTz8VDc2fyqKgtLbAN2Q6GyUzhH5FSTKHn69/1776869350049.jpg)


Then I decided to extend the walk a bit since I had to wait for the shops to open, so I headed towards a more rural area, near some garden centres. It's a very beautiful area, like all the countryside around Pistoia and its surroundings. I had to run through it a bit because, unfortunately, I didn't have much time, and I'd seen the forecast predicting rain, so I didn't want to get all wet! Finally, I took another beautiful city avenue, also lined with traditional, simple houses, and then I reached my destination. I took some photos of the surroundings, especially of one side of the city from above, with houses and buildings and the sky slowly clouding over, a beautiful view of the city. I hope you enjoyed this walk with me. See you next Wednesday, blog friends!

> Entonces decidí alargar un poco el paseo, ya que tenía que esperar a que abrieran las tiendas, así que me dirigí hacia una zona más rural, cerca de algunos viveros. Es una zona preciosa, como todo el campo que rodea Pistoia y sus alrededores. Tuve que correr un poco porque, por desgracia, no tenía mucho tiempo, y había visto que el pronóstico anunciaba lluvia, ¡así que no quería mojarme! Finalmente, tomé otra bonita avenida de la ciudad, también bordeada de casas tradicionales y sencillas, y entonces llegué a mi destino. Saqué algunas fotos de los alrededores, especialmente de un lado de la ciudad desde arriba, con casas y edificios y el cielo que poco a poco se iba nublando, una vista preciosa de la ciudad. Espero que hayáis disfrutado de este paseo conmigo. ¡Nos vemos el próximo miércoles, amigos del blog!

links.body:
<center>

# Emergency Support Appeal, A Friend in Genuine Need | AINAB Welfare Foundation

</center>


![p2424 (1)](https://hivepostify.cloud/uploads/posts/00b4d058d0da1ea920678374b4537644.webp)


---

<center>

*Assalamu Alaikum / Greetings to all,*

</center>

---

Today, I want to share a **raw and honest reality**. A friend of mine is going through a tough time and has reached out to me with a heavy heart.

---

## What Happened

Earlier today, I got a message from a close college friend. He told me he is in a **serious financial emergency** right now. Things had become so dire that he was about to **sell his phone** just to get by, but a couple of friends stepped in at the last moment to help him. Because of this crisis, he couldn’t even come to college today.

He messaged me with trust and hope. I could feel the weight behind his words. This is not someone who complains easily or asks for help without a good reason. I know him well; **he does not lie, and he would never reach out like this unless he truly needed help.**

---

## Why We Are Keeping His Identity Private

Out of respect for his dignity and privacy, **we are not sharing his name or personal details publicly.** His identity will remain protected. However, I am fully aware of this situation and personally vouch for his need being genuine.

The conversation we had was real. His struggle is real. His trust in me is real.

---

### Proof Details


![p1](https://hivepostify.cloud/uploads/posts/7cfaa4621fea8f76d42ddd6f5fd2cc1f.webp)


![p2](https://hivepostify.cloud/uploads/posts/c53733084f3708eb5d8875316034df50.webp)



---

## AINAB Welfare Foundation's Commitment

As always, **transparency and accountability are at the core of what we do.**

✅ All rewards generated from this post will be **fully transferred** to support my friend  
✅ Any donations sent to **@ainabwelfare** with the memo **\

** will go **100% to him**  
✅ We will share a **public update** once funds are transferred as we have done in all previous cases  
✅ **No fees. No deductions. No personal benefit.**

---

## How You Can Help

You can support in any of the following ways:

- **Upvote this post**  every vote increases the rewards that go directly to him  
- **Reblog / Share**  help this reach more people  
- **Donate HIVE or HBD** to **@ainabwelfare** with the memo: `Support for Friend Emergency`  
- **Leave a comment**  even a few encouraging words can mean a lot  

---

## A Word from the Heart

Life is full of unexpected challenges. Sometimes people do their best studying, working, trying and suddenly they find themselves lost. My friend turned to me for help. Now, I am turning to **you** this community that has always shown kindness and support for others.

I cannot solve his problem alone. But together, **we can.**

Even the smallest contribution a vote, a share, a kind word can remind someone that they are not alone in this world.

> *\

*  

Whether you share this belief or not, the principle remains: **kindness in someone's darkest moments is never forgotten.**

---

## About AINAB Welfare Foundation

@ainabwelfare is a student-led, non-profit humanitarian group built on the Hive Blockchain for full transparency. Every donation, transfer, and reward is publicly recorded and verifiable. We have successfully supported a previous case, and our track record speaks for itself.

- 📌 Our Community: https://hivepostify.cloud/communities/hive-134547 
- 📌 Previous Update: See our earlier post **\

*  

---

<center>

*With sincerity and accountability,*  
**AINAB Welfare Foundation**  
*Service Without Profit | Transparency Without Compromise*

</center>

---

links.title: Guild Brawls With Pizza 2 - We Got Lucky With The Misses!
links.body:
<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23uFcH8GDdYWRsixYPTsvDPf9JmL6DpTYvChjYcXZmXabsdzQYzVvDcjqjtdZzdBqG3cQ.png)</center>

Time flies! Just completed the 268th brawl with my awesome guild, which is none other than Pizza 2 The Deep Dish!

***

- *Fun In The Discord Chats*

Really appreciated the interaction in the Discord chats within the Pizza guilds. During the preparation phase, there's a lot of information sharing and discussion on who to fill each fray. During the brawls, there were reminders to members to complete their brawl battles. And after the brawls, there were celebratory messages and some members (including me) would write about our experience in the brawls. Aside from brawls, I thought the donations were also very well organised and tabulated, with lucky draws to incentivise donors as well.

- *Moving Back To Bronze Fray*

Had 8 battles this time and it was not an easy round, especially when they have recently introduced 3 rulesets for each battle. Moreover, I have rented out most of my cards because I was playing lesser these days.

- We Got 6th!!!

So for the final result, we were 8th out of 10 guilds and got 350 Merits and around 8 SPS! A good bag of SPS! Who knows how much one SPS would go to in this market?
<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23tbRm6ULst4d1w2aBgqjP2F2z5dPi2RugP75MQWmnPa7Ew8yLNhqAvutC8mK3VzisV2D.png)</center>



Individually, I had 8 fights this time and I won 6 of them this time! Finished 4th within the guild. Due to change in format, wins are actually awarded to the players present in the fray if guilds decided to skip the fray. For this round, there was 1 additional win for me.
<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23tbLxZ2KNmCGSrt2i1Z7Ve1QpVE29aL7Gi1Th6AQtLJSDmf5C7Pzy4nRtNZERNkEMqsM.png)
</center>


***
**Battle 1 - LOSE**

*Gladius Card Used: None*

As usual, I lost because my opponent had Quora Towershead. I am kind of tired of commenting these unbalanced battles nowadays.

**MVP: None**



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23tGZw8vZRsMzZQkTzkk1uXEtJEYEKNBhiHddqLNNri8it8ZrP4MLNotjDggBKwnrosnR.png)









***
**Battle 2 - WIN**


*Gladius Card Used: None*

The full Magic lineup did extremely well thanks to the boost from Delwyn Dragonscale and we were back to winning ways! Thanks goodness Earth cards weren't allowed. If you know you know, lol!

**MVP: Delwyn Dragonscale**



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23tGcDGr4hmLmWRF5oQeHy8EzB9daoZrzhdAvyDNDfgEWFXKbqAGDsChP3p5WbMxHS3Rq.png)









***
**Battle 3 - WIN**

*Gladius Card Used: Marisol Contuma*

What a fantastic performance from Marisol Contuma! Its high speed absorbed a lot of misses from my hard hitting opponent and that made the difference! A bit lucky with the probabilities as well!

**MVP: Marisol Contuma**


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23tGaDxuULn6oYixPrAhMpKDDcA9Tb9cD5K9z353wRvFSHRbZamgL9jcGd7nPGaTGZTxc.png)


***
**Battle 4 - WIN**

*Gladius Card Used: Trapp Falloway*

I almost thought I lost this because my opponent field a sole Gladius card and my minion cards would easily allowed the Gladius card to clock Bloodlust. But miraculously, Astral Entity came to the rescue with Dodge ability and I was getting all the misses from a card with 5 speed! Credit to Trapp Falloway for dealing the hits swiftly to clear the opponent out.

**MVP: Astral Entity**



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/Eo44rEcF9RPQces9fXiHF8WLLUSw6HZbpKtVAqLveKdL2KVpEocCbLJUHQtSZbZwcdb.png)







***
**Battle 5 - WIN**

*Gladius Card Used: None*

These low mana battles are very interesting and this time I was the one opting to go with 1 card. The ruleset was tricky and I just went with my gut feeling, once again, it could have gone either way but my Flying Dragon card absorbed the critical misses and we made it narrowly!

**MVP: Redwyrm Dragon**


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23tGZrMjXUnGDaQGyJmFUTpQyqhZK1a5BXUkbmZGEjakVtjhqC9hdthVFDr6PDzB24YzP.png)






***
**Battle 6 - WIN**

*Gladius Card Used: None*

Yet another close shave! Both teams put a long list of cards for a 19 mana battle and thanks to Pelacor Deceiver, who bought a lot of time for the team through the misses (again) and we managed to win the race against time.

**MVP: Pelacor Deceiver**


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/Eo1wRHrZFxsTVcrjuFpZViyyiNca3jB1KGM4hRVXAjAiZF1PMomAUm7fvikwHiKe7XB.png)



***
**Battle 7 - LOSE**

*Gladius Card Used: None*

Quora Towershead. Whatever. Hahaha.

**MVP: None**


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23t76y6jA5fVyptTp71275p1aBqpP6pEBe9HQd8ZuPX4A2ujWotoNLRbUjukF77E7iHj8.png)

***
**Battle 8 - WIN**

Opponent fled!

So that sums up my 8 battles for this brawl! 75% win rate this time, and it's 100% win rate even we exclude battles against Quora Towershead. Lol! Let's keep fighting PIZZA 2!
***
**Review Of Gladius Cards**

No new Gladius cards to review this time round.

links.title: Why studying less can sometimes give better results
links.body:
Since early in life, we have all been taught that the more you study the better you perform. Our parents, teachers and the society continue to convey to us that the more time you spend studying, the better your results will be, and the less time you spend, the worse your results will be. But is it ever so? This is something I have been pondering over and, to be honest, I am not entirely certain that more hours of study necessarily yield higher results. Less studying can really produce more results and I believe there are actual reasons as to why this happens.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcCgm4wxbeyTUxHpE26iRwQSYRZoULZ1kbZoPkuLBa879/screenshot_2026_04_22_220442.png)

[Source](https://www.freepik.com/free-photo/woman-home-with-notepad-notebook-thinking-about-plans_13180117.htm#fromView=search&page=1&position=36&uuid=ca28bab9-1ef7-4aa6-bd99-f596e681478b&query=why+studying+less+can+sometimes+give+better+results)

I would like to tell you about my experience. I needed to spend hours studying, and the results were not always satisfactory when I was in my postgraduation. My mind was weary and I was not able to take in things. However, there were moments when I studied less hours but with complete concentration and the outcome was to my surprise better. In my own practice, I believe that it is the quality of studying that is more important than the number of hours studied.

Now, just to think about it. What would happen when a student studies eight hours a day but without a proper focus and plan? He is only reading the book, however, his thoughts are not on it. What sort of outcome should we anticipate of that? I do not believe that it will be a good outcome. Now assume that another student studies three hours but with full concentration and a focus. He is aware of what and how to study. The likelihood of the second student performing better is high, and I think that most individuals will agree to this.

Honestly, I also believe that there is a limit to the brain. At some stage, it cannot take in new information effectively and pushing it to learn further would only worsen the situation. It is stuffing a bottle even when it is too big. The additional water will simply flow and go to waste. Breaks and allowing the brain to relax can also assist the brain to remember information better. The brain is always fresh, and it therefore performs better when it is fresh.

Stress is another thing I would like to mention. During the time when an individual studies too much, the level of stress goes up. And I know that we all know that stress is not a good performance enhancer. During exams a relaxed and calm mind can easily remember things than a stressed and tired mind. In some way, studying less and having the mind relaxed can be more helpful.

I am not indicating that there is no importance of studying or that it should not be avoided. Naturally, one has to study and there is no quick way to learn. Nevertheless, I believe that the approach is important. It is always wise to study less but study intelligently than to study a lot without any intelligence.

Then, as long as you are a person who spends hours and hours on studying and still does not think that the results are proportional to the efforts, there is a possibility that the strategy should be changed. I think quantity will never be more than quality.

links.title: Zamba Mix
links.body:
by Siberiann on Paul Lindstrom 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/paulindstrom [![Zamba Mix](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/961a3a3e-2e46-4461-9f35-dbe60ba03686.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/oxHay8ZaDRgGv3ptyBnN4k) 
 
 El aire seco del norte argentino parece guardar en sus partículas la memoria de cada rasgueo, una vibración que nació del encuentro, a veces violento y otras veces íntimo, entre las tradiciones andinas y la influencia española que llegó con la conquista. No fue un proceso inmediato ni lineal; la zamba surgió como una respiración lenta, un lamento que se fue moldeando en los patios de tierra y en las cocinas de adobe, donde el tiempo no se medía con relojes sino con el movimiento del sol y el ritmo del trabajo. Al principio, era apenas un eco distante de la zambeza africana, transformada por la geografía extrema de Salta, Jujuy y Tucumán, perdiendo su velocidad original para ganar en profundidad emocional y en esa cadencia pausada que hoy define su esencia.

Los músicos de antaño, aquellos cuyas manos estaban curtidas por el campo y cuyas voces llevaban el polvo del camino, entendieron que este género no era solo una cuestión de compás, sino de actitud. La guitarra dejaba de ser un instrumento de acompañamiento rítmico para convertirse en una extensión del cuerpo, dialogando con el bombo legüero, ese corazón de cuero y madera que marca el latido terrestre. Era común ver a las parejas bailar sin tocarse, separados por un pañuelo blanco que agitaban como si fueran alas, creando una tensión erótica y espiritual que resolvía la distancia física con una proximidad emocional abrumadora. 

Con el paso de las décadas, la zamba dejó de ser exclusiva de las fiestas populares rurales para entrar en los salones urbanos y, posteriormente, en los estudios de grabación. Figuras como Atahualpa Yupanqui o Los Chalchaleros no solo interpretaron estas melodías, sino que las dignificaron, puliendo las letras para que hablaran del amor perdido, de la tierra añorada y de la identidad nacional con una poesía que trascendía lo local. La estructura musical se complejizó, incorporando armonías más sofisticadas sin perder esa raíz ancestral que la hace reconocible al primer acorde. El contrapunto entre la voz masculina, grave y contenida, y la femenina, aguda y doliente, creó un tejido sonoro que resonaba en el pecho de quien escuchaba, independientemente de su origen.

Hoy, cuando un intérprete toma una guitarra para ejecutar una zamba, no está simplemente reproduciendo una partitura antigua; está invocando una tradición viva que ha sobrevivido a modas pasajeras y a cambios políticos. La evolución del género ha permitido fusiones con el jazz, el rock o la música electrónica, pero el núcleo permanece intacto: esa capacidad de detener el tiempo. No se trata de volver al pasado, sino de mantener viva la llama de una expresión artística que entiende que, a veces, lo más profundo se dice en silencio, entre un rasgueo y otro, dejando que el eco resuene mucho después de que el último sonido se haya desvanecido en la noche.

La zamba trascendió el ámbito puramente sonoro para infiltrarse en la sensibilidad creativa de otras disciplinas, actuando como un hilo conductor que une distintas formas de expresión artística. En la literatura, los escritores del norte argentino y aquellos atraídos por el paisaje árido encontraron en la estructura narrativa de la zamba una metáfora perfecta para el amor imposible y la distancia insalvable. Poetas como Jaime Dávalos o Manuel J. Castilla no solo escribieron letras, sino que construyeron versos donde el pañuelo blanco se convierte en símbolo de una comunicación silenciosa, de lo que no se dice pero se siente con intensidad. La prosa regionalista adoptó ese ritmo pausado, esa respiración entrecortada, para describir paisajes donde el tiempo parece detenerse, creando una atmósfera literaria cargada de melancolía y espera, reflejo directo de la cadencia musical que inspira la contemplación antes que la acción.

El cine, por su parte, utilizó la zamba como banda sonora emocional para narrar historias de identidad y desarraigo. Directores como Leonardo Favio, en obras maestras como \

, entendieron que la música no era un adorno, sino un personaje más. La cámara aprendió a bailar al ritmo del bombo, realizando movimientos lentos, circulares, que imitaban el giro de los dancers, capturando la tensión entre los cuerpos sin necesidad de diálogo. La imagen se volvía poética, teñida de ese sepia nostálgico que evoca la memoria, y la zamba servía para subrayar la tragedia cotidiana o la belleza efímera de un encuentro, estableciendo un lenguaje cinematográfico propio que priorizaba la emoción sobre la trama lineal.

Incluso la moda, aunque de manera más sutil, absorbió la estética de este género. El vestuario tradicional, con sus polleras amplias y voladas, sus blusas bordadas y el infaltable pañuelo, dejó de ser exclusivo de las festividades folclóricas para inspirar diseños contemporáneos que buscan reconectar con las raíces. Diseñadores argentinos han reinterpretado estos elementos, utilizando telas naturales, colores tierra y cortes que permiten el movimiento fluido, evocando la elegancia rústica de la zamba. No se trata de un disfraz, sino de una reivindicación de la identidad cultural a través de la indumentaria, donde cada pliegue recuerda el giro de una vuelta y cada textura la tierra del norte.

En el terreno musical, la influencia es aún más vasta y permeable. La zamba ha dialogado constantemente con otros géneros, desde el tango hasta el rock nacional. Músicos como Gustavo Santaolalla o grupos como Los Abuelos de la Nada incorporaron la armonía y la métrica de la zamba en composiciones modernas, demostrando que su estructura es lo suficientemente flexible para adaptarse a nuevos contextos sin perder su alma. El jazz latino también encontró en la zamba un terreno fértil para la improvisación, respetando su compás de seis por ocho pero explorando nuevas vías armónicas. Esta capacidad de mestizaje ha permitido que la zamba no quede confinada al museo del folklore, sino que siga viva, transformándose y contaminando positivamente a otras expresiones artísticas, manteniendo su esencia mientras abraza la modernidad.

La zamba se erige no solo como una manifestación artística, sino como un pilar fundamental de la identidad nacional argentina, un símbolo que trasciende las fronteras geográficas del norte para convertirse en patrimonio emocional de todo el país. Su estatus de hito cultural radica en su capacidad única para sintetizar la complejidad histórica de la nación: la mezcla de razas, la fusión de tradiciones y la resistencia silenciosa frente a la homogeneización global. No es simplemente una canción; es un ritual colectivo que se repite generación tras generación, actuando como un ancla temporal que permite a los argentinos reconocer sus raíces en un mundo cada vez más acelerado y fragmentado.

Este género ha logrado algo extraordinario: unir a clases sociales, regiones y edades bajo un mismo sentimiento. En las escuelas, los niños aprenden a bailar la zamba como parte de su formación cívica y cultural, internalizando desde temprana edad los valores de respeto, cortejo sutil y conexión con la tierra. En las plazas públicas, durante las fiestas patrias o los encuentros familiares, la zamba surge espontáneamente, creando espacios de convivencia donde las diferencias políticas o económicas se diluyen ante la belleza compartida de la melodía. Es un lenguaje común que todos entienden, incluso aquellos que nunca han pisado las provincias del noroeste, porque habla de universales humanos como el amor, la pérdida y la esperanza.

Además, la zamba ha sido instrumental en la construcción de una narrativa nacional que valora lo propio frente a lo impuesto. Durante períodos de crisis identitaria o de fuerte influencia cultural externa, este género ha servido como baluarte de la autoestima colectiva. Intelectuales, artistas y líderes sociales han recurrido a la zamba para reafirmar la soberanía cultural, destacando su originalidad y su profundidad estética. No es una reliquia del pasado, sino una fuerza viva que sigue inspirando nuevas obras, nuevos debates y nuevas formas de entender qué significa ser argentino.

Su reconocimiento internacional también contribuye a su peso como hito cultural. Cuando músicos extranjeros estudian la zamba, no solo aprenden una técnica musical, sino que se acercan a una filosofía de vida basada en la paciencia, la escucha y la expresión contenida. Esto proyecta una imagen de Argentina sofisticada y profunda, lejos de los estereotipos superficiales. La zamba, entonces, se convierte en embajadora silenciosa, llevando consigo la esencia de una cultura que sabe encontrar belleza en la lentitud y significado en el silencio.

En definitiva, la zamba argentina es mucho más que música; es un acto de memoria colectiva, un ejercicio de identidad y un legado vivo que se renueva con cada interpretación. Su permanencia a lo largo del tiempo demuestra que ciertas expresiones artísticas tienen la poder de definir el alma de un pueblo, ofreciendo un refugio emocional y un sentido de pertenencia inquebrantable. Mientras haya alguien dispuesto a tomar una guitarra y rasguear esos acordes característicos, la zamba seguirá siendo el corazón latente de la cultura argentina, recordando a todos que, en medio del ruido del mundo, aún existe un espacio para la contemplación, la elegancia y la verdad emocional.

Es todo por hoy.

Disfruten del mix que les comparto, esta vez, sin voz, solo instrumental.

links.title: Bitcoin Pusher Review on Android
links.body:
If you grew up in the late 80s into the 90s then you probably remember seeing coin pusher games in arcades. They were popular because you could win money, most were set up with prize tickets you could redeem in the arcade itself. My brother was horribly addicted to one located in a seedy small town gas station in 2005 – they conveniently cashed paychecks there with no fee if you got at least $10 in quarters to play the coin pusher machine. This fueled my sibling getting addicted. From my experience with these machines, I can safely say, my brother would be addicted to Bitcoin Pusher as well.

Drop Coins, Win Prizes

The concept is simple. Drop coins in the upper area and the game pushes them into the lower field. Coins fall, making space for the coins you just dropped. There are three places’ coins can fall, only one pays. Only the lowest tray counts in your favor. This may sound horribly simple but there is a decent bit of strategy to coin pusher games. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=epsR039Eo1g

Pay Attention and Win Sometimes

The hardest part of these coin pushing games is winning. The coins are intermingled so it is nearly impossible to guarantee how they will react to new coins being dropped. Factor in objects such as dice and even other coins have different sizes and will affect coins and objects around them differently and you can see how Bitcoin Pusher can be infuriating. Don’t worry, the real game is just as maddening.

Earning Potential

Honestly, you are not going to get rich playing Bitcoin Pusher. Any Satoshi’s you earn will just be a little bonus. If you are looking for life-changing earnings, then you will need to look elsewhere. Bitcoin Pusher is not it. If you are looking for a reasonable digital recreation of coin pusher games, and don’t mind ads then Bitcoin Pusher might be for you. The video above is a longplay with ads to show how often they hit.

links.title: Peanuts and Sunflower Seeds Are All Sold Out! Thank You, Lord! 😊🙏❤
links.body:
Hello everyone!

Hope all are safe and well! 😊❤🙏

Today, I’m writing this with a very full and grateful heart. Sometimes, it’s really the simple things that bring the biggest joy and today is one of those moments for me. 😊🙏❤

Peanuts and sunflower seeds are all sold out!❤

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTPEEu2qrJUZBsvDambLqskm22vovoxDALKJrmoXZVCYd/copy_20of_20colorful_20photo_20collage_20food_20blog_20instagram_20post_20260422_233541_0000.png)

I still can’t believe how fast everything went. The peanuts I personally roasted, carefully prepared, and packed with so much effort is now completely sold out. Even the remaining sunflower seeds didn’t last long. It may seem like a small thing to others, but for me, this is already a big win, a reminder that every effort we put into something with love will eventually bear fruit. 😊❤🙏

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYFvc5aDARRLDgrS6x9GfFMN89NmtQRPQX3nEMkTE1787/20260422_185331.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRY89aQrGXZBiPNsHzTrndKQKWtioSMuHXipsVxsmEEpA/20260422_173722.jpg)

Just the other day, I was busy packing the newly arrived sunflower seeds. I even thought it might take a while before everything gets sold. But surprisingly, half of it was already gone that same day. 😊

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb4W4UXzBJNLd1SDJHrq195P7caq4hyNmosPh7aisDFUs/20260419_124711.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYq5yQMqM5jLPxm7cuYHu42azgg7tUnPp2PHMkezNmfkt/20260417_145515.jpg)

Behind these simple products are small but meaningful moments like late afternoons preparing, checking the quality, making sure everything is packed neatly, and silently praying that customers will appreciate it. Every pack I sell carries not just snacks, but also hope, hard work, and a little piece of my journey. 😊🙏

To my supportive customers, thank you so much from the bottom of my heart. Your support means more than just sales. It gives me motivation to continue, to improve, and to believe that I’m on the right path. Moments like this remind me that growth starts small and that’s perfectly okay. 😊💪🙏

Right now, I don’t have any stocks left, and honestly, I feel both excited and challenged. Excited because there is demand, and challenged because I need to prepare again, restock, and make sure I can serve even better next time. I’ll definitely be stocking up again soon, and I’m looking forward to sharing more with all of you.❤🙏

More than anything, this experience reminds me to be grateful. Grateful for the opportunity, for the strength to work, for the people who support me, and for the small victories that make life beautiful.🙏❤

Have a Blessed Wednesday everyone! 😀😀😀💖💖💖

Thank You Lord for the blessings and love!

Be grateful in every little/simple things and you’ll find happiness you ever wanted! 😀😀😀

Everyday is worth to be grateful of!

Praying for the safety and wellness of all.

Heal Our Land Oh God!

Lovelots,
@shikika

# Sustainable Style: The Rise of Eco-Friendly Fashion Trends in 2023

As we step into 2023, the fashion industry is undergoing a significant transformation, with sustainability taking center stage. Eco-friendly fashion is no longer just a trend; it has become a movement that is reshaping how we design, produce, and consume clothing. Here’s a closer look at the sustainable style trends that are defining the fashion landscape this year.

## 1. **Circular Fashion**

Circular fashion emphasizes a closed-loop system where materials are reused and recycled, minimizing waste. Brands are focusing on designing garments that can be easily disassembled and repurposed. This trend encourages consumers to participate by recycling their old clothes, leading to a more sustainable wardrobe.

## 2. **Natural Dyes and Fabrics**

In 2023, there’s a growing preference for natural dyes and fabrics derived from organic sources. From plant-based dyes to fabrics made from hemp, bamboo, and organic cotton, designers are creating pieces that are not only stylish but also environmentally friendly. The use of these materials reduces the carbon footprint associated with conventional textile production.

## 3. **Upcycling and Vintage Revival**

The upcycling trend continues to gain momentum, with designers transforming discarded materials into fashionable pieces. Vintage clothing is also making a comeback, as consumers seek unique items with history. Thrift shopping and swapping events are becoming popular, promoting a culture of reuse and sustainability.

## 4. **Ethical Production Practices**

More brands are committing to ethical production practices, ensuring fair wages and safe working conditions for garment workers. Transparency in the supply chain is becoming a priority, allowing consumers to make informed choices about the brands they support.

## 5. **Minimalism and Timeless Designs**

In a world of fast fashion, minimalism is emerging as a powerful antidote. Timeless designs that transcend seasonal trends encourage consumers to invest in quality pieces that last. Capsule wardrobes, featuring versatile and durable items, are becoming increasingly popular among eco-conscious shoppers.

## 6. **Technological Innovations**

Technology is playing a crucial role in the rise of sustainable fashion. Innovations such as 3D printing, biodegradable materials, and digital fashion are helping to reduce waste and improve efficiency in the production process. Brands are leveraging technology to create more sustainable solutions without compromising on style.

## 7. **Community and Collaboration**

The shift towards sustainable fashion is fostering a sense of community among designers, consumers, and activists. Collaborations between brands, non-profits, and environmental organizations are on the rise, amplifying the message of sustainability and encouraging collective action.

## Conclusion

As we embrace 2023, the rise of eco-friendly fashion trends reflects a profound shift in consumer values and industry practices. Sustainable style is not just a passing fad; it is a necessary evolution towards a more responsible and conscious approach to fashion. By choosing sustainable options, we can all contribute to a healthier planet while looking fabulous. 

Let’s celebrate this movement and continue to advocate for a future where fashion and sustainability go hand in hand! 🌿✨

body.title: Introduceyourself: Más vale tarde que nunca; Mi viaje de dos meses en Hive y quién soy detrás de la cámara/Better late than never; My 2-month journey on Hive
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWsBVH8hpHdmoSSQhHc5AGSmftK7yRKPdYQ4u6xmMRDwm/1776870959338.jpg)

Hola, comunidad de Hive! 👋

​Dicen que el tiempo vuela cuando te diviertes, y eso es exactamente lo que me ha pasado. Llevo un par de meses explorando este ecosistema, compartiendo algunas de mis pasiones, pero me di cuenta de que nunca me detuve a decir formalmente: ¡Mucho gusto, esta soy yo!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbeXJnPWaX8U4JnjA3L2YvkYCvcE8RgP7ttsmN57krZtp/1776870526698.jpg)

Soy una mujer de 38 años, orgullosamente venezolana, esposa y madre de dos hijos que son mi motor. Mi vida es un equilibrio entre lo cotidiano y la búsqueda constante de belleza en los detalles.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRWYW8vK7coar2yKdhrtV3KuvGS5YBGqci5hd5aRT5CRu/1776872991188.jpg)

Mi rutina es una mezcla de dinamismo y creatividad. Mis mañanas suelen empezar temprano, atendiendo el hogar y a mis dos hijos; mi hijo menor siempre me mantiene activa con su gran energía, mientras comparto momentos con mi hija adolescente. Entre las tareas diarias, siempre encuentro un espacio para mi pasión: salgo al jardín o camino por los alrededores para capturar la belleza de las flores con mi teléfono. Por las tardes, cuando la casa está un poco más tranquila, me dedico a escribir mis historias, practicar mi inglés y hornear algo rico para compartir en familia. Cada día es una oportunidad para aprender algo nuevo y encontrar poesía en lo cotidiano.

Algo que realmente me divierte y me motiva de estar aquí es sumergirme en los posts de otras personas. Me encanta descubrir las historias de otros usuarios, aprender de sus experiencias y ver el mundo a través de sus fotos. Cada vez que leo una publicación nueva, siento que aprendo algo diferente o encuentro una nueva perspectiva. Comentar y apoyar el trabajo de mis compañeros es una de las partes que más disfruto de mi día, porque aquí todos crecemos juntos.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVkAPv5virMdX8Pz3a9un2sDyHe3stfm2jzMsLwH5tM2U/1776870682164.jpg)

Si revisan mi blog, notarán que hay tres cosas que hacen que mi corazón lata más rápido:

La Fotografía de Naturaleza: Me encanta capturar la vida a través del lente de mi teléfono. Las flores y los paisajes naturales son mis modelos favoritos.

La Escritura Creativa: Me apasiona crear historias, poemas y participar en retos literarios que me permitan expresar mis emociones.

La Cocina y la Repostería: Disfruto hornear y compartir recetas tradicionales que unen a la familia.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ7EWyYS6cxqwr1i4mxXbPwH2urxt48hZU4FchR3wNQf9/1776871445969.jpg)

En estos dos meses he descubierto que Hive es mucho más que una plataforma; es una comunidad de aprendizaje. Estoy aprovechando este espacio para practicar mi inglés, mejorar mis habilidades de edición y conectar con personas que comparten mis intereses en comunidades como Ecency.

Gracias de todo corazón por dedicar un momento de su tiempo para leer mi historia y conocerme un poco mejor. Estos dos meses han sido solo el comienzo de una aventura que me tiene muy emocionada. Espero que podamos seguir compartiendo experiencias, fotos y muchas historias más. ¡Nos leemos en los comentarios!

Todas las fotografías compartidas en esta publicación son de mi autoría, capturadas con mi teléfono Tecno Spark 30. El texto ha sido redactado por mí y traducido con ayuda para compartirlo con la comunidad global.

English 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWsBVH8hpHdmoSSQhHc5AGSmftK7yRKPdYQ4u6xmMRDwm/1776871045728.jpg)

Hello, Hive community! 👋
They say time flies when you're having fun, and that's exactly what happened to me. I've been exploring this ecosystem for a couple of months, sharing some of my passions, but I realized I never formally stopped to say: Nice to meet you, this is me!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbeXJnPWaX8U4JnjA3L2YvkYCvcE8RgP7ttsmN57krZtp/1776871089834.jpg)

I am a 38-year-old woman, a proud Venezuelan, a wife, and a mother of two children who are my driving force. My life is a balance between the daily routine and the constant search for beauty in the details.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRWYW8vK7coar2yKdhrtV3KuvGS5YBGqci5hd5aRT5CRu/1776873024087.jpg)

My routine is a blend of energy and creativity. My mornings usually start early, taking care of my home and my two children; my youngest son always keeps me active with his high energy, while I share moments with my teenage daughter. Between daily chores, I always find a space for my passion: I go out to the garden or walk around the neighborhood to capture the beauty of flowers with my phone. In the afternoons, when the house is a bit quieter, I dedicate myself to writing my stories, practicing my English, and baking something delicious to share with my family. Each day is an opportunity to learn something new and find poetry in everyday life.

Something that I truly enjoy and motivates me about being here is diving into other people's posts. I love discovering other users' stories, learning from their experiences, and seeing the world through their photos. Every time I read a new post, I feel like I learn something different or find a new perspective. Commenting and supporting my peers' work is one of the parts of my day I enjoy the most, because here, we all grow together.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVkAPv5virMdX8Pz3a9un2sDyHe3stfm2jzMsLwH5tM2U/1776871179341.jpg)

*If you check my blog, you'll notice three things that make my heart beat faster:

Nature Photography: I love capturing life through my phone lens. Flowers and natural landscapes are my favorite models.

Creative Writing: I am passionate about creating stories, poems, and participating in literary challenges that allow me to express my emotions.

Cooking and Baking: I enjoy baking and sharing traditional recipes that bring the family together.*

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ7EWyYS6cxqwr1i4mxXbPwH2urxt48hZU4FchR3wNQf9/1776871398712.jpg)

In these two months, I’ve discovered that Hive is much more than a platform; it’s a learning community. I'm using this space to practice my English, improve my editing skills, and connect with people who share my interests in communities like Ecency.

Thank you from the bottom of my heart for taking a moment of your time to read my story and get to know me a little better. These two months have been just the beginning of an adventure that has me very excited. I hope we can continue sharing experiences, photos, and many more stories. See you in the comments!

All photographs shared in this post are my own, captured with my Tecno Spark 30 phone. The text was written by me and translated with help to share it with the global community.

body.title: Reviewing Devilman CryBaby _ You Just Want To See.
body.body:
Hello Anime Fans, so I watched Devilman Cry baby a while back, and honestly, it is one of those type of anime that doesn't  sit quietly in your head quietly even after you have finished it, it kind of kicks the door down, messes up the place, and leaves you staring at the wall like what did I just go through? The story starts simple enough, you have got this soft, emotionally fragile guy, Akira, who gets pulled into a world of demons by his friend Ryo, and instead of just becoming a monster, Akira becomes something in between still him, but with demon power, from there, everything just spirals, and when I say spirals, I mean it in the most chaotic, messy, emotional way possible.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQALUGb8WXBFoePq2C8rbWamp2nQrFzXGy6Wdvn35gZdN/1776873368628.jpg)

What really got me is not even the demon stuff itself, It is how human everything still feels, Like yeah, people are turning into monsters, the world is basically collapsing, but the real focus is how quickly humans lose their humanity when fear takes over, that part? That hits uncomfortably close.

Akira as a character is actually what makes this whole thing work, he is not some cold, overpowered MC, He cries, he cares too much, he is soft even when he’s strong, and that softness in the middle of all the violence makes the contrast even sharper,  You kind of end up rooting for him not because he is the strongest, but because he still tries to be good in a world that keeps proving goodness is not enough.

Then there’s Ryo… and yeah, so i won’t spoil  this too much, but let us just say that his character is one of those that makes you rethink everything you thought you understood about the story, the kind of relationship between Akira and Ryo is honestly the backbone of the whole anime It is intense, confusing, emotional, and by the end of it, you are probably just sitting there trying to process feelings you didn’t even expect to have.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTJQ6XvzrbN5QSFwNyNZTTKEfUJkqnhrcRqG9sY2tWakb/1776873377833.jpg)

Visually, this anime is kinda loud the art style is rough, almost messy on purpose, but it works, it feels like everything is constantly in motion, constantly breaking down, the music also deserves credit, there are moments where the soundtrack just carries the emotional weight so hard you can not ignore it.

Now let’s be real, this anime is not for everyone, because it is violent, it is sexual in a very raw way, and it does not really try to comfort you as  the vviewer, It is more like it drags you through the chaos and says deal with it, some people will love that boldness, others will probably just drop it halfway.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZqDSsaJqxb63wRZGrutwCrK3ubXxrZC5hJqZVkCiA8Mt/1776873388367.jpg)

But for me, it felt like one of those stories that is not trying to be enjoyed in a casual way, It is trying to be felt, and maybe even questioned after.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXt8pPXJqU9cAkWBKfVMLpZqmq5Ee1N7GXWKgFY5pNvZE/1776873398834.jpg)

By the time it ended, I didn’t really feel entertained in the usual sense,  I felt drained, a bit confused, but also weirdly impressed that an anime was willing to go that far emotionally and narratively.

So yeah I will say that … Devilman Crybaby isn’t a comfy watch, It is more like an experience you go through, you survive, and then sit quietly with it afterwards.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdZwsX9d62Y8fEU9s5mDF35N6N3eDBP3qpYVhdqBpm2t6/1776873410133.jpg)

<sub>[Imdb](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt6660498/mediaviewer/rm862933760/)</sub>***

*Aikay*👾

body.title: [religious brainwash]  Money for Nothing The Scientists, Fraudsters, and Corrupt Politicians Who Reinvented Money, Panicked a Nation, and Made the... #10/177
body.body: But the toll dropped during the winter, and stayed low, with only 2,000 more deaths from the disease tallied through all of 1666. Then, just as it appeared that the epidemic was truly done, came the four days in September when the Great Fire of London destroyed most of what lay within the old city walls, along with some newer neighborhoods to the west. Four hundred and thirty-six acres burned; at least thirteen thousand homes were destroyed. So were 87 out of the city’s 109 churches, including old St. Paul’s Cathedral. When that giant building caught fire, the tons of lead in its roof melted, creating a river of liquid metal flowing into the Thames.\n

>A new London began to rise almost immediately. The fire seemed to obliterate the plague, though that could well have been a coincidence in timing rather than the result of any lasting impact on the city’s rat population. Christopher Wren—often with the aid of his colleague in the nascent Royal Society, Robert Hooke—took the lead in restoring sacred London, building fifty-one parish churches along with his crowning monument: <span id=\

>the new St. Paul’s, with its glorious and technically sophisticated dome.

\n

>Life in the capital soon returned to an approximation of its preplague normal. The savants, Hooke and Wren among them, resumed weekly meetings at the Royal Society. Their conversations overflowed into the invisible university housed in the still-exotic coffeehouses and inns of the rebuilt city. Some of that talk was more enthusiastic than rigorous: at early meetings, the Society heard reports on “<span id=\

>a Very Odd Monstrous Calf” and “Of the Way of Killing Rattle-Snakes,” presented alongside “A Spot in one of the Belts of Jupiter” and “General Heads for a Natural History of a Country.” Newton himself took no part in that eager, hungry, small “c” catholic pursuit of new knowledge. It would take him twenty years and more to organize the results of the plague years into a fully realized body of work. He did so mostly in silence. He had some contact with members of the nascent Royal Society in the early 1670s. But he soon disappeared from the view of learned Europe. That was partly because he resented challenges to his results, partly because of his determination never to share a discovery before he was certain, and partly because for many of those “missing” years

>he pursued lines of inquiry that he actively wanted to keep secret: inquiry into heterodox religious beliefs and into the ancient pursuit of alchemy, which he saw as one more way to investigate change in nature. He wrote of his alchemical experiments to a handful of fellow searchers, but he rarely communicated in any public way with his fellow natural philosophers in London, and he visited the capital even less.

\n

>But such silence did not mean that he was unmoved by the same impulses driving the early Royal Society men, with their public commitment to knowledge for its own sake—and to the application of whatever could be discovered to practical uses. From the beginning, he too recognized that natural philosophy could comprehend daily life as well as the broad sweep of nature. As early as 1664, for example, before he plunged into the question of gravitation, he laid out a geometrical approach for calculating compound interest—his first contribution to the mathematics of money. <span id=\

>A decade later, he turned his quantitative virtuosity to the service of his home institution, helping Trinity College’s bursar analyze how much rent he should charge for land—farms that the college owned. Newton could count and Newton could think, and his work here—pricing an asset that offered payments over time—already hinted at the possibility that those two skills could make a man rich.

\n

>If that thought crossed his mind in his Cambridge years, he didn’t act on it. His full immersion into the world of money—on his own account as well as in service to the crown—would come a full three decades after his miracle year, when he took up new duties as an officer of the Royal Mint. Others, though, were beginning to recognize that there might be a connection between quantitative reasoning and wealth. They would pursue both riches and yet another new discipline: a science of change over time that took not the planets but people as its object. Perhaps the most complete representative of these new men was someone much less remembered than he should be: a polymath and voraciously money-hungry parvenu named William Petty.

\n\n

>*For example: the geometrical definition of a circle is a curve on which every point is the same distance from a single central point, a distance called the radius. Algebra produces that same circle as the solution(s) to an equation: (x – a)

>2, in which x and y are the coordinates for any point on the rim of the circle, a and b are the coordinates of the central point, and r is the radius of the figure.

\n\n

下班的时候肚子已经饿的是前胸贴后背。那该死的煮饭佬就这么会折腾人。
所以拿着我的水壶。里面还有一些茶。赶紧下班走人吃饭。
回来的路上，远远的我就看到那只上次遇到的猫。还是那一只胖猫。

对于这种肉嘟嘟圆滚滚还毛茸茸的毛，我真的一点抵抗力都没有。
跑过去把它撸了一会儿。这小家伙被我撸的特舒服的样子，还眯起了眼睛。
在撸它下巴的时候，它高高的把头扬起来。那头非常宽，而且有点扁。

从这头一下子就看出来，这是一只公猫。像眼镜蛇的头一样，扁扁的。
又让我抱了一下，这小家伙特别好玩。而且它身上的肉特别多。
不像我家的那只狸花猫。我家的那只傻猫除了会咬我，基本上啥都不会。

至少这一只灰猫，它能给我提供一些情绪价值。还不用付出猫粮。
哪像我家那傻猫我还煮了大虾，跟鱼给它吃，它看到不爽还咬我。
吃饱之后就马上往外面跑，也不知道它是平时在外面怎么浪的，肚子饿了才回来。

不过像这种猫，估计我是养不起的。应该是特别有钱的人才养得起这种猫。
像我家养我估计除了狸花猫就是橘猫。因为那两种猫都特别耐扛。
说白了那种就是不用管它。它比咱们自己都还能够照顾好自己。

最近，对于所谓的一体两面有了更多的看法。
慢慢就发觉，很多事情，其实都是善恶同因。
喜欢辣椒的人恰恰是因为辣椒辣，而讨厌辣椒的人也是因为辣椒辣。
喜欢折耳根的人就是要吃它那个独特的味道，而讨厌它的人也是因为那股味道。
随着时间的发展，慢慢就会发现，曾经你因为什么原因喜欢，最后就会因为什么原因讨厌。
其实我小时候一直想养宠物，然后或许是因为看了很多关于狗的电影吧，比如忠犬八公，或者那种狗狗为了救主人而让自己丧生的影片。
所以养宠物时我总会优先考虑狗，当然，还有一个重点是因为它的互动性比较强。
我如果养什么鱼啊乌龟啥的，我很少能得到什么互动。
所以我就是因为这些原因去养狗的。
可是等我养了狗以后，我以为他会忠诚，可是我发现它经常偷吃我东西，像人家视频里那种，食物不掉地上狗不吃的段子完全没照上现实。
事实是我有时候菜才端上桌，要是不拿东西罩着，狗要比我先动嘴……
至于一开始看重的互动性强这点，等它拆起家或者溜出门就叫不回来还去人家菜地里到处折腾就知道有多头疼了。
最终，就是我一开始喜欢它的那些点，都成了我烦它的点。
养宠物如此，人和人之间也是如此。
你如今喜欢她身材好，外貌好，未来就会因为其他人的追求而让你感到厌烦，到时候可能你脱口而出的就是“你都有对象了为什么还总和异性走那么近？”
你如今喜欢他幽默风趣懂浪漫，以后可能也会患得患失的害怕他会不会招其他异性喜欢……
小时候喜欢吃辣条，是因为它油大外加各种添加剂，很能满足味蕾，长大了因为那些添加剂，导致看到辣条都害怕。
这就是善恶同源……

body.body: ¡Qué reflexión tan necesaria y punzante, Issy (@issymarie2)!\nTu concepto de **\

** describe magistralmente esa fragilidad de las conexiones modernas: *algo que parece sólido a la vista, pero que no resiste el peso de la verdadera necesidad ni la lluvia de las dificultades reales*.

Me quedo pensando en que, para que la empatía sea genuina y no de cartón, necesita ser un puente con cimientos en ambos lados. La empatía, por más noble que sea, se alimenta de la reciprocidad. Es un flujo de energía vital que necesita retorno para no agotarse.

Sostener la comprensión y el apoyo hacia alguien que nunca está dispuesto a devolver el gesto, no es solo desgastante, es insostenible. Al final, si no hay ese intercambio mutuo, dejamos de practicar la empatía para caer en una suerte de *masoquismo emocional*. Nadie puede ser el puerto seguro de otro si ese otro nunca está dispuesto a ser, al menos, un refugio cuando nuestra propia marea sube.

¡Gracias por hacernos cuestionar la calidad de los vínculos que construimos! Un abrazo. En este punto, quiero comentar públicamente que extraño a la amiga @charjaim quien ya casi tiene dos meses sin publicar y no sabemos nada de ella.

body.title: Ink on My Hands
body.body:
>





 
It was the first time that Chinedu saw me, and he touched his bag a bit closer to his chest.

It was afternoon and hot in Oshodi bus terminal. There was a dusty, petrol-smelling roasted corn smell in the air. People were screaming of prices, drivers calling names, conductors hitting the sides of buses. I was close to a yellow bus heading to Yaba with my hoodie up, my slippers on and a small backpack on one arm.

Chinedu was seated already before the window. White shirt, white trousers, black shiny shoes. He resembled a person who was visiting an office and there was air conditioning and low tones of voice. As I entered the bus and sat next to him, he stared at me, and then at me. It was then that he fiddled with his bag.

I acted as though I did not see.

“Yaba! Yaba straight!\
And this bus will never pass Sabo, eh?\
It will go round. But traffic may stop us in front of that bridge.\
I have just been hired by a logistic firm,\
I am to present a report today.\
You do not even know me.\
You see, sometimes you can tell,\
You sound like someone that have been here for a long time?\
May I inquire of you something?\
When you got into the bus. I thought.\
you know I thought you might be.\
No. I am sorry, it is just. the manner you dressed, and.\
No, it is not all right, I made a judgment of you without knowing you.\
Fasting in this city, it Saves time.\
Yes, Signs, Posters, sometimes murals, anything people need.\
In Yaba there is a shop, where I work.\
That is why there is ink on your hands.\
I would like to be able to draw.\
I do not believe that I am patient.\
I am glad I had sat next you.\
Perhaps I may visit that store some day,\
You may demonstrate to me your work.\

body.title: Intellectual Obesity
body.body:
I hardly have to defend the benefits of eating healthy. I guess there could be someone out there who believes in hedonism—the YOLO approach to existence—but aside from raw, unfiltered emotion, there’s not much substance in that sandwich.


![49c29aea-dbea-4a74-8136-56a655637329.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/meno/23tmFNWfkChztV9mBSFcxjQ34iJojNim3vLWXUwop78UZmyBMQut17iRLivuD4szHsPxy.png)


So why isn’t it just as important for people to maintain a healthy consumption of media?

We are incredibly vulnerable to mental McDonald’s. In many ways, we’re becoming intellectually obese. Nuanced thinking is tiring, and it doesn’t feel as sweet as the bait the algorithms constantly feed us.

It almost doesn’t matter which platform we analyze—social media is saturated with the lowest-resolution takes on world events, political disputes, or worse: inconsequential tabloid drama. And we, the consumers, lap it up. Our attention drives the incentives, effectively making us participants in our own mental decline. We enjoy it, of course—but at what cost?

A poor diet leads to horrible outcomes—we know this all too well. I know it firsthand. But just as we can change our eating habits and improve our physical health, we can also change our media diet and improve our mental well-being.

When we see rage bait, we can choose to ignore it. When a political figure is sowing division, we can recognize it as performance—nothing more. When we feel tempted to care about fabricated drama between celebrities chasing relevance, we can resist on principle.

I submit that resisting mental McDonald’s will make you a happier person. The emotional highs and lows begin to level out. The noise of social media fades into the background. And while I hesitate to call that “winning” at life, it’s certainly one of the better colors on the palette.

—MenO

body.title: Donde el azul se encuentra con el alma: Un refugio entre sombras y salitre 🌅🇨🇺 / Where the Blue Meets the Soul: A Haven of Shadows and Salt 🌅🇨🇺
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUHA1UxDGwDRXSHk5fsukEuLKqRZmtGpJUoi4HH9dXU5S/1776871995847.jpg)

Hay días que no se miden en horas, sino en la intensidad de los colores y la calidez del sol sobre la piel. Estas imágenes son el resumen de uno de esos momentos donde decidí silenciar el ruido del mundo para escuchar únicamente el susurro de las olas y dejar que el horizonte dictara el ritmo de la tarde.

​Hay algo profundamente sanador en caminar por la orilla, sentir la arena húmeda bajo los pies y dejar que la brisa se encargue de despeinar no solo el cabello, sino también las preocupaciones. Estar frente a la inmensidad del mar nos recuerda lo pequeños que somos, pero también lo conectados que estamos con la naturaleza y su energía renovadora.

​Me detuve un momento a observar nuestra sombra proyectada en la arena, esa silueta compartida que nos recuerda que estamos presentes, que estamos aquí y ahora. Esos pequeños detalles, como el brillo del agua bajo la luz del sol o el contraste de mis pies fundiéndose con la espuma blanca, son los fragmentos de realidad que realmente valen la pena documentar y atesorar.

​En un mundo que corre tan de prisa, Hive es mi espacio para detener el tiempo. Les comparto estos destellos de mi paz, esperando que, al verlos, también puedan sentir un poquito de ese aire fresco y esa libertad que solo el horizonte marino nos puede regalar.

/

There are days that aren't measured in hours, but in the intensity of colors and the warmth of the sun on your skin. These images are the summary of one of those moments when I decided to silence the world's noise to listen only to the whisper of the waves and let the horizon set the pace for the afternoon.

​There is something deeply healing about walking along the shore, feeling the damp sand beneath your feet, and letting the breeze take care of disheveling not just your hair, but your worries as well. Standing before the vastness of the sea reminds us of how small we are, yet how connected we stay to nature and its renewing energy.

​I paused for a moment to observe our shadow cast on the sand—a shared silhouette that reminds us that we are present, that we are here and now. Those small details, like the shimmer of the water under the sunlight or the contrast of my feet merging with the white sea foam, are the fragments of reality truly worth documenting and treasuring.

​In a world that moves so fast, Hive is my space to stop time. I share these glimpses of my peace with you, hoping that by seeing them, you can also feel a bit of that fresh air and the freedom that only the ocean horizon can give us.

,  from researchers at Anthropic, or AI companies saying that term, it was actually us who invented it. Ohad in particular invented Tau, while myself and others invented or at least popularized the idea of a \

or AI Constitution.  The difference between our idea of Constitutional AI and Anthropic's idea, is ours is a decided by the community. The opinion map, the million person discussion, all of this was about creating the rules to govern AI, and only Tau has the ability to do this.

Ohad Asor did the research which you can find in Theories and Application of Boolean Algebra, on the website. This research is what allows for Tau Language which has unique patented properties allowing for a formal constitution to be created. Unlike Anthropic's constitution which has to be enforced centralized, by a company, where you and I have no input on what it says, and Claude isn't guaranteed to follow it, with Tau, I can say that agents are mathematically guaranteed to follow the rules. This means Tau Network is the only network that exists where agents are governable. Tau Language is the only language that exists that allows for true Constitutional AI. 

That's the breakthrough. Now we can look at some other stuff which isn't quite unique to Tau but is still valuable. Tau Language is correct by construction, any decentralized app is a formal specification, which means the sort of bugs where hundreds of millions or billions of dollars are lost, are mathematically impossible. Solana, Ethereum, these suffer vulnerabilities every few weeks, and now they are terrified of Mythos because of how many vulnerable smart contracts their network has.

Tau Net apps written in Tau Language will be invulnerable to the sort of hacks that commonly impact those other chains or even Hive. The only other chain I know of similar to this is Tezos, which also has never been hacked as far as I know. This is important because if we are going to build a decentralized economy, we don't win if people keep losing money from hacks, the whole DeFi loses legitimacy when this happens, and it's hurting everyone.

I hope that summarizes some of what Tau Net can do that no other technology can do. And I hope that shows you the value in the agentic era, where it's all about governing agents not just setting them to create slop and chaos.

body.title: REFLECTIONS OF SILENCE: A VISUAL CHRONICLE IN THE GORGES OF QUÍBOR / REFLEJOS DEL SILENCIO: UNA CRÓNICA VISUAL EN LAS CÁRCAVAS DE QUÍBOR   #monomad  Challenge [Eng/Esp]
body.body:
En el corazón árido del estado Lara, donde la erosión ha esculpido laberintos de arcilla y luz, nace una narrativa visual que desafía la percepción del espacio y la identidad.
> In the arid heart of Lara State, where erosion has carved out labyrinths of clay and light, a visual narrative emerges that challenges our perception of space and identity.

Esta serie fotográfica, capturada en el majestuoso paisaje de Las Cárcavas de Quíbor, Venezuela, es más que una muestra de moda; es un diálogo íntimo entre la fragilidad humana y la inmensidad del desierto. El modelo, vestido con una sastrería fluida y deconstruida que evoca una elegancia nómada, interactúa con un elemento de disrupción: un espejo.
> This photo series, shot against the majestic backdrop of Las Cárcavas de Quíbor in Venezuela, is more than just a fashion shoot; it is an intimate dialogue between human fragility and the vastness of the desert. The model, dressed in fluid, deconstructed tailoring that evokes a nomadic elegance, interacts with an element of disruption: a mirror.

![EML09761.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emlopez/23z7LSWRsqTB71i5yuyyg4AmC8XRNe21uCr6aEXqU42cs4YSAp4oH2CCgqeN2fsY81wUn.jpg)

Bajo una estética cinematográfica en blanco y negro, que exalta la textura rugosa de la tierra y el contraste de la piel con la tela, el espejo se convierte en el verdadero protagonista. Al estar en blanco o \

deliberadamente, se transforma en un lienzo conceptual que refleja la ausencia. No vemos el paisaje; vemos una invitación a la introspección. El vacío en el espejo cuestiona si somos parte del entorno o si somos meros observadores externos de una realidad preexistente. > Through a black-and-white cinematic aesthetic that highlights the earth’s rough texture and the contrast between skin and fabric, the mirror becomes the true protagonist. By being left blank or deliberately “erased,” it transforms into a conceptual canvas that reflects absence. We do not see the landscape; we see an invitation to introspection. The emptiness in the mirror raises the question of whether we are part of the environment or merely external observers of a preexisting reality. ![EML09768.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emlopez/243zffEQPoEiygrYyEDPjU3j2w2N6Wf7ongdQycEdMn2LyTA2Bs9c8LdGiYnp3PACHu8k.jpg) Esta propuesta surge de llevar la moda a la unificacion del arte en espacios naturales, y crear un impacto en la composicion fotografica en series editoriales para incentivar a otros creadores artisitico que podemos hacer increibles sesiones de fotos en espacios como estos. > This project stems from the idea of blending fashion with art in natural settings, and creating a visual impact through photographic composition in editorial series to inspire other artists to create incredible photo shoots in spaces like these. La experiencia fue Viajar a Quíbor a las 11:00 a.m. para estar en la hora perfecta planificada, conocida como la hora dorada, y asi capturar la luz suave antes de que el sol de Lara se ocultara. El desafío técnico fue manejar los reflejos reales del espejo en el desierto para mantener el concepto editorial de 'ausencia' que queríamos proyectar. > The experience involved traveling to Quíbor at 11:00 a.m. to arrive at the perfect planned time, known as the golden hour, and thus capture the soft light before the Lara sun set. The technical challenge was managing the actual reflections from the mirror in the desert to maintain the editorial concept of “absence” that we wanted to convey. ![EML09779.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emlopez/242Y5pqKAETDpQJBaEoZYTKLpS3u7uawXyKzjbxTzjgNQsbQrD8d749oWjuGN17acrXgq.jpg) Espero que esta serie fotografica les haya. gustado a toda la comunidad, nos vemos muy pronto con otra serie artistica y editorial.
I hope the whole community enjoyed this photo series. See you very soon with another artistic and editorial series.
![IMG_4243.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emlopez/23x1BTFmiLjRq9inosM9X3ENYQ6eSeHVqb4HiwrLcZjYESmqP52uiFtrTDtG8b2itt8n3.jpg)

body.title: Television Review: What Is Dead May Never Die (Game of Thrones, S2X03, 2012)
body.body:
![(source:tmdb.org)](https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/neKkHgfX7dgi4E47GKT7bYciq93.jpg)

**What Is Dead May Never Die (S02E03)**

Airdate: 15 April 2012

Written by: David Benioff & D.B. Weiss
Directed by: Alik Sakharov

Running Time: 52 minutes 



The epic scope of *Game of Thrones* is both its greatest strength and its most persistent narrative challenge. When a television series constructs a world as sprawling as Westeros, populated by dozens of factions, each with their own histories, motivations, and internal conflicts, entire hour-long episodes can pass without advancing the plot in any meaningful sense. Instead, these episodes function as elaborate exercises in exposition, moving chess pieces into position for the apocalyptic clashes yet to come. *What Is Dead May Never Die*, the third episode of Season 2, is a textbook example of this phenomenon. Its primary purpose is to introduce new factions, new characters, and their respective agendas, laying the groundwork for the chaos of the War of the Five Kings without delivering any major set-pieces or dramatic reversals of fortune. It is, for all its craftsmanship, an episode of preparation rather than payoff.

The most significant introduction in the episode is the faction supporting Renly Baratheon. By conventional criteria at this point in the series, Renly has the best chance of emerging victorious from the ensuing civil war. His army is the largest, boasting the greatest number of men, and his claim, while legally inferior to Stannis's, carries the weight of popularity and southern wealth. Yet Catelyn Stark, who arrives at his camp to negotiate a potential alliance, immediately identifies the rot beneath the surface. She notes that most of Renly's manpower consists of young knights hounding for glory and opportunistic nobles who expect a short, triumphant war. These are men unprepared for true hardship, for the brutal realities of siege and scorched earth that define warfare in Westeros. They are tournament fighters, not killers. Renly's other significant vulnerability is his homosexuality, a fact of which his wife Margaery Tyrell is acutely aware. Margaery, played with considerable intelligence by Natalie Dormer, warns her husband that he cannot afford to have his supporters whispering behind his back. Any nasty rumours must be put to rest, and the most effective way to do so is for her to conceive. This scene establishes Margaery as a pragmatic political operator, one who understands that perception is often more important than reality in the game of thrones.

While Renly's camp enjoys the comforts of the south, another faction prepares for war in the north. Theon Greyjoy learns that his father Balon intends to invade the North, whose lands have been left undefended because the Starks have sent all their forces south to fight Joffrey. Balon's plan is opportunistic and ruthless, and he assigns his daughter Yara thirty ships for the invasion while giving Theon a single, humiliating vessel. Theon briefly contemplates warning his old friend Robb about his father's treachery, a moment of genuine moral conflict that speaks to his fractured identity. He is caught between the family that raised him and the family that birthed him. In the final moment, he changes his mind and decides to follow his father, symbolically confirming his allegiance through a baptism ceremony. The scene, scored by Ramin Djawadi's powerful music, is one of the more memorable moments of the season, capturing Theon's desperate need for belonging and his tragic choice to embrace the worst aspects of his heritage.

Further north, beyond the Wall, Jon Snow has survived his encounter with Craster, the wildling who sacrifices his sons to the White Walkers. Craster allows the Night's Watch rangers to leave his keep but demands they depart immediately. Jon reports what he witnessed, only to learn that the Lord Commander was already aware of Craster's practices. The old man explains this with the cold pragmatism of the Watch: they must sometimes ignore the questionable practices of their assets beyond the Wall in order to maintain access and intelligence. It is an uncomfortable lesson in moral compromise for Jon. Meanwhile, Samwell Tarly promises Gilly that he will help her when the rangers return to Craster's keep, a vow that plants the seeds for future conflict and demonstrates Sam's quiet courage.

In King's Landing, Tyrion Lannister continues to establish himself as the true power in the city. He hides his lover Shae by employing her as Sansa Stark's personal servant, despite Shae's obvious lack of experience in such matters. But his most effective manoeuvre is a brilliant piece of psychological warfare. He decides to marry off his teenage sister Myrcella (Aimee Richardson) to forge a much-needed alliance for the weakened Lannisters. He informs three Small Council members—Pycelle, Varys, and Baelish—of his intentions but tells each a different groom, warning them all not to inform the queen. When Cersei arrives furious over Myrcella being shipped to Dorne to secure an alliance with House Martell, Tyrion knows that Pycelle betrayed him. He has the old maester arrested and thrown into a black cell. Baelish is furious at being manipulated, but Tyrion offers him a diplomatic mission towards Renly and Catelyn Stark, turning a potential enemy into a useful tool. This sequence represents some of the most effective political theatre in the series so far, and it is followed by Varys's speech about the true nature of power, which would become one of the most quoted passages of dialogue from the entire show.

On the road northwards, Yoren's caravan is intercepted by Lannister men. Yoren puts up a fierce resistance, and in the ensuing chaos, Arya frees prisoners from a burning cart, including the mysterious Jaqen H'ghar. Yoren dies in the attack, and Polliver (Andy Kellegher), a Lannister man-at-arms, kills the wounded boy Lommy Greenhands (Eros Vlahos). Everyone, including Arya and Gendry, is ultimately captured. When asked where Gendry is, Arya points to Lommy, who has been holding Gendry's helmet before he died. It is a moment of quick thinking that saves Gendry's life and demonstrates Arya's growing survival instincts in a world that has shown her no mercy.

*What Is Dead May Never Die* also represents the directing debut of Alik Sakharov, a filmmaker previously renowned as a director of photography for HBO shows, including the first season of *Game of Thrones*. Sakharov would continue his career as a director and go on to make many memorable episodes, bringing his visual expertise to bear on the narrative demands of the series.

The most important part of the episode is the introduction of Renly's camp. Renly's army is supposed to be the strongest and provide the biggest spectacle of the season. Yet the scene looks remarkably underwhelming. This might be explained less by budgetary constraints and more by logistical issues and weather problems on the Irish locations. The result is a camp that feels smaller and less impressive than it should, undermining the visual argument for Renly's superiority.

Margaery Tyrell, played by Natalie Dormer, is arguably the most physically attractive character in the series, but Dormer brings far more than mere looks to the role. Having previously broken out as Anne Boleyn in *The Tudors*, she handles the role with considerable skill, despite some creative choices by the producers, such as casting a 29-year-old actress to play a character who is 15 in the books. Dormer dutifully disrobes herself in front of the camera, but the scene, far from being exploitative, shows Margaery as an extremely pragmatic character who does her best to overcome the problems that her husband's homosexuality might create for their cause.

Another important introduction is Brienne of Tarth, a female knight who excels through her extraordinary height and androgynous looks, earning a position in Renly's Kingsguard. Gwendoline Christie excels in a role that would define much of her career. The introduction of Brienne, although the character was faithfully adapted from the books, marks the start of a trend in which HBO tries to cater to the progressive sensibilities of its millennial audience, bringing content that challenges the rigid patriarchal world of Westeros. This trend would be brought further by the increasingly \

portrayal of Daenerys Targaryen in later seasons.

An interesting production note concerns Julian Glover, who played Pycelle. Unlike Dormer and so many of his younger colleagues, Glover refused to appear naked in the scene of his arrest, when he is caught in the company of a nude prostitute. His character was ultimately allowed to keep his robes in the scenes, a small but telling detail about the different standards applied to veteran actors.

*What Is Dead May Never Die* is an episode of careful positioning. It introduces Renly's flawed strength, Theon's tragic choice, Tyrion's cunning, and Arya's hardening resolve. It lacks the spectacular moments that define the series at its best, but it provides the essential context that makes those moments meaningful. It is an episode of exposition, but exposition executed with intelligence and purpose.


RATING: 7/10 (+++)
