title.title: Road Tripping and Other Things
title.body:
<center> </center>

We’ve been properly racking up the miles on the new Model Y as well as taking advantage of the 30-day free trial of Full Self Driving these past few weeks. Our first road trip was to [Redwing, Minnesota](https://redwing.org/)—the home of one of my favorite products, Red Wing Boots. 

<center> https://youtube.com/shorts/zS0A0opK70s?si=sHriSu3lX2sndhxf </center>


After living with the new car for a couple of weeks I have to say that FSD is a lot better on this 2026 Model Y than I was on my 2022 Model 3. The Y has the updated computer and cameras (HW4) making the autonomous driving feature much more capable. The car no longer nags you every few minutes to grab the steering wheel and you do feel more like a passenger in a train than a driver. It’s so much more relaxing to be able to look at the scenery instead of worrying if the car next to you will drift into your lane or if the car in front of you will slam its brakes on. Almost every FSD drive now is done flawlessly, without intervention. 

Here's a quick video of the car's Smart Summons feature. This allows you to summon the car from a parking spot or your garage. 

<center> https://www.youtube.com/shorts/Qel0Bja77aw </center>



While in Redwing we stopped at the Redwing Boots headquarters and I immediately found the staircase down to the outlet in the basement for the deals. Most of the boots and shoes being sold in the outlet are 25%-50% less than retail price. The footwear in the outlet is all *seconds*, meaning they aren’t perfect, but most of the imperfections are very minor. A lot of Redwing Boots fans are jealous of us who live in close proximity to the headquarters because the deals can be pretty insane. This is one thing I’ll truly miss if we end up moving out of state. 

<center> 
![RW1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ericvancewalton/23w2snQrzxomRH3KTY48HPZhFj6H7WhaCP5NQTU8ZF4WSwJzEHzdDndhFaPt3CTpdLh9k.jpg)
</center>

<center> 
![RW2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ericvancewalton/EoeGrjTzzPh8BYf8w4HdNWpwZrm8Md3Ed2Vk93q5GYYbDWumyuAMa9vTvpWBrpu42tm.jpg)
</center>

<center> 
![RW3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ericvancewalton/23tSagwr5T3zrEPdyA9Djohi2ros5fh4HArZeZeQ5RyATzUfCsgmk4K6RZbkKVPi4JwkL.jpg)
</center>

<center> 
![RW5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ericvancewalton/23wX3L2ZL9YKp2cznwkZWmY7F2hZwEJMyDRE3E32XKxyYHkRnqCavvXjE7XThEvvj4srU.jpg)
</center>


We finished the day with a late lunch at the restaurant in the historic [St. James Hotel](https://st-james-hotel.com/). One of the employees in the shoe store recommended this place to us and it didn’t disappoint. I had a Mediterranean bowl with salmon and it was absolutely delicious. 

<center> 
![RW6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ericvancewalton/241tbUxEapD3PRnkELfRzFzR369xjtSDUgTGV4yVQ46R8bvnimGRAkPFmDYAotdhusgKS.jpg)
</center>


A few days later we hopped in the car, typed the destination into the Model Y's navigation and FSD drove us to another historic Minnesota town, [Stillwater](https://discoverstillwater.com/). Stillwater, founded in 1848, was the birthplace of Minnesota. It was a city before Minnesota was even a State.  

<center> 
![Still1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ericvancewalton/24242Dqtxp2XJTuTRATGSfaEdzAnrwMNCccVwB15gjG4bhSwFCeSNja85PoYc8u6m5EFz.jpg)
</center>

<center> 
![Still2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ericvancewalton/23yws7D9zvGFdExFS5GRXyRqpneNBFsNkLfu5CNb2NgKmMxMv8HNZjj4H3uv5Xmu3Rjcp.jpg)
</center>
<center> 
![Still3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ericvancewalton/242hU2gMwoqYE1AS6Qbwe14rzm8pgmCks9sCNeeDzXaxpmqnfpSPXL4NkCxcUq3WB3A2g.jpg)
</center>

Stillwater is on the west bank of the Saint Croix River and has a wonderful vibe. They’ve done an amazing job preserving the history of the city while making it a top regional destination for good food, shopping, and live music. 

<center> 
![Still4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ericvancewalton/Eq7Mt2TmuU2q9DaQk25D2q6puV4tXtHcXkuXdKy6WECy4cbfWDWbYnLPZCAVf3Q4m7q.jpg)
</center>

# Other Things #
My brother just got back from Kona, Hawaii and while he was there on a family vacation he picked up a bag of this [local coffee](https://kaucoffeemill.com/collections/shop?tw_source=google&tw_adid=799224315076&tw_campaign=22330140673&tw_kwdid=kwd-940305636174&gad_source=1&gad_campaignid=22330140673&gbraid=0AAAAAoPVn7QWiMF5fIRqD2sRieyZXHC6b&gclid=CjwKCAjw46HPBhAMEiwASZpLRP_oblr3O6iEVZ901wVb6pL4GGPbw4OKLM0QueKBZ-QZLEtvC13RxRoCLvcQAvD_BwE) for me. 

<center> 
![Coffee.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ericvancewalton/23wX811XW3ERGfnutPvwtKnLZoXTz62wmRD17ZNtGQjvJ6vp7NiYeEe87t3nWLGUpgSsz.jpg)
</center>

My *go-to* coffee always used to be dark roast but over the last few years I've gravitated more towards medium/light roasts. However, this Medium-Dark roast from Kona is some of the best coffee I've ever tasted. The volcanic soil it's grown in gives the beans a lower acidity and that results in a very smooth and flavorful brew. I'm going to be sad when this is gone because there's no way I'll pay what they're charging to ship it here. 

All for now. Thanks so much for reading.

title.title: Downtown Calgary Alleyway
title.body:
An alley around 1st Street SW between 7th and 8th Ave. Plenty of character and many dark stories—not a place you want to walk down at night or in the day for that matter, but I wasn't worried. The wall mural is what first caught my eye; there was a fenced-off area just before this with some construction going on, so I had to get closer to get a good shot. I turned to my right, and there were so many cars parked and a couple of guys who looked like they were finishing up a service job walking to their work van. As I entered the alleyway, I expected I might encounter a few homeless people, which didn't bother me, what I saw were many clusters of them, and I knew likely some other activities were going on, but when it comes down to it, I minded my business and didn't take any pictures of them and was able to get the shots I wanted of the buildings that lined the alleyway.

title.body:
‎Hello everyone,
I'm @naturaluttom. I hope everyone is well, I'm fine too. Today I want to share about a match of my favorite game Splinterlands.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ4dsE9dH9b5s3GGyUQUJQxNLDQJtMjsTJnB5LwjfKmes/1776869816213.png)

Today I played many matches but this match was the one I liked the most so I'm sharing it with you. This match had 59 mana. There were no extra rules, a very straightforward match. So I didn't think much, I played with a simple plan. I put a strong card in front, so that he could stand in front and take all the hits. And I put a few attacking cards in the back, so that they could hit from safety.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVQFN41hhSBgcVUBxErVXjZC9v8V8mY66CDTuU2uJXyTg/1776869865388.jpg)

At the beginning, the game was very even. It seemed that anyone could win. But gradually I moved forward a little. The cards behind me kept killing the opponent's cards one by one. And the card in front lasted a long time, so I had the advantage.

title.title: Machida Zelvia did it!
title.body: ![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaQdBjdyJJJsFPWPSYe45XMJGBstpu95edVz94pBzRXx8/Machida.webp) Two semifinals, two shattered dreams, and two teams still in the running in the 2025–26 AFC Champions League Elite. Machida Zelvia and Al Ahli Saudi are dreaming of lifting the trophy. Vissel Kobe and Shabab Al Ahli Dubai have been eliminated, and both are protesting the referees’ decisions. Here’s a recap of the semifinals. ![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfU7Mmo3zLmtuNsfnPQr4AJqgmPoUeMiFXwpgLkK1ujc3/F%C3%BAtbol.webp) ## Machida Zelvia won 1-0... again On a historic night for Japanese soccer, FC Machida Zelvia wrote a new chapter in its meteoric rise. The team, which was playing in Japan’s second division just three years ago, reached its first AFC Champions League Elite semifinal and won it thanks to solid defense and an early goal. Yuki Soma, starting after missing the quarterfinals, capitalized on a mistake by Serbian center back Bogdan Planić to steal the ball, dribble past goalkeeper Hamad Al-Meqbaali, and open the scoring in the 12th minute. From there, Machida sat back and limited Shabab Al Ahli to long-range shots. The match, however, will be remembered for the controversy in the 92nd minute. Guilherme Bala scored a goal that appeared to force extra time, but VAR disallowed the goal due to a premature restart from a throw-in while Machida was still completing a substitution. Referee Shaun Evans was surrounded by Emirati players and required a police escort to leave the field at the end of the match. With this result, Machida Zelvia will face defending champions Al Ahli of Saudi Arabia in Saturday’s final, in a matchup unprecedented in Asian soccer. ![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfU7Mmo3zLmtuNsfnPQr4AJqgmPoUeMiFXwpgLkK1ujc3/F%C3%BAtbol.webp) ## Vissel Kobe was too close, but... In a hard-fought semifinal match, Al Ahli Saudi FC lived up to its status as the heavy favorite and advanced to the continental tournament’s final. The Saudi team, the defending champion, came back from an early goal by Yoshinori Muto (31’) for Vissel Kobe with goals from Galeno (62’) and Ivan Toney (70’), sealing a 2-1 victory that keeps their title defense alive. With this result, Al Ahli will face another Japanese side in the final on April 25: Machida Zelvia, which defeated the Emirati team Shabab Al Ahli 1-0. The final, held in Jeddah, serves as the grand finale of a tournament that has further solidified the influence of Middle Eastern clubs on the Asian soccer scene. For Japanese soccer, Machida Zelvia’s presence and dream will unite all fans who oppose the Saudi-led shift the AFC has been undergoing in recent years. ![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfU7Mmo3zLmtuNsfnPQr4AJqgmPoUeMiFXwpgLkK1ujc3/F%C3%BAtbol.webp) *Cover image made with Gemini AI.*

title.body: 1/4 🧵 A playoff crowd crossed the line from loud to dangerous. During Kings-Avalanche, fans pounding the glass behind the LA bench shattered it, sending shards down onto interim coach D.J. Smith. That’s not “rowdy atmosphere.” That’s a safety failure with a hockey soundtrack.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 2/4 🧵 The sequence was pure chaos. With 16:48 left in the 2nd and the game still scoreless, Avalanche goalie Scott Wedgewood stopped Quinton Byfield on a penalty shot. The arena erupted, fans surged into the glass behind the Kings bench, and one section cracked under the pressure. Smith said one fan “just kept pushing and pushing and pushing” before it broke, leaving him heading to the tunnel to pick glass out of his suit.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 3/4 🧵 The aftermath was ugly and bizarre. Glass rained over the bench area, the game stopped for more than 17 minutes, and the cleanup crew had to shovel shards away so play could continue. Avalanche captain Gabriel Landeskog basically summed it up with the understatement of the night: it doesn’t happen every day. No kidding.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body:
4/4 🧵 The actual hockey almost became the side plot. Colorado still won 2-1 in overtime on a Nicolas Roy goal, taking a 2-0 series lead before Game 3 shifts to Los Angeles on Thursday night. But the bigger takeaway is simple: playoff energy is great, fans acting like demolition equipment is idiotic. 📎 Source

title.title: Quiet but Deadly: The Hidden Power of Runeseer Sevaya
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRQegk4bkV5ePWdj2HZUe1EgVBHBdFAiixMAVFjobV2YT/runeseer_sevaya.png)



Hello Splinterlands warriors, welcome back to another post about Splinterlands and all its excitement. And there’s one type of card I used to underestimate—a card with no attack. Yes, the kind that seems to just stand there in the lineup, without any damage numbers to get your heart racing. But everything changed when I got to know one name: **Runeseer Sevaya**.

<center>https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/cards_by_level/rebellion/Runeseer%20Sevaya_lv1.png</center>


The first time I saw this card, honestly, I was a bit confused. It’s a Legendary monster from the Dragon element, with a mana cost of only 4… but it has **no attack at all**. I even muttered to myself, “what is this supposed to do in the arena?”

But it turns out—that’s exactly where its strength lies.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPLDfC6bwtTCa1txTFmkeXcQWJ4QnoZDMftUwvEuZLhDY/stats.png)</center>


Even at level 1, Runeseer Sevaya already brings two important abilities: **Cleanse** and **Protect**. Cleanse works like a “sin washer” for the team—removing all negative effects from the tank instantly. Meanwhile, Protect gives +2 armor to the entire team.

So even though it doesn’t attack, it ensures all its teammates can survive longer.

And in Splinterlands, surviving just one extra round… often means winning.

---

I really started to feel its impact during a high-mana battle. Normally in those situations, we tend to focus on maximizing damage. But this time, I faced Runeseer Sevaya in my opponent’s lineup.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWm2rnnrgJL4iQMMZ9qPSevS2f4AtxXFC2XBNa3W9Zzex/round_1.png)


The result? When paired with Rage, it turned into a magic monster.
That’s when I began to understand—this is a card built for fast wins. And with the right monster combinations on the enemy side, I found myself overwhelmed and had no choice but to acknowledge its strength.

You can check out the full battle here:
<center> 👉  [**LINK BATTLE**](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_7d381e96d2b26d7183d01a7c7876a61b?ref=rqr4)  👈</center>



What impressed me even more about Runeseer Sevaya was when its next abilities unlocked:

* **Blind** → makes enemy attacks miss more often
* **Repair** → gives the team’s armor a “second life”
* **Amplify** → increases damage from Thorns, Return Fire, and Magic Reflect

It’s like a card that stays quiet… but secretly controls the flow of the match.

If I had to compare it, it’s not a frontline fighter. It’s more like a coach on the sidelines—not playing directly, but making sure every strategy works.

Of course, this card isn’t without its challenges.

Since it has no attack, you really need to make sure the slot it takes is “paid off” by its effects. If your lineup lacks damage or doesn’t use weapon training, then it’s pointless—you’ll survive longer, but won’t be able to defeat your opponent.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXAj5pq679DzNuvsnVpmknoEbg23nntr9RsaMk8mitNMD/2_line_red.png)



The most interesting thing for me about Runeseer Sevaya is how it changed the way I think.

I used to always ask: “How much damage does this card deal?”

Now I’m starting to ask: “How long can this card keep my team alive in battle?”

And that’s a pretty big shift.



My impression?
Runeseer Sevaya is a small card with a huge impact. It’s not flashy, but its presence is felt in every round.

Strategies I’ve taken from this experience:

* Use it in **low to mid mana** battles for maximum efficiency
* Combine it with a **strong tank or Taunt unit**
* Take advantage of synergy with **Thorns / Magic Reflect** for Amplify
* Make sure you still have a main damage dealer on the team

Because in the end, Runeseer Sevaya won’t win the battle on its own…

…but without it, that victory might never come.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXuXxp6GBhwB1HpXvoabLn8Dt8QaRKSe1WNYDzqX1v6Vk/chaos_logo.png)

If you haven't tried out this fantastic game called Splinterlands yet, I invite you to [**Join**](https://splinterlands.com?ref=rqr4).
It's free, but you'll need to invest in a beginning deck or buy gaming cards to gain real assets like cards and tokens.

title.title: An Afternoon of Art in the Park | Una Tarde de Arte en el Parque
title.body:
>
 
# English

Happy Valentine's Day, everyone. Welcome to my little corner of the internet. I wanted to tell you that in February, for Valentine's Day, I did something really nice with my boyfriend. I had the idea to buy some canvases and paints and spend an afternoon doing art.

That’s why I had bought the supplies months earlier and kept them stored away, waiting for the perfect moment to use them. It turned out that on February 14th, I was going to be traveling because an unexpected opportunity came up. So, I made plans with my boyfriend and went a week earlier, on Friday, February 13th.

I brought the supplies to work, and when we left, we went to a nearby park for our date. I brought a blanket to spread out on the grass and some snacks to share while we got inspired. 

Although I had told Diego to research the drawing he wanted to paint so we could get a head start, we both skipped that part and started looking for ideas once we arrived. 

Since it was my first time doing this, I looked for references for something simple on TikTok. And that’s where I found the design I painted. I won’t deny it—at first it was hard because I had to draw the trees and couldn’t control the thickness of the lines. However, step by step, I got the hang of it and became more confident in my painting. 

I think doing different activities as a couple is fun. I enjoyed this experience with Diego and spending some quality time together. At the end of the afternoon, we enjoyed a beautiful sunset. 

What did you think? 

We'll read you in the comments! 💛

---

# Español 

Feliz día para todos. Bienvenidos a mi pequeño espacio en internet. Les cuento que en febrero, para el día de los enamorados, tuve una actividad bonita con mi novio. A mi se me ocurrio la idea de comprar unos lienzos, unas pinturas y tener una tarde de arte.

Es por eso, que meses antes había comprado las cosas y las tenía guardadas para esperar el momento ideal para usarlas. Resulta, que para el 14 de febrero yo iba a estar viajando porque me salió una oportunidad inesperada. Entonces, me organice con mi novio y fui un viernes antes, el 13 de febrero.

Yo lleve los materiales al trabajo y cuando salimos. Fuimos a un parque cercano para nuestra cita. Yo lleve un mantel para colocarlo en la grama y unos snacks para compartir mientras nos inspirabamos. 

Aunque le había dicho a Diego que investigara sobre el dibujo que quería pintar para tener adelantado el trabajo. Ambos obviamos esta parte y comenzamos a buscar al llegar. 

Como era la primera vez que yo hacía esto, busque referencias de algo sencillo en Tik Tok. Y allí fue donde encontré el diseño que pinte. No lo voy a negar, al principio fue dificil, porque tenía que hacer los arboles y no controlaba la medida del trazo, sin embargo, paso a paso, fui agarrando el hilo y mayor soltura al pintar. 

Me aprece que hacer actividades diferentes en pareja es divertido. Me gustó vivir esta experiencia con Deigo y pasar un rato diferente. Al final de la tarde disfrutamos de un lindo atardecer. 

¿Qué les pareció? 

¡Nos leemos en los comentarios! 💛

title.title: Adult Stars Turn To AI
title.body:
![Cover Image](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUz6PvDGvs2ur68sdL3VofrcnuudJ15ZYkTDPpLMgXVdP/ai-image-1776869815772.jpeg)



People are starting to get very creative with AI.  It should come as no surprise that the adult content (porn) industry is involved.  Historically, this was one that was quick to adopt new technologies.

What is interesting is the individuals involved are the ones embracing it.  While AI generated scenes and films appear to be occurring, the real change is the fact that individuals are applying AI as a \

.

This is one way that things are changing completely.

Welcome to the world of AI clones.

# Adult Stars Turn To AI 

Hollywood is wrestling with the topic of AI.

Some celebrities are openly to start embracing it.  They realize that this is an inevitable outcome and are doing what they can to get ahead of it.

Others are anti-AI, exerting great effort to push against it.   It is a simple realization that this is going to have a catastrophic effect on most jobs.  While some might still find work, the numbers will diminish.

Porn stars are finding a different use for AI.  They are expanding their each by having AI clones engaging with \

.  

>Adult content platform JustSext lets users have personalized conversations and create on-demand content with the likeness of their favorite erotic creators. 

>“Your AI Girlfriend from Real Creators — One Message Away,” the homepage reads, inviting fans to chat with artificially created versions of about 45 different models.

The AI does the work and the individuals rake in a portion of the profits.

>The digital twins are trained with the personalities, voices, and mannerisms of real life NSFW influencers including Sophie Dee, Lena The Plug, and Brody Jean Tyra, who are all licensed with the company.

>Models can sit back and relax while raking in half the total revenue as their AI personas do the dirty work for them.

<center>[Source](https://nypost.com/2026/03/28/us-news/ai-porn-star-twins-chat-with-fans-and-make-custom-erotic-material/)</center>
This is technology at work.  

Okay, it might not be exactly what the brains behind AI imagined when they first started pushing the technology forward. Most of the big promises were about productivity, research, medical breakthroughs, and maybe a better way to organize information. But once a tool gets into the hands of creators, entrepreneurs, and people trying to make money fast, it almost always ends up being used in ways nobody planned for.

That said, that’s not really unusual. A lot of the biggest internet-era wins came from uses nobody had on the roadmap. Few of the early Internet pioneers probably imagined that Twitter would become one of the main utilities of the web, shaping news, politics, marketing, and day-to-day communication all at once. The same pattern tends to repeat: a technology starts as an idea, then gets repurposed by the market, and eventually becomes something far bigger, messier, and more practical than the original vision.

## The Future of Entertainment

I am of the opinion that AI will completely dominate the entertainment industry.

For the most part, celebrities are 2D images to the majority of the people.  We have never seen them in person.  They appear on a screen, either in a movie or a show, and then in interviews.  Unless we engaged with them personally, or perhaps saw them walking down the street, we know nothing about them.

Who ends up surviving?

This is tough to estimate.  If we think back to the earlier days of the internet, newspapers were the first major casualty.  Hundreds of them closed up within a few years.  The same happened to the record companies.

How things will look is impossible to predict.  What we know is things will be different.  The business models presently employed are almost obsolete.  Something new will emerge.

Labor is becoming a commodity, and that is the part people still seem to be underestimating. If a machine can generate what used to require a writer, an editor, a designer, a performer, or a support rep, then the work itself starts to look less like a craft and more like an output. That changes the whole equation. Companies stop asking, “Who can do this best?” and start asking, “How cheaply and quickly can this be produced?” Once that mindset takes hold, the pressure on human labor gets intense very fast.

The fact that GPUs are already producing things that traditionally took people should be a warning sign. These systems are not just assisting with work anymore; in many cases, they are replacing the first draft, the first response, or even the entire interaction. And that shift is still in its early stages. The models will get faster, more accurate, more persuasive, and much easier to customize. What feels impressive today will likely look primitive a year or two from now.

That is why this matters so much. The technology is not standing still, and the uses for it are expanding in real time. As the tools improve, more tasks become automated, more jobs become vulnerable, and more businesses will realize they can do more with fewer people. That is not a small trend. It is the beginning of a much larger structural change.

Historically, porn was an early adopter with other industries following later.  Will that be the route taken with AI?

‎Most people find it difficult to comprehend my perspective but I'm not hard to understand. People like me prefer to prioritize safety above pleasure, I don't feign ignorance to danger just because it is fun. I'm sure you are already starting to understand how I feel about what I'm about to say.
‎
‎The moment I saw this prompt topic, a floating island, I was like; Na that is not my thing. There is a reason why up till this moment, I have not stepped into a boat before, yeah you heard me right. I don't predict safety, when it comes to safety, I only believe what is guaranteed.
‎
‎The fact that island is surrounded by water, still makes me feel uneasy. Well, I live on the mainland and I'm comfortable.  As if an island surrounded by water is not terrifying enough, now I have to consider a floating Island? No way. Even if it is free, I wouldn't consider it.
‎
‎Lets say crisis were to occur and everybody is running to safety, the only way to descend will be through an aircraft. I'm very sure those pilot will first guaranty the safety of themselves and the wealthy ones, where does that leave an average citizen?
‎
‎Lets get something straight, I wasn't forced to go up there, which means whatever happens is by choice. There are few things that we need to consider, why is the island floating? Does gravitational force work in reverse around it? if it is mechanical engineered, what if whatever is keeping it afloat runs out of power? I wouldn't want to fall to my own death.
‎
‎I am extremely calculative when it comes to my safety, fun and pleasure comes second to my safety. As long as I can't figure out if I would be 100% safe, I'm not going anywhere. Even I if I did, I might still not board it, there are enough adventures for me to explore on land.

title.body:
Vielleicht sollte man mal über die grundsätzlichen Probleme reden, bzw. in die Diskussion mit einbringen.
In der Regel wird man ja auf Hive (früher auch Steemit oder jetzt auch noch Blurt) aufmerksam weil man mit seinen Beiträgen Geld verdienen sollte/könnte...
Leider stellt jeder neue User nach einiger Zeit fest, dass das nicht so stimmt wie es angepriesen wird.
Wenn man direkt gefragt wird geht es allerdings ja keinem darum Geld zu verdienen, sondern es macht ja einfach Spaß!!!
Na ja... da sollte sich jeder selbst Gedanken machen wie es wirklich ist und warum so viele User wieder verschwinden.
Ich persönlich habe weder bei Reddit - X - Facebook o.a. einen Account.
Fragt Euch mal warum zum Beispiel bei Facebook die gesamte Kommunikation - Beiträge - Antworten - eben die komplette Interaktion wesentlich besser klappt als bei Hive/Steemit/Blurt?
Meine Meinung (ist aber wirklich nur meine Meinung) geht dahin, dass bei Facebook dieses Funktionieren anfängt \

sobald man damit beginnt Geld zu verdienen.
Dann wiederholt sich was hier auch passiert ist. Kommt natürlich auf das Belohnungssystem an.
Die Älteren werden sich noch an Steemit erinnern und auch warum Hive entstanden ist.
Kurzum: Die Gier und der lange Hals, der nicht voll zu kriegen war hat für Veränderung gesorgt. Gilt auch für Hive und Blurt.
Mittlerweile drohen ja bereits einige Zeugen damit, nur zu Voten wenn man in der eigenen Community postet. Alle Anderen bleiben Außen vor.
Für meine Begriffe \

gedacht🤮🤮🤮
Vor allem sehr kurzfristig und peinlich.
Da hier gefragt wird was und wie man etwas ändern oder beitragen kann, wäre vielleicht die Anmeldung schon einmal die erste Stufe.

Anmeldeoptionen gibt es genug:

# „Einige Anbieter bieten kostenlose Konten an, die eine gewisse Verifizierung erfordern, um Missbrauch vorzubeugen, während andere Anbieter eine geringe Gebühr erheben, aber keine Verifizierung verlangen.“

Bereits für 0.47$ kann man den Missbrauch also umgehen.
# Wie praktisch!

Klingt irgendwie Seriös, oder?
Warum kann es nicht einheitlich gestaltet werden???

Neue User werden von der Hive-Engine völlig überfordert.

Soviel Mist wie darin zu finden ist, ist einfach Blödsinn.
Die Anforderungen um einen Coin oder auch eine Community zu erstellen sollten nicht niedriger sondern höher sein, damit geplante Projekte auch Sinnvoll aufgebaut werden und Bestand haben.

Was im Laufe der Zeit aus den Zeugen geworden ist, die es in der Hand hatten, ist ja deutlich an der Kursentwicklung zu sehen.
Eigentlich hätte da ein Chef gefehlt, der etwas mehr Überblick als nur die eigene Tasche hat.
Aber es ist ja ein dezentrales Projekt, wo es keine Manipulation durch Zentralisierung geben kann.!?!?!?
Es sei denn, die Zeugen sind sich über das \

body.title: Creciendo al ritmo - Historia [ESP-ENG]
body.body:
Durante varios días la Banda seguía trabajando en escoger esas canciones que los representaría, el estudio olía a café, a cuerdas nuevas y a partituras. Donde practicaron desde baladas que hacían temblar el corazón, hasta riffs potentes que hacían vibrar las paredes. Cada canción era un experimento, un riesgo, un pedazo de ellos mismos. Dani se atrevía con percusiones más complejas, Stewie las tocaba en la batería, Michelle exploraba melodías que parecían imposibles y Lucas encontraba nuevas formas de hacer que su tambor contara historias. Todo fluía de la mejor manera y antes de terminar una pregunta empezó a resonar con fuerza en la mente de todos: ¿dónde sería el concurso nacional de bandas? —No lo han dicho —murmuró Lucas, mientras afinaba el tambor—. ¿Será en una sala enorme, un teatro, un estadio?, Dani cruzó los brazos, tratando de imaginarlo. —Sea donde sea, tenemos que estar listos. Esto no es cualquier concurso. La gente va a recordar quiénes somos. >For several days, the band kept working on choosing the songs that would represent them; the studio smelled of coffee, new strings, and sheet music. There, they practiced everything from heart-wrenching ballads to powerful riffs that made the walls shake. Each song was an experiment, a risk, a piece of themselves. Dani dared to try more complex percussion, Stewie played them on the drums, Michelle explored melodies that seemed impossible, and Lucas found new ways to make his drum tell stories. # >Everything was flowing perfectly, and before they finished, a question began to echo loudly in everyone’s minds: where would the national band competition be held? “They haven’t said,” Lucas murmured, as he tuned his drum. “Will it be in a huge hall, a theater, a stadium?” Dani crossed her arms, trying to picture it. “Wherever it is, we have to be ready.” This isn’t just any competition. People are going to remember who we are.” ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZQqRZCNXfY7WrSJqkZHmus5q37Acej8Qtw7zEDTxS2F5/image.png) [Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/hombres-ordenador-altavoz-auriculares-8133324/) Entonces surgió una idea que hizo que todos se miraran con la chispa de la travesura y la estrategia al mismo tiempo. —¿Y si salimos a la calle? —propuso Michelle—. A ver a la gente tocar, sentir la música fuera de nuestro estudio. Así sabremos qué nos mueve. La noche estaba fría, todos caminaban de felicidad y se dieron cuenta de que las aceras estaban llenas de artistas callejeros, guitarras acústicas, baterías improvisadas, cantantes con voces que erizaban la piel y grupos que bailaban al compás de sus propios ritmos. Cada esquina era una lección y algo distinto para observar, escuchar y tomar notas invisibles, como si cada sonido fuera un mapa hacia lo que querían crear. Lucas se detuvo frente a un grupo que tocaba percusiones con cubetas y latas, llamó su atención, ya que era la primera vez que veía algo así. Dani sonrió y comenzó a marcar el ritmo con los pies. —¡Eso! —exclamó Stewie, señalando a un joven que tocaba una guitarra con pasión contenida—. Eso es lo que necesitamos: emoción cruda. >Then an idea popped into their heads, and they all looked at each other with a spark of mischief and strategy at the same time. “What if we go out onto the street?” Michelle suggested. “To watch people play, to feel the music outside our studio. That way we’ll know what moves us.” # >The night was cold, but everyone walked with joy and realized that the sidewalks were filled with street performers, acoustic guitars, makeshift drum sets, singers with voices that gave you goosebumps, and groups dancing to the beat of their own rhythms. # >Every corner was a lesson and something new to observe, listen to, and take invisible notes on, as if every sound were a map leading to what they wanted to create. Lucas stopped in front of a group playing percussion with buckets and cans; it caught his attention, since it was the first time he’d seen anything like it. Dani smiled and began tapping his feet to the beat. “That!” exclaimed Stewie, pointing to a young man playing a guitar with restrained passion. “That’s what we need: raw emotion.” ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWawsTGWB6sTuR4PSKk9EgNgi4ZyvmSaZed5YpvYmeZhS/image.png) [Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/vista-nocturna-de-la-calle-koningsstraat-con-luces-y-reflejos-en-el-barrio-nieuwmarkt-del-casco-antiguo-de-amsterdam-fotografia-callejera-de-los-30417188/) Michelle cerró los ojos, dejando que el viento mezclara las notas callejeras con sus propias ideas. —Si captamos esto, nuestra música va a ser más que un concurso, va a ser una experiencia. Donde esa caminata les sirvió para pensar no importa dónde será el concurso nacional, lo que importa es estar listo para conquistar cualquier escenario. >Michelle closed her eyes, letting the wind blend the sounds of the street with her own thoughts. “If we capture this, our music will be more than just a competition—it’ll be an experience. That walk gave them time to think: it doesn’t matter where the national competition is held; what matters is being ready to conquer any stage.”
![pngwing.com 3.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPvWeswjaMnCtt69QxnpZHm1una1iw2HUxZJpGBgEY2RH/pngwing.com%203.png)

饭后百步走啊，晚上溜达去香格里拉商场走走，还别说，我挺喜欢商场内的香气，好闻的很；从一楼开始随意转转，平时客流量不多，有一部分是香格里拉酒店客人来逛，另外一部分是附近的居民，当然也有专门来这里打卡的朋友们。。

到了餐厅聚集的商场楼层，很明显客人就多起来了，哈哈哈。。果然民以食为天，你们说如果一个商场没有像样的美食聚集地，估计整体会冷静不少。。。

看到兰蔻的小样赠送专柜，这会没啥人排队领取，那我就也勉为其难的参与一下吧，哈哈哈，根据提示扫码输入手机接收到号码，系统会自动发放，打开一看里面有两片兰蔻试用小样，精华液和塑颜面霜，还不错哦。

逛累了，找一处休闲地坐着，开始划拉手机，好家伙！！！算法都知道我是个吃货了——不管什么时候打开视频或微博，推给我的第一条准是美食相关内容…平时倒也无所谓，随手划过去就好，偶尔还能学学做菜。

但一到晚上刷到美食视频，就有点难受了。我明明在努力戒宵夜，前两天刚破了一次戒，结果刷着刷着手机，又又又给我推送夜宵美食……好家伙，这还让不让人好好“禁止宵夜”了？

吃货朋友们都劝我：忍不了就别忍了。毕竟我现在体重已经恢复正常，身材保持的也不错…平时还有运动加持，偶尔吃顿宵夜也不影响体重～这些道理我当然懂。

可是吃宵夜真的会上瘾。我以前怎么胖起来的，就跟吃宵夜脱不了关系——胃口一打开，就一发不可收拾了。

所以现在刷到美食视频，我会直接点“减少相关推送”。眼不见，心不乱。对自己狠一点总没错，毕竟吃宵夜对胃也不太好。

OK，今天先分享到这儿哈，晚安，朋友们，祝好梦。

**感谢大家的阅读和喜欢，您的点赞给予我莫大的鼓励，感恩❀**

---

In this world, there is one authority. That One who is the final authority knows all things. This is the Lord Jesus Christ. The Lord Jesus Christ is the one who knows all things because the Father has revealed all things unto him. Whatever the Lord Jesus Christ tells us is the absolute truth. We are aware when the Father introduced him to us all at the transfiguration mountain that we should hear him. There is no other person who can tell us what is the truth than the Lord Jesus Christ.

The Lord Jesus Christ himself had said to us in His words that there is no other person who had ascended up to heaven apart from the one who came down from heaven. We do know that it is only himself, the Son who came down from heaven. The words of Jesus Christ are Truth and there are life. Whatever he says is nothing but the truth.

We have read in the Bible about Elijah and Enoch whom God took away and they did not die. We have also heard from the epistles that there is a third heaven. Another instance is when Jesus Christ told us a parable about the Bossom of Abraham. We cannot say more than what we understand. The things that we know, we only know in parts.

> https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/e/e9/Notion-logo.svg/500px-Notion-logo.svg.png [source](https://share.google/gQdaCa05ozn6rKPhA) Well, I was scrolling through TikTok to find posts about farming, and then I stumbled upon a post from a user who shares his way to track his farm, fertilizing, and spraying activities and schedule, and even for the expense and profit tracker, all on one app. When I checked on his bio, I learned that he sells his template from the Notion app, for those who also want to have the same tracking assistance. And my stingy nature take the best out of me. I mean, why would I spend the money for the template that I still need to tweak for my own needs? I also underestimate the skill needed to use the app. How hard can it be for an app to be used? But my oh my, it is harder than I actually think. Completely new, and for sure a lot different from the app that I had used. Especially those from Microsoft or from Google. In the end, it forced me to watch a YouTube tutorial on how to use the app, and hopefully I managed to make my own farming tools that will help me to track all the things that I need for my farm. Does anyone have any experience in using this app called Notion?

title.title: Day Of Rest (and research and rumination!) 🌧️🌧️🔥
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma2wMcrF7B57pbapmsv4df6ex8tZ2rvYT2GiG2pi1sDH2/1776864944106.jpg)

#### Another potent rainy day on our #sovereignhomestead and I wake up from a much-needed nap after a very short night, as @vincentnijman graciously brings me hot soup on the 'sofa'...

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPrwCo3Q5itX3HFqNrU9nwkT6x8ePS2XMnaygamSVGKdN/1776865433761.jpg)

I'm snuggled in under a duvet on this pallet-seat, having slept *poco* - after another 1am meeting of the ongoing discourse around the Blessings Of Liberti. I'm tired, buzzing mentally and creatively, and thinking about where I can most usefully put my ideas and energy (with thevleast physical effort!)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUupy3Uo3FHK1VYEZYp3wpCzEHF7ajdjrQBmhNk4Poshr/1776865401028.jpg)

This day takes a different rhythm as I digest the night's meeting, look over the *etude* documents for the next one, and think about what other research I could be bingeing on.... Like this glorious Ultimate Guide To Rebuilding Civilisation.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZt8AJUV4rska1CqGzQC6Mh2vvUTqWRwBb48SSCEMxWy5/1776865996851.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNXw4REuAwDA9HNDCWdJoQfEot1oXn84Rw9SbkQXJW1Za/1776865997140.jpg)

Days like these, super rainy, everything sodden outside, and us quite out-of-rhythm with sleep, ask for basic needs to be met first. Well fed and watered, we'll go out and check the effects of the intense rains, *if* the sun appears. We already got to the hotel for a hot shower, and want to minimise sweaty, muddy engagement with outdoors, for a change!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZnoxegh4ba46WF69dLr2HmvgZ5Wb5vdMbkpPW2W5E3Hy/1776866388412.jpg)

We've kept an eye on the landslide: it certainly has a bit of life in it yet, and we're just observing, as we're observing the whole property, the surrounding mountain landscape, and the seasonal elemental changes. There is much to note!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZN8uK9JVXqYMNgwyVs3U6M2XHNi977kto4ALp4qVmebd/1776866571880.jpg)

Fruits are beginning to form on the cherries and fig trees. New flowers and herbs seem to appear daily.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbBAHs7Rmn85RAijHCn8sUiprkhA2HSGG13AfwV7tTryd/1776866572345.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYLuRvrG43qj8oLQRcQ69j12vhSHgGU16x75BVrUaw4Vm/1776866572708.jpg)

This elegant tulip popped out quite unexpectedly, just after our planted ones finally flowered last week. Though it's smaller, it packs such a lot of beauty and exotic into one wee bloom: perfectly raggedy edges and a shocking pink-red glow that we can see from the top of the hill. And a quite stunning centre, with a bluey-purple sheen to it. Wow. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZB7VhEj6Rejk56N8T73hYrsmGZJ6kQvQEduGFwutY6iv/1776867077174.jpg)

We make circles of stones around any particular plant or sapling that we want to protect, and the hillside is now littered with many of them. Rocks are super abundant here, so we can easily move them from one point to another.... emphasising a plant here and a path there.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQEVfE8cWG3qEc3ynFafX8hFYpK2QDZvf81aRKQ2nKtAp/1776867077634.jpg)

The growth continues to be voracious, with the vital greens, e.g. nettles and burdock, racing together towards the spring skies. The path need to be trodden daily, or we'll lose them until the hot summer!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfMX48xwzyVPWQor14mJEeL4bZ3PwnsZ7eukyfw7h58L3/1776867078121.jpg)

Vincent and I are also beginning to dismantle the top of the well, which got caught up in the moving landscape during the last floods. It being mostly compromised, we're taking apart the upper hillside above it, which threatens to swallow it completely. Once we create some space, disentangled from the thick bramble roots and giant centipedes (!) we'll see  if we can't adapt the leftover well structure into some kind of a spring (or well!) house. We have a great couple of books on stone-building that help us to think on this.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmej3LfQhYr22eJiUgMFG36F4YHe92cxW8q7vBBjNc8fN1/1776867739663.jpg)

Looking back over the week's snapshots of the land, on a rainy day like this, is most full-fillling. Coming up on these final months of our first year in this place, there's a particular energy of reflection, of reviewing and taking stock of it all.... Little to interfere with on the land - we are more like Natural Law shepherds than folks 'working the land': still using maximum a pair of loppers, snipping and moving twigs and branches, laying down hedge-like boundaries, sitting down a lot and snacking on our own nuts and foraged fruits, gathered herbs in our hot tea as we rest from another gentle session.... We're gaining strength, resolve, attention spans and visioning capacity ❤️‍🔥💝🙏🎨

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVPuQcf3XNFbJGtXZuwJ49vRRuGvDU7VjchaYFM9HkKy6/1776867740244.jpg)

The steepness of the land continues to inspire and guide us!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbm1rEuFX9cLRDfcWmUc2n7LD3SQhFSyw2wG1vit787Y7/1776867740794.jpg)

**Another day slows to a finish, as Vincent offers to make a (divine!) apple crumble, before we go for a sunset walk around our paths, to see what the rain has made happen. A day of rumination and rest. Perfetto and much needed, before the next deep-dive into making our homestead more comfortable and weatherproof!**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNSjd54QdAwLVGVtSZYz69EdQt83NtV3ALybjhJdrxjpg/1776868523681.jpg)

# With Love to one and all!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPNBCoL2kPM2gMDgGg42b7yTPQqYyEhVzW8xn7uV7d3cq/1776868763376.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYDD8qEjo1Jxcpc1AUX6MVNaWCYaN6HrDu6pGeAUm9qz7/1776868867180.jpg)

Vielleicht sollte man mal über die grundsätzlichen Probleme reden, bzw. in die Diskussion mit einbringen.
In der Regel wird man ja auf Hive (früher auch Steemit oder jetzt auch noch Blurt) aufmerksam weil man mit seinen Beiträgen Geld verdienen sollte/könnte...
Leider stellt jeder neue User nach einiger Zeit fest, dass das nicht so stimmt wie es angepriesen wird.
Wenn man direkt gefragt wird geht es allerdings ja keinem darum Geld zu verdienen, sondern es macht ja einfach Spaß!!!
Na ja... da sollte sich jeder selbst Gedanken machen wie es wirklich ist und warum so viele User wieder verschwinden.
Ich persönlich habe weder bei Reddit - X - Facebook o.a. einen Account.
Fragt Euch mal warum zum Beispiel bei Facebook die gesamte Kommunikation - Beiträge - Antworten - eben die komplette Interaktion wesentlich besser klappt als bei Hive/Steemit/Blurt?
Meine Meinung (ist aber wirklich nur meine Meinung) geht dahin, dass bei Facebook dieses Funktionieren anfängt \

sobald man damit beginnt Geld zu verdienen.
Dann wiederholt sich was hier auch passiert ist. Kommt natürlich auf das Belohnungssystem an.
Die Älteren werden sich noch an Steemit erinnern und auch warum Hive entstanden ist.
Kurzum: Die Gier und der lange Hals, der nicht voll zu kriegen war hat für Veränderung gesorgt. Gilt auch für Hive und Blurt.
Mittlerweile drohen ja bereits einige Zeugen damit, nur zu Voten wenn man in der eigenen Community postet. Alle Anderen bleiben Außen vor.
Für meine Begriffe \

gedacht🤮🤮🤮

Da hier gefragt wird was und wie man etwas ändern oder beitragen kann, wäre vielleicht die Anmeldung schon einmal die erste Stufe.

# „Einige Anbieter bieten kostenlose Konten an, die eine gewisse Verifizierung erfordern, um Missbrauch vorzubeugen, während andere Anbieter eine geringe Gebühr erheben, aber keine Verifizierung verlangen.“

Bereits für 0.47$ kann man den Missbrauch also umgehen.
# Wie praktisch!

Klingt irgendwie Seriös, oder?
Warum kann es nicht einheitlich gestaltet werden???

Neue User werden von der Hive-Engine völlig überfordert.

Soviel Mist wie darin zu finden ist, ist einfach Blödsinn.
Die Anforderungen um einen Coin oder auch eine Community zu erstellen sollten nicht niedriger sondern höher sein, damit geplante Projekte auch Sinnvoll aufgebaut werden und Bestand haben.

Was im Laufe der Zeit aus den Zeugen geworden ist, die es in der Hand hatten, ist ja deutlich an der Kursentwicklung zu sehen.
Eigentlich hätte da ein Chef gefehlt, der etwas mehr Überblick als nur die eigene Tasche hat.
Aber es ist ja ein dezentrales Projekt, wo es keine Manipulation durch Zentralisierung geben kann.!?!?!?
Es sei denn, die Zeugen sind sich über das \

body.title: Secret Ukraine Base Mission: A Fight in the Shadows
body.body:
https://youtu.be/P42Zb3ZvHk0?si=B7CXV2Kx3TeYtKMa
Watch on YouTube 

Secret Ukraine Base Mission is a thrilling action and stealth game in which the player has to complete dangerous missions as a secret agent. The game’s story revolves around a secret military base in Ukraine where enemy forces are working on advanced technology and secret weapons. Your mission is to infiltrate silently outsmart the enemies and obtain critical information.

The most special thing about this game is its environment and graphics which give the player a complete sense of a real combat situation. Every step has to be taken carefully because even a small mistake can cause your mission to fail. It includes different types of weapons gadgets and stealth techniques that make the game even more exciting.

The gameplay is not only fast paced but also demands mental strategy. You have to advance while avoiding enemy cameras guards and security systems. The difficulty increases with each level which requires the player to improve their skills.

Secret Ukraine Base Mission is a game that offers the perfect blend of action suspense and strategy. If you like secret missions and thrill-filled games then you will definitely love this game.

body.title: Belonging Over Stability
body.body:
We are often the very architects of our own problems. We tend to bite more than we can chew and then turn around to complain that unseen forces are hindering our progress.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVwB8rHp6ALQnTSLowvWq9XmJHSsesKnUZTkUX4kdGuQ4/1776868837319.jpg)

>Looking rich but not

A lot of young people nowadays are obsessed with looking rich. They focus heavily on what they wear, the designer brands, the latest phones, and all the outward appearances. Yet, they pay little attention to building a solid financial life. They only appear wealthy on the surface. Even the kind of houses they aspire to live in are often far beyond their means.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU38UYkb7WEe7HqPh5RnvJrsCe4LuaPmWMg1hpLKyynwL/1776868654644.jpg)


This is something I experience and observe daily. Even my own brother and some distant relatives are guilty of this. Imagine a student who wants to “live large” without any stable source of income. I remember a brother of mine asking me to pay ₦500,000 for his house rent. I laughed because even I, who is working, am not living in such an apartment. His response was that there was no way to find a cheaper place.
I refused. I told him plainly that if he couldn’t find a more affordable room, then he should forget about it. That was where I stood.

To my surprise, he later came back and told me he had found a room for ₦200,000. I then advised him: if he starts paying such an amount while still in school and without a steady income, how will he cope after graduation when he starts earning a salary?
I also have friends who want to buy wigs worth ₦300,000 when they have no investments or financial stability. It is quite alarming. Even some guys will carry phones worth ₦3.5 million without any meaningful source of income, all in the name of belonging or using an iPhone.

There is nothing wrong with owning nice things. The problem arises when we lack the capacity to sustain them. That kind of lifestyle becomes a burden that may be difficult to manage later.
What many people fail to understand is that our financial life is just as important as our physical life. Life becomes easier when we learn to cut our coat according to our clothes.
You will see many young people looking rich, yet they are far from being financially stable. Most of them are not interested in investing; they only want to appear successful.

Social media also contributes to this illusion. People post pictures showcasing achievements that are often exaggerated or even false. The way celebrities flaunt their wealth influences younger generations. All they want is the sense of belonging—to be called “big boys” and “big girls\

body.body:
<div class='text-justify'> 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSR4oDbVdTCRjVGjUJesjzHSMTrUUbsvsjQX4aKHqEB6e/image.png)

A feast of noodles and tender meat! When god-level braised pork meets incredibly flavorful waterfall noodles, this meal is truly legendary!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNvsicNUXdNPmN65om9auzLacktBqMNUPMCCzLGaX5zSv/image.png)


🇹🇭 Reviewed by P' Sakon Chuan Chim

Hello, fellow foodies! P' Sakon is back, and let me tell you, this meal is truly \

! If you're looking for a subtly delicious yet intensely flavorful experience, get ready because today we're reviewing a noodle dish that's packed with flavor without holding back!

Let's look at the highlights of today's menu:

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW4XogZnCFua5irfD97fJ3SCJSqWDdGJ7MEuZSdJhWXo8/image.png)


Braised Pork Noodle Soup (with plain rice): This dish is the \

of the meal! The pork is braised until it's so tender you barely need to chew; it melts in your mouth with just a touch of your tongue. The broth is fragrant with a deep, rich Chinese herbal aroma and has a perfectly balanced flavor that doesn't need any extra seasoning. When you pour it over hot, beautiful plain rice... wow! It's a perfect combination that's truly indescribable! Every bite is pure bliss!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXqeZtSyr5YDkjpwheUmnpqYZcuwNB813JwAXrrUVSNim/image.png)


Waterfall Pork Noodle Soup with Egg Noodles: If the braised pork noodle soup is subtly delicious, this waterfall noodle soup is... \

is key! The golden yellow noodles are perfectly chewy and soft, tossed in a rich, flavorful broth that's spicy, sour, salty, and sweet – all perfectly balanced without needing any extra condiments. The fresh pork slices and perfectly cooked liver add an exciting dimension to the taste and texture. One sip of the broth and you'll be thrilled!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWkyNpHxd6rmHf9mauHZen4MKGWrYLCrprcx1xoV7J87w/image.png)


Blanched water spinach: And this is the \

of the meal! The fresh, blanched water spinach retains its crunchy texture with every bite. Its natural sweetness perfectly balances the richness of the broth and adds an extra layer of texture, making this noodle dish ten times more enjoyable! It's the recipe for a perfect meal.

Conclusion: I give this meal a perfect 10 out of 10! It's a delightful array of textures – soft, crunchy, smooth, and intensely flavorful. Noodle lovers absolutely must try this combo! You'll be so satisfied you'll forget your way home!

body.body: 1/4 🧵 A Florida inmate already serving life just got another life sentence after murdering his cellmate with a pen — and laughed while the judge described it. The most chilling part wasn’t just the killing. It was the courtroom reaction: when asked why he was laughing, he told the judge, **“You are amusing.”**
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 2/4 🧵 The case centers on Marcus Terry, 43, and the 2021 killing of 64-year-old Ray Matos inside Dade Correctional Institute in Homestead, Florida. Prosecutors said Terry fatally attacked Matos, who had been his cellmate for less than a week. Judge Ellen Sue Venzer recounted that Terry shoved a pillowcase into Matos’ mouth and was found standing over him with a bloodied hand while guards responded. Matos was later found in a pool of blood.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 3/4 🧵 Terry had been convicted of second-degree murder in December 2025. At sentencing, his lawyer tried to win a new trial by arguing inadmissible evidence had been allowed during the case. The judge rejected that argument and moved straight to sentencing. She made clear she saw the crime as brutal and senseless, then handed down **life without parole**. Terry was already serving a life sentence for armed burglary and armed robbery, which makes the whole thing even more grimly absurd.

body.title: Re-Strategyze My Plan
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYCZQ2Kc1QufK2BRW74dvkY2WTjnHH34XJSNdh5aGXrYB/neutral_simple_elegant_travel_vlog_youtube_thumbnail_1_.png)

Hi, I am Arveno from Surabaya city. In this content i want to share about plan after i move out to my new house. Apparently, right now All Cryptocurrency market is like bored. They are already stable and somehow especially gamefi is cannot be reliable again. So, what i need to do is re strategize my strategy. I will come back to designing about plant decoration and learning again about plants variation. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSzZaDysJdsNd9omCYsZTBdeKkvbHRXKD7kfpJaKjcMqp/image.png)

But, before that what we need to do is cleaning up our hair first. So, my son and I are going to barbershop. Cutting our Hair and tidy up our hair. Then we are going to eating out with my wife too. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSdhv2oeAZ3Auucr2NBWRy6beXxPE3iGofxp7qAWDjjLm/image.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZS3FpSuJjQ1SwqHHkaNxdywWwyxgvBx6NQXX4pAowmRF/image.png)

We are trying to eating at \

. This place is actually not new. Its already open since 2 years ago but we never tried it at once. And while we are eating Ramen beside this restaurant we usually seen this place is really crowded. Thats why my wife want to try eating here and yeah we need to try something new. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPHWHtxXqM5Cpvh1pZX87174PHFX57B1DcBXsKaGQzHC3/image.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma5sQ2vc3Ah2Rt8Uqv75c3KtCFSS6aHZYMiu31uDoVTUk/image.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma47rXU1b4JbThtghcrRvNA5NZyDMQq5uqzWzjVTqy8p7/image.png)

At first when i see the price on the menu, all of this restaurant food is kinda affordable. Maybe this is the reason why people come here. And also this food is based on Central Java Area which is dominated with sweet and based on coconut cream. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb1NPQZZxQU4Ckszdr6eTvgL1MfryzXWyZ1rVgoQFKSGM/image.png)

First this is what my son ordered. He is ordered by himself right now, we dont need to pick him up for food anymore i guess. I dont know what it is, it is kind of Chicken Meat Porridge i guess. But, the taste is kinda delicious and since all of the food based on Central Java, yeah this food is really sweet. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV2xgUEccwWyFbj3qVXCMbmgNE2AyiReskJLPtUra4vLX/image.png)

Then this is what my wife ordered. It is same with my son but different broth and filler. My wife ordered complete not only chicken meat but innards and beef. And the broth is taste sweet but also salty. But the saltiness comes out not from Salt but the saltiness comes out from coconut cream. Thats why the taste can be sweet but salty. And since i dont like eating innards i dont taste the beef taste on my wife dish. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdLFy2DQfctcaWfL4ADn2MuqepsSDAXh3fKW3WJkQgEDb/image.png)

Meanwhile me, I ordered Mixed Rice with Tempe,Slice of Cucumber, Fried Noodles, and a bunch of Vegetables and the last is some of beef slice. The taste is good. Yeah All taste is really good. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYYate7GeDKb76aF2eg5izYtat3pEB68CWxojESZQLLho/image.png)

Especially with the drink Ice Grass Jelly Milk. There is so delicious in the hot weather. But, as you can see in all the picture. The portion is like kid portion. Maybe enough for my son. But, it is not enough for me and my wife. So, i will take back that this food in this restaurant is affordable. It is not!! It need double the portion and the price will be doubled. And turns out that all of those food are really expensive. 
Okay, lets move on. Back again with my strategy. I already decided that after i move out to new house. I will prepare some space for my work with plant design to make my portofolio to selling the design. And also maybe i will starting to build my social media with all my design. I think i will continue what i stopped back then. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQyDeHUuayMVAbkHc4GVA6beaFpVrr3i5YeWqonQZ9XnS/image.png)

So, first i need to know how much price of the pot planter. This is the place where the pot planter is sold at very reasonable price. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR8B9Af3LbopP7W3Fu51kVruvA5VNpNMDbWh4oEVPua3s/image.png)

After talking to the owner for several hours, sharing my experience and what i want. Then they are give me a price list that can be good for my base. Then i just need to collect other material such as plants, rocks, driftwood, soil supplier. And this would makes me happy again since i really love doing design and when i seen my desing back then. I really missing it making creation with plants.

 Buenas mi gente , aquí estoy con otro juego . Este es sencillo pero sumamente entretenido. 

El juego consiste en que tienes que armar un ejército y luchar contra bandas contrarias. 

Al inicio de cada batalla te dan un minero y 500 de oro con eso tienes que armar tu estrategia. 

Lo que siempre es recomendable hacer es comprar varios mineros y así te va incrementando rápido el dinero y poder armar el ejército. 

Tienes desde arqueros hasta gigantes.
Lo bueno de los arqueros en tu ejército es que mientras las tropas enemigas van corriendo hacia donde estas estos van disparando y quitándole la vida rápidamente. 
Los soldados son más flojos Pero cuando uno lo evoluciona si están muy bien equipados. 
Los más difíciles de conseguir son el mago y el gigante que valen 1200 y más. Pero como tienes  cinco mineros te da más facilidad comprarte algunos . 
Los magos pueden sacar otros soldados que son también fuertes y el gigante es el mejor de todos por el daño que hace. 

El juego consiste en derrumbar la estatua del enemigo .  Todos estás cosas se mejoran . Los soldados y mineros y hasta la estatua. Con cada batalla que ganas te dan puntos para poder mejorar a tu ejército o a tu estatua. 

De la estatua salen unos arqueros mejorados que son como la defensa  cuando estás adentro del castillo. 

En fin señores hueguenlo a pesar de ser corto el juego está bastante entretenido. 
Además puedes jugsrlo en diferentes modalidades normal , difícil y hasta en zombies.  Y así vas teniendo más formas de juego . 

Yo lo jugué en normal obvio ara ser la primera vez que lo pruebo estuvo bastante bien. 

Las batallas se van complicando Pero ya les digo todo es de estrategia. Saber que sacarás primero si el arquero , el soldado y a los mineros . 

Si l idescargsn y juegan me dicen 😜

title.title: Should we worship only the lord Jesus Christ// Mcgi topic review
title.body:
The Bible presents Jesus Christ as central to faith, revealing Him as the Son of God and the Savior of the world. Through Him, God made Himself known in a personal way, showing His character, love, and plan for salvation. Because of this, many believers direct their worship to Jesus, recognizing His divine authority and His role in redeeming humanity.

At the same time, Scripture consistently teaches that worship belongs to God alone. From the Old Testament to the New, God commands His people not to worship any other being. This foundation is important, because it shows that true worship must always be directed toward the one true God, who is worthy above all.

title.body:
TMAO
Deuterium Toxicity
Stephanie Seneff, MIT

The problem with most supplements is the deuterium they deliver.

Stephanie Seneff, MIT researcher:

\

Most supplements are made in chemistry labs.

The molecules are chemically identical to their natural counterparts.

But they lack one critical property: deuterium depletion.

Deuterium is a heavy form of hydrogen that damages ATPase pumps in the mitochondria.

Melatonin is the clearest example.

Your gut produces 400x more melatonin than your pineal gland — most of it inside mitochondria.

Seneff: Melatonin is not primarily a sleep hormone. It is a deuterium depletion system.

Here's the mechanism:

Gut microbes produce hydrogen gas that is 80% deuterium depleted.

That gas feeds a chain of conversions — producing methyl and acetyl groups that are severely low in deuterium.

Those methyl and acetyl groups get attached to serotonin, converting it into melatonin.

Each melatonin molecule now carries depleted hydrogen — ready to be delivered to the mitochondria.

Inside gut cells (enterocytes), an enzyme called CYP2C19 strips the methyl group off melatonin.

Each time it does, it releases four molecules of deuterium-depleted water directly into the mitochondria — protecting the ATPase pumps that generate your cellular energy.

Four depleted water molecules. Per cycle. To the ATPase pumps that need them most.

When melatonin is made synthetically — which is virtually all commercial melatonin — the methyl and acetyl groups come from bulk chemicals made in a lab.

Random high deuterium content. The biological depletion step never happened.

Your body cannot tell the difference. 

Sleep improves. Antioxidant effects occur.

But the deuterium depletion cycle doesn't run. The mitochondria don't get what they actually need.

The short-term benefit masks the long-term harm.

The TMAO (Trimethylamine N-oxide) evidence:

TMAO is a marker for deuterium toxicity — deuterium-loaded methyl groups accumulating systemically.

People who ate eggs — no TMAO increase.

People who took synthetic choline supplements — elevated TMAO.

The mechanism: enzymes that metabolize methyl groups can detect deuterium — and refuse to process it.

The trimethylamine survives in the gut. Gets oxidized in the liver. Becomes TMAO in the blood.

The same problem applies to:

N-acetylcysteine (NAC) — the acetyl group is low deuterium from gut microbes, unpredictable when synthetic.

Choline bitartrate — Seneff: \

Methionine — methionine-deficient rats lived longer in one study.

Seneff's interpretation: methionine restriction extended lifespan not because methionine itself is harmful — but because the rats stopped receiving deuterium-loaded synthetic methionine.

Their gut microbes produced it naturally — low deuterium.

The rats getting synthetic methionine wrecked their mitochondria with deuterium-enriched methyl groups. 

The deficient rats didn't.

Methylated B vitamins — likely synthetic, likely the same problem.

The studies testing these supplements never account for the fact that they're synthetic.

They have no idea that's even a variable worth measuring.

What to do instead:

- Get methionine from meat, fish and eggs — not synthetic amino acid supplements.

- Get choline from eggs and animal foods — not choline bitartrate.

- Get tryptophan from food — chicken, turkey, beef, pork, fish, eggs, hard cheeses (parmesan, cheddar). Your gut microbes convert it through the biological pathway naturally, producing depleted melatonin the way biology intended.

One study: tryptophan loading increases serum melatonin 4-fold — even in rats without a pineal gland, confirming the melatonin was gut-sourced not pineal-sourced.

- Animal fats — butter, tallow — are among the lowest deuterium foods available. Derived from acetate produced by gut microbes from deuterium-depleted hydrogen gas. The same pathway that makes biological methyl groups low in deuterium.

- Eat certified organic. Glyphosate disrupts the gut microbiome — which disrupts the entire deuterium management system upstream.

- Fermented foods support acetate production and the whole chain. Whenever the food is fermented, the microbes are making nutrients that are low in deuterium.

- Keep your gut microbiome healthy. It is your primary deuterium management system.

Seneff is 78 years old. Still writing papers. Mentally sharp. Doesn't take any supplements.

\

The supplement industry sells you the molecule.

They don't sell you the mechanism biology built into the production process.

title.title: Chasing the Sunset at Brgy. Pintor Marker
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdAL6pXJtNriQA7rMCHJqz7KdPXtNR78WiDuGG6ebXPw4/1776867121398.png)

Hello Worldmappin!

I am happy to share my first post with all of you in this community. I hope you will like and enjoy reading about our experience.

They say that time waits for no one, and this is very true when you are trying to catch the sunset. 😅

Once it starts going down, it disappears very quickly. 

That was exactly our experience during our recent \

in Brgy. Pintor Marker.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcXS4T7i8cw7E8CvMYGFwxfcNUSQP2qgHskfxagUgobgw/1776867152316.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQdRaTaiKBnjd2Li6cjrvhKzE3EHShT7bDD3NzxY67jWs/1776867152399.jpg)

Actually, we were just out to pick up my mother from the next barangay. But after we picked her up, we decided to make the most of our time and go straight to Brgy. Pintor Marker. 

When we started our trip, it was already 5:00 in the afternoon. But because we really wanted to see the sunset in this place, we knew we were in a race against time. 😅

The road going there is not easy, especially when you are riding an e-bike.

The place is located in a mountainous area, so the road goes up and down. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYKJ8UCZofEyUUbAftwvYiYQ1T3KDkDFKdYxNz5vFsRLv/1776867188142.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNvw1axEACZnSGBp57Jq2GE53ErDdKFRaCJrDNyW4ny6Q/1776867188219.jpg)

You cannot just drive as fast as you have to be careful. 

While we were on our way, we could already see the sun looking so beautiful and starting to go down. I was worried that we would arrive too late and miss it. 

But thankfully, it felt like the sun waited for us! We made it just in time. HAHA

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYvVyK37Jff3uFjW8JVc2V2fUHKZX59ho9xZxLyGmha6g/1776867256740.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXbx6s6jvn2ZEj1kgY8ohbAe2E8Ho2zk9jCMQb777pusw/1776867256797.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQLj8eUPwqy4ai8Jf9uP1niWeg5FfpK9No3rPxH4z3oDM/1776867256852.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWmqzP97EvZznZwHiYi9jSNB5gfQ65pZrLjiKSnDxcYhP/1776867256905.jpg)

When we arrived, I was amazed by what I saw. What I love most about this place is the wide and open space. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYBB3XVHsnpDZTx3w2fbxUB8XCcs6DmPYwVkCpveEeFKq/1776867374895.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbUicK9pBahykc6QVA6keKp8SfG8fYCVn6zm2D91bENqx/1776867374993.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc222TSkr8rKF5Uzpot6AfMAdkUaBrCF7eBbBCfut4aTg/1776867375054.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRcxKpK9Rmf63b6QQ1Zt32KcDseYX9XTduRosiJVnWQYW/1776867375092.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRNZ4VEG78NvHWFy3k4HtxWBJdTLvVkZh3iwrk7aAYmyQ/1776867375127.jpg)

You can see nature clearly all around you.

And looking down, you can see lots of green trees and plants. 

It's so refreshing to the eyes. 

And with the sun setting in the background, the view became even more perfect. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSffaCyx8aXN5WtynvPTeNUVWiXi9pddfD9zQrYrhfqRH/1776867439137.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY6o6njcx6MdngAoNeqwgpgovXUf47xg5k76MkLfPpY6D/1776867439208.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUXwQVf2KSdejzBUv86B77S777dWnuBt8f5cyY5tiJPvr/1776867439270.jpg)

It was really peaceful and beautiful. 

I know it just looks like a small bright orb on our camera, but in person, you will surely enjoy it. HAHA

This spot is just along the main road, so it is easy to find. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX3bfsi4jZNjaZYnW9uXreuNNZVJhvLbj5mvdSdGNAVFD/1776867466874.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTGkbxeqQsc14t3D5poCAyqUqgCf3dgcTGTo9qPhvkYf5/1776867466940.jpg)

Of course, since it is a public road, you will see motorcycles and tricycles passing by now and then. 

We also noticed that we were not the only ones there. There were many other people who came to spend their time there too. 

Some were taking pictures, others were just sitting down, relaxing, and enjoying the fresh air. It is nice to see that many people love this place as much as we do.

Also, we saw some goats down. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbdcc91GQZ7UzZvATaJveph5RHizZ2wdQUyz5F9NxW5C9/1776867491170.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme16t93nsDQasTeiuRDr4N3xmj7RhLeK83MkeoYa4Vjy7/1776867491247.jpg)

Our son, Aiden, was so happy to see them! 😅

He was watching them and even tried to copy the sound they made. 🤣 

Hearing him make the \

sound was so cute and funny. HAHA. It made us all laugh. 

Anyway, it was definitely a fun memory for all of us.

Overall, we had a wonderful afternoon at Brgy. Pintor Marker. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTYJUpA7HwzeiK4mYbk11ZzXKMEisDa9NFDnJzRoZXE5E/1776867519223.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmae1pvTUUAzM9tN7hfKGhvnGGfAbdGngqqvvjnmTsbzNT/1776867519287.jpg)

If you are looking for a place to unwind, breathe fresh air, and see a beautiful sunset, this is a great place to visit. 

It is worth the long ride, and we are happy we decided to go there even if it was a last-minute plan.

*Language Assistance: Grammarly*

<center>
ENGLISH 
</center>

Hello, my people, I am sure you all have been having a lot of fun and vibing here in this great community of music. Like I do say that this community gives me a lot of joy anytime I know it's a new week, and I want to share my entry into this community. One thing about music is that you get so happy whenever you want to do it because it is what you love to do. It will be very hard to see someone who does not like music do something related to music because it just won't work.

So for this week's edition, which is the Hive Music Festival Week 184, Round 1. I will be sharing an original song that is titled Ojo Emi Mimo. In other words, this title means the rain of the Holy Spirit in English. What does this song entail? Or what does it mean? In a nutshell, it means the rain of the Holy Spirit will come down on us, and one thing rain does is that when it rains, we get a normal body temperature, and the body begins to cool off from the hot temperature it might have been before.

One of the times this song can be used to minister to people or to pass a message is when you are interceding for the power of the Holy Spirit because songs like this can make you connected to the heavenly host just by singing it. 

The lyrics say;
Ojo emi mimo yo ro
Je ko ro so ri wa
Ojo emi mimo yo ro 
Je ko ro sori wa
Gba to ba ro
Gba to ba ro 
Ara yo tu wa
Ojo emi mimo yo ro
Je ko ro sori wa

This song was done in a Yoruba language, and it is also my mother tongue, so to those that might not understand the song, just vibe with the flow of the beat and enjoy the entry as you watch. I hope you have a very peaceful day ahead.

---
---

<center>
ESPANOL 
</center>

Hola a todos, estoy seguro de que se lo han pasado genial y han disfrutado mucho en esta gran comunidad musical. Como siempre digo, esta comunidad me llena de alegría cada vez que empieza una nueva semana, y quiero compartir mi contribución. Una de las cosas buenas de la música es que te hace muy feliz cuando la disfrutas, porque es lo que te apasiona. Es difícil ver a alguien a quien no le guste la música haciendo algo relacionado con ella, porque simplemente no funciona.

Así que, para la edición de esta semana, que corresponde a la primera ronda de la semana 184 del Festival de Música Hive, compartiré una canción original titulada \
. En otras palabras, este título significa \

. ¿Qué significa esta canción? En resumen, significa que la lluvia del Espíritu Santo caerá sobre nosotros, y una de las cosas que hace la lluvia es que nuestra temperatura corporal se normaliza y el cuerpo empieza a refrescarse después de haber estado caliente. Esta canción se puede usar para ministrar a las personas o transmitir un mensaje cuando se intercede por el poder del Espíritu Santo, ya que canciones como esta pueden conectarte con las huestes celestiales con solo cantarlas.

La letra dice:

Ojo emi mimo yo ro
Je ko ro so ri wa
Ojo emi mimo yo ro
Je ko ro sori wa
Gba to ba ro
Gba to ba ro
Ara yo tu wa
Ojo emi mimo yo ro
Je ko ro sori wa

Esta canción está en yoruba, mi lengua materna, así que para quienes no la entiendan, déjense llevar por el ritmo y disfruten del video. Les deseo un día muy tranquilo.

title.body:
https://youtu.be/m2f0PiWT0c0?si=GkyDptFH3-cCFQvB
We love children. We have always loved children. They make our hearts merry. When they are around laughter and fun are inevitable. Children make us happy. So to hear about a child dying always causes us pain. Some people could not bear this pain. It is very painful. Parents worry a lot if such things like this happen to them. The love for children cannot be overemphasized. Let us take solace in the Word of God that our little ones will spend their eternity. The souls of children (especially those who are not keeping offenses. When we lost children, they are not going to damnation. Their souls will be saved in the bossom of the Lord.

We find it difficult to accept what God does. God sometimes allows our little ones to be taken away so that they might be saved from the evil days coming. It is only God who knows tomorrow. He wants what is the best for the child. We might want that child to grow into adulthood. But what if when he or she had grown into adulthood, he or she will become a child that is lost in hell? So God sometimes does not want that to happen. Therefore the dead of our children does not always mean something evil.

title.title: Otra página de diario y cinco regalos [Es-En] Another diary page and five gifts
title.body: ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfGP56c8BgCrfvNK4jHD41QMtSQRrZuG51qRFVE8omiNW/image.png) Días grises de lluvia no tan fuerte, pero frecuente, han bajado las temperaturas, pero no tanto como para usar chaqueta, así que salí con dos camisas. Una de algodón algo grueso y otra ligera que parece impermeable. Elegí la tarde cuando parecía que se marchaban las nubes, aunque las más oscuras se estacionaron sobre nuestras cabezas. Una salida ineludible para no quedarme sin café; además, son los martes los mejores días para comprar, pues no fallan en ponerle un buen descuento al café y otros muchos productos. Regresando con el morral a la espalda, que no estaba pesado, me detuve al entrar a la urbanización; en la puerta estacionado estaba un cesto con ruedas parecido al del supermercado, repleto de libros brillantes y nuevos. Pregunté por aquello y me respondieron que llevara los que quisiera. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcTBzRwJdMUoPdeSiHtVrUNvXU89QrrjcVnLg5niQgPY3/image.png) Mire, y aunque me parecieron libros de texto, no resistí la tentación y tomé uno de cada título; les he dado un vistazo y una lectura salteada. De momento le dedicaré una lectura al relativo a la psicosomática y tal vez al relativo a la intimidad de la vida amorosa, aunque este en particular tiene un capítulo interesante relacionado con mutilaciones, digamos íntimas, y tatuajes. Tema que quisiera comprender desde otra perspectiva, ya que son muchos los jóvenes que conozco portadores de tatuajes, que yo veo como algo poco recomendable. Pero que cada quien decide. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaTsbxfGdvfbCRqU5tLXss3Vhmhi9YmjCoEwpoPa3fZZo/image.png) El sol anuncia que no lloverá, así que por hoy no escribo más y me dispongo a salir a caminar. Escrito en español con traducción de Google y fotos propias tomadas con el Motorola. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNNj8UNNpnbsoaQ4NJofRxotcyXDgYyRr38tYTooS3J65/image.png) # Another diary page and five gifts ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfGP56c8BgCrfvNK4jHD41QMtSQRrZuG51qRFVE8omiNW/image.png) Gray days with frequent, though not heavy, rain have lowered the temperatures, but not enough to warrant a jacket, so I went out with two shirts. One was a fairly thick cotton shirt, and the other a light one that seemed waterproof. I chose the afternoon when it seemed the clouds were clearing, although the darkest ones lingered overhead. It was an essential outing so I wouldn't run out of coffee; besides, Tuesdays are the best days to shop, as they always offer a good discount on coffee and many other products. Returning with my backpack, which wasn't heavy, I stopped as I entered the gated community. Parked by the entrance was a wheeled basket, similar to those at the supermarket, overflowing with shiny, new books. I asked about them and they told me to take whichever ones I wanted. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcTBzRwJdMUoPdeSiHtVrUNvXU89QrrjcVnLg5niQgPY3/image.png) Look, even though they seemed like textbooks, I couldn't resist the temptation and took one of each title; I've skimmed through them and read them sporadically. For now, I'll dedicate some time to reading the one about psychosomatics and perhaps the one about the intimacy of love life, although this one in particular has an interesting chapter related to mutilations, let's say intimate ones, and tattoos. It's a topic I'd like to understand from another perspective, since I know many young people with tattoos, which I see as something not very advisable. But everyone decides for themselves. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaTsbxfGdvfbCRqU5tLXss3Vhmhi9YmjCoEwpoPa3fZZo/image.png) The sun is shining, so I'm not writing any more today and I'm going for a walk. Written in Spanish with Google translation and my own photos taken with my Motorola. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNNj8UNNpnbsoaQ4NJofRxotcyXDgYyRr38tYTooS3J65/image.png)
