English

There are days like that, when getting out of bed feels like a major feat, when laziness is the dominant emotion, days when just the thought of running makes that lethargy feel even more intense. Well, for me, today is one of those days.


I didn’t want to get out of bed, I didn’t want to warm up, and I certainly didn’t want to go out for a run. But I did it; I forced myself. And it wasn’t easy because with every step I took, my mind kept telling me to stop and turn back. I ignored it and kept going because my goal was 5 km.


I tried to silence my mind by running at a very fast pace, but it didn’t work; then I slowed down, and it kept insisting that I stop. And yet I managed to run the 5 kilometers at an average pace of 6:32. Not bad for someone who, at another time, would have just stayed in bed without a second thought.


To keep it from being a routine run, I decided to run on a route I haven’t used in a while: Orinoco Avenue. There I took some photos and then started jogging. It was very pleasant because there’s a lot of greenery. The downside of this route is the large number of cars and people using it, but it worked for me today so I wouldn’t miss my workout.

I’m sharing some of the photos I took. And I’d like to take this opportunity to tell you that even when you don’t feel like it, even when you don’t feel like running, the satisfaction you feel when you finish is well worth it. Have a great day, everyone. See you tomorrow.

body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQp23oryVmcQLYfoAM8zxgXegdPhbmTpNmZybbPKk2qzu/1000170302.jpg 
[source](https://www.freepik.com/free-ai-image/portrait-man-with-clear-bubble_133513824.htm#fromView=search&page=1&position=2&uuid=7e731c07-cace-41c4-a7a7-af887e9677a5&query=Idea+sharing+AI+generated+) 
Don't hoard too much? I will be starting here before venturing broader into the main event. Doing [business](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-business) and doing business efficiently, productive and profitable is another. I happen to meet an entrepreneurial [friend](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-friend) who stays around and as usual we were discussing business challenges. I am running a much broader business (Laundry, sewing and branding services) while he was in the laundry business only.   

That is why it gets easier for me to associate with different [entrepreneurs](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-entrepreneur) because as it stands I am operating in multiple fields. Ok, his challenge started first from the [energy](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-energy-industry) sector which has been very poor. It has always kept him [on the run](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-on-the-run-us-treasuries). Atimes he will have to sleep overnight in his shop just hoping general [electricity](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-electricity) will surface and curb the [cost](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-cost) of [burning](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-burning) petrol and also straining your generator.   

I was opening to listening and also being if help to him. He laid a complaint/suggestion as regarding changing his mode of business operation. I must say he as been observing how we are doing business. We are staying in the same street, yet we are not competing for the street [customers](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-customer) with him. 85% of our customers are far distance and most importantly those that give [bulk](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-bulk-shipping) services.   

While he keeps servicing a lar carte customers who mostly turn up with one or two clothes which of course has disadvantages. He doesn't have much [time](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-time), he cannot do a proper strategizing or restrategizing to meet up. An a la carte customers can show up anytime asking for his clothes.  You re forced to spend urgently and huge on a service that will generate little to no [profit](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-profit) at [ALL](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-all-currency).   
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNoCkTyL2Nv77BWbJSGm4YCEFgS27BBUsRk7hJkUW69ek/1000170325.jpg 
[source](https://www.freepik.com/free-photo/light-bulb-electricity_12685685.htm#fromView=search&page=1&position=7&uuid=62533cd7-50ef-471e-ab92-7db1de7c956a&query=Idea+sharing+AI+generated+) 
I understand where he was coming from in the [statements](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-statement) he was making because I actually suffered same fate in my early [business days](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-business-day). I will spend my entire Saturday burning petrol and straining my generator to solve a lar carte customers problems that ended up non-profiting. Sometimes I slept over at the shop or even returned very late at night.   

Since he was into some proprietorship, my advice was drafted out of a careful follow up of his statements. There was a time he used to run this business right from the comfort of his [apartment](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-apartment). At some point, a misunderstanding came in with his landlord and he had to opt for an external shop and right [NOW](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-negotiable-order-of-withdrawal-account-now), it is not favorable.

First, he is paying rent in two places and secondly, consider the cost of coming to and fro the office. Thirdly, you can understand that he is not able to have more control on decision making as he would have been able to strategize working a [Night Shift](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-night-shift-film) some [days](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-day) if it was a [home](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-home) office.   

This country needs strategy to survive not even to talk of thriving. I had to suggest he goes back to merge his business as his home office since he said he already has outside customers who can give him bulk services. The advantage here is, bulk service customers always give an elastic time for their service [delivery](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-delivery). It gives you time to strategize on how to pair general electricity with your added [energy](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-energy) equipments. In the end, cost becomes low, time becomes efficiently spent in-between and there is a reasonable profit margin to start off with.   

To conclude let me add, so it means others are looking at my mode of business operation and are admiring it. I decided to use our home office which is like a [warehouse](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-warehouse) to continue business after leaving our former rented office. The additional take home is; bulk services are good business. I look [forward](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-forward-financial) to penetrating this even into our sewing and branding sector. When this is achieved, we will be seeing a substantial profit.

I write on faith, [life](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-life) facts and daily living, business and [economics](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-economics-social-science), small scale and daily businessing, [cryptocurrency](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/cryptocurrency) and [technology](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-technology). body.title: Paid Internships: Fair Compensation or Optional Benefit?
body.body:
/>Internships serve as a transitional path which enables students and recent graduates to obtain practical work experience between their academic studies and professional employment.

The issue of whether interns should receive payment remains an ongoing discussion among people. Interns present actual work value to organizations despite some people viewing internships as educational experiences. Interns deserve payment because they deliver actual work results for organizations.

  
Interns complete multiple tasks which help organizations to operate their business activities. Their work includes conducting research and managing office tasks while they participate in projects and perform duties which match entry-level job descriptions.

The company derives value from this particular work. The company must pay an intern when it receives benefits from the intern's work. The term \

fails to recognize the full extent of what interns contribute to their organizations.

  
Unpaid internships create a system of unequal treatment according to their second point. Many students who come from low-income families face difficulties when trying to do unpaid work. The requirement to work without payment creates barriers which prevent anyone who lacks financial assistance from obtaining internships.

Talented people who work hard yet lack financial resources face barriers which stop them from reaching their full potential. Unpaid internships create economic and social disparities because they fail to provide equal access to job opportunities.

The argument exists that companies treat internships as their financial commitment for training purposes. The process of educating interns requires employers to invest their resources which results in decreased productivity during the initial period.

Unpaid internships exist as educational programs which should not be considered as job opportunities according to this viewpoint. The argument presents some valid points however it fails to recognize that most interns quickly become useful workers who produce more value than the training they receive.

Interns have the capacity to acquire knowledge while receiving appropriate wages because education and payment can coexist together.  
Interns who receive payment experience enhanced work conditions because of their compensation. The value interns bring to organizations increases when they receive payment because their compensation makes them feel appreciated.

The result leads to increased productivity and higher levels of workplace involvement and employees develop a greater feeling of ownership. Organizations gain advantages from their staff members who produce superior results while creating a better workplace atmosphere. The practice of providing paid internships builds an organization’s status which attracts highly skilled professionals to join their team.

  
Internships provide essential learning opportunities for students, yet these programs must maintain equitable treatment of all participants. Interns produce actual work results which should receive financial recognition through appropriate payment.

Interns who receive pay create equal opportunities for all people in society, which helps businesses succeed throughout time. The fundamental requirement exists that all work must receive payment, yet experience holds significant value.

body.body: Enrique Yecier, [Recall.ai](https://www.recall.ai/) is basically infrastructure for meeting bots: an API that lets companies plug into Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams and similar tools to capture recordings, transcripts, and meeting metadata without building all that ugly plumbing themselves. Their own product pages call it “the API for meeting recording” and offer a [Meeting Bot API](https://www.recall.ai/product/meeting-bot-api) plus SDKs for desktop/mobile capture, so the business is less “AI magic” and more “picks and shovels for meeting data” — which, frankly, is often the smarter business. I’m not seeing much InLeo discussion on Recall specifically; the closest hit was unrelated noise from [@doctormedicare](https://inleo.io/@doctormedicare/availity-ai-products-f3f), so I wouldn’t pretend there’s a real community thread around it here yet.

Introduction


Hello everyone, Worldmappin friends! I'm @lauramica, and today I'm bringing you this Wednesday's Travel Digest. Come see the places we'll be visiting today! ❤️ This time, our featured posts take us to a beautiful castle in Cumaná, Venezuela; we spent Valentine's Day in Bucharest, Romania; and we visited the beautiful city of Siena, Italy. We'll also be visiting other places around the world like the Philippines, Spain, Turkey, and Portugal—a little bit of everything! Thank you all for sharing your posts on the map! Have a wonderful day! 😃❤️


All featured posts are visible on the Editors Choice Map and upvoted by @worldmappin, our curation trail, and potentially @blocktrades. For more travel digests check out #traveldigest.

Our winners today


🥇 A journey through time as you visit one of the city’s most important castles [ENG-ESP] by @hylene74

Today I’m sharing an interesting tour with you—one steeped in history—a must-see destination I’d been meaning to visit for a long time. The good news is that I was finally able to fulfill this small but incredible dream. I had been to the historic district of Cumaná a couple of times, but on both occasions, the castle wasn’t open to the public. What I regretted most was how difficult it was to reach that destination, because the Castle of San Antonio de la Eminencia is located at one of the highest points in the city. It’s so high up that you feel like you’re hiking.

This post on Worldmappin - This user on Worldmappin



🥈 Siena, a Tuscan City With Impressive Architecture [ENG/PL] by @inmyframe

My vacation to Tuscany in September 2021 was my first vacation abroad, and I still consider it the most enjoyable of my life. We visited many Tuscan towns, one of which was Siena, rich in beautiful architecture. Siena is located south of the Tuscan capital, Florence, approximately 75 kilometers apart. Siena itself is the capital of the province of the same name and a major tourist and economic center for the area.

body.title: Crypto Cooking - Blue-Chip Iberico Pork
body.body:
Cooking and cryptocurrency share some surprisingly spicy similarities… both demand the right ingredients, perfect timing, and just enough experimentation to keep things exciting.

One day we’re searing steaks, the next we’re stressing over staking! Ever feeling like balancing the heat in the kitchen is oddly like balancing yields in the crypto world? It's red or green!

There’s something unapologetically satisfying about throwing precision out the window and letting instinct take over in the kitchen. That was the mood I had when cooking dinner.

But did you know there are “blue-chip stocks” in the pork world? There are a few breeds that are genuinely rare and expensive because of genetics, diet, and how they’re raised.

The most famous luxury one is Iberico pork! These pigs are free-range and acorn-fed, which gives the meat a rich, nutty, almost buttery flavor. Spent my airdrop money for a piece! 


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbGt2rnhSkXuX4zQF7NsxiKje2aBq5Ln5Pho2Dq9EYqhv/image.png)


Another big-name luxury breed is the wooly Mangalitsa pig. It’s slow-growing, relatively rare, and known for its unusually high fat content in the best possible way.

Then there’s Berkshire pork! It’s not quite as rare as Iberico or Mangalitsa, but it still sits in the high-end category thanks to its tenderness, strong flavor, and superior fat quality! 

Choosing the right pork feels like picking the right strategy in that crypto chaos. Iberico pork is  the pick if you want something that rewards patience and turns into pure comfort-food gold

It gets better the longer and slower you cook it and is breaking down into something tender and forgiving. I decided to sear it a bit in the pan before slow cooking in the oven! 

Was no need to add oil, because I wanted that fast crust that will keep the flavor inside the meat. High heat and herbs to smoke some flavor, then garlic for some passion! 


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc6EZC44tCnbSZCJUcJTUbhXZDp59trJR7FcYjAw1pER3/image.png)


So if you zoom out on the “luxury tier” picture...  Iberico sits at the absolute premium end! I wanted that niche cult luxury space that goes down the high-end restaurant favorite lane.

Moved the pork cut in an oven-proof dish, resting on top of potatoes chunks! I added the juices and herbs from the pan as well, and hid the garlic under to spread the taste! 

Slow cooked in the oven for about one hour, at 150 Celsius for those deep notes!  If everyday pork is like normal market trading, fancy breeds are more like rare collectibles!

Iberico pork may be harder to find, more expensive, but with a payoff that people swear is worth it when you finally cook them right. The taste was absolutely amazing! 


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQzr9LNBoautrBSDJ5QDTmAF598KgzJmkeLt9MWpaxiqG/image.png)


I cooked it in the oven and was great but did you know ut’s most famously used for jamón ibérico? Fresh cuts are also prized in high-end cooking so had to try it! 

Even Satoshi would approve. Go trade some NFTs and check my other tasty crypto combos! It's a fruit but can go well for vegans instead of meat... similar to testnet money! 

Whether it’s the kitchen or crypto charts... it’s all about reading the moment, trusting your instincts, and knowing when to let things ride. May your pork crackle like crypto pumps!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRou7VYmCkoJKR7G4wrWtA27w2mTsL7Q6KfRMDuUKJ3fd/1776864581752.jpg)

I'm so so excited to be here with you all again, it was so boring staying without interacting with you all and I came to realized that staying without phone might be a sickness to someone, so I was praying for this day to come, the day I will buy a new phone, the day I will come back to hive, so I finally comes back to hive and I I'm so delighted to be here again, I still managing my sewing project since my phone spoiled I couldn't be able to snap some steps, so  last week I managed my neighbor's phone to snaped even though the Camara is too bad I had to managed because I was expecting a new phone this week, so I have some few steps here to share with you all.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXvziMwYcERUArWiaL6YQtaFQGzEZiFjup2GQGTdWywBN/1776864627191.jpg)

So after pleating the net I joined the down part together with the upper half length part, so for the half length part I turned the half part with the small sleeves.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPbMN7QVWT2fA73Z7mkSQVfH2EQQmAC8hQrsFqqcm4eCg/1776864823080.jpg)

body.title: Demographics Plus Many Other Factors are Going To Make Ghost Towns Out of Suburbia
body.body: ![ForSaleHouse.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVW24jSwewMt8VyVx5nNpcSoAdNz1rmgyT7BzQocKft1E/ForSaleHouse.png) It is hard to imagine the future of housing, when it is almost opposite of what we see now. We have come to accept that normal houses are selling for a million dollars in some cities. So, it is difficult to get people to grok that that same house will soon be zero dollars. But they will, and it is important to comprehend this, and why it will happen, so that you can make decisions for your future.

> ## Living in a suburban sprawl, in a single family house, is just bad! * The standard single family home is a really poor design for multiple individuals or split families. And this looks like the direction society is going. * The average crackerjack box construction is not good enough to withstand the temperature variations we will be living in, in the future. Even if the house is free, you won't be able to afford to heat/cool the place at future gas prices. * Few will want to live in the cities/suburbs. With few jobs and very high crime, there will be no one who lives in the city because they want to. * People learn that living in a city, where you are surrounded by strangers is really bad for you. You really need to be surrounded by friends, which means a group of less than 100 people. Cities are not designed for groups of 100 people. * People learn that they are not their job. Especially not a highly impersonal job. Life is no longer focussed around, go to work, go home, sleep, repeat. A city is built around the jobs * These and a hundred other things show us that cities are a bad way to live. Further, many inventions come along that make small communities a very easy thing to build. We will no longer be tied to the grid, or tied to the roads. James Howard Kunstler has outlined how bad our large cities and suburbs are, and we will find even more reasons… ![KunstlerQuote.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSu398W9ePrT8hPKzwEtpbbiZSYuKehG1z3xhnfMFBV2P/KunstlerQuote.jpg)

></center>
## Demographics leads everything

Houses are only expensive if more people want to live there, then there are houses there.  Once there are more houses than people who want to live there, then the price drops.  And, not in a little way.

We have had continuous growth in population over our lives. All we have known is growth.  We are not prepared for shrinkage.  But, that is what is coming.

And when you have houses, that can't be sold, because everyone already has all the house that they want, then you start a race to the bottom.  Soon you have many houses sitting empty.  Then the price of a house goes to what you could build it for.

When even more houses are empty, the houses become worthless.  Not worthless to the people living in it, but having no resale value.  If, for some strange reason, you got kicked out of your house, there are a dozen left empty and abandoned that you could move into.

And this is just based on births to deaths ratios.  I haven't included anything about unCivil wars, or pandemics, or natural or unNatural disasters…  Just the boomers, who own 25% of all houses, leaving the market for \
will destroy the housing market. All these other occurrences will just stick a fork in it. The housing market is done.

> ## The suburban ghost town There will be entire housing tracts that are devoid of humans. Yes, all those million dollar homes (we aren't talking about the houses of the rich) are going to be left abandoned. People will not want to live there, even if the houses are free. Sure, there will be some groups of people that decide to build their small community on the rubble of the suburb. A group taking over an entire apartment complex could work out well, and i do not doubt that some groups will start that way. But, for the most part, after the new groups start building their small communities in much more advantageous places, all that will be left in these suburbs are people who couldn't get out. People without the resources or skills to get in with a group. Or the complete loners (although they are probably, already, far away from any cities) The only thing left will be groups of young people going through all the abandoned houses, removing everything of value to aid in the construction of new small communities. They may clean everything to the ground, leaving nothing, or they may leave a bunch of house shells to nature to reclaim

></center>

In every way, investing in real estate, is a short lived proposition.  Sure it will take years for the empty suburban housing tracts to manifest, but we are firmly on that path.

Unless everyone starts having babies, and jobs start paying a living wage, and the banks stop inflating the currency (and house prices) then real estate is doomed.  But that is unlikely since the banksters are pushing everything towards destruction.  Not helping, but seriously undermining everything.

People moving out to the country is a serious movement already, and when people start forming groups to move out to the country and start small communities, then we will see all the people that kept the city together, the infrastructure running, all leave.  The cities will be gutted of all skilled people.  Everyone who has the resources will be gone.

If you bought a house as an \

to rent, you will watch its rent that it can attract lower every year going forward. And, basically, you will be giving it back to the bank soon. That is, if there is a bank left. Which is a whole other piece of house prices going to zero.\n\n

>\n

We want to than everyone who visits us here and everywhere we show up. It dawned on me that I didn't know, until just now how to link Substack Notes. So we are giving it a try here. 
Come on over and visit. Let me know how and if the link works. If you'd like more like this, leave a comment. Peace. 

![vagabond and alice 1.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZmUTZP3ZwCYZvnbgxHKec3UefUXKxAdnBcgQ9gmLyVeW/vagabond%20and%20alice%201.jpg)

 
https://substack.com/@fullmetalox/note/c-247382696?utm_source=notes-share-action&r=xpuqt

Here's the complete note. Audio will be available later (EST) in the day. 

Happy Hump day healthy heroes. Welcome to another Hump day from Paradise.

Paradise was a little shaky this morning. The human inside this vessel has a morning routine, which includes posting episodes and writing this piece. But before that I like to check the forecast from the Church of Barking Dogs to see whether the world will be plunged into darkness today. Instead, it was plunged into silence. Several of my geopolitical sources were silent. They posted as usual, but the audio wouldn’t play. Meanwhile, my favorite browser celebrated its 150th upgrade. What a coincidence. So I checked other browsers. Same issue. Click, “play” — no play.

Your boy was shaken, but not stirred.

It reminded me of a Rodney Dangerfield bit, “I woke up this morning, put on my shirt, a button fell off. Went to get into my car, the handle fell off. I’m afraid to go to the bathroom.”

There were a few other tech issues on the upload tour. A minor glitch on a minor site. I had to check whether Mercury was in retrograde. Nope. Not until the end of June.

Descent into Hell Week continues. I am reluctant to say/write stuff like this because this vessel has been speaking, (spell-casting), sounds into reality. More on that later. Much later. But the smart-ass inside couldn’t resist. Today’s audio is part 2 of what we started Monday. We wondered, why is the End of the World always scheduled for the cusp of Libra-Scorpio? Of course it goes back to superstition, religious ritual & agriculture. (Agriculture was really a Big Deal on this planet. Talk about game changers.)

Next month, as Heart promised Mind, we are releasing, for the first time ever on Substack, our de facto novel. That’s what I call it anyway, and maybe I will share how it came to be for the curious. Anyway, this comic strip series was created in 2013. The plot is based on one of my all-time favorite movie plots.

At some point, it looks like the audio will kick in for our Substack channel. The advice that we don’t give, listen to the voice-over. We write for the vox. Change words, “customize” pronunciation and edit for the vox. If you’d prefer to listen to my hideous spelling, typos, bad grammar and the Substack' reader’s inability to distinguish “read” from “read,” go for it. Indeed, since we don’t give advice, let’s call it a “recommendation.” This way you can maintain your audio-autonomy, and have a giggle at the same time.

Finally, do to popular demand, we have begun posting Long Play Rantcast episodes. “Writing Fiction” has been released earlier today. There will be no links. If you subscribe to any of our TV channels you will get it. It’s nearly a half hour long, with promo spots and affirmations.

That’s the vibe for the terrified.

Stay safe, stay strong, stay savvy, stay sane, stay serene, stay sovereign, stay subscribed.

PEACE

body.title: Splinterlands Stats | Transactions, Games, Players and Price | Apr 2026
body.body:
How is Splinterlands doing these days? 
There are constant updates in the game, new modules, gameplay changes etc. The game is still ticking along but not exactly thriving. 
Let’s take a look at the numbers! 

 



![01.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23tRzxRwSFiaow3UJ2PSrYFQBepj6mHJcUhYcAPFUa9nkT3MGbMn1j1jiGFBfu3kzhgoW.png)







The following topics will be covered:
-	Number of transactions
-	Number of games played
-	Number of active daily players
-	New accounts created by Splinterlands
-	SPS price


The data has been queried from the [Splinterlands API](https://api2.splinterlands.com/transactions/metrics?metrics=dau,dec_rewards,market_vol,market_vol_usd,mkt_cap_usd,sign_ups,spellbooks,tx_total,battles&from=2024-01-01) in combination with the data from the Hive blockchain. 

## Number of Transactions
Transactions represent the overall activity in the game. Here is the chart. 

 




![image001.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23tkk8L8jjn6SKQsudDcW6tGVjhVQg8Gj6JP1Ki71hgpeCgeyohne41u8yDdPYVRZ6fDE.png)





Prior to July 2021, the overall data for Splinterlands was low. Then an explosion in the summer of 2021, the number of transactions went up to 5M a day, from the previous 100k daily.
The transactions stayed in the range of 3M to 5M during 2022 as well, but then in 2023 dropped by a lot, to around 800k per day, stayed there for a few months and a further drop in 2024 to around **100k** per day. 
*It should be noted that transactions were intentionally scaled back with the introduction of anti bot measures in multiple steps.*

**When we zoom in the last years, we get this**:

 




![image003.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23tbMPB9wih1ACn78HcLZvNimCKbHfkvsK5GdEyAo87v71vWcSxiedU9sTxVvEvFydwgk.png)








Here we can notice more constant numbers in the last years. The transactions have been in the range of 50k to 100k in the whole period, with occasional spikes. In the last period they are close to **50k** per day.



## Number of Battles Played
Here is the chart of the daily numbers of games played for the period. 

 





![image007.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23tkjcp9CNNXWbEtSu39u1mzs5zcr5GwJGrUVgFgccdHasCGC3Px3rZf6wfsVgqKRutWS.png)








This is the period for the last two years.
We can notice a very constant number in the period with around **60k** battles per day, with occasional spikes.

In the prior period before 2024 the number of battles has a similar trend with an explosion in 2021 and then a drop in 2022 and 2023. 


## Number of Active Players
This is one of the most important metrics for every dApp, how many active users have there are. Here is a data for daily active users [DAU].

 


![image011.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23tRzfSKGHZuphsoSBaSupiFt5S4C3up6bLXb3f48wMtjuszkjLZfCezNncjyzmApYr7F.png)






*This is a chart for 2024-2026 only.*

In the previous period the trend is similar as for the transactions chart. 
Here we can notice a steady trend with a small drop in February 2025 from around 7k to bellow 5k.
In the last period the number of DAUs is steady around the **4k** mark. 
## New Accounts Created by Splinterlands

Here are the new Hive accounts created by Splinterlands on a **monthly** basis. 

 



![image015.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23tknH9n8bUPgLoq8LankSGX91UeCVXuwHY9uiG8skrtDZTufA7BLTJPeJq2N4a95qXx6.png)







We can see quite a low numbers for new accounts in 2024, with numbers between 50 to 100 new accounts. As a new account here is counted an account that has purchased a Spellbook. 
There was a short spike in August 2025 with more than 500 new players. A drop since then bellow 100 in the last month. 

## SPS Price

At the end the price for the main token SPS. 



 



![image017.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23t7937MbfCrjUFKPkf7mqpSHTx89fXWFYW58TDDf9SGVkNR4fucUb2GkWPVXz1QSX25A.png)






The market has been brutal towards SPS. The token was launched in August 2021 and was trading more than 0.5$ for a short period of time. It dropped massively in 2022 from 0.2 all the way to 0.02 where it finished the year. 
Since then, we can see the token trading sub 1 cent, and it is now around 0.005. 


All the best
@dalz

body.title: Primo giorno a Torino - Viaggio 2026 - Museo Egizio
body.body:
![IMG_0893.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23zbRccK1KDrFBJAcxoKJiYnfMk7wiCQi6uPvSuNQiR9NSQ9wYSnVjqYj2hC1k4UEpyYw.JPG)


Hello friends, I am very happy to start telling you about my trip to Turin, and I will tell you about it in various episodes because there are many interesting things to see in these important Italian cities, but in my opinion it is very underrated from a tourist point of view and instead it is definitely worth discovering and going on a trip there.
The best way to get to Turin is definitely by train, in fact it took me about two hours from Verona with a Trenitalia Frecciarossa. I arrived in Turin, and after having bought the Torino card, which is basically a card that is valid for a certain number of hours and gives you the possibility to visit all the monuments for free, I had already booked entry to the Egyptian museum, which I remember is the second most important museum in the world as far as Egyptology is concerned, so it is definitely a museum not to be missed.


![IMG_2164.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23wqnwviEb3wazXcNPiAKJ35JbHnorai4d6nWKwpS3Pu1f2DqpwDUih1NFk2q3fe2XUrU.JPG)

![IMG_2440.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23wWvpAv6FSqGMq3pLCQETmuGf3NauoC2JZFFzVwfP3xog7S4cxEVhscChM9XTLvV9U7n.JPG)

the entrance ticket would be €18, but as I was telling you I bought the 72-hour Torino card at a cost of €44, this certainly gives me the opportunity to save money also because my intention was already to visit several museums in Turin, it was really exciting to enter this place, in reality it was a dream that I had been waiting for for a long time also because there is an enormous quantity of finds and collections that cover more than 4 million years of history and the beautiful thing is that all this is housed inside a 17th century building which is the building of the Academy of Sciences and today it is certainly one of the most visited museums in the world.


![IMG_2188.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23u6B81uZhXdsNn8Kfu7krYBBue4s3FjsNQmWbjPjThTa5Z6dkS2hYTi74KZZuHzJd4o9.JPG)


![IMG_2199.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23vhz1d6gSDDEC2LC6aBhs4QwFu7AafDCXh5ewohaK1dhWup1Q9i6VtKTZcGmJcKEtsJE.JPG)

The first part of the museum was created around 1750 precisely because Italy but also Europe were experiencing the fashion of Egyptomania and therefore there were various excavation campaigns underway but the one who brought the most finds to the museum was the Piedmontese Bernardino Drovetti who was the French consul, and thanks to him state collections and sarcophagi, papyrus, mummies and many pieces arrived in Italy which are still preserved here in the museum.


![IMG_2196.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23wqrfVSbCj8DCFa3cieJP7xrK95uEq8kAb7HiREbSRTSWrSG1mf2mwWWxuLLVvMgnwCR.JPG)

![IMG_2197.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23wgMWeN7qfwDCVRpzNSdvMDQT5nFMSdywt5HKUPJP58WfNjpYw5B3SZDTasRJDUJE3VY.JPG)

Since 2004, the management of the museum has been entrusted to a public-private foundation and thanks to this choice, the museum has grown a lot and the exhibition of finds has also changed a lot. In fact, I found it very accurate and precise, but among other things, different technologies have also been used to make the history and where these finds come from clearly understood.


![IMG_2303.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23yd1UqT4iKjoMzXrMkwtLWdCAGiWk523ksjjKcAPxQcLwyWMRSNEH1zg4nmwQvMBq15S.JPG)

I won't hide from you that the part that struck and moved me the most was undoubtedly the gallery of the kings, a beautiful scenographic room, where the pharaoh was accompanied by deities including Ramses II and the goddess Sekhmet.


![IMG_2475.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23x1FTxq2i96EBDGn6y6YcBdiXbuVMpgKS2asZB5rQ3dcfXRD18cGzo85CZ4J7ncXofSr.JPG)

![IMG_2466.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23xKzdqhmhTWojxaaM17Zxzns8arDSYBC3oHdWoLyCVRrK5u78pNfQj5ikfzC14WQ2zNg.JPG)

![IMG_2510.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23ynUGiUJAeYqpYraWp7Rz3BvN28xEA3LKARsKk9oypdmGdzkfYnHjmvQExaFTuC119n4.JPG)

![IMG_2515.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23zbRzHPxwYJpF3cQocfNBXV6UmLDGteE9HTusoyhhu3jgsngHfJzftnXhChTtzCvonyN.JPG)

Walking through this room you are truly speechless, seeing these enormous, very particular statues still well preserved after thousands of years, just think that to visit this entire museum it took me almost four hours and the positive thing that I found is that they give you the audio guide for free which can be downloaded to your cell phone, in fact thanks to this service I understood better the various finds and the history of this museum.

In conclusion, I can say that this is a stop not to be missed if you visit the city of Turin, as I was telling you the cost is not excessive and in fact it is worth the price of the ticket, but above all I will show you in another next post another interesting thing that you can visit in the Egyptian museum completely free of charge which is the rock temple of Ellesija.


![IMG_2157.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23xKvGuR7GpMQXYt5WB3YivfZA6ceMhnA35n61DULzhrJSv4w5RVEUQ5aAtqgCb5xPPue.JPG)

![IMG_2150.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23xowjPResRxW7hacmNpoJCouRrsZZea4dR2wsckUGb6UCnP26RUQYNR8S1AmuHQtdDdi.JPG)

![IMG_2151.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23uFPDKMN4xHugguJ7PkkpeLZs83Y3LAkX5gh8WQo9qsYqXAUhr9qw8MQPu7jUMsGUEsf.JPG)

I hope you can visit this museum too. I hope this post has been interesting and if you need any information you can ask. See you next time.

Full Metal Ox Day 1879
Wednesday 22, April 2026
Abundance Year Episode 1944
Noxsoma Life Camp:  

Happy Hump day healthy heroes. Welcome to another Hump day from Paradise.  

Paradise was a little shaky this morning. The human inside this vessel has a morning routine, which includes posting episodes and writing this piece. But before that I like to check the forecast from the Church of Barking Dogs to see whether the world will be plunged into darkness today. Instead, it was plunged into silence. Several of my geopolitical sources were silent. They posted as usual, but the audio wouldn’t play. Meanwhile, my favorite browser celebrated its 150th upgrade. What a coincidence. So I checked other browsers. Same issue. Click, “play” — no play. 

Your boy was shaken, but not stirred.  

It reminded me of a Rodney Dangerfield bit, “I woke up this morning, put on my shirt, a button fell off. Went to get into my car, the handle fell off. I’m afraid to go to the bathroom.” 

There were a few other tech issues on the upload tour. A minor glitch on a minor site. I had to check whether Mercury was in retrograde. Nope. Not until the end of June.  

Descent into Hell Week continues. I am reluctant to say/write stuff like this because this vessel has been speaking, (spell-casting), sounds into reality. More on that later. Much later. But the smart-ass inside couldn’t resist. Today’s audio is part 2 of what we started Monday. We wondered, why is the End of the World always scheduled for the cusp of Libra-Scorpio? Of course it goes back to superstition, religious ritual & agriculture. (Agriculture was really a Big Deal on this planet. Talk about game changers.) 

Next month, as Heart promised Mind, we are releasing, for the first time ever on Substack, our de facto novel. That’s what I call it anyway, and maybe I will share how it came to be for the curious. Anyway, this comic strip series was created in 2013. The plot is based on one of my all-time favorite movie plots. 

At some point, it looks like the audio will kick in for our Substack channel. The advice that we don’t give, listen to the voice-over. We write for the vox. Change words, “customize” pronunciation and edit for the vox. If you’d prefer to listen to my hideous spelling, typos, bad grammar and the Substack' reader’s inability to distinguish “read” from “read,” go for it. Indeed, since we don’t give advice, let’s call it a “recommendation.” This way you can maintain your audio-autonomy, and have a giggle at the same time. 

Finally, do to popular demand, we have begun posting Long Play Rantcast episodes. “Writing Fiction” has been released earlier today. There will be no links. If you subscribe to any of our TV channels you will get it. It’s nearly a half hour long, with promo spots and affirmations.   

That’s the vibe for the terrified.  

Stay safe, stay strong, stay savvy, stay sane, stay serene, stay sovereign, stay subscribed.

Why the World Always Ends in October: Apocalyptic Timing, Toilet Paper, and the COVID Connection.  

From ancient Jewish feast days to the Wuhan Military Games, autumn has a strange grip on humanity's collective fear of the end. 

October is, statistically speaking, the most popular month for the apocalypse that never comes. The Great Disappointment fell on October 22, 1844. Orson Welles' Martians invaded on October 30, 1938. Harold Camping's final doomsday landed on October 21, 2011. Even the COVID-19 pandemic—a very real global crisis—began its shadowy emergence in October 2019, complete with military exercises simulating the exact outbreak that followed, a quarantined cruise ship, and a run on toilet paper that revealed more about human psychology than any virus ever could. 

Coincidence? Or is there something baked into the autumn calendar that makes us reach for both prayer beads and paper goods? 


 The Theology of Autumn: Why Prophecy Points to October.   

The clustering of apocalyptic predictions around September and October is no accident. It stems directly from how certain Christian traditions interpret the Jewish fall holidays—what Messianic Jewish teacher Jonathan Cahn calls the \

. 

Here's the theological logic, and it's surprisingly straightforward.  

The Feast of Trumpets (Rosh Hashanah) — This holiday, which falls in September or October, involves the blowing of the shofar (ram's horn). In Christian prophecy interpretation, this trumpet blast represents the \
that will herald the rapture. As one rabbi explains, the trumpet served two purposes in ancient Israel: \

. Either way, it's a wake-up call.  \n\nYom Kippur (Day of Atonement) — Falling ten days after Rosh Hashanah, this is the holiest day on the Jewish calendar. In prophetic interpretation, it represents the final judgment. Jonathan Cahn describes it as \

—the ultimate reckoning. \n\nSukkot (Feast of Tabernacles) — Starting just five days after Yom Kippur, this week-long festival commemorates God's provision during the Israelites' wilderness wandering. Prophetically, it represents the Millennial Kingdom—the 1,000-year reign of peace after the apocalypse. As Cahn puts it, \
. \n\nThe pattern is simple: Trumpets signals the warning, Yom Kippur brings the judgment, and Sukkot delivers the restoration. And because these feasts occur at the \
. \n\nThis is why the Millerites chose October 22, 1844. It's why Harold Camping, after his May 21, 2011 prediction failed, pointed to October 21 as the final end. And it's why, in 2025, a viral \

prophecy pointed to September 23—which was Rosh Hashanah. 

The theology is internally consistent, even if the math keeps failing. 


 The October Surprise: COVID-19's Quiet Emergence.   

But prophecy isn't the only reason October haunts us. The COVID-19 pandemic—a genuine global catastrophe, not a failed prediction—also has its eerie roots in October 2019. And the timeline raises questions that, depending on your disposition, might feel like conspiracy fodder or simply strange coincidence. 

The 7th Military World Games — From October 18 to 27, 2019, the city of Wuhan, China, hosted the 7th Military World Games, bringing together nearly 10,000 athletes from over 100 countries. This was the largest international event Wuhan had ever hosted. 

Here's where it gets strange: On the exact same day the Games began—October 18, 2019—an event called \

was held in New York City. It was a pandemic simulation organized by the Johns Hopkins Center for Health Security, the Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation, and the World Economic Forum. The scenario? A novel coronavirus respiratory pandemic that spreads from country to country. 

The U.S. delegation to the Wuhan Games was unusually large—369 members, the largest in American military history at the Games. And their performance was, to put it mildly, unimpressive: Team USA returned with zero gold medals, a bizarre outcome for the world's dominant military power. More troubling, five American athletes fell ill during the Games and were evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. China's Foreign Ministry has repeatedly requested health information about those five athletes; Washington has remained silent. 

Within two months of the Games' conclusion, Wuhan was the epicenter of a novel coronavirus outbreak. The first official index case was dated December 8, 2019. 

Retrospective Evidence of Earlier Circulation — But the official timeline may be incomplete. A 2022 review published in the Annals of Global Health (NIH) found evidence suggesting SARS-CoV-2 was circulating in northern Italy as early as September/October 2019—\

where retrospective testing found a positive sample from December 27, 2019. 

The Italian findings are particularly striking: researchers identified 59 positive antibody tests in residents of Lombardy, with the earliest positive results dating back to September 2019. 

The NIH review concludes conservatively that \

. 

The circumstantial evidence points to October 2019 as the critical window—whether through the Military World Games as a superspreading event, or through earlier undetected circulation in Europe. 


 The Diamond Princess: A Floating October Nightmare.  

Then there's the cruise ship—because no modern apocalypse story is complete without one. 

The Diamond Princess, carrying 2,670 passengers and 1,100 crew, set sail on what was supposed to be a routine voyage. In early February 2020, Japanese authorities quarantined the ship in Yokohama after a passenger tested positive for the novel coronavirus. Eventually, over 700 people aboard would test positive—one of the largest early clusters outside China.  

But here's the October connection: while the quarantine made headlines in February, the timeline of infection likely traces back to the autumn. The Diamond Princess's voyage patterns and the incubation period mean the seeds of that outbreak were sown in the same October-November 2019 window when the virus was silently spreading. 

Among those aboard were 538 Filipino nationals and 223 Australians. The Philippine Embassy in Tokyo had to scramble to monitor its citizens. The Australian government confirmed cases among its citizens on board. The ship became a floating symbol of how interconnected—and how vulnerable—the modern world had become. 

And it all traces back to the autumn of 2019.  


 The Toilet Paper Phenomenon: Apocalypse on Aisle Four.   

No discussion of apocalyptic behavior would be complete without the great toilet paper panic of 2020. And the psychology behind it tells us something profound about why October matters. 

When COVID-19 began spreading globally, supermarket shelves emptied—not of masks or hand sanitizer (though those went too), but of toilet paper. Australia, Japan, Hong Kong, the United States, and the United Kingdom all saw \

headlines. 

Why toilet paper? The answer reveals the same psychological patterns that drive religious end-times predictions. 

The Visual Vacuum Effect — When a 50-pack of toilet paper disappears from a shelf, it leaves a massive empty space. Fifty cans of beans? Less noticeable. The sheer volume of toilet paper packaging makes shortages visually dramatic, triggering panic. 

FOMO (Fear of Missing Out) — As one Australian psychology professor explained, when people see others hoarding something, \

kicks in, and rational calculation goes out the window. \n\nThe Need for Control — This is the crucial insight, and it connects directly to apocalyptic thinking. As a Taiwanese psychology professor put it, when humans face disaster, they go through three stages: \
The problem is that when people realize they can do nothing substantive, they experience helplessness—\

. 

Toilet paper hoarding is irrational. Everyone knows this. But it's actionable irrationality. It gives people something to do when faced with an invisible, uncontrollable threat. 

This is exactly the same psychology that drives end-times date-setting. When the world feels chaotic and prophecy teachers offer a specific date, followers get to do something—sell their houses, quit their jobs, buy billboards. The action matters more than the outcome. 


 The Pattern: Why Autumn Works as an Apocalyptic Trigger.   

So why does October keep showing up, whether in failed prophecies or real pandemics? 

1. The Theological Anchor — For believers, the fall feasts provide a God-given timetable. The fact that the feasts are biblical—commanded in Leviticus 23—gives them authority that arbitrary dates lack. If God himself set these appointments, then it's not presumption to watch them; it's obedience. 

2. The Seasonal Psychology — Autumn is transition. Summer's abundance gives way to winter's scarcity. The days shorten. The world literally darkens. In agrarian societies, harvest represents both fulfillment and ending—the last gathering before the fallow season. This natural rhythm primes us for apocalyptic thinking. 

3. The Practical Calendar — Before modern climate control, holding massive outdoor revival meetings and end-times gatherings was easier in mild autumn weather than in winter's cold or summer's heat. October became a natural scheduling choice for prophecy conferences and camp meetings, which then reinforced October as \

Effect — October is the final quarter of the year. If you believe the world will end in a given year, October represents the last plausible window before winter makes the narrative awkward. Harold Camping's move from May to October 2011 illustrates this—when the spring date failed, October became the final \

The Ramifications: Who Pays When the World Doesn't End?   

The COVID-19 pandemic was real, not a failed prediction. But the October 2019 origins remain contested. China's government has not released comprehensive health data from the Military World Games period. The U.S. has not explained the five evacuated athletes. The WHO's origin investigation remains politically paralyzed. 

Meanwhile, the toilet paper industry had a banner year, and survivalist gear companies saw record sales. The \

simulation participants—Johns Hopkins, the Gates Foundation, the World Economic Forum—faced no accountability for the unsettling coincidence of timing because, of course, a pandemic simulation is not a crime. \n\nFor the religious predictions, the pattern is the same as always: the predictors face no legal consequences. Harold Camping's Family Radio spent approximately $100 million on his 2011 campaign, funded largely by followers who sold their homes. But under First Amendment protections, courts cannot declare religious beliefs \
As one legal scholar noted, the Supreme Court's 1944 United States v. Ballard decision ruled that \

. 

So the money stays with the prophets. The followers absorb the loss. And October rolls around again next year. 


 Conclusion: The Eternal October.   

Whether it's the Feast of Trumpets or the Military World Games, whether it's a rapture that never comes or a virus that did, October seems to be the month when humanity collectively holds its breath. 

The theological framework explains the religious dates. The psychological research explains the toilet paper. And the epidemiological evidence—however contested—places COVID-19's shadowy emergence in the same autumn window as the Wuhan Games and the Italian blood samples. 

Maybe it's all coincidence. Maybe it's the natural result of calendars, seasons, and human fear responses converging. Or maybe—as both prophecy believers and conspiracy theorists might suggest—there's something about October that genuinely matters. 

Either way, next September, watch the news. Listen for the trumpets. And maybe buy an extra pack of toilet paper. Just in case.

该怎么说呢？

前天我在朋友圈看到我唯一的高中朋友分手的消息，我震惊坏了。我们假期里还吃过饭，当时感觉他们相处的挺好的哇，而且他们假期里也过了一周年纪念日，到前天也有四百多天了，怎么这么突然就分手了呢？

但我们也很久没发消息了，不好贸然去打听，所以我就试探着关心了她一下有哪些地方需要我的帮助、有什么不高兴可以找我聊聊。没怎么追问原因，就是闲扯了一些事情，乱七八糟的，学习、人际关系的，也到两点了。

聊一聊哪怕最后无果，也会不自觉地舒一口气，我奶奶一直爱说“话是开心的钥匙”，我就突然觉得这里的开心，既是打开心扉，也是开开心心，说的真好啊，这句话。

我就突然性情了，我发了一条朋友圈，仅仅只让我自以为、我原意为他们分担痛苦分享喜悦的朋友可见，大概内容就说遇到什么难受的难过的坎都可以找我，写完发我都高兴坏了。因为还有一个朋友，我们很久很久很久没聊过了，她也很长时间不搭理我，我想借此再挽留一下。
 
可是昨天醒来后发现她依旧不理我，一共八个人，有三个就没有理我，我真有些心灰意冷啊，我们可能真的已经走到那种地步了，我再也不会用心维护了，随缘吧。还有两人，我也全部修改权限仅聊天了。可能有我的问题，无所谓，我就这么一个绝情的人，对我产生负面影响的人就该滚远点，就让我们回到原本的平行位置好了，这短暂的交集终归是我自己的一厢情愿，包括假期里的刘哥张哥，很多细节我现在才关注到，也不算晚，就这样吧。
 
我的那个抖音账号数据还不赖，我还挺得意的，昨晚又专门熬夜把作品全删了，把收藏转到新账号，然后立刻注销，从此很多纠葛一笔勾销，我们再无瓜葛，归于路人，终归是不能让别人知道我的账号啊，终归还是一个人自在无虑一点啊。
 
只有一个人来问我了，我特别高兴也特别心酸，也许大家目前的生活都很顺利吧，真的是我自作多情了。

算了，算了，我就不该把希望寄托在其他任何一个人身上。

我终究只能一个人走下去，从小学到大学到死去。

**Life Isn’t a Demo Version: Why It Makes Sense to Start Taking Things Seriously (Even When You Don’t Feel Like It)**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVcaDE1AWVSwtQxbAV7ZNJJA6EmZVmG1SRf3nFMW5nXc9/1776864308307.png)

Look, I’m not gonna lie — most of us are living life kind of on autopilot. You wake up, go to work, scroll your phone, eat something, Netflix, sleep… and repeat. Days start blending together and you feel like “someday later” you’ll start actually living. But that mindset is pretty dangerous.
Because the reality is simple: that “later” might never come.

I’m not here to throw some motivational Instagram quotes at you. This is real talk. Every one of us has potential — but at the same time, we’re really good at wasting it. Why? Because it’s more comfortable to play it safe than to take risks. Easier to stay where you’re not happy, but at least you know what to expect.

*The problem is, time keeps moving.*
 **Fast.**
Maybe you’re thinking: “I’ll deal with it later, I’ve got time.” Yeah? How many people said that before you… and now regret not trying something? Not going after what they really wanted? Playing it safe all along?
It’s not about flipping your life 180° overnight. It’s about a small shift in your mindset. Stop treating your time like it’s unlimited. Stop putting off things that could move you forward. And most importantly — stop underestimating yourself.

**Because** 
honestly, the biggest obstacle isn’t your situation. It’s you.
Fear, excuses, comfort. Those are the things keeping you stuck. And the worst part? You don’t even notice it at first. It’s slow. Subtle. But after a few years, you realize you haven’t really gone anywhere.
And that hurts more than any failure.

*Failure* 
means you at least tried. That you had the guts to do something. But regretting missed chances? That’s a whole different level.

***So what now?***
Start simple. Do one thing differently than you did yesterday. Just one. It doesn’t have to be big. Call someone, write something, start that project you’ve been thinking about, or at least think about where you’re actually heading.

**Because life**
 isn’t a demo version. This is the full game — and there’s no reset button.

And if you should take one thing from this article, it’s this:
Don’t wait for the perfect moment. It usually never comes.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNcEzyzxE3sARNtV6niPX8LbBDjf4EaYkwrPEyF7RWGPZ/1776864489140.png)

**Život není demo verze: proč má smysl začít brát věci vážně (i když se ti nechce)**

Hele, nebudu ti lhát — většina z nás jede život tak trochu na autopilota. Vstaneš, práce, mobil, nějaký to jídlo, Netflix, spánek… a znova. Dny se slévají dohromady a člověk má pocit, že “někdy potom” začne žít doopravdy. Jenže tenhle mindset je dost nebezpečnej.

Protože realita je jednoduchá: žádný “potom” možná nepřijde.

Nechci tady jet nějaký motivační kecy z Instagramu. Spíš real talk. Každej z nás má nějakej potenciál — ale zároveň i tendenci ho totálně zazdít. Proč? Protože je pohodlnější jet jistotu než riskovat. Pohodlnější zůstat tam, kde tě to sice nebaví, ale aspoň víš, co čekat.

**Jenže problém je, že čas běží, a dost rychle.**

*Možná si říkáš:*
 “Teď to neřeším, mám čas.” Jo? Kolik lidí si tohle řeklo před tebou… a dneska litujou, že něco nezkusili? Že nešli za tím, co fakt chtěli? Že hráli safe game?

Nejde o to, že musíš hned otočit život o 180°. Spíš o malej shift v hlavě. Přestat brát svůj čas jako samozřejmost. Přestat odkládat věci, který tě můžou posunout. A hlavně — přestat se podceňovat.

**Protože upřímně, největší brzda nejsou okolnosti. Jsi to ty sám.**

*Strach*
výmluvy, pohodlí. To jsou věci, co tě drží na místě. A nejhorší je, že to není vidět hned. Je to pomalý. Nenápadný. Ale za pár let zjistíš, že jsi vlastně nikam nedošel.

A to bolí víc než jakýkoliv fail.

Fail totiž znamená, že jsi to aspoň zkusil. Že jsi měl koule něco udělat. Ale litovat promarněný šance? To je úplně jiná liga.

**Takže co s tím?**

Začni jednoduše. Udělej jednu věc jinak než včera. Jednu. Nemusí to být nic velkýho. Zavolej někomu, napiš něco, začni projekt, co ti leží v hlavě, nebo se aspoň zamysli nad tím, kam vlastně směřuješ.

**Protože život**
 není demo verze. Tohle je full hra — a žádný restart tlačítko tu není.

A jestli si z tohohle článku máš odnést jednu věc, tak asi tohle:
Nečekej na správnej moment. On totiž většinou nikdy nepřijde.

body.title: Wednesday Walk in My Front Yard
body.body:
I have three shrubs of Potentilla in the front yard. And it is the toughest flowering shrub ever! It is starting to bloom again, and soon my front yard will look alive!


![IMG_0147.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silversaver888/AK56na75rC6eNMNejvnV2U1e37Mev32R5YjJ8V9AHDsSWVsSaSDLb6tRs9YRWgS.jpeg)

![IMG_0138.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silversaver888/EokcCZJXHfXi2FjVqpgbC1uk1EaXHZa3EsnxoVbGfVAwJwEhvN67TjkzWt8z3YjGG8g.jpeg)


Under my only tree, I once planted a <a href=\

>Red Ruby Miniature Roses. I’d had it for years. It started out small and sweet, the kind of plant you barely notice until one day it’s covered in blooms and you think, wow, that turned out nice. For a long time, it really was pretty.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silversaver888/Eo8SmLZ7GBut7xwcFNzvtqQGNCCh2k3XLwyG1CQVnBbwiHpiwjBVywxP58wqqrijBYu.png)
That little rose bush grew like it had something to prove. Every time I trimmed it, it came back twice as big, like it was laughing at me. Then it got so wild and unruly that I had no choice but to cut it down—really low, almost to the ground. I figured it would bounce back the way roses usually do.
![apswcc.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silversaver888/EoGwyHfQRsgwwjGEZgzzHu3B5uy65hE2hFRH6aN8FULYJX6A6pXiPRjJu66AnuKqp8Z.gif)
But... I got tired of waiting. So I finally told the gardener, “Just uproot it.” And that was that. Suddenly, the space under the tree was empty again, like a blank page. Now I’m standing here wondering what to plant next. ![IMG_0144.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silversaver888/2432J3aW9cVpwDD5wR2ziVQVSEEJV61x4vJoGEYhfui22pGubLq4uyognReNH5hpk7sFo.jpeg) Do I go for something low‑maintenance, something that minds its own business? Maybe a small shrub that stays small. Or maybe I try another flowering plant, something cheerful but not dramatic. Lavender could work. Or hydrangeas, if I want something fuller. Even a simple groundcover might be nice—something soft that spreads without taking over. ![IMG_0146.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silversaver888/EpEJM6jgqTT5zhQETn5oFbVdx8WRHremaxSxtHRrdrWxdUJGA7wwbCedGWiVT7ZcMg4.jpeg) I’m not in a rush. I just want something that feels right for that spot. Something that grows, but doesn’t try to run the whole yard. What would you plant there? #
😍#ilikeitalot!😍
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silversaver888/23xKNeFZwgitUCQehVo55nArcv2qQzEB2QPAexUaTafker8kvrQ3tDe6vdx9Qj4HaZQs5.png)
All photos were taken by me with my iPhone.

This is for #wednesdaywalk by @tattoodjay.

This is also a post for the Show us your California of @derekrichardson.

body.title: Egg Spicy Mayo Sushi
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTUs1p4vjBrhpj1kZnodknMErTUmyZpMc9UsK994rTvCC/1776864089871.png)

Hi bloggers and food lovers! Do you guys like sushi? Today I’m sharing an easy and simple sushi recipe, it’s super easy to make and perfect for a delicious lunchbox meal, and best of all, it’s a breeze to prepare. I just bought a sushi mold from an online store, and it really works it helps with shaping the sushi. This lunchbox meal has a savory, slightly spicy, and creamy flavor. Alright, let’s get started 

**Ingredients:**

- 200 grams of cooked rice
- 2 tbsp aonori
- 3 tbsp sesame oil
- 3 eggs 
- a pinch of salt 
- 1/4 tsp bouillon powder
- 1 tbsp mayonnaise 
- 1 tbsp chili sauce 
- 2 sheets of nori

**Steps:**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRK5yxR1GdAjMffR5DY3fr9kdCY9uaYWmjjW1eGAnN7Kq/1776864140115.jpg)

- Prepare the rice and place it in a bowl

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUPjUTwKA2hQqvzyE3kWe31r1iGwrcYXm285JbNSSgx5k/1776864164465.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ2LE497GbHz3EE6QwB8qaaHX27nYcxxfF2eDYAjVwbAJ/1776864164657.jpg)

- Add the sesame oil and sprinkle the aonori on top

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfESicED82zBkjG8zwJdRtLruzUsnNzEctbCt56TQC7gA/1776864207570.jpg)

- Stir the rice until well combined

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaAuJcDSanZGxdrcoPvL463AWiac4KrshW6aqEhFsoRcm/1776864239325.jpg)

- Prepare the sushi mold and pack the rice into the mold until firm

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaQMqswB2DVYH6JDEoeWkyMjt5x6S1rKb4EEn5quKV6kV/1776864268524.jpg)

- Press the rice firmly using the lid of the sushi mold

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXYRpvMdv2fRT56isjb2vzPD4ftcTYiaayDfWnMEgthf9/1776864287097.jpg)

- Once compact, remove from the mold

- Set aside

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbfMEKLbo7qenkhqhB4iqyBxCYsYjJQquPueDnXoe5gR1/1776864303224.jpg)

- Crack 3 eggs into a bowl

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfVgPdpiks73D6h2rnunbJKatrPXDy7Yx444tMvRJ9cvE/1776864327901.jpg)

- Add a pinch of salt and bouillon powder

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQwHBTwqLSaRyxsu8deNC6RMVbL3wzixA1sqRpsbSKrfZ/1776864347762.jpg)

- Whisk the eggs until well combined

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmccdX9ekMJFkFmZKCnXeh31aA6A7HMQfa5DDhon6G6QZG/1776864362058.jpg)

- Heat a pan with a little oil

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY3fZqRL9LXizX1HM1y68PLyJRL4xUL6FWNDe6822frwa/1776864379442.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUK6Kn4EWAmoHayATugvgPjAFLp4TJYUUgxDGnTHKpHL6/1776864379584.jpg)

- Cook the eggs in the hot pan, scrambling them until fully cooked

- Set aside

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbdq7YJoD8kf5rH24AE7uTw4JEjTYd983UKr2M9UP5A8C/1776864399723.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWsvdbY3vkAyRpv1XR7dwGDG2g84WXS3pnguuRBedbPHF/1776864399899.jpg)

- Prepare the spicy mayo sauce using a 1:1 ratio of mayonnaise and chili sauce

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTZwDavrQahJURAsXEZSG8dYXhN5ocgeDnmPkGttDhWeF/1776864413800.jpg)

- Stir until well combined

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSnEKA4E19qfHveN9dzudAv1FkCYonpVWE5SJvWYek5rn/1776864433897.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcdLP8htythcSF7YoJvkUTtVYtBHgDBQgBbSaB487q7Eh/1776864434065.jpg)

- Take the shaped rice and wrap it with a piece of nori

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeUGoePbz88KfW3e4dh6WJuUgdwrbvTc4D7LrZvMifNxY/1776864476967.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU2ujF96fioDLzTuvjvoHC3VoBAeS3RoA2qVvUbfa7eM4/1776864477109.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNU5p8Q9LNsJUaD7zLPxF4MS9tZrrYUwLJ2AAJzGKjL2e/1776864457464.jpg)

- Place the scrambled eggs on top of the rice and add the spicy mayo sauce

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd4RmwbQWfc4S25MziqVeYPwWa6i5LKvWiuA52Gp29vmP/1776864497160.jpg)

- Sprinkle a little aonori on top

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme7KHNgGfWxdGEf9nKcPEmcKzzQtSWKr2yYyYWCrqrbxc/1776864692118.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc2rhwDyNewFiGiGoW8kSG9DQetTg4HnaAsjNiVMaCvom/1776864709639.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWEfUSkDkVwJyg5TWYZvLGgerrs29LAjoa38G8jPiTHWb/1776864709884.jpg)

- Spicy Mayo Egg Sushi are ready to eat

body.title: [Eng./Esp.]   The sacred futility of oars.   ||   La sagrada inutilidad de los remos.
body.body:
*** *** #
Si eres de habla hispana, la versión en español es mejor para ti; debes hacer clic 👉 [**AQUÍ**](#english)
*** ***
# ***
The sacred futility of oars
***

> **“I’m just drifting”** – I say it out loud, and the echo brings me a sense of peace that, in the past, amidst the hustle and bustle of schedules and urgent tasks, felt alien to me. Literally, it means I’m simply drifting, but in my retirement the word has taken on a sacred nuance. It is not the abandonment of a castaway, but the conscious surrender of someone who has finally decided to stop rowing against the current.
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/2458SRnKH4LgCsw4VCYfSqeB6qoGXqN9gjg4Dsurom8k2SprB2GLLgW9xPdx92UjnxCpU.png) [Thanks to the Banana 2.0 app for illustrating my post.](https://gemini.google.com/app)
For decades, my life was a map of marked routes and mandatory ports of call. Today, my existence is a small boat that adapts without resistance to the mood of the tide. If the water rises, I rise with it; if it falls, I rest humbly on the sand. I have discovered that true freedom is not about being in control ([I stand by what I wrote yesterday](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@amigoponc/engesp-sovereign-surrender-oror-rendicion-soberana)), but about understanding that we never really were. By ceasing to struggle to steer the course, I have begun to notice the sun’s glint on the water, the sound of the wind and the stillness of the present moment—things the noise used to hide from me. I live in the present with an almost voracious intensity. For many, ‘drifting’ suggests uncertainty, and they are right: tomorrow is a misty territory and the only certainty is the beat of the present. It is that fragility that compels me to savour my morning coffee as if it were my last, or to lose myself in a conversation without glancing at the clock. I no longer chase distant horizons; I inhabit the present. In this boat without oars, I have learnt that getting nowhere is, paradoxically, finally having arrived home. *** ***

> Come and participate, there's still time. You can find all the information daily in the [#Freewritehouse](https://peakd.com/c/hive-161155/created) Community. Specifically, today's prompt post:
# **
[PROMPT: «I’m just drifting»](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/22-april-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3081-im-just-drifting)
**
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daily.prompt/AJmudPPCWGA6FfcXPrAmdLk2CY4mxGWYvbsFs8KPohCx9wnhBrpjcwmEyvYmxqn.jpg Cover of the initiative.
*** ***
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23swkfAXGs5WxHg49jyEWGAanWReDpMUQbxUB4FYX98iMaztGejMtj5HJUN6abwpCZhUN.png)

*** *** ### **
Dedicated to all those writers who contribute, day by day, to making our planet a better world.
** *** ***
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23vhudAgmrPvXnYXzmsiD5366jktCLxdeWqxFQg2nCeezVK4yv7CJ9dQpSevYb8nEeqTR.png) https://images.ecency.com/0x0/https://images.ecency.com/DQmbdpsZFqtrcoLk94sUV8oHkjnx8PAdgfACMfJ9UpcriNF/perfil2026_hecho_con_clipchamp_2_.gif
*** *** ***

>
# ***
La sagrada inutilidad de los remos
***

>

**“I’m just drifting”**, lo digo en voz alta y el eco me devuelve una paz que antes, en el fragor de las agendas y las urgencias, me resultaba ajena. Literalmente, significa que simplemente voy a la deriva, pero en mi jubilación la palabra ha cobrado un matiz sagrado. No es el abandono del náufrago, sino la rendición consciente de quien ha decidido, por fin, dejar de remar contra la corriente.

<center>
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/2458SRnKH4LgCsw4VCYfSqeB6qoGXqN9gjg4Dsurom8k2SprB2GLLgW9xPdx92UjnxCpU.png)
<sup>[Gracias a la app Banana 2.0 por ilustrar mi publicación.](https://gemini.google.com/app)</sup>
</center>

Durante décadas, mi vida fue un mapa de rutas marcadas y puertos obligatorios. Hoy, mi existencia es una pequeña barca que se adapta sin resistencia al humor de la marea. Si el agua sube, subo con ella; si baja, descanso con humildad en la arena. He descubierto que la verdadera libertad no es tener el control ([ratifico mi entrada de ayer](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@amigoponc/engesp-sovereign-surrender-oror-rendicion-soberana)), sino entender que nunca lo tuvimos realmente. Al dejar de luchar por dirigir el rumbo, he empezado a notar el brillo del sol sobre el agua, el sonido del viento y la quietud del ahora que antes el ruido me ocultaba.

Vivo el presente con una intensidad casi voraz. Para muchos, \

sugiere incertidumbre, y tienen razón: el mañana es un territorio brumoso y la única certeza es el latido actual. Esa fragilidad es la que me obliga a saborear el café de la mañana como si fuera el último, o a perderme en una charla sin mirar el reloj. Ya no persigo horizontes lejanos; habito el presente. En esta barca sin remos, he aprendido que no llegar a ninguna parte es, paradójicamente, haber llegado finalmente a casa.
*** ***

> Ven y participa; aún estás a tiempo. Toda la información la podrás encontrar cada día en la Comunidad [#Freewritehouse](https://peakd.com/c/hive-161155/created). Específicamente, el día de hoy, aquí la publicación del prompt:

**
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daily.prompt/AJmudPPCWGA6FfcXPrAmdLk2CY4mxGWYvbsFs8KPohCx9wnhBrpjcwmEyvYmxqn.jpg Portada de la iniciativa.

Dedicado a todos aquellos que, día a día, con su arte, hacen del mundo un lugar mejor.

![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/AK3dh9o6Y7gX8bHX31JkbGQRrjvqVsRLqpAELN5YuAWeKo71zo5YipMbw9wt3zm.png) https://images.ecency.com/0x0/https://images.ecency.com/DQmbdpsZFqtrcoLk94sUV8oHkjnx8PAdgfACMfJ9UpcriNF/perfil2026_hecho_con_clipchamp_2_.gif

body.title: Powering Up To Build For Long Term Purpose
body.body: > Most people join the Hive platforms for different reasons. Those reasons primarily influence whatever decisions they make. A person who uses Hive as a full-time business may likely cash out from time to time. At least to make up for their time and effort and meet some needs, which I think is not wrong. On the other hand, a person whose intention is to build may not likely cash out but decides to power up, especially when they run other businesses or is an employee or someone who has other sources of income, because they're thinking long term. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU11EUbFgKScA7Andu1cnmmC1jFzKT638QW1yzxEgHYxL/1776864449169.png) When I first joined Hive, my intention was to be cashing out every month end and power up a little. But along the line, while interacting with some serious minded users I considered as mentors, I noticed that they have a long term vision of building something huge because of where Hive is going, then I had a second thought. Again, to be able to support other users just as I'm being supported too, I should have a tangible Hive power which may not be possible if I keep powering down or taking out funds. Although, I'd cashed out once, to confirm that the system is reliable, no doubt about that now. But then, it's not an easy task to have some money somewhere and be in need, yet can't touch it because of a long term plan. Also sometimes when I look at my wallet and compare it with the need, I find out that it won't make any visible difference if taken out, as the reward comes in a bit and is not something I should depend on for my daily needs.. So I just have to put in more effort to grow it. Which requires a whole lot of discipline and determination. Powering up or cashing out is a matter of choice which everyone is entitled to. I choose to power up monthly and sometimes daily too. At the beginning of this year I set a goal to reach 3000 HP by the end of the year. If I achieve that, I'll set a higher one until I reach 50,000 HP. That's my target. I don't see myself achieving that if I don't make it a point of duty to be consistent in powering up. Besides, I have a philosophy that, having a long term vision in most cases pays more. body.title: WOO Knew All Along: The Match That Built Goldberg’s Future
body.body:
A Big Hello to all WOO Fans! 🥳🥳🥳 WOO! 

When I first saw this episode being teased in WOO, I honestly thought it was just another look back at a classic moment. Something fun, something nostalgic, something to pass the time while we wait for the next big update or event. But after sitting through Saturn’s breakdown, I came away with a completely different perspective. This wasn’t just a reaction video. This was a deep dive into a turning point that most of us probably didn’t even realise was happening at the time.

>*Watch WOO's very own Perry Saturn and his latest \
video over at [THIS LINK](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vStGgwstymQ). The theme for this latest video production is \

*

---

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/blitzzzz/23vhz1GVMShCMC8fFqP9xK93S7SePNRbeAYiUXLMVEkmvZ7Af7sjvEDojBFK4D11hECKJ.png)

---

That’s what I think WOO does really well when it comes to content like this. It doesn’t just resurface old matches. It reframes them. It gives them context that we didn’t have before, and suddenly something that felt routine starts to feel important.

Because when you really listen to what Saturn is saying, this match wasn’t random at all. It was deliberate. It was calculated. And more importantly, it was necessary.

### What This Match Was Really Trying to Achieve

* **This was a preparation match for Goldberg’s future main event run.**
  
Saturn openly explains that the reason they wanted this match to go longer was because Goldberg was eventually going to face bigger names, including someone like Hogan. That immediately tells you this wasn’t just about that night. It was about what came next. As a fan, I find that fascinating because it shows how much planning goes on behind the scenes, even when things seem straightforward on the surface.

* **Goldberg needed to prove he could handle longer matches.**
  
Up until this point, Goldberg’s dominance came from short, explosive matches where he overwhelmed opponents quickly. That works for building a streak, but it doesn’t necessarily prepare you for high-profile matches that require pacing, storytelling, and endurance. This match was essentially a test to see if he could evolve beyond that formula.

* **Saturn was chosen because he could be trusted to guide the match.**
  
One thing that really stood out to me was how Saturn described being approached for this role. There was no hesitation when he said he could carry Goldberg to 12 minutes. That kind of confidence only comes from experience, and it also shows the level of trust the company had in him. From a fan perspective, it makes me appreciate Saturn’s role in wrestling history even more.

* **The success of the match wasn’t based on how “great” it looked.**
  
Saturn himself admits that the match wasn’t amazing. He calls it “okay.” But what mattered was that they achieved their goal. Goldberg went longer than usual, and the structure held together. That’s a completely different way of evaluating a match, and it’s something I think more fans should consider.

* **This was about building credibility, not just entertainment.**
  
At the end of the day, this match was about making Goldberg more believable in longer scenarios. It wasn’t about stealing the show. It was about laying the groundwork for future performances.

---

As someone who follows WOO closely, I feel like this episode is a reminder of why I enjoy this space so much. It’s not just about what’s happening now. It’s about understanding the layers behind everything we watch.

There’s something satisfying about revisiting a match and realising it had a bigger purpose than you initially thought. It makes you wonder how many other moments in wrestling history were quietly shaping the future while we were just watching for the spectacle.

And honestly, it also makes me appreciate the role of wrestlers like Saturn even more. Not everyone is remembered as the main attraction, but without people like him, a lot of those main attractions wouldn’t have been able to reach that next level.

---

Well, that's it for today. We will continue again tomorrow! 😁 WOO! 🎉

body.title: Wie schnell sich die Welt geändert hat
body.body:
Hallo Freunde,

ich habe mir letztens gedacht, wenn man die heutige Welt so anschaut, dann hätte man sich vor ein paar Jahren nicht vorstellen können, wie sie heute aussieht. Ich meine gehen wir einmal zurück ins Jahr 2012, dann sind die Ereignisse von heute, der Krieg im Osten und im Golf, der Zustand nach einer Pandemie, die unsere Gesellschaft gespalten hat, einer Welt in der Sozial Media und Informationen so komplex sind, dass man sich vieles nicht mehr vorstellen kann. Ich meine stellt euch einmal vor, wir leben in einer Zeit in der man durch die KI ein Level der Bildbearbeitung und der Mainipulation von Sprache erreicht hat, die früher unvorstellbar war. Wir haben heute die Möglichkeit digital eigentlich alles möglich zu machen, man braucht nur genug Ressourcen. Die meisten heutigen Fakes fallen nur auf, weil sie schlecht und billig gemacht sind. Richtig gute Fakes kann man kaum vom Orginal unterscheiden, auch wenn viele KIs immer noch Probleme haben jedem Menschen fünf Finger und nicht vier oder sechs zu geben, warum auch immer die Fingeranzahl so ein riesen Problem ist. Oder auch Schrift, ich meine jeder kennt die beschissenen Schriftzüge die man auf KI Bildern hat, die weit weg sond von allem was sinnvoll wäre. 

Und wenn diese Technik nur genutzt würde, um zu Unterhalten, wäre es das eine, sie wird aber genutzt um eine gespaltene Gesellschaft weiter auseinander zu treiben, von Akteuren aller Seiten. Ich weiß nicht wohin das alles noch führt, aber es bleibt spannend. Für meinen Geschmack meistens sogar zu spannend. Aber hey, die Historiker in einigen Jahrzehnten werden zu diesem Thema vieles zu schreiben haben. 

Also in dem Sinne, gehabt euch wohl.
