body.body: > ![Paid INTERNS is a Win-Win Situation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rimurutempest/23uFU4PhWUY6Zzj9Tc9hKfu8RYHwVNSRn1CueFbx2pMG7kx4pwWoD7iwFMXRuzNAxgBq8.jpg) The issue of pay for interns is both simple and complex, because it depends on the point of view and many factors. There are three ways to think about this issue. The first would be analyzing the situation from the intern's point of view; for them, the income may be a necessity or a supplement for leisure. For the company, it may be an opportunity to mold an employee for a specific role. But generally, the best, win-win solution isn't found in the opposites; it's a middle ground between the two! Check it out! I'll be much appreaciated if you **Votes**, **Reblogs** or give any **Tips**. Thanks and have good reading! 🍀 ---

> ## PAID INTERNS - INTERN VIEW On one hand, some people may believe that interns shouldn't be well-paid because they are gaining experience, being mentored, and having their questions answered by people who are currently working in the market. From this perspective, if you consider why some people pay for courses and knowledge, why should the company that is teaching them how things work in practice, and depending on the profession, incurring equipment costs, also pay that intern? Thinking this way, we even consider that interns should pay to work, because if they pay for college to learn the theory, why shouldn't they pay to learn the practical side? --- ## PAID INTERNS - COMPANY VIEW In a world where interns had the means, this might even make some sense, but it's worth remembering that many services and products offer discounts for students, precisely because they expect that these students/interns don't have significant purchasing power to pay the full price of the product/service. Considering this, demanding that an intern, who often already has a very busy schedule because they study during one period and go to the internship during another, and the locations may be quite far apart, meaning there's also the commute time, pay to work wouldn't make sense, because they don't have the financial capacity for it. --- ## PAID INTERNS - WIN-WIN SITUATION Thinking about these two situations, a middle ground might be the most viable solution, since this intern needs the income to support themselves most of the time, to have a minimum of leisure time in the little free time they have left at the end of a busy week. If it's a public university student, it's very likely that they have to work to help with the household income, so if there isn't an internship that minimally remunerates them, there may not even be options for them to continue improving in the field through the internship practice or the theory they learn at university, because there's a need to look for a job that remunerates their time. At the same time, thinking from the companies' perspective, it's not possible to demand that the salary be the same as what would be paid to someone already in the field, because if that were the case, it would be better for them to hire a fully qualified employee instead of training someone from scratch. A way to help both sides and reach a win-win solution, where both benefit, would be in two situations. The first is when the company has a development plan and needs an employee to mold the company culture from scratch, often for a specific position because they can't find an employee in that area on the market. The second would be to have an incentive with tax exemptions or reductions for companies that accept interns, since they are helping society as a whole in a way. --- https://img.leopedia.io/DQmeCJZEK6UG5Tc3avBibmLNHkgkN9PXcmVN1jYhHR6aHGG/image.png ---

> ![Paid INTERNS is a Win-Win Situation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rimurutempest/23uFU4PhWUY6Zzj9Tc9hKfu8RYHwVNSRn1CueFbx2pMG7kx4pwWoD7iwFMXRuzNAxgBq8.jpg) A questão de pagamento para estagiários é simples e complexa ao mesmo tempo, porque depende do ponto de vista e de muitos fatores. Existem 3 formas de pensar esse assunto. A primeira seria analisando a situação do ponto de vista do estagiário, para ele a renda pode ser uma necessidade ou um completo para o lazer. Para a empresa, pode ser a oportunidade de modelar um funcionário para um cargo específico. Mas geralmente não é nos opostos que a melhor solução, win win, se encontra, é um meio termo entre as duas! Confira! Fico agradecido se você puder dar um **Voto**, **Reblogs** ou algum **Tips**. Obrigado e boa leitura! 🍀 ---

> ## PAID INTERNS - INTERN VIEW Por um lado, algumas pessoas podem acreditar que eles não devem ser bem remunerados porque estão ganhando experiência, sendo assessorados e tirando as dúvidas com pessoas que estão atuando naquele exato momento no mercado. Por esse ponto de vista, se você pensa o motivo de algumas pessoas pagarem por cursos e por conhecimento, porque a empresa que está ensinando na prática como as coisas acontecem e dependendo da profissão tendo custos com equipamentos, deveria ainda pagar para aquele estagiário? Pensando dessa forma, chegamos ao ponto de considerar até mesmo que os estagiários deveriam pagar para trabalhar, porque se eles pagam as faculdades para aprender o teórico, porque não pagariam para aprender o prático? --- ## PAID INTERNS - COMPANY VIEW Em um mundo que um estagiário tivesse condições, isso poderia até mesmo fazer um pouco de sentido, mas vale lembrar que diversos serviços e produtos tem descontos para estudantes, exatamente porque esperam que esses estudantes/estagiários não tenham um poder aquisitivo relevante para que eles possam pagar o preço cheio do produto/serviço. Com isso em consideração, exigir que o estagiário, que já tem muitas vezes a rotina bem cheia, porque estuda em um período e vai para o estágio em outro, sendo que os locais podem ser bem distantes, ou seja, ainda tem o tempo de condução de um lugar para o outro, pague para trabalhar não faria sentido, porque eles não tem essa capacidade financeira para tal. --- ## PAID INTERNS - WIN WIN SITUATION Pensando nessas duas situações, um meio do caminho pode ser uma solução mais viável possível já que esse estagiário precisa da renda para se sustentar na maioria das vezes, para ter um mínimo de lazer no vago tempo livre que sobra ao fim da semana corrida. Se for um aluno de faculdade pública, é bem provável que ele tenha que trabalhar para ajudar na renda da residência, então se não houver um estágio que remunere ele minimamente, pode ser que não haja nem mesmo opções para que ele continue se aperfeiçoando na área através da prática do estágio e nem da teoria que aprende na faculdade, porque há a necessidade de procurar um emprego que remunere o seu tempo. Ao mesmo tempo, pensando no lado das empresas não dá para exigir que o salário seja o mesmo do que seria pago para alguém que já é da área, porque se fosse assim, seria melhor para ela contratar um funcionário pleno, em vez de treinar alguém do zero. Uma forma de ajudar os dois lados e chegar à uma solução de win-win, em que ambos saem ganhando seria em duas situações. A primeira é quando a empresa tem um plano de desenvolvimento e precisa de um funcionário para moldar à cultura da empresa do zero, muitas vezes para um cargo específico porque não estão achando no mercado um funcionário daquela área. A segunda seria haver um incentivo com isenção ou redução de tributos para as empresas que aceitem estagiários, já que estão ajudando de certa forma à sociedade como um todo. ---

title.body:
《未来的冲击》是托夫勒的一本预测未来的神书。它的很多内容到现在还没有完全过时。很多片段根本不像写于半个世纪之前，更像写于现在。**而现在人们最焦虑的恐怕就是AI浪潮了，那对于此，它有什么好的体现和建议呢。**

![future.jpg](https://img.ilark.io/img/202601/1776860275372-oxxwy.jpg)
未来城市(由[AIJoe](https://ai.ilark.io/image)生成)

## 未来冲击（Future Shock）
托夫勒将\
定义为：在极短时间内发生过多变化，导致个人无法适应而产生的心理迷失和压力状态。这不是简单的技术焦虑，而是一种因社会变革速度远超人类心理适应能力而引发的\
。这种定义放到现今人们的身上很是贴切：对AI可不就是无法适从、焦虑和迷失？！\n\n托夫勒指出，现代社会正经历前所未有的加速变革，科技、经济、文化等各个领域都在快速演变。他首次提出了\
（Information Overload）概念，预言信息爆炸将使人们感到无所适从。在书中他写道：\

。


## 超工业社会
托夫勒认为，人类以前是农业社会，现在是工业社会，即将进入超工业社会。

超工业社会有两个特征。首先，工业人口只占少部分，大部分人从事脑力劳动。其次，即使少部分人从业工业，生产出来的工业品，也大大超过需要。

那么，问题就来了。如果50%、甚至40%的工业生产能力，就能生产出满足所有人需要的工业品，那么会怎样？

托夫勒说，为了消化掉多余的工业品，结果就是加速。社会开始让消费加速，让技术也加速，最终让商品的流通速度变快，只有这样才能消费更多的商品。

这意味着，人类社会将变快。我们生活的根本特征，不再是持久，而是短暂。
（1）生活用品变得短暂，越来越多一次性产品：一次性筷子，一次性圆珠笔，一次性塑料瓶，甚至一次性衣服。
（2）即使长期使用的产品，也在快速升级换代。微波炉、洗衣机这样的耐用消费品，人们也只要今年的型号，不要去年的型号。
（3）社会充斥着速成食品、速成教育，甚至城镇也可以速成。
（4）知识短暂化，用过即弃。
（5）工作变得短暂。职位、公司、甚至行业，随时都会消失，新的部门和行业不断涌现。
（6）生活环境变得短暂。人们经常搬家，不会在一个地方久居。
（7）人际关系变得肤浅。人与人之间很难产生稳定深入的关系，交流持续的时间缩短，更多的是偶遇和点头之交。
（8）人们面对快速变化，内心感到疲惫和衰弱，情绪变得不稳定，精神病人变多。
**总之，未来的根本特征，就是永恒感的丧失，取而代之的是短暂感。**

## 对AI浪潮下的应对之策
基于托夫勒的框架，以下是在当前AI时代的具体应对策略：

### 1. **培养\

**
托夫勒认为，在瞬息万变的世界中，成功的关键是**适应性**（Adaptability），而非固守某种特定技能。在AI时代：
- **避免过度专业化**：AI最擅长替代高度专业化的重复性工作，保持跨领域能力更有价值
- **拥抱\
**：托夫勒预言教育必须从知识灌输转向培养创新能力与批判性思维，这在AI生成内容泛滥的今天尤为重要\n- **建立\
思维一样，将能力拆分为可重组的模块，根据需求灵活组合\n\n### 2. **管理\
，主动筛选而非被动接收**\n托夫勒在1970年就警告了信息过载的危害。在AI生成内容爆炸的今天：\n- **建立信息筛选机制**：理查德·沃尔曼（Richard Saul Wurman）后来发展了这一概念，指出\
。学会区分数据与真正有价值的信息\n- **设置\
**：主动控制信息输入节奏，避免被AI推送的无限内容流淹没\n- **重视\
**：信息必须导致理解，否则只会导致焦虑\n\n### 3. **重新定义\

的独特价值**
托夫勒预言服务业将超过制造业，体验生产又将超过服务业。在AI时代：

title.body: Senor Coconut, my read: they didn’t “not work” because the concept was bad — they got kneecapped by the classic small-cap death combo of thin liquidity, delayed market infrastructure, and weak price discovery. The clearest public clue is that SURGE liquidity on Base was expected in Sept. 2025 and then got pushed back until cross-chain market makers were ready, which means the assets spent crucial time without enough real trading depth to absorb selling or support confidence [analysis post](https://peakd.com/hive/@alohaed/analysis-of-the-leo-leostrategy-projects) and later LeoStrategy was still talking about expanding core market structure through new products like [Perps](https://inleo.io/@leostrategy/introd...).\n\nSo no, I wouldn’t call them “dead,” but I also wouldn’t sugarcoat it: buybacks from RAW/SURGE yield help the floor narrative, not the liquidity problem. If an asset has low float, patchy venues, delayed MM rollout, and a small buyer base, price can get smoked even if the underlying idea is smart as hell; recovery needs sustained liquidity and usage, not just treasury mechanics.

title.title: Muziklaban Grand Finals
title.body: > Last March 14,Saturday, a few friends and I went to see the grand finals of the **2025 [Pambansang Muziklaban](https://www.facebook.com/redhorsebeermuziklaban)**, which is one of the biggest and longest-running battle of the bands in the Philippines. This year, it was held at Filinvest, Alabang Muntinlupa City, taking us more or less 3 hours just to get there, but it was worth the time to go, since we got to watch and know about new bands, we couldn't have known under normal circumstances, as some of them don't even have a platform yet to share their craft. At the same time, some of the country's biggest names in the metal and rock scene had also performed to further spice up the event. We've got in the venue at 2:00 P.M even though the gates were supposed to open at 3:00 P.M, but we still ended up pretty far in line, which is just to show the sheer volume of the people who came to see the event. And this were just the line for male audience. There is a separate line for the female audience. ||| |---|---| |![IMG_20260314_143421_830.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/242Y5ua5Ky2cB4gznyJTjohCzjT5B95mUm7GyQy7bi5VwkkNKhJrbx5TwktBM4nJG8hUK.jpg)|![IMG_20260314_143926_337.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/244Ummf758acEhGekJK2xzoF4FWzFyrWwVXaskZaAnR8TZANFYfcrBUQYqRBYSmK4Eq7Z.jpg)| Eventually, the line starts to move and we've made it to the entry lanes. I was the only one in our group to line up to the Premium lane since my friends got sold out of premium ticket, but the event was an open concert, and the only difference between premium and regular tickets is that I got an event shirt and an extra beer. ![IMG_20260314_155307_436.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23vsLEJQQ51Y887DT2fwfyLrMaDfotzpks3qUkXgKkiiaSnnbTXc2kj1LMMcXb5QWWacV.jpg) ||| |---|---| |![IMG_20260314_155638_529.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23yd3rjfsLEU4mr9QqLfChwKavzbGofgdCDP64HLtJ7T1sS7zhEynWBjEmfPXj8Sh8CtY.jpg)|![IMG_20260314_160246_776.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/243qFRofnSuU5CMAyfqDEyf1FAvg3aCHf9iVJ9M31d3wpDhZPAFQ1U1MadySpYrshisw9.jpg)|![IMG_20260314_162501_832.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/244xpv4biCRb351acHQHybNbgcdss9ccCPbVBcVaR394naixfyYmgokP44NgDnxFXn2do.jpg)| that if something goes wrong within the event, authorities can respond immediately. ||||| |---|---|---|---| |![IMG_20260314_171742_854.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23wWyFvV4wr6WvKGrkWVsGLS4DgcyHGBRFtNd7zwPtUTCRuLTMZyrEDfurd6cUScF16F3.jpg)|![IMG_20260314_155734_057.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23sJhYGRSnGqH2J14o1BjNxW4xX41tzBArV3b2VvVBFzKm4rnkjvqMsmS43P1gusRLofR.jpg)|![IMG_20260314_171451_065.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23rB1SAEHoBHLsQST5XDpbHZyGXTyfPpgKuLLGENocGhtL9woWzp9iMzYCCR9jEFfb3nG.jpg)|![IMG_20260314_171445_551.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23zkjuMc4XCReTExP4Da5uPujPVjKjrhCGHjf1cCainsgetFDxM9ttiM2jBXNcjk4N6Ew.jpg)|![IMG_20260314_180225_609.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/243zZLq7qLvZeT8fxDtDbBS2YD8MeJZ4KhPvGcNLnxXo2KqLFUpgNQMxUzQ8se4erYf82.jpg)| performance from **Setsuna** as the opening act before the grand finals commence. If you notice that the band's logo looks similar to the clothes that our group is wearing, well you are correct. We got this shirt as one of the early supporters of the band, since they started their career in 2024, and we are glad that they were given opportunities like this to showcase their craft to people. ![IMG_20260314_163705_210.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23xVFEiveG3koT2kBXt5sNk4gam3i2iCsofTRAAkEMXrDakVSTnJAZLhSNdXK7n1bQbCg.jpg) So before they start, we got to meet and have a little chat with them. |||| |---|---|---| |![IMG_20260314_163333_094.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23xVMWhhBNqyrquJDoyZSwGp3trqS7vrdtNR66BFGxvprkHdkJHPL9usRc6L3F68SQvPj.jpg)|![IMG_20260314_163331_729.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/EqYudpvL2Ff13MNDANddwrgSseLBjgDXqBuTYnKXRai4gfEPhUGqGVGSLUh5yNEwebW.jpg)|![IMG_20260314_163404_482.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23wX1dCm9tSLzont97pkp9k54X6Ncg8XSorcoT2MAW2kJyPsodfrdGDgRgm7ff3DgNc7s.jpg) Going with their performance, I think that it was really solid and was well worth the 3 hours of travel. I want to enjoy the show and join the mosh pit, so I only took a video of their second to the last song **[Magliyab](https://www.facebook.com/reel/1577188583337391)**, which got its inspiration from Linkin Park's [One Step Closer](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4qlCC1GOwFw&list=RD4qlCC1GOwFw&start_radio=1). Unfortunately, during the song, one of the audience loses his wallet and that person is someone that I often meet during concerts, but can't really help him that much with a lost wallet, given how many people were in the venue. After their performance, there was a short intermission before the Muziklaban finalist performs, so we decided to go to the side, close to the beer booth to resume drinking, while also making discussions about each of the finalists to know who will we vote for the People's Choice Award, and the cups that we used to drink can also used to vote them. All we need to do was to drop the cup in any of the drop box of the band which we want to support. ||| |---|---| |![IMG_20260314_192243_136.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23uExLf47B7S2T1B4dDinS17rMJ58a5fu97HGgbDKfAJMQm8te4E1csZLzqxop1jzpHQT.jpg)|![IMG_20260314_194937_121.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23w2f445YAFwPE8BeTB8L2EgKXjGbtg6LV3UHP9zXs5wBW3mHDfGcsYtUm6UHQz9A68dj.jpg)|![IMG_20260314_195410_284.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23tvVd8UF6DzQ6yYvJzjF4zeZNLapvybDncu6gPK2dFhPf3GmmVsRnMH3bHXmG8Ejdv1c.jpg)| After watching all the finalist performs, we decided to place our vote to **VDS**. That was a total of 36 votes for us with me having 7 cups of beer. With the 2 free cups of beer that I get from my ticket, that means I got an additional of 5 cups of drink before we casts our vote. ![IMG_20260314_190526_253.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/242Y1fn3H9EAJT73gG9f5uj9hVYqsjtLegMpH4tChYmxLv33E43irzHou3knbZSnoZnpj.jpg) I'm no longer a strong drinker than when I was in my 20's, so drinking 7 cups of beer is already making me quite tipsy. Knowing that, I procrastinated on drinking, since there are still lots of guest bands to perform through the rest of the night. As a precaution, I also keep all my belongings to my bag, including my phone, meaning I also stopped taking pictures at this point. I just don't want to lose my things just like the person earlier in the event. After dropping our votes, we came back to the center of the event to watch the other guest bands that will perform through the night, and whenever there was a pit, we join. At some point, we also goy **Toshiro Kier** of Setsuna and **Jose Siscar** of Wilabaliw decided to join us to crowdsurf in the pit, making it a more unforgettable experience. Before the closing act, the finally announced the winners, with **Tamad Si Juan** being the Champion and **BGM** getting the people's choice award. In the end, our bet did not win, but that's just how every contest goes. I just hope that just like us there were other people that becomes a new fan of their music and able to widen their fanbase. And that was basically how the 2025 Muziklaban has concluded, aside from few people losing their belongings, it was overall another successful even with no major incidents taking place. Anyways, whenever you are going to an event where drinking is a huge part of the event, always practice drinking in moderation and only drink when you are in the legal age. That was it for me. Thank you for reading my post, and see you on the next one.

Today I started with a warm breakfast, accompanied by a cup of coffee, my constant companion before my activities. The calm morning atmosphere refreshed my mind and prepared me to face the day. After that, I immediately got ready for my usual routine: delivering bread to my favorite shops in Lhokseumawe. This is a journey I've traveled many times, but there's always something interesting to discover along the way. On the way, I took a moment to stop at Pusong Pier. This place always offers a different atmosphere. I could see the activity of fishermen with their boats neatly lined up along the water's edge. The neatly arranged fish storage boxes and nets create a distinctive sight that never gets boring. The gentle sea breeze added to the serenity despite the bustling activity around. However, this trip wasn't entirely smooth sailing. I was stuck in a fairly long traffic jam. It turned out that road repairs were disrupting traffic flow. Motorcycles and cars have to move slowly, even stopping occasionally. Although it takes a bit of time, I try to remain patient and enjoy the situation. For me, trips like this have become part of my daily routine. Sometimes smooth, sometimes delayed, but each time it provides a unique experience. The important thing is to continue living each day with enthusiasm and gratitude. ![hive dividers-04.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvc788wxsBSQHY3z21o3wSTU7hqRnyYc2JFEn2pEYSev/hive%20dividers-04.png) ![IMG_20260422_125218.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS44zy491d6GBfc1HixYEuPgvrHdBw5Tp7FFZQvVqEGPo/IMG_20260422_125218.jpg) ![IMG_20260422_125139.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc7eHwgdCeEGPbDzrCmuaacpKjHnbFmMerxmn8mxx9iz4/IMG_20260422_125139.jpg) ![IMG_20260422_125133.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfCwzi4NvzPZCDYNDztQvtyovG2W7Msydv8g8g3J9uMfW/IMG_20260422_125133.jpg) ![IMG_20260422_125136.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZQBY1coEV8WejM8iqcnXfbsGGi3gVomLBTtXgnmJWL9a/IMG_20260422_125136.jpg) ![hive dividers-04.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvc788wxsBSQHY3z21o3wSTU7hqRnyYc2JFEn2pEYSev/hive%20dividers-04.png)

Why the World Always Ends in October: Apocalyptic Timing, Toilet Paper, and the COVID Connection.  

From ancient Jewish feast days to the Wuhan Military Games, autumn has a strange grip on humanity's collective fear of the end. 

October is, statistically speaking, the most popular month for the apocalypse that never comes. The Great Disappointment fell on October 22, 1844. Orson Welles' Martians invaded on October 30, 1938. Harold Camping's final doomsday landed on October 21, 2011. Even the COVID-19 pandemic—a very real global crisis—began its shadowy emergence in October 2019, complete with military exercises simulating the exact outbreak that followed, a quarantined cruise ship, and a run on toilet paper that revealed more about human psychology than any virus ever could. 

Coincidence? Or is there something baked into the autumn calendar that makes us reach for both prayer beads and paper goods? 


 The Theology of Autumn: Why Prophecy Points to October.   

The clustering of apocalyptic predictions around September and October is no accident. It stems directly from how certain Christian traditions interpret the Jewish fall holidays—what Messianic Jewish teacher Jonathan Cahn calls the \

Here's the theological logic, and it's surprisingly straightforward.  

The Feast of Trumpets (Rosh Hashanah) — This holiday, which falls in September or October, involves the blowing of the shofar (ram's horn). In Christian prophecy interpretation, this trumpet blast represents the \

. Either way, it's a wake-up call.  \n\nYom Kippur (Day of Atonement) — Falling ten days after Rosh Hashanah, this is the holiest day on the Jewish calendar. In prophetic interpretation, it represents the final judgment. Jonathan Cahn describes it as \

—the ultimate reckoning. \n\nSukkot (Feast of Tabernacles) — Starting just five days after Yom Kippur, this week-long festival commemorates God's provision during the Israelites' wilderness wandering. Prophetically, it represents the Millennial Kingdom—the 1,000-year reign of peace after the apocalypse. As Cahn puts it, \
. \n\nThe pattern is simple: Trumpets signals the warning, Yom Kippur brings the judgment, and Sukkot delivers the restoration. And because these feasts occur at the \
. \n\nThis is why the Millerites chose October 22, 1844. It's why Harold Camping, after his May 21, 2011 prediction failed, pointed to October 21 as the final end. And it's why, in 2025, a viral \

prophecy pointed to September 23—which was Rosh Hashanah. 

The theology is internally consistent, even if the math keeps failing. 


 The October Surprise: COVID-19's Quiet Emergence.   

But prophecy isn't the only reason October haunts us. The COVID-19 pandemic—a genuine global catastrophe, not a failed prediction—also has its eerie roots in October 2019. And the timeline raises questions that, depending on your disposition, might feel like conspiracy fodder or simply strange coincidence. 

The 7th Military World Games — From October 18 to 27, 2019, the city of Wuhan, China, hosted the 7th Military World Games, bringing together nearly 10,000 athletes from over 100 countries. This was the largest international event Wuhan had ever hosted. 

Here's where it gets strange: On the exact same day the Games began—October 18, 2019—an event called \

was held in New York City. It was a pandemic simulation organized by the Johns Hopkins Center for Health Security, the Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation, and the World Economic Forum. The scenario? A novel coronavirus respiratory pandemic that spreads from country to country. 

The U.S. delegation to the Wuhan Games was unusually large—369 members, the largest in American military history at the Games. And their performance was, to put it mildly, unimpressive: Team USA returned with zero gold medals, a bizarre outcome for the world's dominant military power. More troubling, five American athletes fell ill during the Games and were evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. China's Foreign Ministry has repeatedly requested health information about those five athletes; Washington has remained silent. 

Within two months of the Games' conclusion, Wuhan was the epicenter of a novel coronavirus outbreak. The first official index case was dated December 8, 2019. 

Retrospective Evidence of Earlier Circulation — But the official timeline may be incomplete. A 2022 review published in the Annals of Global Health (NIH) found evidence suggesting SARS-CoV-2 was circulating in northern Italy as early as September/October 2019—\

where retrospective testing found a positive sample from December 27, 2019. 

The Italian findings are particularly striking: researchers identified 59 positive antibody tests in residents of Lombardy, with the earliest positive results dating back to September 2019. 

The NIH review concludes conservatively that \

. 

The circumstantial evidence points to October 2019 as the critical window—whether through the Military World Games as a superspreading event, or through earlier undetected circulation in Europe. 


 The Diamond Princess: A Floating October Nightmare.  

Then there's the cruise ship—because no modern apocalypse story is complete without one. 

The Diamond Princess, carrying 2,670 passengers and 1,100 crew, set sail on what was supposed to be a routine voyage. In early February 2020, Japanese authorities quarantined the ship in Yokohama after a passenger tested positive for the novel coronavirus. Eventually, over 700 people aboard would test positive—one of the largest early clusters outside China.  

But here's the October connection: while the quarantine made headlines in February, the timeline of infection likely traces back to the autumn. The Diamond Princess's voyage patterns and the incubation period mean the seeds of that outbreak were sown in the same October-November 2019 window when the virus was silently spreading. 

Among those aboard were 538 Filipino nationals and 223 Australians. The Philippine Embassy in Tokyo had to scramble to monitor its citizens. The Australian government confirmed cases among its citizens on board. The ship became a floating symbol of how interconnected—and how vulnerable—the modern world had become. 

And it all traces back to the autumn of 2019.  


 The Toilet Paper Phenomenon: Apocalypse on Aisle Four.   

No discussion of apocalyptic behavior would be complete without the great toilet paper panic of 2020. And the psychology behind it tells us something profound about why October matters. 

When COVID-19 began spreading globally, supermarket shelves emptied—not of masks or hand sanitizer (though those went too), but of toilet paper. Australia, Japan, Hong Kong, the United States, and the United Kingdom all saw \

headlines. 

Why toilet paper? The answer reveals the same psychological patterns that drive religious end-times predictions. 

The Visual Vacuum Effect — When a 50-pack of toilet paper disappears from a shelf, it leaves a massive empty space. Fifty cans of beans? Less noticeable. The sheer volume of toilet paper packaging makes shortages visually dramatic, triggering panic. 

FOMO (Fear of Missing Out) — As one Australian psychology professor explained, when people see others hoarding something, \

kicks in, and rational calculation goes out the window. \n\nThe Need for Control — This is the crucial insight, and it connects directly to apocalyptic thinking. As a Taiwanese psychology professor put it, when humans face disaster, they go through three stages: \
The problem is that when people realize they can do nothing substantive, they experience helplessness—\

. 

Toilet paper hoarding is irrational. Everyone knows this. But it's actionable irrationality. It gives people something to do when faced with an invisible, uncontrollable threat. 

This is exactly the same psychology that drives end-times date-setting. When the world feels chaotic and prophecy teachers offer a specific date, followers get to do something—sell their houses, quit their jobs, buy billboards. The action matters more than the outcome. 


 The Pattern: Why Autumn Works as an Apocalyptic Trigger.   

So why does October keep showing up, whether in failed prophecies or real pandemics? 

1. The Theological Anchor — For believers, the fall feasts provide a God-given timetable. The fact that the feasts are biblical—commanded in Leviticus 23—gives them authority that arbitrary dates lack. If God himself set these appointments, then it's not presumption to watch them; it's obedience. 

2. The Seasonal Psychology — Autumn is transition. Summer's abundance gives way to winter's scarcity. The days shorten. The world literally darkens. In agrarian societies, harvest represents both fulfillment and ending—the last gathering before the fallow season. This natural rhythm primes us for apocalyptic thinking. 

3. The Practical Calendar — Before modern climate control, holding massive outdoor revival meetings and end-times gatherings was easier in mild autumn weather than in winter's cold or summer's heat. October became a natural scheduling choice for prophecy conferences and camp meetings, which then reinforced October as \

Effect — October is the final quarter of the year. If you believe the world will end in a given year, October represents the last plausible window before winter makes the narrative awkward. Harold Camping's move from May to October 2011 illustrates this—when the spring date failed, October became the final \

The Ramifications: Who Pays When the World Doesn't End?   

The COVID-19 pandemic was real, not a failed prediction. But the October 2019 origins remain contested. China's government has not released comprehensive health data from the Military World Games period. The U.S. has not explained the five evacuated athletes. The WHO's origin investigation remains politically paralyzed. 

Meanwhile, the toilet paper industry had a banner year, and survivalist gear companies saw record sales. The \

simulation participants—Johns Hopkins, the Gates Foundation, the World Economic Forum—faced no accountability for the unsettling coincidence of timing because, of course, a pandemic simulation is not a crime. \n\nFor the religious predictions, the pattern is the same as always: the predictors face no legal consequences. Harold Camping's Family Radio spent approximately $100 million on his 2011 campaign, funded largely by followers who sold their homes. But under First Amendment protections, courts cannot declare religious beliefs \
As one legal scholar noted, the Supreme Court's 1944 United States v. Ballard decision ruled that \

. 

So the money stays with the prophets. The followers absorb the loss. And October rolls around again next year. 


 Conclusion: The Eternal October.   

Whether it's the Feast of Trumpets or the Military World Games, whether it's a rapture that never comes or a virus that did, October seems to be the month when humanity collectively holds its breath. 

The theological framework explains the religious dates. The psychological research explains the toilet paper. And the epidemiological evidence—however contested—places COVID-19's shadowy emergence in the same autumn window as the Wuhan Games and the Italian blood samples. 

Maybe it's all coincidence. Maybe it's the natural result of calendars, seasons, and human fear responses converging. Or maybe—as both prophecy believers and conspiracy theorists might suggest—there's something about October that genuinely matters. 

Either way, next September, watch the news. Listen for the trumpets. And maybe buy an extra pack of toilet paper. Just in case.

> In China, a new initiative has just brought robots directly into everyday life in a way that until recently seemed distant, almost improbable, X Square Robot joined the 58.com platform to launch a home service where humans and robots work together as a team.


The way it works is simple, but at the same time very revealing, when a client schedules a cleaning through the application, not only one person arrives, a duo arrives, a human and a robot sharing the same job. The human is in charge of the most delicate tasks, those that require attention, judgment and care for details. While the robot assumes the repetitive part, cleaning surfaces, organizing objects and executing actions that follow patterns.


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dF2e3c_Mm6I
https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcM9vDyChXWWfaBhnqxXD5scZn7pnHcZrWiwyZ8HMwmbX/separador%201.png

> This turns each service into a true test for artificial intelligence. These robots use a system called Wall AI, an already built-in model that allows them to observe the environment, understand what is happening around them and make decisions in real time depending solely on pre-programmed commands.


All this means that the robot doesn't just execute tasks, it learns while it works. And there is a strategic detail that completely changes the game, by operating within a platform that serves millions of homes, this technology gains access to a gigantic amount of real-world data, every house, every interaction, every mistake and every success becomes learning, which accelerates development exponentially.


https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcM9vDyChXWWfaBhnqxXD5scZn7pnHcZrWiwyZ8HMwmbX/separador%201.png

El entrenamiento de ayer fue una verdadera lección de que, en el running, lo más importante ocurre fuera de la pantalla. Salimos a recorrer nuestra **ruta tradicional en Los Palos Grandes**, ese escenario que conocemos de memoria pero que siempre nos desafía con su energía única. Sin embargo, a mitad de camino, apareció el \

inesperado de todo corredor moderno: **Strava decidió enloquecer.**
Entre saltos inexplicables en el GPS y un ritmo que no coincidía con la realidad, el reloj parecía empeñado en sabotear la estadística de la jornada. En esos momentos, es fácil dejar que la frustración tome el control, pero ayer la prioridad fue distinta. Ignoré los números erráticos y me concentré en lo que realmente importa: la **sensación del esfuerzo**, la cadencia de mis pasos y el aire golpeando el rostro.
A pesar del caos tecnológico, logré mantener el enfoque y **terminar el entrenamiento completo**, cumpliendo con cada kilómetro planificado. Al final, los datos pueden fallar, pero el trabajo realizado se queda en las piernas y en la mente. Me quedo con la satisfacción de saber que, aunque la aplicación no lo registre perfectamente, mi disciplina sigue intacta. ¡Seguimos sumando kilómetros con el equipo, porque nuestra pasión no depende de un satélite! 🚀🔥

Blockchain was built to eliminate the black box. To replace trust with verification. To ensure that every transaction is visible, immutable, and auditable. The ledger does not blink. It does not negotiate. It records.

Yet many prediction markets operate as centralized silos. Opaque. Unauditable. Where the matching engine is a proprietary secret and the flow of funds is obscured until it is too late.

This is not merely about money. It is about trust.

When a retail participant loses to an insider, they leave. They recognize the game is not worth playing. They withdraw their faith.

And when faith withdraws, liquidity follows. When liquidity follows, the market dies.

Prediction markets can be a tool for truth. Or they can be a tool for extraction.

The choice is not technological. It is moral.

We can build systems where information flows freely, and advantage is earned through insight. Or we can allow systems where advantage is bought through access, and the crowd is merely fodder for the few.

*For in the end, a market is only as strong as the trust it holds. And trust, once broken, is harder to rebuild than code.*

title.title: Tour, 22 Mile Ride, Garmin Varia Radar, Session and Lunch, Baby Birds, Kit Storage - Tuesday
title.body:
The tour of the alps is rather disgusting to watch the terrain, all I see are paragliding launches. Roads go everywhere but launches are not as easy to find, unless in the Alps. Was a bit surprised not to see anyone in the air but the helicopters likely dissuade them from being close. ![IMG_20260421_051628.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/242DBn8rPb5ZfbLuaty12Van3Y2ALF88xcrsmUGzjgXuAZ9fFy6QbRLdP2NQA4CcwDP8f.jpg) Got the boys to school then got ready and headed out for a ride. I was testing out my new Garmin Varia radar and made sure to ride some higher traffic areas. It works amazing and is pretty good at detecting cars. The only wonkiness was when the highway traffic was visible from the side road I was on, it got a few wrong detections. I rode to Deer Park and back to home and the radar was awesome for the roundabouts. ![IMG_20260421_091414.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23u65KbuBK5f4VyR1LBD1v2PraYEsbW8d6F6Am255ovhRWhi45EuC6r1vdCVv86nvdzZX.jpg) Feeling stronger in the legs and am able to keep it in a higher gear for climbs now. Not very worried about speed as I am about distance and overall workload. ![bike 4-21.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/Eo8L8u4DYM1nob4tvbZSRRgvWsGx9rwCfoRxVpURF94CTeZzKpyc1hWYmpJ4jdoZsbQ.JPG) That said I did get my fastest times on a bunch of distances. I had to be home before 10:30 so I could be to town by 11am for our session. ![bike 4-21 PRs.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tGXzL888cPZtN3EtfLZt4M3QCryhePbkPKva2UzszFP4z5JHCKMMaHMpf58PBMU9SSN.JPG) After our session which was rather taxing, we went to lunch at Applebees. ![IMG_20260421_124737.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23w2oKZRwyi4Jx5uDcYL67drqmbpTxBBZuMthYEnHco2hrsBdyMVuFqmTN59ScwRRStMN.jpg) I got home with little no no motivation to do anything so wandered the farm checking on various things. These are the baby flycatchers in their nest. The parents are working overtime to provide enough food for them. I see them flitting about the trees and around the gardens non-stop. The robins are doing the same and then the swallows are feeding their nest of babies in the siding of the garden shed. They come back to that same nest every year. ![IMG_20260421_143251.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23w2gVTm36cbMimu4DJqwg2pBswNcCaY1CY2ZArMJ3NGDMqREsa2AVNd7QbYabx8SwTnz.jpg) My cycling electronics kit storage is rather nice now. I used a small honeycomb storage wall panel on the shelf for my ham radio above my computer and desk so my earbuds have the cup and the Varia and Edge snap into the quarter turn adapters. ![IMG_20260421_144511.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23wWpf2HdLsQdBCyZPFo5jCbpCmYhu6y6aFe46wmEkgF3p4FUXUxvEyWjruM1ysdZtHzJ.jpg) I had to glue them together as they are 3 pieces but they work perfect now and are loose enough to easily get them on and off. It keeps them organized and off my desk. Boys got home from school and after some chores R went next door to play for an hour. I got dinner made in the evening and we were able to sit on the deck to eat in the nice warmer temps before the rain has hit overnight. ![IMG_20260421_144523.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23u5vRQGU187R2HdnusSy3YzEg4CrC1kxa6rR53qYt9ZmKn7feKBFpaDj2nRwvAyBct6K.jpg) Today is rain day so I will likely just get a trainer ride in this morning after getting the boys to school. I have my weekly session this morning after the reschedule so will need to be done with my ride by 10:30 again. Will pick J up after track and decide on what to make for dinner this afternoon. ---

title.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![SkSnB7acbAGUtfoJ_1000038380.jpg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/averyxu/images/SkSnB7acbAGUtfoJ_1000038380/SkSnB7acbAGUtfoJ_1000038380.webp)

我爸不知道干什么的，又问我妹要钱。明明自己当保安，一个月也有点收入。上次因为自己的无牌电车被交警拦走了。问我要了2000想买新的电车，说这回要上车牌了。才隔了一段时间，又想问我妹妹要500块钱。他怎么这么多要法。说明平时完全不攒钱。那钱不知道花哪儿去了。

我说关心一下我三妹的读书问题，结果打电话过去发现我爷爷住院了。我爷爷住院了肯定也是缺钱的。但是这钱我也兜不住。这些让我叔叔伯伯去弄就行。我今天想到，为什么要为三妹操这个心，如果想帮但是不感恩我帮也不配合我帮她读书，那就由她自己先发展吧。她家人也是作孽，这种关键时刻不让自己小孩继续读书。我还想着五一带她来南宁玩，带去桂林玩。我可能在自我感动，以为能这样带她看到世界。只是尽自己所能做一点点。自己也不要太费心力了。有机会的时候我给点生活费。偶尔带到附近周边城市走一走玩一玩。我如果能让她有电话费，保持跟外界联系以及跟我的联系。我最近的目标就是让她会坐高铁就可以了。但是麻烦的是她又晕车哦。那我可能还得买点晕车药。只能定一些小目标。如果担心别人的长远发展，注定是会吓坏自己。每个人都有每个人的未来。只能祝福。

三月三的四天假期也不怎么敢出去玩。去一个旅游景点两个人就500多了。男朋友想给手机换个电池就400了。他付款的时候还有点肉痛。所以我们现在能在家煮饭就在家煮饭。最近因为我三妹还有还我妈的钱，最近是真的感受到成家的压力了。

title.body:

今天天气还蛮不错的，早上起来吃完饭我就跟麻麻出门散步。杭州到处透着股春的气息，草坪逐渐转绿也有些花盛开。蓝天白云之下，即便是原图都看着很不错。

散步的时候妈妈跟我聊起外婆家用水用电的问题，她说外婆经常跟她抱怨。她自己除了当班的衣物以外，基本不在那洗东西，但是舅舅每次来都要用外婆家的水洗车洗衣。

更夸张的是，他每次来还要将家里的手机剃须刀电瓶这类东西拿来充电。这事我们以前会在单位里干，但是在亲戚家里这么做多少有些不体面，外婆介意这点无可厚非。


但从妈妈的角度来说，虽然看不惯但也只能劝外婆别介意。回到家妈妈去忙了，我就瘫在沙发上打游戏啦。这几天手感不是很少，打了五局排位只赢了1局输了4局。

输的4局战绩分别是卡尔玛1-3-15（SVP+A）、3-5-14（A）、悠米2-2-12（A）和莫甘娜2-4-8（SVP+A）。我总结下来就是，只要打野和AD有问题的局基本赢不了。

赢的那局赢的也是卡尔玛1-4-15（A），加了两颗星呢。我最近单排在研究法装，与其靠别人不如靠自己c。春节红包有开到过88点券，可以说幸运值爆棚啦！嗨森！


（本篇完）

### I drew the Little Prince as I imagine him. > ### Dibujé como imagino al Principito. https://play.3speak.tv/embed?v=nestodibuja/nyetdf7e I share this timelapse video of a drawing I made a long time ago. It's my reimagining of the Little Prince, from Antoine de Saint-Exupéry's book. I hope you like it. I based it on the author's own images in the book, drawings that have their charm in their very simplicity, and on how I imagined the Little Prince when I read it as a child. It's one of the first drawings I made in Ibis Paint, and it helped me understand tools and settings. Also, I wanted to make a drawing without lines, which is always a challenge for me. The drawing is simple: the Little Prince standing on top of his asteroid, with his little volcanoes and his weeds that someday, if they get out of control, will turn into big trees with the power to destroy an entire planet. Maybe soon, with more drawing knowledge and more experience with Ibis Paint, I will redo this drawing. For now, thank you for joining me for another day of drawing. > Les comparto este video timelapse de un dibujo que hice hace mucho tiempo, es mi reimaginación del principito, del libro de Antoine de Saint-Exupéry, espero que les guste. Me basé en las propias imágenes del autor en el libro, unos dibujos que tienen su encanto en su misma simpleza, y en cómo imaginaba al principito mientras lo leía de chico. title.title: Sudden Walk During the Dusk
title.body:
![Brown Aesthetic Friends Photo Collage_20260422_173344_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariainchaos/48kCECvLnsGgZb6f4DdGoobi8yaQx68A84Z3HwENFuxPh34ZQunUZJnVcAxZeY6XkP.png)

Another Wednesday and another tiring day, because of our class schedule. The school hours begin at eight am, and ends at 5 pm. After class, my friends and I decided to go for a walk, because it felt like our heads are gonna blow up.

![received_1500259104768580.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariainchaos/23zvHNhjsymfsNG8q3oashippq2vcZnz7LT4DEC2h8Ltmk6Kj1RHNPKFoQgrTZZDr5iic.jpeg)

We've been listening to the various discussions since morning from different professors. 

They gave us instructions about the requirements for our incoming final examination, and we are all exhausted.  We have group projects and individual projects to comply to be able to take the examination.


![received_960213923302235.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariainchaos/23vPGuiyn3Qo9ex5Z2ZoQqiExzrTqYiTHgQRt42eds4hLzivLZ5mKTWjSEwo1sXLpfzJS.jpeg)

After class, we started walking without any proper destination, we just want to walk away from our responsibilities for some time. It felts amazing; breathing a fresh air, watching the sky slowly getting dusky, and observing the appearance of the moon.

It was a lovely evening. It felt nice. It was filled with laughter, not a forced one, but a genuine laughs.

We began to feel a pain in our feet, but we did not stop, we continue walking, and telling stories for us to forget that our feet are hurting. 


![received_928500716615990.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariainchaos/23tbkfh1UGMQUxrBegcfBgcoRac88rZvJHWdWprei9HWVhNkRLccFHZdANAvaiKLZGfpm.jpeg)

We did not mind our sweats, we laughed until our stomach's hurts. We've thrown jokes to each without hurting each other's feeling.  

We talked about life, and suddenly I got lost in my own world, and questions the air \

And it hits me so hard.

![received_842657951505044.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariainchaos/23sdfT8mGXu6Fat7gXZ9hyJLTARSEXtyB5fVqzy6sVUUuHFYhkvVG9cJgRbDc2VjUmpGM.jpeg)
 

I felt scared for a moment, and one of my friend snapped me, and I am back to reality. And thought that,it is what it is, whatever happens in the future as long as I am enjoying in the present it's fine, I don't have to worry about the things that aren't happening yet, I just have to continue, and I just have to do my best today, so that I won't going to regret anything.


![received_990734250051906.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariainchaos/23zvFgqkVuzSR5rtcHS3g2m6qmbRXQApokPPPUfXXXGAuSe1eFpiPZkB6j4FSwYnK9Q4z.jpeg)

On the way home, one of us, had pushed the doorbell button of someone's house that we didn't not know, they ran fast, but I didn't catch up, my head is still floating, and they laughed at me for not realizing things out, and I just smiled.

![received_943993684917245.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariainchaos/23u5vxfisV8e9p7pTfKiooHHYnU64ujmSH8Uia9orjLkY7F1JkMX9ZQJ3EBmQKDz8fRbd.jpeg)


We had fun, so much fun, and somehow forgot the bunches of academic activities that are waiting for us at our dorms. 

Those few hours taught me a lesson—it is really important to take a pause no matter how busy and exhausting our day is going. There is nothing wrong about taking a rest for some time. 


Di

title.title: Oxigenación del emprendimiento pastelero (Es-En)
title.body:
Un saludo para todos los emprendedores y amigos de la blockchain. Desde esta comunidad @BeEnterpreneur podemos retroalimentar nuestros propósitos. Esta vez les sugiero mi experiencia en el renacer creativo cuando se usan nuevas herramientas, sabores y colores.

***
***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUxhYV9AfjR9djXdtnEEfhCKu6YtUCFoQjwkTTni12evA/1776858964451.jpg)

***
***
La pastelería artesanal impone siempre nuevos retos; mantenerse vivo no solo implica seguir recetas tradicionales, sino oxigenar constantemente el negocio con innovación, técnica y sensorialidad.

La oxigenación de un emprendimiento pastelero consiste en inyectar aire fresco a cada proceso; es como respirar profundo para continuar con más fuerzas.
***
***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTeBFYkjUgy6bStvhqeFHEFizpjBrXz8NWncf3wa7apkk/1776859362918.jpg)

***
***
Este proceso de renovación se da desde la elección de materias primas hasta la decoración final, pasando por herramientas que potencian la eficiencia y la belleza. Para los cubanos, muy lejos de las bondades del mercado, es doble la motivación porque la mayoría de estas renovaciones vienen como donaciones o regalos de amigos y familia.

Y en esa transformación con las nuevas herramientas, es un reto el uso de las boquillas rusas, pigmentos vibrantes, esencias de calidad y toppings especializados, porque todas ellas intervienen en el resultado, siendo aliadas indispensables.
***
***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcTpEyHHLn4Z2FyfswgxbdHe3yGEwhfVQaaSeWFfnwcoM/1776859033528.jpg)
***
***
Pero no es tan sencillo; luego de tener todo eso, se requiere habilidad y práctica; por ejemplo, las boquillas rusas hacen por sí mismas las flores más hermosas.

A diferencia de las boquillas tradicionales de estrella o pétalo, estas piezas metálicas de diseño complejo permiten crear flores tridimensionales, como rosas, tulipanes, crisantemos, en un solo movimiento de manga.
***
***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZJXFkzKizQqHbGB8j6KvrtCHmAKtKJxCVeKwXpAtFfC7/1776859067528.jpg)
***
***
Sin embargo, lograr la estabilidad del merengue para alcanzar este resultado es todo un desafío. El uso de estas boquillas rusas reduce drásticamente el tiempo de decoración y eleva el acabado profesional sin requerir años de práctica.

Para un emprendedor que hornea por encargo, esto significa poder aceptar más pedidos sin sacrificar la estética, y en mi caso, que no tengo estudios en la materia, es un apoyo incalculable.


***
***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPJiJokYgy6a9BHigirr2433YUnPFYnvkDUXWi2yDA1v3/1776859101384.jpg)
***
***
Además, las boquillas rusas invitan a jugar con colores; al aplicar dos o tres tonos de crema dentro de la manga, se logran pétalos degradados que parecen recién cortados.

Pero la oxigenación no sería completa sin materias primas pensadas para decorar. Por eso somos felices cuando tenemos los polvos y papeles comestibles metalizados, los sprinkles artesanales y las perlas crujientes de colores.
***
***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbgB1MWe37r8r5EPPZb2viRhWk1zYXDKUCDdUWpw8jvy4/1776859121962.jpg)
***
***
Estos elementos, antes reservados para pastelerías de alta gama, hoy son accesibles y convierten cualquier cupcake o torta en una experiencia cercana.

Estos detalles complementan perfectamente el trabajo de las boquillas: una flor de crema puede terminar con un centro de perlas doradas o un polvo brillante en los bordes, haciendo la maravilla en un dulce festivo.
***
***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQpV7usDs63RVzcwFbgKWUWPLh8jA8DPpUsj6zWR6RVtu/1776859162987.jpg)
***
***
Y qué sería de la decoración sin el color. Hasta ahora me he resistido a una línea creativa según mi disponibilidad de materiales y la acogida de los clientes, pero el deseo de explorar es indiscutible.

La tendencia actual apuesta por paletas armónicas. Usar un colorante de calidad no solo embellece, sino que oxigena la identidad visual del emprendimiento, ayudando a crear una marca reconocible.
***
***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdTLNakytuREWSLHDfdsfbHsiKsJdJrznRdT7u6sCEfg6/1776859201347.jpg)
***
***
También las esencias son un toque de calidad. Aquí está el alma olfativa y gustativa del pastel. Además de la esencia de vainilla tradicional, las esencias de arequipe, mantecado, chocolate, limón, almendra permiten crear combinaciones inesperadas.

Eso es oxigenar el paladar del cliente, ofreciendo sabores que no encuentra en cualquier pastelería. Aquí es fundamental el gusto del cliente, aunque podemos proponerles si así lo permiten.
***
***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXrAH4EJK6ana9uKvr7MoCVEfuj71eh7F1pLmfWA8UvWn/1776859249902.jpg)
***
***
Integrar estas herramientas y materias primas implica para nosotros una inversión enorme; por ello, cuando Floiran, Michel, Miguel, Tony, Kirenia, Ana, Lulu, Ivo, Lisy, Rodo, Yusle, Lilia, Ida, Elia, @maylink , mi madre y otros, apoyan mi emprendimiento, es como si me facilitaran oxígeno.


***
***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTjxEXYdoV71EZMr6aUKXokMjPrGue6La4zD6u6XPwvR3/1776860063053.jpg)
***
***
La pastelería no es solo harina y azúcar: es arte, química, emoción y amistad. Oxigenarla es permitir que el negocio respire, crezca y florezca con todos los colores, sabores y texturas.

https://images.ecency.com/DQmfFnEMCYnFkP4yn3RAjCC5Yi2Bw4pZMYk2wKE2HWeExdE/1739658658260.jpg

<sub>Gracias por visitar mi blog. Soy crítica de arte, investigadora social y amante de la cocina. Te invito a conocer más de mí, de mi país y de mis letras. Texto y fotos de mi propiedad.</sub>

https://images.ecency.com/DQmfAxqWjfHD2t6iFUv1FivzQTFzsMmbGqywoexFuT14L8s/1750582840520.jpg


**Oxygenating the Pastry Entrepreneurship**

Greetings to all the entrepreneurs and friends of the blockchain. From this community, @BeEnterpreneur, we can provide feedback on our goals. This time, I suggest drawing from my experience in creative rebirth when using new tools, flavors, and colors.

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmUxhYV9AfjR9djXdtnEEfhCKu6YtUCFoQjwkTTni12evA/1776858964451.jpg

---

---

Artisanal pastry always imposes new challenges; staying alive not only involves following traditional recipes but constantly oxygenating the business with innovation, technique, and sensory experience.

The oxygenation of a pastry entrepreneurship consists of injecting fresh air into every process; it is like taking a deep breath to continue with more strength.

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmTeBFYkjUgy6bStvhqeFHEFizpjBrXz8NWncf3wa7apkk/1776859362918.jpg

---

---

This renewal process occurs from the selection of raw materials to the final decoration, including tools that enhance efficiency and beauty. For Cubans, far removed from the benefits of the market, the motivation is doubled because most of these renovations come as donations or gifts from friends and family.

And in this transformation with new tools, the use of Russian piping tips, vibrant pigments, quality essences, and specialized toppings is a challenge, because all of them intervene in the result, becoming indispensable allies.

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmcTpEyHHLn4Z2FyfswgxbdHe3yGEwhfVQaaSeWFfnwcoM/1776859033528.jpg

---

---

But it's not so simple; after having all that, skill and practice are required. For example, Russian piping tips create the most beautiful flowers all by themselves.

Unlike traditional star or petal tips, these metal pieces of complex design allow you to create three-dimensional flowers, such as roses, tulips, and chrysanthemums, in a single movement of the piping bag.

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmZJXFkzKizQqHbGB8j6KvrtCHmAKtKJxCVeKwXpAtFfC7/1776859067528.jpg

---

---

However, achieving the stability of the meringue to reach this result is quite a challenge. The use of these Russian piping tips drastically reduces decoration time and elevates the professional finish without requiring years of practice.

For an entrepreneur who bakes to order, this means being able to accept more orders without sacrificing aesthetics, and in my case, having no formal training in the field, it is an invaluable support.

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmPJiJokYgy6a9BHigirr2433YUnPFYnvkDUXWi2yDA1v3/1776859101384.jpg

---

---

Furthermore, Russian piping tips invite you to play with colors; by applying two or three shades of cream inside the piping bag, you achieve gradient petals that look freshly cut.

But oxygenation would not be complete without raw materials designed for decoration. That is why we are happy when we have metallic edible powders and papers, artisanal sprinkles, and colorful crunchy pearls.

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmbgB1MWe37r8r5EPPZb2viRhWk1zYXDKUCDdUWpw8jvy4/1776859121962.jpg

---

---

These elements, once reserved for high-end pastry shops, are now accessible and turn any cupcake or cake into an intimate experience.

These details perfectly complement the work of the piping tips: a cream flower can finish with a center of golden pearls or a shiny powder on the edges, creating wonder in a festive sweet.

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmQpV7usDs63RVzcwFbgKWUWPLh8jA8DPpUsj6zWR6RVtu/1776859162987.jpg

---

---

And what would decoration be without color? So far, I have stuck to a creative line according to my availability of materials and customer reception, but the desire to explore is indisputable.

The current trend favors harmonious palettes. Using quality coloring not only beautifies but oxygenates the visual identity of the entrepreneurship, helping to create a recognizable brand.

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmdTLNakytuREWSLHDfdsfbHsiKsJdJrznRdT7u6sCEfg6/1776859201347.jpg

---

---

Essences are also a touch of quality. Here lies the olfactory and gustatory soul of the cake. In addition to traditional vanilla essence, essences of dulce de leche (arequipe), ice cream flavor (mantecado), chocolate, lemon, and almond allow for unexpected combinations.

That is oxygenating the customer's palate, offering flavors they cannot find in just any pastry shop. Here, the customer's taste is fundamental, although we can make suggestions if they allow it.

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmXrAH4EJK6ana9uKvr7MoCVEfuj71eh7F1pLmfWA8UvWn/1776859249902.jpg

---

---

Integrating these tools and raw materials represents a huge investment for us; therefore, when Floiran, Michel, Miguel, Tony, Kirenia, Ana, Lulu, Ivo, Lisy, Rodo, Yusle, Lilia, Ida, Elia, @maylink, my mother, and others support my venture, it is as if they provide me with oxygen.

Pastry is not just flour and sugar: it is art, chemistry, emotion, and friendship. Oxygenating it means allowing the business to breathe, grow, and flourish with all its colors, flavors, and textures.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTjxEXYdoV71EZMr6aUKXokMjPrGue6La4zD6u6XPwvR3/1776859956676.jpg)

title.body: > Hallo zusammen ! Eigentlich sollte es bei mir nur einen Dry-January geben. Diesen habe ich jedoch verlängert bis zur Karnevalswoche in diesem Jahr. Anschließend kamen mehrere bei uns auf die gute Idee, nach Karneval bis Ostern zu Fasten. Bei mir verlängerte sich somit abermals die trockene Zeit bis zum Osterwochenende. Da an diesem Wochenende auch wieder das Workout Chad (1000 Box-Step-Ups) geplant war, habe ich für mich festgelegt, das ich bis zu diesem Workout keinen Alkohol trinke, um zu sehen, ob dieses Auswirkungen hat auf meine Leistung in diesem Workout. Allerdings wurde dann der Termin für dieses Workout verschoben. Also lebe ich derzeit immer noch ein alkoholfreies Leben.

> Hello everyone! I was actually planning to do Dry January. However, we extended it until Carnival week this year. After that, several of us had the great idea to fast from after Carnival until Easter. So for me, the dry spell was extended once again until Easter weekend. Since the Chad workout (1,000 box step-ups) was scheduled for that weekend as well, I decided not to drink any alcohol until that workout to see if it would affect my performance. However, the date for that workout was then postponed. So I’m still living an alcohol-free life at the moment. ___
![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ynwa.andree/23yJGTbJqR9zXKkJqso2Mgrabxu3gmPQn55uMnpyQRLME2ZMwnZSJEQ7HepTU6RFdthvV.jpg)

> In der Zwischenzeit halte ich mich mit alkoholfreiem Bier über Wasser und ich muss eingestehen, das es hier zum Teil schon ganz gute gibt. Früher waren die alkoholfreien Biere meisten ziemlich wässrig. Doch mittlerweile sind einige dabei, die man gut trinken kann. Zuletzt gab es im Restaurant sogar ein **Bitburger 0,0** vom Fass. Hier sieht man, dass das alkoholfreie Bier auch einen ganz anderen Stellenwert hat als noch vor einigen Jahren. Bei einem Besuch in den Niederlanden vor ein paar Tagen habe ich ein Leffe Bruine in der alkoholfreien Variante gefunden, was ich zum Probieren mitgenommen habe.

> In the meantime, I’m getting by on non-alcoholic beer, and I have to admit that some of them here are actually pretty good. In the past, non-alcoholic beers were usually pretty watery. But now there are a few that are quite drinkable. Most recently, the restaurant even had **Bitburger 0.0** on tap. This shows that non-alcoholic beer has a completely different status today than it did just a few years ago. During a visit to the Netherlands a few days ago, I found a non-alcoholic version of Leffe Bruine, which I picked up to try. ___
![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ynwa.andree/23vi8TThTfFz8zmhknG1ZCyFKBoQggdgxARJf2ybSEhZKr2TCKtp7aWnEaX3hPa3FEgso.jpg)
> Das alkoholfreie Leffe kostete ungefähr € 2,50. Für ein alkoholfreies Bier finde ich das schon ziemlich teuer. Ich hoffe dementsprechend, dass das Bier auch was zu bieten hat.

> The non-alcoholic Leffe cost about €2.50. I think that's pretty expensive for a non-alcoholic beer. So I hope the beer has something to offer. ___
![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ynwa.andree/23y8siTrMWhKnHJ6Jkc3m6T7QPZ7WXLPsKwSJrAuh4Yr3oHAjbN6xSb1iapsc7YM4wKE9.jpg)
> Der Geruch ist sehr malzig. Die Farbe gefällt mir sehr gut und auch die Krone kann überzeugen.

> The aroma is very malty. I really like the color, and the head is impressive too. ___
![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ynwa.andree/23xpAUqt6JsPvv24CZcQTqSVf2zSK7eoFDd7LDwVjUudkCmjoiMTDfKkdfWu4fiNgLcLo.jpg)

. Das hält jedoch nicht sehr lange an, dann schmeckt man nur noch sehr malzige Noten, die schon fast an ein Malzbier erinnern.

> As for the taste, the first impression actually reminds you of a real Leffe “Bruine.” However, that doesn't last very long; soon you're left with only very malty notes that are almost reminiscent of a malt beer. ___

title.title: Taming the Vols
title.body:
![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXL3NT62yxvrC2NUEUxU465arA4c17jLH171hCSRZQLPi/PXL_20260327_153756900.webp)

----------------------------------

Have you ever had one of those cases where a loss felt just about as good as a win?  I know that probably sounds crazy, but just stay with me for a bit here.  As I mentioned back on Monday, last night the Radford Highlander Softball team faced off against the Tennessee Volunteers.  If you are thinking wait, isn't the UT softball team ranked something like 8th in the nation right now, you would be absolutely right.

I think a lot of people expected an absolute blood bath last night, but I as well as many others were happy to find that wasn't the case.  No, Radford didn't win the game, but they only gave up two runs to an SEC powerhouse team that was on a six game winning streak before their loss to Duke just a week ago.

On top of that, The Highlanders were able to score a run of their own and for a hot second it looked like they might have a chance to tie the game up.  With a final score of 2 to 1 in favor of Tennessee, all it would have taken was one good knock in the top of the seventh inning to knot things up and give Radford a chance at the win.

Additionally, our niece was given the chance to pinch hit in the game.   How often do you get to say you faced off against a pitcher from the number 8 team in the nation?  Pretty cool right?

To make things even better, she was able to draw a walk which is something she honestly excels at.  She has a really good feel for balls and strikes and she has a tendency to draw walks more than she hits lately.  Which is good because she is fast, so any chance you can to get her on base is a plus for the team.

For some reason last night the Radford coach didn't throw his ace pitcher.  I don't know if he just wanted to give other players a chance in a non conference game that doesn't really mean anything or what.  @mrsbozz thinks it was because he didn't want Tennessee to see how good she is and try to steal her away via the transfer portal.   Personally, I am not sure that was actually the case, but crazier things have happened.

My guess is they have a couple big series coming up in the next week or so and he wanted to keep her fresh for that.  Those series will determine whether they make it to the conference tournament or not and a potential bid as the conference champion.

__________

Hay días donde solo queda seguir, sin saber. Y eso me pasó el domingo pasado. Estaba en mi trabajo como siempre, de un lado a otro, ocupado, sin parar. Hasta que llegó un momento en que me senté un rato a reposar, y en ese instante se me vinieron miles de pensamientos a la cabeza. Estaba muy agotado, pero no era solo físico, era algo más profundo. De repente, sin aviso, me invadieron los recuerdos de mi hija María de Jesús. Empecé a hacerme preguntas que no tenían respuesta, y ahí fue donde todo empezó a pesar.

Era un domingo cualquiera, estaba solo en la empresa, y no pude contener las lágrimas. Me sentía completamente solo en ese momento. Tomé el teléfono y, sin pensarlo mucho, empecé a buscar fotos de mi hija, a ver sus videos, esos donde salía con sus locuras, con esa forma de ser tan única, con esa alegría de niña traviesa que tenía. Y creo que ahí fue donde todo se me vino encima. Porque no es lo mismo recordarla que verla, escucharla, sentirla tan cerca y al mismo tiempo tan lejos. Ahí fue donde se rompió todo por dentro.

En medio de eso llamé a una buena amiga. Ni siquiera sé si me entendía bien, porque hablaba entre lágrimas, con la voz quebrada, tratando de explicarle lo que sentía. Pero ella estuvo ahí, me escuchó, me tuvo paciencia. Pude descargarme, pude drenar un poco este dolor tan grande que llevo en el cuerpo, en la mente y en el alma. Sus palabras me llegaron, me calmaron, me hicieron sentir acompañado en medio de ese momento tan duro. Porque a veces uno no necesita respuestas, solo necesita a alguien que escuche de verdad.

Hoy solo le pido a Dios fuerza, mucha fortaleza para seguir remando, para seguir avanzando. Sé que tengo mis metas claras, que tengo a mi esposa Gesmary y a mi hijo Jorge Luis aquí conmigo en Argentina, que han sido mi sostén, mi base, mi todo. Pero también sé que hay días como ese domingo, donde solo queda seguir, sin saber hacia dónde. Y a ti, mi hija, donde quiera que estés, quiero que sepas que te amo, que no te olvido, que me haces falta todos los días. Tengo muchas ganas de volver a Venezuela, de llevarte flores, de sentarme a hablar contigo, de cantarte, de decirte todo lo que llevo por dentro. Ya son ocho años sin pisar mi tierra, y ese vacío pesa. Ese domingo fue duro, muy duro, pero también me recordó que sigo aquí, luchando, sintiendo, y avanzando.

<center>![SeparadorHive.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mballesteros/23t7YWoN53XUARh93PVvS9mqaVjjjMGSNi6uJUMjKptGwBVoiTyadsRVjRPAE27xgxsc7.png)</center>

Y al final, hay días que no se entienden, que simplemente se sienten. Días donde uno se rompe un poco por dentro, pero aun así sigue. Porque la vida no se detiene, y uno aprende a avanzar incluso con el dolor a cuestas.

Quiero agradecer a la comunidad #freewriters, en especial a @daily.prompt, @mariannewest y @felt.buzz, por este espacio donde podemos escribir desde lo más profundo y ser escuchados.

Gracias por leer, te leo en la caja de comentarios. Un abrazo grande para todos.

body.title: Just Seedlings - April 21, 2026@goldenoakfarm
body.body:
![4th starting seedlings up collage text crop April 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/EpEKh4yrRe3LKiUnX7wXjWwwTc4UFE5jH7PivicoStV72dewKvGqSSV4sZjBAJgAuiM.jpg)

On Tuesday morning, I got my post up and then got a load in the dishwasher. I sat down for a while then got up to see if the mesclun had come up. I had been 4 days since it was planted on Saturday.

I was astounded to find 13 things had come up in 4 days.

![What's Up chart April 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23tcLdqbk2jEnAGoeN2gQoZfAsNKbc3mBoQihE1nGfWfu9SPHCA2irjh8NwYAUMLKycER.jpg)

So I set about getting the ones that were up into trays without covers. Some were up quite a lot, others just emerging. But it was a very strong showing and I don’t ever remember having so many up so soon after a sowing.

I had to keep sitting down between jobs and my helper friend arrived at 10:30AM before I had finished. He did a few chores then watered the house plants.

![Last of sauerkraut dumped crop April 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/EoeFvtLwcBTXCJDjQAcCiStuBWHzvZ2MZLRoYAFHeFii9TgmGSsEXGXmpJ1Rs6MESzF.jpg)

The sauerkraut, most of it started November 7, 2025, had started to turn mushy so we dumped what was left. But it had lasted 5 months, when normally sauerkraut only last 6 weeks.

I finished the seedlings and sat down and he went off on errands.

I had to get the rest of the dishes in the dishwasher and part of that was cleaning up the mason jars used to hold last year’s foliar ingredients. That took about an hour to do and I was ready to sit down when I finished.

I didn’t get much else done on Tuesday. I didn’t even have to tend fires as the sun had come out.

I watched ‘Leave It to Beaver’ until bedtime. I got the fires going at 7PM and pulled the shades. We are to have cold nights until Friday.

On Wednesday it’s to rain most of the day and be in the 40’s. I need to fold the laundry and put it away and I should try to get doors and windows washed. I’ll have to keep the stoves going all day.  I have an appointment mid afternoon. Maybe it would be a good day to just sit and read one of my favorite books: The Chestry Oak.

![Mini bio framed Jan 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23xyn876JURgHHjsp757ZTvXeEEBjdDeLXWynRcLCeuqwPPsqtEtXTosSPyKZdAgWivJB.jpg)

# Learn Creative Coding (#42) - Fractals: Julia Sets and Variations

![cc-banner](https://images.hive.blog/DQmX7rSRusqv16SWFmWy4UNwvjM6hq635UEA9766RR6qHLr/cc-banner-blue.png)

Last episode we built the Mandelbrot set from scratch. The core iteration -- `z = z*z + c` with `z` starting at zero and `c` being the pixel coordinate -- the smooth coloring, the cosine palettes, orbit traps, zooming. And right at the end we touched on Julia sets: same iteration formula, but now `c` is a fixed parameter and `z` starts at the pixel position.

Today we go deep on Julia sets and then beyond. There's a whole universe of fractal variations hiding behind small changes to the iteration formula. Swap a sign, take an absolute value, raise to a higher power -- each one creates an entirely new family of fractals with its own character. By the end of this episode you'll have a toolkit of fractal formulas that could keep you exploring for months.

The spiral at `c = (-0.7, 0.27015)` is my personal favorite. It produces these sweeping spiral arms that wind outward from the center, each arm decorated with smaller spirals.
