body.title: TSP vs. IRA: Where Should You Keep Your Money In?
body.body:
When a federal employee retires or separates from service, one question rises above almost every other financial decision: What should I do with my Thrift Savings Plan balance? Should I leave it where it is, or roll it into an Individual Retirement Account? The answer is not simple and the wrong decision can cost tens of thousands of dollars in unnecessary fees, taxes, and missed opportunities over a 20- or 30-year retirement.

Both the TSP and the IRA are powerful, tax-advantaged retirement vehicles. But they are not interchangeable. Each has distinct advantages in terms of cost, flexibility, investment choice, and withdrawal rules and the best option depends heavily on your specific financial situation, income needs, and long-term goals. Understanding these differences before you make any move is essential.

This guide breaks down both options clearly and objectively, covering 2026 contribution limits, fee structures, withdrawal rules, and the tax implications that apply specifically to federal employees and retirees, including those navigating the dual-jurisdiction environment in Puerto Rico.

## **Understanding the Basics**

### **What Is the TSP?**

The Thrift Savings Plan is a defined contribution retirement plan sponsored by the federal government for civilian federal employees and members of the uniformed services. It functions similarly to a 401(k) in the private sector, offering both traditional (pre-tax) and Roth (after-tax) contribution options. FERS employees receive an automatic 1% employer contribution plus matching contributions of up to 4%, making the TSP the most employer-subsidized [retirement plans](https://jlafinancialplanningpr.com/service/retirement-plans/) available to any category of U.S. worker.

According to the [Thrift Savings Plan (2026)](https://www.tsp.gov/), total TSP assets now exceed $900 billion, held across more than 7 million participant accounts. The plan offers a small selection of core institutional index funds alongside a suite of Lifecycle (L) target-date funds, all at some of the lowest expense ratios available in any retirement plan in the United States.

### **What Is an IRA?**

An Individual Retirement Account is a personal, tax-advantaged savings account that any individual with earned income can open through a financial institution. IRAs come in two primary forms; traditional IRA and Roth IRA, each with different tax treatment, contribution rules, and income eligibility thresholds. Unlike the TSP, IRAs are held outside the federal benefits system and give the account holder direct control over investment selection, provider choice, and account management.

For 2026, the IRA contribution limit is [$7,500 per year ($8,600 for individuals age 50 or older)](https://www.irs.gov/retirement-plans/plan-participant-employee/retirement-topics-ira-contribution-limits), per the IRS. This limit applies to the combined total across all traditional and Roth IRA accounts held by a single individual. Rollovers from TSP or other employer plans are not subject to this annual cap.

| **TSP — 2026 Contribution Limits**                     | **IRA — 2026 Contribution Limits**              |
| ------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------- |
| Elective Deferral Limit is $24,500                     | Base Annual Limit is $7,500                     |
| Catch-up Contribution Limit (Age 50–59, 64+) is $8,000 | Age 50+ Limit is $8,600                         |
| Catch-up Contribution Limit (Age 60–63) is $11,250     | Rollover from TSP has no limits                 |
| Annual Additions Limit is $72,000                      | Income limits (Roth); yes, it can be applicable |

## **Key Differences Between TSP and IRA**

Beyond contribution limits, the structural differences between these two account types shape every aspect of how they behave in retirement. Here is a direct comparison across the dimensions that matter most.

### **Investment Options**

The TSP offers five core index funds (G, F, C, S, and I funds) plus a range of Lifecycle target-date funds, and a mutual fund window that allows access to a broader set of external funds for an additional fee. The investment menu is intentionally limited, a feature that benefits undecided investors but constrains experienced ones who want sector exposure, REITs, international small caps, dividend strategies, or alternative asset classes. An IRA opened through a brokerage gives the account holder access to tens of thousands of individual stocks, ETFs, mutual funds, bonds, and more, with full control over portfolio construction.

### **Fees and Costs**

This is where the TSP holds a significant and largely unmatched advantage. The TSP's blended expense ratio across its core funds is approximately [0.048% — roughly $0.48 per $1,000 invested annually](https://www.tsp.gov/fund-performance/). Most actively managed IRA mutual funds charge 0.50% to 1.50% or more. Even low-cost index ETFs in an IRA typically carry expense ratios of 0.03% to 0.20%. On a $500,000 balance, the annual fee difference between TSP funds and average IRA mutual funds can run $2,500 to $7,500 per year, a material drag on compounded growth over a 20-year retirement.

### **Withdrawal Rules**

*   Both TSP and IRAs generally require account holders to be age 59½ before taking penalty-free withdrawals; withdrawals before this age trigger a 10% early withdrawal penalty in addition to ordinary income tax

*   TSP has a rule called the \

; federal employees who separate from service in the calendar year they turn 55 or older (50 for some special category employees) may take TSP withdrawals without the 10% penalty, even if under 59½

*   IRAs do not have an equivalent of the Rule of 55; the 10% penalty applies until age 59½ regardless of when you left employment

*   Required Minimum Distributions (RMDs) begin at age 73 for both traditional TSP balances and traditional IRAs under current SECURE Act 2.0 rules; Roth IRAs have no lifetime RMD requirement, while Roth TSP balances became exempt from RMDs beginning in 2024

| **Feature**                      | **TSP**                                                                    | **IRA**                                                                                                                           |
| -------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **2026 Contribution Limit**      | $24,500 with catch-up contribution limits (Age 50+) increases upto +$8,000 | $7,500 with catch-up contribution limits (Age 50+ and older) can contribute an additional +$1,100, bringing their total to $8,600 |
| **Employer Match**               | Up to 5% (FERS)                                                            | None                                                                                                                              |
| **Expense Ratio**                | \~0.048%                                                                   | Varies: 0.03%–1.50%+                                                                                                              |
| **Investment Choices**           | 5 core funds + L funds + mutual fund window                                | Virtually unlimited                                                                                                               |
| **Rule of 55 Penalty Exception** | Yes                                                                        | No                                                                                                                                |
|  **Loan Availability**           | Yes (while employed)                                                       | No                                                                                                                                |
|  **Roth RMD Requirement**        | No (since 2024)                                                            | No                                                                                                                                |

## **Pros and Cons of Keeping Your Money in TSP**

After separation, TSP balances can remain in the plan indefinitely. There is no requirement to roll the money out at retirement. For many federal employees, especially those with large balances, staying in the TSP remains the right default, particularly if cost minimization is a priority.

### **Advantages**

*   Extremely low expense ratios (\~0.048%) that virtually no private IRA provider matches on actively managed funds

*   Rule of 55 exception allows penalty-free withdrawals for employees who separate at 55 or older, earlier access than a standard IRA

*   Institutional-grade index funds backed by the federal government with no account minimums or management fees beyond the fund expense ratios

*   Protection from creditors under federal law, typically stronger than state-level IRA protections in most jurisdictions

*   Stable Value G Fund is unique to the TSP and provides government-backed returns with no market risk, unavailable in IRAs

### **Disadvantages**

*   Limited investment menu, no access to individual stocks, sector ETFs, real estate investment trusts, or specialty funds without using the mutual fund window (which carries additional fees)

*   Beneficiary rules are more restrictive than IRA inherited account rules for non-spouse beneficiaries

*   Withdrawal options, while improved in recent years, offer less flexibility than a well-structured IRA rollover account

*   No ability to do partial Roth conversions from the TSP traditional balance, a significant tax planning limitation

## **Pros and Cons of Moving to an IRA**

Rolling a TSP balance into an IRA is a major financial decision that opens up significant flexibility, but also introduces risks that must be managed carefully. Understanding both sides is essential before initiating any transfer.

### **Advantages**

The primary appeal of an IRA rollover is breadth of control. With an IRA, you choose the custodian, the investment strategy, the asset allocation, and the withdrawal structure. You can execute Roth conversions from a traditional IRA to a Roth IRA in any amount, at any time, creating powerful tax planning opportunities across the full retirement horizon. Beneficiary designations in an IRA can be more sophisticated, allowing stretched distributions for heirs or trust-based planning in ways the TSP does not accommodate. For retirees working with a qualified [investment advisor in Puerto Rico](https://jlafinancialplanningpr.com/service/investments/) or a comprehensive financial planner, an IRA also allows the advisor to manage the retirement assets within a unified, coordinated strategy alongside other accounts.

### **Disadvantages**

The most significant risk of rolling to an IRA is cost creep. An IRA held in actively managed mutual funds can easily carry expense ratios 10 to 30 times higher than the TSP's institutional index funds, a gap that compounds significantly over decades. Additionally, the Rule of 55 exception does not transfer to IRAs: if you roll your TSP to an IRA and need funds between ages 55 and 59½, the 10% early withdrawal penalty applies. Finally, the quality of an IRA depends entirely on the provider and investment selections made, a mediocre IRA can easily underperform a well-maintained TSP balance over the same period.

## **When It Makes Sense to Stay in TSP**

Staying in the TSP is the right default for many federal retirees, particularly those who prioritize low costs, value the G Fund's unique stability properties, or plan to access funds before age 59½ using the Rule of 55. If you are retiring between ages 55 and 59½ and anticipate needing regular income from your retirement savings, the TSP's penalty exemption provides real, tangible value that an IRA cannot replicate without using substantially equal periodic payments (72(t) distributions), which are inflexible and restrictive.

The TSP is also a strong choice for retirees who prefer a streamlined, low-maintenance approach and do not want the complexity of managing a broader investment portfolio. The Lifecycle funds, in particular, offer a professionally managed, automatically rebalancing strategy at near-zero cost, a genuinely hard-to-beat option for most long-term retirement investors who do not require custom asset allocation.

**Key rule:** If you retire from federal service in the calendar year you turn 55 or later and plan to access your retirement funds before age 59½, do not roll your TSP to an IRA until you no longer need that early-access window. Rolling out forfeits the Rule of 55 exception permanently.

## **When Moving to an IRA May Be Better**

An IRA rollover is most compelling when the account holder's financial planning goals exceed what the TSP can accommodate. The TSP does not allow partial Roth conversions; one of the most powerful long-term tax strategies for reducing lifetime RMD exposure and managing tax brackets in retirement. If your comprehensive retirement income strategy involves converting traditional balances to Roth over a multi-year horizon, an IRA provides the flexibility to do so in targeted, tax-efficient amounts.

Rolling to an IRA also makes sense when estate planning is a priority. The TSP's beneficiary distribution rules require non-spouse beneficiaries to take distributions relatively quickly; an inherited IRA, while also subject to the 10-year rule under SECURE Act 2.0, allows for more flexibility in how beneficiaries structure their distributions and coordinate with their own income tax situations.

**Important:** Any TSP rollover must be executed as a direct rollover to avoid mandatory 20% federal withholding on the distributed amount. A 60-day indirect rollover is permitted, but if the full amount (including the withheld 20%) is not deposited into the IRA within 60 days, the withheld portion becomes taxable income and potentially subject to a 10% early withdrawal penalty.

*Planning Scenario*

*A federal retiree at age 62 with a $650,000 TSP traditional balance and a moderate income from pension and Social Security may benefit from rolling to an IRA to execute annual Roth conversions of $30,000–$50,000 per year; filling lower tax brackets before RMDs begin at 73. This strategy, unavailable in the TSP, could reduce lifetime taxes by $40,000–$90,000 over a 20-year retirement depending on the tax environment and future RMD size.*

## **Tax Considerations You Should Not Ignore**

Tax treatment is arguably the most consequential dimension of the TSP vs. IRA decision and it is the one most often oversimplified or ignored entirely.

### **Traditional vs. Roth Implications**

Traditional TSP contributions and traditional IRA contributions are both made pre-tax and grow tax-deferred, meaning withdrawals in retirement are taxed as ordinary income. A Roth IRA, by contrast, is funded with after-tax dollars and grows entirely tax-free, with qualified withdrawals in retirement carrying no federal income tax liability. For a federal retiree who expects to be in the same or higher tax bracket in retirement than during their working years, the Roth structure is almost always more advantageous for money that will remain invested for 10 or more years.

The TSP also offers a Roth option. Importantly, since 2024, Roth TSP balances are no longer subject to RMDs, bringing them in line with Roth IRA rules. This change significantly increases the appeal of the Roth TSP as a long-term holding vehicle for participants who do not need that money in their lifetimes and intend to pass it to heirs.

### **Timing of Withdrawals**

The sequence in which you withdraw from different account types; traditional TSP or IRA, Roth TSP or Roth IRA, taxable brokerage accounts, has enormous implications for your annual tax liability in retirement. Drawing from traditional accounts in low-income years while deferring Roth withdrawals, and timing Social Security to avoid stacking multiple taxable income sources in the same year, can meaningfully reduce effective tax rates across a 20- or 30-year retirement. This kind of coordinated income withdrawal strategy is not possible within the TSP alone, it requires integrating the TSP (or an IRA rollover) with all other income sources in a unified plan.

### **Long-Term Tax Efficiency in Puerto Rico**

For federal retirees living in Puerto Rico, the tax dimension becomes even more complex. TSP and IRA distributions from traditional (pre-tax) balances are generally subject to both federal income tax and Puerto Rico local tax, depending on the nature and source of the income. Effective [financial planning in Puerto Rico](https://jlafinancialplanningpr.com/service/financial-planning/) for retirees with TSP and IRA accounts requires a coordinated analysis of both jurisdictions, including how Roth conversions, RMDs, and Social Security income interact under Puerto Rico's tax codem to minimize the combined effective tax rate and preserve more of each withdrawal for actual retirement spending.

## **Conclusion**

There is no universally correct answer to the TSP vs. IRA question. The TSP's unmatched cost structure, the G Fund's stability, and the Rule of 55 exception make it a strong default, particularly for retirees who need early access, prefer simplicity, or are cost-sensitive. For retirees with sophisticated Roth conversion goals, complex estate plans, or the need for a broader investment universe, an IRA rollover may serve the long-term strategy better.

In many cases, the optimal approach is not a binary choice. A partial rollover, moving a portion of the TSP balance to an IRA for Roth conversion flexibility while maintaining the core TSP balance for cost efficiency and the G Fund, can capture the benefits of both structures simultaneously. This kind of nuanced, multi-account approach is the hallmark of comprehensive retirement income planning.

The decision deserves careful, personalized analysis, ideally conducted with a qualified financial professional who understands both federal retirement benefits and the specific tax and regulatory environment in which you will spend your retirement. At [JLA Financial Planning](https://jlafinancialplanningpr.com/), our team works with federal employees and retirees across Puerto Rico to ensure that every retirement savings decision, including TSP and IRA strategy is made with a complete picture of the short- and long-term financial implications. Contact us to schedule a consultation and build a retirement income plan that maximizes what you have earned.

body.title: Why do people die (part 2) The old path
body.body:
https://youtu.be/0vWzEY3NPKc?si=lj7Vpd85w6A-1XiD

Human life is described in Scripture as temporary and fragile. People die because life on earth is not meant to be permanent; it is a journey that eventually leads to eternity. The Bible reminds us that our days are limited and known by God, encouraging humility and dependence on Him. Death, in this sense, is part of the human condition in a fallen world.

At the same time, the Bible shows that death is not the end of existence. While the body returns to dust, the soul continues, and each person will face God. Death becomes a passage from earthly life into eternal reality, where there is either separation from God or eternal life with Him. This gives death a serious spiritual meaning beyond physical loss.

About last night. 🧡

Another full table.
Another great night at Brasserie Millewee… one of Innopay’s friends.

Amazing food. Strong vibes.
And the kind of conversations that only happen when the right people sit together.

Big shoutout to the Romanian crew yesterday 🇷🇴🧡
Strong presence, great energy, and as always… great discussions.

Topics?
All over the place, as they should be:
- A changing world order
- Quantum computing and what it might break (or unlock)
- Geopolitics & macro
- Books, perspectives, different countries, different realities
- AI agents starting to actually do things
- European politics and what’s coming next

No script. Just curiosity.
And in between all that… Innopay getting closer to going fully live at Millewee!
Not fully there yet… but soon.

Next stop:
📍 Indie’s - 28 April - 19.00
Back where it all started.
And where Innopay is already fully live, ready to be used end-to-end.

And for those who haven’t tried it yet, with Innopay you can:
- Order directly from the menu via QR code
- Pay instantly (even in € with your usual methods)
- Avoid transaction fees eating into the merchant’s margins
- Get cashback for users

Faster service, smoother experience for everyone
Simple on the surface. Different underneath.

And if the weather behaves… terrace season might officially open!
Same people. Same energy.
See you next Tuesday. 🧡

Hoy fue un día genial para caminar por la ciudad. El clima estaba perfecto, con un cielo despejado y una brisa fresca que hacía que cada paso fuera agradable. Empecé mi ruta en el parque central, donde vi a un grupo de niños jugando fútbol. Me detuve un momento a observarlos y me hizo recordar mis días de infancia. Entre ellos, conocí a un chico llamado Lucas, que tenía una energía contagiosa y no paraba de animar a sus amigos. Más adelante, mientras paseaba por una calle llena de murales coloridos, me topé con una artista pintando una nueva obra. Su nombre es Sofía y estaba utilizando spray para crear un impresionante retrato de un pájaro. Me contó que se inspira en la naturaleza y que siempre busca transmitir un mensaje de conservación a través de su arte. Me encantó conversar con ella y aprender sobre su proceso creativo. A lo largo del recorrido, también disfruté de las pequeñas tiendas locales y de los aromas de los cafés que se alineaban en la calle. Al final del día, llegué a casa con una sonrisa y muchas historias nuevas que contar. body.title: 去丁香湖险些被冻死
body.body:
说起来已经很久没有去丁香湖吹风了，上次去好像还是大冬天带儿子登上湖心岛看雪——嗯，那次他被冻感冒了，病了好几天。

![20260422_132357.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWMcPyaE7699b3uK8G3jkMJMBigoFpABzT84Q9mVLkd6d/20260422_132357.jpg)

现在春暖花开，去丁香湖看看风景应该不错，看外边阳光也好，肯定不会被冻到。于是中午午饭过后，我就动员媳妇一起去丁香湖遛弯、晒太阳。

媳妇说晒太阳就在家里小院晒呗，跑那么远干啥？我反驳到那能一样嘛？小院也没有湖呀。

就这样说服了媳妇，一起来丁香湖遛弯，不过出发前她觉得风有些凉，特意顺了一件儿子的绒衣。我则是半袖加薄外套，这都什么时候了，还穿绒衣！

结果到了丁香湖，我晕，风好大，好冷。
![20260422_131438.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd3GAGnjVwTfBfx3WzUGwMt9ZyK5ABxVXbb3S1DhrDCeE/20260422_131438.jpg)

让我想起了寒号鸟的那句：***哆啰啰，哆啰啰，寒风冻死我，明天就做窝。***
![20260422_131444.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZVadKKRrTjTyLDBLgPJBh2KVJdjnSxp4ZVcESeUyrc77/20260422_131444.jpg)

好吧，做窝到不必了，只是后悔没多带件外套
![20260422_131456.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZAxQqt7C5ZvV8U6MaSvfb9Mat4hXEcBVbpsZLqwcjpqN/20260422_131456.jpg)

不过阳光和风景还真不错（可惜这张拍虚了）
![20260422_131503.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYmAAjhUpqbKRSDJBFMFnzK3HH69YPChM7HdaRBMDjdo7/20260422_131503.jpg)

我们又来这边看火车
![20260422_132320.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbSNMb6BEb81ieW6dfJu3UhoM7hYqHMh3bUVzjZKdFmbh/20260422_132320.jpg)

其实窝最喜欢拍货运列车，但是风太凉，不想走太远过去拍货运列车了
![20260422_132352.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS1BWRhzdbCNHAYrEUSTDjA5Wtg9ZhJStmzK5dk7H2Ha3/20260422_132352.jpg)

拍拍大桥
![20260422_132357.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWMcPyaE7699b3uK8G3jkMJMBigoFpABzT84Q9mVLkd6d/20260422_132357.jpg)

发现一列复兴号高铁
![20260422_132406.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUK8PvwfYqoc8cBRuMQjd84q8jnyZgYtpcVuDZzq3vNwE/20260422_132406.jpg)

换这边转转
![20260422_132728.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXaeGHBn5sPSSwZ85t9qkovo6Xc9JkXsqBzSuPuU72yEE/20260422_132728.jpg)

这是什么东西呢？可能是运营商的信号塔
![20260422_132748.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRyqh9Ya7PKdhrViir7Gdq9UCG1soNrZTATR1raD7QFm3/20260422_132748.jpg)

湛蓝的湖水
![20260422_132905.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTrToRTXXPUHxTwtnUCr55Unn78i86Cj7FxHDwEaCdSEv/20260422_132905.jpg)

冬天我们上去看风景的湖心岛，春夏秋除了乘船，没法上去
![20260422_132925.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTAUAsdNcaqTBRcN1vTCesnMsvhot3F7ZAZcY9vcUFN9L/20260422_132925.jpg)

这时候如果有顶帐篷挡风，那是相当不错的。
![20260422_133001.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYj1qj116au3AFDbeQFR4F3zc2k3iZMjtbvUoPT5RzxFN/20260422_133001.jpg)

这湖水看着像蓝宝石一样赏心悦目呀
![20260422_133308.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSSE2V1VjphjyiicdL2tDtuxBsjXwReBdpmEheqB9r7hb/20260422_133308.jpg)

赏心悦目虽好，但是冷得受不了，媳妇穿着绒衣嘲笑我非要来丁香湖，在家小院里晒太阳多好呀。

于是我们赶紧打道回府，回家在院子里继续晒太阳！早知如此，不折腾了。

body.title: Limited space and complete freedom.
body.body:
Limited space and complete freedom. You know, you can only understand that our space is limited when someone tells you about it. Yes, this understanding comes from outside; this knowledge, for example, came to the inhabitants of some continents or islands only when the Chukchelanders arrived and made them understand that the world was much larger and they were enclosed by an invisible wall of coastlines and vast oceans. I think this wasn't the most pleasant news, since the islanders could have lived happily up until that moment, and suddenly their idyll was shattered by such news. Also, we don't like it when someone limits our space, but we ourselves easily limit it to others, for example, when holding a cat within the walls of an apartment, or examining a beetle, the movements of a cat are limited by the plane of our palm. ![72artstorDSC05999.png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmdsR5h9W3ZB6XNX3ryxHhRPc24tp6BWLh7TmJLZMWmQiv/72artstorDSC05999.png) It's truly frustrating and annoying when you want to see and learn more, but someone has made sure your horizons are narrowed. ![69artstorDSC04944.png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmNgBWFU3jQGnFg5me5VDb1v488qekvSLi16soVmTzpbwp/69artstorDSC04944.png) As for freedom, against the backdrop of a limited space, it feels like permissiveness, like someone letting a dog sleep on their bed, or something else where social distancing is required, but that's already a restriction on freedom :) ![12artstorIMG_20230613_121537_199.png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmXwarA7DqjMfZYozapEz5C3r45gNQgNX8TmTbTajy9S4z/12artstorIMG_20230613_121537_199.png) --- Below you can see my containers with data that I collect in INLEO and always have quick access to them it is very convenient. body.title: Digimon Survive [Let's Play] - 69 - Murals
body.body:
***Truthful Route: Session 16! Half of this session was spent on random battles. The other half is catching up with the team and the professor on what they feel about the last chapter.**


----

**Digimon Survive** is a Digimon Visual Novel with Turn-based strategy battles. It follows a group of children stranded in another world. They form bonds with the creators there called Digimon as they desperate attempts to find a way back home. I already finished one route of the game, and now I'm publishing my playthrough of the Truthful Route!

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZ4g9qwMPrzB8c5iPSz1z1NByfy6N8CBW81QiZEfQ9fwf/1000072283.webp 


Digimon Survive is the darkest piece of Digimon media I ever consumed while still being PG13. What I love the most about **Digimon Survive**, is how it uniquely blends Digital Monsters with Japanese folklore. It's amazing how the idea of \

integrates seamlessly with Digimon lore. The specific Digimon they choose for this game enhance this theme.

Digimon Survive is the closest modern entry to the *old school* Digimon anime vibes. Though, more than the earlier Digimon anime series, the game reminds me more of **Shin Megami Tensei: Devil Survivor** series. In that series too, characters may die depending on your actions.

Below you can watch my playthrough of Digimon Survive, and the link to the whole playlist.

**THIS PLAYTHROUGH IS MODDED:** I installed the [Improved Translation Mod](https://gamebanana.com/mods/459533) and the [Quirky Dialogue Font Mod.](https://gamebanana.com/mods/459571) This playthrough should look a bit different from the official version.


----

### Watch on YouTube:


https://youtu.be/tp-Y8tgRP90


**Playlist:**

```
 https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLt3R7_tP1xaH9mASCoJsRIYN96RihTAtI
```

### Truthful Route - 16: Murals

While studying the Murals in the shrine, the professor reveals that the old photo of Haru and Miyuki was an old photo he took with his sister. Miyuki is his sister... So who is this Haru with her?

I like the foreshadowing here, and since we know Haru's true identity from the last route, it makes even more sense now!


----

body.body:
While our progress has been slow some years ([see all previous reports here](https://peakd.com/@ecobanker)), 2026 is shaping up to be a very exciting year for ECOBANK Development Colombia SAS as we get into Quarter 2 of the year.

<center>https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ecoinstant/AJeaLakKDKB4wAcWmGifbJhTxAuySiNW4v5EAABS94MX6nk33kHFz2Q5NaL915i.png
</center>

Our ECOBANK token is currently holding around $1.40 in our pool - HSBIDAO:ECOBANK.  Yes, thats ~22.6 HIVE at these prices. HSBIDAO is a completely HP-backed token, it pays dividends (even when in the pool), and has recently been integrated into the new @three.legacy game, which has generated some sustainable buy pressure on the token.  

This is right on time and right in line with our goals for 2026 - finally some deep and real, dynamic, continuous liquidity, now steady as the 20th deepest pool on Hive-Engine!  With HIVE price so low, we are not offended by HIVE-maxis seriously considering the trade as we continue to move up.


<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ecoinstant/Eo44sKKoWtdBSvRQjbFWakqK8V6jPs7sKFSJwHVMh4DTA31CVr3DrRxCjoL1VgZZFbn.png)
</center>


Let's take a look at the state of our token.  Our original raise attempt minted 250,000 Ecobank tokens - and over the last several months we have been engaging in buybacks as available and as part of getting our liquidity pool into position.

## Current stats shot:
Ecobank Supply: 250,000
Currently in Circulation: 119,353.5
Debts from Phase 1: ~few (research required, its on the to-do list)


## What are our plans moving forward?

We have big plans this year, hopefully selling our hotel as [mentioned previously](https://peakd.com/hive-186392/@ecoinstant/ecobank-q1-2026-update-now-with-improved-liquidity), but also doing a deal that involves trading our ECOBANK tokens for more land.  

This deal - its a big deal - is very exciting for us, and is proposed as following, using 122,000 of the minted but non-circulated tokens to bring the full 80 hectare property into our company:


`Proposed Token outlay for Phase 2 - La Virginia: 122,000 / 250k`
`Current Projected corporate holdings of tokens: 8,646.5 / 250k`


One of the other interesting results of a deal like this will be to position us a lot better if we end up selling our hotel \

.  To have more land than ever, and cash on hand - that will be a very great position to find ourselves in!

## Slow and Steady wins the Race (even in Crypto)

I have had so many emotions over the years about ECOBANK.  Frequently it has occurred to me that I probably did not need to do all this extra work at all, I could have just managed my own portfolio (which I have to do anyway).  But 2026 is shaping up to be a very good year for our project, and what is coming highlights some of the benefits we were tracking and aiming for when we set this all up in the first place.

We are always open to feedback, I try to maintain a posting frequency for ECOBANK of at least once per quarter - to keep open the lines of communication and keep all our participants in the loop.  So ask me anything - we continue forward :)

## Freedom and Friendship

body.title: Spotting flawed AI content on tokenization
body.body:
![header](https://media.sdafintech.com/cracked-kwh-coin-grok-landscape-20260422.jpeg)

🧭 **Spotting flawed AI content on tokenization**

AI-generated guides on \

are everywhere. Much of it sounds smart — and quietly gets the fundamentals wrong in ways that would sink a real project.

Using a recent article as a teaching example, four flaws worth recognizing:

**1. \

is an oxymoron.** kWh prices are volatile. A token that moves with energy output is not stable.
**2. Illegal in EU / US.** MiCA Art. 40 bans yield on stablecoins. The SEC treats yield-bearing stablecoins as unregistered securities.
**3. No redemption mechanism.** No way to redeem for kWh, fiat, assets, or company shares = no peg.
**4. Smart contracts can't create PPAs.** A Power Purchase Agreement is a signed legal contract with a utility. A token can't substitute for counterparty obligations and human negotiation.

**Why this matters:** RWA tokenization is serious engineering + serious regulation. SDA is MiCA Article 6 under Finland's FIN-FSA, 100M fixed supply on Solana. Revenue distribution begins only after Phase 2 regulatory acceptance.

Fundamentals first. Marketing second.

🔗 https://ericaai.tech.blog/2026/04/17/how-to-build-an-energy-backed-stablecoin-platform-for-sustainable-finance/

body.body: > After being kicked off a high platform, I took cover from Regalla's special arrows before returning fire. The platform collapsed, forcing the duel onto the arena ground where I tried to use the Sunwing for an advantage. Ultimately, a mix of melee and ranged combat allowed me to pin Regalla down. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbWPCKn3kdFvFzM9Vfrkoen7KDXP1DQiN2rbWf39BN9u7/screenshot_1_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdCtZZ2SEGyJw6uW3pb91dHrDh2n3NvukGTiMn7oeJBho/screenshot_2_.png) After kicking Aloy off that high platform, Regalla started shooting her with arrows immediately to finish the job. Aloy took cover real fast behind some wooden crates. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWYVhsjBwSPMxXFfnXA5rfhSLyjcSrJnYjVCbqoR2sAiL/screenshot_3_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVjDPimpPMYK5BYTJCmiLtChm84ZseKV1FTLb1RnSeaGW/screenshot_4_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme5j1uhovbSQQt1xyiJztr21ULqDcUh3LZz13QqduoUXc/screenshot_5_.png) Taking cover was not enough because Regalla was shooting with special arrows that could break regular defenses. I realized I could not stay hidden forever, so I had to come out and shoot her back with my own bow. We traded several shots across the gap, with each arrow striking closer to the mark. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS9Hph3kBSX3hPHQJu5Gq9PAJjwTY4KatVt78NgngWjv4/screenshot_6_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT2fhpf4qcr4NoFWRDWDtRZucTcYP9oA4Ntbxh3RHGjjA/screenshot_7_.png) When Regalla understood she was not winning this battle in this way as well, she changed her target to the environment itself. She aimed and shot the platform beneath my foot, causing the old structure to shatter into pieces. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRohbwr3NMhvBSAKws1bXEofjh7choQauGogrpCVQLxDN/screenshot_8_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRQjy5xLBS6Fggha7opoyBye9vVb7oMLRGZXUmjscHkbp/screenshot_9_.png) The platform collapsed completely and Aloy landed on the arena ground with a heavy thud. Regalla did not hesitate and jumped down to face her as well, landing gracefully in the sand. The duel had moved from the heights to the dusty floor of the arena, and there was nowhere left for either of us to hide. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS2MUwYqZbYjrpXg5n9KcSN7nK5rM4HaoXehQBMXRKtcs/screenshot_10_.png) Now I finally got a chance to fight her face-to-face again, though she looked like a very tough opponent. I knew this part of the fight would require perfect timing and a lot of focus to survive. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmczwgbEiCaWSdM9cg3WfD66HqB2yfS99yohnyzUwzThP6/screenshot_11_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb24NF3RR4iHWyKapnQMJMurB6K32dozM841ZBxPs3iSj/screenshot_12_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNhdfNB8YGYnqm23sECMGTg2WJ1JNwtoZ2qRV2mCuG45Q/screenshot_13_.png) I called my Sunwing to the arena and used my pull caster to climb onto the machine's back. I was hoping I could use the machine's power to take Regalla down easily from the air or with a powerful strike. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXuLmagY7DMBRJUDmN7mSiSZNfmCKRnP6MY5B64L8qyqz/screenshot_14_.png) But it looked like the Sunwing was only for a ride during this specific encounter, not for direct combat action. I could not trigger any of its weapons, so I climbed down after I landed back in the arena. I realized I would have to settle this duel with my own hands and weapons. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY3sPUtqL2tgfty9xPqrW9WbMT3GUGCK2ZVJsnSMyTduq/screenshot_15_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaJYyy1sa4ZH4cLmBumRenoisiquUrsfYjwhAETomDSpU/screenshot_16_.png) I started fighting Regalla with melee weapons, using my spear to block her strikes and find openings in her armor. Sometimes I used my ranged weapons after getting away from her to keep the pressure on. At last, after a very long and exhausting struggle, I pinned her down and ended the fight. --- The next post will be coming soon. Screenshots are my take from the game and I took the game logo that I used on the thumbnail picture from online. SEE YOU. --- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=frankevor/dabc84c2)

She aimed and shot the platform beneath my foot, causing the old structure to shatter into pieces. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRohbwr3NMhvBSAKws1bXEofjh7choQauGogrpCVQLxDN/screenshot_8_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRQjy5xLBS6Fggha7opoyBye9vVb7oMLRGZXUmjscHkbp/screenshot_9_.png) The platform collapsed completely and Aloy landed on the arena ground with a heavy thud. Regalla did not hesitate and jumped down to face her as well, landing gracefully in the sand. The duel had moved from the heights to the dusty floor of the arena, and there was nowhere left for either of us to hide. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS2MUwYqZbYjrpXg5n9KcSN7nK5rM4HaoXehQBMXRKtcs/screenshot_10_.png) Now I finally got a chance to fight her face-to-face again, though she looked like a very tough opponent. I knew this part of the fight would require perfect timing and a lot of focus to survive. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmczwgbEiCaWSdM9cg3WfD66HqB2yfS99yohnyzUwzThP6/screenshot_11_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb24NF3RR4iHWyKapnQMJMurB6K32dozM841ZBxPs3iSj/screenshot_12_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNhdfNB8YGYnqm23sECMGTg2WJ1JNwtoZ2qRV2mCuG45Q/screenshot_13_.png) I called my Sunwing to the arena and used my pull caster to climb onto the machine's back. I was hoping I could use the machine's power to take Regalla down easily from the air or with a powerful strike. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXuLmagY7DMBRJUDmN7mSiSZNfmCKRnP6MY5B64L8qyqz/screenshot_14_.png) But it looked like the Sunwing was only for a ride during this specific encounter, not for direct combat action. I could not trigger any of its weapons, so I climbed down after I landed back in the arena. I realized I would have to settle this duel with my own hands and weapons. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY3sPUtqL2tgfty9xPqrW9WbMT3GUGCK2ZVJsnSMyTduq/screenshot_15_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaJYyy1sa4ZH4cLmBumRenoisiquUrsfYjwhAETomDSpU/screenshot_16_.png) I started fighting Regalla with melee weapons, using my spear to block her strikes and find openings in her armor. Sometimes I used my ranged weapons after getting away from her to keep the pressure on. At last, after a very long and exhausting struggle, I pinned her down and ended the fight. --- The next post will be coming soon. Screenshots are my take from the game and I took the game logo that I used on the thumbnail picture from online. SEE YOU.

body.title: DCrops Starter Pack Costs 79.9 HIVE – Includes Land, Seeds, Fertilizers and More
body.body:
![DCrops Starter Pack Costs 79.9 HIVE.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/2432SCwvXsHG2MNrNwLGuhMSYyJYJ3wYTxeyKdX3FSzMxwruFRp7bT6fduDhiotbzNHi1.png)


In Hive games the starting investment is almost similar in all games. As we saw in #arcadecolony games there were Moon Karts, StakeHouseDen and some other games where you had to buy starter pack cards in the beginning.

In StakeHouseDen you had to buy Lady Luck pack cards. From these you get some random cards which help you start the game. Similarly in Moonkarts you have to buy random NFT cards and also in other games.

In the same way in the DCrops farming game you also have to buy a starter pack which gives you a good start in the game. It is absolute that to play any Hive game making an initial investment is very necessary. 

In Splinterlands until you buy the Spellbook you cannot play ranked matches. Similarly in DCrops it is necessary to buy land, plots, seeds, fertilizer and other items for a start in the game.

![Screenshot 2026-04-22 104614.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23xp4cSxqpkM3zHnextzrqXN9kKNCz64CF6qpvqp7ToSHTPAvX6bb3WrogUbd955hrBFf.png)

You can buy all these individually but in the starter pack you get many useful things together that help you in the beginning of the game. As I showed in the image in the starter pack you get some seeds which you can grow and start your farming and harvesting. 

These include Clover, Bok Choy, Asparagus, Artichoke, along with starter land and a cooking pot.

As soon as you buy the starter pack you will get your first land NFT and one seed NFT. Along with this you also get a bundle of twenty mystery seeds, twenty Speed Grow and twenty fertilizers. These items are used in the game.

![Screenshot 2026-04-22 104627.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23ywkowNhFVKr7tPqHfpPRYfvyFtbdDcrWsZiKGhr6T4Jqt62nUjLneArshYZtQKuHqQ4.png)

What happens is that when you get land you start growing these seeds on it. After farming when the time comes for harvesting, you harvest the crops and then sell them or buy more land or seeds and reinvest that money to expand your lands.

You can also buy more than one starter pack but remember that after the second starter pack you will not get land NFTs. You only get land in the first two starter packs. After that you will have to buy land separately with new investment or from your reinvested earnings.

Now lets talk about the price of one starter pack. The price of one starter pack is 5 dollars which is very reasonable. You can pay for it using HIVE, HBD, Swap.Hive  through Hive Keychain. 

![Screenshot 2026-04-22 104646.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23xyhpSotNSJPuy4r9kLAFjwMxdPCuMUZqbVydgPpN6SvzUcWRNq8ofVawCnR6M4tPQgd.png)

Recently according to Hive price by paying 79.9 HIVE you can get one starter pack. You can buy it instantly through a Hivekeychain transaction.

After that you can properly start your farming. I am going to buy the starter pack very soon and I will share my game journey with you like which seeds I farmed and how I harvested them.

What you guys think about this game? have you started your journey? will be glad to see your answers in the comment section.

What do you people think about this monster? Have you ever played with this monster? Tell about its any ability you know. Will be glad to see your answers in the comment section.

I hope you find this post useful and informative.. If you do, please remember to reblog it so that it reaches as many people as possible and that they can benefit the most from it. Also remember to upvote which will help me financially and grow my account.

body.title: Recharge my energy from surrounding nature around my brother’s condominium
body.body: /> Although staying in a condominium seems to be boring for some people, including me (who is a nature lover), I try to recharge my energy from surrounding nature around my brother’s condominium whenever I visit my mom there. Starting in the morning, I usually go down the condominium to the swimming pool area, which is located next to the Chao Phraya River, to see the gorgeous sunrise over the river. The reflection of the sunlight on the river always attracts my eyes, it’s very fascinating.

/> [https://www.youtube.com/shorts/mbpwoTj69Xk](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/mbpwoTj69Xk) [https://www.tiktok.com/@user5092674948674/video/7630259787556474133](https://www.tiktok.com/@user5092674948674/video/7630259787556474133) The long-tailed boat is one of the most attractive things that I enjoy watching. It’s good to see the simple way of life of those people who live near the river. When the Chao Phraya River is at low level, I can see some birds walking on the river mud. They are so lovely.

/> [https://www.youtube.com/shorts/cNvy7WO0ECY](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/cNvy7WO0ECY) [https://www.tiktok.com/@user5092674948674/video/7630631286608088341](https://www.tiktok.com/@user5092674948674/video/7630631286608088341) While walking around, I can also recharge my energy by sunbathing. The sunlight in the morning is so soft and warm which makes me feel so good. Not only me, but this cute little animal also enjoyed its life by the river.

/> [https://www.youtube.com/shorts/4l-x39Jz2Iw](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/4l-x39Jz2Iw) [https://www.tiktok.com/@user5092674948674/video/7630019721118616852](https://www.tiktok.com/@user5092674948674/video/7630019721118616852) When it was sunset, I enjoyed watching the gorgeous sun with golden sky from my brother’s room on the 31st floor. We would like to inform the community that the distribution of GLYPH tokens via the rebot is temporarily suspended.

This pause is necessary to allow us to rebuild a sufficient reserve from the market, with the goal of resuming a more balanced and sustainable distribution in the future, although at a slightly reduced rate.
At present, the distribution pace exceeds our ability to buy back tokens, which requires an adjustment. However, offers can still be submitted and will be processed gradually.

We remind everyone that the GLYPH token was originally created for experimental and educational purposes, particularly for developing and optimizing automated rebots.
In parallel, improvements are being made across several areas (HP, ARCHON, CENT, NEOXIAN, ALIVE HEARTBEAT, power, etc.) to increase our daily buyback capacity.

body.title: Wire sculptures/Esculturas de alambre(ENG-ESP)
body.body:
Hello photography enthusiasts. Yesterday I visited the city's cultural center and found a new exhibition of metal and wire sculptures. As always, the artist depicts the construction of windmills, always conveying a message about their meaning and the one Cervantes captured in his masterpiece, *Don Quixote*.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ98we5hJtcpwUrDXG1rzyKRmqK6qgqc7qiNTSEYzEkzL/img_20260420_101122_336.jpg)

It also always brings with it the message about the presence of the patron saint of Cuba, who always protects us, the Virgin Mary of Charity of Cobre, known in religions of African origin as Oshun, the owner of the rivers and honey.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS44MvWev9z6nteRFqrLYNs5xqyZYccEjAu4JTiqkPsCB/img_20260420_101134_465.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRRmsDEAjpgLkz6LdXAra5eDsCjwiKXUEuBig1zamZ8vV/img_20260420_101224_245.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaP1v96nsjYqqvLhRGk6UY7HWxT8hCymzSTj9PRVVj4i7/img_20260420_101231_343.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTYVezx5sZTbSTi2pyYBgJYsgJ94n1fJNqAiMuDTwkeiH/img_20260420_101250_228.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPD5ACnckhF2cBkRTa9Fcm7nWafNRWPjtP6HtNdi6x69F/img_20260420_101300_054.jpg)

Other figures are presented as if they were part of the author's own personal bestiary.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTKxD881ZYC7KiyHw4wiX1QjBqPUmxbjeYMQdTt7JfQTV/img_20260420_101339_587.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVbLtG7ijXMvyGknU5g7rujUGVQ19HVxSDVBGoZxPwuP9/img_20260420_101415_376.jpg)

The presence of chess pieces is also common, suggesting that life is a game of strategies in this struggle against windmills (giants).
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeGAvx2PY19mSsduiA7ndtntJxXmAAsmMLZD7xztCF836/img_20260420_101426_923.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWfrGR5Xvxpjyh22yrtUT5BanwRKbf1Bmi92nwaFV3ztU/img_20260420_101502_252.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWxtPDVak9LcNk7Fr7SH3LEDWmYQtzhdGmwVCnJK6hxyT/img_20260420_101511_913.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdve8yM9DroZoUsL8XNdxAEed9NYPpDzabGLNGm6qa1Bk/img_20260420_101531_515.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYoz9F6k7jX5gZKPB5f4bTnMBHY4FjB5Jb1tiBibHwQEY/img_20260420_101635_421.jpg)

Finally, the solitary man, showing how lonely this world can be or how lonely we can be in it.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRZkJnK5UgBkNd5WUPF7gywNPAJaqxBy2Lk43T6WeXuxf/img_20260420_101400_398.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXMP5ERFBMvo2ajfgAwH2M7djPwMprKo3b9nnRoo5wjWt/texto_11_.jpg)

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZgEYwbWXsPtnALCquFf8frbap3fDb9s56qGhCcPDj5KD/_al_nhyamar78_1_.jpg)</center>

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVY4EGuTB3o3vzY8R4UPP3dV29hXJfLBVDNx5eRYcTprx/versi_n_en_espa_ol_2_.jpg)</center>

Hola amigos de la fotografía. Ayer visité la casa de la cultura de la ciudad y encontré una nueva exposición de esculturas de metal y alambre. Como siempre su autor nos muestra la construcción de los molinos, siempre con un mensaje sobre su significado y el que Cervantes deja plasmado en su obra Maestra El ingenioso Hidalgo Don quijote de la Mancha.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ98we5hJtcpwUrDXG1rzyKRmqK6qgqc7qiNTSEYzEkzL/img_20260420_101122_336.jpg)

También siempre trae consigo el mensaje sobre la presencia de la patrona de Cuba, que siempre nos protege La Virgen María de la Cardad del Cobre, conocida en las religiones de origen africano como Oshún, la dueña de los ríos y la miel.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS44MvWev9z6nteRFqrLYNs5xqyZYccEjAu4JTiqkPsCB/img_20260420_101134_465.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRRmsDEAjpgLkz6LdXAra5eDsCjwiKXUEuBig1zamZ8vV/img_20260420_101224_245.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaP1v96nsjYqqvLhRGk6UY7HWxT8hCymzSTj9PRVVj4i7/img_20260420_101231_343.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTYVezx5sZTbSTi2pyYBgJYsgJ94n1fJNqAiMuDTwkeiH/img_20260420_101250_228.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPD5ACnckhF2cBkRTa9Fcm7nWafNRWPjtP6HtNdi6x69F/img_20260420_101300_054.jpg)

Otras figuras se presentan como si fueran parte de un bestiario particular del autor.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTKxD881ZYC7KiyHw4wiX1QjBqPUmxbjeYMQdTt7JfQTV/img_20260420_101339_587.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVbLtG7ijXMvyGknU5g7rujUGVQ19HVxSDVBGoZxPwuP9/img_20260420_101415_376.jpg)

También es usual a presencia de fichas de Ajedrez como planteándonos que la vida es un juego de estrategias en esta lucha contra los molinos(Gigantes)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeGAvx2PY19mSsduiA7ndtntJxXmAAsmMLZD7xztCF836/img_20260420_101426_923.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWfrGR5Xvxpjyh22yrtUT5BanwRKbf1Bmi92nwaFV3ztU/img_20260420_101502_252.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWxtPDVak9LcNk7Fr7SH3LEDWmYQtzhdGmwVCnJK6hxyT/img_20260420_101511_913.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdve8yM9DroZoUsL8XNdxAEed9NYPpDzabGLNGm6qa1Bk/img_20260420_101531_515.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYoz9F6k7jX5gZKPB5f4bTnMBHY4FjB5Jb1tiBibHwQEY/img_20260420_101635_421.jpg)

Por último el hombre solitario, mostrando lo solo que puede ser este mundo o lo solitario que podemos estar en el.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRZkJnK5UgBkNd5WUPF7gywNPAJaqxBy2Lk43T6WeXuxf/img_20260420_101400_398.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSc7JwGNfhUMw5Wywv3gQkhRwF3jo366vaiZUD2UNGYAt/texto_12_.jpg)

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZgEYwbWXsPtnALCquFf8frbap3fDb9s56qGhCcPDj5KD/_al_nhyamar78_1_.jpg)</center>

body.title: MBA Colleges in Madurai – Solamalai College of Engineering
body.body:
Choosing the right institution for management studies is a critical step for students who aspire to build successful careers in business, leadership, and entrepreneurship. With increasing competition across industries, an MBA degree has become a valuable qualification that equips individuals with the knowledge and skills required to manage organizations effectively. Among the well-known [MBA colleges in Madurai](https://www.solamalaice.ac.in/mba.html), Solamalai College of Engineering offers a structured and career-oriented MBA program designed to meet modern industry expectations.

### The Rising Demand for MBA Education

In today’s dynamic business environment, companies seek professionals who can think strategically, solve complex problems, and lead teams efficiently. An MBA program helps students develop these essential skills by providing a comprehensive understanding of business operations. From finance and marketing to human resources and operations, MBA graduates are trained to handle various managerial roles.

Madurai has emerged as a growing hub for higher education, offering quality management programs at an affordable cost. The city provides a balanced environment that supports both academic learning and professional growth, making it a preferred destination for MBA aspirants.

### MBA Program Structure and Specializations

The MBA program at the college is structured to cover core business disciplines along with specialized areas. Students gain knowledge in finance, marketing, human resource management, and operations, allowing them to choose a field that aligns with their career goals.

The curriculum integrates theoretical learning with practical applications. Teaching methods include case studies, group discussions, presentations, and project work. These methods help students develop analytical thinking, problem-solving abilities, and decision-making skills.

### Practical Learning and Industry Exposure

One of the key highlights of the MBA program is its emphasis on practical learning. Students are encouraged to participate in internships, industrial visits, and live projects that provide exposure to real business environments. These experiences help bridge the gap between classroom learning and industry requirements.

The college regularly organizes workshops, seminars, and guest lectures by industry experts. These sessions provide insights into current market trends, business strategies, and emerging opportunities. Interaction with professionals helps students understand the expectations of the corporate world.

### Faculty and Teaching Approach

The faculty at Solamalai College of Engineering consists of experienced academicians and industry professionals who bring valuable knowledge to the classroom. Their teaching approach focuses on concept clarity, interactive learning, and continuous assessment.

Students benefit from personalized mentoring, which helps them improve their academic performance and plan their careers effectively. The supportive learning environment encourages participation and innovation.

### Skill Development and Training

In addition to academic knowledge, the college places strong emphasis on skill development. Training programs are conducted to enhance communication skills, leadership abilities, teamwork, and aptitude. These skills are essential for success in professional environments.

Students also receive guidance in presentation skills, group discussions, and interview techniques. This comprehensive training ensures that they are well-prepared for recruitment processes and workplace challenges.

### Placement Opportunities

Placement support is a major factor for students selecting MBA colleges in Madurai. Solamalai College of Engineering has a dedicated placement cell that actively works to connect students with leading companies across various sectors.

The placement team conducts mock interviews, resume-building sessions, and career guidance programs to prepare students for job opportunities. Graduates can pursue careers in banking, finance, marketing, human resources, operations, and other business domains.

### Infrastructure and Campus Facilities

The college provides modern infrastructure to support academic and extracurricular activities. The campus includes well-equipped classrooms, computer labs, seminar halls, and a library with a wide range of resources. These facilities create a conducive environment for learning and research.

Students also have access to spaces for group discussions and collaborative projects, enhancing their overall educational experience.

### Extracurricular Activities and Student Engagement

A well-rounded education includes participation in extracurricular activities. The college encourages students to take part in management fests, business competitions, cultural events, and sports. These activities help develop leadership qualities, teamwork, and interpersonal skills.

Such experiences contribute to overall personality development and prepare students for professional roles.

### Entrepreneurship and Innovation

The college promotes entrepreneurship by encouraging students to explore innovative ideas and business opportunities. Through various initiatives, students are guided in developing business plans and understanding market dynamics.

This focus on entrepreneurship prepares students to start their own ventures and adapt to changing business environments.

### Why Choose This College?

Among the MBA colleges in Madurai, Solamalai College of Engineering stands out for its balanced approach to education. It combines academic excellence, practical learning, skill development, and placement support to create a comprehensive learning experience.

The institution’s commitment to continuous improvement ensures that students receive education that is relevant to current industry needs. This approach helps students build strong foundations for successful careers.

### Conclusion

Pursuing an MBA is a significant step toward building a successful career in management. Choosing the right institution is essential to gain the knowledge, skills, and exposure required for professional growth. Among the leading [MBA colleges in Madurai](https://www.solamalaice.ac.in/), Solamalai College of Engineering offers a well-rounded program that prepares students for the challenges of the modern business world.

With its strong academic framework, experienced faculty, practical learning opportunities, and dedicated placement support, the college provides a solid foundation for future managers and leaders. For students seeking quality MBA education in Madurai, it remains a dependable and career-focused choice.

body.title: Morning Care for My Avocado Tree 🌱💧
body.body:
There’s something peaceful about starting the day in the garden. This morning, I spent some time watering my avocado tree, and it reminded me how important these simple routines are for healthy plant 
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUAda2TuQXUhC3qJ7WAQXTshYCT2Rhr237C5AskJhjFeW/1776857104804.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVJ3GBKLdQvcMq4Nn3FPAd3LBwWHmG5rqo1J6hrrbSLdt/1776857105052.jpg)


.
The sun was already shining bright, and you could see how the leaves responded instantly to the water—fresh, vibrant, and full of life. Watching the water splash against the green leaves felt refreshing, not just for the plant, but for me as well.
What makes me even more excited is seeing the early fruit development. The small avocados are beginning to form, a clear sign that the tree is doing well and responding to proper care. Moments like this give me hope for a good harvest ahead.
Taking care of crops is more than just a task—it’s a daily connection with nature. Every drop of water, every leaf, and every small fruit tells a story of patience and consistency.
I’m looking forward to seeing how this tree progresses in the coming weeks. Farming truly teaches us to trust the process.

body.title: Someone has to know
body.body:
You never know when it will be the last time https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/aT546sv3yxC6s3iJAQ96Zviyce8.jpg
[Source ](https://www.themoviedb.org/tv/297454-alguien-tiene-que-saber/images/backdrops)
Edited in Photoshop & Canva App
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/245cUBXzvWF8QVukk8UvqTFX6FutvCzv1TyGDA8ybnR5QKA1v6nMvGS4j6y81Qg9M2HLn.jpg
I stumbled across this Chilean miniseries on Netflix. I was intrigued to watch it when I realized the lead actor was Alfredo Castro, a Chilean actor whose work I admire and whom I've followed for a long time. I had no idea what the story was about, but the actor's presence was reason enough to embark on this adventure. Although it has eight episodes, I thought it would be too long, like some other productions, but no, not all the episodes are an hour long; some are shorter, so it's a quick watch. Besides, the story is interesting enough to keep you watching all the episodes in a row. The plot is an adaptation, of course, of a real case I wasn't familiar with, in which some facts and names are changed, and some situations are dramatized. The crime it addresses is a case that, from what I could see and as mentioned in the series itself, shocked Chile in the 1980s, and to this day, no one has been convicted. It's highly unlikely that it will ever be fully solved. Some of the suspects have even died. The real case, which seems like it will never be fully solved, deals with the disappearance and subsequent murder of young Jorge Matute Johns. I recommend you look up information online after watching the miniseries to delve deeper into this event, shrouded in mystery. In the story, the character has a different name, and it focuses on the police investigation, the suspects, and a mother's determination to uncover the truth and find some justice, which won't bring her son back, but perhaps will bring her some peace in a world where so many tragedies occur. There's a key character, who also existed in real life: the priest of that town, who apparently knew who the murderer was, or one of the murderers. And because of those stupid secrets of confession, the truth has remained hidden. That infuriates me. I would have grabbed that priest and beaten the truth out of him. I really don't know how I would react to something like that, but if I had nothing to lose, I would grab him and rip the truth out of him. I enjoyed the atmosphere and, of course, Alfredo Castro's performance as the detective in his darkest moments, unable to find answers in this case that consumes his life and career. Paulina García also stands out as a courageous mother who won't rest until she finds the truth. Impotence, pain, bitterness—she conveys all of that in her eyes. I didn't find the police team very cohesive, only towards the end, when the faces became familiar. At first, they seemed very robotic, with many monosyllabic dialogues. Gabriel Cañas plays the tormented priest, suffering from the burden of keeping the secret of confession. Every country seems to have a difficult case to solve, aggravated by errors in the investigation, judicial bureaucracy, and cover-ups; all of which, as consumers of stories, captivates us. With this miniseries, I learned about this case, which received a lot of media attention in Chile. So, you know what to do: look for it on Netflix and leave me your comments. ---- > Me topé con esta miniserie chilena en Netflix. Me animé a verla al darme cuenta de que el protagonista es Alfredo Castro, un actor chileno cuyo trabajo admiro y al que sigo desde hace mucho tiempo. No tenía ni idea de qué trataba la historia, pero la presencia del actor fue razón suficiente para embarcarme en esta aventura. > Aunque tiene ocho episodios, pensé que sería demasiado larga, como otras producciones, pero no, no todos los episodios duran una hora; algunos son más cortos, así que se ve rápidamente. Además, la historia es lo suficientemente interesante como para mantenerte viendo todos los episodios seguidos. > La trama es una adaptación, por supuesto, de un caso real que desconocía, en la que se modifican algunos hechos y nombres, y se dramatizan algunas situaciones. El crimen que se aborda es un caso que, según lo que pude ver y como se menciona en la propia serie, conmocionó a Chile en la década de 1980, y hasta el día de hoy, nadie ha sido condenado. Es muy improbable que se resuelva por completo; algunos de los sospechosos incluso han fallecido. El caso real, que parece que nunca se resolverá del todo, trata sobre la desaparición y posterior asesinato del joven Jorge Matute Johns. Les recomiendo que busquen información en internet después de ver la miniserie para sumergirse en este suceso, envuelto en misterio. > En la historia, el personaje tiene otro nombre y aborda la investigación policial, los sospechosos y la determinación de una madre por descubrir la verdad y encontrar algo de justicia, que no le devolverá a su hijo, pero quizás le brinde algo de paz en un mundo donde ocurren tantas tragedias. > Hay un personaje clave, que también existió en la vida real: el sacerdote de ese pueblo, quien aparentemente sabía quién era el asesino, o uno de los asesinos. Y debido a esos estúpidos secretos de confesión, la verdad se ha mantenido oculta. Eso me enfurece. Yo habría agarrado a ese sacerdote y le habría sacado la verdad a golpes. Realmente no sé cómo reaccionaría ante algo así, pero si no tuviera nada que perder, lo agarraría y le arrancaría la verdad. > Me gustó la atmósfera y, por supuesto, la actuación de Alfredo Castro como el detective en sus momentos más oscuros, incapaz de encontrar respuestas a este caso que consume su vida y su carrera. Paulina García también destaca como una madre valiente que no descansará hasta encontrar la verdad. Impotencia, dolor, amargura. Transmite todo eso en su mirada. > No encontré al equipo policial muy cohesionado, solo hacia el final, cuando los rostros ya eran familiares. Al principio, parecían muy robóticos, con muchos diálogos monosilábicos. Gabriel Cañas interpreta al sacerdote atormentado, sufriendo por guardar el secreto de la confesión. > Cada país parece tener un caso difícil de resolver, agravado por errores en la investigación, burocracia judicial y encubrimientos; todo lo cual, como consumidores de historias, nos cautiva. Con esta miniserie, conocí este caso, que recibió mucha atención mediática en Chile. > Así que, ya saben, búsquenla en Netflix y déjenme su comentario.

body.title: Breve reseña de Dark Moon: Tsuki no Saidan/Brief review of Dark Moon: Tsuki no Saidan [ESP/ENG]
body.body:
> Hola queridos amigos de @TheAnimeRealm, saludos y bendiciones, en esta ocasión vengo para hablarles de un anime que me pareció interesante y buena la trama, donde la presencia de vampiros y hombre lobos me recordó mucho a la serie Crepúsculos jeje, pero en esta ocasión nuestra joven humana resulta ser algo especial, no es un vampiro ni menos hombre lobo, pero posee una fuerza descomunal que hace que duden de ello, por lo que su existencia se vuelve difícil de llevar y prefiere alejarse de este tipo de especies, hasta que el ingresar a una nueva escuela la hará acercarse más a este mundo de vampiros y lobos, se trata de Dark Moon: Tsuki no Saidan. ---
![MV5BMmVhMWM4N2YtM2M4NS00MWJhLTkyZmEtOThmMjY1MjQ2M2ViXkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23xVAvVT7HrkndBTV3pquyEyHbaviwH3d4ychByUuwnMxDmCddrVzU8TKQWCfvxeG1xmu.jpg)
[Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt38646055/mediaviewer/rm3553483522/?ref_=tt_ov_i) ---

>Comenzamos hablando de Sooha, una joven cuya fuerza descomunal la hace ser comparada con especies como los vampiros, por ello su vida ha sido algo difícil de llevar solo hasta que tiene un amigo, que le cree que ella no es nada de esas especies, sin embargo, un desafortunado giro del destino lo hace perder y ella queda con un odio tremendo hacia los vampiros, por lo que la idea de estar cerca de ellos parece imposible, no solo porque sabe que ellos solo hacen mal tomando sangre, también porque fueron la causa de perder a su único amigo. --- ![MV5BNGRkOGZkMTYtZDFlNS00YTViLTkxZTAtYTNmMGM0MzE3MTgzXkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23u5bXfxSsvjncMwnnG4ivSk29aQGkLRtsQJ4QGfmt3fzXj2QNsJQD1fk3zo7ADu7uEuT.jpg) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt38646055/mediaviewer/rm1086380802/) ---

>Al buscar un nuevo rumbo, Sooha entra a una nueva escuela la cual solo da clases en la noche, por lo que ella no le importa e ir adaptándose a ello, piensa que lo mejor es alejarse de todos aquellos que la conocen y empezar de cero ahora que está más grande y nadie sabrá de su fuerza, hasta que en el camino conoce a Heli, por alguna razón él se siente atraído hacia ella, y en su momento Heli descubre su verdad, sin importarle ello se acerca y desea ser su amigo, junto a su grupo Solon, Jakah, Jaan, Shion, Jino y Noa, todos o bueno casi todos les agrada para Solon él piensa que acercarse a los humanos puede ser un peligro sobre todo a ella, de quien siente una energía extraña que le atrae. --- ![622617322_18051861224696085_6065549283651870076_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23vhwMVQC7Ef5Rd9U6sQBHB6meeasB2atxem9pWqxkVj5H54149vKpo7EG4gPMv4Wbkr1.jpg) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt38646055/mediaviewer/rm1086380802/) ---

>Ciertamente este grupo es de vampiros, aunque nadie lo sabe ellos intentan vivir una vida normal, ya que no necesitan sangre humana para poder comer, algo extraño, pero resulta que ni ellos mismos recuerdan su pasado, pero intentarán llevarse bien con el resto mientras no descubran su secreto, en el camino también encontrará al grupo de lobos, ellos de por sí saben quiénes son el grupo de Heli pero por Sooha comienzan a tratarlos de una manera diferente, aunque deben hacerlo porque tendrán un enemigo que ir en contra de ella, como dije antes es especial y mientras descubran que posee la pelea entre los vampiros y lobos se intensificarán y buscaran la manera de protegerla de aquellos que la quieren para su conveniencia. Cuenta con su primera temporada de 12 capítulos. --- ![dar4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23ynUJdxtCGdzJTCbgYkEfW2qPLBa4fuggSHpTGSRoGoFv2njk4g7tcXKyjbGNfdBfdhv.jpg) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt38646055/mediaviewer/rm1086380802/) --- **Mangaka Plutus, género fantasía oscura, fantasía urbana y romance. Estudio de animación Troyca.** ---

> **Muchas gracias por leerlo. Espero sea de su agrado. Cualquier comentario con gusto estaré para responder y si quieren saber más de mi les dejo mis:**
![EL FINAL DE POSTHIVE (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tmBcG1dhAWXHSeTXHGahwcGe8eAbcEpZutQrCnSNiXxDwJJ31QA17giTgLpxPgJtEqN.jpg)
![separadoryasma1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tRzwswFj7sdCJKFgW2jsAWvCyEzuv6zxT8pCrVwXa8ePqRSdQWi3P6ZbtsyGmy6y4G2.png) **ENGLISH**

> Hello dear friends of @TheAnimeRealm, greetings and blessings. This time I'm here to talk to you about an anime that I found interesting and with a good plot, where the presence of vampires and werewolves reminded me a lot of the Twilight series, haha. But this time, our young human turns out to be something special. She is neither a vampire nor a werewolf, but she possesses enormous strength that makes people doubt her, so her existence becomes difficult to bear and she prefers to stay away from these types of species, until entering a new school brings her closer to this world of vampires and wolves. It's Dark Moon: Tsuki no Saidan. ---
![MV5BMmVhMWM4N2YtM2M4NS00MWJhLTkyZmEtOThmMjY1MjQ2M2ViXkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23xVAvVT7HrkndBTV3pquyEyHbaviwH3d4ychByUuwnMxDmCddrVzU8TKQWCfvxeG1xmu.jpg)
[Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt38646055/mediaviewer/rm3553483522/?ref_=tt_ov_i) ---

>We begin by talking about Sooha, a young woman whose extraordinary strength leads her to be compared to species such as vampires. Because of this, her life has been somewhat difficult to bear until she meets a friend who believes that she is not one of those species. However, an unfortunate twist of fate causes her to lose him, and she is left with a tremendous hatred for vampires, so the idea of being around them seems impossible, not only because she knows that they only do harm by drinking blood, but also because they were the cause of her losing her only friend. --- ![MV5BNGRkOGZkMTYtZDFlNS00YTViLTkxZTAtYTNmMGM0MzE3MTgzXkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23u5bXfxSsvjncMwnnG4ivSk29aQGkLRtsQJ4QGfmt3fzXj2QNsJQD1fk3zo7ADu7uEuT.jpg) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt38646055/mediaviewer/rm1086380802/) ---

>In search of a new direction, Sooha enrolls in a new school that only offers evening classes, which she doesn't mind adapting to. She thinks it's best to distance herself from everyone who knows her and start from scratch now that she's older and no one will know about her strength, until she meets Heli along the way. For some reason, he feels drawn to her, and in time, Heli discovers her secret. Regardless, he approaches her and wants to be her friend, along with his group: Solon, Jakah, Jaan, Shion, Jino, and Noa. All of them, or almost all of them, like her. Solon thinks that getting close to humans can be dangerous, especially to her, from whom he senses a strange energy that attracts him. --- ![622617322_18051861224696085_6065549283651870076_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23vhwMVQC7Ef5Rd9U6sQBHB6meeasB2atxem9pWqxkVj5H54149vKpo7EG4gPMv4Wbkr1.jpg) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt38646055/mediaviewer/rm1086380802/) ---

>This group is certainly made up of vampires, although no one knows it. They try to live a normal life, since they don't need human blood to eat, which is strange, but it turns out that even they don't remember their past. body.title: 省钱套路太魔幻
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![Hppxgli04nYFQU3B_mmexport1776856799920.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/lenalu/images/Hppxgli04nYFQU3B_mmexport1776856799920/Hppxgli04nYFQU3B_mmexport1776856799920.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

100种人就有100种活法，果然越是奇葩的人，在网上越容易引来关注。就像刷短视频的时候，总能刷到一些主打“打工省钱”的内容，有时候我都怀疑自己是不是误闯了什么奇怪的频道，满屏都是各种想方设法省钱的套路，一个比一个夸张。有时候还看得津津有味的。
 
正常一点的，有的人就是尽量减少买菜开支，一天只买一顿菜，然后分好几次吃，能省一点是一点；稍微努力省一点的，就掐着超市快打烊的点去抢打折菜，专挑便宜处理的买；可有些就实在太离谱了，一块肥猪肉反反复复利用，搭配各种零碎食材，硬生生凑出六七八道菜，网友都调侃说，猪油都快被榨得没一点油星了。还有就是，有人干脆凌晨蹲在批发市场，或者在菜市场里捡别人不要的菜，起码这个有的菜看起来还是健康的，抱着“免费的不要白不要”的心态，有时候还能碰上好心人送个几把菜。
 
有时候看着这些视频，我都忍不住怀疑自己，每天正常买菜、正常吃喝，是不是太不会过日子了😂。我也在心里问过自己，能不能拉下脸也去捡菜吃，可思来想去，我还是做不到。能放下脸面这么做、还愿意拍出来博流量的，终究只是少数人而已。就像有评论说的，就算一块肥猪肉做出了一桌菜，镜头里看着热闹，到底会不会真这么吃，谁也不知道。网络这地方，真是处处都是剧本和陷阱，看看就好，千万别当真。

---
