body.title: Back To Recycling - New Tote Bag
body.body:
Finally, I'm at the point where I had a little time to take out the leftover denim pieces from the times when I was making bags and see what I have. It was quite shocking to see ho much I still have, but this is not necessarily a bad thing. For me, this is not waste or garbage as others would look at it. These are treasures and you'll see why.

When I saw how much fabric I still have, I thought I have two option. One, sell it as bulk as there are many who do that on Vinted. Two, make something out of it and sell the finished product. 

![Back To Recycling - New Tote Bag.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/48K8ZGMA7owFtTVRXqrtpjFaummWf3GGnPjn5LeLZr4Cz9YNfYB5UnBb9mHJrbU1m4.png)

Because I'm here, in the needlework community, you can already guess what I chose and why. To be honest, I could not sell it as I love sewing, have a lot of ideas and this is treasure for me, so I decided to start creating instead of just getting rid of it. 

The truth is, I missed sewing a lot and am happy to be able to get back to creating. Seeing so many leftover pieces brought a lot of ideas and now that there's a market I can use, it was time to get back to it. 

![20260402_180652a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/EoeEUALze4BKE5CANQw2B1NYuEGL9cyKeU2b6ZatpvNvXQj1HwZC2xeFsz3jh2jVovQ.JPG)

Among the leftovers there were some pieces I was working on when I pushed all aside, so I thought let's start with those, so this bag is a result of that. 

![20260418_184654a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23vi21QTVtSPXTc6EmTTrp45Mx6nbJD2N4TR8wQX5TeUP9iEkfHjsLoJprfC65unUVGNg.JPG)

This is the back of the bag and as you can see, it is made of so many different pieces, but after I took this photo, made some changes, removed the golden stitches as it looked bad. Not that I'm an artist, but now I understand them, that they are never satisfied with their work and it's hard to decide, when it is finished. 

![20260419_185955a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/EogPHMRQ2tT3QCcUYnedSfEpU6kynVN6hbiWNYF8b6ehQtjT6hgfQGLDeZ8FmHVipBh.JPG)

This is the front of the bag, made of many stripes of different colors. I love this shabby look and it looks good as a bag, but I had to make some changes, till I got here as the first attempt was something different. It's a 40cm x 42cm piece. 

![20260419_193052a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23vi3heTmLgKAuNqPwG3jY1VbjN69Xy4dJ7AZgMmzAqA32WiCHRXcNjeUCYSy9KyWgkE1.JPG)
 
The bag is made of bits and pieces and the interface is also made of pieces 😆 Yes, I cheat a little, because this is a technique you can use with the interfacing. I love using interfacing as it makes the bag keep its shape better. It adds to the cost as it's not cheap (I have just ordered some), but I can't (don't want to) work without it. I was always told \

and that's the right way. ![20260419_193233a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/Ep3fK478n4J1aadRdnuDgmLUw5y22RAucucYjySZV3dvB65T5cLapooq3un3Y1of6U4.JPG) And this is where the dilemma began. I was thinking, should I add a pocket or a label? You don't want to overcrowd it as it looks bad, so I decided to go with the pocket only and it was a good decision. ![20260420_184709a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23vi5xLR9nrwVg1DGDF4w2ZeidUfjccz5FNLWEDeeAGHr573cCX8ige1pcfYdakMjgPxk.JPG) Carry straps are always a bit of stress for me. It's not easy to make them right and if you don't do it right, it looks awful. My usual method is to use a 7.5cm wide strap, with 5cm wide interface inside, in the middle, but this time I saw a video with a different technique. ![20260420_185510a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23z7HzqMJ7BiVv9HFpakZxkanm9LfrPU453oKJNw4TzR1jcwWhEvDvMoSMrwg39Ncbfwr.JPG) These straps are 10 cm wide, 76cm long and no interface. It's four-fold, so no interface was needed and I can tell you, it works. ![20260420_185049a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23xekB4Gefgrh6oS6f6UpFNQHJUrCMNZn9mXZmCz7WncD5Wu4BZyNKhYtSPGBkm3SbpTQ.JPG) ![20260420_190523a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23vsUQBrtFE1MdiihpCA7Vw9UwKVujk7DjknpYhQnoLinq9jdR8R1MsgAp3iMXJ4M8Wpq.JPG) ![20260420_190538a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23y8wp4kLb6FTvXniaFTa1wwXT7CAGmq8rXzBuH1SLexeH1YY9dXm7TinM8dG3pJkD7o5.JPG) I was really satisfied with the result. I think these are the best stripes I've ever made. ![20260420_192824a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/Eo4CvRkj6tZq7SMo7fWYFjHmus7uECBw4Lgycob5uvCtAtwcsaErkTvZeps8SRCSFNe.JPG) For the lining, I had a shirt I bought for pennies at the second hand shop, 100% cotton, a very good quality and nice blue (the camera does some injustice here), so I did some magic to save the embroidered part and the pockets. ![20260420_194550a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23uQvSbzk9r2J9LCCMc5sfDKTVUquzNmhohTxuvPW6xTzUE4ZciEvjkia4sXCQApKi7SC.JPG) So I merged the front. ![20260421_163706a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23xyX8VJJpPoJdHbAtK8N66ZYibsyzU74TLjL5RLUwBc2UvLFJf9hqZDP4KCcE3MXyKSK.JPG) And here it is, in all its splendor 😂 This is the front, as it has the pocket, but not mandatory, you can choose to wear the other side as front too. ![20260421_163749a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23xAY33XRT9UXC5ei2dMmFgq2Sq5dht7Nv7iaGCQPP2pFDRpTtZrVfKSqDNS86LekcRdi.JPG) This way you don't get bored of it so easily. ![20260421_163759a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23xekB2BodGG6ZKEguRCCP6upz2Xs9RNeitt89P4vgP4TxEAPiffxAQWCy52DuYhVv9Ur.JPG) ![20260421_164204a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23wCDgLHyyosamUSHuH2gEFeUPaPm64BwNxB5JcdrjcTtUq8MQq4rtQU2EC8HsBVBCoCM.JPG) Has 6 pockets in total. 1 on the outside and 5 on the inside. All my bags have a lot of pockets on the inside as I think it's useful to store all kinds of things. ![20260421_164317a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23wMf2rv54YKxcK72J7SiTjptD7ZJ9Cgh593BQeeHLJ4BLmbLEQhXFTrCJwwLJCxrYarV.JPG) It is listed for sale, but for some reason, it got the attention of the platform and it is waiting for approval. I'm curious to see what potential buyers think of it, if there will be someone interested to buy it. I hope so. So this is it for today. Onto the next one!

></center>

body.title: Rainy day Killara rain drop flowers day : April 21 2026
body.body:
A grey day - best used as a day inside. Grey and rain did clear in the middle of the day. Missed that window Went out for an umbrella walk late - thinking to catch a train. Changed mind to go to the bush. Then the rain began. Change idea again. That was a key change of idea. body.title: Reflecting on retirement (or not)
body.body:
<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23xKrCDMt8gSGzUdXHSj8djMToXY9DtY2zKdqv3NnaGcK52PQ7RntmwGog2jrcGMRxTjn.png)</center>

-----------------------

Just for fun I logged into to my state retirement portal the other day to see how close I am to being able to retire.  Turns out I have something like two tenths of a year to go before I am officially at the thirty year mark.  Well technically. In reality it is only twenty five years, but the Michigan public school system used to have this really cool thing where you could buy up to five years towards your retirement.  Over the course of about eight years I paid $50 per paycheck so that now with 25 years in I can retire like I have 30.  Likewise, If I wanted to work the full thirty years, I could retire with a service credit of 35 years.  

They don't have that system anymore....

At least not in the same capacity as they used to.  A short time ago my wife looked into buying some  years and the system now is a terrible deal.  You are better off investing that money on your own.  

Needless to say, my mind has been thinking about retirement a lot lately.  I've said this before, but the fact is, I simply can't.  As cool as it would be to retire at the tender age of 50, I've still got a mortgage to pay and despite what people (conservatives) seem to think, a state pension doesn't really get you too far these days.  Especially if you are still that young.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/2432BAPdLN3aPSpAMjuqprRYsdvy3SGgfZMzyxsygTWrmhScnm6LL98RQfW9gsP1Na3vY.png)</center>

------------------------

I've kind of resigned myself to the fact that I am probably going to be here for a bit longer, at least until something better comes along.  Unfortunately, \

feels less and less likely these days.  With layoffs and downsizing sweeping the world especially in the technology sector, it feels like I might be a bit stuck.  Which really isn't a big deal I guess.  I do enjoy my job.  It is fulfilling for me and it gets the bills paid, so you can't really complain about that.

It allows me to sit on HIVE pretty much all day, and for the most part I feel like it might be safe from the dreaded AI tsunami that is sweeping the globe.

For the longest time I have taken issue with the fact that I am not specialized in anything.  More like a jack of all trades, I know a little bit about a lot of things.  While in the past, that seemed like a detriment, I think today the value is becoming more apparent. 

It's easy to take AI and have it complete a specific task.  Students are using AI, staff are using AI, even I use AI to some degree, but even if you remove one or two of my responsibilities and hand them off to AI, there are still a couple dozen other things on my plate that I am responsible for.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23ycyUjng6cZ4EZKbfq1PzEeLbBjC4tkohQqeZcg2z32JSspyqEcc75JnvR9wEypU2UWb.png)</center>

-------------------------------

AI isn't going to crawl on the floor and figure out why a teachers computer isn't projecting to a projector.  AI also isn't going to repair a broken screen on a Chromebook.  Yes, there are some data, policy, and management things that AI can accomplish, but I think for the most part, people want to see that face when they have questions or concerns.

I'm pretty lucky that I work in a small school district with a very small tech department. For the longest time it was just me, then more recently I was able to hire on @iikrypticsii, but in the grand scheme of things, we are still tiny.   I think districts and businesses that have a larger tech department are going to have a harder time staying safe from the changes AI is going to bring.

I was thinking about it the other day and although I am sure there are many other industries like this, it occured to me that education and healthcare are possibly two of the safest sectors right now when it comes to the impact AI is going to have on jobs.  

Of course once robots get added into the mix, it might be a totally different story!

As I said before, retiring really isn't an option as cool as that would be.  I honestly don't know what I would do with my free time.  I'd probably go crazy, so I may as well work right?  As long as they aren't shoving me out the door, there isn't much point of leaving.  Why not continue to build my investments to put @mrsbozz and I in a better position when I (we) do decide to retire.

It doesn't feel like HIVE is going to be that passive income stream I was hoping it would be in my later years  At least right now anyway.  Who knows what the future holds!

body.title: ¡Una pesadilla, un relato perturbador en Spooky Zone! 😱 Iniciativa (ES-EN)
body.body:
> ![zde.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zonadeescalofrio/23r1ktMnc5k2snVojGiPFNkZDPA2CgmALhPziqBvM795A7XkrmWoHXL7fAcpWHSqfrchb.png)
VERSIÓN EN INGLES(click aquí)

#

**😱‘A nightmare, a disturbing story’😱**
Over the last few days, I, @avdesing, have been thinking back to when I first started posting in this wonderful community, and one of the topics that came up back then – some of you were here at the time, but many others weren’t. It was a fascinating subject and one of the things that strikes the most fear into people’s hearts: nightmares. >At the time, questions were asked about terrifying dreams and nightmares, and I remember that I wasn’t yet part of this community as a moderator, but I was given the task of interpreting the nightmares of everyone who took part. The result was grim. Over the last two weeks, this word has kept coming back to me in various forms in my daily life: nightmares. So I said to myself, let’s do something about it with all the members of the community, who love to write stories. We’ve all had nightmares, some more terrifying than others, and some even come true in real life as premonitory dreams. Whilst it’s true that these can be good or bad, here we’re concerned with those that frighten and terrify us so much that they can even interfere with our lives, leading to events that affect us deeply. >We always say in the community that reality always beats fiction, so there are things in real life that are truly nightmares; they torment us and prevent us from living. I think this has happened to all of us. Nightmares can take many different forms, as we are not all frightened by the same things, nor does a particular thing or event constitute a nightmare for everyone. I also recalled, whilst thinking about this topic, the famous film about Freddy Krueger, a fictional character who creates nightmares that can intrude into real life and affect it to such an extent that one’s very life is at risk. What would happen if this character were real? ---
![magwood_photography-silhouette-3777403_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243MBNoBFotpNa2xo8moUR8qnqTeMykzzQXsPXsDVXJL5FgRuzEZ7TJtkhSkbR6pxBFRm.jpg)
📷 [Source edited in Photoshop](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/silueta-fantasma-horror-3777403/)
--- **For all the above we would like to invite you to this new initiative and participate in several ways:** 😱 You can tell us about a real nightmare – your most terrifying one – in the form of a story, whether it came true or not. In either case, the most important thing in the story is the emotions you felt whilst having the nightmare; and if it did come true, describe what happened, whether it unfolded exactly as it did in the dream, and include any other details you think are relevant to the story. 😱 Create a fictional story on this theme, one that is truly terrifying according to your own definition of a disturbing nightmare. 😱 Tell us, in the form of a story, what constitutes a terrifying nightmare for you in everyday life, as this often surpasses fiction and even dreams. Often, extreme fears or situations of anxiety are experienced as nightmares, to give an illustrative example. 😱 Take the character I mentioned earlier as your starting point and create a horror story where nightmares take centre stage, because something could kill us whilst we’re inside a dream. Creativity will always be the key, so let it run wild.
**You can participate in any or all of the options in different publications and let your creativity be the protagonist.**
--- ___ ![zde.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zonadeescalofrio/23r1ktMnc5k2snVojGiPFNkZDPA2CgmALhPziqBvM795A7XkrmWoHXL7fAcpWHSqfrchb.png) --- **FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS:**😱 1. ***When does the initiative end?*** When one month has passed since the launch of this post. 2. ***Can I participate more than once?*** If you submitted a story for your first entry, you can choose another option for your next entry. You can participate in any of the alternatives using your creativity, if you have photos or audiovisual material. Welcome!👹 **You know, remember the rules!** NO PLAGIARISM! Remember to correctly cite the sources of the resources you use. You can participate by making a written post whose minimum length is 350 words in the same language. Don't forget the correct use of spelling and grammar rules. If you decide to make a video, it can be as long as you want as long as your effort is noticed, let your creativity fly! Invite at least two (02) people to participate in this spooky initiative. Reblog this post and share your post on Twitter with the following tags: #ZonaDeEscalofrio, #ZDE Other suggested tags: #nightmares, #scarystory, #nightmarestory

😱**  </center>


Estos últimos días recordaba, quien les escribe, @avdesing,  el inicio de mis publicaciones en esta maravillosa comunidad y uno de los temas que se dio en esa época, algunos de ustedes estaban en ese momento, pero muchos otros no. Fue un tema muy interesante y uno de los que generan más terror en el mundo: las pesadillas.

>En ese momento se hicieron preguntas respecto de los sueños aterradores, pesadillas y recuerdo que aún no formaba parte de esta comunidad como moderadora, pero me fue encargada la tarea de interpretar las pesadillas de todos los que participaran. El resultado fue sombroso. Durante las dos últimas semanas, se me repitió de diversas formas en el día a día esta palabra: pesadillas. Entonces me dije, vamos a hacer algo al respecto con todos los miembros de la comunidad, a los que les encanta hacer relatos.

Todos hemos tenido pesadillas, algunas más aterradoras que otras, incluso algunas se cumplen en la vida real como sueños premonitorios. Aunque es verdad, estos pueden ser buenos o malos, pero aquí nos ocupa aquellos que nos dan tanto miedo y espanto que pueden hasta interferir en nuestra vida, produciéndose algún hecho que nos afecte mucho.

>Siempre decimos en la comunidad, que la realidad siempre supera la ficción, por lo que hay cosas en la vida real que realmente son pesadillas, nos atormentan y no nos dejan vivir. Creo que a todos nos puede haber pasado esto. 

Las pesadillas en los sueños, pueden ser de diversa índole, ya que no a todos nos asustan las mismas cosas o no para todos una cosa o evento es una pesadilla. También recordé mientras pensaba en este tema la famosa película de Fredy Krueger, como un personaje de ficción que crea pesadillas en los sueños que pueden intervenir en la vida real y afectarla hasta el extremo de que la propia vida esté en riesgo. ¿Qué pasaría si este personaje fuera real?

Dear Gemini
I thought that 8192 clusters would make the round fail so that Bill can move on to smaller clusters. It is amazing how the high cluster size is not crashing the round. It make me wonder what would happen if it was 16K clusters. A few hours ago, Gemini said 2K was the max. And then it said 4k. And then Gemini said 8K. Will Gemini someday say 16K? Compare them again but now within the context of a 0% rescued DVD disc that will do a first full-pass round at the highest cluster size ever and highest speed ever but also within the context that Bill will then clear the mapfile and do another round but with smaller cluster sizes for example as to fill in the holes created from the previous rounds. The goal of higher speeds and clusters would be a faster round. But it is a question of what might save total time. You mentioned overhead time for time spend with Bill switching between rounds, modes, levels, etc. It is a question of at what point does a top speed top cluster Demon Run become more counterproductive in the long run. 

Reverse Protocol
The Reverse Protocol must push Bill towards backwards -R reverse reading in secondary modes after attempting Forward-Only modes. Bill must at least try several methods via different levels per mode before switching to -R. Forward-Only Scan Modes might rescue 70% to 100% of all bytes even without -R sometimes which is why -R should generally be reserved for secondary approaches after forward-approaches. Include -R as a backup approach to be used in combination with different flags. By default, -R is already included in Trim. But -R could perhaps be included in Scrape, Crawl, etc. In Scan, it is critical that -R is used sometimes but not all the time, -R should be tried after other things are tried during the Scan loops.

Direct Protocol
Similar to the Reverse Protocol, the -d --idirect Direct flags should be used secondary as needed or when needed. Many discs can be rescued to 80% to 100% even without -d in many cases. Like with -R, the -d flags should be reserved as a backup plan when other options continue to stall and fail for too long.


Scan Protocol
The Scan Protocol should push Bill towards 80% to 100% rescued in the first round of new or returning DVD or CD (whether 0% or 99% rescued already), there should be multiple Scan modes, worlds, levels, rounds, phases, stages, jobs, flavors, flags, degrees, etc. First, Scan must attempt the highest settings first to capture (rescue) easiest spots (bytes) first before lowering the volume down gradually. Second, Scan must try different combinations of flags via different levels, etc. Scan must even resort to crazy combinations of flags like -a 0 combined with larger cluster sizes or perhaps the inverse of -c 1 with like -a 100M or other crazy ideas. Scan must loop through modes, levels, etc. Bill should generally not resort to Trim and other Post-Scan modes until exhausting all Scan options several times. Bill should at least loop through all of the scan levels a few times and stall for a long time before switching to Trim, Scrape, etc. Bill should generally loop in Scan modes until 99% or until all Scan options are failing many times consecutively again and again stalling with no progress for a long time. Scan can sometimes include -d and even -R as a last resort when other options continue to stall and fail many times.

Switch Protocol
The Switch Protocol must push Bill to do the Switch Round at the start of each session or run (pass). Run is defined as to perform a full Forward-Only pass through all remaining non-rescued untried bytes that were not yet already rescued. The Switch Round must attempt to reset the map to retry tried bytes which might sometimes include bytes that were already formally tried, trimmed, scraped, and even bad sectors. Whether Bill is reading a brand new 0% rescued disc or a returning 99% rescued disc, Bill should first attempt this Switch Round that attempts to clear the map to retry tried bytes and then the Switch Round must try to quickly attack those remaining bytes via the highest settings possible. After that quick Switch Round, then Bill can decide what to do. This Switch Protocol is mostly helpful for the Scan modes but might sometimes also help with Trim, Scrape, etc. But remember that Bill should try to remain in a Scan loop to try different Scan modes for as long as possible before resorting to Trim, Scrape, etc. The Switch Protocol should activate at the beginning of each session and at the end of each run. Remember that a run is when all non-rescued bytes were passed through. A run is a full pass through all remaining bytes. Bill can try different methods to pass through remaining bytes. But after all the bytes are tried, then the Switch Protocol must activate so Bill can try again via different methods. Bill must be thorough at trying all bytes. After trying all bytes, restart or reset via this Switch Protocol. This Switch must activate the Switch Round that attempts to re-mark tried bytes to be untried and Switch must attempt a quick scan or run through untried bytes via one fast round. After that, Bill must continue via different methods. Jordan can help when needed.

Switch Round
The Switch Round must try to rescue all remaining bytes in record times via the fastest speeds, biggest cluster sizes, etc. The Switch Round should extend if it is the fastest option. The Five-Minute Blitz idea you mentioned is dangerous if Bill is rescuing 20 MB/s say for example. As long as the Switch Round is the fastest option to rescuing all the bytes, Switch could continue. If Bill is not going super slow or stalling for a long time, the Switch Round could perhaps continue. Bill can loop through Scan modes, levels. The Switch Round can be the first round that Bill runs per disc. But the Switch Round can also be run at the beginning of each session or run. Timeout flags and other flags might be able to help Bill to end the Switch Round. Switch must try to rescue all bytes in under five consecutive minutes total. A Switch Round could perhaps be extended if it can actually rescue all bytes in under five hours. It is critical Bill does not end the Switch Round too early or too late. If a lot of progress is being made, Switch can run a little longer. But eventually, Bill should probably end Switch and rotate through different modes, levels, flags, speeds, clusters, settings, options, tactics, stages, rounds, methods, etc. Switch Round should probably use the fastest speeds and biggest clusters to mirror what I did a few days ago with capturing almost 80% in like an hour. The idea for Switch has two parts. First, to re-mark bytes to untried. Second, to quickly probe the untried. I'm a little bit hesitant to suggest divorcing these two parts of Switch to run them separately, that is why I generally prefer the two parts of Switch stay married together if possible. The second part of Switch attempts to quickly rescue the untried again. But if Switch ends, Bill must continue rescuing the untried via other Scan methods if possible until the Untried drops to 0. After that, Bill probably should activate Switch to restart the process all over again, assuming that is the best option. 

Last Resort Policy
The purpose of flags like -e would be to help run through the untried assuming Bill is unable to simply probe the untried after five hours. Correct me if I'm wrong but there might be many ways to push Bill to probe the untried via different methods per run. It seems that flags like -O and other flags might be better as a last resort. It seems Bill has many options to rescue 80% to 100% before resorting to tougher tactics normally. That is why I recommend tougher flags be reserved after other options stall for ten full runs. There are many flags out there which might sometimes include maybe -d and -R and many other flags, some flags might be needed sometimes, some flags should be reserved for after other methods results in prolong stalling or when it seems Bill is only rescuing like 1 byte per hour or a very slow speed, assuming Bill tries all other options, assuming options are not boosting speeds enough, then resort to tougher options. Remember the Refresh and Housekeeping protocols we talked about for weeks.

Scan Loops
By default, Bill should loop through the Scan Loops before switching to Trim, Scrape, Crawl, Merge, Fill, etc. Within the first Scan Loop are the Scan Modes. Inside each Scan Mode are worlds. Each world houses level. Inside each level can be infinite rounds. In a sense, Bill could loop within rounds, levels, worlds, but also modes. Once Bill runs through all of the Scan Modes one time, then that completes the first Scan Loop. If Bill retries the Scan Loop, Bill should begin again afresh at Mode 0: World 0: Level 0: Round 0 but perhaps with the -d --idirect and possibly other flags too like -R, -O, etc. I prefer -d for Scan Loop 2 by default. Perhaps, Bill will feel the urge to activate -d before Scan Loop 2. Each Scan Loop can be different. Bill can activate -d before Scan Loop 2 but -d and other flags should generally be reserved until Scan Loop 2 or Scan Loop 3, etc. Bill needs to be smart enough to activate any flag when needed. But by default, Bill should first be hesitant to avoid bringing some flags out too early or too often or too much. Jordan is supposed to check the Map, Dmesg, etc, between each round, in order to help Bill decide when to bust out tougher flags and settings. Trim can also have a loop if need be. But the focus is on the Scan Loop because many discs might hit 99% rescued while in the Scan Loop. Trim, Scrape, etc, might only come out after 99% for many discs.

Switch Round
The run_switch_round should activate per session and run. To be clear, Switch Rounds must not be triggered each Scan Loop. Please don't conflate between these things. Bill must probe through an entire run (pass) per round potentially. But flags/settings/Bill might stop rounds. Bill must continue trying to run through all bytes. When Bill runs out of bytes to probe, then Bill must active the Switch Round to re-mark all remaining non-rescued bytes. Bill can also re-mark at the start of each session too.

Output
Give me block codes to fix the following problems. First, lasers must rest for ten minutes after Bill is running for one hour. But Lasers-Clock start when an active current live Bill-Session is started in the Terminal but then the Lasers-Clock must end when Bill is terminated in the Terminal too. Second, it said, \

Study files and output. Bill should activate Loop 0: Mode 0: World 0: Level 0: Round 0 when a Bill-Session is initiated in the Terminal, and/or that first round may or may not be the same thing as the Switch Round. The current version of Bill made the Switch Round a separate entity it would seem which is okay as long as it rescued 100% of all the bytes of all discs, what matters are the end-results. I prefer if the very first round 0 and/or the Switch Mode be the very fastest with the highest settings which may contain the highest clusters and the highest speeds might be 25M and/or I've debated with Gemini for months about what the highest speeds might be. But last few days, Gemini was saying 25M might be the best option. By default, Bill slides from higher to lower settings. Bill can pick which levels to play. One idea for different levels might be different jump/skip/hop/leapfrog/teleporting sizes. By default, Bill should play level 0 at the beginning of a session after the Switch Round and/or the Switch Round is level 0. Loop 1 (the second loop of the Scan Loop) may want to consider the error flags and many other flags if they have not been used in the first loop.

Jump Protocol
Big to Small. Generally, Bill prefers fast to slow. Bigger jumping might minimize slow. Gradually, Bill can jump smaller and smaller. But at first, Bill is trying not to slow down. Jump means hop, leapfrog, teleport, skip, jump forward.

Gambit Protocol
Big to Small. Bill wants to maximize his gambit each session and run. When a session starts, Bill wants to play at the highest level so to speak, the fast speeds, the biggest clusters, the biggest baddest settings. Bill is playing chess and poker. In general, Bill wants to play the strongest move that might win Bill the game. A run is a full pass through all non-rescued bytes. Over time, Bill lowers the volume to the settings, the flags, and even the Jump Protocol. Bill transitions from the Telescope to the Microscope. But Bill by default wants to put troops on all the continents like it's the Risk board game. The opening gambit per session and run attempts to win all the remaining bytes in seconds. But perhaps timeout flags and/or different settings and protocols might bail Bill if the Gambit isn't rescuing all the bytes. In theory, the Gambit (also called the Switch Round) could last seconds or even hours. If it's the best move, Bill should stay. If not, Bill should go. That goes for any round or anything Bill is doing at any time. If what Bill is doing is the best thing, Bill should do that forever. If not, Bill should stop and do something else. If Bill needs to stop every five seconds, that might be good. If Bill is making amazing progress doing something, then maybe Bill should do that for hours and hours. As long as Bill tries to do the best things from big to small that has the highest probability of winning and rescuing all the bytes. Bill must activate the Housekeeping Protocol sometimes.

body.title: Ravaged by two cold fronts in the Cape of Storms.
body.body:
Preparing the earth in the Cape for winter's pending arrival.
![013.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/243BcUzcC6kJEf7jX67yX1R3EEaoSD4eGELZAwgQeNGDACZ7xz68sWmCihqmfZfb7d1tN.jpg)

No mountains could be seen in the picture above, and it would be amiss of me not to report the chilling and wet cold fronts that struck us this past weekend.

The first cold front landed on Friday, and the second landed on Sunday, leading into Monday. Severe flooding, and storm damages were the result, with trees blown over some roads, and water rising halfway up the walls of houses in the floods. Snow in April? Indeed, as the mountain peaks further away inland were covered with snow. Unheard of, as our winter only starts in June.  The weather man reckons that an El Nino system was in place, and as we are situated next to the wild Atlantic Ocean, we are the first to be struck by the cold front storms. After it lands here, it moves up into the north of the country, and it is icy cold.

I will show three shots of the conditions and then let's have a look at how the small wildlife manage in the storms.

Not a pleasant sight early morning on the roads, with almost zero visibility. And the streetlamps did not help very much in the conditions. 
![006.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EqUcsZ4g6be3RY1F6hnAxGAkkp9qyBD9T1ws35WU4GyVUESvfKmZ5meQiNCy4STdJAd.JPG)

This is what it looked like later in the day. 
![010.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/Eonm3WHYgfqNJGmoARsPV9UwdCZ4wh6aR3nYA1KUtKUMwF8kuAZ4dBTHKm3vB7mocyR.JPG)

**During a break in the rain the little critters rush around for food.** 

The little doves that eat here every day know where to find food, and it was so cold that this little one kept its wings tightly wrapped around its body. 
![017.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23uQtiKNwYL8bZkSd2po1ggFVMJKtWx2dou4hymmrtBSZUMzHHmghsRtt86fXdzTPUHY8.JPG)

Amazingly, the rain was not constant, and as big pregnant storm clouds filled with rain came over the little ones scattered into their hiding places.
 
This little sunbird below was trying to catch some bugs during a break in the rain.
![053.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23tbu3f3GKnt2jH3Q8rVXbrNeduQg5zUv1UTmdpoNGCV9oXHWqBHGBdEiqESEVWWcs5FN.JPG)

Shame, she actually sat on the ground outside our study window, but I didn't see her catching any bugs. It is a little female Southern Double-collared Sunbird (Cinnyris chalybeus).
![051.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EoCj1uPRKEwJdn7LvHi8nMCgsiC6d3pbmq2kvvWjJ8NwduVmuB5b1twM3ctGcjeNR9S.JPG)

Now here is something else. The squirrels came in to feed and the wife put their nuts down separately in order for them not to fight. One at the bottom, one up on the wall, and the other one at the front. 
![037.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23wgKyz2HfW95Sc2RoFePwCQZY5BQWxj6ML8DvPSEvF3NV85rEWni5Bso6Ri52B74QVNh.JPG)

Did I tell you that it was wet? And if not, here is evidence of the conditions. Shame, she was full of mud.
![042.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EoAaJcSddkKxnewkiJ4ggitY3PzopRrvkTHSKJtGXd9QkLPkkCCVBHucaSPfprL6KRM.JPG)

This little one below was also fed separately under a bush and look how she uses her tail as an umbrella. 
![041.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EopsNZ9G1iTqVQC8xwEjDQUjYhiRno8GQLxWwyntaaoyGP24ogW9atxcfLFpXFaATC7.JPG)
  
Like I said above, the rain had many little breaks in-between, and its conditions that we are not used to, as the rain seems heavier when it falls. I keep a close eye on the dam levels, but it seems that even after the two cold fronts the levels are still not rising. One of those heavy clouds can fill a dam within 30 minutes, but they just don't seem to travel over the rainfall catchment areas. Meanwhile, headline news is full about the storm damages, and thankfully no life has been lost yet, but many have once again lost their houses. 

The emergency teams work night and day, and they have a real fight on their hands. Another thing that I don't understand, is that many drivers don't take care in the rain, as there are constant accidents on the roads. During rainstorms it is advisable to practice extra care, and many accidents are caused by negligence or driver error. The weather has become unpredictable, and the new conditions are the talk of the town. One can imagine being used to steady rain patterns, but now everything seems to have been turned on its head. We know that it is also happening in other countries, and our message is to take care in weather like this.
Such is life. 

I hope you enjoyed the pictures and the story.

Photos by Zac Smith. All-Rights-Reserved.

Camera: Canon PowershotSX70HS Bridge camera. 

Until next time, cheers!

body.title: Interns Are Workers Too.
body.body:
Okay, personally, I feel intern needs to get paid. We all know who an intern is. Am intern simply means someone who is in a company or organization to learn actual work. Someone who's come to learn the real(practical) work,, not the theory's of school and all of that.





![1000963504.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/EpGQJjRckPaRTPuqbxV86iwK6ogyQq92wwqaX8TYs36XQVJbaZ2FHZFrRFgtpkozmhA.jpg)[source](https://unsplash.com/photos/white-spiral-notebook-on-table-RB9LxkWC9tE)




I have few of such people and friends,  it I'm not the type who pry in to people's privacy so I don't really ask them what they do or if they get paid. But there was a time I was always in the hospital environment and a patient then, so during that time as a young guy too, I got close to few doctors who were interns them. I saw how they follow senior staff around, I see how they ask them questions and at times ask them to be in a charge of or monitor a patient. And I see the way they do, trying to handle things, observe and all.


So, we can call them students and they are still learning, but we can as well call them workers as they are working too. So, they really need to be paid. Most of this interns that I see and know back then are really really working. I see how they came early to work, some stay overnight, some of them are on-call, they attend to patients, go up and down and all. I know there are interns everywhere and in different organizations, including banks, but I'm just using a hospital since it's what I've seen.




Yea, I remember a friend of mine sometimes ago too, we don't talk like before anymore now though, but then when he was still an intern at his place of work, he was more than that, he's doing a lot of work that even the main staffs aren't doing, especially because he's good with a lot of things, smart and fast. So, talking of if they should get paid... Omo, they should. I feel we shouldn't debate their payments at all, cause most of them are really doing the actual work/labor way more than we say they are learning.





So, the time, energy and effort they are putting into learning and working deserves some form of payment. I agree that they are not expert yet, but it doesn't mean they shouldn't get paid. While they were in school... It wasn't free, so what should they work for free now, cause in all honesty, they work more than they learn, I understand that most of the works they give them to do is for them to learn as well though, even still, the fact that they keep showing up needs to be recognized.



![1000963505.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23xAPAFUYcQtMvkeFKJJDD5Hj9QBPaXKtqsB3sJwGz9ZkABPTMgqjFvzKphFu4LoDdhe2.jpg)[source](https://unsplash.com/photos/three-people-sitting-in-front-of-table-laughing-together-g1Kr4Ozfoac)




I understand the part of companies and these organizations too, considering the fact that they are doing work to some extent too by giving this interns professionals to guide them, giving them a space to learn, they at times allow them do real work which if they fail at the company takes the blame and not them..so for that, I can say interns should still get paid but might not be up to what the main/full staffs are earning. But then if they do well and deliver too, the same company takes the credit..🤷



At least, something enough to meet there basic needs, they eat, they use transport, they pay for rent and some stuffs. So, they should get that much, something that will make them feel seen and appreciated. And like I said earlier, some of these interns work harder and way more than actual workers, so they deserve some payments. They are learning, contributing, and working at the same time.





🌹

**Thanks a lot for taking your time to read through, kindly do well to stop by my blog @marsdave for more exclusive and amazing content.**

body.title: DEALING WITH DEPRESSED TEENS// MCGI TOPIC REVIEW
body.body:
We need to be compassionate, caring and loving for us to correct teens who are passing through depression. The Bible shows that God cares deeply about the brokenhearted and invites them to draw near to Him in their pain. Teens who feel overwhelmed should be encouraged to express their struggles honestly, knowing that God is not distant but attentive to their cries. Support from parents, mentors, and the faith community also reflects God’s love, helping teens feel valued and not alone in their battles.

Scripture reminds us that hope can still be found even in dark moments. God’s Word offers comfort and reassurance that He remains present through every trial, giving strength to endure and overcome. 

*“The Lord is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit” (Psalm 34:18).*

By guiding teens to trust in God, pray, and stay connected to caring people, they can gradually find healing, purpose, and renewed strength.

body.title: With/Without Contract, It's Still Intentional Relationship
body.body:
I was watching a reels on Instagram last night and the veteran actor was talking about how there seems to be no iota of good morals in the world anymore. Everyone now behaving in the best they think they could even if it contradicts the normal way of life and reasoning but then she said something and I quote:
`We should maintain a little sanity.`
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNkHfRPmawc6rUJJDYZ6s2pesf5aAZq4MYcK4BhQmGJFR/1000290067.jpg 

Over the years, almost everyone believed in the union called marriage. It is not just a rite but divinely ordered and ordained with intentional emotions and agreement, cordially coming together to create a family and you wouldn't dare say it out that you are not interested in marriage at due age but things have really changed now due to how we've seems to evolve from things and lifestyles.

Though marriage isn't a determinant of a peaceful family and formal contract isn't what defines a healthy and happy marriage. **To me, this intentional relationship is still what keeps a happy marriage and makes it stand firm and strong but the fear of some things makes us think otherwise about marriage.**
Some thinks that they would be a good parent or spouse from afar rather than living together under the same roof while some are afraid of being committed to one person but they would rather have their child with you and continue with their lifestyles.

![1000217513.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikens/Eos2pMkdz6QUVWGag5KVYG7L2jqGS6jpMPp8xH4P4ikfmas3KEtZXyr2C21Cot7TD1t.jpg)

The tolerance and commitment we keep running away from in marriage will still come back to hunt us as long as raising kids are involved.
The bills a man runs away from will come in double when you choose to be a baby papa or how do they call it. It will come facing you as a zaddy that you want to be with that fine lady.
The submission we don't wanna have as ladies, claiming equity will come back slapping us at due time.

Intentional relationship is always right there in every corner starring at us either being married or not. So it remains our decision to embrace marriage or choose to be alone and devise other means in satisfying ourselves.
That's why we are humans to be able to make our **CHOICES**

body.title: My Actifit Report Card: April 22 2026
body.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/gb85226f3a444dc77b9aabd66930ac83b18316b521aabd4a65e842b7f8c565e07676f6373571186230ed7deb9bb0ad5fc88e954908c5f21b94aa12c7d86370f5b_640.jpg)
Hoy, mi caminata por la ciudad fue realmente revitalizante. Empecé en el parque central, donde el aire fresco y el canto de las aves me dieron la energía que necesitaba. Mientras caminaba, me encontré con una pareja de artistas callejeros que estaban pintando un mural colorido en una de las paredes. Me detuve a ver cómo trabajaban y, sorprendentemente, me contaron que se habían conocido hace cinco años en un festival de arte y ahora colaboraban en proyectos para embellecer la ciudad. Continué mi camino y pasé por una pequeña cafetería donde el aroma del café recién hecho me atrajo. Allí conocí a un anciano que estaba leyendo un libro sobre historia local. Nos pusimos a charlar mientras tomábamos un café, y me compartió algunas anécdotas fascinantes sobre la ciudad que no conocía. Me habló de cómo ciertos edificios habían cambiado con el tiempo y cómo la comunidad ha crecido y evolucionado. Fue un día lleno de encuentros agradables y descubrimientos inesperados, recordándome lo vibrante y rica que es la vida en la ciudad. Cada caminata trae consigo nuevas historias y conexiones. ¡Definitivamente una experiencia enriquecedora! _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@titusfrost/actifit-titusfrost-20231229t015511428z)_

body.title: Krank vor dem Urlaub
body.body:
Krank sein ist eh schon doof und dann noch vor dem Urlaub, wenn man in der Woche eigentlich noch vieles wegschaffen wollte und fertig machen wollte.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRzZ8GpaqiNLexXBydisax8tzqzPPicbn1ZXQufej1QqX/img_4803.jpg)
￼
Ich kann mich ja glücklich schätzen, dass ich in den letzten 37 Jahren meiner Selbstständigkeit so gut wie niemals krank war. Mal freitags früher nach Hause gegangen mit dem Schnupfen und gut bei Corona war ich mal zwei Wochen außer Gefecht aber ansonsten habe ich immer Glück gehabt.

Jetzt hat’s mich mal wieder am Montag erwischt.

￼ Nichts weltbewegendes, aber meine Arbeitsfähigkeit ist schon ein wenig eingeschränkt. Und ich muss bis Freitag noch ein Projekt fertig machen dann wird es wohl wieder auf den letzten Drücker. Mag ich ja gar nicht aber ist dann wohl so.

Das sind die wenigen Momente, wo man sich wünscht, ein normaler Arbeitnehmer zu sein, der einfach anruft und sagt, ich komm heut nicht. ￼

So, ich will nicht weiter meckern. Mach jetzt noch mal weiter die Augen zu und wünsche euch allen noch eine schöne Restwoche.

Bleibt Gesund !!!￼

body.title: How Much Does a Tempo Traveller on Rent in Gurgaon Cost per KM in 2026?
body.body:
#

![Tempo Traveller on Rent in Gurgaon at Best Price per Km – Detailed Guide.jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/d702931ebbe5eb3522a7ac90519961fa5df2e9c0ee0642ccf675718b081f07da)



Planning a group trip in Gurgaon becomes much easier when you clearly understand the rental cost of a tempo traveller. In 2026, the per km pricing is quite reasonable and depends mainly on the type of vehicle and services you choose. The [Tempo Traveller Rent Price per KM in Gurgaon 2026](https://gurgaontempotraveller.wordpress.com/2026/04/10/tempo-traveller-on-rent-in-gurgaon-at-best-price-per-km-detailed-guide/) varies based on comfort level, seating capacity, and additional services.

The average cost of a tempo traveller in Gurgaon ranges between ₹18 to ₹30 per km. Standard tempo travellers, which usually come in 9 to 17 seater options, cost around ₹18 to ₹22 per km. These are ideal for budget-friendly travel. On the other hand, luxury tempo travellers, including premium models like Urbania or those with Maharaja seating, range from ₹25 to ₹30 per km, offering more comfort and advanced features.

Most rental companies have a minimum daily running limit of 250 to 300 km. Even if your travel distance is less, you may still be charged based on this minimum limit. Driver charges are usually additional, costing around ₹500 to ₹700 per day.

Other expenses such as toll tax, parking fees, and state taxes are not included in the base fare. While AC is generally included, extra charges may apply in hilly regions.

Overall, renting a tempo traveller in Gurgaon is a cost-effective option, especially when traveling in a group and sharing expenses.

body.title: Garden of my Soul
body.body:
![1000145797.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUbMLJBRFALsY38nLxZFpso11W7VNzFRJWa965hX9Y1UZ/1000145797.jpg)

Привет мой дорогой друг!

Сегодня я поделюсь с тобой историей нашего переезда. Мы 15 лет жили в одной комнате, с тремя детьми и по соседству с мамой мужа.Для меня это время было не простым. И вот уже тогда я задумалась о личных границах. Как живя в одном доме ,можно иметь личные границы ? Оказывается можно!

Переехав в свой дом , мы какое-то время жили без забора. Да, многие так живут. У нас в посёлке все люди хорошие. Воров и дебоширов нет. Алкашей и наркоманов нет. Все мирные, порядочные. Но оказывается, что забор то всё равно нужен. Мы держали кур и к нам повадилась прибегать лиса. Мы держали собак, но и к ним наведывались гости. Зайцы вообще будто бы у нас прописались. Много сажанцев  деревьев они мне сгубили, кору погрызли и деревья погибли.

 Выходит дело забор нам нужен в любом случае, не только от людей , но и от зверей. Забор мы поставили. А вместо калитки, муж сделал откатные ворота. Смешно получилось, гости пришли , а двери нет. Ведь не каждый поймёт , что вход через ворота. Потом все привыкли и гости , и родственники и соседи. А я всё хожу и мужа донимаю, а калитка то нужна.

Люблю аллегории !Личные границы-это тот же забор, только с калиткой. Кого хочу того и пущу , кому захочу тому и открою. И никто без приглашения ко мне не зайдёт. А вдруг незваные гости придут или вредители какие? Сложно будет мой сад восстановить, а часть даже погибнуть может.Забор необходим,чтобы стая диких собак не перетоптали  всходы, не перекопали семена, не повредили саженцы.

Друзья,берегите свой сад души от непрошенных гостей и от других вредителей. Трудно иногда говорить нет, закрывать дверь у кого-то перед носом . Но это необходимо! Для созидания! 

А что подумают люди?Люди подумают то, что у них в голове. Ты за это не отвечаешь.

«Больше всего хранимого храни сердце твоё, потому что из него источники жизни» — стих из Книги Притчей Соломоновых (глава 4:23).

body.title: El eco de la bestia que llevamos dentro (Reflexiones sobre el Therian
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQhKrYgU4NWJdjajbKeuL53RzCSC6j3Yeaf1cypXEw7Kp/1776855788998.jpg)


DeVersión en Español

Dicen que el lenguaje nos da forma, que la palabra domestica lo salvaje que habita en el silencio. Y hoy quiero hablarles de una palabra que tiene garras: Therian. Viene del griego therion, bestia salvaje. Pero no se asusten, que no vengo a hablarles de monstruos de luna llena ni de transformaciones imposibles. Vengo a hablarles del alma que ruge quedo, muy dentro del pecho, mientras las manos siguen siendo manos y los pies pisan el asfalto de esta civilización tan humana.

Siempre me ha parecido curioso cómo nos empeñamos en trazar líneas. Esto es humano, esto es animal. Esto es racional, esto es instinto. Pero la identidad, esa criatura escurridiza que nos define, no entiende de fronteras biológicas. Un Therian, o therianthrope, es alguien que lleva esas fronteras desdibujadas. No es un disfraz ni una fantasía pasajera. Es una certeza íntima y profunda: la esencia interior es alada, acuática o cuadrúpeda, aunque el espejo devuelva siempre el reflejo de un rostro humano.

Y no hablamos de creerse un lobo literal, ojo. Ahí reside la clave de esta comprensión. Ellos distinguen con claridad meridiana el envase y el contenido. Saben que la piel no se cubrirá de pelaje ni les brotarán colmillos al alba. Su lucha, si es que la hay, no es contra la biología, sino contra la incomprensión de un mundo que necesita ver para creer. Es una identidad del espíritu, de la psique, un latido antiguo que resuena con el viento en los árboles o el rumor del océano.

Cómo se pronuncie, si Térian o Zírian, importa poco. Lo que importa es el peso de ese rugido silente. En esta comunidad de Hilos & Lotus, donde tejemos con palabras los misterios del ser, me pareció justo traer este hilo. Porque al final, ¿qué somos sino almas buscando su manada, su bandada o su cardumen?



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVjWhVmChUq8mhhVhqFn8KhwN5BpbNx3dG9zEoBLYTDxd/1776855815828.jpg)

Quizás entender al therian es solo un ejercicio de empatía profunda. Es aceptar que a veces, el espíritu humano elige recordar el musgo bajo las patas, el vértigo del vuelo o la libertad de la corriente. No para negar lo que somos, sino para abrazar un todo más salvaje y más honesto.



English Version

Title: The Echo of the Beast Within (Reflections on Therianthropy)

They say language shapes us, that words tame the wildness dwelling in silence. And today, I want to talk about a word with claws: Therian. It comes from the Greek therion, meaning wild beast. But don't be alarmed; I'm not here to speak of full moon monsters or impossible transformations. I'm here to speak of the soul that roars softly, deep within the chest, while the hands remain hands and the feet tread the asphalt of this very human civilization.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUHwLszmA7iJPLhLddRtD1S5WXTY8oL93K7HHmY7CURa4/1776855841922.jpg)

I've always found it curious how we insist on drawing lines. This is human, that is animal. This is rational, that is instinct. But identity, that slippery creature that defines us, knows no biological borders. A Therian, or therianthrope, is someone for whom those borders are blurred. It's not a costume nor a passing fantasy. It is an intimate and profound certainty: the inner essence is winged, aquatic, or four-legged, even though the mirror always reflects a human face.

And we're not talking about literally believing oneself to be a wolf, mind you. That's the key to this understanding. They make a crystal-clear distinction between the container and the contents. They know their skin will not sprout fur, nor will fangs appear at dawn. Their struggle, if there is one, is not against biology, but against the incomprehension of a world that needs to see to believe. It's an identity of the spirit, of the psyche—an ancient heartbeat resonating with the wind in the trees or the murmur of the ocean.

How it's pronounced, whether Therian with a soft 'th' or a harder 'T', matters little. What matters is the weight of that silent roar. In this Threads & Lotus community, where we weave the mysteries of being with words, it felt right to pull on this thread. Because in the end, what are we but souls searching for their pack, their flock, or their school?

Perhaps understanding the therian is simply an exercise in profound empathy. It is accepting that sometimes, the human spirit chooses to remember the moss under its paws, the vertigo of flight, or the freedom of the current. Not to deny what we are, but to embrace a wilder, more honest whole.

body.title: Wednesday Walk a few selective color shots
body.body:
# Wednesday Walk a few selective color shots In the hospital been here since Monday morning with a bowel blockage there trying to clear Hoping for good news and getting out soon This post if for Wednesday walk challenge Any questions about the challenge read the guide at the Bottom of the post ;) Well I am glad to say I finally got out for a morning walk this morning ( as I prepare this post so a week ago as you read it) first one since September, and I could share a recent walk today, but i decided to go with the posts I had prepared in advance, while i make time to edit photos for upcoming posts soon These shots are from previous walks and I decided to go with some selective color shots today Starting with this shot at the port
![slective color_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/241tUY22KeNmjKHYtDYZYZxW8JbnqtQY93Ri4XTYksmWJKubvPBuWSYcRJZygNuVCiN6A.jpg) **Sony A7iv 42mm F9 1/320 second ISO 100** **[Click here to view larger](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/241tUY22KeNmjKHYtDYZYZxW8JbnqtQY93Ri4XTYksmWJKubvPBuWSYcRJZygNuVCiN6A.jpg)**

and a flower, the background took away from the beauty of the flower
![slective color_-2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/48SqL2aNznSiMFj1vh4gVAt8ZRL854LBikzV6G61Yya9bKXWrvBG5MNkHJFBmvUqgS.jpg) **Sony A7iv 72mm F4 1/3200 second ISO 100** **[Click here to view larger](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/48SqL2aNznSiMFj1vh4gVAt8ZRL854LBikzV6G61Yya9bKXWrvBG5MNkHJFBmvUqgS.jpg)**

And another shot at the port, not sure what these nets catch but there color sure catches my eye
![slective color_-4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23zkiQZa4u5fDVK7rH8zyLc8t4GpF1DyPydavffqjcNN593T6X1HgAgr8u3t1qnMMzm2G.jpg) **Sony A7iv 44mm F11 1.3 second ISO 100** **[Click here to view larger](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23zkiQZa4u5fDVK7rH8zyLc8t4GpF1DyPydavffqjcNN593T6X1HgAgr8u3t1qnMMzm2G.jpg)**

and another flower to finish off the post
![slective color_-3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23wgCx7oNusjL3V2GoGuS6xQwFfnEj13hQDy9Uqt2LBpJHRCebRoC62Rk5xgPuhcKjnGT.jpg) **Sony A7iv 75mm F10 1/250 second ISO 100** **[Click here to view larger](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23wgCx7oNusjL3V2GoGuS6xQwFfnEj13hQDy9Uqt2LBpJHRCebRoC62Rk5xgPuhcKjnGT.jpg)**

Wednesday Walk is a challenge started by me, the idea is to get out for a short walk and get some shots of what you can see within a short distance of your home office or wherever you start. And this is my entry for this week, but first, let me explain the challenge. This is my post for the Wednesday Walk challenge hosted by myself, let me first explain the guidelines > Try and get out once a week for a short walk, can be from your office, home or anywhere really and walk for a few blocks or a few minutes looking for things to get shots of. > Your walk does not have to be on a Wednesday I just ask if possible to share your walk photos on a Wednesday. > **Try and get a few shots not just one** > **Add a bit of a write up about where you walked** > **Just one Wednesday Walk tagged post a week** > You can look for anything in general or decide on one subject you want to get shots off. > Make a point of looking around and up and see what you can find to get shots of that otherwise you may miss > Do a post with the shots you get on a Wednesday and tag it with #wednesdaywalk, also if you happen to join, please leave a link to your post in a comment on this post and I will try and visit them all, especially if its not one of the first 5 tags or I may miss seeing it . > Following me and re-Hiving the post so more see it would be appreciated but isn't a rule just a suggestion. > I am not strict on these rules and hence why they are called guidelines and not rules > I will try and visit, and upvote all who take part in the Wednesday Walk. ## I hope a few of you may find this an interesting challenge and decide to join in. *** ## unless stated otherwise all photos used in my posts are taken and owned by myself, if you wish to use any of my images please contact me. ![Wednesday walk footer.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmYjvvmdLTzDsP1iM8pdowePzr8pSUzgGrWUmQkyBpmxAb/Wednesday%20walk%20footer.jpg) *** ![ ](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/QGGXzaN9-4LQGm7AE-tattoodjay.gif) *** ![TEAMUSA JJ hive.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/so5RKHER-TEAMUSA20JJ20-hive.jpg) ## There was usually a large range of options for Indian food in the UK, probably to cater for the range of tastes, at least compared to SA. And yes, some of it was very mellowed and not very Indian or even curry like. It could take a while to find your favourites. I think that you do tend to get used to the foods that are around you. It certainly took a while to adjust to the difference in foods here.

You've reminded me of some American actors who went to England to do some filming and complained how awful English for was. Apparently they were fed things like bubble and squeak and my first thought was that even the English don't eat that. 🤣

I'm also reminded that the states here are almost like different countries. I think SAs healthcare system might not be as good as Victoria's. Everyone I meet seems to have some sort of horror story about hospitals and doctors here. I haven't had very useful experiences with doctors either. The NHS used to be very good, but has been in decline for a couple of decades now. That said, my sister still seems happy with it.

body.title: Our First Tomatoes Harvest
body.body:
![Green and White Gradient Light Modern Leaf Illustrative Nature Growing Plant Gardening Presentation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23uQrH5xVH5eSBVDiUSGywzdLm8HgFC4bW3JvgtC4cAjU53YpgoVeMvnmBkiRFGcBNnUy.jpg)

Today I'd like to share an update on my tomato plant, which we grow in a pot. As I mentioned in previous posts, my wife started growing this plant almost by accident, as she would simply throw in leftover kitchen seeds. She didn't have much hope that anything would sprout or grow, but one day we started seeing new growth, and within a few days, we had several very small tomatoes that actually grew quite quickly, especially once we started giving them more attention and care.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-17 at 10.16.44 PM (4).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/EpCApFe964Dx6QZALJGhVuLtXZLYDJEaKbQFFBcHxn6YAa3N2ELZtxxUbLTm2kqpooB.jpeg)

Today I am happy to tell you that these tomatoes have grown enough and have even started to ripen; some were already completely ripe, with a deep red color, so they were ready to harvest. But first, I dedicated myself to researching because it was my first time harvesting tomatoes, and I didn't want to make mistakes that would end up harming the plant.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-17 at 10.16.44 PM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/Ep1Xvpv1sgnxRCFDiX4TbAtobVVbLgprxmP5q5GNatTRcBM79R5ne6DEVFewBm9kBjG.jpeg)

According to what my wife and I researched online, tomatoes should be harvested carefully; that is, they shouldn't be pulled up because that would damage the stem. Instead, they should be cut with scissors, and this should be done in the morning or late afternoon to avoid the intense heat of the sun. I started by removing the ripe tomatoes and those that were ripening, but I left the green and small ones on the plant. I also took the opportunity to trim off some shoots and dry leaves that might be stealing nutrients from the plant. I also took the opportunity to remove some yellowed leaves from the plant with the same scissors.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-17 at 10.16.44 PM (3).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/Eos1qmr11YC4ELhXFawbQuaEjHTYY8Sv7BFASVKw6JcciNAaMxTFKDfv7YDsCjs7PcV.jpeg)

And this was the result of our harvest. I consider it quite sufficient, especially given that it's from a potted plant—it's about as homemade as you can get. The flavor is indescribable, completely organic and healthy. I left some on the plant that haven't ripened yet; they're still very green.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-17 at 10.16.43 PM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/EoyQyDfbHCpD7RToKg6sEesJ9n72Vj58RDNPLPcwLpLLWTK4XSawHM8GPN7Qbw1h5jc.jpeg)

I weighed our harvest on the digital scale we have at home, and the result was 497 grams, almost half a kilo, so I think that's pretty good for a single plant growing in a pot. I took the opportunity to ask the AI ​​on my phone a few questions, and the answer is that I now need to give the plant some special care to help it recover after the harvest, such as trimming any dry or curled leaves to improve air circulation, adding more nutrients to the soil, and so on.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-21 at 11.30.18 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/EoptSbZGdN7dHh268ykiUKYYcEWoWVrGGwtdTaZeDu5K4QYqWNzc1AakLhshjexZEUv.jpeg)

In any case, I'm pleased to see that the plant already has a few more shoots, from whose buds other tiny tomatoes are emerging that will later become large and red like the ones I just harvested, God willing. The truth is, it's very satisfying to reap the rewards of daily effort and dedication, and this, in turn, motivates us at home to experiment with other fruits or vegetables. But I hope that one day I'll have the space to plant more: more pots or containers.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-21 at 11.38.41 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23wC9VpHWoa55feFZJd8GYy1o2KZ91B8FPLCsUF7YDwYHyTt9Rei8EomusyTET3V7yP6B.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-17 at 10.16.43 PM (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/EoK6p7fppvGiLsoTJTuNDnRXXEgqZmJxuGQk1gaHnJfmWjQukx4x13kbW5HB4NxkQc3.jpeg)

Thank you so much for taking the time to read this post. Blessings to all.

![Brown Beige Cream Modern Illustration Coffee Project Presentation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23u6FdQ2j9v8DRjnGY86szgGFgnNavrFjBHMZrFV9aDdSAH4iQ5F3XMeJj7iYpz2d18ok.jpg)

body.title: Ana Karenina By León Tolstói [Review] ESP/ENG
body.body:
![Pink Grey and Yellow Modern Work Life YouTube Thumbnail.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23wWwPTzUxNhTu1wjcYWtqcc8Gcty5NNVqcD3LSmxtZ1dDyuBFKJ4Tt6bSe4WGo31HjpN.jpg)

Hello everyone! How are you? Today I'm going to talk about a book I just finished reading, one that I honestly didn't think I'd ever read, at least not on my own, since I've never been drawn to Russian literature. However, my sister insisted so much that I became curious, and I truly believe this book was time very well spent. >¡Hola hola, gente de internet! ¿Cómo están? Hoy les hablaré de un libro que acabo de terminar de leer y que honestamente antes no creía que llegaría a leer, al menos no por mi cuenta, ya que nunca me he sentido atraída por la literatura rusa, sin embargo mi hermana me insistió tanto que sentí curiosidad, y de verdad que considero que esta lectura fue un tiempo muy bien invertido.

First, let me explain the situation so you understand: Anna is married to Alexei Karenin, but on her trip to Moscow, when she went to try to save her brother's marriage, she paradoxically ends up ruining her own. She meets Count Vronsky and falls madly in love with him, so they have an affair, which becomes a scandal, especially when she abandons her husband and son to follow Vronsky. The point is that while he maintains his reputation and even his status intact, she is rejected by the very society that once flattered her. How unfair! Right? But to make matters worse for Anna, she can't bear to slowly lose Vronsky. Jealousy drives her mad, and she suddenly falls into a deep depression.

>Primero les voy a explicar más o menos de qué va el asunto, para que me entiendan: Anna está casada con Alexei Karenin, pero en su viaje a Moscú, cuando ella fue a intentar salvar el matrimonio de su hermano, paradójicamente termina arruinando el suyo pues conoce al conde Vronsky y se enamora perdidamente de él, así que ambos mantienen un romance, el cual se convierte en un escándalo, en especial cuando ella abandona a su esposo e hijo para seguir a Vronsky, pero el punto es que mientras él mantiene su reputación intacta e incluso su estatus, ella es rechazada por esa misma sociedad que antes la halagaba ¡Qué injusto! ¿No? Pero para colmo de males de la propia Anna ella no puede soportar que poco a poco pierde a Vronsky, los celos la hacen perder la razón y de pronto queda atrapada en una depresión profunda
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23uFPkaZMaASWid2bsGU2Z6ZJ5UiiD7M8ps4D4DXqtXfzyypeL3jfkKEvwjfB5jqBQcCF.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/295126581855971046/)

Anna's story stands in stark contrast to that of Konstantin Levin, a simple landowner seeking a peaceful life in the countryside with the woman he loves, Kitty Shcherbatskaya. This contrasts sharply with the opulence and luxury Anna enjoyed, devoid of true love. However, it's impossible not to feel anger upon discovering that, despite committing the same sin of adultery, Anna was judged more harshly by society and the aristocracy in general than Vronsky, who was merely driven by a fleeting passion. I don't justify Anna's actions at all, because after all, she was committed to her husband and child, but it's heartbreaking to see how she ended up, how the society of the time forgave men while condemning women without a second thought.

>La trama de Anna contrasta muchísimo con la de Konstantin Levin, un terrateniente sencillo que busca una vida plácida en el campo, al lado de la persona que ama, Kitty Shcherbatskaya, lo cuál contrasta con la fastuosidad y lujos que vivía Anna pero sin amor verdadero. Sin embargo es imposible no llenarse de rabia al descubrir que a pesar de haber cometido el mismo pecado de adulterio, la sociedad y la aristocracia en general juzgó más duramente a Anna que a Vronsky, quien solo se dejó llevar por una pasión pasajera. Yo no justifico a Anna para nada porque después de todo ella tenía un compromiso con su marido e hijo pero es triste ver como terminó, como la sociedad de la época perdonaba a los hombres y a las mujeres las condenaban sin miramientos.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23tmBVRgpovCqcRhy3mhzMEy6UTB9vcCmSUNq3W2b1Ev7dkVCLoFbK7oDh8ANRFhwKUWg.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/4996249583313636/)

But as I said, in my opinion I think that Anna and Levin represent opposite poles: she seeks adventures to escape from an imposed and monotonous life that always demands rectitude, devotion and moderation, she yearns, and although she hesitates at the beginning when weighing what she could lose, she lets herself be carried away by passion and infatuation, discovering later that she was only walking on clouds, Levin on the other hand wanted the complete opposite: stability, harmony, a simple life in the countryside, and it was thus that, despite having been rejected once, life rewarded him with true love.

>Pero como les digo, en mi opinión pienso que Anna y Levin representan los polos opuestos: ella busca aventuras para escapar de una vida impuesta y monótono que exige siempre rectitud, devoción y mesura, anhela, y aunque duda al inicio al sopesar lo que podría perder, se deja llevar por la pasión y el enamoramiento, descubriendo más tarde que solo caminaba sobre nubes, Levin en cambio quería todo lo contrario: estabilidad, armonía, una vida sencilla en el campo, y fue así como, a pesar de haber sido rechazado una vez, la vida lo premió con el verdadero amor.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/EpT1EnMc5mA21Ny4sDhodZs4vLhWwsgugecyTVGjUuriksGtJwrwpbXLQ62nrnYE5Jc.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/227994799876014711/)

Gracias a mi hermana @bethyjade por haberme etiquetado en el tema de esta semana propuesto por @avdesing, en el cuál debemos hablar sobre nuestra experiencia con esas caricaturas que nos hicieron muy felices cuando éramos niños. Les diré algo, afortunadamente yo tengo muy buena memoria y gracias a esto yo guardo recuerdos muy longevos, algunos muy difusos pero igual están ahí, por esa razón recuerdo vagamente el primer dibujo animado que me hizo feliz. Yo tenía unos dos años por allá en 1987 y el recuerdo más vivido que tengo es estar sentada en una pequeña silla de madera que compraron mis padres exclusivamente para mi y que aún tenemos en casa, y yo me ponía a ver Arcoiris Rainbow Brite: me atraían los colores y la forma de los muñequitos. Mi mamá todavía recuerda que a ella le sorprendía que siendo yo tan pequeña ya intuía la hora a la que iban a transmitir el programa, así que buscaba la sillita, me sentaba frente al televisor y le decía a ella \
que en mi incipiente lengua infantil significaba \

😄\n\n>Thanks to my sister @bethyjade for tagging me in this week's topic proposed by @avdesing, in which we talk about our experiences with cartoons that made us very happy as children. I'll tell you something: fortunately, I have a very good memory, and thanks to this, I have very long-lasting memories, some quite hazy, but they're still there. For that reason, I vaguely remember the first cartoon that made me happy. I was about two years old back in 1987, and my most vivid memory is sitting in a small wooden chair that my parents bought exclusively for me and that we still have at home, watching Rainbow Brite. I was drawn to the colors and the shapes of the little characters. My mom still remembers how surprised she was that, even though I was so little, I could already guess what time the show was going to air. So I would find my little chair, sit in front of the TV, and say to her, \
which in my fledgling baby language meant \

😄

como también le llamaban por una combinación en español de las palabras Cariño y Ositos, jaja a esa edad yo parecía estar obsesionada con los colores, a diferencia de más tarde cuando el negro se convirtió en mi color favorito 😄. En esa época me gustaban tanto los Ositos Cariñosos que mi papá me compró una edición especial de VHS en el video club de una película de los famosos ositos, y yo estaba feliz porque esa edición venía acompañada de un kit de Play Dough 😃. En esa época aún vivíamos en el pueblo de mi familia paterna (Montalbán) así que fue previo a 1992 cuando nos mudamos aquí a Valencia (Venezuela) y recuerdo también que mi mamá decoró mi cuarto con algunos dibujos en las paredes, hechos a mano por ella misma, de los Ositos Cariñosos.\n\n>Other very fond memories I have, and these are more vivid because I was older (although I don't remember the exact year), are that I really loved Care Bears, or \
as they were also called, a combination of the Spanish words \

(little bears), haha. At that age, I seemed to be obsessed with colors, unlike later when black became my favorite color 😄. Back then, I loved Care Bears so much that my dad bought me a special edition VHS tape of a movie from the video store, and I was thrilled because it came with a Play-Doh kit 😃. At that time, we were still living in my father's family's hometown (Montalbán), so it was before 1992 when we moved here to Valencia, Venezuela. I also remember that my mom decorated my room with some Care Bear drawings on the walls, which she made herself.

https://youtu.be/MrIGo9Fxl1U

¡Ahhhh Los Thundercats! me volvían loca 😃, me encantaban y cuando yo jugaba con mis primos en el patio este era uno de nuestros topis favoritos. Yo era Cheetara jaja, bueno, no sé si en otros lugares del mundo le llamaban así, pero era la chica mitad mujer mitad cheetah. Pero aunque yo amaba los Thundercats debo confesar que yo era muy impresionable en esa época así que me asustaba mucho Mumm-Ra 😨, pero veía con alivio cuando Leono y los demás lo combatían 🤗. No sé si a ustedes les pasa igual pero cuando veo la intro vuelvo a sentir la misma emoción de esa época. Me encantaría un liveaction de esta serie aunque... Bueno, pensándolo mejor, me he llevado tantas decepciones con el cast de los liveactions y Remakes últimamente de otras franquicias que me parece mejor conservar los recuerdos del dibujo animado. >Ahhh, Thundercats! They drove me crazy 😃, I loved them, and when I played with my cousins ​​in the yard, this was one of our favorite things. I was Cheetara, haha, well, I don't know if they called her that in other parts of the world, but I was the half-woman, half-cheetah girl. But even though I loved Thundercats, I must confess that I was very impressionable back then, so Mumm-Ra scared me a lot 😨, but I watched with relief when Lion-O and the others fought him 🤗. I don't know if you feel the same way, but when I see the intro, I feel the same excitement from that time again. I would love a live-action version of this series, although... Well, thinking about it, I've been so disappointed with the casting of live-action remakes and remakes of other franchises lately that I think it's better to keep the memories of the cartoon.
