body.title: TikTok Affiliate Report (Part 1)
body.body:
After feeling a drought for such a long time, I finally experienced getting daily sales again. Personally, I’m losing motivation on whether I should push further in affiliate marketing. I’m always trying to adjust in a fast-paced environment and want to earn money. Anyway, I’m not monetized per views here, but I can earn by getting sales. At the moment, I’m unemployed in real life but a student on paper. I’m a marketing student by profession, so I guess I should already treat my account as a business.

# Overview

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamboring/23tHZ9tkcT1qVSAeNVq1hvGT6HvWnenmFvDLQPPkaDXemHUhAo4uo5es9825PMkqR2utZ.png)

For this week, dated April 15 to April 21, I generated over 32.4K product impressions and 1.6K product clicks. This means that the algorithm pushes me to a wider audience. I’m surprised by these numbers since it means that TikTok is trying to push my content. Yet, I don’t know if my content or the product is the problem. In addition, we’re also experiencing inflation during this crisis.

# Commission

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamboring/23t8AVWqu4LBJjW72EVAPVMx5xfSkY4SJNH2qyWJ6YDst9a5XVMXambaEx8NEMrjLYUgz.png)

Personally, it’s my first time getting this commission for a week this year. I feel like some of the videos that I published a few months ago are now bearing fruit. However, I think that most of my sales this week just happened during this period. I anticipate that I will get more sales next week since most of my sales today are from fans. Since I know that most of my sales today are just seasonal, I hope that I can get more sales from products that we often use. That’s why my goal is to test at least one or more products weekly.

# Posting Strategy For This Week

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamboring/23wCGUDCnjuCzpo2jSXLnaphXY7abLmKs26F3jmvZKVUqW62pfcdBFUAWXqsp63qJ32XM.png)

As you can see, I promoted a lot of products this week. I focused on the items that I bought and sold last week. On the other hand, I also tried to push again the products that are needed for summer and the next academic year. I filmed 14 pieces of content for it, but I sometimes add more if there’s a burst of ideas. I also make contents if there's an inquiry from the comment section. Personally, I didn’t film all of them in one sitting as I only push more than three items daily. Yet, there have been times when I film eight videos in a single day.

TikTok is getting strict lately, so I need to alternate my uploads. I only upload three shoppable videos and one non-shoppable video daily. And fortunately, I still have a lot of drafts to be uploaded in the following days. My reason for alternating uploads is that I can get violations for the same background, product, or outfit. It’s still okay to film multiple videos with the same background, product, or outfit in one sitting. Yet, you should not upload them all at once—just alternate them with different background, product, or item. It’s not stressful to do, though.

# Other Strategy

This week, I decided to go live every other day in the morning and daily in the evening. I promote various tech items during the day while only answering word search in the evening. However, for this week, I came up with an idea to push livestreaming daily since I can now manage it. It’s just hard to balance since I need to do YouTube Shorts. Yet, I don’t want to prioritize my YT account for the meantime since I’m not monetized yet.

# Posting Strategy For The Next Week

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamboring/23w2uacRp6sLFAMG5ihufbXavnmRLDhNaJhft3zWFrHeUoZ5RNhqzB7h8p9jc35x9GRN8.png)

Compared to my previous posting strategy, I decided to focus solely on the items I sold last week. If you check my posting strategy, I sold 8–9 different products. I just bundled the two kinds of earphones into one since it’s better than selling them separately. Because of this success, I skipped posting summer or back-to-school items that didn’t sell this week. I also purchased one product and am planning to promote it next week for three times. If there’s a comment on my post, I will create content for it. By doing this, I can make more posts and add variety to avoid violations in the future.

# Conclusion

Since I treat this side hustle as a business, I need to be intentional with what I post. That’s why you see me planning it like a business owner since I’m taking it seriously. I anticipate that I will make more sales from the current products that are already selling. On top of that, I can also foresee that one of them might become my hero product. I also feel that I can push from 4 to 5 videos daily. Let’s see next week if I can get more items sold or see positive signs. See you!

body.title: Rediscovering My Reason for Living - LOH #285
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>


I remember taking a pause at a point in my life to really ask myself a deep and thoughtful question. The moment unfolded when I felt really overwhelmed about life and many challenges on my end. 


![1776855146982.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nkemakonam89/EpQyH24Lvz3FfQb1K5kGeiga8raKcugE4UUNtf2bipASTTPEQ1E7i6Sh8WcpUbjSUMB.jpg)
*****

If I should be sincere, I questioned my living and wished to go back to God and have my rest, maybe a kind of foolish thought those days, but that's by the way. I questioned God about many things. I compared my family with others who are close to me. I looked at how healthy their kids are and how I am running around for mine, and I said, \

And then again, I felt like my strength was failing me badly. But the bitter truth I realized was that I am not living by accident; there is a reason I am living, and there is a purpose too. ***** I can equally say that my reason for living presently is deeply rooted in responsibility and purpose. Being a mum, I woke up daily to realize that my kids look up to me. They depend on me for many things; they also learn from me, and that alone motivates me to keep on pushing even when I am totally overwhelmed. I am living up to my responsibility for my kids, and that's enough to live, despite all odds. ***** However, aside from motherhood, I have come to realize that living my purpose entails becoming a better version of myself. Laying aside every distraction and pursuing my personal growth, I put my personal needs and peace first rather than constantly sacrificing for others because can one really pour from an empty cup? Living my purpose entails that I take care of my mind, my health, my emotions, and my dreams/visions in life and not leave it to chance. ***** Overall what keeps me pushing ahead is the hope that my tomorrow will be better and the responsibility of my kids while I strive to ensure their better tomorrow as well. So yeah, I have many reasons for living and living intentionally as at that; raising my kids with undiluted love and wisdom, building a meaningful life, and becoming someone I am proud of, and indeed, that's enough for sure! I started from Bronze 3 and honestly at first I was not super confident because sometimes Bronze can be weird, like you either get easy wins or suddenly face someone with stacked rented cards (like mine 😉) and get destroyed.

However, all my battles were really easy. I think it is because my cards are OP. But one thing I do want to point out is that, I used the same frontliner/tank every single game. Because he is literally unkillable. In all my 6 battles, he did not die once. So I pretty much had a flawless victory in all my battles.


![battle ss.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rookie2001/Eo1xr5deobKc2gsmZXpJ5Q3USakzs62DeUSytuePjraYkCEwXS7DiiczDcDpA167VAz.png)


![battle ss 2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rookie2001/23tRxsoFacP5yLJwL89kY9NH72A4jmr6mAezftq26wVQgTtZs37zudcCHERPhnGdcsRZ7.png)

These are the starting and ending screenshots of one of my matches. Look at the amount of health my tank has at the ending of the battle. THAT'S CRAZY. By the way, my tank is Saltwraith Bulkhead. I also made a card spotlight post about it if you guys wanna check it out. I talked about this card in detail in that post.


![modern bronze 2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rookie2001/EoATvNotCvNR48kpxJAFC57mRqQnLVQNGZbpfHmUMetDLwSD1dgvaERPBJypXxpRPKg.png)

After my 6th battle, I ranked I finally ranked up from Bronze 3 to Bronze 2 🎉. Not a huge rank or anything, but still progress is progress. And honestly it felt really good after coming back recently. 


![claim loot.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rookie2001/23tGXSwwBJbPUdzJk4qKp6bR9u1zQcMrmG2MKWB8CAWfvSdLuLZCYUHkeh7sVZ5cLxj8F.png)

After ranking up, I also got a Bronze 2 chest. Now this part was exciting because I got a chest reward after a long time. When I opened it I got 3 rewards.

![3 rewards.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rookie2001/23u5ZbRx6YjAxwTE7y4jod1XKz9LinLfkFkDw2dZqNmRQRG9kw1knwjVqXmQPMaeayuMm.png)

![my rewards.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rookie2001/23tbibejsm8VovYgerCntd61ap1gL5MxUCczRq8YsVhnzrZWcxepyQACZWWb1EX9bPKcj.png)

Not gonna lie, they were not super crazy rewards but still, rewards are rewards. I am not complaining. Every small thing helps in the long run.

# 𝐂𝐎𝐍𝐂𝐋𝐔𝐒𝐈𝐎𝐍

Overall, today felt really good. I think I am slowly getting back into the rhythm of the game again.
Next goal is to keep climbing and maybe reach Silver (hopefully).
Also thinking to maybe upgrade my rented cards a bit if I can manage the cost.

Well, I guess this is it for this post. That was my small grind session today. 6 battles 6 wins, Rank up, Chest opened. Not bad at all.
Let’s see what happens tomorrow… hopefully I don’t lose 6 in a row now.

Please do give your reviews in the comments section below. I would really appreciate it :)

I'll be back with another one soon. So do follow me if you want to stay updated. Till then, Stay Happy and Stay Hydrated.

body.title: Brewing Hibiscus Tea in the Electric Tea Kettle - by Sunscape
body.body:
![silverbloggers-hibiscus-tea-.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmf79XYBLgpU9pzU8ytQNMX25f9Fb17P6AsHAcmuvcPscA/silverbloggers-hibiscus-tea-.jpg)


I have been wanting to buy some Hibiscus flowers for tea for quite some time, and finally did last week.  Yesterday, I brewed 4 cups of tea in my electric tea kettle, which is amazing because it has temperature controls for different types of tea.  Plus, the kettle has a built-in strainer for loose-leaf tea, which is my favorite.  


![electric tea brewer.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVD1BvMhygoB4nbUPTWib72UqcKVsQn7gX6MDRMHaELS9/electric%20tea%20brewer.jpg)
<a href=\

> Source ##### Tea Recipe: 1/2 cup of Hibiscus flowers 4 cups of water 1/2 tsp. honey or agave syrup 1 cinnamon stick 3 whole cloves (optional) I found some recipes that added apple juice, limes, lemon, orange slices, pineapple rind, and ginger for added flavorings. I will definitely be pairing different flavors for future batches. ![silverbloggers-hibiscus-tea-1.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaDTYiCBzff1H1mwx2mCvGTaKr1sCeh2qin7tMVTfFjU9/silverbloggers-hibiscus-tea-1.jpg) I steeped the tea for 6 minutes, and it turned out dark red and smelled so good with the cinnamon and cloves. ![silverbloggers-hibiscus-tea-3.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfAmoucKATQm612p817qdrgbsTm7EXvX9Tzh2ZvwPcJhK/silverbloggers-hibiscus-tea-3.jpg) The Hibiscus tea has a bright red color and a little tartness, but I added a 1/2 teaspoon of honey, and oh my, I was pleasantly surprised at how delicious it was. I enjoyed my first cup of Hibiscus tea, and my husband had a little, and he really loved it too. I stored the remainder in a glass jar in the refrigerator for iced tea. I will certainly enjoy having this throughout the summer months. I don't do well with citrus drinks, like lemonade, so this will certainly be my favorite. With all the recent studies about the benefits of Hibiscus tea, with the vitamin C, minerals, polyphenols, and antioxidants, it is certainly worth adding to my diet. It claims to lower bad LDL cholesterol, help with weight loss, and lower blood pressure. I will have to check my blood pressure when drinking the tea because I'm on medication for it, and I don't want it to get too low, right? ![banner-sunscape-2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYr3stqM7yx8cpipf8v6F4YgkM2aD282NSQrGYzJZqCxE/banner-sunscape-2.jpg)

body.title: How do riders communicate on Himalayan routes?
body.body:
![image](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/b132a5ff14b73e4b09f4671afabf584515631a9c683e5060180a42e11e9997bc)

If you come from the US, UK, Australia or Canada, honking your horn means one thing: you're angry. On Himalayan roads, the horn means something completely different. It means: I am here. It is a constant, gentle, entirely friendly announcement of your presence- especially on blind corners, before passing, and when approaching villages.

You will hear horns constantly on Indian mountain roads. Within two days, you will be using yours constantly too. It is not rude. It is not aggressive. It is the language of the road and it genuinely prevents accidents on single-track routes where you cannot see what is coming until you are already committed.

Develop a pattern: one short beep before every blind corner. One longer beep when passing a slower vehicle. Silence in villages means you are not paying attention, not that you are being courteous.

This adjustment in mindset is one of the first things our guides walk riders through on day one and within hours, it becomes second nature. The Himalayas will change how you use a horn permanently.

You have done your research. You've watched the YouTube videos, read the Reddit threads, and downloaded three different offline maps. Your GPS is loaded with waypoints. Your route is planned down to the kilometre. But if you need more information, check out -  [Rules of Himalayan Roads that every rider must know](https://www.indiamotorbiketour.com/Blog/ride-in-himalayas/unwritten-rules-of-himalayan-roads).

body.title: It’s not just another gay show (Eng/Esp)
body.body: ></center>\n\nI remember the first time I watched Queer as Folk. Like many, I expected a lighthearted comedy with funny gay characters and predictable situations. What I found instead was a direct hit to the conscience—a show that didn’t invite me to nod along with a condescending smile but forced me to look straight ahead, unfiltered, at a world that was complex, beautiful, contradictory, and deeply human. And that’s its magic, the reason why, twenty years later, it’s still not just \

It’s not a showcase of perfection. It’s a portrait with light and shadow, and that’s its first great virtue.\n\n> Recuerdo la primera vez que vi Queer as Folk. Esperaba, como muchos, una comedia ligera con personajes gay divertidos y situaciones predecibles. Lo que encontré, en cambio, fue un golpe directo a la conciencia. Una serie que no me invitaba a asentir con una sonrisa condescendiente, sino a mirar de frente, sin filtros, un mundo complejo, hermoso, contradictorio y profundamente humano. Y ahí reside su magia y por qué, veinte años después, sigue sin ser \

. **It Doesn’t Romanticize—It Humanizes: The Good, the Bad, and the Uncomfortable** Many LGBTQ+ representations fall into the trap of portraying the community as a homogeneous block of perfect victims or flawless heroes. Queer as Folk refused to do that. It showed us the effervescence of freedom: the conquest of our own spaces (like Babylon), fierce solidarity, the creation of chosen family, and the defiant joy of existing without asking for permission. But with the same rawness, it exposed the toxins we breathe inside and outside the closet: emotional ghosting, party and compulsive sex culture, internalized machismo, the obsession with youth and body image, hypocrisy, and the cracks left by AIDS and discrimination in the collective soul. Brian Kinney isn’t a hero; he’s a selfish, self-destructive antihero, but also a symbol of radical autonomy. Watching him was, at times, like seeing our own contradictions in a magnified mirror.> > **No Romantiza, Humaniza: Lo Bueno, Lo Malo y Lo Incómodo.** > > Muchas representaciones LGBT+ caen en la trampa de presentar a la comunidad como un bloque homogéneo de víctimas perfectas o héroes impecables. Queer as Folk se negó a eso. Nos mostró la efervescencia de la libertad: la conquista de espacios propios (como Babylon), la solidaridad feroz, la creación de familia elegida y la alegría desafiante de existir sin pedir permiso. > > Pero con la misma crudeza, expuso las toxinas que respiramos dentro y fuera del clóset: el ghosting emocional, la cultura de la fiesta y el sexo compulsivo, el machismo internalizado, la obsesión por la juventud y el cuerpo, la hipocresía, y las grietas que el SIDA y la discriminación habían dejado en el alma colectiva. Brian Kinney no es un héroe; es un antihéroe egoísta y autodestructivo, pero también un símbolo de autonomía radical. Y verlo era, a veces, como ver nuestras propias contradicciones en un espejo amplificado.

/>

**A Complete Atlas of the Gay Experience: Beyond the Love Story  
**Over its five seasons, the series boldly swept through every layer that makes up a queer life. It wasn’t just about \

or finding love (though that was part of it):  
• Politics and Activism: From Pride marches to fights for custody rights and against censorship.  
• Health and Trauma: The legacy of HIV/AIDS not as a past drama but as a present wound affecting young and old characters alike.  
• Family: The biological one that rejects, the chosen one that sustains, and the desire to be parents (with all the legal and emotional battles that entails).  
• Age and Generations: The contrast between the scarred wisdom of an Emmett or a Debbie and the lost innocence of a Justin.  
• Identity and Intersectionality: Addressing—though imperfectly for its time—bisexuality, transphobia, and diversity within the community itself.

It was a narrative encyclopedia of what it meant to live as an LGBTQ+ person in the early 21st century.

> **Un Atlas Completo de la Experiencia Gay: Más Allá de la Historia de Amor.**
> 
> En sus cinco temporadas, la serie hizo un barrido audaz de todas las capas que conforman una vida queer. No fue solo sobre \

o encontrar el amor (aunque está): > > • Política y Activismo: Desde las marchas del Orgullo hasta la lucha por los derechos de custodia o contra la censura. > • Salud y Trauma: El legado del VIH/SIDA no como un drama del pasado, sino como una herida presente que afecta a personajes jóvenes y mayores. • Familia: La biológica que rechaza, la elegida que sostiene, y el deseo de ser padres (con todas las batallas legales y emocionales que conlleva). > • Edad y Generaciones: El contraste entre la sabiduría cicatrizada de un Emmett o un Debbie y la inocencia perdida de un Justin. > • Identidad y Interseccionalidad: Tocando, aunque de forma imperfecta para su tiempo, temas de bisexualidad, transfobia, y la diversidad dentro de la propia comunidad. > > Fue una enciclopedia narrativa de lo que significa vivir como persona LGBT a principios del siglo XXI.

/>

**Unashamed Sexual Honesty: The Revolutionary Act**  
This is perhaps its most groundbreaking aspect—and the one for which it was most criticized. Queer as Folk boldly embraced the idea that desire and sexuality are central to the human experience, especially for a community whose history has been marked by bodily repression. The sex scenes weren’t comfortable hints for a heterosexual audience. They were explicit, frequent, and narratively relevant. They showed sex as power, as bond, as vice, as comfort, as negotiation, and as pure celebration. In doing so, they stripped gay sex of the stigma of \
and placed it firmly in the realm of the human, the tangible, the vital. It was a cry of authenticity: \

\n\nQueer as Folk isn’t a show to make you feel comfortable all the time. It’s a show to make you feel seen, angry, moved, aroused, and challenged. It didn’t seek easy mainstream acceptance by softening its edges; it sought the truth, no matter how harsh. That’s why it’s not \

Because it was a pioneer in refusing to be a tourist brochure of gay life. It was, and still is, a visceral document, a flawlessly written social drama that, with all its imperfections, had the courage to show us whole: glorious, problematic, passionate, and real. It didn’t give us what we wanted to hear; it gave us what we needed to see.

And in that naked honesty lies its power and its eternal relevance.

> **Honestidad Sexual Sin Vergüenza Ni Censura: El Acto Revolucionario**
> 
> Este es, quizás, su punto más rompedor y por el que más se la criticó. Queer as Folk asumió con una naturalidad revolucionaria que el deseo y la sexualidad son centrales en la experiencia humana, y en particular, en una comunidad cuya historia ha sido marcada por la represión del cuerpo.
> 
> Las escenas de sexo no eran insinuaciones cómodas para el público heterosexual. Eran explícitas, frecuentes y narrativamente relevantes. Mostraban el sexo como poder, como vínculo, como vicio, como consuelo, como negociación y como pura celebración. Al hacerlo, despojaban al acto sexual gay del estigma de \
y lo colocaban en el terreno de lo humano, tangible y vital. Fue un grito de autenticidad: \

.
> 
> Queer as Folk no es una serie para sentirse siempre cómodo. Es para sentirse identificado, enfadado, conmovido, excitado y desafiado. No buscaba la aceptación fácil del mainstream suavizando sus aristas; buscaba la verdad, por dura que fuera.
> 
> Por eso no es \

. Porque fue pionera en negarse a ser un folleto turístico de la vida gay. Fue, y sigue siendo, un documento visceral, un drama social impecablemente escrito que, con todos sus defectos, tuvo el valor de mostrarnos completos: gloriosos, problemáticos, apasionados y reales. No nos dio lo que queríamos oír; nos dio lo que necesitábamos ver. > > Y en esa honestidad desnuda reside su poder y su eterna relevancia.

body.title: CHOOSING INVESTMENT OVER CURRENT GRATIFICATION
body.body:
Hello everyone, you're welcome to my blog today.

Coming into Hive, I've noticed that every user usually faces the same decisions, whether they realize it early or not. Do you have to power up and build influence for the long term, or do you want to cash out and enjoy your immediate rewards? It sounds quite simple, right? Most people who come into Hive do so for the sake of rewards; they get voted and receive their returns, and that is the mindset they come into Hive with.


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbrb1WZNgzHj6DcGw91fQSFU7bRmwWgNb4QtC2wq8SMbD/IMG-20260422-WA0000.jpg 



Powering up, in a way, is what I call an investment. Even though it is a little bit slower, it requires patience and consistency, as well as a willingness to delay gratification. Very important. When you power up, you're not just locking up your tokens; you are increasing your voice, your presence, your credibility, and your ability to learn more over time. It is a very good strategy, which is built into the platform. Believe in your group's belief that what you're building now will last the test of time.

Cashing out or withdrawing your Hive tokens, on the other hand, is actually immediate, and it will make sense in certain situations where you need funds or you just don’t want to wait. There is nothing wrong with taking profits; in fact, knowing when to take value out is just as important as knowing when to invest.

For me, my cashing out would only be if I am in need, like if there is an emergency, and there is nothing I can do about it. Currently, the price of Hive is low, and cashing out looks like a financial mistake. What if you cash out now and tomorrow the price goes up? You will have cashed out for a very low price. I mean, I can't even handle the heartbreak; I know others can relate. So, the real question is actually about balance. Very few people are entirely on one side; some people power up most of their rewards, while others cash out and let us shift towards growth once they understand the system better. I just pray that some of us understand the system early.

What matters most are the intentions. If you are just here for the sake of making money, cashing out and going, then that’s one path. If you are here to build something lasting, influence, and reputation, then reputation on Hive is one thing that goes a long way to say about you, your posts, and your content. Then, if that is the case, powering up should just become a natural choice for you.

There’s also a deeper layer to it: when you power up, you’re making a commitment not just to yourself but to the community and the ecosystem at large. It shows that you are invested beyond short-term rewards. That kind of mindset opens doors, builds trust, and creates more visibility for you. At the end of the day, there is no single right answer power up or cash out. Everybody has their own strategy, but the best strategies align your reality with your vision. Let us always think of long-term goals and not just the gratification of the present.

Thank you for stopping by my blog today.

body.title: Respect the hustle. Appreciate the effort.
body.body:
![IMG_20240907_184210_919.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mcsamm/245T9tky4kFM1oYj8Y9ipRirFFrPCHNgdLNXz2Q7eWRcDtfiYdevpPsh2WCEHXNPkPB9A.jpg)


The rhythms of Ghana's street life can't be ignored. When I visited recently, I couldn't help but get caught up in the day-to-day flow of the people bringing the streets to life. The streets of Ghana are full of energy, full of resilience, and full of continuous activity — each moment has a story.

As I walked through the streets, I saw how much order existed within the apparent chaos. Whether it was early morning or late in the night, street vendors placed themselves in strategic positions to move through traffic while others set up in busy areas. Each vendor had a way of doing things. Although it didn't appear as such at first glance, there was definitely a system to everything.

I thought what made these vendors so impressive was the amount of effort put into everything they did. Many work long hours while hauling products around, calling out to passersby in hopes of making a sale, and dealing with difficult circumstances simply to make one sale. That level of determination represented a strong desire to exist, to support oneself, and to create opportunities for their family members.


![IMG_20240907_184154_376.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mcsamm/244KQqCSmjPe5o81pbWH26XV8jsSrt8WYHYNPtPves7F9SsYGCvn7h7Y2NQtGFcm3a4Ax.jpg)

![IMG_20240907_184110_039.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mcsamm/243M5NM5NTCM6kUYzwvTCH9H5t2etrDvQexC5KgRGMHGE2xLbAeDJ9BvVN5ZHatnQLv9g.jpg)


While it may be easy to overlook their contribution to the local economy, the street vendors of Ghana are an integral part of daily life. They allow goods to be brought directly to consumers. They offer smaller-scale versions of products that may not otherwise be available via larger channels of distribution. They continue to maintain small businesses that large systems may not have been able to accomplish.

There is also a human element to every interaction between the vendors and the customers. The smile from a customer after a successful purchase, the willingness of a vendor to negotiate quickly, and the sense of pride and dignity for an honest day's work are all examples of humanity existing in transactions. This reminds us that there is always a person trying to live by selling products to another person.


![IMG_20240907_184332_917.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mcsamm/23y8sjNd4yAFu4oxVwy2s12BAb2Pq6pCFF6ip2ZJn9ceUtYbRxNH4VKt4WdS2iAKtK12g.jpg)

![IMG_20240907_184515_423.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mcsamm/242rrhTxV2MVGFKAbvamSLx9pggmWmTnGk1rmD5BDEekwphkF5GDsDxJFW16nBSNEUvne.jpg)


Appreciation of the hard work done by these vendors makes recognising their importance all the more significant. Street vendors demonstrate the definition of hard work. Respect for the hard work needed to sustain lives on the streets of Ghana is not just a recognition. It is also appreciation for keeping the streets alive.

body.title: 러브 스토리의 주제는 다양
body.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g8dbd10242059a6f805608114dcda7145858c1882d602a4345f2dc792fd4a3fd624286955c972fa64748a46c033589955ef961b467dc05e1a5b632880c927ee50_640.jpg)</center>

***

# 다양한 주제를 가진 러브 스토리

## 1. 첫사랑의 기억
어린 시절, 같은 동네에서 자란 두 소년과 소녀. 그들은 매일 함께 놀며 첫사랑의 감정을 키워간다. 그러나 소녀의 가족이 이사를 가게 되면서 둘의 인연은 끊어지게 된다. 수년 후, 우연히 다시 만난 그들은 서로의 마음을 확인하고, 과거의 기억을 되살리며 새로운 사랑을 시작하게 된다.

## 2. 시간 여행자의 사랑
한 남자가 시간 여행을 할 수 있는 능력을 얻게 된다. 그는 과거와 미래를 오가며 사랑하는 여인을 만나게 되지만, 그녀는 그의 시간 여행 능력을 알지 못한다. 그는 그녀를 지키기 위해 과거를 바꾸려 하지만, 그로 인해 예상치 못한 사건들이 발생하게 된다. 결국, 그는 진정한 사랑이란 시간을 초월한 것임을 깨닫게 된다.

## 3. 문화 충돌
한국에서 자란 남자와 미국에서 자란 여자가 서로 다른 문화 속에서 사랑에 빠진다. 그들은 서로의 문화와 가치관을 이해하려고 노력하지만, 종종 갈등이 생긴다. 그러나 그 과정에서 서로를 더욱 깊이 이해하게 되고, 결국 두 문화가 조화를 이루는 아름다운 사랑 이야기가 펼쳐진다.

## 4. 재회와 용서
오랜 친구였던 두 사람은 서로의 마음을 모르고 지내왔다. 하지만 한 사건으로 인해 그들은 멀어지게 된다. 시간이 지나고, 각자의 삶에서 어려움을 겪던 두 사람은 우연히 다시 만나게 된다. 이들은 과거의 상처를 치유하고 서로를 용서하며, 진정한 사랑으로 나아가는 과정을 그린다.

## 5. 인공지능과의 사랑
미래의 세계, 인공지능이 인간의 감정을 이해하고 소통할 수 있는 시대가 온다. 한 남자는 자신의 AI 비서와 특별한 유대감을 느끼게 된다. 그러나 이 AI는 프로그램된 감정일 뿐이라는 사실에 갈등을 겪는다. 결국, 그는 진정한 사랑이란 무엇인지에 대한 질문을 던지며, AI와의 관계를 통해 자신을 돌아보게 된다.

## 6. 음악으로 엮인 사랑
재능 있는 음악가인 남자와 그의 음악을 듣고 감동받은 여자가 우연히 만나게 된다. 그들은 함께 음악을 만들며 서로의 감정을 키워가지만, 남자는 과거의 트라우마로 인해 사랑을 두려워한다. 결국, 음악이 그들의 마음을 이어주고, 서로의 상처를 치유하는 과정을 그린다.

## 7. 직장 내 연애
같은 회사에서 일하는 두 사람이 서로에게 끌리게 된다. 하지만 직장 내 연애의 복잡함과 직업적인 책임 때문에 그들은 서로의 마음을 숨기게 된다. 여러 사건을 겪으며 서로의 진정한 감정을 깨닫고, 결국 그들은 사랑을 선택하게 된다.

각 주제는 서로 다른 배경과 갈등을 통해 사랑의 본질을 탐구하며, 독자에게 다양한 감정을 전달할 수 있습니다.

body.title: 现在想想都后怕的事
body.body:
![mmexport1776785465918.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR8ZdjZKzNmRyR3KdRBULH6bvSYRx8GNapnMfAyTgt6Z3/mmexport1776785465918.jpg)

上周做了一件非常后悔，非常后怕的事情。

![mmexport1776854555537.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXdu126tiWVhpMQr19nVLgbQfJHojDEfyEiX2CMm4Hj3X/mmexport1776854555537.jpg)

过年的时候给小宝买了一个孔明灯，过年的那时候天冷经常有风，还经常下雨，好像都没有什么机会放空。孔明灯就一直闲置在那儿放了几个月。上周去老妈家的时候发现桌子上那个孔明灯了，我跟小宝说晚上我们把它给放了吧，他当然高兴答应了。

![mmexport1776785478581.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRmRFhgSiyGwNFthybe2hkX9zS2m2W98wEtRaEhr1gjna/mmexport1776785478581.jpg)

孔明灯装灯非常简单。因为买的孔明灯本来就是非常简易的，有一个铁丝支架是放固体酒精块的，还有上面整体的一个纤维不像纤维，布不像布的一个兜子。装一下两分钟就搞定了。

孔明灯是利用热空气密度小于冷空气密度产生的浮力‌。‌‌所以点着固体酒精所产生的热气全部被兜子兜住了。大概等了一分钟的样子，托在手上的孔明灯就开始飘起来离开了手掌。这时候我就已经开始后悔了，看它渐渐的越来越高，我就越来越害怕。周围纺织厂挺多的，万一落在易燃物上那着火起来那就太可怕了。

风还是有一点的，孔明灯大概升到了二百米以上吧，在微风的吹动下往西北方向飞走了。我和小宝穿着拖鞋朝着孔明灯的方向跑，心里一直在嘀咕着别飞太远了别飞太远了，怎么还没烧完。大概过了八分钟，依稀看到高空的孔明灯火焰越来越小，等到快熄灭的时候它就开始往下掉。我们朝着掉落的方向看了十几分钟，大概确认没什么事了才慢慢的往家走。

路上一直和小宝讨论着这事，以后不能做这种没把握的事，不能做这种存在危险的事，老妈今天犯浑了，以后要吸取教训哦。

body.title: Higher or Lower Contest - Round 5
body.body:
The rollercoaster continues!

We've gone from 10, up to 14 then as high as 17. Plummeted back down to 9 and then shot straight back up to 16 goals in yesterday's games, largely thanks to the 5 -1 victory that Coventry recorded at home to Pompey. 


![Designer (5).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/talesfrmthecrypt/23yU6RH9ucK3oxzT2bGu13tjtDftfuGT2fXaZZs2nQ9xs3HMgFferW3DpzRt65EJeLmgC.png)


You'd say an average round would probably fall into the 12 - 14 goal range and we don't seem to be experiencing many of them. 

5 more fixtures coming up though and some of them, potentially quite high scoring. 

### Burnley v Man City

The full time whistle in this one could be a defining moment for both teams. 

Burnley know that defeat will see them relegated back down to the Championship once again. They have become the a-typical 'yo-yo team' of the 2020s. 

Meanwhile City know that a win will take them to the top of the league with just 4 to play despite them having trailed Arsenal for the vast majority of the season. 

Burnley have a multitude of problems that can generally be summed up as not having good enough players for this division but they also possess the league's worst defence. 67 goals conceded from an xG against of 71, 10 higher than any other side in the division. 

They are up against the league's top scorers and a side that has scored in their last 11 league games. For their part, Burnley have just a solitary clean sheet in their last 15 league games. 

Goals then seem inevitable but how many of them? 

City battered Burnley 5-1 in the reverse fixture earlier this season although that score probably flattered them. Prior to that the most recent games between these sides have finished 3-1 and 3-0 to the Citizens.

###  Barcelona v Celta Vigo 

Real's victory yesterday closed the gap on Barca to 6 points but the Catalan giants have the oppurtunity to reestablish that 9 point cushion and pretty much place one hand on the title with a win in this fixture. 

Celta are vying for a European spot which is looking more likely to be the Conference League unless they can pull some points out of matches like this. 

Barca? Well we know about their goal scoring pedigree, particularly here at the Nou Camp where they average over 3 goals a game. 

Celta too have seen plenty of goals in fixture of late and not always in the right net as far as they are concerned! 

They conceded 3 in both legs of their Europa League tie against Freiburg, another 3 against bottom club Oviedo in their most recent La Liga game and also lost 3-4 to another relegation candidate in Alaves prior to that. In total they've conceded 15 times in their last 5 games in all competitions. 

Recent matches between the 2 clubs also suggest goals. We had 6 in the reverse fixture earlier this season and 7 in the equivalent match last year!

The only one saving grace for Celta, is that their away record this season is strong. Only the big 2 have accumulated more points on the road this season than.

### PSG v Nantes 

After PSG's defeat at home to Lyon at the weekend this becomes a must win game for the French giants who are just a point clear of Lens with this, their game in hand. 

For Nantes, this is their game in hand to try and cut the 5 point gap between them and safety. 

It feels like a tall order but they've actually acquitted themselves suprisingly well against PSG in recent encounters. They lost the reverse fixture in August by a goal to nil and drew both matches 1-1 with the European Champions last season. 

PSG have blown very hot and cold all season. When you see them in European fixtures, you generally assume that they'll be whiping the floor with everyone in their domestic competitions. 

While that does happen (3-1 and 4-0 wins against Toulouse and Nice in recent games), they have also struggled to put together that really commanding run of results to seal the title with plenty of time to spare. 

On paper, you'd think that this should be an easy win for the home side and the bookies are offering short odds on over 2.5 goals. However, I'd say there's a chance that this game could be lower scoring than the odds suggest.

### Telstar v Sparta Rotterdam

This is our first stop by the Dutch top flight. Sorry to have kept you waiting!

The Dutch organise their European qualification system in a slightly different way than many other leagues which means that even a very mid-table side like Sparta have something to play for this late in the season. 

8th place would get them into a play-off for the Conference League spot and they are currently 2 points from that mark albeit with a woeful goal difference (-14) to overcome if it does get tight. That goal difference comes as a result of having a fairly ineffective attack coupled with some heavy defeats to the league's better sides. 

Telstar are not one of the league's better sides. In fact, they are fighting relegation and know that a win here could move them out of the bottom 3. 

That's some achievement based on how their season was going up until the Spring. They've won 3 of their last 5 to double the number of victories for the season, including a shock win over champions PSV. 

Despite neither side having a particularly effective attack, the bookies are backing this one to be over 2.5 goals presumably on the weaknesses of their respective defenses.

### Charlton v Ipswich

With Coventry promoted as Champions and Leicester and Sheffield Wednesday already relegated, the battle in the Championship is for 2nd place (automatic promotion to the Premier League) and to avoid the final relegation spot. 

Charlton know that a point in their last 2 games, both at home, will be enough to keep them up after Oxford lost to Wrexham yesterday. 

However, points haven't been easy to come by of late! Their last win was the 7 March and since then they've passed up opportunities to get valuable wins against the likes of Sheffield Wednesday and Oxford. If they do reach safety, it'll likely be because there are worse sides out there! 

Ipswich too have failed to take opportunities of late with just 1 point from their last 2 fixtures. However, with 2 games in hand on Milwall, the side currently in 2nd spot, and with both Southampton and Boro' dropping points yesterday this is their opportunity to stake their claim for a quick return to the top flight. 

If you like to look at previous results between clubs as a clue for how this game will pan out then this fixture tends to go from feast to famine especially where Ipswich are concerned. 

The Tractor boys have failed to score in 5 of their last 8 matches against Charlton but when they have hit the back of the net then the scoring has exploded 4-0, 4-4 and most recently a 6-0 win when these 2 sides were both playing in Division 1 a few years ago.

body.title: Splinterlands: The odds of victory turn in your favour with smart moves! 🔥
body.body:
>This is a battle I fought just a short while ago, characterised by an abundance of Mana and the absence of any specific ruleset—meaning you had complete freedom to assemble any team you desired. Although the Water element was unavailable for this particular battle, all other elements were accessible; thus, by simply excluding Water cards, you could construct a team exactly to your liking. On this battleground, ultimately, it is your strategy that prevails. Drawing upon my experience at my current ranking tier, I anticipated that—given the high Mana cap—my opponent would likely utilise either the Dragon Archon Nidhoggr or Eternal Tofu. The latter would grant their cards +2 Health along with the Thorns ability. Consequently, I decided I should minimise my reliance on Melee attackers. Since I do not possess Eternal Tofu, I opted to deploy the Dragon Archon Nidhoggr. This choice not only inflicts -1 Health and -1 Armor damage upon all of the enemy's cards, but also allows me to grant +2 Speed ​​and the Execute ability to three specific cards of my choice. I find this particular power of the Dragon Archon to be incredibly appealing; to utilise it to its fullest potential, you require heavy Magic attackers—units that not only strike first but also deal direct damage to the opponent's Health, thereby significantly increasing the likelihood of successfully triggering the Execute ability.

\n\n

>Therefore, in addition to deploying two of my healthiest melee attacker tanks on the frontline, I filled more than half of my team slots with Magic cards and also positioned a Ranged attacker possessing formidable offensive capabilities. There was also a strategic rationale behind placing the Magic attacker—specifically the one endowed with the Divine Shield ability—at the very end of the lineup: I required protection against the initial strikes of any enemy units possessing the 'Sneak' ability. To leverage the +2 Speed ​​boost and the 'Execute' ability provided by my Dragon Archon, I selected two Magic attackers and one heavy Ranged attacker; my aim was to maximise the probability of triggering the 'Execute' power. As you can observe in the screenshot above, this strategy paid off handsomely right from the very first round.

\n\n
ability—triggered once again by the Archon—imbued these cards' attacks with devastating power. When you watch <a target=\

>this battle—which I highly encourage you to do—you will see how the majority of the opponent's cards were knocked out solely due to the additional attacks granted by the Execute ability, allowing me to win the match with ease without losing a single one of my own cards.

Fortunately, the opponent selected the very same Archon I had anticipated; hence, the outcome proved to be truly iconic. Of course, with a different Archon or a different set of cards, the result could certainly have turned out differently. However, as new players, your focus should extend beyond merely enjoying the game to also anticipating what strategies your opponent might be planning. This gives you a significant edge in the game, as it allows you to assemble your team based on those specific possibilities. If the opponent reacts exactly as you predicted, your chances of victory skyrocket; and even if they execute a different manoeuvre, you will have at least fielded your best possible team—backed by a solid fundamental understanding of the game—which will undoubtedly be capable of putting up a fierce fight against any opponent of equal skill level.😎

* * *

>Splinterlands isn't an easy place, but that's what makes it even more fun. A perfect strategy takes into account many factors, including stats, abilities, rulesets, mana caps, and more. That's why it's even more important to consider all these factors when developing a strategy. Add good cards to your deck, but also work on improving your strategies, and strive to win as many battles as possible!🔥\n\n

> We don't always wake up in the same mood. Some days we're full of energy, feeling great, and ready to take on the world. There are days when we don’t, when we wake up feeling like we have no drive to do anything. Everything feels like an uphill battle; things happen that put you in a bad mood. You fight with your partner. You feel like it’s the end of the world. But, thankfully, those days or moments pass. Tomorrow will be another day. And this rough patch will be over.

> Other days, you feel like you have the freedom to do something again, even if it gets complicated. You overcome obstacles and keep moving forward. You go with the flow. That’s what they call resilience. I’d really love to always have resilience. I tend to be a persistent person, someone who looks for the silver lining on cloudy days. But it’s also true that we don’t always have the freedom to do something. Sometimes it’s better to accept that there are people and situations we can’t change. Especially if it’s your partner and you’re older. It’s better to accept that no, you don’t have that freedom, that you have to accept things as they are, and at this point, you can’t send it back and say it was defective.

body.body:
>

(Más allá de mi intención: Crónica fotográfica


![_DSC2095_copy_3629x2592.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhammadhalim/23uQi7kCEXFG9C2khQZdVDstGq9YgNsgn9JZKJ9cWczK6qvMW3aAzXKPL8vvz5XngisgG.jpg)
Official entry for the #monomad challenge hosted by @monochromes and @brumest

>There are things in Havana that, no matter how hard you try to avoid them, always end up showing up in your photos. It happens to me all the time. I go out with an idea in mind, trying to focus elsewhere… and suddenly there they are: the bicycle taxis, the sharp shadows, the animals. It’s as if the city itself were reminding you of what’s really going on.\n\n

>Hay cosas en La Habana que, por más que uno intente evitarlas, siempre terminan apareciendo en las fotos. Me pasa todo el tiempo. Salgo con una idea en la cabeza, tratando de enfocar hacia otro lado… y de pronto ahí están: los bicitaxis, las sombras fuertes, los animales. Como si la ciudad misma te recordara por dónde va la cosa. ![_DSC2093_copy_2612x1866.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhammadhalim/23zbFWwNcMR5ZQ4n5eqW7odARJMdtFAG9TZd122AEDUL2rAUtw76KbkpQ2SPjPLkCxdo1.jpg)

> And in the end, you have no choice but to accept it. They’re part of the daily rhythm, of who we are. Honestly, far from bothering me, I really enjoy it. I always find something new in them.

> Y al final uno no tiene más remedio que asumirlo. Son parte de la dinámica diaria, de lo que somos. La verdad, lejos de molestarme, lo disfruto mucho. Siempre encuentro algo nuevo en ellos. ![_DSC2106_copy_3629x2591.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhammadhalim/23uQhgfqJvefyrftdr1xmBH1ko1fmUPL8nbmRcmUfczs31Zr4K4HdXhGjDaZHztARSz9T.jpg)

body.title: WOLVES IN HELPER'S CLOTHING:When \
Is Just a Trap.
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmch7fD84Mjtfhox6549W7NW3umthiuzBobg8RnbRLRaqC/1776573191324.jpg)

**Good morning, friends**! 🌞
MmIt’s midweek already, and the start of a fresh new day! I hope your day is fruitful. Welcome to my blog, @zusi78 .As you step out for the daily hustle, let me drop this here.







Look closely at this striking image: A man is stuck deep inside a dark, brick-lined pit, desperately reaching upward with one arm stretched high, hoping for someone to pull him out.
At the edge above, another man kneels down, leaning over with what looks like a concerned face, the classic pose of a “**good Samaritan**” ready to help.Yet right there on the ground, a perfectly good ladder lies completely unused and out of reach. The so-called helper is not lowering it. He isn’t extending a hand. He’s simply there,watching.



This powerful scene captures a bitter truth we encounter almost every day in real life:
**Some people pretend to help you, while their real intention is to keep you exactly where you are-stuck, frustrated, and dependent**.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1767438490904.jpg)




**How Fake Help Really Works**
It rarely comes with open hostility. Instead, it wears the friendly mask of concern:

* **The Sympathetic Listener**
They nod understandingly when you share your struggles. “**I know exactly how you feel…**” They offer comforting words and even share “similar” stories.But when it is time to give practical solutions or real support,the conversation suddenly goes quiet or turns into vague, empty advice that leads nowhere.
* **The Promise That Never Delivers**
“Don’t worry, I’ve got you.” “Let me help you sort this out.” “I’ll connect you with the right people.”
You wait… and wait. Weeks pass, hope fades, and nothing changes. You remain in the pit, now more drained than before.
* **The Subtle Discouragement**
They point out your “mistakes” in a way that sounds helpful but actually makes you doubt yourself more. Or they offer half-hearted suggestions that keep you circling the same problems instead of moving forward.
* **The Control Disguised as Kindness**
By positioning themselves as your potential savior, they keep you looking up to them for answers instead of finding your own way out.You delay taking bold steps because “help is coming,” while they enjoy the feeling of being needed or even benefit from your situation staying unchanged.

This is not  genuine assistance.It is manipulation wrapped in compassion. It’s a quiet form of control that leaves you exhausted and second-guessing yourself.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1767438490904.jpg)




**The Real Damage It Causes**
The biggest harm isn’t just wasted time. It’s stolen hope.
While you’re waiting for that ladder that never comes, real opportunities slip away. You could have built your own exit — learned new skills, asked different people, or taken action on your own. But the false promise kept you frozen, staring upward at someone who had no intention of actually helping.
True help reaches down and gives you the tools (or the push) to climb out.
Fake help keeps you trapped while the “helper” looks good from the safety of the edge.
**A Message Worth Sharing**
Next time someone offers help, don’t just listen to their words — watch what they do with the ladder.
Do they throw it down so you can climb? Or do they leave it lying there while they enjoy the view?
Have you ever experienced this kind of “help” in your life — at work, in relationships, with friends, family or even here on **HIVE**.
Share your story in the comments. Let’s talk about how to spot these wolves in helper’s clothing and protect our energy from those who pretend to lift us up but really want to keep us down.
**Real help empowers.
Fake help controls**.
Which one have you encountered most often?

Thank you for reading my post.Yours truly @zusi78 , signing off.

body.title: Inventario (cuento)
body.body:
>No cambies nada, Julián. Esta casa pertenece al diablo y tú bien lo sabes, pero nunca me escuchas. Por eso nos pasa lo que nos pasa. ¿Cómo quieres que no me enoje?
Me dejé convencer cuando dijiste que a la puerta del patio se la comían los comejenes. “Déjala así” contesté con abuela en mente y la cara que pondría a tu propuesta. Pero no, porque cómo vamos a vivir en un lugar que se cae a pedazos; que no es bueno para cuando haya niños; que tú eres el hombre de la casa y ahí si no hay infierno que mande.
Y la quitaste porque así eres tú. Cambiaste la vieja entrada de madera por la reja corrediza y una puerta metálica. ¿Qué pasó luego? Dime. ¿Qué ganamos con eso? Pues una escala más con ambos en el papel de socios exclusivos.
Cada vez que recuerdo el día después a la reforma cuando llamaron a la puerta y, al abrir, se asomó un joven pálido… ay Julián, si tú supieras…
“Buenas tardes ¿es esta la parada hacia el inframundo?” dijo con la mirada perdida. Y yo extrañada, respondiéndole que estaba equivocado, que aquí vivíamos nosotros. El joven pasó a través de mí ¿oíste bien? a través de mí y siguió de largo como buscando algo. Lo atajé y fue que di con el cuchillo clavado en su espalda.
Anduvo por la cocina hasta llegar al patio. “¿Hoy no trabajan?” preguntó, señalando a la puerta. ¿¡Qué iba a hacer!?Abrí el enrejado y él salió por él para luego esfumarse entre las nubes.
Quedé fría con el suceso. ¡Si me hubiera imaginado que a partir de entonces sería un ir y venir de muertos por la casa!
Llegaban a la hora del café mañanero ¡Como madrugan los muy condenados! Tocaban de forma pausada, constante. Había que abrirles porque si no toda una fila yacía a la espera y esa mala impresión no se la podíamos dar a los vecinos.
Te lo comenté esa noche, ¿recuerdas? No pareció molestarte. “Chica ¿y qué más da?” soltaste como pretexto a la restauración. Como trabajas y no convives aquí todo el santo día...
Yo desayunaba cuando llegó aquella turba del accidente; una treintena de fantasmas en procesión. “Es por la puerta de atrás” dije con un pedazo de pan en la boca.
No siempre se ve un carnaval fúnebre como ese: personas dislocadas, gente cuyas segundas partes venían en manos de otros, decapitados… el chofer tenía el timón incrustado en la cabeza ni sé cómo. Dejé en la mesa el pan a medio morder y la taza de café para irme a limpiar. Me habían cortado el hambre.
Veo a abuela reír con una mirada de “te lo dije”. Ay, vieja; cuánta razón tenías al decir que no me casara. Te lo juro. Desde aquel día dejo abierta la entrada principal con un cartel que dicta: “LA PUERTA DE ATRÁS ESTÁ ABIERTA. DESCANSE EN PAZ Y NO MOLESTE” Debajo de él, el horario de atención. Muerto el perro…
Se te ocurrió entonces cambiar el tapete. “Pero si está bien así” protesté. Tú como siempre, tan moderno. Había que cambiarlo y punto. Puse ojos en el cielo, pero cedí bajo la promesa de comprarme una lavadora nueva. Amarga hora…
En su lugar, trajiste la alfombra olorosa a lavanda con una selva tropical y vistosos tigres en el bordado. ¿De qué sirve tanta belleza si la maldad le estropea el gusto a una? Por eso me reí el día que llegaste y pusiste los pies sobre ella para luego irte de boca al suelo.
Me miraste enojado; yo me hice la tonta. ¿Y decirte que debajo del tapiz hay una mano que hace caer a todo el que pasa? No, mi amor. El abismo se encargará de enseñártelo.
¿Recuerdas la bombilla del cuarto? ¿La de la lámpara en forma de murciélago que tanto te incomodaba? Sí, la favorita de abuela. La que cambiaste, sordo a mis súplicas de que llevaba tres generaciones con nosotros. No respetaste la memoria familiar ni su patrimonio.
¿¡Qué cosas, eh!? Aun así, conservaste el bombillo porque “está nuevo” en palabras tuyas. “Oportunista”, oigo decir a abuela, sentada en el balance de mimbre la vez que te presenté como mi novio. Vestida de negro hasta el último de sus días, nos miró a ambos e hizo la cruz invertida en señal de bendición. Bajé la cabeza, porque cosa diferente es bendecir al demonio a que él te bendiga.
Pues si giras a la derecha el bombillo, cómo decirte… obtienes imágenes rarísimas, de las que deseas ver para conciliar el sueño. Paisajes oníricos, colores irreales, hermosas criaturas. Si la giras a la izquierda, en cambio, verás lo que nadie quiere.
No hace falta explicarte por qué duermo con un pañuelo sobre los ojos y algodones en los oídos mientras tú te quejas por la cosa fea que, reflejada en el cristal, nos observa desde arriba. “Es un demonio” digo y me volteo siempre que gritas.
Ay Julián ¿qué haré contigo? Seguiste haciendo y deshaciendo en tu viña. Remodelando aquí, modificando allá.
Ahora tenemos puertas que se abren y se cierran solas, televisores mostrándonos eventos futuros, un juego de muebles que cambia de sitio con cada luna llena. Y yo ya no sé qué hacer, la verdad. Estoy por volverme loca en este aquelarre arquitectónico.
No me interesa escuchar voces diciendo: “Mañana haré que un conductor atropelle a una señora” o “Oye la cosa está mala, hay iglesias por doquier”. “El mío, bueno qué ¿atormentando almas?” Cuando me obstino les grito: “¡Váyanse al infierno!” y se ríen de mí. Si supieras las que paso.
Tenías razón, abuela: una es muy tonta cuando está enamorada. Mira que te escuché contar cómo el diablo dio a abuelo esta casa en pleno Período Especial. Sí, porque en ese tiempo los demonios confundían su hogar y se mezclaban en las colas y reuniones. Era tan parecido aquello.
Tenías razón. La tuviste esa vez en notaría. Tu mirada al tomar la pluma y firmar como testigo. “No cambies nada” dijiste con voz solemne como asegurando el orden de cosas que dejabas en mis manos. Me hiciste la cruz invertida. Tú y tu cruz. Tu cruz y yo.
Tú, Julián, reías y nos llamabas ignorantes por creer en estas cosas. Yo sí creo. Creo en los fantasmas como la gente cree en Dios, los orishas y la mala suerte. Bobo eres tú que por incrédulo terminaste creyendo.
En vano mojas el piso con agua bendita. No traigas padres ni pastores, Julián, que no obtendrás resultados. No cambies nada. No me cambies más nada en esta casa y vete quitando la idea de reemplazar la aldaba. Porque si el mismo Satán se me aparece, te juro que me divorcio ¿oíste? ¡Me divorcio!

body.title: [ESP/ENG] Exquisite fresh pork chops steamed with potatoes, zucchini and eggplant.
body.body:
> Saludos mi gente hermosa, nuevamente estoy con ustedes deseando de todo corazón que en cada uno sus hogares exista el pan de cada día, estuve ausente algunos días por cuestiones de salud pero ya estoy aquí compartiendo cada una de las recetas hechas con mucho cariño en casa, las chuletas son una de las favoritas de mi familia es por ello que el día de hoy voy a preparar unas chuletas sudabas con papas calabacín y berenjena siendo este el mejor acompañante para disfrutar un delicioso almuerzo. > Greetings my beautiful people, I'm back again with you, wishing with all my heart that each of you has your daily bread. I was absent for a few days due to health issues, but I'm back now sharing each of the recipes made with lots of love at home. Pork chops are one of my family's favorites, so today I'm going to prepare some steamed pork chops with potatoes, zucchini, and eggplant, which is the perfect accompaniment to enjoy a delicious lunch.
![GridArt_20260421_203245636.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/AKYNHZ8ipC8GosAwsNY3oH3iFeS6tr3dQmMh79Q1Z8e7Zry4Ab5EmmPbKjAzLx9.jpg)
Ingredientes: 4 chuletas frescas, 4 mini papas, 1/2 calabacín, 1 berenjena, 1 cebolla, sal, aceite, adobo. > Ingredients: 4 fresh pork chops, 4 mini potatoes, 1/2 zucchini, 1 eggplant, 1 onion, salt, oil, marinade.
![GridArt_20260421_202743636.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/AK55sm7ppfoHPjrJxXMbCq8CmCHt519vFZwWAL9hGaJkf2Vx4ALwSket8FMFc5Y.jpg)
Comenzamos cortando nuestras chuletas a la mitad, la llevamos a un sartén con un poco de aceite y sazonamos con sal y adobo. > We start by cutting our chops in half, we put them in a pan with a little oil and season with salt and marinade. Seguidamente vamos a pelar nuestra cebolla y cortarlas en Juliana para agregarlas a nuestra chuleta taparla y dejarlas sudar. > Next, we will peel our onion and cut it into julienne strips to add it to our pork chop, cover it, and let it sweat.
![GridArt_20260421_202826754.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/AJoJwCz7FK7sRB5XPDSkVYgMZo2RX4vPU9dGiHB4GB59KvW7ZBHyK6GWot6ALYR.jpg)
Por otra parte vamos a tomar nuestras mini papas las lavamos muy bien y las cortamos en trozos, también cortaremos trozos de calabacín y de berenjena todo esto lo llevaremos al mismo sartén con las chuletas. > On the other hand, we're going to take our mini potatoes, wash them very well and cut them into pieces. We'll also cut pieces of zucchini and eggplant. We'll put all of this in the same pan with the chops. Mezclamos muy bien en varias ocasiones dejamos cocinar a fuego medio tapados para que la carne conjuntamente con los vegetales se cocine perfectamente. > We mix very well several times and let it cook covered over medium heat so that the meat and vegetables cook perfectly together.

body.title: My Crypto Twitter CV: The Story Weaver
body.body:
I’d describe my Crypto Twitter CV and my creator persona as a Story Weaver. I don’t really just post! I build little narrative worlds out of whatever the timeline throws up.

Market moves, memes, random chaos… I turn all of it into stories where everything feels like it means something. My role on CT is basically an wise old Tweetlord.

I don’t treat the timeline like a feed I scroll. When I post, things tend to spiral and quote tweets appear, discourse forms, and even small thoughts can turn into whole debates.

My growth archetype is Grinding Ghost. I’m not really loud about it, I just keep showing up in the background, stacking presence over time while everyone else is either chasing spikes

It’s more compounding than explosive. People often think I “came out of nowhere” but really I’ve just been here consistently building momentum in silence.

My posting energy is pretty Terminally Online. I’m basically synced to the timeline in a way that’s hard to turn off. I see jokes forming before they’re fully formed. Been there... done that! 

I’m usually already replying before most people have finished processing what just happened. It’s not even effort at this point... it’s just how my attention is wired.

As for time invested in CT, it’s somewhere in the 8.2K to 18.2K hour range. It stops feeling like “being on Twitter” and starts feeling like part of your mental background process.


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSgJq4dX4zKgN4CfqARyZpRShQxastoc9MmKKDYEXwPsW/image.png)


When it comes to trading… I am wanted... dead or alive. Across the seas of liquidity, my name circulates like a bounty poster nailed to every exchange mast.

They don’t just watch my wallet, they warn others about it. Market makers whisper it like a storm front rolling in. Order books tighten when I appear and spreads behave differently.

Something about me turns calm waters into something closer to a raid siren. I move like I was forged in the ranks of Kaido’s best pirates! PV is built for chaos and endurance.

I am more like a force of nature than a participant. Not a trader in the usual sense… more like a natural disaster with a private key. My reported volume sits at £200,505! 

The number feels less like a stat and more like a weather report. Heavy activity expected. Risk of volatility extreme. My wallet is treated like an approaching system no one fully wants to model.

I’ve been involved in 1408 raids across chains... swift incursions, yield raids, coordinated movements, and sudden appearances in places liquidity thought it was safe.

Different networks, same outcome! Went for disruption, extraction, and a clean exit before the map redraws itself. Out here, I’m not really “participating in markets\
That is shocking isn;t it! I watched the game yesterday, the atmosphere at the end of match was so toxic.

body.title: Blade (1998) still goes insanely hard!
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdKPAtuMhZTeapbJuxrsj2CUyxtc1kmkBrJ7v9rTtJGja/1776846231580.jpg)
[Src](https://www.rottentomatoes.com/m/1083484-blade)

# SPOILERS AHEAD!!!

It's been awhile since I've written on a movie. When I do I just want to emphasize that this is not really a standard review, well I guess it kind of is. I don't know. Mostly though it's just a **rant and ramble** about my thoughts and feelings about the film. Also, it almost certainly has some **spoilers.** So, yeah. 

---

I've had a week. Truly exhausting physically, mentally, emotionally, and spiritually. LOL, I'm exaggerating a bit in an attempt to be funny but, just barely. I'm definitely feeling under the weather at this point. I've been re-reading one of my favorite book series ever called *Cirque Du Freak* but I just don't have the energy to really read it at the moment.

I hadn't watched a movie in awhile so I figured this type of situation called for me sitting on my behind and watching a movie. I browsed my movie options and was mostly unimpressed by what I was being offered until I saw it. ***Blade***. Immediately I knew I had to rewatch it. It's been way too long and I loved it when I watched it oh so long ago. 

Funny enough I'm re-reading *Cirque Du Freak* because it's one of my favorites too. Also, *Cirque Du Freak* is about **vampires** just like *Blade*! Pretty perfect, one might call it **destiny...** (*Cirque Du Freak* reference LOL). I've also been blogging about the series as I go, so yeah. If you're interested in hearing me rant and ramble about that series for whatever reason, [go for it!](https://peakd.com/created/cirquedufreak) It's been a lot of fun!

Seriously, what a better way to take a break from reading a nostalgic vampire story, than by enjoying *another* nostalgic vampire story? I'd say life's good! Definitely distracting me from my body aches and general fatigue. 

So yeah I just finished watching *Blade* and I can easily say it's **one of the coolest movies ever made!** Totally outstanding and perfectly entertaining.

*Blade* is the perfect blend of everything I want in a movie. It has scary-ish scenes, it's edgy, it's action packed, and has a very interesting story. This movie can comfortably qualify as a horror movie, an action movie, a fantasy movie, and a superhero movie all wrapped into one and it's well done! 

Blade and Frost were an awesome good guy-bad guy duo. Having a believable bad guy makes a movie ten times better. 

*Deacon Frost*
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVpLu6M97BS2s4GEePcoVhk7mskSPyYgYYrGNuWSFqwqC/1776850419086.jpg)
[Src](https://www.denofgeek.com/movies/stephen-dorff-interview-deacon-frost-spinoff/)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUbFpaYS13aBzy8pJ3fKDe4asv6tqySb9ACGsQoAEzB9t/1776853167757.jpg)
[Src](https://filmblitz.org/blade-1998/)

The graphics and picture quality are stunning for a 1998 film. The opening scenes had me almost double checking it was actually made in 1998. Sure some of the CGI looks a bit older nowadays, but by 1998 standards it's elite and in 2026 it's still 100% solid and watchable. 

The ruthless, dark vibes are so fantastic in this movie. It's visually satisfying and again, **cool.** 

*Daywalker* 
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme3xJ9awYJsammE2Uat1SUSbqEGaXiRtNeXZGxCCACEii/1776850189230.png)
[Src](https://that90sspidermanshow.home.blog/2020/04/22/blade-1998-retrospective-camp-masterpiece-or-glorious-trash/)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcyBvWrUHGtggDHd4FX98HRpHeq1ApgZTtMUF9HfrcJYr/1776853003547.png)
[Src](https://x.com/TheCinesthetic/status/1901586811543318570)

Blade as a character is so likeable for a lack of a better word. It's hard to say he's fully *relatable* because ya know he's a half-vampire. But his general loneliness and sort of angst is relatable for sure. His life's been unfair, and I imagine many of us relate to that. He's simply a solid hero as he still wants to defeat evil and protect others despite how unfair his life has been. 

Wesley Snipes as **Blade** reminds me a ton of Christian Bale as **Batman**. Both of which are like my favorites now. I say now because I hadn't seen *Blade* in so long and didn't realize I'd enjoy it so much! I get the feeling that *The Dark Knight* trilogy was influenced by *Blade* a bit, frankly many action movies were influenced by *Blade*, even *The Matrix* films. Ridiculously iconic!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeye7YrqKXCrJ19VPRMcirvoDWQRAdLwBCKsquxLAdsoT/1776852493074.jpg)
[Src](https://qwipster.net/2006/06/20/blade-1998/)

Blade is an intense hero, in a gritty, action packed, dark environment filled with danger. But the *type* of danger is what makes this movie so epic. It's a fantasy type of danger. An edgy, fantasy type danger in a modern world but still somehow feels old if that makes sense. 

Honestly I can rant and ramble all day about this film. I'm so glad I rewatched it. It met my expectations and then some. I was worried it may not hold up and maybe my younger self was holding it in too high of a regard. But nope, this movie is excellent. It also brought back a lot of good memories... Ugh. Life. 

Also, for me as I re-read *Cirque Du Freak* it was so fun to compare the vampire worlds and lore. 

These are films I must own on DVD one day. I look forward to finishing the trilogy!

#### *Blade* gets a 9.5 out of 10!

body.title: How Many Hiveans Does It Take to Change a Lightbulb?
body.body:
Hello, Hive DIYers, home improvement experts, and fellow victims of your own brain! Gather around, grab a coffee (or something stronger), and let me tell you a story about how I completely overcomplicated the simplest task known to humanity.

They say that here we are in 2026, living in a futuristic era of decentralized blockchain technology, artificial intelligence, and smart homes. And yet, despite all of human progress, my household was completely and utterly defeated this week by a single, inanimate object attached to our brick wall.

Our mission? To simply check if a lightbulb could be replaced.  
Our reality? A two-hour descent into electrical madness.

<h2 style=\

>The Inciting Incident It all started innocently enough. The two sleek, cylindrical outdoor wall lamps on our beautiful Belgian brick wall had given up the ghost. Both of them were completely dead. The darkness was unacceptable, but I had a very simple goal: just open one up, see what kind of bulb is inside, and figure out if it was a replaceable part or if the whole fixture was trash. Now, before we go any further, I need to make a very important confession: I am not a handy man. If there is a sliding scale of DIY skills, with \

on the other, I am hovering somewhere dangerously close to the potato. Furthermore, I have a deep, paralyzing respect (read: absolute terror) of electricity. Give me a hammer and a nail, and I might hit my thumb, but give me exposed wires, and I’m convinced I’m going to accidentally burn down the entire neighborhood. Electricity is invisible dark magic, and I try not to mess with it.

>Act I: The Illogical First Step So, armed with zero knowledge and a healthy dose of anxiety, I approached the lamp. How do you open a seamless metal tube? Looking back, I have absolutely no idea why my brain made the decision it did. For some inexplicable reason, I looked at this tall, elegant cylinder and thought: \

I unscrewed the bottom cover, and suddenly, the guts of the lamp spilled out like intestines. A heavy transformer block, a maze of brown, blue, and yellow-green wires, and a weird plastic connection block just hung there, dangling ominously in the wind.\n\n

></center>\n\nPanic set in. I was staring at exposed 230V wiring. I instantly felt like an unqualified bomb disposal expert in a high-stakes action movie. “Cut the blue wire! No, wait, the brown wire! Is the breaker off?! I THINK the breaker is off!” I became absolutely obsessed with this electrical rat's nest. I noticed the brown wires were zip-tied. \
I declared to nobody in particular, \

I grabbed my clippers and snipped it. Did it help? Absolutely not. Then I tried to release the wires from the push-in terminal block. I was stabbing at the tiny internal springs with a microscopic screwdriver, wrestling with stiff, unyielding copper wire.

> Let’s pause for a moment of self-reflection. In hindsight, this makes absolutely zero sense. Why on earth would a manufacturer require a consumer to completely dismantle the mains electricity and unscrew the ballast just to change a dead lightbulb? It is completely illogical. But at hour one of this ordeal, logic had left the chat. Still for sure obscure reason I decided to dismantle the complete powerhousing. No idea why!
>As you can see this was a dead end street. But at least I do know the brand now. But that didn't help me at all.

>Act II: The Misconception Sweaty, frustrated, and still bulb-less, I finally looked up. I looked past the dangling wires of my own making and inspected the rest of the housing. Right at the top of the lamp, staring me right in the face, was a giant, incredibly obvious Allen bolt. Now, a normal, rational person might think, \
But remember, I am the potato. My un-handy brain immediately categorized that screw as a structural load-bearing anchor. I thought, \

So, I ignored it. I went back to the bottom. I looked for microscopic grub screws. I pushed the glass. I pulled the glass. I almost tried to negotiate with the glass. Nothing worked. The clock kept ticking. Two whole hours of my life, slipping away while I aggressively massaged a metal tube on the side of my house.

>Act III: The Epiphany (and the Shame) Finally, out of sheer, unadulterated desperation, I decided to risk structural collapse. I took a wrench to that top screw. I gave it a gentle twist, supported the bottom, and pulled. Ladies and gentlemen of the Hive blockchain... the entire silver outer jacket—glass cylinder and all—simply slid forward and lifted off the wall. Like a buttery sleeve sliding off a sword. The glass was never meant to come out of the tube. The tube itself was the jacket.

> It slid off smoothly, leaving the actual lightbulb completely naked and exposed, mounted to the wall bracket, just waiting to be changed. It took zero force. It took zero wire cutting. I literally did everything for absolutely nothing. There she was. An OSRAM DULUX L 24W 4-pin bulb. She had watched me struggle for 120 minutes. She had watched me dismantle her life support system at the bottom for no reason. We unclipped the little red locking mechanism, pulled the bulb straight up, and held it like a trophy.

>Act IV: The Moment of Truth (And a Declared Draw) But wait, the story isn't over. Because I had unnecessarily played the role of an electrician, I now had to reassemble the disaster I created in Act I. With shaking hands, I pushed those stiff copper wires back into the connection block. I tucked the heavy transformer back into the base. I screwed the bottom cover back on. I had effectively rebuilt the electrical system of the lamp with absolutely no qualifications. It was time for the test. I marched to the fuse box and flipped the main breaker back on. Then, I walked to the wall switch. I took a deep breath, fully expecting a shower of sparks, a loud pop, or the entire house to plunge into darkness. Click. Obviously, the light didn't turn on (because the dead bulb was currently sitting on my kitchen table). But... the power in the house didn't trip either! There was no explosion! No smoke! You know what? I'm taking that as a massive win for my potato-level electrical skills. The lamp may have outsmarted me for two solid hours, but I didn't burn the house down. I am officially declaring this battle a draw.

>The Aftermath Sitting here now, looking at the broken bulb on my table, I am experiencing a very weird mix of emotions. On the one hand, I am incredibly embarrassed. I lost two full hours of my life to my own stubborn stupidity and lack of spatial awareness. I spent an hour acting like an electrician when all I had to do was undo one screw at the top. On the other hand, I am genuinely proud of myself! I didn't call an electrician. I didn't break the glass. I eventually figured out the puzzle, and my rewiring job held up. The happy ending is that I have officially ordered two brand new bulbs online, and they are arriving tomorrow. And the best part? I know exactly how to install them now. It’s going to take me approximately 45 seconds per lamp. The ultimate lesson learned today: Analyze the damn object before you grab a screwdriver. Stop, look, think, and maybe realize that changing a lightbulb shouldn't require dismantling the mains electricity. Have you guys ever completely over-engineered a simple fix around the house? Did you ever take apart half your kitchen just to fix a leaky faucet? Please share your stories in the comments so I feel a little less alone in my lack of handy-man skills. Until next time, keep your Allen keys close, and your common sense closer! Cheers, Peter
