body.body:
![۲۰۲۶۰۴۲۱_۲۱۰۸۳۱.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQCxFpL6CHF3YoMoYipgkuyS1pAa7GRp5ovzWAXwqBGmN/%DB%B2%DB%B0%DB%B2%DB%B6%DB%B0%DB%B4%DB%B2%DB%B1_%DB%B2%DB%B1%DB%B0%DB%B8%DB%B3%DB%B1.jpg)

Digital Serenity: A Journey Through Colors and Pixels
Art has always been a mirror of the soul, but in the digital age, the canvas has transformed into a glowing screen, and the palette into infinite lines of code. 
Today, I want to share the story behind my latest digital painting—a piece born from the harmony of white, orange, blue, navy, and purple. 



![۲۰۲۶۰۴۲۱_۲۱۰۶۲۴.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP8cBgd7u8XoHTHRhypsmyX3YA1ayzU7QsRwwGx4BfuWA/%DB%B2%DB%B0%DB%B2%DB%B6%DB%B0%DB%B4%DB%B2%DB%B1_%DB%B2%DB%B1%DB%B0%DB%B6%DB%B2%DB%B4.jpg)

![۲۰۲۶۰۴۲۱_۲۱۰۶۳۱.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmad1YShToGJcDFtDDVe9PkDNVkNVoXdagjxS9qE62MQin/%DB%B2%DB%B0%DB%B2%DB%B6%DB%B0%DB%B4%DB%B2%DB%B1_%DB%B2%DB%B1%DB%B0%DB%B6%DB%B3%DB%B1.jpg)



This artwork wasn't created on a traditional easel; it was brought to life on my laptop using the powerful open-source software, Krita.
The Palette: A Dance of Warmth and Depth
When I started this piece, I wanted to explore the contrast between energy and tranquility. I chose Orange as the heartbeat of the painting—it represents creativity, warmth, and the spark of an idea. 
To balance this intensity, I introduced Navy Blue and Deep Purple. 
These colors provide a sense of mystery and vastness, like the night sky or the depths of the ocean.

![۲۰۲۶۰۴۲۱_۲۱۰۶۴۳.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTjWGD48pz2PSW5mpzLfhsLG9HschLuTaog7s7mKnM5c4/%DB%B2%DB%B0%DB%B2%DB%B6%DB%B0%DB%B4%DB%B2%DB%B1_%DB%B2%DB%B1%DB%B0%DB%B6%DB%B4%DB%B3.jpg)

![۲۰۲۶۰۴۲۱_۲۱۰۶۵۴.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbPgEZdeqmrNYqDdJ24YZnv7DLu2tahPSm399aPCzSPfr/%DB%B2%DB%B0%DB%B2%DB%B6%DB%B0%DB%B4%DB%B2%DB%B1_%DB%B2%DB%B1%DB%B0%DB%B6%DB%B5%DB%B4.jpg)

![۲۰۲۶۰۴۲۱_۲۱۰۷۱۰.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcKx4HzUBEYMX62CqtpV1s5DXjp8tPEjSUvCZCCaSqP4N/%DB%B2%DB%B0%DB%B2%DB%B6%DB%B0%DB%B4%DB%B2%DB%B1_%DB%B2%DB%B1%DB%B0%DB%B7%DB%B1%DB%B0.jpg)



The Light Blue acts as a bridge, softening the transition between the dark shadows and the fiery orange highlights. 
Finally, White was used not just for light, but for \

In digital art, white can be as powerful as any pigment, creating focal points that draw the eye and give the composition a sense of clarity.


![۲۰۲۶۰۴۲۱_۲۱۰۷۱۰.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcKx4HzUBEYMX62CqtpV1s5DXjp8tPEjSUvCZCCaSqP4N/%DB%B2%DB%B0%DB%B2%DB%B6%DB%B0%DB%B4%DB%B2%DB%B1_%DB%B2%DB%B1%DB%B0%DB%B7%DB%B1%DB%B0.jpg)

![۲۰۲۶۰۴۲۱_۲۱۰۷۴۸.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmebjBCsEpzw4WApzYMzx3kVp682KnNugX79rKB6cgr8Pk/%DB%B2%DB%B0%DB%B2%DB%B6%DB%B0%DB%B4%DB%B2%DB%B1_%DB%B2%DB%B1%DB%B0%DB%B7%DB%B4%DB%B8.jpg)


The Digital Experience
Working on a laptop offers a unique kind of freedom. 
There’s something magical about sitting in a quiet corner of a café or a cozy room, with nothing but your stylus and your imagination. 
Using Krita allowed me to blend these contrasting colors with a fluidity that mimics oil paints. 
The way the navy blue bleeds into the purple, and how the orange pops against the dark background, is a testament to the sophisticated brush engine of digital tools.
Digital painting is more than just clicking buttons; it’s about understanding light and texture in a virtual space.
 Every stroke of white light in this painting was a deliberate choice to bring balance to the chaotic energy of the orange and blue.
20 Pros and Cons of Using Krita for Digital Art
Pros :
Free and Open Source: It is completely free for everyone to use.
Professional Brush Engine: Offers one of the best brush customization systems.
Layer Management: Supports complex layering, groups, and blending modes.
Vector Support: Allows you to combine raster and vector art easily.
Resourceful Community: There are thousands of free brushes and tutorials available.
Animation Tools: It has a built-in timeline for 2D animation.
PSD Support: You can open and save Photoshop files.
Brush Stabilizers: Helps in drawing smooth lines even with a shaky hand.
Wrap-around Mode: Perfect for creating seamless textures and patterns.
Customizable Interface: You can arrange the workspace exactly how you like it.
Cons :
11. Performance Issues: It can lag on older laptops or very high-resolution canvases.
12. Steep Learning Curve: The many features can be overwhelming for beginners.
13. No Official Mobile Version: Unlike some competitors, it's mainly for desktop/tablets.
14. Occasional Crashes: Being open-source, it can sometimes be unstable during heavy tasks.
15. Text Tool: The text editing tool is often considered clunky and unintuitive.
16. Limited Photo Editing: It’s an art tool, not a full photo editor like Photoshop.
17. Battery Drain: Using it on a laptop can consume battery quickly.
18. Update Frequency: Sometimes bugs take a while to get fixed in the next stable release.
19. Touch Gestures: Touch support on Windows laptops can sometimes be finicky.
20. File Size: Large projects with many layers can result in very big file sizes.
A Heartfelt Thank You to My Followers
Finally, I want to take a moment to speak directly to you—my amazing community.
To everyone who takes the time to look at my paintings, leave a comment, or hit the like button: Thank you from the bottom of my heart. Your support is the fuel that keeps my creativity burning. 
Seeing your reactions to my use of colors and my digital journey gives me the confidence to keep experimenting and growing as an artist. You are not just followers; you are my inspiration. 
Thank you for being part of this colorful journey with me!



![۲۰۲۶۰۴۲۱_۲۱۰۷۴۸.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmebjBCsEpzw4WApzYMzx3kVp682KnNugX79rKB6cgr8Pk/%DB%B2%DB%B0%DB%B2%DB%B6%DB%B0%DB%B4%DB%B2%DB%B1_%DB%B2%DB%B1%DB%B0%DB%B7%DB%B4%DB%B8.jpg)

body.title: Solidifying software ecosystems with AI
body.body:
During a talk with a friend I've got a series of ideas that compliment my [previous article](https://ecency.com/ai/@jza/ai-is-expanding-into-different) on how the AI has been impacting my life. Discussing about which AI model is better or how it can be better I came across a realization. Google is missing out on a huge opportunity to take advantage of their ecosystem and how integrating AI with their tools you can get a lot for almost no cost.

So first you need to understand, at least conceptually, what are the meaning of 'skills' in AI as well as agents, I asked an AI to give the definition:

*   Skill: A modular, reusable capability or tool that an AI system can call to perform a specific task (e.g., web search, code execution, image generation).
    
*   Agent: An autonomous AI system that perceives, reasons, plans, and uses skills/tools to achieve complex goals independently, often over multiple steps.
    

Using skills I can perform tasks that could automate many of the tools of an ecosystem of applications but even gain access to other tools that were not meant to work together. For example, using a Calendar with a Sport game data to make daily reports of who is playing that day (along with other reports like weather, holidays and birthdays). Here is where the ecosystem plays a great deal.

Imagine having Google's LLMS like [Gemma4](https://deepmind.google/models/gemma/gemma-4/) work deeply with Android OS to perform tasks like battery saving mode, DND mode and other features that a n00b might even not know about. But even then, other Google products that went nowhere like Google Wallet and [Google Sites](https://workspace.google.com/products/sites/) might become more capable once the LLM work with those tools 'out of the box'.

To be honest, I think Google is not focused on rescuing dead projects or potential value added services. However, it is a chance for people that might want to take a deep dive into it.

Other ecosystems like the Apple, Amazon, or even Microsoft, but also the Open Source ecosystem stack. Still hold a similar potential to deliver services or workflows that are touched from different areas. From the old school LAMP stack, to the Linux Desktop platforms like [KDE Gear](https://kde.org/categories/gear/) or Gnome/GTK services, built up to web and other links from the MPC to the Desktop services like KDE Plasma services and [Gnome Shell Extensions](https://extensions.gnome.org/) and tie it to home automation, not just music and entertainment. Extending the OS reach that your house send you notifications on your desktop could be a cool dream, or maybe a lame one, depending how you see it 🤣

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GT\_h\_RE-zYg

body.title: My First Time Trying Chicken Steak at Pujasera Café
body.body:
> ![20260422_151627.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/AKAqji73Yne7th5x3Eq57xK7WkrcZnTJC1NKV8VaP76DR16nQdfL6U3kBYEgV6C.jpg)
Last weekend, I took the time to visit one of the outdoor cafes and restaurants that’s been quite popular on social media lately. It was quite a distance from the village where I live. The trip took about an hour by car, though it might have taken much longer if there had been traffic.
Actually, my husband invited me to attend a party for one of his coworkers at a building in the city. The trip really got me excited; I love it when my husband invites me because he rarely takes me to formal events like this. It was quite a long drive from home, and there I met my husband’s coworkers; he introduced me to all of them. After about an hour there, once my husband’s photo session was over, I immediately suggested we leave because it was quite crowded and the weather was extremely hot. ![20260419_114906.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23wX5ERe6GTS6x8gmZGML1WZS4xGQiDrHtjUukrZWzm6RnBwoe4Ncd89QZNdUvXG55hdm.jpg) Once we were out, I felt really uncomfortable in my dress, so I changed into something else and we continued on to a café that had long been a dream of mine. Today my husband granted my wish—even though he’d said it would have to wait until the end of the month, that’s exactly the kind of persuasion that made him give in. ![20260419_145415.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23vsQqL2aimzWhay7xwYAisBgckfbsXHA2neDQEnrdmiEK1faZEP7jyS2faMFpEgoWmBy.jpg) Of course, before heading into the café area, I snapped a quick outfit photo in the parking lot—it’s that kind of place. There are lots of trees, it’s super comfortable, and the atmosphere is definitely very peaceful.
![20260419_145038.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/EoptQpc3Zh8P9nJRSagdLSw5QAAJoy6W4EqpyZyp2n8g2gC4tdANuTbLTYvmbx6Ftf9.jpg) The name of the café is PujaSera Pim, one of the cafés and restaurants that was once a garden and has been transformed into a rather aesthetically pleasing outdoor café and restaurant. The area is quite spacious; I think it could accommodate hundreds of people, because it’s so vast with rows of chairs neatly arranged there. It’s very lush—the green trees are thriving. I really like it; even though the plants look young, they’re well-maintained, clean, and incredibly comfortable.
|![20260419_143154.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/EnmCGeXcEXpCTR18JBgobYHdaR91hfraSibLfgjNMF97Z26T2Fhxd5pE3jjKHvxR8mZ.jpg)|![20260419_144855.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23yTmo11zKV4vQ2SuR12ahhGfbkezSAG11k5jDAUXqCDRRCzZT4EjosettbJ8KChiXN6Y.jpg)|![20260419_144905.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/EqDkdvXeGyfcbrT3UvnDxgZtKgdn5i95iHysh7oddPamAi5C5NKFPkLK1DYP7iQigqG.jpg)| |-|-|-| |![20260419_143137.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/EnWJY2XGT9F3scJU63B3BTAsoWDq1tPwcsziry9E5b5ASkgwpXLhn4SVNV7HbuDVASj.jpg)|![20260419_133132.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/EpT69QAB5sKzs11K7GowTDdWe2ipNWWGA8pNBjeo7qDqeTeznfKpoErr5LJPFkAzWsc.jpg)|![20260419_133034.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/EpT5DUDUaCpszq9bRLybojjn34Xha3dqr4ntVUjYwLyPaNdxQikrNx6Y3T9ifVQ324Z.jpg)|
In addition to the dining area, there’s also a photo booth here—the kind that’s all the rage among Gen young these days and has been really popular in my area lately. I’m not really into trying it out, but maybe if I went with my best friend, it would be the perfect opportunity. Since my husband isn’t into taking photos, I’ll just skip it and take pictures from a distance. I’m not exactly sure how much the photo booth costs, but clearly, there’s a fee. ![20260419_144750.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23yThUqF6fur668h2j52FXmDzj1ibMs9AzWVHLEQqfCoknXYT4x4sJzDV6jdpd8GkPRRb.jpg)
This is my first time here. The place is located within one of Aceh’s major companies, the PT. PIM housing complex Kruenggukueh, Aceh Utara. Before entering the complex, on your right, you’ll find a large mosque, a clinic, and a minimarket. The food court is right behind that PT. PIM minimarket.
![20260419_143131.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/EowH4kbFMQ9TLNgMQzExEFGgRphS6EUt7V129UykKbGBsNYLLc68nEZPYy1TVNwdzYz.jpg) I chose a seat that was fairly far inside, near the food stalls. Wow, it’s so unique—the food stalls there are neatly lined up, and there are so many food options to choose from.

> ![20260419_133649.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23wX7ns85KKK2Q1pDP9VuF1HDATrs6Suu7GRiW3T6FdrzPKxzBnjHEuF8urLtUqKLHZQB.jpg)
The menu ranges from traditional dishes to international cuisine, various drinks and snacks, and even desserts—everything is available. That made us unsure of what to order. So, while looking at the menu, my husband helped me choose.

> ![20260419_135512.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/EoeHMhqHU8BPbVyPi1fn54TXeYsT32ccZyCvJLja1PUUMq7JiSYDKN8mTkPDCVQxWPE.jpg)
This time we didn’t go for the local dishes; my husband and I decided to try something more Western-style. Haha, I hope our taste buds can handle it, since I rarely eat steak. And I thought this was just an ordinary steak, nothing special compared to what you’d find at restaurants out there. ![20260419_134943.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/Eq7QES33DmwtWqhgfyzqk3bJ8E3UkkFswucducEnCG3HCTvB8aEbKUBCWkfnV5p1vuA.jpg) I was really curious about the steak because it’s their best-selling item. Steak remains my go-to dish, though the other options are also quite varied.
Chikhen Steak
![20260419_135128.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23z7QkjEYa35gBzuBgUHPu3fG3WVZd1nhVKZXnkYpN9ZtSLKkPUrgepDrNLxE977Q9yQm.jpg) Tedjo’s chicken steak is the best-selling item here after the meat steak, so since I was curious about the crispy chicken steak, I decided to order them. From the outside, the steak are coated in a crispy batter and deep-fried. They’re then drizzled with a thick, dark-colored sauce that’s distinctly black pepper-flavored.

> ![20260419_140525.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23vsXHTmR5djWYUDS1saQQQCvbBJneKwCJ1c2aHtSj4Ls5v1rNQiaFx9puamjMiiXiEFB.jpg)
Not only that, the steak are served with french fries, along with boiled carrots and broccoli. Served on a hot plate, it retains its smoky aroma with the distinctive black pepper flavor.
|![20260419_135925.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23wgU4yBNVe1hgd9JmzDs8KXon3KUHNsB1UH2W24S5krWowau1fAQUZp4txKUBq8iHv2S.jpg)|![20260419_135848.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23zS9pnDwcRHdbxWR1s6qGiZ6UYk4ycE1PDzgVqQmgh2zzubk979xRnsKGGDgrciDKUgc.jpg)|![20260419_135830.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23wgHcVhajwTF5w3hTsFuCJhYsFkctHgNCZDwYXDpP2nfFFVmoDKiEEBrj921WXJuk9ji.jpg)| |-|-|-|
The main part of the steak isn’t hard at all—the outside is crispy, but the inside is super tender, enhanced by the spicy flavor of the sauce. The sauce is very rich and thick, with just the right amount of cornstarch; I love the texture and the full-bodied seasoning. The price for these chicken sticks is also very affordable—just IDR 30,000.
Tuna Burger
![20260419_135001.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23yTqi7H4b29NxWtWxRwZAacLdmjwJgtrjbZhoaS7SdcWX5AbFYmMLX4GALKcikAkwfDh.jpg) The burger is pretty simple; this time we chose to order the tuna burger. It’s like a regular burger, but the difference is there’s no meat or chicken—we ordered shredded tuna that’s been seasoned and then layered into the burger patty along with sambal, an egg, and vegetables. ![20260419_135632.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23wCSRLT9hF6of9iRTrcQaMjYd663GBNC8E4qYRy61snPpqkxNbih6moGn5ebhb6TpPVm.jpg) When I cut into it, it was truly delicious—there was plenty of tuna, and when I took a bite, the burger tasted amazing; there was no fishy smell at all, just the aroma of the spices inside.
|![20260419_135754.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23y94bx7RnJ4TGGgRZeiWajjCLHKnZcPnt67kXkXjPdE9Jex5EWhxTmRgtsuWrbZei9LF.jpg)|![20260419_135800.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23yJTSPpqm8DtoVe7AVjawjTZdsYq2rdomCDEj7ZKUmb1faTEL6xNUb7cTq8wNzTj7KwJ.jpg)|![20260419_140136.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23xyhjBaV18FztJCSw21La5ieUsPrw1j2uNH1Qmv5n1qtYbRLtZUsqeHMRL7z2Yg7ruLZ.jpg)| |-|-|-|
The price of the burger is also quite affordable, in my opinion; for just IDR 15,000, you can enjoy a delicious, satisfying burger. My husband loved it so much that he finished it off—he even dipped it in my steak sauce because the steak sauce was indeed spicy.
Drinks Ice Teller and Lychee Tea
![20260419_140020.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23xVTgjn36BHChEVJMmAj2q9ZF5u8wjKDb45Ah2xc2akoEsddx4QWsD7V2iPDifaf6KgH.jpg) The drinks we ordered were es teler and lechi tea. My husband really loves es teler—he really enjoys the combination of avocado mixed with corn, jackfruit, and other jellies. Es teler is typically known for its thick consistency and generous fillings. However, in my opinion, this es teler felt a bit lacking in texture—it wasn’t very creamy, and the avocado was almost nonexistent. That said, the taste itself wasn’t bad at all; it was just the creaminess and thickness of the es teler that fell short.
|![20260419_140008.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23vsSMco7biM8pput56pH8tyGsUTVhtEDRKuZEQUSxAL21P4aWh6CuJRH6SvaR5YiBFtm.jpg)|![20260419_135023.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23xVTmZ8Wr1X3tQe3o6BcPsn7s3aiTk1i563EYN5jhp3VnHqrQWqdpk2AjDDgjUxAUA5Z.jpg)|![20260419_135036.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23wX3nz2Z1rmUjwf4CBxDbWtLSPPidyvS97dKRrBHEJ5kxozZkC51sEJNM3XvSQF4aa6S.jpg)| |-|-|-|
The price of this es teler is still quite affordable—just IDR 15,000 per cup, and you get a whole canned lychee inside the cup. Unfortunately, I forgot to take a picture of it. Overall, the lychee tea tastes really delicious. For those of you on a diet, be sure to ask for a little less sugar, just like I did. ![20260419_135109.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23xyfwUXAT57of3M8FKs1yndJEbi2rC1XbAvQcx3M99soFYUEuyZuKaag67o1JPWwKrrL.jpg)
![20260419_144758.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/EpJaWTN3UHDv9pNsSynrg2tMRw8wAPz443UggTxt8DzZMeeoBztDwF3bawZety6RZiW.jpg) After finishing our meal—we spent about two hours here—my husband and I went straight to the cashier to pay the bill. It’s very affordable—the prices are still very reasonable for our area. The food is all under IDR 50,000 and tastes great, even though the es teler isn’t very thick, but at least 85 percent of the flavors are delicious. I really love the steak and burgers—they’re that good. I highly recommend this café to anyone visiting. ![20260419_164058.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23w2s4XNs8x4eXTrfaod2K6VLFN64DMTzLHDVcBJWdadwS5ztBC2GejmA1rL66MViW7FR.jpg) This was a special experience for me—enjoying such unique dishes. The place has such a charming atmosphere, and coming here with my loved ones is sure to make anyone happy, isn’t it? I hope that one day, when my little family is complete, I can come back here again.
![20231026_133848_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23z7NDfinzBXBSBn23w6cxHmpE1B9xmCz6dpnpAFdRuJJ7XLC37Xz9hoadZxj4AwmZPSs.png)

body.title: Loggia and the sky
body.body:
At the heart of Heraklion stands the elegant Loggia of Heraklion,  a masterpiece of Venetian architecture built in the early 17th century as a gathering place for the city’s nobles. Inspired by Italian Renaissance design, it once hosted political discussions and social life during Venetian rule.

Today, its harmonious arches and timeless symmetry make it one of the most photographed and visited spots in the city,  a place where history quietly meets everyday life.

body.title: PURPOSE IN IT ~loh 285
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWMUceCXoyFoUB8meobzNbeNwYrbt8wGBUMpbDeiN5AuQ/1776850470145.jpg)


[pixabay](https://pixabay.com/images/download/x-3959411_1920.jpg)


There is something quietly powerful about the image, wooden pieces scattered without order, yet somehow spelling PURPOSE. 

The above reflects a truth many women live but rarely articulate, that is life does not begin in clarity. It begins in fragments and still, something meaningful being formed in it 

For some women, purpose is not always loud. It does not always announce itself with certainty or arrive wrapped in confidence. Sometimes, it begins as a question, a restlessness, or a subtle dissatisfaction with simply existing. 

Purpose is that inner pull that refuses to let you settle for a life that looks complete on the outside but feels empty within.

What does purpose look like?  you may ask, it looks like growth that is uncomfortable. It looks like choosing yourself in rooms where you have always chosen others. It looks like discipline when motivation fades, it looks like quiet resilience the kind that keeps going, even when no one is clapping.

And you see, purpose is not perfection. In fact, it often coexists with doubt. A woman in purpose may still feel uncertain, may still question her path, may still carry fears but she moves anyway. That movement is what defines her, not the absence of fear, but the decision to not be ruled by it.

To live in purpose is to become intentional, it is to wake up aware that your life is not random. Your voice matters, your actions carry weight. The way you love, the way you work, the way you rise after setbacks all of it becomes an expression of something greater than routine.

But here is where many get it wrong, that purpose is not something you wait to “find.” 

It is something you choose to live into, it is built daily in our small decisions, in boundaries set, in courage exercised. It is found in showing up fully where you are, even before you fully understand where you are going.

“Purpose in it” explains the moment you start recognising that purpose is not always ahead of you, it is within what you are already living. It is in how you speak, how you serve, how you rise after falling, it is in the courage to become.

So the question is not “Do I have purpose?” The question is, “Am I willing to live it, even when it feels scattered?”

Because in the end, purpose is not about having a perfect life. It is about aligning the pieces, one choice, one step, one moment at a time until your life begins to spell something meaningful.

The weather is getting change here as there's no sign of winters because we left the winter's behind and now it's spring and summer is almost on the way because in day time temperature is already high then previous days. body.title: El cuerpo equivocado | Historia [ESP-ENG]
body.body:
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWnbDQMjQX4Qf8KZ6mkrkq1SDGKz7YoTTzN92VJGBBr6o/image.png) [Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/people-girl-face-lips-mirror-2604159/) Al terminar la última presentación el teatro quedo vació, pero no en silencio. La pianista Faye lo sabía y cada vez que tocaba una tecla del piano algo más respondía y causaba miedo. En el medio del escenario estaba Nile un bailarín, que esperaba esa primera nota. Faye comenzó a tocar y era una melodía suave y Nile empezó a moverse, siguiendo cada nota con precisión, donde se notaba que tenía años bailando, movimientos perfectos con fluidez. Hasta que ocurrió algo extraño y es que su brazo bajo con un movimiento, pero en el espejo frente a él, el brazo bajó un instante después. Nile, no se detuvo y pensó que era el ángulo, la luz o el escenario. Continúo bailando, pero todo cambio y es que el reflejo se adelantaba, como si su imagen supiera lo que iba a hacer antes de que él mismo lo decidiera. Faye, no podía detenerse, tocaba el piano con velocidad, pero ahora sonaba diferente. Nile miró el espejo y se detuvo en seco, pero la figura en el espejo siguió bailando, con movimientos un poco exagerados, donde las articulaciones se doblaban un poco más de lo posible, la espalda se arqueaba en ángulos muy imposibles para un ser humano. >When the final performance ended, the theater was empty, but not silent. The pianist, Faye, knew this, and every time she struck a key on the piano, something else responded, creating a sense of dread. In the middle of the stage stood Nile, a dancer, waiting for that first note. # >Faye began to play a soft melody, and Nile started to move, following each note with precision—it was clear he’d been dancing for years, his movements perfect and fluid. Until something strange happened: his arm dropped with a single movement, but in the mirror in front of him, the arm dropped a split second later. Nile didn’t stop; he thought it was the angle, the lighting, or the stage. # >He kept dancing, but everything changed—the reflection was getting ahead of him, as if his image knew what he was going to do before he even decided it himself. Faye couldn’t stop; she played the piano quickly, but now it sounded different. Nile looked at the mirror and stopped dead in his tracks, but the figure in the mirror kept dancing, with slightly exaggerated movements, where the joints bent a little more than possible, and the back arched at angles that were impossible for a human being. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPnSYHcZ414mo91yakR5DMB4aaeu2kXB8org6xPfohffR/image.png) [Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/foto-en-primer-plano-de-una-persona-tocando-el-piano-1246437/) Faye gritó y dijo —La música evolucionó— todos quedaron en silencio y el reflejo también se detuvo, mirándolos. Nile, no comentó nada, solo miro el espejo y seguía asustado. Faye logró despegarse del piano, pero de inmediato en el espejo apareció ella aún estaba sentada al piano, sus manos firmes y una mirada aterradora. El aire en ese lugar cambio, había miedo y el reflejo de Nile sonrió y luego habló, pero no se entendió nada. El joven se asustó y retrocedió, pero el reflejo dio un paso adelante, extendió la mano y la apoyó contra el vidrio. Nile sintió un tirón del brazo, no era físico, era más profundo, como si alguien lo jalara con mucha fuerza y salió una mano dedos extraños, un color de piel oscura. Nile gritó y cayó hacia atrás, donde la pianista corrió hacia él, su piel estaba fría. Pero el reflejo empezó a salir más, ambos gritaron, ya que no era la forma de un humano, era algo extraño.—¡El espejo! —gritó Faye—. ¡Rómpelo!, sin embargo, Nile intentó levantarse, pero no podía, puesto que su cuerpo estaba débil. La pianista revisó el lugar y encontró una barra metálica y con ambas manos la levantó. Miro el espejo y dudo, pero golpeo y el espejo se agrietó por todo el medio, aun así se podía verse el reflejo. Se escuchó un grito muy fuerte, como voces tratando de decir algo. El bailarín fue arrastrado hacia el espejo nuevamente y el reflejo seguía allí viéndolos. >Faye screamed and said, “The music changed.” Everyone fell silent, and the reflection in the mirror froze as well, staring at them. Nile didn’t say a word; he just stared at the mirror, still terrified. Faye managed to pull herself away from the piano, but immediately, the reflection in the mirror showed her still sitting at the piano, her hands steady and her gaze terrifying. # >The atmosphere in the room shifted; fear hung in the air, and Nile’s reflection smiled and then spoke, but nothing could be understood. The young man was frightened and stepped back, but the reflection took a step forward, reached out, and pressed its hand against the glass. Nile felt a tug on his arm—it wasn’t physical, it was deeper, as if someone were pulling him with great force—and a hand with strange fingers emerged, its skin a dark color. # >Nile screamed and fell backward, where the pianist ran toward him; his skin was cold. But the reflection began to emerge further; both screamed, for it was not the form of a human—it was something strange. “The mirror!” Faye shouted. “Break it!” However, Nile tried to get up but couldn’t, since his body was weak. # >The pianist scanned the room and found a metal bar; she lifted it with both hands. She looked at the mirror and hesitated, but then struck it, and the mirror cracked right down the middle—yet the reflection was still visible. A very loud scream was heard, like voices trying to say something. The dancer was dragged toward the mirror again, and the reflection was still there, watching them. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSiLM9SVAKXN8BbzFovCyJCQKgtLVkPkNktphBgt3RCpN/image.png) [Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/hombre-reflejo-reflexion-estilo-7888045/) —¡Faye! —gritó y volvió a golpear, hasta que el espejo finalmente se rompió y el reflejo desapareció en la oscuridad del otro lado, silencio y Faye cayó de rodillas junto a Nile, ya se terminó todo. Nile respiraba con dificultad, giró la cabeza hacia ella, logrando sonreír y en sus ojos, por un instante, el reflejo no coincidió. >“Faye!” he shouted, striking it again and again until the mirror finally shattered and the reflection vanished into the darkness on the other side. Silence. Faye fell to her knees beside Nile. It was all over. Nile was breathing heavily; he turned his head toward her, managing a smile, and in his eyes, for a moment, the reflection didn’t match.
![pngwing.com 3.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPvWeswjaMnCtt69QxnpZHm1una1iw2HUxZJpGBgEY2RH/pngwing.com%203.png)

The project failed\\.title: What's the true value of blockchain's near-instant settlement?
The project failed\\.body:
![image (4).webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/badbitch/23xxyTXsqNf3DCSkSCqAmmhuFiC3qb8homKTDQA6bbKS6NRNZ3GLRJwWPxTqxectz3PFZ.webp)

A couple of people question if having a blockchain that settles transactions in 3 seconds is truly a probably valuable feature to have or if transactions per second (TPS) is something we've paid too much attention to.

I think it is particularly important to discuss this more openly now, with everything new happening in the technology landscape.

### Fast vs Slow

Many stocks and securities trade systems and global transactions run on \

settlements design.

This means the trade date plus an additional two days, effectively 3 days at minimum, is what it takes for a trade to settle.

Sometimes, 3 days become 5 and sometimes more.

This delay was long considered normal, even useful, to allow back-office processing and error correction.

But how does this perceived value compare to faster settlements?

To understand this, one must look at the cost of slow settlements.

In securities trading for instance, the consequences of those settlement gaps are not merely inconvenient. 

During the settlement period, market participants have credit exposure to each other. If one party defaults on either delivery of a security it sold or payment for a security it purchased, the counterparty to the trade may sustain financial losses.

Given the very large volume of daily trading in U.S. financial markets for instance, the amount of credit exposure that financial market participants have collectively is substantial and the risk associated with this exposure is especially great during times of systemic financial stress.

In addition to this, we are also dealing with a feature that allows fraud to thrive. Slow means that one party holds very little leverage (very close to zero) in every transaction, leaving them virtually exposed to being exploited.

Fast transactions solves all of this.

All parties involved in a trade are given equal leverage over each transactions. There's virtually no room for fraud when it comes to settlement time, and near-instant transactions means that little credit exposure, and higher money velocity.

### Machine economies need speed

It is also important to consider the future of world economies.

Financial transactions will largely be carried out by machines and slow settlements is an expensive feature for machines, not only because it leaves them open to external attacks but because there's a direct energy costs associated with it.

When settlements are near-instant, machines can move money across economies at low latency, being essentially economically efficient.

### Security should be intelligence

Blockchains are programmable, machined are gaining operational intelligence.

The inevitable end product here is programmable intelligence, and when it comes to finance, this means that security moves away from being fixed rules on potentially outdated data to being real-time continuously adapting intelligence.

The convergence of blockchain and AI, means that financial transactions will have applied intelligence. Fraud will be battled in real time, ensuring that even though blockchains settle transactions in 3 seconds, security measures can still be taken throughout the process.

The future will run on faster systems integrating real-time data to every operations. The near-instant settlement of blockchains are incredibly valuable for this future, a lot of people just don't realize it yet.

The project failed\\.title: Shenzhen: Ein Blick in die futuristischste Stadt der Welt
The project failed\\.body:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P7W20hdgWXY ---

Shenzhen hat sich in nur 45 Jahren von einem bescheidenen Fischerdorf zu einer Megacity mit 17 Millionen Einwohnern entwickelt. Dieser rasante Aufstieg ist kein Zufall, sondern das Ergebnis gezielter wirtschaftlicher Experimente und einer einzigartigen geografischen Lage.

Der Ursprung als Sonderwirtschaftszone

Alles begann im Jahr 1980 unter Deng Xiaoping, als Shenzhen zur ersten Sonderwirtschaftszone Chinas ernannt wurde. Ziel war es, einen Raum für wirtschaftliche Experimente mit niedrigeren Steuern und weniger Regulierung zu schaffen. Dank der direkten Nachbarschaft zum Finanzzentrum Hongkong und der Tatsache, dass die Stadt auf einem unbeschriebenen Blatt ohne veraltete Infrastruktur erbaut werden konnte, entwickelte sie sich in Rekordzeit zu einem globalen Innovationszentrum.

Automatisierung und Robotik im Alltag

Der technologische Fortschritt ist in Shenzhen allgegenwärtig und tief in den Alltag integriert. Besucher werden oft von Robotern in Hotels begrüßt, die das Frühstück liefern, oder bestellen Kaffee und Essen per Drohne, die direkt zu speziellen Abholstationen in Parks fliegt. Auch auf den Straßen ist die Zukunft sichtbar: Vollautonome Robo-Taxis ohne Fahrer navigieren sicher durch den Verkehr, während Reinigungsroboter die Gehwege säubern.

Elektromobilität und grüne Infrastruktur

Ein bemerkenswertes Merkmal der Stadt ist ihre Stille, die auf eine konsequente Elektrifizierung zurückzuführen ist. Die gesamte Busflotte (16.000 Fahrzeuge) und alle Taxis (21.000 Fahrzeuge) fahren rein elektrisch. Unterstützt wird dies durch ein dichtes Netz von über 410.000 Ladestationen. Trotz der hohen Wolkenkratzerdichte ist Shenzhen eine der grünsten Städte Chinas mit einer enormen Anzahl an Parks, die oft mit smarten Fitnessgeräten und Solarpanels ausgestattet sind.

Huaqiangbei: Das Herz der Hardware-Welt

Das Viertel Huaqiangbei beherbergt den größten Elektronikmarkt der Welt. Hier geht es nicht nur um den Verkauf von Endprodukten, sondern vor allem um die Verfügbarkeit jeder erdenklichen Komponente – von Mikrochips bis zu Sensoren. Für Ingenieure und Erfinder bietet dieser Ort eine beispiellose Geschwindigkeit: Ein Prototyp, der anderswo Wochen dauern würde, kann hier oft innerhalb eines Tages realisiert werden.

Nanshan: Das technologische Kraftzentrum

Der Distrikt Nanshan ist der Sitz globaler Tech-Giganten wie DJI (Marktführer bei Drohnen) und Tencent (Entwickler von WeChat). Das Durchschnittsalter der Bewohner liegt hier bei nur etwa 32,5 Jahren, was die dynamische und innovative Atmosphäre widerspiegelt. Die Firmenzentralen sind oft wie vertikale Städte konzipiert, die Sportanlagen, Laufstrecken und Erholungszonen integrieren, um den Austausch von Ideen zu fördern.

Sicherheit und digitale Integration

Durch eine flächendeckende Überwachung mit Kameras fühlt sich die Stadt extrem sicher an, selbst bei Nacht. Das digitale Leben wird fast vollständig über Apps wie WeChat abgewickelt. Bargeld ist nahezu verschwunden; selbst kleinste Straßenhändler nutzen QR-Codes für Zahlungen. In einigen Bereichen wird sogar bereits mit Handflächen-Scans oder Gesichtserkennung bezahlt.

Kulturelle Kontraste und Entspannung

Trotz des Fokus auf High-Tech gibt es Orte wie das OCT Loft, ein ehemaliges Fabrikviertel, das heute als kreatives Zentrum mit Galerien und Cafés dient, oder Nanto Ancient Town, das die historische Dorfstruktur bewahrt hat. Zur Entspannung besuchen viele Einwohner riesige 24-Stunden-Spas wie das Queen Spa, die wie komfortable Flughafen-Lounges funktionieren und als Rückzugsort vom intensiven Arbeitsleben dienen.

ENGLISH VERSION (click here!) Good morning, travelers. We’re almost done exploring the beautiful state of Trujillo. Just as we were about to set off on a new route toward the state of Mérida, we visited the Parque de la Trujillanidad (also known as the Parque de las Fuerzas Armadas), which had really caught our eye on the way to the Peace Monument. So, on the way back, it was a must-see stop, since we don’t know when we’ll be able to return. ![InShot_20260421_124135316.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYfiTy3wo5hYXBHjah63VrUo4RzskxwagBsBkoK3sN4J2/InShot_20260421_124135316.jpg) This park is an outdoor space built in honor of the heroes and soldiers who bravely defended these lands during the country’s War of Independence. It features various monuments that give meaning to an important part of our history. ![20260402_155002.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYMGDUbTugTEUof33Uug2swtAgg9NF3GikZ5rriBQ9hL7/20260402_155002.jpg) ![20260402_154141.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdKjZgo73cYHaPihKxsyrs7GeVikB7UfHbWho6SindcRk/20260402_154141.jpg) ![20260402_154358.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWh3qPDXoeAP5LPA3hn1UjbXuepCvBKskvTGrSkdwYoyv/20260402_154358.jpg) First, there is a massive monument on a concrete and ceramic base. Before climbing it, there is a torch holder with the Trujillo State Anthem in the background and a plaque in front paying tribute to those who fell in defense of the nation. At the other end are the Venezuelan Anthem and the National Coat of Arms; the only thing missing was the flag. ![20260402_154224.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTBKbnwYKfMkxCkqPWiQ7VQySUBdR31KhhBx2xF31gTLs/20260402_154224.jpg) ![20260402_154232.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRJ8HYmdcxhZJGuNwHcZWzJboXubrRf4bqNthZtKGYpqC/20260402_154232.jpg) ![20260402_154256.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTKzPXqxhy7ivNJDgW6ffNVJ8n6fkXoFjAha3U6n86bX5/20260402_154256.jpg) ![20260402_154302.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVvwjGWpTATUgZ6fJg4cRDjVdM88oQpB1UY5YS6cxfTwz/20260402_154302.jpg) We climbed to the highest point of the imposing monument, which looks very lifelike, where a fallen soldier is depicted while one of his comrades continues to fight in battle. It’s a powerful way of conveying that his death was not in vain but for the greater good. From here, the view of the Andes Mountains is spectacular. ![20260402_154448.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdQC2d9AuTusin1757yGCUpT6oiYSSkuSrqWCqDfsFbd5/20260402_154448.jpg) ![20260402_154537.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc3xx6r87CDmE4q4sXDgDuzhv4pb6mmiuQ5sLMcpmXoEU/20260402_154537.jpg) ![20260402_154550.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYpNX9R7VyGsYJp7HTCwWwAahTQQHcDGDpNpz8VmjX8wB/20260402_154550.jpg) ![20260402_154601.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmboUCpRMSpfhdrApwSQumvpDXhMzdZxP9uKd4whhBjGbM/20260402_154601.jpg) We head down to the other part of the park, where various historical and military figures are located, such as Manuel Gogorza, Antonio Nicolás Briceño, Vicente de la Torre, Pedro Miguel Chipia, Miguel Vicente Cegarra, Barbarita de la Torre, José Manuel Arraiz, and Andrés Linares, who died during the War of Independence. ![20260402_154737.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSJadKuKjYiZcBpRgidTm49xAurUPpQ1DYqdgnkENwRRD/20260402_154737.jpg) ![20260402_154759.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQSzBFGX62uFBCwthi9dngYfaoBCFH6sRLWNgFApCfi4y/20260402_154759.jpg) ![20260402_154844.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbgB9U7PKhS9Ka9jHJwBAtB8JfzWnb8R1VhxtfuHQeHy6/20260402_154844.jpg) To conclude the tour, we come across an exhibition of a tankette and an airplane, used for military purposes—perhaps not in the past, but certainly in the present. ![20260402_154957.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfDJD7uQiBPzTZSNV1zajrBvvoQ3AENSrNYtT2f5FyjfK/20260402_154957.jpg)

--- Photos taken with a Samsung Galaxy A35. Collage created in [Inshot](https://v.inshot.com/invite) Content owned by me. Translation by: [Deepl](https://www.deepl.com/es/translator)

>

Buenas días, viajeros. 

Estamos muy cerca de culminar nuestro paso por el hermoso estado Trujillo, cuando estábamos a punto de iniciar una nueva ruta hacia el Estado Mérida, visitamos el Parque de la Trujillanidad o Parque de las Fuerzas Armadas, el cuál llamó mucho nuestra atención cuando íbamos al Monumento de la Paz así que de regreso era una parada necesaria, ya que no sabemos cuando vamos a poder regresar.

![InShot_20260421_124135316.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYfiTy3wo5hYXBHjah63VrUo4RzskxwagBsBkoK3sN4J2/InShot_20260421_124135316.jpg)

Este parque es un espacio al aire libre y esta construido en honor a los héroes y soldados que han defendido estas tierras en época de la Independencia del país con mucha valentía, en el se encuentran distintos monumentos que le aportan un sentido a parte importante de nuestra historia. 

![20260402_155002.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYMGDUbTugTEUof33Uug2swtAgg9NF3GikZ5rriBQ9hL7/20260402_155002.jpg)

![20260402_154141.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdKjZgo73cYHaPihKxsyrs7GeVikB7UfHbWho6SindcRk/20260402_154141.jpg)

![20260402_154358.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWh3qPDXoeAP5LPA3hn1UjbXuepCvBKskvTGrSkdwYoyv/20260402_154358.jpg)

En un primer lugar tenemos un enorme monumento sobre una base de concreto y cerámica, antes de subir al mismo se encuentra una base para antorcha con el Himno del estado Trujillo de fondo y una lápida adelante con un tributo a los caídos en defensa de la nación, en otro extremo se encuentra el Himno de Venezuela y el Escudo Nacional, solo faltaba la bandera.

![20260402_154224.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTBKbnwYKfMkxCkqPWiQ7VQySUBdR31KhhBx2xF31gTLs/20260402_154224.jpg)

![20260402_154232.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRJ8HYmdcxhZJGuNwHcZWzJboXubrRf4bqNthZtKGYpqC/20260402_154232.jpg)

![20260402_154256.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTKzPXqxhy7ivNJDgW6ffNVJ8n6fkXoFjAha3U6n86bX5/20260402_154256.jpg)

![20260402_154302.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVvwjGWpTATUgZ6fJg4cRDjVdM88oQpB1UY5YS6cxfTwz/20260402_154302.jpg)

Subimos a la parte más alta del imponente monumento que se ve muy real, donde se refleja a un soldado caído mientras uno de sus compañeros sigue luchando en batalla, es una buena forma de decir que su muerte no fue en vano sino por un bien mayor, desde aquí la vista de la Cordillera de los Andes es espectacular. 

![20260402_154448.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdQC2d9AuTusin1757yGCUpT6oiYSSkuSrqWCqDfsFbd5/20260402_154448.jpg)

![20260402_154537.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc3xx6r87CDmE4q4sXDgDuzhv4pb6mmiuQ5sLMcpmXoEU/20260402_154537.jpg)

![20260402_154550.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYpNX9R7VyGsYJp7HTCwWwAahTQQHcDGDpNpz8VmjX8wB/20260402_154550.jpg)

![20260402_154601.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmboUCpRMSpfhdrApwSQumvpDXhMzdZxP9uKd4whhBjGbM/20260402_154601.jpg)

Bajamos para ir a la otra parte del parque donde se encuentran distintos personajes históricos y militares como Manuel Gogorza, Antonio Nicolas Briceño, Vicente de la Torre, Pedro Miguel Chipia, Miguel Vicente Cegarra, Barbarita de la Torre, José Manuel Arraiz y Andrés Linares que murieron durante la guerra de la independencia.

![20260402_154737.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSJadKuKjYiZcBpRgidTm49xAurUPpQ1DYqdgnkENwRRD/20260402_154737.jpg)

![20260402_154759.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQSzBFGX62uFBCwthi9dngYfaoBCFH6sRLWNgFApCfi4y/20260402_154759.jpg)

![20260402_154844.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbgB9U7PKhS9Ka9jHJwBAtB8JfzWnb8R1VhxtfuHQeHy6/20260402_154844.jpg)
 
Para finalizar el recorrido nos encontramos con una exhibición de una tanqueta y un avión, utilizada para fines militares, quizás no en la antigüedad pero si en el presente. 

![20260402_154957.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfDJD7uQiBPzTZSNV1zajrBvvoQ3AENSrNYtT2f5FyjfK/20260402_154957.jpg)

The project failed\\.body:
<div class=text-justify>



![IMG_5001.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/23xKqwJYPxm2cXkEaQBgyo7BbHtPgkP6B3ToE7Kpi6Wn1CuQKKXhnJmtbvyACDygq38xJ.jpeg)

Today, I don’t have much to say. I woke up with a strange feeling in my gut that I couldn’t fully explain, but I just knew my body wasn't at its best. It started last night, actually. I felt slightly feverish before going to bed, but I brushed it off as stress or maybe just too much screen time.

So I did the responsible thing by putting my phone away and went to sleep, hoping I’d wake up feeling better. But morning came, and the feeling had only grown stronger. It wasn’t overwhelming, but it was enough to make me consider going to the pharmacy to get something to fix whatever was going on.

While thinking of that, I also thought of what natural method could help and that’s how I remembered the warm water hack my mom told me about. She said whenever I feel a little off, especially in the morning, I should drink warm water so I decided to try it.

I drank a cup of warm water, not expecting much, but hoping for some kind of relief. But a few minutes later, I started sweating profusely. It was strange because just moments before, I had been feeling cold. Suddenly, my body felt warm, like something inside me had been stirred awake, which prompted me to open the curtains to let fresh air in, then I laid back down.

![IMG_4999.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/23wqeDQTZnepJ4Tx7BrbXLJwwUc6TF3jd3XTfd6XBUkPWe2VAfWaRmNfyfdR13vqEk46G.jpeg)

At that point, I didn’t even question it. I just let my body do what it needed to do. When I woke up again, I felt the urge to use the bathroom, and after that I felt instant relief. That heavy, uncomfortable feeling I woke up with had eased and my body felt lighter. 

Now that made me reflect on how sometimes, we’re quick to panic at the slightest discomfort. Quick to reach for medication, to assume something serious is wrong. And while it’s always important to take our health seriously, maybe not every small signal from our body needs an immediate rush to external solutions.

At times, the body just needs a little support with something simple. But of course, not everything can be solved this way, and it’s also important to know when to seek proper medical help.

promenade\\.title: 【吉隆坡】中央艺术坊 Central Market Kuala Lumpur
promenade\\.body:
我在上星期的年假到吉隆坡游玩，同行的还有米特一起，因为他说来吉隆坡那么多次，却一次都没来过「茨场街」这里，「茨场街」这地方是个游客区，我也只来过两次。 ![Central Market Kuala Lumpur](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/EoyNzCzuQzW788JZ7qtMCGA4kyvypD3taPYmpMqRyCmZLY9wFEdvjChqjaeoxGNWJJo.jpeg) **中央艺术坊** 是马来西亚吉隆坡市中心非常有名的历史文化购物中心和地标景点，每天都有无数游客到此游览，距离「茨场街」也不远。 我还记得上次来到了 **中央艺术坊** ，但是已经接近晚上 10 点，这地方都关门了，都没机会进去逛逛。这次带着米特一起，就得进去参观一番。 这名字既然叫做“艺术坊”，那必定跟艺术非常有关联，给大家看看我拍到的： ▼ 马来西亚版的【我在吉隆坡很想你】 ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/EoK7JXBA7pJQXH3u99kAB1kfqKHS2nF1jRayVzEFEHjdghMevdzqBbkE34aJEn18aaV.jpeg) ▼ 老式杂货店【回忆童年】 ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/EonkwqcDDiJ2Z3KAKM98odAZiY74Z727g1RKh449zWj3qzbeGvt4GtKNkj3YpFY9qFT.jpeg) ▼ 艺术相框店 ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/EoEr4bEUR2m2J3KJsjX6rm4EvrGaxFe1GMTut95UcrY2oDy88xRDzsHnFDx4MrJxdsw.jpeg) ▼ 像条小街 ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/EoeEyRRCqcVCmvkVzvySuK5KLYY7Wr4KHiooSB7bTj2hGPtnXFU97AsQtHeTjC74eWz.jpeg) ▼ 复古相机店 ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/Eoc8Xj4nE7rzPHpJBSCHVRYRegeaSgqyhLgDhNju74hFTSMFjFBUxZykMuFdgLqroig.jpeg) ▼ 各式传统服装 ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/EoK7DW6z1on9z8NxtKaHs8gtTvgAg7w6Ng7ZM8dMmcigMjC8nL7VLWeMnWwYts39BgR.jpeg) ▼ 西装店 ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/EogPoJREdzQBEXLFmUg6X9rV69Nu4jHZA9qf29msTvZzpxyfCNQUDwzHob6ux2eTY5n.jpeg) 以上都是 **中央艺术坊** 室内的照片，而从这里走出去旁边那里还有一条小街，那里有各种小摊位卖着不同的小吃和饮料。 ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/Eou8knZfRRrCZfeaBUiVaVyavqzPmCxtjE7UrZRwVtnftrXXu3zKuhAR4n77G62mzxQ.jpeg) ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/Eonm4VGgDQZb5RC2BeAvtdeHj62KKzSoyUeLEbVBJ8Dpw9xUrVYXkYXsCsrcuZ2ZjD3.jpeg) 室内还有冷气吹一吹，这室外让我感觉像是进了桑拿房，快热死宝宝了。 当下决定买一杯冰凉的饮料喝喝，然后我买了 **Kee Nguyen** 的酸奶咖啡，感兴趣的可以等等看我明天的《文章》。

promenade\\.title: The painter's choice
promenade\\.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaiHxwb18FaGHWJo8YA2PT2VixqLKkzxGVDFD2RnY6dER/img_20260422_wa0014.jpg)

The truth is that whatever we put all our energy, strength and might into we don't like when it's criticized with so much disdain. 
Whether we like it or not most time criticism help us see our work from another perspective. I think I love constructive criticism. In other words don't criticise me, if you don't have a solution to the critism. 

Ola was a very admirable painter in his town. The funny thing is that no one has actually seen his painting before. \

Some said as they made their favourite comparisons.

That never stopped Ola from always painting. Every day, at the same time, from 11pm to 2am, a slow and subtle music will be heard from his home. They considered it his work atmosphere.

That late in the day, when the noise had subsided, when everywhere is calm. He could focus more on the ideas that had troubled his young mind all through the day. 

Tunde was the known and the most famous painter. He often boasted of his work which apparently were extremely good for a village champion. 

\

He boasted for the millionth time. 

It became so loud when the king even boasted about his work to the neighboring kings. That was the main reason the painting competition between the kingdoms started. 
Tunde had won for three years since the competition begun. 

Painters all over town always visit Tunde to get inspiration from his paintings. He was an Icon in the field.

At the other end, Ola was always indoors with his painting. 
\

Foluke asked.

They had been in a relationship for two years and even her hadn't seen Ola's painting.

\
She threatened as she moved away from him.\n\nOla laughed. \
He walked up to her. \

Ola won the arguement for that day, but it never mattered because Foluke always came at him time and again.

Mr. Ade from the neighboring village who had been rumoured to have lived in the United States for half of his life was finally in town, to visit his new mansion. 

He felt his house was empty and void without good paintings. He appreciated artistry and the beauty it brought to environments. 
\

He said as he drove with his village scouts.

They showed his both big and small painters but nothing was calling his attention. He was discouraged that there weren't any local champion who could attract his attention with amazing artistry. 
The scouts finally suggested that their was a biggest painter in all five villages and he had won the kings contest three times in a row.

They journeyed to Tunde's workshop. Mr. Ade was truly amazed at his design. And was shocked that such talent existed in this local areas.
That was a chip on Tunde's shoulders. 
As much as he adored Tunde's painting, he said it was too harsh for what he was looking for. 
\
Mr. Ade said.\n\n\
Ojo said as he drove Mr. Ade. \
He stuttered.\n\n\
Mr. Ade asked.\n\n\
\n\n\
Mr. Ade asked \n\n\

Mr. Ade agreed to visit Ola in his workshop. It was like killing two birds with one stone. Foluke was also present so after much persuasion, he finally agreed to show his paintings.
Mr. Ade walked into his workroom and was bewildered by what his eyes saw. 
It took a stranger to make Ola make the bold move.
Mr. Ade couldn't leave any of the paintings. He bought all of them and also told Ola to paint fifty more which he would take to the United states to sell.

The king heard about what had happended because in a small village like that, once an information leaves your mouth, the air takes it to another person's ear.

The king personally paid a visit to Ola's workshop and couldn't find any art work because Mr. Ade bought all. The king had to pay ahead to be the next in line to purchase after Mr. Ade.

A stranger's view rewrite Ola's entire story. Ola never hid because he felt small. He hid because the environment at the initial time may not have appreciated his work.
Mr. Ade from the United States loved his work, which made the entire village love it to.


Thanks for stopping by💃🏿❤️❤️.

Julley Everyone,


Starting this fresh new morning over here in these beautiful corners around Himalayas as the journey begins something just like this one thing around this beautiful locations around over here in these peaceful forest over in the jungle of the nearest known isolated village of Kain somewhere around 15 km before Manali all the way and also around 20 km deep into the mountain valley of Hallan in Manali was this beautiful location and I thought why not to share this moment with you guys for this post so now sharing this particular moment that I spend over here in the place unknown with you guys through this post.


![IMG_7279.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcC93UWD5Kuru5scfhdCNThUZbiBxFKvBwcbfYf1pgCDq/IMG_7279.jpeg)
It was that particular time of the year, when it was neither summer neither the the winter season, but it was somewhere in between time where the higher himalayan mountain ranges were covered with a thick sheet of snow and the foothills being covered with less snow that just opened a whole new lot of adventure has with this, I got the opportunity to explore the lower foothills of the higher mountains over here, especially at this particular corner around kullu Valley, Himachal Pradesh and this was my plan and my expeditions for this particular time of the year

![IMG_7280.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXsqYkTJiBpADmiCJAVYRe4EX3RR7QpJMxbaPbiwx1D5w/IMG_7280.jpeg)

![IMG_7282.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmY463KtJ37YTpjw4zza2QVEU3HjZMe34UytqhkhFwDFGY/IMG_7282.jpeg)
<center>*The Snow around the Corners*</center>
*Another thing that I noticed when I was at this place, it was that there were these small it's over. We are there was a lot of snow that this together around that just fell from the winter season and now just leftover of the snow. It looks something just like this.*

![IMG_7286.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdtR21H3rzcGpNKUFjpfZB1oQ42rqhxuUqiH32ybfezBn/IMG_7286.jpeg)
***So currently we were at an altitude of near about 2800 m above the sea level, somewhere extreme north all the way, hiking, and just enjoying the time in the world is making our way over the snow and ice and spending the perfect time of the afternoon, just not to change the particular location, but moreover, enjoying and spending some time in the woods and in the peaceful nature and capturing beautiful photographs of places unknown.***


![IMG_7287.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUsaiKQNvJFfJQ2pQHA2obgrGGXV6Y2QrBreb349vLbSn/IMG_7287.jpeg)
***

![IMG_7288.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmV4pjyniqUTH2fhyQJ5WUr3eDYQkt1wVwQH7EqdhYsKYR/IMG_7288.jpeg)
Even at certain points, we literally made our way all the way to the rocks through the trees, the fallen trees and also much more and this day was a lovely day filled with countless number of adventure and memories not having much to say about sharing these peaceful photographs and peaceful moments from these hidden portions around Himalayas. Do let me know my friends, the photographs on the part of my adventure or the journey like the most in the comment section and I would love to hear it from.

promenade\\.title: 再次读完《杨家将》后的一点感受
promenade\\.body:
这几天回老家，路途远，在车上也没什么事情做，只好刷刷手机，看会书。出门前孩子给带的小说《杨家将》顺便读完了。

《杨家将》这本书已经是我第二次读，我上中学的时候就读过这本小说，算是读的较早的小说之一了。只是，当时少年时候，读书关注的重心跟今天完全不同，只注意看重杨家的和潘仁美的恩恩怨怨，没太注重其它的细节。就如同很多人调侃，说年少时看《西游记》，总是关注猴子的打打杀杀，完全忽视了除了猴子之外，《西游记》里还有很多美女呢。囧

因为读了不少历史，对历史人物有了较为全面的印象，比如太宗在历史上有个著名的“高粱河之战”，开始时节节胜利。似乎胜利很有把握，但到后边就忽然大败。毛主席对宋太宗就有过评价，说宋太宗其实并不懂兵法，这就是典型的“诱敌深入”打法，开始辽人的败退，其实就是一种策略，故意引诱你进入全套而已。

太宗之后，是真宗。真宗就是那个历史上著名的“檀渊之盟”时的皇帝。小说里显然是把真宗夸张化了，说真宗一箭射死辽人大将。。。

实际上以我读历史对真宗的总结有两点：一是胆子较小，二来特别迷信和虚荣。

这不是我瞎说，你读史书，里边记载了很多真宗时期的“祥瑞”之兆。

所谓的“祥瑞”，表面上看是上天降临的吉祥兆象，实际上呢？稍微想一下便知道，要么是刻意美化，要么就是故意为之。

有句话讲，“上有所好，下必甚焉。” 真宗既然那么喜欢祥瑞，那民间出的“祥瑞”自然就少不了。

除了“祥瑞”之外，真宗还大搞“天书”，，，我估摸着也是从真宗之后，后世的皇帝所幸都看透（穿）了这些，反而不怎么搞这些“祥瑞”、“天书”了。


![s7048334.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rivalhw/23yJNrLZsTU6BfrRfVNtNyWKAer2pGwf41LiJMSckMtg3Z89XBLbGdwTZXMkTmgMgc5eP.jpg)

source from [douban,com](https://img9.doubanio.com/view/subject/l/public/s7048334.jpg)



小说里讲，是潘仁美故意陷害杨业，导致其自杀身亡，杨家从此跟潘仁美结下仇恨，虽然潘仁美多次陷害杨家，但后来因为边关需要，每每临近紧要关头，最后还是需要杨家出面。而后来潘仁美也被杨家所除，可谓大快人心。

实际上，太宗时期，真有位潘仁美的原型，不过人家叫潘美，另外潘美不仅没那么坏，反而是宋朝的栋梁之才臣。

我看《杨家将》，有个很深的印象，就是其中间许多情节内容，非常相似于《封神演义》、《说岳全传》，这种题材的小说，往往构思较为天马行空，想象力也极为丰富，非常适合评书类演绎，容易让人听的热血沸腾。

但这类小说也有缺点，就是故事内容较为重复，文学水平也较为一般，很多文字内容不能过于要求，比起传统的六大名著显然还是差距不小。

跟《杨家将》题材相关改变的戏剧、电影和电视剧等内容是非常多的。我小时候就经常听我母亲唱《辕门斩子》、《四郎探母》，听我外公给我讲《佘太君十二寡妇征西》。。电影最出名的《五郎八卦棍》更是小时候孩童伙伴们讨论的主要内容之一。

由此可见，人们对《杨家将》有多么的喜爱。

Oba continued to flap its wings and flap its wings, soaring higher. He would occasionally check the ground for living organisms. Oba saw a chick, clenched it with his claws, and decided to make it his dinner. However, Oba wasn't stingy. He remembered his wives and children. Immediately, he flapped his wings to soar higher and higher. He then began drifting like the king of the skies.

Soon, Oba got home and fed his family the dinner he caught. His wives were grateful for the dinner. Almost immediately, he flapped his wings and soared higher. He soon got to a very high altitude, where he spread his wings and drifted away like the king, looking for prey to catch. After a few months in the sky, Oba explored new areas and new opportunities. Soon, he grasped a tiny snake and took it to the sky. Oba released it downward from a very tall height.

Oba grasped it again after confirming its death.

Again, Oba took it home for dinner. On getting home, Oba saw his youngest bibi about to take her first flight. She was excited. With the help of her parents, bibi overcame her fear and took her first flight. Everyone was happy for bibi's progress.

Soon, bibi began to drift in the skies with her dad by her side, and they lived happily ever after.

promenade\\.title: Reframing the Journey: From Unfinished Chapters to New Beginnings
promenade\\.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQBYVTcJCnt4gfJZizGzCZLL6h67E4xxN8i9YEz7sbNsR/Gemini_Generated_Image_wztpyywztpyywztp.png 
image generated using Gemini AI

There are always a lot of things we wish we could have done
differently, a lot of decisions, and other things that affect our lives
directly or indirectly. 
 
Five years ago, I was a master's student. I had finished
with my coursework and had passed my exams. What was left for me to do was to
choose a topic for my thesis and a lecturer of my choice to supervise me
through my thesis. I left the school with the form, and it is 5 year after I
never went back with the form or even filled it out. I didn't choose a topic
for my thesis and also found it difficult to select among the lectures who i
wanted to supervise me.
 
This was not the school to which I did my first degree, and
I didn't come to familiarise myself with the lectures to know who was the best
person to pick. I later came around to go with our then HOD, but a few weeks
later, he died of a heart attack. 
 
I used to be someone who always made sure he finishes
anything they started, but this will come to be the first of many things I have
left uncompleted in my life, I now call myself a dropout because I know fully
Well,t since I am never going back to complete the program, maybe I will start
Another one later, but for this, I have been away for too long. I will always look
back and wish I had done things differently. Maybe if I had taken it seriously
and outlined why I needed the degree, I would have finished the program and be
An M.Sc. holder today.
 
On a lighter note, and the bright side, I know that I learned
a lot during the period of my program,m even though I have no papers to prove it,
I am not a dropout; I withdrew from the program because of uncertainties and
unfamiliar environment,t and if i will go back today, I am sure of mapping out my
goals and how to achieve them, even before I start. In trying to return to
Someone who always finishes what they start, I try to focus on little wins,
making and completing daily tasks. I also break my goals down into smaller ones
and make sure to achieve them little by little until the whole goal is fully
achieved.
 
My name is @rishagamo, and this is my response to the Hive student week 39 prompt, Title: “FIVE YEARS BACK”.

promenade\\.title: Siena, a Tuscan City With Impressive Architecture [ENG/PL]
promenade\\.body:
*** ![szablon cover — Odzyskano.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23xpAn9chyCorbAPYC3WDRzbcJQ7hZ6LBaJVRB7u31nYxys9RrX1HBAuvM4pa9ke3zokL.jpg) ***
### Hello Worldmappin Community!

> My vacation to Tuscany in September 2021 was my first vacation abroad, and I still consider it the most enjoyable of my life. We visited many Tuscan towns, one of which was **Siena**, rich in beautiful architecture. **Siena** is located south of the **Tuscan capital, Florence**, approximately 75 kilometers apart. Siena itself is the capital of the province of the same name and a major tourist and economic center for the area.
> Moje wakacje w Toskanii we wrześniu 2021 roku były pierwszymi wakacjami, które spędziłem na zagranicznym wyjeździe, i do tej pory uznaję je za najbardziej udane w moim życiu. Odwiedziliśmy wtedy sporo toskańskich miejscowości, a jedną z nich była bogata w piękną architekturę **Siena**. > **Siena** zlokalizowana jest na południe od stolicy **Toskanii**, czyli **Florencji**. Obie miejscowości dzieli około 75 kilometrów. Sama Siena jest natomiast stolicą prowincji o tej samej nazwie oraz ważnym ośrodkiem turystycznym i gospodarczym tego obszaru.
![line.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/EoJy9ee9vJf2Cwv6D2SAKPm8cDrt2HZEpLT3GqpRvBeYRTZ6TB2xUPkyKZowzgWTXxy.png) *** ![PSX_20260422_093448.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23y8soEVARiXTUkeoGJoA6UFVZ81bQgNFJedEc4xdfKWXuj5kEfqKcEYMFsMiHbiMprDG.jpg) ![PSX_20260422_093554.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23yJGfdB86dZxbYCgTGokEjwniUSmk7L1DkFSsLsm689EvcCTnJr7tDLNv6tyViUyJY3U.jpg) ***
The outskirts of the city are lined with typical Italian townhouses adorned with wooden shutters. One could say their facades are neglected, the only factor affecting their appearance being the inexorable passage of time. This doesn't bother me, however. It's precisely in these facades that I treasure not only Tuscany, but generally all the Italian towns I've visited. I still remember standing in that alley in the photo above, which at one point split in two, and suddenly I was overcome with a strange sense of indecision. I said to my future wife (I proposed a few days later), \
A strange feeling – for no apparent reason, I was gripped by anxiety, as if my life depended on which side of the alley we took. Fortunately, my partner rose to the occasion and said, \

And she simply moved forward.
> Obrzeża miasta to typowe włoskie kamienice ozdobione drewnianymi okiennicami. Można by powiedzieć, że ich fasady są zaniedbane, a jedynym czynnikiem ingerującym w ich wygląd jest czas, który nieubłaganie pozostawia na nich swoje piętno. Mnie to jednak nie przeszkadza. To właśnie w tych fasadach tkwi cały urok, za który cenię nie tylko Toskanię, ale ogólnie wszelkie włoskie miejscowości, które dotąd odwiedziłem. > Do dziś pamiętam, jak stanęliśmy w tej alejce na zdjęciu powyżej, która w pewnym momencie dzieliła się na dwie części, a mnie nagle dopadło dziwne niezdecydowanie. Powiedziałem do mojej przyszłej żony (kilka dni później się oświadczyłem): „Kochanie, nie wiem, gdzie powinniśmy iść. Co mamy robić?”. Dziwne uczucie – właściwie bez przyczyny dopadł mnie lęk, jakby od tego, w którą odnogę alejki pójdziemy, zależało moje życie. Na szczęście moja partnerka stanęła na wysokości zadania i powiedziała: „A czym Ty się przejmujesz, człowieku?”. I po prostu ruszyła przed siebie.
*** ![PSX_20260422_093308.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23wgRi5QFuY1nb24bbCYGchQfzQHkoTf7QL3avEFHiqJGMJqKMJYaEnRAZ7PvdYou3MwV.jpg)
![PSX_20260422_093331.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23xL2zoz1Nn3u7Bp46ttwSvzQrFXvi8e464mi9GCc4AvG3D87GWJzuT2yubGGrKuQ9qx1.jpg)
***
Further exploring the city, we came across one of its greatest monuments – the ***Cattedrale Metropolitana di Santa Maria Assunta***. It is one of the most distinctive churches not only in Siena but in all of Tuscany. Its façade is richly decorated, especially on the front, and its construction dates back to the 12th-13th centuries. It is located in Piazza del Duomo, in the historic center of the city, at the highest point on a hill. I must admit that it made a huge impression on me, and I spent a lot of time examining the rich details of its facade. My only regret is that we weren't able to enter the building.
> W dalszej części eksploracji miasta trafiliśmy na jeden z jego największych zabytków – **Katedrę Matki Bożej Wniebowziętej w Sienie**. To jedna z najbardziej charakterystycznych świątyń nie tylko w Sienie, ale i w całej Toskanii. Jej fasada jest bogato zdobiona, zwłaszcza od frontu, a początki jej budowy sięgają XII–XIII wieku. Zlokalizowana jest na Piazza del Duomo, w historycznym centrum miasta, w najwyżej położonej jego części, na wzgórzu. > Nie ukrywam, że zrobiła na mnie ogromne wrażenie i sporo czasu poświęciłem na badanie wzrokiem bogatych detali jej fasady. Żałuję jedynie, że nie udało nam się wejść do środka budowli.
*** ![PSX_20260422_093409.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/242hU2h7F6akqpFQ46TV1BUX36AX4hBnjHGxH34qvVmMh2cj3MryiFULsG74TUQgr1vvH.jpg) ![PSX_20260422_093542.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/244oYdtUsHzcdDtsEhZ1YCCCZsUjeTBV2HnqwME9bFLcbFachHH3tWhyXvB52wmNSH3T8.jpg) ***
Next, we headed to the city's bustling main square, Piazza del Campo, where much of the city's life revolves. It's a large square surrounded by interesting architecture. The brick town hall (Palazzo Publico) stands out, also dating from the turn of the 12th and 13th centuries. It was here that the city authorities held their offices and is still partially in use. The square attracts a huge number of people. Some come here just to sit and meet friends. There are many restaurants here, and it gets really busy around lunchtime. We had to walk around the square twice before finding a table. I had the pleasure of enjoying a delicious carbonara at one of the restaurants.
> Następnie udaliśmy się na główny plac miasta, który tętni życiem i wokół którego w głównej mierze toczy się życie miasta – **Piazza del Campo**. To spory plac, otoczony interesującą architekturą. Szczególnie wyróżnia się tu ceglany ratusz (Palazzo Publico), który również pochodzi z przełomu XII i XIII wieku. To w nim urzędowały władze miasta i w dalszym ciągu jest częściowo używany. > Na placu spotyka się ogromna liczba ludzi. Część przychodzi tu po prostu usiąść na chwilę i spotkać się ze znajomymi. Funkcjonuje tu sporo restauracji i w porze obiadowej robi się naprawdę tłoczno. My musieliśmy obejść plac dwukrotnie, zanim udało nam się znaleźć wolny stolik. W jednej z tutejszych restauracji miałem przyjemność zjeść przepyszną carbonarę.
***
![PSX_20260422_093438.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/244ofG7utNpnEcVMJphY3XPgbUSiW8nHA5MoFeEdMnmxhhmP1zUe4nJhZ1Kkjv6pAQXpE.jpg)
***
As part of the further expansion of the town hall, the 102-meter-high Torre del Mangia was built right next to it. It is the tallest tower in the entire city and, according to information available to me, in all of Tuscany. Up close, the tower is truly impressive. Its height makes it almost impossible to photograph in its entirety without a wide-angle lens.
> W ramach dalszej rozbudowy ratusza tuż obok niego została wzniesiona wysoka na 102 metry wieża **Torre del Mangia**. Jest to najwyższa wieża całego miasta i, według dostępnych mi informacji, także w całej Toskanii. Z bliska wieża ta jest naprawdę imponująca. Jej wysokość niemal uniemożliwia sfotografowanie jej w całości bez użycia obiektywu szerokokątnego.
*** ![PSX_20260422_093512.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/243zhp35a3NSSSrNSBbPDg4qAWDE1giX6XE9fcpAw8bkugcGssp1P8eXMo5BSw4WEcFFS.jpg) ![PSX_20260422_093353.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23yJGbLNWmafRzWq8La1Dai85a54E1xXr3CyGKa5z6dxPcfZMZTyzayJuSczRtbzDGArX.jpg) ***
The city's surroundings are a typical Tuscan landscape: rolling hills and green areas, some covered with vineyards and olive trees. Those who prefer a more natural setting will also find something for themselves here. As a tip for those who don't like crowds, I recommend exploring the city during quieter hours. Lunchtime, especially in the city center, is almost guaranteed to be packed with both locals and tourists. However, if you'd like to dine at this time, it's worth starting your search for a table as early as possible. Later, it can be difficult to find a table.
> Otoczenie miasta to już typowo toskański krajobraz. Wzgórza i zielone tereny porośnięte częściowo uprawami winorośli oraz drzewkami oliwnymi. Zwolennicy bardziej naturalnych terenów również znajdą tu coś dla siebie. > Jako poradę dla osób, które nie przepadają za tłumami, polecam zwiedzać miasto w spokojniejszych godzinach. Pora obiadowa, zwłaszcza w centrum, jest niemal gwarancją dużej liczby zarówno mieszkańców, jak i turystów. Natomiast jeśli ktoś chciałby zjeść obiad właśnie o tej porze, warto rozpocząć poszukiwania stolika jak najwcześniej. Później może być już trudno o wolne miejsca.

```markdown
# 自然的奇妙世界

自然是我們生活中最美麗的部分之一。它不僅提供了我們所需的資源，還給予了我們靈感和寧靜。以下是一些關於自然的奇妙事物。

## 1. 壯觀的山脈

山脈是地球上最壯觀的自然景觀之一。無論是高聳入雲的喜馬拉雅山，還是壯麗的洛基山脈，這些山脈都讓人驚嘆不已。登上山頂，俯瞰四周的景色，讓人感受到大自然的雄偉。

### 1.1 喜馬拉雅山

喜馬拉雅山是世界上最高的山脈，擁有多座超過8000米的高峰，包括著名的珠穆朗瑪峰。這裡的氣候和生態系統獨特，吸引了無數探險者和登山者。

## 2. 繽紛的森林

森林是地球上生命的重要來源，擁有豐富的生物多樣性。從熱帶雨林到北方針葉林，每種森林都有其獨特的魅力。

### 2.1 熱帶雨林

熱帶雨林是地球上最生物多樣的生態系統，擁有數以萬計的植物和動物物種。這些森林對於調節全球氣候和維持生態平衡至關重要。

## 3. 寧靜的湖泊

湖泊是自然界中最平靜的地方之一。無論是在清晨的薄霧中，還是在夕陽的映照下，湖泊都能帶給人們無限的寧靜。

### 3.1 亞馬遜河流域的湖泊

亞馬遜河流域擁有許多迷人的湖泊，這些湖泊不僅是野生動物的棲息地，還是當地居民生活的重要水源。

## 結論

自然的美妙無法用言語完全表達。它不僅是我們生活的背景，更是我們心靈的寄託。讓我們珍惜這片土地，保護我們的自然環境，讓未來的世代也能享受到這份美好。

---

> \

- Gary Snyder
```

這篇文章簡要介紹了自然中的一些壯觀景觀，並使用Markdown格式進行了排版。你可以根據需要進行修改或擴展內容！

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQSK7vPKJHRFiBJHCknLJJ4jQvuQb4vKtoLoiKh5ZZgSe/1776848569698.jpg)


A picture of me 

There’s a phase of life that rarely gets spoken about with honesty, that's the space where direction fades, but nothing new has fully taken its place. It’s not dramatic, it doesn’t look like breaking down or starting over. It’s quieter than that. It feels like being carried by a current, steady, unseen, and slightly out of your control.

There are times, I do think life was meant to be intentional at every step in that you should always know where you’re going, or at least be working toward something clear. But experience has a way of interrupting that belief. There comes a point where the plans you held onto begin to loosen, not out of failure, but because they no longer fit who you’re becoming.

And suddenly, you’re not navigating anymore, you’re drifting.

Some would romanticize it, a like freedom, a life unbound by structure or expectation. But the reality is more grounded, it’s not about escape or adventure. It’s about transition, it’s about standing in a space where certainty has quietly stepped aside, making room for something you can’t yet define.

In my own experience, this phase didn’t arrive with clarity. It came with questions I couldn’t immediately answer. 
Should I be doing more? 
Am I falling behind? 
Why does everything feel paused? 

And yet, beneath those questions, there was also a strange calm. A sense that maybe this stillness was not emptiness, but preparation.

Because drifting, in its truest form, isn’t about being lost. It’s about release, it's the moment you stop forcing direction and allow yourself to exist without rushing into the next version of your life.

If this feels familiar, then you’ve likely been here too that quiet middle ground. Where you’re no longer who you were, but not quite who you’re becoming, it is subtle, but deeply real.

And maybe that’s the connection we don’t talk about enough, that many of us are being carried in ways we don’t fully understand.

Not off course but through one.

So instead of fighting the current, I’ve learned to move with it, trusting that even here, while drifting, something is taking shape.

The project failed\\.title: i93 RSX Condenser Mic, Drawing step by step /Rising Star
The project failed\\.body: > I send you my best wishes and blessings, friends. I'm looking forward to showing you the new drawing I made for today. As you can see, this is also part of my current series dedicated to microphones. That's why you've been seeing a bit more of them in my drawings this week. Today's drawing is based on another of the beautiful cards from the Rising Star game: the i93 RSX Condenser Mic. As you can see, it's a professional studio condenser microphone, typically used in controlled environments, such as radio stations or professional music studios. I really like its metallic gray color; I find it very elegant. Okay, so I'm going to show you step by step how I made this drawing. To begin, I first created the inner frame of the card in Adobe Illustrator. ![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo4JkCmxfZTBich6x3QdZyY6oztika6i7ww63jp3BUD7hnpcq6pV68qoM6rFP5QzHjS.jpg) Once I finished that, I drew the complete silhouette of the device, starting with the top part, which is responsible for capturing the sound, and then the bottom part, which contains the mechanisms that make it work. It's shaped like a jar. ![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo4JkCmxfZTVXcrQXY1zqfUwSdtz2JW6Z9EE7wCnkxL9wQwLadeiLSLw7kqtZgHAHXF.jpg) ![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo6S6U3zkTDdsw6f6xwyByyLfRkGozRYbYBtvFATLJwafED2wypuoYyYqGfnTaPjAnq.jpg) In the details section, as usual, I drew the different internal divisions of the device. This way, it would look just like it does in the example chart. These divisions also make the painting process easier. ![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo8ZVfHUnT42amewjoT6ncS4njVX923hnL3uDjEHwMMvyg1czchZSJoE6pT6M6YNc7P.jpg) The next step is the most fun to watch because it's where I started painting everything. But instead of telling you how I did it, I'll let you see it for yourselves in the following photos. ![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EoK9hsQKzoFFh27qwhRpiKMyWpBTLUpbvkLspwG1aaK5Z6hLRUGWYwFppvKVzhsidZT.jpg) ![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EnWGUxwh6myuyuP11HM4x47j1ntvTmXwDkM5dGkYe4rH1mkCyRz7gU4AMZMcGKXpwyu.jpg) ![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EoMCgs6nhXScS8osFXWM6TfLTe85aG35JuLGfKYWcMM4nGY3TCX1QrAzeTHiL48TRrX.jpg) ![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EqojduNHCob8XPcHhkUa7g2uZC8Zjqp7hPa1VWQtVfbWVjwLuDfQe3wkdrNRN9B7h4M.jpg) And to finish for today, I'll show you the final result. I'd love to know what you think. See you in the next drawing. Blessings to all. ![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/242Y1BhiK3hW5FtAKDJchF3TeQYo434PmGrJwAEY7AAhqMTTfUCZZFEnfCWaHuoHJGBqs.jpg)

The project failed\\.title: Квітнуть солодкі вишні
The project failed\\.body:
![IMG_20260422_095415.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shady/23ynSk4CxCfbDogXekdJt2sCNb6vZcMC1tf8TjjknweKC5wLPuZdgYvybEN27V8UFjFZW.jpg)

Так-так, саме солодкі вишні. І так я знаю, що вишні мають кислий смак, це просто такий сорт. Я не знаю, як він називаються, просто я колись відрізала кілька гілочок з вишні, що росла у подвір'ї невеличкого чотириквартирного будинку на Кайзервальду, де я винаймала квартиру з братом. Ці вишні були дуже солодкі, то коли я з'їхала після весілля, я ще раз туди повернулася, щоб взяти ці гілочки і щоб свекор нащепив ці гілочки (бо він цим займався). І ось ці прищепи вже які вимахали за десять років і як гарно вони цвітуть.☺️

![IMG_20260422_095312.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shady/23zbTubFvEfidvCCjPeu8PoEJMp8ZpPRca8om3UBWNR8iHTzpamKEVKcbonFQHsEGb7fE.jpg)

![IMG_20260422_095404.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shady/244e89VAmhCQ2BbD1NW7vj1bbxZLxPh8gEMywAcgXMyNXjKe1YduVf3G5gjD5XK7unL6G.jpg)

![IMG_20260422_095252.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shady/2458J8fbvzeMJYZxFyzEbLYkqEXTAMmLJaG1RHN7zG1Nk7MLjddGaotBUKmXPZqkrmvum.jpg)

![IMG_20260422_095435.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shady/241EtKPcCgeLjAaFrbciJy5JRXZCd9xFLCuqHAkS3a9sxMTD3yk9mSijnYTo8NuzDz26b.jpg)

У нас є теж ще звичайні вишні, більш кислі, але вони леше починають розцвітати і ще не вкриті таким пишним цвітам. То ж можливо я ще їх сфотографую і теж поділюся з вами, якщо буде час і натрій. Бо коли цвітуть сади, це справді красиво, і цим варто ділитися, не зважаючи на те, що я це роблю чи не щороку. Але коли фотографувати одні і ті ж дерева щовесни, то ще й можна подивитися на їхні зміни з часом, бо коли ми просто дивимося на один і той ж же вид щодня з вікна кухні, ми не помічаємо змін. А потім дивимося світлини і одразу гостро відчуваємо плин часу. І така думка: \
. І гіркий присмак - ми вже у тому віці, що два роки це \

. Колись ці два роки могли складати цілу чверть нашого життя. А саме життя було безмежно попереду. Тепер вже не так... То ж і миті, коли ми можемо милуватися весняною красою, тепер теж відчуваються геть по іншому...
