The project failed\\.title: အဓိက
The project failed\\.body:
နွေအပူက လေးဆယ့်တစ်ဒီကရီ ရှိပေသည်။
သင်္ကြန်အပြီး အပူတွေ လာချေပြီဆိုသလို။
သင်္ကြန်မှာ ပျော်ထားကြအုံးပေါ့ကွာ။ ပြီတော့မှ
မင်းတို့နဲ့ ငါတို့နဲ့ တွေ့မယ်ဆိုသလား အဲ့သလို
ကြိမ်ဝါးထားတာ ဖတ်လိုက်ရသည်။ ကျွန်တော်ရေး
‌ထားတာ နားမလည်ဖြစ်သွားမလားပဲ။ ကလိုဗျာ
မြန်မာပြည်သူတွေ သင်္ကြန်ပွဲတော်ကြီးမှာ
ပျော်ပါးမြူးတူးနေကြတာ တွေ့ခဲ့ကြတယ်မို့လား။
အဲ့သလိုပဲ မြန်မာပြည်သူတွေရဲ့ ဒုက္ခပေါင်းစုံ
ကိုလည်း တွေ့ကြမှာပါ။ လောင်စာဆီဒုက္ခ၊
ကုန်ဈေးနှုန်းဒုက္ခ နှင့် အခြားသော သောင်းခြောက်ထောင် 
ဒုက္ခပေါင်းစုံကို ကျောကော့အောင် ခံစားကြရပါလိမ့်မည်။
အဲ့သဟာကို ရေးပြခြင်း ဖြစ်ပါသည်။ 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXMK2NzsLUj1t99tVG5uaFpuYWDQqRJpXK1tjbgHHJb3w/1776847499949.jpg)

ယခုနှစ်မြန်မာသင်္ကြန်ပွဲက အတော်ကို စည်ကား
ပေသည်ဟု သတင်းတွေမှာ ဖော်ပြထားကြသည်။
ပျော်ကြပေမည်ပေါ့ အပျော်နဲ့ ဝေးကွာနေကြတာ
ကလား။ ပျော်လိုက်ကြတာ သူတို့မို့ ပျော်နိုင်လိုက်တာ။
ဒုက္ခရောက်နေကြသူတွေကိုမှ အားမနာ ပျော်ရက်
ကြပါပေ့။ စသဖြင့် အမျိုးမျိုးသော ဝေဖန်၊ လေကန်
သမှုများလည်း ရှိကြသည်။ 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSHYoViZ1mRBW7tRYSsaYEq2F8kTjGduGBbTT56pUFJeH/1776847909635.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRtBeEZD4dbSZUAWHoHVibaiSCty8r9N1wfEimeuh8Lx2/1776847910635.jpg)

အဲ့သလို၊ ထိုသို့ ပြောဆိုဝေဖန်သမှု ပြုကြသည်များ
ကလည်း လူ့သဘာဝပေကိုး။ ပျော်ကြတာလည်း
ပျော်ကြပေါ့။ စာနာသမို့ မပျော်နိုင်သူလည်း
ချီးကျူးပါတယ်ပေါ့။ မည်သို့ပင်ဖြစ်စေ ထိုသူတို့
အားလုံးသည် အဓိက ကိုဖြင့် အဓိကလို့ မှတ်ယူ
ထားကြပါရင်ဖြင့် ကိုယ့်စီ စိတ်ကူးတိုင်းက
လှပနေပါလိမ့်မည်။ 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWapujPUpxaQvB7c8tsgopG1DUwaUhZEG8uS49de5kEK1/img_0.4141831110063943.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT6vZMxomDbbe1TMRt2LomFgvgUGudipAhSKjJ4THB5VJ/img_0.5027579172290048.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdqqENSkRysWpvPAes3nBKbqb7ZVybwyXK4o2Xn2vABTL/img_0.5047116689611975.jpg)

လူ့ဘဝအချိန်တိုတိုမှာ ဘယ်ဟာက ဘယ်လိုဆိုတာ
လူတိုင်းနီးပါး အားလုံးသိကြသည်။ အမှန်လား၊
အမှားလား ဝေခွဲစရာမလိုအောင် ရှင်းလင်းသေချာ
နေသည်ကို သိမြင်ကြရသည်။ ထိုသည်ကိုမှ
ရေစုန်မှာ မျောရင်း သာယာနေကြသည်ဆိုပါရင်ဖြင့်
ပြောစရာစကားမရှိတော့ပါလေ။ 
ရေစုန်မှာ မျောမလား။
ရေဆန်မှာ လှော်မလား။
ရေစုန်‌ မျောသူတွေက တဖက်၊ ရေဆန် လှော်သူတွေက
တဖက်။ ဘယ်သူတွေ ဘယ်လိုဖြစ်လာမလဲဆိုသည်က
အချိန်က ပြောပြပေးသွားမှာပါ။

A diet based mostly on fish and water sounds like a great idea, especially for fish eating fans who wouldn’t say no, if they were asked to follow this diet for the rest of their life.

Of course, this is exactly what you would naturally do if you lived alone on an island and fish was available in abundance, perhaps supplementing this diet with some carbohydrates and vegetables and fruits.

**Is the \

diet safe?**

However, it is questionable whether this type of diet is effective and safe when applied to overweight people with obesity problems.

First of all, the point should be emphasized that, before you start any type of diet, you should first consult your doctor, especially when the weight of your body is very far from normal and you suffer from various health conditions.

You must accept the fact that it is hard, and even impossible to lose weight in just a few days or weeks, when it took so long for fat to accumulate in your body.

Taking it slowly and working on a method approved by your doctor is the safest, surest and best way to achieve impressive long-term results in terms of your body's weight and health, otherwise you may end up doing more harm than good to your health.

Although the name \

implies that fish is the main ingredient on your daily menu, it doesn't, and shouldn’t, mean that it is the only one.

A fish diet may also include, for example, eating fruit, drinking coffee, and consuming other types of food.

**Stopping the \

diet and gaining weight again**

In this way, you will be able to avoid the risk of becoming bored or just disgusted by consuming only fish (tuna) every single day, which could make you stop your diet at an early stage.

Another thing is that you should follow the diet for only three days in a row.

However, after those three days, you shouldn't by any means return to your old Lucullian habits.

The reason is that, as the human body has an incredible ability to adapt to changing conditions, it will quickly get used to less food and calorie intake, and reorganize its activities and processes, in order to be able to work with less \
for longer periods of time.\n\nSo when you stop living only on tuna and water, and start eating more and more carbohydrates and fats, your body will receive the message that it has to work \

to consume this extra energy, and it has to adapt itself to your new eating habits. Of course, you should not forget that feeling hungry all the time, because of being on a diet, will only make things worse, when you stop your diet, and let yourself free to devour all this food that you were not allowed to touch before. However, your appetite will also come back even stronger, and you will not be able to control it as easily as before. Therefore, be careful when you decide to play games with the weight of your body, and remember that there is no single panacea to any health problem. If you try to get results too fast, and without proper medical advice, you will probably end up to the other extreme, and then, it may be too late to recover any damage caused to your health. Furthermore, don't underestimate the healing power of physical exercise. Even if you've had very little exercise in your life, you can motivate yourself to start it now, if you see it as an opportunity to improve your well-being, and become a healthier and more attractive person. 조합은 그저 또 다른 유행일 뿐일까요?

주로 생선과 물을 중심으로 한 식단은 아주 좋은 생각처럼 들립니다. 특히 생선을 좋아하는 사람이라면 평생 이 식단을 따르라는 요청을 받아도 마다하지 않을 것입니다.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5zaxpsIF7rQ&pp=ygUbbGl2aW5nIG9uIGZpc2ggb24gYW4gaXNsYW5k

물론, 만약 당신이 섬에 혼자 살면서 생선을 풍부하게 구할 수 있다면, 아마도 탄수화물과 채소, 과일을 곁들여 식단을 보충하면서 자연스럽게 그렇게 할 것입니다.

**생선과 물만 먹는 식단은 안전한가요?**

하지만 이러한 유형의 다이어트가 비만 문제를 가진 과체중 사람들에게 효과적이고 안전한지는 의문입니다.

무엇보다도, 어떤 다이어트를 시작하기 전에 반드시 의사와 상담해야 한다는 점을 강조해야 합니다. 특히 체중이 정상 범위에서 크게 벗어나 있거나 여러 가지 건강 문제가 있는 경우에는 더욱 그렇습니다.

몸에 지방이 축적되는 데 오랜 시간이 걸렸는데, 단 며칠이나 몇 주 만에 체중을 감량하는 것은 어렵고 심지어 불가능하다는 사실을 받아들여야 합니다.

천천히 진행하고 의사의 승인을 받은 방법을 따르는 것이 체중과 건강 측면에서 장기적으로 놀라운 결과를 얻는 가장 안전하고 확실한 방법입니다. 그렇지 않으면 오히려 건강에 더 해를 끼칠 수 있습니다.

\

라는 이름은 생선이 식단의 주재료임을 암시하지만, 생선만 먹어야 한다는 것을 의미하는 것은 아니며, 그래서도 안 됩니다.

생선 다이어트에는 과일, 커피, 기타 다양한 음식을 섭취하는 것도 포함될 수 있습니다.

**생선과 물만 먹는 다이어트를 중단하고 다시 체중이 늘었습니다**

이렇게 하면 매일 생선(참치)만 먹는 것에 질리거나 혐오감을 느껴 다이어트를 일찍 포기하는 위험을 피할 수 있습니다.

또 한 가지 중요한 점은 이 다이어트를 단 3일 동안만 연속으로 따라야 한다는 것입니다.

하지만 3일이 지난 후에는 절대로 이전의 식습관으로 돌아가서는 안 됩니다.

인체는 변화에 놀라울 정도로 잘 적응하는 능력을 가지고 있기 때문에, 적은 음식과 칼로리 섭취에 빠르게 익숙해지고, 더 적은 \

로 더 오랫동안 기능할 수 있도록 신체 활동과 과정을 재구성하기 때문입니다.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lt670sAU8YQ&pp=ygUYc3RvcCBkaWV0IGFuZCBnZXQgd2VpZ2h0

참치와 물만 먹던 식단에서 벗어나 탄수화물과 지방을 점점 더 많이 섭취하기 시작하면, 우리 몸은 추가 에너지를 소비하기 위해 \

상태로 작동해야 한다는 신호를 받게 되고, 새로운 식습관에 적응해야 합니다.

물론, 다이어트 때문에 항상 배고픔을 느끼는 것은 다이어트를 중단하고 이전에는 절대 먹지 못했던 음식을 마음껏 먹을 때 상황을 더욱 악화시킬 뿐입니다.

게다가 식욕은 더욱 강해져서 이전처럼 쉽게 조절할 수 없게 될 것입니다.

따라서 체중 감량을 위해 무리하게 다이어트를 시도할 때는 신중해야 하며, 모든 건강 문제에 대한 만병통치약은 없다는 것을 기억해야 합니다.

적절한 의학적 조언 없이 너무 빨리 결과를 얻으려고 하면 오히려 극단적인 상황에 빠지게 되고, 그때는 이미 건강을 회복하기에는 너무 늦을 수도 있습니다.

또한, 규칙적인 운동의 치유력을 과소평가해서는 안 됩니다.

평생 운동을 거의 해본 적이 없더라도, 운동을 통해 건강을 증진하고 더 건강하고 매력적인 사람이 될 수 있는 기회라고 생각한다면, 지금 당장 운동을 시작할 동기를 부여할 수 있습니다.

Der Gedanke, eine Abzweigung verpasst zu haben, ist mir nicht fremd. Ich habe ihn oft gehabt – besonders dann, wenn ich auf andere Lebensläufe geschaut habe, die geradliniger oder leichter wirkten.

Bei mir kam früh ein anderer Impuls dazu: unabhängig zu sein. Vielleicht geprägt durch den frühen Verlust meines Vaters. Ich war viel mit älteren Menschen unterwegs und habe gesehen, wie sie sich durch ihr Leben gearbeitet haben – und auch, wo manche stecken geblieben sind.

Ich hatte nie das Gefühl, dass es den richtigen Weg gibt. Eher nur unterschiedliche Gelände. Manche gehen außen herum. Ich bin oft direkt über die Steine gegangen. Nicht, weil es klüger war, sondern weil es sich für mich oft einfacher anfühlte, mich hineinzuarbeiten, bis ich etwas verstehe.

Gerade in der Technik war das deutlich. Je komplexer es wurde, desto größer wurde meine Ruhe darin. Vielleicht, weil ich irgendwann gemerkt habe: Das ist alles von Menschen gemacht. Also kann man es auch verstehen. Heute sehe ich das etwas anders. Technik ist für mich weniger etwas, das ich „bezwingen“ muss, sondern eher ein Werkzeug, das mich unterstützt – oder auch einfach mal liegen bleiben kann.

Was du schreibst, wirkt für mich nicht wie ein Verpassen einer Abzweigung. Eher wie jemand, der bewusst auf seinem Weg geblieben ist. Vielleicht ist es gar kein Schlafen gewesen. Vielleicht eher eine Form von Wachsein, die nicht ständig den Kurs wechselt. Und genau das hat seinen eigenen Wert.

> Sumário executivo
O sistema silvopastoril do Montado em Portugal — que cobre 1 milhão de hectares e fornece serviços de ecossistema essenciais — encontra-se em declínio a longo prazo, perdendo cerca de 2 500 ha/ano. As medidas agroambientais da Política Agrícola Comum (PAC) continuam a focar-se em práticas prescritas, gerando uma elevada carga administrativa e um impacto ambiental limitado. ### On to today's episode

In episodes #42 and #43, we built models using `nn.Sequential` -- stack a few layers in a list, pass data through them top to bottom. That approach works great for simple architectures. But what happens when you need a network with **skip connections** (where the input of a block gets added to its output)? Or **multiple inputs** feeding into different branches? Or **shared parameters** between two different parts of the network? `nn.Sequential` can't express any of these because it only knows how to pipe data linearly from one layer to the next.

Every serious PyTorch architecture -- from ResNets to Transformers to GANs -- is built by subclassing **`nn.Module`**. It's the base class for *everything* in PyTorch: individual layers (`nn.Linear`, `nn.Conv2d`), activation functions (`nn.ReLU`), regularization layers (`nn.Dropout`, `nn.BatchNorm1d`), and complete models. `nn.Sequential` itself is just a convenience wrapper around `nn.Module`. Understanding `nn.Module` deeply is the key to building, modifying, and debugging any architecture you'll encounter in practice. Here we go!

## Your first custom Module

The recipe is simple: subclass `nn.Module`, define your layers in `__init__`, and implement the `forward` method. If you've been following the Learn Python Series (especially the episodes on classes and inheritance), this will feel completely natural -- it's just Python OOP:

```python
import torch
import torch.nn as nn

class SimpleClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim, hidden_dim, output_dim):
        super().__init__()
        self.layer1 = nn.Linear(input_dim, hidden_dim)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(hidden_dim)
        self.layer2 = nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(hidden_dim)
        self.output = nn.Linear(hidden_dim, output_dim)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU()
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(0.3)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.dropout(self.relu(self.bn1(self.layer1(x))))
        x = self.dropout(self.relu(self.bn2(self.layer2(x))))
        return self.output(x)

model = SimpleClassifier(20, 64, 3)
```

Notice something elegant: `ResidualBlock` is itself an `nn.Module`, and we compose five of them inside another `nn.Module` (`ResNet`). Modules nest seamlessly because they all share the same interface. This composability is one of the most powerful aspects of the `nn.Module` design -- you build complex architectures from simple, reusable pieces.

But *why* do skip connections matter? Remember the vanishing gradient problem from episode #40: in deep networks, gradients shrink as they travel backward through many layers, eventually becoming too small to update the early layers. The skip connection provides a **gradient highway** -- during backpropagation, gradients can flow directly through the addition operation (the derivative of `f(x) + x` with respect to `x` always includes a `1` term), bypassing the block's layers entirely. This means even the earliest layers in a 100-layer network still receive meaningful gradient signal.

Without skip connections, plain networks start degrading in performance beyond roughly 20 layers -- adding more layers actually makes accuracy *worse* (not just due to overfitting but because training fails). With skip connections, ResNets have been trained with 152 layers and beyond. That's a prettyy dramatic improvement from a single `+ x` ;-)

## Hooks: inspecting the internals

Hooks let you observe (or even modify) what happens inside a model without touching the model's code. This is incredibly useful for debugging, visualization, and feature extraction. **Forward hooks** fire after a layer computes its output; **backward hooks** fire during backpropagation:

```python
activation_stats = {}

def make_hook(name):
    def hook(module, input, output):
        activation_stats[name] = {
            'mean': output.detach().mean().item(),
            'std': output.detach().std().item(),
            'min': output.detach().min().item(),
            'max': output.detach().max().item(),
            'dead_frac': (output.detach() == 0).float().mean().item()
        }
    return hook

# Attach hooks to specific layers
model = SimpleClassifier(20, 64, 3)
handles = []
handles.append(model.layer1.register_forward_hook(make_hook('layer1')))
handles.append(model.layer2.register_forward_hook(make_hook('layer2')))
handles.append(model.output.register_forward_hook(make_hook('output')))

# Forward pass triggers all hooks
x = torch.randn(32, 20)
_ = model(x)

print(\

)

# Clean up hooks when done
for h in handles:
    h.remove()
```

The **dead fraction** tells you what percentage of outputs are exactly zero after ReLU. If a layer shows 70-80% dead neurons, something is wrong -- those neurons aren't contributing to the network's predictions at all. Possible fixes: lower the learning rate (large updates can push neurons into the permanently-dead zone), use a different initialization, or switch from ReLU to Leaky ReLU (which has a small non-zero gradient for negative inputs, preventing neurons from dying entirely -- we covered this in episode #40).

Hooks are non-invasive. You attach them from outside the model and remove them when you're done. The model's forward method doesn't change at all. This makes hooks ideal for diagnostics on models you didn't write -- you can inspect any pretrained model's internals without modifying a single line of its source code.

A practical example: extracting intermediate representations for transfer learning. You hook into an early layer of a pretrained image model, run your data through it, and use the activations as features for a completely different task. We'll do exactly this when we start working with pretrained CNNs.

```python
# Gradient hook example -- monitor gradient magnitudes
gradient_stats = {}

def grad_hook(name):
    def hook(module, grad_input, grad_output):
        if grad_output[0] is not None:
            gradient_stats[name] = {
                'grad_mean': grad_output[0].detach().mean().item(),
                'grad_std': grad_output[0].detach().std().item(),
                'grad_norm': grad_output[0].detach().norm().item()
            }
    return hook

model2 = SimpleClassifier(20, 64, 3)
model2.layer1.register_full_backward_hook(grad_hook('layer1'))
model2.layer2.register_full_backward_hook(grad_hook('layer2'))
model2.output.register_full_backward_hook(grad_hook('output'))

# Forward + backward to trigger gradient hooks
x = torch.randn(32, 20)
y = torch.randint(0, 3, (32,))
loss = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()(model2(x), y)
loss.backward()

print(\

)
```

If you see gradient norms that are orders of magnitude different between layers (output layer at 0.1, layer1 at 0.00001), you've got a vanishing gradient problem. This is the exact problem we diagnosed theoretically in episode #40 -- hooks give you the empirical measurement.

## Parameter groups: fine-grained optimizer control

Different parts of a model often need different learning rates. The classic scenario: you take a pretrained model (trained on millions of images over days of GPU time), add a new classification head, and want to train the head aggressively while barely touching the pretrained weights. Parameter groups make this possible:

```python
resnet = ResNet(20, 64, 3, n_blocks=3)

# Different learning rates per component
optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW([
    {'params': resnet.input_layer.parameters(), 'lr': 1e-4},   # low LR
    {'params': resnet.blocks.parameters(), 'lr': 1e-4},        # low LR
    {'params': resnet.output_layer.parameters(), 'lr': 1e-3},  # high LR (10x)
], weight_decay=0.01)

for i, group in enumerate(optimizer.param_groups):
    n_params = sum(p.numel() for p in group['params'])
    print(f\

)
```

Parameter groups are passed to the optimizer as a list of dictionaries. Each dictionary must have a `'params'` key (an iterable of parameters) and can optionally override any optimizer setting -- learning rate, weight decay, momentum, whatever the specific optimizer supports. Parameters not explicitly assigned to a group use the optimizer's default settings.

This is the mechanism behind **fine-tuning** pretrained models. The standard recipe: freeze the backbone (set `requires_grad = False` on all backbone parameters) or use a very low learning rate, train the new head at a much higher rate, then optionally \

layers gradually from top to bottom with progressively lower learning rates. This technique -- called **gradual unfreezing** -- lets the model adapt its pretrained representations without catastrophically forgetting what it already knows.

```python
# Freezing parameters -- exclude from optimization entirely
for param in resnet.input_layer.parameters():
    param.requires_grad = False

# Only unfrozen parameters get updated
trainable = sum(p.numel() for p in resnet.parameters() if p.requires_grad)
frozen = sum(p.numel() for p in resnet.parameters() if not p.requires_grad)
print(f\

)

trainable = sum(p.numel() for p in pretrained.parameters() if p.requires_grad)
total = sum(p.numel() for p in pretrained.parameters())
print(f\

)
```

In practice, you'd use `torchvision.models.resnet50(pretrained=True)`, replace its `.fc` attribute with `nn.Linear(2048, num_classes)`, and freeze everything else. We'll do exactly this when we build CNNs in upcoming episodes -- the pattern will be identical, just with real image data and real pretrained weights. The key insight: you're adapting a model trained on 1.4 million ImageNet images by training only a few thousand new parameters. The feature extractor already knows how to recognize edges, textures, shapes, and objects. Your new classifier just needs to learn the mapping from those rich features to your specific categories.

```python
# Verify the model still works end-to-end after surgery
x = torch.randn(16, 100)
output = pretrained(x)
print(f\

)

# Train ONLY the new classifier
optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(
    filter(lambda p: p.requires_grad, pretrained.parameters()),
    lr=0.001
)

# Quick training loop to show it works
y = torch.randint(0, 5, (16,))
loss_fn = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()

for epoch in range(10):
    pred = pretrained(x)
    loss = loss_fn(pred, y)
    optimizer.zero_grad()
    loss.backward()
    optimizer.step()
    if epoch % 3 == 0:
        acc = (pred.argmax(dim=1) == y).float().mean()
        print(f\

)
```

Notice the `filter(lambda p: p.requires_grad, ...)` trick -- this passes only the unfrozen parameters to the optimizer, saving memory (the optimizer doesn't need to maintain Adam state for frozen parameters) and making the optimizer step faster.

## Custom parameters with nn.Parameter

Sometimes you need learnable parameters that aren't part of a standard layer. `nn.Parameter` wraps a tensor and tells PyTorch \

:

```python
class ScaledDotProduct(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, dim):
        super().__init__()
        self.scale = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(dim))    # learnable scale
        self.bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(dim))     # learnable bias
        self.linear = nn.Linear(dim, dim)

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.linear(x) * self.scale + self.bias

sdp = ScaledDotProduct(32)
print(\

)

# scale and bias show up alongside linear's weight and bias
```

Any tensor wrapped in `nn.Parameter` and assigned as an attribute of an `nn.Module` is automatically included in `model.parameters()`. The optimizer treats it just like any other weight or bias. This is how attention mechanisms implement their query/key/value projections and how layer normalization implements its learnable affine parameters -- the building blocks we'll need for Transformers.

## Putting it all together: a complete example

Let's combine everything -- custom Module, residual connections, parameter groups, hooks -- into a single training example:

```python
import numpy as np
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, TensorDataset

# Generate synthetic data (10-class classification)
np.random.seed(42)
X_train = torch.randn(2000, 20)
y_train = torch.randint(0, 10, (2000,))
X_val = torch.randn(500, 20)
y_val = torch.randint(0, 10, (500,))

train_loader = DataLoader(TensorDataset(X_train, y_train), batch_size=64, shuffle=True)
val_loader = DataLoader(TensorDataset(X_val, y_val), batch_size=128)

# Build the model
model = ResNet(input_dim=20, hidden_dim=64, output_dim=10, n_blocks=3)
print(f\

)

# Parameter groups
optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW([
    {'params': model.input_layer.parameters(), 'lr': 1e-3},
    {'params': model.blocks.parameters(), 'lr': 1e-3},
    {'params': model.output_layer.parameters(), 'lr': 1e-3},
], weight_decay=0.01)

scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingLR(optimizer, T_max=30)
loss_fn = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()

# Training
for epoch in range(30):
    model.train()
    total_loss = 0
    for X_b, y_b in train_loader:
        pred = model(X_b)
        loss = loss_fn(pred, y_b)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
        total_loss += loss.item()
    scheduler.step()

    if epoch % 5 == 0:
        model.eval()
        correct, total = 0, 0
        with torch.no_grad():
            for X_v, y_v in val_loader:
                correct += (model(X_v).argmax(1) == y_v).sum().item()
                total += len(y_v)
        print(f\

)

# Final
model.eval()
correct, total = 0, 0
with torch.no_grad():
    for X_v, y_v in val_loader:
        correct += (model(X_v).argmax(1) == y_v).sum().item()
        total += len(y_v)
print(f\

)
```

Random data with 10 classes means ~10% baseline accuracy. The model should do meaningfully better than that -- but don't expect 90%+ on random data. The point here is that all the pieces fit together: custom Module with residual blocks, parameter groups, cosine annealing, proper train/eval toggling.

body.title: Be enchanted by yourself.
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/xrayman/23y8xKRz5mPy83vNVVBV6xDqthrSTHgVxbEgNWDpmpqr8j1K7vFdCQyTDp9EuyYxs64ks.png)



There are certain things we take for granted in life. The first, and most obvious, is that our life, this brief passage, is just that. A passage. We will not continue to live in this reality after our death. And for now, death is a certainty. But that certainty should not leave us worried or distressed. That certainty makes our choices, our way of life, all the more valuable. 
A second certainty follows on from the first one I mentioned. We will watch our entire life unfold from the front row. We will be spectators of our own lives. Of the things we experience, of what happens to us, of what we do or fail to do, of the sounds, smells and shapes that our body perceives around us, and even of our dreams, fears and anxieties. 

As spectators, therefore, we must not leave our seats to focus solely on the very best parts of the vast play that is life. We must allow ourselves to be enchanted by ourselves. We must laugh and smile at the moments that make us feel most embarrassed. We must not be afraid to let our spirit discover what in life makes us smile. If we cannot enchant ourselves with what we do, we must seek something new to do that will restore that capacity for enchantment. 


The sea does not remember all the beaches it has kissed. Just like the sky, it does not retain the same colours every day, and is constantly changing. Change should not be a cause of anguish or suffering for us. Let us look at what changes before our eyes. We must appreciate the beautiful amber-coloured sky when it truly seems beautiful to us, and not ‘weep’ because that sky, those clouds, have dissipated, or will surely dissipate. 

As observers of our own behaviour until we die, it is our duty. And as such, we cannot simply be enchanted by ourselves wherever we are, and not just when the sky is breathtakingly beautiful. If we need very special, unique and glamorous moments to be happy, in situations where things do not go our way, we will not be able to derive a positive feeling. If we allow ourselves to be guided by the desire to find the best in any situation, we will have a more positive attitude and a better emotional state to face any less favourable situation that may arise.

Let the enchantment of our own lives – and, for that matter, respect for others – guide our days more fully. 




![separador.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/xrayman/23swppYGLECw991bW1wsSTEwnV8YKgqPHaiAdDJioriDcMJR4GymNLH1VbQ98ykpBYkob.png)

body.title: Manage A Program Such As This
body.body:
They're going to make a impact at the societal level, or it makes an economic impact by creating new economic models or new accountancy systems for accounting for monetariness in a tokenized form. Those are the four categories. We've done the research, we've done our homework. 

When somebody learns something new, they get an immediate release in the brain of dopamine. When somebody learns something new, and they're willingly, which they are, because we are very upfront with everybody about this, participating in altruistic activities or efforts, it releases another chemical called acetylcholine, or ACH for short. When you have a simultaneous release of dopamine and acetylcholine in the brain, it is one of the most profound euphoric responses the brain in its current state is capable of.

I don't say it's like creating an addiction, but it does encourage the learners to continue their learning journey, because not only are they getting the tokens, not only are they getting new information that they haven't been exposed to before, but they're also getting this very amazing feeling about themselves. It's going to build confidence in them, and it's going to be a very positive response to them as a human being. We have a few other programs. 

I just want to talk really quick. I'll take about 20 seconds on this one. This is our newest program. 

We actually have an O right now for it. On the profile page of KF Media, you'll see the open call for the winter edition. This so far has been everything we expected it to be. 

It's called KFM Talks. We have 22 alumni who have signaled their interest to participate in this. We have five independent content creators that we've not only produced these talks for, but we've published them out on the open marketplace. 

Yes, Yanda, we are now media publishing. We are now media publishing. That is our first revenue stream.

What KFM Talks is, very briefly, it's bringing TEDx-style talks in that same format, in that same spirit and vein of having an impactful, passionate, probably inspiring talk that someone else is going to benefit from. We bring TEDx-style talks into the Web3 ecosystem using nothing but Web3 tooling to manage the program. Yes, we have enough tools out there, ladies and gentlemen, to manage a program such as this.

body.title: Amidst magical paths, lush vegetation and art.
body.body:
> --- >There are some walks that seem timeless; later, when I look at the photographs, I say to myself: ‘There are places that look exactly the same as when I arrived, apart from a few small details.’ So, going for walks in certain places, especially natural ones, makes time pass in a very different way; sometimes it seems to stand still. --- ![20260421_175807.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23vi2AytS1A6kqsc3H8XfJCPYop3VyYbVqd7sckPsjpWqQqXNtmqkS9jycnQKyeTvTHqr.jpg) --- I don’t know if you’ve noticed, many people mention it to me, that time flies by, that there isn’t enough of it, that it feels like it’s always Monday because they’ve barely seen the week go by. Today’s world is so busy, everything moves so fast, that we rarely stop to see, to look, to listen, to perceive with all our senses everything that is happening. Everything moves very fast, but as I say, there are certain places that seem to be on another planet, even though we see them on this one. Places with a unique magic. Upon entering, it feels as though you’re breathing a very different air, rich in extra oxygen. Perhaps that is the element that manages to stop time. --- ![20230420_134056.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zkkCG5nwzfKaAjTvfMyF76sFcmi6zwpyLJyfEEBra1WfHQ3W5pBAUnyE2UzbuxaL7JW.jpg) ![20230420_143625.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tvcSNqVUgvjg34DcqeyhquS9URSiAwzsE6pQZKc4n2dii5ATATrKFK9XdWUQrigA1EA.jpg) ![20230420_135022.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23w2jHRnhgowZmCRbEdq7txf5oFMuhwrnZJEgGZmbucoL1PboxzoDTRGALYU1u2HNm5hi.jpg) ![20230420_135656.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tvc9RX9L4z34yUADXWQMArY9TaTpuY8j75MkZ8JqNduoF4rxSBuYTYZrsDzcrPdyA2z.jpg) --- What’s more, the healing effect of these places is amazing; when I walk along the paths, I feel lighter, freer, and I put that down to the fact that nature is so wise, it clears our minds, frees us from stress and allows us to think more clearly afterwards. It’s like a natural therapy centre, a space with so much vegetation, so many different species, that often you can’t even see the sun for all the plants and trees. I always say this: the first time I went to the city’s botanical garden, my mother said, ‘This is paradise,’ and I saw the look of happiness on her face. My mission was accomplished; she’d loved the place and enjoyed exploring it. --- ![20230420_144623.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23vsE9ud8cucfVvoG7DcMPzWMT3f7LcHz9VxkYRpgjxi4GTtQ1RwsBLrj3at3k12mK4rk.jpg) ![20230420_182013.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tva4vxBydzSSRWcuM9iaTfisC3uRDio1AdYKBkpMJp7Nzo4BzJmtUqEkHhdGxnV6gP7.jpg) --- She’s been there many times now, but she’d go a thousand times more; it’s ideal for disconnecting from the daily grind, from thoughts, from work, from everyday life, and for recharging your batteries. Even more so if I touch the plants; I always love touching the leaves, the flowers, the tree trunks, as if that interaction creates a connection and a spectacular flow of energy. I feel that recharge in my body. Of course, that hasn’t always happened to me; only when I allowed nature to speak to me, to guide me, and simply sat in silence with it. The connection grows stronger, and every time I visit these wonderful gardens, the sensation is even more intense, making the walk magical and unique each time. --- ![20230420_144215.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wC3CXdPUPaFv3ZcfVkWe39nmHLGD55AGmLxCGYBY7m8AEXLGWEN4FpXTD6AWyDNbWso.jpg) --- There’s something I love and I must mention it: the staircases amidst the greenery, the lush vegetation, as if they were an invitation to a space where fairies fly, an invitation to something more, to surprises, new paths and new ways of surprising me. A comment someone left me recently mentioned that I’m always surprised by the little things, by what I see. It’s not that I’m surprised, but that I let myself be. But above all, it happens to me with nature; it’s amazing. --- ![20230420_182449.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wqbmbBs8ZsGjheBs7H1n2M41rj2J1uyzcKdGufux9KrPsEn9yeqPQmzg23uCZ5jc9mt.jpg) ![20230420_182500.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wWpfQaYUytutY6Tkv2KxngKokF2foceoPYeDXqdbCrJnWyVGCSn1WyhS1mLziEiUyMc.jpg) ![20230420_182512.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wC7vqZX5YzT2Yp4Ey5r2nJetNTetVYgRg6yzPLpELvWid5BbBomfskL86RrABs7Vukj.jpg)
![20230420_182532.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xVEe44Wg4YHYi8FjVQQ43JSuGZc5NCS6AizupJU9t3Cpv8EAXFzvKFyJnc8geQQ2v6L.jpg)
![20230420_182520.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wWvg1jYVLSVD6smhLb5C2g1XmXBi8RqMwBQsErTfkHihxPYtfD7hHgXE2JZmvugFhe5.jpg)
--- Amidst so much beauty, and as this botanical garden once belonged to a married couple of marquises, there was a spot specially dedicated to them with some very beautiful sculptures; I couldn’t help but photograph them. A secluded corner where echoes of the past mingled with nature in a timeless place, yet one where all possible times seemed to converge. Nature evokes those strange, inexplicable sensations. --- ![20230420_182859.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wWvtwZDyuHL72De5ec5F4Fnr1XBtv6PFSBUYoF33acp7wA2GxZvCV5ZAgaxVMCidZMW.jpg) ![IMG_20190929_160224.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23x12vfzrYh44n6miQn4xeVJe5hE2EA43QnN5CPyaiB3j6Qw5YxEQcT1NHJy8GmreAzV1.jpg) --- I crossed bridges, walked along paths, saw distant buildings, terrain that rose and fell, whilst the sun’s rays were lost in some places and found in others --- ![IMG_20190929_160731.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xyXRW6wiTovd7RD5Xw3xVHQ7dUWSH5dSYco3XzVHMjFRzpyooeFsCisefvMfTUeuhWv.jpg) ![IMG_20190929_160800.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xVCzXvgSnyevD8NbLA9ZBe2Zpa71FW3dwH8W3gqGWFwaLYh7cR3WWKg6ohPmWfNt1AM.jpg) ![IMG_20190929_160853_1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23yTajsCuDQib5BfwBQhYhwmLw3Q47sEgY1iMXGM8u9QaZPxU7uaE1djMWJ7K2HmLTsDw.jpg) --- Signs everywhere provided information, but on this walk I focused on breathing and enjoying myself, on learning, not about history, but about my inner self and the beautiful natural world. Time here is different; it stands still. ---
![IMG_20190929_160939_1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23vi1fCrJEo3QoZMDAHD65HQ18PGvnzktiWhNAzAh3KVMo4th55xHtH9Eq6Fw1dUok9Hk.jpg)
--- Even sitting on a bench to admire it all without walking is not a waste of time, but time gained, time spent with oneself. ---
![IMG_20190929_160957_1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zbMgUGkud553gTNix45Espi75yz2fZZeao7zbGd1E9RYE6v36JgaJr1gs3rcCW7CNcA.jpg)
![IMG_20190929_161344_1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23x14sURjxvsQj9dLyFGr9CsmPXmK1sCFA82uWPEQWbjx86Ay9eRjjHxdfREuLZjoTcDF.jpg) ![IMG_20190929_163533.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wg92Btfw8bbZdS9KpZumTnu9ns4PCCY15wmPQLa55B2Dgd1ZQrmdVxCz7UQEYq8XZiG.jpg) ![IMG_20190929_165623.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23ycyV8bn2HAKRJf72j5Ghye9jCRS3uUHrtrppVk2pytErKENM8frkTcZQTikQbJj7A5A.jpg) --- If I had to describe this garden, I’d say it’s a vast labyrinth, full of passages, some narrow, others with staircases, full of little waterfalls and small lakes, sculptures; a vast labyrinth full of magic. It even has a spot that looks like a wishing well; perhaps at that moment I thought of a wish or two. ---
![IMG_20190929_171809_1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xp47YgaCcoMyg6rJ34bvvqhg74mNEY2b4qg4oqqyoAx7wgCCbZirYE8dx3KDGdgEsam.jpg)
|![IMG_20190929_171815_1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23ynPw984s1Dz2YH9BGSjopZdLzxfHvpcBfJdYjHCCyGpkjayH1shWAGTf2htqX3uzk6Z.jpg)|![IMG_20190929_171844.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wMaeuRY1Xd8NqwXUXey3fzaEGNDqmmY35FTnYoGAGzE1CrLs1qhZM6D3akYb7DGWrY4.jpg)| |-|-| |![IMG_20190929_171911_1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xAXqUL2YvKmohNppTDL5186Hg5FbTVc5xrfBiJUfUoHQGsWmGZ96oP1phVk9wvXtAGL.jpg)|![IMG_20190929_171916_1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wWvswzupBCoMqbFXY7FKtF3e6tWG8rXP1U4gDgXigQdzSfSLh8kW5CDqqgGiFNasHhJ.jpg)| --- The place is so special that I could even see a grand avenue with palm trees, street lamps, benches and flowers. I had plenty of reasons to be amazed by it all. I think the key is knowing how to look, not just walking for the sake of it, as an exercise, but the other way round: let the walk be a consequence of the desire to see and explore, to seek and to feel. Allowing ourselves to feel and experience, that must be the most important thing. A healthy mind and heart generate a healthy body; I’ve seen it for myself. --- ![IMG_20190929_172017_1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wgKuWd1xMKAGvcwLrNGaWoz7U1WPY4dE6MiAifSmQoyopSiBKbfZr4ojgQ1xh8aDFsS.jpg) |![IMG_20190929_172120_1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23uQpegArfCHi9eDyp12njezDRnRAazHPC22LfeW6WPAcL6TCp1AqfxuLqUEXwLRFKkCz.jpg)|![IMG_20190929_172138_1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244KEjv1pXuphThWyySHeBwpK2d8AD5m2GA3UzKzU9pcuxEfhVigrMKAf77MipmttLjSV.jpg)| |-|-| --- Perhaps those flowers are no longer there; as I say, time passes differently in that place. The flowers give way to more palm trees, to the radiant sun and those rays that always want to sneak in. --- ![IMG_20190929_174114.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242DDzjGX6MABzw4ANcW8P4DdHDXs3eh5LKrHA1vSMmkAbR88FRzFTwwiTAZWPSn2EMqA.jpg) ![IMG_20190929_172711.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/241Ev38h7a8PpBdmEZMAxBtLUSQi4kQQDh2J1L4KNCUkZ5oWuqF1DETeU6VsXVhpdxpGj.jpg) --- The lesson of walking is knowing how to look, knowing how to see the sights, and not just of nature, but of the life before us. Thank you for joining me on this Wednesday walk; I send you my warmest regards. See you soon. Amonet. --- --- >All photographs are my own. ![Separador Amonet rosa.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/Eo45huwdpJdeDRRmb3tm3Sv7mxs8Uq3XUZDd5bjvGqBDKfDE5DLGQM1duXTEQQYhyjs.png) [//]:# (!worldmappin 36.762742 lat -4.425971 long Amidst magical paths, lush vegetation and art. d3scr)

body.title: Siendo un bello dia, me hice cargo de las ensaladasºººººBeing a beautiful day, I took care of the salads.
body.body:
Hola a todos, la verdad que al haber amanecido un bello dia, despues de una ardua lluvia, lo cual debido a dicha inclemencia pudimos descansar un pococo jajaja, bueno hasi que hoy para el almuerzo me toco la parte de las ensaladas, las cuales no son muchas, pero las mas sabrosas y facil de prepararlas.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23xKvGuqY2pgcFAVjChWeueeoYbjM1UXj1tKWG1mgwhc4nLJuRDsFAeFTtiXifM2Ef7TP.png)

Para la ensalada de repollo, como se puede ver en esta fotografia, lo importante es cortar en hebras bien finas el repollo, de esa manera luego se lo enjuaga bien y se lo condimente con aceite de oliva y sal a gusto.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23x19AZJWtiXoenkD66Up5LMxnqrePCnzr6qXsymsPWxits9bnw7C8m9QbXk2FKczrxXR.png)

Bueno justo en esta foto es cuando me hablaron, porque como bien saben ustedes, que cuando estoy en la cocina, hasta yo me asombro de estar muy concentrado en lo que hago, mas cuando se trata de comida.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23tbyWYgG73anS1yAKE36WbNtDxS6ukUH7u8HYy5qTW6dsjvnwHrMgAFBDFSpWTdJnFba.png)

Luego de haber terminado con la ensalada de repollo y hbarla condimentado, lo siguiente fue preparar una ensalada muy tradicional, la cual contiene, cebolla morada cortada en julianas y tomates cortado en trozos pequeños, condimentada con sal a gusto y limon.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23wMipjNTAZP2gwosYNsJzNtxwhn1WosADsdneFFv8PDpFTruTivzfT81MMeiRjeqT2wa.png)

Bueno amigos siempre tenemos que sobresalir en elgo jajaja, por ejemplo con esta ensalada de cebolla, choclo, pepino y tomate, todo cortado en julianas y condimentado a gusto de cada comensal.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23wX7YuypFEcwWcfi4UHt8kbhFgYi4mf47nZawMP7qfJsTxrryw41AtH2JBTpq53Lt8qX.png)

De esta manera es un dia mas que pas, pero como bien sabemos que es en el campo, parece una eternidad jajaja, por lo bello que se disfruta de todo.

body.title: What’s Inside a MydEmpire Pack?
body.body:
/>

**Hello to all Hivers and Gamers!**  
For the past weeks MydEmpire has been quietly built step by step.

Every empire begins with a single decision:  
opening your first pack.

A MydEmpire pack contains the core assets required to start building an industrial empire. These assets are randomly generated but follow a balanced distribution designed to create a fair and sustainable economy.

When a pack is opened, players receive:

*   Land
    
*   Blueprints
    
*   EMP (Empire token)
    
*   Relic
    

Each of these assets plays a specific role in the economic system.

<h2 style=\

>Land The Foundation of Industry Land is the physical space where factories are built. Without land, a blueprint cannot be used. Each land type determines how many factories can be built and upgraded.

>

5

Higher-tier land allows larger industrial complexes, which means higher production potential. **Example -** A player with L3 land could run three factories simultaneously, each capable of reaching the highest blueprint level.

>Blueprints — Industrial Technology Blueprints determine what kind of factory you can build. Each blueprint belongs to an industry sector and a technology level. Industries Blueprints may belong to one of the following industries: * Food * Textile * Pharma * Chemical * Supermarket Each industry represents a different branch of the empire economy.

>Higher-level blueprints generate more economic power and production potential. This ensures:

* Basic factories are common * Advanced industry remains rare and valuable * High-tier production becomes a strategic asset

>EMP — The Energy of the Economy EMP is the utility resource of MydEmpire. It is used for: * Building factories * Mint Extra Blueprint * Paying maintenance * Upgrading Factories * Opening Imperial Supply Crates (Cooming soon!) EMP acts as the circulating energy of the economic system, powering industrial growth.
>Bonus Rewards Some packs may also contain special rewards, including: * Bonus EMP * Bonus Blueprint These rewards add excitement to pack openings and encourage strategic expansion.

>Relic (Ultra Rare) Relics are extremely rare artifacts that provide strategic advantages. Possible benefits include: * Production boosts * Construction advantages * Reduced factory build costs * Faster empire expansion

>Every empire begins with a pack — but how you use it defines your empire future! The Genesis phase is only the beginning. As MydEmpire evolves, the treasury system will continue to grow alongside the player economy, new industries, and future expansions. We are excited to see how players build their empires within a transparent, production-driven economy. **The first empires are rising.** And this is only the beginning. The MydEmpire world is just starting to grow. [**MydEmpire**](https://mydempire.com)

body.title: Television Review: The Next Phase (Star Trek: The Next Generation, S5X24, 1992)
body.body:
![(source:tmdb.org)](https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/2xnTT3POhDldl1xVdhvIBBCtymK.jpg)

**The Next Phase (S05E24)**

Airdate: 18 May 1992

Written by: Ronald D. Moore
Directed by: David Carson

Running Time: 46 minutes 



For *Star Trek: The Next Generation* aficionados, a recurring observation holds that when the franchise turned its attention to the Romulans, the results were typically more compelling than when it dealt with the Ferengi. At least for the majority of TNG's run, episodes centred on the enigmatic, militaristic Romulan Star Empire tended to deliver tighter plotting, greater suspense, and more sophisticated political intrigue than the often broadly comic outings featuring the profit-obsessed Ferengi. *The Next Phase*, the twenty-fourth episode of the fifth season, follows this pattern admirably, but adds an intriguing scientific twist that elevates its premise into purer science fiction territory.

The episode begins with the USS Enterprise-D responding to a distress signal from a disabled Romulan vessel. An away team consisting of Commander Riker, Data, Ensign Ro Laren, and Lieutenant Geordi La Forge beams over to offer assistance. They discover the Romulan ship's experimental graviton field generator is unstable and could cause a catastrophic warp core breach. To avert disaster, Ro and La Forge take the device to be beamed back to the Enterprise for further analysis. However, during transport, Transporter Chief Brossmer (played by Shelly Leverington) fails to rematerialise them. They are presumed lost in a transporter accident.

Ro later regains consciousness on the Enterprise, but to her astonishment, she finds herself invisible and intangible to the crew. No one can see or hear her. She soon discovers La Forge is in the same predicament, and the two can communicate with each other. Convinced they are dead—a belief seemingly confirmed when she witnesses Dr. Crusher signing her death certificate—Ro succumbs to despair. La Forge, ever the engineer, insists there must be a rational, scientific explanation. His investigation leads him to a Romulan phase inverter device, part of an experimental cloaking project, which he deducts was activated during the transport, shifting them into a phased state, a \
of existence.\n\nTheir urgent mission becomes twofold: find a way to return to normal phase, and warn the crew of a deadly Romulan plot they overhear. It transpires that the Romulan \

was a ruse; the Romulans plan to emit a signal that will trigger the Enterprise's warp core breach. Complicating matters is the revelation that Romulan named Parem (Brian Cousins) himself is also phased. He now stalks the corridors of the Enterprise, armed with a phased disruptor, intent on eliminating Ro and La Forge to protect the sabotage plot.

After a tense confrontation, they manage to defeat Parem. The energy discharges from his disruptor, however, leave traces of chronoton radiation, which piques Data's scientific curiosity. Realising they need to create a visible sign of their presence, Ro and La Forge devise a risky plan: overcharge Parem's disruptor to cause a controlled explosion during their own memorial service in Ten Forward, hoping the energy surge will make them briefly visible. The plan works; Data, having theorised about anyon particles, is able to reverse the phase inversion using a modified transporter beam, bringing them back to our reality just in time for Engineering to thwart the Romulan sabotage.

Written by one of Star Trek's most celebrated writers, Ronald D. Moore, and directed by the always dependable David Carson, *The Next Phase* was initially conceived as a \

—a cost-saving story confined to existing sets. Ironically, it became one of the season's more expensive and technically demanding productions, largely due to the complex visual effects required to show Ro and La Forge passing through walls and objects as \
. This very concept, however, is the episode's great strength. It provides a fascinating \

perspective, allowing the phased characters to observe how their colleagues react in the belief they are dead. This setup generates plenty of effective, macabre humour.

The inclusion of the phased Romulan, Parem, is a masterstroke, transforming the narrative from a pure predicament story into a suspenseful spy thriller within the Enterprise's own hull. The cat-and-mouse game between the invisible adversaries adds a layer of genuine tension and danger that the premise otherwise might have lacked.

Despite being generally well-regarded, the episode has not escaped criticism, primarily for inconsistencies in its own internal logic. The most notable flaw is that while the phased characters can pass through solid walls, they do not fall through the decks of the ship; they walk on the floor as normal. This logical hiccup was later gleefully mocked in the *Stargate SG-1* episode \

, a testament to its recognisability as a sci-fi trope pitfall. Nonetheless, the core concept proved fertile ground for the franchise itself, with the idea of a phase cloaking device being explored in greater depth in the seventh-season episode *The Pegasus*.

In the end, *The Next Phase* excels not merely because of its clever premise or taut plotting, but due to the strength of its performances. Michelle Forbes delivers a particularly powerful turn as Ensign Ro, masterfully conveying her character's trademark blend of defiance, vulnerability, and simmering anger, especially in her interplay with LeVar Burton's steadfastly optimistic La Forge. Their dynamic—the pragmatic, faith-driven Bajoran and the logical, science-minded engineer—provides the emotional core that grounds the high-concept science fiction. It is this human (and alien) element, framed within a classic Romulan-centric conspiracy, that ensures *The Next Phase* is a standout entry in *The Next Generation*'s formidable catalogue.

RATING: 7/10 (+++)

body.title: More pink please =/= Mehr Rosa bitte 👹🍣🎎 Wonderful Japan ENG-GER
body.body: ![IMG_8245.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/EoGyomKQJYvgPJCtQaMJ1888QwQB3M3aJHJTtFG1aW5wcjWhbUX6i2f9e6R8W95fAzM.JPG) What can I say? I just took way too many photos, and somehow I want to post them all here on my blog. Well, the occasion was just too tempting—after all, who could resist all the magic surrounding us these days? Queen Sakura is among us and has clearly taken the reins. And so everything is blooming and glowing these days, and the people around me can’t stop marveling and admiring it all. Of course, I feel the same way, and I certainly don’t want to hide it. I’m enjoying this spectacle and often find myself right in the front row, ready to give myself fully to the moment. And that’s exactly why I’m sharing a few more cherry blossom photos today. For my part, I can never get enough of them, and I’m delighted every time I find a few cherry trees in bloom. Usually, white is the dominant color these days, accented with a very light shade of pink. But sometimes it’s the pink itself that dominates and is the driving force of the scene. Both colors have their charm, and in the end, they harmonize perfectly with each other. At least well enough that they made it into today’s photos, which can only be seen here in this little blog post. For me, it’s also a way to sort through and preserve my memories and to rejoice once again in what I’ve experienced recently. And to remind myself that I had the best team in the world by my side. Oh yes, life can be truly wonderful. And sometimes we even make it just a little bit better ourselves... ![IMG_8254.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/EpxqKgh2mchhaYDtonPU9RmxPevfQVz2WsGHkfL3hR6G8L6VWE7DyY3tfkb99onx53A.JPG) DEUTSCH Was soll ich sagen? Ich hab einfach zu viele Fotos gemacht, und irgendwie will ich die alle hier in meinen Blogs unterbringen. Nun ja, der Anlass war ja auch zu verlockend, denn wer kan nbei all die Magie, die uns in diesen Tagen umgibt, schon widerstehen. Königin Sakura ist im Lande und hat ganz klar das Zepter des Handelns übernommen. Und so blüht und leuchtet es in diesen Tagen um uns herum, und die Menschen um mich herum kommen aus dem Staunen und der Bewunderung gar nicht mehr heraus. Mir geht es natürlich auch so, und ich will mich dabei auch gar nicht verstecken. Ich genieße dieses Schauspiel und stehe oft ganz vorn in der ersten Reihe, bereit mich vol und ganz dem Augenblick hinzugeben. Und eben ganu aus diesem Grund gibt es heute auch wieder ein paar Kirschblütenbilder. Ich für meinen Teil kann davon nie genug bekommen, und freue mich jedes Mal, wenn ich ein paar blühende Kirschbäume finde. Normalerweise ist Weiß die dominieren Farbe in diesen Tagen, unterlegt mit einem ganz leichten Rosaton. Aber manchmal ist es auch das Rosa selber, was dominiert und die treibenden Kraft an Ort und Stelle ist. Beide Farben haben ihren Reiz und am Ende harmonieren sie wohl perfekt miteinander. Zumindest so gut, dass sie es auf die heutigen Bilder geschafft haben, welche nur hier in diesem kleinen Blogbeitrag zu sehen sind. Für mich ist es auch ein Weg, meine Erinnerungen zu sortieren und festzuhalten und mich noch einmal über das zu freuen, was ich in der letzten Zeit erlebt habe. Und mir klarzumachen, dass ich dabei das beste Team der Welt an meiner Seite hatte. Ach ja, das Leben kann schon herrlich sein. Und manchmal machen wir es selber sogar noch ein klein wenig besser... ![IMG_8248.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/EqSV6vPwPyycAgURkgM3w48TjJNTKyNfgJqHUFpAdqyKtpxaWh6KWKq6WSrSYfX5QLg.JPG) ![blog-ende.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/23tv6H18WKn98nBVkn2MwVhwWsuFRFgjBGwxLEMVhRZD7zRRbFokaNiAn39fUaB3TxVX6.png)

body.title: When Expectations Are Clear, Unpaid Internships Work
body.body:
<div  class=text-justify>

I'm just taken back to a time when I ignorantly applied for an intern job to learn what I had little to no knowledge about. I imagined I would try to learn as much as I can so I could have the experience, the recommendation and knowledge gained if I am selected to intern for the project.

At that point, I didn't even bothered about the \

in the description because all I needed at that point is, gaining knowledge and experience to do a job that I'll get paid for. I remember it was a 6 months long internship and even though it seemed too long, I still wanted it for the benefits. To cut long story short, I wasn't selected and I wasn't pained about it since it was going to be an internship with no pay after all. But deep down, I'd have loved the experience that would have come with it. Applying with those thoughts and being rejected taught me something for this prompt. Internship, in its simplest form, is about gaining experience and knowledge using the real world as a playground. You get to gain real life experience on a job that you admire but have no real experience on aside theories. So firstly, you shouldn't apply for an internship if you want pay. ![file_0000000080e87243b266ae1b5eb36992.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/merit.ahama/EpA6MKx8f18xiepvQpgUauZB5VjzPFqeT5Qeo5RbvUXyyY8zizsTSfCQUq23MTv6Z7q.png) The purpose of applying for an internship should be clear, that way, you won't feel like you're being exploited when the company make you do activities especially if they were all in the description of the internship opening when you applied or was stated clearly during the interview. I know of internship programs that do pay their interns and it is stated clearly from the beginning of the internship opening. For those kinds, I think the company or project owners are being generous because internship experiences have helped many people gain good jobs afterwards. I think the exploitation is happening on both ends when an internship is set as unpaid, the company provides the intern experiences on their expenses and the interns are taking tasks off the company for possible profits by doing real time work. At the end, both have gained something. For me, I believe deciding if a company should pay an intern or not, depends on the kind of internship, the location and the worth of experience to be gained at the end of it. The intern applying should know what it entails and the company should be clear on what they offer. So it is easy that in the process, when the intern seem to be doing more than was agreed, they can say they are being exploited and the best option after that realization is to leave. No company should exploit an intern but if it was clear on the description before the contract was accepted, interns know what they stand to gain. **Image used is AI generated.** ----- ##### 🔗 Apps body.title: 又到冬天了？
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![w80aWp14ntHmZI5P_IMG_20260422_113646.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/angelina6688/images/w80aWp14ntHmZI5P_IMG_20260422_113646/w80aWp14ntHmZI5P_IMG_20260422_113646.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

天呐，我感觉我快要被冻感冒了。今天只有11~16度，我只穿了一条厚一点的外裤，没有穿秋裤。我以为会像昨天那样冷得不是那么彻底，结果大错特错。
 
上衣穿的还行，加绒衣加外套，一点不冷，就是下身腿在宽裤腿里面瑟瑟发抖。今天是真的冷，哪里有半分夏天的痕迹，感觉又要倒回冬天了。武汉的天气真是涨跌快将近20度，快把人冻死了。
 
而且我之前把薄羽绒服都送去干洗了，洗完直接收到阁楼上去，厚衣服一件都没留在外面。今天在路上，都看到有人把薄羽绒袄又翻出来穿上了，还是我收衣服收早了。
 
看天气预报，今天才周三，到周六周日又要回升到28度。这气温起起伏伏温差这么大，真让人受不了。以后不到五一，坚决不能这么早把厚外套收起来。
 
这忽冷忽热的天气最容易让人中招，本来还想着春天随便穿穿就行，完全没料到会冷得这么突然。
 
还好给娃穿的比我自己多一点，但愿他不会冷。我还是太高估自己的抗寒能力了，此刻我在冷风中瑟瑟发抖，只求赶紧到办公室暖和一下。

前些天晚上下班，我和娃都不想吃饭，我说要么出去逛一圈，看看有啥可以吃的，随便吃点，但是好像他也提不起多大兴趣，那我提议回去煮小馄饨吧，不吃又怕晚上饿的睡不着。

回家的路上看到五龙广场门口摆了很多小摊，有图书贩卖，小手办，还有打气球等等，旁边还有卖小鸭子的，就是那种很小的鸭子染了点颜色，然后二十块一只，我娃还想买呢，一问价格吓我一跳，我记得小时候学校门口不是五元一只吗。

而且这种小鸭子都养不活的，拿回家几天就死了，我反正觉得是非正常死亡的，商家故意的，玩不了几天，现在居然物价卖这么贵。我拉着我娃不给买，买了真要命，这咋养啊。

还有那个气枪打气球也很坑，20块钱就6发子弹，男孩子就喜欢这些，给玩了一次，本想着全中就能领个奖品，但是也没全中，歪了一发子弹，后面给了他一个钥匙扣，说白了这钥匙扣白送我都不要啊，一看就很廉价，我娃还引以为傲，战利品。

好了出来逛一圈钱包又扁了，还啥也没吃到，回家还得煮馄饨吃。

body.title: Ashes #1
body.body:
'Make sure you spread them within a year' the Morticia like crematarian women said. No shit - she had long black hair, sleek black outfit, serious composure, and bright red lipstick against pale skin. 'And if you're going to do them at the beach, make sure you wear sensible footwear'. My sister, Mum and I bit our tongues as she proceeded to give this life long beach going family and the dead man-as-ashes in the cardboard tube beach going advice, including watching the wind wasn't blowing onshore or that we wouldn't throw our father's remains in the path of ongoing joggers. Notes taken, Morticia. 

Dad's still in the tube. 




The tube is meant to be opened at a particular beach he chose himself. We’re at the point where we’re ready, I think. Even Mum is ready. It’s just getting everyone together and picking a day that actually works, which sounds simple but somehow isn’t - people work, and I have genuine concerns about one relative even making it down the beach stairs. Then there is the weather - we're deep in Autumn now, and it's rather unpredictable. 

I went down there the other day with Jamie. I wanted to get the lay of the land a little, see what he was thinking. 

![2177.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/riverflows/245wMfY1kjc3AoWLYh5EoksGEv9oMfGzfjjvgxUBRhBmWegoMHJvnnzKSRpFQn7moZ5Az.jpg)

I’ve been pn this beach many times before - it's a wilder beach, the beach more undulating and harder to walk, but it's quieter, and I have many memories walking with lovers and friends and dogs, surfing at the other end (which seemed always harder to get to), beach parties, fossicking, sunbaking. 


![2192.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/riverflows/23zGgVV59vFS9pY2SWA7NqAoLJ47e6UR9mgnPjefjn9MeCoXufkxs1mC3XZ8oF8bRy7QM.jpg)
<sup>*Coastal saltbush*</sup>

There are plenty of beaches along this stretch of coast. Some are easier, some are more obvious, some would probably be the “normal” choice. But he picked this one that you go down a set of stairs to, and it opens out into this wide stretch of sand that’s usually fairly empty. You can see the town off in the distance - the one I live in - but it doesn’t really feel like part of it. 


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/riverflows/23yJLu52xw1mN6FN99EM6Z9zs4vHfheaM55KBvXtv51VhtWpJ1wnCD9oPqBoczLizpCDj.jpg
<sup>**Terrible photo - it's with the phone zoom - but this is part of the town where I live, visible from this beach.**</sup>

Funny Dad never knew we moved to that town - I wish he did. But I'll be able to see this point and this beach from the cliffs and surf break where I live. His spirit, right there. 

He said to Mum that he liked the idea of his ashes spread here because it was quieter, especially on weekends when everyone comes down from Melbourne. That sounds like him. Not wanting anything too busy or too obvious. He never wanted a paddle out like some surfers get. Too showy. 

I’ve actually been there with him before, not long before he died - I wrote a Hive post about it [here](https://peakd.com/hive-155530/@riverflows/storm-chasing-adventure). We went down and there was this huge hailstorm that came in out of nowhere. It just smashed through while we were on path to the beach - a miracle he'd made it that far, given the amount of breath in his lungs. Dad's eyes were sparking. His last adventure. I’ve still got photos from that day.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/riverflows/23s9PFvhnWgGxjmCZNgb6wUgR2U1gpQkXH1fXXfPmfsYww3HHkGXY2Ws2tgEZzig9afQC.JPG

Standing there now felt a little sad - nothing crippling, just a bit of quiet. Even Jamie felt it. I do love this place so much, and can see why Dad felt this was the place to spread his ashes. Nothing about the place has changed. The stairs, the way the beach opens, the water. But just knowing we'd spread his ashes here and this was the last beach adventure he ever had spread a layer over the top of it, a layer of poignancy I suppose, or the veil being thinner.

He's already part of this landscape really - we don't need to spread his ashes to know that. 

I dreamt about him the other day, and every time I do I spend half the dream trying to work out how he’s suddenly back - how they've reanimated him, or how he's broken some death life rules to be here. It's the scientist in me I suppose. Like there must be some explanation for it and I’ve just missed something. 

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/riverflows/EnaZJfX4FhJtAt7S9wLeB1wJonKPrnC3u5o4ekHcp9s3oif9rrsuG5Zmm27R8Hi4DDt.jpg


In the dream I’m always a bit stuck on that, trying to make sense of it, while still just talking to him normally. He's so *present* in these dreams and I need to stop analysing it and just enjoy his company. I did tell him we'd moved to the coast and he was pretty happy about it. It doesn’t feel strange in the moment, just afterwards when I wake up.


![2175.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/riverflows/245cWGdeEdSYoBpAJNqDGenet5uemL1r44kK6NDJ69kNUDjmeFTMcRVXc4GYyDNerMHBa.jpg)
<sup>**This is the little nook at one end of the beach we're going to have a fire and farewell Dad. Nice thinking, Dad.**</sup>


It’s not absence exactly - people say they're still there, although I do struggle with the well meaning of that. It’s more like he’s still there but not in the same way, and my brain keeps trying to fix that.

I'm kinda talking to him on the beach, can hear him saying: 'see, good spot hey? Told ya' - and I can see it's perfect and I'm agreeing with him, and we're both waxing lyrical about the colour of the sky, the horizon, the red cliffs against the water. Like father like daughter. And I *know* I'm talking to myself, and whatever 'spirit' is there is just my memory of him, my sense of him, but it's all I've got. 


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/riverflows/EnaZJfX4FhJtAt7S9wLeB1wJonKPrnC3u5o4ekHcp9s3oif9rrsuG5Zmm27R8Hi4DDt.jpg
<sup>*Jamie misses him too. He was a father to him.*</sup>

Maybe I'll fell better when he's swirling around in the water, moving in and out with the tide. For now it’s just something that’s still ahead of us. We’re ready, it just hasn’t lined up yet.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/riverflows/244Ur9BbL3syjotp6hb4fk4wu38MxEoBHULQ22RW78x5GAsULG5Ttc7suBjqm88VLVymC.jpg

body.title: Win-win Strategy
body.body:
Hello Beautiful Folks! I hope you all are the living the best of your lives.

> So, before I start to yap around, let me make one thing clear: **I am here for a long run.** 



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNdUxUyHZvQ856BfZHHcYGz3Kw2NcZLJ86w8dNkdi6tJV/1776844621166.jpg)
(Picture Taken by Me. Depicting hope even in the darkest hours. And miles to go before I sleep!) 


>My Strategy

Well, I do have a daily, weekly, monthly, and even yearly plans. But most of the time, I fail to follow these. However, it is near to impossible to stay consistent, at least for me. I know I can be consistent; but I just don't want to. I believe it is okay to be bit lazy, because what good is life if lived perfectly? 

>Daily Plan 

For my daily routine, I try to stay fully engaged via shorts/waves/snaps content. Along with short content, it is obligatory to engage on two to three big posts. There is no specific criteria or standards, I will choose a random post or someone I know with capital attached (yes I am not an angel). Still, I prefer the one who will reply back with genuine answer or question. Moreover, I will give away my votes manually, so the control is all mine. 

>Weekly Plan 

On weekly basis, goal is to follow daily plan for five days, as a must. I do sometimes think of writing everyday in a week, but I procrastinate a lot, so yeah. So, I just have a goal of two or three posts in a week. On normal days, I earn around 1-4 dollars via all sources. Because of my internship and university, I was not actively serious about it. But last month and this month, I am doing better. Furthermore, I haven't withdrawn any amount and it's been five or six months now. It means I prefer to stake more for the long-term rather than gaining short term pleasure. However, it is mostly because of my internship that I am earning well enough to get feeded and all. Once, it ends I might change my strategy. 

>Monthly Plan 

I just follow the weekly plan four times in a month, with one major goal. **Stake the double from previous month**. If I have staked 50 HP then I try my best to make it 100 HP next month. Although, I don't know whether I have achieved it or not. 

>Yearly Plan 

Now this is the big deal. With one year on this platform, I have developed enough trust. I believe that Hive will stay, and it is staying for a serious long-term. The prices do scare me a lot sometimes, but it will pass too, so no need to be scared all the time. For this year, my target is to achieve $0.020 voting mana with my staking. I haven't checked how much staked HP will give me this power, but after June, I will surely generate a plan according to this. Maybe to cover the gap, I will just invest. 

>Midway Strategy

I do have a backup plan, in case, I need some extra money. Most of the times, my expenses for the next month are already calculated. Occasionally, some small changes do hurt but I can manage that. If I need some extra momey for a specific month; I will earn enough through out of comfort zone writing and interactions. And, I will follow one of the two plans:  1x2/3 (1 out of 3 portion is for withdrawal and 2 goes to staking) or 2x1/3 (similarly 2 for withdrawal and third part is for staking). Yes, I just create my own type of rules :) 

>HBD 

I did start saving some amount, because the profit is actually good there. However, later on, I changed my mind. I just prefered to use that money to buy some extra Hive. Because staked Hive is just win-win scenario for me and for all. So yeah, trying my so-called best to play my part. Hehehhe! 

>Final Thoughts

No matter what happens, I believe in this platform and beautiful folks living in this part of the virtual world. I will just keep on going, until I achieve something that will benefit me as well as other people of this world. This is my strategy; this is my hope. 




>This is my entry for [India United Contest](https://ecency.com/hive-197685/@indiaunited/indiaunited-new-contest-and-last-7af84b1d12ba8). Let us stay united; let us grow together! 

.............................. 

Peace 🕊

body.title: One Should not make fun of Someone's Face or Body.
body.body:
Hi Hivelearners friends.
I hope you all are well, I am also well. So today we have been given another special and interesting topic, whether we should make fun of other people, especially the way some people are disabled or if there is something inside a human being that is called a deficiency, which should be made fun of. So do we find physical harassment worse or online? Today, everything is happening online.
Whether it is online or physical, no one should be made fun of like this. It breaks the heart of the next person and completely destroys his confidence and then he cannot work hard in his life. So what I have to say here is that things are going to be very different in the coming time and we have to think that as time is changing, we have to bring about changes within ourselves. Here we see that if a person is fat,
He is made fun of so much that that person goes into depression and does nothing in his life, just wondering why I was made like this. This thing we see in every city, every country, there are people who are beautiful, they keep making fun of black people and then there are people who keep making fun of being very fat and if a person is disabled or if someone has an eye problem or a problem with any body part, then he is made fun of in the same way.

/> \[Source\](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-person-in-a-garment-lJfgwQ1nNQo)
So what I want to say here is that we should not make fun of this way at all. Whenever we have made fun of another person in our life and then when the same thing happened to us, we feel very sad, very regretful that we wish we had not made fun of that person in this way. Now here we see that the time of social media has come.
Every person puts their profile picture and updates every case on social media. Similarly, we are also seeing that people are making fun of them a lot in the comments. Some time ago I was watching TikTok. There is a girl there who is quite short in height but she has worked hard in her life and has become a teacher. But people are making fun of her so much in the comments that children will not be afraid of you and are saying such wrong things which break her heart a lot.

/> \[Source\](https://unsplash.com/photos/selective-color-photography-of-person-portraying-of-being-fragile-tSfuLGojT60)
And these are the messages she is getting and these are the videos she is making saying that I did not make me myself, God made me. Should I stop living my normal life now? So what I want to say to these people here is that when we ourselves cannot create something,
Then how can we make fun of each other like this? We are all created by God. We all have learned a lot by reading these posts and you all have also written about this post and this interesting topic.

body.title: Is there any protection for the sinners// The old path
body.body:
God cares for everyone He created because of He is all merciful God and he loves everyone. God is a good God and because of this, He doesn't condemn anyone instead He waits patiently for us to repent and come back to Him. This kind of protection is often seen as God preserving life and offering opportunities for change rather than approving of sinful behavior.

The bible teaches us that they is consequences for sin, that He protects us doesn't mean we should continue to sin. While He may shield sinners from immediate judgment, there are still spiritual and sometimes physical consequences for disobedience. God’s justice works alongside His mercy, reminding us that protection is not the same as exemption from accountability.
https://youtu.be/1vsr_G6DxJE?si=sSUq4wxHRhhVvqz2
God’s greatest protection for sinners is found in His offer of salvation. Through repentance and faith, a sinner can come under a deeper and more lasting form of God’s care. This protection is not just about earthly safety, but about being restored into a right relationship with Him and receiving eternal life.

Anything is possible; who’s to say what’s real and what isn’t?

You handle the dialogue very well, leading the reader to consider different hypotheses throughout the story. I loved it! Thank you so much for always being part of the community and, as I always say, for interacting with other members, I really appreciate it. A big hug!🤗

>Que historia más aterradora, pero quien sabe si podría ser real, en algún momento quizás. Es uno de los posibles finales que las películas mencionan de vez en cuando, ser invadidos por aliens y nuestro mundo termine. Pero le añadiste el plus de la experimentación en humanos y otro aspecto que también se trata a menudo que es la implantación de recuerdos. ¿Será que este mundo es real o vivimos en una matriz?
