body.title: Tethered Tüten: Das Folienverbrechen
body.body:
>Verbundstofftüten mit Klarsichtfenster sorgen für Transparenz, sie umgibt allerdings aufgrund mangelnder EU-Richtlinien ein großes Entsorgungsgeheimnis.

Sie sind überall, in jeder deutschen Bäckerei, in jedem Supermarkt, nicht nur in der hippen Großstadt-Hood, sondern auch in den letzten betulichen Dorfkonditoreien. Eine Errungenschaft, sagen die einen. Eine Plage nennen sie die anderen. Ihr Ursprung liegt im Dunkeln, ihr Nutzen ist begrenzt, ihr Siegeszug aber unübersehbar: Brötchen- und Brottüten mit Sichtfenster sind ein selbstverständlicher Teil des Alltages einer Gesellschaft geworden, in der die Angst vor Mikroplastik sich ein enges Rennen mit der Angst vor plastinisierten Ozeanen liefert. Was ist noch bedrohlicher? Woran wird die Menschheit zuerst untergehen?

>Bedrohliche Brötchentüten 

Die Brötchentüte kommt in der Diskussion eher weniger oft vor. Sie, in den alten Zeiten der allgegenwärtigen kleinen Bäckereien eine einfache Papiertüte gewesen waren, sind heute Hightech-Produkte aus Verbundmaterial. Als die alten Meister der Familienbackstuben beschlossen, ihr Recht auf einen ausgedehnten Habeck-Urlaub zu nehmen, bis die Zeiten wieder besser werden ist, nahmen sie Anlauf zur Eroberung der Brot- und Brötchenwelt. 

Ein scheinbar harmloses Stück Papier mit einem Hauch Plastik, das engagierte und um Klimaschutz bemühte Verbrauchende heute Tag für Tag in ein existenzielles moralisches Dilemma stürzt. Wohin damit? Papiermüll? Gelber Sack? Restmüll? Oder gar die Biotonne, weil es drinnen noch nach Brot riecht?

>Warnung auf Galapagos 

Bei einer Reise auf die Galapagos-Inseln hatte Bundespräsident Walter Steinmeier schon vor Jahren antrat, um den deutschen Naturforscher Alexander von Humboldt durch die Herstellung von 1.211.710 Kilogramm CO₂ zu ehren, zeigte sich Sozialdemokrat besorgt ob der \

(FAZ). „Wenn wir weitermachen wie bislang, schwimmt bis 2050 womöglich mehr Plastik als Fisch in den Ozeanen“, sagte der Bundespräsident, der damit ein beliebtes Stereotyp reproduzierte, das vor Jahren vom World Wildlife Found (WWF) erfunden worden war und seitdem mit leicht variierenden Daten herumgereicht wird wie ein Schrottwichtelgeschenk.

Nichts an der Zahl stimmt, denn die in den Meeren schwimmenden 150 Millionen Tonnen Plastik entsprechen keineswegs etwa einem Fünftel des Gewichts aller Fische. Entgegen früherer Annahmen über die Menge der in den Weltmeeren schwimmenden Fische wurde deren Anzahl immer um den Faktor 10 zu niedrig geschätzt. Statt einer Milliarde Tonne Fisch tummeln sich in den Ozeanen wohl um die zehn Milliarden, wie eine Forschergruppe um den Ozeanologen Xabier Irigoien herausbekommen hatte - ohne damit an der Plastikfischbeschwörung etwas ändern zu können.

>Tüten nur noch angebunden 

Es muss etwas getan werden. Und nur Europa kann es tun. Eine Gewissensfrage, um die bis in die höchsten europäischen Regelkreise gestritten wird. Dort, wo Experten, Beamte, die Wissenschaft, die EU-Kommissare und die Volksvertreter in Straßburg gemeinsam mit den Regierungschefs der 27 Mitgliedsstaaten nach einer langen Schwangerschaft die Einwegkunststoffrichtlinie der Europäischen Union zur Welt brachten, ist das Problem bisher unbeachtet geblieben. Auch deutsche Regierungen, die die Vorgaben aus Brüssel mit der  Einwegkunststoffkennzeichnungsverordnung (EWKKennzV) in geltendes Recht übersetzt haben, drückten sich um eine klare Aussage zur Brötchentüte.

>Die Wissenschaft streitet 

Ist die Auslegung richtig, dass Brötchentüten eine Einwegverpackung sind, bei der die transparente Plastikfläche dem Deckel einer Einwegflasche entspricht? Oder mangelt es an einer dafür notwendigen Verschlussfunktion, um das Sichtfenster als \

-Regeln definieren zu können? Die Wissenschaft ist uneins, zwischen Ökoengagierten und Plastikschützern entbrennen im Internet leidenschaftliche Diskussionen. Die Verunsicherung sitzt auf allen Seiten tief und die Politik schweigt, wenn Bürgerinnen und Bürger verzweifelt Bilder ihrer Tüten posten, verbunden mit der Frage: \

Niemand will schuld sein am Untergang der Erde, niemand möchte sich nur aus Unkenntnis der aktuell geltenden Gepflogenheiten falsch verhalten. Aber die Bauart einer Brötchentüte lässt viele Entsorgungsarten als möglich und richtig erscheinen. Da ist das Papier, der dominierende Werkstoff. Und da ist der Plastikteil, der anklagend in der Papiermülltonne glänzt als wolle er sagen: Hier gehöre ich sicher nicht hin.

>Einfach zur Schere greifen 

Gehört also alles in den Restmüll? Obwohl es sich sowohl beim Brötchentütenpapier als auch beim Brötchentütenplastik um recyclebare Werkstoffe handelt? Oder muss der Bürger, der nicht gegen Gesetze verstoßen will, zur Schere greifen und Plastik und Papier säuberlich trennen, um sie getrennt entsorgen zu können?

In Deutschland ist alles geregelt, bis hin zur Vorschrift, dass Altglas in den Altglascontainer gehört, aber nur, wenn es sich um Verpackungsglas handelt, nicht, wenn es alte Bier- oder Schnapsgläser sind. Die Entsorgungsfrage bei Brötchentüten aber hat der Gesetzgeber nicht beantwortet. Verbände und Vereine haben sich im Nachhinein an einer Deutung versucht - \

, hat etwa die Verbraucherzentrale dekretiert. 

Forscher der Freien Universität in Berlin aber wecken Zweifel:
. Und wenn die Tüte fettig ist? Gehört sie vielleicht in den Restmüll?

>Tüten zur Reinhaltung der Meere 

Die Brötchentüte ist ein weitgehend aus der öffentlichen Diskussion verdrängtes Folienverbrechen. Mit den umfassenden neuen EU-Vorschriften zur Reinhaltung der Meere kollidieren zudem zwei Schutzrechte. Einerseits wäre es vorbildlich, Sichtfenster und Papiertütenteil zu trennen. Andererseits bestimmt die Tethered-Caps-Regel aus Direktive 2019/904, dass nur noch Einwegverpackungen mit angebundenen Verschlüssen genutzt werden dürfen - unter diese strenge Vorgabe fällt auch die Brötchentüte. 

Sie ist nach den EU-Richtlinien ein

, wie ihn die EU-Vorschriften nennen, der ins Altpapier gehört, tethered mit einem Folienteil, der einerseits konstruktiv fest verbunden ist, andererseits im Sinne der Gesunderhaltung des Planeten aber besser abzutrennen wäre.

Der technische Fortschritt hat die Bürokratie überholt. Trotz aller Bemühungen in Brüssel, mit der Regulierung der Zukunft schneller zu sein als diese Gegenwart wird, hinkt die gesetzgeberische Praxis bei Brötchentüten der Realität dramatisch hinterher. Der Nabu, ein Umweltschutzverband, der durch zahlreiche Klagen gegen Verkehrs- und Wirtschaftsprojekte bekanntgeworden ist, spricht von \

>Papiertonne oder Gelber Sack 

Solche Tüten gehörten weder in Papiertonne noch in den Gelben Sack, sondern in die Biotonne. Andere Tüten aus Verbundmaterialien setzen auf eine Kombination aus recyclebarem Plastik und kunststoffbeschichtetem Papier - beides sei dann ein Fall für die Plastiktonne. Jedoch nicht, warnt der Nabu, wenn \

. Es gelte die SPAI-Regel: Sauberes Papier ins Altpapier!

Wer nach einem Sichttest unsicher ist, ob sie aus unterschiedlichen Materialien bestehen, sollte das Material langsam einreißen. Dann zeigt sich, ob noch eine Kunststoffschicht auf dem Papier ist. Mit Kunststoff ist die gelbe Tonne die richtige Auffangstation, ansonsten sollte die papierene Umhüllung in die Papiertonne. Mit einem Materialtest, entsprechende Testkits werden im Internet angeboten, lässt sich der Kunststoffanteil an einer Brötchentüte ermitteln. Liegt er bei über 51 Prozent, wandert sie in den Gelben Sack, allerdings nur, so der Nabu, \

>Gezielt geschürte Verwirrung 

Was nun genau? Wie und wo? Die gezielt geschürte Verwirrung hat einen durchaus beabsichtigten psychologischen Effekt. Verbraucher, die sich ohnehin schon von der Mülltrennung überfordert fühlen, bemühen sich, richtig zu handeln, tragen aber dennoch beständig an der Last eines Schuldgefühls, alles falsch zu machen. Die Frage \

, treibt Millionen um, nächtelang debattieren Freunde und Familien über die besten Methoden, Cellophan zu erkennen und von PVC zu unterscheiden. 

Bei den  Brötchentüten-Herstellern, die als die eigentlichen Verursacher der Probleme in der Verantwortung wären, eine Lösung zu finden, herrscht Schweigen. Allenfalls versehen einige Produzenten ihre Tüten mit kryptischen Symbole, die eher an ägyptische Hieroglyphen erinnern als an klare Recyclinghinweise. Andere haben reagiert und sie bieten wieder Tüten ohne Sichtfenster an – doch die sind bei den Transparenz gewohnten Kunden unbeliebt. \

>Keine einheitliche europäische Regelung 

Es ist hohe Zeit, dass Brüssel handelt, zumal bis zu einer einheitlichen europäischen Regelung der Brötchentütenfrage aller Erfahrung nach ein gutes Jahrzehnt vergehen wird. Bis dahin bleibt Verbrauchern im Recycling-Lotteriespiel nur Eigenengagement: Der NABU empfiehlt, Tüten ganz zu meiden und einen traditionellen Stoffbeutel in die Bäckerei mitzubringen. Deren Ökobilanz ist einer Analyse des Umweltbundesamtes zufolge zwar erschütternd.

,  konnten die Experten dort ermitteln. 

Doch das gute Gefühl, das Richtige getan zu haben, ist auch ein Schritt in Richtung Nachhaltigkeit, ganz egal, wie viel Aufwand aufgrund fehlender Tiefenregulierung hier auch privat betrieben werden muss. Jeder muss mitmachen. Alle sind verantwortlich. Am Ende ist es der verantwortlich handelnde aufgeklärte Verbraucher vor seiner Mülltonne, Verbundstofftüte in der Hand, der eigenständig entscheidet, nachdem er sich selbst befragt hat: \

body.title: Wednesday Walk - Move for a healthy life.
body.body: Greetings everyone from another Wednesday Walk! It feels like the days have flown by so quickly this week. Time is moving fast, as always. What matters is how we use that time. If we've used it productively, then we're fortunate. Sharing my activities with visuals in this community gives me pleasure. It also provides extra motivation for me to post new things in the coming weeks. _Yeni bir Wednesday Walk gününden herkese selamlar. Bu hafta günler çok çabuk geçti gibi bir his oluştu ben de. Zaman her zaman olduğu gibi hızlı bir şekilde ilerliyor. Önemli olan bu sürede zamanı nasıl değerlendirdiğimiz. Zamanı faydalı değerlendirdiysek ne mutlu bizlere. Bu toplulukta yaptıklarımı paylaşmak görsellerle ispatlamak bana keyif veriyor. Sonraki haftalar için yeni gönderi paylaşmam için ekstra bir motivasyon kaynağı oluşturuyor._

/> As I mentioned in most of my posts, the excessive rainfall has significantly reduced the number of sunny days this year. If it rains six days a week, only one day is sunny. We were used to snowfall in winter, but we are not used to this much snowfall in spring, and we are not prepared. Heavy rainfall causes floods, landslides, and the collapse of old buildings. _Gönderimin çoğunda bahsettiğim gibi yağışların fazlalığı nedeniyle bu yıl güneşli gün sayısında oldukça azalma oldu. Haftada 6 gün yağış varsa 1 günü güneşlidir. Kış mevsiminde kar yağışına alışkındık, ilkbaharda bu denli kar yağışına alışkın değiliz ve hazırlıklı da değiliz. Yoğun yağışlar sellere, heyelanlara, eski yapıların yıkılmasına neden oluyor._

/> I wake up early in the morning, around 6:00 AM. Then there's about an hour of taking care of the cows and chickens. I've observed that the earlier the animals are cared for, the higher their productivity. Early and longer hours are especially beneficial for the chickens; they become more productive. After that, I continue with my usual daily routine. While I'm doing all this, most people are still asleep in their beds. _Sabah erken saatlerde uyanıyorum. Bu sırada saat 06:00 oluyor. Yaklaşık bir saat süren inek ve tavukların bakımı var. Hayvanlara ne kadar erken saatlerde bakım yapılırsa verimin o kadar arttığını gözlemledim. Erken ve uzun mesai özellikle tavuklar için faydalı. Daha verimli oluyorlar.Sonrasında gün içindeki kendi rutinime devam ediyorum. Tüm bunları yaparken insanların çoğu halen yataklarında uyuyor._

/>

Most of the photos this week are from the city center. The city center isn't as crowded as it used to be; the city used to be one single entity, but now it's divided into 4-5 parts. The last photo is of the front of my friend's house. They mostly use the house during the summer. In winter, they stay in their more comfortable house with natural gas heating. That's all for this week. See you next week.

_Bu haftaki fotoğrafların çoğu şehir merkezine ait. Çarşı merkezi artık eskisi kadar kalabalık değil, şehir önceden tek parçaydı şimdi ise 4-5 parçaya ayrılmış durumda. Son fotoğraf ise arkadaşımın evinin bahçesinin önü. Evi çoğu zaman yaz mevsiminde kullanıyorlar. Kış mevsiminde daha rahat edecekleri, doğalgazlı evlerinde kalıyorlar. Bu hafta anlatacaklarım bu kadardı. Gelecek hafta görüşmek üzere._

body.body:
![IMG_20241001_175943_edit_598171476527994.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNVtrwPcG8mscts2T7bXsKFqKV6oc1cUBAf9HgAwGkfH2/IMG_20241001_175943_edit_598171476527994.jpg)

**Elegant Pair of Chantili Vintage Pink Swans – Selenium Glass**

**Introduction:** Presenting an elegant pair of Chantili vintage pink swans, crafted from high-quality selenium glass. These exquisite pieces showcase a captivating blend of clear glass with streaks of soft pink, flowing gracefully from their necks to their bodies. Dating back to the 1950s, these swans embody the charm and craftsmanship of mid-century Canadian glassmaking.

**Key Features:**
- **Design:** The swans stand at 16.5 cm tall, featuring a sleek and graceful form that adds a touch of elegance to any space. Their delicate design is complemented by a crosshatch pattern on the base, a characteristic left behind by the handblowing tools used during manufacturing.
- **Materials:** Made from selenium glass, these pieces are notable for their unique ultraviolet-reactive properties, glowing softly under UV light.

body.title: Música rusa: Vals
body.body: >La película soviética Mi dulce y tierna bestia (Мой ласковый и нежный зверь) fue estrenada en 1978; es un drama dirigido por Emil Loteanu y basado en la novela La partida de caza de Antón Chéjov.

>La trama se centra en un triángulo amoroso por medio del cual explora la pasión, los celos y el conflicto entre el deseo del corazón y las circunstancias de la vida. La protagonista es una joven hermosa e ingenua, Olga Skvortsova (Galina Belyaeva), pretendida por varios hombres debido a su encanto. Pero ella deberá tomar una difícil decisión, dado por unos puede sentir amor y pasión, en tanto otros le pueden dar una mejor vida con su dinero.
>Portada de la película Mi dulce y tierna bestia

>En resumen, la película trata de un tema recurrente, un dilema de casi todas las muchachas desde tiempos inmemoriales, porque por un motivo u otro, siempre suelen enamorarse del menos indicado en cuanto a los asuntos económicos, y a menudo deben renunciar a ese amor a favor de la estabilidad, si bien en nuestra época con la emancipación de la mujer todo ha cambiado mucho.
>De todos modos, en esta oportunidad como en otras me gustaría más bien comentar sobre la música utilizada en la banda sonora de la película antes mencionada.

>La música se titula Vals (Вальс), pertenece a Eugen Doga (Евгений Дога), y en primer lugar fue compuesta expresamente para este filme, no obstante, después llegó a ser usada en otros contextos, como en las ceremonias de inauguración de los Juegos Olímpicos de Moscú 1980 y Sochi 2014.
>En poco tiempo después de darse a conocer a través de la película fue profusamente galardonada.
>El propio presidente de EE.UU., Ronald Reagan, la llamó \
, y la UNESCO la declaró una de las 4 obras maestras musicales del siglo XX.

>También ha llegado a convertirse en una pieza clásica en bodas en distintos países como Rusia, Moldavia o Rumanía, puesto precisamente fue compuesta originalmente para la escena de la boda del personaje principal de la película.

>En particular a mí me parece buena y me gusta mucho, sin embargo, como cada cual puede tener una apreciación distinta...

* * *

>Los interesados en conocer esta magnífica obra musical pueden escucharla a través de este video en YouTube, donde de paso también se encontrarán con escenas memorables de la película:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ftpL1YAO1v4

>En este otro video en la misma plataforma también pueden escuchar la interpretación:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gdwvaGluY3k

>En adición, por medio de este otro video, pueden ver la comentada escena del vals de la película:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fGvTJ583xzQ

>El filme es conocido internacionalmente por otros nombres como Un accidente de caza o Accidente de caza; es famoso por su final trágico y su atmósfera poética, y como otras producciones soviéticas de época, tiene gran calidad artística.
>Por último me despido deseándoles lo mejor, pronto volveré a comentar sobre otra música de mi gusto.

body.title: Opportunity Charging Market to Reach USD 6.8 Billion by 2033 with 22.9% CAGR Growth
body.body:
The global [Opportunity Charging](https://marketintelo.com/report/opportunity-charging-market) market has gained strong momentum, expanding from approximately **USD 1.1 billion in 2017** to **USD 2.9 billion in 2023**, reflecting a solid **CAGR of 17.6%** over the historical period. Increasing electrification of public transport and rapid deployment of electric buses have significantly boosted demand. In 2023, over **38% of electric buses globally** used opportunity charging systems, compared to **14% in 2018**, marking a **24 percentage-point increase**.

## Historical Market Growth (2016–2023): Accelerated Electrification Impact

The Opportunity Charging market has expanded steadily over the past seven years:

*   **2016:** USD 820 million


*   **2017:** USD 1.1 billion (+34.1%)


*   **2018:** USD 1.4 billion (+27.3%)


*   **2019:** USD 1.8 billion (+28.6%)


*   **2020:** USD 2.1 billion (+16.7%)


*   **2021:** USD 2.4 billion (+14.3%)


*   **2022:** USD 2.7 billion (+12.5%)


*   **2023:** USD 2.9 billion (+7.4%)


This represents a **253% increase from 2016 to 2023**, supported by the growth in electric bus fleets, which exceeded **950,000 units globally in 2023**, up from **320,000 units in 2018**.

## Year-over-Year Growth Trends and Key Drivers

The Opportunity Charging market continues to benefit from strong YoY growth drivers:

*   **2020–2021:** Electric bus adoption increased by **29%**, driving **14.3% growth** in charging infrastructure


*   **2021–2022:** Urban electrification programs grew by **31%**, contributing to **12.5% market expansion**

*   **2022–2023:** Smart city investments rose by **26%**, supporting **7.4% growth**

Transit agencies reported **20–40% reduction in battery size requirements** and **15–25% lower operational costs** when using opportunity charging systems.

## Regional Market Distribution and Share Analysis

The Opportunity Charging market shows strong regional segmentation:

*   **Asia-Pacific (44%)**: USD 1.28 billion in 2023, driven by China’s large-scale electric bus deployment


*   **Europe (27%)**: USD 783 million, supported by emission reduction policies


*   **North America (21%)**: USD 609 million, growing public transit electrification


*   **Latin America (5%)**: USD 145 million, expanding urban mobility programs


*   **Middle East & Africa (3%)**: USD 87 million, emerging infrastructure investments


Asia-Pacific is projected to maintain leadership, reaching **USD 3.2 billion by 2030**, accounting for over **47% of the Opportunity Charging market**.

## Industry Adoption and Public Transport Insights

Adoption of Opportunity Charging systems is rising across transport networks:

*   **76% of new electric bus deployments** in urban areas include opportunity charging


*   **63% of transit authorities** reported improved route efficiency


*   **48% reduction in charging downtime** compared to depot charging systems


*   **35% increase in fleet utilization rates**

Public transportation accounts for **68% of total demand**, followed by commercial fleets at **21%**, and logistics vehicles at **11%**, highlighting the dominance of transit applications.

## Technology Trends and Infrastructure Development

Technological advancements are shaping the Opportunity Charging market:

*
    Fast-charging systems below **10 minutes charging time** grew by **33% YoY in 2023**

*
    Wireless opportunity charging adoption increased by **28%**, especially in Europe


*
    Pantograph-based systems hold **62% market share**, dominating urban deployments


*
    Charging station installations exceeded **85,000 units globally in 2023**, up from **28,000 in 2018**

Leading infrastructure providers generated over **USD 1.6 billion in revenue in 2023**, reflecting strong commercial activity.

## Long-Term Market Evolution (2015–2023)

The Opportunity Charging market has evolved rapidly:

*   **2015:** USD 540 million


*   **2018:** USD 1.4 billion (2.6x growth in 3 years)


*   **2020:** USD 2.1 billion (electric mobility surge)


*   **2023:** USD 2.9 billion (mass deployment phase)


Overall, the market recorded **over 437% growth between 2015 and 2023**, driven by global electrification policies and increasing urbanization.

## Future Market Projections (2024–2033)

The Opportunity Charging market is expected to maintain strong growth:

*   **2024:** USD 3.4 billion


*   **2026:** USD 4.5 billion


*   **2028:** USD 5.6 billion


*   **2030:** USD 6.2 billion

This reflects a projected **CAGR of 22.9% from 2024 to 2033**, driven by expanding EV adoption and smart city initiatives.

By 2030, over **65% of electric buses globally** are expected to rely on opportunity charging, compared to **38% in 2023**, indicating rapid technology adoption.

## Investment Trends and Government Initiatives

Global investments are significantly accelerating the Opportunity Charging market:

*
    Governments allocated over **USD 90 billion** toward electric mobility infrastructure in 2023


*
    Public transport electrification funding grew by **24% annually since 2020**

*
    Smart city investments exceeded **USD 1 trillion globally**, with **8–12% directed toward EV infrastructure**

*
    Private sector investment in EV charging startups surpassed **USD 4.2 billion in 2023**

China and the EU together account for over **70% of global opportunity charging deployments**, driven by aggressive emission reduction targets.

## Conclusion: Strong Growth Driven by Urban Electrification

The Opportunity Charging market has grown from **USD 1.1 billion in 2017 to USD 2.9 billion in 2023**, and is projected to reach **USD 6.8 billion by 2033**, driven by a strong **22.9% CAGR**. With **76% of new electric buses** integrating opportunity charging systems, the market is becoming central to sustainable urban transport.

Rising EV adoption, increasing government investments, and technological advancements will continue to drive growth. The Opportunity Charging market is poised to play a critical role in enabling efficient, cost-effective, and scalable electric mobility solutions worldwide.

body.title: Пастки для Оленки
body.body:
Нещодавно я писав про проблему з жуками волохата Оленка, які знищують цвіт на деревах. І ось сьогодні трохи в додаток до цієї теми про те, як ми намагаємось боротися з цією проблемою. Бо проблема, як виявляється, дуже серйозна, оскільки хімічні препарати для боротьби з цим жуком наче і є, але ефективність дорівнює майже нулю, бо один раз покропивши дерева, ти знищуєш лише тих, хто в цей час на дереві, але за пару годин на місце вбитих жуків сідають вже нові.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZVf37SzgeuKidpfmok9a3JSpmeTHxmmw5j8kqfpAGGNa/1776829958453.jpg)

Тому основною допоміжною силою в боротьбі з Оленкою є погода, наприклад як зараз, коли в період їх розмноження та максимальної активності вночі луплять приморозки, що зменшує чисельність в жуків відчутно.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbr97vjGgwknu4X6uTNN1CmbDoEyusyErETyFjvzhzSdJ/1776829966145.jpg)

А інший дієвий засіб, це розміщення біля дерев в період цвітіння пасток у вигляді ємностей з водою. Головна умова, щоб ці ємності були білого, або блакитного кольору. Жуки сприймають їх як квіти і намагаються на них сісти, а потрапляють у воду, де й гинуть.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYHjs5LzwaXkvkgpezosXgbbAYx4DnwEuvW1Yn35Jir1S/1776829957765.jpg)

Hi, guys!

It's time for me to get back to work today, as there are only two days left until the book festival, and I need to start reading reviews of the books I'll be participating in. But first, I still have to film some commercials, as I've already accumulated some unfinished business, and deadlines are looming. So, I'll have a very busy week ahead of me, and I'll have to push myself to the limit to make sure everything goes smoothly.

Today, I need to write to the publisher and ask where my presentation fee is. I don't like asking questions like that, but it's been three days, and I'd like to receive my payment. So, it looks like I'll have to write to them myself. It's not surprising that they might have forgotten about me before the festival, but I'd still like to get paid for my work.

Besides, I have a ton of other work, and it's frustrating that toy commercial shoots are now being split into several days, because they're constantly writing disjointed briefs for them. But I hope they'll fix this soon and everything will be back to normal. In the meantime, I'm waiting for them to learn how to organize all the information again.

So, overall, there's a lot and a little work at the same time. Today, I still have to film a video about the publisher's press pack, and I'll probably have to start there. I don't really want to film anything today, but I'm simply out of options.

So now I'll finish my morning coffee, wait for my phone to fully charge, and then I need to get to work—no one else can do it for me. And I hope everything goes smoothly.

To generate an image, you need to enter a prompt (which is like a command).
Since I like flowers, I entered the following:

Orchids Cattleya Cymbidium Dendrobium Paphiopedilum Botanical Garden Greenhouse Forest

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ7r8DwQZrJ1eakXceu8gZ3CFpkxcgUe9GxKiwjbvu9iV/peakd_ai_orchid.jpg)



Here’s the image that appeared. You can download each one individually and save them as PNG files.
It’s pretty good.
There are paid options, but you can do this much even with the free version.

By the way, PeakD also seems to generate videos, but that appears to be a paid feature. For paid features, you pay with HBD.


### AI Image Generator (Ecency)

If you click the “Plus” icon in the top-right menu of Ecency, “Ecency Perks” will appear. Among them, you’ll see a small “AI Image Generator” option; clicking it brings up the screen shown below.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVcSQjgrqbQik5BEkUh2VMHvas1hQf4mAr4Cc4zCxtEnG/ecency_ai.jpg)



You can generate images using the Ecency points you’ve accumulated. It costs 150 points to create a single image.

Let’s try entering the same prompt as before.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf3SbBBQAHBj3tKsfX8QtPrmvjkjMgeo1rVJzQJWg2CLR/ecency_ai_orchid.jpg)





This tool only generates a single image. It’s saved as a WEBP file.

I really wish it offered variations for the minimum point cost.

But it's a really beautiful image.

It might be a good option for those with extra points.

Why not give it a try?


--------------------------------

今は画像生成AIも優秀なものが出回っていますが、Hive上にも画像生成AIがあった！
ちょっとヘッダーやアイコンの画像を作るのに便利ですね。
今のところPeakDとEcencyで見つけたので、画像を生成させて遊んでみたいと思います。

### AI-Powered Images Generation(PeakD)

PeakDの右上のメニューの重ねてAIと書いてある画像アイコンをクリックすると下のようなAI-Powered Images Generationが出てきます。
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV8mXrW3YQjUTd9JAHuMVZT5HMv8YbZyhFzHyALRv22HE/peakd_ai.jpg)



画像を生成してもらうにはPrompt(命令文みたいなものですね)を入力しなければなりません。

Orchids Cattleya Cymbidium Dendrobium Paphiopedilum Botanical Garden Greenhouse Forest

洋ラン　カトレヤ　シンビジウム　デンドロビウム　パフィオペディルム　植物園　温室　森林

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ7r8DwQZrJ1eakXceu8gZ3CFpkxcgUe9GxKiwjbvu9iV/peakd_ai_orchid.jpg)



こんな画像が出てきました。一つ一つダウンロードできます。PNGファイルとして保存できます。
なかなかいいですね。
有料のメニューもありますが、無料でもこれだけできます。

なおPeakDのはVideoも生成してくれるみたいですが、こちらは有料のようです。有料の場合はHBDで支払います。


### AI Image Generator(Ecency)

Ecencyの右上のメニューのPlusというアイコンをクリックすると、Ecency perksというのが出てきます。その中に小さめにAI Image Generatorというのが出てきますので、それをクリックすると下のような画面が出てきます。

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVcSQjgrqbQik5BEkUh2VMHvas1hQf4mAr4Cc4zCxtEnG/ecency_ai.jpg)



こちらは日頃ためているEcencyポイントで生成することができます。ひとつ画像を作るのに150ポイントかかります。

さっきと同じプロンプトを入力してみます。

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf3SbBBQAHBj3tKsfX8QtPrmvjkjMgeo1rVJzQJWg2CLR/ecency_ai_orchid.jpg)

やっぱり最低ポイント数でバリエーションが欲しかったですね。
でもとてもきれいな画像です。

ポイントが余っている人にはいいかも。

気軽に使ってみてはいかがですか。

body.title: Does a clean and organized website still matter for first impressions?
body.body:
Oh, absolutely, it still matters a huge amount! A website <https://thehusbandsbio.com/why-people-still-judge-a-platform-by-its-website-first/> is often the first real point of contact, even if people discover a platform through other means. If it's messy or hard to use, it immediately creates a negative impression about the professionalism of the service behind it. I wholeheartedly agree that layout, structure, and speed are crucial for building trust. The website should signal whether the service is stable and clear, rather than rushed. I recently read an insightful article that delves into why people still judge a platform by its website first, highlighting that a clean site actually builds confidence and makes users more likely to engage.

雖說八方雲集算是台灣的平民美食餐廳，但這樣一桌子也要價台幣三四百元，要說一餐兩人份是這個價錢算平民價的話，也真的是太說不過去了吧?
不過沒辦法，光牛肉麵就要台幣一百八十元了，這道菜如果改成陽春麵的話，整個價格就會往下調整約一百元，平均一個人的餐費也要台幣一百多元。

若是這樣計算就和一個便當差不多錢了，以前吃一個便當六十到八十元搞定，現在一個便當是一百一十元到一百五十元，就看你怎麼挑菜色囉，像我這種很愛吃魚的，每次去自助餐買便當都要一百三十元起跳，想想也真的是太可怕了。

所以我基本上是不太執著為了省錢吃便當，因為我平日隨便吃簡餐或是火鍋一客兩三百，就是比便當多一倍價錢，好像也沒貴多少?但如果是真的去吃大餐，像是飯店百匯、烤肉、牛排等等等，那就真的是比較奢侈的消費啦。

想想，或許在老一些可以搬到鄉下去住?就算不開伙，鄉下的外食餐廳吃起來應該也比較便宜?房子本身也比較便宜，就是怕不習慣罷了，畢竟幾十年來都待在北部生活，改去住鄉下真的要有勇氣與決心啊~~

body.title: Wednesday walking in the yard
body.body:
Greetings everyone.
Hello, how are you, my good community friends ?. Thank you Wednesdaywalk by @tattoodjay as manager and inspiration. When I was out of town, I took the time to walk even though it was in a fairly large yard.


![IMG_20260421_134707.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23u611xAV1x8N3n69u2SdtkE4Cu3xuteK7YAxKfWPCjYvasFeWwRsgU2E3GqpUwU9oN3y.jpg)


This place is not mine, but belongs to a friend. The location is at the foot of Mount Slamet, central Java, far from the city. The road goes down and up, the yard around his house is well arranged. And they also have a hobby of plants. 


![IMG_20260421_134915.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23tvc9ZqQWXnLKjDYKFPonpVb17Wn91hLr9UqZXf23SjvBfXTKwXG6jnsoAST3Qd9php8.jpg)


After I parked the vehicle, the servant told me to go into his house. Because my friend was still on his way. To wait for time, I better use it to walk around they yard. The shape of the roof of the house uses a joglo roof, a typical form of central Javanese architecture.


![IMG_20260421_134825.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23yTfRHGzHZzoXrRAMefUhWBXvYKrzPXdJesNpbSLfDMbvDRAXEiAkW2kVG9LfaTT7VG1.jpg)


![IMG_20260421_134608.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23xySmynV2RhVJQ2T2RgHh1cMx9hAabLJyQCmAWnReKSb3xtZ9JiuzNRFSaY2JJioR3hE.jpg)



Seeing a water source that never dries up, the water is used to fill large Ponds for fish farming. In the middle of the pond, there is a place to rest and sit while enjoying the beautiful natural scenery. 


![IMG_20260421_134441.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23wgFKUSPLMvikS6JzN8VFY7grp3R2YKXBKe4652CSpKYYQU3aQRxJFWcvoQF9NrcPqPh.jpg)


![IMG_20260421_134210.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/242DG9asWia71NyRP6RCALzosampau5ZjS5v2aZX3UtKT9nyzgMZpi9aKQQEWnwTS3Hqc.jpg)



The fruit plants look lush and bear fruit, one of which is a durian, seen from a distance hanging from a branch. Bonsai trees are neatly arranged in front of the house, various types of old bonsai trees creating an artistic sight. 


![IMG_20260421_134245.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23vsSYAaTPTQRhZTk4CXgUfnkPdRDuu14TijAsH6eakrKvs3MUBa5iCkYgqNqvvqzCri4.jpg)


![IMG_20260421_134023.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/EoEqVb9DVb7euRywgVUNMDTHPu6PSg1pfGaTQw8m77vXpQe78ZhVDvoLRJk1XJprLXr.jpg)

![IMG_20260421_134059.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/EogMsLVZf3sfXvDcTxJy6x2u7pTSri2tKToxzYj4pSBjAbrjFxkRyLWiS52QqX46dma.jpg)

Beside the main house, there's also another building for guest to stay in while they wait. This ensures visitors don't get bored and feel at home. It took 40 minutes to walk around the yard, and finally the homeowner arrived and was invited in. 


![IMG_20260421_133847.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23wqe4AsZFmvLjo3ybML1So59Mmj9HHdmd3XVoe5PdUF7YN1NATB6DNLzQKnMUDFvDSLd.jpg)

body.title: Welcome to the enchanting weather in the natural scenery, rice fields, rural environment.
body.body:
>Today I will take you to the beautiful scenery of our beloved rural environment, which includes natural green paddy fields and beautiful weather with buildings. To complete this special journey, one wants to get lost in the lush green nature. 
‎
‎

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmekXP67WsR7VNBt8W1u3uEASdF3GwDAa6LQsb5LWr1kTg/1776530782987.jpg)

The rice plants have become very thick and tall. I have shared some scenes with you here before. At that time the rice plants were very small. But now the rice plants have become fully mature and there is a possibility of rice coming out in a few days.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb11YB2CBfLqEp2b9zfQ3srF9cBT4axWx2iAt4hp1RAg8/1776530783053.jpg)

Their wait teaches us to think anew and the farmers are counting down the days of waiting for new rice. However, I am very happy to see that the rice plants have grown a lot now.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfCGCM5gro8BVPcPpK7sb2F5nsp39mLtcxYP5Zdn24nsS/1776530783097.jpg)

This huge wall is included in the government area. However, the land outside, including all the trees, belongs to the farmers. The hardworking farmers are happy to work as laborers in the rice fields to make ends meet.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb4cEcvgRvj5g79enhPcNdT7hRXnqG8rGhr7BwronCfrC/1776530783140.jpg)

What a beautiful view of the lush grass around the rice field. A line has been dug through the ground through which water comes. Especially at this time, very little water is given to the rice. Because the rice can be damaged by storms and rains, the roots of the plants can become soft. And if the roots of the plants are soft, the rice plants will lie on the ground in a little wind.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYPrXD3it74zh8CjnDFdq21fDj6xRmL2s9FvT8wyfn9Bf/1776530783175.jpg)


Here, one can enjoy natural walks and beautiful breaths. This special natural scenery of rice fields and the beautiful view is truly a delight for everyone from young to old.  

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXXVmBd9SX7dAfbAENgoj1TkT9VvGXBbJ4hTB4u3MeTvN/1776530826771.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQv8VdJXodxGGwfC245SGshaS9pfuTf9ey4nYCwq6jPny/1776530826817.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVD7FWZCjSii81CMZRErTWEgYbHgaVKhehyN4Ynqgdfzh/1776530826859.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZnuoxPmUXsm49Uvm58CWRcH212Zd9UjokB77nqgmGJFG/1776530826896.jpg)

The light is starting to fade and it's getting dark. But slowly a beautiful evening will come. The view of the sky is wonderful, the trees and the branches of the trees look beautiful green when you look up at the sky from below.


![18.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mdakash62/EoAUXZjGAPyY3oMMK4f3oHgNhH1gR25mTMmu7pBuiWx6a2eAfCbUiUbmkLz3qgzSuJv.png)

body.title: Gravel Shopping
body.body:
>

<center>![Gravel Shopping.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bengy/EogPoQJcEgmqxKgU7LrToyhmQbe91aiLTeBav648A5aEpWAKQzpfPus7SiMuqgiPGz1.jpg)</center>

Sigh... this was something that we had been putting off for quite a while. Our house is currently surrounded by various piles of rock, mulch, and other things that we have been using for our amateur landscaping. And it has all been used slowly over the last couple of years with a small restock whenever we need more of things... 

... anyway, we originally a plan of doing a path around our house in white rounded decorative gravel... which is nice, but costs a fortune compared to the regular river gravel. And I do wonder if it would just get too bright when in full sun...

Anyway, we had ordered a batch of that for the kids playground area... which they are quickly growing out of... and we had some regular gray gravel that we had used for insides of the retaining wall blocks and also for the base of the wicking bed areas. After seeing roughly how much the white decorative gravel would cost for a relatively large pathing area, we decided to switch to the regular river gravel. 

And after we that... we had weed matted the pathing area... and sort of stalled a bit there as we both got quite busy. Thankfully the weeds haven't grown through the double layers of fabric, but I suspect that will given enough time. But in the meantime, my wife changed her mind about the gravel choice and had wanted to go back to the white rounded decorative gravel... but unfortunately, they no longer came in the sizes that we wanted, only a larger version which wouldn't be much use for a garden path! And even when we priced that up... well something on the order of 3000 dollars for rocks! 

So, after dropping off a car for a service, we were in the right area to do a bit of a search around for appropriate gravel. And we sort of settled on this Bungendore Brown in 10mm.... it isn't rounded, but not quite sharp edged... and unlike the current gray river gravel that we do have and were going to use, it doesn't look as \

!

So, we are going to have to get this priced up soon... probably will cost a fair bit still given the volume that we need... but not quite as much as the fancy stuff (which is unavailable anyway...). 

... and bloody diesel prices means that there is a significant delivery surcharge. Grrrrr...

body.title: [ENG/ESP] A Glimpse of the Bigger Picture. || Una visión general de la situación.
body.body:
Just this weekend, I had an eye-opening conversation with my friend and hair stylist. We've been friends for over eight years and during this time, we've just been doing the basic and non-so-basic things friends do. I'm not saying we haven't had intriguing conversations in the past but my friend stepped into a different dimension while she was advising me last weekend. I left her place not just looking beautiful but a  whole lot wiser. 


![1001341024.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wongi/EoyN6RoEcCZ62Fg3v5FVB1Q6WMfr2JwiqjxNcsD99E8eiVhHXyQTWngsfPRsSYMN2h8.jpg)


We were randomly talking about my crochet business and she was appraising my growth, especially with my social media presence. During this very random discussion, she asked how far I was willing to take my business. The question went something like this “soon, you become a fully qualified nurse. Are you just going to drop your business and focus on saving lives or would you put in the work to ensure you grow your business simultaneously?”


Nothing prepared me for that question and when it came, I gave it a minute's thought.  I'm very passionate about serving life and basically ensuring that people are properly cared for but I also absolutely love my brand and will be willing to go all out for it, so I told her I was going to strive to juggle both. This was when her stream of advice started flowing in. 



She clearly pointed out that she would hate for me to just be mediocre with my craft and as such, I should look into scaling up.  Prior to this conversation, whenever I thought about scaling up, I just thought “ensuring my craft reaches as many people as possible”  and with this thought comes: creating a team (since crochet items are 100% handmade and I can only make so many pieces at a time), finding investors, interacting with my audience and all that.  But my friend threw light on an entirely different aspect.  


She asked who my target audience was and when I responded, she said she knew I could do way better than that.  For a start-up brand like mine, my target audience is ideal  but the friend was all about the bigger picture. She mentioned numerous sectors where a crochet artist would be greatly appreciated, especially judging from the fact that crochet crafts can be so versatile.  She mentioned some sectors and asked me to think about them and ensure that venturing into these sectors would still align with my long term goals as a crochet artist.

![1001341479.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wongi/23uFKTNcidHmTV6mPNtJA3hf158EWqegk1eoxoJnAnPgbH8aSMwrmry11XRmjTo1UH87r.jpg)


Finally, she talked about something I had thought about but had forgotten to ponder upon; “time”.  It's very easy to work towards a goal without a time frame but when the time factor comes in and goals are properly outlined to match certain periods, then discipline comes in.  I had failed to do this but immediately I got back home that day, this was the first thing I did. 


The conversation made me realize that it's not okay to just brush the surface. When one digs deeper and glimpses the bigger picture, then a better and even more feasible perspective may come to light. 


Again, for the umpteenth time, having good friends who genuinely care about you and your growth is such a blessing. The fact is, some other person could have easily delivered the speech my friend delivered in an absolutely different tone and manner but my friend not only advised me but ensured I left her space feeling energized and “ready” instead broken and on the verge of giving up.  For this, I'm truly grateful.

## Ŀ Ī Ɛ ß Ɛ 🤍



![2021_02_21_20_04_57.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/doze/VUbbU4qs-2021_02_21_20_04_57.gif)



>> ![LEER EN ESPANOL]

Este mismo fin de semana tuve una conversación reveladora con mi amiga y peluquera. Llevamos más de ocho años siendo amigas y, durante este tiempo, nos hemos dedicado a hacer las cosas básicas —y otras no tan básicas— que hacen las amigas. No digo que no hayamos tenido conversaciones interesantes en el pasado, pero mi amiga entró en otra dimensión mientras me daba consejos el fin de semana pasado. Salí de su casa no solo guapísima, sino también mucho más sabia. 


![1001341024.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wongi/EoyN6RoEcCZ62Fg3v5FVB1Q6WMfr2JwiqjxNcsD99E8eiVhHXyQTWngsfPRsSYMN2h8.jpg)


Estábamos hablando de mi negocio de ganchillo y ella estaba valorando mi crecimiento, especialmente en las redes sociales. Durante esta conversación tan espontánea, me preguntó hasta dónde estaba dispuesta a llevar mi negocio. La pregunta fue algo así: «Pronto te convertirás en enfermera titulada. ¿Vas a dejar tu negocio y centrarte en salvar vidas, o te esforzarás para garantizar que tu negocio crezca al mismo tiempo?».


No estaba preparada para esa pregunta y, cuando me la hizo, me lo pensé un momento. Me apasiona servir a la vida y, básicamente, asegurarme de que las personas reciban los cuidados adecuados, pero también me encanta mi marca y estoy dispuesta a darlo todo por ella, así que le dije que iba a esforzarme por compaginar ambas cosas. Fue entonces cuando empezó a darme un montón de consejos.



Me dejó muy claro que no le gustaría que mi trabajo fuera mediocre y que, por eso, debería plantearme ampliar mi negocio.  Antes de esta conversación, cada vez que pensaba en ampliar mi negocio, solo pensaba en «asegurarme de que mi trabajo llegara al mayor número de personas posible», y con este pensamiento venía todo lo demás: crear un equipo (ya que los artículos de ganchillo son 100 % hechos a mano y solo puedo hacer un número limitado de piezas a la vez), buscar inversores, interactuar con mi público y todo eso.  Pero mi amiga me hizo ver un aspecto totalmente diferente.  


Me preguntó quién era mi público objetivo y, cuando le respondí, me dijo que sabía que podía hacerlo mucho mejor que eso.  Para una marca emergente como la mía, mi público objetivo es ideal, pero mi amiga se centró en el panorama general. Mencionó numerosos sectores en los que una artista del ganchillo sería muy apreciada, especialmente teniendo en cuenta que las manualidades de ganchillo pueden ser tan versátiles. Mencionó algunos sectores y me pidió que los tuviera en cuenta y me asegurara de que aventurarme en ellos seguiría estando en línea con mis objetivos a largo plazo como artista del ganchillo.

![1001341479.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wongi/23uFKTNcidHmTV6mPNtJA3hf158EWqegk1eoxoJnAnPgbH8aSMwrmry11XRmjTo1UH87r.jpg)


Por último, ella mencionó algo en lo que yo había pensado, pero que se me había olvidado considerar: «el tiempo». Es muy fácil trabajar para alcanzar un objetivo sin un plazo concreto, pero cuando entra en juego el factor tiempo y los objetivos se definen adecuadamente para ajustarse a determinados periodos, es entonces cuando entra en juego la disciplina. Yo no lo había hecho, pero nada más llegar a casa ese mismo día, fue lo primero que hice. 


La conversación me hizo darme cuenta de que no basta con quedarse en lo superficial. Cuando uno profundiza y vislumbra el panorama general, puede surgir una perspectiva mejor y aún más factible. 


Una vez más, por enésima vez, tener buenos amigos que se preocupan de verdad por ti y por tu crecimiento es una bendición. La verdad es que cualquier otra persona podría haber pronunciado fácilmente el discurso que me dio mi amiga con un tono y una actitud totalmente diferentes, pero ella no solo me aconsejó, sino que se aseguró de que saliera de su casa sintiéndome con energía y «preparada», en lugar de abatida y a punto de rendirme.  Por eso, le estoy verdaderamente agradecida.

body.body:
Hello creative people!!! I hope you're all doing well. After some time away, I'm coming back to share with you some of what I've been making lately. ![InShot_20260422_021853696.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mdrguez/AJgC1g1MjCj65MhdrD8q2yL8paQxzYzaRhQFX4gxFFzwQV5feX1LpaReRTxKHgT.jpg) If you've read my previous posts, you know I love working with cardboard and handmade paper. And today I'm bringing you another name to decorate a baby's room — his name is Oliver, and he's a little one just 3 months old. His grandmother got in touch with me to order her grandson's name, and she wanted it to have a decoration similar to the tool sets they sell for kids. So I got to work creating the design — in all the years I've been making these decorations, this is the first time I've been asked for this particular theme. Once it was ready, presented, and approved by the client, I started the making process. It's quite easy to do, and you can look for alternatives for the decoration and even for making the letters themselves. Sometimes we have a gift to give and we want to make it with our own hands, full of love for someone special — and this kind of project can be the perfect gift. I'm leaving you the materials list and the step-by-step instructions. Don't hold back — dare to make it!!!
Español - Click aquí

Hola gente creativa!!! Espero estén todos bien. Después de un tiempo vengo a compartir con ustedes algo de lo que he hecho últimamente. Si han leído mis publicaciones anteriores, saben que me encanta trabajar con cartón y papel artesanal. Y hoy les traigo otro nombre para decorar la habitación de un bebé, su nombre es Oliver, y es un pequeño de apenas 3 meses de nacido. Su abuela se puso en contacto conmigo para encargar el nombre de su nieto y quería que tuviese una decoración semejante a los juegos de herramientas que venden para niños. Así que puse manos a la obra para crear el diseño, en los años que llevo haciendo estas decoraciones, es la primera vez que me encargaban este tema en particular. Una vez listo, presentado y con la aprobación de la clienta comencé la elaboración. Es bastante fácil de hacer y se pueden buscar alternativas para la decoración y hasta para la misma confección de las letras. A veces tenemos un regalo que hacer y queremos hacerlo con nuestras manos, lleno de cariño para alguien especial y este tipo de proyectos puede ser el regalo perfecto. Les dejo la lista de materiales y el paso a paso, no te limites, atrévete a hacerlo!!!

![baner espiral.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mdrguez/23yxEJsUksL5dmYCVDY2oSUBQc3QRTLQFiqR1hhWUScGojeeJNp8wx7ok7ydcmmmHC38a.jpg) Needed: - Molds - Corrugated cardboard (enough to fit everything) - Craft paper - Recycled white paper - Foam sheets - Glue - Scissors - Cutter knife - Acrylic paints (blue and metallic gray, orange, red, yellow, and green) - Brushes - Double-sided tape Cutter knife > Se necesita:
> - Moldes > - Cartón corrugado (suficiente para que quepa todo) > - Papel artesanal > - Papel blanco reutilizado > - Foami > - Pegamento > - Tijeras > - Cúter > - Pinturas acrílicas (azul y gris metalico, naranja, rojo, amarillo y verde) > - Pinceles > - Cinta adhesiva doble cara ![baner espiral.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mdrguez/23yxEJsUksL5dmYCVDY2oSUBQc3QRTLQFiqR1hhWUScGojeeJNp8wx7ok7ydcmmmHC38a.jpg) The first step was to cover the cardboard on both sides. I glued the handmade paper to the front and the reused paper to the back. Then I traced the letters and cut them out. Once cut, I covered the exposed edges of the cardboard with pre-cut strips of handmade paper. > El primer paso fue forrar el cartón por ambas caras. Pegué por el anverso el papel artesanal y por el reverso el reutilizado. Después marqué las letras y las calé. Una vez caladas cubrí los bordes expuestos del cartón con tiras de papel artesanal previamente cortadas. ![1-4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mdrguez/23wCL6RrP86mHnx1Fw5vk4oGpnq2Dy4t2QE3WVnZfogxqsyTUAwYfML9k9FYDbNP4Pn6Z.jpg) ![baner espiral.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mdrguez/23yxEJsUksL5dmYCVDY2oSUBQc3QRTLQFiqR1hhWUScGojeeJNp8wx7ok7ydcmmmHC38a.jpg) Next, I painted all the letters blue and started making the decorations that I would place on and around them. With foam sheet, I made several circles and semicircles that I used to create shapes that look like screw heads. For that, I painted them metallic gray. Using the templates, I traced, cut out, and painted each tool in the chosen color. > Seguidamente pinté todas las letras de color azul y empecé a hacer los adornos que pondría sobre y alrededor de ellas. Con foami, hace varios círculos y semicírculos que utilicé para hacer figuras que parecen cabezas de tornillos. Para eso, las pinté de gris metálico. Con ayuda de los moldes marqué, calé y pinté del color elegido cada herramienta. ![2-3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mdrguez/23z7ST6cF3KNDGs97HEUdzkPNunfuxSWJT5nWyie2QqccYnDWDnLSYBEP7b7E6XrxdBPV.jpg) ![baner espiral.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mdrguez/23yxEJsUksL5dmYCVDY2oSUBQc3QRTLQFiqR1hhWUScGojeeJNp8wx7ok7ydcmmmHC38a.jpg) With every detail ready, I glued the screws harmoniously onto the letters and put tape on the back so it could be hung on the wall. And that's how it was ready to deliver. > Con cada detalle listo, pegué de manera armónica, los tornillos sobre las letras y puse cinta adhesiva por la parte trasera para poder pegarlo a la pared. Así quedó listo para entregar. ![3-3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mdrguez/23xenLmnRzSSfpZZZPb8GvZoAgfhTQXr624B3pfUWSDBpJSw1vuNUak6peDTkSdXckLeo.jpg) ![baner espiral.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mdrguez/23yxEJsUksL5dmYCVDY2oSUBQc3QRTLQFiqR1hhWUScGojeeJNp8wx7ok7ydcmmmHC38a.jpg) This project turned out absolutely amazing, and the client ended up super pleased. I hope Oliver liked it too 😉. > Este proyecto quedó chulísimo y la clienta terminó super complacida. Espero que a Oliver también le haya gustado 😉. ![final-5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mdrguez/23uFeTHaGCtpeiZv2bZmpijpfSYDufkqxMGgb8wWrH6pr67W1LRFBuYXj2CfQRjLvj4RN.jpg) ![baner texto.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mdrguez/23yJhpN4yGqeNY5CVruHtcAyrMygMVBuEDxL7BrCADDbCaueKuxrLxvSvsSRQWBbys7Sb.jpg) All rights reserved on the text and images, which are of my authorship unless otherwise indicated. body.title: Planting Juniper.
body.body:
Planting Juniper. 
Yesterday we went to Grandma’s cottage. We bought some trees to plant along the fence. 
First, we need to measure to make sure everything is straight. We used a measuring tape and a string for this. 
Next, we dig holes. The holes need to be large. At the bottom of the hole, you need to put in gravel for drainage, then sand mixed with soil and fertilizer. If you have bugs, add a teaspoon of bug poison, then cover with about 10 cm of soil. Then water it with half a bucket of water. Take the tree out of the pot, keeping the soil around it, and plant it in the hole. 
Pack down the edges a little, make a ring around the base, and pour water along the edge of the ring—another half a bucket. 
Plant all the trees this way. 🌲
These trees don’t grow too big, but they’ll still grow. That’s why you need to plant them 70 cm apart.  We left a meter between them and the fence and a meter between each tree. 
Today we’re going to plant some more trees. They’ll be thuja trees, but much bigger than these ones.

body.title: Living amidst hardships and suffering
body.body:
May you be filled with all blessings.

How can we live a comfortable life with all kinds of heat, such as summer heat, sun heat, and War fire heat?

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUVoNkKC5vXudhvqqiC5uBiPsFGu7zioj566ukPFEGT1v/img_20260421_174833.jpg)

I am a grassroots person living in rural areas of Myanmar.
There is a civil war raging in Myanmar.
I am someone who lives away from the civil war environment.
This April, Myanmar held a fake parliament through fake elections and the power-hungry Min Aung Hlaing is acting as the fake president. The commander-
in-chief of the terrorist army, Min Aung Hlaing, has just taken off his military uniform and put on the presidential insignia.
He is dropping bombs from the air every day on ordinary people in areas where he has no power.
How can we be happy in such a situation?

No matter what, I still have to live in this country. I still have to work and earn money to survive.
So I have to learn to live with the hardships.
I can't increase my income every day, but the prices goods are getting higher.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaRwDRwHXswTYFMayLw1cnuy7r2jYiTWfCVCrQZA1AkT7/img_20260415_061424.jpg)

In this kind of situation, I have to face the world.
That's why I describe the hot sun as a natural beauty.
The heat of the summer sun is no match for the heat inside me.

မင်္ဂလာအပေါင်းနှင့်ပြည့်စုံကြပါစေ။

နွေအပူ နေအပူ စစ်မီးအပူ စသော ပူလောင်မှုမျိုးစုံဖြင့် ကျွန်တော်တို့ဘဝ ဘယ်လို သာယာနေနိုင်ကြပါမလဲ။

ကျွန်တော်သည်ကား မြန်မာနိုင်ငံ၏ ကျေးလက်ဒေသ၌ နေထိုင်သော အခြေခံလူတန်းစားတစ်ဦး ဖြစ်သည်။
မြန်မာနိုင်ငံ၌ကား ပြည်တွင်းစစ်မီး တောက်လောင်လျက်ရှိသည်။
ကျွန်တော်သည် ပြည်တွင်းစစ်မီး ပတ်ဝန်းကျင်ကို ရှောင်ရှားနေထိုင်နေသူ ဖြစ်သည်။
ယခု ဧပြီလ၌ မြန်မာနိုင်ငံတွင် အတုအယောင်ရွေးကောက်ပွဲဖြင့် အတုအယောင်လွှတ်တော် ကျင်းပကာ အာဏာရူး မင်းအောင်လှိုင် က အတုအယောင်သမ္မတ လုပ်နေသည်။
အကြမ်းဖက်စစ်တပ် ကာကွယ်ရေးဦးစီးချုပ် မင်းအောင်လှိုင် က စစ်ယူနီဖောင်း ချွတ်ကာ သမ္မတအဆောင်အယောင်ကို ဝတ်ဆင်လိုက်ခြင်းသာ ဖြစ်သည်။
၎င်း အာဏာ မသက်ရောက်သော ဒေသက သာမန်ပြည်သူတွေ အပေါ် နေ့စဉ် လေကြောင်းမှ ဗုံးကျဲချလျက်ရှိနေသည်။
ဤသို့သော အခြေအနေမှာ ကျွန်တော်တို့ ဘယ်လို ပျော်အောင် နေနိုင်ပါမည်လဲ။

မည်သို့ရှိစေ ကျွန်တော်သည် ဤနိုင်ငံအတွင်း၌ နေထိုင်ရဦးမည်။
ရှင်သန်နေနိုင်အောင် အလုပ်အကိုင်တွေ လုပ်ဆောင်ကာ ဝင်ငွေရှာနေရဦးမည်။
ဒီတော့ ဒုက္ခတွေကြားမှာ နေတတ်အောင်လည်း ကျင့်ကြံရပါမည်။
နေ့စဉ် ဝင်ငွေ ပိုမို တိုးပွားအောင် မလုပ်ဆောင်နိုင်ပေမယ့် ကုန်ဈေးနှုန်းသည်ကား ပိုမို မြင့်မားလာလျက်ရှိသည်။

ဤသို့သော အခြေအနေ ခံစားချက်မျိုးမှာ ကျွန်တော် လောကဓံကို ရင်ဆိုင် အံတုနေရပါသည်။
ဒါကြောင့်သာပဲ ပူလောာင်နျေသာ နေမင်း ကို သဘာဝရှုခင်း အလှ အဖြစ် ခံစား ဖော်ပြပေးလိုက်ပါသည်။
နွေအပူ နေအပူ သည်ကား ရင်ထဲက အပူကို မယှဉ်သာပါဘူးလေ။

body.title: POWER UP OR CASH OUT
body.body:
This is a question of that sort that would seem to be easy to answer.

When you start earning the first time on Hive, it is exciting. You write, you are involved and then you begin to receive rewards. Naturally the first thought which comes to mind is: Can I claim this money now or can I multiply it?


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQBjprS2CXd8ZVq1i1jJiCjh1eHRHXEQpHCDfyaWbFPhj/img_20260422_wa0001.jpg)

I have at both ends several times.


The idea behind Powering Up is straightforward. You are investing yourself back in the platform. The more power you have, the more serious you are perceived to be in the ecosystem.

It is like planting seeds.

It will not make you have the entire benefit at the moment, but it works out at time. The more you vote, the more you can be there, and you start to establish yourself as an individual, who is heading towards a long-term project.

This makes a lot of sense.

When you believe in the platform, and you are determined to be consistent then power up will be like telling yourself that you are here to stay.


But there's still the Cash Out side of it.

And here comes in reality.

Not everybody is as well-off. There are other people relying on the revenue they receive online to meet their offline demands. Bills don’t wait. Needs do not rest to make long term value creation.

Sometimes, it is even worth cashing in your earnings. Not that you do not believe in growth, but simply because there is life which exists outside the platform and which must be satisfied.


In my situation, I have grasped that I need not make this or that decision.

Initially, it appears to be a nice thought to go either all the way and turn everything off or empty the wallet. But overtime, I realized that a more moderate stance would be more reasonable.

Some of that is put in growth.

What I have also understood is that attitude matters a lot here.

You will want to cash out when you consider Hive as a temporary phenomenon. But when you consider it as a platform, you are building something - your voice, your network, your consistency then it becomes worth more to power up.

Not that much about immediate gratification but positioning.


The end of the day will not be judgmental on whether a strategy is right or wrong.

All you need is just experience on Hive as a platformand Express yourself.

It is essential to construct, and therefore to stay in touch with reality not to lose it.


If i were to answer it in a word:

Power up if you're thinking long term.
Borrow a Cash Out when you require it in life.

The secret lies in the fact that one should know when to do either of them, and not to be guilty of it.

body.title: 🌍 Bitcoin and Energy: The Dirty Myth That Won't Die — And Why the Data Tells a Different Story
body.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/no-advice/23wWnaTDZp1ttbpgW58637bGbk5iCrMeXvZjc6quqfbDeMJQveqPhg6ZNBcCAvoNtEAWA.png)

Every time Bitcoin makes headlines, the energy debate comes with it.
\

These claims are repeated so often that most people accept them as fact.
But the data tells a very different story.
- - - 
### 💡 Why the Narrative Exists
The criticism is not random. It has roots in a real observation:
Bitcoin mining consumes a significant and measurable amount of electricity — roughly comparable to a mid-sized country.
That is true. And it matters.
But the conversation almost always stops there — without asking the more important questions:

🔍 Where does that electricity come from?
🔍 What is it replacing?
🔍 What does it produce?

Stopping at \

without mentioning what hospitals do.
- - -
### ⚡ The Energy Mix Is Changing Fast
Here's what the critics consistently ignore:
Bitcoin mining is uniquely location-independent and interruptible. Miners don't need offices, foot traffic, or proximity to customers. They go where energy is cheapest — and the cheapest energy in the world is almost always stranded or excess renewable energy.
Recent industry estimates suggest that:

♻️ 50–60% of Bitcoin mining now runs on renewable or low-carbon energy sources
💧 Hydroelectric surplus in regions like Scandinavia, Iceland, and parts of Latin America powers large mining operations
☀️ Solar and wind curtailment — energy that would otherwise be wasted — is increasingly captured by miners
🔥 Some operations use flared natural gas that would otherwise be burned off into the atmosphere with zero economic benefit

Bitcoin mining doesn't just consume energy. In many cases, it monetizes energy that would otherwise be wasted entirely.
- - -
### 🏭 Comparing Apples to Apples
Let's put this in perspective.
The traditional banking system — with its millions of office buildings, ATM networks, data centers, armored vehicles, and server farms — consumes an estimated 2–3x more energy per year than Bitcoin.
Gold mining, with its open-pit excavations, heavy machinery, and global logistics chains, has an environmental footprint that dwarfs Bitcoin's.
Yet neither gold nor banking faces the same level of scrutiny.
The question is not whether Bitcoin uses energy.
The question is whether the value it produces justifies that energy.
For the billions of people with unstable currencies, no banking access, or savings destroyed by inflation — the answer is not a difficult one.
- - -
### 🌱 Earth Day 2026: A Different Conversation
On Earth Day this year, the conversation around Bitcoin and energy deserves a reset.
Instead of repeating the same worn-out criticism, it's worth asking what Bitcoin is actually incentivizing:

👉 Investment in stranded renewable infrastructure that would otherwise sit idle
👉 Grid-balancing services that stabilize local energy networks
👉 Demand for clean, cheap, abundant power — which accelerates the buildout of exactly the energy sources we need

Bitcoin doesn't solve climate change. No single technology does.
But the framing of Bitcoin as an environmental villain is increasingly at odds with the reality on the ground.
- - -
### ⚠️ The Legitimate Concerns
Not everything is rosy.
In regions where mining runs on coal-heavy grids, the carbon footprint is real and shouldn't be minimized.
Proof-of-Work is energy-intensive by design — that is a feature for security, not a bug. But it does mean the pressure to shift toward cleaner energy sources must remain constant.
Transparency in mining energy reporting is still inconsistent. Better data is needed — and the industry should demand it.
- - -
### ⚖️ The Bottom Line
Bitcoin's energy use is a legitimate topic. It deserves serious, data-driven discussion.
What it doesn't deserve is the lazy, selective framing that compares Bitcoin to a country's consumption — without comparing it to the systems it is replacing.
The narrative is shifting.
The miners, the data, and the energy economics are all pointing in the same direction.
Bitcoin is not the enemy of a sustainable future.
In many ways, it is quietly becoming part of building one.
- - -
This is No-advice. Always do your own research.

body.title: Motherhood: A Journey of Sweet and Sour Moments
body.body:
My journey as a mother has not been that long, but in this short span of time, I’ve learned more than I ever imagined. Motherhood, in all its beauty and chaos, has been a path filled with both sweet and sour moments, moments that challenge and fulfill me in ways I never thought possible.

From the moment I became a mother, my life shifted in ways that words can hardly capture. The love I feel for my child is immense, a force so powerful it’s difficult to articulate. The sweet moments, like hearing my baby’s first laugh, feeling their tiny hand curl around my finger, their first  step, their first words are the things that keep me going. These fleeting instances of joy remind me that motherhood is as much about the little, beautiful moments as it is about the challenges.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUu3kSPEgFGBERDXo89D5NdeRCFgKJQBHR6bWRGky5KDt/1000191982.jpg 


But it’s not all sweet,  Some days are a rollercoaster of emotions. The tantrums for example  can be exhausting and testing. There are moments when I feel like I can’t get through to them, and their cries seem endless, but I remind myself that it’s part of their growth—learning to express their emotions and understanding the world around them. It’s not easy, and sometimes I wonder if I have the patience to handle it all, but then I see them calm down and I realize these tough moments don’t last forever. They’re just another phase.

Then there are the endless questions. The “why” phase, where everything is a mystery that needs to be explained. Sometimes I feel like I’m drowning in their curiosity, answering questions all day long, from the simplest to the most complex. It’s a beautiful thing, to watch their minds grow, but it can be overwhelming, especially when you feel like you’ve answered the same question a dozen times. But in those moments, I remind myself that their inquisitive nature is a sign of their development and that one day, I will miss these endless questions when they grow older.

And of course, there are the nights spent awake, nurturing them through high fevers or illness. Those sleepless hours, holding their fragile little body close, feeling their heat against my chest, are some of the most challenging and heartbreaking moments of motherhood. I wish i could take away their pain and make everything better, but all I can do is comfort them and hope that the fever breaks. Those nights feel endless, but they are also moments of deep bonding, where my love and care shine brightest.

Through it all, I’ve come to realize that these rough patches are not the end of the story, they’re simply a part of the bigger picture. Just like the sweet moments, the tough ones don’t last forever. I’ve learned that motherhood isn’t about being perfect, it’s about being present. It’s about finding the strength to keep going, even when things get difficult. It’s about knowing that while the days may feel long, the years are short, and before I know it, my little one will have grown, and I’ll look back on this time with a sense of pride and nostalgia.
I often pray that the tough times won’t outweigh the sweet moments, but I’ve come to understand that both are necessary. The challenges teach me resilience, patience, and the importance of self-compassion. They show me that I’m stronger than I sometimes realize. And in the midst of the struggles, the sweet moments become even more precious. They’re the light that keeps me going, reminding me of the beauty that exists in the chaos of motherhood.

Motherhood is a journey of constant growth and transformation. I may not have all the answers, and I may not have the ability to predict what will happen next, but I know one thing for sure, I am not alone. Every mother has her own unique journey, with its own challenges and triumphs. And while the road may not always be smooth, it’s the love, the lessons, and the memories that make it all worthwhile.

So, to all the mothers out there, keep going. The sweet moments will always make the tough ones worth it. And in the end, it’s the love we give and receive that makes this journey so incredibly special.




**Thanks for checking on my blog and have a wonderful day**

body.title: Hive is Ugly.   Let’s change that
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeLbQx2XgsP6YessvRkMDJuDbwZnt9o4KEmH5iRT8PBEA/img_2864.png)
*image from the game Omori*

Ok, it’s not UGLY, but it’s not pretty either. 

Straight to the point, no fluff:  

-### Hive projects need a makeover. Most, if not all of them. They need more character.  They need an identity that is just as visual as it is conceptual.  

## I’m not talking about a UI or UX overhaul. I’m talking about the details. Icons, colors, fonts, logos and landing pages. They need are not interesting enough to keep anyone’s attention in 2026 and onward. 

Professional isn’t the word I’d use. Interesting and Unique is more like it. 

“Decent” doesn’t cut it, and “Unoffensive” doesn’t scale in 2026. I’m not saying it should be jarring or ridiculous (athough it COULD be), but I haven’t seen one project take a risk or make an attempt to stand out in their visual design. @meno (whose project Hivesnaps is still new) pointed out Hive Skate and I stand corrected, they at least have a direction, but what about the major front ends? 

I get the sense that @meno is thinking about finding a visual identity for his project, and I hope that Ecency, Peakd and Inleo could level up theirs. 

This is not a jab at them or whoever made the call on their visuals, I’m just saying “decent” or even “good” doesn’t speak to people in 2026, we need to know who you are through your design and if it isn’t something that catches attention, we need to explore what you could be, at least if we want to catch new users and keep them. 

All this time we thought outreach was the problem and usability and politics were the problem and yes, they all influenced our growth, but considering how much Hive has had an impact on so many of it’s users and ex-users lives, it should have been able to go further than it did up until now, even without fixing any of that. 

It just didn’t catch people’s eye like it could have. 

Everyone is focused on integrating AI and, don’t get me wrong, in some aspects it is really important, being able to code fast and impliment features quicker will keep other projects from stealing your ideas before you grow legs and make it easier to turn imagination into reality.  Autotranslate is wonderful. Text to speech can be very helpful. 

But what about adapting to the changing psychology of people with the world in their pocket, access to everything, never sure what’s real an what’s not, able to start a million dollar business in a few hours a day on GPT but not commited to doing so because before you’ve even solidify your vision, someone’s beat you to it. 

How do we create projects for such an era? 

Experimentation, creativity, and real human connection are more vital than ever.  That doesn’t just mean monetizing such behavior, it requires embodying it at every level. From the devs to the team to the core community. 

## That includes visual design. 

We need to get our minds off being X killers and reddit killers and reaching the masses and focus more on being exactly what we want to be and how we can get closer to it in the present moment because that speaks to people louder than anything. 

And I am telling you with 100% certainty that for every Hive project, leveling up the visuals will be the fastest easiest way to see more interest in your project. 

Not the promise of earnings. 
Not the promise of immutability. 
Both are important but they aren’t what make people want to stick around long enough to find out what this place really is. 

The promise of profit sounds sketchy and the promise of censorship resistant only appeals to a tiny fraction of people, many of which aren’t all that active online because physical reality is inheritaly more censorship resistant than the internet. **Don’t even consider giving up on censorship resistence if that’s important to you, but maybe it doesn’t belong in the tagline or the first few sentences**. 

I realize there are other issues at Hive.  Downvotes have scared some people off, and demand for the token has gone down due to lukewarm sentiment towards crypto in general. It’s not as if we don’t have other problems. We can talk about those another time. 

I love what this place has been for me and as I develop my own ability to express myself, I want to help this ecosystem do the same. 

### We need to be catchy, but notjust for the sale of being catchy. Catchy and real and raw enough to embody the future. it needs to be genuine and fun and have high stanards for itself, not just in the tech. 

### It’s not about catching everyone, but about making everything cohesive and consistent in it’s energy. If we represent the future and if we envision that future is less corporate controlled, we need to find an aestetic that is very much detached from one a corproation would design. 


For the past two years I’ve been focused on music in a way I wasn’t before. I’ve been trying not to neglect the physical world and to meet people face to face more. I don’t look at my music as just music, I look for ways to create worlds with my music. 

My shows aren’t just a presentation of my songs.  They are an invitation to participate and think about things we don’t usually think about. 

I stopped trying to catch people who are all overwhelmed with a wall of disconnected information whenever they open their phone, and I started focusing on developing myself into something so unique to me that it naturally invited curiousty. 

I started experimenting with video and images rather than waiting til I had money to hire people to do it. If i could afford to hire then I would, but I think this experimentation phase was vital for me because it helped me figure out what kind of colors and effects and stimuli I am naturally attracted to. Even if you want to hire someone, it’s good to play with the tools to get a sense of what’s possible and what you like. 

The result wasn’t instant success, but a clear path opened up, where there was no room for doubt. I no longer felt uncertain about what might get people’s interest. 

It became undeniable that developing my own unique style would come naturaly through my curiosity and pragmatic problem solving, and that I didn’t need to think about attracting people, only being more attractive. Not more attractive in an objective way, more of what I wanted to see, without any self-limiting beliefs about what might alienate people. 

I was realistic enough to start with the easier fixes and take steps to get there rather than jump right in prematurely, and that whole process created a story that people were more eager to be a part of.  I didn’t need to engineer the story. I needed to start living it.  You don’t need to state upfront who you are, just to move closer and closer to it every day. 

Once again, I am still a tiny artist without many followers, but I’ve gotten the attention of more than one of my favorite artists in Tokyo, and now I am invited to play shows when I wasn’t before, and I get new follows on social media almost every day from friends of friends.  The momentum is slow but it’s obviously increasing beyond any doubt.  

Many hive projects already have some momentum just by having an existing (albiet small) user base and experience. 

I recognize a front end and a music project are not the same but I believe the same overall philosophy applies. 

Experiment. 
Look for aspects of yourself or your project that you never appreciated before. Or challenge your ideas of how things “should be” to find new possibilities. 

Reflect. 
Develop and redevelop the way you express your identity through trial and error. 

Focus.
Don’t aim for the masses.  Aim to be undeniable to those who  can see you for what you are, and get better and better at just knowing cleary what that is and what that LOOKS LIKE (literaly) 

Look and Listen. 
Your current situation will tell you what’s missing or what could be better. Sometimes new or a dicuasion will spark an inspiration, and sometomes a random user will tell you exactly what you need to focus on out of the blue🙃

As for visual design, I am sorry for putting her on the spot again but I really really think that no projects asking @hiddenblade to be a visual advisor is a MASSIVE wasted opportunity. She is the one artist here that I’ve felt for years has the sensibiltiy that could make a project stand out and still feel comfortable. 

I would also be happy to just advise if you are insane enough to ask me. High risk, high reward, right? I’d put more effort into it than I do on most of my blog images, those I usually make in a hurry. 

Just to give you some ideas to run with or to get the juices flowing, here are the themes I’ve come up with as starting points that I think easily catch peoples eyes and shouldn’t be THAT hard to design without a world class web designer and artist. 

- graffiti
- gentle neon 
- vaporwave
- 8-bit
- minimalistic cartoon (similar to the game “Hidden Folk”
- modern art (various versions of it) 
-clay figure
-paper cut-out
-dreamcore 

Search any of those terms if you are unfamiliar. 

I went ahead and had GPT generate some rough idea of what this could look like. I know there are better AI for image generation but I just wanted to give a rough idea of what I am takong about. 

Ideally a real artist and or web designer with unique tastes will work to adjust or at least to advise with each project: 

Ecency X Minimalist Cartoon - 
GPT automatically changed the blog image and icons to the theme, which actually would be an awesome option while uploading your post “Do you want us to edit your image to fit Ecency’s theme? yes/No”

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRiM2aUygJeWtzWfgDUDbW1vEpeg7iX2TsQLTEMKy4kG9/img_2892.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSnnkVNNTUGyV6W7cYnzoLm1r6MftTAuh5KQmM8jp8W8p/img_2893.png)

Peakd X Vaporwave - 
Ideally the image above would be something a little less generically vaporwave than this, but that’s where an artist comes in.  I would like more abstract shapes and images in there and a slight change in color, but I love the color scheme of the first image here:


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNVgA7BHGDir1H2xJK4nwPcoL4uGDVDRzj3dhYtLMswho/img_2874.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNNz39ueP9SyURTgy6v75yK8fMz1VAxp4a6JPQRZ1g5Bb/img_2875.png)

INLEO X 8 bit - 
i couldnt get GPT to stop using nintendo characters after mentioning old NES and arcade games without forfeiting the theme entirey but some original 8 bit unique lion characters and crypto themes sprites would be PERFECT


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPAq4KtFcNv1sZW8Ao1UWVRujvUmC4Q7CQ25J6UuYvbZ6/img_2897.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeWk7k7N9kKL8DKmdGF7rQndL78KDkE8qjoHZBtzbtKg8/img_2896.png)



Hive Snaps X Modern Art / Dream core - 
I ran out of images twice trying to get something interesting out of modern art, jackson pollack style and other prompts focused around modern art so finally I tried dream-core. This was the batch I was least satisfied with but “modern art” has a lot of potential. Dream core is very niche and would be a cool option, not a good default for most projects, and you could definetly do it better than this 



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQZ8ih49jo3ispCjXWiEoN1guNwq2YiWCsjoHtTyUNeF5/img_2898.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVV6gYyeqxm4mc4bQjVoMrrwgrwKPeohQeU7ivRwjYxNJ/img_2904.png)

I hope this sparks some conversation around visual aestetics and getting outside of the norm a little bit, experimenting a bit more, and finding people with visual talent and unoqie sense to help with the design of projects.
