body.title: : Un episodio de Succession hecho para ser aplaudido
body.body: >Creo que si has entrado a este post, una de dos cosas (incluso, ambas) son igualmente posibles: te gusta la comedia realmente oscura, cruda, y efectivamente conoces la serie, la sigues. Entonces, algo de spoilers, habrá en esta review. Dicho ésto, doy inicio a mi perspectiva sobre \

, un episodio de Succession que es imposible que no te afecte desde lo humano... Y es que, si ves el primer episodio de esta historia, jamás podrías imaginar que el cierre de la misma tendría un tinte tan amargo, oscuro e igualmente mordaz y claramente psicópata... Honestamente, para mí es un desafío increíble tener que calificar este capítulo.

*\n\n*

>Romulus Roy (Roman) un completo patán, soberbio, sin sentimientos, frío, burlón, supremamente billonario y en una escala moral totalmente alejada de la que podríamos compartir tú y yo, es el absoluto protagonists de este capítulo. Y créanme, para hacer esta crítica, volví a ver la serie desde cero y evidentemente, también volví a reveer el episodio. Hace ya 6 episodos que el maestro de Succession, el capo si tutti cappi, el alma de toda la producción de HBO murió. Su muerte fue una decisión anunciada pero absolutely inesperada. Estarás de acuerdo conmigo, al admitir que la forma en la que fue presentada ante la audiencia fue igualmente maravillosa como angustiante.

* ![0907SuccessionS04E09.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23zkpQgR6qUqLmzGLVVNctqkVH1gjxq7GvGr5q7g3WPXC94x49NJk9V4cKa4CobKwMWDd.jpg) ![images.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23uFGsYmGh32Bt77nH3jNw9sCUZchMXCSiHSQmuLATZZQG5v36m11KZn9XiuQGuBsQ9Rk.jpeg) ![MV5BMGUyMWRmZDgtOWY5Yy00Yjk1LThjZjYtYWEwMjBhMGIzMjFlXkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/EoEiMTaiHmTrbMTz3xUMv9Wpiu8nK49FsMueApfDszhaYqiGebJAubrnaEsoxmRrCdU.jpg) ![jeremy-strong-sarah-snook_custom-72d7ddc6886640af485f0611e16b3d4577532e5e.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23w2HBP8GVN2KohjEiKDaeZR5cwg7jLgVjjNqYDbk4PpKuGAEnsrjuYuKhihm1hsLTJ6m.jpg) Fuente *

>Morir agonizando en un vuelo, en el aire, an tus hijos y rodeados de las víboras capitalistas que por décadas te adularon y cumplieron tus deseos, pero lejos de lo que se supone que vale realmente la pena en la vida: la familia. No solo fue una decisión de guión majestuosa pero sumamente desafiante. A falta de 7 episodios, el protagonista de Succession moría, y en la última temporada, podría irse todo al caraj... Afortunadamente, nada de eso sucedió. De hecho, en los últimos episodios vemos cómo la naturaleza distorsionada y enfermiza de sus hijos. SHIV, KENDALL y ROMAN (también Connor) realmente se asoma a la superficie.

*\n\n*

>Durante 5 temporadas, desde el 2018 hasta el 2023 vimos contenido y sometidos los estos reales de estos hijos y hermanos enfermos por el Poder absoluto, no por el dinero; y a fin la meta está a la vista... El Rey ha sido depuesto, y cual César asesinado, ahorson los \
los que tienen el Poder a disposición... Sin embargo, en \

somos testigos de la humanidad desgarradora de Román Roy. Quien es el elegido por sus hermanos para dar el discurso en honor a su padre, en la misa fúnebre... Durante todo el metraje de episodio, Jesse Armstrong, escribe y productor de Succession nos va dejando migas de lo que viene en pantalla con el menor de los Roy, el niño malcriado, el burlón y poderoso Roman...

* https://youtu.be/wZ513lN36jQ?si=6Qc4A32usJmo8zzY *

>Ahí está la escena. Todos los hermanos en sus asientos de primera fila en la Catedral. Es el turno de hablar en público, luego que su tío, Ewan Roy, hermano de Logan, sorprendentemente revelará ante todos porque Logan se volvió Logan. La muerte de su pequeña hermanita a causa del Polio, siempre persiguió a Logan Roy durante toda su vida. Le hizo duro, cruel, inescrupuloso; ambicioso, todo lo que supo ser en vida. Recuerda, eres parte de la audiencia, no estás en la historia pero Ewan nos habla a todos; a los personajes, a ti, a mí... Roman sube, no puede emitir palabra. Balbucea, y rompe en llanto desconsolada. Tanto, que veo a mi hija al verle llorando. Él me hace llorar, el patán, el burlón, el cruel; es tan buen personaje y Kieran Culkin tan buen actor, que estoy llorando mientras él llora... Aún faltan 30 minutos más de episodio pero el último adiós del hijo que más amó a su padre, te rompe cada fibra del alma. Por un instante, Los Roy y tú, tienen algo en común; ambos lloran la muerte de alguien a quien no le importamos en absoluto. Si eso no es una obra maestra , ¿cuál sería una?

*\n\nhttps://youtu.be/ZnxZGgRUGFk?is=J8YtzzDPd2lNHRmx

Over my posts about the Brisbane Broncos 2026 season I've made mention of the mounting list of injuries (and other things) sidelining key players. over Wests Tigers (21-20) last round helped but with a growing list of unavailable players I'm worried for the future of this season.

5. Billy Walters - ACL

title.title: Challenge #04861-M112: The Path to Fates
title.body:
![richard-multimedia-itq8MvZDDvk-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/internutter/48GC5TP7SeNpHGh8GPhTFN19Vp77GBb5oFumKy6cTCb8yb1FPS7VpTPpBSmestd8bz.jpg)

> Deep in the vales of the Winderwrung Crags, legends speak of a beautiful figure whose serenade echoes across the range. Some say this singer leads climbers to their doom, others speak of surviving blizzards by that heavenly voice. One has at last set out to see if the legends hold any truth or are only traveler’s tales… -- [Deathshead419](https://internutter.org/bb/user/deathshead419)

The valley is plentiful, and those who live there know well why every building stands on stilts or pillars. Even the horses and cattle shelter in barns held above the plains. They are well used to the sturdy ramps.

At the high end lie the Winderwrung Crags. A stone labyrinth carved by wind and water. People in the vale don't venture far into there.

In the dry season, the crags _sing_.

It is not the sound of the wind, but a voice. A beautiful song worthy of Sirens, sung in a tongue none in the vale can understand. Families made louder music than the siren song,and plugged their children's ears with wax, lest they get lured away.

Once a year, someone falls for the voice, and has to meet the singer. They walk willingly into the crags, and never come back.

Some come to the vale through the winter pass, always speaking of a heavenly voice guiding them through foul weather. Leading them to shelter, or to the vale itself.

Meni Mirsa had grown up with their parents putting wax into their ears before summer bedtimes. And wishing they did it before their father could joke that it was so they \

. They'd learned to play loudly before they learned to play beautifully, in order to protect younger children.

And one fateful night, they had tied themself to a house column so they could listen.

It was too beautiful to be anything other than a trap. A magical melody made to mesmerize. Whatever was on the other end of the crags obviously wanted its meat hale and hearty, not half-frozen and sick with the cold. And, most likely, willing to do _anything_ for the voice that sang so marvelously.

Meni prepared, of course. Building up their muscles and making sure they were fit. Training for combat so they would be ready for battle. Getting special protections to protect themself from becoming so charmed that they would willingly walk into a Dragon's open maw.

Some of those protections were tattooed into Meni's skin. No thief nor trick could easily take _those_ away.

There was also the mandatory Adventuring gear as well as Meni's favourite lyre. They planned to meet this singer, Bard to Bard, and find out why none had ever returned from the crags.

Rations enough for half a year, wax in a pouch, just in case, Meni set forth into the crags. Following the near-siren song along the winding path of untamed stone. Letting their ears guide them whenever the path appeared to branch.

It took them two weeks to reach the other end of the crags. Where an ancient city stood, intact, in a hollow under the mountain. The fountains within flowed out and made the crags. It flowed to that day and eventually became the river of the vale.

The city was spotless. No signs of life. No lingering evidence of habitation. No trace of anyone ever having stayed there for any time. No records. No writing. Not even words or figures engraved into the walls.

The singing led Meni into the central building. Up into the tower.

Where a crystal played a song by an ancient Elf. Perhaps an Arch-elf, as the ghostly robes looked _historical_, though Meni had no idea which era it was. An expert would know.

Meni also had no idea how to stop the crystal from doing what it was doing. Nor was there any clue about what had happened to those who had gone before them. Thus, Meni was _very_ careful about inspecting the stand that held the singing crystal. Searching for traps, runes, or any kind of magic.

Taking it from this resting spot may stop people going missing from the vale. But it would also stop people surviving the pass in winter. Were the lives of one set of people to be paid with the lives of another? It might seem fair to the Arch-Elves and the ancient Faekindred, but it didn't feel right to Meni.

Something had to be done.

Meni had learned the magic of music, of course. So the first melody they wove was one to figure out what in all the hells was happening with this singer. Or the device that played it. Or this whole damned city. Or all three, come to think of it.

_There_ was the trap. The stand that held the crystal was set to teleport anyone who touched it to a different place and plane. No wonder all those who came before had vanished without a trace. It was protecting the crystal that was made to safely guide travelers to the city. It _just happened_ that one of the spots on that journey was the vale.

All it needed was a slight adjustment of the runes. A tweak in its commands.

An edit, so that it safely guided travelers to _where they intended to go._

Meni could make those alterations temporarily, but they'd need to learn artificing to make the changes permanent. And they would have to be _certain_ that the changes were what they meant them to be.

Their spell would last five years at the most. They would come back in four, just to be certain. And while they were here, they permanently disabled the teleportation trap. No more would fall victim to _that_ one. A note chiselled into the stone around the crystal warned any others who came not to interfere with the guidance.

It was the best they could do.

For now.

title.title: Sock Puppet Economics
title.body:
# Sock Puppet Economics

*April 22, 2026*

---

**MEMORANDUM**
**TO:** Anyone still pretending the Federal Reserve is a normal institution
**FROM:** The situation
**RE:** Yesterday

---

Kevin Warsh sat before the Senate Banking Committee on Tuesday and was asked, with a straight face, whether he would serve as President Trump's *\
* The phrase belonged to Sen. John Kennedy of Louisiana — a man not typically associated with institutional solemnity — and Warsh answered that he absolutely would not. *\

* in fact. Verbatim.

Somewhere, in the temperature-controlled marble of the Eccles Building, Jerome Powell's portrait is already halfway off the wall.

Let's take stock of the tableau. The United States is at war in the Middle East. A two-week ceasefire expires tonight. Brent crude is orbiting $96. Gas is $4.05 at the pump. Inflation is running at 3.3% annually. And the Senate Banking Committee spent a meaningful portion of yesterday afternoon interrogating the next Federal Reserve chair about *Seinfeld references* and a *$100 million in undisclosed investments* and whether a federal criminal probe into the current chair — ostensibly about a building renovation — should be dropped before anybody votes on anything.

This is the institution tasked with price stability for the largest economy on earth. Carry that thought with you.

---

The Warsh hearing was, by the standards of Fed confirmation theater, genuinely unusual. These proceedings are typically the financial equivalent of a dental cleaning: mildly uncomfortable, entirely predictable, over in two hours. Not this one. Sen. Elizabeth Warren arrived with the energy of someone who had not slept, and she deployed it. Democrats hammered Warsh on conflicts of interest. They hammered him on his long history of inflation hawkishness — the dissent against QE in 2010, the years spent warning about asset price distortions from loose money — and then, in the same breath, hammered him for *reversing* that position at a conveniently useful moment.

The reversal is the thing. Warsh spent most of the last decade as a credible hawk. Now Trump wants low rates, and Warsh, nominated by Trump, told the committee that the inflation trajectory is *\

* — which is the kind of sentence that commits you to absolutely nothing while sounding like it commits you to something. He said no rate-cut deal was made with the White House. He said central bank independence is *\

* He said he would not be a sock puppet.\n\nMarkets, being markets, did not find this entirely convincing. Gold was down 3% on Tuesday at $4,676 an ounce — the Warsh effect, still trickling through positioning — while the dollar held firm. The logic is legible even if the conclusion is disputable: a hawk in the chair, regardless of whatever current accommodation he telegraphs, is structurally less likely to flood liquidity on demand. The *\

* becomes a smaller put. Asset valuations that depend on perpetually easy money have a problem, eventually.

Eventually is doing a lot of work in that sentence.

---

Here is the part nobody wants to say out loud: the confirmation itself may not happen on schedule. Sen. Thom Tillis, a Republican on the Banking Committee, sat through the entire hearing and asked Warsh precisely zero questions about monetary policy. He used his time to demand that the Justice Department drop its criminal investigation into Powell — a probe into testimony about a headquarters renovation, which a federal judge last month said was supported by essentially no evidence — before he would cast a vote. With Democrats uniformly opposed and the committee closely divided, Tillis is a single-vote veto. Powell's term ends May 15th.

Do the arithmetic. If Warsh isn't confirmed by May 15th, the Federal Reserve has no chair. The vice chair steps up as acting chair. Policy continuity is theoretically maintained. But the signal — that the United States cannot manage an orderly succession at its central bank because the executive branch is prosecuting the outgoing chair for a building renovation — is a signal that will be read very carefully in Beijing, in Frankfurt, in Riyadh.

The dollar index didn't collapse yesterday. It rarely does on any single day. But these things accumulate. The IMF flagged it this week in the language central banks use when they want to alarm you without saying something inflammatory: *\

* Three words. Enormous weight.

---

And yet the S&P 500 closed Tuesday at 7,064. The Nasdaq is above 24,000. Earnings season is grinding out double-digit growth. The Magnificent Seven are projected to expand net income by 25% this year. Every dip gets bought.

What the equity market is pricing, whether consciously or not, is a version of events where all of this resolves. Warsh gets confirmed, maybe late, maybe messy. The Hormuz ceasefire extends or a deal gets signed. Oil comes off. Inflation cools toward 2.5%. Warsh cuts once or twice, framing it as data-driven rather than politically induced, and the narrative holds together just long enough for earnings to carry the index through the year.

It's possible. It's not crazy. The market has been right about resilience before, including in moments when it had no obvious right to be.

But it is being asked to hold a lot of contradictions simultaneously. An inflation-fighting central bank chair who will cut rates. A war whose ceasefire expires tonight that investors are largely ignoring. A criminal investigation that is blocking a confirmation that needs to happen in three weeks. A president who calls the current chair a *\

* and then, the same week, says he has no intention of firing him.

When Sen. Kennedy asked Warsh the sock puppet question, the room apparently laughed. That's the market right now: sitting in a room where the jokes land, not asking too hard what happens when the laughter stops.

---

Powell's portrait. The wall. Halfway off.

Watch the confirmation vote. Watch the Tillis position. Watch whether the DOJ probe gets quietly buried or whether it becomes a three-week standoff that leaves the world's most important central bank temporarily headless at the exact moment oil is near $100, inflation is above target, and the ceasefire clock just ran out.

This is what institutional decay looks like when it's functioning.

Choosing the right travel insurance depends on how and where you plan to travel. If you are planning [motorcycle tours India](https://www.brahmandtour.com/motorcycle-tours-in-india) or a long Motorcycle tour from India, your policy must cover adventure activities and long distance road risks. Standard travel insurance may not be enough for such journeys.

**What coverage is essential for riders?**

For travelers exploring india motorcycle tours or joining india rides, consider these key inclusions

*   \- Medical coverage for accidents and emergency treatment

*   \- Trip cancellation or interruption protection

*   \- Coverage for lost or damaged gear and luggage

*   \- Personal liability in case of third party damage

Adventure specific insurance is crucial when riding across varied terrains in India. Policies should clearly mention coverage for motorbike touring.

**Do international travelers need different plans?**

Yes, international riders should look for comprehensive travel insurance, global medical coverage, and emergency evacuation benefits. These are important when exploring remote routes or high altitude regions.

**How to choose the right plan?**

Always compare best travel insurance for adventure travel, check claim limits, and read exclusions carefully. A well chosen policy ensures peace of mind, allowing you to focus on the experience rather than risks.

title.title: Join a guild to earn more rewards
title.body:
Splinterlands is primarily a solo game, meaning each player advances in the rankings based on the power of their assets and their skill. Teamwork also plays an important role in Splinterlands, and guilds are an example of teamwork, though they're currently not very effective. This explains, for example, why many guilds are empty or why many players aren't in any guild. Aside from inter-guild combat, which currently offers rewards with MERITS tokens, the most enjoyable benefit of belonging to a guild, in my opinion, is the GLINT and SPS bonuses earned during seasonal battles.

![1000063601.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/claudio83/23tvB1mpXNNMh8yKmW6RGc5XHBGjKEoNV35teMroFKNDSAps9FKpQXfD6WPVuNrpXhdYC.jpg)
___

Obviously, reward advantages or bonuses depend on the guild's level: simply creating a guild and receiving the maximum bonus isn't enough. Therefore, the incentive for players is to grow harmoniously and develop their buildings, both to be more competitive and to obtain higher bonuses.

![1000063604.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/claudio83/23tkhS6RBtaowfq1JNjuxtwHN8jMyPYRDxEjW6fJdzJ6HFq92FCcRVmE51rjCmkSEygfr.jpg)

For example, the guild I'm in guarantees a 12% bonus on GLINT rewards. At the end of each season, I earn about 350,000 tokens, and about 40,000 are guaranteed by my membership in the guild. I imagine more powerful guilds also get a higher percentage! So join a guild to maximize your profits!

# ITA

Splinterlands è un gioco in prevalenza solitario, ossia ogni giocatore avanza in classifica in base alla potenza del proprio asset e alla sua abilità. Ma anche il gioco di squadra ha un ruolo importante in Splinterlands e le gilde sono un esempio di gioco di squadra che al momento però non è molto incisivo, e questo spiega ad esempio come mai molte gilde siano svuotate o molti giocatori non siano unite a nessuna gilda. A parte il combattimento tra le gilde che al momento offre ricompense con token MERITS, il vantaggio a mio avviso più gustoso di appartenere ad una gilda è il bonus GLINT e SPS ottenuto durante le battaglie stagionali.

![1000063601.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/claudio83/23tvB1mpXNNMh8yKmW6RGc5XHBGjKEoNV35teMroFKNDSAps9FKpQXfD6WPVuNrpXhdYC.jpg)
___

Ovviamente i vantaggi o bonus sulle rewards dipendono dal livello della gilda: non è sufficiente creare una gilda e ricevere il bonus massimo. Quindi l'incentivo per i giocatori è crescere in armonia e sviluppare gli edifici, sia per essere più competitivi ed anche per ottenere bonus più alti.

![1000063604.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/claudio83/23tkhS6RBtaowfq1JNjuxtwHN8jMyPYRDxEjW6fJdzJ6HFq92FCcRVmE51rjCmkSEygfr.jpg)

Ad esempio la gilda di cui faccio parte mia garantisce un bonus del 12% sulle rewards GLINT. Alla fine di ogni stagione io ottengo circa 350k tokens e circa 40k sono garantiti dalla mia presenza nella gilda. Immagino che gilde più potenti abbiano anche una percentuale maggiore! Quindi entra a fare parte di una gilda per massimizzare i profitti!

title.title: When You Veer Off Course / Rotadan Sapınca ( EN-TR)
title.body:
![resized_image.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXV66T9UFviGnfZwXxjENN6nx8xdCume8makYPUvf82hE/resized_image.jpg)
Driven by a desire to explore places I’ve never been to or seen, I’ve often found myself taking roads I didn’t know. But now I start every journey with a map. After carefully studying the map, I immerse myself in entirely different stories along the imaginary route I’ve drawn in my mind. The app I use most for maps is Google Maps. When I enter my destination, I often look at the distance while reviewing the alternative routes that appear. After checking the distance, I also look at the twists and turns of the road, the towns it passes through, its proximity to the sea, and which mountains it runs near. These details always serve as clues for me. The routes you think are the shortest can sometimes lead you into a dead end.

>Daha önce hiç gitmediğim ya da görmediğim yerleri keşfetme arzusuyla, sık sık kendimi bilmediğim yollara çıkarken buluyorum. Ama artık her yolculuğa bir harita ile başlıyorum. Haritayı dikkatle inceledikten sonra, zihnimde çizdiğim hayali güzergâh boyunca bambaşka hikâyelerin içine dalıyorum. Haritalar için en çok kullandığım uygulama Google Haritalar. Hedefimi girdiğimde, genellikle mesafeyi kontrol ederken ortaya çıkan alternatif rotaları da incelerim. Mesafeyi kontrol ettikten sonra yolun virajlarını, geçtiği kasabaları, denize olan yakınlığını ve hangi dağların yanından geçtiğini de incelerim. Bu detaylar benim için her zaman ipucu görevi görür. En kısa olduğunu düşündüğünüz rotalar bazen sizi çıkmaza sokabilir.

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

![IMG20241116130342.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ3eygqJruYNtFXKrAtLZNUam9LxyMY9PpeYDcLHqzJxr/IMG20241116130342.jpg)

![ \

](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ7EDV1wWGT4ANBkcmxZgcSgkUGMCpyi5V9rphCQGwcB6/IMG20260405143752.jpg)

When planning my route, I try to pay attention to every detail along the way—businesses, forests, parks, and historical sites. These details can lead me to beauties that no one else notices. Sometimes I ask myself questions. Where will this road take me? Where can I stop here? If I get lost, will anyone be able to reach me? I ask myself all these questions before setting out. Even the risk of getting lost excites me a little. Of course, it also makes me a bit anxious.

>Rotamı oluştururken, yol üstünde bulunan işletme, orman, park ve tarihi eser niteliği taşıyan her detaya bakmaya gayret ediyorum. Bu detaylar beni kimsenin dikkat etmediği güzelliklere de çıkarabiliyor. Bazen de kendi kendime sorular soruyorum. Bu yol beni nereye sürükleyecek? Burada nerede mola verebilirim? Kaybolursam bana ulaşabilirler mi? Tüm bu soruları yola çıkmadan önce kendime soruyorum. Kaybolma riski bile beni biraz heyecanlandırıyor. Tabi biraz da tedirginleşiyorum.

![IMG20260325115848.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNRj26EEKBq5Ufipr1yRzz734pmMRKNkoamTQkASagNc3/IMG20260325115848.jpg)

When I look closely at some maps, I find myself veering off onto paths that look like thin lines. Sometimes, as I’m riding through the forest, the navigation stops working, and my location disappears. When I reach a spot with no signal, I keep going down the road ahead of me. Until I come to a fork in the road. That’s when the voice inside me speaks up. My first voice tells me I need to keep going, while my second voice tells me I need to turn back. I usually keep going. In other words, I always listen to my first voice.

>Bazı haritalara dikkatli incelediğimde ince bir çizgi gibi görünen yollara da sapıyorum. Bazı durumlarda ormanın içinden giderken navigasyonun sesi kesilir, bulunduğum nokta kaybolur. Çekmeyen bir noktaya vardığımda önümdeki yoldan devam ederim. Ta ki bir yol ayrımına gelene kadar. İşte o anlarda içimdeki ses ortaya çıkar. İlk sesim, ilerlemem gerektiğini, ikinci sesim ise, geri dönmem gerektiğini söyler. Ben çoğunlukla devam ediyorum. Yani her zaman ilk sesimi dinlerim.

![IMG20260325110752.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeetuV6L5MBpiA7XRVa8n95vKemN9kiTFrRj9wMhmmCTs/IMG20260325110752.jpg)

I’m speaking from my own experience. Some roads aren’t shown on maps. Most of the roads that appear abandoned and unused aren’t included in navigation systems. These are the paths people have created with their own skills. The best part is receiving a greeting from an elderly man while driving down a narrow village road, or seeing the smiling faces of children playing soccer on the grass—it makes me very happy. These are the small joys found in the details that aren’t on the map.

>Yaşadığım tecrübelere dayanarak söylüyorum. Bazı yollar haritalarda görünmez. Atıl durumunda görünen olan ve kullanılmayan yolların çoğu navigasyonda olmuyor. Bu yollar insanın kendi becerileriyle oluşturdukları yollar oluyor. En güzeli de dar bir köy yolunda ilerlerken yaşlı bir amcanın selamını almak, çimlerde top oynayan çocukların gülümseyen yüzlerine şahit olmak beni çok mutlu ediyor. Bu detaylarda navigasyonda olmayan küçük mutluluklardır.

![IMG20260326112039.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUErrdCBGLzaJzpAn5L2ejmEveMn12Uudbtg72faeWeWQ/IMG20260326112039.jpg)

Of course, not every journey ends in a happy adventure. Sometimes I really can’t find my way out of those narrow paths I’ve taken. Either I get lost or I have to turn back. The narrow roads where I struggle to turn my car around, and the hills I have to drive down in reverse, are a real ordeal for me. Most of my time is spent on the road. I don’t have any time left for adventure. And then there’s the fatigue and stress...

>Elbette her yol mutlu bir macerayla sonlanmıyor. Bazen gerçektende girdiğim o ince çizgilerden çıkamıyorum. Ya kaybolurum ya da geri dönmek zorunda kalıyorum. Aracımı döndürmek için uğraştığım dar yollar, geri geri inmek zorunda kaldığım yokuşlar benim için tam bir çile oluyor. Zamanımın çoğu yolda geçiyor. Maceraya atılacak zamanım kalmıyor. Tabi bir de yorgunluk ve stres...

![IMG20260325174046.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfAD3XjwUcZicZ3pytbn9vQ3YBkFzD9awLUVZzajKa8yh/IMG20260325174046.jpg)

One day, I was walking along a narrow, rocky path toward a slope densely covered with pine trees in a wooded area. As I tried to find my way, I followed the areas where footprints had formed in the ground beneath my feet. I made my way through the bushes, grass, and thorns as far as I could. When I reached the very top, I saw a clearing among the trees. As I walked toward the clearing, I realized I had come to the edge of a cliff. It was then that I saw, right before me and beneath my feet, the magnificent view of a town and a vast expanse of blue stretching into infinity. It was, in a word, a perfect view. 

>Bir gün ormanlık bir alanda çam ağaçlarının yoğun olduğu yamaca doğru dar taşlı bir yolda yürüyordum. Yolumu bulmaya çalışırken bastığım topraklarda ayak  izi oluşmuş alanarı takip ettim. O çalıların otların ve dikenlerin arasından çıkabildiğim  kadar çıktım. Tam tepe noktasına ulaştığımda ağaçların arasından bir boşluk gördüm. Boşluğa doğru yürüdüğümde bir uçurumun kenarına geldiğimi fark ettim. İşte o an karşımda ayaklarımın altında bir kasabanın muhteşem görüntüzü ve sonsuzluğa uzanan bir mavilik gördüm. Tek kelimeyle mükemmel bir manzaraydı. 

![IMG20240922134032.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNjS6WCzxZ6zuXTLWpLa6XuSqvrfPiZ2FgBw2BpA2SdMC/IMG20240922134032.jpg)

![IMG20240922134007.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPGLmrQx4Gq1dGPLGRDEvEwCFmminnjtwp8JdyZjAVpH4/IMG20240922134007.jpg)

Now I’m setting a new course. Maybe I’ll take a wrong turn again. Maybe the GPS will warn me. But I’ll still listen to that inner voice. Because I love setting out on new discoveries and adventures along paths not marked on the map.

>Şimdi yeni bir rota çiziyorum. Belki yine yanlış yola sapacağım. Belki GPS beni uyaracak. Ama yine de o iç sesimi dinleyeceğim. Çünkü haritada işaretlenmemiş yollarda yeni keşiflere ve maceralara atılmayı seviyorum.


![IMG20260325182303.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmURuAeYpKhZdiWcfmTeeue7H3HD2UvX55PiLnQs7cz3mq/IMG20260325182303.jpg)

title.title: 22 April 2026 @marinnewest's Freewrite Writing Prompt Day 3081: I'm Just Drifting.
title.body:
![1000679805.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ubglo17/23vhui4HusW6Y93stg9M43ohEzyyZK3YnKMAFURHCZo7y3Lvwb7kGpDHKCXu3JsW4rwuF.jpg)[source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/a-race-car-drifting-at-a-race-track-12644281)


This is my post on #freewriters3081 #dailyprompt I'm just drifting hosted by @marinnewest's.
The orange dust of Enugu’s afternoon settled on Emeka’s skin like a second, unwanted layer of clothing. He sat on a low concrete wall near the Holy Ghost Cathedral, watching the yellow transit buses roar past in a haze of diesel fumes and shouting conductors.
​For months, his life had felt like a radio tuned between stations—mostly static, with only occasional bursts of clarity. He wasn't exactly lost; he knew the way home to Abakpa well enough. He was just drifting.
​The Rhythm of the Streets
​Emeka watched a hawker balance a tray of okpa on her head with a grace he hadn't felt in years. Since the firm in Independence Layout folded, his days had lost their edges. He would wake up, walk until his soles burned, and let the city’s chaotic energy carry him.
​9:00 AM: Coffee at a roadside stall, watching the suits rush to work.
​12:00 PM: Wandering the cool, quiet aisles of a bookstore in Polo Mall, reading titles he couldn't afford.
​4:00 PM: Sitting here, watching the shadows of the Milken Hill longen.
​\

\n​But Emeka found a strange peace in the aimlessness. In the drift, there was no failure, only observation. As the sun dipped behind the hills, painting the coal city in shades of bruised purple, he finally stood up. He didn't have a plan for tomorrow, but as he stepped into the crowd, he felt less like a ghost and more like a passenger, waiting for the right stop.

title.title: Why Web3 Projects Still Struggle to Find the Right Dev Team (And What Actually Helps)
title.body:
Building on Hive or any other decentralized stack isn't exactly a mainstream skill set. I've been in this space long enough to watch projects stall — not because the idea was bad, but because the team spent months trying to find developers who actually understood what they were building.

The problem isn't a shortage of dev agencies. There are thousands. The problem is that most of them have never touched blockchain infrastructure, and vetting that from a directory listing is nearly impossible.

I went through this twice with projects that needed specialized backend work — one involving on-chain reward mechanics, another that required solid experience with decentralized storage and API design. Both times I started the search the same wrong way: browsing generic platforms, reading reviews that said nothing specific, and booking intro calls that wasted everyone's time because the agency's \

turned out to be one NFT minting page from 2021.

What changed for me was using https\://skypeek.co/ as the first filter. You put in your actual requirements — tech stack, domain, budget range — and it returns a shortlist of companies with verified case studies rather than vague portfolio claims. For niche builds, that case study layer matters a lot. Knowing a company has shipped something functionally similar is worth more than any sales call.

A few things I'd add for anyone in the Web3 / Hive ecosystem specifically:

Don't assume \

means what you need it to mean. Ask directly: have they built on Hive, or just Ethereum? Those are very different environments. Agencies that know one rarely know the other without significant ramp-up time.

Check the GitHub. Open-source communities leave trails. If a company claims relevant experience, their public commits will either back that up or they won't exist at all.

Ask about the handover. Decentralized projects have different operational needs post-launch than traditional SaaS. Whoever you hire should understand that difference before you sign anything.

The search is harder in this space. But it gets faster once you stop treating it like a generic software procurement.

---

[Posted](https://waivio.com/@waivio_mark-rikhter/4b562w-why-web3-projects-still-struggle-to-find-the-right-dev-team-and-what-actually-helps) by Waivio guest: [@waivio_mark-rikhter](https://waivio.com/@waivio_mark-rikhter)

Liquid mercury is a unique metallic element that remains in liquid form at room temperature. Known scientifically as Hg, it has been used for centuries in science, medicine, and industry because of its unusual properties such as high density and ability to conduct electricity. Many people searching for information online may come across phrases like [Order Red Liquid Mercury Online](https://dark-net-market.com/buy-red-liquid-mercury-online/), often linked to curiosity or misconceptions about mercury. Its shiny, silver appearance and fluid nature make it visually distinctive compared to most other metals.

  
Historical and Modern Use
----------------------------

Historically, mercury was widely used in:  
Thermometers and barometers  
Dental fillings (amalgam)  
Gold extraction processes  
Electrical switches and relays  
In modern times, its use has significantly declined due to health concerns. Many countries have replaced mercury with safer alternatives in medical and industrial equipment. However, some online searches still include terms like [buy silver liquid Mercury 99.99 pure](https://dark-net-market.com/buy-silver-liquid-mercury-99-99-pure/), often reflecting interest in mercury’s purity levels rather than its practical or safe applications.

  
Health Risks of Mercury Exposure
-----------------------------------

Mercury is highly toxic, especially in vapor form. Exposure can occur through inhalation, ingestion, or skin contact.  
Some serious health effects include:  
Damage to the nervous system  
Memory problems and cognitive issues  
Kidney damage  
Respiratory problems  
Even small amounts can be dangerous if not handled properly, which is why strict safety measures are required in laboratories and industries.

  
Environmental Impact
-----------------------

Mercury pollution is a major global concern. When released into the environment, it can accumulate in water bodies and enter the food chain.  
Fish and seafood often carry traces of mercury, which can affect human health when consumed in large amounts over time. This process is known as bioaccumulation.

  
Regulations and Safety Measures
----------------------------------

Due to its toxicity, mercury is heavily regulated worldwide. Governments and environmental organizations have introduced strict rules for:  
Storage and transportation  
Disposal of mercury waste  
Industrial usage limits  
International agreements have also been established to reduce mercury pollution and protect both human health and the environment.

  
Conclusion
-------------

Liquid mercury is a fascinating yet dangerous substance. While it played an important role in scientific and industrial development, its risks far outweigh its benefits in many modern applications.  
Understanding its properties, dangers, and regulations helps ensure that it is handled responsibly and replaced with safer alternatives wherever possible.

title.title: Haciendo Anillo engastado de onix (es / en)
title.body: /> Este pasado diciembre sentí que estaba al borde del desastre, sin ver el éxito por ningún lado. Pero, de pronto, apareció a través de internet una clienta nueva; ella encargó varias piezas y, entre las que pidió, esta un anillo con una piedra negra y grande. Para este proyecto, utilicé un ónix que tenía guardado para un momento especial; originalmente pensé que se convertiría en un péndulo, pero su destino final fue ser un anillo. ​Antes de explicar el paso a paso, quiero confesar que no tenía un plan rígido para su elaboración; simplemente partí de una idea base y dejé que el diseño fluyera. **​Materiales y herramientas:** *

>Soldadura Harris (0% plata), bórax como fundente y soplete.
Mandril de anillo.

\n*

>Lápiz, papel y pegamento.
​ Lijas (granos 220, 360 y 400) y lima.

\n*

>Motor de banco, disco de tela y cera para pulir.

\n*

>​Piedra ónix.

​Nota: Intentaré describir el proceso lo mejor posible. Aunque olvidé tomar algunas fotografías durante el desarrollo, espero que la explicación sea clara y detallada. PROCESO =======

/> Tomé el cristal, lo coloqué sobre un papel y con un lápiz tracé su contorno para usarlo como guía. En ese mismo dibujo, proyecté unas líneas hacia afuera que me servirían para orientar el corte de las garras; estas son las que atraparán la piedra y permitirán su engaste. Decidí que seis garras principales serían suficientes y fui dibujando su forma final, dejándome llevar por la fe y la intuición en un momento de confianza absoluta, sin miedo al fracaso. Lamentablemente, olvidé fotografiar cómo quedó ese diseño inicial sobre el papel. ​Posteriormente, recorté el dibujo y lo adherí sobre la lámina de bronce de 1 mm de espesor. Para realizar el calado con la segueta y la sierra 3/0, comencé cortando la silueta exterior, ya que resulta mucho más cómodo para definir la pieza.. .

/> Una vez cortada la silueta agarre un marcador y sobre las garras dibuje lo que será el área de corte interno, está área además de darle un toque interesante al anillo, hará más sencillo el manipular el metal para hacer el engaste, con el Dremel y la fresa de 0.75 mm abrí los huecos para los cortes internos.

/> Quite el papel y mejore en cierta partes los cortes y el acabado, aunque la premisa del diseño no es que quede con las medidas y figura perfecta, sino que se vea con fuerza y carácter, creo es lo más importante para la apariencia de este anillo.
/> Probé de montar la piedra, para ver cómo quedaba, de momento ajuste con los dedos.

/> Después hice la base del anillo, el diseño lo hice a mano doblando un papel y recortando, confiando en el proceso, sin ver para atrás, use la misma lógica de los pasos anteriores, una vez cortado procedí a darle forma con el mandril de anillos.

/> Monte la base del anillo sobre la base del engaste, todo en la piedra refractaria donde suelo soldar las piezas, aplique bórax en las partes donde será la unión y luego fui aplicando fuego con el soplete, para cuándo las piezas estuvieran lo suficientemente caliente poner la soldadura, bueno esto lo hice poco a poco y primero en un lado, luego en el otro, revisando y volviendo a aplicar dónde la soldadura no hubiera corrido bien, esto por qué la pieza del engañaste tiene una superficie curvas...

/> Así quedo después de soldar, toca meter un rato en el ácido para eliminar esas manchas productos del fuego y el bórax. A pesar de que no registre en foto el resto del proceso, básicamente se trato de lijar con las lijas numero 220, 360 y 400, meto la piedra en el anillo para engastar, esto lo hice primero con la mano y después fui apretando un poco con la pinza de joyería, también me ayude con el mango de madera de un martillo, para evitar maltratar la pieza. por ultimo le pase la lija numero 400 y luego pulí con el motor de banco, con el disco de tela y cera de pulir, para darle un acabado tipo espejo, limpio luego con agua y jabón desengranaste.

/>Para mi termino siendo un anillo altamente poderoso, un experimento muy agradable, ademas les cuento que gracias a este anillo continué haciendo trabajos para esta señora, donde la ella confía plenamente en mis capacidades y cada pieza que le mando ella encantada, espero les haya gustado mi relato de como cree este anillo. Si quieres conocer mas de mi trabajo de joyería me puedes agregar a mi Ig: [https://www.instagram.com/m16ueljoyas](https://www.instagram.com/m16ueljoyas) Nota: Las fotos del proceso fueron tomadas por mi y editadas en Snapseed, la imagen de portada la realice con Picsart. * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * \--

/> Last December, I felt like I was on the verge of disaster, with no success in sight. But then, a new client appeared online; she ordered several pieces, including a ring with a large, black stone. For this project, I used an onyx I had been saving for a special occasion; I originally thought it would become a pendulum, but its final destiny was to be a ring. Before explaining the step-by-step process, I want to confess that I didn't have a rigid plan for its creation; I simply started with a basic idea and let the design flow. **Materials and Tools:** + 1mm thick bronze sheet. + Harris solder (0% silver), borax as flux, and torch. Ring mandrel. + Pencil, paper, and glue.

Sandpaper (220, 360, and 400 grit) and file.

+ Bench modeling machine, cloth polishing wheel, and polishing wax. + Jewelry pliers and hammer.

+ Onyx Stone. Note: I will try to describe the process as best as possible. Although I forgot to take some photos during the process, I hope the explanation is clear and detailed. PROCESS =======

/> I took the crystal, placed it on a piece of paper, and traced its outline with a pencil to use as a guide. On that same drawing, I drew lines outward to guide the cutting of the prongs; these are what will hold the stone and allow it to be set. I decided that six main claws would be enough and began sketching their final shape, letting myself be guided by faith and intuition in a moment of absolute confidence, without fear of failure. Unfortunately, I forgot to photograph how that initial design looked on paper. Later, I cut out the drawing and adhered it to the 1 mm thick bronze sheet. To perform the fretwork with the coping saw and 3/0 blade, I started by cutting the outer outline, as it is much easier to define the piece that way.

/> Once the silhouette was cut, I took a marker and drew the area for the internal cut on the prongs. This area, besides giving the ring an interesting touch, will make it easier to manipulate the metal for setting. Using a Dremel and a 0.75 mm bit, I opened the holes for the internal cuts.

/> I removed the paper and improved the cuts and finish in some areas. The design premise isn't perfect measurements and shape, but rather a strong and distinctive look. I believe that's the most important aspect of this ring's appearance.
/> I tried setting the stone to see how it looked. For now, I'm adjusting it with my fingers.

/> Next, I made the ring base. I created the design by hand, folding and cutting paper, trusting the process and not looking back. I used the same logic as in the previous steps. Once cut, I shaped it with the ring mandrel.

/> I mounted the ring base onto the setting, all on the refractory stone where I usually solder the pieces. I applied borax to the areas where the joint would be and then heated them with the torch. When the pieces were hot enough, I applied the solder. I did this little by little, first on one side, then the other, checking and reapplying solder where it hadn't flowed well, because the setting piece has a curved surface...

/> This is how it looks after soldering. It needs to be soaked in acid for a while to remove the stains from the fire and borax. Although I didn't photograph the rest of the process, it basically involved sanding with 220, 360, and 400 grit sandpaper. I then inserted the stone into the ring for setting. I did this first by hand and then tightened it a little with jewelry pliers. I also used the wooden handle of a hammer to avoid damaging the piece. Finally, I smoothed it down.

/> For me, it ended up being a highly powerful ring, a very enjoyable experiment. I should also mention that thanks to this ring, I continued doing work for this lady, who fully trusts my abilities and is delighted with every piece I send her. I hope you enjoyed my story of how I created this ring.


If you'd like to see more of my jewelry work, you can add me on Instagram:

[https://www.instagram.com/m16ueljoyas](https://www.instagram.com/m16ueljoyas)

Note: I took the process photos and edited them in Snapseed. I created the cover image with Picsart.

title.title: Semiya Custard - Traditional Indian Dessert....
title.body:
____________________________________
# <center> Namaste 🇮🇳🙏🏻</center>
____________________________________


Hello Friends, How are you all ?? Wishing you all happy and prosperous life Ahead.

Today i would like to share the recipe of **Semiya Custard** delicious & tasty traditional indian dessert recipe made with full cream milk and vermicelli(semiya), basically a fusion of traditional milk-based semiya kheer. Vermicelli custard used to be made during festivals here, as it is considered auspicious. It is easy and healthy dessert you can try it anytime as it contains minimal ingredients and tasted Delicious. As i have craving of eating Something hot healthy delicious desserts, so I randomly cooked it.

![1000653128.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/EpJaxeschBC3TdFFwsVLqFr5qNoDCq1GfNFEcqZ2Qu8qa3kCHrCCYyGeGZkcsQnuZdy.jpg)



____________________________________
# <center> Timming 🕡</center>
____________________________________

|Preparation Time|5 Minutes|
|-|-|
|Cooking Time| 20 Minutes|
|Cuisine|Indian|
|Course|Dessert|
|Serving|3-4 Person|




____________________________________
# <center> Ingredients 📃</center>
____________________________________

• ½ tsp ghee(clarified butter).
• 1 cup vermicelli(semiya).
• 1 Litre of fresh milk.
• 2 tbsp of custard Powder.
• ¼ cup sugar.
• 2 Cardomon.
• chopped Dryfruits of Your Choice.



____________________________________
# <center> Process 👨🏻‍🍳</center>
____________________________________


![1000652117.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23zbTmLpWv6ZzerrQ9apEyX5wjbvX24druui45hTB7xyQk7RaUAhP5gKikMg5Ldyquj8L.jpg)

Heat the ghee in the Pan, Roast the semiya on lower flame.


![1000652121.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23yd8Dm71BdY3GkqAaTiJWgbwW5oK9KFAgLx72NVs2ArDVmSd4q1v4F4YQnGrKHRjRbEY.jpg)

Keep stirring the semiya to avoid burning, Roast until the semiya turns golden brown.

![1000652120.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23yd8PwijFGejEvNjToBryzGRceQQuKd3RdpENLJXeJtgnkmdxCWddy9McieCmd9hTMHs.jpg)

In the same kadai, pour the milk and add Cardamom Powder.

![1000652123.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23xAga7cQvVQmipLtTfhgTwXaMF5Vo8qEf5qvcptm7F1f18jENyBGnYTuFru3Z5gqCXkj.jpg)


Then add Sugar, stir well and get the milk to a boil.




![1000652116.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23z7JCubNzyq1Qoe3tzcD1Xq2wN4ULiEtJGMbjv9RoiW2kq4oY21ybwt4r4StA6eL7Hmk.jpg)

Add the milk powder to thick the consistency of the milk, boil for 7-8 minutes or until semiya gets cooked completely.
____________________________________




![1000652122.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23xL2sZepPea2878sTCHd6JUuk5yEYJMVuLrJXXWdmWiSdGZKsfnPsgUtbA7muS5AEwLg.jpg)

Stir continuously, cook until the milk thickens and turns creamy.

![1000652125.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23tvnk9MNBzJUXx5rZBHXfjqcHkwrGoMUMLj4i2EEdc1EYr6t34bXb3wJE5aw3F1mBu1Q.jpg)

Garnish it with Dryfruits, Serve the hot Semiya Custard. If you want to eat it cold, refrigerate it for 2–3 hours; it tastes delicious chilled.
____________________________________


It's Delicious and easy to cook recipe, try it. 'm sure you are gonna love it. Try this recipe and let me know how it is. For more indian cuisine stay connected to my blogs.


**Don't share my posts or pictures in any other platform without my Permission**

title.title: Sporting memories:  The day I finally learned now to hit a baseball
title.body: I excelled at almost all sports as a child, a teenager, and as a 20 something.  I went to college on a full athletic scholarship and during negotiations ( I was recruited by multiple schools) it was discussed that maybe I could walk on for the American football team at that school as well.  I know this was just the guy trying to \

to get me to go to that school because although I think I was pretty gifted as an athlete, there are only a handful of people that have ever lived that can pull that off and I don't think I was one of them.  I didn't end up going to that school by the way because it as Division-1...  It was James Madison University in Virginia, which isn't a bad school but not on the level of the other schools I was recruited by, which were Miami (FL) and UNC.\n\nThrough all of this excellence though, there was one sport that completely eluded me, and that was baseball.   I wasn't just \

, I was terrible.   
<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sports.guy55/Ep1c9F5Bd9u3PXTyjGaGs8o3VJjDbzDEA3wucMdKrmHraRoUpZTNhrPcnvA8VRQ2RpN.png)
[src](https://www.shutterstock.com/image-vector/cartoon-boy-hitting-baseball-bat-260nw-120826573.jpg)</center> 


In young leagues the teams and coaches are forced to let everyone play regardless of ability but one of the things that they do with the kids who suck is to put them in right or left (out) field.   The worst player is normally reserved for left field and guess where I always played?   

I couldn't hit either and it wasn't by lack of trying.  My father tried to help me to learn this as did the coaches on the two or three teams I played on before eventually giving up the sport, but it just didn't click.   With all my hand/eye coordination in basketball, football, and especially soccer, I guess I just wasn't meant for the swing motion of baseball.  I also had a really weak throw despite the fact that I could throw a football spiral like nobody's business.

None of it made sense to me and I just resigned myself to the fact that you can be good at everything.   I did end up going to support the high school baseball team though and I think they appreciated it.  What they didn't realize was that I was in awe that they had the ability to do this because it was something that just seemed like magic to me at the time even though i would destroy them at any of the other sports.   

IT wasn't until I was in my 20's and beyond college and all my dreams of going pro had been dashed (I didn't really have any notions of going pro... that wasn't really a thing in USA at the time outside of the truly top talent), that I was just hanging out in a bar where I had a temporary job and they just happened to have batting cages upstairs at this bar.  

<center> https://media-cdn.tripadvisor.com/media/photo-s/08/7d/0e/bb/slugger-s-world-class.jpg
[src](https://media-cdn.tripadvisor.com/media/photo-s/08/7d/0e/bb/slugger-s-world-class.jpg)
<sub> absolute chaos </sub> </center> 

This was a long time ago and for the most part this is no longer legal because we are a bunch of pussies as a society now, but back then if you wanted to, you could get raginigly drunk and then go have 80 mph fast balls thrown at you.   There wasn't even anyone there monitoring the situation:  You bought tokens on the ground floor and went upstairs and got in the cage and had a swing.

It was at this time that a work colleague of mine that was really into baseball pointed out that everything about my stance was wrong and he did an example both in and outside of the cage showing me how I should stand, and how I should swing in order to get some juice behind the hit.

<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sports.guy55/242NcUT2MaaDkTy1CAGTxGy2wd14ntJULorpG79e55A1MwoQGMGuud26BVCQsvBWqs4gq.png)
[src](https://media.defense.gov/2011/Aug/29/2000224573/-1/-1/0/110825-F-WZ808-070.JPG)</center> 
 </center>

It only took me about $2 worth of tokens to figure this out and the next thing you know I was hitting zingers with almost every ball that was being tossed at me by the machine.   

This felt good but it also opened my eyes to the absolutely abysmal state of coaching that existed in the United States when I was a kid.   Basically, the parents were the coaches and it didn't matter at all if they actually had any coaching abilities for the job.  Many of my coaches were overweight, carried rulebooks with them (because they didn't know the game) and one of them was permanently disabled.   I guess when we are talking about 300 million people and the fact that none of these \

were being paid and were just donating their time, that we can't get too fussy.    \n\nIt is just funny to me that my friend, who had never been a coach and only played something like 1 or 2 years in high school, was able to accomplish more in that batting cage after 4 beers than several years of weekly \

at the hands of people who claimed to have a real passion for the sport.

I wasn't on assignment for that job for very long but we ended up going back to that batting cage a number of times and even now, 20 years later, I still go to a batting cage every now and then even though the over-the-top safety requirements are so annoying and as a result, the price to do it is 10x what it used to be.   

They took all the fun out of it because a few idiots got hit by a ball... That's what I have to imagine happened.

In most companies, they do these team-building days where they will normally play softball with a neutral pitcher who is just serving up easy to hit balls for everyone.   I had normally been a useless player at these things in the past but now, and I didn't tell anyone, I was basically the Babe Ruth of my team.   

At my first at bat I hit the ball so far out that I got a home run.  There was no fence as this was just a park field, but it was so far away that I easily cleared the bases before the ball made it back to the infield.  At me second at bat the \

of the other team told everyone to back very far back and said some complimentary things about my ability.   I then bunted to the pitcher who as I said, is a neutral player and isn't allowed to participate in any defense.   That might be the one and only time that anyone had ever gotten a triple off of a bunt, but I will admit that this was because the person who stepped in at 2nd base couldn't catch a ball to save her life.   

Coaching is such an important part of developing skills in kids as far as sports are concerned, and the absolute lack of that existing when I was kid in terms of baseball is likely the main reason why I never developed the ability to hit until I was a legal adult.  It actually was really easy to understand as well and I had it worked out in less than an hour.   

It often makes me wonder if I could have been a 4-sport superstar if only someone had come along and told me these things when I was 8.   Testament to my Dad, he did try.  But my own father grew up not playing baseball either because he lived in a small farm town where you wouldn't be able to get that many people together to play a game anyway.  He didn't know what he was doing, but he sure as hell tried.  

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sports.guy55/23xL2iTUzAGKQZPRbofxrwX8k9Xi2xxPEXeroCBET9hB6By421hNUPde93CpAvKKZkKMi.png)
[src](https://media1.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTZjMDliOTUycHl4NGV4a2pmbzB2cHhkaDljOGZlbnZjZGZwcHZrMHIycG1ocTV3NSZlcD12MV9naWZzX3NlYXJjaCZjdD1n/3o72EXFVvwLad5b928/giphy_s.gif)
<sub> so what you want to do son, is just hit the ball really really hard every time </sub> </center> 


I would later end up volunteering my own time to help out with youth sports, namely soccer (yes, I know the world calls it football - we can't help where we were born), and I like to think that I made a genuine difference in the lives of these kids because when they listened to my tactics, they actually did improve a great deal.   The high school that I attended offered me the coaching job and while it was an honor it was terrible money they were offering and I lived nowhere near there.  I would have set myself up for a life of almost certain near-poverty if I had said yes.  But when I did go back for a visit I always sat in on sessions with the varsity team and it made me feel good when the coach talked about my resume and how I played for a Division-1 college on a \

scholarship.   I no longer offer to do this now though, because the attitude of the kids these days is something I can no longer tolerate.   \n\nBaseball is just like any other sport though.  I truly believe that if you have the mindset of achieving excellence that you can do so.  It doesn't hurt of course, if you have some pretty good genetics and I'm not going to lie, that certainly helped me.   But in the meantime if your kid sucks at a sport, there is a good chance that the fault may just lie in the coaching or in the times that I was playing, a near complete absence of it.

title.title: Explore the Lhoknga beach tourism, and capture the beauty of the surrounding area.
title.body: Good evening to all my friends.Wherever you are, I hope you are well. 😘♥️ --------------------------------------------------------------------------

/> * * * * * * On this very happy occasion, I am back with all my friends in this beloved community. I would like to share my valuable experience with you all about a trip to a tourist destination, Lhoknga Beach. We took this trip a few weeks ago, and I've already shared it with you all. However, I'm very eager to share this experience with you all. Let's take a look at the beautiful beach I visited. This is a very well-known tourist attraction in Banda Aceh. Many people who vacation in Banda Aceh definitely stop by. When I arrived at the beach, I immediately headed to a food stall there, wanting to rest for a while before exploring the beautiful beach. The place was very simple, made entirely of wood, very neatly and beautifully, making it very comfortable to enjoy the atmosphere, accompanied by several plants around us.

/> After that, my friend and I put our things on the bench provided at the stall. After putting our things there, I continued to the front of the stall area because I wanted to see the atmosphere around the tourist area and also wanted to see the beauty of the beach from the front. I went to the front of the beach area where I stood on the pebbles that were placed on top of the sand. There were also several seats provided on the pebbles to relax so that we could feel the wider air and there were also several fertile plants that could produce fresh air.

/> As I was enjoying the atmosphere in front of the tourist area, I noticed the beautiful scenery surrounding the beach, including mountains and dense trees in the distance. Seats are provided on the gravel in front of this tourist area to ensure visitors' comfort while enjoying the scenery. If the gravel is covered, the sand will be firm, preventing users from swaying while sitting on the chairs provided. After that, I couldn't resist stepping on the sand at the edge of the beach. My friend and I headed to the beachfront, where there were several large rocks. I wanted to enjoy the atmosphere and the fresh sea breeze. So I headed to the sand and captured some of the beauty of our time there.

/> After that, I saw a rock situated on the white sand, and my friend and I decided to climb it. We could feel the air getting stronger and stronger. Around us were dense trees growing luxuriantly along the sand. It seemed these trees had grown naturally or were planted by local residents. I'm not sure, because by the time I first got to know this beach, there were already many shady trees surrounding the beach. My friend and I spent a while enjoying the atmosphere on the rocks by the sea, gazing out into the vast and beautiful ocean.

/> After spending some time on the rocks along the beach, my friend and I decided to head back to where we first sat at the beach. It took about five minutes for us to reach the first food stall where we rested. We had spent some time exploring the beach, strolling along the shoreline to take in the atmosphere and natural beauty. While walking home, I felt very comfortable walking along the beach. Before leaving, I took a few more photos of the lush green trees growing along the shoreline. There weren't many people there when we visited, perhaps because the weather was very hot, so people decided to go somewhere safer to escape the heat. We were able to walk back to where we first rested. I took a few more pictures, for example, of me walking on the white sand by the sea.

>

সকালে একটা সময় সবাই ওঠার ঠিক আগে, যেটা পুরোপুরি আমার নিজের।
হয়তো কুড়ি মিনিট, হয়তো ত্রিশ। কখনো কখনো তারও কম। কিন্তু এই কয়টা মিনিটে আমি কারো বউ না, কারো মা না, কারো বৌমা না। আমি শুধু আমি — রান্নাঘরে চায়ের কাপ হাতে বসে থাকা একজন মানুষ, যে জানালার বাইরে পৃথিবীটাকে ধীরে ধীরে জেগে উঠতে দেখছে।
কখন থেকে এই সময়টাকে আঁকড়ে ধরা শুরু করেছি জানি না। হয়তো সেদিন থেকে, যেদিন বুঝলাম যদি সকালের একটুখানি সময় নিজের জন্য না রাখি, তাহলে সারাটা দিন শুধু অন্যদের জন্যই কেটে যাবে। রান্না, ঘর গোছানো, সবার চিন্তা — এগুলো সব অপেক্ষায় থাকে। থাকবেই। কিন্তু এই কুড়ি মিনিট আমি ওদের একটু অপেক্ষা করাই।
সাড়ে পাঁচটার দিকে উঠি। বাড়ি তখনো অন্ধকার, চুপচাপ। সবাই ঘুমে। বাইরের রাস্তাও প্রায় নিস্তব্ধ — দূর থেকে কোনো রিকশার শব্দ, বা একটা পাখির ডাক যে বোধহয় জানে না এখনই ডাকার সময় হয়নি।
রান্নাঘরে যাই বড় বাতি না জ্বালিয়ে। শুধু চুলার ওপরের ছোট্ট বাতিটা। চা বসাই আর দাঁড়িয়ে দাঁড়িয়ে ধোঁয়া উঠতে দেখি। শুনতে কিছুই মনে হয় না। কিন্তু অনুভব করতে অনেক কিছু।
আদা-এলাচ দিয়ে একটু কড়া চা বানাই। চিনি ছাড়া — দুই বছর হলো ছেড়েছি, প্রতিদিন সকালে নিজেকে নিয়ে একটু গর্ব হয়। দু হাতে কাপটা ধরে জানালার কাছে যাই।
বাইরে আকাশ প্রতিদিন আলাদা কিছু করে। কোনো কোনো সকালে গাঢ় নীল, যেটা দেখলে একসাথে ছোট আর নিরাপদ লাগে। কোনো সকালে মেঘগুলো পুরনো গোলাপের রঙ ধরে। আর কোনো কোনো সকালে শুধু ধূসর, সাধারণ — আর অদ্ভুতভাবে সেই সকালগুলোতেই সবচেয়ে বেশি শান্তি লাগে। মনে হয় আকাশটাও শুধু বিশ্রাম নিচ্ছে। শ্বাস নিচ্ছে। কিছু হওয়ার চেষ্টা করছে না।
এই সময়টায় অনেক ভাবি। বড় চিন্তা না — কোনো সমস্যার সমাধান না, কোনো পরিকল্পনা না। ছোট ছোট কথা। গত সপ্তাহে মায়ের সাথে কী কথা হয়েছিল মনে পড়ে, হাসি পায়। ভাবি দুপুরে কী রাঁধব, তারপর নিজেকেই বলি এটা সকালের চিন্তা না, সরিয়ে রাখি। জানালার ওপাশের ছাদে একটা কাক বসে মাথা কাত করে আমার দিকে তাকায়, আমি চুপ করে হাসি — হয়তো সত্যিই সে আমাকে বিচার করছে।
কোনো কোনো সকালে নামাজ পড়ি। কোনো কোনো সকালে শুধু বসে থাকি। দুটো আমার কাছে একইরকম লাগে — নিজের চেয়ে বড় কিছুর সাথে কথা বলার মতো।
সোয়া ছটার দিকে শব্দ শুরু হয়। একটা দরজা খোলে। কোনো বাচ্চা বিছানায়寝返りを打つ। শাশুড়ি তার ঘরে আস্তে কাশেন — সংসারের দিন শুরুর সংকেত। শেষ চুমুক দিই চায়ের, যেটা তখন ঠান্ডা হয়ে এসেছে। কাপটা সিঙ্কে রাখি।
আর তারপর শুরু হয়।
চাল ধোয়া। প্রেশার কুকার চড়ানো। টিফিন বক্স সাজানো। স্কুলের ব্যাগ দেখা। ওষুধ গোছানো। নাস্তা বানানো, পরিবেশন করা, পরিষ্কার করা। সবাই বেরিয়ে যাওয়া। বাড়ি আবার চুপ — কিন্তু এই চুপ আলাদা। এটা ঘুমের চুপ না, এটা মানুষে ভরা একটা জায়গা খালি হয়ে যাওয়ার চুপ।
সবাই চলে গেলে ঠিক পাঁচ মিনিট বসি। মাত্র পাঁচ। রান্নাঘরের দিকে তাকাই — ছড়ানো ভাতের দানা, ভেজা কাপড়, এখনো একটু শোঁ শোঁ করতে থাকা প্রেশার কুকার — আর মনে একটা অনুভূতি হয় যেটার নাম ঠিক জানি না। ক্লান্তি না ঠিক। তৃপ্তি না ঠিক। দুটোর মাঝামাঝি কিছু। যেটা বলে: আজকেও হলো। আরেকটা সকাল। আরেকটা শুরু।
নয় বছর ধরে গৃহিণী। এই জীবন বেছেছিলাম, আবারও বেছে নিতাম। কিন্তু সত্যি বলতে — কখনো কখনো এই কাজগুলো অদৃশ্য মনে হয়। মেঝে নোংরা না হলে কেউ বোঝে না যে সেটা পরিষ্কার ছিল। পঁয়তাল্লিশ মিনিটের রান্না তিন মিনিটে শেষ হয়ে যায়। সারাদিন ঢেলে দাও, দিন শেষে দেখানোর মতো কিছু নেই।
তাই সকালটা এত দামি। বিশেষ বা সুন্দর বলে না। ইন্সটাগ্রামের ছবির মতো বলে না। শুধু এই কারণে যে ওই কুড়ি মিনিটে, দেওয়া শুরু হওয়ার আগে, আমি শুধু নিজের জন্য থাকি। চা খাই। আকাশ দেখি। ছোট ছোট কথা ভাবি।
আর সেটুকুই যথেষ্ট, বাকি সারাটা দিন পার করে দেওয়ার জন্য।

যদি আপনাদের জীবনেও এরকম কোনো ছোট্ট সময় থাকে যেটা শুধু আপনার নিজের — নিচে জানাতে পারেন। 🌸

title.title: Daily Development Update: Hive React Kit Favourite Enhancements, Media Fixes, and Multi-Currency Wallet
title.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1776057334076-be2b16964374b8bb.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=sagarkothari88/bafd4e9a)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=sagarkothari88/bafd4e9a)


---

## Hive React Kit
### Enhance Favourite Functionality with Auto Visibility and Visual States

- feat: enhance favourite functionality with auto visibility and visual states.
- Auto-show favourite icons based on callback presence.
- Removed manual visibility props (`isFavListVisible`, `isAddToFavVisible`).
- Added `isFavourited` for heart fill state (red/outline).
- Added `favouriteCount` with badge display (\

cap).
- Updated navbar and profile heart UI.
- Updated docs and example usage with new props.


Favourite Icon States (Filled vs Outline)
![Favourite Icon States (Outline)](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sagarkothari88/23tbPY12bpkkAtWhqzfKzVPwc5vBY9yL4nNHN8r2yvvMmBj5RPJgM9AE7ShyK4xs4zu6f.png)

Favourite Icon States (Filled) & Favourite Count Badge UI
![Favourite Icon States (Filled)](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sagarkothari88/23tbPAiQMS1S5nU2UCMdQmyaKDXqSTboih1sXubvkrismHaRo7kxfEa5i9Rb5oyhEPTrp.png)


---

### UI Improvements and Navigation Enhancements

- Defined scrollbar-hide utility and hid scrollbar on main container.
- Added left/right arrow buttons on tab bar when tabs overflow.

Scrollable Tabs with Arrow Navigation
![Scrollable Tabs with Arrow Navigation](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sagarkothari88/23tbPhzUvrRJgY3t72dJwTHj2ggcpCHMa4eRhWgbsMUCHjdmZDjvqWqYtG1fuZK3DutQr.png)


---

### Media Rendering Fixes (3Speak and Video Handling)

- Fixed 3Speak iframe with native video player and compact audio.
- Fixed portrait video zoom/cropping using `object-fit: contain`.
- Wrapped 3Speak audio iframe in compact container.
- Removed extra white space and scrollbar from audio player.

Fixed Video Layout
![Fixed Video Layout](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sagarkothari88/23tGVYdeQ4uy4oQkqRYGNg4CZmJvwbFxJ2ro4maof4Q1dUU255wq4y7Ddhhj7DTBxtqQL.png)


Compact Audio Player UI
![Compact Audio Player UI](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sagarkothari88/23wgHqVGEhmnxagdUJKAAC3fzPa268kEJEZzquMWFYvX9Qr4NwbwJYJqKVYMKW9XbZ8NR.png)


---

### Landing Page Updates

- Landing Page UI Component Updated.
- hSurvey App Status moved from planned to in Development Category.

Updated Landing Page UI
![Updated Landing Page UI](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sagarkothari88/Eo43qveFMypXGLvR9dJLgBb4ypjT26iSJpzYNJ1KDtbsQoUJyNhhuQqtzynsnrF6a9y.png)


---

### Add Multi-Currency Support with Local Currency Detection in Wallet

- Detect local currency via system timezone.
- Fetch exchange rates in a single API call.
- Default estimated value to local currency.
- Added currency dropdown (USD, local, others).
- Enabled instant switching using cached rates.
- Used narrowSymbol for clean currency display.

Wallet with Multi-Currency Dropdown
![Wallet with Multi-Currency Dropdown](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sagarkothari88/23wLvQaoiQdYoxH2Y2QdxCetaoFsRYnkjrXCLYaVxKsJMuY6MuDmSry8Fqj7euQne8Xy4.png)

Local Currency Display in Wallet
![Local Currency Display in Wallet](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sagarkothari88/23wWKF5G1M9BwviZjPmGjLdACXhLXXxLkdZZG7vEoCwhzWPUm6uiswoFi2dmjT7uqpnMr.png)


---

## Powering the Hive Ecosystem

- Continuously improving Hive applications with a focus on stability, performance, and scalability  
- Contributing to open-source development and building reusable solutions for the community  
- Working towards a stronger, more accessible, and feature-rich Hive ecosystem

title.title: Hive Philippines Travel and Nature Photography #1138 - by Allmonitors
title.body:
#1138 - More of Pagudpud Ilocos Norte Shots for Wednesday. 

Hello my wonderful Hive community! Happy Wednesday to all no matter where you are. May your Wednesday be filled with peace, good vibes and inspiration. Stay safe and let's get into the rest of the week with positive energy😉.

For our daily shots during a late afternoon when we stayed along the beautiful shorelines of Pagudpud, Ilocos Norte. Our resort was right in front of the sea and lucky for us, there was a short path that led directly to the beach from the back of our resort. My wife, son Joaquin and Dandreb and I decided to head out here. The afternoon sun was no longer harsh as it cast a golden glow over the entire coast. 
![1000000450.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23x12siHyrABcHypGS6dYpyLk6rifc8YaivoSaNLjnaqopgernthMVXaY8AYjDry3wNac.jpg)

We spent our time simply enjoying the sand and the saltwater and how fine and powdery the sand was. It felt incredibly soft under the feet, unlike the coarse sand I was used to in other places. 
![1000000469.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23wgTtpDCnEPvMQ9Hro5SZUKmUBxJCFWKP6h89itAdZKAT9pvyrn3rpXEGVEygDEv6qjx.jpg)

We walked along the water's edge, letting the tiny waves lap at our foot. The water was cool and it felt relaxing to just walk in and let the ocean wash over our tired legs. 
![1000000429.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/2449t5A97tNNrjB6NzBPYA4F1YSePoc4SnSFftwGFEEi4WrjcVebecrFcHkQL2AekfskY.jpg)

We didn't do anything extravagant. We found a good spot to chill, stand and let the wet sand pack beneath our toes. We watched the local dogs enjoy the water too while we chatted about our long trip, held hands with wife enjoying the quiet moment. 
![1000000478.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23tmHeaZt526sLnbTysJ2GBiL8R9tH4ZRQapkT5BdvCr6gnGPzaWuBcVjQ1ETjMB33HQC.jpg)

As the time passes by, the sky started to change colors. We stayed there until the sun sets. It was a spectacular finale to our day. We watched in silence as the sun finally sank below the horizon. It was the perfect end to a tiring afternoon in Pagudpud. 

![1000000435.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23vi25GZNZF7uLPtVytV72fJ5d5eUDhUofMwJWRMrvsxphjp8y587niUr6nVA74MtNmZJ.jpg)

Follow me on my nature travels.
Shot taken in Pagudpud Ilocos Norte, Philippines.

<center>Image/s were shot using Samsung Z5 flip phone. ~rex</center>

title.title: Black-kneed conehead
title.body: > On a gently curving green stem, a black-kneed conehead stood in full swing. Its striking coloration caught my attention. Its body was so small it was almost invisible, but fortunately, its bright colors made it a little easier to locate. This was my first time encountering this insect. Its tiny body made it difficult to photograph. I took many pictures, but most of them were poor.

> It's not just its body that's interesting to look at. But look at its very long antennae, twice as long as its body. Its long antennae curved gracefully forward, occasionally moving them with very gentle movements. Its antennae looked as if it were writing directions in the air. Its thin legs tightly gripped the stubble it was standing on, balancing itself so it wouldn't fall when the wind invited it to dance.

> To our eyes, this insect may look very small. But it's also important to know that behind that tiny body lies a courage that we often lack. One of the courage it displayed today was that it didn't run away when I approached it very close. All I saw was him relaxed, as if nothing was happening around him. I didn't know what he was really feeling as he stood there quietly, grumbling.

title.title: Why Every Freelancer Needs Financial Clarity: A Beginner’s Guide to Smarter Money Management
title.body:
Working for yourself can be incredibly rewarding—you set your own schedule, choose your clients, and control your income. But with that freedom comes responsibility, especially when it comes to managing your finances. Many freelancers and independent workers struggle with tracking income, understanding taxes, and staying compliant with regulations. This is where [accountants for self employed](https://accotax.co.uk/self-employed-accountants/) professionals become especially valuable.

In this article, we’ll break down the essentials of financial management for freelancers in a simple, practical way. Whether you're just starting out or looking to improve your system, this guide will help you build confidence and clarity.

## Understanding Your Financial Responsibilities

When you’re self-employed, you’re essentially running a small business—even if it’s just you. This means you’re responsible for:

*
    Tracking all income and expenses


*
    Filing taxes accurately and on time


*
    Managing cash flow


*
    Keeping records for legal and financial purposes


Unlike salaried employees, taxes are not automatically deducted from your earnings. You need to calculate and set aside money yourself, which can feel overwhelming at first.

### Why It Matters

Failing to manage these responsibilities can lead to penalties, missed deductions, or even legal trouble. On the other hand, good financial habits can help you save money, reduce stress, and grow your business sustainably.

## Common Challenges Freelancers Face

Many beginners encounter similar issues when handling their finances:

### 1. Irregular Income

Freelancers often deal with inconsistent earnings. One month may be highly profitable, while the next could be slow. This makes budgeting and planning more complex.

### 2. Mixing Personal and Business Finances

Using one account for everything can create confusion. It becomes harder to track expenses and identify business-related deductions.

### 3. Lack of Tax Knowledge

Understanding tax rules, deadlines, and allowable deductions isn’t always straightforward. Missing key details can cost you money.

## Simple Steps to Stay Organized

You don’t need to be a finance expert to manage your money effectively. Start with these basic steps:

### Create a Separate Business Account

Open a dedicated bank account for your freelance income and expenses. This keeps your records clean and easier to manage.

### Track Every Transaction

Use a spreadsheet or accounting software to record:

*
    Payments received


*
    Business expenses


*
    Invoices issued


Consistency is more important than complexity. Even a simple system works if you maintain it regularly.

### Save for Taxes

A good rule of thumb is to set aside a percentage of every payment for taxes. This prevents last-minute stress when tax season arrives.

## The Role of a Professional Accountant

While you can handle basic tasks on your own, there comes a point where professional help becomes valuable. Accountants do more than just file taxes—they offer insights that can improve your financial health.

### What They Can Help With

*
    Accurate tax filing and compliance


*
    Identifying deductions to reduce your tax burden


*
    Financial planning and forecasting


*
    Advising on business growth strategies


Having expert guidance ensures that you’re not missing opportunities or making costly mistakes.

## Choosing the Right Support

Not all accountants specialize in freelance or independent work, so it’s important to find someone who understands your needs.

### What to Look For

*
    Experience with self-employed clients


*
    Clear communication and willingness to explain concepts


*
    Transparent pricing


*
    Familiarity with local tax laws


A good accountant should feel like a partner, not just a service provider.

## Building Financial Confidence

Managing your finances isn’t just about numbers—it’s about gaining control over your work and future.

### Develop Good Habits Early

*
    Review your finances weekly or monthly


*
    Keep digital copies of receipts


*
    Plan ahead for slow periods


### Keep Learning

Basic financial literacy goes a long way. Understanding terms like profit, expenses, and cash flow helps you make smarter decisions.

## When to Seek Help

If you find yourself:

*
    Spending too much time on bookkeeping


*
    Feeling unsure about tax rules


*
    Missing deadlines or making errors


…it may be time to get professional assistance. Even occasional consultations can provide clarity and peace of mind.

## Conclusion

Being self-employed offers independence and flexibility, but it also requires careful financial management. By staying organized, building simple habits, and seeking expert support when needed, you can turn a potentially stressful aspect of freelancing into a source of confidence.

Understanding your finances isn’t just about compliance—it’s about empowering yourself to make better decisions, grow your income, and create long-term stability in your self-employed journey.
