title.title: You Cannot Pour From An Empty Cup
title.body: >\n\nNo one can give from what they do not have. Imagine someone promising to give you something that they do not have, how will it make them to look like? Someone once said that \

This does not just talk about cap literally. It means that someone can only give from what they have. In life, you cannot service the needs of humanity if you have not built the means. This is why you have to learn to build and develop yourself to the point that you can become an answer to the needs of others. To pour from your cup, you have to fill your cup first.

<center>![20260421_184214.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmc9KjxMYkBSbATnyALzTC9MMJd2KNdMH1LVnFeFcfP29d/20260421_184214.jpg)</center>

<center><sub>Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/barista-pouring-specialty-coffee-into-glass-mug-34470146)</sub></center>

A friend of mine, while growing up, had passion to help the people within her community with health-related issues. But she could not, because she lacked the necessary requirements and skills for it. After she finished her secondary education, she went on to pursue a career in Public Health Nursing. After that, she got employed under a programme in the Ministry of Health. This was what gave her the access she needed to reach out to her community. She started organising health outreach in collaboration with other agencies. It was possible for her to help others because she first developed herself. You see, it was from the abundance of what she already has that it was possible for her to give to others.

In the pursuit of success, responsibilities, and service to others, a lot of people tend to forget that you cannot pour anything from a cup that has nothing. In other words, you will not be able to give your best; your time, energy, effort, love, etc, when you are emotionally, mentally and physically drained. You need to take care of yourself first, so you will be able to do the same for other. Taking care of yourself, working on yourself, upgrading and gathering more skills, are not acts of selfishness, rather they are necessities that you need to do to help yourself, so you can help others.

There are some people that take pride in constantly being busy, always available for others, always giving and giving. They always push themselves to attend to the needs of others, meet expectations, support people, and even handle responsibilities without rest. At the initial, this may appear admirable, but along the line, it may lead to exhaustion. What you need to understand is that when you are drained, it will affect your effectiveness, and it will also reduce it. Even if you show up, you may not give your best. You have to fill up yourself first so you will be able to pour out when it is required.

I once followed one of my Uncles for his farming activities many years ago when I went for vacation in his house. I noticed that before he would talk about harvesting anything from his farmland, he would have already planted crops on the farm during the planting season. Then when the harvesting season comes, he will have what to harvest. In the same way in life and in other aspects of life, it is what you have put inside you that you will bring out when the time comes for it. For example, you should not wait for opportunities to come first before you build up yourself or develop capacity to handle it. You have to develop the required capacity and skills to handle it first. So when it comes, you will simply deliver from what you already have.

<center>![pexels-silverkblack-36764558.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmYrYpGFNXsKj9QbeusacUtK9QwEJ6byUHHeurisNxnnwb/pexels-silverkblack-36764558.jpg)</center>

<center><sub>Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/overhead-view-of-workspace-with-laptop-36764558)</sub></center>

Have you ever asked yourself this; \

One of the reasons why a lot of people do not recognise opportunities is because they are not even prepared for them. You will be surprised how lots of opportunities are around you and even passing by, but until you are prepared for them, you may not even recognise them. There is no limit to what can be achieved, but you have to understand that it is what you put in that you will be able to bring out. A friend once said; \

In this video, I go over an example of obtaining and graphing the velocity and acceleration vectors of an object moving in 3D whose position vector is known. This follows from my earlier video in which I showed that the velocity of an object is just the derivative of its position vector, and likewise, the acceleration is the derivative of the velocity vector — hence the second derivative of the position vector. The speed of the moving object is obtained just by the magnitude or length of the velocity vector, which we can calculate using the distance formula in 3 dimensions. I also plot this out in the amazing GeoGebra 3D graphing calculator, which you can play around with here: https://www.geogebra.org/3d/h7epqemu

title.title: Sustainable Lawn Care: Smarter Ways to Maintain a Healthier Yard
title.body:
Sustainable lawn care gets talked about mostly in terms of what to stop doing — stop using chemical fertilizers, stop overwatering, stop applying pesticides. That's a reasonable starting point, but it misses the bigger picture. How you mow, what equipment you use, and how consistently you maintain your yard have just as much impact on long-term lawn health and environmental footprint as anything you spray or spread.

The good news is that a more sustainable yard routine and a lower-effort one largely overlap. The habits that are better for your lawn tend to be better for your time, your wallet, and the environment — often at the same time.

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPZgrKZDm1oggAbiQRBSBQfSjj34wWTEtPZp2xd4afrEe/image.png)

**The Hidden Costs of a Traditional Yard Maintenance Routine**

*Time and physical effort that adds up season after season*

The average homeowner spends over 70 hours a year on lawn maintenance. Mowing alone accounts for the bulk of that — and unlike most household tasks, it resets completely every week from spring through fall. It's one of the few chores where the effort required never decreases, no matter how many times you've done it.

That time cost is easy to overlook because it arrives in small weekly increments. But across a full season, it represents real hours that could be spent elsewhere — and a level of physical effort that becomes harder to sustain as households age.

*Gas-powered equipment and its ongoing environmental footprint*

A conventional gas lawn mower running for one hour produces roughly the same emissions as driving a car for 45 miles. Across a full mowing season, that's a significant and largely invisible environmental cost attached to what feels like a routine weekend chore.

Beyond direct emissions, gas equipment carries a broader footprint: fuel that has to be purchased, stored, and handled; oil that needs regular changing; engines that require tune-ups and eventually replacement. Small engines are disproportionately polluting relative to their size, and for a task as routine as cutting a suburban lawn, the overhead is harder to justify now that cleaner alternatives are widely available.

*Irregular mowing patterns that stress grass and increase water needs*

Once-a-week mowing sounds disciplined, but in practice it produces more lawn stress than people realize. Letting grass grow long between cuts means removing a large portion of the blade in a single pass — more than the lawn can easily absorb. Stressed grass develops shallower roots, retains moisture less effectively, and becomes more vulnerable to weeds and disease. The result is a lawn that needs more water and more chemical intervention than one that's maintained more consistently.

The irony is that mowing less frequently often creates more work downstream, not less.

**What a Smarter, More Sustainable Yard Routine Actually Looks Like**

*Mowing more frequently at a lower cut*

The most effective shift in lawn care habits is also the simplest: mow more often, remove less each time. The general rule is never to cut more than one-third of the grass blade in a single session. Grass maintained at a consistent height develops deeper roots, retains water more efficiently, and produces clippings fine enough to decompose directly into the soil — returning nitrogen naturally and reducing the need for synthetic fertilizer.

This approach requires more frequent mowing, which is exactly where scheduling and automation become valuable. The environmental benefit isn't just in the cutting itself — it's in the compounding effect on soil health, water retention, and reduced chemical dependency over a full season.

*Replacing gas tools with electric or battery-powered alternatives*

The electric lawn mower has matured significantly in recent years. Modern battery-powered models deliver cutting performance comparable to gas equivalents without the emissions, fuel costs, or engine maintenance. For most residential properties, an electric lawn mower is the straightforwardly better choice — quieter, cleaner, and cheaper to run over time.
The transition doesn't need to be dramatic. Replacing gas equipment at its natural end of life with an electric alternative is a low-friction change that most households can make without adjusting their routine at all. The environmental difference, however, accumulates meaningfully across years of use.

*Using scheduling and automation to maintain consistency without effort*

Consistency is the hardest part of any lawn care routine to sustain. Work gets busy, weekends fill up, and the mowing gets pushed back a week. Over time, those delays add up — and the lawn shows it.

This is where automation changes the equation. A robot lawn mower operates on a fixed schedule regardless of how the rest of your week unfolds. It cuts a small amount every day or two, maintaining the kind of frequency that's genuinely difficult to achieve manually. The grass stays at a healthy height, the clippings stay fine, and the downstream benefits — better water retention, less need for fertilizer, reduced weed pressure — follow naturally from that consistency.

**How Robotic and Electric Yard Tools Support Long-Term Lawn Health**

Yarbo's robot lawn mower operates wire-free using RTK-GPS navigation, planning deliberate mowing routes across the property rather than bouncing randomly within a boundary wire. It cuts daily at a low, consistent height — exactly the pattern that produces the healthiest turf over time. Running at around 60 dB, it's quiet enough to operate in the early morning without disturbing the neighborhood, which means it can run on a schedule that suits the lawn rather than one that suits the neighbors.

The environmental profile is straightforward: zero direct emissions, no fuel, no oil changes, no engine to maintain. The steel frame and weather-resistant construction mean it operates through the full season without degradation — and regular firmware updates improve its performance over time without requiring new hardware.

For homeowners already thinking about reducing the footprint of their home, the yard is a more significant lever than it often appears. Switching from a gas lawn mower to an electric or robotic alternative is one of the higher-impact changes available — not because any single mowing session is transformative, but because the habit repeats every week for six months of the year.

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRD1YTtHJUZRC7yX8y2Yi2DiyBVdf5ehq4UcU9Rim3ta6/image.png)


**Building a Yard Routine That's Easier to Maintain — and Better for the Environment**

The most sustainable yard routine is one you can actually stick to. That means removing friction wherever possible — automating what can be automated, replacing high-maintenance equipment with low-maintenance alternatives, and building habits around how grass actually grows rather than the convenience of a weekly schedule.

Mow more frequently at a consistent height. Replace gas equipment with electric when the opportunity arises. Let a robot handle the repetitive work so that consistency stops depending on a free Saturday afternoon.

None of these changes require a significant lifestyle adjustment. Together, they produce a lawn that's healthier, easier to maintain, and meaningfully lighter on the environment — not just on Earth Day, but through every ordinary week of the growing season.

title.title: Easy to Grow Blooms: Colorful Portulaca, Small Sunflower, Cosmos and Margarita Brighten Our Community Garden
title.body:
![Pale Blue Wooden Table Summer Time Photo Collage (6).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/48PTikdi2bBe3j5EcXKz1fxAQW5poPumoP9MkneqtxjTti94RT7zBtdtJ83386CuEB.png)


Greetings to all gardeners! 
Today I want to share about the beautiful flowers growing around our community. Every morning when I go outside, I always check which flowers are blooming. Seeing them open with different colors gives me a good mood and makes the surroundings more alive. Our garden is full of colors and positive vibes.

![IMG_20260422_081501.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23tmDEcSAVrAH8ezH8uqLn2zPFmouZc5gKHggn7uuJwDhLuY4hAoZwA7CPowTCZ2Fq1HP.jpg)

![IMG_20260422_081631.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23tvcMZHmziGfsvLnACTjhySrStoUnxbThmezRC1B5e2pEPq2WxwCTyypBj8DRMArWYCd.jpg)

One of my favorites is Portulaca and Magic Rose. I really love them because they bloom in many colors like yellow, pink, orange, white, and peach. They are very attractive, especially when the sun shines on them. What I like most is even when the weather is very hot, they continue to live and bloom. They are strong flowers and do not need too much care. Which makes it perfect for busy people or for those who want low-maintenance plants. Sometimes no time to water them, but they still survive.

![IMG_20260422_090447.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23w2jGSaqBXTeKhQLsDiZHQ3KKxUQLCXFLVCeXZB9UEYb3x8TJpRYpcbzVK4rjRmcM1BZ.jpg)

I planted some of them in recycled plastic bottles. I painted the bottles yellow because yellow is a happy color for me. It also makes the flowers stand out more. I like using bottles because I can transfer the plants anytime. If I want flowers near the door, I move them there. If I want to decorate another area, I transfer them again. It is simple, but it makes me happy arranging them.



![Pale Blue Wooden Table Summer Time Photo Collage (7).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/48KbqkJVTtKUHbnm9JCyW6eVk2hxRsCtizmnR1kfk7sNHLuLWQXYAxBETXSAKmcXE2.png)


![IMG_20260422_081432.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23tvcMYxyijfDL1BsZateS36gEfnfRWTtmktpyWVVnkjNoWEzHaDYBWC5W7Y28PnyWqi6.jpg)


I also got more Portulaca cuttings because I want to plant them beside the rice field. Most of the time, the rice field is full of green, which is already beautiful. But I thought it would be nicer if there are colorful flowers on the side too. Instead of seeing only green, there will also be yellow, pink, orange, and white flowers dancing with the wind. It can make the place more relaxing and attractive.



We also have Margarita flowers here in our community. This flower is one of the easiest to grow and blooms fast. That is why many people like planting it. We often use these flowers for church decorations and bouquets during special occasions. It is nice to have flowers that are both beautiful and useful.

![IMG_20260422_081756.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23tbiXujixJit3VEjjfRsqq56oZ4fV4ZmrmUaLQVurqwghuAT9zjPZVJcouAzcDLPtzsa.jpg)

![IMG_20260422_081747.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23w2gVsLyPTfn8rKrecTTA3Ken9VRAatWLnMpJrL3P9fjmcfRtfgMzi5duv8Guu7jiz3e.jpg)

Another flower We planted is Cosmos. I have yellow and orange colors. The yellow one already bloomed, but the orange one is still preparing. I am excited to see it bloom soon. Cosmos flowers are very attractive, and many say they also help lessen mosquitoes around the area.

Having flowers around me gives many benefits. When I feel tired, I just look at them and my mind becomes calm. They help reduce stress and make me feel peaceful. Gardening also gives me exercise because I move around while cleaning and planting. Flowers are also good for the eyes because they are refreshing to look at.

![IMG_20260422_081723.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23u5zowjENxeAzWd8zSdN5WCu82cPNF8GjawzyGrUh2ELnE25eFMh3CKW1mwkMfUDcDkp.jpg)

People also say that if many flowers bloom in your home, it means you are a friendly person. Maybe that is true because flowers make a place feel welcoming.

![IMG_20260422_081608.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23u63AKVDTCPtD8yojfgkGZdhvJB9sCKpzdMM2N1Hag4kcQ3h1W7V4EPSPYsPEpzUYQHW.jpg)

![IMG_20260422_081639.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23tbu7uQWyvZshLRWX4YuHp4YKRgfZqJMM6iCpULgVj3aCQCBG1uRytnK97Vo82ZnzkDh.jpg)

A home with flowers is a home full of life.💛

Thank you for reading my story! This is my owned picture, edited in Canva. Have a nice day!

title.title: My Hive Goals for 2026 Week #16
title.body:
I have decided to start posting a weekly update on my progress toward [my 2026 goals](https://peakd.com/hive-167922/@jfang003/my-hive-goals-for-2026-lma) here on [Hive](https://leofinance.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-what-is-hive). It helps me stay on track, and I can realize if I am behind on a goal at any point in time. It's the fourth month of the year so far, and there is plenty of time left in the year. Also, for everyone's note, the Saturday Savers has ended, but the Slothly Savers Club has started in its place. 

## Progress

![graph.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23wCdA7nLMjaEsSQ3sx48B1VCerTW1UfGmeNeeBTcwmmCkJZitEjeqzM5vrbBYB9qeCze.png)
Above are statistics that I have gotten from [HiveStats](https://hivestats.io/). This week is looking a bit worse than last week, and it all adds up over time.

### HP
I earned 97 [HP](https://leofinance.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-hive-power-hp) earned throughout the week. I am checking this through the difference between the two endpoints on the graph on Hivestats. The numbers are looking decent. The numbers are looking good, but I am not sure why the numbers on the chart don't match that.

### HBD 

![HBD.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23tv3v8SY678vRsK3nDzXoh6BazKzsfa8aYabG1aUKvz1kKUCGDw5f1CYfUMJyo8gs5xJ.png)
I earned 0 [HBD](https://leofinance.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-hive-backed-dollar-hbd) this week. With the price of Hive lower, we have hit the debt limit. This means that we will be earning Hive instead of HBD. I won't be able to add to my HBD savings for a while, but the interest will help me towards that goal. When the Hive price is above the debt limit, I'll add to my savings. There isn't much I can do here, but at least that interest will add up. It looks like the interest on HBD has finally dropped. It's now 12% instead of 15% and I think that is more reasonable given the current debt limit.

## Conclusion

![goal progress.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23tmmEVQaCP8XsrJ8ihSwcaL4wy9c4tnop3WLthFyfKyrto6s45ZhK3L5gENdvmtwX3HF.png)
My progress is looking decent for now. I need around 2% per week, so this week I met that standard. HBD is officially behind where I need to be now. However, without any HBD being earned, it might not be enough if that doesn't change by the end of the year. Other than that, nothing much has changed, and I am just slowly grinding away at my goals. The HBD goal isn't looking that great as I am behind, and I don't think we will be getting HBD anytime soon with the current Hive price. Also, the interest rate on HBD has dropped this time around so that goal will be even harder.

Do you have any goals for 2026? What is the progress towards your own goals? 

Feel free to leave a comment if you read my post. If you have any questions, feel free to ask, and I will do my best to answer.

title.title: Noche humeda✍️
title.body:
Que dispersos mis pensamientos, en las noches se pierden buscando conectar recuerdos con olores, en el día se encuentran con una puerta en la nariz.

Parte de mi olvido quien era, pensé que era imposible cortar tus raíces... pero a veces las situaciones son como un transbordo, el retoño en la maceta se mudo al campo, en el cambio y en el viaje a ser más grande perdió sus aires, perdió su arena... perdí mis raíces. 

Y es que a veces siento que no soy de aquí ni de allá,  hoy en día mis pies son del mundo, mi corazón creo una coraza da cristal ahumado, se ve oscuro y parece firme, pero ya sabemos lo que pasa con el cristal, en fin... si no soy de donde nací ni de donde estoy... entonces de donde soy? 

Mi conclusión más oscilante es que soy de tus recuerdos... es decir, vivo hoy en tu mirada y tu en la mía, en este momento podrías palparme y saber que soy aquí y ahora, nada más...Ya no soy de mi tierra ni de la que pisan mis pies en este momento.

De haber sabido que no habría una segunda oportunidad,  quizás te hubiera mordido los labios de vuelta. 

Aquella noche dispersa, que posibilidad había de que todo se alineara para lo que sucedió? Llegue tan lejos como mi conciencia me lo permitía, eras tu y era yo, mucho alcohol y una noche fría, el asiento de atrás del auto y un karaoque inconcluso, solo me fije en como brillaban tus pómulos al sonreírme,  y en como dirigias mis manos a tus muslos mientras me besabas el cuello, fue trampa y jugaste bajo... toque tus labios húmedos con mis dedos, bese tu boca y luego chupaste mi pulgar, llegamos tan lejos como la conciencia nos permitía, hay que admitir que esto fue una posibilidad de una noche, ahora veo tus mensajes sin conclusiones, veo tus intenciones sin ganas, no llegamos a nada.

title.title: Peaceful Afternoon Walk Capturing The Beauty Of Trees And Plants
title.body:
![1000033181.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jocabanero4/23uFW42BhxyF6foEgH1oi73jC91hZzxpau5BfF8HnPf5Wh5JaxVG8m1iHdNYGVTcyg9wK.jpg)

# *Greetings to all my friends*

Walking outside our house this afternoon, the sun was going down slowly. Golden light shining everywhere around, it looks so beautiful.


![1000033183.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jocabanero4/23w2z5oeAAgPfVTqJ1C5rE2wbY71YMr14WjFK8ajSTTXChPmBcrL2gy8g4tbjJbLJe6cD.jpg)


I really love seeing the sunset
the rays of light are so nice.
Touching the leaves and the ground. Making everything look shiny and bright.


![1000033186.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jocabanero4/23uFRNE1f85PxQemKpFiczaXSPtJroWPeieYyR94JT3AyMMTmLp96NCsBchkSeDi5QsF5.jpg)

While walking i took some pictures of the plants and big trees, they are all growing healthy green leaves are dancing in wind.. 


![1000033182.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jocabanero4/242rpiBekTkNEy8W1k6yWwxbWLXb18F7J59gZgEhFUBq2RarNuuEyVR1rSHvAYunxafX6.jpg)


Look at this big tree beside it is so tall and very strong, giving us fresh air and shade.. Nature is really amazing to see.


![1000033189.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jocabanero4/23xpAUnbijV7fA6kbjNVsXRyJA9tZfB897JA4HCvngZnQymx8vAxMxkSHvbJEAM3Mxn6i.jpg)

Different kinds of plants are here, some are small and some are big, their leaves are so green and clean they look so fresh and lively.


![1000033188.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jocabanero4/23y92TYTaLNUhTMsWvgBEuGuQQPi2s7od7n2fsVVh3yab1P6dEsrdhzN2E2Ltj6Lcsao7.jpg)

The sunlight hits the leaves nicely creating shadows on the wall. It feels so peacefull and calm walking here makes my heat calm.

![1000033184.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jocabanero4/23uFWDAbyofJbFwviFez8Gtb7xFGXixUZ27rtoyCQNs7veVKR5chPBdHHgt7injUToBvP.jpg)

I am so glad i went out to capture these moments, God created nature so perfect every plant and tree is blessed.


![1000033187.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jocabanero4/23wgPuzaDtzbppn6uRG591Qo4hLAzAmXSZkiutKuQR6naAKRUk36Hv4FafTYtphNqC1DZ.jpg)


Thank you Lord for this view, simple life but full of beauty. I will always love our nature. Happy to see things today. So happy to walk around here. Good place to rekax and think nature is really good for us.. I love this peaceful afternoon time 😊

title.title: First Time Ever || Got a Monster Card Reward from a Campaign Tutorial || Which Card I Got?
title.body:
![ChatGPT Image Apr 22, 2026, 10_36_12 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23vsEEoNoV7eHQRgj7aPisXzac99LzabtRw45tpgDXwFmxMV6tojQbKohKaq9mEp3MYXq.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)


I am seeing for the first time that in a campaign by watching or running a tutorial you get a monster card as a reward. This is very interesting. Before this I have also shared my different campaign experiences with you where I have completed Prologue Part 1, 2, and 3. 

And today I thought to continue it further so I entered Prologue Part 4 and completed this campaign. It was very simple and you just have to keep on doing next the every scene and in the end collect monster card reward. 

I dont know whether all users will get the same reward or there are different for different users. I need to confirm this as well.

![Screenshot 2026-04-22 101438.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23tRzbDMasPp6d7wPCofT5pBcxvU5bsqPFbGKkp7yUpQV2yxJwGf12QVtaUqiVaYRsLMG.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)

The good thing is that by completing this short campaign I got a good monster card as a reward which will work well in battle. I will discuss this monster in the next paragraph. 

The main purpose of the campaign is that a player who is interested in Splinterlands should watch it, complete it and understand the game properly. The main job of the campaign is to explain different things so that you become properly familiar with the game.

You simply have to open Splinterlands, go to the campaign and complete from Part 1 to Part 4 and like this there are three chapters. After that you will keep getting more tasks which you have to complete. 

![Screenshot 2026-04-22 101457.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23tvgSCATKhsCbi8wpbddPy3exe7wi452nUTA6E5QiSpy9NubSiYXxdLQKSiyGHDtLMdN.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)

Earlier in Prologue Part 3 there was “Know Thyself” where I recognized myself and in the end I got an avatar as a gift which I set as my profile picture.


In Prologue Part 4 it actually welcomes you to a Waur Medge where Headmaster Blmblenok welcomes you to Praetoria Premier Academy. There you will see different scenes like a school academy, many monsters sitting together at a dining table and eating, a beautiful nature view, a battle practice and many more things. 

You just have to click next on these screen and your Prologue Part 4 will be completed easily.

![Screenshot 2026-04-22 101533.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23tv66RajSutjncJtcR8hdYfczMD11ztizXfvKkk1anEW4whoSEu1WbD5Vz8cLmcJLY3k.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)

These are very easy campaigns where you get rewarding gifts. And when I completed it I got the Lady Amara monster card as a reward which has very good abilities. 

Its mana cost is 6 which you can easily select in any mana battle. Its health is 6. Its best position is mid position because it has no armor and if you place it on the front line damage will quickly finish its health. It also has 1 speed attack and it is a magic attacker.

![Screenshot 2026-04-22 101625.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/EokWqwZko6tRrXRqoy56drKwJnhiMoCpo7oeVyrr8QQNfuctddqgKDEYZ7Scc3hfcwT.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)

If I talk about its price, in the market it is available at cheap prices starting from 0.01 and depending on its level and CC, the price varies. This is how campaigns give rewards after completing their parts. I hope you liked these campaigns and you will also complete them soon.

body.title: Алліуми : посів
body.body:
Минулого року вперше побачила на своїй клумбі справжні сортові алліуми. Замовляла цибулини цих квітів і висаджувала їх восени. І вже наступної весни вони по черзі почали квітнути, щоразу вражаючи нас своєю незвичною формою та красою. Навіть вже відцвівші суцвіття викидати було шкода, тому вирішила їх зберегти і прикрасити інтер'єр сухими красивими кулями.

![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valentinalife/Ep1XpHoWiwm6j8nZjM62WBQjcfv6bxvuFsmj9N49hGqhrN3ixEzdTYHGxu8bW9AnHPd.jpg)

![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valentinalife/23wgMX6Uf5XePc1Bo5SVXxfSF92fG6KMDLYcX6JusiqNi6k9kaB7Q6F1BfyYttoQM4wpC.jpg)

![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valentinalife/Ep5mmjLVQW68jN3AavqoJWKNxahNZ4zHYdPKCGaKUPB7ERUqxHgV9jrNpf29tPHpAAC.jpg)

А взимку, коли з цих суцвіть почали потроху випадати гарні стиглі насінинки, я зібрала їх та підписала, тільки не назву сорту, а як вони виглядали. Не тримаються в голові всі ці іноземні хитромудрі назви, добре хоч слово АЛІУМ запам'ятала.😁

![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valentinalife/EoiWG5cxKpKWgNjnHsFh97YLpiZha5btsTNzSioChPsFKnGEYUPcEQiHzEKfzoktYd9.jpg)

Настав час висіяти збережене. Хочу виростити з насіння повноцінні цибулинки, щоб мати море розсади прекрасних квітів. Перекопала місце, де стояла будка нашого бідного улюбленця Хенка, що пішов на райдугу... Зробила рядочки, посіяла у вогку землю і замульчувала травою. Тепер буду чекати, чи зійде хоч щось. Бо такі експерименти не щодня робиш, тому й невідомо, що з цього вийде. Але ж оптимісти завжди налаштовані на позитивний результат, а я себе відношу саме до такої категорії людей!😎

![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valentinalife/EoK5mjx9gVhZp9vUVGCesW9GYJuuHPGwMPbCPp7QUhbwFHpwQGgSciwbJ6v3wQyvjRu.jpg)

body.title: LOC Contest #285 ~ What Keeps Me Moving Forward
body.body:
>
![1011dad6f9b942438207a1cc04dfce49.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nwaadiaha/23xAkWZdQFZAEwdVXQSw8TPG1X4aGFvgL2eP58WtpgbcssEMatoVbaW78XZSoCayN99DD.jpg)
***Right now in your life, what feels like your main reason for living? How would you describe your purpose at this moment, and what keeps you moving forward each day?*** ___ ___ ___ Thinking about an answer to this question, I am realizing that since I got to become an adult or teen I have had many reasons for living, I have had many things that have been the reason for my decision to keep pushing and keep moving forward irrespective of how things are. There was a time when I had kept moving forward, kept pushing, kept trying because of my dad, he was the only support system I had, the only best friend and my cheerleader, he was the only one that I looked at and had a reason for pushing no matter how hard academic was for me back then, I was wiling to scale through, I pushed every single day, I put in my best every day because of him and then I lost him. So, I transferred my attention, I kept pushing, I had to finish school so I could start working in earnest, I had to take on two many jobs so there was money to keep at home for food and for their school fees, I worked harder because I didn't want then to experience the suffering I did, I pushed harder because I knew they had nobody but me, my purpose in life was to make sure they were not feeling the absence of their father and husband. I lived for the remaining family that I had which was my two siblings and my mother. I lived and breathed because of them until years when I realized that age was no longer one my side, that I was pouring more into people than into myself, although my attention was focused now more on my mother, so I started pushing for just myself and my mom, I never had plans or made plans that didn't include her about my life. My life practically revolved around her, I pushed for more financial stability because of her, I made decisions based on her, until last year when we lost her. I found myself thinking about how I was going to navigate around her without her, how I was going to keep pushing without her, how I was going to make plans without including her, and how I was going to go on with the many plans I had that majorly included her without her now. Although it has not been easy lately, I am starting to push for myself, I am starting to live for myself, I am starting to learn to keep pushing every foot forward for myself and it feels strange because every life at my young age has always been for family but I am starting to see me, I am starting to understand what it actually means to push forward for myself alone, i am starting to realize what it means to live for myself, I am starting to understand what it means to have ones purpose not revolve or tired around anyone. My purpose at this moment in my life is to become financially stable, settled, and understand more about what I want to do for myself at each stage of my life. Although I have not figured it all out yet, I know it's going to be one step at a time. ___ ___ ___ This is my entry to [Ladies of Hive Community Contest #285](https://peakd.com/hive-124452/@ladiesofhive/ladies-of-hive-community-contest-285) *The image used is mine* Thank you for reading my blog!!! ___ ___ ___

body.title: Finding the Right Anxiety Therapy in Adelaide for Lasting Relief
body.body:
How does anxiety feel for anyone else? And for others, it might be just the broken record of overthinking. In others, it manifests itself as muscle tension, insomnia or avoidance of life situations Well let me be clear—there certainly is no one therapy that works for all people—but the truth is this: there are some proven therapies which will be of benefit.,If you are in Adelaide and asking what actually works, here it is …

It should not necessarily be the most popular one but rather what best fits you.

**Why There’s No One-Size-Fits-All Answer**

Those asking what is the best therapy for anxiety in Adelaide want an easy answer. Well, anxiety comes in so many varieties—you have generalised anxiety, social anxiety, symptoms of panic—and all of them respond to treatment differently.

Some of the elements that affect the appropriate approach include:

The length of time you have had symptoms

The severity of anxiety

Your everyday life and the sources of stress

Individual Preferences with regard to the type of therapy (structured vs. flexible therapy styles)

And that is why if you are going to walk the path of treatment, many times you will start with your pattern and not a diagnosis label.

Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT): A Great Place to Begin

CBT is widely recommended because it’s practical; unlike many other approaches, it focuses on real-world results. Rather than simply discussing emotions, it enables you to recognise that certain thought patterns and behaviours keep anxiety going.

If you have a tendency to jump to the worst conclusion in social situations then CBT works on cutting that cycle and installing a more neutral thought process.

**Why it works well:**

It’s structured and goal-oriented

You learn tools you can use after sessions

It’s backed by strong evidence

CBT is flexible to different forms of anxiety, which means it is used as a basis in many therapies throughout Adelaide.

**ACT: A Different Way of Looking at Things**

Unlike SAT, ACT use a little different way. Well, it is not about getting rid of anxious thoughts but rather shifting your response to them.

You learn to:

Accept thoughts without identification

Don't get caught up in the \

Stay present

Even if anxiety is nagging you, do stuff that is consistent with your values

This can be invaluable, particularly when you feel as though you are battling anxiety and nothing has worked for a long time.

**Therapy for Children and Teens**

Anxiety doesn’t just affect adults. It tends to be demonstrated physically with behaviour in children – not wanting to go to school, being reclusive or becoming rebellious over very minor changes.

Therapies for younger people tend to be more active and may involve:

Play-based sessions

Visual tools and storytelling

Involvement of parents or caregivers

Getting support early can be crucial, providing kids with emotional skills that will serve them for the rest of their lives.

**Lifestyle Support Still Matters**

When everyday habits support therapy, the therapy works best. These will reinforce what you learn during your sessions but in small changes.

**Things that help:**

Regular sleep patterns

Physical activity (even light movement)

Reducing caffeine and screen overload

Creating predictable routines

They are not substitutes to therapy; they enhance the effects.

How to Find the Right Therapist for You in Adelaide

Selecting the type of therapy you want to explore is irrelevant and finding a provider who understands you is what matters the most. You will be more open and consistent when it is a good connection.

**Look for:**

Clear communication and realistic expectations

Your particular form of anxiety experience

A comfortable style, neither rushed nor clinical.

You may even be able to try a session or two before making your decision. It should feel supportive — not like a forced fit.

**Final Thoughts**

[What is the best therapy for anxiety in Adelaide?](https://roseparkpsychology.com.au/anxiety-treatment/) The best option is the one that suits your needs, clicks comfortably in a static-fit manner and keeps you moving up.

For many that is CBT or ACT to begin with — but the real difference comes from consistency, appropriate guidance, and an ability to see it through!

Anxiety can be managed. It becomes something you know and manage, not something that rules your life, with the right support.


---

요즘 학원 액션 드라마를 보면 보통은 “누가 더 강한가”에 초점이 맞춰져 있는데, <약한영웅 Class 1>은 조금 다르게 다가왔다. 이 작품은 네이버 웹툰 약한영웅을 원작으로, OTT 플랫폼 웨이브에서 공개된 드라마다. 겉으로 보면 학교 폭력에 맞서는 이야기지만, 실제로는 훨씬 더 내면적인 감정과 관계에 집중하는 것 같다.

처음에는 주인공 연시은의 방식이 인상적이었다. 힘이 아니라 계산과 관찰로 싸운다는 설정도 신선했지만, 그보다 더 눈에 들어온 건 사람을 대하는 태도였다. 무심해 보이지만 선입견 없이 사람을 보고, 상대의 감정과 상황을 빠르게 읽어낸다. 그래서 문제아처럼 보이는 안수호를 단순히 폭력적인 인물로 치부하지 않고, 또 어딘가 불안정해 보이는 오범석도 쉽게 밀어내지 않는다.

이 세 사람이 친구가 되어가는 과정은 자연스럽고 따뜻하다. 특히 시은이 점점 변해가는 모습—누군가를 신경 쓰고, 관계 안으로 들어오려는 시도—은 이 드라마의 중요한 성장 포인트라고 느꼈다. 그리고 그런 변화를 가장 잘 받아들이는 사람이 수호다. 감정을 솔직하게 표현하는 수호는 시은의 작은 변화에도 바로 반응하고, 둘 사이에는 빠르게 신뢰가 쌓인다.

하지만 이 지점에서 균열이 시작된다.  
둘의 이해가 깊어질수록, 범석은 그 안에서 점점 외로워진다.

범석이 안타까웠던 이유는, 그가 특별히 나쁜 선택을 하고 싶어서가 아니라는 점이다. 그는 인정받고 싶었고, 친구를 잃고 싶지 않았고, 그 관계 안에 계속 남아 있고 싶었을 뿐이다. 하지만 그 감정을 표현하는 방식이 서툴렀다. 불안과 열등감이 쌓이면서, 결국 엉뚱한 방향으로 감정을 터뜨리고 만다.

그래서 이 드라마는 단순히 “악인과의 싸움”이 아니라, 서로 다른 방식으로 감정을 다루는 사람들이 관계 속에서 어떻게 어긋나는지를 보여준다.

특히 인상 깊었던 건, 시은이 여러 번 범석에게 “그만하라”고 신호를 보냈음에도 불구하고 그 말이 닿지 않았다는 점이다. 그건 말이 부족해서가 아니라, 범석이 그 말을 “나를 밀어내는 신호”로 받아들였기 때문일 것이다. 같은 상황을 두고도 각자가 전혀 다른 감정으로 해석한다는 점이 굉장히 현실적으로 느껴졌다.

여기에 배우들의 연기가 더해지면서 감정선이 훨씬 설득력 있게 다가온다.  
박지훈이 연기한 시은은 말수가 적은 대신, 눈빛 하나로 감정을 전달한다. 특히 슬픔과 공허함이 섞인 듯한 그 눈은 캐릭터의 내면을 고스란히 보여준다.  
최현욱의 수호는 시원하고 직선적인 에너지가 매력적이다. 답답한 상황에서도 한 번에 감정을 터뜨리는 그 ‘시원함’이 관계 속 균형을 만들어준다.  
그리고 홍경이 표현한 범석은 쉽게 밉상으로만 보일 수 있는 캐릭터를 훨씬 입체적으로 만든다. 찌질하고 불안정하지만, 그 안에 남아 있는 따뜻함과 인정받고 싶은 마음이 계속 느껴져서 더 안타깝게 다가온다.
전석대를 연기한 신승호 배우, 츤데레에 찰떡!

결국 이 작품이 더 아프게 다가오는 이유는, 누가 악해서 망가진 관계가 아니라는 데 있다.

모두가 서툴렀고, 모두가 나름대로 최선을 다했지만, 그 방식이 서로를 더 멀어지게 만들었다.

그래서 <약한영웅 Class 1>은 통쾌한 액션 드라마라기보다, 나약한 인간들이 관계 속에서 어떻게 상처를 주고받는지를 담은 이야기에 가깝다.

보고 나면 누가 잘못했는지를 따지기보다, “왜 저렇게밖에 할 수 없었을까”라는 생각이 더 오래 남는다.  
그리고 그 질문이 남는다는 것 자체가, 이 드라마가 가진 힘이라고 느꼈다.

body.title: Finnish Air Force gets in trouble for drawing \
in the sky
body.body: If you have any history with me you may know that what I USED to to was to point out the bias that is involved in the various news networks that exist and are popular around the world.   This stopped being interesting or involving any sort of digging because all of these networks and outlets, well, I don't think they are even trying to hide their bias anymore and instead they are just preaching to the choir as hard as they can before eventually their line of work gets completely replaced and there is nobody left.\n\nDon't believe me?  Well where are newspapers now?   How else do you explain the meteoric rise in popularity of \

or people like Joe Rogan who readily admit that they don't know what they are talking about?  

So these days instead I focus on things like the government clearly influencing news and of course, the most fun thing, just whackey stuff that happens when boys will be boys.

This next one is a fun one and I am unhappy that people got in trouble. 

<center>  https://www.thesun.ie/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2026/04/newspress-collage-cosbkf7fo-1776790121674.jpg?quality=80&strip=all&1776794959&w=1080&h=1080&crop=1
[src](https://www.thesun.ie/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2026/04/newspress-collage-cosbkf7fo-1776790121674.jpg?quality=80&strip=all&1776794959&w=1080&h=1080&crop=1)</center>

I can only guess that these exercises are rather routine and are meant to keep the pilots' skills up to date even though Finland hasn't fought anyone since the 1940's but they are important because you don't want an emergency to arise and all of a sudden pilots don't know where the car keys are.   

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dumb-news/23t7gvDhFodYvsDk8jj8UBfrRQ6tdvHi5rtVr8fNwBBzVQiLuyPcXirj3DsoqkT53c3ba.png)
[src](https://images.cdn.yle.fi/image/upload/w_1200,h_628,ar_1.91,c_fill,g_faces/q_auto:eco,f_auto,fl_lossy/39-162938769e236cb6b8c2)</center>

This had clearly been pre-arranged before the pilots even took to the sky and it seems as though there was a competition of sorts to see who could get the most accurate looking privates in the sky.   

The funny thing about this isn’t just the action itself, but the fact that the “holier-than-thou” media is treating this as some sort of tragedy and how the pilots should be ashamed of themselves.   

I love how the media and various Karens on the internet all of a sudden have never done anything remotely offensive ever at any point in their lives when it comes time to point the finger at others.    

The Finnish military responded in a very military sort of way

> The Air Force requires soldiers to follow good manners and rules of conduct, and if these are deviated from, it will be responded to in an appropriate manner

This is what they told the press who should have just been minding their own business.  I would imagine that the stern-faced commander went back and gave high-fives to the pilots because come on now, this is funny.  

They also mentioned that the pilots managed to stay in the airspace that they were meant to be in, no other aircraft were ever in any danger, and that the pilots had certain objectives that they were meant to accomplish during these runs and not only achieved them, but exceeded them.   

So what's the problem here?   Are people just not allowed to have fun anymore?   

Personally, I hope this becomes some sort of global competition among all military pilots even though that first one is so precise it is going to be tough to top.  

I say do boobies next.


<center> 
![logo_dumb_brush.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dumb-news/EoCgAFPuQnQAAykioiQYE5LtC27NLjZPWHMpPdYyDPvqS1bQwBEvY8FNT8xNpsyGxhH.png)</center>

body.title: My First Day in Zombie Hunter: A New Survival Fight
body.body: > Today, I played a zombie survival game for the first time in a long time. I liked the graphics and mood of the game from the beginning. As soon as I started the game, I was thrown into the middle of a dilapidated and abandoned alley. The surroundings were so deserted and smoky that it seemed that danger could strike at any moment. I stepped carefully with a submachine gun in my hand. ![Screenshot_20260422_122620.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVuWy1spCunCsC1uahJoNoHXXyUksyyLw7LLLToJz7KUp/Screenshot_20260422_122620.jpg) As I went a little further into the alley, I saw a zombie lurking there. Most likely, he didn't notice me. I adjusted the tip of my gun from a distance. In this type of game, I always try to shoot directly at the head (headshot), because it takes fewer bullets and the zombie is immediately knocked out. ![Screenshot_20260422_122643.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSJzJqag8aakVyaMvKvA3ftZg9TaRZGR6ZMJFJix7PVMM/Screenshot_20260422_122643.jpg) ![Screenshot_20260422_122702.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcHoWSZwCs5H6iTZhJvAPcHjtiK2URQ2JgrAbqrL2ceih/Screenshot_20260422_122702.jpg) As I moved forward a little, I saw an abandoned police car. But the view next to it was not good at all. There was green blood and dirt all over the floor. Perhaps there had been a big trouble here a while ago. I walked very carefully past the car, because zombies often hide in such places. ![Screenshot_20260422_122735.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYNHiieaDQ4afZtFQYyFKbveGL6MgMmEhMUUL1booEoUc/Screenshot_20260422_122735.jpg) ![Screenshot_20260422_122719.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmY7MLz98exixRNKMsoDFGzQZUGkpjcQFqVHEZtH8baS5U/Screenshot_20260422_122719.jpg) But my guess was right. Suddenly, two zombies came out of nowhere together. Their eyes were glowing red, and they were rushing towards me, making strange noises. The situation was getting quite heated. I kept retreating and shooting so that they could not bite me. ![Screenshot_20260422_122737.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXAwZqsDiGF7g3HGAVT1G7prMkmo1jF1GCq9wXYWV6ebW/Screenshot_20260422_122737.jpg) ![Screenshot_20260422_122741.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYb48qz6aamLfWYipjPea4QwQPQ9KptEYPJ3WjWSmFZnd/Screenshot_20260422_122741.jpg) When the number of zombies started to increase, I thought it would not be right to fight in the open like this. I took cover behind a wooden wall. I checked my health bar to make sure everything was okay. The gameplay was pretty smooth, so I didn't have any problems moving. ![Screenshot_20260422_122749.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdHLsm8a5DZFoBSRXvrtHeJFgGD6DUbSHRdMX1McELysM/Screenshot_20260422_122749.jpg) ![Screenshot_20260422_122752.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc6nGKuYSyXMeyqA9WW3n7AgiVWAnJwsQ7mXwiRYhCes6/Screenshot_20260422_122752.jpg) The most exciting moment of the fight came right then. When a group of zombies were coming to attack at once, I caused a big explosion. With a loud noise, a huge fireball was created. The damage from the explosion was so high that all the zombies were finished at once. ![Screenshot_20260422_122755.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYvgRo1tozqBaH3QHnADPXpNKiQp5BBRr4Jqi7CefYPi8/Screenshot_20260422_122755.jpg) ![Screenshot_20260422_122802.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd5RJ1KEWZgQC3Eu34oRKQtSpkkR4BGCdVfdgkAhsvTaC/Screenshot_20260422_122802.jpg) When the word 'MULTIKILL' appeared on the screen after the explosion, I couldn't describe the peace I felt. The surroundings were filled with dead zombies. In that one moment, all the previous tension seemed to be washed away. ![Screenshot_20260422_122816.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRv6euN3CezE8AtYUHPF64xhA2tWC9MaZ3oAbeQxnD8xR/Screenshot_20260422_122816.jpg) After completing the mission, I had a chance to breathe a little. That's when I met a mysterious woman wearing a cowboy hat. She told me that I had survived this danger and that she would take me to her safe base. She gave me a lot of information about the current situation along the way. ![Screenshot_20260422_122820.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSwfx5s6acEbNN867TZGXNv5aNB1DEmStBsxXZ6Z5S49p/Screenshot_20260422_122820.jpg) ![Screenshot_20260422_122825.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYUqBMPYEeiQdQuUsJFsJURKzonxXgw2Wuy2SS1fMq8bV/Screenshot_20260422_122825.jpg) Finally, the mission was successfully completed, and the 'VICTORY' screen appeared. At the end of the mission, I received 150 cash, 4 XP, and some fuel as rewards. These will be very useful for levelling up in the game in the future. ![Screenshot_20260422_122836.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaMSx88r4PgsRaSGJh7LAVyd3gzBUDdWPMk4dc4soBP7i/Screenshot_20260422_122836.jpg) ![Screenshot_20260422_122840.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmahL2Wm8385rF7DzhAqjUfU5E8PXFMZC2MNfEWxZbbL5e/Screenshot_20260422_122840.jpg) After returning to the main map of the game, my companion suggested that we needed to upgrade our weapons. He told me to unlock the shotgun slot and said that a shotgun is very useful for close combat. ![Screenshot_20260422_122851.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXh6uZCEqEuQobuzuGW9q2FRj1GThwk5QEbGuJhKqPvPc/Screenshot_20260422_122851.jpg) ![Screenshot_20260422_122904.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdeWir4s9z4GMPLDE9fd78Ky475mEf49Gko4h6mW7m6rH/Screenshot_20260422_122904.jpg) ![Screenshot_20260422_122929.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRYcLdVkvWjEqktPNfbDPEqZSh72T9j3HV8wbgAAmhJUz/Screenshot_20260422_122929.jpg) I went to the game store and chose a great shotgun called 'CRUISER-12 GAUGE'. I bought it for 100 taka. After getting the new song, I am now ready to go to the next mission. Let's see what dangers await us! ![Screenshot_20260422_122934.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSbC3VBK8axzQ9eybwRLgin2QygxPE2BEy7DK8URPcvgS/Screenshot_20260422_122934.jpg) ![Screenshot_20260422_122940.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbapwk464cSyuSrwR72T9Mv2hnbFy6MdeWF3FY6NTwawv/Screenshot_20260422_122940.jpg) Image Source: In-game screenshots. Today's experience was quite exciting. If there is anything more interesting ahead, I will share it with you. Has anyone else played this game? Let me know in the comments! --- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=mirzaiqi/1077e471)

body.title: Una hoja que recuerdos escritos lleva / A sheet of paper bearing written memories
body.body:
<center>

En una pradera cercana,
un día cayó una hoja blanca,
de las que ya han sido usadas
con notas que recuerdos guardan.

Al tocar el césped se contrae
y una bola se hace,
esto a una verde rama atrae,
que se acerca con afanes. 

>In a nearby meadow,
one day a white leaf fell,
one of those that had already been used
to hold notes and memories.

>As it touches the grass, it curls up
and forms a ball,
which attracts a green branch,
that eagerly reaches out.

![33789.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23qrDfRfQUBT72VAMuPJQf85YhJGgERXHEsbgcYqMpCRx7fSu59Zt5FdBoGdmVZ1FKDye.gif)

La rama le muestra por dónde caminar
para que poco a poco pueda trepar,
entre arbustos logra avanzar
y llega hasta la zona más alta que hay. 

La rama se acerca y el papel carga,
lo eleva de forma inmediata,
no es una hoja pesada
y luego con fuerza al cielo la lanza.

>The branch shows it the way to go
so it can climb little by little,
making its way through the bushes
until it reaches the highest point.

>The branch reaches out and takes hold of the paper,
lifting it up instantly,
it isn’t a heavy sheet,
and then it flings it forcefully into the sky.

![33790.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23s9P3TP1c81XuQLtx9NiiDzvcDtbKQ6HBXrAWYAuQ7D5d6HShdp8wuRuxPnQnNjY7cVE.gif)

La hoja de papel en lo alto se queda,
es que este lugar bien le sienta
y cuando la noche llega,
aparece la Luna con su refulgencia. 

Los dos se saludan con inocencia
el astro ve en el otro la belleza,
ella sabe que no son competencia
y ahora tiene una compañera que recuerdos escritos en su cuerpo lleva. 

>The sheet of paper up above remains,
for this place suits it well,
and when night falls,
the Moon appears in all its radiance.

>The two greet each other innocently;
the Moon sees beauty in the other,
she knows they are not rivals,
and now she has a companion who carries memories written on her body.

![33791.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/243LWvxkXnwWimx1SD28L5vy6E2DCTGp7ugVS4cPqoyHocbCr15sdEaveKx6WR8WdKSfi.gif)

body.title: Cuadernos de Isabel #11 Después de la ausencia. [Esp/Eng]
body.body:
## 📖 Cuadernos de Isabel #11  
### *Después de la ausencia*  

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeWBnMPpv2SJjDsgyaLyyEWCmqNhA5wGaqCnvVJb1jqDX/manfredrichter_chair_7618320_640.jpg)
Fuente [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/chair-fishing-chair-camping-chair-7618320/)

---

Hola querida comunidad @holos-lotus,  

Hay momentos en la medicina que no se cuentan en la consulta.  

No aparecen en los informes.  
No se registran en los expedientes.  

Pero se quedan.  

---

Hoy no quiero escribir sobre lo que pasó.  
Quiero escribir sobre lo que queda después.  

---

Todo ocurrió como ocurren muchas cosas en un hospital: rápido, contenido, sin espacio para detenerse demasiado.  

Decisiones.  
Indicaciones.  
Intentos.  

Tiempo.  

Siempre el tiempo.  

---

Hubo un momento en que aún era posible.  

Y otro en que dejó de serlo.  

---

No hay una línea clara que separe esos dos instantes.  
No hay una señal visible que diga “hasta aquí”.  

Solo se siente.  

---

Cuando terminó, la sala no hizo ruido.  

Nadie lo dice en voz alta, pero hay un silencio distinto cuando ya no hay nada que hacer. No es el silencio de la espera. No es el silencio de la concentración.  

Es otro.  

Más definitivo.  

---

Miré alrededor.  

Todo seguía en su lugar.  
Los instrumentos.  
La luz.  
Las manos.  

Pero algo ya no estaba.  

---

Y eso cambia todo, aunque nada se mueva.  

---

No pensé en protocolos.  
No pensé en si hice todo lo correcto.  

Pensé en la ausencia.  

---

En cómo algo que estaba hace unos minutos… deja de estar.  

En lo rápido que puede suceder.  

En lo difícil que es aceptar que no siempre se puede sostener.  

---

Hay una idea que acompaña a quienes ejercen esta profesión: salvar, ayudar, resolver.  

Pero hay otra, menos cómoda:  

---

no siempre se llega a tiempo.  

---

Después de eso, la jornada continúa.  

Esa es una de las cosas más extrañas de la medicina. El mundo no se detiene cuando algo importante ocurre.  

Hay otros pacientes.  
Otras historias.  
Otras urgencias.  

Y uno tiene que seguir.  

---

Seguí.  

Con la misma bata.  
Con las mismas manos.  

Pero no exactamente igual.  

---

Porque hay experiencias que no se ven desde afuera… pero cambian la forma en que uno está dentro.  

---

Al terminar, no me fui de inmediato.  

Me quedé unos segundos más de lo habitual.  

No haciendo nada.  
No pensando en nada concreto.  

Solo estando ahí.  

---

A veces el cuerpo necesita entender lo que la mente todavía no organiza.  

---

Cuando salí del hospital, la ciudad seguía su ritmo.  

Personas caminando.  
Conversaciones.  
Movimiento.  

La vida.  

---

Y pensé en lo contradictorio que es todo.  

Cómo algo puede terminar en un lugar… mientras en otro todo continúa como si nada.  

---

Al llegar a casa, Bruno estaba en silencio. No dormido. Solo quieto. Max se acercó sin la energía de otros días.  

Me senté en el suelo.  

No dije nada.  

Ellos tampoco.  

---

Y, por primera vez en el día, no tuve que sostener nada.  

---

Entendí algo que no se enseña en los libros:  

no todo en la medicina es intervención.  

A veces es aceptar.  

---

Aceptar que hay límites.  
Aceptar que no todo depende de uno.  
Aceptar que hay momentos en los que acompañar es lo único que queda… incluso cuando ya no hay a quién.  

---

No lo escribo desde la derrota.  

Lo escribo desde la conciencia.  

---

Porque también en eso se construye esta profesión.  

En lo que no se logra.  
En lo que no se puede cambiar.  
En lo que deja una marca que no se borra, pero que enseña.  

---

Gracias por acompañarme en este undécimo trazo de mis Cuadernos de Isabel. Nos seguimos encontrando en lo que se dice, en lo que se calla y en todo aquello que, aunque no tenga nombre, también forma parte de cuidar.  

Las imágenes son de Pixabay y la traducción al inglés fue realizada con DeepL Translate.  

---

🇺🇸 **ENGLISH VERSION**  

---

## 📖 Isabel’s Notebooks #11  
### *After the Absence*  

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeWBnMPpv2SJjDsgyaLyyEWCmqNhA5wGaqCnvVJb1jqDX/manfredrichter_chair_7618320_640.jpg)
Source [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/chair-fishing-chair-camping-chair-7618320/)

---

Hello dear @holos-lotus community,  

There are moments in medicine that are never told in the consultation room.  

They don’t appear in reports.  
They are not recorded in medical files.  

But they remain.  

---

Today I don’t want to write about what happened.  
I want to write about what remains after.  

---

Everything unfolded the way many things do in a hospital: quickly, contained, with no time to pause.  

Decisions.  
Instructions.  
Attempts.  

Time.  

Always time.  

---

There was a moment when it was still possible.  

And another when it was not anymore.  

---

There is no clear line separating those two moments.  
No visible signal that says “until here.”  

You just feel it.  

---

When it ended, the room made no sound.  

No one says it out loud, but there is a different kind of silence when nothing else can be done. It is not the silence of waiting. It is not the silence of concentration.  

It is something else.  

More final.  

---

I looked around.  

Everything was still in place.  
The instruments.  
The light.  
The hands.  

But something was no longer there.  

---

And that changes everything, even when nothing moves.  

---

I didn’t think about protocols.  
I didn’t think about whether I had done everything right.  

I thought about absence.  

---

About how something that was there just minutes ago… is no longer there.  

About how quickly it can happen.  

About how difficult it is to accept that we cannot always hold on.  

---

There is an idea that follows those in this profession: to save, to help, to resolve.  

But there is another one, less comfortable:  

---

we don’t always arrive in time.  

---

After that, the day continues.  

This is one of the strangest things about medicine. The world does not stop when something important happens.  

There are other patients.  
Other stories.  
Other urgencies.  

And you have to continue.  

---

I continued.  

With the same coat.  
With the same hands.  

But not exactly the same.  

---

Because there are experiences that are not visible from the outside… but change how you exist on the inside.  

---

At the end, I didn’t leave immediately.  

I stayed a few seconds longer than usual.  

Doing nothing.  
Thinking of nothing specific.  

Just being there.  

---

Sometimes the body needs to understand what the mind cannot yet organize.  

---

When I left the hospital, the city continued its rhythm.  

People walking.  
Conversations.  
Movement.  

Life.  

---

And I thought about how contradictory everything is.  

How something can end in one place… while somewhere else everything continues as if nothing happened.  

---

When I arrived home, Bruno was quiet. Not asleep. Just still. Max approached without his usual energy.  

I sat on the floor.  

I said nothing.  

They didn’t either.  

---

And for the first time that day, I didn’t have to hold anything together.  

---

I understood something that is not taught in books:  

not everything in medicine is intervention.  

Sometimes, it is acceptance.  

---

Accepting limits.  
Accepting that not everything depends on you.  
Accepting that there are moments when accompanying is all that remains… even when there is no one left to accompany.  

---

I don’t write this from defeat.  

I write it from awareness.  

---

Because this profession is also built on that.  

On what is not achieved.  
On what cannot be changed.  
On what leaves a mark that does not disappear, but teaches.  

---

Thank you for accompanying me in this eleventh entry of Isabel’s Notebooks. We continue meeting in what is said, in what remains unspoken, and in everything that, even without a name, is also part of caring.  

The images are from Pixabay and the English translation was done with DeepL Translate.

body.title: A book changed my life / Un libro cambió mi vida - LOH contest week #285 (eng-esp)
body.body:
Hello, my friends.

Literature changed my life from a very young age. That's no exaggeration. I still remember when the neighborhood kids would ask me why I read so much. They never understood my reasons.

I never imagined that years later, all that reading would be so useful when I began my career as a writer.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc88xwz7AFXuZE1uaesyZkowovZM4xojnz61VC4Ns8c57/1776807462849.webp)
[source](https://www.buscalibre.cl/libro-mientras-escribo-stephen-king-libro-fisico/9788497597326/p/4023831)

Every writer wants to see their work published. However, before seeing it published, the first thing we experience is rejection. They don't reject us, they reject our writing. And I honestly don't know which is worse.

Our stories are like our children.

When someone points out a mistake, it's like being stabbed with a burning nail. We always submit our writing thinking it's perfect, but then someone comes along and points out the errors.
Months and years go by and we don't see any progress, a publication, etc.

That's when discouragement sets in, that thought of *this isn't for me, nothing I write is any good, etc.*.

And that's how it was; I felt terrible until I read Stephen King's book: *On Writing*.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWqiVvKX7ho8YGP4Ymb2UYyKfaNw94omevCZB5vJH9qNp/1776807671615.jpg)

This book is a kind of autobiography; his experiences as a writer. You could say it's a self-help book for the aspiring writer.
King tells us about the endless problems and rejections he faced until he finally achieved success.

He also offers advice, not only as a published author, but as someone who loves literature.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmesK1WLLgzDdWBKRm8FT5qCd8AvAPyBumk5K1TAxoJFJi/1776807671657.jpg)

If it hadn't been for Stephen King, I think my writing career would have been different... if I had one at all.

I'm sure I'm not the only one who finds solace in this book. I'm not the only one who thinks all these problems *only happen to me*.

Nothing could be further from the truth.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWnZFaj4F6ZSbFQRuCXd1HiFXUeV4avioaMorwKnJJSrq/1776807671786.jpg)

This is a book that gives hope to all emerging authors. It's not just a guide to life as a writer; it's a kind of bible for the novice, a beacon amidst the storms and darkness so common in the literary world.

This is a lifeline. At least, it was for me.

***
**Versión en español**
***

Hola, amigas mías.

La literatura me cambió la vida desde que era un niño todavía. No es una exageración. Aún recuerdo cuando los muchachos del barrio me preguntaban por qué leía tanto. Nunca entendieron mis razones.
Nunca me iba a imaginar que años después, todas esas lecturas me servirían muchísimo cuando comencé mi carrera como escritor.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc88xwz7AFXuZE1uaesyZkowovZM4xojnz61VC4Ns8c57/1776807462849.webp)
[fuente](https://www.buscalibre.cl/libro-mientras-escribo-stephen-king-libro-fisico/9788497597326/p/4023831)

Todo escritor quiere ver publicado sus textos. Sin embargo, antes de verlos publicados, lo primero que experimentamos es el rechazo. No nos rechazan a nosostros, sino a nuestros textos. Y, de veras que no sé qué es peor. 
Nuestros cuentos son como nuestros hijos. 
Cuando nos señalan algún error, es como si nos clavaran un clavo ardiente. Siempre damos los textos y pensamos que son perfectos, pero viene alguien y nos hace ver los errores.
Pasan los meses y años y no vemos un avance, una publicación, etc. 
Ahí llega el desaliento, ese pensamiento de *esto no es lo mío, no sirve nada de lo que escribo, etc*.
Y todo fue así, me sentía muy mal hasta que leí el libro de Stephen King: *Mientras escribo*.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWqiVvKX7ho8YGP4Ymb2UYyKfaNw94omevCZB5vJH9qNp/1776807671615.jpg)

Este libro es una especie de autobiografía; sus experiencias como escritor. Se pudiera decir que es un libro de autoayuda para el escritor emergente.
King nos cuenta el sinfín de problemas y rechazos que recibió hasta que logró triunfar. 
También nos brinda consejos, no solo como autor publicado, sino como alguien que ama la literatura.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmesK1WLLgzDdWBKRm8FT5qCd8AvAPyBumk5K1TAxoJFJi/1776807671657.jpg)

Si no hubiera sido por S. King, creo que mi carrera como escritor hubiera sido distinta... si es que hubiera habido alguna. 
Estoy seguro que no soy el único en encontrar consuelo en este libro. No soy el único en pensar que todos estos problemas *solo me ocurren a mí*. 
Nada que ver.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWnZFaj4F6ZSbFQRuCXd1HiFXUeV4avioaMorwKnJJSrq/1776807671786.jpg)

Este es un libro que nos da esperanzas a todos los autores emergentes. No solo es una guía para la vida como escritor, es una especie de Biblia para el neófito, un faro entre tanta tormenta y oscuridad habitual en el mundo literario. 
Este es un libro salvavidas. Al menos, así lo fue para mí.

body.body:
Happy Wednesday hivers!!!!

It's been 4 months since I started walking with a goal of 10k steps a day.I am doing this for my health.

![Messenger_creation_094FD60C-E5B9-4F5A-8290-3069C74D306D.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mitch18/23xp26Wr49reTAaSGjMPgRg6WXV7nyDu9x8VaSVMXzgeMVH1PE7UoWWjXSsrrnpjgLZm7.jpeg)


It was November 2025 when I learned that I am having a hormonal imbalance and according to the OBGYNE I was consulting is because of my weight .I need to loss to weight so my monthly period will back to normal again.

The doctor advices me to take a walk everyday .I was started for a 30 minutes walk until I can walk for two hours.For that two hours I can accumulate 8km with a 10k steps.

From doing it by solo for almost 3 months ,I able to create a group now and I called it the \

. It's my neighborhood anyway.
They are amazed on how walking changed me and motivates them to do it as well.


I am glad that my walking journey motivates other person's who struggling different body problems.
Some of them experiencing high blood pressure and high cholesterol.
With a medication and walking as our exercise ,I can say that it really helps us to have a healthy body.

Aside of that ,I am happy to have my walking buddies now coz there are times I got scared on walking alone.There are times that I am not sure for my safety upon walking along the road.

I am glad that to know also the positive results of our check ups just a few weeks ago.

Although it's a bit tiring to do ,imagine we woke up at 4am to prepare our selves coz we started walking at 4:30 in the morning and got home around 6:30 am and started preparing our breakfast and othe things as a mother need to do hihi.
But I can say that it's all worth it.

Anyway ,here's my walking buddies ...

body.title: ‎Stacking Strength: How My Tuesdays Became a Ritual of Growth
body.body:
‎
‎Hi Hive,
‎
‎It's with great pleasure that I'm welcoming everyone to my blog today and I hope you're all doing well and having a great day.
‎
‎There is something about Tuesdays that now feels more intentional to me. What used to be just another day in the week has gradually turned into a day of commitment, growth, and quiet discipline for me. And it's Alive staking day and Heartbeat staking day.
‎
‎![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbicW7FFxrE3iaGWCMUPnuLD3a4eNqQ3gk1i7ZigATv2Z/1776824086040.jpg)
‎
‎![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbw12TLTqTzSsVmeUTWq1kbqsJ4LTXQU9Fs7RfihrAaLZ/1776824086176.jpg)
‎
‎Today, I took another step forward on that journey. I was able to stake 161.443 ALIVE tokens, adding to my already staked 446.986. And that brings my total ALIVE power to 608.428. Seeing that number keep rising  gives me a sense of progress that goes beyond just figures on a screen and it reflects consistency, patience, and belief in the process.
‎
‎![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWEqvWnY6eRsQMARzGL6dd8HaNieen6xqGs4G2LDVsBrw/1776824085985.jpg)
‎
‎![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfFrohEep8UnDbJdLJLn283k3WSDLxi9CCHvUTziPf9Jk/1776824086082.jpg)
‎
‎I didn’t just stop there. I also added 176.196 HEARTBEAT tokens to the 165.151 I already had in staked. And that pushes my total HEARTBEAT stake to 341.364. It might seem like just numbers to someone else, but for me, each increment tells a story of effort, small decisions, gradual growth and showing up even when it’s easy to overlook days like this.
‎
‎![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPo852FHhN5HY2JsGNvo7hmtgw1QPJHcLSbEsuGhYQa5a/1776824086129.jpg)
‎
‎![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXtdy4HmV3NbkwvrxQkWJeA1zhBTmZBWCGYdPixEtw6cb/1776824110140.jpg)
‎
‎What makes this more meaningful to me is not just the act of staking, but the mindset behind it. I’ve come to understand that growth in this space doesn’t always come from big, dramatic moves. Sometimes, it’s the steady, almost unnoticed actions like consistently staking  every week that build something solid over time.
‎
‎There is also a level of discipline involved. It’s easy to ignore routines when there’s no immediate reward staring back at you. But days like this remind me why I started to build, to grow, and to stay committed to a long-term vision.
‎
‎As I look at my ALIVE power now sitting at 608.428 and my HEARTBEAT stake at 341.364, I feel overwhelmed and encouraged. Not because I’ve reached a final destination, but because I’m clearly not where I used to be.
‎
‎And that’s what matters most—progress.
‎
‎Another Tuesday, another step forward.
‎
‎
‎![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYaWnApEziAtLL5Zwv3ZNbDjRfSfG6h5njgTrpyasnE6y/1775569275821.png)
‎

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@twicejoy/stacking-strength-how-my-tuesdays-became-a-ritual-of-growth-3zf)

body.body: The Ecency wallet isn't just for viewing balances. It's a full transaction engine that supports every financial operation the Hive blockchain offers - and then some.\n\n

/>

### Direct Transfers

Send HIVE or HBD to any Hive account instantly. Ecency supports **batch transfers to up to 50 recipients** in a single transaction - useful for contest payouts, team distributions, or community rewards. You can also transfer Hive Engine tokens and Ecency Points the same way.

Every transfer supports optional memos, so you can include payment references, notes, or encrypted messages.

### Savings Account

Hive has a built-in savings feature with a **3-day security delay** on withdrawals. This is your on-chain cold storage:

*   **Deposit** HIVE or HBD into savings with one tap
    
*   **Withdraw** with a 3-day cooldown period (protection against theft)
    
*   **HBD Savings earn interest** - currently around 15% APR, paid monthly by the blockchain
    

Ecency shows your pending withdrawal requests with countdown timers so you always know when funds will be available.

### Recurring Transfers

Set up automated scheduled payments:

*   **Daily, weekly, or monthly** frequency
    
*   Specify total number of executions
    
*   View upcoming payment dates
    
*   Cancel anytime
    

This is perfect for subscription-style payments, regular savings contributions, or ongoing support to content creators - all trustlessly executed by the blockchain.

### Conversions

Convert between HIVE and HBD using the blockchain's built-in conversion mechanism:

*   **HBD to HIVE conversion** (3.5-day processing)
    
*   Track pending conversion requests in your wallet
    

### Safety Features

Before you send funds, Ecency checks the recipient against a **known bad actors list** and warns you if the destination account has been flagged. This helps protect users from scams and phishing attempts.

**From one-time sends to automated recurring payments, Ecency gives you banking-level transaction capabilities - powered entirely by the Hive blockchain.**

body.title: Dejar que el aire entre. Cosas pequeñas que me sostienen #15 por veramfund. [Esp/Eng]
body.body:
- - -


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbPLEnPYEL3xQoHDxvoJp4kWcJSZoapocckFkUDj778Ca/pexels_curtains_1854110_640.jpg)
Fuente [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/curtains-decoration-indoors-plant-1854110/)

---

Hola comunidad @ladiesofhive nuevamente con ustedes con el decimoquinto capítulo de las **Cosas pequeñas que me Sostienen**.

Hay momentos en que el ambiente se siente cargado.

No siempre es algo visible. A veces es el calor, el encierro… o simplemente el peso de un día largo.

Y entonces, casi sin pensarlo, abro una ventana.

Es un gesto simple. Tan cotidiano que pasa desapercibido.

Pero en cuanto el aire entra, algo cambia.

No solo en la habitación.

También en mí.

El movimiento de las cortinas, ese primer soplo fresco, el sonido leve de lo que hay afuera… todo empieza a moverse un poco.

Como si lo estancado encontrara por dónde salir.

Me gusta ese instante en que me quedo cerca, sin hacer nada más.

Sintiendo el aire en la piel.  
Dejando que el espacio respire.  

Es curioso cómo algo tan pequeño puede transformar el ambiente.

No resuelve lo que llevo dentro.  
No borra el cansancio.

Pero lo hace más liviano.

Abrir una ventana es, de alguna manera, dar permiso.

A que entre algo nuevo.  
A que salga lo que pesa.  

Y en ese intercambio silencioso, algo se acomoda.

No es un gran cambio.  
No es un momento extraordinario.

Pero es suficiente.

Porque a veces, todo lo que necesito es un poco de aire.

Y eso, aunque parezca pequeño, también me sostiene.

---

 *Esto es Vera, aprendiendo a sostenerse en lo simple.*

Las imágenes son de Pixabay.  
La versión en inglés fue hecha utilizando Google Translate.

- - - 
# *English Version*
- - - 

**Small Things That Sustain Me #15**  
*Opening a Window and Letting the Air In*
---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbPLEnPYEL3xQoHDxvoJp4kWcJSZoapocckFkUDj778Ca/pexels_curtains_1854110_640.jpg)
Source [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/curtains-decoration-indoors-plant-1854110/)

---

Hello @ladiesofhive community, once again with you with the fifteenth chapter of **Small Things That Sustain Me**.

There are moments when the air feels heavy.

Not always something you can see. Sometimes it’s the heat, the closed space… or simply the weight of a long day.

And then, almost without thinking, I open a window.

It’s a simple gesture. So everyday that it often goes unnoticed.

But the moment the air comes in, something changes.

Not only in the room.

Also within me.

The movement of the curtains, that first fresh breeze, the soft sounds from outside… everything begins to shift a little.

As if what was stuck finds a way out.

I like that moment when I stay there for a few seconds, doing nothing else.

Feeling the air on my skin.  
Letting the space breathe.  

It’s curious how something so small can transform the atmosphere.

It doesn’t solve what I carry inside.  
It doesn’t erase the tiredness.

But it makes it lighter.

Opening a window is, in a way, giving permission.

For something new to come in.  
For what feels heavy to leave.  

And in that silent exchange, something settles.

It’s not a big change.  
It’s not an extraordinary moment.

But it is enough.

Because sometimes, all I need is a bit of air.

And that, even if it seems small, also sustains me.

---

 *This is Vera, learning to sustain herself in the simple things.*

The images are from Pixabay.  
The English version was made using Google Translate.

body.title: Waiting for the Safe Zone in Erangel | with English Commentay
body.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1776834372795-024f4fb5de649d3a.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=lazybug/b8f22c8c)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=lazybug/b8f22c8c)


---

<center><sup>The thumbnail was created in Canva.</sup></center>

<div class=\

>

I played a solo match on Erangel and was kicked out of the plane over Zharki. After finding a creepy doll and scavenging for supplies, I drove through the Red Zone toward Georgopol. I attempted to snipe an enemy from a rooftop with a Kar98, but I was eventually taken down by a driver and finished the match with zero kills.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP3WYpmzY36QUgaHLVTRAjLGirYt39SKHj3jUaN3gzMKM/screenshot_1_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme2AnqJTSxQmn8bwkfgUwf6cdrex7xC8cXCqvBYiwAuEe/screenshot_2_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaVr4fHj4LHP6uukppZhoAHugFNaZnTb7ajStQoavGejN/screenshot_3_.png)

I went for another solo match, and this time I tried Erangel to see if I could finally get a win. I decided to land on the farthest place on the map, which was Zharki, to avoid early fights. Actually, the airplane staff kicked me out of the plane as I was not ejecting on my own.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSn96rgXScfDPh2YzX3Hv94FPfY1GmTNezG8W9Woe53px/screenshot_4_.png)

When I was checking the buildings for loot, I found this creepy doll sitting in the corner of one of the rooms. It looked very out of place and gave me a strange feeling as I gathered my gear. I was really hoping it would not start haunting me or following me through the rest of the match.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXB5WscpGXXsKKrjUAo4qW3hQ5LrZNTpVVyrnq6TkXryU/screenshot_5_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXboB6U3H6WX9Jk26PjVeJPzG2zKhrt7VxwWLrvGq5Y9u/screenshot_6_.png)

As the safe zone started chipping in, I realized I was very far away from where I needed to be. I took a car and I started driving towards Georgopol through this long bridge. I hoped no one would ambush me or set up a blockade, as I was feeling quite vulnerable in the open while crossing the bridge.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSobBarZM4jBHgWMSt8QLbsf1FZoLuqPN9LvkKindap8V/screenshot_7_.png)

I was honking my car horn while I was riding through this town to see if any enemies were out. I wanted to draw them out or just have a bit of fun while I searched for more loot. No one showed up to challenge me, leaving the streets empty and silent as I continued my journey toward the center of the island.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeYr1YpYFFoeZaFeFz8JSSGVpdE3VA6B7GoYKtvbdB6g1/screenshot_9_.png)

After driving on this high hill, I stopped there to check out the surroundings and plan my next move. I noticed missiles falling into the Red Zone nearby, which was a beautiful but terrifying sight from a distance.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdv3VpgUpwWnKe6jj3qZmn1mNavmPmDoth8uBSvFGuVEe/screenshot_10_.png)

I decided to fix my position on the roof of a building, hoping it would stay inside the safe zone for a while. It gave me a great view of the surroundings, but the circle got out of the safe zone later when I noticed there was an airdrop falling down in the distance.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTQNamHoMDjTN8TTLEnXGzRVq2uSP1vnz18Wa4UZyAUcK/screenshot_11_.png)

From that roof, I spotted an enemy and tried to pin him down with my Kar98 and a 4x scope. I lined up the shot, but I couldn't land the hit before he moved behind cover. It was a frustrating moment, as I really wanted to get my first kill of the match.

Later, I went for that enemy and planned to take him down while he was distracted. But someone else came in a car and took me down. I stayed and spectated my killer till he got killed by someone else. And yeah, I died with zero kills again, making it another tough day on the battlefield.

---

<center>** **To be continued** **</center>

<center><sup>The logo of the game that I used on the thumbnail, I borrowed it from [CityPNG.](https://www.citypng.com/png-download/3671)</sup></center>

---
