title.title: What are the strongest offensive abilities in all of “Splinterlands” in 2026?
title.body:
>

<center> **Best regards Splinterlovers** 💚</center>

Mastering the gameplay in Splinterlands is a bit more complex than it seems at first glance; it’s not that easy to achieve given all the aspects you have to learn and understand. Of course, it’s not the most complicated thing in the world—games like this are usually picked up very quickly— but it all comes down to how much discipline and consistency you put into it. If you want to master the game, become a pro, and dominate the leagues, you need to stay on top of everything—and a big part of that, along with the elements you need to learn, is the skills themselves.

In Splinterlands, there are various types of abilities—you might focus on attack, defense, support, or debuffs— but you need to know them all to develop combat strategies that will increase your chances of winning in the game—that’s the key. That’s why I’m launching a new series of posts where I’ll discuss the different types of abilities in Splinterlands, starting with the most well-known ones—the “Offensive” abilities, at least the ones I consider the strongest.

**That’s why, in this post, I’ll be breaking down the strongest “Offensive” abilities in the entire game—the ones that are dominating the current meta and feature incredibly powerful mechanics you definitely need to know about:**

---
https://images.ecency.com/DQmUYoUgCugij9Zc9YqZStweXGkczF99nE2M3751EwFvhAF/image.png

## <center>Key offensive skills and their mechanics</center>
https://images.hive.blog/DQmaGxPb1AgP9whK3yUktqV6aRxGY3gavovoadSZwkVoX1t/gif%20sp.gif

I’m going to make this post a bit more dynamic and fast-paced, without beating around the bush. That said, context is always important so that newcomers to the game can understand many concepts that nobody else explains—that’s the difference, and that’s why I’m doing it this way. But without further ado, let’s get to the abilities:

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/23tkp8cd5gvvhKG9Ar71nV7nrae8YSetvBPC7s4D2oMwKqFHDatyxAGbifSMuz2E7z8EU.png)

#### <center>Very strong offensive abilities</center>

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/23w2cScy5yoHXafi8GsqqJ3q96BQTzqz4qLvCmh492hzCt8r58ro7CAWP4JFJKQSji6hw.png)

* **Blast:** Although this is one of the oldest abilities in the game, it remains one of the most damaging ones, as its effect causes damage to spread to adjacent cards surrounding the primary target upon impact, all while dealing an additional 50% damage (rounded up).

* **Sneak:** This is another one of those ancient abilities that remains incredibly powerful when used correctly. Its effect lies in the ability to attack from any position, but focusing solely on the unit in the back row of the opponent’s formation. It may be fairly countered these days, but choosing it with the right modifiers will help you win many battles.

* **Opportunity:** Another ancient ability—though not quite as old as the others—this is an excellent skill because, with the right modifiers, you can practically stalk your prey, since its effect allows you to focus your attack on the units with the lowest health points. Of course, like the others, it’s not a skill meant for general play, but it can adapt very well to all kinds of situations, dealing massive damage.

* **Double Strike:** This ability may seem simple, but it packs a powerful punch by allowing you to attack any unit three times in a single turn. It may be an old-school ability, but it can deal massive damage quickly, throwing your opponent’s strategy off course. In the right hands, it can be a very powerful weapon.

* **Apex Strike:** This ability is newer; in fact, it was introduced recently with “Escalation,” if I’m not mistaken. In any case, it reminds me a lot of “Sneak” or “Opportunity,” except that the attacks target the opponent’s card with the highest attack power.

* **Ambush:** In my opinion, this is one of the most broken abilities in the entire game, because it allows any unit that has it to attack even before the battle begins—in other words, before the first round even starts—which is insane. If you use it correctly, you can practically win the battle from the very first second.

* **Bloodlust:** I couldn't leave out the ability that disrupted the META for a long time in the game, and the truth is that it still does, even though it can be countered more easily than in the past. This ability grants its user nearly unlimited power, since every time they defeat an opponent, they gain +1 point in all their stats. If used correctly, you can be unstoppable on the battlefield.

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmUYoUgCugij9Zc9YqZStweXGkczF99nE2M3751EwFvhAF/image.png

## <center>Other important aspects of “Offensive” abilities</center>

https://images.hive.blog/DQmaGxPb1AgP9whK3yUktqV6aRxGY3gavovoadSZwkVoX1t/gif%20sp.gif

Understanding the effects of abilities isn't everything in the game; many other factors come into play to ensure everything fits together perfectly and you can truly make the most of them. This means we must manage card placement—a crucial aspect of strategy—and, in addition, analyze offensive superiority, a concept you may be hearing about for the first time but have likely already applied without realizing it.

**To understand all this, pay close attention:**


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/23tkp8cd5gvvhKG9Ar71nV7nrae8YSetvBPC7s4D2oMwKqFHDatyxAGbifSMuz2E7z8EU.png)

#### <center>Positioning strategies:</center>

* **Removal of Support:** This is essential if we want to survive in battle; one of the most effective strategies against them is to use “Sneak” cards to take out healers or support units, who tend to hide in the back lines.

* **Control of the front line:** First, you need a \
sturdy enough to withstand several rounds in the first position. On the other hand, the best strategy for this situation is to place a card with the \

ability in the second position, which attacks from that position and adds its attack to the first one. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/23tkp8cd5gvvhKG9Ar71nV7nrae8YSetvBPC7s4D2oMwKqFHDatyxAGbifSMuz2E7z8EU.png) ####
Offensive Superiority:
* **Direct Damage vs. Mitigation:** Here, it is important to distinguish the order of attacks or their priority. For example, magical attacks are superior to physical melee and ranged attacks, simply because they can be launched from any position and target vital points directly. * **Versatility:** In matches, we need to be very versatile in our play so that our opponent can’t read us like a book; This means that, for example, if we want to attack “Support” cards with at least one or two units, we could play “Sneak” as I mentioned earlier, but the reality is that “Opportunity” is superior in certain situations, which is why we need to know when and how to use one or the other. --- https://images.ecency.com/DQmUYoUgCugij9Zc9YqZStweXGkczF99nE2M3751EwFvhAF/image.png ##
Conclusion
https://images.hive.blog/DQmaGxPb1AgP9whK3yUktqV6aRxGY3gavovoadSZwkVoX1t/gif%20sp.gif I hope you enjoyed this post, as it covers a lot of educational content about skills—in this case, focusing solely on offensive skills. However, stay tuned for posts on other types of skills as well, since they can all work together. That said, any strategy should always be directed toward a single goal, even if we combine several of them. If you have any questions, don't hesitate to ask—just leave them in the comments, and I'll be happy to answer them.
https://images.ecency.com/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mhowii/23t74jP9PwnQVm1xvGFRSWNw9CX8dtyaB4fPKB2YqhBL6VuzewvG9Sd3Ft2qNL4scwN2L.gif
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/AJhYgvAA2jMdAtev45LxeeeYzzVqonoQgjHfk865cC9GnBW1MVqFA5B5cJ6BKaa.gif ### **I invite everyone to join Splinterlands, the best game based on chains of blocks, full of adventures, battles, and strategies where you will have fun and get rewards according to your league**
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/Eoc6Yq8EJ2L35tJnQyXixtVnvmKBsf6xNX4yVaZQfn4SPonejdcZVSUfs2LcNi53bp4.png ---  https://i.postimg.cc/d02nBjTg/banner-doradas.gif

title.title: More Vinfast VF3's.
title.body:
These ultra-cheap cars are extremely popular here in Vietnam and with good reason.  There is likely no other car that you can acquire brand new for $10,000.   We will not find out for several years if they are really worth it or not because if they don't last at least 5 years, it's not really a good deal now, is it.  

I have heard some stories from Vietnamese people but I don't know if they are true or just a story about people wanting to have something to talk about but one VN person told me that the batteries have a long warranty and will be replaced for free if they fail, and another person said that they do NOT have a warranty and as you might expect, the battery is half of the value of the car.   If the first person is correct than this car is a safe buy, if the 2nd person is correct the cars are probably trash to be avoided.  

In the meantime I am really enjoying how individual people are kitting these things out to make them all unique.  They have become sort of like the notebooks of a teenager in school where it becomes a competition of sorts to see who can make their car the most unique.

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabe.radke/23tmHsB9qbBMREv3ev3Pc4fFk1fXDzUR4bXSXxw4vUV7YRX2kvHV8QHfzPXWL9GNvpktG.png)
</center>

This is just downright adorable here.  And since I have seen the
Interior of these are actually very small in the back seat and storage area, that decal is about the maximum size that a family could be and still all be able to fit inside of the car.  The back seat is only going to be fitting someone who has legs that are the size of a kid under 8 years old.  Other than that, it could be considered torture.  An adult would definitely not fit back there.  

<center>  
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabe.radke/23tbsLrEcXwkrr6rChuujnUsd2BNEJnyqiw2QFrbtkmoMGpcH3S6swnZ2HVjTzetzwYKa.png)
</center> 

I have no idea if these things have any off-road capability to speak of.  Based on how cheap they are I am going to take a guess and say that they have near none.  I don’t know what the roof rack thing on this one is for, it could just be extra storage because the interior obviously doesn’t have very much of that.  Either way, I think it looks cool and gives this one a lot of character.  

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabe.radke/23wMTvoh69sscAVAAeyzFGQxmHXRR6ECuwCZnJxQB9xPwSuxNqzth1s8rpqrJXn1aadMa.png)</center>

Whoever owns this one is clearly going for a more “extreme” look and I think this is very funny.  There is absolutely nothing that is extreme about this car other than the extremely low price that it costs to get one.   That ladder… would it even be able to handle the weight of an adult human?  I’m not going to be the one that tries it out.  Again though, I think this looks really cool and I believe that is the entire point with most of these alterations.  

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabe.radke/EoGwR41gQ7cH4GrnjCvDfbgcASBrnPkH6h2YedRBnH6x7wf3wp5wNhSdLMRQvMGxDfa.png)</center>

Lastly we have this pink number that appears to have the stock standard wheels on it.  This is just a guess on my part but the ones of these that I see that appear to have the least amount of optional addons tend to have these wheels.  You have to look closely but you can see some bunny ears on the top near the back.   

I would look absolutely wonderful driving this car and would surprise a lot of people if I rocked up in it.  



The word around town is that these vehicles are not selling very well in the very few markets that they are available in outside of Vietnam and I can only imagine that this is because they are seen as trash vehicles.   Is that true?  It's impossible to say.  But when I hear about people paying over 100 thousand dollars for a Tesla, I think I would rather have an army of VF3's and then just drive them until they die.  It's not like you are ever going to be able to go fast in Vietnam anyway, the roads are too crowded.

Which one is your favorite!

title.title: 🤰La maternidad, el verbo en su ejercer.♥️// ♥️Motherhood, the act of being a mother.🤰 [Esp/Eng]
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRRG6mg6ipF4oYST4nnVjgMSkWrvUz7VfSDSfjpTdvKmd/1776830079767.jpg)

Hola a todos, espero se encuentren bien, y que Dios les esté acompañando en su andar. ✨
‎
‎En mi rutina diaria observo que fuera del ámbito laboral, en casa tengo el empleo más demandante pero fructífero que jamás haya podido imaginar, y por eso se me complica redactar como me gusta, escribir y editar con sentido, y declino en ocasiones . Pero me gusta hablar de la maternidad, me gusta compartir de todo lo que voy aprendiendo en ese transitar.

Como he publicado anteriormente tengo 2 hijos, dos maravillosos y tremendos hijos, y es mi trabajo más arduo, complicado y demandante. Ser madre ha sido para mí la decisión más sutil que tomé cuando nos propusimos tenerlos. 

# [English]
<Center>Hello everyone, I hope you’re all doing well, and that God is walking with you on your journey.<\center>
‎
<Center>‎In my daily routine, I realize that outside of work, at home I have the most demanding yet rewarding job I could ever have imagined, and that’s why it’s hard for me to write the way I’d like to—to write and edit with purpose—and sometimes I just can’t bring myself to do it. But I love talking about motherhood; I love sharing everything I’m learning along the way.<\center>

<Center>As I’ve mentioned before, I have two children—two wonderful, amazing children—and this is my hardest, most complicated, and most demanding job. Becoming a mother was the most profound decision I made when we decided to have them.<\center>


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT6vgHt4hvasMFjcweoUUH1Fd6BAfPtYNeYmnuaU5cGAu/1776828522670.gif)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSvEN1fwUHuhfqZ4GJYS8pBLr8NAUMNJmEo5pwmGdJVH9/1776830269059.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXQaPzq7krNrHQCpGDf6nbMV3hmJzdP6egJ2z5p5xGugp/1776830373058.jpg)

‎Me levanto antes de que salga el sol, para **COCINAR**, al salir el sol mi tarea es **DESPERTAR** a mi tercio, porque conmigo es que somos el cuarteto. Mi esposo me ayuda a **VESTIR** a los niños (él viste al niño, yo visto a la niña, a veces viceversa). **LLEVAR** el niño al colegio, **ACOMPAÑAR** a la niña que queda conmigo porque aún no cumple la edad para ir al colegio... Uy, esta última si es un poco demandante porque la niña me ha salido más tremenda e hiperactiva que el niño. **TRABAJAR** también lo hago, para **AYUDAR** a maridito con los gastos del hogar, **LIDIAR** con situaciones externas también entra en el rol maternal (gente que no respeta tu forma de criar)... 

# [English]
<Center>I wake up before the sun rises to **COOK**; when the sun comes up, my task is to **WAKE UP** my partner, because together we make up the family of four. My husband helps me **GET THE KIDS DRESSED** (he dresses the boy, I dress the girl, sometimes vice versa). I **TAKE*** the boy to school and **STAY WITH** the girl, who stays with me because she’s not old enough to go to school yet... Oh, this last part is a bit demanding because the girl has turned out to be even more energetic and hyperactive than the boy. I also **WORK** to **HELP** my husband with household expenses; **DEALING** with external situations is also part of the maternal role (people who don’t respect your parenting style)...<\center>

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT6vgHt4hvasMFjcweoUUH1Fd6BAfPtYNeYmnuaU5cGAu/1776828522670.gif)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQeNbPg73LLZYUVHnHspa7Wg8Psd51gMAiYBjekTqxiRE/1776830509911.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcwf8c7Ls3cxofKMxPqQSxozvqbGDwa8GTkcgv7hBviGP/1776830510080.jpg)

En fin, las actividades de la mañana, aunque son rutinarias, son actividades maternales que se ejercen mediante infinitivos interminables. Con ello iniciamos el medio día, **COCINAR** nuevamente el almuerzo, **REVISAR** que todo haya regresado bien del colegio, **INDAGAR** sobre las actividades que realizó mi niño en el colegio, **AVERIGUAR** si estuvo todo bien, si no hubo alguna novedad, si el aprendizaje del día fue de provecho. **ALMORZAR**, para luego encargarme de que los niños duerman su siesta, lo que implica **BAÑARLOS** (a la niña, porque el niño ya está en el proceso de bañarse solo). En ese tiempo que ellos duermen, **APROVECHAR** de **ASEAR** la casa, **RECOGER** juguetes, y bueno, cuando entre todos colaboramos con la limpieza del hogar, aprovecho ese rato para **DAR** amor y **CONVERSAR** con maridito acerca de nuestros días. 

# [English]
<Center>In short, the morning activities, though routine, are maternal tasks carried out through an endless series of chores. With that, we start the afternoon: **COOKING** lunch again, **CHECKING** that everything came back safely from school, **ASKING** about the activities my child did at school, **FINDING OUT** if everything went well, if there was any news, if the day’s learning was productive. **HAVING LUNCH**, and then making sure the children take their nap, which involves **BATHING THEM** (the girl, because the boy is already learning to bathe himself). While they’re sleeping, I **TAKE ADVANTAGE** of the time to **CLEAN** the house, PICK UP toys, and well, when we all pitch in with the housework, I use that time to SHOW affection and **CHAT** with my husband about our days.<\center>

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT6vgHt4hvasMFjcweoUUH1Fd6BAfPtYNeYmnuaU5cGAu/1776828522670.gif)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbHVzBie1PsF8eXur8hzBN7hLgwR9ZDq1UdGPBCirJfe5/1776830830211.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT7DW8b5U2PRdKD1N96iKyBRuFyX5LjeSW2fojsfYY82o/1776830830325.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVqEVnvpxvsX2RMRZvMcdf6Bt1uqFaigkmXfforx86V1P/1776830830452.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTx1ezE9EfABC8VogLqD6Ws9qVWHm6oKGzkxsr3GKWEZp/1776830830511.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmau3nQdKZbVu1pLJsAHhCaZGZ9mkZV2Aw1rtcvKBew7Ds/1776830830595.jpg)

‎Luego de esa pequeña siesta, estoy súper pendiente de tenerles la merienda a los niños, por lo que a veces vuelvo a **COCINAR** ya que les gusta mucho panqueca, donas, churritos dulces, y esas mezclas con cambur o algo le invento. 
‎
‎Con eso pasamos la tarde, si podemos mamá también se dedica a **JUGAR, BAILAR, SALTAR** con los niños hasta que llega la hora de la cena. Antes de ello, **ORGANIZAR** es importante para tener todo en orden para el día siguiente. BUSCAR el uniforme, **REVISAR** que esté limpio, y mientras, hacemos la cena, lavamos los platos, **PREPARAR** o adelantar el almuerzo del día siguiente también me ha resultado porque en el día, trabajamos ambos en casa.

# [English]
<Center>After that little nap, I’m super focused on getting the kids’ snacks ready, so sometimes I go back to **COOKING** since they really like pancakes, donuts, sweet churros, and those banana-based mixtures—or I just make something up.<\center>
‎
<Center>That’s how we spend the afternoon; if we can, Mom also spends time **PLAYING, DANCING, and JUMPING** with the kids until it’s time for dinner. Before that, **ORGANIZING** is important to have everything in order for the next day. FINDING the uniform, **CHECKING** that it’s clean, and while we make dinner and wash the dishes, **PREPARING** or getting a head start on the next day’s lunch has also worked for me because during the day, we both work from home.<\center>

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT6vgHt4hvasMFjcweoUUH1Fd6BAfPtYNeYmnuaU5cGAu/1776828522670.gif)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTXqV4WaM4Ght314yoNxoDCwgWk97WTsF8Yp5xDZDpZMN/1776830998784.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmevzk37w61GoKvBgML3XhZYwmZzpv2gWB1ybrYNxZruRn/1776830998926.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYNr4vCYWHxgUJUKa7tTjYw4BJn1cLUxHgqtwteMvQM2m/1776830999106.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUgfzQN1esptaizKAGAD7dyZEwmDeRDmUFH86sn5Fkaww/1776830999207.jpg)

Me he propuesto ser para ellos, no la mamá perfecta, pero sí su cuidadora y protectora, por lo menos hasta que ellos puedan tomar sus propias decisiones. Y debo admitir, que al final del día ambos caemos como muertos por el cansancio del día, pero sin duda alguna, soy una mamá feliz y orgullosa de ver cómo van creciendo sus bebés. 
‎
***‎Y sí, tal y como titulé este post, y como dice una de las canciones de Ricardo Arjona, que Jesús es verbo no sustantivo, Maternidad para mí, también es verbo y no sustantivo. (Sin ánimos de decir que somos Dios, claro esté), Pero si que vamos de la mano de él, y por él es que somos todo lo que somos, y hacemos todo lo que hacemos.***

# [English]
<Center>I’ve made it my goal to be there for them—not as the perfect mom, but as their caregiver and protector, at least until they can make their own decisions. And I have to admit, at the end of the day, we both collapse from exhaustion, but without a doubt, I’m a happy mom, proud to watch her babies grow.<\center>
‎
<Center>***‎And yes, just as I titled this post, and as one of Ricardo Arjona’s songs says, that Jesus is a verb, not a noun—motherhood, for me, is also a verb, not a noun. (Not to say that we are God, of course.) But we do walk hand in hand with Him, and it is because of Him that we are everything we are and do everything we do.***<\center>
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT6vgHt4hvasMFjcweoUUH1Fd6BAfPtYNeYmnuaU5cGAu/1776828522670.gif)

title.title: 当然可以！以下是一个关于自然的博客主题建议：\n\n**“四季的变迁
title.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/gc2d88bd78bd1e023e37a54c0c401b0fa70bd0e3b04895c6bca80bd386e24a588ffb0da6d09f33a73af9cc228d5e9c7fa274d84c977dc346e0d07a54f936b8f2c_640.jpg)</center>

***

当然可以！以下是一个关于自然的博客主题建议，主题为“四季的变迁”。你可以使用Markdown格式来撰写这个帖子。以下是一个示例：

```markdown
# 四季的变迁

四季的变迁是自然界中最美丽的现象之一。每个季节都有其独特的魅力和特色，下面我们将一一探讨春、夏、秋、冬四个季节的变化。

## 春天：万物复苏

春天是生命重生的季节。随着气温的回升，冰雪融化，花朵开始绽放，树木抽出新芽。

### 特点：
- **花卉盛开**：樱花、桃花等各种花卉竞相开放，装点大地。
- **动物活动**：许多动物从冬眠中苏醒，开始繁殖。
- **气候温暖**：温暖的阳光和适度的降雨为植物生长提供了良好的条件。

## 夏天：生机盎然

夏天是阳光明媚、万物繁茂的季节。大自然在这个时候展现出最为旺盛的生命力。

### 特点：
- **高温天气**：阳光强烈，气温升高。
- **丰收季节**：农田里的作物逐渐成熟，果实累累。
- **户外活动**：人们喜欢在海滩、山野中享受阳光与自然。

## 秋天：丰收与凋零

秋天是一个收获的季节，同时也是万物开始凋零的时刻。树叶变色，逐渐从绿色转为金黄、红色。

### 特点：
- **丰收的季节**：稻谷、苹果、南瓜等成熟，农民忙于收割。
- **气温下降**：随着日照时间缩短，气温逐渐降低。
- **自然景观**：秋天的风景如画，五彩斑斓的树叶吸引着无数游客。

## 冬天：静谧与沉寂

冬天是一个寒冷而宁静的季节，许多植物进入休眠状态，动物也减少了活动。

### 特点：
- **寒冷天气**：气温骤降，常常伴随降雪。
- **自然的沉寂**：大自然似乎进入了沉睡，万物静谧。
- **节日氛围**：冬季的节日，如圣诞节和春节，为这个寒冷的季节增添了温暖的氛围。

## 结论

四季的变迁不仅是自然界的规律，也深深影响着人类的生活。每个季节都有其独特的美丽与意义，让我们珍惜每一个季节带来的体验与感受。

body.body:
![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hooiyewlim/EoyQv2w9JN7r295XW9au8nvMeyUKEytm9bAgtmYb7qN4MFmq7NwDwn15CaHUb56BkzH.jpg)

Today I visited the Food Place food court, located at Pavilion Mall. The food court is located beside the Oriental Kopi Restaurant.

![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hooiyewlim/Ep1WzfFn5udYEoPuvwoHdsVFpZxJRFmRcnSYd4TSKREYUfSVoYfQZHqJvHoWKmjYt6U.jpg)

![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hooiyewlim/EoyRrmXCV6uLzBUEgn1dxtqgzt89W8nEa4MqCHKJReTdUN8NnKzGbJcJHdAfiJiaaJY.jpg)

This time, I ordered passion fruit pickled veges fish mihun soup from the ZDY Express stall, which cost RM19.80 per bowl.

This bowl of passion fruit pickled vegetables fish mihun soup looks bright, light and refreshing. The soup has a golden-orange colour with a glossy surface, showing that the broth is rich yet not too heavy. The thin mihun sits beneath slices of soft white fish, while vegetables like bok choy and Chinese cabbage add freshness and crunch.

What makes this soup stand out is the combination of passion fruit, pickled vegetables and a light spicy kick. The passion fruit gives the broth a fruity sweetness and tropical aroma, while the pickled vegetables bring a sour, fermented taste. There is also a mild spiciness in the soup, likely coming from the pickled vegetables themselves, as many preserved vegetables are mixed with chilli during the pickling process. This creates a layered flavour that is sour, savoury, slightly sweet and gently spicy all at once.

The fish slices look soft and delicate, allowing the soup to remain the main highlight. The thin mihun absorbs the broth easily, so every bite carries the flavour of the spicy-sour soup. The vegetables also help balance the richness, making the dish feel lighter and more refreshing.

Traditional fish bee hoon soup has roots in Chinese and Southeast Asian cooking, especially among Teochew communities. It is usually made with fish stock, sliced fish, bee hoon and vegetables. Over time, many modern versions started adding ingredients like pickled vegetables, tomatoes, sour plum or passion fruit to create more unique flavours.

This passion fruit pickled vegetables fish mihun soup is special because it combines the comfort of traditional fish soup with a modern fruity and spicy twist. The sourness from the pickled vegetables, the sweetness of the passion fruit and the slight chilli heat work together to make the broth more addictive and appetising.

Our body is very valuable and our greatest asset is our health. There are many ways to destroy our health. We know how to keep our body healthy and we also know how to make our body sick, that is, what things can make our body sick and how much laziness can destroy our body. Yet, despite knowing everything, we are constantly destroying our body. There are many people who know everything and intentionally consume various toxic, bad, intoxicating substances and unhealthy food that are harmful to the body. People who intentionally destroy their body definitely need to get some education. We get a beautiful body at the time of our birth which has no flaws. But as we grow up and understand little by little, we get attracted to various harmful things and eat bad food and intoxicating substances and damage our body. If we go around different places including different hospitals and nursing homes, we will see how many people are fighting with life without any fault.

Small children who have not yet learned to understand are also affected by serious diseases and are involved in the struggle for survival. How many people have never come close to any drug in their lives and even tried to eat good food, they are also constantly diagnosed with various serious diseases. These people are constantly fighting to survive and are trying to fix their diseases and problems. On the one hand, some people are involved in trying to save their lives and maintain the property called the body, and on the other hand, some people are constantly destroying their healthy body bit by bit. And the result of this destruction may not be seen in the present situation, but they will definitely get it in the future. People do not always get all kinds of karma immediately, so many times when people get the result of bad deeds in old age, they think, \

. But they do not remember what actions they have done throughout their lives and how much wrong they have done. Similarly, the body will give us the result at the end of life, just as we will be treated throughout our lives. It is already seen that even after trying to be good, many times we cannot be good or healthy. There are so many organs in the body that we have no idea or proper knowledge about. As a result, we cannot or do not think about keeping them healthy. We constantly look at how our body feels from above or how beautiful we look. Even though we always look beautiful or healthy from above, there is no guarantee that we are healthy from within. Maybe people who think that they are very healthy and do not have any kind of problem, for which they can eat whatever they want or take drugs. But since we cannot know what is happening inside the body, our behavior can destroy the internal organs of our body. It is seen that even if we eat good food many times, our body has various problems, in which case bad food is more dangerous than poison for our body. No matter how much we see from the outside that our body is beautiful and fresh and we are living very well, we cannot give any guarantee to our body in any way. Because what we think is beautiful may not actually be beautiful. It may also be that the body looks beautiful or healthy from the outside, but inside there is a treasure trove of countless diseases or some problem is arising somewhere or the other. Even if we eat good food, we cannot guarantee our body, and we should not harm our body by eating bad food. Our body never tells us about any problem in advance. When we have a major disease or a major problem, when that problem reaches a very extreme level, then various symptoms appear in our body or we start feeling sick. The body never tells us in advance that it is sick and suddenly gives us a lot of trouble. Therefore, we can never guarantee our body that our body is healthy or sick. body.title: One of the Good Rare Cards on Splinterlands - Vengeful Monk
body.body:
![My Modern Journey on (4).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/23tvAt9SKSVe6q8utKpCTTNBmashqmGP9gzaYn3j7X6MiCKutXRqwa2RaUTKwy5trCBUw.png)
Greetings again readers! Hoping you are all good and healthy! I am sharing again another thoughts on my Splinterlands journey but focusing on a card that I frequently used. Not that legendary nor epic. Even pricey card to boot. It is rare, yes, but can be minted from foundation packs or some daily reward grind. Take note that this packs can be claimed as long you are owning with spellbook for splinterland by buying them on the market directly or chance owning them on daily grind reward system of frontier rank battles. If ever you tried the Frontier Rank battle of Splinterlands you must be familiar of this card for the reason that it is a card that commonly used in the team of players (which is I believed). Well, I personally always use this on my team for it is a good win grabber. Hailing from the Neutral Splinters, Vengeful Monk is what I am stating with my introduction. # Vengeful Monk #
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/23u5V68k4tadUjVdRnD6GPHtsisuFX6pePsHFBSn6bj9L96eZqNGKVQ72oi2DZ4GJsz2d.png)
I own a maxed Gold Foil card of Vengeful Monk at the moment. Well, minting with the black foil and black foil arcane is still a possibility from the weekly draws or if ever you want to own it by choice, you can just search it in the market if you desired to own it this instant. Having a 2 Melee attack damage and an opportunity ability a good choice for an offensive card. Take note that this is a Neutral splinter and it means that it is mostly compatible with almost every team you are trying to form unless restricted. ##### Opportunity Ability ###### > Targets the enemy unit with the least health.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/23vsC5TfvsBEFvxcUnJAtkJJXZD6n6WFVEi6tPsg654UkhMZVakdmQNfXonzpqbbXGPcx.png
So you see, an Opportunity ability is crucial to grab a win in your battle. It is an edge where that you can take down an enemy card that might gain a chance to flip the situation in a battle. Normally, this type of ability will target cards that got less, unless taunted, health from the beginning of the battle. With that, I believed that it is crucial to lessen your opponent's card team as early as possible. With 3 speed, Vengeful monk card will perfectly perform a good offensive capability to your team. # Battle Sample # The best part of explanation comes from a sample battle of course. So here it is.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/23t7DRcH7NRa7PNe4CfRLGVGRsbx9iHkwSBiAen5q3k1jVJ3sAgEeRuNQFmtXJUXDN1KS.png)
Battling water splinters for this round and I am choosing Life splinters. With Counter Spell on the Rulesets, I am not planning to put any magician card on my team and with that I arrived in the conclusion that using the Life splinters with the Incessant Sage as my summoner. See, that card also came also from frontier and is usable to modern rank battles. It will add an additional extra armor to my monster units and it is a perfect protection to the incoming melee and range offense. It is a high mana battle with 58 mana capacity so I built my team with medium to high mana monsters and my archon currently for Life splinters came from foundation packs. So my monster unit line up starts with Anyu Huntswoman that got flank ability followed by Mantaroth with its Aromored strike ability. Vengeful Monk is placed on the 3rd which is being protected both from front and back of my team. Sherringham Logger and A'lan Musketeer where added with their offensive capabilities. To avoid early damages from the early round to my low hp cards, I am using New Beluruc Aegis to absorb those attack with its taunt ability.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/23tGa9EomtKAcmSB45PE7xESTZvVnaUuMDnGECAjBZgFX19T65oAFTTiikGtXxPQDr6Wh.png)
Round 1 is a bit rough start for my team. I lost 2 cards from the attacks of my opponent that got magic damage. Although counter spell was triggered, it is not enough to take down the cards which was magic reflected. Vengeful Monk with this round already targeted the card that got the most minimum health which was A'lan Musketeer from my opponent's team.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/23tGZwAu1wJQd5FoU5W1ktGLtZcjqtgKE3sm2XRFszRqF7g2swDi2RE52gfeZ1kW67tNe.png)
Continuing on the second round, this time my Vengeful monk targeted Mystic Scaleweaver of my opponent it was on the verge of collapsing. Lucky snake!
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/23tGXZkVbo1cxmHLwHobMzmLdreuYxVeAixtvqJxbm6h1MPCAxWDarYEqXgdfLjj6zmen.png)
Round 4 is where the battle is going to be concluded. I lost my Vengeful monk in this round while tanking a few attacks. It got a descent amount of health that it survive long enough for the battle.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/23tbCQSeXh4iHgsXHGBnffghQcDHT1hfvqzjfv2nEYgrjfcQTpuo6W7SV8DRcrWrYPeGB.png)
I still won the fight in the end with a little margin and thanks to the ruleset of course. ![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/6EvhIxWxuGYAAAAC/bird-lol.gif) 
Ma posti piccoli come l'Islanda, Malta e Cipro rischiano di fare la fine dell'Italia soltanto per l'appartenenza all'UE? Mi auguro di no, considerando che questi paesi (e gli scandinavi a maggior ragione) non hanno mai avuto politici teste di rapa come in sud Europa, nè l'UE sembra troppo interessata come invece è interessata ai paesi che considera l'ultima ruota del carro. Non menziono i paesi dell'est in UE che non si fanno mettere i piedi in testa da Bruxelles (anzi, Bruxelles sembra perfino avere paura di Romania e dintorni).   
E no, il rischio della mancata spendibilità delle cripto è serio. Spostarsi di paese senza poterne fare uso, ma poi come si campa, dato che in nessun paese si vive gratis?😱

body.title: Rice with chicken, zucchini and carrot (Eng-Esp)
body.body: <center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23tvvzGBfxWv19aALonCSPu8Swd6HfBcBrtx6KjQzG7q2RUXtQ3HB5xn3pS4DPBRgvFF6.png)</center>\n\n* Good evening friends, welcome back to my blog! This time, I'm sharing with you the delicious lunch I prepared to enjoy with my family. Below, I'll explain how to make an \

. I hope you enjoy the process of making this tasty recipe... Let's get started!\n\n>* Buenas noches amigos, bienvenidos de nuevo a mi blog... En esta ocasión, comparto con ustedes el delicioso almuerzo que preparé para disfrutar con mi familia, a continuación les explicaré como realizar un \

. Espero disfruten el proceso de esta sabrosa receta, empecemos!

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/Eq5Gwtb84StTSoJJw11BhUDskdJVm8hjYwRqonqUcPfMuxG2xK64sP7K9n5CWDtKebG.png)</center>

* INGREDIENTS: zucchini, carrot, sweet peppers, garlic cloves, onion, chicken breast (cut into small cubes), pepper, curry, herbs, rice and salt.

>* INGREDIENTES: calabacín, zanahoria, ajies dulces, dientes de ajo, cebolla, pechuga de pollo (cortada en cubos pequeños), pimienta, curry, finas hierbas, arroz y sal.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23xyjxsXn2xBGr1juWcAjbe64naXyuSQvsNwnxEujihKr1nQdjq6N5Ew8A28y6nMdEJFa.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23uFiWaDUkwWSqfQvjxfWJiX9iNEg6XjSbBnTrryRL1LC9Nn2CCQy8eutVRqcunYxHYw9.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23tHQhd4hoFmPXoui3P2vHx4XPZxWuvhmsjC8YTYBhA6UjfRWdr8Bw6gz56e1QPhQn1pL.png)</center>

<center>PREPARATION/PREPARATION</center>

* The first step is to add 3 tablespoons of olive or sunflower oil to the pot where we'll be preparing our dish. Sauté the onion, along with the garlic cloves, sweet peppers, and carrot, which we've previously cut into very thin strips.
Sauté until the carrot softens slightly (season with salt and pepper).

>* El primer paso será incorporar 3 cucharadas de aceite de oliva o de girasol a la olla donde vamos a realizar nuestra preparación... Sofreímos la cebolla, junto con los dientes de ajo, los ajies dulces y la zanahoria, que previamente habremos cortado en tiras muy delgadas.
Salteamos hasta que la textura de la zanahoria se ablande un poco (salpimentamos).

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23vsV3kq1f2H69HYRquYasEhpjtz8vHPYBPamv8MqBSaYPXSGJBWBvtGiUpNmL3xE7hR1.png)</center>

* Add the chicken... Whenever I make this recipe, I love adding a touch of soy sauce. It's optional, but it makes it really tasty!
Cook until cooked through.

>* Añadimos el pollo... Siempre que realizo esta receta me encanta colocar un toque de salsa de soja, es opcional, pero queda muy sabroso!
Cocinamos hasta comprobar que está cocido.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23tvnk3SoNn7GwzvoAogxvhfh3vKN4ffw6SYAwxLutaEfXn4kpddTSU6Qj1u6izJ4BaVW.png)</center>

* In this step we add the zucchini (leaving the skin on)... Sauté for 3 minutes.

>* En este paso añadimos el calabacín (dejamos la piel)... Salteamos durante 3 minutos.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/EouAErT6LiTeNPdQ17NeqqJmSDJ21NRgtUeB2cZ5fTYpdVbtZwwVNpJ4GZfSk3Lq2Dh.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23wCE6QmRPCQ1mqVRJjE4JPVFmcydFXZNoeTPtuaHwUKEqvvhKo2PQs26foTCHVcgMZVW.png)</center>

* Add the rice, sauté together with the ingredients... Add water to cover, season with: curry, fine herbs, adjust the salt and pepper.

>* Incorporamos el arroz, sofreímos junto con los ingredientes... Colocamos agua hasta cubrir, aliñamos con: curry, finas hierbas, ajustamos el punto de sal y pimienta.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23wX5mN6DZFpRd8AjYS13Ezvtpj4SZ19pPdHEUsHVe6NuYkHhkH7M3SkHZiQuDmLzkMn8.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/48JeAbhzor5zLhbXBTsGdU7ZNA4nZv8RkGNEKm6hxKZLCSUKf2e6v8N9Jw1PanjFgR.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23uR3ExXkhh67N8wAt67RC2gD1N2BMSNRde9WNPCsnP6dfw2g9nsmuFgSzFCciXov5AQG.png)</center>

* Next, we add cilantro (leaves and stems); this ingredient will provide an aromatic flavor that I'm sure you'll love!

>* A continuación, integramos cilantro (hojas y tallos), este ingrediente aportará un sabor aromático, que estoy segura amarán!

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23xKzMWDNLSRj6uWiZvUyYycUJMxAQj2VWYfoUXv9fACguuZcixzejsyGaHnVfiWNhaCg.png)</center>

* Our delicious dish is ready to enjoy!

>* Nuestro suculento platillo está listo para disfrutar!

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23xAcSXpAJKuD6SJvidcTiJj9XBkBqBPC4eWSHNUSWWKR8bu7i8RSVHwhFcWza8c8z2MG.png)</center>

* Friends, here's a wonderful lunch option for you and your family—a real treat!
Thank you so much for visiting my blog. Enjoy your meal!

>* Amigos, a continuación les presento una maravillosa opción para almorzar con sus familiares, un manjar al paladar!
Muchas gracias por visitar mi blog, me despido deseándoles buen provecho!

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/Eq5Gwtb84StTSoJJw11BhUDskdJVm8hjYwRqonqUcPfMuxG2xK64sP7K9n5CWDtKebG.png)</center>

body.title: Mike and Nick and Nick and Alice (film):  Could be right for the right person
body.body:
I have a soft spot of Vince Vaughn because of his comedy roles back in the 90's and early 2000's.   I don't feel as though he has ever had the clout or ability for that matter, to carry a lead role and can't really think of too many films where he was able to pull this off.  There are exceptions of course, but often this was because of his co-star or co-stars as much as it was about him.

For the most part he is a good guy to have on the cast, but not the one you want first on the list.  There is a reason for this and I think that this film is a good example of why studios don't really bank on his star-power to pull a film over the top.

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/netflixr/23sK2b3MREhs5jb9p8G4ekcvsLNN9hCWLuYFefxWQK5J9hf8GQ8BRs4N3mLATkyNhoSLM.png)
[src](https://img1.hulu.com/user/v3/artwork/dda7510f-0b80-422c-94d8-50a12502427e?base_image_bucket_name=image_manager&base_image=019ca177-972c-7646-a6d5-f7579ee14f76&region=US&format=webp&size=952x536) </center>

This film begins with Nick (Vince) being portrayed as a charismatic gangster of sorts that is well-known to be a law-breaking person, but because of his connections and all the charity that he does alongside his criminal activities, he never faces justice.  He is well-liked despite being a known killer.

This is the first problem because Vince, to me, just doesn't have that sort of feared gangster persona to him.   Let's run with it anyway though.   

Nick is friends with a contract killer named \
(James Marsden) but is unaware/maybe aware that Mike is having an affair with his smokin' hot wife \
(Eiza González).   One night at a fundraiser that is organized by the real boss of the city's thugs, Nick invited Mike out to the parking lot to have a chat about a \

he has going on that he needs Mike's help with. Mike is under Nick in the pecking order so he goes with him even though Mike believes at the time that he is going to get killed for the affair he is having.
https://filmthreat.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/mike-nick-nick-alice-alice-mike-present-nick-future-nick-eiza-gonzalez-james-marsden-vince-vaughn-1200x900.jpeg [src](https://filmthreat.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/mike-nick-nick-alice-alice-mike-present-nick-future-nick-eiza-gonzalez-james-marsden-vince-vaughn-1200x900.jpeg)
Instead, Nick asks Mike to some help with an actual special project that involves Mike re-activating his old skills as an assassin and they drive off to make this happen. We are not given much information as to what is going to happen here, when Mike gets dropped off at a house with a bottle of chloroform and a rag to kidnap whoever opens the door, and I guess it is supposed to be funny when the person who opens the door is Nick himself, Although it is another Nick and Nick is two of the same person existing in the same time and space. This is where the film makes an attempt at being a time-travel movie and it is somewhat interesting if you are into science-fiction the way that I am, but honestly, the story becomes rather convoluted and complicated from that point forward to the point where I think that most people just kind of tune out to the main story and just decide to roll with it and wait for the next series of fast-talkin' comedy speeches that Vince Vaughn is so well known for in basically all of the films he has ever been in.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/netflixr/EogKvYm2mVzSowY9Waoe7sPZK7GGWDJDuGKdyxJhEJzDeUAnaQNTttG4s8RDbDxpgc4.png) [src](https://img4.hulu.com/user/v3/artwork/e2fa283a-db59-4d25-a399-782284cdf2ca?base_image_bucket_name=image_manager&base_image=019cd694-4d68-769a-91eb-9425af29dcfd&size=600x338&format=webp) at nearly 60, Vince is lookin good
There's some action which is actually really well done considering that Vaughn is in his late 50's and can't be the easiest person to get a body double for, and also because of the fact that in many of the scenes, Vince is playing two different characters that are in the same scene. I am sure this was a bit of a direction nightmare, and I can appreciate this. However, this method has been used in a lot of films, and at least to me, it rarely works in dazzling the audience and for me, I kept trying to figure out where it was that they clearly had a body double for Vince in most of what was going on. The whole story is eventually revealed to have a reason behind it that you might not be suspecting, and because I don't want to ruin this honestly, not-so-amazing plot twist, I will leave it out of this writeup. But I will say that when you do find out about it, you don't really care. The entire situation is a happenstance sort of thing that isn't really a plot so much as it is a bunch of things that just fell together in order to make a story. If you take too much time to think about what these 4 are trying to accomplish, there were many other ways in which they could have gone about it that would have been more effective than the ways they choose.
https://thespool.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/Mike-Nick-Nick-Alice-Keith-David-1024x576.jpg [src](https://thespool.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/Mike-Nick-Nick-Alice-Keith-David-1024x576.jpg) probably trying to figure out how to transform into a turkey in order to catch Rick
A lot of the side characters are ok, i guess as they are parodies of what we would all consider to be actual bad guys in life and for me at least, I cannot take actor Keith David seriously ever since he did the voice of the President of the United States in *Rick and Morty*. I hope he got a lot of money for that because for a lot of people I can't view him as anything other than that. This sort of movie has it's place I would imagine, but I don't think that 20th Century had much faith in it either seeing as how it was never even given a theatrical run and just went straight to streaming on Hulu. That is today's version of a film that went straight to DVD because the people who made it realized they would just lose a ton of money by bothering to advertise it. This is the reason why I would imagine that most people, much like myself, had never even heard of this movie until it popped up as an option on streaming. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Jfng-SUVkGM

Should I watch it ?

That trailer gives away entirely too much of the plot and the reason for that is because the film was probably too difficult to market otherwise. The main things that are good about this movie is that Vince and James have pretty good on-screen chemistry and their fast-talking comedy hits pretty well in a lot of places. The convoluted and often confusing story is an afterthought here though and that is not surprising considering we have ourselves a time-traveling movie where the main character breaks the main rule of time-travel that was established in meeting their own self. This was established by the BEST time-travel movie ever made, *Back to the Future* and it's just personal, but I don't like when people don't follow that script and that important rule. Anyway, before I make this too long just know that this film is perfectly find because of certain key moments and therefore I would qualify it as something that you put on while you clean your house around the TV. It isn't a date-night movie or something that you watch intently for the super-compelling storyline or outstanding acting, because it has neither of those.
![50119633_m.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/netflixr/23yxCTVfbh1bAPfiDSXjwM8yo3PJuE88475xKnSdamLEVNFQAa2rV1c6EebLczqDwFMg1.jpg) As implied in the body of the text, this is only legally streamed on Hulu at the moment but will likely migrate to other services in a month or so. It is very unlikely to ever be on Netflix

body.title: Stewed Chickpeas in Tomato Sauce\\Geschmorte Kichererbsen in Tomatensoße
body.body:
Hello,my friends!
Today we're cooking another chickpea dish. First, we'll pre-boil the chickpeas until almost done, then simmer them in tomato sauce with apples and carrots. This dish is suitable for vegans and vegetarians; although there's no meat, it's still quite filling. Let's go, it's going to be delicious!



![1.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNpEAYrHPihQQ4xwaxmTL6TiVqVSs1ATNRyxxbMbkMW7u/1.jpg)


Ingredients:
● Chickpeas - 1.5 cups
● Tomato paste - 3 tbsp
● Apples - 2 pcs
● Onion - 1 pc
● Sugar - 3 tbsp
● Cumin - 1 tbsp (to taste)
● Water for the sauce - 2 cups
● Starch - 2 tbsp
● Apple cider vinegar 6% - 3 tbsp
● Starch - 2 tbsp.
● Black pepper, salt, soy sauce, spices, baking soda, vegetable oil for frying, herbs - to taste

1.Let's prepare the chickpeas. Soak the chickpeas in water with a teaspoon of baking soda the night before. This will help them cook faster. Drain the old water and cook the chickpeas in fresh water with a pinch of baking soda and salt. Cook for 25 minutes, skimming off any foam that rises to the surface. The chickpeas are almost done; they're cooked, but still al dente; they shouldn't be mushy; this isn't hummus. Turn off the heat and drain the chickpeas.



![2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXWpN3nB49QcGX8dGNWTAVrxrgsK3igAR4RBRdNcXxFFp/2.jpg)


2.Peel the onion and carrot. Cut the vegetables into cubes no larger than the chickpeas and fry in vegetable oil. Fry until the onion and carrot are golden brown.



![3.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ9AFBd3RUCTLsYont8inszEZTdxmaA9xo4D47zMpd5uj/3.jpg)


3.Prepare the tomato sauce with apples. Dissolve good-quality tomato paste in 2 cups of water. Grate the apples, peeling and removing the seeds, and add to the tomato sauce. Add 3 tablespoons of sugar, 3 tablespoons of apple cider vinegar, 2 tablespoons of starch, 4 tablespoons of soy sauce, 1 tablespoon of cumin, hot pepper, salt, and black pepper to taste. Stir the tomato sauce.


![4.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdEWnTJJPUrkttNVEVbK6rWSUkBGq1JqQGefwYuL9tyHH/4.jpg)


4.Add the chickpeas to the onions and carrots, add 1/2 cup of water, and simmer for 10 minutes over medium heat, stirring.



![5.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPR2PEaz6To7fLmy1nq5cT2iv6tDroHb2ptPZUBTToG6Z/5.jpg)


5.Pour in the tomato sauce, stir, and cover. Cook over medium-low heat for 20 minutes until the sauce thickens and the chickpeas become soft and tender.


![6.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfVMwGFNKWjGRXi7ddgb8eYVaKt7UyDVnqTiwXVHbmRzy/6.jpg)


6.Taste the dish and add any missing flavorings (salt, sugar, spices).



![7.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNwM5vgakypDHaJ5dARd7GtWyWdjm5Q7GuRdEP1ucknSa/7.jpg)


Place the stewed chickpeas in tomato sauce into bowls and serve. Garnish with green onions and sesame seeds. Very filling, very tasty!



![8.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRZM7KxLsL2ZvuwukXpUsCK2yJoX56V98rcZNZdyhxH14/8.jpg)


Shall we cook it?


![3-poloska-1.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYyhhAydYCgxXo6MZeZ3YC526qwyBdU2NCdMXtyoJGAXB/3-poloska-1.png)

Heute bereiten wir ein weiteres Kichererbsengericht zu. Zuerst kochen wir die Kichererbsen fast gar vor und lassen sie dann in Tomatensoße mit Äpfeln und Karotten köcheln. Dieses Gericht ist für Veganer und Vegetarier geeignet; obwohl es kein Fleisch enthält, ist es trotzdem sehr sättigend. Los geht's, es wird köstlich!

Zutaten:
● Kichererbsen – 1,5 Tassen
● Tomatenmark – 3 EL
● Äpfel – 2 Stück
● Zwiebel – 1 Stück
● Zucker – 3 EL
● Kreuzkümmel – 1 EL (nach Geschmack)
● Wasser für die Soße – 2 Tassen
● Stärke – 2 EL
● Apfelessig (6 %) – 3 EL
● Stärke – 2 EL
● Schwarzer Pfeffer, Salz, Sojasauce, Gewürze, Natron, Pflanzenöl zum Braten, Kräuter – nach Geschmack

1.Kichererbsen vorbereiten: Die Kichererbsen am Vorabend in Wasser mit einem Teelöffel Natron einweichen. Dadurch garen sie schneller. Das alte Wasser abgießen und die Kichererbsen in frischem Wasser mit einer Prise Natron und Salz kochen. 25 Minuten kochen lassen und dabei den entstehenden Schaum abschöpfen. Die Kichererbsen sind fast gar; sie sind gar, aber noch bissfest; sie sollten nicht matschig sein; es handelt sich schließlich nicht um Hummus. Herdplatte ausschalten und die Kichererbsen abgießen.

2.Zwiebel und Karotte schälen. Das Gemüse in Würfel schneiden, die nicht größer als die Kichererbsen sind, und in Pflanzenöl anbraten. Braten, bis Zwiebel und Karotte goldbraun sind.

3.Tomatensauce mit Äpfeln zubereiten. Hochwertiges Tomatenmark in 2 Tassen Wasser auflösen. Äpfel schälen, entkernen und unter die Tomatensoße reiben. 3 EL Zucker, 3 EL Apfelessig, 2 EL Stärke, 4 EL Sojasauce, 1 EL Kreuzkümmel, Chilipulver, Salz und Pfeffer nach Geschmack hinzufügen. Die Tomatensoße umrühren.

4.Kichererbsen zu Zwiebeln und Karotten geben, ½ Tasse Wasser hinzufügen und 10 Minuten bei mittlerer Hitze unter Rühren köcheln lassen.

5.Die Tomatensoße angießen, umrühren und abdecken. Bei schwacher bis mittlerer Hitze 20 Minuten köcheln lassen, bis die Soße eindickt und die Kichererbsen weich sind.

6.Abschmecken und gegebenenfalls mit Salz, Zucker und Gewürzen nachwürzen.

Die geschmorten Kichererbsen in Schüsseln anrichten und servieren. Mit Frühlingszwiebeln und Sesamsamen garnieren. Sehr sättigend, sehr lecker!

Sollen wir kochen?

![3-poloska-1.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYyhhAydYCgxXo6MZeZ3YC526qwyBdU2NCdMXtyoJGAXB/3-poloska-1.png)

# <center>[*«*D*e*p*r*e*s*s*i*v*e* *R*e*a*l*i*s*m*»](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Depressive_realism#:~:text=Defensive%20pessimism%20%E2%80%93%20Cognitive%20strategy%20for,to%20see%20oneself%20overly%20favorably)</center>
https://youtu.be/O5b0ZxUWNf0

<div class=\

>

It is fascinating how we are handing over our most intimate selves to be replaced by a machine. I believe there has never been a will to deceive others that so fools the deceivers. Now we have millions of tyrants, many influencers. This time the one lending his soul is not a someone in love with life, it is an algorithm trained with all the human writing that exists. And the somebodies of the day are executives, students, journalists, politicians, **content creators.** ¿But who invented that crap about content creators?

¿But what content? In short, they are asking artificial intelligence to write down what they think before they have even thought it or even been able to think it. Good old philosophers were talking about alienation. No one anticipated that they would also come for the most intimate work, the work of thinking, of doubting, of making mistakes with elegance, of finding one's own words. It turns out that in the end people no longer write letters, or even emails, they generate them. They no longer write arguments, they delegate them. They no longer look for the exact word for 10 minutes looking out the window or at the ceiling. That which is the moment when we become who we are.

Now they say: *\

*  And in 3 seconds there is something correct, clean, efficient and absolutely empty of the person who is going to sign it. Personality is not a file you can save while AI works for you. Personality is a process of clumsiness, of failed attempts, of phrases that don't quite work but are nonetheless yours. When you delegate that process systematically, it's not true that you're saving time. You are giving up the ground where the self is formed. And it's not just that you're lazy, it's that you're giving up on revealing who you really are.

Aristotle said that we become just by doing just acts, and brave by doing brave acts. In short, I would add, we are not artificial intelligence. We become writers by writing, thinkers by thinking, people having the courage to articulate what we are, even if it turns out badly. ¿What happens when we delegate?  Well, it happens to everyone. You need to be more productive, you need to generate more content, you need to amplify your **own** voice. 

But how can you amplify your **own** voice if you don't listen to it?  ¿If your voice is that of an algorithm? That way what you multiply is only the emptiness of yourself that would be of greater volume.  And I'm not saying that artificial intelligence is absolute evil, no. I'm not saying that there isn't a use that impoverishes us and that we are normalizing it at a terrifying speed, especially in schools and universities. There is a huge difference between using a tool to do better what you already know how to do and using a tool to avoid learning how to do it. That is exclusively my entire premise.

Actually we live with a great deal of uncertainty about how much control we have on everything in life. Over our careers, our health, our body weight, our friendships, or our happiness. ¿What actions can we take that really matter? If we want to make good choices in life, it’s very helpful to know what we control and what we don’t. ¿Right?

Because certainly, the future is one of those things we can't control, even if we think we can. Controlling it ourselves without considering the control others around us might exert over that same future is just a mistake, a mirage, a deception, a mere big fallacy. And even more so in these rapidly changing technological times in which everyone has access to everyone else trying to impose their own reality and point of view on the future through someone else **artificial** arguments and alien biased algorithms. And that's why nowadays you need to forget about what that nice, sweet, convenient and comfortable phrase \

hints and imply.

Reality has never been clearly defined. Nor has the future. Everyone has their own version of both, based on their own experiences, life events and limited perspective, shaped by the intimate environment in which they have had to exist and they find themselves today.

A world full of multiple existential bubbles and echo chambers to which we have gradually [moved](https://youtu.be/6YXX_Y8R3qY) from one to another without knowing exactly why. Although we nevertheless intuit that this endless displacement from one bubble to the other, from one echo chamber to the other, was nothing more than pure social pressure and the need to fit in with the group, with the herd to be somehow accepted, validated and recognized.

But then I ask you: In a historical moment where DeepFakes are the norm. In a historical moment where more and more everyone has access to the very same tools to influence others. In a historical moment where everyone is capable of plant, brandishing and establish an artificial truth. And in a historical moment where those same truths are governed and controlled by an artificial and biased algorithm that everyone has used. ¿Where is the truth? ¿Where is the reality? ¿Where is the future?  ¿Can you point them out? ¿Can you identify them unequivocally? ¿Yes? Ok, then show me!

https://youtu.be/IheL31luaEs

<div class=\

](https://youtu.be/iOucwX7Z1HU) when everyone uniformly is using the exact same artificial tools and imposed algorithms to approach the ultimate and indisputable truth and achieve authentic awareness, knowledge & wisdom?

Yeah! because for me in this current world, it's way better to be wise. Being wiser no matter what. No matter how different and distant your wisdom and opinion might sound from the homogeneous artificial crowd. Because only by being yourself will you genuinely connect with those who are truly like you. **¡With those who truly matter!**

title.title: JUMPSCARE!!! - 3D Render Holozing Fanart!
title.body:
Bet that was your immediate reaction to this. I mean, Arachlet had fair reasons to jumpscare its healer. We'll get to know them eventually in this post.

So yeah, I recently finished Arachlet's rig, game ready.

![spider_process_0000_Layer 1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anima-shot/23tbPKwXX2pfmnqwsU5haRsm7PwRhVHHnzzFbUo8UN2EuixwcB5rEQrbY7qGvszHS9QJC.jpg)

It was time for the usual render. I didn't know what kind of scenery would have fit it better, and also didn't want to make another cave render, not for now at least. But I've been wanting since a while ago to make a picnic scene, for unknown reasons. Don't ask, it just felt like it xD

My knowledge about materials in blender is way too basic. Made this picnic blanket using a checker texture and a noise texture with a bump shader but it sucked, it didn't look like an actual picnic blanket.

![spider_process_0001_Layer 2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anima-shot/23wqkdW6PsFWQLy3pVUHULJ9oZ1VVqqh2u42B1dHjVcGkkoH5Yut1irvTkLv3iB5SGmRn.jpg)

With the help of a youtube tutorial I managed to make this material. I learned a lot about materials in general during the making and now instead of deeply hating it I'm starting to love experimenting with the nodes!

![spider_process_0002_Layer 3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anima-shot/23yTfFFdMpUTiv1DHDfkrc2nbXDym5XpkU7cTn1skfR7rYCG6H2ABZ7vRdk3wnsuB82Y3.jpg)

![spider_process_0003_Layer 5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anima-shot/23wqkHA5q4XNYHT18BFGmYtRFiVLNaQxpRQuqLKXzATyahQpzCWK4WiXCAndUogsy4zFA.jpg)

I posed Arachlet on it, looking at us. I called it cute, but it got mad at me.

![spider_process_0004_Layer 7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anima-shot/23xyXVMyodmLTWRY7v5HAoUft9nPk6ZhY6bEb8kJynXBMhRweLoaU4rxwQxQeTaKfxQa6.jpg)

That was it, Arachlet got mad at its healer because he called it cute. Arachlet wanted some kind of revenge for that. Arachlet got its paws dirty with...

![spider_process_0005_Layer 6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anima-shot/23yJEgvBLqF7Lh5CfuHqwhuxnDBaQVXJ7hpNvKyNsg387NxYq8QoKQJzEzfkf3NZCz2Bb.jpg)

... IT'S KETCHUP, IT'S JUST KETCHUP, DON'T FREAK OUT!! Also, shhhh... the healer is not watching, it's gonna be a creepy surprise for him ;)

![spider_process_0006_Layer 10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anima-shot/23tbkSKVEFgst3xQgHHhHRLZpdTFnZhHFW7HE4MYcdp98YdUE1TowfTiSJjLc9gfbw1do.jpg)

Using metaballs I made ketchup drops in the blanket under the paws and making a path behind the cu... ahem, spooky spider.

![spider_process_0007_Layer 8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anima-shot/23uQpVXRBZHtoQpJset5pGGeTkCRSS9MHq9NVLWz7zcb2m2oGNy8hPfxJ6ahEPEjUb5na.jpg)

I wanted to make Arachlet forget to hide the evidence, so I quickly made a basic ketchup bottle...

![spider_process_0008_Layer 9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anima-shot/23tbkbSC8wk7hhfUNucDQujfUUSL6gM2fUVcB26VQWPFqMSEnhtktnBMP2xXTxCZavk7x.jpg)

... and squashed it.

![spider_process_0009_Layer 11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anima-shot/23xAdqTejFbW3d8RtE11LZErm9ERCkBc8t4hkk3cfbK5Kt265vRZDLNba1sSXArTSuxN7.jpg)

Added some drops behind the tip and under it too. Now this was the perfect crime scene.

Settled the camera.

![spider_process_0010_anima-shot.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anima-shot/23uQvj1oAR7TKpzjTjLtT3RV4VyasPwg53ZXfVRSWa4Vk5tTtFdB2sLYCzVVrGt9E5ov7.jpg)

Added and HDR texture for nature ambience and proper reflections and lighting.

![spider_process_0012_Layer 14.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anima-shot/23wgKyueBY2Qb66LC5VbsxLvvb4MyQ38jozG3d5pte9dHgkorfEQJJ2fZVN9Xb8az43RM.jpg)

Everything was ready. The healer suddenly turned around to check on Arachlet. Little do you know his reaction.

# ***Final Result - JUMPSCARE!!!***
![dont scare me like that animashot ok.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anima-shot/23wr3gebf96yijNCyRfm1HRdY3E1w21x6xyZxASabi9FdF6jHvegDm3xDasQZZNuGaCXv.png)

All this took like... 5-6 continued hours??
I really didn't notice the time passing by, I just now the sun was up there in the sky when I sat down and it was pitch black by the time I was done rendering it. I like a lot to get drawn in by what I'm passionate of, it's my comfort zone.

Hope you liked this one and got jumpscared too, it'd make Arachlet's day and my day :3 (well, my night)!

---
<center><sub>*All images are renders/screenshots of my progress in the Blender project*</sub></center>

![weekee goodbye.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anima-shot/23tRrDKLVs1KiTbrht6vqYHNaM4DQrtwzreJY3MHkbQo7CND1hxpCZCVKkNQtLts4T9j1.gif)

title.title: El arte de crear: Letra A / The Art of Creation: Letter A
title.body:
>

[Esp]

¡Saludos comunidad!

Estoy dominando los elementos...

Me di cuenta que para hacer esto bien necesito comprar cinta para enmascarar o lo que conozco como \

pues otras cintas tienden a pegarse mucho de la cartulina y puede dañarla, afortunadamente resolví el problema con el marcador negro, pero no es la idea.

Empecé con este proyecto que me relaja y pienso quedarme un buen rato con él, porque me ayuda a controlar mis nervios y ansiedad producto de las continuas idas de servicio eléctrico que han sido por 11 horas, ayer por ejemplo fueron 8 horas y eso repercute negativamente en mi estabilidad en la salud y mi economía, me descompenso demasiado por el calor extremo por mucho que intente algo para no sentir el golpe de calor.

Buscando vías de palear o sobrellevar esta situación empecé con \

es algo que siempre quise hacer. Hoy muestro mi primera letra, por supuesto irá en mejora, ya que no es fácil pintar con estos marcadores de pintura acrílica. La experiencia fue genial, me sentí satisfecha y con una sonrisa. Tiene su potencial. Espero que les guste.

> [Eng] Hello everyone! I’m getting the hang of it... I realised that to do this properly I need to buy masking tape – or what I call ‘tirro’ – as other types of tape tend to stick too strongly to the card and can damage it. Fortunately, I solved the problem with a black marker, but that’s not the ideal solution. I started this project, which helps me relax, and I plan to stick with it for a while, because it helps me control my nerves and anxiety caused by the constant power cuts, which have lasted for 11 hours. Yesterday, for example, it was 8 hours, and that has a negative impact on my health and my finances; I get really unwell from the extreme heat, no matter how hard I try to avoid heatstroke. Looking for ways to cope with or get through this situation, I started with ‘Floral typography on black paper’ – it’s something I’ve always wanted to do. Today I’m showing my first letter; of course, it will improve, as it’s not easy to paint with these acrylic paint markers. The experience was brilliant; I felt satisfied and left with a smile. It has potential. I hope you like it. ---
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-21 at 1.32.19 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EpCAwuyWnb6tiTCPcPKeAdFqdZKWxxxVtjAonbv4sAzisFMEcJuv6qpFNQsizJnC316.jpeg) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23xyV8wiu41GpoEivqXdgrYSvLV5xbw7A3mP6XbdRzxQnDM6Q62nRE1iR7x2Q8JKBH6LF.png)
> [Esp] No tenía tirro, entonces usé cinta transparente, no lo recomiendo, destruye la cartulina al retirarlo. Comencé a dibujar las primeras flores.

> [Eng] I didn’t have any tape, so I used clear adhesive tape – I wouldn’t recommend it, as it damages the card when you remove it. I started drawing the first flowers.
---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23vsQkYt5GWFYoAWNy145YNF6V3Sfs9obi49dsvHfwnMFLhAANVqJA2JzJmyHLFPmZAad.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23uQpZpJRMhswLSjVMQh9khrjSwfxZGqyivSsek8gUWzBQzGWYc5tu8QstBaQgvfCuANF.png)

> [Esp] Trato de no dibujar por dentro de la letra porque no sé si traspasará la pintura. Dibujo las hojas, enredaderas y flores, tratando de cubrir los bordes así realzará la letra. Luego unos puntos de luz lo hacen mas bonito.

> [Eng] I try not to draw inside the letter because I’m not sure if the paint will bleed through. I draw the leaves, vines and flowers, trying to cover the edges so that the letter stands out. Then a few highlights make it look nicer. ---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23w2oL39hDiZQVmJbvHWPGnb41mGuHBFgTzoq5pWUEqYeodMvj24kf3P3UaXUHgFjms6z.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23w2mSFmbNp2hhka9rDcXw3k2VxZ9PZRgBjueAV64Pc1ACcQgfxKjmYNPZP94EU5fLUBC.png)

> [Esp] En mi próximo diseño espero corregir las fallas e incomodidades, mi primera experiencia fue fantástica y aprendí un poco más. Retirar la cinta transparente fue un dilema, por mucho que al pegarla no hice presión, al retirarla levantó parte de la cartulina, se había arruinado mi trabajo. Como dije al principio, pude salvarlo con el marcador negro. Espero les guste

> [Eng] In my next design, I hope to iron out the flaws and make it more comfortable; my first attempt was brilliant and I learnt a bit more. Removing the clear tape was a real headache – even though I hadn’t pressed down too hard when sticking it on, when I peeled it off it lifted part of the card, and my work was ruined. As I said at the start, I managed to salvage it with the black marker. I hope you like it

title.title: Stream of Affection
title.body: https://img.leopedia.io/DQmd2gy8o1X6mmg3woUiW3fJqyHG5Q5y82AvLJLQXsgbtHH/1776829959995973562285295196835.png [source](https://pixabay.com/photos/couple-love-dating-sweethearts-168191/) The streams of affection don't flow by chance, they are the original sources of time, in which the first sounds of civilization and the first breath of humanity are found Their flow sometimes echoing after striking stones, sometimes quietly sinking into the sand, but it never stops until someone pollutes them For me, a pure, prudent life is not merely about following rules it is about keeping the water pure, which has been gifted to me from countless unknown shores. I want whenever I remember them, the same cool, transparent stream should flow within me that lies at the root of these streams of affection The very thing that wants to preserve within me Because wrath does not always fall like a storm, a cataclysm, a thunderbolt it simply diverts the flow of affection in other directions And when that happens, an entire river disappears from the map of history That is why I refrain so that the streams of affection, invisible support, deep affection, and unspoken blessings of my life do not change their course. And when God, in his countless forms, and with his endless streams, stands before me, may I look into his eyes just as a river, recognizes its source, and returns and says “I still flow—pure, pure and untainted.” Thank you so much for reading. Have a great day 😊🙏 @vikbuddy Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@vikbuddy/stream-of-affection--dhr)

title.title: 🌿 Wandering through hidden streets
title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmeMGyWKxa7DKAaZ4LTcrgWjaMUZSrzLKQByC4hYpzTXjm/IMG_0055.png 

There’s something about getting lost in a place that wasn’t planned…  No maps, no rush, just walking and letting the streets tell their story.Today felt like that.I found this quiet little alley, warm colors on the walls, plants growing like they belong there forever, and that soft sunlight that makes everything feel slower… softer. I didn’t even realize how much I needed that pause until I was already in it.Travel isn’t always about the big landmarks or the perfect itinerary. Sometimes it’s just about these small, unexpected moments that stay with you longer than anything else.I think that’s why I keep chasing new places…  because I never know what little corner of the world is about to feel like home, even if it’s just for a few minutes.

title.title: You’re not going to believe it! 😄
title.body: I jumped up to second place on that Strava segment near home — yep, second with 35 seconds.

>
</center>

You may not understand the joy this achievement gives me because you haven’t followed my posts. 

So here’s a summary for you.

<a href=\

>Who is Hunyaris, and a note on speed and peace That day I said: Tomorrow first thing I’m going to try to catch the QOM on that segment. 😋 Hands up, elderly ladies on bikes — we’ve got to put up a fight while we still can. Back in those last days of December, with my 52‑second time, I was determined to beat the Queen of the Mountain… until I saw she had done it in 33 seconds. You really have to be on a bike, climbing a 4‑metre rise at full speed, to realise how quickly your pace drops if you’re not in good shape — and if you don’t use the gears wisely.
Wait… analysing the data again, with all my grey hairs back in place. 😁 Whaaaaat? 😱 Hunyaris climbed that hill at 33 km/h! Oh Universe, isn’t that a bit too fast? 🤣
There are other forces at play as well — the wind and the traffic… it is far from simple. 😑 Of course, the next day I almost drowned from the effort, haha… and I didn’t make it. On 13 March I climbed to fourth place. 😅

>(Sunday ChitChat) I smashed the challenge! My final words in that post were as follows:
In life, you only need a clear idea and the courage to go for it. Nothing is impossible. So I might set myself another little challenge on this segment… 😅 What will it be?

>this link you can see how I did, compared with the current QOM, and you can even play it back to watch both of us moving on that climb. So yeah, the plan was to get better. And hey, maybe someday I’ll be the QOM. We’ll see! 😁 https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/23swsB5Ru5B7QMYCEvVjM1egJDhfEQMKeULT5DaX68BtYLbgdHwdp7u4429NnB85P1Sw6.png What I did today was make a delivery in that neighbourhood called Lawton. I like having these opportunities from time to time because, besides earning a bit of money, I get to discover new places. The seller called me mid‑morning, but it wasn’t until the afternoon that the client asked her to send the product — a white dress. I didn’t waste time heading out, wanting to be back before dark. The route is really fun, with its ups and downs. I recorded one on my phone to show you. When you’re climbing, you only see the road and the sky, not what lies behind — that only reveals itself at the crest of the hill.

>YouTube Here I was recording with my right hand and with my left on the handlebars, climbing this hill — so under other conditions I would have gone up better. I only wanted to show it here, as well as how much fun I have in the street, chatting with myself and with the street. They’re not pretty photos, because it was already late, the sky looked rather odd and cloudy, and at times I even felt a fine drizzle falling on me.

> Something that catches my attention in that area is that from the hills you can see the domes of several churches. So I stopped to photograph one of them, and another church that happened to be right in front of me… yes, because you should know that I don’t usually come to these places, and whenever I have to make a delivery I rely on Google Maps and on the people I ask in the street. It’s also great fun because I almost always joke around and manage to get a smile out of them.

> Porvenir Street. In English, Porvenir just means the future.
Indeed, the future seems promising if I continue surpassing my own challenges. Wouldn’t you agree?
> And when I got home, I grabbed the pot where I’d left some cold spaghetti, a beer from the fridge, and went with my dog to watch the last hours of the day fade away.

> Cyclists are always hungry. https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/23swsB5Rj2bY9wtqkTLsNfFvjcM8c7BrVDwNkLsEPDoyojWtKu5szHdVicNWYMXNsUaN8.png
Today’s ride analysed by my personal trainer — Copilot — 🤣
📊 Straight read of your stats
• Distance: 15.40 km • Moving time: 1:06:55 • Elevation: 115 m • Avg power: 52 W • Energy: 208 kJ • Speed: 13.8 km/h avg · 38.9 km/h max • Heart rate: 111 bpm avg · 155 bpm max • Calories: 314 • Total time: 1:38:04
❤️‍🔥 Effort breakdown
Heart rate: super chill An average of 111 bpm means an easy ride — classic Zone 1–2 stuff. That’s recovery and basic endurance territory, where you can chat away and your body just rolls with it. The 155 bpm spike shows a quick hit of intensity — probably a hill or a cheeky acceleration. Speed: steady cruise with a pop 13.8 km/h average = relaxed ride, maybe traffic, stops, mixed terrain. 38.9 km/h max = you definitely had a moment of “let’s gooo”. Power and energy 52 W average is low — perfect for a soft spin. 208 kJ lines up with the 314 kcal, so yep, light effort. Duration and vibe Over an hour moving and a total of about 1 hour and 38 minutes suggests a laid-back outing, no rush at all — just moving your body, keeping that aerobic base in check, and having a good time.
🧭 What kind of training was this?
Based on your numbers and usual heart rate zones: • Main zone: Zone 1–2 (recovery + endurance) • Benefits: • Builds up your aerobic base • Active recovery • Boosts cardiovascular efficiency • No extra stress Basically, it’s your classic endurance ride: comfy pace, steady breathing, and easy effort all the way.
