title.title: Cultivo hidropónico en casa (final inesperado)
title.body:
![1000524913.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23wX113PRwLfRd96sxHftECmKBxGt2aUdJc1FtKibNgViE2w7xJ1wEUyrPPfiFYfygCfe.jpg)
Siempre me han llamado la atención los cultivos hidropónicos y, al buscar información en línea y ver que de forma fácil se podían replicar en casa, me motivé a llevar a cabo este proyecto. Para hacer la base del cultivo hidropónico, solo necesitas una botella de agua de 500 mililitros, un cúter o un cuchillo. Esta es una forma de darles vida útil a estos envases de plástico que tienes en casa. >I’ve always been fascinated by hydroponics, and when I did some research online and saw how easy it was to set up a system at home, I decided to take on this project. >To build the base of your hydroponic setup, all you need is a 500-milliliter water bottle and a utility knife or a regular knife. This is a great way to give new life to those plastic bottles you have lying around the house. ![1000524895.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23uQvSdRcLJ5gqc6HcXR26BqwTgHhu6dQ8dJL8ME4usRYcKtk83ZBCkBtK5PKGeTkDs3k.jpg) Ahora solo queda cortar la botella; yo lo hice por encima de las líneas de la botella. Así tendrás dos partes, siendo una de ellas la base donde colocarás el agua y la siguiente que ahora tiene forma de embudo; la colocarás dentro de la base. >Now all that's left is to cut the bottle; I cut along the lines on the bottle. This will give you two pieces: one is the base where you'll pour the water, and the other, which is now funnel-shaped, goes inside the base. ![1000524864.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23x1HYX6yd7A6a3URhioG4whQG4pjZamGfLFJLHhBAPa3VektSqtKhSBeePkuUrXmPqD9.jpg) En primera instancia, decidí hacer un cultivo de cebollín, ya que sabía que podía funcionar de maravilla y crecer, pues usualmente lo siembro después de usarlo y de tener el remanente que conserva las raíces. También me animé a tratar con un cultivo de cilantro, el cual jamás he podido reproducir en casa, pues aunque traiga sus raíces completas, al plantarlo en tierra, muere en pocos días. >First, I decided to try growing chives, since I knew they’d work great and grow well—I usually plant them after using them, using the leftover pieces that still have their roots. >I also decided to try growing cilantro, which I’ve never been able to grow at home; even if I plant it with its roots intact, it dies within a few days. ![1000524897.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23vhwKTf6ZZb4URf9FEe1BWqsBaGLzcJceCKtRhQChfAZxSfjqQLZu1223NfPoaXJGGMn.jpg) ![1000524900.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23tbrid9UUbUHzMTuGRMwixmGPyRZUQWMCs6Jgd3HKY3w6EPAZppc5qhN34ypcXrzsfSu.jpg) Ambos los coloqué en la boca de la botella, y añadí un poco de agua a la base de modo tal que las raíces se alimentaran de ella. Cuando veía el agua evaporarse colocaba un poco más y así las plantitas fueron retomando. Estas plantas las mantuve dentro de casa sin recibir luz natural directa y aun así se mantuvieron vivas alrededor de un mes, viento en popa. La planta de cebollín puedes ver que tuvo un gran crecimiento y con la de cilantro fue un gran avance que se mantuviera a flote, pues las veces que la coloqué en tierra moría al día siguiente. >I placed both of them in the mouth of the bottle and added a little water to the bottom so the roots could draw from it. >Whenever I saw the water evaporating, I added a little more, and that’s how the plants began to recover. I kept these plants indoors without direct natural light, and even so, they stayed alive for about a month, thriving. >You can see that the chive plant grew a lot, and it was a huge improvement that the cilantro managed to stay alive, since every time I planted it in soil, it died the next day. ![1000524909.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23vsUqjxZzRa4pCWHLAH8GfWRMJUZkYrSRwqzhCEm1hrAiVWBNEvppSyKkQM76iE2zgXJ.jpg) ![1000524912.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23vsNfyhoVdkaRzPo89viUsNpnKf6mQSxXZPDJ2sAHPa8f9JA7qZVLX4o2G1rnLzz5HuV.jpg) ***Y el final inesperado...*** Un triste día las encontré así; lamentablemente, los bachacos hicieron de las suyas, entraron a la casa y, como ladrones furtivos, acabaron con las plantitas que seguían creciendo. > ***And the unexpected ending...*** >One sad day, I found them like this; unfortunately, the bachacos had been up to their old tricks—they snuck into the house and, like stealthy thieves, destroyed the little plants that were still growing. ![1000524914.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23w2nsbqh83zdkAAWL6p5kQpK5xgX3oTLirg9WETZsJ1jiHXgrX8X3iD2fvKSpUGLD4AF.jpg) ¿Funciona este método? Sí, sin embargo, con las plantas son tantos los factores a tomar en cuenta que hay que tener mucha paciencia para lograr cultivos exitosos. ***¡Buena suerte con tus plantitas!*** > Does this method work? Yes, but when it comes to plants, there are so many factors to consider that you need a lot of patience to grow them successfully. > ***Good luck with your little plants!***

*Gracias por pasar por aquí, por detenerte a leer o a escuchar, por comentar, por votar-*

title.title: Pumpkin, Oat, and Mixed Seed Arepas [Esp-Eng]
title.body:
<center> 

### ❣️_Hola amigos de hive!_❣️ 

>### ❣️_Hello friends of hive!_❣️ 
</center>
<hr>
<div class=\

>
Hoy voy a compartir una receta de arepas de auyama, avena y mix de semillas: una opción saludable y fácil de preparar que aporta a las arepas una textura nutritiva, suave y crujiente. Son perfectas para el desayuno o la cena, ya que están repletas de fibra, proteínas, vitaminas y minerales. Tienen un sabor increíble y son un complemento ideal para tu dieta. Sigue las instrucciones paso a paso que te indico a continuación.

> >Today I’m sharing a recipe for pumpkin, oat, and mixed-seed arepas—a healthy, easy-to-make option that gives the arepas a nutritious, soft, and crunchy texture. They’re perfect for breakfast or dinner, as they’re packed with fiber, protein, vitamins, and minerals. They taste amazing and are a great addition to your diet. Follow the step-by-step instructions below.
![Añadir un subtítulo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/23zS9kYqk63ZZepcij5oCUhU95HbU2kLFP5KKuaJ2xfxgmruJYoFKgMWURy2KudVJ3iyH.jpg)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/48a5mJrfDHAmwWoz38hgptfiWQnXDZdBjC7FvrycEqcnHCJdmNi4EnNSReLZSLbmQr.png)

> ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/Ep1ZsyCaztwcLRTohaBgLozPjk3jbahLhqufUX4Z8bn9hiigUKv7nEFoCywuUfHGPLg.png) 150 gr de auyama, 1/2 taza de avena, 1/3 de harina de maíz, 1/4 taza de mix de semillas nutritivas (linaza, chía, ajonjolí y semillas de calabazas), sal al gusto. >150 g of pumpkin, 1/2 cup of oats, 1/3 cup of cornmeal, 1/4 cup of a mix of nutritious seeds (flaxseed, chia, sesame, and pumpkin seeds), salt to taste.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/48YA3dVucGUQ3j5STqMX3enFGLhvzgymiszf9aqeZzxzyW8oooVgCVPH9wwS7LPMkv.png)

>
Para preparar estas nutritivas arepas, lo primero que hay que hacer es lavar, pelar y cortar auyama n trozos; cocerla al vapor hasta que esté tierna; machacarla con un tenedor hasta hacer un puré y dejarla enfriar.

> >To make these nutritious arepas, the first step is to wash, peel, and chop the pumpkin; steam it until tender; mash it with a fork, and let it cool.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoH1qoTqXuKxt1djqR96iPg2HXF8cWwwHxrSffM26vwt9CxP2aYshrhTxomegLRX4Zy.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/Eoc8Tsm8sVVisqGoKfj2ziSUE7bhSRGPULYhwRJsh7JUpnbosg7MSQUXfZJ2PNw8R6R.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoGww5wgX4v3BcfsN4DYThW9LugHxkPbqsFMqcj9o1RrtaJVbxxZfbBZvxq7FKaZgz4.png) -|-|- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoGzuYi7TwcjRRsEQvnCRNULpqe9AqyAEtfqVRXagKwK6pM6BGWsgK7CUKYdkuZmfqC.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EocBKU7bdJ5hoZdE5hYkspSUSgxcYiobkUyjJnk4q2QRnpDCNQn7zDyJyxd5fkH7BeU.png) -|-

>
Cuando el puré de auyama esté listo, ponlo en un bol, añade la sal, la avena, la harina de maíz y el mix de semillas, y amasa con las manos hasta obtener una masa homogénea. Si queda demasiado blanda, añade más avena; si queda demasiado dura, añade agua. Déjala reposar durante media hora.

> >Once the pumpkin puree is ready, place it in a bowl, add the salt, oats, cornmeal, and seed mix, and knead with your hands until you have a smooth dough. If it’s too soft, add more oats; if it’s too hard, add water. Let it rest for half an hour.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EogPFAZcBg55DNRDrMwRe19bmmBya7qBmDvhjgJwSgW9xCHv77BvDWQmcDZd3bj4ppV.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/Eoc8Uyk3vQ8iq9bTrdS6SEnAcxfNASGjLtEQZ7a7WLSJvgSNW1NnuEPQrdV9dKHZdyy.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EpVB4CiMr6gASWYNWmsxzD4EXp7maEp6Yg9oDgnCeuTcrB8Bk2K2FA59fUbhMhtxpSj.png) -|-|- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/Eos3eqQzAUKRKwhnwXK33i5pKt4tDm2mqTV32pmaGXAdgQ6u8ZGFUSzjdNrSWov9rie.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoK8C4s6ocuUSH7p28kiCFByFhZLGKUGUUNU4AKjmEd1FrHD2foLmns7yM5pYrUTazv.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EpJY4EsAa4S17p5X9oy4KSnHucUs47YbcecFCUbsLqxfNjseFXsXVFx7EdycX68HPTh.png)

>
Forma bolas con la masa y, a continuación, dale forma de arepas con un movimiento circular, presionando hasta que queden planas. El grosor y el tamaño los decides tú. Con esta receta salen 4 bolas.

> >Form the dough into balls, then shape them into arepas using a circular motion, pressing down until they are flat. The thickness and size are up to you. This recipe makes 4 balls.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EowH3eLZxUF6o1aF7xPzqeDphB6UganXBaG6XiJERrrxRQg4MY2JtzcDfSmtvqf6cRb.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/Eonmx8XUC9hZ33GbM2CQGeQmWXfFGe2i3vno2xoQW2hXHd5dRmbVv54958PX3ZBP1xr.png) -|-

title.body:

![dg1WdM7GBGPTOMNo_IMG_20260417_122845.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/trina77/images/dg1WdM7GBGPTOMNo_IMG_20260417_122845/dg1WdM7GBGPTOMNo_IMG_20260417_122845.webp)
![x8NihjqWlnaJxIWp_wx_camera_1776556550616.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/trina77/images/x8NihjqWlnaJxIWp_wx_camera_1776556550616/x8NihjqWlnaJxIWp_wx_camera_1776556550616.webp)
![jUJmI0gUB9qVIc80_IMG_20260419_084504.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/trina77/images/jUJmI0gUB9qVIc80_IMG_20260419_084504/jUJmI0gUB9qVIc80_IMG_20260419_084504.webp)
![HHYuBACPIHPJTWYx_IMG_20260420_182834.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/trina77/images/HHYuBACPIHPJTWYx_IMG_20260420_182834/HHYuBACPIHPJTWYx_IMG_20260420_182834.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

自从上周四弄丢耳机后，我一直心神不宁，嘴上说着不在意内心还是有些遗憾，毕竟丢了两只。昨天食堂用餐后我去小卖部买点孩子们爱吃的零食，付款之余顺势问了收银的阿姨：“阿姨，请问你们打扫卫生有没有捡到一个耳机啊？”阿姨应声答道：“有啊！是银色的吧！放了几天了没人拿。”

我一听别提多兴奋，阿姨指着餐盘回收处让我自己去玻璃柜拿就好。我三步并做两步跑过去，看着调料品展示柜，里面除了米和酱油及其他调味品之外还有一张饭卡却不见我的耳机。我还翻动着是不是小小的耳机跑角落去了，还是没见着。

我又再次跑回小卖部，阿姨提醒我：“你怎么到调味品那里去找啊！那里怎么可能有你的耳机呢？在旁边那个柜子啊！失物招领柜。”我老远望去，原来两头分别放了一个柜子，由于我常往另一边取纸巾，竟没注意到还有一个柜子。赫然看着我的耳机就躺在那，这种失而复得的感觉令我一整天都心情舒畅。

下班后，接上大宝我们去超市购买了一些蔬菜还有孩子们爱吃的鸡翅和土豆。打算给孩子们做红烧鸡翅和薯条。家里有玉米淀粉，再买一瓶番茄酱就可以了。

到家后迫不及待的先给土豆削皮、切成条状、再洗掉表面的淀粉，用开水烫过之后再过凉水，用纸巾吸干水分，再撒上玉米淀粉抓拌均匀，放进冰冻——这样炸出来的土豆更酥脆。

趁这功夫我开始准备其他的菜，鸡翅焯水后，待葱姜蒜配料下油锅煎至两面金黄再沸水煮，很快就做好了。

土豆冷冻一个多小时后，往锅里倒上些许油，待油温烧至七成热，就可以下油锅炸了。刚开始油温不够高，炸出来的颜色是淡黄色，而且还不成型，无法像视频上看的那种金黄酥脆的模样，尝了一口软趴趴的，大宝这时候提醒：“妈妈你要复炸一遍，而且是不是火太小了？”

我恍然大悟赶紧开到中大火，很快薯条就变成金黄色，一个个漂浮在油面上，我这才知道火候真是关键。

看这样子与肯德基的无二了吧！浅尝一口味道还真是不错，外酥里嫩很成功。

title.title: Pea Soup (Eng/Esp)
title.body:
> Pea soup is always a great choice for lunch. This time, I decided to serve it with chicken, potatoes, and carrots—a simple combination that just needs a few seasonings to bring out the broth’s rich flavor. I like my soup thick, so I let the peas break down to fully enjoy this delicious dish, which is best when shared with the family.
![1000110765.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23w2j6HAjXeqUaxiTJxanFNeT8gCnRmtHtkANmqkAQi6UhssLRMNdgFjVZbggcc9oNZBE.png)
## Ingredients: - 400 grams of peas - 4 pieces of chicken - 2 potatoes - 1 large carrot - 1 onion - 2 bell peppers - 7 sweet peppers - Salt to taste - 3 liters of water
![1000110770.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wMgpZf2kBKUFBcG6SpqWCCjqV86bjdvF3yZpMvT8KH6UzPR6kQJfP8mvmji6cNVKLes.jpg)
## Preparation: I soaked the peas overnight. When I took them out of the fridge, I noticed they had doubled in size and their texture had changed—they had become softer. I then changed the water to remove any impurities.
![1000110750.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xemsr6ZUfrzUtyeSxD68A1iJCqyN7XrY87CWYSSX7u4aE5uA7p7vv17PsaK7QqP5AV6.jpg)
I poured three liters of water into a pot, added the peas and a tablespoon of salt, and brought them to a boil. I placed the chili peppers, bell peppers, and onion in a bowl, cleaned them, removed the seeds, and diced them. I did the same with the onion after peeling it. I washed the chicken pieces and let them drain, then set them aside.
![1000110754.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23uFYMcJ5jrZkszg62BkKDHGDdC9oK6W5uATkF1D9hEV9uLD4mMzWCpCYpGscqkiDzvXW.jpg)
![1000110757.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23vi2AXZ3j2CX7PLCAmYaXATBxiaLkSkTbVn5aX3LTWZgKWofuFZ5MU3ateyDMU9gr3dW.jpg)
Next, I peeled the potatoes and carrots and cut them into medium-sized pieces. After thirty minutes, I used a fork to check if the grains were tender, then added the chicken and another tablespoon of salt. I waited a few minutes before adding the potato and carrot pieces. When everything was ready, I added the seasonings, which gave it an incredible flavor and aroma. Five more minutes, and I sat down to enjoy my lunch. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> Una sopa de arvejas siempre será una buena opción para almorzar, esta vez quise acompañarla con pollo, papas y zanahorias, una combinación sencilla que solo necesita algunos aliños para lograr el buen sabor del caldo. Me gusta la sopa espesa, por eso dejo que se rompan los granos y así disfrutar esta delicia, la cual es mejor cuando se comparte en familia.
![1000110765.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23w2j6HAjXeqUaxiTJxanFNeT8gCnRmtHtkANmqkAQi6UhssLRMNdgFjVZbggcc9oNZBE.png)
## Ingredientes: - 400 gramos de arvejas - 4 piezas de pollo - 2 papas - 1 zanahoria grande - 1 cebolla - 2 pimentones - 7 ajíes dulces - Sal al gusto - 3 litros de agua
![1000110770.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wMgpZf2kBKUFBcG6SpqWCCjqV86bjdvF3yZpMvT8KH6UzPR6kQJfP8mvmji6cNVKLes.jpg)
## Preparación: Coloqué las arvejas a remojar desde la noche anterior, cuando las saqué de la nevera me percaté que habían duplicado el tamaño y que la consistencia había cambiado, se volvieron más blandas.
![1000110750.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xemsr6ZUfrzUtyeSxD68A1iJCqyN7XrY87CWYSSX7u4aE5uA7p7vv17PsaK7QqP5AV6.jpg)
Posteriormente les cambié el agua para retirar las impurezas. En una olla coloqué tres litros de agua, agregué las arvejas, una cucharada de sal y las puse a sancochar. En un envase coloqué los ajíes, pimentones y cebolla, los limpié, retiré las semillas y piqué en cuadritos. Hice lo propio con la cebolla, después de desconcharla. Lavé las piezas de pollo y las puse a escurrir, reservé.
![1000110754.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23uFYMcJ5jrZkszg62BkKDHGDdC9oK6W5uATkF1D9hEV9uLD4mMzWCpCYpGscqkiDzvXW.jpg)
![1000110757.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23vi2AXZ3j2CX7PLCAmYaXATBxiaLkSkTbVn5aX3LTWZgKWofuFZ5MU3ateyDMU9gr3dW.jpg)
Ahora vendría el paso de retirar las conchas de las papas y zanahorias, corté en pedazos medianos. Hi friends, today we're going to draw **Yuta Okkotsu**. This character isn't my favorite, but I'm practicing so I can draw him properly later because he's a very important character in the story. Yuta is a teenager who is haunted by **Rika Orimoto**, his deceased childhood friend who is now possessed because they promised to get married when they grew up.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/23tveahmdgKuH3xiJjyEn1DkvUiWA9z6tojXZyZ4io2FM5U4fEXen5cb3sJB48CJoX9MW.png)

He witnessed his friend Rika Orimoto being hit by a car, and as she lay dying, she gave him a ring. This ring would later grant him immense energy, allowing him to gain the abilities and powers to fight his enemies. With this ring, he can copy She possesses the abilities of others and can also summon her deceased friend, Rika Orimoto, known as the Queen of Evil.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/23tHEBRaGMXiTFpmHNLEsJbjDMC4mDNusmAZ8DrLvVujeeNjMxsT3EpUPVzxCMDKiwAkZ.png)

For **Yuta Okkotsu** to obtain powers and abilities, he must give a part of the enemy's body to *Rika Orimoto*. Depending on the size of the body part, **Rika Orimoto** will grant **Yuta Okkotsu** a great deal of power.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/23tbwVM7MBDXSHvE8Nqt8JDBVkzHdbXV4mMATbDdQzZiRUrERbQkirAYY1pX7DCPvBiA6.png)

Remember that I'm practicing my drawing to improve it in a future video. I hope you enjoy the video, and I'll see you soon. Thank you.

body.title: Going to the Shrine with My Favorite People... <3
body.body: My mom has six siblings. *(They're seven in total, including her.)* They don't have the best relationship, but she's especially close to her younger siblings. She has 3 younger siblings with whom she has a really good relationship, though unfortunately, my uncle passed away several years ago. Now, it's just her and her two younger siblings. *(They still have two older sisters, but they don't get along well that much. haha XD)* These two younger sisters are the mothers of my favorite younger cousins, Nicole and Godwyn. We tend to celebrate special events together, regardless of distance. Since we moved to the countryside, we usually get the chance to meet up with Nicole and her mom. However, Godwyn and his mom are now even further away. Nicole and I surprised him during his moving up ceremony last month, though. Then last week, it was my father's birthday. They couldn't come on the day, but they visited us for the first time here in the countryside the day after! And since all sisters are present, we decided to go to the shrine together. My father was left at home and at the store. *haha*
> > Here's my mom and her two younger siblings. :)

> > Me with my younger cousins, Godwyn and Nicole. I'm an only child, and so are they. So somehow, we treat each other as siblings. It's interesting how our age gap doesn't really matter. I'm in my mid-30s, Nicole's in her 20s, and Godwyn is turning 16 in July. Despite that, we share the same interests, and we are on the same wavelength.

> Having them in my life is such a bliss. No matter the trials and challenges we face in life, we are aware that we're not alone because we have each other's backs. When my family and I lost our house due to the flood last year, my aunts and my cousins immediately visited us in our temporary place, bought us some groceries and clothes, and helped us in any way they could.

>
</center>

I am indeed blessed to have these people in my life. We're together through thick and thin, and of course, with God and our faith in the center of it all. 

I look forward to spending time with them again soon. That's it for this post. Thanks for checking, and I'll see you around! (^^,)/

** Bendiciones abundantes y eternas para todos los miembros de esta fabulosa comunidad #hivediy. Encantado en saludarles y desearles feliz y Bendito martes. > **
ENGLISH
** Abundant and everlasting blessings to all the members of this fabulous #hivediy community. It’s a pleasure to greet you and wish you a happy and blessed Tuesday. Today I’m sharing a beautiful macramé bracelet made with rattail cord and a stunning design for men. It’s worth mentioning that this bracelet is very easy to make, and in just a few minutes it’s ready to wear. Without further ado, I invite you to join me in this fascinating project and get your hands on the cord. ![1000392448.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Eops1vvbrbHKSnfNk3PvLZttAsPdUGa7KBw1M1ywfWUuZUuzmRZCeQ4i74nbdC8TA4M.jpg) ![separador virgilio 1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48fPJW5oSR5NrT5insR3hayLh9ET1ifvCG8zGp4Rfk8EhMtUrcwakXhr5g3cRk6Y8x.gif)
> Los materiales que utilicé para realizar esta hermosa pulsera son los siguientes, a saber: Hilo Tijera Encendedor Cinta métrica

> The materials I used to make this beautiful bracelet are as follows: Thread Scissors Lighter Tape measure ![1000392391.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23vsQDDC8PAofrRJ4YMW39w4JX8paLz6aDe6hnyerUbXjsyzGAfSurKAtAgGJfzzstKb4.jpg)
> Para comenzar esta hermosa joya iniciamos cortando dos hebras de hilo de 40cm el cuál utilizaremos como base para nuestra pulsera.
> To begin making this beautiful piece of jewelry, start by cutting two 40-centimeter lengths of thread, which we’ll use as the base for our bracelet.
> Luego corté una hebra de hilo chino de 80cm que utilizaremos para realizar el tejido plano.

> Then I cut a 80cm strand of Chinese thread that we will use to make the flat weave. ![1000392395.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EoyQ2PQgDvDNBy5fA7LzR9svwoHzwAUDguwEHnxxgdbRtj9wECFU72qcUQjgkPsDyng.jpg) ![separador virgilio.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48KdAZ2oktyDRja9ez5m3v1qBY6PZfFU8sSGEE17ey9FUfktwmCJiLv2c2YiZggq73.png)
> Después llevamos el hilo base a una tabla a una distancia de 10cm de la punta superior hacia abajo. A partir de esa medida comenzamos a realizar el nudo plano.

> Then we take the base thread to a board at a distance of 10cm from the top end down. From that measurement we start to make the flat knot ![1000392423.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpGRcCsT57scs2cD2Vxjwf61VFC5UNgu5gg7LcfmDhfaBNzQaCpTj4VT21WP2MWgsxK.jpg)

> Para comenzar esta pulsera vamos a realizar un nudo plano, comenzamos de la siguiente manera: Primero tomamos el hilo del lado izquierdo y lo pasé por encima del hilo base, formamos una especie de cuatro, luego pasamos el hilo del lado derecho por encima del hilo izquierdo que tenemos en el lado derecho, después lo pasamos por debajo del hilo base y lo sacamos por el interior o argolla del hilo izquierdo como nos lo señala la imagen . Seguidamente con los dedos presionamos para que quede igual de ambos lados. Así comenzamos nuestro tejido

> To start this bracelet we are going to make a flat knot, we start as follows: First we take the thread on the left side and pass it over the base thread, we form a kind of four, then we pass the thread on the right side over the left thread that we have on the right side, then we pass it under the base thread and take it out through the inside or ring of the left thread as shown in the image. Then we press with our fingers so that it is the same on both sides. This is how we start our weaving. ![1000392454.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Eoc7VQqPN5qqt66BkwJx8M6mbRRaksvDc1GqxELSk2FeswxGeHi2fY6X2tfGyTc6Ymf.jpg)

Seguidamente con los dedos presioné para que de ambos lados tengan similitud.

> Now I took the thread on the left side and passed it over the base thread, I formed a kind of four, then I passed the thread on the right side over the left thread that we have on the right side, then I passed it under the base thread and took it out through the inside or ring of the left thread as shown in the image. Then I pressed with my fingers so that both sides have similarity ![1000392455.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EoeEpvGVENmqMYknDEVygxoa9tHVXKRNVNMmF5vmcPKvC5LSFKRLE1yyMNnPhf2AgVg.jpg)
> Seguí realizando el mismo procedimiento.

这部剧我刷到过好多次没打开看，今天也是机缘巧合之下吧，打开后看发现女主还是个意料之外的人。我看过姚慧演了好多恶毒女配，颜值和演技双在线的演员。

从剧情的角度来说，女主是那种重生归来开智了的。她重生后第一件事就是阻止母亲写下和离书，因为她知道三天后父亲战死沙场被皇帝封为镇国公的圣旨会到府里。

她从筛选下人中心与否开始，到同找上门来的外室及其女儿斗智斗勇。本来以为赶走了她们就完事了，没想到后续还有宗亲以及外室的亲戚乃至背后势力，环环相扣.jpg

女主是妥妥的重心，男主则是关键时刻支撑一把让女主的计谋更顺利完成的存在。我觉得大户人家的嫡女就该是女主这样子的，能够沉着应付后宅各种发生的人和事情。

从演员的角度来说，女主的脸是非常有辨识度的。可能因为她之前演的大部分是女配，而短国的女配绝大多数都是恶毒的吧，我真没见她演过什么好人…这部剧她演得很好

总的来说，如果你也喜欢看宅斗的，很推荐看！

body.title: 武汉版高启强
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![oYFyXNjSvgrcCJXX_IMG_20260422_111935.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/yellowbird/images/oYFyXNjSvgrcCJXX_IMG_20260422_111935/oYFyXNjSvgrcCJXX_IMG_20260422_111935.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

今天刷到一个新闻，就是武汉版的高启强——黄大发，近日宣判了~~~他的传说落幕了！

我之前并不熟悉这个人，但是我对二环线上的武昌核心地段的那栋和成中心的楼印象很深。每次开车跑汉阳和光谷走二环，一路上最羡慕的风景就是这栋楼了。它临近武汉市的老图书馆，我读大学时还来过这个图书馆，那个时候还没有这栋楼。

感觉似乎是很快时间，这栋楼就立起来了。

我第一次的印象是，大楼上顶一个大大的钻石，这也太丑了了吧，给人一种有钱又很土豪的感觉，就是不够高级。不过后来，看多了，到觉得这栋楼的造型是成功的，让人过目不忘，也许就是那种反差的冲击，那种直白的表达。

为什么说这栋楼，后来了解，**原来这栋楼是武汉的一个黑社会老大建的。也就是我了解武汉版高启强，是从这栋楼开始的。**

主人公名叫“黄大发”他有个弟弟叫“黄有财”，退伍专业，临危受命当上村支书，接收负债三千万，濒临崩盘的村子。赶上城中村改造的风口，发展黑社会实力，强制拆迁，强霸占土地，暴力拆迁....靠着黑恶势力赶上房地产风口，迅速发家。后继续靠着保护伞庇护，盘踞武汉近三十年。

最辉煌的时候应该就是建成了这一栋和成中心了。

后来有人说，楼顶的不是钻石，是一个大大的保护伞。

去搜索黄大发的整个人生经历，会发现《狂飙》这样的电视剧，真是艺术源于生活，而生活现实又远比电视剧更荒诞和真实。

---

Not everyone sees it as a benefit to the office and to the populace as a whole, but it is a benefit.
The license is to protect the people from copyright infringement and to make sure everything is in order.
It is also a source of revenue to the authorities.
But overall, if people are given opportunity to do whatever they like without a license, they will take advantage of it. It can also increase the rate of crime because there is no means of identifying the owner from the copycat.
License gives is all the information we need to know.




You can also participate by clicking [here](https://hive.blog/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/21-april-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3080-licence-to-do-something)

body.title: Pasta con carne molida y salsa blanca [ESP/ENG ]
body.body: # Pasta con carne molida y salsa blanca [ESP/ENG ]\n\n<div class=\

>

Buenas noches a todos los amigos del buen comer y  que me leen en la comunidad de @hivefood, espero que hayan pasado un excelente inicio de semana, les deseo a cada uno de ustedes bendiciones en abundancia. Sean bienvenidos a mi blog.

![12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23w2gXpboAZ1HF9FG7sMzd9D3cgKpeEatqEFLmP1tDHenHdJBZW7fPgbemstGDWTGtqzb.jpg)

Hoy me encuentro nuevamente pasando por esta comunidad  para contarles mi experiencia que he tenido al degustar unas deliciosa pasta larga con carne molida y salsa blanca, la acompañe con rodajas de pan al ajillo y de bebida una deliciosa Coca-Cola para refrescarme del calor que hace en l la playa.

![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xeWz4ipD3Ae8CLQUqfZnx7d48ANPhmXmZVz1f28r7Ybms5v7CC6kN3qvWm67FsowwpP.jpg)

Les cuento que fui a la playa con un grupo de trabajadores de la empresa donde labora mi esposo. De regreso en la cena veníamos muertos del hambre, a pesar de haber comido los platos del mar que venden en el mar, pero era poco, por tal razón al llegar al hotel pedimos que nos prepararan una pasta con carne molida y por un costado le colocaron una salsa blanca que estaba de chuparse los dedos, super rica, al igual que la carne molida que contenía por encima y el pan tostado al ajillo, de verdad que fue un deleite lo que nos degustamos.

![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/242NithKviut8JoSxm1mPJoMe4JZrRgxqkpvvZ1PVMzz4dqzRpX1DwCZEtsaYS2infATW.jpg)

![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23yd1dxvTbk7JjvSig5TgrzJqzYxWfzY5sDvV4MkRLFJQ5DAfTb9Dv5KY9moK4NfG8f2R.jpg)|![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23zkdpVHrP2mySpaoW37CrUb7HpowZKYPvGx4RwaTfcMiqF46Yi3cpswRUC13vpsKuHPu.jpg)
-|-

Yo poco como pasta en la noche pero m los deguste completo, estaba muy rico, la carne con poca sal, la pasta sueltecita como me encanta a mi, de textura super buena, con pocos condimentos, la salsa blanca estaba rica un poco simple y esos panes al ajillo muy crujientes, de verdad que quede satisfecha con este plato y con los que pude degustar en el hotel aventura en la estadía que dure ahí, recomiendo tanto el hotel como el restaurante del hotel por su atención y amabilidad, les doy 10/10. Realmente en este restaurante se degusta comida casera limpia de grasas, me encanto.

![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/243BY44nufqDqy2smVurCas2BG7bwaq84d73GXBswiz6U1krScQV8vAHBogC7KAsaAFKr.jpg)
![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23zknQyoXLBJsx2z56XDXcdn2wwssMWgaKHyEaFtrfZUJ7jku7rGQ93CgPa8Sz8x3BNc3.jpg)

La Coca-Cola estaba bien fría, saben que rico es? comer pasta recién hecha con carne molida y rosearle un poquito de queso parmesano que también tenia y acompañarlo con una gaseosa o refresco bien frio, esto es del otro mundo.

El refresco quedo perfecto para esa ocasión porque veníamos acalorados y con ganas de comer algo sabroso. Una vez que culminamos nuestra cena, ordenamos unas cervezas bien frías para cerrar la noche y el dia.

Hasta aquí mi post, les doy las gracias a quienes puedan llegar hasta el final de mi contenido, les dejo algunas fotografías , nos seguimos leyendo y escribiendo, nos vemos en un próximo post.

* Fotos tomadas con Iphone 8 plus
* Portada diseñada con Canva
* Texto traducido con Deepl

<div class=\
> # English Version # Pasta with Ground Beef and White Sauce

> Good evening to all my food-loving friends and readers in the @hivefood community. I hope you’ve had a great start to the week, and I wish each and every one of you abundant blessings. Welcome to my blog. ![12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23w2gXpboAZ1HF9FG7sMzd9D3cgKpeEatqEFLmP1tDHenHdJBZW7fPgbemstGDWTGtqzb.jpg) Today I’m stopping by this community again to tell you about my experience tasting some delicious long pasta with ground beef and white sauce. I paired it with slices of garlic bread and a delicious Coca-Cola to cool off from the heat at the beach. ![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xeWz4ipD3Ae8CLQUqfZnx7d48ANPhmXmZVz1f28r7Ybms5v7CC6kN3qvWm67FsowwpP.jpg) I’ll tell you that I went to the beach with a group of coworkers from my husband’s company. On the way back, we were starving at dinner, even though we’d already eaten the seafood dishes sold right on the beach, but it wasn’t enough. So when we got back to the hotel, we asked them to make us some pasta with ground beef, and on the side they served a white sauce that was finger-licking good—super delicious, just like the ground beef on top and the garlic toast. It was truly a delight. ![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/242NithKviut8JoSxm1mPJoMe4JZrRgxqkpvvZ1PVMzz4dqzRpX1DwCZEtsaYS2infATW.jpg) ![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23yd1dxvTbk7JjvSig5TgrzJqzYxWfzY5sDvV4MkRLFJQ5DAfTb9Dv5KY9moK4NfG8f2R.jpg) |![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23zkdpVHrP2mySpaoW37CrUb7HpowZKYPvGx4RwaTfcMiqF46Yi3cpswRUC13vpsKuHPu.jpg) -|- I rarely eat pasta at night, but I tried this dish and it was delicious—the meat was lightly salted, the pasta was al dente just the way I like it, with a great texture and minimal seasoning. The white sauce was tasty, though a bit simple, and those garlic bread sticks were very crispy. I was truly satisfied with this dish and with the others I got to try at the Aventura Hotel during my stay there. I highly recommend both the hotel and the hotel restaurant for their service and kindness—I give them a 10/10. You really get to enjoy clean, low-fat home-style food at this restaurant; I loved it. ![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/243BY44nufqDqy2smVurCas2BG7bwaq84d73GXBswiz6U1krScQV8vAHBogC7KAsaAFKr.jpg) ![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23zknQyoXLBJsx2z56XDXcdn2wwssMWgaKHyEaFtrfZUJ7jku7rGQ93CgPa8Sz8x3BNc3.jpg) The Coca-Cola was nice and cold—you know how good it is? Eating freshly made pasta with ground beef, sprinkling a little Parmesan cheese on top (which I also had), and pairing it with a nice cold soda or soft drink—it’s out of this world. The drink was perfect for the occasion because we were hot and craving something tasty. Once we finished dinner, we ordered some ice-cold beers to wrap up the night and the day. That’s all for this post. Thanks to everyone who made it to the end. Here are a few photos. Let’s keep reading and writing—see you in the next post. * Photos taken with iPhone 8 Plus * Cover designed with Canva * Text translated with Deepl Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@morepina/-pasta-con-carne-molida-y-salsa-blanca-espeng--ib)

body.title: My visit to Tío Pedro Beach, Carúpano, Sucre (Eng - Esp)
body.body:
> **
INGLÉS
** Greetings fellow travelers! I hope you have a wonderful and blessed day with your loved ones. Continuing my journey through Carúpano, the capital of the Bermúdez municipality, I'm sharing my visit to Tío Pedro Beach, located approximately 6 km from the area known as El Boquete. Along the way to the beach, you'll see a long hill covered in large, brown rocks, as well as the Carúpano pier. The beach boasts calm, shallow waters, perfect for a fun and relaxing day with the little ones. Its location right on the main avenue makes it easily accessible. If you're in El Boquete or near the market, you can reach the beach in just a few minutes to enjoy its warm and refreshing waters. The waves are gentle, and the beach is surrounded by a beautiful mountain, creating a stunning landscape that contrasts beautifully with the sea and sky. On the day of my visit, there was a refreshing breeze, perfect for relaxing to the sound of the waves. The beach has a concrete walkway and an identification wall where the name Playa Tío Pedro can be read. It appeared to have a landscape and multicolored lettering; it's a concrete rectangle with a support column at the back. The identification sign is located on the walkway. From this point, we have a view of the beach and the concrete and rock wall that borders it and separates it from the main avenue. The hill, as I mentioned, has large brown and gray rocks and a layer of vegetation on top. You can also see the pier, the main road or Rómulo Gallegos Avenue, and the walkway that leads to the beach. The beach is beautiful, and you can see several trees and logs that are used for sitting.

> **
ESPAÑOL
** Saludos amigos viajeros, deseo que tengan un excelente y bendecido día en unión de sus seres queridos, continuando mi recorrido por Carúpano capital del municipio Bermúdez, Les comparto mi visita a la playa Tío Pedro, que se ubica aproximadamente a 6 km del sector conocido como El Boquete, en el trayecto hacia la playa, se ubica un largo cerro con rocas grandes de color marrón, también el muelle de Carúpano, la playa es de aguas tranquilas y poca profundidad, perfecta para un día de diversión y esparcimiento con los más pequeños de la casa, su ubicación en plena avenida facilita el acceso, si te encuentras en el Boquete o por los alrededores del mercado, en pocos minutos ya estarás en esta playa para disfrutar sus cálidas y refrescantes aguas; el oleaje es suave y está rodeada por una hermosa montaña, que crea un increíble paisaje, en contraste con el mar y el cielo, el día de mi visita había bastante brisa muy fresca por cierto y perfecta para relajarse con los sonidos de las olas. La playa cuenta con una caminería de concreto y un muro de identificación donde se lee el nombre Playa Tío Pedro. Al parecer tenía un paisaje y las letras de varios colores, es un rectángulo de concreto y en la parte posterior tiene una columna de soporte, la valla de identificación se ubica en la caminería, desde este punto tenemos una vista de la playa y el muro de concreto y rocas que la bordea y a su vez la separa de la avenida principal, el cerro como ya lo mencioné tiene grandes rocas de color marrón, gris y una capa vegetal en la parte superior, se aprecia también una vista del muelle, la carretera principal o avenida Rómulo Gallegos y la caminería que conduce hasta la playa, la vista playa hermosa y se observan varios árboles y troncos que son utilizados para sentarse. ![Tío pedro playa (21).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EoPMBBJJHJEZ4KnHz4LUyNyf3KFvZE6nG8Khw8wqdwNJCoQbNrUiMoWgVCKBefEW6Ac.jpeg) ![Tío pedro playa (17).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EpC9NVhPQvwciZgma8KquuAEkGDtVWEhHyoonFZTUNdudqrLBc8NqS3GD5VxYVkc1Us.jpeg) ![Tío pedro playa (3).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EqhPk2KwNaxzRJh7mJf1YA3wbwfP2axPbSyD98tAgKv7H53yhT5D2RMbA754gG2T8a3.jpeg) ![Tío pedro playa (19).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/244xuL23tiqhrPURpA5ZQGwDqzkkrWxDGhHp9j5TdJJGUsbmgD7DZdREUBuM38BVBiy8z.jpeg) ![Tío pedro playa (20).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EoyP3H56S6xa1ehdnZiTpzr3HxvcbsCYWPN5bGTJgmR1uCeokXL2umZQpHYp8nphahZ.jpeg)

> On the beach, near the seawall, there's a concrete table. Its cylindrical base is covered in ceramic tiles. It's generally used for recreational activities and board games like dominoes and chess, and also for eating and placing utensils. Continuing along the path, I saw a lovely sculpture that I adored. It's a cute dolphin made of concrete, with eyes as blue as the sea. This friendly marine companion sits on a curious tree trunk with a hole in the center, offering a beautiful view of the landscape. This sculpture definitely adds something special to the beach. The trunk as a base is my favorite part. They really knew how to use these trunks to decorate the beach with a lovely cetacean, welcoming visitors to the refreshing waters of the Carúpano coast, bathed by the Caribbean Sea. In the following photograph, the trunk and the dolphin located in the center can be seen in detail. The shore of the beach has a rock walkway and there are several plants such as mangroves and sea grapes. Very close to the beach is also a well-known restaurant that offers a delicious menu with typical dishes in the city and the specialty is seafood stews prepared with seafood.

> En la orilla de la playa, cerca del muro que la bordea, se encuentra una mesa de concreto, cuya base cilíndrica la parte superior y está cubierta con cerámica, se emplea generalmente para actividades recreativas y juegos de mesa que se realizan en esta área como dominó, ajedrez, entre otros, además se usa para comer y colocar los utensilios. Avanzando en el recorrido, vi una linda escultura que me encantó, se trata de un tierno delfín hecho en concreto, con los ojos de color azul como el mar, este simpático amigo marino, tiene como base un curioso tronco de árbol, con un orificio en el centro, en el cual está cómodamente ubicado y ofrece una hermosa vista del paisaje, definitivamente esta escultura agrega un plus a la playa, el tronco como base es mi parte favorita, si que supieron aprovechar estos troncos para decorar la playa con un lindo cetaceo, que da la bienvenida a las refrescantes aguas de la costa carupanera bañada por el Mar Caribe; en la siguiente fotografía se observa en detalle el tronco y el delfín ubicado en el centro, la orilla de la playa tiene una pasarela de rocas y hay varias plantas como Mangles y Uveros de playa, muy cerca de la playa se ubica también un conocido restaurante que ofrece un delicioso menú con platos típicos en la ciudad y la especialidad los asopados preparados con productos del mar. ![Tío pedro playa (7).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EnaXNiEXuYCc4DHRNSZ3u5i9AZJs4c8Cfhq6RPj5GHKNAG4JLDL8tmaZoWYofwBhPPn.jpeg) ![Tío pedro playa (11).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EpEHNWzMMoAYJT3nXiE7feSZRjchdsgxEYWFviocuDTpc7nYrmG5MMRVJ7qV1QDLvCo.jpeg) ![Tío pedro playa (12).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/243zZaPzHx2i5v1H2aNBciniYsiBTbGLXotcQzLqXMkZYyTWqxhzV2J7Extq81rQNaKjH.jpeg) ![Tío pedro playa (9).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EqBamU7ZzMefgutnXqdTBscDtVCvk8isrCmZfDdQXzjjYomJkz6xfXHRWDM556mZWQ8.jpeg) ![Tío pedro playa (8).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/2423m3h4twpyzs8VtVKkdW6b8Es5S3bXBJdq4SnsKgyGKA9XrK1pRRXNYqBNR4s7rBLZP.jpeg)

> ![Tío pedro playa (13).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EqhNu6atpLHSdSAqjGZWtwKKL3DVoJYf7tLaAM8gXdgKuHcSi6sUPJ4miPLTPmikkkb.jpeg) ![Tío pedro playa (15).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EpXKYfR4LJ6jE25jCS2YPCy2xEVdyMHTwXJTg9WRFVy1kvM5TJV9tvqmo2vjv6hBpAX.jpeg) ![Tío pedro playa (14).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/Epvgw2NMywAVN8o32wo1GCjimCwZwCHT73CEsxgVLuzHMKwuKVUB4VxdQmjHLGxAPYZ.jpeg) ![playa Tío Pedro.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/245wFXLLaPmNePQTK9DBj94fZEiV6LJVBLbbWvRpBktJiYcdDiL7wnd4QNvMtiTxL7n7s.png)

> ![dese.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23xpa97s1nEmxvZDqAMx4ZzmjvkUmxhHxiCA1BRqEKxTZWwMi7qP93b8ZBqN27bMBVLD2.png) ¡Bendiciones! ![298840ed-dc99-44dd-88ae-e5dd98c6a2fd-e077c470-b3b4-41b7-8298-8b73f49e1a25-v1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/AKCBArsVymhAtxSEXuQEXVtGFqs179BAJqxscwbiHjeUjfHW4BXK94BrzTQoN88.png)

I finished mowing, and came back inside. The house was sitting at 70 degrees………. I changed into long blue jeans pants, and a sweatshirt, for my hike! As I walked out the driveway, I noticed a steady plume of wood smoke was coming from our next door neighbors chimney…….. “Liz it must be 90 degrees inside our neighbor’s house, maybe Jim isn’t well!”😮 As I hiked further up our road, Tessa my neighbor from the tiny house, was outside tending to her Goats and Chickens!☺️ She had on a Russian “Ushankas” hat. They are also called “Ear Hats” because they have the flaps that can be pulled down over your ears in bitter cold weather! Hmmm……… is Silvertop missing something Lol!😇 By the time I climbed to the top of the “High Trail”, Silvertop was back to just a t-shirt!😅 Tomorrow morning I will probably be back to a sweatshirt again Lol…….☺️ So goes the Spring dance my friends!😎 Make sure you dress warm/ cool Lol!🤣 Till tomorrow Silvertop Mike 😊

body.title: Coffee And Cake, In A Cozy Cafe
body.body:
Hello guys....

How are you all? I hope you are all well and always happy. Meet me again, nice to meet you all. I'm back with my story about visiting a beautiful cafe with delicious drinks.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfMomz72iq7vpjZNicHpyiLWxHWsQt8tFFRM33BwjoYj5/1776759273467.jpg)

This time, I was at The White Coffee Pastry, located on Jalan Sakti Lubis, Medan, Indonesia. This beautiful cafe not only serves food and drinks but also offers wedding planning services. Behind the cafe is a hall for weddings and other events.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVz6aM1U9eaXqCUmEbdsiubSxWUJL8penKrxXsCCPu6ry/1776827501871.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd4w5DoewXmLLGNnLNhP3fBQJTfG6HYb4mvexYyqe24vW/1776827501920.jpg)

As the name suggests, this cafe is dominated by white, combined with various colors, making it look beautiful and feel comfortable. The cafe has two floors, as well as both outdoor and indoor areas.

When you enter, you will see two sections, namely the first section is the cashier section and to order food or drinks, and the other section is to see and choose the pastries they have.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZAfXnKWaSvVvpgf3sWJoTMcTtbvFNHRSMeWyZvwHmkg3/1776827686084.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSN49EC8Ty1kRW77gtsJUFzVB2Rf5KMngVUjpFQo8ydc1/1776827686130.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdHyMmmBPoa9SXJxQNZFftkH8agp7Zm5X6NSYHqy7z2iV/1776827704031.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSay4u9zipejiJjfBt17DdCVUeSmApct9vW6YPRzyYXLN/1776827704076.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXp3AEpzs8PzcqvwB7US3RQkdaVzVTkDJB9QepJeovS3H/1776827704116.jpg)

The menu options here are quite extensive, including coffee, refreshing drinks, milk bases, and tea. For food, there are salads, bread, pasta, soup, snacks, main courses, and burgers. There are also various pastry options that aren't on the menu, but you can see them directly on the pastry display.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbijjN3fjbbuGaosJkNKbC4Zax82FXFMmJKxBMejRBruB/1776827929137.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbQmkbcpiJ3zYfUoCvMVanuCk1urQz5iB6K98vm8aPZ4d/1776827929183.jpg)

And of course I will order coffee and a delicious slice of cake.

*Palm Sugar Latte*

Palm sugar latte, that's the drink I ordered. I really like this variant, so I want to try palm sugar latte at every cafe I visit.

A combination of coffee, milk, milk foam and palm sugar. The palm sugar is not only mixed with the coffee, but also sprinkled on top of the milk foam, making this drink look beautiful.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmci3bwpJfMP33uuqSq1Y9rD5oW2FHRQhxt1wjjKcgs5um/1776828223944.jpg)

The taste of this drink is very delicious. A delicious combination of sweet and bitter flavors. The sweetness is not too much, the coffee is also not too strong but not light either. It is very suitable for my taste, especially with the addition of palm sugar, making this coffee even more delicious. The perfect coffee to drink on a hot day like this.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNkyWZheHeAYyK8LzHY8p5yN3tXXnobhqULhqFeyaSSEy/1776828370207.jpg)

*Triple Choco*

For the cake slice, I ordered the Triple Choco, a cake with layers of chocolate. Sweet with chocolate that melts on the tongue, it's delicious. A soft, sweet cake, topped with peanuts.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdcfzWKxVHhbvTJTkwTYdiGCvNqHpcTzuivPgnfeeiwoU/1776828487841.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTAV2p3RySmtHFvumc7znTPgYkpTT9bt6Db5zQbaMq2wm/1776828487880.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS7UcNWgaBitv6ZeT26A9WthPo2A7bP5sEtmRkgQyhkG7/1776828487915.jpg)

That's my story at this cafe. Actually, this is beyond my expectations, because usually cafes that look luxurious and beautiful like this don't have very delicious food or drinks and have expensive prices. But for this cafe, it's not like that, because the coffee and cakes at this cafe are very delicious, and the prices are standard for cafes in Medan. I am very happy to be able to come to this cafe, and want to come back.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYhheaeXuJpKrA338YvJw9VXqFF861HvP4V8JXuTUGZYz/1776828631531.jpg)

body.title: 囤货油辣子＆吃了胃火烧火辣的串串
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![NPm40BmMyh5POyWU_mmexport1776828458706.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/jingjing1616/images/NPm40BmMyh5POyWU_mmexport1776828458706/NPm40BmMyh5POyWU_mmexport1776828458706.webp)
![WV5CHO5SF72OuZiu_mmexport1776828460851.jpg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/jingjing1616/images/WV5CHO5SF72OuZiu_mmexport1776828460851/WV5CHO5SF72OuZiu_mmexport1776828460851.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

家里的辣椒油快见底了，夏天到了吃凉菜的频率也变多了，所以就做一次，一次做多点，有备无患，上次做我记得还是一月份的样子，可想而知消耗之快，份量还不少呢。

用了两天买齐配件，香葱，香菜，洋葱，老姜，八角，花椒粒，切好备用，冷油下锅，然后开始熬制，差不多了就把配菜给盛出来，菜油经过这么一熬制，这么好香。

开始我辣椒面都没弄多少，丑丑来看，说少了少了，然后我又加，最后索性都做了，换大盆子，他给我打下手，还是很快就做好了，真的很香，丑丑对我的油泼辣子还是很认可的，婆婆也认可呢，觉得很香。装了一个满罐，一个大半罐，够我嚯嚯了。

出去逛了街，丑丑就有点不想回去煮饭了，其实我也不想外头吃，他就说去吃之前那家串串，貌似他之前都念过一次了，好吧，最后我妥协了，去吧，虽然我内心不想出去吃，我就陪他吧，整个过程我就吃得素菜，不想吃肉，而且这次我觉得有点辣，不直达是我口味没那么大了还是真的辣。

我让他别拿那么多菜，不够再加，结果他说多拿点免得上次那样去加菜还要等，结果这次没吃完打包了，主要是这次我没吃多少，我是这么不想吃。

结果吃了回去我胃里火飘飘的，极其难受，喝水也没有缓解，还好回来的路上买了个馒头，然后我去掰了一小点馒头吃，缓解了胃里那种灼烧感，他说以后我不出去吃就不强迫我出去吃了。

---

For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@jingjing1616/3m7k5p)

body.title: 潮汕遊7 - 汕頭小公園
body.body: 在潮州待了兩天，我就去了汕頭，本來沒打算去汕頭的，不過反正假期還有，來都來了，順便去汕頭走一走吧。我在汕頭只待了一天，因為景點不多，主要就是一個小公園、一個南澳島和一個礐石風景區，而我對自然景觀的興趣不大，那麼剩下的就只有小公園了，那麼待一天就夠了。 小公園在汕頭金平區，在當年汕頭開埠時成為了主要的轉運港，從而變成汕頭的主要商業區，直到後來在潮州待了兩天，我就去了汕頭，本來沒打算去汕頭的，不過反正假期還有，來都來了，順便去汕頭走一走吧。我在汕頭只待了一天，因為景點不多，主要就是一個小公園、一個南澳島和一個礐石風景區，而我對自然景觀的興趣不大，那麼剩下的就只有小公園了，那麼待一天就夠了。 ￼
/> 小公園在汕頭金平區，在當年汕頭開埠時成為了主要的轉運港，從而變成汕頭的主要商業區，直到後來汕頭發展龍湖區，加上小公園開始老化就逐漸荒廢，但卻保留下民國期間的建築，直到約10年前政府開始活化小公園成旅遊景區，讓小公園成為中國現存最大規模的民國騎樓建築群。
/> 處身小公園，真的感覺像回到民國時代，可能突然就有一群斧頭幫走到你旁邊跳舞。這當然不可能發生了，我來的這天是星期日，人實在太多了，斧頭幫也不敢出來搞事。 小公園有幾個打卡點，第一個是鎮邦美食街，整條街都是吃的，基本上想吃的這裡都有，但其他除了這條街，其他很多街都是整條街吃的，也不用特別來這。
/> 然後是汕頭旅社，是解放後最早的國營旅營，一個歐式騎樓，一直營業到1996，到了現在，卻成為了超級打卡點，我來到的時候應該有過百人在這排隊拍照，現場更已有了專門幫人拍照的團隊，連凳子都準備好了，實在有點誇張。
/> 然後是汕頭郵政局大樓，現在見到的是1922年重建版本，是廣東現存兩個歐陸式郵政建築之一，而到了現在這郵區依然是在運作的，不過同時加設了郵政歷史展及一個郵票展，還有紀念品店。
/> 老媽宮戲台，始於清嘉慶年間，每逢大時大節都會搭台做戲，是汕頭最早的市集，到解放後曾成為商品市場，直到近年重新保育成演出舞台，會表演潮劇、潮樂、雜技歌舞等。 最有趣的是，我進到戲台看到有很多人坐下，還以為有表演，問了一下職員才知道當年沒有表演，只是後來的人看到有人坐下都以為有表演就紛紛一起坐下。
/> 最後還有小公園核心的中山紀念亭和南生公司大廈，中山紀念亭顧名思義，是民國年間紀念孫中山而建成的，其實在1969年已拆除了，直到近年保育時才原貌重建。而亭後的那座南生公司大廈，則是當年汕頭最代表性的建築之一，有百貨、酒樓、旅社，就大約等如民國時上海的先旅或香港的利舞台了。 不過現在的南生大樓還沒有開放參觀，可惜了。 還有，就是實在太多人，我拍了張照就忍不住要走了。
/> 除此之外，小公園還有很多景點如汕頭開埠文化陳列館、僑批文物館、大埔會館、麥當營等等，就不一一列出了。 看似很多，其實小公園很少，我走了大約兩三個小時就走完了，結果下午我去了市區的博物館，順便體驗了汕頭的按摩 lol。不得不說，汕頭的按摩很厲害，硬件很好。

/>

100分鐘的按摩還送老火湯和自助餐，不過價錢不低，要450塊，但我也覺得挺值的。順帶一提，綠色的，綠過大草原。

我的汕頭之旅就這樣，去完博物館，在按摩店吃完飯都晚上了，回到小公園都差不多睡了，這邊跟潮州古城不一樣，晚上八九點街上已沒有什麼人了。

但至此，潮汕遊還沒有完，明天還有一篇，明天見。

body.title: The Quinceañera: A Milestone Uniting Tradition and Emotion.
body.body:
The quinceañera is much more than a simple party; it is a rite of passage that marks the transition from childhood to youth, full of cultural, family and personal meaning in many Latin American and Hispanic communities around the world.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRCEPLkKQoUiCXz9JwBFktc5NwHsrGEwH1TQ1HjNeXAQ2/1776828481871.jpg)

and friends. The celebration then continues with a banquet, music, dancing, and emotional moments such as the father-daughter waltz, the exchange of her shoes for high heels, and the presentation of a bouquet or a watch as a symbol of responsibility and the passage of time that begins in this new stage of her life.

Behind every detail—the stunning dress, the floral arrangements, the guest list—lie months of preparation and a collective effort from the family, demonstrating the love and support they give the young woman. For her, this day is a treasure she will cherish forever: a reminder that she is ready to face the world with strength, surrounded by the love of those who care for her.

body.title: The Housemaid (2025) - Massive Psychological Surprise - REVIEW
body.body:
https://i.postimg.cc/CK4Trvs0/The-House-Maid-(2025)-REVIEW-000.gif

[Source](https://www.starz.com/us/en/movies/the-housemaid-73779)

https://i.imgur.com/PGNq5Ek.png

Paul Feig is one of those directors where the second his name comes up, you start doing the mental math of whether this is going to be worth your time, because the guy has made some funny stuff in the past and also some stuff that felt like it was running purely on goodwill and nothing else, one production I remember he work on was Minx the TV series that was pretty good on its first season although idk if it still alife, so when my wife picked this for movie night, as a good geeky movie guy Im pick up the IMDB url and check who was on this besides your dear friend Sydney Sweeney. I kept things cool, neutral and started preparing to be politely bored for two hours. What actually happened was that The Housemaid grabbed you by the neck, almost like sit down I got you attention now, right out of the gate and did not let go, and that is not something I say about a domestic thriller lightly because that genre has been coasting on cheap execution and streaming budgets for years now, pumping out content that you forget before the thing end you are like what ever. The movie builds the story of Millie, played by Sydney Sweeney, a woman who just finished a ten year stretch and is trying to claw her way back to something close to what anyone would call a normal life, so when a live as housemaid opens up with the Winchester family out in Long Island, she takes it without asking too many questions, and the movie is smart enough not to ask them for her either, it just drops you into that house and lets everything you are supposed to feel settle in on its own time because as the movie goes many things about the family starts to uncover. That attic bedroom that only locks from the outside is the kind of nasty little detail that tells you immediately what kind of movie you are in, and Feig plants it early and just lets it sit there the whole time like poking at your brain.

- IMDB: https://www.imdb.com/title/tt27543632/
- Platform: [Starz](https://www.starz.com/us/en/movies/the-housemaid-73779)
https://t6.picb.cc/2026/04/22/uXKr6g.png
<div style=\

> https://t6.picb.cc/2026/04/22/uXK5MX.png [Source](https://www.starz.com/us/en/movies/the-housemaid-73779) Sydney Sweeney and Amanda Seyfried are both doing real work here and that combination is the main reason this thing rises above although this movie is not ground braking or anything that will make you remember it for days but to be honest it seems like the internet love it and want more out of it, it truly would not be strange if they do a TV series about it. For the most part the story gets your attention when Seyfried as Nina, the wife who swings between warm and completely unraveled, accusing Millie over misplaced notes and unexplained household incidents, she is playing a character with so many faces that you cannot get a read on her from scene to scene, and that kind of performance requires serious control to keep from going off the rails, and Seyfried never drops it. Brandon Sklenar as Andrew, the husband, walks in with this whole Bruce Wayne energy where the charm make the guy look so slick and polish, so deliberate that you almost cannot blame anyone around him for buying it completely, and the way he positions himself as the only sane and reasonable person in a house full of chaos is smooth enough that you just got to remember you have to  stay suspicious because this mfs cant be trusted, some things are just too nice to be true. The house itself is doing a lot of work too, all white walls and dark corners and that attic pressing down on everything from above, and the movie itself uses the space the way good thriller atmosphere should, making you feel like every room is holding something back from you. Feig also uses early scenes to get you rooting for exactly the wrong outcomes, which is a gut move that takes actual confidence in your work as a director to pull off and I got to say this movie was killing my wife, almost like it was one of this Mexican soap opera. https://t6.picb.cc/2026/04/22/uXK8PG.png [Source](https://www.starz.com/us/en/movies/the-housemaid-73779) https://t6.picb.cc/2026/04/22/uXKMgy.png [Source](https://www.starz.com/us/en/movies/the-housemaid-73779) Now it expected that content like this would be draggy if you are not fully committed to it, sometimes it almost felt like scenes were glue together since they loose rhythm here and there, there are moments where the logic does not fully click into place until the next piece of information arrives to patch the gap, and that creates a slump early in the movie where you are working harder than you should have to keep trying to guess whats going to happen next or even keep up the thread of the story and Im not sure if its be design but it felt wrong, when you have to think too much during a movie it just feels bad. Elizabeth Perkins shows up as Andrew's mother and she has exactly enough screen time to make you realize they cast someone great and then gave her absolutely nothing to do with it, like why most of the time they have to do this with the wife in the story? they cast someone great probably just to grab the audience attention but the role is crap, she could do so much more, remember her days on Weeds tv series, after all frustrating waste of time as she just disappears in the back. A couple of the story mechanics also fit together a little too perfectly in the back half, the kind of convenient click where you can feel the screenplay deciding things rather than letting them happen, things become too predictable and cliche but I guess there is that soap opera dna, and at the end it all felt rushed to close out its loose ends in a way that suggests someone ran out of either time or ideas and just punched it to the finish line. It is not enough to sink the movie but it is enough to leave a slightly incomplete feeling if you are paying close enough attention. https://t6.picb.cc/2026/04/22/uXKOGj.png [Source](https://www.starz.com/us/en/movies/the-housemaid-73779) https://t6.picb.cc/2026/04/22/uXKWpc.png [Source](https://www.starz.com/us/en/movies/the-housemaid-73779) The nineties erotic thriller is the obvious reference point for what The Housemaid is going for and the closest comparison is The Hand That Rocks the Cradle, where domestic space functions as a trap and politeness is just another weapon everybody is quietly loading, this is a family worst nightmare to a certain point almost like sleeping with the enemy and Feig actually manages to make that formula feel like it still a relevant style rather than just being a nostalgia reboot that feels flat, the movie during many moments have enough character to keep you interested. The humor is very very dialed way back compared to the 90s era where the jokes were basically firing at you not improvise but systematically one after another on choose scenes just to keep things funny, what I mean by this is that the movie doesnt have too many funny moments but enough to break the ice, it leans more into the drama and the psychological terror, and the restraint in been fun is noticeable because the comedy that does appear is being used to crack the pressure open for a second before letting it build again. From my understanding this is actually based on content a book that I have not touched and probably never will to be honest, I have said it many times, Im not a reader so I cannot speak to how faithful any of it is, but my wife was online looking up the novel before the movie was even all the way finished, she is a reader and that is probably the most positive argument for me from this movie, not a movie that I enjoy that much, very meh in my opinion. https://i.imgur.com/uwwnjtd.png
>\nhttps://i.imgur.com/r0yj9oi.png\nFor me its a 7.5 out of 10 but I ask my wife and she was \

, I was like wtf, but on the good side and this is me saying the movie is not bad, The Housemaid is exactly the kind of movie you stopped expecting to get from mainstream releases, a domestic thriller that actually makes the effort to keep you interested enough and backs it up with actors who are trying their best with a script that goes on for the most part and delivers something that keeps you interested for the most part without making you to pick up the phone and start scrolling or looking at what time is it, so weird that picking up a phone during a movie has become a benchmark now that I think about it. Millie becomes such an interesting character that when she finally decides to act doesnt feel force or fake and goes with the flow of the script, it is coming from someone who has been pushed into a corner and knows exactly how far she is willing to go when that happens, to be honest the evolution of her character reminds me a bit of my post from early today about \

body.title: Lost in my own thoughts 🌫️🖤
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdnA9g4V5DinRQfgKVDfP7uYSQR2YXEchmtoPMt6zySid/IMG_8491.PNG 


I like moments like this…  
when everything gets quiet and it’s just me, my thoughts, and the view.

No noise, no pressure… just space to think.

Sometimes I sit and wonder where I’m really going.  
Like… am I doing things right?  
Am I getting closer to the life I imagine or just moving without direction?

I don’t always have answers.  
Most days I don’t.

But I’ve learned that it’s okay to pause.  
To sit with your thoughts instead of running from them.

This is me… not posing, not trying to be perfect.  
Just feeling everything at once and letting it be.

Maybe growth doesn’t always look strong and confident.  
Maybe sometimes it looks like this… quiet, thoughtful, a little uncertain… but still moving forward.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@bryanavita/lost-in-my-own-thoughts--4cp)

body.title: Toasted bread with garlic, olive oil, and cheese (Eng/Esp)
body.body:
> Sometimes, the bread we buy doesn’t have the texture we like, either because the recipe didn’t strike the right balance in ingredient proportions or because it’s been sitting for several days and has gone stale. When this happens, we need to give it a new lease on life so we can enjoy a light and tasty breakfast. I should also mention that this recipe can serve as a party appetizer—this is where creativity knows no bounds.
![1000110737.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23yncqhNZBDtkgPVoHkKLiEiWhFkXig6XsE4TDPDZMjjkmMPzZws5hkuvUz7R9BuvMHpC.png)
## Ingredients: - 2 loaves of bread - 50 grams of white cheese for grating - 5 cloves of garlic - Olive oil - Pinch of salt
![1000110726.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23xKjqPWLFb2wQxbYHhxDSBRiYyZwAcQe1X1RfYH7Amc33vcGF2vsMVT2gXkJ34gABbZU.jpg)
## Preparation: I put the garlic cloves, a little olive oil, and a pinch of salt in the blender and blended them thoroughly. I sliced the bread into thin strips. Then I spread the mixture from the blender on them—it tasted great, just like an improvised garlic spread.
![1000110729.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23w2aKHUEJaW8bxnjGn2RKWxti1uWi9EVfrCNmxuiL5PXxEmFAGmssE7n6aBQeq8eA3xH.jpg)
Next, I set up a griddle with a completely clean surface, placed the bread strips on it, and grated cheese over each one. The idea was to toast them while melting the cheese at the same time. To achieve this, I put a lid on and set the heat to low.
![1000110734.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23vi1x39tzt7DwRsMjvXU2bH5b643AoJaXCRKatAoxzCJfujFC9D7N2qfeYmSQBxFu7Pr.jpg)
Six minutes later, they were soft on the inside and crispy on the outside. The bread had transformed completely, making for a striking appetizer that would go well with any meal. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> A veces, los panes que compramos no tienen la consistencia que nos gusta, bien porque la receta no siguió el equilibrio en cuanto a proporción de los ingredientes o porque ya tienen varios días de elaboración y se ponen duros, cuando esto ocurre hay que darles una nueva vida, de modo que podamos disfrutar de un desayuno ligero y sabroso. También debo mencionar que esta receta puede ser un pasabocas para una fiesta, es acá donde la creatividad no tiene límites.
![1000110737.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23yncqhNZBDtkgPVoHkKLiEiWhFkXig6XsE4TDPDZMjjkmMPzZws5hkuvUz7R9BuvMHpC.png)
## Ingredientes: - 2 panes - 50 gramos de queso blanco para rallar - 5 dientes de ajo - Aceite de oliva - Pizca de sal
![1000110726.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23xKjqPWLFb2wQxbYHhxDSBRiYyZwAcQe1X1RfYH7Amc33vcGF2vsMVT2gXkJ34gABbZU.jpg)
## Preparación: En la licuadora coloqué los dientes de ajo, un poquito de aceite de oliva y una pizca de sal, licué muy bien. Rebané los panes como lengüetas. Luego les unté la mezcla que salió de la licuadora, la cual tenía un excelente sabor, tal como una crema de ajo improvisada.
![1000110729.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23w2aKHUEJaW8bxnjGn2RKWxti1uWi9EVfrCNmxuiL5PXxEmFAGmssE7n6aBQeq8eA3xH.jpg)
Luego monté un budare con la superficie completamente limpia, coloqué las piezas de pan y le rallé queso a cada una. La idea era que se tostaran y, al mismo tiempo, que el queso se derritiera, para lograr tal objetivo puse una tapa y ajusté a fuego bajo.
![1000110734.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23vi1x39tzt7DwRsMjvXU2bH5b643AoJaXCRKatAoxzCJfujFC9D7N2qfeYmSQBxFu7Pr.jpg)
Seis minutos después tenía unas lengüetas suaves por dentro y crujientes por fuera. El pan cambió drásticamente, ofreciendo un aperitivo muy llamativo que puede ser el acompañante de cualquier comida.   *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

body.title: 優秀漫畫家早逝
body.body: >Unsplash 最近看了一部漫畫作品，叫做M.O小隊，故事題材是1930-1940年代的滿州國，當然裡面可能虛構的部分很多，但也多多少少了解了這段，對我而言是陌生的歷史，以前這段歷史在課本上也可能是兩三句話就帶過了。 此作是由一位故事原作者配上作畫家，現在好像也很流行這樣的搭配，很多有趣的作品也都是作畫與編劇分離，畢竟漫畫家如果有連載的期限壓力，一邊作畫又要一邊想劇情，可能是一種更大的壓力。 不過令人惋惜的是，這位畫家在去年11月因病過世，在過世前也表達過遺願，希望有人能接續作畫，當然更煥作者肯定是一個風險，很多人會因為畫風轉變而棄坑，特別是這位作者畫工精美。 也有讀者列了幾個畫風比較接近，且有一定功力的漫畫家，不過有些已經有名氣的，可能會自顧身份，不願意接手，或著當作畫師身份，可能還是會從還未出名的作畫師中尋找。 反而是故事方面，我雖然覺得題材不錯，但過程太過刻意要周遊整個滿洲，還有各種國籍的同伴聚集，反而會顯得不太自然，另外也過度強調友軍與敵對者，少了一些中立地帶的角色，感覺上讓故事深度少了很多。 --- For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@azazqwe/33ct7m)

body.title: Música, música y ¿artes plásticas? [ENG/ESP]
body.body:
>Greetings to everyone in the LifeStyle community. Today I’m joining you here to share another day in my life. This time, I want to tell you about how this lovely day went, since today was choir rehearsal—a day filled with music. I also had a few tasks to take care of before the rehearsal, so I took advantage of the day to plan, together with the teacher and the academy director, a project we hope to carry out in the coming weeks. I think it’s going to be quite interesting, as it’s something that will be useful and beneficial both for me and for the academy in terms of artistic diversity. A comprehensive initiative.

\n\n>

>Saludos a todos en la comunidad de LifeStyle. El día de hoy me uno por acá para compartir con ustedes un nuevo día mi vida. En esta ocasión les quiero compartir. Cómo fue este bonito día, pues hoy tocaba ensayo en el coro. Día de música. También me tocó hacer algunas actividades antes de entrar y aproveché este día para planificar junto a la profesora y directora de la academia, un proyecto que deseamos poder llevar a cabo en las próximas semanas. Creo que va a estar bastante interesante, pues es algo que va a ser útil y de provecho tanto para mí como para la academia en cuanto a diversidad artística. Una propuesta integral.

body.title: Two years later, do these markers still work?
body.body: >Estos marcadores ya tienen casi dos años conmigo y durante todo este tiempo me han ayudado para muchos proyectos, cosas de la escuela de mi hijo y tambien algunas decoraciones personales que he hecho, a pesar de tener casi dos años conmigo aun funcionan la mayoría, pero obviamente no todo es perfecto, hoy hice una prueba para ir eliminando los colores que ya no funcionan y aunque pensé que iba a botar más, es una perdida bastante grande teniendo en cuenta que son colores sumamente importantes, quizás los que mas suelo utilizar. > I’ve had these markers for almost two years now, and during that time they’ve helped me with many projects—things for my son’s school and some personal decorations I’ve made. Even though I’ve had them for almost two years, most of them still work, but obviously not everything is perfect. Today I did a test to start weeding out the colors that no longer work, and although I thought I’d be throwing away more, it’s quite a big loss considering that these are extremely important colors—perhaps the ones I use most often. ![Corazón banner (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23uFgAbHNHepcyH3o8wH15M4pR8K7Jsf3tw4TsSj65zyY1UyQpKRK2L9tGpjABj48Qxzb.png)

>Estos marcadores los compre en Aliexpress, no recuerdo exactamente cuánto me costaron, creo que fue $18, trae 48 colores y como son marcadores acrílicos sirven para todo tipo de superficies, asi que eso los hace aun mas especiales. Aunque cuando los recibi senti que eran demasiado delgados y que no había demasiada variedad de colores, hay muchos tonos que son casi idénticos y la mayoría son tonalidades marrones/verdosas muy feas, como color fango y evidentemente los colores que menos he usado en todo este tiempo, esos tonos estan casi nuevos de hecho.- > I bought these markers on AliExpress; I don't remember exactly how much they cost me, but I think it was $18. They come in 48 colors, and since they're acrylic markers, they work on all kinds of surfaces, which makes them even more special. Although when I received them, I felt they were too thin and that there wasn’t much variety in the colors—there are many shades that are almost identical, and most are very ugly brownish-green tones, like mud color—and obviously, those are the colors I’ve used the least during all this time; in fact, those shades are almost brand new. ![IMG_20260421_192043.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23tvkkqfVbScX8sCytWi4m6bdBqfXvo2q4frsDSH5RqS1CsaoPjv7FFAZR41CKkHUS1yo.jpg) ![IMG_20260421_192235.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23uFXvT89ooa5EE51zxeoRujF8ZN3npkfZ3F5PQuGYf87Fd62uRgKnEJLWLURStzRaAVD.jpg)

>Y los colores que mas suelo utilizar son los tonos básicos, azules, rojos, amarillos, negro… Justamente algunos de esos ya no tienen mas vida. Asi que decidí botarlos porque estan completamente secos. > And the colors I use most often are the basic shades—blues, reds, yellows, black… Some of those are actually past their prime. So I decided to throw them away because they’re completely dried out. ![IMG_20260421_192245.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23tmL4qQNxQb1BCH2jBtu9XEtYH8RVgzJbQL8Vg2x6msbpB3EtfPNRLtZPif3jwtceffQ.jpg) ![IMG_20260421_193028.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23vsQTkVyPxtb8WQXtz9fqsYhtBi2Uvv41usETx9NqEepC9n7UkYCEpJDhhajFDU41KGv.jpg)

>Me sorprendió que no bote tantos colores ya que la ultima vez que use estos marcadores había muchísimos secos. Pero hoy pareciera que se refrescaron un poco y muchos de ellos revivieron, hice una prueba en un cuaderno y casi todos pintaban bastante bien. Aun puedo disfrutar un tiempo mas de estos marcadores, sinceramente me gustaron aunque si debo confesar que hay tonos que son bastante claros y ni pigmentan demasiado (blanco, beige, color piel claro) esos tonos necesitan varias capas para al menos darse notar. > I was surprised that so many of the colors still worked, since the last time I used these markers, a lot of them had dried out. But today it seems like they’ve freshened up a bit and many of them have come back to life; I tested them on a notebook and almost all of them worked pretty well. I can still enjoy these markers for a while longer. Honestly, I liked them, though I have to admit that some shades are quite light and don’t have much pigment (white, beige, light skin tone)—those shades need several layers to even show up. ![IMG_20260421_193019.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23tvijLVTxtA56FcjK6Ynkb3Y1e3WcxHbXcD3hVupSVqsR1W637HbBAnwBcHGjBHqWcZ4.jpg) ![IMG_20260421_193453.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23tvgEf272McJ9KsKNSCBEjeC3tecimQwb6V2hgS1gE1um1U3iGbk8E3r9E616bakC2A1.jpg)

body.title: Mar Estrellado/Starry Sea
body.body: />Hola a todos en la comunidad! Es un placer compartir con ustedes mi más reciente creación. Como artista, siempre me ha fascinado la conexión entre el cosmos y la naturaleza terrestre; hay algo profundamente pacífico en observar las estrellas frente al mar. Hoy quiero mostrarles cómo transformé esa inspiración en un lienzo al óleo, compartiendo con ustedes no solo el resultado final, sino parte del proceso técnico y los sentimientos que puse en cada pincelada. Espero que disfruten este viaje visual tanto como yo disfruté pintándolo.\

Hello everyone in the community! It is a pleasure to share my latest creation with you. As an artist, I have always been fascinated by the connection between the cosmos and our earthly nature; there is something deeply peaceful about watching the stars by the sea. Today, I want to show you how I transformed that inspiration into an oil canvas, sharing not only the final result but also part of the technical process and the emotions I poured into every brushstroke. I hope you enjoy this visual journey as much as I enjoyed painting it.\n\n

/>Mi objetivo principal con esta pieza era capturar la magia y la inmensidad de una noche perfecta en la costa, donde el cielo se fusiona con el mar en un abrazo cósmico. ​Para lograrlo, utilicé una técnica meticulosa por capas. Comencé trabajando en la galaxia, utilizando óleos de la más alta calidad. Apliqué primero capas base de azules profundos, ultramar y cerúleo, y luego, mediante la técnica del estarcido (o splattering), creé la base de las estrellas más finas. El núcleo luminoso de la Vía Láctea lo conseguí velando capas translúcidas de blancos cálidos y amarillos pálidos, fundiéndolas suavemente (blending) para crear ese efecto etéreo y nebuloso que podéis ver. Para las estrellas más brillantes y los meteoros, utilicé un pincel de detalle muy fino, aplicando pequeños toques de color puro. My main goal with this piece was to capture the magic and vastness of a perfect night on the coast, where the sky merges with the sea in a cosmic embrace. ​To achieve this, I used a meticulous, layered painting technique. I began by working on the galaxy using artist-grade oils. I first applied base layers of deep blues, ultramarine, and cerulean. Then, using a splattering technique, I created the field of finer stars. The luminous core of the Milky Way was built by glazing translucent layers of warm whites and pale yellows, which were softly blended to create that ethereal, nebulous effect you see. For the brighter stars and meteors, I used a very fine detail brush, applying small touches of pure color.

/>Para el océano y la playa, quería que la luz de la galaxia se reflejara. Pinté las olas en el horizonte con tonos más oscuros para dar profundidad, y a medida que se acercaban a la orilla, incorporé blancos de titanio y sutiles toques turquesa para darles movimiento y frescura. La arena está trabajada con una mezcla de tonos siena y ocre, con pequeños toques de textura para que parezca palpable. El resplandor en la orilla es un reflejo directo del centro de la galaxia, uniendo ambas partes de la composición.

​Es una obra cargada de paz, y espero que, al verla, os sintáis transportados a ese momento mágico bajo las estrellas. ¡Gracias por apoyar mi arte!

For the ocean and the beach, I wanted the galaxy’s light to be reflected. I painted the waves on the horizon with darker tones to provide depth, and as they approach the shore, I incorporated titanium whites and subtle turquoise touches to give them movement and freshness. The sand is worked with a mixture of sienna and ochre tones, with small textured details to make it feel palpable. The glow on the shoreline is a direct reflection of the galaxy's center, unifying both parts of the composition.

​This is a work filled with peace, and I hope that when you view it, you feel transported to that magical moment under the stars. Thank you for supporting my art!

... Ah y por cierto mucho bosque, mucho lobo y apenas luz para divisar ni tan siquiera como alucinación algo de hombre nuevo...

body.title: A Great Ally for Melee Cards
body.body:
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmfN3ZYiAMMDLaZisogTsAucpE5zk2h8ShkLkUyJocXCHS/melee.png</center>

Summoners are essential in Splinterlands, and today I'm going to talk about the card Possibilus the Wise, one of the summoners in the Water Deck that I really like to use in my battles.

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcZMi25NhRYMhPL9WzhT6BnGRhSPg1qzcVY7nsG9LRdMP/m.png</center>

This is Possibilus the Wise, a Legendary summoner belonging to the Water Deck. Possibilus the Wise costs 6 mana to use in battles and has 3 functions:

- Increase the life of allied cards by +2.

- Grant the Trample ability to all allied cards.

- Grant the Reach ability to all allied cards.

In my opinion, the main function of Possibilus the Wise is the Reach ability. I say this because melee attack cards are powerful, and this ability is very useful when creating strategies; you'll understand why soon.

To better understand how Possibilus the Wise works, let's learn about the Trample ability and the Reach ability.

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmY1yobF6eiPjkwokfgUCmHvey53wci6fsmrCz1wxwnwoK/mm.png</center>

**Trample**: After using a melee attack to defeat a unit, performs another melee attack against the unit in the next position.

*This ability helps melee cards deal more damage in battle.*

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQt4u4N9mX1ftM4fbAD2FYS9qs6Ne8Xbjw5cbjxYVoUBZ/mmm.png</center>

**Reach**: Can use melee attacks from the second position.

*This is the ability I mentioned, and since melee cards can only attack in the first position, Reach is very useful for having more melee cards in battle.*

Explaining how abilities work is better when you see them in battles, so let's go to the battlefield in Splinterlands.

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYVB54uLLPHWKeGupVkeYHQNinLdnqxGKKdvY6o2avW6Y/mmmm.png</center>

## <center>[Watch The Battle](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_758d74cc959ec3f72597e59c4b31acac?ref=moonblast)</center>

This battle is a great example of how the Trample ability and the Reach ability are useful in battles in Splinterlands. I know I mentioned Reach ability as the main function of the Possibilus the Wise card, but Trample ability was a major factor in helping me deal more damage in battle.

With this strategy, I easily defeated my opponent in just 2 rounds.

## Arcade Colony

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmeVhSb4SzdyDLvV8kzgZHxx6k28Qf7zRFm1ENJnTfcxxR/mmmmm.png</center>

Now I'll talk about the **[Arcade Colony](https://arcadecolony.com/)** platform. On it, you'll find the games: **[Splinterlands](https://splinterlands.com/?ref=moonblast)**, **[Moon Karts](https://moonkarts.arcadecolony.com/)**, **[StakeHouse Den](https://stakehouseden.arcadecolony.com/)**, and **[Genesis League Goals](https://goals.genesisleaguesports.com/)**.

*For those unfamiliar with Arcade Colony, it's owned by Invennium Corp. Arcade Colony is a platform for arcades and video games with a functional economy based on a governance token, \

.*

**Invennium Corp. is a 100% subsidiary of Splinterlands.**

Find more information about Arcade Colony in my post: **[Discover the Arcade Colony Platform](https://peakd.com/hive-13323/@moonblast/discover-the-arcade-colony-platform-lne)**.
