body.title: Chicken and Calabrian Pepper Rice
body.body:
> **
ESPAÑOL
** Hoy preparé para mi almuerzo familiar un arroz amarillo con pollo y para realzar su sabor añadi una calabresa, que le dio un toque espectacular! les muestro el procedimiento

> **
ENGLISH
** Today I made yellow rice with chicken for my family lunch, and to bring out the flavor, I added a calabrese pepper, which gave it a spectacular touch! Here’s how I did it ![IMG_20260419_143334_391.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23tmFZEQ5RQ3ZVDTJLMR4ACKKzGDJV6VkYs1MydWDWPMperb9uT5MkuGNK9KcynEvyjg3.jpg)

> **
INGREDIENTES
** pollo, arroz, calabresa, ají, ajo, cebolla, cilantro, cebollín

> **
INGREDIENTS
** chicken, rice, pepperoni, chili pepper, garlic, onion, cilantro, chives ![IMG_20260419_131911_140.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23x12W1DkGPKPMuzqPCKBvETLQh4NV3iaZ5REWycQz75jrsWRHYkLnJwrMdCTBeMHFPd3.jpg) ![IMG_20260419_124502_274.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23tbsB6CbmDfMVwg43WYwvC4dSuCxw6yQj4PkaXwuLULwia9TV5FXCek1myFvEJ889YPD.jpg)

> **
PROCEDIMIENTO
** Después de lavar muy bien todos los aliños, los corté en trocitos, los llevé a sofreír e incorporé el pollo también cortado en cuadros, la calabresa, dejé cocinar oor espacio de unos 5 minutos . Luego agregué el arroz previamente lavado, añadí cúrcuma para darle el color amarillo, agregué la cantidad de agua necesaria y sazoné con adobo, comino, pimienta, dejé cocinar hasta que hubo secado por completo

> **
PROCEDURE
** After thoroughly washing all the vegetables, I chopped them into small pieces, sautéed them, and added the chicken (also cut into cubes) and the zucchini, letting them cook for about 5 minutes. Then I added the pre-washed rice, added turmeric to give it a yellow color, added the necessary amount of water, and seasoned it with adobo, cumin, and pepper. I let it cook until the liquid had completely evaporated. ![IMG_20260419_132135_028.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23wgMycGr3BoPrFLX3bsGm9DvvkcQNZ7S3mRWesbi4HBxKEvhEjKWRhUi7kfDATh46VGQ.jpg) ![IMG_20260419_130503_691.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23wC7dwqPNHDFUeDrAN8yzTpMdJN7QUg3K9JCVGJeXW4Ajw1UBwPuenRuCZfKM2KDnp6q.jpg) ![IMG_20260419_130458_007.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23tmMkphf4NWUdZPEptkFxRN6rzHwKv3Z4htkWfqvABqsZo8a7FTAArsPuMzX1KBf3V5S.jpg) ![IMG_20260419_133351_229.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23xAP5uR3cjro7VVWHzs9QBk9NLJfXSRGTDD7AP7devTnTAhRSgAE7kx4jkgZ38kYjEUX.jpg) ![IMG_20260419_140335_314.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23yJBuVotAdBvRDcX5UhhUMZwBqjXwCfzQujqBoydr2SQL1V16E5vPuUVkeFAXMURJoJB.jpg) ![IMG_20260419_142427_832.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23xKrPfFDpBxDpoD39Ssi9bKB4X8iUWrmMSxt7QYJcYU6hJ7U4eZy44YSGaczWZg5j1Cu.jpg)

⚡️ As the Portuguese Liga 2 season approaches its business end, the highly anticipated clash between Feirense and Torreense on April 28, 2026, promises to be a pivotal encounter with significant implications for both sides. Set to unfold at the Estádio Marcolino de Castro, this fixture pits two teams with differing ambitions but a shared desire for three crucial points. **Feirense: Battling for Survival** Feirense finds themselves in a precarious position, deeply entrenched in the relegation battle. Every match from here on out is a cup final for the \

and a home fixture against a mid-table side like Torreense presents a prime opportunity to claw their way out of the danger zone.

Under the guidance of Manager Miguel Leal, Feirense has displayed flashes of resilience, particularly at home. Their recent form, however, has been a mixed bag, characterized by moments of defensive solidity interspersed with a frustrating lack of cutting edge in front of goal. The onus will be on their attacking midfielders and lone striker to capitalize on any chances created. Midfielder Tiago Dias, with his creative flair and ability to dictate tempo, will be key to unlocking the Torreense defense. Defensively, the experienced centre-back pairing will need to be at their absolute best to thwart Torreense's attacking threats and maintain a clean sheet, which has been a rarity for them this season.

A victory would not only provide a much-needed boost in confidence but could also see them leapfrog a direct rival, giving them a fighting chance to avoid the drop. The home crowd, renowned for their passionate support, will undoubtedly play a crucial role in rallying their team.

**Torreense: Aiming for Mid-Table Stability**

Torreense, comfortably positioned in the mid-table, arrives at this fixture with less pressure but no less desire for a win. While promotion seems out of reach and relegation a distant concern, a strong finish to the season can build momentum for the next campaign and potentially attract new talent. Manager Rui Ferreira will be keen to see his side maintain their professional approach and avoid complacency against a desperate Feirense.

Torreense has built its reputation this season on a solid defensive foundation and effective counter-attacking football. Their ability to soak up pressure and then transition quickly has proven problematic for many opponents. Key to their success will be the industrious midfield, responsible for winning possession and launching attacks. Upfront, their primary goalscorer, who has enjoyed a productive season, will be looking to add to his tally against a vulnerable Feirense defense. Their full-backs, often venturing forward, will also be crucial in providing width and delivering dangerous crosses into the box.

A win for Torreense would solidify their mid-table standing and ensure a comfortable run-in to the season's conclusion, allowing them to experiment with tactics and potentially integrate younger players.

**Tactical Battleground**

The match is likely to be a classic contrast of styles. Feirense will be expected to push forward with urgency, attempting to dictate play and create opportunities. Torreense, on the other hand, will likely adopt a more cautious approach, looking to absorb pressure, exploit spaces left by Feirense's attacking forays, and hit them on the break.

The midfield battle will be crucial. Whichever team gains control of the central areas will likely dictate the pace and flow of the game. Set pieces could also prove to be a decisive factor, with both teams possessing players capable of delivering and converting from dead-ball situations.

**Prediction**

This is a tough one to call, primarily due to the contrasting motivations. Feirense's desperation for points will fuel a fervent performance, especially with their home support behind them. However, Torreense's disciplined approach and counter-attacking prowess could exploit Feirense's need to attack.

body.title: Una sorpresa muy grata entre amigos🥰😍 || A very pleasant surprise among friends🥰😍
body.body:
> 


![Picsart_26-04-21_23-01-46-276.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/milagrosmhbl/ALEZr3gwRjDDA3QhYDABj5CjMjXr4haPoAczDu1mZ7Zi1EHekG9e5zWXf6dZ1oN.jpg)

Hola amigos de #Familyandfriends, feliz martes. Hoy quiero mostrarles un poquito de lo que fue la sorpresa que entre todos le pudimos dar a la maestra de mi muchachito 🥰. El pasado viernes celebró un año más de vida y entre todas las mamis del salón nos pusimos de acuerdo para hacerle esta sorpresa; aunque llegar a este acuerdo fue todo un caos porque, ya saben, cada quien tiene una opinión diferente jeje. Aparte no todas dieron el aporte, aunque solo fue un dólar, pero bueno, a veces a uno le falta medio para completar uno, así dice mi abuela jeje. Pero al final, entre todas las que colaboramos, pudimos hacerle este detalle.
​
> Hello #Familyandfriends friends, happy Tuesday. Today I want to show you a little bit of the surprise we all put together for my boy's teacher 🥰. Last Friday she celebrated another year of life, and all the moms in the classroom got together to plan this surprise; although reaching an agreement was total chaos because, you know, everyone has a different opinion lol. Also, not everyone contributed, even though it was only a dollar, but oh well, sometimes you're just a bit short, as my grandma says lol. In the end, those of us who collaborated were able to give her this special gift.


![IMG_20260417_091234_420.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/milagrosmhbl/Ep7vduWSYWUtkgN8H3Efa4S5KKrdJ1bWNGkmHWH8tKU4TuN1WcHDxFCJPwwUow7kSkX.jpg)

​Lo primero que le compramos fueron los materiales de la torta que, gracias a Dios, nos ahorramos la mano de obra porque la mami de una estudiante se encargó de hacerla; de hecho, es la encargada de las tortas desde primer grado jeje. Llevar los materiales unos días antes fue todo un show porque había que dárselos sin que la maestra lo notara jajaja. Para nada, porque el mismo día de la sorpresa un alumno se lo dijo 😂, es decir, tan sorpresa no fue jajaja. Pero bueno, aparte de la torta, le compramos un perfume y un ramito de flores, y adornamos el salón mientras ella estaba en otro salón con los niños; aquí estábamos manos a la obra.
​
> The first thing we bought were the ingredients for the cake. Thank God we saved on labor because one of the students' moms took care of baking it; in fact, she’s been the one in charge of the cakes since first grade lol. Bringing the materials a few days early was quite a production because we had to hand them over without the teacher noticing hahaha. It was all for nothing because on the day of the surprise, a student told her 😂, so it wasn't much of a surprise anymore hahaha. But anyway, besides the cake, we bought her perfume and a small bouquet of flowers, and we decorated the classroom while she was in another room with the children; here we were, hard at work.

![IMG_20260417_090742_932.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/milagrosmhbl/EqFtxC45E2p651Z9qg9WZm18kSYBygSjEswnN34H4uezTTirGuE9bvQGKHJ3HA7qo6S.jpg)

![IMG_20260417_091226_481.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/milagrosmhbl/EpvhzWro1kvY6MSrDAcAZd8j2USDkSgdiAdrwYztuWDtncigYT2hNeNQNuJL4LEc2xx.jpg)



​Todos los niños estaban contentísimos de que iban a comer torta, obvio jajaja, y al entrar la maestra le gritamos \

🥳 y obvio ella feliz; aunque ya sabía de la sorpresa, igual fue muy grato para ella 🥰.\n​\n> All the kids were thrilled because they were going to eat cake, obviously lol, and when the teacher walked in, we all shouted \

🥳 and she was obviously happy; even though she already knew about it, it was still very pleasant for her 🥰.



![1776827383598.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/milagrosmhbl/23uFVzaDdjGELaugYkeeSZvmjHjYzcj6JGkMGxbGLuBTepsjrXENFr8AiTWMfEKCPpkRe.jpg)


​Las flores estaban bellas y la torta igual, además DELICIOSA 🥰.

> ​The flowers were beautiful and so was the cake, plus it was DELICIOUS 🥰.




![IMG_20260417_091236_986.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/milagrosmhbl/EoK6Mc9BtNiJhGY2Rk17PMDcxE2N9GezNRGZbBX2ha8FBwsQqgbN4Dz6wGXiP23xG8m.jpg)

![IMG_20260417_090045_623.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/milagrosmhbl/EoGzSN4o9QLQaE3rFERkm6defPWsYYu8dkS6D1X95Xg6r37DyfpvA7EQB5iC75kETaC.jpg)|![IMG_20260417_090749_196.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/milagrosmhbl/EoptwsWz7ixspK7xNkFeNHv47cd46DGHhppohmJHq6FUvsvugifkikEg8nA9NGouvPZ.jpg)
--|--|

​Y la maestra feliz con sus pollitos y los detalles que entre todas le dimos 🥰. Al final ella es la encargada de llevar de la mano a nuestros niños en el camino del aprendizaje y para nosotras es un placer haberle preparado dicha sorpresa ❤️.
​
> And the teacher was happy with her \

and the gifts we all gave her 🥰. In the end, she is the one in charge of guiding our children along the path of learning, and for us, it is a pleasure to have prepared this surprise for her ❤️. ​Fotos de mi propiedad. ![1776827368552.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/milagrosmhbl/24244XQPs5Uv2esF7G1memfK1LR3xBTrFyoZXwciqUX2boiFLuszhpoHwri5Ar5Hmf2Dd.jpg) Portada editada en PicsArt. ​Photos are my own. body.title: Una buena velada familiar para iniciar el fin de semana [ESP/ENG]
body.body:
>

Saludos estimados amigos de la comunidad familiar @family-friends, espero que estén disfrutando de una excelente semana en compañía de sus seres queridos.

Hoy les quiero compartir imágenes de un agasajo que la empresa donde presto mis servicios, hizo a todo su personal en un conocido hotel de Tucacas en el estado Falcón. 

![@morepina.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/23wqnx1XQWNSihThEoMXh4F5Rt2pAx8zMW2b78LCewfGnmCxCZPXy6198VVYhDodXQHjj.jpg)

Hace tres años que laboro en esta empresa  constructora y como no nos habían hecho fiesta de fin de año, la jefa nos preparó un viaje a la playa el pasado fin de semana junto a los familiares de los empleados.

![IMG-20260418-WA0094.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/23w2oCMhC3mZEeNnijsxT52vjJ3bwRk9yL3QCBa5FUj7FCsuBgyQjPeUo3paZhz9KFUmK.jpg)

Cuando llegamos al hotel nos estaban esperando en la recepción un pequeño grupo de empleados del hotel, quienes nos recibieron muy amablemente y luego de registrarnos y guardar el equipaje, nos ofrecieron unos cocos fríos muy bien decorados y nos pasaron al área de la piscina.

 ![IMG-20260418-WA0090.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/23xAVU6uTwnbRimupgsmivsLnZ9RiW4a5kHNRY3kVBHozNC9L4icArHf8c2JNGdehvPjs.jpg)

![IMG-20260418-WA0078.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/23x19P9bmJP9FDn3h4giePr98RSs9k6yp1gFNSE2E7yL2LwGgdCrJ5Gu38aHPtKJUapQT.jpg)

Mientras degustábamos el agua de coco y las cervezas,  compartíamos con la familia y los amigos del trabajo. Todo era alegría y caras sonrientes en toda el área de la piscina.

![IMG-20260418-WA0066.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EoEq2HSv8PGB1nfqwdmDkUhfCfYBqq7T3zLCtFSvayKQQrAM726Sq9LpZaWfN43wWeE.jpg)


![IMG-20260418-WA0071.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/Eo8SodikwA47LmorDpcfWvB6E3B5wRV6yuh6DYT8YGmqHcvwK6T8BiVmAieR65rvyKf.jpg)

Las horas pasaban y la diversión no paraba en aquel ambiente tan agradable, escuchando la buena música que colocaba el DJ y disfrutando de la exquisita velada entre todos los asistentes al evento.

En verdad fue una noche para recordar, no solo por el disfrute de las comidas y bebidas sino por el compañerismo que se vivió en ese momento entre todos los presentes.

Hasta una nueva oportunidad me despido de ustedes agradeciendo la atención prestada.
Saludos y bendiciones para todos. 


![por-su-atención--¡muchas-gracias!-.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/23u5taqyW6uQY3DH43A7wERRAaZuFK1yiTMxXsBz1DzBTEPeSaFFFTE4N2aft2gwdwXZC.jpeg)

body.title: Chiton or Sea Cockroach (Eng/Esp)
body.body:
> During one of my walks along Caigüire Beach, I sat down to rest on one of the large rocks near the shore and took advantage of this moment of peace to gaze at the scenery for a while. But then I leaned on a rock near the water, and it tipped over—revealing a curious creature I’d never seen before.
![1000110693.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23x19AawdN5dKjHwGyJsaDhoXJLdaKKYR44n4BEEPyuNJuKLq5oDptos2SocfDAL6h7jd.png)
At first glance, it looked like a cockroach with a small brown shell, and I wasn’t far off—a quick search on my phone revealed that it was a sea cockroach, known as a chitón or quitón (Chiton articulatus). It turns out to be a very unique mollusk, so I decided to learn more about it and took some photos. This specimen, about four centimeters long, is dark brown with black spots on its shell—which is made up of eight articulated plates—and is capable of detecting movement through eye sensors located on its upper surface, though they aren’t visible to the naked eye because they’re so tiny. So it was watching me too after I moved the rock—a meeting of two worlds.
![VID-20260421-WA-1776821564610.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23x1DPWRJksteEbd62n8iWoC1kVDMcYyMRbmJhrQUfB8q6y9koi6cq3cyWLvDDc56uFtm.gif)
They come in various colors, the most common being the one shown here, though it is possible to find gray, black, red, or yellow specimens. While it would be interesting to find some of these varieties, I wouldn’t dare mess with a multicolored marine animal because it’s a sign of toxicity. A positive aspect of the marine cockroach, for the purposes of this research, is its slowness, as it allows you to observe it and keep it under control.
![1000110696.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23u69cnKVDFAAaQAjjTi5rjM8NL8YxHnMkJGATkuhaPzSAc5BHBNJd7uHkhhyT4b2qS61.png)
I discovered that this animal lives attached to rocks in humid areas and feeds on algae, although some species (Placiphorella) are carnivorous; they catch small crustaceans by lifting their front section, thereby capturing and devouring their prey with a tongue equipped with sharp teeth encrusted with magnetic iron, which allows them to break through shells. Although it is commonly known as the sea cockroach, this name has nothing to do with the undesirable insect that transmits many diseases (except for the resemblance); this mollusk is called this because it is practically a living fossil that was discovered over 400 years ago. However, it turns out that this marine species is considered an exotic delicacy, in high demand in countries across the Americas for its flavor; it can even be eaten raw, ceviche-style. It is important to note that the animal must be fresh to be consumed, just as oysters are, since if it has been dead for some time or is decomposing, it releases toxins that are dangerous to humans.
![1000110694.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23wqiRmxwAEcJViNvDPCXzpQ2PuJbyT8ziKuxqu96SqPufd1UJxC8XkhUHXczoGkjkk74.png)
Curiosity got the better of me, so I gently nudged it with a small stick to make it move so I could observe it in action. When it turned around, I noticed the suction cup that allows it to attach itself to rocks and move; it was soft and cream-colored, and it also had excellent elasticity, as it curled up like worms do—something they do when they feel threatened.
![1000110689.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23vsJHW45Cxq6ErkmaBUkjYKxDq9GyPku2rwZJKwtQByTXHqBfkpL6na2dmM9evWuD2ET.png)
![1000110691.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23xKtQnztDnEGGRv8jmpxMy8HBSbaQfq2vJ6Pz2he3wnawXjoVmBtp5NSjzTaZeqvaLbS.jpg)
As for reproduction, they are sexually dimorphic, generally having a single ovary or testis. The process works as follows: females release eggs, which are fertilized by sperm from males. Another possibility is internal fertilization, in which the larvae develop within the oviducts. While they are fascinating animals for those who enjoy studying nature’s strangest species, it probably isn’t very pleasant to be enjoying a day at the beach and have a strange, unattractive chitons appear on the scene. Although beauty and ugliness will always depend on the lens through which one views them. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> En una de las caminatas por la Playa Caigüire me senté a descansar sobre una de las grandes rocas que están cerca de la orilla, aproveché este instante de paz para contemplar el paisaje un rato. Pero entonces me apoyé sobre una piedra que estaba cerca del agua, la cual se volteó y allí estaba un curioso animal que no había tenido la oportunidad de ver antes.
![1000110693.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23x19AawdN5dKjHwGyJsaDhoXJLdaKKYR44n4BEEPyuNJuKLq5oDptos2SocfDAL6h7jd.png)
A primera vista parecía una cucaracha con un pequeño caparazón de morrocoy y no estaba tan equivocado, una inmediata investigación en mi teléfono arrojó que se trataba de una cucaracha de mar, denominada chitón o quitón (Chiton articulatus). Resulta que es un molusco muy particular, así que decidí profundizar sobre él, así que le tomé algunas fotografías. Este espécimen, de unos cuatro centímetros, de color marrón oscuro con pintas negras en su caparazón, el cual está compuesto por ocho placas articuladas, es capaz de detectar movimiento a través de sensores oculares ubicados en su parte de arriba, pero a simple vista no se aprecian porque son minúsculos. Así que también me estaba observando tras mover la piedra, un encuentro de dos mundos.
![VID-20260421-WA-1776821564610.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23x1DPWRJksteEbd62n8iWoC1kVDMcYyMRbmJhrQUfB8q6y9koi6cq3cyWLvDDc56uFtm.gif)
Existen de varios colores, siendo el más común el que se muestra, aunque es posible hallar especímenes grises, negros, rojos o amarillos. Si bien sería interesante encontrar algunas de estas variedades, no me atrevería a meterme con un animal marino multicolor porque es indicio de toxicidad. Un aspecto positivo de la cucaracha marina, para efectos de esta investigación, es su lentitud porque permite contemplarla y mantenerla bajo control.
![1000110696.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23u69cnKVDFAAaQAjjTi5rjM8NL8YxHnMkJGATkuhaPzSAc5BHBNJd7uHkhhyT4b2qS61.png)
Descubrí que este animal vive pegado a las rocas en zonas húmedas y se alimenta de algas, aunque algunas especies (Placiphorella) son carnívoras, atrapan a pequeños crustáceos, tras levantar la parte frontal, para de esta forma apresar y devorar a su presa con una lengua que posee filosos dientes con incrustaciones de hierro magnético, así que pueden romper caparazones. Si bien se le conoce comúnmente como cucaracha de mar, este nombre nada tiene que ver con el insecto indeseable transmisor de muchas enfermedades (solo en el parecido), a este molusco se le dice así porque es prácticamente un fósil viviente que fue descubierto hace más de 400 años. Sin embargo, resulta que esta especie marina es considerada un aperitivo exótico, de gran demanda en países de América por su sabor, inclusive se pueden comer crudos al estilo ceviche. Es importante advertir que el animal debe estar fresco para ser ingerido, así como se degustan las ostras, puesto que si está muerto desde hace rato o en período de descomposición, exterioriza toxinas peligrosas para los humanos.
![1000110694.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23wqiRmxwAEcJViNvDPCXzpQ2PuJbyT8ziKuxqu96SqPufd1UJxC8XkhUHXczoGkjkk74.png)
La curiosidad me invadió y con un pequeño palo lo rocé para que se moviera y poder observarlo en acción, al voltearse noté la ventosa que le permite fijarse a las rocas y moverse, era blando y de color crema, además posee excelente elasticidad, pues se enrolló, como los hacen los gusanos, esto ocurre cuando se sienten amenazados.
![1000110689.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23vsJHW45Cxq6ErkmaBUkjYKxDq9GyPku2rwZJKwtQByTXHqBfkpL6na2dmM9evWuD2ET.png)
![1000110691.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23xKtQnztDnEGGRv8jmpxMy8HBSbaQfq2vJ6Pz2he3wnawXjoVmBtp5NSjzTaZeqvaLbS.jpg)
Con respecto a su reproducción tienen sexos separados, por lo general un solo ovario o testículo. El mecanismo sería el siguiente, las hembras sueltan los huevos y estos son fecundados por el esperma de los machos. Otro caso que se puede dar es la fecundación interna, acá las larvas se desarrollan en los conductos ováricos. Si bien son animales fascinantes para quienes les gusta estudiar las especies más extrañas de la naturaleza, no debe ser muy agradable estar disfrutando de un día de playa y que se aparezca un quitón extraño y poco agraciado en el escenario. Aunque la belleza y la fealdad siempre dependerán del cristal con el cual se mire. *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery. ✓Translated with DeepL.

body.body: Wow! Thank you for introducing us to this Blue Lake in Mount Gambier. Its intense blue color is truly extraordinary. I love the tranquility of the place, ideal for walks and relaxing moments immersed in nature. At least from the photos and your story, this seems to be evident. From a little research I did online, the intense color of the Blue Lake is due to a combination of physical, chemical, and environmental factors. The lake water is extremely clean and free of particles. Light absorption is a physical phenomenon that plays a key role in the color of this lake. Water absorbs red and yellow wavelengths more, while reflecting blue ones. The clearer the water, the more evident this effect becomes. Great post, and thanks again for showing us this beautiful place.

body.body:

![qdIzXSCvmQMKwkfV_1776826108191.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/yueliang/images/qdIzXSCvmQMKwkfV_1776826108191/qdIzXSCvmQMKwkfV_1776826108191.webp)
![pyaulqLJT4Mmjamm_1776826117591.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/yueliang/images/pyaulqLJT4Mmjamm_1776826117591/pyaulqLJT4Mmjamm_1776826117591.webp)
![zgDecDhNKO81uwbd_1776826123774.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/yueliang/images/zgDecDhNKO81uwbd_1776826123774/zgDecDhNKO81uwbd_1776826123774.webp)
![TcfbIEMSb6acxnQn_1776826129674.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/yueliang/images/TcfbIEMSb6acxnQn_1776826129674/TcfbIEMSb6acxnQn_1776826129674.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

雨后天晴，推开门，一抬头，绿意盎然，满眼春意，再也没有了之前的荒芜和凄凉。一阵风袭来，凉凉的，裹紧外套下楼。

好久没走出门认真看这生活气息了，来来往往的人群，悠走的街贩，一切照旧。不同的是，雨后的空气格外的清新，让人振奋清醒。

转了一圈，也没有什么其他的欲望，琳琅满目的商品和花花绿绿的衣服，也勾不起心中的一点涟漪，无欲无求大概也就是如此吧。

孩子的学校有了新的着落，应该说是该停下来，但也只是稍微放松了一下，继续往前冲。学习这件事情要养成持续学习的能力，不能取得一点成绩就想放松，这种心理也不可取的。

到了省会上学，压力会更大，一切习惯了就好了，荣誉带来的力量也是大的，那是一种发自内心的喜悦冲击。

把一件事情看成自己应该做的日常，天天做，重复做，就会乐在其中。



---

body.title: Walking around the Western Medical Centre. | Paseando por el centro medico de occidente.
body.body:
> **Gratos saludos tengan todos mis queridos amigos de esta comunidad de Lifestyle en este martes.** **Warm greetings to all my dear friends in this Lifestyle community on this Tuesday.** Recientemente tuve tomando fotos por la ciudad de Maracaibo, y entre ellos, uno de los lugares ha asignado para la visita, era el centro médico de occidente, pues este tiene un arquitectura bastante colonial, así como también con orígenes de otro país, ya que este hospital está inspirado en los campos petroleros con edificacione de los Estados Unidos, puesto que era un recinto médico que permitía la atención médica a cada una de las personas que trabajaban arduamente en los campos petroleros, en los tiempos anteriores caminé por toda la avenida de 5 de Julio hasta llegar al sector santa Rita donde se encuentra. >I was recently taking photos around the city of Maracaibo, and one of the places I visited was the Centro Médico del Occidente, as it features quite colonial architecture, as well as influences from another country, since this hospital was inspired by the oil fields and buildings of the United States; it was a medical facility that provided healthcare to all those who worked hard in the oil fields. In the past, I used to walk the whole length of 5 de Julio Avenue until I reached the Santa Rita district, where it is located. ![1000489812.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noelyss/23zS5XdSVdx8U6PR8oRojAzUqSLUzrSWVkhm4xYz38D53F2eGgrRfAPw1cZxhjVmvm327.png) Bien, caminé por lo largo de toda esta avenida, hasta llegar al centro médico, comencé a tomar diversos fotos desde distintas fachadas, puesto que me parece que su arquitectura es bastante interesante y su interior es bastante sofisticado, un centro médico de alto nivel totalmente privado, a pesar que ya no se le prioriza la atención todas las personas, que tienen trabajo petroleros puesto que dentro de algún tiempo estos trabajos fueron completamente desplazados no es que se no es que no se hace sí se hace pero las personas ya tienen su seguro médico en un hospital que les brinda atención. >Well, I walked the entire length of this avenue until I reached the medical centre, and I started taking various photos of the different façades, as I find the architecture quite interesting and the interior quite sophisticated a high end, entirely private medical centre, although it no longer prioritises care for everyone; those who used to work in the oil industry, as these jobs were eventually phased out completely. It’s not that they don’t provide care they do but people now have health insurance through a hospital that provides them with care. ![20260314_083114.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noelyss/2449v1cAmoJq27MjxNiVc54uYHPsryFaXwTmqj2R55tZaXz6t5rynCNwtHinoYAUe8J4X.jpg) ![20260314_083515.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noelyss/243Lvkro7iM2kSjMGcAv78MkhGwRH8jpmGeQQiuthWWmarjv5iUDEqF3mo6k6LWqFooz2.jpg) ![20260314_083526.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noelyss/23ynNSL5dNzYEQPzYmAXc9rSzP9jDiQNYYftwy76cyR1SUfuXu5g3uHEQh7NZEc1eU7MH.jpg) ![20260314_083414.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noelyss/23uFRzKE4YeCPyosfR1dSwY8K7mAu3KkLma5EEPQU9jYi2hcALGUrFnTKYjym1hJLBSxD.jpg) -- Está publicación, me hizo recordar cuando años anteriores venía en mi primer año de la carrera de odontología a presentar exámenes de anatomía, en dicho lugar, puesto que mi doctor tenía ciertas partes de este lugar él es el dueño, entonces tenía la facilidad de prestarnos el hermoso grande auditorio que posee el centro médico era bastante, reconfortante y cómodo ver las clases de anatomía en este lugar, me recuerda todo el nerviosismo que sentía al momento de presentar mis exámenes ya que esto eran bastante extensos complejos y difíciles. >This post reminded me of when, back in my first year of dentistry, I used to come here to sit my anatomy exams. As my doctor owns part of the premises, he was able to lend us the medical centre’s beautiful, spacious auditorium. It was quite comforting and pleasant to attend anatomy classes there; It reminds me of how nervous I felt when taking my exams, as they were quite extensive, complex and difficult. ![20260314_083750.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noelyss/242hN4wjN2fJjpY2eb2BVjbGC9hTXu89qnnEi1ue4dCReHnwM1y6ekHurfcdtWuJTDGak.jpg) ![20260314_083332.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noelyss/241tSbDvZDhk61gw46mPVPPKshnHk4b69K4RTYkQej7znNA7qJtUX5ACiWeiKgeVzgCpU.jpg) ![20260314_083346.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVk2QANkCQNkVp45iu7ktwVYyDtMqvp99SDmL8zZ2uQmV/20260314_083346.jpg) ![20260314_083449.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmT4JJUcMN9D4CWdDhnb9JW6GnxkdyUM3fhmYoSqENsJSN/20260314_083449.jpg) --- Que el centro médico occidente tiene una forma de en forma de H, ya que hace referencia a la Segunda Guerra Mundial, ya que este fue construido en ese tiempo era un hospital que permitía que esta no fuera afectada por la guerra en caso de que lo llegara a afectar los arquitectos se esperaron en esta obra y fue elaborado, por uno de los mejores arquitectos de la ciudad de Maracaibo, que hizo grandes edificaciones a ver destacar que también podemos ver qué las afuera del centro médico del occidente tienen plantas qué hacen también referencia a esa onda americana que emana este lugar. >The Western Medical Centre is H-shaped, as it refers to the Second World War, as it was built during that period as a hospital designed to remain unaffected by the war should it have been affected; the architects took their time with this project, and it was designed by one of the finest architects in the city of Maracaibo, who created many notable buildings. It is also worth noting that the exterior of the Western Medical Centre features plants that also evoke the American vibe emanating from this place ![20260314_083535.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYDBRwSadQ5kvsxQRn1xiFHsKKCz4R4iWZnsDQPTsFHpq/20260314_083535.jpg) Por último fue totalmente fascinante realizar este contenido, pero cabe destacar que visitar a este lugar me tenía un poco nerviosa, ya que lo estaba haciendo yo sola, normalmente acostumbro de que mi hermano pueda acompañarme, ya que me da miedo que puedan robarme el celular, aunque ya esto no ocurre desde hace algunos años se debe tener cuidado porque se dice que han vuelto los robos poco a poco en la ciudad, entonces rápidamente tomé estas lindas fotografías que acaban de ver, gracias a ellos tengo mi teléfono totalmente intacto, me despido esta una próxima oportunidad amigos gracias por leerme hasta pronto. >Finally, creating this content was absolutely fascinating, but I must admit that visiting this place made me a bit nervous, as I was doing it on my own. I’m usually used to having my brother come with me, as I’m worried someone might steal my mobile phone; although this hasn’t happened for a few years now, you still have to be careful because they say thefts are gradually on the rise again in the city, So I quickly snapped these lovely photos you’ve just seen; thanks to them, my phone is completely intact. I’ll say goodbye for now, friends. Thanks for reading – see you soon. ![20260314_083943.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQsGSsq88qby8rBBhZqz84rpfG7fDPz1UU5vgsvqTfVRE/20260314_083943.jpg)

Hello, everyone. This is your @rufajane, back with another blog.

First, I want to thank all of you for your constant support and for staying with me until my very last day in high school. It truly feels like I grew, not just older but more mature, with you all by my side. For that, thank you… not just a thousand times, but more than words can hold.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/EpvgxypL5e7BKufc6jR6SqKcbCAuCYzoHu3t8EgwF2acswxDKQbiHQ7mGjfzAFpkaCT.png)

This blog was supposed to be posted right after graduation, but life got a little busy. I sincerely apologize for the delay. I was taking my examination for my TESOL certificate because as an ESL teacher, it’s something I need for both growth and credibility. But here I am again, ready to share a piece of my life—my graduation day on March 29, 2026. I hope you'll read till the end.

I woke up early that day to prepare everything—my toga, my hairstyle, and myself—especially since the processional would begin at 12:30 PM. Surprisingly, I finished earlier than expected. I don’t usually wear much makeup because of my allergies, so getting ready was simple, but meaningful.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/EpVBaMrjemr53tsZrNeAH6BqG18oJCqjsYyLdadfM6KCKPUhgr4vhwQQButZJGxmAP7.png)

After everything was done, I found myself staring at the ceiling, something I’ve always done when I have nothing else to do. But this time, it felt different. A mix of emotions slowly settled in. And somehow, I knew this was a feeling I would miss someday.

Before I even realized it, time had passed, and my father called me as we were about to leave for the venue.
<div class=\

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/23xyZSWdvjVXwmK3r8Zx8wmz6d4spswLhBpy6PxSjS1PJ3EuREaVAEoHJCPMczq5N8KZ5.png When we arrived, the first thing I did was look for my adviser to get my graduation sash. But I couldn’t find her anywhere. The heat was intense, and for a moment, I felt like I might collapse under the scorching sun. I had to sit down and rest. Then, out of nowhere, one of my classmates approached me and handed me my sash. It felt like such a small act but in that moment, it meant everything. My father and I quickly found my assigned line for the processional, as the heat continued to press down and sweat traced quietly along my face.

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/23wqvx9GrQXHuwhtgZES3ChrLGCRLM4JU6ADkoJ6mnyMUsioNWsp72ZEwhPU2i2JVHbpf.png As the processional began, I suddenly felt unexpected emotion. While walking, I suddenly felt a deep sadness. Because I knew deep in my heart, that this moment would never happen again. That I may never walk alongside these same people, smiling like this, in the same place, at the same time. The thought that one day, some of us might pass each other as strangers hurt more than I expected.

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/23uQzt81YgCP5H6bn84u9kbHQHBfmEJHz1YMUCYmEoHp1QspBuZrH8XqTydnhUVdwqR5A.png And without even noticing, tears began to fall. I watched my close friends walk down the aisle with proud smiles, and I couldn’t help but think about the distance that would soon grow between us as we all chase different dreams. The future we once talked about together was now pulling us in separate directions. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/EoEqWUgYxYgdyZxkpA1eivsThLbSoqatoixdPEuKbnkh2zNPqjENWawh7BDYDpKZnbj.png) Why does it hurt this much? Back then, we were so excited to finally wear our togas... to reach this moment. But now that I was living it, I found myself wishing time would just pause even for a little while. I wanted one more laugh, one more moment, one more hug with everyone in that venue. But time doesn’t wait. And maybe that’s the hardest truth we have to accept. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/EpJXAhshSUCkQ23NXZhTp4S1eQXZX4ZPWY7YS3apiGX59rSCA4495fezzQyDXEBfVTs.png) To the next generation who will walk the halls of our beloved school—San Remigio National High School—please take care of it. That school is more than just buildings and classrooms. It carries the memories, laughter, struggles, and dreams of countless students from different generations. It may be known as one of the most advanced and recognized schools in Northern Cebu, but beyond that, it is a home built by stories like ours. Thank you, SRNHS. Thank you to all our teachers. Thank you for the memories. Until we meet again. And with that, this is Ruffa Jane V. Companion—an aspiring attorney, inspired public speaker, debater, and writer—signing off. — Proud Alumni of San Remigio National High School ![Gray and White Simple Fashion Sale Facebook Fundraiser Cover Photo.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/EnYUGipUouu6yKzkTmc7tRdjcLxqjsxjsxkJXxLHFVemDL3w5NnmW83nAY3mnnAEXgm.gif)

body.title: Misty, cover by juancarlossaez
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPrcnfX4rkJkBJWRujAGbaSwZ8RSmSVpQ55EyK6qSW4Lh/1776826265614.jpg)


https://youtu.be/7DdECUAQOck?si=_w-Y5GrGxaDLp6VY

Hoy voy a tocar Misty, una pieza de Erroll Garner. Es una canción que se ha tocado muchísimo, pero aun así cada versión cambia bastante según quién la haga.

La voy a interpretar en guitarra y voz. La voz lleva la melodía y la guitarra acompaña, tratando de que todo quede bien ubicado. Es una canción donde hay que estar pendiente de las entradas y de cómo se conectan las frases, porque si no se siente cortada.

La melodía tiene bastante movimiento, no es recta, y eso hace que no puedas cantarla de cualquier forma. Hay partes donde tienes que sostener y otras donde tienes que dejar espacio, y ahí es donde realmente se define cómo suena.

La estructura también tiene varios cambios que hay que tener claros para no perderse. No es una canción larga, pero sí tiene momentos donde si no estás concentrado se nota enseguida.

En esta versión la idea es que todo se escuche claro, sin exagerar. Que la voz y la guitarra vayan juntas y que la canción se entienda de principio a fin sin complicarla.
Vamos a ver cómo sale, espero que les guste.

English 

Today I'm going to play Misty, a piece by Erroll Garner. It's a song that's been played a lot, but even so, each version changes quite a bit depending on who performs it.

I'm going to play it with just guitar and vocals. The vocals carry the melody, and the guitar accompanies, trying to keep everything well-placed. It's a song where you have to pay attention to the entrances and how the phrases connect, because otherwise it sounds disjointed.

The melody has a lot of movement; it's not linear, and that means you can't just sing it any old way. There are parts where you have to hold the notes and others where you have to leave space, and that's where the sound really comes through.

The structure also has several changes that you need to be aware of so you don't get lost. It's not a long song, but it does have moments where if you're not focused, it's immediately noticeable.

In this version, the idea is for everything to be clear, without exaggerating. The vocals and guitar should blend together, and the song should be understandable from beginning to end without being complicated. Let's see how it goes; I hope you like it.

Enlace de video original 

https://youtu.be/cjqlNpvzcKo?si=2HecKvW1mYT2mMxe

body.title: Entre Sombras y Texturas: El Proceso de mi Retrato a Lápiz/Between Shadows and Textures: The Process of My Pencil Portrait\n
body.body: /> ¡Hola a todos! Hoy quiero compartir con ustedes mi más reciente dibujo, un trabajo que disfruté muchísimo realizar. Para crear esta pieza, me enfoqué en la técnica del claroscuro utilizando diferentes graduaciones de lápices de grafito. ​El proceso comenzó con un boceto suave para establecer las proporciones del rostro. Lo más desafiante —y a la vez lo más gratificante— fue trabajar el cabello afro; lo logré mediante capas de trazos circulares y pequeños garabatos para dar esa sensación de volumen y densidad. En la piel, utilicé un difuminado suave en las zonas de luz y busqué contrastes fuertes en las sombras para darle tridimensionalidad a las facciones. ¡Espero que disfruten este resultado tanto como yo disfruté el proceso! Hi everyone! Today I want to share with you my most recent drawing, a piece that I truly enjoyed creating. To bring this portrait to life, I focused on the chiaroscuro technique using various grades of graphite pencils. ​The process started with a light sketch to establish the facial proportions. The most challenging—yet rewarding—part was rendering the afro hair; I achieved this by layering circular strokes and small scribbles to create a sense of volume and density. For the skin, I used smooth blending in the highlighted areas and pushed for strong contrasts in the shadows to give the features a three-dimensional feel. I hope you enjoy the result as much as I enjoyed the process!

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPoxi68fbajpE9c525ZvH2E1aiWcc8NwMh2aDKsy126EL/PSL.PNG)

# <center>**<u>Peace be upon you all</u> ✨🌟**</center>

**Warm greetings to everyone.🤍🌸**

I hope you are all doing well, staying healthy, motivated, and full of positive energy, and your days are full of joy, peace, and little moments that make you smile. 🌟✨🌟

**PSL 2026: Current Standings and Stats Update**

I've been following PSL 2026, and honestly, the stats are getting really interesting. And once again, I'm sharing the most recent PSL stats with you guys. Let me break them down in a simple way.

If you've been following along, thank you. If you're new, welcome. Let's go.

**Points Table**

Let's start with current standings. 

Right now, Peshawar Zalmi are just running away with this tournament. Seven wins from eight games, 15 points, and an NRR of +2.911. Nobody is close to them. Multan Sultans are second with 12 points, and Islamabad United are third with 9. At the bottom, Rawalpindiz have played eight games and lost all eight. Zero points. That is rough.

There’s still a tight race between Lahore Qalandars, Hyderabad Kingsmen, and Karachi Kings for a playoff spot. Even though Lahore Qalandars have 8 points, a couple of poor performances could put them in a difficult position. Still, I’m backing Lahore Qalandars. After all, it’s my home team.
![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbEXmnWXfH2Q9F4bUM2qD2Pb8X5Cp8zV9rrzR9TzdXSJi/STANDING.PNG)
<center><sub>POINTS TABLE</sub></center>

**Top Run Scorers**

This is basically a two-man race, and both of them play for Peshawar Zalmi.
Kusal Mendis is leading the runs chart with 413 runs and has been the MVP of the season so far. He is just destroying bowlers every time he walks out. His best knock was a stunning 109 off just 52 balls against Karachi Kings, where he and Babar Azam put on a massive 161-run partnership as Peshawar Zalmi managed to post 246/3. Karachi were bowled out for 87 in reply. That was a 159-run win. Unbelievable.

Babar Azam is right behind with 401 runs at an average of 100.25. He smashed a century off just 52 balls against Quetta Gladiators; one of the fastest hundreds of his career. Babar has been on a completely different level this season.

Hasan Nawaz of Quetta is third with 288 runs, then Fakhar Zaman with 282, and Sahibzada Farhan with 269.

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmai13bFLXpsgDLBBTL472Dba6dZGLdCt3KHN39JMVCsP5/RUNS.PNG)
<center><sub>MOST RUNS</sub></center>

**Hundreds and Top Scores**

Three centuries in the tournament so far, and all three are special.
Kusal Mendis-109 vs Karachi Kings
He became the first Sri Lankan to score a century in PSL history. 

Sahibzada Farhan-106 (Not Out) vs Hyderabad Kingsmen
Scored an unbeaten 106 off 57 balls for Multan Sultans chasing down a huge target of 226. He just outclassed Hyderabad's bowlers, smashing eight sixes in that innings. 

Babar Azam-100 (Not Out) vs Quetta Gladiators
His century against Quetta comes third, followed by his 87 (Not Out) also against Karachi Kings.

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbUpt1m63Xvh5LfrU6bZ9prVSSRZDcempkRGtCW5Jt9W4/HIGHEST%20SCORERS.PNG)
<center><sub>HUNDREDS and TOP SCORES</sub></center>

**Most Boundaries**

Mendis leads with 57 boundaries, which makes total sense when you watch how he bats. Babar Azam is second with 48, Fakhar Zaman third with 46. Sahibzada Farhan and Sameer Minhas are tied on 40 each.
![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXPYcrMm9e7n1RmQTUTMa9stkyPRHcvXRTRrWxoCv74Uj/BOUNDRIES.PNG)
<center><sub>MOST BOUNDRIES</sub></center>

**Most Wickets**

Sufiyan Muqeem of Peshawar Zalmi is running away with the bowling charts too; 17 wickets already, four more than Shaheen Afridi, who is second with 14. A left-arm wrist spinner taking wickets at under 10 average in T20 cricket is just special. Hasan Ali has 11, then Iftikhar Ahmed and Mohammad Amir both have 10.

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZVuq2eqLknwUC6YhjB3iM9JiUsXbEQEB3uufvoBMQHqD/WICKETS.PNG)
<center><sub>MOST WICKETS</sub></center>

**Best Bowling Figures**

Two bowlers share the top spot with 4/18 each.
Shaheen Afridi- 4/18 vs Peshawar Zalmi
Even in a losing game, Shaheen showed his class.
Asif Mehmood- 4/18 vs Islamabad United
Bowling for Hyderabad Kingsmen, he took four wickets in the final over on his PSL debut. That is some way to announce yourself. Hyderabad won the match by 6 wickets.
Iftikhar Ahmed- 4/21 vs Hyderabad Kingsmen
Third on the list, followed by Hasan Ali with 4/27 and Faisal Akram with 4/31 for Quetta Gladiators.

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVr6sgJGXUNd24LSJoMThRe79P8wxzjtZNdk2Hz8SAAtr/BEST%20BOWLING%20FIGURES.PNG)
<center><sub>BEST BOWLING FIGURES</sub></center>

So far, Peshawar Zalmi are the team of the League with both bat and ball. If they keep this up, the playoff teams are going to have a really hard time stopping them. 🔥

body.body:
<center>
![ap9tej.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRYYWoMVYAacQj1RmQoWe3gMGomdWoTCym7PC5vn4ahuG/ap9tej.jpg)</center>



I guess it's all good for the MSM to be all kinds of deceptive to get clicks by posting up a headline that makes it sound as though eating fruits and vegetables may cause cancer.  Once you read the article though it's the pesticides as the \

culprit, among other environmental concerns, as if that wasn't your go to thought in the first place, but hey, it worked to get more clicks.  They recommended people wash, scrub and rinse their produce before consuming, but you make note that rinsing the chemical down the drain could come back potentially three fold to bite you, and you get met with the usual that your comment goes against their community standards.  My comment was within range of how the FDA and EPA cites as examples of how 1,4 dioxane gets into the water supply.   I guess you can only strike fear in people's hearts when the story has a good ending.


>Fruits and vegetables may increase your cancer risk, new research shows


>A new study from researchers at the University of Southern California (USC) has suggested that diets rich in fruits, vegetables and whole grains may possibly be linked to a higher risk of early‑onset lung cancer.

>The study found this correlation specifically in younger people who have never smoked. 

>Health experts stress, however, the findings do not mean fruits and vegetables cause cancer and the overall benefits of eating produce still overwhelmingly outweigh any potential risks.

>Why It Matters
>Fruits and vegetables are widely seen as essential to a healthy diet and key tools for cancer prevention, making this study’s findings especially striking.

>At the same time, the research taps into a real and growing concern among scientists as to why lung cancer rates are rising in younger people who have never smoked, particularly women. If environmental exposures such as pesticides are contributing even indirectly, it could point to broader issues with agricultural practices, regulation and long‑term chemical exposure.

>What To Know
>The research, conducted by scientists at USC Norris Comprehensive Cancer Center, focused on an unusual and growing trend: rising lung cancer diagnoses among non‑smokers under age 50, particularly women.

>Researchers analyzed data from the Epidemiology of Young Lung Cancer Project, which included 187 patients diagnosed with lung cancer before age 50, with women accounting for 78 percent of the cohort. Most participants had never smoked, and many had tumor types that differ biologically from lung cancers typically associated with smoking. 

>When researchers examined lifestyle factors, one result stood out: patients with early‑onset lung cancer reported eating significantly more fruits, vegetables and whole grains than the general population. Their diets scored higher on the Healthy Eating Index, a measure of overall diet quality. 

>“Our research shows that younger non-smokers who eat a higher quantity of healthy foods than the general population are more likely to develop lung cancer,” Jorge Nieva, MD, a medical oncologist and lung cancer specialist with USC Norris and lead investigator of the study, said in a statement. “These counter-intuitive findings raise important questions about an unknown environmental risk factor for lung cancer related to otherwise beneficial food that needs to be addressed.”  

>Nieva and other researchers speculated pesticides could be the risk factor in question.
However, experts do not believe that fruits and vegetables themselves are harmful. 

>According to Nieva, commercially grown (non‑organic) produce tends to carry higher pesticide residues than many processed foods, dairy products or meats. Previous research has shown that agricultural workers exposed to pesticides have higher lung cancer rates, lending some support to the hypothesis. 

>Outside experts have urged the public not to interpret the findings as a reason to cut back on fruits and vegetables, and decades of large‑scale studies show diets rich in produce are linked to lower risks of heart disease, stroke, obesity and many types of cancer. 

>“In our study and for the U.S. on average, women seem to have much healthier diets than men, and this might mean greater relative exposure to any contaminants that may be in whole grains, fruits and vegetables,” Nieva said, per Medical News Today.

>The Dirty Dozen
>According to a report released earlier this year by the Environmental Working Group (EWG), a health advocacy organization, the following produce held the highest levels of potentially harmful pesticide residues based on tests conducted by the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) on 54,344 samples of 47 fruits and vegetables.

Spinach
Kale, Collard and Mustard Greens
Strawberries
Grapes
Nectraines
Peaches
Cherries
Apples
Blackberries
Pears
Potatoes
Blueberries
What Happens Next
>The USC team said further research is needed to directly measure pesticide exposure and confirm whether it plays a role in early‑onset lung cancer. 

>For people concerned about pesticide exposure, washing produce thoroughly, peeling when appropriate, and choosing organic options when feasible could help, especially for fruits and vegetables known to carry higher residue levels.

body.title: Mi lectura actual: Una inmersión en el suspenso | My Current Read: A Dive into Suspense 📙🔎 [ESP/ENG]
body.body:
## Mi lectura actual: Una inmersión en el suspenso 


![1000175261.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23tveT1zyMYSqVZ7iky8hSQpcSywHzEeSrHiXn1t87ppi1oAeYJCyMcrVRSuFEPsw2HKV.jpg)

<center><sub>Imagen creada con Gemini.</sub></center> 

Hola amigos de la comunidad de Holos & Lotus, deseo que estén teniendo un buen día. Leí [la iniciativa](https://peakd.com/hive-131951/@damarysvibra/que-estoy-leyendoororwhat-am-i-reading) de nuestra amiga @damarysvibra donde nos invita a hablar sobre el libro que estamos leyendo en este momento. A mi me gusta mucho poder leer, antes me gustaba leer más novelas juveniles o incluso libros de crecimiento personal, ambos eran de mis géneros literarios favoritos. Pero ahora me está gustando más el género del suspenso y el thriller psicológico. En este momento estoy leyendo **A fuego lento** de la escritora **Paula Hawkins**. 
 
![1000175263.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23tvaT5v1FeX859fRjxTpqDtiG4rzy6JZQYiYXXPxUDfDuJj7nczGkLbQwWft7Utjw8Gg.jpg)

<center><sub>[fuente](https://share.google/GcWDg4CRsqTiTBVgr)</sub></center>

Ya he leído dos libros de ella: La chica del tren y escrito en el agua. Ambos libros tienen ideas interesantes y una historia que atrapa hasta finalizarlos. No conocía a la escritora más que por la adaptación a película de La chica del tren, pero estuve después buscando más información y me encontré con la idea de que debía leerme el libro aunque ya me había visto la película y me había gustado bastante. Siento que leer el libro primero te da una sensación aún más íntima con la historia y el escritor, me gusta poder finalizar los libros si tengo la oportunidad antes de poder ver las adaptaciones a película, que en ocasiones no le suelen hacer mucha justicia a la historia contada en el libro. 


No solo me gusta porque siento que sus historias son bastante originales, sino porque tiene una forma de contarlas que si o si tienes que terminar el libro. Esto hace que sea una gran escritora, porque ya que el libro te atrape de una manera que quieras terminarlo en días, quiere decir que la historia realmente vale la pena. Hay otras escritoras que tienen historias más rosas como los libros de Colleen Hoover, de ella me gustó leer Romper el círculo aunque la película no me gustó para nada. Son géneros literarios distintos, pero siento que siempre es genial poder ir variando lo que vamos leyendo, no solo para culturizarnos sino también para disfrutar de un tiempo libre mientras estamos dentro de otro mundo que no es el nuestro. 

![1000175262.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23wgKcmSYuVQX1fSZcDwxTAxKNGHoBr3QTBZXRdJRLaopfATZTk8KNjZm367ngVLpvhXm.jpg)

<center><sub>[fuente](https://share.google/L80wfb2J2kbeoucr2)</sub></center>

La historia que estoy leyendo tiene misterio, asesinato y tres mujeres que pueden ser las principales sospechosas de la muerte de un hombre. Apenas voy como por la primera parte del libro, por lo que aún estoy conociendo a la primera sospechosa y las cosas que podrían decir que la hacen ser la sospechosa. De los libros anteriores me quedo una sensación de que nunca sabes que va a suceder realmente y como podrá terminar las historias Paula Hawkins, y amo que pude encontrarla y darme esa oportunidad de leer sus libros y no quedarme solo con una lectura sino buscar más de sus obras literarias. 

Leer para mí significa que puedo darme un espacio donde la creatividad y el enfoque lo coloco solo en la lectura que este leyendo, cuando era más joven leí muchos libros juveniles y aún me impresiona que habían libros de más de 500 páginas que me leí en tan solo tres días o más. Creo que la juventud te permite hacer este tipo de cosas jaja, pero ahora tardo más en leer un libro, porque voy despacio y entendiendo de que va la historia que este leyendo. Entre un libro digital y uno físico siento que me he acostumbrado a los libros en digital, pero tener tu libro favorito en físico es una sensación indescriptible, porque puedes volver a leerlo en papel y es una experiencia totalmente diferente. 

![1000175264.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23wMRdRgNoVztADDgFuWxQ6XHUBR8g63eT8jfcYueu5CvB8axPNWZhCJaU9beYwZyDKQU.gif)

<center><sub>[fuente](https://share.google/RcVAVZkGV2dxirrL7)</sub></center>

Es agradable poder compartir también con otros la pasión por la lectura y poder inculcarlo en los más jóvenes. Leer permite que nuestro cerebro esté activo de manera que podamos siempre analizar y aprender cosas nuevas, incluso nos puede ayudar con nuestro dialecto y la forma en la que puede cambiar nuestra perspectiva de la vida. Cualquier instante donde se tenga el espacio, una taza de café y un ambiente agradable es bueno para tomar un libro y aventurarnos entre tantas historias increíbles que existen y que esperan por nosotros. Sin importar el género, cada lectura nos deja algo importante y renueva nuestras ideas. 


![1000175265.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/EqUhKW7MhyraywZBo7VzwihS135e5MRvuWhEUPVoc1Pi4tHLNF7BkKqBmawgCTR8Z3g.png)


## My Current Read: A Dive into Suspense

![1000175261.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23tveT1zyMYSqVZ7iky8hSQpcSywHzEeSrHiXn1t87ppi1oAeYJCyMcrVRSuFEPsw2HKV.jpg)

<center><sub>Image created using Gemini.</sub></center> 


Hello, friends of the **Holos & Lotus** community! I hope you are all having a wonderful day. I recently came across [the initiative](https://peakd.com/hive-131951/@damarysvibra/que-estoy-leyendoororwhat-am-i-reading) by our friend **@damarysvibra**, where she invites us to talk about the book we are currently reading.
I truly love being able to read. In the past, I leaned more toward Young Adult (YA) novels or even personal growth books—those were my two favorite genres. However, lately, I’ve been finding myself drawn more to **suspense and psychological thrillers**. Right now, I am reading **\

** by the author **Paula Hawkins**.

![1000175263.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23tvaT5v1FeX859fRjxTpqDtiG4rzy6JZQYiYXXPxUDfDuJj7nczGkLbQwWft7Utjw8Gg.jpg)

<center><sub>[source](https://share.google/GcWDg4CRsqTiTBVgr)</sub></center>

I have already read two of her previous books: *The Girl on the Train* and *Into the Water*. Both stories have intriguing premises and plots that keep you hooked until the very last page. I initially only knew the author because of the movie adaptation of *The Girl on the Train*, but after looking for more information, I realized I had to read the book—even though I had already seen the film and enjoyed it quite a bit.
I feel that reading the book first provides a much more intimate connection with the story and the author. Whenever I have the chance, I prefer to finish the book before watching the movie adaptation, as films often don’t do the original story much justice.


It’s not just that her stories feel original; it’s her storytelling style—it practically forces you to finish the book. To me, that’s the mark of a great writer. If a story grips you so tightly that you want to finish it in just a few days, it means it’s truly worth it. I also enjoy variety. There are other authors with \

stories, like **Colleen Hoover**. I liked reading *It Ends with Us*, though I have to say, I didn't like the movie version at all! Even though the genres are completely different, I think it’s great to vary our reading material. It’s not just about culture; it’s about enjoying our free time by stepping into a world that isn't our own.

![1000175262.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23wgKcmSYuVQX1fSZcDwxTAxKNGHoBr3QTBZXRdJRLaopfATZTk8KNjZm367ngVLpvhXm.jpg)

<center><sub>[source](https://share.google/L80wfb2J2kbeoucr2)</sub></center>

The story I’m reading right now involves mystery, a murder, and three women who are the primary suspects in a man’s death. I’m only in the first part of the book, so I’m still getting to know the first suspect and the circumstances that make her look guilty. Based on Hawkins' previous work, I’m left with that feeling that you never truly know what’s going to happen or how the story will end. I love that I discovered her and gave myself the opportunity to explore her literary works rather than just sticking to one book.

For me, reading is a space for creativity and focus. When I was younger, I read so many YA novels; it still impresses me that I could fly through a 500-page book in just three days. I think youth gives you that kind of energy, haha! Nowadays, I take longer to finish a book because I move more slowly, making sure I really understand the depth of the story. Regarding the **digital vs. physical** debate: I’ve grown accustomed to digital books, but holding your favorite book in your hands is an indescribable feeling. Reading on paper is a completely different experience.

![1000175264.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23wMRdRgNoVztADDgFuWxQ6XHUBR8g63eT8jfcYueu5CvB8axPNWZhCJaU9beYwZyDKQU.gif)

<center><sub>[source](https://share.google/RcVAVZkGV2dxirrL7)</sub></center>

It is so rewarding to share the passion for reading with others and to encourage it in younger generations. Reading keeps our brains active, allowing us to analyze and learn new things constantly. it even improves our vocabulary and can shift our entire perspective on life. Any moment with a little bit of space, a cup of coffee, and a pleasant environment is the perfect time to pick up a book and venture into the incredible stories waiting for us. Regardless of the genre, every book leaves us with something important and refreshes our ideas.

One sunny day my mother inlaw and i decided to go to salon together. She told me she wanted to have her hair cut saying it was time for a change and to feel lighter and fresher. When we arrived the place was nice and cozy. She sat comfortably with chairs looking excited but also a little bit shy. The hairdresser gently combed her hair and started cutting and we chatted happily while waiting. Watching her i could see how happily she was. She trusted the stylist and let them work their magic. After a while when the cutting and styling were done she look in the mirror and smiled widely
  Her new hairstyle looked so good on her. It made her look younger more elegant and very fresh. She was so pleased with the  result and seeing her happy made me happy too. We left the salon feeling great not just because of the new look but because of the nice time we spend together. It was a simple day but it was full of joy and good memories.

body.title: I Don't Build Bridges, I Build the People Who Build Them 🌻My Fruit Wears a Cap
body.body:
>

A person's life is changed by his profession. Whatever field of life you belong to, whatever profession you have will definitely change your life. If you are an engineer, a doctor, a teacher, then your field will have a far-reaching impact on your life. I am a teacher. The life of a teacher is much different from that of people associated with other fields. A teacher is a role model for his students. Students follow the actions of their teacher. And if a teacher is living an organized life, there is discipline, punctuality, honesty, and justice in his life. Then he transfers all these things to his students. If a teacher is a leader, then he is a leader who is followed by thousands of students of the new generation. So I am very proud of my field of life and I am very satisfied with my profession because I believe that teaching is the only field from which a person takes people to heights and spends his life to make them a better and better person.

Not only is the teaching sector the most important and delicate sector, but every sector of life in which a person works is a prominent aspect of his life. If you work in a factory and you work hard and you fulfill the duties assigned to you honestly and you protect everything in the factory in which you are working with discipline, then you are an excellent engineer. Similarly, if you are a judge, now you are associated with any sector and you establish justice in this sector. You live your life by considering every single thing related to this sector and respecting each and every person. You work with love and respect for all the people in this community. So you are doing justice to your sector. A teacher has a lot of responsibilities, a lot of responsibilities, such responsibilities that he is preparing the new generation, guiding them to make them the best people in the society.  He is busy guiding them to give good health to their minds and souls, so that when these people, these children, these young people grow up, when they step into society, their steps in society will be good, for the betterment of society.

But I would like to write here that the teaching profession and the people associated with this profession are among the best people in society because their responsibilities and duties are very different from those of people working in other professions. A doctor looks after his own medical profession, an engineer looks after his own profession, other businessmen look after the business profession, look after the financial problems, but a teacher looks after all these professions and prepares the best people for all these professions. If a person is a doctor, he becomes a doctor when he takes guidelines from his teacher at different stages. The teacher teaches him and then he passes the exams and then he goes and becomes a doctor and serves humanity. So a teacher also makes doctors, lawyers, judges, businessmen, engineers and politicians who run the country. So a teacher is such an individual, such a valuable person.  It is what prepares you for a generation that serves humanity in every walk of life, that sacrifices its life for its country, that prepares its people for the nation, that prepares its youth for the army, that prepares its youth for the police, that prepares its doctors, businessmen, engineers.


![IMG_20260421_081942.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWmhMjs4N1a3jUeAkFYxpakq6aEQKbq5bdujPQ3uZRp27/IMG_20260421_081942.jpg)

So I am proud to be associated with this field. I have been working as a teacher for almost 18 years. Thousands of my students are working in different fields of life. There is a long list of my students who have been successful. Today, when I was giving a lecture in the class, some students said that sir, we want to take pictures of you. So I gave my mobile phone to the children. They made different pictures of me in the class. Then I shared those pictures with my students on WhatsApp. The students said that sir, we want to make pictures of you. Then we will put these pictures on our social media. So I also thanked them because children are not allowed to bring mobile phones inside the school. So on their request, I gave them my own mobile phone so that they could make these pictures. If we do not respect the wishes of our students, they will get a little bored. So it is my habit that I always mix with the children during and outside of education because I give the children a free environment to learn. I try to  I explain each point to them in a very simple way, but before teaching any lesson, I try to prepare one thing at home and then explain it to the children. I am happy that my students are satisfied with me and happy with me. And Allah will definitely reward me for it because if I remain honest in my field, I will definitely get the fruits of honesty.

![IMG_20260421_081937.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZfZSZVefnp8DsbpZBFomJtngWFQCTqh1UsukEhKzVU5G/IMG_20260421_081937.jpg)

Here, one thing will definitely come to the mind of some people reading this article of mine. They will say what is the fruit of honesty? What is the fruit of honesty for a teacher? So, I will say this about the fruit of honesty: The fruit of honesty for a teacher is that his students succeed and they get happiness. If the student succeeds, then this is the fruit of the teacher. This is the fruit. This is the reward that every teacher wants. Whenever a teacher stands in the class and teaches the students, the only purpose of his teaching is that the children understand the subject he is trying to explain to the children well and after understanding it, apply it honestly in their practical life. So, the fruit of the teachers' hard work, honesty, justice is that his children succeed and become excellent members of the society. When a student succeeds, the teacher's chest expands. The teacher proudly says that this is my student. If a student fails,  If a student goes home with some problems, the teacher tries in every way to get him out of his problems and lead him towards success. This is the mission of a teacher and this is my mission and I am proud of it.

![IMG_20260421_082039.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWMUZPYXqm9T6vud445JNL3j4rYnQKeuTJKDLMJYeu2Je/IMG_20260421_082039.jpg)

These pictures that you are seeing in this article are a gift from my student to me because when a person is living, he moves from youth to old age and when I become old, I will be proud to see these pictures of my youth because one day a person has to retire from his field. When a person retires, he misses the days he has passed in his field and in his profession very much because in this teaching journey there are many such incidents that are not going to be forgotten. There are many students who will never forget. And a matter of pride for me is that when a student comes to us and when he completes the Great 10 education, he is between 14 and 16 years old and at that age when he completes Grade 10, he takes admission to pursue higher education at the university level. Then there are some students who after three years, after five years, after 10 years  We meet because students are busy with their higher education. Teachers are busy with their daily routine in their field of study. When students meet, a teacher cannot recognize them. Because at the age of 14 to 16, when a child passes the Great 10 from school, after that, many effects of his face become different. There are changes in his face, there are changes in his speech, so many changes occur in children. Teachers cannot recognize them, but students recognize their teachers even from a distance. Even if they meet their teachers after 50 years, sometimes teachers cannot recognize their students by their faces. Whenever I am going somewhere, my old students meet me, introduce me, respect me. That day and time is a very proud moment for me and I pray that my students succeed in every field of life.

![IMG_20260421_082018.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdVJtb7cFJkjq1vhvDLckjy3CUmK4BQ7cm2JsZ3mpi84g/IMG_20260421_082018.jpg)

![IMG_20260421_082014.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSpdeX8w2A6zdjNDRQWLBTZmv3vjT8Bw9mRkco8gsXd66/IMG_20260421_082014.jpg)

![IMG_20260421_081753.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSVcREcP4v9HgFLxNZCdKdMm71FUK3118Vufofabcybt6/IMG_20260421_081753.jpg)

Let me tell you a beautiful incident from my life or a sad incident, which I am going to tell you now as a teacher. The fact is that one day I was in school teaching the children. I was very tired. I had completed my sessions and when it was break time, I was sitting on the lawn. A man came. His beard had grown and he looked very weak and frail. He looked like he was 70 years old. I asked him what his business was. He said that I have to get the documents signed and the documents attested. I asked him to sit on the chair. He replied that I am not your uncle. I am your student. You are my teacher. How can I sit on the chair next to you? I looked at him carefully. I said, \

When he gave me the gloves, I told him that I was worried about my own problems. I felt very sad about my illness and my family situation and I told him that you are my student, you are my son, you sit down, sit down with me. He was sitting with me because of the purpose of sitting or when he was not sitting, he was not sitting out of respect for me. How could I sit on the chair with my teacher? I remember that day. You felt very sad. How much sorrow, worries and illnesses weaken a person. I pray that every student of mine remains healthy, has a long life, is successful and keeps smiling and never has to face any problems.\n\n

body.body:
> Hello everyone, how are you doing today? Hope you are having a great time. This will be *Week 214 Edition 01* of our Weekly Featured Content. ![1000023744.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kronias/23zH3ihhxgjN5Ydxs9LGWWgZQUHDtgcBQh3F5t5GocCquu6RBk2TZs4o6AVkcZjCz1P6z.png)
Made With Canva
So, last Saturday we had our hangout as usual, and it was just so much fun that we did not want it to end. We are currently on the first topic for this week, which is “ONLINE VS PHYSICAL”. But before we proceed with the details of the topic, let us take a look at the winners of the last topic, which was “COUNT YOUR BLESSINGS”. This topic was geared toward each member of the community, asking them about what they were happy with in their lives. Even if it’s just one thing, it has to be something that we’re genuinely happy about. We got to see that many of us have things about our lives that we are happy with. From families, to achievements, to just life in general. All that is required for happiness is a grateful heart, and when one chooses to be positive, it becomes easier to see the good happening around us and be happy with it. It was an enlightening topic, indeed. ***
> For this topic, we went through every entry post, and that is every post with the #hl-exclusive & #hl-w213e2 tag. And with the number of wonderful posts out there, it was quite difficult to make a selection. But eventually, we did just that. And so, the posts that will be featured not just for their exceptional content, but also for their level of engagement with other authors, will be listed below. ![hl_footer.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcnAnsqHA4KMYRqnS9QzWMpQUxM71wRhKabXz7paozHKJ/hl_footer.png)

Featured Contents


[A VALUABLE GIFT](https://peakd.com/hive-153850/@kilvnrex/a-valuable-gift-ml) by @kilvnrex
*For this author, he told us that many times, we forget what we have when we try so hard to get what we want. He told us about how fuckle life is, and how it can all change within seconds. Having to watch someone lose his life reminded him just how valuable life is, for which he was grateful.*
[GREATUL FOR THE LIFE I ORTGEN OVERLOOKED](https://peakd.com/hive-153850/@nkemakonam89/grateful-for-the-life-i) by @nkemakonam8
*For this author, she told us that one of the things she would be most grateful for is being a complete human with no developmental defects. A single trip showed her that indeed, she had a lot to be grateful for, including the ability to provide for her family as well. Which, with the current state of the economy, was no easy feat.”
[BETWEEN HEAVEN AND HELL, I AM GREATFUL FOR MY LIMBO](https://peakd.com/hive-153850/@ladyaryastark/between-heaven-and-hell-i) by @ladyaryastark
*This author told us that having a normal life is a blessing. She is also grateful for the blessings of her parents, her culture, and her society. Because while her life might not be perfect, there are so many things that are actually going right. And for that alone, she was happy.*
*** > All of the above contents were supported by our official curation account [lazy-panda](https://peakd.com/@lazy-panda) with an extra amount. The first 3 authors will receive 100 ECENCY Points [ Sponsored By Ecency Team (@melinda010100) ] and 1 $PANDAMINER each as a reward next Monday. These posts were selected because of their special attention to detail and how they followed the topic. There were a lot of good ones out there, but we just could not pick them all. But then, we have some honorable mentions listed below:

Honorable Mention

[GRAITUDE: THE THINGS WE FORGET TO APPRECIATE](https://peakd.com/hive-153850/@burlarj/gratitude-the-things-we-forget) by @burlarj [HAVING LIVED A LIFE OF CHOICE](https://peakd.com/hive-153850/@emrysjobber/f7c21911bb2d8) by @emrysjobber [REASON TO BE GREATFUL](https://peakd.com/hive-153850/@intishar/reason-to-be-grateful-9zw) by @intishar These are posts that were also found to be quite exceptional. ---- ---- ![hl_footer.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcnAnsqHA4KMYRqnS9QzWMpQUxM71wRhKabXz7paozHKJ/hl_footer.png)
AND NOW, WE MOVE ON TO THE NEW TOPIC!
***

Week 214 - Edition 01 Topic
