body.title: Hivechess Lecture - A Slight Edge is all that is needed in positional chess
body.body:
![17767772903775570501513146124659.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/23wMgtohPGCEysVGsCCoTGXMSKUoJALuYTxAFxHDZTmkojhDsEcs4CjRCts4JP1uBwAjE.png)


Hi everyone,

Welcome to a new Hivechess lecture where we will be talking about something new we all could learn from to improve our chess. In today lecture is a game from the German Bundesliga between Grandmaster Duda against Grandmaster Aleksandar. It is a game that required positional play from both players because of the type of opening played. Positional chess is one of the hardest to play in my opinion because it requires a level of understanding of what is going on in the given position. If you miss a critical move, it becomes bad for you and if you play a simple move that looks like you are placing your piece on a better square, it can be a bad move in disguise. 

**1. Nf3 Nf6 2. g3 d5 3. Bg2 e6 4. c4 dxc4 5. Qa4+ Bd7 6. Qxc4 c5 7. Ne5 Qc8**


![Screenshot_20260421-133650.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/23u6LPcHAAgcJt6Y4WxuXwCUf4PhoME3wiWFgSruTUmAehuGzpeskaemRQiQsefDy7tPV.jpg)

The game's opening is English Opening: Agincourt Defense, Catalan Defense Accepted, where play was on the queenside flank of the board. In the opening, you will notice that white brought his queen out early inorder to get his pawn back and that worked because of how he played his next set of moves. I was surprised by the next move Qd3 because I did not understand why he would move his queen multiple times, from a4 to c4 and now to d3. What is more shocking is that is the engine recommended move. When I checked it out on the computer, that is what was the best continuation. This is simple, because after the exchange of black's light-squared bishop, the queen will be left to hold on to the semi open file while development of the remaining pieces continue. 


![Screenshot_20260421-134826.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/23uR7iM6yy2R35w9EHgiBJMS5Aq6ZpmCfK4txNGJVuj8zeb9JcxrK1yFA6fwGCDchHARW.jpg)

As explained, the queen is doing just that. Positions like this are considered positional because of how most moves are centered on control of squares. 

**8 Qd3 Nc6 9 Nxd7 Nxd7 10 Nc3 Be7 11 b3 O-O 12 Bb2 Rd8 13 Rd1 Nf6 14 Qb1 Qd7 15 O-O Rac8 16 d3 b6 17 Rd2 h5 18 e3 h4 19 Qd1 hxg3 20 hxg3 Nb4 21 Qe2 b5 22 Rfd1 a6 23 g4 Nfd5**


![Screenshot_20260421-135612.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/23u6NAD8sJeJYoyY5ATfoJyZwLAyxrobfcBQjCz1aD8YrpFp35hVrEPGEoBhmMX7aDbZk.jpg)

The game was going on fine until Nfd5 on move 23. This move was considered to give advantage to white and it just because of one thing, it allows white's knight to move to the center square e4. Then white will go ahead with the counterattack on the black king. Honestly I did not see anything work with that move because it seems like a simple developing move that centralizes the knight so how can it that be bad? Not until I saw the threat white carried out with this simple oversight of placing the knight on d5. What was better was bringing the other knight to d5 instead, that is the knight on b4.

This simple inaccuracy cost black the game. All it takes is just a minor edge. 

Here is the link to the game

https://lichess.org/broadcast/german-bundesliga-202526/round-10/rbWGGERo/mCljeNXt

And here is the PGN game:

```
[Event \

] 1. Nf3 Nf6 2. g3 d5 3. Bg2 e6 4. c4 dxc4 5. Qa4+ Bd7 6. Qxc4 c5 7. Ne5 Qc8 8. Qd3 Nc6 9. Nxd7 Nxd7 10. Nc3 Be7 11. b3 O-O 12. Bb2 Rd8 13. Rd1 Nf6 14. Qb1 Qd7 15. O-O Rac8 16. d3 b6 17. Rd2 h5 18. e3 h4 19. Qd1 hxg3 20. hxg3 Nb4 21. Qe2 b5 22. Rfd1 a6 23. g4 Nfd5 24. Ne4 Nxa2 25. g5 Nab4 26. Qg4 Qc7 27. Bf3 Bd6 28. g6 Bh2+ 29. Kg2 f5 30. Qh3 fxe4 31. dxe4 c4 32. bxc4 bxc4 33. exd5 1-0 ```
___ ![samosti 2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/23t7DhyLBcxoXuUmgwLnZvioQ3v5QnMB9qFkMvfhpceXCucVBy9yV435N3hgNLQdeLYpm.png)
![Samostically Banner.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/Eo6Cie7XPvRCoFSbPcHCY2WLfe8w5upAP4o2FvnNPV8d52md62bx9Gg7vhkcHNi1hnr.png)
I am @samostically, a chess player and writer. I love to share the experience I have gained from different battles over the 64 squares and the knowledgeable insights from books I have read. But most importantly, [I am a Midnight Owl and I founded the community Midnight Letters.](https://peakd.com/c/hive-186424/about) ♟♟♟♟♟♟♟♟♟ ![samosti 2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/23t7DhyLBcxoXuUmgwLnZvioQ3v5QnMB9qFkMvfhpceXCucVBy9yV435N3hgNLQdeLYpm.png)

body.title: ¡Salven a los Hipopotamos¡..... Esp-Eng
body.body:
> Hay una esperanza…...ojala que asi sea. Saludos a todos los que bien compartimos en esta comunidad muchas cosas de nuestras vidas, de nuestro entorno, como de otras cosas que estan como decimos en auge como noticias. Para este mes de abril creo o cuando mucho en marzo, una noticia que para mi me impacto mucho sobra la aplicación de la Eutanasia a unos seres vivos, ellos unos animales, que no tienen culpa, no tienen voz, y sus voces seriamos nosotros. Todo esta sucediendo en Colombia, sobre unos HIPOPOTAMOS, que desde un principio fue mal hecho, que fueran traido desde su habitat, lugar de origen, solo por satisfaccion o un antojo de alguien, que por su poder que tenia, no hubo quien pusiera un alto y prohibiera tal cosa.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23vi3x8rw4YU8No9Qy7Sxp3vLXyfg5JenRKgqVwdaadWjAvZgDrUAsbuuwhy6pVyTg7ct.png) [](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/hipop%c3%b3tamo-masculino-paquidermo-4330924/)

> Pero ahora esa persona en cuestion no esta, quedando los Hipopotamos, a su suerte diria yo, estos a su vez se fueron reproduciendo tanto que los mismos llegaron como a entonces cambiar el ecosistema de donde estan ellos. Es lo que entonces el gobierno hasta cierta parte, han tomado como solucion lo de aplicar la Eutanasia a unos cuantos de ellos, pero de ser asi, con los demas que siguen siendo muchos, que van hacer.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23vhyb51HhPFG55osnLLzFt364YLBRf6wjucqJVDNn1jpLTuDvDgZC12N1mCpHNtihWYh.png) [](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/zoo-animales-hipop%c3%b3tamos-24926/)

> Antes de esto, se buscaron medidas de ser trasladados, llevados a otros paises, donde pudieran estar en su habitat, pero fueron rechazados, seguian entonces insistiendo con lo de la Eutanasia, pero los grupos ambientalistas en favor de los animales, no se han quedado tranquilos, estan luchando en contra de esta decision fatal. Hace poco lei en las redes sociales sobre un matrimonio la familia AMBANI de Asia ha dicho que estan interesados en llevarse los Hipopotamos esto ha despertado una esperanza para ellos sin saber cual es el destino que les espera, pero a mi me alegro mucho, como un alivio, para que lean algo sobre eso este es el enlace https://www.instagram.com/p/DXQiDO4DqpC/?igsh=MWk5dGV3M2tlbjNmaw==
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23tbuWbjvdEDWJyRD7GancyJsA3ok8bB1Ep4kcsbSAHx8PeFafzVi3KMVaWYXrEi3suRf.png) [](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/hipop%c3%b3tamo-animales-r%c3%ado-hipop%c3%b3tamos-5815535/)

> Ahora solo queda digo yo hacer todo lo pertinente para el traslado, que ojala el gobierno de Colombia no se oponga, de hacerlo, esta claro entonces que quieren que mueran, seria ser egoista, no querer a la naturaleza. Si fue asi, no debieron permitir nunca que se quedaran en el pais. Lo que hizo el poder de una sola persona, en alterar el ecosistema de un pais, que como dije ahora no esta para ver el gran error cometido. Creo que las personas que amamos los animales, en si los domesticos como perros y gatos que son los mas comunes sufrimos mucho cuando estos enferman o fallecen, imaginense que quieran dormir a unos seres inocentes de todo. Espero que todo llegue a feliz termino por esos animales que nunca pidieron venir. Portada editada en Canva, con imganes libres con sus enlaces. Traduccion del contenido con la app DeepL.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23z7fUxN9hsnf5bzVgj64rU74PCh8dmMRc9a4ZcTgi93cosMQchrBxFShDQQJgE9zDj6k.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/242YE4XojgT4CvvHN1AvBqg2ywBXJoukHQANTB2iGcR2b17Gq3XCETRcLEVWoEUjMuCyM.png) [](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/hipop%c3%b3tamos-lago-%c3%a1frica-tanzania-7376753/)

> There is hope…...I hope so. Greetings to everyone with whom we share so much in this community—about our lives, our surroundings, and other things that, as we say, are trending in the news. This past April, or perhaps as early as March, a news story that deeply impacted me concerned the application of euthanasia to living beings—animals, to be precise—who are blameless, have no voice, and whose voices we are meant to be. All of this is happening in Colombia, involving some HIPPO, which from the very beginning was a mistake—they were brought from their habitat, their place of origin, simply to satisfy someone’s whim or desire. Because of the power that person held, there was no one to put a stop to it and prohibit such a thing.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23vi3x8rw4YU8No9Qy7Sxp3vLXyfg5JenRKgqVwdaadWjAvZgDrUAsbuuwhy6pVyTg7ct.png) [](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/hipop%c3%b3tamo-masculino-paquidermo-4330924/)

> But now that person in question is gone, leaving the hippos, I would say, to fend for themselves. They, in turn, have reproduced so much that they have come to the point of altering the ecosystem where they live. This is why the government, to a certain extent, has decided to euthanize a few of them as a solution, but if that’s the case, what will they do with the rest, of which there are still many?
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23vhyb51HhPFG55osnLLzFt364YLBRf6wjucqJVDNn1jpLTuDvDgZC12N1mCpHNtihWYh.png) [](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/zoo-animales-hipop%c3%b3tamos-24926/)

> Prior to this, efforts were made to relocate them to other countries where they could live in their natural habitat, but these were rejected. Authorities continued to push for euthanasia, but animal rights groups have not remained silent; they are fighting against this fatal decision. I recently read on social media that the Ambani family from Asia has expressed interest in taking the hippos. This has given them hope, even though they don’t know what fate awaits them, but I am very happy about it—it’s a relief. To read more about this, here is the link: https://www.instagram.com/p/DXQiDO4DqpC/?igsh=MWk5dGV3M2tlbjNmaw==
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23tbuWbjvdEDWJyRD7GancyJsA3ok8bB1Ep4kcsbSAHx8PeFafzVi3KMVaWYXrEi3suRf.png) [](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/hipop%c3%b3tamo-animales-r%c3%ado-hipop%c3%b3tamos-5815535/)

> Now, all that’s left, in my opinion, is to do everything necessary for the relocation. Hopefully, the Colombian government won’t oppose it; if they do, it’s clear they want them to die. That would be selfish—not caring about nature. If that were the case, they should never have allowed them to stay in the country. What the power of a single person did—disrupting a country’s ecosystem—is, as I said, now impossible to see the magnitude of the mistake made. I believe that those of us who love animals—especially domestic ones like dogs and cats, which are the most common—suffer greatly when they get sick or die. Imagine wanting to put innocent creatures to sleep. I hope everything comes to a happy conclusion for those animals who never asked to come here. Cover edited in Canva, using free images with their links. Content translated using the DeepL app.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23ydQz4vkUWhD7SD1cR8oH6m3NnjUmtdKAfmnS8jGVatgrgo7Z8L7JHnVRr92UPX3hRJ9.png)

body.title: Sin City Is a Bold and Uncompromising Film That Redefined What a Comic Book Movie Could Be. A Dark, Violent, and Visually Stunning Experience That Still Feels Unique.
body.body:
Released in 2005, Sin City did not try to fit in with anything else at the time, and that is exactly why it stands out. While most comic book films were moving toward bright colors and traditional storytelling, this one went in the opposite direction. It embraced darkness, style, and a very specific tone that made it feel completely different from anything else in theaters.

![IMG_0594.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQHKc4dNWApY2HAAYEgq1GwJg1ixDvGh3b4s5vJiCkFqg/IMG_0594.jpeg)

The film was directed by Robert Rodriguez alongside Frank Miller, the creator of the original graphic novels. That collaboration is the key to everything. This is not just an adaptation. It is a direct translation of Miller’s work to the screen. Rodriguez made the unusual decision to shoot the film in a way that preserved the original panels, dialogue, and structure, and that choice paid off.

The movie features a large ensemble cast, and nearly every performance leaves an impression. Bruce Willis plays John Hartigan, a worn down cop trying to do one last good thing in a city full of corruption. Willis brings a quiet, emotional weight to the role that gives his storyline real impact, especially as it unfolds over time.

Mickey Rourke delivers one of the most memorable performances in the film as Marv, a brutal but strangely honorable enforcer on a mission of revenge. Underneath the violence and rough exterior, Rourke gives Marv a sense of loyalty and heartbreak that makes his story one of the strongest in the movie.

![IMG_0592.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVJm3mcuEyhRjeteg3oHga5u2f2pFS2TbSFpkMLhuY9rr/IMG_0592.webp)

Clive Owen plays Dwight, a character caught in the middle of a dangerous situation involving corrupt cops and deadly criminals. Owen gives a controlled and confident performance, acting as a steady presence in a world that constantly feels like it is about to explode.

The supporting cast is just as strong, with Jessica Alba, Rosario Dawson, Benicio del Toro, and Elijah Wood all contributing to the film’s dark and unpredictable tone. Each character feels like they belong in this world, and each adds another layer to the chaos of Basin City.

Instead of following a single storyline, Sin City is built around multiple interconnected stories. Each one focuses on different characters dealing with crime, betrayal, revenge, and survival. While the stories stand on their own, they are tied together by the city itself, which feels like a character just as much as the people in it.

![IMG_0586.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPBxHZk63i289xZ9xFx3NeatDvtkvVytZ6udYWHZhQvEf/IMG_0586.webp)

Basin City is not a normal setting. It is exaggerated, dangerous, and completely unforgiving. The film presents it as a place where morality is blurred and violence is always just around the corner. That consistent tone helps tie all the separate storylines together.

Visually, Sin City is one of the most striking films ever made. Shot almost entirely in black and white, with selective bursts of color, the movie creates an atmosphere that feels like a living comic book. Every frame is carefully designed, with heavy shadows and sharp contrasts that give the film its signature look.

Robert Rodriguez uses this style to full effect, combining it with creative camera work and editing that keeps the film visually engaging from beginning to end. The action scenes feel stylized rather than realistic, which fits perfectly with the world the movie creates.

![IMG_0590.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZWubpyQ7MZqExfMQMTaGebzkTCZKQKcbBWS9uCrqtcYg/IMG_0590.webp)

The dialogue is another major strength. Much of it comes directly from Frank Miller’s writing, giving the film a hard edged, almost poetic tone. Characters speak in a way that feels heightened, but it works because it matches the exaggerated world they live in.

Violence plays a major role in the film, and it is often intense, but it never feels out of place. It is part of the storytelling and part of the tone. This is not meant to be a comfortable movie, and it does not try to be.

What really makes Sin City work is its commitment. It never backs away from its style or its tone. It knows exactly what it wants to be and fully commits to it from start to finish. That level of confidence is rare.

![IMG_0588.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdNMeVyqMAEdf5RSrxTMG3AsnzLhJgRSdavhMpgLU5AnY/IMG_0588.webp)

Sin City remains an excellent film because it is bold, different, and unforgettable. It is not trying to please everyone, and that is exactly why it has become such a respected and lasting classic.
